text.body:
<2.1.1>
veṅkaṭācalamāhātmyam nāradasya sumeruśikharasthayajñavarāhadarśanam pāvane naimiṣāraṇye śaunakādyā maharṣayaḥ || cakrire lokarakṣārthaṃ satraṃ dvādaśavārṣikam ||1|| tānabhyagacchatkathako vyāsaśiṣyo mahāmatiḥ || munirugraśravā nāma romaharṣaṇasambhavaḥ || 2|| samyagabhyarcitastveṣāṃ sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ | kathayāmāsa taddivyaṃ purāṇaṃ skandanāmakam ||3 || sṛṣṭisaṃhāravaṃśānāṃ vaṃśānucaritasya ca | kathāṃ manvantarāṇāṃ ca vistarātsa nyavedayat ||4|| kathāstīrthaprabhāvāṇāṃ śrutvā te munipuṅgavāḥ || ūcire vaśinaṃ sūtaṃ kathāśravaṇakāṅkṣayā ||5|| ||ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || romaharṣaṇa sarvajña purāṇārthaviśārada || māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmo girīndrāṇāṃ mahītale || brūhi tvaṃ no mahābhāga ke pradhānā mahīdharāḥ |6||| ||śrīsūta uvāca || etameva purā praśnamapṛcchaṃ jāhnavītaṭe || vyāsaṃ munivaraśreṣṭhaṃ so'bravīnme gurūttamaḥ || 7 || ||vyāsa uvāca|| purā devayuge sūta nārado munisattamaḥ | sumeruśikharaṃ gatvā nānāratnasuśobhinam ||8|| tanmadhye vipulaṃ dīptaṃ brahmaṇo divyamālayam | dṛṣṭvā tasyottare deśe pippaladrumamuttamam ||9|| sahasrayojanocchrāyaṃ vistīrṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ tathā | tanmūle maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ nānāratnasamanvitam ||2.1.1.10|| padmarāgamaṇistambhaiḥ sahasraiḥ samalaṃkṛtam || vaiḍūryamuktāmaṇibhiḥ kṛtasvastikamālikam ||11|| navaratnasamākīrṇaṃ divyatoraṇaśobhitam | mṛgapakṣibhirākīrṇaṃ navaratnamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 12|| puṣparāgamahādvāraṃ saptabhūmikagopuram || sandīptavajrasukṛtakavāṭadvayaśobhitam || 13| praviśyā'sau dadarśāntardivyamauktikamaṇḍapam || vaiḍūryavedikaṃ tuṅgamāruroha mahāmuniḥ ||14|| tanmadhye tuṅgamatulaṃ vasupādavirājitam || dadarśa muktāsaṅkīrṇaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ mahādyuti|| 15|| tanmadhye puṣkaraṃ divyaṃ sahasradalaśobhitam || śvetaṃ candrasahasrābhaṃ karṇikākesarojjvalam|| 16|| tasya madhye samāsīnaṃ pūrṇacandrāyutaprabham|| kailāsaparvatākāraṃ sundaraṃ puruṣākṛtim|| 17||| caturbāhumudārāṃgaṃ varāhavadanaṃ śubham|| śaṃkhacakrābhayavarānbibhrāṇaṃ puruṣottamam||18|| pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ puṃḍarīkāyatekṣaṇam|| pūrṇeṃdusaumyavadanaṃ dhūpagaṃdhimukhāṃbujam|| 19|| sāmadhvaniṃ yajñamūrtiṃ sruktuṇḍaṃ sruvanāsikam|| kṣīrasāgarasaṃkāśaṃ kirīṭojjvalitānanam||2.1.1.20|| śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ śubhrayajñasūtravirājitam|| kaustubhaśrīsamuddyotaṃ samunnatamahorasam|| 21|| jāṃbūnadamayairdivyaiḥ suratnābharaṇairyutam|| vidyunmālāparikṣiptaśaranmeghamivojjvalam|| 22|| vāmapādatalākrāṃtapādapīṭhavirājitam|| kaṭakāṃgadakeyūrakuṇḍalojjvalitaṃ sadā||23|| caturmukhavasiṣṭhātrimārkaṇḍeyairmunīśvaraiḥ|| bhṛgvādibhiranekaiśca sevyamānamaharniśam || 24 || indrādilokapālaiśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || sevitaṃ devadeveśaṃ praṇipatyābhigamya ca || 25 || divyairupaniṣadbhāgairabhiṣṭūya dharādharam || nāradaḥ paramaprītaḥ sthito devasya sannidhau || 26 || || atha varāhasannidhiṃ prati dharaṇyāgamanam || || etasminnaṃtare cābhūddivyadundubhiniḥsvanaḥ || 27 || tatastamāgatā devī dharaṇī sakhisaṃyutā || suratnasāgarākāradivyāṃbarasamujjvalā || 28 || sumerumandarākārastanabhārāvanāmitā || navadūrvādalaśyāmā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 29 || ilayā vai piṃgalayā sakhībhyāṃ ca samanvitā || tatastābhyāṃ samānītaṃ puṣpāṇāṃ nicayaṃ mahī || 2.1.1.30 || śrīmadvarāhadevasya pādamūle vikīrya ca || praṇamya devadeveśaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭā sthitā || 31 || tāṃ devīṃ śrīvarāho'pi hyāliṃgyāṃke nidhāya ca || 32 || || atha dharaṇivarāhasaṃvādaḥ || || papraccha kuśalaṃ pṛthvīṃ prītipravaṇamānasaḥ || 33 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || tvāṃ niveśya mahīdevi śeṣaśīrṣe sukhāvahe || lokaṃ tvayi niveśyaiva tvatsahāyāndharādharān || hahāgato'smyahaṃ devi kimarthaṃ tvamihāgatā || 34 || || pṛthivyuvāca || || māṃ samuddhṛtya pātālātsahasraphaṇaśobhite || ratnapīṭha ivottuṃge saratne'nantamūrdhani || kṛtvā māṃ susthirāṃ deva bhūdharānsaṃniveśya ca || 35 || maddhāraṇakṣamānpuṇyāṃstvanmayānpuruṣottama || teṣu mukhyānmahābāho madādhārānvadasva me || 36 || || atha śeṣācalasyasarvaparvatātiśāyitvavarṇanam || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || sumerurhimavānviṃdhyo mandaro gaṃdhamādanaḥ || sālagrāmaścitrakūṭo mālyavānpāriyātrakaḥ || 37 || maheṃdro malayaḥ sahyaḥ siṃhādrirapi raivataḥ || meruputro'ñjano nāma śailaḥ svarṇamayo mahān || 38 || ete śailavarāḥ sarve tvadādhārā vasundhare || ye mayā devasaṃghaiśca ṛṣisaṃghaiśca sevitāḥ ||39|| eteṣu pravarānvakṣye tattvataḥ śṛṇu mādhavi || sālagrāmaśca siṃhādriśśaileṃdro gandhamādanaḥ|| ||2.1.1.40|| ete śailavarā devi diśaṃ haimavatīṃ śritāḥ || dakṣiṇasyāṃ pratītāṃstu vakṣye śailānvasundhare ||41|| aruṇādrirhastiśailo gṛdhrādrirghaṭikācalaḥ || ete śailavarāḥ sarve kṣīranadyāssamīpagāḥ || 42|| hastiśailāduttarataḥ paṃcayojanamātrataḥ || suvarṇamukharīnāma nadīnāṃ pravarā nadī || 43 || tasyā evottare tīre kamalākhyaṃ sarovaram || tattīre bhagavānāste śukasya varado hariḥ||44|| balabhadreṇa saṃyuktaḥ kṛṣṇo bhaktārtināśanaḥ|| vaikhānasairmunigaṇairnityamārādhito'malaiḥ |45|| kamalākhyasya sarasa uttare kānanottame || krośadvayārdhamātre tu haricaṃdanaśobhite || śrīveṃkaṭācalonāma vāsudevālayo mahān |||46|| saptayojanavistīrṇaḥ śailendro yojanocchritaḥ || asti svarṇamayo devi ratnasānubhṛdāyataḥ ||47|| indrādyā daivatagaṇā vasiṣṭhādyā munīśvarāḥ|| siddhāḥ sādhyāśca maruto dānavā daityarākṣasāḥ || rambhādyā apsaraḥsaṃghā vasanti niyataṃ dhare || 40 || tapaścaraṃti nāgāśca garuḍāḥ kinnarāstathā || etairadhiṣṭhitāstatra saritaḥ puṇyadarśanāḥ || sarāṃsi vividhānyatra saṃti divyāni mādhavi || 49 || || atha svāmipuṣkariṇyāḥ sarvatīrthātiśāyitvavarṇanam || || tīrthānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śṛṇuṣva pravarāṇi vai ||2.1.1.50|| cakratīrthaṃ daivatīrthaṃ viyadgaṃgā tathaiva ca || kumāradhārikātīrthaṃ pāpanāśanameva ca || pāṇḍavaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ ca svāmipuṣkariṇī tathā || 51 || saptaitāni varāṇyāhurnārāyaṇagirau śubhe || eteṣu pravarā devi svāmipuṣkariṇī śubhā || 52 || asyāstu paścime tīraṃ nivasāmi tvayā saha || āste'syā dakṣiṇe tīraṃ śrīnivāso jagatpatiḥ || 53 || gaṃgādyaiḥ sakalaistīrthaiḥ samā sā sāgarāmbare || trailokye yāni tīrthāni sarāṃsi saritastathā || teṣāṃ svāmitvamāpannaṃ dhare svāmisarovare || 54 || svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ puṇyāṃ sevituṃ divyabhūdhare || vasanti sarvatīrthāni teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ vadāmi te || 55 || ṣaṭṣaṣṭikoṭitīrthāni puṇye'sminbhūdharottame || teṣu cātyaṃtamukhyāni ṣaṭ tīrthāni vasundhare || 56 || pañcānāṃ tīrtharājānāṃ tumbo garbhasamo mahān || garbhavāsabhayadhvaṃsī snātānāṃ bhūdharottame || 57 || || dharaṇyuvāca || || ṣaṭ tīrthāni mahābāho tvayoktāni mahīdhare || māhātmyaṃ vada teṣāṃ me yathākālaṃ yathāvidhi || phalāni teṣu snātānāṃ narāṇāṃ vada bhūdhara || 58 || || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || nārāyaṇādrimāhātmyaṃ vadāmi śṛṇu mādhavi || 59 || devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ || kṛteṃ'janādriṃ tretāyāṃ nārāyaṇagiriṃ tathā || 2.1.1.60 || dvāpare siṃhaśailaṃ ca kalau śrīveṅkaṭācalam || pravadantīha vidvāṃsaḥ paramātmālayaṃ girim || 61 || yojanānāṃ sahasrānte dvīpāṃtaragato'pi vā || yo namedbhūdharendraṃ taddiśamuddiśya bhaktitaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 62 || tasminṣaṭtīrthamāhātmyaṃ yathākālaṃ vadāmi te || 63 || || atha kumāradhārāmāhātmyam || || śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhadre sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || kubhasaṃsthe ravau māghe paurṇamāsyāṃ mahātithau || 64 || maghānakṣatrayuktāyāṃ bhūdharendre vasundhare || kumāradhārikānāma sarasī lokapāvanī || 65 || yatrāste pārvatīsūnuḥ kārtikeyo'gnisaṃbhavaḥ || devasenāsamāyuktaḥ śrīnivāsārcako'male || 66 || tasyāṃ yaḥ snāti madhyāhne tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || gaṃgādisarvatīrtheṣu yaḥ snāti niyamāddharaṃ || dvādaśābdaṃ jagaddhātri tatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt || 67 || yo'nnaṃ dadāti tattīrthe śaktyā dakṣiṇayānvitam || sa tāvatphalamāpnoti snāne tūktaṃ phalaṃ yathā || 68 || || atha tuṃbatīrthamāhātmyam || || mānasaṃsthe savitari paurṇamāsītithau dhare || uttarāphālgunīyukte caturthe kāla uttame || 69 || paṃcānāmapi tīrthānāṃ tuṃbe'tha girigahvare || yaḥ snāti manujo devi punargarbhe na jāyate || 2.1.1.70 || atha ākāśagaṃgāmāhātmyam || agnivāhasthite bhānau citrānakṣatrasaṃyute || pūrṇimākhye tithau puṇye prātaḥkāle tathaiva ca || ākāśagaṃgāsariti snāto mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 71 || || atha pāṇḍavatīrthamāhātmyam || || vṛṣabhasthe ravau rādhe dvādaśyāṃ ravivāsare || śukle vāpyatha vā kṛṣṇe pakṣe bhaumasamanvite || 72 || śukle vāpyathavā kṛṣṇe bhānuvāreṇa saṃyute || puṣyanakṣatrasaṃyukta hastarkṣeṇa yute'pi vā || 73 || tīrthe pāṃḍavanāmnyatra saṃgave snāti yo naraḥ || neha duḥkhamavāpnoti paratra sukhamaśnute || 74 || atha pāpanāśanatīrthamāhātmyam || śukle pakṣe'tha vā kṛṣṇe yārkavāreṇa saptamī || puṣyanakṣatrasaṃyuktā hastarkṣeṇa yutāpi vā || 75 || tasyāṃ tithau mahābhāge pāpanāśanasaṃjñake || tīrthe yaḥ snāti niyamādbhūdharendrasya mastake || 76 || koṭijanmārjitaiḥ pāpairmucyate sa narottamaḥ || 77 || || atha devatīrthamāhātmyam || || śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyamanantākhye mahāgirau || maddivyālayavāyavye śikhare girigahvare || devatīrthamiti khyātaṃ taṭākamatiśobhanam || 78 || tasminpuṇyatame devi snānakālaṃ vadāmi te || 79 || gurupuṣye vyatīpāte somaśravaṇake tathā || dineṣveteṣu yaḥ snāti tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 2.1.1.80 || yāni kānīha pāpāni jñānājñānakṛtāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi naśyaṃti devatīrthe'tipāvane || 81 || puṇyānyapi ca vardhaṃte devatīrthanimajjanāta || dīrghamāyuravāpnoti putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || ante svargaṃ samāsādya candraloke mahīyate || 82 || taddineṣvannado devi yāvajjīvānnado bhavet || atiguhyatamaṃ devi proktaṃ tubhyaṃ vasundhare || || 83 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śrutvātha pṛthivī devī prītipravaṇamānasā || iṣṭābhirvāgbhiratulaṃ tuṣṭāva dharaṇīdharam || 84 || || atha dharaṇīkṛta varāhastutiḥ || || dharaṇyuvāca || || namaste devadeveśa varāhavadanācyuta || kṣīrasāgarasaṃkāśa vajraśṛṃga mahābhuja || 85 || uddhṛtāsmi tvayā deva kalpādau sāgarāṃbhasaḥ || sahasrabāhunā viṣṇo dhārayāmi jagantyaham || 86 || anekadivyābharaṇayajñasūtravirājita || aruṇāruṇāṃbaradhara divyaratnavibhūṣita || 87 || udyadbhānupratīkāśapādapadma namonamaḥ || bālacaṃdrābhadaṃṣṭrāgramahābalaparākrama || 88 || divyacandanaliptāṃga taptakāṃcanakuṇḍala || indranīlamaṇidyotihemāṃgadavibhūṣita || 89 || vajradaṃṣṭrāgranirbhinnahiṇayākṣa mahābala || puṇḍarīkābhirāmākṣa sāmasvanamanohara || 2.1.1.90 || śrutisīmantabhūṣātmansarvātmaścāruvikrama || caturānanaśaṃbhubhyāṃ vanditā''yatalocana || 91 || sarvavidyāmayākāra śabdātīta namo namaḥ || ānaṃdavigrahā'nanta kālakāla namonamaḥ || 92 || iti stutvā'calā devī vavande pādayorvibhum || vandamānā samudvīkṣya devaḥ phullavilocanaḥ || 93 || uddhṛtya dharaṇīṃ devīmāliliṃge'tha bāhubhiḥ || āghrāya dharaṇīvaktraṃ vāmāṃke sanniveśya ca || 94 || atha varāhasya bhagavato dharaṇyā sākaṃ śeṣācalāgamanam || || āruhya garuḍeśānaṃ jagāma vṛṣabhācalam || munīṃdrairnāradādyaiśca stūyamāno mahīpatiḥ || 95 || svāmipuṣkariṇītīre paścime lokapūjite || āste varāhavadano munīndraistatra pūjitaḥ || vaikhānasairmahābhāgairbrahmatulyairmahātmabhiḥ || 96 || || atha veṃkaṭācalamāhātmyaśravaṇāvasaraḥ || || vyāsa uvāca || || taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ sūta munīnāmuktavānpurā || tadetadahamaśrauṣaṃ tatra vai munisaṃsadi || 97 || yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayā sūta māhātmyaṃ dharaṇībhṛtām || mayā tūktaṃ yathāvaddhi nāradācca purā śrutam || 98 || || athādhyāyaphalaśrutiḥ || || ya idaṃ dharmasaṃvādamāvayoḥ sūta pāvanam || paṭhedvā devapurato brāhmaṇānāṃ purastathā || 99 || sarveṣāmapi varṇānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bhaktipūrvakam || sa pratiṣṭhāmavāpnoti putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ || 2.1.1.100 || śṛṇvatāmapi sarveṣāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ tadbhaviṣyati || 101 || || sūta uvāca || || iti me bhagavānvyāsaḥ provāca munisevitaḥ || yathāśrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādguroḥ || 102 || tattathā sarvamevātra mayāpyuktaṃ munīśvarāḥ || śrutvā sūtavacastvitthaṃ te prītamanaso'bhavan || 103 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta tvayoktaṃ bhuvi parvateṣu puṇyeṣu puṇyasya mahīdharasya || māhātmyamasmākamahīndranāmnaḥ pāpāpahaṃ mokṣaphalapradāyakam || 104 || tato vṛṣādriṃ saṃprāpya varāho dharaṇīyutaḥ || kimuktavāndharaṇyai sa tanno brūhi mahāmate || 105 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde nāradasya sumeruśikharastha yajñavarāhadarśanaprāptyādivarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || || cha ||
<2.1.2>
|| atha śrīvarāhamaṃtrārādhanavidhiḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve kathāṃ puṇyāṃ purātanīm || vaivasvateṃ'tare pūrvaṃ kṛte puṇyatame yuge || 1 || nārāyaṇādrau deveśaṃ nivasantaṃ kṣamāpatim || varāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ dharaṇī sakhibhirvṛtā || 2 || praṇamya paripapraccha raktapadmāyatekṣaṇam || 3 || || dharaṇyuvāca || || ārādhyaḥ kena maṃtreṇa bhavānprīto bhaviṣyati || taṃ me vada tvaṃ deveśa yaḥ priyo bhavataḥ sadā || 4 || japatāṃ sarvasaṃpattikārakaṃ putrapautradam || sārvabhaumatvadaṃ caiva kāmināṃ kāmadaṃ sadā || || 5 || ante yastvatpadaprāptiṃ dadāti niyamātmanām || evaṃbhūtaṃ vada prītyā mayi vārāha mānada || 6 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || iti pṛṣṭastayā bhūmyā prāha prītismitānanaḥ || 7 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ sadyaḥ saṃpattikārakam || bhūmidaṃ putradaṃ gopyamaprakāśyaṃ kadācana || 8 || kiṃ ca śuśrūṣave vācyaṃ bhaktāya niyatātmane || 9 || oṃ namaḥ śrīvarāhāya dharaṇyuddharaṇāya ca || vahnijāyāsamāyuktaḥ sadā japyo mumukṣubhiḥ || 2.1.2.10 || ayaṃ maṃtro dharādevi sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ || ṛṣiḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prokto devatā tvahameva hi || 11 || chandaḥ paṃktiḥ samākhyātā śrībījaṃ samudāhṛtam || caturlakṣaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ sadgurorlabdhatanmanuḥ || 12 || juhuyātpāyasānnaṃ vai kṣaudrasarpiḥsamanvitam || atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi manaḥśuddhipradāyakam || 13 || śuddhisphaṭikaśailābhaṃ raktapadmadalekṣaṇam || varāhavadanaṃ saumyaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 14 || śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ cakraśaṃkhābhayakarāṃbujam || vāmorusthitayā yuktaṃ tvayā māṃ sāgarāṃbare || 15 || raktapītāṃbaradharaṃ raktābharaṇabhūṣitam || śrī kūrmapṛṣṭhamadhyasthaśeṣamūrtyabjasaṃsthitam || 16 || evaṃ dhyātvā japenmaṃtraṃ sadā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti mokṣaṃ cānte vrajeddhruvam || 17 || proktaṃ mayā te dharaṇi yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayā'male || ataḥ kiṃ te vyavasitaṃ brūhi tadvimalānane || 18 || || ||atha śrīvarāhamaṃtreṇa dharmādīnāṃ svābhīṣṭasiddhivarṇanam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || etacchrutvā tato bhūmiḥ papraccha punareva tam || kenaivānuṣṭhitaṃ deva purā prāptaṃ phalaṃ ca kim || 19 || iti pṛṣṭaḥ punardevaḥ śrīvarāho'bravīdidam || purā kṛtayuge devi dharmo nāma manurmahān || 2.1.2.20 || brahmaṇo'muṃ manuṃ labdhvā japtvāsmindharaṇīdhare || māṃ ca dṛṣṭvā varaṃ labdhvā prāpto'bhūnmāmakaṃ padam || 21 || iṃdro durvāsasaḥ śāpātpurā bhraṣṭastriviṣṭapāt || aneneṣṭvā'tra māṃ devi punaḥ prāptastriviṣṭapam || 22 || anye'pi munayo bhūme japtvā prāptāḥ parāṃ gatim || anaṃtaḥ pannagādhīśo hyamuṃ labdhvātha kaśyapāt || 23 || śvetadvīpe japitvaiva babhūva dharaṇīdharaḥ || tasmājjapyaḥ sadā ceha manuṣyaiśca dharārthibhiḥ || 24 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || etacchrutvātha suprītā punaḥ prāha dharādharam || 25 || || dharaṇyuvāca || || veṃkaṭākhye mahāśaile śrīnivāso jagatpatiḥ || kadā hyāyāti deveśaḥ śrībhūmisahito'malaḥ || 26 || kathaṃ kalpāntarasthāyī bhaviṣyati janārdanaḥ || etadbrūhi varāhātmanmahatkautahalaṃ mama || 27 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde śrīvarāhamaṃtrārādhanavidhyādivarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || || cha || ||
<2.1.3>
atha agastyaprārthanayā bhagavataḥ sarvajanadṛggocaratvavarṇanam || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || hanta te kathayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ varānane || śṛṇu puṇyaṃ mahādevi sabhaviṣyaṃ sahottaram || 1 || vaivasvate'ntare devi pūrve kṛtayugeṃ'tare || vāyostapo mahadṛṣṭvā śrībhūmisahito'nagha || āgacchacchrīnivāsaśca svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe || 2 || dakṣiṇe'sminpuṇyatama ānandākhyavimānake || vasiṣyati ca śrīkāṃto vāyoḥ priyakaro hariḥ || 3 || tadārabhya hṛṣīkeśaḥ senānyārādhito'niśam || ākalpāṃtamadṛśyo'sminvimāne'sau vasiṣyati || 4 || || dharaṇyuvāca || || adṛśyo bhagavānmartyaiḥ katha dṛśyo bhaviṣyati || 5 || śrīnivāso'pi deveśo bhavaddakṣiṇapārśvagaḥ || etadvada surādhīśa janairārādhyate katham || 6 || || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || agastyo'sminsamāsādya dṛṣṭvā devaṃ sanātanam || ārādhya dvādaśābdaṃ taṃ prīṇayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || 7 || yayāce tatra sānnidhyaṃ bhavāndṛśyo bhavatviti || evamukto hṛṣīkeśaḥ śrībhūmisahito dhare || 8 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || ahaṃ dṛśyo bhaviṣyāmi tvatkṛte sarvadehinām || etadvimānaṃ devarṣe na dṛśyaṃ syātkadācana || 9 || ākalpāntaṃ munīndrāsmindṛśyo'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || munistadvacanaṃ śrutvā prītaḥ prāyātsvamāśramam || 2.1.3.10 || tataścaturbhujo devaḥ sa dṛśyo'bhūnnarādibhiḥ || vimāne municintye'sminnāsitā ca tathottaram || 11 || ārādhyamānaḥ skaṃdena vāyunā sevitaḥ sadā || evaṃ gate mahākāle caturyugasamanvite || 12 || ||atha mitravarmaṇa ākāśarājākhyasutotpattivarṇanam || aṣṭāviṃśe tu saṃjāte dvāparānte vasundhare || yuddhe ca bhārate'tīte tiṣye sati yuge tathā || 13 || vikramārkādayo bhūpāḥ śakāḥ śūdrādayastathā || gamiṣyaṃti svargalokaṃ māmajñātvā varānane || 14 || tataḥ somakulodbhūto mitravarmā mahārathaḥ || tuṇḍīramaṇḍale rājā nārāyaṇapuraṃ vasan || 15 || bhaviṣyati varārohe mahābhāgyodayo mahān || tasmiñchāsati bhūlokaṃ dharmeṇa pṛthivīpatau || 16 || akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī sarvasasyavibhūṣaṇā || nirītiko'bhavatsarvo jano dharmasamanvitaḥ || 17 || tasya patnī samabhavatpāṃḍyakanyā manoramā || tasya jajñe kulottaṃso viyannāmā suto'sya vai || 18 || tasya patnī tu dharaṇī nāmnāsīcchakavaṃśajā || tasminrājyaṃ vinikṣipya mitravarmā nṛpottamaḥ || 19 || yayau tapovanaṃ puṇyaṃ veṃkaṭādreḥ samīpataḥ || 2.1.3.20 || || atha dharaṇītalātpadmāvatyutpattikramaḥ || || ākāśanāmā tu mahānrājābhūtsārvabhaumakaḥ || ekadāravrato rājā dharaṇīsaktacetanaḥ || 21 || yajñārthaṃ śodhayāmāsa bhuvamāraṇitīrataḥ || kāṃcanena halenaiva kṛṣyamāṇe dharātale || 22 || bījamuṣṭiṃ vikiratā dṛṣṭā kanyā dharodgatā || padmaśayyāgatā ramyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 23 || taptajāṃbūnadamayī putrikeva virājatī || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa mahīpālo vismayotphullalocanaḥ || 24 || ādāya tanayā ceyaṃ mamaiveti punaḥpunaḥ || jaharṣa maṃtribhiścainaṃ prāha vāgaśarīriṇī || 25 || satyaṃ tavaiva tanayā vardhayasva sulocanām || tataḥ prītamanā rājā svapuraṃ praviveśa ha || 26 || āhūya dharaṇīṃ devīmidamāha mahīpatiḥ || devadattāmimāṃ paśya bhūtalādutthitāṃ mama || 27 || āvābhyāṃ tadaputrābhyāṃ putrīyaṃ bhavitā dhruvam || ityuktvā pradadau devyā haste prītyā viyannṛpaḥ || 28 || || atha ākāśarājasya dharaṇyākhyapatnyāṃ vasudānākhyasutotpattiḥ || || tasyāṃ gṛhaṃ praviṣṭāyāṃ dharaṇī garbhamādadhau || viyannṛpaśca suprīto vīkṣya snigdhavilocanām || 29 || uvāca phalitā subhrurlatā sāntānikī ca me || 2.1.3.30 || atha sā dharaṇī devī kāle kamalalocanā || supraśaste muhūrte ca svoccasaṃstheṣu pañcasu || graheṣu suṣuve putraṃ meṣasthe ca divākare || 31 || devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirgṛhe'patat || vavau vāyuḥ sukhasparśastajjanmadivase tadā || 32 || putrasūtipravaktṝṇāṃ suprītaḥ putrajanmani || sarvasvadānamakarocchatracāmara varjitam || 33 || kapilākoṭidānaṃ ca vṛṣabhāṇāṃ śatādhikam || divase dvādaśe puṇye jātakarmādikāḥ kriyā || cakāra nāmadheyaṃ ca vasudāna iti svayam || 34 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || ākāśatanayo devi vasudāno manoramaḥ || vavṛdhe divasairbālaḥ śuklapakṣa ivoḍurāṭ || 35 || upanīto vinīto'sau gurubhirbrahmapāragaiḥ || piturastrāṇi śastrāṇi mantravatso'pyaśikṣata || 36 || catuṣpādaṃ dhanurvedaṃ sāṃgopāṃgamadhītavān || pitā tenātibalinā durādharṣaḥ parairabhūt || 37 || ākāśa iva niṣpaṃko grīṣme bhānumatā yutaḥ || vaiśākha iva madhyāhne duḥsaho durnirīkṣakaḥ || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde'gastyaprārthanayābhagavataḥ sarvajanadṛggocaratvādivarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha ||
<2.1.4>
|| atha udyānavāsinyāḥ padmāvatyāḥ samīpe nāradāgamanam || || dharaṇyuvāca || || uktaṃ bhagavatā tasya viyatputrasya nāma ca || ayonijāyāstatputryāḥ kiṃ nāma ca tadā'karot||1|| || śrīsūta uvāca || || iti pṛṣṭaḥ punaḥ prāha śrīvarāho jagatpatiḥ || 2 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || ākāśarājo matimāṃstāṃ dṛṣṭvā kamaleśayām || 3 || padminīti ca nāmnā vai cakāra vasudhāsutām || tāṃ tu yauvanasampannāṃ sakhībhiḥ parivāritām || 4 || ārāme viharaṃtīṃ ca śukakokilanādite || yadṛcchayā''gatastatra nārado munisattamaḥ || 5 || vanalakṣmīmivālokya vismayādidamabravīt || 6 || || nārada uvāca || || kāsi kasya sutā bhīru hastaṃ darśaya me tava || ityuktā sā sucārvaṃgī svātmānaṃ munaye'bravīt|| 7 || viyadrājasutā brahmam̐llakṣaṇāni vadasva me || ityuktaḥ sa tadā prāha nārado munisattamaḥ || 8 || || atha nāradodīrita padmāvatīśarīralakṣaṇāni || || nāradauvāca || śṛṇu tvaṃ cāruvadane lakṣaṇāni vadāmi te || pādau pratiṣṭhitau subhru raktapadmadalānvitau || 9 || pādāṃgulyaḥ samā raktā raktatuṃganakhānvitāḥ || gulphau gūḍhau samāvetau jaṃghe cāromaśe śubhe || 2.1.4.10 || jānunī samasusnigdhe samāvūrū kramādurū || nitaṃbau pṛthulau pīnau jaghanaṃ ciṃtyameva hi || 11 || nābhirmaṃḍalavānnimnaḥ pārśvau te medurāvubhau || trivalīlalitaṃ madhyaṃ romarājivirājitam || 12 || stanau pīnau ghanau snigdhābunnatau magnacūcukau || karau te raktapadmābhau padmarekhāsamanvitau || susūkṣmau raktasatparva nirantarasamāṃgulī || 13 || śukatuṃḍasamākāranakhapaṃktivirājitau || dīrghau ca komalau bhadre bhujau te puṣpadaṃḍavat || 14 || pṛṣṭhaṃ te vedivadbhāti vilagnamṛju madhyamam || kaṃṭhastu rakto dīrghaśca skandhau cāvanatau śubhe || 15 || mukhaṃ prasannaṃ satatamakalaṃkaśaśiprabham || kapolau kanakādarśasadṛśau kuṃḍalojjvalau || 16 || tilapuṣpasamākārā nāsikā te śubhānane || akalaṃkāṣṭamīcaṃdrasadṛśo'timanoharaḥ || 17|| dṛśyate'yaṃ lalāṭaste nīlālakasuśobhitaḥ || mūrdhā te samavṛttaśca snigdhāyatakacānvitaḥ || 18 || smitasaṃśobhidaśanaṃ biṃbādharasamanvitam || mukhaṃ te viṣṇuyogyaṃ syāditi me niścitā matiḥ ||19|| nābhiste dakṣiṇāvarta āvarta iva gāṃgajaḥ || tvaṃ hi kṣīrābdhisambhūtā lakṣmīriva hi dṛśyase || 2.1.4.20 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || ityuktvā pūjitastābhirnārado'ntardadhe tadā || etacchrutvā'tha tatsakhyastāmūcuḥ padminīṃ sakhīm ||21|| atha padmāvatyāḥ svasakhībhiḥ sākaṃ puṣpāṭavī gamanam || || vanaṃ gacchāma puṣpārthaṃ vasantaḥ samupāgataḥ || karṇikārāśca cūtāśca caṃpakāḥ pāribhadrakāḥ ||22|| palāśāḥ pāṭalāḥ kundā raktāśokāśca puṣpitāḥ|| padminyaḥ sindhuvārāśca mālatyo yūthikālatāḥ||23|| kahlārakaravīrāśca saṃgharṣādiva puṣpitāḥ || puṣpāvacayanaṃ kurmo vane'sminsumanohare ||24|| ityuktvā tā vanaṃ jagmurākāśatanayāyutāḥ || puṣpāṇyāharamāṇāstu vicarantyastatastataḥ || 25 || kaṃcidgajeṃdraṃ dadṛśuḥ śubhradantadvayojjvalam || gaṇḍabhittitalodbhūtamadadhārādvayojjvalam||26|| unnataṃ kariṇīyūthaiḥ samupetaṃ rajojjvalam || phūtkāripuṣkaraprodyacchīkarāpūritānanam|| 27 || dṛṣṭvā codvignahṛdayā vanaspatimupāśritāḥ || etasminnaṃtare cāśu dadṛśurhayamuttamam||28|| atha mṛgayārthaṃ puṣpāṭavīṃ prati śrīnivāsāgamanam|| akalaṃkendudhavalaṃ jāmbūnadapariṣkṛtam || sphuradvidyullatāyuktaśaranmeghamivonnatam || 29 || tasmiṃstu puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ madanākāravarcasam|| puṃḍarīkadalākārakarṇāntāyatalocanam || 2.1.4.30 || susūkṣmakṣaumasaṃvītanīlacūlikayojjvalam || padmarāgamaṇidyotisphuratkuṃḍalamaṇḍitam || 31 || suvarṇaratnakhacitaśārṅgadivyadhanurdharam || apareṇa kareṇaiva vahantaṃ kāñcanaṃ śaram ||32|| pītakakṣomasaṃvītakaṭideśaṃ sumadhyamam || ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūrakaṭisūtravirājitama||33|| viśālavakṣaḥ saṃśobhidakṣiṇāvartasaṃyutam || svarṇayajñopavītena sphuratskandhaṃ manoharam||34|| īhāmṛgaṃ samuddiśya mahāvegādanudrutam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitā nāryaḥ sasmitāstasthuratra vai ||35|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā hayamārūḍhaṃ gajendro namramastakaḥ || tuṇḍamuddhṛtya garjanvai vinirvṛtya yayau vanam ||36|| tasmingate gaje tatra hayārūḍhaḥ samāyayau || īhāmṛgaṃ vicinvānaḥ puṣpalāvīsamīpataḥ||37|| || atha bhagavataḥ kanyakānāṃ cānyonyasaṃvādaḥ|| || tāḥ sametya sa covāca turagopari saṃsthitaḥ|| atrāgato mṛgaḥ kaścidīhāmṛga itīritaḥ ||38|| dṛṣṭo vā bhavatībhiḥ sa brūta me kanyakā iti ||39| || śrīvarāha uvāca || || pratyūcustāstu taṃ kanyā dṛṣṭosmābhirna kaścana ||2.1.4.40|| kimarthamāgatosmākaṃ vanaṃ varadhanurdharaḥ || atrāvadhyā mṛgāḥ sarve vartamānā niṣādapa ||41|| āśu gaccha vanādasmādākāśanṛpapālitāt || iti tāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā hayādavaruroha saḥ || 42 || kāstu yūyamiyaṃ cāpi kanyakāṃbujasannibhā || subhagā cārusarvāṃgī pīnonnatapayodharā || brūta me'haṃ gamiṣyāmi śrutvā svasyālayaṃ girim || 43 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā dharaṇyātmajayeritā || sakhī padmāvatī prāha niṣādaṃ parvatālayam || 44 || ākāśarājatanayā vasudhātalasaṃbhavā || asmākaṃ nāyikā śūra padminīnāma nāmataḥ || 45 || brūhi tvaṃ subhagākāra kinnāmā kasya vā sutaḥ || jātiḥ kā kutra te vāsaḥ kimarthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ || iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa tāḥ prāha mandasmitamukhāṃbujaḥ || 46 || divākarakulaṃ prāhurasmākaṃ tu purāvidaḥ || yasya nāmānyanaṃtāni pāvanāni manīṣiṇām || 47 || varṇato nāmataścāpi kṛṣṇaṃ prāhustapasvinaḥ || brahmadviṣāṃ surārīṇāṃ yasya cakraṃ bhayāvaham || 48 || yasya śaṃkhadhvaniṃ śrutvā mohamīyurhi vairiṇaḥ || yasya vai dhanuṣastulyaṃ dhanurnaivāmareṣvapi || 49 || taṃ māṃ vīrapatiṃ prāhurveṃkaṭādrinivāsinam || tasmādadritaṭātso'haṃ niṣādairanugairvṛtaḥ || 2.1.4.50 || mṛgayārthaṃ hayārūḍho yuṣmākaṃ vanamāgataḥ || mayāpyanudrutaḥ kaścinmṛgo vāyugatiryayau || 51 || tamadṛṣṭvā vanaṃ paśyandṛṣṭavānsubhagāmimām || kāmādihāgato'haṃ vo mayā kiṃ labhyate nviyam || 52 || iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā kuddhāstāḥ punarabruvan || ākāśarājo dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ kṛtvā nigaḍabandhanam || yāvannayati tāvattvaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ svamālayam ||53|| tarjitastābhirevaṃ sa hayamāruhya śīghragam || yuktaḥ svānucaraiḥ sarvairyayau drutataraṃ girim || 54 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāda udyānavāsinyāḥ padmāvatyāssamīpe nāradāgamana śrīnivāsamṛgayādivarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha || ||
<2.1.5>
atha padmāvatīdarśanena śrīnivāsasya mohaprāptiḥ || || || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || samprāpya cālayaṃ divyamavatīrya hayottamāt || visṛjya sānugānsarvāndevānkairātarūpakān || 1 || viśramadhvamiti procya viveśa maṇimaṇḍapam || āruhya maṇisopānaṃ paṃcakakṣā atītya ca || 2 || muktāgṛhaṃ samāsādya tasmim̐llolāyite śubhe || navaratnamaye maṃce saṃviveśāvaśo hariḥ || 3 || saṃsmaranpadmagarbhābhāṃ tāmevāyatalocanām || tanumadhyāṃ pīnakucāṃ mandasmitasukhāṃbujām || 4 || kṣīrābdhitanayāmeva mene padmodbhavāṃ śubhām || tasyāṃ gatamanā devaḥ śrīnivāso mumoha ca || 5 || || atha muhyamānaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ prati bakulamālikoktiḥ || || tato madhyāhnasamaye kṛtvānnaṃ divyamuttamam || sūpadaṃśaṃ sugandhaṃ ca devārhamatiśobhanam || 6 || śuddhānnaṃ pāyasānnaṃ ca gauḍaṃ mudgānnameva ca || kṛtvā pañcavidhāpūpānpūrikāvaṭakānapi || 7 || devaṃ draṣṭuṃ yayau śīghraṃ sakhī vakulamālikā || padmāvatīpadmapatrā citrarekhāsamanvitā || 8 || niveśya dvāri devasya tāḥ sarvāḥ pramadottamāḥ || viveśa tatsamīpaṃ sā svayaṃ bakulamālikā ||9|| gatvā samīpaṃ devasya vavande bhaktibhāvataḥ || dṛṣṭvātha devaṃ vivaśaṃ paryaṃke ratnabhūṣite || 2.1.5.10 || pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛtvā nimīlitavilocanam || taṃ dhyāyantaṃ ca kimapi vyājahāra śucismitā || 11 || uttiṣṭha devadeveśa kiṃ śeṣe puruṣottama || paramānnaṃ kṛtaṃ deva bhoktumāgaccha mādhava || 12 || kiṃ vā tvamārtavaccheṣe sarvalokārtināśana || mṛgayāmaṭatā deva ki dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā vane || 13 || avasthā te viśālākṣa kāmukasyeva dṛśyate || kā dṛṣṭā devakanyā vā mānuṣī vā'hikanyakā || || 14 || brūhi me tvamacintyātmankanyāṃ tāṃ cittahāriṇīm || 15 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā niḥśvāsamakarodvibhuḥ || niḥśvasaṃtaṃ punaḥ prāha prītā bakulamālikā || 16 || evaṃ manoharā kā sā tavāpi puruṣottama || tāmavocaddhṛṣīkeśo vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvataḥ || 17 || || || atha śrīnivāsoktapadmāvatīpariṇayakāraṇāni || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || purā tretāyuge puṇye rāvaṇaṃ hatavānaham || tadā vedavatī kanyā sāhāyyamakarocchriyaḥ ||18|| sītārūpābhavallakṣmīrjanakasya mahītalāt || gate mayi tu mārīcaṃ hantuṃ pañcavaṭīvane || 19 || mamānujo'pi māmeva sītayā coditonvayāt || tadantare rākṣasendro hartuṃ sītāmupāyayau || 2.1.5.20 || agnihotragato vahnistaṃ jñātvā rāvaṇodyamam || ādāya sītāṃ pātāle svāhāyāṃ sanniveśya ca || 21 || tenaiva rakṣasā spṛṣṭāṃ purā vedavatīṃ śubhām || agnau visṛṣṭadehāṃ tāṃ saṃhartuṃ rāvaṇaṃ punaḥ || 22 || sītāyā rūpasadṛśīṃ kṛtvā caivotsasarja ha || sā rāvaṇahṛtā bhūtvā laṃkāyāṃ ca niveśitā || 23 || hate tu rāvaṇe paścātpunaragniṃ viveśa sā || agnistu rakṣitāṃ lakṣmīṃ svāhāyāṃ mama jānakīm || 24 || dattvā haste ca māmāha sītayā sahitāṃ sakhīma || iyaṃ vedavatī deva sītāyāḥ priyakāriṇī || 25 || sītārthaṃ rākṣasapure tena bandīkṛtā sthitā || tasmādenāṃ vareṇaiva prīṇaya tvaṃ śriyā saha || 26 || iti vahnivacaḥ śrutvā sītā māmavadacchubhā || mama prītikarī nityamiyaṃ vedavatī vibho || 27 || tasmātparaṃ bhāgavatīṃ devaināṃ varaya prabho || 28 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || tathā devi kariṣyāmi hyaṣṭāviṃśe kalau yuge || tāvadeṣā brahmaloke vasatvamarapūjitā || 29 || paścāttu bhūmitanayā bhaviṣyati viyatsutā || iti dattavarā pūrvaṃ mayā lakṣmyā ca sundarī || 2.1.5.30 || adya nārāyaṇapure sambhūtā dharaṇītalāt || padmāsamā padmanetrī padmādattavarā satī || 31 || sakhībhiranurūpābhirvane puṣpāṇi cinvatī || mṛgayāmaṭatā tatra mayā dṛṣṭā manoramā || 32 || tasyā rūpaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyaṃ śatahāyanaiḥ || lakṣmyeva ca tayā me'dya saṃgamo bhavitā yadi || 33 || prāṇāḥ sthirā bhaviṣyanti satyamityavadhāraya || 34 || || atha viyadrājapuraṃ prati bakulamālikāgamanam|| || tvaṃ tatra gatvā tāṃ kanyāṃ dṛṣṭvā bakulamālike || jānīhi rūpalāvaṇyādiyaṃ yogyeti cāsya vai || anavadyā viśālākṣī padmendīvaralocanā || 35 || ityuktvā mohamāpannaṃ taṃ prāha bakulā punaḥ || ito gacchāmi deveśa manojñā tava yatra sā || 36 || mārgaṃ vada ramādhīśa gamiṣye yena tāṃ prati || evamukto ramādhīśastāṃ prāha vakulasrajam || 37 || ito gaccha mahābhāge śrīnṛsiṃhaguhā yataḥ || tanmārgeṇāvatīryāsmādbhūdharendrānmanoramāt || 38 || agastyāśramamāsādya dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ tadarcitam || agastyeśa iti khyātaṃ suvarṇamukharītaṭe || 39 || tīreṇaiva tato gaccha śukabrahmaṛṣervanam || paśyantī svarṇamukharīṃ tatra kallolamālinīm || 2.1.5.40 || tatra padmasaronāma pāvanaṃ padmasaṃyutam || tatra snātvā'tha tattīre tapantaṃ munisattamam || 41 || chāyāśukaṃ namaskṛtya kṛṣṇaṃ ca balasaṃyutam || ārādhyamānaṃ muninā śukena satataṃ śubhe || 42 || indranīlamaṇiśyāmaṃ pītanirmalavāsasam || tīrthayātrāṃ gamiṣyantaṃ balabhadraṃ sitākṛtim || 43 || upāsayantaṃ maṃtrāṇi muktānvitakaradvayam || udyantaṃ pādukāyuktaṃ balabhadraṃ praṇamya ca || 44 || ādāya svarṇakamalaṃ saraso'smādvarānane || tīrtvā suvarṇamukharīṃ vanānyupavanāni ca || 45 || araṇītīramāsādya viśramya ca vanāntare || nārāyaṇapurīṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ ca gamiṣyasi || 46 || tasyāścopavane vṛkṣānpuṣpāḍhyānphalasaṃyutān || panasāmraśirīṣāṃśca kundatindukapāṭalān || 47 || punnāganāgavaraṇarasālāṃkolacaṃpakān|| bakulāmalakānsālāṃstālahiṃtālapadmakān || 48 || jambūnimbakadambailāpippalīmadhukārjunān || priyaṃguhiṃgukharjūramāyūrāśokalodhrakān || 49 || aśvatthodumbaraplakṣabadarībhūrjakīcakān || ciñcākiṃśukamandāraśālmalībījapūrakān || 2.1.5.50 || pūganāraṃgalikucanārikelavanākulān || mallikāmālatīkunda yūthikāketakīyutān || 51 || karavīrābjasaṃpannānrājaraṃbhāvirājitān || mayūrakīragaruḍaśukasārasasaṃkulān || 52 || bhṛṃgajhaṃkāranibiḍānārāmānsumanoharān || paśyantīṃ paramaṃ harṣamavāpya ca nadītaṭe || 53 || gatvā pūrvottare mārge purīmindrapurīsamām || gaṅgayevāvṛtāṃ nityaṃ saritāraṇināmayā || 54 || ākāśarājanagarīṃ gatvā tatrocitaṃ kuru || 55 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || ityādiśya surādhīśaḥ sakhīṃ tāṃ bakulābhidhām || visṛjya śayane śubhre sa śiśye śrīsamanvitaḥ || 56 || praṇamya devadeveśaṃ sakhī bakulamālikā || guñjāmaṇisamākāraṃ raktāśvamadhiruhya sā || 57 || yathoktamārgeṇa yayau paśyantī vividhānmṛgān || mattebhānparvatākārāñchvetadantavibhūṣitān || || 58 || kariṇīyūthasahitāñjaladādānatatparān || siṃhāñchve(?)taghanaprakhyānsiṃhīyūthairanudrutān || 59 || śārdūlarkṣāṃśca khaḍgāṃśca śarabhāngavayānmṛgān || kṛṣṇasārāṃśca gomāyūñchaśāṃśca priyakānapi || 2.1.5.60 || sārasāṃśca mayūrāṃśca mārjārānvanagocarān || vṛkāñchukānsūkarāṃśca suvācaḥ pakṣiṇastathā || 61 || paśyantī vividhākārāṃstuṣyantī ca muhurmuhuḥ || āsasādāraṇītīraṃ paścimaṃ pādapākulam || 62 || avatīryāruṇādaśvādagastyeśasamīpataḥ || dṛṣṭvāgastyeśvaraṃ liṅgamagastyena supūjitam || 63 || tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca viśaśrāma nadītaṭe || 64 || || || atha divyodyānasthapadmāvatīsakhīḥ prati bakulamālikoktiḥ || || tatrāgatā rājagṛhādyoṣito devasaṃnidhau || sakhīḥ padmālayāyāstā dṛṣṭvā bakulamālikā || 65 || gatvā samīpe tāsāṃ sā kiṃvadantīṃ sma pṛcchati || 66 || || bakulamālikovāca || || kā yūyaṃ yoṣito brūta vicitrābharaṇasrajaḥ || kutaḥ samāgatā hyatra kiṃ kāryaṃ vo'malānanāḥ || 67 || tāstu tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā smitapūrvamathābruvan || śṛṇuṣvāvahitā devi vayaṃ vakṣyāmahe'dhunā || 68 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde padmāvatīdarśanena śrīnivāsasyamohaprāptyādivarṇanaṃnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || || cha ||
<2.1.6>
|| atha bakulamālikāṃ prati sakhīviniveditapadmāvatyudantaḥ || || yoṣita ūcuḥ || || vayamākāśarājasya śuddhāntanilayāḥ striyaḥ || sakhyaḥ padmālayāyā vai duhiturvasudhāpateḥ || 1 || rājaputrīṃ puraskṛtya gatāḥ pūrvaṃ vanāṃtaram || kurvaṃtyaḥ puṣpāvacayaṃ rājaputryarthamākulāḥ || 2 || vṛkṣamūle samāsīnāstatra paśyāma pūruṣam || indranīlamaṇiśyāmamindirāmandirorasam|| 3 || īṣatsmitamukhaṃ cārupīnadīrghabhujadvayam || mṛṣṭapītāṃbaraṃ hemabāṇabāṇāsanojjvalam || 4 || suvarṇamukuṭaṃ hārakeyūrādivibhūṣitam || taṃ tu padmālayā dṛṣṭvā sakhī kamalalocanā || 5 || drutahemanibhākārā paśya paśyeti sābravīt || paśyantīnāṃ tadāsmākaṃ gato'ntardhānamāśu saḥ || 6 || sā sakhī mūrcchitāsmābhinītā rājagṛhaṃ tataḥ|| 7 || || atha padmāvatīmuddiśya daivajñaṃ prati viyadrājakṛtapraśnādiḥ || || dṛṣṭvā'svasthāṃ nṛpaḥ putrīmapṛcchaddaivacintakam || vada viprendra putryā me grahacāraphalaṃ mune || 8 || bṛhaspatisamo vipro vicāryātmani khecarān || anukūlā grahāḥ sarve tava putryā nṛpottama || 9 || kintu nityaṃ grahaphalaṃ kiṃcidbhrāṃtikaraṃ nṛpa || tamuvāca punardhīmānpraśnakālaṃ vicārya ca || 2.1.6.10 || chāyāṃ guṇitvā lagnaṃ ca tatphalāni vicārya ca || lagne lagnādhipaścandraḥ keṃdre caiva bṛhaspatiḥ || 11 || nidrāti dinapakṣī tu praśnapakṣī tu rājyagaḥ || śṛṇu rājanphalaṃ tasya svāsthyameva bhaviṣyati || 12 || uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścidāgataḥ kanyakāṃ prati || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitā putrī tena yogaṃ sameṣyati || 13 || tenaiva preṣitā kācidāgamiṣyati kanyakā || sā tu vakṣyati yadvākyaṃ taddhitaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 14 || tatkuruṣva mahārāja satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmyaham || kiṃ ca sarvārthadaṃ yattu sarvavyādhivināśanam || 15 || vakṣyāmi tatkuruṣvādya putryāstava sukhāvaham || kārayāgastyaliṃgasya brāhmaṇairabhiṣecanam || 16 || ityuktātha gṛhaṃ yāto rājānaṃ daivacitakaḥ || || 17 || || atha daivajñoktyāgastyaliṃgārcanāya viprādipreṣaṇam || || ākāśarājo'pi tadā viprānāhūya vaidikān || abhyarcyājñāpayāmāsa gatvā devālayaṃ dvijāḥ || 18 || mahābhiṣekaṃ śambhośca kurudhvaṃ maṃtrapūrvakam || ityanujñāpya tānasmānāhūyābhyavadacchubhe || 19 || mahābhiṣekasambhārānsampādayata kanyakāḥ || ityājñaptā nṛpeṇaiva vayaṃ devālayaṃ gatāḥ || 2.1.6.20 || brūhi tvaṃ subhage'smākaṃ tvadāgamanamaṃjasā || kutosi kasya vārthena kva vā jigamiṣā hi te || 21 || divyāśvamadhiruhyemaṃ devalokādivāgatā || 22 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || iti tābhistadā pṛṣṭā hṛṣṭā bakulamālikā || provāca vācaṃ madhurāṃ harṣayantīva bālikāḥ || 23 || || bakulamālikovāca || || śrīveṃkaṭādreḥ prāptāhaṃ nāmnā bakulamālikā || dharaṇīṃ draṣṭukāmāhamāruhyemaṃ turaṃgamam || 24 || draṣṭuṃ śakyā bhaveddevī kimu tatra nṛpālaye || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā tāḥ procurnṛpakanyakāḥ || 25 || asmābhiḥ sahitā tvaṃ vai drakṣyase dharaṇīṃ śubhe || ityuktā sā tatastābhirāgatā nṛpamaṃdiram ||26|| āgacchantīṣu tāsvevaṃ dharaṇī tu pulindinīm || 27 || || atha dharaṇīkṛta praśnasya pulindinīprativacanam || || āyāntīṃ vīthikāyāṃ sā saguṃjāśaṃkhabhūṣitām || śiśuṃ stanaṃ dhayaṃ pṛṣṭhe baddhvā vastrāṃcalena vai || 28 || vadāmi satyaṃ śṛṇuta bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyakam || vadantī vīthivīthīṣu tāmāhūya śucismitā || 29 || svarṇaśūrpaṃ samādāya tasminmuktā nidhāya ca || triprasthamātrāṃstrīnrāśīnkṛtvā tasyai nidhāya ca || 2.1.6.30 || vada satyaṃ tvameṣyadvā bhūtameva vā || ityevaṃ dharaṇī devī pṛcchaṃtī tāṃ sthitā'bhavat || 31 || pṛṣṭā sāvadadasyāstu manasā yadvicintitam|| madhyarāśau cintitaṃ te vada kalyāṇi me ṛju || 32 || omityāhātha dharaṇī puliṃdāṃ rājavallabhā || || dharaṇyuvāca || || rāśiruktaḥ phalaṃ brūhi dhanarāśiṃ dadāmi te || 33 || || pulindovāca || || satyaṃ vadāmi te subhru śiśorannaṃ prayaccha me || ityuktā sā tu dharaṇī svarṇapātre'nnamādade || 34 || dattvā tasyai puliṃdinyai satyaṃ brūhīti sāvadat|| sakṣīramannamādāya dattvā putrāya bhāminī || 35 || sā satyamavadatsubhrūrduhiturdehaśoṣaṇam|| puruṣādāgataṃ bhīru tadrūpā'darśanādiyam || 36 || aṃgatāpaṃ samāpannā hyanaṃgaśarapīḍitā || sa tu devādidevo vai vaikuṇṭhādāgataḥ svayam || 37 || śrīveṃkaṭādriśikhare svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe || māyāvī paramānaṃdaḥ śriyā saha ramāpatiḥ || 38 || kāmarūpī viharate bhaktābhīṣṭaprado hariḥ || sa turaṃgaṃ samāruhya viharankānanāntare || 39 || āgatyopavanaṃ rājñi tava kanyāṃ sa dṛṣṭavān || ramāsamāmimāṃ dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ || 2.1.6.40 || svasakhīṃ lalitāṃ devaḥ preṣayiṣyati teṃtikam || rameva taṃ sametyaiṣā ramiṣyati sukhaṃ ciram || 41 || etatsatyaṃ mama vacaḥ paśyādyaiva nṛpātmaje || putrasyānnaṃ prayaccheti tūṣṇīmāsa pulindinī || 42 || annaṃ dattvā punarbhūri tasyai tāṃ visasarja ha || tasyāṃ vinirgatāyāṃ tu puliṃdinyāmaninditā || 43 || utthāya cāṃgaṇāttasmādviveśāṃtaḥpuraṃ śubham || yatra padmālayā kanyā samāste svasakhīvṛtā || 44 || gatvā putrīsamīpasthā kanyāṃ kāmāturāṃ sutām|| putri kiṃ te kariṣyāmi vastu kiṃ vā priyaṃ śubhe || 45 || iti mātrābhipṛṣṭā sā mandamāha manasvinī || 46 || || atha padmāvatī nivedita bhagavadbhāgavatayorlakṣaṇāni || || netrābhirāmaṃ yalloke satāmapi manaḥpriyam || yaddraṣṭukāmā brahmādyā yattu sarvagataṃ mahat || 47 || tejasāmapi tejasvi devānāmapi daivatam || bhaktaissadbhiriha prāpyamabhaktairna kadācana || 48 || tasminneva mano me'mba vastunīha pravartate|| tadevānviṣyatāṃ mātarbhaktānāṃ sarvakāmadam || 49 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || etacchrutvātha dharaṇī tāmapṛcchatpunaḥ sutām || tadbhaktalakṣaṇaṃ brūhi yaiḥ prāpyaṃ tatsulocane || 2.1.6.50 || || padmālayovāca || || bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mātaḥ śṛṇu guhyaṃ samāhitā || śaṃkhacakrāṃkitā nityaṃ bhujayugme vasundhare|| || 51 || ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ sāntarālaṃ teṣāmeva viśeṣataḥ || puṇḍrāni dvādaśa punardhārayaṃti tathāpare || 52 || lalāṭodarahṛtkaṇṭhe jaṭhare pārśvayorapi || kūrparayorbhujadvandve pṛṣṭhe ca galapṛṣṭhake || 53 || keśavādīni nāmāni dvādaśāṃgeṣu dvādaśa || vāsudeveti tanmūrdhni dhārayaṃti namo'stviti || 54 || teṣāṃ tu niyamānvakṣye mātaḥ śṛṇu manoramān || vedapārāyaṇaratāḥ karma kurvaṃti vaidikam || 55 || satyaṃ vadanti ye devi nāsūyaṃti parānkvacit || paraniṃdāṃ na kurvaṃti parasvaṃ na haraṃti ca || 56 || na smaraṃti na paśyanti na spṛśaṃti kadācana || paradārānsurūpāṃśca ye ca tānviddhi vaiṣṇavān ||57|| sarvabhūtadayāvaṃtaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ || sadā gāyaṃti deveśametānbhaktānavehi vai || 58 || yena kena ca santuṣṭāḥ svadāraniratāśca ye || vītarāgabhayakrodhāstānbhaktānviddhi vaiṣṇavān || 59 || evaṃvidhairguṇairyuktāḥ paṃcāyudhadharā api || pitrā cācāryarūpeṇa śiṣṭenānyena vā punaḥ || 2.1.6.60 || svagṛhyoktavidhānena vahnimādāya vai budhaḥ || cakrādyāyudhamaṃtreṇa juhuyātṣoḍaśāhutīḥ || 61 || mūlamaṃtreṇa sūktena pauruṣeṇa tataḥ param || jātavedaḥ sumaṃtreṇa paścādaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 62 || hutvā mahāvyāhṛtibhiścakrādīṃstatra tāpayet || sahyānsutaptānguruṇā maṃtravaddhārayedbudhaḥ || 63 || bhujadvaye śaṃkhacakre mūrdhni śārṅgaśarau tathā || lalāṭe tu gadā dhāryā hṛdaye khaḍgameva ca || 64 || evaṃ dhāryāṇi pañcaiva viṣṇubhaktairmumukṣubhiḥ || athavā bhujayoścakra śaṃkhau caiva sulakṣaṇau || 65 || evaṃ lāñchanayuktā ye bhaktāste vaiṣṇavāḥ smṛtāḥ || taireva labhyaṃ tadbrahma sadācārasamanvitaiḥ || 66 || tasminneva mama prītistatprāptiṃ kāṃkṣate manaḥ || mātarviṣṇuvinānyeṣu vāñchā kācinna jāyate || 67 || smarāmi śyāmalaṃ viṣṇuṃ vadāmi harimacyutam || tenaiva mātarjīvāmi tadyoge cintyatāṃ vidhiḥ || 68 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || ityuktvā mātaraṃ dīnā virarāmāmbujānanā || tacchrutvā cintayāmāsa viṣṇuḥ prītaḥ kathaṃ bhavet||69|| atha bakulamālikayā sārddhaṃ sakhīnāṃ dharaṇīsamīpa āgamanam|| etasminnaṃtare kanyā agastyeśaṃ samarcya ca || āgatā dharaṇīṃ draṣṭuṃ sahaiva bakulasrajā || 2.1.6.70 || āgatānbrāhmaṇānsātha pūjayitvā subhojanaiḥ || dattvātha dakṣiṇāḥ pūrṇā vastrālaṃkārasaṃyutāḥ || 71 || āśiṣau vācayitvātha vāṃchitārthasya siddhaye || visṛjya vrāhmaṇānsarvānathāpṛcchatsvayoṣitaḥ || 72 || pūjayitvā hyagastyeśamāgatāstā manasvinīḥ || 73 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde bakulamālikāṃ prati sakhīviniveditapadmāvatyudantaviṣṇubhaktalakṣaṇādivarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || ||
<2.1.7>
atha dharaṇīdevyai bakulamālikāniveditaśrīnivāsodantaḥ || || dharaṇyuvāca || || kaiṣā bata varā kanyā yuṣmābhiḥ saṃgatā kutaḥ || kimarthamāgatā ceha pūjyaiṣā pratibhāti me || 1 || || kanyakā ūcuḥ || || eṣā divyāṅganā devī tvayi kāryārthamāgatā || devālaye saṅgateyamasmābhiḥ śivasannidhau || 2 || pṛṣṭāvadacca bhavatīṃ draṣṭumevāgateti vai || śakyā draṣṭuṃ rājagṛhe mayā rājñī sukhena vā || 3 || evaṃ pṛṣṭāstato brūmaḥ sahāsmābhiśca gamyatām|| vayaṃ tu dharaṇīdāsyo gamiṣyāmo nṛpālayam || 4 || ityuktāsmābhirāyātā tvatsamīpaṃ vasundhare|| bhavatyā pṛcchayatāmeṣā kimityāgamanaṃ tava || 5 || śrīvarāha uvāca || || iti tāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā tāmapṛcchadvasundharā || 6 || || dharaṇyuvāca || || kutastvamāgatā devi kiṃ vā kāryaṃ mayā tava || brūhi satyaṃ kariṣyāmi tvadāgamanakāraṇam || 7 || || bakulamālikovāca || || veṅkaṭādreḥ samāyātā nāmnā bakulamālikā || 8 || svāmī nārāyaṇo'smākamāste śrīveṃkaṭācale || kadāciddhayamāruhya haṃsaśuklaṃ manojavam || 9 || mṛgayārthaṃ gato rājño veṃkaṭādreḥ samīpataḥ || vanāni vicarankāle śobhane kusumākare || 2.1.7.10 || paśyanmṛgāngajānsiṃhāngavayāñcharabhānrurūn || śukānpārāvatānhaṃsānpatriṇo'nyānvanāntare || 11 || gajarājaṃ tatra kañcidyūthapaṃ madavarṣiṇam || kareṇusahitaṃ tuṃgamanvagacchatsurottamaḥ || 12 || || atha śrīnivāsoktyā śaṃkhanṛpasya svāmitīrthe tapaḥkaraṇam || || vanādvanāntaraṃ gatvā nṛpaṃ śaṃkhamupāgamat || tapasyantaṃ bṛhacchaile pratiṣṭhāpya janārdanam || 13 || śrībhūmisahitaṃ nityamarcayantaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ || śaṃkhanāgabilaṃnāma saraḥ pāvanamuttamam || 14 || tatsarastīramāsādya turaṃgādavaruhya ca || rājaveṣaṃ samāsādya tamapṛcchannṛpottamam|| 15 || kriyate kiṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha pāde'smiccheṣabhūbhṛtaḥ || 16 || || śaṃkha uvāca || || ahaṃ haihayadeśīyaḥ putraḥ śvetasya bhūbhṛtaḥ || mahāviṣṇoḥ prītaye'tra kṛtavānakhilānkratūn || 17 || adarśanānmahāviṣṇornirviṇṇohaṃ nṛpātmaja || tadānīmavadaddivyā vāṇī sarvārttināśinī || 18 || rājannātra bhaviṣyāmi pratyakṣaste vacaḥ śṛṇu || gaccha nārāyaṇādriṃ tvaṃ tapaḥ kurviti māṃ sphuṭam || 19 || tato deśamahaṃ tyaktvā tapasā''rādhayāmyaham|| atra devaṃ nṛpāciṃtyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya śriyaḥ patim || 2.1.7.20 || agastyānugrahānnityamarcayāmi vidhānataḥ || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sotprāsaṃ prāha taṃ vibhuḥ|| || 21 || gaccha nārāyaṇādriṃ tvamasya pāde kimāsyate || āruhyānena mārgeṇa paścime śikhare sthitam || 22 || praṇamya viṣvaksenaṃ tvaṃ bālaṃ nyagrodhamūlataḥ || svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ gatvā snātvā tīre'tha paścime || 23 || aśvatthaṃ tatra valmīkaṃ drakṣyase nṛpanandana || tayormadhyaṃ samāsādya tapaḥ kurvityacodayat || 24 || kaścicchveto varāho'sminvalmīke carati dhuvam || sa tu puṇyavatāmeva darśanaṃ yāti bhūpate ||25 || || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || ityādiśya hayārūḍho jagāma mṛgayāṃ vibhuḥ || caranvanādvanaṃ subhrūḥ samāsādyāraṇīṃ nadīm || 26 || avaruhya hayāttatra vicacāra taṭe śubhe || vanāntādāgato vāyuḥ padmakahlāraśītalaḥ || śramāpanayano mandaṃ siṣeve puruṣottamam || 27 || taravaḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi vikirantaḥ siṣevire || evaṃ sa vicarandevaḥ puṣpabhārānatāṃstarūn || 28 || vicinvangajarājaṃ taṃ puṣpalāvīrdadarśa ha || kanyāḥ suveṣā rucirā megheṣviva śatahradāḥ || 29 ||| tāsāṃ madhyagatāṃ tanvīṃ dadarśātimanoharām || lakṣmīsamāṃ hemavarṇāṃ tasyāṃ saktamanā abhūt || 2.1.7.30 || tāṃ gṛdhnurāha tāḥ kanyāḥ keyamityeva pūruṣaḥ || uktastābhiriyaṃ kanyā viyadrājño mahābala || 31 || idaṃ śrutvā vacastāsāṃ hayamāruhya vegavān || ājagāmāśu bhagavānsvālayaṃ ruciraṃ girim|| 32 || tatra svālayamāsādya svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe || māmāhūyāvadaddevo halā bakulamālike || 33 || viyadrājapuraṃ gatvā praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ sakhi || tatpatnīṃ dharaṇīṃ prāpya pṛṣṭvā kuśalameva ca || 34 || yācasva tanayāṃ tasyā rucirāṃ kamalālayām || rājñobhimatamājñāya śīghramāgaccha bhāmini || 35 || itthaṃ daivena cājñaptā devi tvadgṛhamāgatā || yathocitaṃ kuruṣveha rājñā maṃtriyutena ca || 36 || || atha bakulamālikoktyā dharaṇyādikṛtavivāhaniścayaḥ || || kanyayā ca vicāryaiva procyatāmuttaraṃ vacaḥ || 37 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || atha tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā prītā rājñī babhūva ha || āhūyākāśarājaṃ tamupetya kamalālayām || 38 || maṃtrimadhye'vadaddevī vacanaṃ bakulasrajaḥ || śru tvā prīto'vadadrājā maṃtriṇaḥ sapurohitān || 39 || || ākāśarāja uvāca || || kanyā tvayonijā divyā subhagā kamalālayā || arthitā devadevena veṃkaṭādrinivāsinā || 2.1.7.40 || pūrṇo manoratho me'dya brūta kiṃ saṃmataṃ tu vaḥ || śrutvā maṃtrigaṇāḥ sarve rājño vacanamuttamam || 41 || procuḥ suprītamanaso viyadrājaṃ mahīpatim || vayaṃ kṛtārthā rājendra kulaṃ sarvonnataṃ bhavet || 42 || bhavatkanyeyamatulā śriyā saha ramiṣyati || dīyatāṃ devadevāya śārṅgiṇe paramātmane || 43 || ayaṃ vasantaḥ śrīmāṃśca śubhaṃ śīghraṃ vidhīyatām || 44 || || atha bṛhaspatyuktyā vivāhalagnasthirīkaraṇam || || āhūya dhiṣaṇaṃ lagnaṃ vivāhārthaṃ vidhīyatām || 45 || tathāstvityāhvayāmāsa suralokādbṛhaspatim || papraccha kanyāvarayorvivāhārthaṃ nareśvaraḥ || 46 || || rājovāca || || kanyāyā janmanakṣatraṃ mṛgaśīrṣamiti smṛtam || devasya śravaṇarkṣantu tayoryogo vicāryatām || 47 || śrutvā'bravītsa dhiṣaṇastayoruttaraphalgunī || saṃmatā sukhavṛddhyarthaṃ procyate daivaciṃtakaiḥ || 48 || tayoruttaraphalgunyāṃ vivāhaḥ kriyatāmiti || vaiśākhamāse vidhivatkriyatāmiti so'bravīt || 49 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || rājā tu dhiṣaṇaṃ tatra saṃpūjyātha visṛjya ca || devasya dūtikāmāha gaccha devālayaṃ śubhe || || 2.1.7.50 || vaiśākhe devadevāya kalyāṇaṃ vada suvrate || vaivāhikavidhānaṃ tu kṛtvā cāgamyatāmiti || 51 || tato devyāḥ priyakaraṃ śukaṃ dūtaṃ tayā saha || visṛjya vāyuṃ svasutamindrādyānayane'sṛjat || 52 || || atha viśvakarmādikṛtapurālaṃkārādikramaḥ || || āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ purālaṃkārakarmaṇi || niyojayāmāsa so'pi nirmame nimiṣāṃtarāt || 53 || indro'sṛjatpuṣpavṛṣṭiṃ nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || dhanado dhanadhānyādyaiḥ pūrayāmāsa veśma tat || || 54 || yamastu rogarahitāṃścakāra manujānbhuvi || varuṇo ratnajālāni mauktikādīnyapūrayat || 55 || evaṃ saṃpādya sarvāṇi yayurdevā vṛṣācalam || || 56 || || atha śukena saha bakulāyāḥ śrīnivāsasamīpe gamanam || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || tataḥ sā hayamāruhya śukena sahitā yayau || śrīveṃkaṭādrimāsādya devālayasamīpataḥ || 57 || avaruhya turaṃgātsā saśukā'bhyantaraṃ yayau || dṛṣṭvā devaṃ ratnapīṭhe śriyā saha sulocanam || || 58 || praṇamya hyavadatprītā kṛtyaṃ tatra kṛtaṃ vibho || māṃgalyavārtāṃ vaktuṃ vai śuka eṣa samāgataḥ || 59 || || atha śrīnivāsāya śukāvedita padmāvatīpariṇayavṛttāntaḥ || || vadeti devenājñaptaḥ śuko natvā tamabravīt || || śuka uvāca || || tvāṃ pratyāha sutā bhūmermāmaṃgīkuru mādhava || 2.1.7.60 || vadāmi tava nāmāni smarāmi tvadvapussadā || dhriyante tava cihnāni bhujādyaṃgai ramāpate || 61 || tvadbhaktānarcayāmīha paṃcasaṃskārasaṃyutān || tvatprītaye hi karmāṇi karomi madhusūdana || 62 || evaṃ sadaivācaraṃtyāḥ pitroranumate mama || kuru prasādaṃ deveśa māmaṃgīkuru mādhava || 63 || iti vijñāpayāmāsa kamalasthā dharāsutā || śukasya vacanaṃ śrutvā supriyaṃ tvātmano hariḥ || 64 || || atha padmāvatyāḥ śukadattaśrīnivāsamālādhāraṇam|| || śrībhagavānuvāca || || kartuṃ kalyāṇamudvāhamāgamiṣyāmi cā'maraiḥ || śuka gaccha vadaivaṃ tāmitthaṃ devo'bravīditi || 65 || śukaḥ śrutvā devavākyamādāya vanamālikām|| devadattāṃ yayau śīghraṃ viyadrājasutāṃ prati || 66 || tulasīmālikāṃ dattvā mṛganābhisugaṃdhinīm || praṇamya devīmavadacchuko devavacaḥ śubham || 67 || śrutvā tanmālikāṃ gṛhya bhūmijā śirasā dadhau || cakre'laṃkāramucitaṃ devāgamanakāṃkṣiṇī || || 68 || viyadrājo'pi sānandamindumāhūya sādaram|| annaṃ vidhīyatāṃ rājanvividhaṃ rasasaṃyutam || 69 || viṣṇornaivedyayogyaṃ yatparamānnaṃ vidhīyatām || devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca narāṇāmapi saṃmatam || 2.1.7.70 || caturvidhaṃ sugandhāḍhyamamṛtāṃśaiḥ sudhākara || evaṃ kṛtvā saṃvidhānaṃ pratīkṣyāgamanaṃ vibhoḥ || 71 || sabhāyāṃ maṃtrisahitaḥ samāsta prītamānasaḥ || putrīmalaṃkṛtāṃ kṛtvā dharaṇīsahito nṛpaḥ || 72 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde dharaṇīdevyai bakulamālikānivedita śrīnivāsodantakamalālayākalyāṇavidhyādivṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<2.1.8>
|| atha śrīnivāsasya lakṣmyādikṛtapariṇayālaṃkāraḥ || || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || tato devādhidevo'pi lakṣmīmāhūya bhāminīm || kiṃ kāryaṃ vada kalyāṇi vivāhārthaṃ sulocane || 1 || ājñāpayasva svasakhī rame kāryaṃ kuru priyam || śrīstu kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā sakhīrāhūya codayat || 2 || śriyājñaptā tataḥ prītiḥ sugaṃdhaṃ tailamādadau || śrutiḥ kṣaumaṃ samādāya tasthau devasya sannidhau || 3 || bhūṣaṇāni samādāya smṛtirapyāyayau mudā || dhṛtirādarśamādhatta śāntirmṛgamadaṃ dadhau || 4 || yakṣakardamamādāya hrīḥ sthitā purato hareḥ || kīrtiḥ kanakapaṭṭaṃ ca saratnaṃ mukuṭaṃ dadhau || 5 || chatraṃ dadhau tadeṃdrāṇī cāmaraṃ tu sarasvatī || dvitīyaṃ cāmaraṃ gaurī vyajane vijayājaye || 6 || āgatāstāḥ samālokya śrīrutthāyātha satvarā || sugaṃdhaṃ tailamādāya devamabhyajya śīrṣataḥ || 7 || udvartitaṃ gaṃdhacūrṇairdevāṃgaṃ parimṛjya ca || ānītānkaribhistoyakalaśānkāṃcanāñchatam || 8 || viyadgaṃgāditīrthebhyaḥ karpūrādisuvāsitān|| ekamekaṃ samādāya tvabhyaṣiṃcadramā harim || 9 || saṃdhūpya keśāndhūpena tānāśyāmānbabaṃdha ca || sugaṃdhenānulipyāṃgaṃ svarṇavarṇena tadvibhoḥ || 2.1.8.10 || pītakauśeyakaṃ baddhvā kaṭyāṃ kāṃcīsamanvitam || mukuṭādivibhūṣābhirbhūṣayāmāsa cendirā || 11 || aṃgulīyakaratnāni sarvāsvevāṃgulīṣu ca || ādarśaṃ darśayāmāsa dhṛtirdevasya sannidhau || 12 || dṛṣṭvādarśaṃ devadevo hyūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ svayaṃ dadhau || āruhya garuḍaṃ paścātsvayaṃ lakṣmīsamanvitaḥ || 13 || || atha brahmādibhissākaṃ śrīnivāsasya viyadrājapuragamanam || || brahmeśavajrivaruṇayamayakṣeśasevitaḥ || vasiṣṭhādyairmunīṃdraiśca sanakādyaiśca yogibhiḥ || 14 || bhaktairbhāgavatairyukto nārāyaṇapurīṃ yayau || jagurgandharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ||15|| devaduṃdubhayo nedustadā devasya sannidhau || japantaḥ svastisūktāni munayastaṃ samanvayuḥ || 16 || devo devagaṇairyukto viṣvaksenādipārṣadaiḥ || sakhībhissyaṃdanasthābhirbakulādyābhiranvitaḥ || ākāśarājasya puramāsasāda svalaṃkṛtam || 17 || || atha padmāvatīpariṇayaghaṭṭaḥ || || devamāgatamālokya kanyāmairāvatasthitām|| purīṃ pradakṣaṇīkṛtya gopuradvāramāgatām || 18 || ālokyākāśarājo'pi samānīya vadhūvarau || bandhubhiḥ sahitastasthau devamālokya keśavam || 19 || viṣṇurmālāṃ svakaṃṭhasthāṃ hastenādāya sasmitaḥ || kamalāyāḥ skandhadeśe mumoca sumanaścitām || 2.1.8.20 || ādāya mallikāmālā sā'sya kaṃṭhe samarpayat || evaṃ trivāraṃ tau kṛtvā vāhanādavaruhya ca || 21 || sthitvā pīṭhe kṣaṇaṃ paścādgṛhaṃ viviśatuḥ śubham || brahmādidevayūthaiśca sahitau bhūmijāharī o| 22 || māṃgalyasūtrabaṃdhādi sāṃkurārpaṇamabjajaḥ || vaivāhikaṃ kārayitvā lājahomāntameva ca || 23 || vratādeśaṃ samājñāya śayitau kamalāharī || caturthe divase sarvaṃ samāpayya caturmukhaḥ || 24 || anujñāpya viyadrājamāropya garuḍe harim || devībhyāṃ sahitaṃ devaṃ devairgantuṃ pracakrame || 25 || divyadundubhirnirghoṣaiḥ saṃprāpya vṛṣabhācalam || tuṣṭuvurdevadeveśaṃ brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ || 26 || śukādayo munigaṇāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam || stūyamāno'tha devo'pi viveśa maṇimaṃḍapam || 27 || ramādharaṇijābhyāṃ ca tatra siṃhāsanaṃ yayau|| 28 || || atha vadhūvarayorviyadrājavitīrṇaprābhṛtādikam || || ākāśarājo'pi tadā mahendrādisuraiḥ saha || putrīviṣṇvoḥ priyārthaṃ tu prābhṛtaṃ katumudyataḥ ||29|| sauvarṇeṣu kaṭāheṣu taṃḍulāñchālisaṃbhavān|| mudgapātrāṇyanekāni ghṛtakumbhaśatāni ca || 2.1.8.30 || payoghaṭasahasrāṇi dadhibhāṇḍānyanekaśaḥ || divyāni cūtakadalīnārikelaphalāni ca || 31 || dhātrīphalāni kūṣmāḍarājaraṃbhāphalāni ca || panasānmātuluṃgāṃśca śarkarāpūritānghaṭān || 32 || suvarṇamaṇimuktāśca kṣaumakoṭyaṃbarāṇi ca || dāsīdāsasahasrāṇi koṭiśo gāstathaiva ca|| 33 || haṃsenduśuklavarṇānāṃ hayānāmayutaṃ dadau || tuṃgānāṃ nityamattānāṃ gajānāmadhikaṃ śatāt || 34 || aṃtaḥpuracarā nārīrnṛttagītaviśāradāḥ || dadau catuḥsahasrāṇi śrīnivāsāya viṣṇave || dattvā caitāni sarvāṇi tasthau devapuro vibhuḥ || 35 || || atha śrīnivāsakṛpayā viyadrājasya bhaktirūpavaraprāptiḥ || || dṛṣṭvā devo'pi tatsarvaṃ devībhyāṃ sahito hariḥ || 36 || suprītaḥ prāha rājānaṃ śvaśuraṃ veṃkaṭeśvaraḥ || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva he rājanguro matto yadīcchasi || 37 || iti śrīśavacaḥ śrutvā viyadrājo'vadadvibhum || tvatsevaiveha devaivaṃ bhūyādavyabhicāriṇī || 38 || manastvatpādakamale tvayi bhaktirmamāstu vai || 39 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || tvayā yaduktaṃ rājendra sarvametadbhaviṣyati || iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai saṃmānyaiva yathocitam || 2.1.8.40 || || atha vivāhārthamāgatānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ svāvāsagamanam || || brahmeśādisurānsarvānsamabhyarcya yathocitam || svarlokagamanāyaivamanumene mudā hariḥ || gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu śriyā bhūmijayā yutaḥ || 41 || viharansa yathāpūrvaṃ svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe || āste divyālaye devopyarcyamāno guhena vai || 42 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde brahmādibhiḥ sākaṃ śrīnivāsasya viyadrājapuragamana kamalālayāpariṇayādivarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<2.1.9>
|| atha vasunāmakaniṣādavṛttāṃtaḥ || || dharaṇyuvāca || || kalau yuge bhūmidhara kena tvaṃ drakṣyase priya || vimānaṃ kena te deva kāryate'sminmahīdhare || 1 || śrīnivāso'pi kenaiva drakṣyate subhagākṛtiḥ || etadbrūhi mama prītyā śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ vibho || 2 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || vakṣyāmi śṛṇu he devi bhaviṣyadyadvadāmi te || asminmahīdhare puṇye niṣādo vasunāmakaḥ || 3 || śyāmākavanapālo'bhūdbhaktimānpuruṣottame || śyāmākataṃḍulānpaktvā madhunā pariṣicya ca || 4 || nivedya devadevāya śrībhūmi sahitāya ca || evaṃ bhaktimatastasya bhāryā citravatī śubhā || 5 || asūta tanayaṃ bālā vīranāmānamuttamam || vasuḥ putreṇa sahito bhāryayā patibhaktayā || 6 || kasmiṃściddivase putraṃ śyāmākaṃ pālayeti ca || visṛjya patnyā sahito madhvanveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 7 || gato vanāntaraṃ śīghraṃ madhucchatradidṛkṣayā || bālaḥ śyāmākapakvāni gṛhītvāgnau nidhāya ca || 8 || piṣṭvā nivedayāmāsa vṛkṣamūle śriyaḥ pateḥ || naivedyaṃ bhakṣayitvaiva vīrastvāsa sukhena vai|| 9 || tadantare vasuścāpi madhvādāya samāgataḥ || śyāmākānbhakṣitāndṛṣṭvā saṃtarjya sutamātmanaḥ || 2.1.9.10 || khaṅgamādāya taṃ hantuṃ tvarayā hastamuddadhau || 11 || || atha sutahananodyuktaṃ vasuṃ prati bhagavaduktiḥ || || tadvṛkṣasthastadā viṣṇuḥ khaṅgaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā || khaḍgo gṛhītaḥ keneti paśyanvṛkṣaṃ dadarśa saḥ || 12 || śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ vṛkṣārūḍhārdhavigraham || muktvā vasuśca taṃ khaḍgaṃ praṇamyovāca keśavam || 13 || kimidaṃ devadeveśa ceṣṭitaṃ kriyate tvayā || 14 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || vaso śṛṇu vaco me tvaṃ putraste bhaktimānmayi || tvatto'pi me priyatamastasmātpratyakṣamāgataḥ ||15|| asya sarvatra tiṣṭhāmi tava svāmisarastaṭe || iti devavacaḥ śrutvā prītimānabhavadvasuḥ || 16 || etasminneva kāle tu pāṃḍyadeśātsamāgataḥ || bālyātprabhṛti śūdro'pi viṣṇubhaktisamanvitaḥ || 17 || || atha raṃgadāsasya śrīnivāsasevārthaṃ śrīśeṣācalāgamanam || || nārāyaṇapurīṃ prāpya śrīvarāhaṃ praṇamya ca || tatra śrutvā śrīnivāsaṃ veṃkaṭādrinivāsinam || 18 || svayaṃbhuvaṃ devadevasevitaṃ prayayau tataḥ || suvarṇamukharīṃ prāpya snātvā cottīrya tattaṭe || 19|| kamalākhye sarasi ca snātvā puṇyapradāyini || tattīravāsinaṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmeṇa saṃvṛtam || 2.1.9.20 || namaskṛtya tataḥ prāyādvanaṃ gajaghaṭāyutam || śanaiḥ saṃprāpya śeṣādriṃ nirjharaṃ saṃdadarśa ha || 21 || tatsamīpaṃ samāsādya kapilāpūjitaṃ śivam || tatpuraścakratīrthaṃ tadagādhaṃ pāpanāśanam || 22 || tatra snātvā tato'gacchadveṃkaṭādriṃ śanaiḥśanaiḥ || ārāddhuṃ gacchatā mārge yukto vaikhānasena ca || 23 || raṃgadāsastvāruroha bālo dvādaśavārṣikaḥ || svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ prāya snātvā bhaktisamanvitaḥ ||24|| vaikhānasena muninā gopīnāthena pūjitam || vanamadhye tarormūle svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe ||25|| tiṣṭhantaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śrībhūmisahitaṃ harim || ākāśasthaṃ saṃdadarśa pītanīlākṛtiṃ śubham || 26 || pārśvasthaśaṃkhacakrābhyāṃ gadāsibhyāṃ niṣevitam|| pakṣau vistārya cākāśe devamūrdhni vitānavat ||27|| sthitaṃ ca garuḍeśānaṃ paścācchārṅgaṃ śaraṃ tathā ||28|| || atha śrīnivāsārthaṃ raṃgadāsakṛtadivyodyānamaṇḍapādinirmāṇāni || || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīnivāsaṃ vismito raṃgadāsakaḥ || asya devasya cārāmaṃ kariṣyāmītyacintayat || 29 || niścitya manasā sarvaṃ tarumūle'vasatsudhīḥ || kṛtvā vaikhānasādviṣṇornaivedyaṃ ca dinedine || 2.1.9.30 || śanaiśchittvā vanaṃ ghoraṃ vṛkṣāṃściccheda pārśvagān || āsthānaciñcāṃ devasya ramāyāścampakaṃ tarum ||31|| devājñapto varjayitvā tāvubhau devasevitau || devasyaparito bhūmau śilākuḍyaṃ tadākarot ||32|| tatkuḍyasyaiva paritaḥ puṣpārāmāṃścakāra ha || mallikākaravīrābjakundamaṃdāramālatīḥ ||33|| tulasīcampakānāṃ tu vanānyeva cakāra ha || khanitvā tatra kūpaṃ tu vardhayaṃstajjalairvanam || 34 || ārāmapuṣpāṇyādāya svayaṃ dāmānyathākarot || vicitrāṇi tadā baddhvā pūjakasya kare dadau || 35 || ādāya pūjakastāni skandhe mūrdhni babandha ca || śrīnivāsasya devasya śrībhūmisahitasya ca || 36 || evaṃ devasya kaiṃkaryaṃ kurvaṃstasthāvudāradhīḥ || tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya samāstvā saptatergatāḥ || 37 || kurvāṇe puṣpāvacayaṃ raṃgadāse mahātmani || 38 || || atha raṃgadāsasya gandharvakrīḍādarśanena bhagavatkaiṃkaryavismṛtiḥ || || ārāme sarasi snātuṃ gandharvaḥ kaścidāyayau || gandharvarājakanyābhistaruṇībhiḥ samanvitaḥ || 39 || jalakrīḍāṃ karoti sma divi sthāpya vimānakam|| surūpābhiśca sahitaṃ krīḍantaṃ kamalākare || 2.1.9.40 || paśyañchrīraṃgadāso'yaṃ vyasmaranmālyasañcayam || jitendriyo'pi tatkakrīḍāṃ paśyanretaḥ sasarja ha || 41 || paśyatastasya sarasaḥ samuttīrya manoharam || divyavastrāṇi cācchādya kāntābhiḥ saha sasmitam || || 42 || adhiruhya vimānaṃ tu yayau sa dhanadālayam || gate gandharvarāje tu raṃgadāso vimohitaḥ || 43 || tyaktvā ca tāni mālyāni snātvā sarasi lajjitaḥ || punarāhṛtya puṣpāṇi śanairdevālayaṃ yayau || 44 || vaikhānasastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjākālamatītya ca || āgataṃ kimiti prāha sakhe'tikramya cāgataḥ || 45 || na baddhā mālikāścāpi tvayā''rāme ca kiṃ kṛtam || 46 || || śrīvarāhauvāca || || itthaṃ pṛṣṭo raṃgadāso nāvadallajjayā tataḥ || lajjitaṃ raṃgadāsaṃ taṃ provāca madhusūdanaḥ || 47 || || atha svarūpānusandhānena lajjitaṃ raṃgadāsaṃ prati śrīnivāsavacanam|| || śrībhagavānuvāca || || lajjayā kiṃ raṃgadāsa mayā tvaṃ mohito hyasi || tvaṃ tāvajjitakāmo'si dhīro bhava mahāmate || 48 || gandharvarājavadrājā bhavitāsi mahītale || tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānbhaktimānmayi sarvadā || 49 || prākāraṃ ca vimānaṃ ca kārayiṣyasi me tadā || tatra muktiṃ pradāsyāmi prītyā paramayā yutaḥ || 2.1.9.50 || atraiva kuru sevāṃ tvamāśarīravimokṣaṇāt || madbhaktānāṃ sakāmānāmevaṃ muktirbhaviṣyati || 51 || ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ punarnovāca kiṃcana || śrutvā tadraṃgadāso'pi cakārārāmamuttamam || || 52 || || atha toṇḍamānnāmakanṛpavṛttāntaḥ || || sāgraṃ śatābdaṃ sevitvā gataḥ svargamamandadhīḥ || jātaḥ somakule tuṃge toṇḍamāniti viśrutaḥ || 53 || suvīratanayo vīro nandinīgarbhasaṃbhavaḥ || sa paṃcavarṣādudbhūtaviṣṇubhaktiḥ svayaṃ sudhīḥ || sauśīlyaśauryavīryādiguṇānāmākaro mahān|| 54 || pāṇḍyasya tanayāṃ padmāmupayeme manoharām || tato rājā śataṃ kanyā nānādeśyāḥ svayaṃvarāḥ || 55 || reme deveṃdravadbhūmau nārāyaṇapure vasan|| anujñāṃ prāpya pitṛtaḥ putraḥ paṃcāsyavikramaḥ|| 56 || uddiśya mṛgayāṃ vīro veṅkaṭādreḥ samīpataḥ || 57 || || atha toṇḍamānnṛpasya mṛgayārthaṃ śrīśeṣācalagamanam || || pādacāreṇa vicaranparivāraiḥ samanvitaḥ || madadhārāṃ vimuṃcaṃtaṃ dadarśa gajayūthapam || 58 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito bhūtvā grahītuṃ tamanudrutaḥ || suvarṇamukharīṃ tīrtvā brahmāṣa śukamuttamam || 59 || namaskṛtyābhyanujñātastato'gacchadvanādvanam || dadarśa reṇukāṃ devīṃ valmīkākārasaṃsthitām || 2.1.9.60 || iṣṭadāmiṣṭabhaktānāṃ divyārāmanivāsinīm|| parivāraiḥ sadopetāṃ pūjitāṃ tridaśairapi ||61 || toṇḍamānapi tāṃ natvā tataḥ paścānmukho yayau || 62 || || atha śrīnivāsasamīpasthapaṃcavarṇaśukavṛttāṃtaḥ || || paṃcavarṇaṃ śukaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ jighṛkṣuranudrutaḥ || sa vadañchrīnivāseti giriṃ śīghrataraṃ yayau || 63 || anudravansa rājāpi girirājaṃ samāruhat || darīśca vividhāḥ paśyañchikharāṇi samaṃtataḥ|| || 64 || śukamanveṣamāṇo'sau śyāmākavanameyivān || tamadṛṣṭvā śukavaraṃ vanapālaṃ dadarśa ha || 65 || taṃ tu rājānamāyāṃtaṃ pratyudgacchansa satvaraḥ || praṇamya vinayopetaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||66|| toṇḍamānapi saṃpūjya taṃ papraccha vanecaram|| paṃcavarṇaḥ śukaḥ kaściddṛṣṭaścātrāgatastvayā || 67 || śrīnivāseti ca vadankva gato'sau vanecara || 68 || || vanecara uvāca || || sa paṃcavarṇo rājeṃdra śrīnivāsapriyaḥ sadā || pārśvavartī sadā tasya śrībhūmibhyāṃ vivardhitaḥ || 69 || svāmipuṣkariṇītīre sadāste devasannidhau || grahītuṃ sa śukaḥ śrīmānna tu kenāpi śakyate || 2.1.9.70 || vihṛtya svecchayā nityamasmingirivare śubhe || dināṃte devamāsādya tatsamīpe vasatyayam || 71 || taṃ devamārādhayituṃ gamiṣyāmi nṛpātmaja || viśramyatāṃ vṛkṣamūle yāvadāgamanaṃ mama || 72 || putreṇānena sahito vihara tvaṃ yathāsukham || 73 || || rājovāca || || tvayā sahāgamiṣyāmi draṣṭuṃ devaṃ janārdanam || tvaṃ me darśaya deveśaṃ veṃkaṭādrinivāsinam || 74 || tasya rājño vacaḥ śrutvā śyāmākaṃ madhumiśritam || cūtapatrapuṭe kṣiptvā rājñā saha yayau harim || 75 || || atha toṇḍamānnṛpasya niṣādena saha śrīnivāsasamīpāgamanam || || gatvā sudūramadhvānaṃ paśyantau tau śilātalam || muhūrtādeva saṃprāptau svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ śubhām || 76 || snātvā tatra vidhānena rājñā saha niṣādapaḥ || darśayāmāsa devaśaṃ rājñastasya mahātmanaḥ || 77 || svāmipuṣkariṇītīre sthitaṃ śrīvṛkṣamūlake || atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśamaṃbujāyatalocanam || 78 || caturbhujamudārāṅgamīṣatsmitamukhāṃbujam || divyapītāṃbaradharaṃ kirīṭakaṭakojjvalam || 79 || pārśvasthābhyāṃ surūpābhyāṃ śrībhūmibhyāṃ samanvitam || paritaḥ śaṃkhacakrāsigadāśārṅgeṣusevitam |||| 2.1.9.80 || anyairdivyāyudhaiścāpi divyamālyairniṣevitam || skandenārādhyamānaṃ taṃ trisandhyaṃ puruṣottamam || 81 || valmīkagūḍhapādābjamājānupuruṣottamam || tato dṛṣṭvā mudā devaṃ praṇematurubhau tadā || 82 || rājā tu prāṃjalirbhūtvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ || ānaṃdalaharīṃ prāpya na prājñāyata kiṃcana || 83 || niṣādo'pi nivedyaiva śyāmākaṃ madhumiśritam || rājñe tadardhaṃ dattvaiva śiṣṭārdhaṃ bhuktavānsvayam || 84 || pītvā puṣkariṇītoyaṃ tena rājñā samanvitaḥ || sa punaḥ śyāmakavane puṇyāṃ parṇakuṭīṃ yayau || 85 || uṣitvā caikarātraṃ tu prātarutthāya bhūmipaḥ || svasainyena samāyukto nivṛttaḥ svapuraṃ yayau || 86 || || atha toṇḍamānnṛpaṃ prati reṇukoktiḥ || || punardevīvanaṃ gatvā hayādavatatāra ha || caitraśuddhanavamyāṃ tu pūjayāmāsa reṇukām || 87|| haviṣyaṃ paramānnaṃ ca sopaskaramanekaśaḥ || paśūpahārasahitaṃ dhūpadīpasamanvitam || 88 || surāghaṭīśataṃ dattvā jātīkesaravāsitam || evaṃ saṃpūjitā devī prītā rājñe varaṃ dadau || 89 || āviṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścidavadannṛpasattamam || śṛṇu rājanbhaviṣyaṃ te rājyaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam || 2.1.9.90 || rājaṃstavaiva nāmnātra rājadhānī bhaviṣyati || matsamīpe mahārāja ciraṃ rājyaṃ kariṣyasi || 91 || devadevaprasādaśca bhaviṣyati tavānagha || iti dattvā varaṃ tasmā āviṣṭaḥ prakṛtiṃ yayau || 92 || tato labdhavaro rājā yayau śukamuniṃ punaḥ || 93 || || atha śukavarṇitapadmasarovaramāhātmyam || || abhivādya muniṃ tena pūjito mudito'bhavat || māhātmyaṃ saraso brūhi kamalākhyasya me mune || 94 || || śrīśuka uvāca || || purā durvāsasaḥ śāpādavatīrṇā surālayāt || padmā padmākṣadayitā viṣṇunā sahitā nṛpa || 95 || saraḥ kāṃcanapadmāḍhyamidaṃ prāpya maheśvarī || tapaścakāra varṣāṇāṃ divyānāmayutaṃ ramā || 96 || tato devā vicinvantaḥ śriyaṃ viṣṇusamanvitām || puraṃdareṇa saṃyuktā rājannasminsarovare || 97 || sthitā suvarṇakamale puṇḍarīkākṣasaṃyutām || dṛṣṭvā prītisamāyuktāḥ praṇamyāṃbujadhāriṇīm || kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sendrāstuṣṭuvurlokamātaram || || 96 || || atha devādikṛtaśrīlakṣmīstutiḥ || || devā ūcuḥ || || namaḥ śriyai lokadhātryai brahmamātre namonamaḥ || namaste padmanetrāyai padmamukhyai namonamaḥ || 99 || prasannamukhapadmāyai padmakāntyai namonamaḥ || namo bilvavanasthāyai viṣṇupatnyai namonamaḥ || 2.1.9.100 || vicitrakṣaumadhāriṇyai pṛthuśroṇyai namonamaḥ || pakvabilvaphalāpīnatuṃgastanyai namonamaḥ || 101 || suraktapadmapatrābhakarapādatale śubhe || suratnāṃgadakeyūrakāṃcīnūpuraśobhite || yakṣakardamasaṃliptasarvāṃge kaṭakojjvale || 102 || māṃgalyābharaṇaiścitrairmuktāhārairvibhūṣite || tāṭaṃkairavataṃsaiśca śobhamānamukhāṃbuje || 103 || padmahaste namastubhyaṃ prasīda harivallabhe || ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpāyai vidyāyai te namonamaḥ || 104 || prasīdāsmānkṛpādṛṣṭipātairālokayābdhije || ye dṛṣṭāste tvayā brahmarudreṃdratvaṃ samāpnuyuḥ || 105 || || atha iṃdrādīnprati stutiprasannalakṣmīvacanam || || śrīśuka uvāca || || iti stutā tadā daivairviṣṇuvakṣaḥsthalālayā || viṣṇunā saha saṃdṛśyā ramā prītāvadatsurān || 106 || || śrīruvāca || || surārīnsahasā hatvā svapadāni gamiṣyatha || ye sthānahīnāḥ svasthānādbhraṃśitā ye narā bhuvi || 107 || te māmanena stotreṇa stutvā sthānamavāpnuyuḥ || akhaṃḍairbilvapatrairmāmarcayaṃti narā bhuvi || 108 || stotreṇānena ye devā narā yuṣmatkṛtena vai || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmākarāste bhavanti vai || 109 || idaṃ padmasaro devā ye kecana narā bhuvi || prāpya snānaṃ kariṣyanti māṃ stutvā viṣṇuvallabhām || 2.1.9.110 || te'pi śriyaṃ dīrghamāyurvidyāṃ putrānsuvarcasaḥ || labdhvā bhogāṃśca bhuktvā'nte narā mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ || 111 || iti dattvā varaṃ devī devena saha viṣṇunā || āruhya garuḍeśānaṃ vaikuṇṭhasthānamāyayau || || 112 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde vasu nāmaka niṣādavṛttāntapadmasaromāhātmyādivarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || || cha ||
<2.1.10>
|| atha toṇḍamānnṛpasya svapituḥ sakāśādrājyaprāptiḥ || || śrīśuka uvāca || || idaṃ padmasaronāma rājanpāpapraṇāśanam || kīrtanātsmaraṇātsnānānnṛṇāṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ bhuvi || kṛtvā snānaṃ tvamapyasminvraja svapituraṃtikam || 1 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || etacchukavacaḥ śrutvā snātvā padmasarovare || 2 || taṃ natvā hayamāruhya toṇḍamānsvapuraṃ yayau || taṃ pitā yuvarājānaṃ kṛtvā trīnvatsarānatha || 3 || raṃjakatvaṃ ca sāmarthyaṃ śauryaṃ vīryaṃ suśīlatām || bhaktiṃ vipreṣu putrasya vīkṣya rājā svamaṃtribhiḥ || 4 || svapade sthāpayāmāsa svabhiṣicya vidhānataḥ || anunīya sutaṃ patnyā sārdhaṃ rājā vanaṃ yayau || 5 || || atha vasorvalmīke śrīvarāhasandarśanam || || toṇḍamānapi sāmrājyaṃ labdhvā rājyaṃ cakāra ha || niṣādasya vane devo vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ || 6 || śyāmākapakvaṃ bhakṣitvā rātraurātrau cacāra ha || padāni sa varāhasya cānviyeṣa divādivā || 7 || adṛṣṭvā taṃ varāhaṃ sa rātrau jāgraddhanurdharaḥ || sthito'paśyaccarantaṃ taṃ caṃdrakoṭisamaprabham || 8 || varāhaṃ subhagākāraṃ śyāmākavanamadhyataḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanurādāya siṃhanādaṃ cakāra ha || 9 || varāhastaddhvaniṃ śrutvā vanānniṣkramya satvaram || yayau taṃ cāpyanuyayau varāhaṃ sa niṣādapaḥ || 2.1.10.10 || rātriśeṣamanudrutya vane caṃdrasamaprabham || valmīkaṃ praviśantaṃ ca dadarśa sa niṣādapaḥ || 11 || gacchaṃtaṃ pūrṇimācandramastaṃ girivaraṃ yathā || vismito'khānayatkopādvalmīkaṃ sa niṣādapaḥ || 12 || dharāvarāho dadṛśe mūrcchito'yaṃ papāta ha || pitaraṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatputro bhaktimāṃstadā || || 13 || varāhadevaṃ tuṣṭāva tena prīto'bhavaddhariḥ || āviśya pitaraṃ tasya provāca madhusūdanaḥ || 14 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || ahaṃ varāha deveśo nityamasminvasāmyaham || rājñe tvamuktvā māmatra pratiṣṭhāpyaiva pūjaya || 15 || valmīkaṃ kṛṣṇagokṣīraiḥ kṣālayitvā tadutthite || śilātale ca vārāhamuddhṛtya dharaṇīsthitam || 16 || kārayitvā pratiṣṭhāpya viprairvaikhānasaiśca mām || pūjayedvividhairbhogaistoṇḍamānrājasattamaḥ || 17 || ityuktvā taṃ jahau devaḥ sa ca svastho babhūva ha || sukhāsīnaṃ tu pitaraṃ namaskṛtya niṣādajaḥ || 18 || nyavedayaddevavacaḥ pitre sarvaṃ yathātatham || sa śrutvā vismito bhūtvā kṛtsnaṃ putravacaḥ śubham || 19 || || atha toṇḍamannṛpāya vasuniveditavārāhodaṃtaḥ || || rājñe vaktuṃ yayau śīghraṃ niṣādaḥ svānugaiḥ saha || vasurniṣādādhipatī rājadvāramupāgamat || 2.1.10.20 || niṣādādhipamājñāya dvārapālairnṛpottamaḥ || āhūya taṃ niṣādeśaṃ sabhāyāṃ maṃtribhiḥ saha || || 21 || satkṛtya taṃ vasuṃ rājā saputraṃ saparicchadam || papraccha prītimānrājā vasuṃ taṃ vanagocaram|| kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ te vada tvaṃ vanagocara ||22|| || || vasuruvāca || || rājanmama vane dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate || 23 || kaścicchvetavarāhastu śyāmākamacaranniśi || || taṃ varāhaṃ dhanuṣpāṇiranvadhāvamahaṃ nṛpa || 24 || anudruto vāyuvego gatvā valmīkamāviśat || svāmipuṣkariṇītīre paśyate mama bhūpate || 25 || valmīkamakhanaṃ krodhānmūrcchito nyapataṃ bhuvi || matputro'yaṃ samāgatya māṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitaṃ bhuvi || 26 || śucirbhūtvā devadevaṃ tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam || tato mayi samāviśya varāho'dhyavadatsutam || 27 || rājñe nivedaya kṣipraṃ maccaritraṃ niṣādapa || kṛṣṇagokṣīrasekena valmīkaṃ kṣālayennṛpaḥ || 28 || dṛśyate ca śilā kācidvalmīkasthā suśobhanā || vāmāṃkasthabhuvaṃ māṃ ca varāhavadanaṃ sthitam || 29 || kārayitvā śilpinātha pratiṣṭhāpya munīśvaraiḥ || vaikhānasairmunivarairarcayettoṇḍamānapi || 2.1.10.30 || atha gatvā śrīnivāsaṃ valmīkāvṛtapaddvayam || kapilākṛṣṇagokṣīrasecanaiḥ kṣālayecchanaiḥ || || 31 || āpādapīṭhaparyaṃtaṃ kṣālayitvā dinedine || kuryātprākāramubhayoruttare dakṣiṇe tathā || 32 || ityuktvā caiva mā'muṃcaddevaḥ svastho'bhavaṃ nṛpa || idaṃ te vaktumāyāto devadevacikīrṣitam || 33 || || atha nṛpasya niṣādavākyasvapnābhyāṃ bilamārgeṇa śeṣācalagamanam || || || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || toṇḍamānapi tacchrutvā suprīto vismito'bhavat || tataḥ kāryaṃ viniścitya mantribhiḥ puṣkarādibhiḥ || 34 || vekaṭādriṃ jigamiṣurgopānāhūya sarvaśaḥ || kṛṣṇāśca kapilā gāvo yāḥ kāścitsaṃti māmikāḥ || 35 || tāḥ savatsā ānayadhvaṃ veṃkaṭādrisamīpataḥ || ityājñāpya nṛpo gopāñchvo yātreti ca mantriṇaḥ || 36 || visṛjya prakṛtīḥ sarvā viveśāṃtaḥpuraṃ vaśī || uktvā kathāṃ tāṃ patnībhyaḥ suṣvāpa niśi pārthivaḥ || 37 || taṃ svapne śrīnivāso'pi bilamārgaṃ hyadarśayat || svapurādābilaṃ mārge pallavānasṛjaddhariḥ || 38 || evaṃ svapnaṃ nṛpo dṛṣṭvā prātarutthāya satvaraḥ || āhūya mantriṇaḥ sarvānprakṛtīrbrāhmaṇānapi || 39 || svapnaṃ tathāvidhaṃ coktvā'paśyaddvāre'tha pallavān || yukte muhūrte prayayau hayamāruhya toṇḍamān || 2.1.10.40 || paśyanpallavabhaṃgāṃśca śanaiḥ prīto yayau bilam || dṛṣṭvā vismayamāpanno nirmame tatra pattanam || || 41 || || atha bhagavaduktyā toṇḍamannṛpakṛtakṣīrābhiṣekavapranirmāṇādikam || || bilamaṃtaḥpure kṛtvā prākāraṃ cāpyakārayat || vasaṃstatra nṛpendro'sau nirjitya pṛthivīmimām|| 42 || yathoktaṃ devadevena kṣīraprakṣālanādikam || kṛtvā prākāranirmāṇaṃ kartumudyogamāyayau || 43 || tadānīṃ devadevena svayamājñāpito nṛpaḥ || tiṃtiṇīṃ caṃpakaṃ cobhau pālayaitau nagottamau || 44 || mama cāsthānikī ciṃcā lakṣmyāḥ sthānaṃ ca caṃpakaḥ || namaskāryau nṛpaistau hi ṛṣidevanaraiḥ sadā || 45 || saṃsthāpyaitau nṛpaśreṣṭha cchedayānyānnagottamān || prākāramātraṃ kuru me dvāragopurasaṃyutam || 46 || vimānaṃ tu bhavadvaṃśyo nāmnā nārāyaṇo nṛpaḥ || kārayiṣyati madbhaktaḥ svarṇenālaṃkariṣyati || 47 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || evamuktvā toṇḍamānaṃ virarāma śriyaḥ patiḥ || 48 || evaṃ devavacaḥ śrutvā kṛtvā prākārameva ca || pūjayāmāsa munibhirvaikhānasakulodbhavaiḥ || 49 || nityaṃ bilena cāgatya devaṃ natvā nṛpottamaḥ || rājyaṃ cakāra dharmeṇa bhuṃjāno bhogamuttamam || 2.1.10.50 || || atha gaṃgāsnānāgatavīraśarmākhyavipracaritram || || etasminneva kāle tu dākṣiṇātyo dvijottamaḥ || 51 || gaṃgāsnānāya gacchanvai sadāraḥ prayayau purāt || mārge'tha garbhiṇī jātā brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇaḥ sa ca || 52 || tāṃ tu garbhavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā svātmānugamane'kṣamām || rājānaṃ draṣṭukāmo'sau rājadvāramupāgamat || 53 || dvāḥsthenājñāpito rājā tamāhūya dvijottamam || pūjayitvā tu vidhivatpapraccha kuśalaṃ dvijam || 54 || || rājovāca || || kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ te kiṃ kariṣyāmyahaṃ dvija || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || vāsiṣṭho vīraśarmāhaṃ sāmavedī nṛpottama || 55 || sadāro nirgato rāktagaṃgāsnānāya sādaraḥ || mārge ca garbhiṇī ceyaṃ kauśikī puṇyaśālinī || 56 || nāmnā lakṣmīriti khyātā śīlā ca pativratā || saṃsthāpyaināṃ tava gṛhe vrataṃ nirvartayāmyaham || 57 || tasmādrājanprayacchāsyai yatheṣṭaṃ bhaktavetane || tāvacca rakṣyatāṃ lakṣmīryāvadāgamanaṃ mama || 58 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || rājā tasya vacaḥ śrutvā taṃḍulāni dhanānyapi || dattvā ṣaṇmāsaparyantaṃ gṛhamaṃtaḥpure dadau || 59 || tāṃ nyasya brāhmaṇaḥ prīto gaṃgāsnānāya niryayau || gatvā bhāgīrathīṃ gaṃgāṃ prayāge kṣetra uttame || 2.1.10.60 || snātvā kāśīṃ tato gatvā tatroṣitvā dinatrayam || gayāṃ prāpya pitṛśrāddhamakarodbrāhmaṇottamaḥ || 61 || gatvāyodhyāmapi purīṃ prayayau badarīvanam || sālagrāmaṃ tato gatvā svadeśaṃ prati niryayau || 62 || saṃvatsaradvaye'tīte caitre māsi śubhe dine || nivṛtto'sau dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ śanairāgatya mādhave || 63 || ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe punā rājānamāyayau || rājā tu vismṛtya tadā brāhmaṇīṃ nāsmarannṛpaḥ || 64 || brāhmaṇī māninī gehe mṛtā śuṣkā babhūva ha || vīraśarmā tato vipro gaṃgātoyakaraṃḍakam || 65 || vimucya bandhanaṃ tvekaṃ gaṃgāṃbhaḥkarakaṃ śubham || prādāya rājñe papraccha patnī kuśalinīti me || 66 || smṛtvātha rājā vipraṃ taṃ sthīyatāmiti cābravīt || antaḥpuraṃ tato gatvā tāmapaśyanmṛtāṃ gṛhe || 67 || anuktvā brahmaṇe tasmai praviśya bilamuttamam || śrīnṛsiṃhaṃ namaskṛtya punaḥ prāpya bilottamam || 68 || śrīnivāsaṃ yayau draṣṭuṃ śrībhūmisahitaṃ param || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasāyāṃtaṃ jugūhāte dharārame || 69 || praṇamantamavocattaṃ kimakāle nṛpāgataḥ|| nṛpo'vadatpraṇamyeśaṃ bhīto'tha brāhmaṇīṃ mṛtām || 2.1.10.70 || || atha asthisarovaramāhātmyam || || tacchrutvā devadevo'pi mā bhai rājandvijottamāt || āndolikāṃ tāmāropya strībhiḥ svābhiḥ samanvitām|| 71 || madālayātpūrvabhāge dvādaśyāṃ snāpaya prabho || asthināmni sarasyasminnapamṛtyunivāraṇe || 72 || prāptajīvā samaṃ strībhirbrāhmaṇena ca yokṣyate || śīghraṃ yāhi nṛpaśreṣṭha yathoktaṃ vacanaṃ kuru || 73 || iti devavacaḥ śrutvā prayayau svapuraṃ nṛpaḥ || āndolikāsu ramyāsu striya āropya tāmapi || 74 || brāhmaṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya draṣṭuṃ devaṃ yayau nṛpaḥ || asthikūṭasaraḥ prāpya snāpayāmāsa tāḥ striyaḥ || 75.|| tvagasthirūpā sā cāpi tābhiḥ kṣiptā sarovare || prāptajīvā yathāpūrvaṃ suvyaṃjitaśarīrajā || 76 || utthitā sarasaḥ snātvā rājñībhiḥ sahamaṃgalā || prāptā ca brāhmaṇaṃ prītā bhartāraṃ punarāgatam || 77 || rājā hariṃ pūjayitvā brāhmaṇāya dhanaṃ dadau || sahasraniṣkaparyaṃtaṃ vastrāṇi vividhāni ca || 78 || svadeśagamanāyaiva sādaraṃ visasarja ha || vipraḥ śrutvā striyo vṛttaṃ prabhāvaṃ veṃkaṭeśituḥ || 79 || āśīḥ prayujya rājñe'tha svadeśaṃ prayayau dvijaḥ || vipre gate śrīnivāso rājānaṃ punarabravīt || 2.1.10.80 || dinedine ca madhyāhne naivedyānetaraṃ nṛpa || āgatya māmarcayitvā yatheṣṭaṃ svarṇapaṃkajaiḥ || 81 || gatvā purīṃ svadharmeṇa rājyaṃ kuru narādhipa || yadyadiṣṭaṃ tava nṛpa bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 82 || nāgaṃtavyamakāle tu tvayā nṛpa kadācana || evaṃ kālārcanaṃ kṛtvā gatvā tvaṃ svapuraṃ vasa || 83 || || rājovāca || || tathā kariṣye deveśa madhyāhne cārcayāmyaham || iti devājñayā nityamarcayansvarṇapaṃkajaiḥ || 84 || tadūrdhvaṃ tulasīpuṣpaṃ jāttvapaśyatsa mṛṇmayam || 85 || || atha kurvagrāmasthakulālavaṃśajabhīmākhyabhaktodantaḥ || || vismito devadeveśamapṛcchannṛpasattamaḥ || || rājovāca || || kenārcyase mṛnmayaiśca kamalaistulasīsamaiḥ || 86 || rājñā pṛṣṭo devadevaḥ smṛtvā rājānamabravīt || kaścitkulālo madbhaktaḥ kurvagrāme vasatyasau || 87 || svagṛhe'rcayate rājaṃstadaṃgīkriyate mayā || iti devavacaḥ śrutvā taṃ draṣṭuṃ prayayau nṛpaḥ || 88 || gatvā kurvapuraṃ tasya kulālasya gṛhaṃ yayau || rājānamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyaivāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || 89 || sthitaṃ taṃ bhīmanāmānaṃ papraccha nṛpasattamaḥ || || || toṇḍamānuvāca || || bhīma pūjayase devaṃ kathaṃ vada kulottama || 2.1.10.90 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || pṛṣṭaḥ prāha kulālo'pi jātu jāne na cārcanam || kenoktaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭha kulālo'rcayatīti hi || 91 || || toṇḍamānuvāca || || devena śrīnivāsena mamoktaṃ hi tvadarcanam || sa tu śrutvā nṛpavacaḥ smṛtvā devavaraṃ purā || 92 || || bhīma uvāca || || yadā prakāśitā pūjā yadā rājā samāgataḥ || toṇḍamāṃstena saṃvādastadā mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasi || 93 || iti pūrvaṃ varaṃ devo dattavānvekaṭeśvaraḥ || 94 || || atha kurvagrāmasthabhīmākhyabhaktasya patnyā saha vaikuṇṭhaprāptiḥ || || ityuktvātha kulālo'pi patnyā sārdhaṃ tathaiva ca || vimānamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ dṛṣṭvā janārdanam||95|| praṇamanprajahau prāṇānsadāro bhaktasattamaḥ || paśyato rājarājasya vimānamadhiruhya ca ||96|| divyarūpadharo devyā sārdhaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ yayau || dṛṣṭvā rājādbhutaṃ tatra svapuraṃ prāpya harṣitaḥ || 97 || svaputraṃ śrīnivāsākhyamabhiṣicya vidhānataḥ || paripālaya dharmeṇa mānavāṃśca vasundharām || 98 || ityājñāpya sutaṃ dhīmāṃstatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ || tapyatastasya devo'pi pratyakṣamabhavaddhariḥ || 99 || || atha śrīnivāsakṛpayā toṇḍamannṛpasya sārūpyaprāptiḥ || || āruhya garuḍaṃ devo ramābhūmisamanvitaḥ || 2.1.10.100 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || kiṃ karomi nṛpaśreṣṭha tapasā toṣitastava || ityukto devadevena toṇḍamānapi rājarāṭ || 101 || prītimānprāñjalirbhūtvā sagadgadamuvāca ha || tvalloke vastumicchāmi jarāmaraṇavarjite || 102 || idameva varaṃ dehi mādhavaitanmamepsitam || 103 || || śrīvarāha uvāca || || ityuktvā nipapātorvyāṃ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ devasannidhau || tadā kalevaraṃ muktvā vimānaṃ tvāruroha ca || || 104 || gandharvaiḥ stūyamāno'sau sārūpyaṃ prāpya śārṅgiṇaḥ || yacchokamohahataṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 105 || punarāvṛttirahitaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ padamāyayau || 106 || || athaitanmāhātmyaśravaṇapaṭhanaphalaśrutiḥ || || etadbhaviṣyaṃ deveśi mayoktaṃ varavarṇini || yaḥ śrāvayedyaḥ śṛṇuyādviṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 107 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ityuktaṃ devadevena sabhaviṣyaṃ sahottaram || śṛṇuyādyaḥ paṭhedbhaktyā kathāṃ puṇyāṃ purātanīm || 108 || sa tu bhuktvākhilānkāmānante viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet || 109 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde bhaviṣyadvarṇane toṇḍamāṃścakravartivṛttavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha ||
<2.1.11>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || atha kāśyapasya svāmipuṣkariṇīsnānena mahāpātakanāśaḥ || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ śubhām|| lakṣīkṛtya kathāmekāṃ pavitrāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 1 || kāśyapākhyo dvijaḥ pūrvamasmiṃstīrthavare śubhe || snātvātimahataḥ pāpādvimukto narakapradāt || 2 || || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || mune kāśyapanāmāsāvakarotkiṃ hi pātakam || snātvā tīrthavare hyatra yasmānmukto'bhavatkṣaṇāt || 3 || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ brūhi sūta kṛpābalāt || tvadvaco'mṛtatṛptānāṃ na pipāsāpi vidyate || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śrīsvāmipuṣkariṇyāśca māhātmyapratipādakam|| itihāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi paṭhatāṃ pāpanāśanam || 5 || || atha parīkṣidvṛttāntaḥ || || abhimanyusuto rājā parīkṣinnāma nāmataḥ || adhyāsta hāstinapuraṃ pālayandharmato mahīm || 6 || sa rājā jātu vipine cacāra mṛgayārataḥ || ṣaṣṭivarṣavayā bhūpaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇāparipīḍitaḥ || 7 || naṣṭamekaṃ sa vipine mārgayanmṛgamādarāt || dhyānārūḍhaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha bhūpālakottamaḥ || 8 || mayā bāṇena vipine mṛgo viddho'dhunā mune || dṛṣṭaḥ sa kiṃ tvayā vidvanvidruto bhayakātaraḥ || 9 || samādhiniṣṭho maunitvānna kiṃcidapi so'bravīt || tato dhanuraṭanyā sa skandhe tasya mahāmuneḥ || 2.1.11.10 || nidhāya mṛtasarpaṃ tu kupitaḥ svapuraṃ yayau || munestasya sutaḥ kaścicchṛṃgīnāma babhūva vai || 11 || sakhā tasya kṛśākhyo'bhūcchṛṃgiṇo dvijasattamaḥ || sakhāyaṃ śṛṃgiṇaṃ prāha kṛśākhyaḥ sa sakhā tataḥ || 12 || pitā tava mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ skandhena vahate'dhunā || mā bhūddarpastava sakhe mā krudhyastvamidaṃ vṛthā || 13 || so'bhavatkupitaḥ śṛṃgī ditsuḥ śāpaṃ nṛpāya vai || mattāte śavasarpaṃ yo nyastavānmūḍhacetanaḥ || || 14 || sa saptarātrānmriyatāṃ saṃdaṣṭastakṣakāhinā || śaśāpaivaṃ munisutaḥ saubhadreyaṃ parīkṣitam || 15 || śamīkākhyaḥ pitā tasya śaptaṃ śrutvā sutena tam || nṛpaṃ provāca tanayaṃ śṛṅgiṇaṃ munipuṃgavaḥ || 16 || rakṣakaṃ sarvalokānāṃ nṛpaṃ kiṃ śaptavānasi || arājake vayaṃ loke sthāsyāmaḥ kathamañjasā || 17 || krodhena pātakaṃ bhūyāddayayā prāpyate sukham || yaḥ samutpāditaṃ kopaṃ kṣamayaiva nirasyati || 18 || iha loke paratrāsāvatyaṃtaṃ sukhamaśnute || kṣamāyuktā hi puruṣā labhaṃte śreya uttamam || 19 || tataḥ śamīkaḥ svaṃ śiṣyaṃ prāha gauramukhābhidham || bho gauramukha gatvā tvaṃ vada bhūpaṃ parīkṣitam || 2.1.11.20 || imaṃ śāpaṃ matsutoktaṃ takṣakādhipadaṃśanam || punarāyāhi śīghraṃ tvaṃ matsamīpaṃ mahāmate || 21 || evamuktaḥ śamīkena yayau gauramukho nṛpam || sametya cābravīdbhūpaṃ saubhadreyaṃ parīkṣitam || 22 || dṛṣṭvā sarpaṃ pituḥ skaṃdhe tvayā vinihitaṃ mṛtam || śamīkasya sutaḥ śṛṅgī śaśāpa tvāṃ ruṣānvitaḥ || 23 || etaddinātsaptame'hni takṣakeṇa mahāhinā || daṣṭo viṣāgninā dagdho bhūyādāśvabhimanyujaḥ || 24 || evaṃ śaśāpa tvāṃ rājañchṛṃgī tasya muneḥ sutaḥ || etadvaktuṃ pitā tasya prāhiṇonmāṃ tvadaṃtikam || 25 || itīrayitvā taṃ bhūpamāśu gauramukho yayau || gate gauramukhe paścādrājā śokaparāyaṇaḥ || 26 || abhraṃlihamathottuṅgamekastaṃbhaṃ suvistṛtam || madhye gaṅgaṃ vyatanuta maṇḍapaṃ nṛpapuṅgavaḥ || 27 ||
