mahāgāruḍamantrajñairoṣadhijñaiścikitsakaiḥ || takṣakasya viṣaṃ hantuṃ yatnaṃ kurvansamāhitaḥ || 28 || anekadevabrahmarṣirājarṣipravarānvitaḥ || āste tasminnṛpastuṅge maṇḍape viṣṇubhaktimān || 29 || tasminnavasare vipraḥ kāśyapo māntrikottamaḥ || rājānaṃ rakṣituṃ prāyāttakṣakasya mahāviṣāt || || 2.1.11.30 || saptame'hani viprendro daridro dhanakāmukaḥ || atrāṃtare takṣako'pi viprarūpī samāyayau || 31 || madhyemārgaṃ vilokyātha kāśyapaṃ pratyabhāṣata || brāhmaṇa tvaṃ kutra yāsi vada me'dya mahāmune || 32 || iti pṛṣṭastadā'vādītkāśyapastakṣakaṃ dvijaḥ || parīkṣitaṃ mahārājaṃ takṣako'dya viṣāgninā || 33 || dhakṣyate taṃ śamayituṃ tatsamīpamupaimyaham || ityuktaḥ sa ca taṃ vipraṃ takṣakaḥ punarabravīt || 34 || takṣako'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭha mayā daṣṭaścikitsitum || na śakyobdaśatenā'pi mahāmantrāyutairapi || 35 || cikitsituṃ cenmaddaṣṭaṃ śaktirasti tavādhunā || anekayojanocchrāyaṃ daśāmyujjīvaya drumam|| 36 || tato bhavānsamartho hītyevaṃ me bhāti he dvija || itīrayitvā taṃ vṛkṣamadaśattakṣakastadā || 37 || abhavadbhasmasātso'pi vṛkṣotyantasamucchritaḥ || pūrvameva naraḥ kaścittaṃ vṛkṣamadhirūḍhavān || 38 || takṣakasya viṣolkābhiḥ so'pi dagdho'bhavattadā || tannaraṃ na vijajñāte tau ca kāśyapatakṣakau || 39 || kāśyapaḥ pratijajñe'tha takṣakasyāpi śṛṇvataḥ || manmantraśaktiṃ paśyantu sarve viprādayo'dhunā || 2.1.11.40 || itīrayitvā taṃ vṛkṣaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ viṣāgninā || ājīvayanmantraśaktyā kāśyapo māntrikottamaḥ || 41 || sa narastena vṛkṣeṇa sākamujjīvito'bhavat || athābravīttakṣakastaṃ kāśyapaṃ mantrakovidam || 42 || yathā na munivāṅmithyā bhavedevaṃ kuru dvija || yatte rājā dhanaṃ dadyāttato'pi dviguṇaṃ dhanam || 43 || dadāmyahaṃ nivartasva śīghrameva dvijottama || ityuktvānargharatnāni tasmai dattvā sa takṣakaḥ || 44 || nyavartayatkāśyapaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ mantrakovidam || alpāyuṣaṃ nṛpaṃ matvā jñānadṛṣṭyā sa kāśyapaḥ || 45 || svāśramaṃ prayayau tūṣṇīṃ labdharatnaśca takṣakāt || so'bravīttakṣakaḥ sarpānsarvānāhūya tatkṣaṇe || 46 || yūyaṃ taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya munīnāṃ veṣadhāriṇaḥ || upahāraphalānyāśu prayacchata parīkṣite || 47 || tathetyuktvā sarvasarpā dadū rājñe phalānyamī || takṣako'pi tathā tatra kasmiṃścidbadarīphale || 48 || kṛmiveṣadharo bhūtvā vyatiṣṭhaddaṃśituṃ nṛpam || atha rājā pradattāni sarvairbrāhmaṇarūpakaiḥ || 49 || parīkṣinmantrivṛddhebhyo dattvā sarvaphalānyapi || 2.1.11.50 || kautūhalena jagrāha sthūlamekaṃ kare phalam || tasminnavasare sūryo'pyastācalamagāhata || 51 || mithyā ṛṣivaco mābhūditi tatratyamānavāḥ || anyo'nyamavadansarve brāhmaṇāśca nṛpāstadā || 52 || evaṃ vadatsu sarveṣu phale tasminnadṛśyata || sādhu raktaḥ kṛmiḥ sarvai rājñā cāpi parīkṣitā || 53 || ayaṃ kiṃ māṃ daśedadya krimirityuktavānnṛpaḥ || nidadhe tatphalaṃ kaṇṭhe sakṛmi dvijasattamāḥ || 54 || takṣako'sminsthitaḥ kaṇṭhe kṛmirūpī phale tadā || nirgatya tatphalādāśu nṛpadehamaveṣṭayat || 55 || takṣakāveṣṭite bhūpe pārśvasthā dudruvurbhayāt || anantaraṃ nṛpo viprāstakṣakasya viṣāgninā || 56 || dagdhobhūdbhasmasādāśu saprāsādo balīyasā || kṛtvaurdhvadehikaṃ tasya nṛpasya sapurohitāḥ || 57 || maṃtriṇastatsutaṃ rājye janamejayanāmakam || rājānamabhyaṣiñcanvai jagadrakṣaṇavācchayā || 58 || takṣakādrakṣituṃ bhūpamāyātaḥ kāśyapābhidhaḥ || yo brāhmaṇo muniśreṣṭhaḥ sa sarvairniṃdito janaiḥ || 59 || babhrāma sakalāndeśāñchiṣṭaiḥ sarvaiśca dūṣitaḥ || avasthānaṃ na lebhe sa grāme vāpyāśrame'pi vā || 2.1.11.60 || yānyāndeśānasau yātastatra tatra mahājanaiḥ || tattaddeśānnirastaḥ sañchākalyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || 61 || praṇamya śākalyamuniṃ kāśyapo nindito janaiḥ || idaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa śākalyāya mahātmane|| || 62|| || kāśyapa uvāca || || bhagavansarvadharmajña śākalya harivallabha || munayo brāhmaṇāścānye māṃ nindaṃti suhṛjjanāḥ || 63 || nāsyāhaṃ kāraṇaṃ jāne kiṃ māṃ nindaṃti mānavāḥ || brahmahatyā surāpānagurustrīgamanaṃ tathā || 64 || steyaṃ saṃsargadoṣo vā mayā nācaritaṃ kvacit || anyānyapi ca pāpāni na kṛtāni mayā mune || 65 || tathā'pi nindaṃti janā vṛthā māṃ bāndhavādayaḥ || jānāsi cettvaṃ śākalya mayā doṣaṃ kṛtaṃ vada || || 66 || ukto'tha kāśyapenaiva śākalyākhyo mahāmuniḥ || kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā babhāṣe taṃ kāśyapaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 67 || atha śākalyoktadharmāḥ || || śākalya uvāca || || parīkṣitaṃ mahārājaṃ takṣakādrakṣituṃ bhavān || āyāsīdardhamārge tu takṣakeṇa nivāritaḥ || 68 || cikitsituṃ samartho'pi viṣarogādipīḍitam || yo na rakṣati lokesmiṃstamāhurbrahmaghātakam || 69 || krodhātkāmādbhayāllobhānmātsaryānmohato'pi vā || yo na rakṣati vipreṃdra viṣarogāturaṃ naram || 2.1.11.70 || brahmahā ca surāpī vā steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ || saṃsargadoṣaduṣṭaśca nāpi tasya viniṣkṛtiḥ || 71 || kanyāvikrayiṇaścāpi hayavikrayiṇastathā || kṛtaghnasyā'pi śāstreṣu prāyaścittaṃ tu vidyate || 72 || viṣarogāturaṃ yastu samartho'pi na rakṣati || na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ proktā prāyaścittāyutairapi || 73 || na tena saha paṅktau ca bhuñjīta sukṛtī janaḥ || na tena saha bhāṣeta na paśyettaṃ naraṃ kvacit || 74 || tatsaṃbhāṣaṇamātreṇa mahāpātakabhāgbhavet || parīkṣitsa mahārājaḥ puṇyaślokaśca dhārmikaḥ || 75 || viṣṇubhakto mahāyogī cāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā || vyāsaputrāddharikathāṃ śrutavānbhaktipūrvakam || 76 || arakṣitvā nṛpaṃ taṃ tu vacasā takṣakasya yat || nivṛttastena viprendrairbāndhavairapi dūṣyase || 77 || sa parīkṣinmahārājo yadyapi kṣaṇajīvitaḥ || tathāpi yāvanmaraṇaṃ budhaiḥ kāryaṃ cikitsitam ||78|| yāvatkaṇṭhagatāḥ prāṇā mumūṣormānavasya hi || tāvaccikitsā kartavyā kālasya kuṭilā gatiḥ || 79 || iti prāhuḥ purā ślokaṃ bhiṣagvidyābdhipāragāḥ || tataścikitsāśakto'pi yasmādakṛtabheṣajaḥ || 2.1.11.80 || ardhamārge nivṛttaśca tena tvaṃ garhito hyasi || śākalyenaivamuditaḥ kāśyapaḥ pratyabhāṣata || 81 || || kāśyapa uvāca || || mamaitaddoṣaśāṃtyarthamupāyaṃ vada suvrata || yena māṃ pratigṛhṇīyurbāndhavāḥ sasuhṛjjanāḥ || 82 || kṛpāṃ mayi kuruṣva tvaṃ śākalya harivallabha || kāśyapenaivamuktastu śākalyo'pi munīśvaraḥ || 83 || kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā jagādaivaṃ kāśyapaṃ kṛpayā tadā || 84 || || śākalya uvāca || asya pāpasya śāntyarthamupāyaṃ pravadāmi te || tatkartavyaṃ tvayā śīghraṃ vilambaṃ mā kṛthā dvija || 85 || suvarṇamukharītīre lakṣmīpatinivāsabhūḥ || veṃkaṭādririti khyātaḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ || 86 || tasmiñcheṣagirau puṇye surāsuranamaskṛte || brahmahatyāsurāpānasvarṇasteyādināśake || 87 || svāmipuṣkariṇī ceti sarvapāpāpanodinī || uttare śrīnivāsasya vartate maṃgalapradā|| 88 || taṃ gatvā veṃkaṭaṃ śailaṃ svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ śubhām || snātvā saṃkalpapūrvaṃ tu varāhasvāminaṃ harim || 89 || sevitvā paścime tīre nirgatya harimandiram || gatvā tatra vidhānena svarṇācalanivāsinam || 2.1.11.90 || śrīnivāsaṃ paraṃ devaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam|| śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 91 || dṛṣṭvā nirdhūtapāpo'si saṃśayaṃ mā kṛthā dvija || śākalyenaivamuktastu kāśyapo munipuṃgavaḥ || 92 || gatvā veṃkaṭaśailendraṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam || puṣkariṇyāṃ śubhāyāṃ tu snāto niyamapūrvakam || 93 || svastho'bhūtkāśyapo vipro bhiṣagvidyābdhipāragaḥ || sarve baṃdhujanā viprāḥ kāśyapaṃ brāhmaṇottamam || 94 || pūjayitvā vidhānena pūjyo'si na ca saṃśayaḥ || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā veṃkaṭācalavaibhavam || 95 || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 96 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṃḍe śrīveṅkaṭācalasthasvāmipuṣkariṇīmāhātmye kāśyapadoṣanivṛttirnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<2.1.12>
|| atha svāmipuṣkariṇī snānāttāmisrādinarakanistāraḥ || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta sarvārthatattvajña vedavedāṃgapāraga || śrīsvāmipuṣkariṇyāśca vaibhavaṃ vada naḥ prabho || || 1 || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa muktaḥ syānmānavo bhuvi || 2 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || svāmitīrthaṃ praśaṃsanti snāṃti vā kathayaṃti ye || aṣṭāviṃśatibhedāṃste narakānnopabhuñjate || 3 || tāmisramandhatāmisraṃ mahārauravarauravau || kumbhīpākaṃ kālasūtramasipatravanaṃ tathā || 4 || kṛmibhakṣo'ndhakūpaśca saṃdaṃśaḥ śālmalī tathā || lālābhakṣo hyavīciśca sārameyādanaṃ tathā || 5 || tathaiva vajrakaṇakaḥ kṣārakardamapātanam || rakṣogaṇāśanaṃ cāpi śūlaprotanirodhanam|| 6 || tirodhānābhidhaṃ viprāstathā sūcīmukhābhidham || pūyaśoṇitabhakṣaṃ ca viṣāgniparipīḍanam || 7 || aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyātametannarakasaṃcayam|| na yāti manujo viprāḥ svāmitīrthanimajjanāt || 8 || vittāpatyakalatrāṇāṃ yo'nyeṣāmapahārakaḥ || sa kālapāśabaddho'yaṃ yamadūtairbhayānakaiḥ || 9 || tāmisre narake ghore pātyate bahuvatsaram || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe sa tasminnāsau nipātyate || 2.1.12.10 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ viprānyo dveṣṭi puruṣādhamaḥ || sa kālasūtranarake vistṛtāyutayojane || 11 || adhastādagnisantapte uparyarkamarīcibhiḥ || khale tāmramaye viprāḥ pātyate kṣudhayārditaḥ || 12 || snāti cetpuṣkariṇyāṃ vai tasminnā'sau nipātyate || yo vedamārgamullaṃghya vartate kupathe naraḥ || 13 || so'sipatravane ghore pātyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe tu tasminnā'sau nipātyate || 14 || yo'śnāti paṃktibhedena pakvaṃ sūpādikaṃ naraḥ || akṛtvā paṃcayajñānvā bhuṃkte mohena sa dvijāḥ || 15 || pātyate'yaṃ yamabhaṭairnarake kṛmibhojane || bhakṣyamāṇaḥ kṛmiśatairbhakṣayankṛmisaṃcayān || 16 || svayaṃ ca kṛmibhūtaḥ saṃstiṣṭhedyāvadaghakṣayam || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe vai tasminnā'sau nipātyate || 17 || yo haredvipravittāni snehena balato'pi vā || anyeṣāmapi vittāni rājā tatpuruṣo'pi vā || 18 || ayomayāgnikuṃḍeṣu saṃdaṃśaiḥ so'pi pīḍitaḥ || saṃdaṃśe narake ghore pātyate yamapūruṣaiḥ || 19 || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe tu tasminnāsau nipātyate || agamyāṃ yobhigaccheta striyaṃ vai puruṣādhamaḥ || 2.1.12.20 || agamyaṃ puruṣaṃ yoṣidabhigaccheta vā dvijāḥ || tāvayomayanārīṃ ca puruṣaṃ cāpyayomayam || 21 || taptāvāliṅgya tiṣṭhantau yāvaccandradivākaram || sūcyākhye narake ghore pātyete yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 22 || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe ca tasminnāsau nipāpyate || bādhate sarvajantūnyo nānopāyairupadravaiḥ || 23 || śālmalīnarake ghore pātyate bahukaṇṭake || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe tu tasminnāsau nipātyate || 24 || rājā vā rājabhṛtyo vā yaḥ pāṣaṇḍamanudrutaḥ || bhedako dharmasetūnāṃ vaitaraṇyāṃ nipātyate || 25 || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe tu tasminnāsau nipātyate || vṛṣalīsaṅgaduṣṭo vā śaucādyācāravarjitaḥ || 26 || tyaktalajjastyaktavedaḥ paśucaryārataḥ sadā || sa pūyaviṣṭhāmūtrāsṛkchleṣmapittādipūrite || 27 || atibībhatsanarake pātyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe tu tasminnāsau nipātyate || 28 || yaḥ śvabhirmṛgayurvanyānbāṇairvā bādhate mṛgān || sa vidhyamāno bāṇaughaiḥ paratra yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 29 || prāṇarodhākhyanarake pātyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe tu tasminnāsau nipātyate|| 2.1.12.30 || dāmbhiko yaḥ paśūnyajñe vidhyanuṣṭhānavarjitaḥ || hantyasau paralokeṣu vaiśase narake dvijāḥ ||31|| kartyamāno yamabhaṭaiḥ pātyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || snāti cetpuṣkariṇyāṃ vai tasminnāsau nipātyate ||32|| ātmabhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ yo retaḥ pāyayate yadi || paratra retaḥpāyī sa retaḥkuṇḍe nipātyate || 33 || snāti cetpuṣkariṇyāṃ vai tasminnāsau nipātyate || yo dasyurmārgamāśritya garado grāmadāhakaḥ || || 34 || vaṇigdravyāpahārī ca sa paratra dvijottamāḥ || vajradaṃṣṭrābhidhe ghore pātyate narake ciram || 35 || snāti cetsvāmitīrthe tu tasminnāsau nipātyate || vidyante yāni cānyāni narakāṇi paratra vai || 36 || tāni nāpnoti manujaḥ svāmitīrthanimajjanāt || puṣkariṇyāṃ sakṛtsnānādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 37 || ātmavidyā bhavetsākṣānmuktiścāpi caturvidhā || na pāpe ramate buddhirna bhaveduḥkhameva vā || 38 || tulāpuruṣadānena yatphalaṃ labhyate naraiḥ || tatphalaṃ labhyate pumbhiḥ svāmitīrthanimajjanāt || 39 || gosahasrapradānena yatpuṇyaṃ hi bhavennṛṇām || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyaḥ svāmitīrthanimajanāt || 2.1.12.40 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yaṃ yamicchati pūruṣaḥ || taṃ taṃ sadyaḥ samāpnoti svāmitīrthanimajjanāt || 41 || mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ || sadyaḥ pūto bhavedviprāḥ svāmitīrthanimajjanāt || 42 || prajñā lakṣmīryaśaḥ saṃpajjñānaṃ dharmo viraktatā || manaḥśuddhirbhavennṛṇāṃ svāmitīrthaniṣevaṇāt || 43 || brahmahatyā'yutaṃ cāpi surāpānāyutaṃ tathā || ayutaṃ gurudārāṇāṃ gamanaṃ pāpakāriṇām || || 44 || steyāyutaṃ suvarṇānāṃ tatsaṃsargāśca koṭiśaḥ || śīghraṃ vilayamāyānti svāmitīrthanimajjanāt || 45 || brahmahatyāsamānāni surāpānasamāni ca || gurustrīgamanenāpi yāni tulyāni cāstikāḥ || 46 || suvarṇasteyatulyāni tatsaṃsargasamāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti svāmitīrthanimajjanāt || 47 || || atha svāmitīrthamahimāśraddhālūnāṃ mahānarakaprāptiḥ || || ukteṣveteṣu sandeho na karttavyaḥ kadācana || jihvāgre paraśuṃ taptaṃ prakṣipaṃti ca kiṃkarāḥ || 48 || arthavādamimaṃ sarvaṃ bruvanvai narakaṃ vrajet || sūkaraḥ sa hi vijñeyaḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 49 || aho maurkhyamaho maurkhyamaho maurkhyaṃ dvijottamāḥ || svāmitīrthābhidhe tīrthe sarvapātakanāśane || 2.1.12.50 || advaitajñānade puṃsāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyini || iṣṭakāmaprade nityaṃ tathaivājñānanāśane || 51 || sthite'pi tadvihāyāyaṃ ramatenyatra vai janaḥ || aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || 52 || snātasya svāmitīrthe tu nāntakādbhayamasti vai || svāmitīrthaṃ ca paśyaṃti tatra snāṃti ca ye narāḥ || 53 || stuvanti ca praśaṃsaṃti spṛśaṃti ca namanti ca || na pibanti hi te stanyaṃ mātṝṇāṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 54 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ svāmitīrthasya vaibhavam || bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvapāpanibarhaṇam ||55|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye śrī svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthamahimānuvarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<2.1.13>
|| atha dharmaguptacaritravarṇanam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || bhūyopi saṃpravakṣyāmi svāmitīrthasya vaibhavam || yuṣmākamādareṇā'haṃ naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || 1 || nandonāma mahārājaḥ somavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa sāgarāntāṃ dharāmimām || 2 || tasya putraḥ samabhavaddharmagupta iti smṛtaḥ || rājyarakṣādhuraṃ nando nijaputre nidhāya saḥ || 3 || jiteṃdriyo jitāhāraḥ praviveśa tapovanam || tāte tapovanaṃ yāte dharmaguptābhidho nṛpaḥ || 4 || medinīṃ pālayāmāsa dharmajño nītitatparaḥ || īje vahuvidhairyajñairdevānindra purogamān || 5 || brāhmaṇānāṃ dadau vittaṃ kṣetrāṇi ca bahūni saḥ || sarve svadharmaniratāstasminrājani śāsati ||6|| kadācinnābhavanpīḍāstasmiṃścorādisaṃbhavāḥ || kadāciddharmagupto'yamāruhya turagottamam || 7 || vanaṃ viveśa vipreṃdrā mṛgayārasakautukī || tamālatālahintālakuravākuladiṅmukhe || 8 || vicacāra vane tasminsiṃsahavyāghrabhayānake || mattālikulasannādasaṃmūrcchitadigantare || 9 || padmakalhārakumudanīlotpalavanākule || taṭāke rasasaṃpūrṇe tapasvijanamaṇḍite || 2.1.13.10 || tasminvane sañcarato dharmaguptasya bhūpateḥ || abhūdvibhāvarī viprāstamasāvṛtadiṅmukhā || 11 || rājā'pi paścimāṃ sandhyāmupāsya vinayānvitaḥ || jajāpa ca vane tatra gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram || 12 || siṃhavyāghrādibhītyāsminvṛkṣamekaṃ samāśrite || rājaputre tadabhyāśamṛkṣaḥ siṃhabhayārditaḥ || 13 || anvadhāvata vṛkṣaṃ tamekaḥ siṃho vanecaraḥ || anudrutaḥ sa siṃhena ṛkṣo vṛkṣamupāruhat || 14 || āruhya ṛkṣo vṛkṣaṃ taṃ dadarśa jagatīpatim || vṛkṣasthitaṃ mahātmānaṃ mahābalaparākramam || 15 || uvāca bhūpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛkṣoyaṃ vanagocaraḥ || mā bhītiṃ kuru rājeṃdra vatsyāvo rajanīmiha || 16 || mahāsattvo mahākāyo mahādaṃṣṭrasamākulaḥ || vṛkṣamūlaṃ samāyātaḥ siṃho'yamatibhīṣaṇaḥ || 17 || rātryardhaṃ bhaja nidrāṃ tvaṃ rakṣyamāṇo mayodyataḥ || tataḥ prasuptaṃ māṃ rakṣa śarvaryardhaṃ mahāmate || 18 || iti tadvākyamākarṇya supte nandasute hariḥ || provāca ṛkṣaṃ supto'yaṃ nṛpo me tyajyatāmiti || 19 || taṃ siṃhamabravīdṛkṣo dharmajño dvijasattamāḥ || bhavāndharmaṃ na jānīte mṛgarāja vanecara || 2.1.13.20 || viśvāsaghātināṃ loke mahākaṣṭaṃ bhavatyaho || na hi mitradruhāṃ pāpaṃ naśyedyajñāyutairapi || 21 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ kathañcinniṣkṛtirbhavet || viśvāsaghātināṃ pāpaṃ na naśyejjanmakoṭibhiḥ || 22 || nāhaṃ meruṃ mahābhāraṃ manye pañcāsya bhūtale || mahābhāramimaṃ manye lokaviśvāsaghātakam || 23 || evamukto'tha ṛkṣeṇa siṃhastūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha || dharmagupte prabuddhe tu ṛkṣaḥ suṣvāpa bhūruhe || 24 || tataḥ siṃho'bravīdbhūpamenamṛkṣaṃ tyajasva me || evamukto'tha siṃhena rājā suptamaśaṃkitaḥ || 25 || svāṃkanyastaśiraskaṃ tamṛkṣaṃ tatyāja bhūtale || pātyamānastato rājñā samālambitapādapaḥ || 26 || ṛkṣaḥ puṇyavaśādvṛkṣānna papāta mahītale || sa ṛkṣo nṛpamabhyetya kopādvākyamabhāṣata || 27 || kāmarūpadharo rājannahaṃ bhṛgukulodbhavaḥ || dhyānakāṣṭhābhidho nāmnā ṛkṣarūpamadhārayam || 28 || kasmādanāgasaṃ suptamatyākṣīnmāṃ bhavānnṛpa || macchāpādatiśīghraṃ tvamunmattaścara bhūtale || 29 || iti śaptvā munirbhūpaṃ tataḥ siṃhamabhāṣata || na siṃhastvaṃ mahāyakṣaḥ kuberasacivaḥ purā || 2.1.13.30 || himavadgirimāsādya kadācittaṃ vadhūsakhaḥ || ajñānādgautamābhyāśe vihāramatanormudā || 31 || gautamo'pyuṭajāddaivātsamidāharaṇāya vai || nirgatastvāṃ vivasanaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāpamudāharat || 32 || yasmānmamāśrame'dya tvaṃ vivastraḥ sthitavānasi || ataḥ siṃhatvamadyaiva bhavitā te na saṃśayaḥ || 33 || iti gautamaśāpena siṃhatvamagamatpurā || kuberasacivo yakṣo bhadranāmā bhavānpurā || 34 || kubero dharmaśīlo hi tadbhṛtyāśca tathaiva hi || ataḥ kimarthaṃ tvaṃ haṃsi māmṛṣiṃ vanagocaram || 35 || etatsarvamahaṃ dhyānājjānāmi hi mṛgādhipa || ityukto dhyānakāṣṭhena tyaktvā siṃhatvamāśu saḥ || || 36 || yakṣarūpaṃ gato divyaṃ kuberasacivātmakam || dhyānakāṣṭhamasāvāha prāṃjaliḥ praṇato munim || 37 || adya jñātaṃ mayā sarvaṃ pūrvavṛttaṃ mahāmune || gautamaḥ śāpakāle me śāpāntamapi coktavān || 38 || dhyānakāṣṭhena saṃvāda ṛkṣarūpeṇa te yadā || tadā nirdhūya siṃhatvaṃ yakṣarūpamavāpsyasi || 39 || iti māmabravīdbrahmangautamo munipuṅgavaḥ || adya siṃhatvanāśānme jānāmi tvāṃ mahāmune || 2.1.13.40 || dhyānakāṣṭhābhidhaṃ śuddhaṃ kāmarūpadharaṃ sadā || ityuktvā taṃ praṇamyātha dhyānakāṣṭhaṃ sa yakṣarāṭ || 41 || vimānavaramāruhya prayayāvalakāpurīm || unmattarūpaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā mantriṇastu nṛpottamam|| || 42 || pituḥ sakāśamāninyū revātīre nṛpottamam || tasmai nivedayāmāsurmatibhraṃśaṃ sutasya ca || 43 || jñātvā tu putravṛttāntaṃ pitā vai naṃdanastadā || 44 || || atha jaiminivākyātsvāmitīrthasnātasya dharmaguptasyonmādanivṛttiḥ || || putramādāya sahasā jaiminerantikaṃ yayau || tasmai nivedayāmāsa putravṛttāntamāditaḥ || 45 || bhagavañjaimine putro mamādyonmattatāṃ gataḥ || asyonmādavināśāya brūhyupāyaṃ mahāmune || 46 || iti pṛṣṭaściraṃ dadhyau jaiminirmunipuṃgavaḥ || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ nṛpanandanamabravīt || 47 || dhyānakāṣṭhasya śāpena hyunmattaste suto'bhavat || tasya śāpasya mokṣārthamupāyaṃ prabravīmi te || 48 || suvarṇamukharītīre veṃkaṭenāma parvate || sarvapāpahare puṇye nānādhātuvinirmite || 49 || svāmipuṣkariṇī ceti tīrthamasti mahattaram || pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ hi maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam || 2.1.13.50 || śrutisiddhaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ brahmahatyādiśodhakam || nītvā tatra sutaṃ te'dya snāpayasva mahāmate || 51 || unmādastatkṣaṇādeva tasya naśyenna saṃśayaḥ || ityuktastaṃ praṇamyāsau jaiminiṃ munipuṃgavam || 52 || nandaḥ putraṃ samādāya svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ yayau || tatra ca snāpayāmāsa putraṃ niyamapūrvakam || 53 || snānamātrāttataḥ sadyo naṣṭonmādo'bhavatsutaḥ || svayaṃ sasnau sa nando'pi svāmipuṣkariṇījale || 54 || uṣitvā dinamekaṃ tu sahaputraḥ pitā tadā || sevitvā veṃkaṭeśaṃ ca śrīnivāsaṃ kṛpānidhim || 55 || putramāpṛcchya nandastaṃ prayayau tapase vanam || gate pitari putro'pi dharmagupto nṛpo dvijāḥ || 56 || pradadau veṃkaṭeśasya bahuvittāni bhaktitaḥ || brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ kṣetrāṇi ca dadau tadā || 57 || prayayau mantribhiḥ sārdhaṃ svāṃ purīṃ tadanantaram || dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam || 58 || pitṛpaitāmahaṃ viprā dharmaguptotidhārmikaḥ || unmādairapyapasmārairgrahairduṣṭaiśca ye narāḥ || 59 || grastā bhavanti viprendrāste'pi cātra nimajjanāt || puṣkariṇyāṃ vimuktāḥ syuḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 2.1.13.60 || svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ tyaktvā tīrthamanyadvrajettu yaḥ || snigdhaṃ sa gopayastyaktvā snuhīkṣīraṃ prayācate || 61 || svāmitīrthaṃ svāmitīrthaṃ svāmitīrthamiti dvijāḥ || triḥpaṭhanto narā evaṃ yatra kvāpi jalāśaye || 62 || snāṃti sarve narāste vai yāsyanti brahmaṇaḥ padam || evaṃ vaḥ kathitā viprā dharmaguptakathā śubhā || 63 || yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa brahmahatyā vinaśyati || || 64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhālye svāmipuṣkariṇīmahimānuvarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || cha ||
<2.1.14>
|| atha sumatyākhyadvijavṛttāntaḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || bhobhostapodhanāḥ sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || svāmitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ bhūyo'pi pravadāmyaham || 1 || purā kirātīsaṃsargātsumatirbrāhmaṇaḥ surām || pītavānpuṣkariṇyāṃ sa snātvā pāpādvimocitaḥ || 2 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sumatiḥ kasya putro'sau kathaṃ sa ca surāṃ papau || kathaṃ kirātyāsakto'bhūtsūta paurāṇikottama || 3 || sarveṣāṃ vistarādetadvada tvaṃ kṛpayādhunā || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || mahārāṣṭrābhidhe deśe brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidāstikaḥ || yajñadeva iti khyāto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || 5 || dayālurātitheyaśca śivanārāyaṇārcakaḥ || sumatirnāmaputro'bhūdyajñadevasya tasya vai || 6 || pitaraṃ sa parityajya bhāryāmapi pativratām || prayayāvutkale deśe viṭagoṣṭhīparāyaṇaḥ ||7|| kācitkirātī taddeśe vasantī yuvamohanī || yūnāṃ samastadravyāṇi pralobhya jagṛhe ciram ||8|| tasyā gṛhaṃ sa prayayau sumatirbrāhmaṇādhamaḥ || sumatiṃ sā ca jagrāha kirātī nirdhanaṃ dvijam || 9 || ||atha sumatyākhyadvijasya kirātīsaṅgānmahāpātakaprāptiḥ || tayā yukto'tha sumatistatsaṃyogaikatatparaḥ || itastataścorayitvā bahudravyāṇi santatam ||2.1.14.10|| dattvā tayā ciraṃ reme tadgṛhe bubhuje ca saḥ|| ekena caṣakeṇāsau tayā saha surāṃ papau || 11 || evaṃ sa bahukālaṃ vai ramamāṇastayā saha || pitarau nijapatnīṃ ca nāsmaradviṣayāturaḥ || 12 || sa kadācitkirātaistu cauryaṃ kartuṃ yayau saha || viprasya kasyacidgehe so'pi kairātaveṣabhṛt || 13 || yayau corayituṃ dravyaṃ sāhasī khaṅgahastavān || tadgṛhasvāminaṃ vipraṃ hatvā khaṅgena sāhasāt ||14|| samādāya bahu dravyaṃ kirātībhavanaṃ yayau || taṃ yāntamanuyāti sma brahmahatyā bhayaṃkarī || 15 || nīlavastradharā bhīmā bhṛśaṃ raktaśiroruhā || garjantī sāṭṭahāsaṃ sā kampayantī ca rodasī || 16 || anudrutastayā so'yaṃ babhrāma jagatītale || evaṃ bhramanbhuvaṃ sarvāṃ kadācitsumatiḥ svayam || 17 || svagrāmaṃ prayayau bhītyā viprabandhurdurātmavān|| anudrutastayā bhītaḥ prayayau svagṛhaṃ prati || 18 || brahmahatyāpyanudrutya tena sākaṃ gṛhaṃ yayau || pitaraṃ rakṣarakṣeti sumatiḥ śaraṇaṃ yayau || 19 || mā bhaiṣīriti taṃ procya pitā rakṣitumudyataḥ || tadānīṃ brahmahatyeyaṃ tattātaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 2.1.14.20|| || brahmahatyovāca|| || maiva tvaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva yajñadeva dvijottama || asau surāpī steyī ca brahmahā cātipātakī ||21|| mātṛdrohī pitṛdrohī bhāryātyāgī ca pātakī || kirātīsaṃgaduṣṭaśca hyenaṃ muṃca durātmakam || 22 || gṛhṇāsi cedimaṃ vipra mahāpātakinaṃ sutam || tvadbhāryāmasya bhāryāṃ ca tvāṃ ca putramimaṃ dvija || 23 || bhakṣayiṣyāmi vaṃśaṃ ca tasmānmuñca sutaṃ tvimam || imaṃ tyajasi cetputraṃ yuṣmānmucāṃmi sāṃpratam|| || 24 || naikasyārthe kulaṃ hantumarhasi tvaṃ mahāmate || ityuktaḥ sa tayā tatra yajñadevo'bravīcca tām || 25 || || yajñadeva uvāca || || bādhate māṃ sutasnehaḥ kathamenaṃ parityaje || brahmahatyā tadākarṇya dvijoktaṃ tamabhāṣata || 26 || || brahmahatyovāca || || ayaṃ hi patito bhūtvā varṇāśrama bahiṣkṛtaḥ || putresminmā kuru snehaṃ ninditaṃ cāsya darśanam || 27 || ityuktvā brahmahatyā sā yajñadevasya paśyataḥ || talena prajahārāsya putraṃ sumatināmakam || 28 || ruroda tātatāteti pitaraṃ prabruvanmuhuḥ || 29 || || atha sumatiṃ prati durvāsaḥ kathita brahmahatyāmuktyupāyaḥ || || ruru durjanako mātā bhāryāpi sumatestadā || etasminnaṃtare tatra durvāsāḥ śaṃkarāṃśakaḥ || 2.1.14.30 || diṣṭyā samāyayau yogī dhārmiko munisattamaḥ || yajñadevo'tha taṃ dṛṣṭvā muniṃ rudrāvatārakam|| 31 || stutvā praṇamya śaraṇaṃ yayāce putrakāraṇāt || durvāsāstvaṃ mahāyoginsākṣādvai śaṃkarāṃśakaḥ || || 32 || tvaddarśanamapuṇyānāṃ bhavitā na kadācana || brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī cābhūtsuto mama || 33 || enaṃ prahartumāyātā brahmahatyāpi vartate || syādyathā me putro'yaṃ mahāpātakamocitaḥ || 34 || ghorā ca brahmahatyeyaṃ yathā śīghraṃ layaṃ vrajet || tamupāyaṃ vadasvādya mama putre dayāṃ kuru || 35 || ayameva hi putro me nānyo'sti tanayo mune || asminmṛte tu vaṃśo me samucchidyeta mūlataḥ || 36 || tataḥ pitṛbhyaḥ piṇḍānāṃ dātāpi na bhaveddhruvam || tataḥ kṛpāṃ kuruṣva tvamasmāsu bhagavanmune || 37 || ityuktaḥ sa tadovāca durvāsāḥ śaṃkarāṃśakaḥ || dhyātvāthasuciraṃ kālaṃ yajñadevaṃ dvijottamam || 38 || || durvāsā uvāca || || yajñadevakṛtaṃ ṣāpamatidūra sutena te || nāsya pāpasya śātiḥ syātprāyaścittāyutairapi || || 39 || tathāpi te sutasyāhaṃ tasya pāpasya śāntaye || prāyaścittaṃ vadiṣyāmi śṛṇu nānyamanā dvija || 2.1.14.40 || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane || svāmipuṣkariṇī ceti vartate maṃgalapradā || 41 || || atha sumateḥ svāmipuṣkariṇīsnānādbrahmahatyā vimuktiḥ || || snāti cettava putro'yaṃ pātakānmucyate kṣaṇāt || evaṃ śrutvā munervākyaṃ yajñadevo mahāmatiḥ || 42 || putramādāya sumatiṃ svāmipuṣkariṇīṃgataḥ || snāpayāmāsa sumatiṃ hatyayā pīḍitaṃ sutam || 43 || ākāśavāṇī taṃ vipramuvāca madhurasvarā || yajñadeva mahābhāga snānenānena suvrata || 44 || pūto'bhavattava sutaḥ saṃśayaṃ mā kṛthā dvija || evaṃprabhāvaṃ tattīrthaṃ pāpavṛkṣakuṭhārakam || 45 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā itihāsaṃ purātanam|| śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ cāpi vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthamahimānuvarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<2.1.15>
|| atha rāmakṛṣṇatīrthamāhātmyam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || veṃkaṭākhye mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane || kṛṣṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 1 || yatra majjanamātreṇa kṛtaghno'pi vimucyate || pitṝnmātṝrgurūṃścāvamanyaṃte mohamohitāḥ || 2 || ye cāpyanye durātmānaḥ kṛtaghnā nirapatrapāḥ || te sarve kṛṣṇatīrthesmiñchuddhyanti snānamātrataḥ || 3 || kṛṣṇanāmā muniḥ pūrvaṃ veṃkaṭāhṛyabhūdhare || avartata tapaḥ kurvanviṣṇuṃ dhyāyansamāhitaḥ || 4 || sa tatra kalpayāmāsa snānārthaṃ tīrthamuttamam || tatra snātvā sakṛnmartyaḥ kṛtaghno'pi vimucyate || 5 || atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ pāpanāśanam || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa naro muktimavāpnuyāt|| 6 || purā babhūva viprendro rāmakṛṣṇo mahāmuniḥ || satyavāñchīlavānvāgmī sarvabhūtadayānvitaḥ || 7 || śatrumitrasamo dāntastapasvī vijiteṃdriyaḥ || pare brahmaṇi niṣṇāto brahmatattvaikasaṃśrayaḥ || 8 || evaṃprabhāvaḥ sa munistapastepe sudāruṇam || sa vai niścalasarvāṃgastiṣṭhansarvatra bhūtale || 9 || paramāṇvantaraṃ vāpi na svasthānāccacāla saḥ || sthitvā tatra tapasyaṃtamanekaśatavatsarān || 2.1.15.10 || taṃ cākramata valmīkaṃ chāditāṃgaṃ cakāra vai || valmīkākrāntadeho'pi rāmakṛṣṇo mahāmuniḥ ||11|| akarottapa evāsau valmīkaṃ na tvabudhyata || tasmiṃśca tapyati tapo vāsavo munipuṃgave|| 12 || visṛjya meghajālāni varṣayāmāsa vegavān || evaṃ dināni saptāyaṃ vavarṣa ca nirantaram || 13 || dhārāvarṣeṇa mahatā vṛṣyamāṇopi vai muniḥ || tadvarṣaṃ pratijagrāha nimīlitavilocanaḥ || 14 || mahatā stanitenāśu tadā badhirayanchrutīḥ || valmīkasyopariṣṭādvai nipapāta mahāśaniḥ || 15 || tasminvarṣati parjanye śītavātādiduḥsahe || 16 || || atha rāmakṛṣṇākhyamaharṣitapaḥprasannabhagavadāvirbhāvaḥ || || valmīkaśikharaṃ dhvastaṃ babhūvāśanitāḍitam|| tadāprādurabhūddevaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ || 17 || vinatānandanārūḍho vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || rāmakṛṣṇasya tapasā toṣito vākyamabravīt|| 18 || taponidhe rāmakṛṣṇa vedaśāstrārthapāraga || madāvirbhāvadivase yaḥ snāti manujottamaḥ || 19 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ śeṣeṇāpi na śakyate || makarasthe ravau vipra paurṇamāsyāṃ mahātithau || 2.1.15.20 || puṣyanakṣatrayuktāyāṃ snānakālo vidhīyate || taddine snāti yo martyaḥ kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ mahāmatiḥ || 21 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvānkāmām̐llabheta saḥ || madāvirbhāvadivase kṛṣṇatīrthajale śubhe || 22 || snātuṃ tatra samāyāṃti svapāpapariśuddhaye || devā manuṣyāḥ sarve ca dikpālāśca mahaujasaḥ || 23 || ete sarve mahātmānaḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhāḥ || te sarve kṛṣṇatīrthesminsnānātpūtā bhavaṃti hi || 24 || tvannāmnedaṃ mahātīrthaṃ loke prakhyātimeṣyati || ityuktvā śrīnivāsaśca tatraivāntaradhīyata || 25 || evaṃ prabhāvaṃ tattīrthaṃ mahāpāpaviśodhanam || buddhiśuddhipradaṃ pusāṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam || 26 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ kṛṣṇatīrthasya vaibhavam || śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ caiva viṣṇulokapradāyakam || 27 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye rāmakṛṣṇatīrthamahimānuvarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || || cha ||
<2.1.16>
|| atha śrīveṃkaṭādrau jaladānapraśaṃsā || || śrīsūta uvāca || || veṃkaṭākhye mahāpuṇye tṛṣārtānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || jaladānamakurvāṇastiryagyonimavāpnuyāt ||1|| tasmādveṃkaṭaśailendre yathāśaktyanusārataḥ || jaladānaṃ hi kartavyaṃ sarveṣāṃ jīvanaṃ mahat|| 2 || atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || viprasya gṛhagodhāyāḥ saṃvādaṃ paramādbhutam || 3 || || atha hemāṃgasya jaladānākaraṇena gṛhagodhikātvaprāptiḥ || || purā cekṣvākuvaṃśe'bhūddhemāṃga iti bhūmipaḥ || brahmaṇyo brahmabhūyiṣṭho jitāmitro jiteṃdriyaḥ ||4|| yāvanto bhūmikaṇikā yāvantastoyabindavaḥ || yāvantyuḍūni gagane tāvatīrgā dadātyasau || 5 || yeneṣṭayajñadarbhaiśca bhūmirbarhiṣmatī smṛtā || gobhūtilahiraṇyādyaistoṣitā bahavo dvijāḥ || 6 || tenādattāni dānāni na vidyanta iti śrutam || tenādattaṃ jalaṃ caikaṃ sukhalabhyadhiyā dvijāḥ || 7 || bodhito brahmaputreṇa vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā || amūlyaṃ sarvatolabhyaṃ taddātuḥ kiṃ phalaṃ labhet || 8 || iti durdhīrhetuvādairna jalaṃ dattavānvibhuḥ || alabhyadāne puṇyaṃ syādityavādītsayuktikam || 9 || sa ānarca dvijānvyaṅgāndaridrānvṛttikarśitān || nānarca śrotriyānviprānbrahmajñānbrahmavādinaḥ || 2.1.16.10 || prakhyātānpūjayiṣyanti sarvalokāḥ sahārhaṇaiḥ || anāthānāmavidyānāṃ vyaṅgānāṃ ca kuṭuṃbinām || 11 || daridrāṇāṃ gatiḥ kā vā tasmātte maddayāspadāḥ || iti duṣṭeṣu pātreṣu dattavānkimapi svakam || 12 || tena doṣeṇa mahatā cātakatvaṃ trijanmasu || ekajanmani gṛdhratvaṃ śvatvaṃ vā sapta janmasu || 13 || prāpya paścādgṛhe jāto bhūpo'yaṃ gṛhagodhikā || śrutakīrtestu bhūpasya mithilādhipaterdvijāḥ || 14 || gṛhadvārapratolyāṃ sma vartate kīṭakāśanaḥ || aṣṭāśītiṣu varṣeṣu sthitaṃ tena durātmanā || 15 || || atha śrutadevapādodakasevanena hemāṃgasya jātismaraṇam || || videhādhipatergehaṃ kadācidṛṣisattamaḥ || śrutadeva iti khyātaḥ śrānto madhyāhna āgamat || 16 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya jātaharṣo narādhipaḥ || madhuparkaḥ susaṃpūjya tasya pādāvanejanīḥ || 17 || apo mūrdhnāvahatkṣipraṃ tadotkṣiptaiśca bindubhiḥ || daivopadiṣṭakālena prokṣitā gṛhagodhikā || 18 || sadyo jātismṛtirabhūtkṛtakarmātiduḥkhitā || trāhi trāhīti cukrośa brāhmaṇaṃ gṛhamāgatam || 19 || tiryagjanturavaṃ śrutvā brāhmaṇo vismito'bhavat || kutaḥ krośasi godhe tvaṃ daśeyaṃ kena karmaṇā || 2.1.16.20 || upadevo'tha devo vā tvaṃ nṛpo'tha dvijottamaḥ || kastvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga tvāmadyāhaṃ samuddhare || 21 || ityuktaḥ sa nṛpaḥ prāha śrutadevaṃ mahāprabhuḥ || ahamikṣvākukulajaḥ śastravidyāviśāradaḥ || 22 || yāvanto bhūmikaṇikā yāvantastoyabindavaḥ || yāvantyuḍūni gagane tāvatīrgā adāmaham || 23 || sarvairyajñairmayā ceṣṭaṃ pūrtānyācaritāni me || dānānyapi ca dattāni dharmajātaṃ svanuṣṭhitam || || 24 || tathāpi durgatirjātā na me cordhvagatirvibho || trivāraṃ cātakatvaṃ me gṛdhratvaṃ caikajanmani ||25|| saptajanmasu ca śvatvaṃ prāptaṃ pūrvaṃ mayā dvija || dharatānena bhūpena cāpaḥ pādāvanejanīḥ || 26 || bindavo dūramutkṣiptāstaiḥ sikto'haṃ kathaṃcana || tadā janmasmṛtirabhūttena me hatapāpmanaḥ || 27 || godhājanmāni bhāvyānītyaṣṭāviṃśati me dvija || dṛśyante devadiṣṭāni bibhyate janmabhirbhṛśam || 28 || na kāraṇaṃ prapaśyāmi tanme vistarato vada || ityuktaḥ sa dvijaḥ prāha jñātaṃ vijñānacakṣuṣā || 29 || || atha śrutadevadattapuṇyena hemāṃgasya godhikātvavimuktiḥ || || śṛṇu bhūpa pravakṣyāmi tava durgatikāraṇam || na jalaṃ tu tvayā dattaṃ veṃkaṭāhvayabhūdhare || 2.1.16.30 || tajjalaṃ sulabhaṃ matvā na maulyamiti niścitaḥ || nādhvagānāṃ dvijādīnāṃ gharmakāle'pyajānatā || 31 || tathā pātraṃ samutsṛjya hyapātre pratipāditam || jvalantamagnimutsṛjya na hi bhasmani hūyate || 32 || tulasīṃ tu samutsṛjya bṛhatī pūjyate nu kim || anāthavyaṃgapaṃgutvaṃ na prayojakatāmiyāt || 33 || paṃgvādyā yepyanāthā hi dayāpātraṃ hi kevalam || taponiṣṭhā jñānaniṣṭhāḥ śrutiśāstraparāyaṇāḥ || 34 || viṣṇurūpāḥ sadā pūjyā netare tu kadācana || tatrāpi jñānino'tyarthaṃ priyā viṣṇoḥ sadaiva hi || 35 || jñānināmapi bhūpāla viṣṇureva sadā priyaḥ || tasmājjñānī sadā pūjyaḥ pūjyātpūjyataraḥ smṛtaḥ || 36 || na jalaṃ tu tvayā dattaṃ sādhavo vā na sevitāḥ || tena te durgatiśceyaṃ prāptā cekṣvākunandana || 37 || veṃkaṭādrau kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi śāntaye || bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavattena karmajātaṃ vijeṣyasi || 38 || ityuktvāpa upaspṛśya dadau puṇyamanuttamam || yaddattaṃ brāhmaṇenāpi snānaṃ caikadine kṛtam || 39 || tena dhvastākhilā''gāstu tyaktvā ca gṛhagodhikā || rūpaṃ karmocitaṃ ghoraṃ sadyo'dṛśyata pūruṣaḥ || 2.1.16.40 || divyaṃ vimānamārūḍho divyasragvastrabhūṣaṇaḥ || paśyatāmeva sādhūnāṃ maithilasya gṛhāntare || 41 || baddhāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā parikramya praṇamya ca || anujñāto yayau rājā stūyamāno'marairdivam || 42 || tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānvarṣāyutamatandritaḥ || sa eva cekṣvākukule kakutstho'bhūnmahārathaḥ || 43 || saptadvīpapratīpālo brahmaṇyaḥ sādhusaṃmataḥ || devendrasya samo viṣṇoraṃśa evaṃ mahāprabhuḥ || 44 || bodhitastu vasiṣṭhena sarvāndharmānmanoharān || anuṣṭhāyākhilānrājā tena dhvastāśubhādikaḥ || 45 || divyaṃ jñānaṃ samāsādya viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāptavān || tasmādveṃkaṭaśailendraḥ puṇyaḥ pāpavināśanaḥ || 46 || tasmiṃśca jaladānaṃ tu viṣṇulokapradāyakam || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā jaladānasya vaibhavam || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane || 47 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye jaladānavaibhavavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<2.1.17>
|| atha śrīveṃkaṭācalakṣetrādivarṇanam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || veṃkaṭādrestu māhātmyaṃ bhūyo'pi pravadāmyaham || yuṣmākaṃ sāvadhānena śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 1 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni brahmāṇḍāntargatāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi vartaṃte veṃkaṭāhvayabhūdhare || 2 || tasminnagottame puṇye vasantaṃ puruṣottamam || śaṃkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ śubham || 3 || kaustubhālaṃkṛtoraskaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || devadevaṃ viśālākṣaṃ vedavedyaṃ sanātanam || || 4 || aṃgakosalakarṇāṭakāśīgurjaradeśagāḥ || colakeralapāṇḍyādisarvadeśasamudbhavāḥ || 5 || sakuṭuṃbāśca sevārthamāyānti prativatsaram || devāśca ṛṣayaḥ siddhā yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ || 6 || ye bhādrapadamāse tu veṃkaṭeśamahotsave || sevāṃ kurvanti te sarve niṣpāpā uttamottamāḥ || 7 || tatra śrīveṃkaṭeśasya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || cakāra kanyāmāse tu dhvajāropamahotsavam || 8 || prativarṣaṃ ca tatsevā nimittaṃ sarvamānavāḥ || sarve devāśca gaṃdharvāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyā mahaujasaḥ || 9 || brahmotsave bhagavataḥ samāyāṃti dvijottamāḥ || vidyānāṃ vedavidyeva maṃtrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā || 2.1.17.10 || prāṇavatpriyavastūnāṃ dhenūnāṃ kāmadhenuvat || tathā veṃkaṭaśailendraḥ kṣetrāṇāmuttamottamaḥ || 11 || śeṣavatsarvanāgānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā || devānāṃ tu yathā viṣṇurvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā || 12 || tathā veṃkaṭaśailendraḥ kṣetrāṇāmuttamottamaḥ || bhūruhāṇāṃ suratarurbhāryeva suhṛdāṃ yathā || 13 || tīrthānāṃ tu yathā gaṃgā tejasāṃ tu raviryathā || tathā veṃkaṭaśailendraḥ kṣetrāṇāmuttamottamaḥ ||14|| āyudhānāṃ yathā vajraṃ lohānāṃ kāṃcanaṃ yathā || vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā rudro ratnānāṃ kaustubho yathā || 15 || tathā veṃkaṭaśailendraḥ kṣetrāṇāmuttamottamaḥ || nānena sadṛśo loke viṣṇuprītivivardhanaḥ || 16 || na mādhavasamo māso na kṛtena samaṃ yugam || na ca vedasamaṃ śāstraṃ na tīrthaṃ gaṃgayā samam || 17 || na jalena samaṃ dānaṃ na sukhaṃ bhāryayā samam|| na kṛṣestu samaṃ vittaṃ na lābho jīvitātparaḥ || 18 || na tapo'naśanādanyanna dānātparamaṃ sukham || na dharmastu dayātulyo na jyotiścakṣuṣā samam || 19 || na tṛptiraśanātulyā na vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣeḥ samam || na dharmeṇa samaṃ mitraṃ na satyena samaṃ yaśaḥ || || 2.1.17.20 || yathā tathā bhagavataḥ sthānena sadṛśaṃ na hi || 21 || yatkīrtanaṃ sakalapāpaharaṃ munīndrā yadvandanaṃ sakalasaukhyadameva loke || yātrāpi yaṃ prati surairapi pūjanīyā tādṛṅmahānbhavati veṃkaṭaśailamukhyaḥ || 22 || tasyānubhāvaṃ pravadāmi bhūyaḥ samastatīrthāni vasaṃti yatra || evaṃ samasteṣu ca mukhyatīrthaṃ śrīsvāmināmāsti sarovaraṃ tat || 23 || māhātmyametasya mayocyate kathaṃ yatpaścime rodhasi bhūvarāhaḥ || āliṃgya kāntāmatisaumyamūrtirvirājate viśvajanopakārī || 24 || śrīsvāmipuṣkariṇyāṃ ca dakṣiṇe veṃkaṭeśvaraḥ || āliṃgitavapurlakṣmyā varado vartate ciram || 25 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam || yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 26 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye kṣetramahimānuvarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<2.1.18>
|| atha śrīveṃkaṭeśvaravaibhavavarṇanam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || athedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi veṃkaṭeśvaravaibhavam || yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 || śrīveṃkaṭeśvaraṃ devaṃ yaḥ paśyati sakṛnnaraḥ || sa naro muktimāpnoti viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt || 2 || daśavarṣaistu yatpuṇyaṃ kriyate tu kṛte yuge || tretāyāmekavarṣeṇa tatpuṇyaṃ sādhyate nṛbhiḥ || 3 || dvāpare pañcamāsena taddinena kalau yuge || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ nimiṣenimiṣe nṛṇām || 4 || niḥsaṃdehaṃ bhavedevaṃ śrīnivāsavilokinām|| śrīveṃkaṭeśvare deve tīrthāni sakalānyapi || 5 || vidyante sarvadevāśca munayaḥ pitarastathā || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ sarvadaiva vā || 6 || ye smaranti mahādevaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ vimuktidam || kīrtayantyathavā viprāste muktāḥ pāpapañjarāt || 7 || nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ devaṃ veṃkaṭeśaṃ prayānti vai || pūjitaṃ śaṅkharājena saccidānaṃdavigraham || 8 || tasya smaraṇamātreṇa yamapīḍā'pi no bhavet || śrīnivāsaṃ mahādevaṃ ye'rcayaṃti sakṛnnarāḥ|| || 9 || kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ vrataisteṣāṃ kiṃ tapobhiḥ kimadhvaraiḥ || veṃkaṭeśaṃ paraṃ devaṃ yo na cintayati kṣaṇam || 2.1.18.10 || ajñānī sa ca pāpī syātsa mūko badhirastathā || sa jaḍo'ndhaśca vijñeyaśchidraṃ tasya sadā bhavet || 11 || śrīnivāse mahādeve sakṛddṛṣṭe munīśvarāḥ || kiṃ kāśyā gayayā caiva prayāgenāpi kiṃ phalam|| 12 || durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ mānavā iha bhūtale || veṃkaṭeśaṃ paraṃ devaṃ ye paśyantyarcayanti vā || 13 || janma teṣāṃ hi saphalaṃ te kṛtārthāśca netare || veṃkaṭeśe pare deve dṛṣṭe vā pūjite'pi vā || 14 || śambhunā brahmaṇā kiṃ vā śakreṇāpyakhilāmaraiḥ || veṃkaṭeśe mahādeve bhaktiyuktāśca ye narāḥ || 15 || teṣāṃ praṇāmasmaraṇapūjāyuktāstu ye narāḥ || na te paśyaṃti duḥkhāni naiva yāṃti yamālayam || 16 || brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi surāpānāyutāni ca || dṛṣṭe nārāyaṇe deve vilayaṃ yāṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ || 17 || ye vāñchaṃti sadā bhogaṃ rājyaṃ ca tridaśālaye || veṃkaṭādrinivāsaṃ te praṇamantu sakṛnmudā || 18 || yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmakoṭikṛtāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti veṃkaṭeśvaradarśanāt || 19 || saṃparkātkautukāllobhādbhayādvāpi ca saṃsmaran || veṃkaṭeśaṃ mahādevaṃ nehāmutra ca duḥkhabhāk || 2.1.18.20 || veṃkaṭācaladeveśaṃ kīrtayannarcayannapi || avaśyaṃ viṣṇusārūpyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 21 || yathaidhāṃsi samiddho'gnirbhasmasātkurute kṣaṇāt || tathā pāpāni sarvāṇi veṃkaṭeśvaradarśanam || 22 || veṃkaṭeśvaradevasya bhaktiraṣṭavidhā smṛtā || tadbhaktajanavātsalyaṃ tatpūjāparitoṣaṇam || 23 || svayaṃ tatpūjanaṃ bhaktyā tadarthe dehaceṣṭitam || tanmāhātmyakathāvāṃchāśravaṇeṣvādarastathā || 24 || svaranetraśarīreṣu vikārasphuraṇaṃ tathā || śrīnivāsasya devasya smaraṇaṃ satataṃ tathā || 25 || veṃkaṭādrinivāsaṃ tamāśrityaivopajīvanam|| evamaṣṭavidhā bhaktiryasminmlecche'pi vartate||26|| sa eva muktimāpnoti śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ|| bhaktyā tvananyayā muktirbrahmajñānena niścitā|| 27|| vedāntaśāstraśravaṇādyatīnāmūrdhvaretasām || sā ca muktirvinā jñānaṃ vedāntaśravaṇodbhavam|| yatyāśramaṃ vinā viprā viraktiṃ ca vinā tathā || 28 || sarveṣāṃ caiva varṇānāmakhilāśramiṇāmapi || vekaṭeśvaradevasya darśanādeva kevalam || 29 || apunarbhavadā muktirbhaviṣyatyavilaṃbitam || kṛmikīṭāśca devāśca munayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 2.1.18.30 || tulyā veṃkaṭaśailendre śrīnivāsaprasādataḥ || pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ mayānekamiti mā kriyatāṃ bhayam || 31 || mā garvaḥ kriyatāṃ puṇyaṃ mayā'kārīti vā janaiḥ || veṃkaṭeśe mahādeve śrīnivāse vilokite || 32 || na nyūnā nādhikāśca syuḥ kintu sarve mahājanāḥ|| veṃkaṭākhye mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane||33|| śrīnivāsaṃ paraṃ devaṃ yaḥ paśyati sabhaktikam|| na tena tulyatāmeti caturvedyāpi bhūtale||34|| veṃkaṭeśvaradeveśaṃ yaḥ pūjayati bhaktitaḥ|| sa koṭikulasaṃyuktaḥ prayāti harimaṃdiram||35|| śrīnivāsācca na samaṃ nādhikaṃ puṇyamasti vai || veṃkaṭādrinivāsaṃ taṃ dveṣṭi yo mohamāsthitaḥ || 36 || brahmahatyāyutaṃ tena kṛtaṃ narakakāraṇam || tatsaṃbhāṣaṇamātreṇa mānavo narakaṃ vrajet || 37 || śrīnivāsaparā vedāḥ śrīnivāsaparā makhāḥ || śrīnivāsaparāḥ sarve tasmādanyanna vidyate || 38 || anyatsarvaṃ parityajya śrīnivāsaṃ samāśrayet || sarvayajñatapodānatīrthasnāne tu yatphalam || 39 || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ śrīnivāsasya sevayā || veṃkaṭādrinivāsaṃ taṃ ciṃtayanghaṭikādvayam || 2.1.18.40 || kulaikaviṃśatiṃ dhṛtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe snānaṃ devasya darśanam || 41 || yadi labhyeta vai puṃsāṃ kiṃ gaṅgājalasevayā || vekaṭeśaṃ paraṃ devaṃ yaḥ kadāpi na paśyati || 42 || saṃkaraḥ sa tu vijñeyo na piturbījasaṃbhavaḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena veṃkaṭeśo dayānidhiḥ || 43 || draṣṭavyo'tiprayatnena paralokecchayā dvijāḥ || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā veṃkaṭeśasya vaibhavam || 44 || yastvetacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhate ca sabhaktikam || sa vai veṃkaṭanāthasya sevāphalamavāpnuyāt || 45 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye veṃkaṭeśvaravaibhavānuvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || ||
<2.1.19>
atha brahmādīnāṃ nairaṃtaryeṇa śrīveṃkaṭācale sthitivarṇanam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi veṃkaṭācalavaibhavam || yuṣmākaṃ sāvadhānena śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 1 || lakṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sarāṃsi saritastathā || samudrāśca mahāpuṇyā vanānyapyāśramā api || 2 || puṇyāni kṣetrajātāni vedāraṇyādikāni ca || munayaśca vasiṣṭhādyā siddhacāraṇakiṃnarāḥ || 3 || lakṣmyā saha dharaṇyā ca bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || sāvitryā ca sarasvatyā sahaiva caturānanaḥ || 4 || pārvatyā saha deveśastryambakastripurāṃtakaḥ || herambaṣaṇmukhādyāśca devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ || 5 || ādityādi grahāścaiva tathāṣṭavasavo dvijāḥ || pitaro lokapālāśca tathānye devatāgaṇāḥ || 6 || mahāpātakasaṃghānāṃ nāśane lokapāvane || divāniśaṃ vasantyaṃtarveṃkaṭācalamūrdhani || 7 || tasya darśanamātreṇa buddhisaukhyaṃ nṛṇāṃ bhavet || tanmūrdhani kṛtāvāsā siddhacāraṇayoṣitaḥ || 8 || pūjayaṃti sadākālaṃ veṃkaṭeśaṃ kṛpānidhim || koṭayo brahmahatyānāmagamyāgamakoṭayaḥ || 9 || aṅgalagnā vinaśyaṃti veṃkaṭācalamārutaiḥ || 2.1.19.10 || || atha śrīveṃkaṭācalārohaṇasamayānusaṃdhyānakramaḥ || || veṃkaṭādriṃ giriṃ taṃ tu prārthayetpuṇyavardhanam || svarṇācala mahāpuṇya sarvadevaniṣevita || 11 || brahmādayo'pi yaṃ devāḥ sevante śraddhayā saha || taṃ bhavantamahaṃ padbhyāmākrameyaṃ nagottama || 12 || kṣamasva tadaghaṃ me'dya dayayā pāpacetasaḥ || tvanmūrdhani kṛtāvāsaṃ mādhavaṃ darśayasva me || 13 || prārthayitvā narastvevaṃ veṃkaṭādriṃ nagottamam || tato mṛdupadaṃ gacchetpāvanaṃ veṃkaṭācalam || 14 || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane || svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe snātvā niyamapūrvakam || 15 || piṇḍadānaṃ tataḥ kuryādapi sarṣapamātrakam || śamīdalasamānānvā dadyātpiṃḍānpitṝnprati || 16 || svargasthā mokṣamāyāṃti svargaṃ narakavāsinaḥ || 17 || || atha pāpavināśanākhyatīrthamāhātmyam || || tatastasyopari mahatsarvalokeṣu viśrutam || sarvatīrthottamaṃ puṇyaṃ nāmnā pāpavināśanam || 18 || asti puṇyatame viprāḥ pavitre veṃkaṭācale || yasya saṃsmaraṇādeva garbhavāso na vidyate || 19 || tatprāpya tu naraḥ snāyātsvāmitīrthasya cottare || tatra snānānnarā yāṃti vaikuṇṭhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2.1.19.20 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta pāpavināśākhyatīrthasya brūhi vaibhavam || vyāsena bodhitastvaṃ hi vetsi sarvaṃ mahāmune || 21 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || brahmāśramapade vṛttāṃ pārśve himavataḥ śubhe || vakṣyāmi brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ tu kathāṃ śubhām || 22 || tadāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmāśramapadaṃ śubham|| nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇaṃ pārśve himavataḥ śubhe || 23 || bahugulmalatākīrṇaṃ mṛgadvipaniṣevitam || siddhacāraṇasaṃghuṣṭaṃ ramyaṃ puṣpitakānanam || || 24 || yatibhirbahubhiḥ kīrṇaṃ tāpasairupaśobhitam|| brāhmaṇaiśca mahābhāgaiḥ sūryajvalanasannibhaiḥ || 25 || niyamavratasampannaiḥ samākīrṇe tapasvibhiḥ || dīkṣitairyāgaśīlaiśca yatāhāraiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ||26|| vedādhyayanasaṃpannairvaidikaiḥ pariveṣṭitam || varṇibhiśca gṛhasthaiśca vānaprasthaiśca bhikṣubhiḥ || 27 || svāśramācāranirataiḥ svavarṇoktavidhāyibhiḥ || vālakhilyaiśca ṛṣibhiḥ samaṃtātpariveṣṭitam ||28 || || atha dṛḍhamatyākhyaśūdravṛttāntaḥ || || tatrāśrame purā kaścicchūdro dṛḍhamatirdvijāḥ || sāhasī brāhmaṇābhyāśamājagāma mudānvitaḥ || 29 || āgato hyāśramapadaṃ pūjitaśca tapasvibhiḥ || nāmnā dṛḍhamatiḥ śūdraḥ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇanāma vai || 2.1.19.30 || tānsa dṛṣṭvā munigaṇāndevakalpānmahaujasaḥ || kurvato vividhānyajñānsaṃprāśahṛṣyata śūdrakaḥ || 31 || athāsya buddhirabhavattapaḥ kartumanuttamam || tato'bravītkulapatiṃ munimāgatya tāpasam || 32 || || dṛḍhamatiruvāca|| || tapodhana namaste'stu rakṣa māṃ karuṇānidhe || tava prasādādicchāmi yāgaṃ kartuṃ prasīda me || 33 || || atha dṛḍhamatiṃ prati kulapatyākhyamunyupadiṣṭaśūdradharmāḥ || || evamuktastu śūdreṇa tamāha brāhmaṇastadā || 34 || || kulapatiruvāca || || yāge dīkṣayituṃ śakyo na śūdro hīnajanmabhāk || bhūyate yadi te buddhiḥ śuśrūṣā nirato bhava || 35 || upadeśo na kartavyo jātihīnasya karhicit || upadeśe mahāndoṣa upādhyāyasyavidyate || 36 || nādhyāpayedbudhaḥ śūdraṃ tathā naiva ca yājayet || na pāṭhayettathā śūdraṃ śāstraṃ vyākaraṇādikam || 37 || kāvyaṃ vā nāṭakaṃ vāpi tathālaṃkārameva vā || purāṇamitihāsaṃ ca śūdraṃ naiva tu pāṭhayet || 38 || yadi copadiśedvipraḥ śūdrasyaitāni karhicit || tyajeyurbrāhmaṇā vipraṃ te grāmādbrahmasaṃkulāt || 39 || śūdrāya copadeṣṭāraṃ dvijaṃ caṇḍālavattyajet|| śūdraṃ cākṣarasaṃyuktaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet || 2.1.19.40 || tacchuśrūṣasva bhadraṃ te brāhmaṇācchaddhayāsaha || śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā manvādibhirudīritā || 41 || na hi naisargikaṃ karma parityaktuṃ tvamarhasi || evamuktaḥ sa muninā sa śūdro'cintayattadā || 42 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā tvadya vrate śraddhā hi me parā || yathā syānmamasujñāna yatiṣye'haṃ tathādya vai || 43 || iti niścitya manasā śūdro dṛḍhamatistadā || gatvāśramapadādūraṃ kṛtavānuṭajaśubham|| 44 || tatra vai devatāgāraṃ puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || puṣpārāmādikaṃ cāpi taṭākakhananādikam || 45|| śraddhayā kārayāmāsa tapaḥ siddhyarthamātmana || abhiṣekāṃśca niyamānupavāsādikānapi || 46 || baliṃ kṛtvā ca hutvā ca daivatānyabhyapūjayat || saṃkalpaniyamopetaḥ phalāhāro jiteṃdriyaḥ || 47 || nityaṃ kandaiśca mūlaiśca puṣpairapi tathā phalaiḥ || atithīnpūjayāmāsa yathāvatsamupāgatān || 48 || evaṃ hi sumahānkālo vyaticakrāma tasya vai || 49 || || atha dṛḍhamataye sumatyākhyavipraprakāśitakarmānuṣṭhānakramaḥ || || athāśramamagāttasya sumatirnāma nāmataḥ || dvijo gargakulodbhūtaḥ satyavādī jiteṃdriyaḥ || 2.1.19.50 || svāgatairmunimārādhya toṣayitvā phalādikaiḥ || kathayanvai kathāḥ puṇyāḥ kuśalaṃ paryapṛcchata || 51 || itthaṃ vipraḥ sa pādyādyairupacāraistu pūjitaḥ || āśīrbhirabhinandyainaṃ pratigṛhya ca satkriyām || 52 || tamāpṛcchatprahṛṣṭātmā svāśramaṃ punarāyayau || evaṃ dinedine vipraḥ śūdre'sminpakṣapātavān || 53 || āgacchadāśramaṃ tasya draṣṭuṃ taṃ śūdrayonijam || bahukālaṃ dvijasyābhūtsaṃsargaḥ śūdrayoninā || 54 || snehasya vaśamāpannaḥ śūdroktaṃ nāticakrame || athāgataṃ dvijaṃ śūdraḥ prāha snehavaśīkṛtam || 55 || havyakavyavidhānaṃ me brūhi tvaṃ tu gururmataḥ || evamuktaḥ sa śūdreṇa sarvametadupādiśat ||56|| kārayāmāsa śūdrasya pitṛkāryādikaṃ tadā || pitṛkārye kṛte tena visṛṣṭaḥ sa dvijottamaḥ || 57 || || atha śūdrasya vaidikakarmopadeśena sumatyanubhūtadurgatiḥ || || atha dīrgheṇa kālena poṣitaḥ śūdrayoninā || tyakto vipragaṇaiḥ so'yaṃ pañcatvamagamaddvijaḥ || 58 || vaivasvatabhaṭairnītvā pātito narakeṣvapi || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca || 59 || bhuktvā krameṇa narakāṃstadante sthāvaro'bhavat || gardabhastu tato jajñe viḍvarāhastataḥ param || 2.1.19.60 || jajñe'tha sārameyo'sau paścādvāyasatāṃ gataḥ || atha caṇḍālatāṃ prāpya śūdrayonimagāttataḥ || 61 || gatavānvaiśyatāṃ paścātkṣatriyastadanantaram || prabalairbādhyamāno'sau brāhmaṇo vai tadābhavat || 62 || upanītaḥ sa pitrā tu varṣe garbhāṣṭame dvijaḥ || vartamānaḥ piturgehe svācārābhyāsatatparaḥ || 63 || gacchankadācidgahane gṛhīto brahmarakṣasā || rudanbhramanskhalanmūḍhaḥ pralapanprahasannasau || 64 || śaśvaddhāheti ca vadanvaidikaṃ karma so'tyajat || dṛṣṭvā sutaṃ tathābhūtaṃ pitā duḥkhena pīḍitaḥ || 65 || sutamādāya ca snehādagastyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || suvarṇamukharītīre tapasyantaṃ śivāgrataḥ ||66|| bhaktyā muniṃ praṇamyāsau pitā tasya sutasya vai || tasmai nivedayāmāsa svaputrasya viceṣṭitam ||67|| || athāgastyoktyā durgatyapanodanārthaṃ sumaterveṃkaṭādrigamanam || || abravīcca tadā vipraḥ kumbhajaṃ munipuṃgavam || eṣa me tanayo brahmangṛhīto brahmarakṣasā ||68|| sukhaṃ na labhate brahmanrakṣa taṃ karuṇādṛśā || nāsti me tanayo'pyanyaḥ pitṝṇāmṛṇamuktaye || 69 || tasya pīḍāvināśārthamupāyaṃ brūhi kumbhaja || tvatsamastriṣu lokeṣu tapaḥśīlo na vidyate || 2.1.19.70 || tvāṃ vināsya paritrātā na me putrasya vidyate || putre dayāṃ kuru guro dayāśīlā hi sādhavaḥ || 71 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamuktastadā tena kumbhajo dhyānamāsthitaḥ || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālamabravīdbrāhmaṇaṃ tataḥ ||72|| || agastya uvāca || || pūrvajanmani te putro brāhmaṇo'yaṃ mahāmate || sumatirnāma vipro'yaṃ matiṃ śūdrāya vai dadau || 73 || karmāṇi vaidikānyeṣa sarvāṇyupadideśa vai || ato'yaṃ narakānbhuktvā kalpakoṭisahasrakam || 74 || jāto bhuvi tadanteṣu sthāvarādiṣu yoniṣu || idānīṃ brāhmaṇo jātaḥ karmaśeṣeṇa te sutaḥ || 75 || yamena preṣitenātra gṛhīto brahmarakṣasā || krūreṇa pātakenādya pūrvajanmakṛtena vai || 76 || upāyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi brahmarakṣovināśane || śṛṇuṣva śraddhayā yuktaḥ samādhāya ca mānasam|| 77 || suvarṇamukharītīre ṛṣisaṃghaniṣevite || vartate daivataiḥ sevyaḥ pāvano veṃkaṭācalaḥ || 78 || tasyopari mahātīrthaṃ nāmnā pāpavināśanam|| asti puṇyaṃ prasiddhaṃ ca mahāpātakanāśanam || 79 || bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ vetālabrahmarakṣasām || mahatāṃ caiva rogāṇāṃ tīrthaṃ tannāśakaṃ smṛtam || 2.1.19.80 || sutamādāya gaccha tvaṃ tattīrthaṃ girimadhyagam || prayataḥ snāpaya sutaṃ tīrthe pāpavināśane || 81 || snānena tridinaṃ tatra bahmarakṣo vinaśyati || naivopāyāntaraṃ tasya vināśe vidyate bhuvi || 82 || tasmācchīghraṃ prayāhi tvaṃ veṃkaṭāhvayaparvatam || tatra pāpavināśākhyatīrthe snāpaya te sutam || 83 || mā vilambaṃ kuruṣvātra tvarayā yāhi vai dvija || ityuktaḥ sa dvijo'gastyaṃ praṇamya bhuvi daṇḍavat || 84 || anujñātaśca tenāsau prayayau veṃkaṭācalam || sutena sākaṃ vipro'sau gatvā pāpavināśanam || 85 || || atha sumateḥ pāpanāśanasnānena durgatyapanodanam || || saṃkalpapūrvaṃ saṃsnāpya dinatrayamasau sutam || sasnau svayaṃ ca viprendraḥ pitā pāpavināśane || 86 || samāgataḥ papau toyaṃ kṛtvā cāpyāhnikakramam || atha tasya sutastatra vimukto brahmarakṣasā || 87 || samajāyata nīrogaḥ svasthaḥ sundararūpadhṛk || sarvasaṃpatsamṛddho'sau bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ || 88 || dehānte prayayau muktiṃ snānātpāpavināśane || pitāpi tatra snānena dehānte muktimāptavān || 89 || || atha vaidikakarmānuṣṭhāturdṛḍhamaterdurgatiprāptyapanodanam || || tenopadiṣṭo'yaṃ śūdraḥ sa bhuktvā narakānkramāt || anekāsu janitvā ca kutsitāsvapi yoniṣu || 2.1.19.90 || gṛdhrajanmābhavatpaścādveṃkaṭācalabhūdhare || sa kadācijjalaṃ pātuṃ tīrthe pāpavināśane || 91 || samāgataḥ papau toyaṃ siṣice cātmanastanum || tadaiva divyadehaḥ sansarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 92 || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya prayayāvamarālayam|| 93 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamprabhāvametadvai tīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam || pāpānāṃ nāśanādviprāḥ pāpanāśābhidhaṃ hi tat || 94 || itthaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ munīndrāstadvaibhavaṃ pāpavināśanasya || yatrābhiṣekātsahasā vimuktau dvijaśca śūdraśca vinindyakṛtyau || 95 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmyaṃ pāpavināśanatīrthamahimānuvarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || || cha ||
<2.1.20>
|| atha pāpavināśanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam || || || śrīsūta uvāca || || punaścāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi pāpanāśanavaibhavam || bhagavadbhaktibhāvena śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 1 || itihāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpavināśanam || yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || || atha bhadramatyākhyadaridradvijavṛttāntaḥ || || āsītpurā dvijavaro vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || daridro vṛttihīnaśca nāmnā bhadramatirdvijaḥ || 3 || śrutāni sarvaśāstrāṇi tena vipreṇa dhīmatā || śrutāni ca purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 4 || abhavaṃstasya ṣaṭ patnyaḥ kṛtā siṃdhuryaśovatī || kāminī mālinī caiva śobhā caiva prakīrtitāḥ || 5 || tāsu patnīṣu tasyāsītputrāṇāṃ ca śatadvayam || te sarve tasya putrādyāḥ kṣudhayā paripīḍitāḥ || 6 || akiñcano bhadramatiḥ kṣudhārtānātmajānpriyān || paśyanpriyāḥ kṣudhārtāśca vilalāpākulendriyaḥ || 7 || dhigjanma bhāgyarahitaṃ dhigjanma dhanavarjitam || dhigjanma kīrtirahitaṃ dhigjanmātithyavarjitam || 8 || dhigjanmācārarahitaṃ dhigjanma jñānavarjitam || dhigjanma yatnarahitaṃ dhigjanma sukhavarjitam || || 9 || dhigjanma bandhurahitaṃ dhigjanma khyātivarjitam || narasya bahvapatyasya dhigjanmaiśvaryavarjitam || 2.1.20.10 || aho guṇāḥ saumyatā ca vidvattā janma satkule || dāridryāmbudhimagnasya sarvametanna śobhate || 11 || viprāḥ putrāśca pautrāśca bāndhavā bhrātarastathā || śiṣyāśca sarve manujāstyajantyaiśvaryavarjitam || 12 || iti niścitya matimāndhīro bhadramatirdvijaḥ || caṇḍālo vā dvijo vāpi bhāgyavāneva pūjyate || 13 || daridraḥ puruṣo loke śavavallokaninditaḥ || aho sampatsamāyukto niṣṭhuro vāpyaniṣṭhuraḥ || 14 || guṇahīno'pi guṇavānmūrkho vāpi sa paṇḍitaḥ || niṣṭhuro vā guṇī vāpi dharmahīno'tha vā naraḥ || 15 || aiśvaryaguṇayuktaścetpūjya eva na saṃśayaḥ || aho daridratā duḥkhaṃ tatrāpyāśātiduḥkhadā || 16 || āśābhibhūtāḥ puruṣā duḥkhamaśnuvate kṣaṇāt || 17 || āśāyā ye dāsā dāsāste sarvalokasya || āśā dāsī yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ dāsāyate lokaḥ || || 18 || sarvaśāstrārthavettāpi daridro bhāti mūrkhavat || ākiñcanyamahāgrāhagrastānāṃ nāsti mocakaḥ || 19 || aho duḥkhamaho duḥkhamaho duḥkhaṃ daridratā || tatrāpi putradārāṇāṃ bāhulyamatiduḥkhadam || 2.1.20.20 || evamuktvā bhadramatiḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ || atyaiśvaryapradaṃ dharmaṃ manasā cintayaṃstadā || tūṣṇīṃ sthito bhadramatimahākleśasamanvitaḥ || 21 || || atha bhadramateḥ kāminīkṛtaveṃkaṭādrigamanaprotsāhanam || || tadānīṃ tāsu bhāryāsu kāminī patidevatā || 22 || bhāryā sādhuguṇairyuktā patiṃ taṃ pratyabhāṣata || 23 || || kāminyuvāca || || bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstrārthapāraga || mama nātha mahābhāga vākyaṃ śṛṇu mahāmate || 24 || suvarṇamukharītīre ṛṣisaṃghaniṣevite || vartate daivataiḥ sevyaḥ pāvano veṃkaṭācalaḥ || 25 || tasminveṃkaṭaśailendre surāsuranamaskṛte || vartate pāvanaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpānāṃ dāhakaṃ śubham || 26 || tatra gatvā mahābhāga pāpanāśe mahāmate || kuru snānaṃ prayatnena bhāryāputrasamanvitaḥ || 27 || tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ nāradācca śrutaṃ mayā || bālabhāve mama pituraṃtike proktavānmuniḥ || 28 || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane || sarvaduḥkhapraśamane sarvasaṃpatpradāyake || 29 || pāpanāśe mahātīrthe snātvā saṃkalpapūrvakam || atyaiśvaryapradaṃ dharmaṃ manasā cintayaṃstadā || 2.1.20.30 || bhūmidānaṃ viniścitya sarvadānottamottamam || prāpakaṃ paralokasya sarvakāmaphalapradam || 31 || dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ bhūdānaṃ parikīrtitam|| taddattvā samavāpnoti yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ naraḥ || 32 || ityevaṃ nāradenoktaṃ śrutvā me janako dvijaḥ || saṃprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā śeṣādriṃ prāptavāṃstadā || 33 || tatra gatvā mahābhāgaḥ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakam || bhūdānaṃ vipravaryāya śrotriyāya pradattavān || 34 || tato me janako vidvansarvabhāgyasamanvitaḥ || ihaloke sukhaṃ prāpya cānte viṣṇupuraṃ yayau || 35 || tvaṃ ca gatvā mahābhāga veṃkaṭādriṃ nagottamam || kuru dānaṃ prayatnena bhūdānaṃ sarvakāmadam || 36 || || atha kāminīkathitabhūdānapraśaṃsā || || bhūmidānasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ || na ko'pi gadituṃ śakto loke'sminbhagavanprabho || 37 || bhūmidānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnoti bhūmido nātra saṃśayaḥ || 38 || svalpāmapi mahīṃ dattvā śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye || brahmalokamavāpnoti punarāvṛttivarjitam || 39 || bhūmidaḥ sarvadaḥ prokto bhūmido mokṣabhāgbhavet || bhūbhidānaṃ vṛṣādrau ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 2.1.20.40 || mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ || daśahastāṃ mahīṃ dattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 41 || satpātre bhūmidātā yaḥ sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet || bhūmidasya samo nānyastriṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 42 || dvijasya vṛttihīnasya yaḥ pradadyānmahīṃ śubhām|| tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ śeṣo nārhaḥ kadācana || 43 || viprasya vṛttihīnasya sadācārasya kasyacit || yo 'lpāmapi mahīṃ dadyātsa viṣṇurnātra saṃśayaḥ || 44 || ikṣugodhūmakedārapūgadṛkṣādisaṃyutā || pṛthvī pradīyate yena sa viṣṇurnātra saṃśayaḥ || 45 || vṛttihīnasya viprasya daridrasya kuṭumbinaḥ || svalpāmapi mahīṃ dattvā viṣṇusāyujyamaśnute || 46 || saktasya devapūjāsu viprasyāṭavikā mahī || dattā bhavati gaṃgāyāṃ trirātrasnānajaṃ phalam|| 47 || viprasya vṛttihīnasya sadācāraratasya ca || droṇikāṃ pṛthivīṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ labhate śṛṇu || 48 || gaṃgātīre'śvamedhānāṃ śatāni vidhivannaraḥ || kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti tadāpnoti mahatphalam || 49 || dadāti bhārikāṃ bhūmiṃ daridrāya dvijātaye || tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi mannātha bhagavanprabho || 2.1.20.50 || aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca || vidhāya jāhnavītīre yatphalaṃ tallabheta saḥ || 51 || bhūmidānaṃ mahādānamatidānaṃ prakīrtitam || sarvapāpapraśamanamapavargaphalapradam || 52 || yacchrutvā śraddhayā yukto bhūmidānaphalaṃ labhet || bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā tvitihāsasamanvitam || 53 || santuṣṭo manasi dhyātvā śeṣācalanivāsinam || 54 || || atha bhadramataye bhūpradānātsughoṣasya sadgatiḥ || || gantuṃ pracakrame buddhyā krīḍācalamanuttamam || tato bhadramatiḥ saumyaḥ sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 55 || suśāliṃnāma nagarīṃ kalatrasahito yayau || sughoṣaṃ nāma viprendraṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitam || 56 || gatvā yācitavānbhūmiṃ pañcahastāyatāṃ dvijaḥ || sughoṣo dharmaniratastaṃ nirīkṣya kuṭumbinam || || 57 || manasā prītimāpannaṃ samabhyarcyainamabravīt || kṛtārtho'haṃ bhadramate saphalaṃ mama janma ca || matkulaṃ cānaghaṃ jātaṃ tvaṃ hi grāhyo'si me yataḥ || 58 || ityuktvā taṃ samabhyarcya sughoṣo dharmatatparaḥ || pañcahastapramāṇāṃ tāṃ dadau tasmai mahāmatiḥ || 59 || pṛthivī vaiṣṇavī puṇyā pṛthivī viṣṇupālitā || pṛthivyāstu pradānena prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ || 2.1.20.60 || mantreṇānena viprendrāḥ sughoṣastaṃ dvijeśvaram || viṣṇubuddhyā samabhyarcya tāvatīṃ pṛthivīṃ dadau || 61 || sa bhadramataye viprā dhīmāṃstāṃ yācitāṃ bhuvam || dattavānharibhaktāya śrotriyāya kuṭuṃbine || 62 || sughoṣo bhūmidānena koṭivaṃśasamanvitaḥ || prapede viṣṇubhavanaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati || 63 || || atha bhadramateḥ pāpanāśanatīre bhūdānārthaṃ veṃkaṭādrigamanam|| || vipro bhadramatiścāpi putradārasamanvitaḥ || gato veṃkaṭaśailendraṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam ||64|| gandharvayakṣaśailādisevitaṃ meruputrakam || vaikuṇṭhādāgataṃ divyaṃ krīḍācalamanuttamam || 65 || tatra svāmisarastoye nirmale pāvane śubhe || dāraputrādisaṃyuktaḥ snātvā saṃkalpapūrvakam || 66 || tatpaścimataṭe śvetasūkaraṃ vasudhādharam || natvā tatra vidhānena śrīnivāsālayaṃ gataḥ ||67|| tatra brahmādidevaiśca sevitaṃ veṃkaṭeśvaram || dṛṣṭavānsaha putrādyairviṣṇubhakto mahāmatiḥ||68|| bhaktyā praṇamya deveśaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ kṛpānidhim || putradārādisaṃyuktaḥ pāpanāśanamāyayau || 69 || tatra snātvā vidhānena kṛtadharmādisatkriyaḥ || kasmaicidviṣṇubhaktāya śrotriyāya mahāmatiḥ ||2.1.20.70|| viṣṇubuddhyā sa pradadau bhūdānaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham||71|| || atha bhūdānaprabhāveṇa bhadramaterbhagavatsākṣātkāraḥ|| tadā prādurabhūddevaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 72 || vinatānandanārūḍho vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || pāpanāśasya tīre tu bhūdānasya prabhāvataḥ ||73|| tadā bhadramatiḥ saumyaḥ stotuṃ samupacakrame || 74 || namonamaste'khilakāraṇāya namonamaste'khilapālakāya || namonamaste'maranāyakāya namonamo daityavimardanāya || 75 || namonamo bhaktajanapriyāya namonamaḥ pāpavidāraṇāya || namonamo durjananāśakāya namo'stu tasmai jagadīśvarāya || 76 || namo namaḥ kāraṇavāmanāya nārāyaṇāyāmitavikramāya || śrīśārṅgacakrāsigadādharāya namo'stu tasmai puruṣottamāya || 77 || namaḥ payorāśinivāsakāya namo'stu lakṣmīpataye'vyayāya || namo'stu sūryādyamitaprabhāya namonamaḥ puṇyagatāgatāya || 78 || namonamo'rkenduvilocanāya namo'stu te yajñaphalapradāya || namostu yajñāṃgavirājitāya namo'stu te sajjanavallabhāya || 79 || namonamaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya namo'stu śabdādivivarjitāya || namo'stu te'bhīṣṭasukhapradāya namonamo bhaktamanoramāya || 2.1.20.80 || namonamaste'dbhutakāraṇāya namo'stu te mandaradhārakāya || namo'stu te yajñavarāhanāmne namo hiraṇyākṣavidārakāya || 81 || namo'stu te vāmanarūpabhāje namo'stu te kṣatrakulāntakāya || namo'stu te rāvaṇamardanāya namo'stu te nandasutāgrajāya || 82 || namaste kamalākānta namaste sukhadāyine || śritārtināśine tubhyaṃ bhūyobhūyo namonamaḥ || 83 || vipreṇa saṃstuto devo bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || vātsalyenābravīdvākyaṃ śrīnivāso dayānidhiḥ || 84 || tāta tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te stotreṇa mahatā dvija || sarvabhogasamāyuktaḥ putrapautrādibhiryutaḥ || 85 || iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya dehānte muktimāpnuhi || ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇustatraivāntaradhīyata || 86 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ pāpanāśanavaibhavam || tattīre bhūpradānasya māhātmyaṃ cāpi varṇitam || 87 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye pāpavināśanatīrthe bhūdānaphalānuvarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || || cha || ||
<2.1.21>
|| atha rāmānujākhyadvijavṛttāntaḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || bhobhostapodhanāḥ sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || ākāśagaṃgātīrthasya māhātmyaṃ pravadāmyaham || 1 || ākāśagaṃgānikaṭe sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ || rāmānuja iti khyāto viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ || 2 || tapaścakāra dharmātmā vaikhānasamate sthitaḥ || grīṣme paṃcāgnimadhyastho viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 3 || japannaṣṭākṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ dhyāyanhṛdi janārdanam || varṣāsvākāśago nityaṃ hemanteṣu jaleśayaḥ || 4 || sarvabhūtahito dāntaḥ sarvadvandvavivarjitaḥ || varṣāṇi katicitso'yaṃ jīrṇaparṇāśanobhavat || 5 || kañcitkālaṃ jalāhāro vāyubhakṣaḥ kiyatsamāḥ ||6|| || athākāśagaṃgātīre rāmānujatapastuṣṭabhagavadāvirbhāvaḥ || || atha tattapasā tuṣṭo bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || pratyakṣatāmagāttasya śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 7 || vikacāmbujapatrākṣaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ || vinatānandanārūḍhaśchatracāmaraśobhitaḥ || 8 || hārakeyūramukuṭaḥ kaṭakādivibhūṣitaḥ || viṣvaksenasunandādi kiṅkaraiḥ parivāritaḥ || 9 || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgādivādakairnāradādibhiḥ || gīyamānaḥ suvibhavaḥ pītāmbaravirājitaḥ ||2.1.21.10|| lakṣmīvirājitorasko nīlameghanivacchaviḥ || sanakādimahāyogisevitaḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ || 11 || mandasmitena sakalaṃ mohayanbhuvanatrayam || svabhāsā mānayansarvā diśo daśa virājayan|| 12 || subhaktasulabho devo veṃkaṭeśo dayānidhiḥ || punaḥ sannidadhe tasya rāmānujamahāmuneḥ || 13 || āvirbhūtaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā śrīnivāsaṃ kṛpānidhim || pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭiṃ prāpa mahāmuniḥ || 14 || bhaktyā paramayā yuktastuṣṭāva jagadīśvaram ||15|| || atha rāmānujākhyaviprakṛtabhagavatstutiḥ || || rāmānuja uvāca || || namo devādhidevāya śaṅkhacakragadābhṛte || namo nityāya śuddhāya veṃkaṭaśāya te namaḥ || 16 || namo bhaktārtihaṃtre te havyakavyasvarūpiṇe || namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇe || 17 || namaḥ pareśāya namo'tibhūmne namo'stu lakṣmīpataye vidhātre || namo'stu sūryenduvilocanāya namo viriñcādyabhivanditāya || 18 || yo nāma jātyādivikalpahīnaḥ samastadoṣairapi varjito yaḥ || samastasaṃsārabhayāpahāriṇe tasmai namo daityavināśakāya||19|| vedāṃtavedyāya rameśvarāya vṛṣādivāsāya vidhātṛpitre || namonamaḥ sarvajanārtihāriṇe nārāyaṇāyāmitavikramāya || 2.1.21.20 || namastubhyaṃ bhagavate vāsudevāya śārṅgiṇe || bhūyobhūyo namastubhyaṃ veṃkaṭādrinivāsine || 21 || iti stutvā veṃkaṭeśaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ jagadgurum || rāmānujo munistūṣṇīmāste vipravarottamaḥ || 22 || śrutvā stutiṃ śrutisukhāṃ stutastasya mahātmanaḥ || avāpa paramaṃ toṣaṃ veṃkaṭācalanāyakaḥ || 23 || athāliṅgya muniṃ śauriścaturbhirbāhubhistadā || babhāṣe prītisaṃyukto varaṃ vai vriyatāmiti || 24 || tuṣṭo'smi tapasā te'dya stotreṇāpi mahāmune || namaskāreṇa ca prīto varado'haṃ tavāgataḥ || 25 || || atha rāmānujākhyaviprakṛtabhagavatprārthanā || || || || rāmānuja uvāca || || nārāyaṇa ramānātha śrīnivāsa jaganmaya || janārdana jagaddhāma govinda narakāntaka || 26 || tvaddarśanātkṛtārtho'smi veṃkaṭādriśiromaṇe || tvāṃ namasyaṃti dharmiṣṭhā yatastvaṃ dharmapālakaḥ || 27 || yaṃ na vetti bhavo brahmā yaṃ na vetti trayī tathā || tvāṃ vedmi paramātmānaṃ kimasmādadhikaṃ param || 28 || yogino yaṃ na paśyaṃti yaṃ na paśyaṃti karmaṭhāḥ || paśyāmi paramātmānaṃ kimasmādadhikaṃ param || 29 || etena ca kṛtārtho'smi veṃkaṭeśa jagatpate || yannāmasmṛtimātreṇa mahāpātakino'pi ca || 2.1.21.30 || muktiṃ prayāṃti manujāstaṃ paśyāmi janārdanam || tvatpādapadmayugale niścalā bhaktirastu me || 31 || || atha bhagavadvarṇitākāśagaṃgātīrthasnānakālaḥ || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || mayi bhaktirdṛḍhā testu rāmānuja mahāmate || śṛṇu cāpyaparaṃ vākyamucyate te mayā dvija || 32 || meṣasaṃkramaṇe bhānościtrānakṣatrasaṃyute || paurṇamāsyāṃ ca gaṃgāyāṃ snānaṃ kurvanti ye janāḥ || 33 || te yāṃti paramaṃ dhāma punarāvṛttivarjitam || viyadgaṃgāsamīpe tvaṃ vasa rāmānuja dvija || 34 || etatprārabdhadehāṃte matsvarūpamavāpsyasi || bahunā kimihoktena viyadgaṃgājale śubhe || 35 || snānti ye vai janāḥ sarve te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || bhavanti muniśārdūla nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 36 || || rāmānuja uvāca || || kiṃlakṣaṇā bhāgavatā jñāyante kena karmaṇā || etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ kautūhalaparo yataḥ || 37 || || || atha bhagavadvarṇitabhāgavatalakṣaṇāni || || śrīveṃkaṭeśa uvāca || lakṣma bhāgavatānāṃ tu śṛṇuṣva munisattama || 38 || vaktuṃ teṣāṃ prabhāvaṃ tu śakyate nābdakoṭibhiḥ || 39 || ye hitāḥ sarvajantūnāṃ gatāsūyā vimatsarāḥ || jñānino niḥspṛhāḥ śāntāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 2.1.21.40 || karmaṇā manasā vācā parapīḍāṃ na kurvate || aparigrahaśīlāśca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 41 || satkathāśravaṇe yeṣāṃ vartate sāttvikī matiḥ || matpādāmbujabhaktā ye te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 42 || mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣāṃ kurvate ye narottamāḥ || ye tu devārcanaratā ye tu tatsādhakā narāḥ || pūjāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu modante te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 43 || varṇināṃ ca yatīnāṃ ca paricaryāparāśca ye || paranindāmakurvāṇāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 44 || sarveṣāṃ hitavākyāni ye vadanti narottamāḥ || ye guṇagrāhiṇo loke te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 45 || ātmavatsarvabhūtāni ye paśyanti narottamāḥ || tulyāḥ śatruṣu mitreṣu te vai bhāgavatāḥ smṛtāḥ || 46 || dharmaśāstrapravaktāraḥ satyavākyaratāśca ye || teṣāṃ śuśrūṣavo ye ca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 47 || vyākurvanti purāṇāni tāni śṛṇvanti ye tathā || tadvaktari ca bhaktā ye te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 48 || ye gobrāhmaṇaśuśrūṣāṃ kurvanti satataṃ narāḥ || tīrthayātrāparā ye ca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 49 || anyeṣāmudayaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye'bhinandaṃti mānavāḥ || harināmaparā ye ca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 2.1.21.50 || ārāmāropaṇaratāstaṭākaparirakṣakāḥ || kāsārakūpakartāraste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 51 || ye vai taṭākakartāro devasadmāni kurvate || gāyatrīniratā ye ca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 52 || ye'bhinandaṃti nāmāni hareḥ śrutvā'tiharṣitāḥ || romāñcitaśarīrāśca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 53 || tulasīkānanaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye namaskurvate narāḥ || tatkāṣṭhāṃkitakarṇā ye te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ |||| 54 || tulasīgandhamāghrāya santoṣaṃ kurvate tu ye || tanmūlamuddharā ye ca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 55 || svāśramācāraniratāstathaivātithipūjakāḥ || ye ca vedārthavaktāraste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 56 || viditāni ca śāstrāṇi parārthaṃ pravadanti ye || sarvatra guṇabhājo ye te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 57 || pānīyadānaniratā hyannadānaratāśca ye || ekādaśīvrataparāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 58 || godānaniratā ye ca kanyādānaratāśca ye || madarthaṃ karmakartāraste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 59 || manmānasāśca madbhaktā ye madbhajanalolupāḥ || mannāmasmaraṇāsaktāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ |||| 2.1.21.60 || bahunātra kimuktena saṃkṣepātte bravīmyaham || sadguṇāya pravartaṃte te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ || 61 || ete bhāgavatā viprāḥ kecidatra prakīrtitāḥ || mamāpi gadituṃ śakyā nābdakoṭiśatairapi || 62 || rāmānuja mahābhāga madbhaktānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam || mayi bhakte tvayi prītyā yuktaṃ kila mahāmate || 63 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || vṛṣādrau ca viyadgaṃgātīrthamāhātmyamuttamama || || 64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye ākāśagaṃgāmāhātmya rāmānujavipravratacaryādivarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || || cha ||
<2.1.22>
|| atha dānārhasatpātranirṇayaḥ || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavansūta sarvajña vedavedāntakovida || dānāni kasmai deyāni dānakālaśca kīdṛśaḥ || 1 || kaśca tatpratigṛhṇīyātsarvaṃ no vaktumarhasi || 2 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || mahāpuṇyaprade kṣetre veṃkaṭākhye dvijottamāḥ || sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ paramo guruḥ || 3 || tasmai dānāni deyāni sa tārayati paṃḍitaḥ || brāhmaṇaḥ pratigṛhṇīyādvarjayitvā tvavarṇakam || 4 || ṣaṇḍasya putrahīnasya daṃbhācāraratasya ca || vedavidveṣiṇaścaiva dvijavidveṣiṇastathā || 5 || svakarmatyāginaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam || paradāraratasyāpi paradravyaratasya ca || 6 || gāyakasyāpi viprasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam || asūyāviṣṭamanasaḥ kṛtaghnasya ca māyinaḥ || 7 || jñānaśūnyasya viprasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam || nityaṃ yāñcāparasyāpi hiṃsakasyābalasya ca || 8 || nāmavikrayiṇaścaiva vedavikrayiṇastathā || smṛtivikrayiṇaścaiva dharmavikrayiṇastathā || 9 || paropatāpaśīlasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam || ye kecitpāpaniratā ninditāḥ sukṛtaistathā || 2.1.22.10 || na tebhyaḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna deyaṃ vāpi kiñcana || satkarmaniratāyaiva śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye || 11 || vṛttihīnāya vai deyaṃ daridrāya kuṭumbine || devapūjāsu saktāya purāṇakathakāya ca || 12 || deyaṃ prayatnato viprā daridrasya viśeṣataḥ || bahunā kimihoktena śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 13 || sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pradātuṃ śakyate sadā || vandhyābhartre pradattañcedrāsabho jāyate naraḥ || 14 || nāstikaṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ putrahīnaṃ jaḍaṃ khalam || steyinaṃ kitavaṃ caiva kadācinnābhivādayet || 15 || pāṣaṇḍaṃ patitaṃ vrātyaṃ vedavikrayiṇaṃ tathā || kṛtaghnaṃ pāpanirataṃ kadācinnābhivādayet || 16 || tathā snānaṃ prakurvantaṃ samitpuṣpakaraṃ tathā || udapātradharañcaiva bhuṃjantaṃ nābhivādayet || 17 || vivādaśālinaṃ caṇḍaṃ vamantaṃ janamadhyagam || bhikṣānnadhāriṇaṃ caiva śayānaṃ nābhivādayet || 18 || vandhyāñca puṣpiṇīṃ jārāṃ sūtikāṃ garbhapātinīm || vrataghnīñca tathā caṇḍīṃ kadācinnābhivādayet || 19 || sabhāyāṃ yajñaśālāyāṃ devatāyataneṣvapi || pratyekaṃ tu namaskāro hanti puṇyaṃ purātanam || || 2.1.22.20 || śrāddhavrate niyuktañca devatābhyarcakaṃ tathā || yajñaṃ ca tarpaṇañcaiva kurvantaṃ nābhivādayet || 21 || kurvate vandanaṃ yastu na kuryātprativandanam || nābhivādyaḥ sa vijñeyo yathā śūdrastathaiva ca || 22 || tasmātsarvepu kāleṣu buddhimānbrāhmaṇottamaḥ || vandhyāpatiṃ dvijaṃ krūraṃ kadācinnābhivādayet || || 23 || || athākāśagaṃgāmāhātmyam|| || śrīsūta uvāca || || atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi puṇyaśīlasya dhīmataḥ || sanatkumāramunaye nāradena prabhāṣitam || 24 || tadvakṣyāmi muniśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || purā godāvarītīre sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 25 || puṇyaśīlo dvijavaraḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ || dayāvānsarvabhūteṣu devāgnidvijapūjakaḥ ||26|| karmaṇā janmaśuddhaśca mātāpitṛhite rataḥ || gurubhaktiḥ sadākṣiṇyo brahmaṇyaḥ sādhusaṃmataḥ || 27 || etādṛśaguṇairyuktaḥ puṇyaśīlasya dhīmataḥ || 28 || || atha puṇyaśīlasya vandhyāpatinimantraṇena gardabhamukhatvaprāptiḥ || || gṛhaṃ samprāptavānvipro vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || prārthitaḥ puṇyaśīlena pitṛśrāddhe'tivegataḥ || 29 || taṃ vipraṃ śrotriyaṃ śāntaṃ pitṛśrāddhe niyojya vai || śrāddhaṃ cakāra dharmātmā pratyābdikamanuttamam|| 2.1.22.30 || tataḥ kālāntare tasya puṇyaśīlasya cānane || vairūpyaṃ prāptamatyugraṃ rāsabhānanavattadā || 31 || tataḥ khinnamanā bhūtvā puṇyaśīlo'tidhārmikaḥ || niḥśvasya bahudhā khinnaḥ prapede'gastyayoginaḥ || 32 || suvarṇamukharītīre ṛṣisaṃghaniṣevite || āśramaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam|| 33 || tatrāśrame munivaraiḥ sevyamānamaharniśam || dṛṣṭvāgastyaṃ mahātmānaṃ sarvalokahitaiṣiṇam || 34 || praṇāmamakarottasmai gārdabhāsyo'tiduḥkhitaḥ || 35 || || puṇyaśīla uvāca || || taponidhe namastubhyamagastya munisevita || kutsitāsyaṃ mahāpāpaṃ rakṣarakṣa dayānidhe || 36 || kena doṣeṇa me cātra mukhasyāsītkurūpatā || 37 || mayi prītyā mahābhāga vadasva munisattama || 38 || agastya uvāca || || vipravarya mahābhāga puṇyaśīla mahāmate || ānanasya virūpaṃ vai śṛṇu nānyamanā dvija ||39|| || atha vandhyāpateḥ śrāddhanimantraṇānarhatvakathanam || || kañcidvipraṃ guṇanidhiṃ vedavedāṃgapāragam || śrotriyaṃ putrarahitaṃ śrāddhe tvaṃ viniyuktavān || 2.1.22.40 || tena doṣeṇa mahatā mukhe tava virūpatā || ye loke havyakavyādau vandhyāyāḥ svāminaṃ dvijam|| 41 || niyojayanti te yānti mukhe gardabharūpatām || śubhakarmaṇi vā vipra paitṛke vāpi karmaṇi || || 42 || vandhyāpatiṃ mahāpāpaṃ kadācinna nimantrayet || vandhyāpatiṃ mahākrūraṃ vṛṣalīpatimeva vā || 43 || śreyaskāmī hi vipreṃdra śrāddhe tu na nimantrayet || vedaśāstrādiyukto'pi kulīnaḥ karmaṭho'pi vā || 44 || vandhyābhartā dvijaśreṣṭha śrāddhe tyājyaḥ kathañcana || jyotiṣṭomādiyajñeṣu vrateṣu ca tapaḥsu ca || 45 || samartho'pi dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ śrāddhe vandhyāpatiṃ tyajet || alabhye tu dvije pātre tantumātropajīvinam || 46 || putravantaṃ sadācāraṃ śrāddhārthaṃ tu nimantrayet || tadabhāve dvijaśreṣṭha putraṃ vā'nujameva vā || 47 || ātmānaṃ vā niyuñjīta śrāddhe vandhyāpatiṃ tyajet || puṇyaśīla mahābhāga coddhṛtya bhujamucyate || 48 || sarvathā putrahīnaṃ tu śrāddhārthaṃ na niyojayet || vandhyāpatiṃ dvijaṃ yastu śrāddhakartā niyokṣyati || 49 || tacchrāddhamāsuraṃ jñeyaṃ kartā ca narakaṃ vrajet || 2.1.22.50 || || athākāśagaṃgāsnānena puṇyaśīlasya tadvikṛtinivṛttiḥ || || bahunātra kimuktena taddoṣavinivṛttaye || upāyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi svarṇamukhyāstaṭe śubhe || 51 || vartate devasaṃghaiśca sevito veṃkaṭācalaḥ || meruputro mahāpuṇyaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || || 52 || tasminveṃkaṭaśailendre surāsuranamaskṛte || viyadgaṃgeti nāmnā vai tīrthamasti mahattaram || 53 || sarvapāpapraśamanamāyurārogyavardhanam || tvaṃ gatvā veṃkaṭaṃ śailaṃ svāmipuṣkariṇījale || 54 || snātvā saṃkalpapūrvaṃ tu gaṃgātīrthamanantaram || gatvā tīrthavidhānena snānaṃ kuru mahāmate || 55 || snānamātrāttataḥ sadyo mukhasyāsya mahāmate || vairūpyaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naṃkṣyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||56|| evamuktaḥ puṇyaśīlo hyagastyena mahātmanā || taṃ praṇamya mahātmānaṃ veṃkaṭādriṃ tato yayau ||57 || tatra gatvā mahābhāgaḥ svāmipuṣkariṇījale || snātvā niyamapūrvaṃ tu viyadgaṃgāsamīpagaḥ || 58 || tatra snānena dharmātmā kāmavakropamaṃ mukham || prāptavānpuṇyaśīlastu aho tīrthasya vaibhavam || 59 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā nāradena prabhāṣitam || sanatkumāramunaye śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || 2.1.22.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmya ākāśagaṃgāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || || cha ||
<2.1.23>
|| atha cakratīrthamāhātmyam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || athāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi dvijendrāḥ satyavādinaḥ|| cakratīrthasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||1|| ye śṛṇvanti mahāpuṇyaṃ cakratīrthasya vaibhavam || te yāṃti viṣṇubhavanaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam ||2|| annadāne ca vimukhā jaladāne tathaiva ca || godānavimukhā ye ca śuddhāste'tra nimajjanāt ||3|| tasmātpuṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam|| 4 || || atha padmanābhākhyadvijakṛtatapaḥprakāraḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || purā śrīvatsagotrīyaḥ padmanābho jitendriyaḥ || cakrapuṣkariṇītīre so'tapyata mahattapaḥ || 5 || dayāyukto nirāhāraḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ || ātmavatsarvabhūtāni paśyanviṣayaniḥspṛhaḥ || 6 || sarvabhūtahito dāntaḥ sarvadvandvavivarjitaḥ || varṣāṇi katicitso'yaṃ jīrṇaparṇāśano'bhavat || 7 || kañcitkālaṃ jalāhāro vāyubhakṣaḥ kiyatsamāḥ || evaṃ dvādaśa varṣāṇi padmanābho mahāmuniḥ || 8 || || atha cakratīrthe padmanābhākhyadvijakṛtatapastuṣṭabhagavadāvirbhāvaḥ || || atapyata tapo ghoraṃ devairapi suduṣkaram|| atha tattapasā tuṣṭo bhagavānkamalāpatiḥ || 9 || pratyakṣatāmagāttasya śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ || vikacāmbujapatrākṣaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ || 2.1.23.10 || unmīlya cakṣuṣī tatra dṛṣṭavānveṃkaṭeśvaram || śaṃkhacakradharaṃ śāṃtaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ kṛpānidhim || dṛṣṭvā devaṃ mahātmānaṃ stotuṃ samupacakrame || 11 || || atha padmanābhākhyadvijakṛtaśrīnivāsastutiḥ || || namo devādhidevāya veṃkaṭeśāya śārṅgiṇe || nārāyaṇādrivāsāya śrīnivāsāya te namaḥ || 12 || namaḥ kalmaṣanāśāya vāsudevāya viṣṇave || śeṣācalanivāsāya śrīnivāsāya te namaḥ || 13 || namastrailokyanāthāya viśvarūpāya sākṣiṇe || śivabrahmādivaṃdyāya śrīnivāsāya te namaḥ || 14 || namaḥ kamalanetrāya kṣīrābdhiśayanāya te || duṣṭarākṣasasaṃhartre śrīnivāsāya te namaḥ || 15 || bhaktapriyāya devāya devānāṃ pataye namaḥ || 16 || praṇatārtivināśāya śrīnivāsāya te namaḥ || 17 || yogināṃ pataye nityaṃ vedavedyāya viṣṇave || bhaktānāṃ pāpasaṃhartre śrīnivāsāya te namaḥ || 18 || evaṃ stuto mahābhāgaḥ śrīnivāso jaganmayaḥ || padmanābhākhyaṛṣiṇā cakratīrthanivāsinā || 19 || || atha padmanābhasya cakratīrthe niraṃtaravāsāya bhagavanniyamanam || || saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ prāpya veṃkaṭeśo dayānidhiḥ || 2.1.23.20 || padmanābhaṃ dvijavaraṃ śāṃtaṃ dharmaparāyaṇam || sudhādhāropamaṃ vākyamabravītpuruṣottamaḥ || 21 || || śrīnivāsa uvāca || || dvijavarya mahābhāga matpādakamalārcaka || cakratīrthasya tīre tvamākalpaṃ pūjayanvasa || 22 || ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇustatraivāṃtaradhīyata || antardhānaṃ gate deve śrīnivāse jagadgurau || 23 || cakratīrthasya tīre tu vāsaṃ cakre mahāmatiḥ || tataḥ kālāṃtare kaścidrākṣaso bhīmadarśanaḥ || 24 || muniṃ taṃ padmanābhākhyaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam || āyayau bhakṣituṃ krūraḥ kṣudhayā paripīḍataḥ || 25 || brāhmaṇaṃ tarasā so'yaṃ rākṣaso jagṛhe tadā || gṛhītastarasā ten vipro vedāṃgapāragaḥ || 54 || pracukrośa dayāmbhodhimāpannānāṃ parāyaṇam|| nārāyaṇaṃ cakrapāṇiṃ pakṣa rakṣeti vai muhuḥ|| 27|| veṃkaṭeśa dayāsindho śaraṇāgatapālaka || trāhi māṃ puruṣavyāghra rakṣovaśamupāgatam||28|| lakṣmīkāṃta hare viṣṇo vaikuṇṭha garuḍadhvaja|| māṃ rakṣa rākṣasākrāṃtaṃ grāhākrāṃtaṃ gajaṃ yathā|| 29|| dāmodara jagannātha hiraṇyāsuramardana || prahlādamiva māṃ rakṣa rākṣasenātipīḍitam || 2.1.23.30 || || atha padmanābhahananodyuktāsuravadhāya bhagavatkṛtacakrapreṣaṇam || || ityevaṃ stuvatatastasya padmanābhasya he dvijāḥ || svabhaktasya bhayaṃ jñātvā cakrapāṇirdayānidhiḥ || 31 || svacakraṃ preṣayāmāsa bhaktarakṣaṇakāraṇāt || preritaṃ viṣṇucakraṃ tadviṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā|| 32|| ājagāmātha vegena cakrapuṣkariṇītaṭam|| anantādityasaṃkāśamanantāgnisamaprabham|| 33|| mahājvālaṃ mahānāda mahāsuravimardanam|| dṛṣṭvā sudarśanaṃ viṣṇo rākṣaso'tha pradudruve|| 34|| atha bhagavatpreṣitacakrakṛtāsuravadhaḥ|| dravamāṇasya tasyāśu rākṣasasya sudarśanam|| śiraścakarta sahasā jvālāmālādurāsadam || 35 || tato vipravaro dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaṃ patitaṃ bhuvi || mudā paramayā yuktastuṣṭāva ca sudarśanam || 36 || || padmanābha uvāca || || viṣṇucakra namaste'stu viśvarakṣaṇadīkṣita || nārāyaṇakarāmbhoja bhūṣaṇāya namo'stu te || 37 || yuddheṣvasurasaṃhārakuśalāya mahārava || sudarśana namastubhyaṃ bhaktānāmārtināśana || 38 || rakṣa māṃ bhayasaṃvignaṃ sarvasmādapi kalmaṣāt || svāminsudarśana vibho cakratīrthe sadā bhavān || 39 || sannidhehi hitāya tvaṃ jagato muktikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || brāhmaṇenaivamuktaṃ tadviṣṇucakraṃ munīśvarāḥ || 2.1.23.40 || taṃ prāha padmanābhākhyaṃ prīṇayanniva sauhṛdāt || 41 || || atha dvijaprārthanayā cakrakṛtavaradānādiḥ || || sudarśana uvāca || || padmanābha mahāpuṇyaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam|| asminvasāmi satataṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 42 || tvatpīḍāṃ paricintyāhaṃ rākṣasena durātmanā || 43 || prerito viṣṇunā vipra tvarayā samupāgataḥ || tvatpīḍako'pi nihato mayā'yaṃ rākṣasādhamaḥ || 44 || mocitastvaṃ bhayādasmāttvaṃ hi bhakto hareḥ sadā || cakratīrthe mahāpuṇye sarvapāpahare dvija || 45 || satataṃ lokarakṣārthaṃ sannidhānaṃ karomi te || asminmatsannidhānātte tathānyeṣāmapi dvija || 46 || itaḥ paraṃ na pīḍā syādbhūtarākṣasasambhavā || asminmatsannidhānātsyāccakratīrthamiti prathā || 47 || snānaṃ ye'tra prakurvanti cakratīrthe vimuktide || teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca vaṃśajāḥ sarva eva hi || 48 || vidhūtapāpā yāsyanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || ityuktvā viṣṇucakraṃ tatpadmanābhasya paśyataḥ || 49 || anyeṣāmapi viprāṇāṃ paśyatāṃ sahasā dvijāḥ || cakrapuṣkariṇīṃ tāṃ tu prāviśatpāpanāśinīm || 2.1.23.50 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || cakratīrthasya māhātmyaṃ viprendrāḥ pāpanāśanam || yuṣmākaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || 51 || cakratīrthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || atra snātvā narā viprā mokṣabhājo na saṃśayaḥ ||92 || kīrtayedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ || cakratīrthābhiṣekasya prāpnoti phalamuttamam || 53 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye cakratīrthamahimānuvarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || || cha ||
<2.1.24>
atha sundarākhyagandharvasya rākṣasatvaprāptinivṛttyorupodghātaḥ || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavanrākṣasaḥ ko'sau sūta paurāṇikottama || viṣṇubhaktaṃ mahātmānaṃ yo brāhmaṇamabādhata || 1 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || vakṣyāmi rākṣasaṃ krūraṃ taṃ viprāḥ śṛṇutādarāt || yathā ca rākṣaso jāto munīnāṃ śāpavaibhavāt || 2 || purā vaikuṇṭhasadṛśe śrīraṅge viṣṇumaṃdire || vasiṣṭhātrimukhāḥ sarve viṣṇubhaktā
