mahaujasaḥ || || 3 || śrīraṅganāthaṃ deveśaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || upāsāṃcakrire muktyai śrīraṅgapuravāsinaḥ || 4 || kadācittatra gandharvo vīrabāhusuto balī || sundaro nāma vipreṃdrā viṭagoṣṭhīparāyaṇaḥ || 5 || lalanāśatasaṃyukto vivastraḥ salilāśaye || cikrīḍa sa vivastrābhiḥ sākaṃ yuvatibhirmudā || 6 || kaverajāyāstīrthe tu vasiṣṭho munibhiḥ saha || mādhyāhnikaṃ kartumanā yayau śrīraṃgamaṃdirāt || 7 || tānṛṣīnavalokyātha rāmāstā bhayakātarāḥ || vāsāṃsyācchādayāmāsuḥ sundaro na tu sāhasī || 8 || tato vasiṣṭhaḥ kupitaḥ śaśāpainaṃ gatatrapam || 9 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || yasmātsundara gandharva dṛṣṭvā'smām̐llajjayā tvayā || vāso nācchāditaṃ śīghraṃ yāhi rākṣasatāṃ tataḥ || 2.1.24.10 || evamukte vasiṣṭhena rāmāḥ prāñjalayastadā || praṇipatya vasiṣṭhaṃ taṃ bhaktinamreṇa cetasā ||11|| munimaṇḍalamadhye tu vasiṣṭhamidamabruvan || 12 || || rāmā ūcuḥ || || bhagavansarvadharmajña caturānananandana || dayāsindho'valokyāsmānna kopaṃ kartumarhasi || 13 || patireva hi nārīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ paramucyate || patihīnā tu yā nārī śataputrāpi sā mune || || 14 || vidhavetyucyate loke tāsāṃ janma nirarthakam || tatprasādaṃ kuru mune patyāvasmākamādarāt || 15 || eko'parādhaḥ kṣaṃtavyo munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || kṣamāṃ kuru dayāsindho yuṣmacchiṣye'tra sundare || 16 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || vasiṣṭhaḥ prārthitastvevaṃ sundarasyāṃganājanaiḥ || provāca vacanaṃ bhūyaḥ prasannaḥ sa dvijottamaḥ || 17 || || atha sundarākhyasya vasiṣṭhoktarākṣatvanivṛttyupāyaḥ || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || na me syādvacanaṃ mithyā kadācidapi subhruvaḥ || upāyaṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ śraddhayā saha || 18 || ṣoḍaśābdāvadhiḥ śāpo bharturvai bhavitā dhruvam || ṣoḍaśābdāvadhau caiva sundaro rākṣasākṛtiḥ || 19 || yadṛcchayā veṃkaṭādriṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham || gatvāsau cakratīrthaṃ tadgamiṣyati surāṃganāḥ || 2.1.24.20 || āste tatra mahāyogī padmanābho munīśvaraḥ || bhakṣārthaṃ taṃ muniṃ so'yaṃ rākṣaso'bhigamiṣyati || 21 || tato brāhmaṇarakṣārtha preritaṃ cakramuttamam || viṣṇunāsya śiraḥ kāyāddhariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || tataḥ svaṃ rūpamāsādya śāpānmuktaḥ sa sundaraḥ || patirvastridivaṃ bhūyo gantā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 23 || tatastridivamāsādya sundaro'yaṃ patirhi vaḥ || ramayiṣyati sundaryo yuṣmānsundaraveṣabhṛt || 24 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ityuktvā tu vasiṣṭhastāḥ sundarasya varāṃganāḥ || svāśramaṃ prayayau tūrṇaṃ śrīraṃgeśvarabhaktimān || 25 || atha rāmāstamāliṃgya sundaraṃ patimātmanaḥ || ruruduḥ śokasantaptā duḥkhasāgaramadhyagāḥ || 26 || dṛśyamānāsu tāsvevaṃ sundaro rākṣaso'bhavat || mahādaṃṣṭro mahākāyo raktaśmaśruśiroruhaḥ || 27 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayasaṃvignā jagmū rāmāstriviṣṭapam || tato rākṣasaveṣo'yaṃ suṃdarī bhairavākṛtiḥ || 28 || bhakṣayanprāṇinaḥ sarvāndeśāddeśaṃ vanādvanam|| bhramannanilavego'yaṃ veṃkaṭādriṃ nagottamam || 29 || praviśyāsau mahāpāpī cakratīrthaṃ tato yayau || evaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣāṇi bhramato'sya yayustadā || 2.1.24.30 || tatastu ṣoḍaśābdānte rākṣaso'yaṃ munīśvarāḥ || bhakṣituṃ padmanābhaṃ taṃ cakratīrthanivāsinam || 31 || upādravadvāyuvegaḥ sacāstauṣījjanārdanam || yoginā ca stuto viṣṇustadā cakramacodayat || 32 || rakṣituṃ padmanābhaṃ taṃ rākṣasena prapīḍitam || athāgatya hareścakraṃ rākṣasasya śiro'harat || || 33 || || atha sundarākhyasya rākṣasatvavimuktipūrvakaṃ svasvarūpaprāptiḥ || || tato'yaṃ rākṣasaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā divyakalevaraḥ || vimānavaramāruhya sundaraḥ puṣpavarṣitaḥ || 34 || prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā vavaṃde tatsudarśanam || tuṣṭāva śrutiramyābhirvāgbhiragryābhirādarāt || 35 || || sundara uvāca || || sudarśana namaste'stu viṣṇuhastaikabhūṣaṇa || namaste'surasaṃhartre sahasrādityatejase || 36 || kṛpāveśena bhavatastyakvāhaṃ rākṣasīṃ tanum || svaṃ rūpamabhajaṃ viṣṇoścakrāyudha namo'stu te || 37 || anujānīhi māṃ gaṃtuṃ tridivaṃ viṣṇuvallabha || bhāryā me pariśocanti virahāturacetasaḥ || 38 || tvanmanasko bhaviṣyāmi yāvajjīvaṃ yathā hyaham || tathā rūpaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ mayi cakra namo'stu te || 39 || evaṃ stutaṃ viṣṇucakraṃ sundareṇa sabhaktikam || anujagrāha sahasā tathāstviti munīśvarāḥ || 2.1.24.40 || cakrāyudhābhyanujñātaḥ sundaro brāhmaṇottamam || praṇamya tenānujñāto gandharvastridivaṃ yayau || 41 || sundare tu gate svargaṃ padmanābho munīśvaraḥ || taccakraṃ prārthayāmāsa viṣṇvāyudha namo'stu te || || 42 || cakrāyudha namāmi tvāṃ mahāsuravimardana || sannidhānaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ cakratīrthe'male śubhe ||43|| tvatsannidhānātsarveṣāṃ snātānāṃ pāpināmiha || pāpanāśaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ mokṣaṃ ca kuru śāśvatam || 44 || cakratīrthamiti khyātiṃ loke'sya parikalpaya || tvatsannidhānādatratyamunīnāṃ bhayanāśanam || 45 || itaḥ paraṃ bhavatvārya cakrāyudha namo'stu te || bhūtapretapiśācebhyo bhayaṃ mā bhavatu prabho || 46 || iti samprārthitaṃ cakraṃ padmanābhena yoginā || tathaivāstviti sambhāṣya tasmiṃstīrthe tirohitam || 47 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā rākṣasasyodbhave mayā || māhātmyaṃ cakratīrthasya kathitaṃ ca malāpaham || 48 || yacchutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavo bhuvi || 49 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye cakratīrthamahimānuvarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
<2.1.25>
|| atha jābālitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || bhobhostapodhanāḥ sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane || 1 || tato jābālitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ varṇayāmyaham || durācārābhidho yatra snātvā mukto'bhavaddvijāḥ || 2 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || durācārābhidhaḥ ko'sau sūta tattvārthakovida || kiñca pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ tena durācāreṇa vai mune || 3 || kathaṃ vā pātakānmuktastīrthesminsnānavaibhavāt || etacchuśrūṣamāṇānāṃ vistarādvada no mune || 4 || || atha kāverītīravāsidurācārākhyadvijodantaḥ || ||śrīsūta uvāca || || munayaḥ śrūyatāṃ tasya durācārasya pātakam || jābālitīrthasnānena yathā muktaśca pātakāt|| 5 || durācārābhidho vipraḥ kāverītīramāśritaḥ || kaścidāste dvijaḥ pāpī krūrakarmarataḥ sadā || 6 || brahmaghnaiśca surāpaiśca steyibhirgurutalpagaiḥ || sadā saṃsargaduṣṭo'sau taiḥ sākaṃ nyavasaddvijāḥ || 7 || mahāpātakasaṃsargadoṣeṇāsya dvijasya vai || brāhmaṇyaṃ sakalaṃ naṣṭaṃ niḥśeṣeṇa dvijottamāḥ || 8 || mahāpātakibhiḥ sārdhaṃ dinamekaṃ tu yo dvijaḥ || nivasetsādaraṃ tasya tatkṣaṇādvai dvijanmanaḥ || 9 || brāhmaṇasya tu caikāṃśo naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || dvidinaṃ sevanātsparśāddarśanācchayanāttathā || 2.1.25.10 || bhojanātsaha paṃktau ca mahāpātakibhirdvijāḥ || dvitīyabhāgo naśyeta brāhmaṇyasya na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || tridinācca tṛtīyāṃśo naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || caturdināccaturthāṃśo vilayaṃ yāti hi dhuvam || 12 || ataḥ paraṃ ca taiḥ sākaṃ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ || tattulyapātakī bhūyānmahāpātakisaṃgavān || 13 || tena brāhmaṇyahīno'yaṃ durācārābhidho dvija. || grasto'bhavadbhīṣaṇena vyāleneva balīyasā || 14 || asau paravaśastena vetālenātipīḍitaḥ || deśāddeśaṃ bhramanvipro vanāccaiva vanāntaram || 15 || pūrvapuṇyavipākena daivayogena sa dvijaḥ || veṃkaṭādriṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 16 || || atha jñābālitīrthasnānāddurācāravetālayormahapātakādinivṛttiḥ || || anudrutaḥ piśācena vetālena dvijo yayau || nyamajjayatsa vetālo mahāpātakanāśane || 17 || jābālitīrthe viprendrā mahāpātakisaṃginam || udatiṣṭhatkṣaṇādeva vetālena vimocitaḥ || 18 || utthito'sau dvijo viprāstasmāttīrthāttu pāvanāt || svastho vyacintayatko'yaṃ svarṇamukhyāḥ samīpataḥ || 19 || kathaṃ mayāgatamaho kāverītīravāsinā || iti cintākulaḥ so'yaṃ jābālestīrthamuttamam || 2.1.25.20 || jābāliṃ ca mahātmānaṃ yogīndravaramuttamam || samāgamya praṇamyāsau durācāro'bhyabhāṣata || 21 || na jāne bhagavanvipra parvato'yaṃ vadādhunā || kāverītīranilayo durācārābhidho hyaham || 22 || kṛpayā brūhi me brahmanmayātra kathamāgatam|| iti pṛṣṭo munistena durācāreṇa suvrataḥ || 23 || dhyātvā muhurtamavadaddurācāraṃ kṛpānidhiḥ || 24 || || || atha jābālivarṇitapārvaṇaśrāddhākaraṇadoṣakathanam || || jābāliruvāca || || mahāpātakisaṃsargāddurācārasya te purā || brāhmaṇyaṃ naṣṭamabhavadvetālastvāṃ tato'grahīt || 25 || tenāviṣṭastvamāyāto vivaśo'tra vimūḍhadhīḥ || nyamajjayattvāṃ vetālastīrthe'sminnatipāvane || 26 || atra majjanamātreṇa vimuktaḥ pātakādbhavān || jābālitīrthe ye snānaṃ puṇyaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ|| 27|| teṣāṃ naśyaṃti vai satyaṃ pañcapātakasaṃcayāḥ || satkarmasādhane puṇyatīrthe'sminsnānamātrataḥ || 28 || mahāpātakisaṃsargadoṣaste vilayaṃ gataḥ || tvāmagrahīdyo vetālaḥ purāyaṃ brāhmaṇo'bhavat || 29 || mṛte'hani pitṛśrāddhaṃ nākarotpārvaṇena vai || tena svapitṛbhiḥ śapto vetālatvamagādayam || 2.1.25.30 || so'pi jābālitīrthasya jale snānaprabhāvataḥ || vetālatvaṃ vihāyaiva viṣṇulokamavāptavān|| 31 || na kuryādyo naraḥ śrāddhaṃ mātāpitrormṛte'hani || vetālatvamavāpyāśu paścānnarakamaśnute || 32 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || durācāro mahāpāpī tīrthe'smitsnānamātrataḥ || prāptavānviṣṇulokaṃ vai punarāvṛttivarjitam || 33 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ durācāravimokṣaṇam|| tasmātpuṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham || 34 || yatra hi snānamātreṇa durācāro vimocitaḥ || yāni niṣkṛtihīnāni pāpānyapi vināśayet || 35 || śūdreṇa pūjitaṃ liṅgaṃ viṣṇuṃ vā yo nameddvijaḥ || prāyaścittaṃ na smṛtiṣu tasyoktaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ || 36 || naśyettasyāpi tatpāpaṃ tīrthe jābālisaṃjñake || vipranindākṛtāṃ caiva prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 37 || viśvāsaghātukānāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ ca niṣkṛtiḥ || bhrātṛbhāryāratānāṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 38 || teṣāṃ jābālitīrthe vai snānācchuddhirbhaviṣyati || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā jābālestīrthavaibhavam || 39 || yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavo bhuvi || 2.1.25.40 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye jābālitīrthamahimānuvarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<2.1.26>
|| atha tumburu(ghoṇa)tīrthamāhātmyam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || atrāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || ghoṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || tatra snānaṃ janānāṃ tu janmāntaratapaḥphalam || uttarāphalgunīyuktaśuklapakṣīyaparvaṇi || 2 || tumbostīrthaṃ mīnasaṃsthe ravau tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ || aparāhne samāyānti gaṃgādīni jagattraye || 3 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |||| bhagavansūta sarvajña sarvaśāstrārthapāraga || gaṃgāyāḥ saritaḥ sarvā ghoṇatīrthe'tipāvane || 4 || kimarthaṃ snāṃti vai tatra mīnasaṃsthe prabhākare || 5 || || || śrīsūta uvāca || || pāpino manujāḥ sarve hyasmāsu snānti yatnataḥ || visṛjya pāpajālāni kṛtārthā yāṃti vai janāḥ || 6 || asmākaṃ pāpajālaṃ tatkathaṃ naśyati sarvataḥ || evamālocya tīrthāni gaṃgādīni prayatnataḥ || 7 || saṃsmṛtya brahmaputrasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || vākyaṃ manoharaṃ divyaṃ sarvapāpaniṣūdanam || 8 || gatvā śrīveṃkaṭaṃ śailaṃ brahmahatyādiśoṣakam || tatra snātvā tīrthavarye svāmipuṣkariṇījale || 9 || anantaraṃ tato viprā ghoṇatīrthe'tipāvane || uttarāphalgunīyuktaśuktyapakṣīyaparvaṇi || 2.1.26.10 || snāṃti tīrthāni sarvāṇi mīnasaṃsthe prabhākare || tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ ko vetti bhuvanatraye || 11 || || atha ghoṇatīrthasnānavimukhānāṃ mahādoṣavarṇanam || || tasmātpuṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ ghoṇatīrthaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||12|| ārāmocchedakaṃ krūraṃ kanyāturagavikrayam|| ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhurbrahmaghātukam || 13 || devadravyāpahantāraṃ tathā dattāpahārakam || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhurbrahmaghātukam || 14 || taṭākasetubhettāraṃ parastrīsaṃgalolupam || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhuḥ steyinaṃ budhāḥ || 15 || dadāmīti dvijāyoktvā paścādyo nāstiko'dhamaḥ || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ surāpaṃ taṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 16 || guruviprajanadveṣyamātmastutiparāyaṇam || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhuḥ steyinaṃ budhāḥ || 17 || asaṃskṛtānnabhoktāraṃ pitṛśeṣānnabhojinam|| ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhuḥ steyinaṃ dvijāḥ || 18 || pitṛśeṣānnadātāraṃ mātāpitṛvirodhinam|| ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhuḥ steyinaṃ budhāḥ || 19 || parastrīsaṃganirataṃ bhrātṛbhāryāratipriyam || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhurgurutalpagam || 2.1.26.20 || caṇḍālabhāṣiṇaṃ vipraṃ sadaivādarbhapāṇikam || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tatsaṃsargaṃ tu pañcamam || 21 || rajasvalāśvacaṇḍāladhvani śrutvānnabhojinam || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tatsaṃsargaṃ tu pañcamam || 22 || purāṇodvāhamauṃjyādidharmāṇāṃ vighnakārakam || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhuḥ paśughātukam|| 23 || śaraṇāgatahantāraṃ sarvatīrthaparāṅmukham|| ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhurbhrūṇahaṃ budhāḥ ||24 || pitṛyajña parityaktaṃ tyaktabhāryaṃ kulādhamam || ghoṇasnānaparityaktaṃ tamāhurgovighātukam || 25 || mahāpāpasamānāni kṣudrapāpāni yāni ca || ghoṇasnānaparityaktamāśrayanti dvijottamāḥ || 26 || || atha ghoṇasnānasyasarvapāpāpanodakatvavarṇanam || || mahāpāparataṃ viprāḥ śvapacaṃ vā kulādhamam || krūraṃ kulāntakaṃ kaṣṭamadattaṃ karmavarjitam || 27 || paśughnaṃ ca paradrohamāśritaṃ piśunaṃ tathā || asatyabhāṣiṇaṃ dambhaparadārarataṃ tathā || 28 || mitradrohaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ ca bhrūṇaha cātipātakam || paradārarataṃ pāpaṃ parāṇāmarthasūcakam || 29 || anṛtaṃ kṛṣikarmāṇaṃ svāmidrohaṃ ca vañcakam || salobhaṃ pitṛhantāraṃ sarvadevaparāṅmukham || 2.1.26.30 || ātmapraśaṃsāṃ kurvāṇaṃ dharmavighnakaraṃ śaṭham || apātravyayakartāraṃ sānukūlyavibhedakam || 31 || supallavaphalopetavṛkṣavicchedakārakam|| viśvāsaghātukaṃ caiva vīrahatyāparāyaṇam || 32 || anagnikamaputraṃ ca viṣakarmaprayogiṇam || gurudveṣakaraṃ pāpaṃ dampatyorvirasāvaham || 33 || grāmādhipatyaṃ kurvāṇaṃ tathā devālayasya ca || bhṛtakakhyāpakaṃ vipraṃ kūrakarmaparāyaṇam || 34 || prakṛtīkṛta pāpaughaṃ guhyāghaughaparāyaṇam || ajñānādaghakartāraṃ jñānādduṣkarmakārakam || 35 || etānsarvāṃśca vipreṃdrā ghoṇatīrthaṃ manoharam|| punāti snānapānādyairaho tīrthasya vaibhavam || 36 || || atha tumburvākhyagaṃdharvacaritam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ pāpanāśanam || sarvapāpapraśamanamapavargaphalapradam || 37 || purā gārgyo mahātejāḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ || sarvajño nītimānvipraḥ prāha cetthaṃ jitendriyaḥ || 38 || devalaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ namaskṛtya prasannadhīḥ || kathayasva mahābhāga mayi kāruṇiko bhava || ghoṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham |||| 39 || || devala uvāca || || tumbururnāma gandharvo bhāryāṃ śaptvā pativratām || atra snātvā samabhyarcya veṃkaṭeśaṃ dayānidhim || 2.1.26.40 || prāptavānviṣṇulokaṃ vai punarāvṛttivarjitam|| 41 || || gārgya uvāca || || kimarthaṃ devala ṛṣe bhāryāṃ rūpavatīṃ striyam || tumbururnāma gandharvaḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ ||42 || śaptavānkena doṣeṇa bhāryāṃ sarvaguṇānvitām || tadvadasva mahābhāga śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 43 || || atha svabhāryāyai tumburūpadiṣṭamāghasnānavidhiprakāraḥ || || tumbururnāma gandharvo bhāryāṃ prītyā hyuvāca ha || māghatraye mayā sākaṃ snānaṃ kuru malāpaham || || 44 || māghamāsyudite sūrye sarvakalmaṣanāśane || tīre'sminviṣṇupūjārthaṃ gomayālepanaṃ kuru || 45 || raṃgavallyādibhiḥ śubhrapadmasvastika dhātubhiḥ || śuśrūṣāṃ kuru me viṣṇormāse'sminmaṃgalaprade || 46 || māghe'sminmādhavasyāsya kuru tvaṃ dīpavartikām || sadhūpaṃ pāvakaṃ bhaktyā samarpaya hareḥ puraḥ || 47 || kuru pākaṃ śucirbhūtvā mādhavāya mahātmane || pradakṣiṇānamaskārairbhaktyā māghe mayā saha || 48 || kuruṣva devadevasya saparyāṃ viṣṇave'nvaham || purāṇaśravaṇaṃ viṣṇoḥ kuru nityamataṃdritā || 49 || nityaṃ snātvā prayatnena piba pādodakaṃ hareḥ || kṛṣṇa viṣṇo mukundeti nārāyaṇa janārdana || 2.1.26.50 || acyutānanta viśvātmanniti kīrtaya santatam || krodhamātsaryalobhādīṃstyaktvā tvaṃ vratamācara || 51 || tena te jāyate muktirviṣṇulokaśca śāśvataḥ || || atha bhāryāṃ prati tumburudattaśāpatadvimuktiprakārau || || itthaṃ sā bhartṛgaditaṃ śrutvā gaṃdharvavallabhā || bhartāramabravītkopādasahyaṃ durgatipradam || 52 || māghe codbhūtaśīte tu prātarmandodite ravau || kathaṃ nimajjayedasminmāghe śītārtike'nagha || 53 || yattvayoktāni karmāṇi na śakyāni mayā'sakṛt|| na karomi pate snānaṃ prātaḥkāle tvayā saha || 54 || mṛtau śītātipātena na ca me rakṣako bhavān || ityevamuditaṃ śrutvā patirgandharvavallabhaḥ || 55 || saśānto'pi śaśāpātha bhāryāṃ cāpriyavādinīm || putraṃ ca dharmavimukhaṃ bhāryāṃ cāpriyabhāṣiṇīm ||56|| abrahmaṇyaṃ ca rājānaṃ sadyaḥ śāpena daṇḍayet || iti nyāyaṃ viciṃtyāsau śaśāpetthaṃ satīṃ tadā || 57 || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane || ghoṇatīrthasamīpe ca pippaladrumakoṭare || 58 || tatrāmburahite mūḍhe maṇḍūkā bhava kevalam || ityevaṃ bhartṛvākyaṃ tacchrutvā gaṃdharvavallabhā || 59 || patitvā pādayostasya tumbaruṃ prārthayatsatī || viśāpamavadatpaścādbhartā vai tumburustadā || 2.1.26.60 || agastyo vai mahābhāgastapasvī vijitendriyaḥ || ghoṇatīrthavare snātvā paurṇamāsyāṃ mahātithau || 61 || śiṣyebhyo vai yadā tasminnaśvatthadrumasaṃnidhau || ghoṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vakti vai brāhmaṇottamaḥ || 62 || tadā pippalavṛkṣasya koṭare tvaṃ samāhitā || śrutvā vai ghoṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mokṣadāyakam || 63 || vidhūya sarvapāpāni mayā sākaṃ ramiṣyasi || ityuktā virarāmātha dharmapatnī pativratā || 64 || bhartṛśāpānmahāghorāṃ maṃḍūkatanumāśritā || śeṣādriśikhare tasminghoṇatīrthasya dakṣiṇe || || 65 || śanaiḥśanairgatā nārī pippaladrumakoṭaram || abdāyutaṃ gataṃ tasyā aśvatthadrumakoṭare || 66 || tataḥ kālāṃtare'gastyo veṃkaṭādriṃ manoharam || gatvā śrīsvāmitīrthe ca snātvā niyamapūrvakam || 67 || varāhasvāminaṃ devaṃ natvā tīrthasya dakṣiṇe || veṃkaṭeśālayaṃ gatvā śrīnivāsaṃ kṛpānidhim|| 68 || vedavedyaṃ viśālākṣaṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam || natvā'gastyo mahābhāgo ghoṇatīrthaṃ tato yayau || 69 || tatra snātvā tīrthavarye svaśiṣyai yogināṃ varaḥ || pippaladrumacchāyāyāṃ śiṣyebhyo bhaktipūrvakam || 2.1.26.70 || ghoṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ brahmahatyāvināśakam || sarvamaṃgaladaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasampatpradāyakam|| 71 || uktavānyogināṃ śreṣṭho hyagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 72 || || atha ghoṇatīrthe agastyadarśanena tumburupatnyā varṣābhūtva nivṛttiḥ || || tadā śrutvā tu varṣābhūḥ pādayostasya yoginaḥ || patitvā jñānadīpena viditvā vaibhavaṃ muneḥ || 73 || pūrvarūpaṃ samāsādya nārī rūpaṃ manoharam || agastya yogināṃ śreṣṭha rakṣarakṣa dayānidhe || 74 || māṃ rakṣa dayayā brahmanpativākyavirodhinīm || ityuktvā taṃ vikṣālākṣī virarāma tataḥ param || 75 || || agastya uvāca || || kā tvaṃ suśroṇi bhadraṃ te bhekajanmapradāyakam || pāpaṃ pūrvabhave cāsīttadvadasva ca mā ciram ||76|| || || nāryuvāca || || tumbururnāma gandharvaḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ || tasya bhāryāsmyahaṃ vipra hyagastya munisevita || 77 || bhartā me sarvadharmajñastumbururmunisattamaḥ || sarvadharmānmanojñā tvaṃ kuru nityaṃ mayā saha || 78 || pativākyaṃ tadā śrutvā paralokopakārakam || asahyaṃ vākyamatyugraṃ durgatipradameva hi || 79 || mayā coktaṃ hi durbuddhyā he tāta munisattama || 2.1.26.80 || || athāgastyakathitapativratādharmāḥ || || agastya uvāca || || kuśāgrabuddhiste bhartā śaśāpa tvāṃ ruṣānvitaḥ || evaṃ śāpo yukta eva pativākyavirodhinīm || 81 || pativākyamanādṛtya svecchayā vartate tu yā || sā nārī niraye ghore patatyācandratārakam || 82 || na svātantryaṃ tu nārīṇāṃ nollaṃghyaṃ patibhāṣaṇam || pātivratyena puṇyena patiśuśrūṣaṇena ca || 83 || striyo viṣṇupadaṃ yānti na cānyairapi suvrataiḥ || patirmātā patirviṣṇuḥ patirbrahmā patiḥ śivaḥ || 84 || patirguruḥ patistīrthamiti strīṇāṃ vidurbudhāḥ || pativākyamapākṛtya yā nārī sukṛtaiḥ paraiḥ || 85 || sadaiva yujyate sāpi naiva śuddhā bhavetsakṛt || patihīnā tu yā nārī gurubhirdharmavittamaiḥ || 86 || sā kṛtajñā vidadhyāttu vrataṃ dharmaphalapradam || patinā preritā saiva patibuddhiparāyaṇā || 87 || patipādābjatīrthena yā snātā sā haripriyā || sā snātā sarvatīrtheṣu gaṅgādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ || 88 || tasmāttvatkṛtadoṣastu tvāmāyātīti tatphalam || bhuñjantyāste'tra śṛṇvantyā ghoṇatīrthasya vaibhavam || 89 || muktirāsīcchubhāṃgaṃ tannārīrūpaṃ punaryathā || || tasmādghoṇasya tīrthasya tumbutīrthamitīha vai || 2.1.26.90 || loke prasiddhirabhavadaho tīrthasya vaibhavam || 91 || || atha ghoṇatīrthasnātṝṇāṃ nānāvidhaphalaprāptiḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ghoṇatīrthe mahāpuṇye sarvapāpavināśini || snānti ye paurṇamāsyāṃ vai śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || 92 || teṣāṃ kratuphalaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthāyutaphalaṃ bhavet || kapilāgosahasraṃ tu yo dadāti dinedine || 93 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti snānāttumburutīrthake || ratnakoṭisahasrāṇi yo dadāti dinedine || 94 || mattebhānāṃ sahasrāṇi tathaivāśvāyutānyapi || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ghoṇatīrthāvagāhanāt || 95 || kanyākoṭipradānena yatphalaṃ carṣibhiḥ smṛtam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ghoṇatīrthācca pāvanāt || 96 || hemāṃbarasahasraṃ yaḥ kurukṣetre prayacchati || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ghoṇatīrthasya vaibhavāt || 97 || gurvarthe brāhmaṇārthe ca svāmyarthe yastyajettanum || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ghoṇatīrthasya vaibhavāt || 98 || āpannārtiharāṇāṃ ca tīrthasevāparātmanām || satyavratānāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ ghoṇatīrthācca tadbhavet || 99 || yatphalaṃ śrāddhakartṝṇāṃ pitṛṇāmindusaṃkṣaye || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ghoṇatīrthāddhi pāvanāt || 2.1.26.100 || gaṅgāyāṃ narmadāyāṃ ca sarayūcandrabhāgayoḥ || sarveṣu puṇyatīrtheṣu yaḥ snānaṃ kurute naraḥ || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ghoṇatīrthāddhi pāvanāt || 101 || tasmātpuṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ ghoṇatīrthaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 102 || ya imaṃ śṛṇute'dhyāyaṃ sarvapāpanibarhaṇam || vājapeyaphalaṃ tasya viṣṇulokaśca śāśvataḥ || 103 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṃḍe śrīveṅkaṭācalamāhātmye tumburutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 26 || ||
<2.1.27>
atha śrīveṃkaṭācalasya sarvapuṇyatīrthādhāratvavarṇanam || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye sarvasaṃkaṭanāśane || santi vai kati tīrthāni sūta paurāṇikottama || 1 || teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ ca me brūhi kati mukhyāni tatra vai || tatrāpyatyantamukhyāni vada me munisattama || 2 || saddharmaratidānyatra kati mukhyāni tāni ca || kāni jñānapradānyatra bhaktiverāgyadāni ca || 3 || muktipradāni kānyatra tāni me vada suvrata || 4 || || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ṣaṭṣaṣṭikoṭitīrthāni puṇyānyatra nagottame || aṣṭottarasahasrāṇi teṣu mukhyāni suvrata || 5 || saddharmaratidānyatra santi cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || sahasrebhyaśca mukhyāni pṛthaktebhyaśca tāni ca ||6|| bhaktivairāgyadānyatra ṣaṣṭiraṣṭottare śate || 7 || || atha svāmipuṣkariṇyādiṣaṭtīrthasnānakālanirṇayaḥ || || muktidānyatra ṣaṭ caiva veṃkaṭācalamūrdhani || svāmipuṣkariṇī caiva viyadgaṅgā tataḥ param || 8 || paścātpāpavināśaṃ ca pāṇḍutīrthamataḥparam || kumāradhārikātīrthaṃ tumbostīrthamataḥ param || 9 || kumbhamāse paurṇamāsyāṃ maghāyogo yadā bhavet || kumāradhārikāṃ yānti sarvatīrthāni he dvijāḥ || 2.1.27.10 || tatra yaḥ snāti viprendrā rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || muktiśca bhavitā tatra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 11|| annadānavidhistatra sārdhaṃ dakṣiṇayā' dvijāḥ || uttarāphalgunīyuktaśuklapakṣīyaparvaṇi || 12 || tumbostīrthaṃ mīnasaṃsthe ravau tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ || aparāhṇe samāyānti tatra snāto na jāyate||13|| mauñjībandhaṃ vivāhaṃ ca kārayeddravyadānataḥ || meṣasaṃkramaṇe bhānau citrānakṣatrasaṃyute || || 14 || paurṇamāsyāṃ samāyānti viyadgaṅgāṃ tathaiva ca || tatra snātvā naraḥ sadyaḥ śatakratuphalaṃ labhet || 15|| suvarṇaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ kanyādānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || vṛṣabhasthe ravau viprā dvādaśyāṃ harivāsare || 16 || śukle vāpyatha kṛṣṇe vā bhaumenāpi samanvite || pāṇḍutīrthaṃ samāyānti gaṅgādīni jagattraye || 17 || tatra snātvā ca gāṃ dattvā mucyate pratibandhakāt || āśvayukchuklapakṣe ca saptamyāṃ bhānuvāsare || 18 || uttarāṣāḍhayuktāyāṃ tathā pāpavināśanam || uttarābhādrayuktāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ vā samāgataḥ || 19 || śālagrāmaśilāṃ dattvā snātvā ca vidhipūrvakam || mucyate sarvapāpaiśca janma koṭiśatodbhavaiḥ || 2.1.27.20 || dhanurmāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāmaruṇodaye || āyānti sarvatīrthāni svāmipuṣkariṇījale || 21 || tatra snātvā naraḥ sadyo muktimeti na saṃśayaḥ || yasya janmasahasreṣu puṇyamevārjitaṃ purā || 22 || tasya snānaṃ bhavedviprā nānyasya tvakṛtātmanaḥ || vibhavānuguṇaṃ dānaṃ kāryaṃ tatra yathāvidhi|| 23|| śāligrāmaśilādānaṃ gāṃ dadyācca viśeṣataḥ|| 24|| || atha purāṇaśravaṇasya viśeṣataḥ prāśastyavarṇanam|| || ye śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ viṣṇoḥ sadā bhuvanapāvanīm || te vai manuṣyaloke'sminviṣṇubhaktā bhavanti hi||25|| yadyaśaktaḥ sadā śrotuṃ kathāṃ bhuvanapāvanīm|| muhūrtaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ vā viṣṇusatkathām|| yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā durgatirnāsti tasya hi|| 26|| yatphalaṃ sarvayajñeṣu sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || sakṛtapurāṇaśravaṇāttatphalaṃ vindate naraḥ|| 27|| kalau yuge viśeṣeṇa purāṇaśravaṇādṛte|| nāsti dharmaḥ paraḥ puṃsāṃ nāsti muktipradaṃ param||28 || purāṇaśravaṇaṃ viṣṇornāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ param|| ubhe eva manuṣyāṇāṃ puṇyadrumamahāphale|| 29|| pibannevāmṛtaṃ yatnādekaḥ syādajarāmaraḥ|| viṇṇoḥ kathāmṛtaṃ kuryātkulamevājarāmaram || 2.1.27.30 || || atha purāṇavaktuḥ sarvapūjanīyatvavarṇanam || || bālo yuvātha vṛddho vā daridro durbhago'pi vā || purāṇajñaḥ sadā vandyaḥ sa pūjyaḥ sukṛtātmabhiḥ || 31 || nīcabuddhiṃ na kurvīta purāṇajñe kadācana || yasya vaktrodgatā vāṇī kāmadhenuḥ śarīriṇām || 32 || bhavakoṭisahasreṣu bhūtvā bhūtvāvasīdatām || yo dadātyapunarvṛttiṃ ko'nyastasmātparo guruḥ || 33 || vyāsāsanasamārūḍho yadā paurāṇiko dvijaḥ || ā samāpteḥ prasaṃgasya namaskuryānna kasyacit || 34 || na durjanasamākīrṇe na śūdraśvāpadāvṛte || deśe na dyūtasadane vadetpuṇyakathāṃ sudhīḥ || 35 || sugrāme sujanākīrṇe sukṣetre devatālaye || puṇye vātha nadītīre vadetpuṇyakathāṃ sudhīḥ ||36|| śraddhābhaktisamāyuktā nānyakāryeṣu lālasā || vāgyatāḥ śucayo'vyagrāḥ śrotāraḥ puṇyabhāginaḥ || 37 || abhaktyā ye kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śṛṇvaṃti manujādhamāḥ || teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ nāsti duḥkhaṃ janmani janmani || 38 || purāṇaṃ ye tu saṃpūjya tāmbūlādyairupāyanaiḥ || śṛṇvaṃti ca kathāṃ bhaktyā na daridrā na pāpinaḥ || 39 || kathāyāṃ kathyamānāyāṃ ye gacchantyanyato narāḥ|| bhogāntare praṇaśyanti teṣāṃ dārāśca saṃpadaḥ ||2.1.27.40|| soṣṇīṣamastakā ye ca kathāṃ śṛṇvaṃti pāvanīm || te bālakāḥ prajāyante pāpino manujādhamāḥ||41|| tāṃbūlaṃ bhakṣayanto ye kathāṃ śṛṇvaṃti pāvanīm || śvaviṣṭhāṃ bhakṣayantyete narake ca pataṃti hi||42|| ye ca tuṃgāsanārūḍhāḥ kathāṃ śṛṇvanti dāṃbhikāḥ || akṣayyānnarakānbhuktvā te bhavantyeva vāyasāḥ ||43|| ye ca vīrāsanārūḍhā ye ca siṃhāsanasthitā|| śṛṇvanti satkathāṃ te vai bhavantyarjunapādapāḥ ||44|| asaṃpraṇamya śṛṇvanto viṣavṛkṣā bhavanti hi || tathā śayānāḥ śṛṇvanto bhavantyajagarā hi te || 45 || yaḥ śṛṇoti kathāṃ vaktuḥ samānāsanasaṃsthitaḥ|| gurutalpasamaṃ pāpaṃ saṃprāpya narakaṃ vrajet || 46 || ye nindaṃti purāṇajñaṃ satkathāṃ pāpahāriṇīm || te vai janmaśataṃ martyāḥ śunakāśca bhavaṃti hi || 47 || kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ ye vadaṃti duruttaram || te gardabhāḥ prajāyante kṛkalāsāstataḥparam || 48 || kadācidapi ye puṇyāṃ na śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ narāḥ || te bhuktvā narakānghorānbhavanti vanasūkarāḥ || 49 || kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ vighnaṃ kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || koṭyabdaṃ narakānbhuktvā bhavaṃti grāmasūkarāḥ || 2.1.27.50 || ye kathāmanumodante kīrtyamānāṃ narottamāḥ || aśṛṇvanto'pi te yānti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam|| || 51 || ye śrāvayanti manujāḥ puṇyāṃ paurāṇikīṃ kathām || kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tiṣṭhanti brahmaṇaḥ pade || 52 || āsanārthaṃ prayacchanti purāṇajñasya ye narāḥ || kambalājinavāsāṃsi tathā maṃcakameva vā || 53 || svargalokaṃ samāsādya bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān || sthitvā brahmādilokeṣu padaṃ yāṃti nirāmayam || 54 || purāṇasya prayacchanti ye ca sūtraṃ navaṃ varam || bhogino jñānasaṃpannāste bhavaṃti bhave bhave || 55 || ye mahāpātakairyuktā hyupapātakinaśca ye || purāṇaśravaṇādeva te yāṃti paramaṃ padam || 56 || veṃkaṭādrestu māhātmyaṃ śrutvā ta ṛṣayastataḥ || vyāsaprasādasaṃpannaṃ sūtaṃ paurāṇikottamam || pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ praharṣamatulaṃ gatāḥ || 57 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye sarvatīrthamahimopasaṃhārapūrvakapurāṇaśravaṇaprakriyādyanuvarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || || cha || ||
<2.1.28>
|| atha kaṭāhatīrthamāhātmyam || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta sarvārthatattvajña vedavedāntapāraga || śrīveṃkaṭācale tīrthaṃ kaṭāhākhyaṃ supāvanam || ||1|| śrūyate tasya māhātmyaṃ ghuṣyate ca jagattraye || asmākametadbrūhi tvaṃ kṛpayā vyāsaśāsita || 2 || purā vai nāradaḥ śrīmānbrahmaputro mahānṛṣiḥ || dṛṣṭvā vai naimiṣāraṇyaṃ saṃprāpto dvijasattamaḥ || 3 || tadānīṃ brahmaputraṃ tamarghyapādyādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ || pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pavitre ca kuśāsane || || 4 || sanniveśya mahābhaktyā vinayānatakandharāḥ || praṇamya prārthayāmāsurime sarve maharṣayaḥ || 5 || tvāṃ vinā nārada śrīmannasmākaṃ bhuvanatraye || dharmopadeśakaḥ kaścinnāsti nāsti maharṣiṣu || 6 || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye sarvadevaniṣevite|| vaikuṇḍādāgate divye siddhagandharvasevite || 7 || kaṭāhatīrthamāhātmyaṃ varṇayādya vanaukasām || 8 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || kaṭāhatīrthamāhātmyaṃ ko vetti bhuvanatraye || 9 || mahādevo vijānāti tasya tīrthasya vaibhavam || yāni kāni ca puṇyāni brahmāṇḍāntargatāni vai || 2.1.28.10 || tāni gaṃgāditīrthāni svapāpapariśuddhaye || kaṭāhatīrthasevāṃ ca kurvanti dvijasattamāḥ || 11 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣattriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścetarajātayaḥ || spṛśanti tajjalamiti na pibedyo vimūḍhadhīḥ || 12 || sa hi caṇḍālatāṃ prāpya kumbhīpāke patiṣyati || brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho yatīśvaraḥ || 13 || sevayā tasya tīrthasya prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || śrutismṛtipurāṇeṣu tattīrthasya praśaṃsanam || 14 || bahudhā varṇyate paṃcamahāpātakanāśanam || atyadbhutataraṃ viprāḥ sarvalokaikapāvanam || 15 || brahmahatyāyutaṃ cāpi surāpānāyutaṃ tathā || ayutaṃ gurudārāṇāṃ gamanaṃ pāpakāraṇam || 16 || steyāyutaṃ suvarṇānāṃ tatsaṃsargāśca koṭayaḥ || śīghraṃ vilayamāyāṃti tasya tīrthasya sevayā || 17 || yāni niṣkṛtihīnāni pāpāni vividhāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi naśyaṃti tīrthasyāsya niṣevaṇāt || 18 || idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhagavatpādanissṛtam || kuṣṭhādirogayukto yaḥ pratyahaṃ ca pibedidam || 19 || || || atha kaṭāhatīrthamahimaśraddhāśūnyānāṃ mahānarakaprāptiḥ || || so'pi rogavihīnaḥ sanviṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati || bhagavāñchaṃkaro devo rahasyānubhave purā || 2.1.28.20 || pārvatyai kathayāmāsa tasya tīrthasya vaibhavam || ukteṣveteṣu sandeho na kartavyaḥ kadācana || 21 || arthavādo'yamiti ca na vaktavyaṃ kadācana || ye'rthavādamidaṃ brūyusteṣāṃ vai nāstikātmanām || 22 || jihvāgre paraśuṃ taptaṃ prakṣipanti ca kiṃkarāḥ || tasmātkaṭāhatīrthaṃ tu sevanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||23|| sarvaduḥkhapraśamanamapavargaphalapradam || yatra pītvā naro bhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt||24|| evamuktvā mahābhāgaḥ kāśīṃ trailokyapāvanīm || saṃprāpto nāradaḥ śrīmānsūta paurāṇikottama || 25 || saṃkṣepataśca bhagavānnaimiṣe hyuktavānkhalu || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmaḥ kaṭāhasya ca vaibhavam || 26 || suvistareṇa cāsmākaṃ vada sūta kṛpāvaśāt || 27 || || atha kaṭāhatīrthapānakramaḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || bhobhostapodhanāḥ sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || kaṭāhatīrthamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 28 || kaṭāhatīrthaṃ bho viprāḥ sarva lokeṣu viśrutam || sarvasampatkaraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 29 || duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ hyetanmahāpātakanāśanam || mahāvighnapraśamanaṃ mahāśāntikaraṃ nṛṇām || 2.1.28.30 || smṛtimātreṇa yatpuṃsāṃ sarvapāpaniṣūdanam || mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇaiva pibettīrthaṃ manoharam || 31 || athavā keśavādyaiśca nāmabhirvā pibejjalam || yadvā nāmatrayeṇā'pi pibettīrthaṃ śubhapradam || 32 || āhosvidveṃkaṭeśasya mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa vai || pibetkaṭāhatīrthaṃ tadbhuktimuktipradāyakam || 33 || vinā maṃtreṇa yo vipraḥ saṃpibettīrthamuttamam || pāpaṃ me nāśaya kṣipraṃ janmāntarakṛtaṃ mahat || 34 || ityuktvā sa pibennityaṃ mokṣamārgaikasādhanam || svāmipuṣkariṇīsnānaṃ varāhaśrīśadarśanam || 35 || kaṭāhatīrthapānaṃ ca trayaṃ trailokyadurlabham || bahunā kimihoktena brahmahatyādināśanam || 36 || || atha keśavākhyadvijavṛttāntaḥ || || purā kaściddvijo mohātkeśavākhyo bahuśrutam || hatvā khaḍgena durbuddhyā brahmahatyāmavāptavān || 37 || so'pi tasminmahātīrthe pītvā jalamanuttamam || keśavākhyo mahāpāpī vimukto brahmahatyayā || 38 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kasya putraḥ keśavākhyaḥ kathaṃ prāpto bhayaṃkarīm || brahmahatyāmatikrūrāmasmākaṃ vaktumarhasi || 39 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || tuṅgabhadrātaṭe ramye gandharvairupasevite || agrahāro mahānāsīdvedāḍhya iti nāmataḥ || 2.1.28.40 || tasminvedapure ramye brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || śabdaśāstraparāḥ sarve jyotiḥśāstrapravartakāḥ || 41 || mīmāṃsātarkaśāstrajñāḥ sarve vedāntavādinaḥ || dharmaśāstreṣu niratā annadānaparāḥ sadā || 42 || putravantaśca te sarve hyagrahāre mahājanāḥ || vedāḍhaye'pyagrahāre vai padmanābha iti śrutaḥ || 43 || || atha gaṇikālaṃpaṭasya keśavadvijasya brahmahatyāprāptikramaḥ || || tasya putraḥ keśavākhyaḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tyaktvā bhāryāmapi pativratām || 44 || sarvadā gaṇikāsakto veśyāgāraṃ viveśa ha || dinadvaye ca tāṃ veśyāmanubhūya dvijastataḥ || 45 || niṣkadvayaṃ pradātavyaṃ haste dattvā gataḥ sukham || veśyayā cādhanastyaktastatsaṃyogaikatatparaḥ || 46 || itastataścorayitvā bahudravyāṇi santatam || dattvā tayā ciraṃ reme tadgṛhe bubhuje ca saḥ || 47 || ekena caṣakeṇāsau tayā saha surāṃ papau || sa kadācitkirātaistu dravyaṃ hartuṃ yayau dvijaḥ |||| 48 || viprasya kasyacidgehe so'pi kairātaveṣadhṛk || keśavo viprabandhurvai sāhasī khaṅgahastavān || 49 || tadgṛhasvāminaṃ vipraṃ hatvā khaḍgena sāhasāt || samādāya bahu dravyaṃ veśyāgāraṃ viveśa ha || 2.1.28.50 || taṃ yāntamanuyāti sma brahmahatyā bhayaṃkarī || nīlavastradharā bhīmā bhṛśaṃ raktaśiroruhā |||| 51 || garjantī sāṭṭahāsaṃ sā kampayantī ca rodasī || anudrutastayā vipro babhrāma jagatītale || 52 || evaṃ bhramandharāṃ sarvāṃ viprabandhurdurātmavān || svagrāmaṃ prayayau bhītyā śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || 53 || anudrutastayā bhītaḥ prayayau svaniketanam|| brahmahatyāpyanudrutya tena sākaṃ gṛhaṃ yayau ||54|| janakaṃ rakṣa rakṣeti keśavaḥ śaraṇaṃ yayau || mā bhaiṣīriti sa procya pitā rakṣitumudyataḥ || 55 || || atha svasutarakṣaṇodyukte padmanābhe brahmahatyoktiḥ || krūrainaṃ brahmahatyā sā janakaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 56 || || brahmahatyovāca || || mainaṃ tvaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva padmanābha dvijottama || ayaṃ surāpī steyī ca brahmahā cātipātakī || 57 || mātṛdrohī pitṛdrohī bhāryātyāgī ca duṣṭadhīḥ || gaṇikāsaktacittaśca hyenaṃ muñca durātmakam || 58 || gṛhṇāsi cetsutaṃ vipra mahāpātakinaṃ vṛthā || tvadbhāryāmasya bhāryāṃ ca tvāṃ ca putramimaṃ dvija || 59 || bhakṣayiṣyāmi vaṃśaṃ ca tasmānmuñca durātmakam || imaṃ tyajasi cetputraṃ yuṣmānmuñcāmi sāṃpratam || 2.1.28.60 || naikasyārthe kulaṃ hantumarhasi tvaṃ mahāmate || ityuktaḥ sa tayā tatra padmanābho'bravīcca tām || 61 || || || padmanābha uvāca || || bādhate māṃ sutasnehaḥ kathaṃ putraṃ parityaje || brahmahatyā tadākarṇya padmanābhaṃ tamabravīt || 62 || || brahmahatyovāca || || putro'yaṃ patito'bhūtte varṇāśramabahiṣkṛtaḥ || putresminmā kuru snehaṃ niṃditaṃ tasya darśanam || 63 || ityuktvā brahmahatyā sā padmanābhasya paśyataḥ || hastena prajahārāsya sutaṃ keśavanāmakam || 64 || ruroda tātatāteti janakaṃ prabruvanmuhuḥ || rurudurjanako mātā bhāryā tasya durātmanaḥ || 65 || || atha padmanābhaṃ prati bharadvājakathito brahmahatyāvimuktyupāyaḥ || || tasminkāle mahābhāgo bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ || diṣṭyā samāyayau yogī śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || 66 || padmanābho'tha taṃ dṛṣṭvā bharadvājaṃ mahāmunim || stutvā praṇamya śaraṇaṃ yayāce putrakāraṇāt || 67 || bharadvāja mahābhāga sākṣādviṣṇvaṃśako bhavān || tvaddarśanamapuṇyānāṃ bhavitā na kadācana || 68 || brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī cābhūtsuto mama || putraṃ prahartumā yātā brahmahatyā bhayaṃkarī || 69 || bhūyādyathā me putroyaṃ mahāpātakamocitaḥ || ghoreyaṃ brahmahatyā ca yathā śīghraṃ layaṃ vrajet || 2.1.28.70 || tamupāyaṃ vadasvādya mama putre dayāṃ kuru || eka eva hi putro me nānyo'sti tanayo mune || 71 || sute mṛte tu vaṃśo me samucchidyeta mūlataḥ || tataḥ pitṛbhyaḥ piṇḍānāṃ dātā'pi na bhaveddhruvam || 72 || tataḥ kṛpāṃ kuruṣva tvamasmāsu bhagavanmune || ityuktaḥ sa bharadvājaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇāṃśakaḥ || 73 || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ padmanābhaṃ vaco'bravīt || 74 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || padmanābha kṛtaṃ pāpamatikrūraṃ sutena te || nāsya pāpasya śāntiḥ syātprāyaścittāyutairapi || 75 || tathā'pi te sutasyāhamasya pāpasya śāntaye || prāyaścittaṃ vadiṣyāmi padmanābha śṛṇu dvija || 76 || gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe bhāge dviśatīyojane dvija || pūrvāmbhodheḥ paścime tu pañcabhiryojanairmite || 77 || suvarṇamukharītīre cottare krośamātrake || veṃkaṭādriti khyātaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 78 || meruputro mahāpuṇyaḥ sarvadevābhivanditaḥ || vaikuṇṭhalokādānīto viṣṇoḥ krīḍācalo mahān || 79 || garutmatā vegavatā svarṇamukhyāstaṭe śubhe || vartate devasaṃghaiśca ṛṣisaṃghaiśca pūjitaḥ || 2.1.28.80 || tasminveṃkaṭaśailendre sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ svayam || lakṣmīdevyā ca bhūdevyā nīlādevyā samāgataḥ || 81 || vartate veṃkaṭeśaḥ sa sākṣānmokṣapradāyakaḥ || tasya veṃkaṭanāthasya hyālayasya tathottare || 82 || kaṭāhatīrthaṃ viprendra vartate maṅgalapradam || brahmahatyādipāpaghnaṃ vāñchitārthapradāyakam || 83 || sutena sākaṃ vipreṃdra piba tīrthaṃ manoharam || bharadvājasya vākyaṃ tacchrutvā vai vedasaṃmitam || 84 || śirasā taṃ praṇamyātha yayau veṃkaṭaparvatam || || 85 || || atha bharadvājoktyā kaṭāhatīrthapānena keśavasya brahmahatyāvimuktiḥ || || taṃ gatvā veṃkaṭaṃ śailaṃ svāmipuṣkariṇījale || sutena sākaṃ vipreṃdraḥ sasnau niyamapūrvakam || 86 || varāhasvāminaṃ natvā śrīnivāsālayaṃ gataḥ || pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vimānaṃ saṃpraṇamya ca || 87 || padmanābho'tha putreṇa keśavena durātmanā || papau kaṭāhatīrthaṃ tadbrahmahatyāvināśakam || 88 || tadānīṃ brahmahatyā sā śīghrameva layaṃ gatā || anantaraṃ tato gatvā veṃkaṭeśaṃ kṛpānidhim || 89 || putreṇa saha viprendraḥ padmanābho dadarśa saḥ || tadā prādurabhūddevo veṅkaṭeśo dayānidhiḥ || 2.1.28.90 || kaṭāhatīrthapānena toṣito vākyamabravīt || 91 || || atha brahmahatyāvimuktasutena sahitaṃ padmanābhaṃ prati bhagavaduktiḥ || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || padmanābha mahābuddhe vedavedāntapāraga || bharadvājasya vākyena prāpya veṃkaṭaparvatam || 92 || kaṭāhatīrthaṃ tvaṃ pītvā kṛtārtho'si na saṃśayaḥ || tava putraḥ keśavākhyo vimukto brahmahatyayā || 93 || tasmātkaṭāhatīrthaṃ tu sevanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || tasmiṃstīrthe mahābhāga pītvā jalamanuttamam || 94 || pāpino'pi kṛtārthāḥ syuḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || māmakaṃ lokamāgatya sukhī bhava mahāmate || 95 || ityuktvā veṃkaṭeśo'sāvantardhānaṃ gatastataḥ || 96 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || tasmāttapodhanāḥ sarve śaunakādyā mahaujasaḥ || kaṭāhatīrthamāhātmyamitihāsasamanvitam || 97 || yathāśrutaṃ mayā samyaktathoktaṃ bhavatāṃ dvijāḥ || 98 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye sūtaśaunaka saṃvāde kaṭāhatīrthapraśaṃsanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || || cha ||
<2.1.29>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || tīrthānāmiha sarveṣāṃ prabhāvaḥ kathitastvayā || nadīnāṃ parvatānāṃ ca kṣetrāṇāṃ sarasāmapi || 1 || nideśātpadmagarbhasya suvarṇamukharī nadī || nītā bhuvamagastyena vyākhyātā bhavatānagha || 2 || tadutpattiprabhāvaṃ ca tīrthaughāṃstatsamāśrayān || śrotuṃ saṃprītirutpannā tanno vaktuṃ tvamarhasi || 3 || praṇamya śambhuṃ nandīśaṃ ṣaḍāsyaṃ vyāsameva ca || munibhiḥ prārthitaḥ sūtastadā vaktuṃ pracakrame || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahābhāga bhavadbhirmaṃgalāvaham || ākhyānametadāmnāya śravaṇodbhūtasiddhidam || 5 || śṛṇutāvahitā divyāṃ kathāṃ kalmaṣanāśinīm || bharadvājena kathitāṃ pārthāya kathayāmi vaḥ || 6 || avāpya drupadātprājñādyājñasenīṃ pṛthāsutāḥ || dhṛtarāṣṭranideśena jagmuḥ karipuraṃ śubham || 7 || bhīṣmeṇa cāṃbikeyena tatra saṃmānitāstadā || duryodhanādibhiḥ sārddhaṃ nyavasanpañcavatsarān || 8 || tato'nuśiṣṭo bhīṣmādyairdhṛtarāṣṭro mahāyaśāḥ || sarveṣāṃ kulavṛddhānāṃ vāsudevasya cāgrataḥ || 9 || pradadau pāṃḍuputrebhyastatsevāhṛṣṭamānasaḥ || sārdharājyaṃ puravaraṃ khāṇḍavaprasthasaṃjñikam || 2.1.29.10 || āmaṃtrya pāṇḍutanayā dhṛtarāṣṭrādikānkurūn || jagmustatkhāṇḍavaprasthaṃ puraṃ kṛṣṇasamanvitāḥ | 11 || indraprasthāhvaye tatra rakṣite viśvakarmaṇā || vasanpure'śiṣatpṛthvīṃ sānujo dharmanaṃdanaḥ ||12|| gate kṛṣṇe nijapuraṃ nāradasyānuśāsanāt|| pratijñāṃ cakrire pārthā dharmajñā draupadīṃ prati || 13 || || athārjunatīrthayātropoddhātaḥ || || yathākrameṇa sā kṛṣṇā varṣamekaikamādarāt || ekaikasya gṛhe tiṣṭhetpratinirṇayapūrvakam || 14 || yaḥ paśyettāṃ paragṛhe sthitāṃ pāṃcālanaṃdinīm || tenaikahāyanamitaṃ vidheyaṃ tīrthasevanam || 15 || evaṃ kṛtapratijñāste pāṇḍubhūpālanaṃdanāḥ || vyāpārairloṃkasāmānyairninyuḥ kālamataṃdritāḥ || 16 || atha jānapado vipro rājagehāṃgaṇe sthitaḥ || cukrośa bahudhā dhenurhṛtā me taskarairiti || 17 || samāśvāsya ca taṃ vipraṃ praviveśa dhanaṃjayaḥ || āyudhāni samānetuṃ tvarayā śastramaṃdiram || 18 || tatrāpaśyatsamāsīnau pāṃcālīdharmanandanau || jānannapi pratijñāṃ sa dhanurjagrāha seṣudhi || 19 || sa gatvā taskarānājau nihatya nṛpanandanaḥ || nivartya dhenuṃ tāṃ tasmai dadau viprāya sādaram || 2.1.29.20 || atha vijñāpayāmāsa phālguno dharmanandanam || tīrthayātrā mayā kāryā samayollaṃghanāditi || 21 || anujasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarvadharmavidāṃ varaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ dhīraḥ sādaraṃ dharmanaṃdanaḥ || 22 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || gavārthaṃ brāhmaṇārthaṃ ca yadvadedanṛtaṃ vacaḥ || yadācaredasatkarma tatsatyaṃ tatsamaṃjasam || 23 || brāhmaṇārthaṃ gavārthaṃ ca tvayā karmedṛśaṃ kṛtam || tadasadbhāvamāpnoti kathaṃ kathaya suvrata || 24 || prajāpālanakṛtyasya coropekṣaṇaśikṣaṇaiḥ || nūnaṃ phalaṃ bhavedrājño brahmahatyāśvamedhajam || 25 || asādhyānvairiṇo jñātvā'pyavanīśo na bhadrabhāk || svadeśopaplavakarāstaskarā yadyaśikṣitāḥ || 26 || asmākaṃ bhūbhujāṃ lokajālasya ca hitaṃ hi yat || tvayedṛśaṃ kṛtaṃ karma nāsti doṣo hyatastava || 27 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || dharmaputrasya vacanamākarṇya racitāṃjaliḥ || punarvijñāpayāmāsa dharmanityo dhanaṃjayaḥ |||| 28 || || arjuna uvāca || || maivaṃ bhūpāla vādīstvaṃ svapratijñātilaṃghanam || jānatā dharmasarvasvamullasaddharmamūrtinā || 29 || kṛtyākṛtyavidā dakṣeṇātmanā prāksamīritā || nollaṃghanīyā satataṃ pratijñā puruṣeṇa hi || 2.1.29.30 || aśaktānāṃ gatiḥ seyaṃ yadbaṃdhuguruvākyataḥ || dharmaṃ tyajaṃti samayaṃ tyaktāḥ prāksvaṃ samīritam || 31 || kṛpayā tīrthagamanādāryo yadi nivartayet || hatapratijñaṃ māṃ lokāñjalpataḥ ko nivārayet || 32 || mamāpi tīrthayātrāyāṃ kautukottaralaṃ manaḥ || kartavyaṃ ca smṛtaṃ rājannāradādiṣṭaśāsanam || 33 || tatprasīda mahārāja yattīrthagamanodyame || saṃmānanīyaḥ prabhubhiḥ samayo hyanujīvinām || 34 || tatheti bhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ kṛtānumatirarjunaḥ || agrajaṃ toṣayāmāsa praṇāmapraśrayādibhiḥ || 35 || yathārhaṃ bhīmasenādīnbhrātṝnāmantrya pāṇḍavaḥ || kṛtasvastyayano bhavyairniryayau dharaṇīsuraiḥ || 36 || paurāṇikā jyautiṣikā bhiṣajo dharaṇīsurāḥ || anujagmurbhṛtyagaṇāḥ śilpinaḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ || 37 || yudhiṣṭhirājñayā tasya bhogatyāgakṣamaṃ dhanam || gṛhītvānuyayuḥ snigdhāḥ sabhyāḥ kośādhikāriṇaḥ || 38 || || atha arjunasya gaṃgāditīrthāvagāhanapūrvaka suvarṇamukharyāgamanam || || sa rājaputraḥ prathamaṃ prāpya bhāgīrathīṃ nadīm || gaṃgādvāraṃ prayāgaṃ ca siṣeve kāśikāmapi || 39 || paśyaṃstīrthāni jāhnavyāstattīropāntavartmanā || āsasāda samuttuṅgakallolaṃ dakṣiṇodadhim || 2.1.29.40 || mahānadīṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ prasiddhaṃ puruṣottamam || siṃhācalaṃ ca saṃvīkṣya prāptavānkṛtakṛtyatām || 41 || tato dadarśa kaunteyaḥ puṇyāṃ godāvarīṃ nadīm || samastaduritavrātaśātanottīrṇagauravām || 42 || kṛtābhiṣekastattoyairvidhivatpāṇḍunandanaḥ || pramodaṃ vividhairdānairakarodbhūsuvarṇakaiḥ || 43 || nadīṃ malāpahākhyāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā modaṃ yayau śubham || tataḥ samāsasādāsau kṛṣṇaveṇīṃ saridvarām || 44 || śivasya niyatāvāsaṃ caturdvārasamanvitam || nānātīrthagaṇākīrṇaṃ śrīparvatamavaikṣata || 45 || nadīṃ pinākinīṃ tīrtvā gatvā devarṣisevitam || nārāyaṇapriyāvāsamapaśyadveṃkaṭācalam || 46 || śṛṅge'sya bhūbhṛtastuṃge sthitaṃ lokaikanāyakam || apūjayaddhariṃ bhaktyā prasiddhaṃ śubhasiddhaye || 47 || avaruhya veṃkaṭamahādriśṛṅgataḥ sa dadarśa siddhamunisaṃghasevitām || kalaśodbhavena muninā samāhṛtāṃ taṭinīṃ suvarṇamukharīsamāhvayām || 48 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye suvarṇamukharīmāhātmye arjunatīrthayātrāgamanavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || || cha ||
<2.1.30>
|| atha suvarṇamukharīvarṇanam || || sūta uvāca || || tathā sarvāṇi tīrthāni samālokyāgatasya ca || mudaṃ praguṇayāñcake sā pārthasya mahāpagā || 1 || yasyāstaṭanikuñjeṣu modante vanitāḥ sukhāḥ || siddhāḥ saṃsevitā vātaiḥ śīkarāsāraśītalaiḥ |||| 2 || yā samudyatahasteva gaṅgāmākāśavāhinīm || āliṃgituṃ samuttuṃgaiḥ kallolairabhrasaṃgibhiḥ || 3 || dhūmairāhutisaṃbhūtaistaruśākhopalaṃbhibhiḥ || valkalaiśca virājante yattaṭāśramabhūmayaḥ || 4 || munīndraiḥ suravaryaiśca sthāpitāni samantataḥ || yattaṭadvitaye bhāṃti divyaliṃgāni śūlinaḥ || 5 || yadīyasaikatāvāsaviśrāntā mānasaṃ saraḥ || na smaraṃti nijāvāsaṃ marālā vihagottamāḥ || 6 || śamitāvagrahātaṃkaiḥ kulyāmukhavinirgataiḥ || puṣṇāti toyaiḥ sasyāni lokarakṣākṣamāṇi yā || 7 || cakravākakucottuṃgavīcivallīvibhūṣitā || āvartanābhivilasatsaikataśroṇi maṇḍalā || 8 || praphullapadmavadanā calanmīnayugekṣaṇā || vilasatphenavasanā haṃsayānamanoharā || 9 || jalapakṣiravālāpā nayanānandakāriṇī || apūrvakāminīrūpā yā vibhātyambudhipriyā || 2.1.30.10 || rodhasyantaravāhinyā nadyāḥ prācyāṃ dhanañjayaḥ || dadarśa śailamuttuṃgaṃ kālahastisamāhayam ||11|| udagraśikharābhogollikhitākāśamaṇḍalam || saptapātālamūlādhorūḍhamūlopalāṃcitam || 12 || || atha arjunasya svarṇamukharītīrasthakālahastīśvarādisevāprāptiḥ || || snātvā tasyāṃ mahānadyāṃ tasmiñchaile surārcitam || apaśyadarjuno devaṃ kālahastīśanāmakam || 13 || saṃpūjya ca mahādevaṃ nagendratanayāsakham || manasā bhaktiyuktena kṛtārthatvamupeyivān || 14 || tato mahāgirau tasminnadbhutaikaniketane || cacārābhūtapūrvāṇāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ didṛkṣayā || 15 || siddhānālokayāmāsa vasato girisānuṣu || gāyato devadevasya caritrāṇyabalāyutān || 16 || apsarolalanājuṣṭānpuṣpāsavamadākulān || nikuñjeṣu samāsīnāngaṃdharvānaikṣatādarāt || 17 || vivikteṣu pradeśeṣu śivadhyānaparāyaṇān || apaśyadyogino divyānādarānandaśālinaḥ || 18 || praśāntānyāśramapadānyavaikṣata samaṃtataḥ || balinīvāravilasaddvārabhūmīśca pāṇḍavaḥ || 19 || nirāhārānvāyubhujaḥ parṇādānātapāśanān || śāntānālokayāmāsa munīnniyamitendriyān || 2.1.30.20 || mudaṃ vitenire tasya netrayoḥ kamalākarāḥ|| phullasaugandhikāmodasaṃvāsitadigantarāḥ || 21 || mṛgayāsaṃbhṛtadhiyaścarato'dhijyakārmukān || 22 || || athā'rjunasya suvarṇamukharītīrasthabharadvājāśramagamanam || || dadarśānveṣitamṛgānkirātānvanitāyutān || tato dakṣiṇadigbhāge carannadrermanohare || 23 || puṇyamāśramamadrākṣīdbharadvājasya kauravaḥ || kadalīnārikelāmrakolacaṃpakacaṃdanaiḥ || 24 || takkolāśokahintālatālaketakidāḍimaiḥ || jaṃbūkadamvakatakakhadirārjunapāṭalaiḥ |||| 25 || nāgapunnāgasaraladevadārukarañjakaiḥ || lavaṃgaluṃgalavalīpriyaṃgutilakairapi || 26 || bibhītaśrīphalāśvatthamadhūkaplakṣakesaraiḥ || pūgajambīranāraṃganimbāmalakakauśikaiḥ || 27 || anyaiśca phalapuṣpāḍhyaiḥ śobhitaṃ dharaṇīruhaiḥ || vāsantīkundajātyādilatābhiḥ pariveṣṭitam || 28 || apūrvasaurabhākṛṣṭabhramarībhiḥ samantataḥ || cakravākabakakrauñcahaṃsakāraṇḍavāśrayaiḥ || 29 || saugandhikotpalāṃbhojakairavaughavirājitaiḥ || sarobhiramṛtasyaṃdimadhurasphāravāribhiḥ || 2.1.30.30 || samāpāditalakṣmīkaṃ kautukaikaniketanam || siṃhadantāvalavyāghratarakṣurururaṅkubhiḥ || 31 || mṛgairanyaiḥ samākīrṇamanyo'nyahitakāribhiḥ || jitacaitrarathodyānamadharīkṛtanandanam || 32 || ativāṅmanasodāraṃ paramānandakāraṇam || śivāgamānāṃ divyānāmarthajātamanuttamam || 33 || prakāśayanti śāvānāṃ yatra mañjugiraḥ śukāḥ || yasminhutāśano dāradhūmaśyāmalitaṃ nabhaḥ || 34 || akālajaladabhrāṃtimātanoti śikhaṇḍinām || yasminvihāraśrāntānāṃ siṃhānāṃ svecchayāgatāḥ || 35 || nirvāpayanti gātrāṇi kariṇaḥ karaśīkaraiḥ || tadāśramapadaṃ paśyanvismayākrāṃtamānasaḥ || 36 || prabhāvaṃ pāṇḍutanayaḥ praśaśaṃsa tapasvinām || nivārya tatra tatraiva sakalānanujīvinaḥ || 37 || || athārjunakṛtabharadvājasevākramaḥ || || mitrairvipravaraiḥ sārdhaṃ praviveśa tamāśramam || agre dadarśa kaunteyaḥ sphuratpāvakatejasam || 38 || bharadvājaṃ munivarairanekaiḥ parivāritam || bhasmānuliptasarvāṃgaṃ mṛgacarmottarīyakam || 39 || navavāridasaṃvītaṃ kailāsamiva bhāsvaram || jaṭābhirlambamānābhirbhāsvantaṃ svarṇakāṃtibhiḥ || 2.1.30.40 || sthiravidyullatākīrṇamiva śāradanīradam || śrutismṛti purāṇārthairekībhūya samāgataiḥ || 41 || aṅgīkṛtamivākāraṃ divyajñānaśubhāspadam || dhṛtikṣāṃtidayātuṣṭiśāṃtibhirnityasevitam || 42 || priyābhiriva raktābhirakhaṃḍabrahmavarcasam || upagamya śanaiḥ pārthastatpādāṃbujayoḥ puraḥ || 43 || cakre praṇāmaṃ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ samāliṃgitabhūtalam || 44 || || athārjunaṃ prati bharadvājakṛtātithyaprakāraḥ|| tamāgataṃ pṛthāputramutthāpya munipuṅgavaḥ|| āśīrbhiredhayāñcakre praharṣotphullamānasaḥ|| 45|| saṃpūjya ca yathānyāyaṃ tamarghyādyaiḥ priyātithim|| vinirdiṣṭāsanāsīnaṃ samapṛcchadanāmayam||46|| saṃmānanamavāpyāsmānmuneḥ pāṇḍavamadhyamaḥ|| priyairvākyairmunipaterakaronmanaso mudam || 47 || sasmārātha bharadvājaḥ svardhenuṃ kāmadohinīm || sā vitene'timahatīṃ bhakṣyabhojyādikalpanām || 48 || bhuktvā pārthaḥ sānucarastamupāsya taponidhim || dinaśeṣaṃ kathālāpakautukenātyavāhayat || 49 || tataḥ sāyantanīṃ saṃdhyāmupāsya hutapāvakaḥ || viprairamātyaiḥ sahito yayau tasya kuṭīgṛhān || 2.1.30.50 || tatrāsīno munipaterāśīrbhirabhinanditaḥ || ānandyamāno mumude tannadīśītalānilaiḥ || 51 || saṃprāpitā kena bhuvaḥ prabhūtā kasmānmahīdhrādadhikaprabhāvā || iti prabhāvaṃ paripṛcchya nadyāḥ śrotuṃ munīndrānmatirasya jajñe || 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye suvarṇamukharīmāhātmyapraśaṃsāyāṃ bharadvājāśramavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
<2.1.31>
|| atha suvarṇamukharīprabhāvaśuśrūṣayā bharadvājaṃ pratyarjunapraśraḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || kṛtasāyantanavidhiṃ hutāśanasamadyutim || sukhāsīnaṃ munipatiṃ praṇamya bharatarṣabhaḥ || 1 || tadīyaśītalāmodasudhāpūrānumoditaḥ || gambhīraṃ praśrayopetamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 2 || || || arjuna uvāca || || munipuṃgava loke'smindhanya eko'hameva hi || putrāviśeṣaṃ bhavatā yadevaṃ samyagādṛtaḥ || 3 || bhavadādarasañjātakautukaṃ mama mānasam || bhavadvākyāmṛtaṃ divyaṃ pātuṃ tvarayatīva mām ||4|| kasmācchailādiyaṃ jātā kenānītā mahānadī || kiṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānādyaiḥ kṛtaistatropalabhyate ||5|| asyāḥ prabhāvaṃ prabhavaṃ prahvasya mama sanmune || vaktumarhasi kāryo hi bhaktānugraha eva te ||6|| arjunasya vacaḥ śrutvā bharadvājo dvijottamaḥ || tadānanaṃ samālokya vākyaṃ vākyavidabravīt || 7 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || tvamarjuna mahābāho kauravānvayapāvanaḥ || viśeṣānmama mānyo'si dharmaputrānujo yataḥ || 8 || aneke bhūmipā dṛṣṭā na te tvamiva phālguna || līlārjavadayaudāryadhairyagāmbhīryaśālinaḥ || 9 || kulaṃ vidyā dhanaṃ caiva balināṃ madakāraṇam || bhavādṛśānāṃ bhavyānāṃ tāni praśrayakāraṇam || 2.1.31.10 || prājyeṣu rājyabhogeṣu vidyamāneṣu kaurava || ṛte bhavantaṃ ko vānyo nopaiti vikṛtervaśam || 11 || paravānasmi kaunteya guṇailākottaraistava || kimastyakathanīyaṃ te kautukopetamānasa || 12 || śṛṇu rājankathāṃ divyāṃ mayā munimukhācchutām || yāṃ śrutvā pātakātaṅkānmucyante sarvajantavaḥ || 13 || || atha bharadvājakathita śaṃkaravivāhaprakriyā || || pūrvaṃ dākṣāyaṇī devī janakenāvamānitā || tyaktvā tanuṃ tāṃ nīhāragirerabhavadātmajā || 14 || saptarṣibhirupāgamya prārthito dharaṇīdharaḥ || mṛtyuṃjayāya svāṃ putrīṃ vivāhe dātumudyataḥ || 15 || vṛṣabhāṃko jagatsvāmī vivoḍhuṃ sarvamaṃgalām || prāpto himavadāvāsamoṣadhīprasthanāmakam || 16 || tacchāsanātsamājagmuḥ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || bhūtāni bhūtanāthasya kalyāṇamabhinaṃditum || 17 || tadbhūribhārasaṃbhagnā bhūmiruttarasaṃśrayā || nimnatāmāyayau tāvadyāvatpātālamāsthitā ||18|| nirbhāralāghavādasmādbhṛśaṃ dakṣiṇagāminī | ūrdhvaṃ gatā ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarveṣāmabhavadbhayam ||19|| jñātvā tāṃ vikṛtiṃ bhūmerdṛṣṭvāgastyaṃmaheśvaraḥ || ita ehi mahāprājñetyuktvā vacanamabravīt || 2.1.31.20 || āgateṣu samasteṣu bhūteṣvatra vasundharā || tadbhāreṇa samākrāntā vikṛtiṃ samupāgatā || 21 || tadbhuvaḥ sāmyakaraṇe tvamarhasi mahāmate || ṛte tvāmatra hi tvattaḥ pareṇaitatkathaṃ bhavet || 22 || mattejaḥsaṃbhavo hi tvaṃ lokasaṃrakṣaṇodyataḥ || tasmānmadvacanādvatsa bhuvametāṃ samīkuru || 23 || matpāṇigrahaṇāllokakautukāyattabuddhiṣu || āgateṣu samasteṣu sthātavyaṃ bhavatā'pi ca || 24 || tvaṃ na tiṣṭhasi cedatra na kaścidvikṛtiṃ bhuvaḥ || apanetuṃ hi śaknoti tadgantavyaṃ tvayānagha || 25 || imāṃ girisutāpāṇigrahakalyāṇabhāsurām || mūrtiṃ pradarśayiṣyāmi yatra tiṣṭhasi tatra te || 26 || || atha bhūsāmyakaraṇāyāgastyasya himādrerdakṣiṇadiggamanam || || ityuktvā taṃ pariṣvajya visasarja maheśvaraḥ || tatheti praṇamyāsau yayau yāmyāṃ diśaṃ muniḥ || 27 || vindhyādriṃ samatikramya dakṣiṇāmāgate diśam || agastye muniśārdūle mahī sāmyamupāyayau || 28 || bhuvo'panīya vikṛtiṃ sthitaṃ kalaśajaṃ munim || tuṣṭuvurharṣataralāḥ suragandharvakinnarāḥ || 29 || sa dadarśa tato gatvā kaścicchailaṃ samunnatam || vitatairdharaṇīṃ pādairdhṛtvā saṃsthitamagrataḥ || 2.1.31.30 || mahauṣadhīnāṃ ratnānāmaśeṣāṇāṃ svayaṃbhuvā || akhaṇḍatejodīptānāṃ vinirmitamivākaram || 31 || samunnatairyaḥ śikharairnipatadvyomabhūtale || udāradhārāsaṃpannairdadhātīva nirantaram || 32 || śanairāruhya taṃ śailamagastyo munipuṃgavaḥ || nivāsāya matiṃ cakre ramye tacchikharasthale || 33 || tasyāmṛtopameyasya padmotpalakulaśriyaḥ || nānādrumaparītasya kāsārasyottare taṭe || 34 || manohare mahībhāge vidhāyāśramamuttamam || ārādhya pitṛdevarṣīnvidhivadvāstudevatām || 35 || uvāsa suciraṃ tatra munisaṅghasamanvitaḥ || devatāsiddhagandharvāpsarojuṣṭamahīdhare || 36 || tapaḥ samāveśitavittavṛttau tapovane tiṣṭhati kumbhajāte || praśastasaubhāgyasamanvito'driragastyaśailāhvayamāsasāda || 37 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe veṃkaṭācalamāhātmye suvarṇamukharīmāhātmyapraśaṃsāyāmarjunabharadvājasaṃvāde śaṃkaravivāhāgastyadakṣiṇadiggamanavarṇananāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 || || cha || || ||
<2.1.32>
|| atha nadyutpādanāyāgastvaṃ prati aśarīryuktiḥ || || bharadvāja uvāca || || sa kadācinmunivaraḥ kṛtapaurvāhnikakriyaḥ || viveśa devatāgāraṃ samārādhayituṃ śivam|| 1 || adṛśyarūpā vāgdevī tatrāśrāvi mahātmanā || tenādbhutopapannena vyaktavarṇasamujjvalā || 2 || ākāśavāṇyuvācainamagastyaṃ japatāṃ varam || nadīhīno hyayaṃ deśaḥ prasiddho'pi na śobhate || 3 || jñānavijñānavimukhaḥ sākāra iva bhūsuraḥ || dīkṣeva dakṣiṇāhīnā jyotsnāhīneva śarvarī || 4 || na vibhāti nadīhīnā pṛthvīyaṃ bhūsurottama || pravartaya nadīṃ kāñcillokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 5 || agādhaduritodbhūtabhītimocanaśālinīm || hitametatsuraughānāmetanmunivarārthitam || 6 || bhadrametanmanuṣyāṇāmetadācara suvrata || devānāmṛṣivaryāṇāṃ bhūjanānāṃ hitāvahām || 7 || pāpapaṃkapraśamanīṃ pravartaya mahānadīm || 8 || || śrībharadvāja uvāca || || tadākarṇya vaco vipraḥ kṣaṇaṃ cintāparāyaṇaḥ || samāpya devatāpūjāṃ bahirvedyāmupāviśat || 9 || ānāyayāmāsa tadā tadāśramagatānmunīn || teṣāmakathayaccāsau divyavāṇīritaṃ vacaḥ || 2.1.32.10 || tadadbhutamupaśrutya munayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || 11 || abhivandya muniśreṣṭhaṃ maitrāvaruṇimabruvan || 12 || || atha suvarṇamukharyutpādanāyāgastyaṃ prati maharṣiprārthanā || || munaya ūcuḥ || || āścaryāṇāṃ mahāścaryaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam || tavaiva śobhate divyaṃ tvaccaritraṃ kṛpānidhe |||| 13 || tava huṃkāramātreṇa bhraṣṭo devādhirājyataḥ || nahuṣaḥ kīṭatāṃ prāpa tataścitraṃ na vidyate || 14 || samāvṛtadharācakraḥ kallolātāḍitāmbaraḥ || kiṃ nvato vidyate citraṃ yadabdhiśculakīkṛtaḥ || 15 || sūryamārganirodhārthaṃ pravṛtto vindhyabhūdharaḥ || tvayā praśāṃtiṃ gamitaḥ kiṃ nvato vidyate param || 16 || tavādbhutāni karmāṇi kaḥ stotuṃ prabhavedbhuvi || manmahābhāgyayogāttvaṃ prāpto'sīti śarīritām || 17 || vayaṃ kṛtārthāḥ saṃjātāstrailokye yanmahāmune || nivasāmo'tra bhavatā sanāthā hyāśramasthale || 18 || varṇyo hi yāmyato dūre viṣayo'yaṃ dvijottama || samastavastupūrṇopi nadīhīno na rājate || 19 || kimalabdhanadīsnānenā'munā hatajanmanā || anadīke janapade vāsādajananaṃ varam || 2.1.32.20 || paripākastu bhāgyānāmasmākaṃ samupasthitaḥ || yadādiṣṭosi vibudhaiḥ pravartaya mahānadīm || 21 || pravartitāyāṃ deśesminmahānadyāṃ tavānagha || kadā nu khalu yāsyāmaḥ kṛtasnānā kṛtārthatām || 22 || kiṃ vitarkeṇa bahunā prayatnaḥ kriyatāṃ dhuvam || samānetuṃ jagadvandyāṃ śaraṇyāṃ sariduttamām || 23 || || || śrībharadvāja uvāca || || sa teṣāṃ vacanaṃ hṛdyaṃ mānayitvā mahādvijaḥ || samāneṣyāmi saritamiti cakre viniścayam || 24 || || || atha suvarṇamukharyāvirbhāvāyāgastyakṛtatapaḥprakāraḥ || || munīśvarairanujñātastānabhyarcya surānapi || viśeṣapūjāṃ vidhivadvidhāya puravidviṣaḥ|| 25 || aṃgīkṛtya vrataṃ gāḍhaṃ bahulakleśaduḥsaham || ananyasulabhaṃ yatnātsa cakāra mahattapaḥ || 26 || ghoreṣu gharmadivaseṣvantarastho havirbhujām || caturṇāṃ savitṛnyastadṛṣṭirnāpayayau klamam || 27 || vārṣikeṣu dineṣūgravāyusampātaduḥsahaiḥ || āsāraistāḍyamāno'pi nodvegamagamaddhṛdi || 28 || hemante samaye tiṣṭhankaṇṭhadaghneṣu vāriṣu || japadhyānaparo bhūtvā na kiñcidvikṛtiṃ yayau || 29 || tataḥ samīhitārthasya vilambamavalokya saḥ || punargāḍhatarāṃ niṣṭhāṃ prapede lokabhīṣaṇām || 2.1.32.30 || nigṛhya mānasīṃ vṛttiṃ nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ || avijñātabahirvṛttistasthau pāṣāṇavattadā || 31 || evaṃ tapasyatastasya sarvāṅgeṣu hutāśanaḥ || abhraṃliho jvalajjyotirniścakrāma bhayaṅkaraḥ ||32|| tato'dbhutaśikhājālairāvṛtāḥ sarvato diśaḥ || samudagrabhayodvignā janaughāḥ paricukruśuḥ || 33 || tadā tathāvidhaṃ ghoraṃ jagatsaṃkṣobhamāgatam || devā vijñāpayāmāsurnamaskṛtyābjajanmane || 34 || || athāgastyāśramaṃ prati caturmukhāgamanam || || tānāśvāsya tato brahmā siddhagandharvasevitaḥ || prādurāsītkumbhabhuvaḥ purobhāge tapasyataḥ || 35 || tamāgataṃ samālokya brahmāṇaṃ paramaṃ dvijaḥ || praṇamya vividhaiḥ stotraistoṣayāmāsa tanmanāḥ || 36 || tatastaṃ vinayānamramagastyaṃ vīkṣya padmabhūḥ || prasādasumukho bhūtvā pūtāṃ giramupādade || 37 || || brahmovāca || || parituṣṭo'smi tapasā duścareṇa tavānagha || vṛṇīṣva yadyadiṣṭaṃ te tattaddāsyāmi suvrata || 38 || || agastya uvāca || || tava prasādātsakalamupapannaṃ mama prabho || saṃprayacchasi cetkāmaṃ yāce niḥśaṃkayā dhiyā || 39 || nadīhīnamimaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā khidyati me manaḥ || arthāvavodharahitaṃ śrutipāṭhamivādhikam || 2.1.32.40 || urvīṃ pāvayituṃ dakṣāṃ rakṣituṃ ca mahānadīm || prasādaṃ kuru deveśa mameṣṭamidameva hi || 41 || || athāgastyaprārthanayā gaṅgāṃ prati caturmukhacodanā || || śrībharadvāja uvāca || || agastyasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhūyādevamiti bruvan || sasmāra manasā brahmā suravartmāśrayāṃ nadīm || 42 || athopetya viyadgaṃgā purastātparameṣṭhinaḥ || atiṣṭhanmukuṭanyastapraśastāñjalibhāsurā || 43 || svaśāsanātsamāyātāṃ vinayānatamastakām || tāṃ sarvajagatāṃ dhātrīmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 44 || || || brahmovāca || || gaṃge mayānuśāsyāsi kārye lokopakārake || tavāpi lokarakṣāyāṃ mameva niyatā sthitiḥ || 45 || deśe nadīvihīne'tra pravartayitumāpagām || hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ kumbhajanmā samīhate || 46 || tasmāttvamavatīryorvīṃ svāṃśenaikena bhūjanān || punīhi gaccha vasudhāmetaddarśitavartmanā|| 47 || bhūloke saṃpravṛtte tu pravāhe siddhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || seviṣyante suravarā munivaryāśca saṃtatam || 48 || nadīṣūttamatāṃ yāhi trāhi tvatsaṃśrayāñjanān || kuru priyamagastyasya gaccha bhadre yathāsukham || 49 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || ityuktvāntardadhe brahmā tayā nadyā ca tena ca || praṇāmapūjanastotrairviśeṣairabhinanditaḥ || 2.1.32.50 || || athāgastyasamīpe svāṃśatvena gaṃgākṛtanadyutpattyabhyupagamaḥ || || atha gaṃgā munipateḥ purastātsvāṃśasaṃbhavām || divyatejomayīṃ mūrtiṃ darśayitvā vaco'bravīt || 51 || || gaṃgovāca || || madīyāṃśo'yamavanīṃ saṃprāpya munivallabha || pūrayiṣyati te'bhīṣṭaṃ nadīrūpaṃ samāśritaḥ || 52 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || ityuktvā siddhavāhinyāṃ gatāyāṃ tatprayuktayā || gantavyaṃ vartmanā kenetyukto muniruvāca tām || 53 || || agastya uvāca || || gacchanpurastātkalyāṇi tvadīyagamanocitam || ahaṃ pradarśayiṣyāmi mārgaṃ tvaṃ māmanuvraja || 54 || ityuktā muninā tena saṃprahṛṣṭā tavānagha || yadiṣṭaṃ tatkariṣye'hamiti provāca sā śubhā || 55 || atha muniravatārya tāṃ nagendrāddhṛtataṭinītanumabhrasaṃgiśṛṅgāt || muditataramanā yayau purastāttadabhimatāṃ padavīṃ pradarśayansaḥ || 56 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye śrīsuvarṇamukharīmāhātmyapraśaṃsāyāṃ suvarṇamukharyāvirbhāvavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || || cha ||
<2.1.33>
|| atha suvarṇamukharīṃ prati śakrādistutiḥ || || bharadvāja uvāca || tadā divyavimānasthāḥ śakramukhyā divaukasaḥ || agastyamanuyāntīṃ tāmanujagmurmahāpagām || 1 || navāvatārāṃ tāṃ divyāṃ sarve ca munipuṃgavāḥ || kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ stotrairanuyātāḥ siṣevire || 2 || siddhacāraṇagandharvāḥ saṃbhṛtāśca sahasraśa || tāṃ nadīṃ taṃ munīndraṃ ca praśaśaṃsuḥ śubhaiḥstavaiḥ || 3 || sudhopamānamamalaṃ diṣṭyā labdhamidaṃ jalam || ityautsukyarasāyattā nanandurdharaṇījanāḥ || 4 || tadā nideśāddevasya padmayoneḥ samīraṇaḥ || śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 5 || || atha vāyukathitasuvarṇamukharīnāmaniṣpattiḥ || || vāyuruvāca || || suvarṇamiva lokānāṃ bhāgadheyādiyaṃ nadī || nītā bhuvamagastyena mukharīkṛtadiṅmukhā || 6 || tasmādyāsyati vikhyātiṃ sarvalokābhinanditām || suvarṇamukharī nāmnā dhāmni kaivalyasaṃpadaḥ || 7 || eṣā suvarṇamukharī saritsu sakalāsvapi || viśiṣṭā sevanīyā ca brahmaṇo vacanaṃ tvidam || 8 || || athāgastyakṛtasvānītasuvarṇamukharīmahimānuvarṇanam || || bharadvāja uvāca || || śrutvetthaṃ pavanenoktaṃ vacanaṃ kumbhasambhavaḥ || tutoṣa vismayākrāntaḥ svāntaḥpulakitāṃgakaḥ || 9 || evameṣā divyanadī snānapānādikalpanaiḥ || saukhyāvahā manuṣyāṇāṃ pratiṣṭhāmagamadbhuvi |||| 2.1.33.10 || ājñayā padmagarbhasya taṭinyākāśavāhinī| || suvarṇamukharīnāmnā punātyātmaikasaṃśrayān || 11 || bahūngirīndrānvanamaṇḍalaṃ ca deśānanekānsarariduttameyam || kramādatikramya niṣevyamāṇā mahānadībhirgirisaṃbhavābhiḥ || 12 || rogāhatānāmadhikāturāṇāmanāmayaikapratipādakāni || antarbahiḥ saṃbhṛtabhūritāpanivāraṇāni priyakāraṇāni || 13 || vihāraloladviradaprakāṇḍaśuṇḍāmahāghātarayotthitena || puṣpopahāraṃ pṛṣatotkareṇa harṣāddadātīva divākarasya || 14 || saugaṃdhikāmbhoruhakairavāṇāṃ saurabhyasaṃvāsitadiṅmukhānām || dvirephabhāgyaikaniketanānāmādhārabhūtānpratinirmalāni || 15 || līlāvagāhotsukanākanārīsīmantasindūrarajo'ruṇāni || tatkeśapāśacyutapārijātaprasūnagandhairadhivāsitāni || 16 || sā bibhratī saṃbhṛtamaṃgalāni svādūnyapaṃkānyatinirmalāni || sudhopamānāni surendrasūnoḥ payāṃsi pāpapratighātukāni || 17 || agastyaśailātsamavāptajanmā nītā bhuvaṃ kumbhasamudbhavena || praśastatīrthaughavirājamānā samāyayau dakṣiṇavārirāśim || 18 || śīkarākṣatavinyāsai ratnadīpārpaṇairapi || pratyudyayustāmambhodhervīcayo'bhimukhāgatāḥ || 19 || taraṃgahastairāliṃgya saṃbhāvyaināṃ samāgatām || cakāra saritāṃ nāthaḥ priyamāghoṣabhāṣaṇaiḥ |||| 2.1.33.20 || prāptāyāmanukūlāyāṃ tadā tasyāmapāṃnidheḥ || prahṛṣṭena taraṃgeṇa jīvanaṃ vavṛdhetarām || 21 || itthaṃ saṃsṛjya saritamagastyastāmudanvatā || stutvā yayau samāmantrya kṛtakṛtyo yadṛcchayā || 22 || || arjuna uvāca || || tvayaiṣa kathito brahmanmahānadyāḥ samudbhavaḥ || asyāḥ prabhāvaṃ bhagavannidānīṃ śrotumutsahe || 23 || || atha bharadvājavarṇitasuvarṇamukharīmāhātmyam || || bharadvāja uvāca || || aho nivarhaṇaṃ sarvaśreyasāmekakāraṇam || śṛṇu māhātmyamasyāste kathayiṣyāmi pāṇḍava || 24 || pāścāttyaṃ janma saṃprāpya jñānināṃ karmaṇaḥ kṣaye || suvarṇamukharīsnānaṃ siddhyedbrahmatvakāraṇam || 25 || etāṃ suvarṇamukharīṃ yojanānāṃ śatairapi || smṛtvā manuṣyaḥ pāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |||| 26 || niḥkṣiptamasthi jantūnāṃ suvarṇamukharījale || sopānatāṃ samāyāti brahmalokādhirohaṇe || 27 || smarantaḥ svarṇamukharīṃ yatra kutrāpi mānavāḥ || toyāntareṣu snātvāpi labhante phalamuttamam || 28 || tāvadevābhibhūyante narāḥ pātakakoṭibhiḥ|| suvarṇamukharīsnānaṃ yāvattallabhyate śubham || 29 || divyāntarikṣabhaumāni tīrthāni nijasiddhaye || smarantyaharahaḥ prātaḥ suvarṇamukharīṃ nadīm || 2.1.33.30 || agastyācalasaṃbhūtā dakṣiṇodadhigāminī || pāpāni svarṇamukharī smaraṇādeva nāśayet || 31 || suvarṇamukharīsnānalolupenāntarātmanā || vāñchaṃti martyatāmeva devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || 32 || suvarṇamukharītoyapuṣṭasasyānnabhojinaḥ || na lipyante mahāpāpairdurbhojanaśatodbhavaiḥ || 43 || api niṣkamitaṃ pītaṃ suvarṇamukharījalam || nāśayedadritulyāni hyāśu pāpāni dehinām || 34 || prāpyā'pi mānuṣaṃ janma suvaṇamukharījale || ye vā snānaṃ na kurvanti teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam || 35 || suvarṇamukharīsnānaṃ yadekaṃ vidhinā kṛtam || jāhnavīsnānakoṭīnāṃ samaṃ bhavati parvasu || 36 || goviṃda iva deveṣu nakṣatreṣviva candramāḥ || nareṣviva mahīpālo bhūruheṣviva kalpakaḥ || 37 || mahābhūteṣviva viyanmāyevākhilaśaktiṣu || gāyatrīva ca mantreṣu vajraṃ devāyudheṣviva || 38 || tattveṣvivātmanastattvaṃ rudrādhyāyo yajuṣṣviva || ananta iva nāgeṣu himācala ivādriṣu || 39 || potrikṣetramiva kṣetreṣvindriyeṣviva mānasam || nadīṣvapi ca sarvāsu suvarṇamukharī varā || 2.1.33.40 || nityaṃ smarennamaskuryātkīrtayenmanasārcayet || śuddhikṣema śivāpekṣī suvarṇamukharīṃ śubhām || 41 || agastyācalasaṃbhūtāṃ dakṣiṇodadhigāminīm || samastapāpahantrīṃ tvāṃ suvarṇamukharīṃ śraye || 42 || mahāpātakavipluṣṭaṃ gātraṃ mama tavodakaiḥ || kṣālayāmi jagaddhātri śreyasā yojayasva mām || 43 || iti sūktadvayaṃ samyaguccārya niyato naraḥ || suvarṇamukharītoye snātvā śuddhaḥ pramodate || 44 || brahmaṇā nirmitā pūrvamagastyena samāhṛtā || svayaṃ mandākinī mūrtā suvarṇamukharī varā || 45 || evaṃprabhāvā divyeyaṃ kīrtanīyā śubhārthibhiḥ || manasā bhaktiyuktena snātavyā śubhakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 46 || somasūryoparāgeṣu snānadānādikaṃ kṛtam || syādameyaphalaṃ pārtha suvarṇamukharītaṭe || 47 || saṃkrāntāvayane puṇye vyatīpāte'tha vāsare || suvarṇamukharīsnānaṃ kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet || 48 || janmarkṣe janmadivase suvarṇamukharījale || snātvā vidhivadāpnoti kṣemārogyasukhaśriyaḥ || 49 || duḥsvapnavighnajaṃ bhūtagrahaduḥsthānajaṃ tathā || suvarṇamukharītoye snātvā tarati kilbiṣam || 2.1.33.50 || suvarṇamukharītīre gopādapramitāṃ bhuvam || dattvā sarvamahīdānādyatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt || 51 || dhenuṃ savastrālaṃkārāṃ suvarṇamukharītaṭe || dattvā viprāya vidhivadyāti brahma sanātanam || 52 || puṇyakāleṣu dānāni vidheyānyakhilānyapi || ihāmutra phalaprāptyai suvarṇamukharītaṭe || 53 || japo homastapo dānaṃ pitṛkarma surārcanam || kṛtaṃ bhavecchataguṇaṃ suvarṇamukharītaṭe || 54 || anyatte kathayiṣyāmi vidheyaṃ vratamuttamam || suvarṇamukharītīre prativarṣaṃ sukhārthibhiḥ || 55 || meghakāle ravikaraistirodhānamupāgataḥ || yadodeti muniḥ śrīmānmitrāvaruṇanandanaḥ|| 56 || tasmindine ye niyatāḥ snānamasyāṃ prakurvate || taiḥ kalpaṃ ca surāvāse sthīyate kurunandana || 57 || tadāgastyasya yadrūpaṃ suvarṇena vinirmitam || vidhinā dadate pārtha te yāṃti brahma śāśvatam || 58 || || arjuna uvāca || || vidhinā kena kartavyaṃ vratametanmahāmune || tanmamācakṣva sakalaṃ jijñāsostu mahātmanaḥ || 59 || || athāgastyapratimādānavidhiḥ || || bharadvāja uvāca || || agastyasyodayadinaṃ jñātvā niyatamānasaḥ || svaśaktyā kārayedrūpaṃ tasya hemnā mahāmuneḥ || 2.1.33.60 || suvarṇabhāsvaracchāyaṃ jaṭābandhamanoharam || dadhānaṃ karapadmābhyāmakṣamālāṃ kamaṇḍalum || 61 || vasānaṃ mṛdulaṃ valkaṃ mṛgacarmottarīyakam || saumyaṃ bhasmāṃkaruciraṃ rudrākṣakṛtabhūṣaṇam || 62 || evaṃ vidhāya tadrūpaṃ snātvā niyatamānasaḥ || ācāryaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairalaṅkṛtya yathāvidhi || 63 || śāleyataṇḍulānāṃ tāmāḍhakasyopari sthitām || vastradvayasamāyuktāṃ pratimāṃ pratipūjayet || 64 || vindhyasaṃstambhano vārdhiculakīkṛtipeśalaḥ || brahmādisarvadevānāṃ tejasā suprakāśitaḥ || 65 || agastyaḥ kumbhasaṃbhūto devāsuranamaskṛtaḥ || prītimāpnotu mahatīṃ dānenānena me prabhuḥ || 66 || imaṃ mantraṃ samuccārya dhārāpūrvaṃ sadakṣiṇam || dattvā vimuktaḥ pāpebhyo yāti brahma sanātanam || 67 || janmāntarakṛtairnūnamiha janmakṛtairapi || mahāpāpopapāpaughairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 68 || brahmādyāḥ sakalā devāḥ sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ || carācarāṇi bhūtāni prītiṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 69 || kṛtvā vratamidaṃ puṇyamagastyasya ca sanmuneḥ || prītyarthaṃ bhojayedviprānyathāśakti sadakṣiṇam || 2.1.33.70 || tasminkarmaṇi cāśakto yathāśakti mahīsurān || svarṇadhānyādidānena toṣayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 71 || tithiṃ na vitathīkuryāttāṃ yatnena samācaret || yatkiñcidapi cāvaśyaṃ karma kuryācca pūruṣaḥ || 72 || mahāmuneragastyasya paripakvaṃ tapaḥphalam || nadī suvarṇamukharī kīrtanīyā surāsuraiḥ || 73 || evaṃ te kathitaḥ samyaṅmahānadyāḥ samudbhavaḥ || prabhāvaśca tadācakṣva yadbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 74 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe veṃkaṭācalamāhātmye suvarṇamukharīprabhāvapraśaṃsānāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
<2.1.34>
|| athāgastyatīrthāgastyeśvarayoḥ prabhāvaḥ || || arjuna uvāca || || śrotrāñjalibhyāṃ pītvāpi bhavadvākyāmṛtaṃ muhuḥ || mano nopaiti me tṛptiṃ bhūyaḥ śravaṇakāṅkṣayā || 1 || kriyāsamabhihāro me tvadvākyākarṇanaiṣiṇaḥ || manaḥ khedāya mā bhūtte karuṇābharitātmanaḥ || 2 || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi nadyāmasyāṃ mahāmune || kutra kutra samarthāni tīrthānyaghanibarhaṇe || 3 || kāḥ kāḥ puṇyataraṃgiṇyaḥ saṅgatā anayā mune || kutra snānena kṛttāghā nopayāṃti yamādbhayam || 4 || harācyutādidevānāṃ puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || yāniyāni ca puṇyāni tiṣṭhantyasyāstaṭadvaye |||| 5 || teṣu kṣetreṣu manujairyatphalaṃ samavāpyate || vihitairvidhivatsnānadānādiśubhakarmabhiḥ || 6 || sopākhyānamidaṃ sarvaṃ veditaṃ vedavittama || saṃjātā mahatī prītirvistāryācakṣva me kramāt || 7 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā pārtha kramādvistārya kathyate || ārabhyāgastyatīrthendrādasyāstīrthaughavaibhavam || 8 || akhaṇḍajñānarūpeṇa sarvalokahitaiṣiṇā || surāsurāṇāṃ saṃbhāvyenāgastyena mahātmanā || 9 || vasudhāmavatīrṇāyāṃ prathamaṃ taddharādharāt || snātvā yatra mahānadyāṃ saṃprāpnoti kṛtārthatām || 2.1.34.10 || agastyatīrthamityuktaṃ pāvanaṃ tajjagattraye || tatra snānena śuddhiḥ syānmahāpātakināmapi || 11 || anekajanmācaritamahāpātakasaṃhatiṃm || nira divi modante tatra snānaratā janāḥ || 12 || ye tatra tīrthe yatinaḥ kṛtasnānā yatendriyāḥ || gobhūtilahiraṇyādimahādānāni kurvate || 13 || te prāpnuvanti saṃpūrṇaṃ gaṃgādvāre samāhitaiḥ || vihitānāṃ śataguṇaṃ dānānāṃ phalamarjuna|| || 14 || atrāsti bhagavānīśaḥ khyāto'gastyeśasaṃjñayā || sthāpito'gastyamuninā lokānandavidhāyinā || 15 || snātvā tasyāṃ mahānadyāṃ talliṃgaṃ pūjayanti ye || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ saṃprāpnuvaṃti te || 16 || || atha suvarṇamukharīsnānakālanirṇayaḥ || || dhanūrāśiṃ parityajya yadā makaramaṃśumān|| viśettadayanaṃ puṇyamuttaraṃ parikīrtitam || 17 || tasmindine ye niyatā nadyāṃ snātvā samāhitāḥ || paśyanti pārvatīnāthamagastyeśaṃ surārcitam || 18 || agniṣṭomasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca || phalaṃ saṃprāpya modante divi devagaṇārcitāḥ || 19 || mṛgasaṃkramavelāyāṃ puruṣairmaṃgalārthibhiḥ || avaśyameva kartavyamagastyeśasya darśanam || 2.1.34.20 || || atha devarṣipitṛtīrthamāhātmyam || || aiśānyāṃ tasya tīrthasya deśe krośamite'rjuna || asti tīrthatrayaṃ khyātaṃ devarṣipitṛnāmabhiḥ || 21 || devarṣipitarastatra muninā tena pūjitāḥ || pradadurhṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarvānsamabhivāñchitān|| 22 || tadā devarṣipitṛbhiridaṃ tīrthatrayaṃ kramāt || asmannāmabhirīḍyaṃ syādityuktaṃ tasya sannidhau || 23 || tasmiṃstīrthatraye ye tu snātvā vihitatarpaṇāḥ || ṛṇatrayavinirmuktāste yānti divamakṣayām || 24 || || atha veṇāsuvarṇamukharīsaṃgamavarṇanam || || tataḥ prāguttarakṣoṇyāṃ yojanadvayasīmani || prāptā suvarṇamukharī veṇānāma mahānadī || 25 || samudagrarayāghātanipātitataṭadrumā || kulyānirgatavāḥpūrasamāplāvitakānanā || 26 || uttuṅgapulinotsaṃgakhelatkokakulākulā || ambujāmodalolālimālālīlāravānvitā || 27 || atikramya samuttuṃgānanekāndharaṇīdharān|| prabhūtatoyarucirā suvarṇamukharīṃ gatā || 28 || nadīdvayavyatikare kṛtasnānā yathāvidhi || daśānāmaśvamedhānāmakhaṇḍaṃ prāpnuyuḥ phalam || 29 || saṃgatā veṇayā puṇyā suvarṇamukharī nadī || giridurgamamārgeṇa yayāvuttaravāhinī || 2.1.34.30 || madhyagena mahīdhrāṇāṃ mārgeṇa viṣameṇa sā || gatvā vireje taṭinī yojanānāṃ catuṣṭayam|| 31 || pūrvatastasya deśasya viṣaye sārdhayojane || udakkūle mahānadyāḥ prāgvāhinyā manohare || 32 || agastyeśvara nāmāste khyātaṃ liṃgaṃ puradviṣaḥ || smaraṇaṃ devamartyānāṃ samastāghanivāraṇam || 33 || tatra snātvā mahānadyāṃ ye narā niyatendriyāḥ || paśyanti pārvatīnāthamagastyena pratiṣṭhitam || 34 || anekaiḥ pūrvajananairarjitaṃ pāpasañcayam || te nirasya surāvāse modante kālamakṣayam || || 35 || tataḥ sodaṅmukhī bhūtvā suvarṇamukharī yayau || yojanārdhamidaṃ deśaṃ tīrthasaṃghasamanvitā || 36 || || atha suvarṇamukharyā vyāghrapadāhvaya nadīsaṃgamaḥ || || tasmindeśe tu hintālatālasālamanorame || gatā suvarṇamukharī nadī vyāghrapadāhvayā || 37 || durvārabhūriduritavinivāraṇapeśalā || nīraṃdhatīravānīravanamaṇḍalamaṃḍitā || 38 || siddhagaṃdharvalalanā līlāgāhanaśālinī || tapasvikanyāniḥkṣipta balipuṣpavirājitā || || 39 || haṃsakāraṇḍavakrauñcakulakolāhalākulā || prākpravāhā samāgatya śailāntaragatādhvanā || 2.1.34.40 || saṃgame saritostatra kṛtasnānā narottamāḥ || samagramaśvamedhānāṃ daśānāprāpnuyuḥ phalam || 41 || || atha śaṃkhatīrthavarṇanam || || tatra vyāghrapadākhyāyāstaṭe lokamalāpahe || anaghaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ śaṃkhatīrthaṃ virājate || 42 || brahmarṣiniyatāvāsaṃ suragandharvasevitam || darśanasnānapānādyairamitānandadāyakam|| 43 || tatrāste bhagavānīśaḥ śaṃkheśonāma phālguna || śaṃkhanāmnā munīṃdreṇa liṃgarūpaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 44 || ye tatra tīrthe susnātāḥ paśyanti vṛṣavāhanam || daśāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ labdhvā yāṃti surālayam || 45 || yuktā tayā vyāghrapadābhidhānayā gatvā tato yojanasaṃmitāṃ bhuvam || yayau munīndrairvṛṣabhācalāṃtikaṃ saṃsevyamānā śubhanirmalodakā || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye'gastyatīrthādivividhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
<2.1.35>
|| atha suvarṇamukharyā kalyānadīsaṃgamaḥ || || bharadvāja uvāca || || suvarṇamukharī tatra saṃgatā maṃgalapradā || kalyānāma nadī puṇyā kālindī jāhnavīmiva || 1 || vṛṣabhācalasaṃbhūtā tīrtharājavirājitā || nadīnāmuttamā kalyā kaluṣaughavināśinī || 2 || nānātarulatāvrātavibhūṣitataṭadvayā || munisaṃghasukhāvāsā puṇyāśramasamutkaṭā || 3 || dvijadattārdhyavilasatkuśākṣatalasattaṭā || apsaraḥkucakastūrīpaṃkakṣālanapaṃkilā || 4 || dantāvalakaṭacyotanmadāmbusurabhīkṛtā || viprabhūpālavitatamakhayūpa śatāvṛtā || 5 || anāvilajalāpūratoṣitāśeṣamānavā || ekaivālaṃ parā kartuṃ mahānadyostu pātakam || 6 || tayoḥ saṃgatayoḥ stotuṃ mahimānaṃ ka īśate || yatra brahmaśilānāma sarinmadhye ca vartate || 7 || agastyatapasā paścādgayā sāṃnidhyameti ca || nadīdvayajale tatra snātāḥ puṇye kurūdvaha ||8|| makhānāṃ pauṇḍarīkāṇāṃ śatasya phalamāpnuyuḥ || brahmahatyādipāpāni samāyāṃti parikṣayam || 9 || tatrābhiṣekapūtānāṃ nadīdvitayasaṃgame || saṅgatā bhavanāśinyā kṛṣṇaveṇīva pāvanī || 2.1.35.10 || || atha suvarṇamukharītīrasthitaśrīveṃkaṭācalavarṇanam || || rājate svarṇamukharī kalyayā saṃgatā tadā || 11 || athodīcyāṃ mahānadyā yojanārddhe virājate || yojanotsedhasahito vikhyāto veṃkaṭācalaḥ || 12 || sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāmāśrayo'yaṃ nagottamaḥ || añjanānantavṛṣabhanīlakesaripotriṇaḥ || 13 || etānyupavanānyadreḥ syurnārāyaṇaveṃkaṭau|| varāhavapuṣā pūrvaṃ svīkṛtatvānmadhudviṣā |||| 14 || varāhakṣetramityāryaiḥ kīrtito'yaṃ mahīdharaḥ || suvarṇamukharītīre vikhyāte veṃkaṭācale || 15 || nivasatyacyuto nityamabdhīndratanayānvitaḥ|| tasmingirau śriyā sārddhaṃ vasante veṃkaṭādhipam|| 16|| sevante siddhagandharvamunimānavadānavāḥ|| tasminvinyastacittānāṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame|| 17|| vāṃchitānyāśu sidhyaṃti naśyaṃti vipado'rjuna || ye smaraṃti jagannāthaṃ veṃkaṭādrinivāsinam ||18|| nirastadoṣāste yāṃti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam ||19|| || || arjuna uvāca || || veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ || kathaṃ prādurabhūddevo bhagavānkamalāpatiḥ || 2.1.35.20 || kasya vā kṛtinastatra prasanno nijamadbhutam || rūpaṃ prakāśayāṃcakre bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 21 || viṣṇordevādidevasya mahimānaṃ mahāmune || śrotumicchāmi tattvena tanme kathaya vistarāt || 22 || || atha śrīveṃkaṭācalavāsibhagavadvaibhavavarṇanam || || bharadvāja uvāca || || śṛṇu veṃkaṭanāthasya mahimānaṃ samāhitaḥ || vistareṇa samākhyātuṃ brahmaṇāpi na śakyate || 23 || dhanyo'si devadevasya māhātmyaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ || yadbhaktiyuktābhūttāta śrotuṃ matirarindama || 24 || kṛtapuṇyo'smyahaṃ pārtha sarvabhūtapaterhareḥ || pavitrāṇi caritrāṇi stoṣyante yanmayā'dhunā || 25 || purā bhāgīrathītīre janakāya mahātmane || kratudīkṣāprasaktāya viśuddhajñānaśāline || 26 || vāmadevena kathitāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || kathayiṣyāmi te pārtha viṣṇukīrtanapāvanīm || 27 || sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāmādyo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || jaganmayo jagatkartā citsvarūpo niraṃjanaḥ || || 28 || sahasraśīrṣā bhagavānsahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt || yasya bhāsā jagadidaṃ vibhāti sacarācaram || 29 || tasmātparataraṃ tejastasmātparataraṃ tapaḥ || tasmātparataraṃ jñānaṃ yogastasmātparo na ca || 2.1.35.30 || vidyā tasmādapi parā nāsti pārtha nararṣabha || sarveṣvapi ca bhūteṣu sadā sannihitaḥ prabhuḥ || 31 || sarvāṇyapi ca bhūtāni tasminnevāsate sukham || sa eva yajño yajvā ca sādhanaṃ sruksruvādikam || 32 || phalaṃ phalapradātā ca tatsaṃprāpyā gatistathā || vahnau praṇīte paśunā prokṣitena prajuhvati || ye taṃ prayāṃti te yāṃti gatiṃ tatpratipāditām || 33 || karmabandhaṃ paśuṃ kṛtvā jñānāgnau saṃpravartite || ye juhvate tamuddiśya te tatsāyujyabhāginaḥ || 34 || hariḥ sadāśivo brahmā mahendraḥ paramaḥ svarāṭ || sarveśvarasya tasyaite paryāyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 35 || mamāhito'nusaṃdhatte ya idaṃ paramātmanaḥ || nārāyaṇasya māhātmyaṃ sa na yāti punarbhavam || 36 || cidānandamayaḥ sākṣī nirguṇo nirupādhikaḥ || nityo'pi bhajate tāṃtāmavasthāṃ sa yadṛcchayā || 37 || pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yo hyagatīnāṃ parā gatiḥ || daivataṃ devatānāṃ ca śreyasāṃ śreya uttamam || 38 || bodhyānāṃ bodhya eko'sau dhyeyānāṃ dhyeya uttamaḥ || vinayānāṃ samadhiko vinayo nayasaṃyutaḥ || 39 || tejasāṃ janakaṃ tejaḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ tapasāṃ tapaḥ || ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāmanādyanto janārdanaḥ || 2.1.35.40 || tasyedaṃ bhāvavijñāne mūḍhā brahmādayo'pi ca || ajo gṛhṇāti jananaṃ sarvātmā hanti vidviṣaḥ || 41 || svatantro'pi svabhaktānāṃ paratantraḥ pravartate || sa sākṣī karmaṇāṃ devaḥ sarvajño garuḍadhvajaḥ || 42 || tasya svarūpaṃ munayo mṛgayante samāhitāḥ || saṅkarṣaṇo vāsudevaḥ pradyumnaśca tathā punaḥ || 43 || aniruddha iti khyātaṃ tanmūrtīnāṃ catuṣṭayam || kīrtitaḥ praṇavaḥ paścāddhṛdayaṃ tasya bhāsvaram || 44 || bhagavānvāsudevaśca mantro'yaṃ tatprakāśakaḥ || 45 || mantrarājamimaṃ nityaṃ prajapedyaḥ samāhitaḥ || sa viṣṇoḥ karuṇāyogātsiddhīnāṃ bhājanaṃ bhavet || 46 || || atha bhagavatkṛtabhūtasṛṣṭyādivarṇanam || || āpannivārakaḥ saṃpatprāpako bhuktimuktidaḥ || yathā sasarja bhūtāni kalpādāveva mādhavaḥ || 47 || tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi samāhitamanāḥ śṛṇu || tasya cintayataḥ sargaṃ tejorūpaṃ paraṃ hareḥ || 48 || viriṃca iti vikhyātaṃ rājasaṃ guṇamāśritam || tasya devasya vadanācchakro devaḥ sapāvakaḥ || jajñe yaśca trilokeśaḥ pākakarmaṇi yaḥ prabhuḥ || 49 || manasaścābhavaccandraḥ karuṇānityaśītalāt || apāṃ sarvauṣadhīnāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ rakṣakaḥ sadā || || 2.1.35.50 || netrābhyāmudabhūtsūryastasya viśvaprakāśakaḥ || śītoṣṇavarṣakṛtkālakāraṇaṃ tejasāṃ nidhiḥ || 51 || prāṇebhyo'sya jagatprāṇaḥ samīraḥ samajāyata || dhartā graharkṣasvargaṃgā vimānānāṃ mahābalaḥ || 52 || nābhideśātsamutpannamantarikṣaṃ mahātmanaḥ || tasyāsīcchiraso vyoma bhūtasaṃbhavakāraṇam || 53 || pādāmbujābhyāmudabhūdbhūmirbhūtagaṇāśrayā || viniḥsṛtā diśaḥ sarvāḥ śrotrābhyāṃ paramātmanaḥ || 54 || bhūrbhuvādyāstathā lokāḥ smaraṇāttasya jajñire || rasātalādilokāśca yakṣarakṣogaṇādayaḥ || 55 || mukhabāhūrupādebhyo janayāmāsa sa kramāt || brāhmaṇānkṣattriyānvaiśyāñchūdrādīṃśca kurūdvaha || 56 || chandāṃsi yajñasturagā gāvo meṣāvikādayaḥ || atarkyaprabhavāṃ tasmādutpattiṃ pratipedire || 57 || saṃkalpāddevadevasya tasya sthāvarajaṃgamam || bhūtajātamabhūtkālo bhūto bhāvī bhavaṃstathā || 58 || pibatyambu samudrāṇāṃ baḍavānalarūpadhṛka || kalpāntakāle tatsarvaṃ visṛjatyātmani sthitam || 59 || sañcārayati bhūtānāṃ vṛttiṃ sūryendurūpadhṛk || tamonirasanāccāpi kāladharmapravartanāt || 2.1.35.60 || jaganti kalpavirame vinyasya svodarāntare || līlābālākṛtiḥ śete vaṭapatre mahāmbudhau || 61 || atha codagrabhogīndrabhogatalpe sukhocite || yoganidrāmavāpnoti sadvitīyo'bjavāsayā || 62 || nābhikāsārasaṃbhūtājjanayāmāsa paṃkajāt || 63 || sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ nātho vidhātāraṃ caturmukham || 64 || līlā hyeṣā mukundasya svecchāyogapravartinaḥ || vijñāyate na kenā'pi yāthārthyena sa īśvaraḥ || 64 || yadā dharmasya hāniḥ syādadharmo vardhate yadā || yadā vā mahatīṃ pīḍāṃ bhajante devatāgaṇāḥ || 65 || yadāvalepadurvārā yāṃti vṛddhiṃ suradruhaḥ || bhūmerbhūmijanānāṃ ca yadodeti mahadbhayam || 66 || yadā vā nijabhaktānāṃ sādhūnāmanivāritā || durantātaṃkajananī vipatsamupajāyate || 67 || tadā tadanurūpāṇi rūpāṇyāsthāya kautukāt || adharmamavadhūyāśu kurute jagato hitam || 68 || sṛjati vidhisamākhyo rājasenātmanā'sau vahati harisamākhyaḥ sattvaniṣṭhaḥ prapañcam || harati harasamākhyastāmasīmetya vṛttiṃ madhumathanamahimnāmasti vettā na ko'pi || 69 || yajñāṃgaiḥ kṛtasakalāṃgasaṃdhibaṃdhaṃ vārāhaṃ vapuradhigamya lokanāthaḥ || śaile'sminnabhajadasau yathā nivāsaṃ tadvakṣye śṛṇu vibudhādhināthasūno || 2.1.35.70 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye suvarṇamukharīmāhātmye viṣṇumāhātmyaprastāve sṛṣṭyādivarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || ||
<2.1.36>
|| atha varāhakṛtadharaṇyuddharaṇakramaḥ|| || bharadvāja uvāca || || purā niśātyaye dhātuḥ prabuddho madhusūdanaḥ || punaḥ pravṛttiṃ bhūtānāmanviyeṣa dhiyā bhṛśam ||1|| vinā vasumatīmanye bhūtaughadharaṇakṣamāḥ || na bhavantīti hṛdaye tarkastasyājaniṣṭa ca || 2 || apaśyatpraṇidhānena mahīṃ pātālagocarām|| atimātrabhayodvignāṃ parītāṃ mahatāmbunā || 3 || pratipede tadā rūpaṃ bhūsamuddharaṇocitam || upakarmoṣṭhamanalajihvaṃ praṇavaghoṣaṇam ||4|| caturāmnāyacaraṇaṃ prāyaścittakhurāṃcitam || prāgvaṃśakāyaṃ vilasaddarbharomāvalīyutam || 5 || pravargyāvartasaṃpannaṃ
