dakṣiṇāgnyudarānvitam || sruktuṇḍamakhilaiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃvibhaktāṃgasandhikam || 6 || divyasūktasaṭājālaṃ paratrahmaśirastathā || havyakavyarayopetaṃ viśuddhapaśujānukam || 7 || uktātyuktādikacchandomārgamaṃtra balānvitam || sarvayajñamayaṃ divyaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ || 8 || anveṣṭuṃ dharaṇīmabdherviveśa salilāṃtaram || daṃṣṭrābālaśaśāṃkotthalasatkāṃticayairhaṭhāt|| || 9 || kalpāṃtasamayasphītaṃ tamisramapasārayan || abhibhūtāṃbubhṛdghoṣairmuhurbrahmāṇḍakandarām || 2.1.36.10 || ninādamukharāṃ kurvangāḍhairghurughurusvanaiḥ || khuraprakhuravinyāsairjarjarīkṛtavigraham || 11 || itastato viluṭhayannuragāṇāmadhīśvaram || tīvrairniḥśvāsapavanairāpātālaṃ saritpateḥ || 12 || prāpayannatalasparśamantaraṃ darśanīyatām || atidīrgheṇa pātreṇa magnonmagnena vāridheḥ || 13 || saṃkṣobhitāni pāthāṃsi kurvannantaryayau tadā || saptapātālamūlādhaḥ sthitāṃ toye bhayākulām || 14 || vepamānāṃ samālokya dharaṇīṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || tāmāropya svadaṃṣṭrāgramunmamajja saritpateḥ || 15 || saṃstūyamāno munibhirjanalokanivāsibhiḥ || tasminnudvahati premṇā deve vasumatīṃ kṣaṇam || 16 || pratisārā babhūvādho vāridhemarṅgalocitā || taduttāraṇavelāyāṃ varāhavapuṣo'rjuna || 17 || gambhīraghoṣairambhodhiḥ prāpa maṃgalatūryatām || udvṛttavīcivikṣiptaśīkarāsārasaṃgataḥ || 18 || bheje muktāphalacayo maṃgalākṣatavibhramam|| udūḍhā tena devena sā babhau salilāplutā || 19 || gāḍharāgasamutpannasvedaklinnatanūriva || itthamuddhṛtya bhagavānmahīṃ pātālamūlataḥ || 2.1.36.20 || sudṛḍhaṃ sthāpayāmāsa madhye'mbunidhipāthasām || tenoddhṛtāyāṃ medinyāṃ pūrṇaṃ tadbhūnabhontare || 21 || jalaṃ tatkṛtamaryādā'vyavacchinnamabhūttadā || saṃsthāpya pṛthivīmitthaṃ tadīyādhārasiddhaye || 22 || diggajānahirājaṃ ca kamaṭhaṃ ca nyaveśayat || teṣāmapi ca sarveṣāmādhāratvena sādaram || 23 || avyaktarūpāṃ svāṃ śaktiṃ yuyoja ca dayānidhiḥ || tato dharāṃ samuddhṛtya sthitaṃ kiṭitanuṃ harim || 24 || tuṣṭuvuḥ sanakādyāstaṃ janalokanivāsinaḥ || tadā varāhavapuṣamārādhya puruṣottamam || 25 || tadājñayā jagadbrahmā yathāpūrvamakalpayat || 26 || || arjuna uvāca || || kalpāntasalile magnā kathaṃ tiṣṭhati bhūriyam || saptapātālalokādhaḥ kimādhārā mahāmune || 27 || kalpakālaḥ kiyāneṣa syāttadvṛttiśca kīdṛśī || 28 || || atha kalpavṛttāṃtavarṇanapūrvakaṃ śvetavarāhāvatāravarṇanam || || etadvistārya sakalaṃ mama brahmanmune vada || 29 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || vināḍikānāṃ ṣaṣṭyā syānnāḍikaikā dinaṃ bhavet || tatṣaṣṭyā divasāstriṃśanmāsaḥ pakṣadvayātmakaḥ || 2.1.36.30 || māsau dvāvṛturityuktastaiḥ ṣaṅbhirvatsaro bhavet || ayanadvitayākāraḥ śītavarṣoṣṇasaṃśrayaḥ || 31 || devāsurāṇāmanyoyamahorātraṃ viparyayāt || uttaraṃ dakṣiṇe bhānorayane te yathākramam || 32 || mānuṣābdaiḥ khakhavyomakhākṣipāvakasāgaraiḥ || mahāyugaṃ bhavetpārtha kṛtādyākārasaṃyutam || || 33 || saptatyā saikayā kālo yugānāmantaraṃ manoḥ || asmiñchvetavarāhākhye kalpe jātānmanūñchṛṇu || 34 || svāyaṃbhuvaḥ syātprathamastataḥ svārociṣo manuḥ || uttamastāmasākhyaśca raivataścākṣuṣāhvayaḥ || 35 || ete gatāḥ prāṅmanavaḥ ṣaṭsendrasuratāpasāḥ || vaivasvato vartate'dya saptamo manurarjuna || 36 || ādityavasurudrādyāstatkāle devatāgaṇāḥ || iṣṭvāśvamedhaśatakaṃ tejasvī prāpa śakratām || 37 || viśvāmitro'hamatriśca jamadagniśca kaśyapaḥ || vasiṣṭho gautamaścaiva te vai saptarṣayo'rjuna || 38 || ikṣvākupramukhāḥ śūrā manuputrā mahābalāḥ || avaniṃ pālayāmāsurnityaṃ dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 39 || sūryadakṣabrahmadharmarudrāṇāṃ pañca sūnavaḥ || sāvarṇiraucyabhaumādyā bhaviṣyanmanusaptakam || 2.1.36.40 || caturdaśa vidhātuste bhavanti manavo'hani || tatkalpasaṃjñaṃ tasyānte niśā syāttatsamā śṛṇu || 41 || dināvasānasamaye brahmaṇaḥ pāṇḍunandana || jāyate'vagraho ghoraḥ pṛthivyāṃ śatavārṣikaḥ || 42|| tasminnavagrahe pṛthvyāṃ nīrasāyāṃ dhanañjaya || caturvidhāni bhūtāni samāyānti parikṣayam || 43 || tadā taptaśikhākārairupeto gharmadīdhitiḥ || mayūkhairagnisadṛśairvamadbhiḥ pāvakacchaṭāḥ || 44 || vinaṣṭagrāmanagaraśailavṛkṣādikānanā || kūrmapṛṣṭhopamorvī syāttaptāyaḥpiṇḍasannibhā || 45 || tato vidhāturgātrebhyaḥ samutpannā mahāghanāḥ || ācchādayanto gaganaṃ garjitadhvānabandhurāḥ || 46 || sitapītāruṇaśyāmāścitravarṇāśca bhīṣaṇāḥ || śailebhasaudhavṛkṣādinānārūpasamanvitāḥ || 47 || te śatābdamitaṃ kālaṃ mahāvṛṣṭiṃ vitanvate || tenāmbhasā śamaṃ yāti sūryodbhūto mahānalaḥ || 48 || bhūyaśca śatavarṣāṇi varṣantyugraṃ mahāghanāḥ || tadambhasā samudvelā vikṛtiṃ yānti vārddhayaḥ || 49 || kalpāntāmbudanirmuktaṃ lokānvyāpnoti tajjalam || bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmaharlokānāvṛṇoti tamo mahat || tadā nimagnā salile mahī pātālamūlagā || 2.1.36.50 || anaṣṭā kathamapyāste brahmaśaktyavalambitā || atha niḥśvāsasaṃbhūto māruto brahmaṇo'rjuna || 51 || utsārayati tānsarvānkalpāntotthānmahāghanān || evaṃ pravṛddhaḥ pavanaḥ śatasaṃvatsarātmakam || 52 || kālaṃ nirantaraṃ vāti durnivārarayotthitaḥ || tamugramanilaṃ hitvā harernābhisaroruhe || 53 || yoganidrāmavāpnoti tasminpāthasi padmabhūḥ || yoganidrānuṣaktasya yāti tasya jagadvibhoḥ || 54 || tāvatī śarvarī pārtha dinaṃ yāvatpramāṇakam || niśāyāṃ samatītāyāmutthito vegavānpunaḥ || 55 || sṛjapyakhilajantūnvai pūrvavacchāsanāddhareḥ || kalpekalpe samucitai rūpaiḥ pāti jagaddhariḥ | 56 || asminkalpe śvetavarṇāṃ prāptavānyajñapotritām|| varāhavapuṣā devo viharannavanītale ||57|| svapūrvaniyatāvāsaṃ prapede veṃkaṭācalam || svāmipuṣkariṇītīre caraṃściramadhokṣajaḥ||58|| bhaktyā paramayā yuktamapaśyajjalajāsanam || saṃpūjya prārthayāmāsa brahmā taṃ bhūtabhāvanam || 59 || purātanīṃ nijāṃ svāminbhaja divyāṃ tanūmiti || gṛhītvānunayaṃ tasya tyaktvā tāṃ sūkarākṛtim || 2.1.36.60 || ananyabhajanīyāṃ svāṃ prāpa viśvātmikāṃ tanum || tathāsthitaṃ girau tatra kṛtvāpyutsāhamūrjitam |||| 61 || draṣṭuṃ na śekuḥ sarve'pi kālena bahunāpi ca || 62 || || arjuna uvāca || || darśanasmaraṇādīnāṃ hariritthamagocaraḥ || kathaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ prāpa mānuṣāṇāṃ mahāmune || 63 || bhāgyabhūto'tha jagatāṃ yaḥ ko vā''rādhya taṃ vibhum || iha prakāśayāmāsa kathāmetāṃ nivedaya || 64 || harikathāśravaṇaṃ duritāpahaṃ kathayatāṃ sakalāgamavidbhavān || sukṛtināṃ nanu saṃprati dhuryatā munivareṇya mamādya samāgatā || 65 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye suvarṇamukharīmāhātmyapraśaṃsāyāṃ varāhāvatārakīrtanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||
<2.1.37>
|| || atha śaṃkhābhidhānanṛpavṛttāntaḥ || || bhāradvāja uvāca || || śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi kathāmāścaryakāriṇīm || yathā'sau bhagavānasmiñchaile prāpa prakāśatām || 1 || śrutābhidhāno nṛpatirasti haihayavaṃśajaḥ || yaḥ prajāḥ svā iva ciraṃ śaśāsa dharaṇīṃ śubhām || 2 || tasya putro guṇanidhiḥ śaṃkho nāma mahīpatiḥ || pālayāmāsa vasudhāṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 3 || tasya viṣṇau jagannāthe puṇḍarīkāyatekṣaṇe || babhūva niścalā bhaktiḥ parityaktānyasaṃśrayā || 4 || devadevaṃ jagannāthamanantaṃ puruṣottamam || pragāḍhaniścayo nityaṃ dhyāyannadbhutavaibhavam || 5 || cakre vratāni dānāni puṇyāni vividhāni ca || vedavedyasya niyataṃ prītyarthaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ || 6 || tamuddiśyaiva vidadhe vājimedhādikānkratūn || yathoktadakṣiṇāyogātprīṇitāśeṣabhūsuraḥ || || 7 || iṣṭāpūrttātmakaṃ cakre karmajātamatandritaḥ || vinyastahṛdayo nityaṃ keśave bhaktavatsale || 8 || smaratyajasraṃ govindaṃ japatyacyutamavyayam || pūjayatyabjanayanaṃ saṃkīrtayati śārṅgiṇam || 9 || śṛṇoti satataṃ rājā saṃsārārṇavatāriṇīḥ || paurāṇikaiḥ samākhyātāḥ pavitrā vaiṣṇavī kathāḥ ||2.1.37.10|| brāhmaṇānarcati smāyaṃ hariprītyarthameva ca || itthaṃ sarvātmanā yukto'pyaśrāntaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 11 || nāpaśyacchāśvataiśvaryaṃ svatantraṃ puruṣottamam || aprāpya darśanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sarvayajñamayātmanaḥ || 12 || saśokākrāntahṛdayaḥ parāṃ cintāmupāgamat || 13 || || śaṃkha uvāca || || paraḥ sahasrairjanairatītaduṣkṛtaṃ bahu || kṛtaṃ mayā yadaprāptaṃ hṛṣīkeśasya darśanam || 14 || upārjitānāṃ tamasāmanekaiḥ pūrvajanmabhiḥ || akhaṇḍaṃ hi phalaṃ viṣṇordarśanaṃ madhughātinaḥ || 15 || kathaṃ nu yāyādbhagavānviṣayaṃ mama netrayoḥ || kadā vā labhyate śreyastadvākyākarṇanātmakam || 16 || hā dhiṅmāṃ vihitāgaskaṃ kriyāsāphalyavarjitam || nārāyaṇakṛpādūraṃ saṃsārakleśagocaram || 17 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || iti cintākule tasminrājñi jīvitaniḥspṛhe || adṛśyamūrtiḥ sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāmāha keśavaḥ || 18 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || mā śokasya vaśaṃ yāyāḥ śṛṇu vakṣyābhi te hitam || madekaśaraṇaṃ sādhuṃ tvāṃ tyakṣyāmi kathaṃ nṛpa || 19 || ayaṃ veṃkaṭanāmādristriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || vaikuṇṭhādapi me rājannāvāso'tipriyāvahaḥ || ||2.1.37.20|| taṃ gatvā bhūdharavaraṃ tava bhaktyā tapasyataḥ || gate sahasre varṣāṇāṃ yāsyāmyālokanīyatām ||21|| bhavānivodyato'gastyo mama darśanamañjasā || kva vā saṃdṛśyate viṣṇurevamāha caturmukham || 22 || vṛṣabhādrau harirdraṣṭuṃ labhyate niyatātmabhiḥ || gaccha tatreti munaye kathayāmāsa padmabhūḥ || 23|| ambhojasaṃbhavenetthamādiṣṭaḥ kumbhasambhavaḥ || añjanādrau mahāvāse tapastaptuṃ sameṣyati || 24 || tasminmahīdhare puṇye kṛtavāso bhavānapi || ārādhya māṃ taponiṣṭho mama darśanamāpsyasi || 25 || || atha bhagavaduktyā śaṃkhanṛpasya śrīveṃkaṭācalāgamanam || || bharadvāja uvāca || || ityājñapto bhagavatā śaṃkho dānavavairiṇā || jagāma prītimatulāṃ dhanyosmīti svacetasi || 26 || vinyasya tanayaṃ vajraṃ prajāpālanakarmaṇi || govindadarśanāpekṣī nārāyaṇagiriṃ yayau || 27 || tasya śṛṃge samuttuṃge svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ śubhām || divyaiḥ payobhirāpūrṇāmapaśyadamṛtopamaiḥ || 28 || anekasiddhagandharvadevarṣigaṇasevitām || bhavatāpapraśamanī sarvatīrthasamāśrayām || 29 || jalakākabakakrauñcahaṃsakāraṇḍavākulām || kumudotpalarājīvasaugandhikamanoharām || 2.1.37.30 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā padminīṃ divyāṃ tattīre vihitoṭajaḥ || toṣitaḥ snānapānādyairnirvikalpamanogatiḥ || 31 || sarvakarmāṇi vinyasya jagadīśe janārdane || 32 || || atha bhagavaddarśanārthamagastyasya veṃkaṭācalāgamanam || || japadhyānaparo nityaṃ tapastepe sudāruṇam || tasminneva muniḥ kāle śāsanātparameṣṭhinaḥ || 33 || agastyo'pyāsasādādyaṃ śailaṃ muniśatāvṛtaḥ || pratīcīṃ diśamārabhya kṛtayatnaḥ pradakṣiṇe || 34 || paśyaṃstīrthāni puṇyāni babhrāma suciraṃ girau || tatra tatra dadarśāsau haridarśanalālasān || 35 || viriṃciguhaśakreśaviṣvaksenādikānkramāt || sanakādyāṃśca yogīndrānnāradapramukhānṛṣīn || 36 || siddhagandharvadaiteyayakṣarākṣasapannagān || taistaiḥ saṃmānyamāno'sau praśrayapriyabhāṣaṇaiḥ || 37 || paśyannāścaryabhūtāni sarvāṇi vicacāra ha || snātvā tīrtheṣu sarveṣu skandadhārādikeṣu ca || 38 || tatra tatrārcayāmāsa govindaṃ jagatāṃ patim || evaṃ bhrāntvā gate'bdānāṃ sahasre munisattamaḥ || 39 || nāpaśyatpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ cintāśokaparo'bhavat || 2.1.37.40 || || athāgastyaṃ prati guruvasvādyuktiḥ || || tasminkāle samājagmurdhiṣaṇośanasau punaḥ || rājoparicaro nāma vasuśca tamṛṣīśvaram || 41 || asmākaṃ saphalaṃ jātaṃ jīvitaṃ munisattama || dṛṣṭo bhavānyadasmābhirnārāyaṇa ivāparaḥ || 42 || brahmaṇā lokanāthena yadādiṣṭā vayaṃ mune || acyutālokanaparāstadidaṃ kathyate tava || 43 || asti dakṣiṇadigbhāge veṃkaṭonāma bhūdharaḥ || śvetadvīpādapi harerāvāso'yamabhīpsitaḥ || 44 || tasmingirāvagastyasya śaṃkhasya ca mahīpateḥ || darśayiṣyati govindo nijarūpaṃ jagadguruḥ || 45 || tadānīṃ sarvadevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ yakṣarakṣasām || asmākaṃ devadevasya darśanaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 46 || acireṇaiva tadbhāvi tataḥ saṃtyaktakalmaṣāḥ || anveṣṭuṃ gacchatāgastyaṃ tasminnārāyaṇācale || 47 || ityājñaptā vayaṃ dhātrā samāgamyātra bhāgyataḥ || dṛṣṭavanto mahābhāgaṃ bhavaṃtaṃ bhūritejasam || 48 || bhavatā sahitā gatvā svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe || tamapyālokayiṣyāmaḥ śaṃkhaṃ bhāgavatottamam || 49 || || athāgastyādikṛtaśrīveṃkaṭācalastharamyavastudarśanam || || || bharadvāja uvāca || || gīṣpatipramukhairitthamādiṣṭaḥ kumbhasaṃbhavaḥ || śokajālaṃ parityajya yayau taiḥ sahito drutam || 2.1.37.50 || sa dadarśa mahāvṛkṣānphalapuṣpabharānatāt || prarūḍhaśākhānikaracchāyācchāditadiktaṭān || 51 || siṃhadaṃtāvalavyāghravarāhamahiṣādikān || mṛgānālokayāmāsa paṃthānaṃ cāṃtarāṃtarā || 52 || taistadānīṃ dadṛśire sānavo'pyambubhṛdbhṛtaḥ || suvarṇaraupyatāmrādiśobhitāstatra tatra tu || 53 || uccalacchīkarāsāranirvāhitadivaukasaḥ || vegoddhṛtaśilā dṛṣṭāḥ śataśo girinirjharāḥ || 54 || teṣāmāpādayāmāsa pramodaṃ maṃdamārutaḥ || kamalāmodasaṃvāhī vicarangirisānuṣu || 55 || śukānāṃ kokilānāṃ ca tadā śuśruvire giraḥ || 56 || tatra tatra samāsīnānvistīrṇāsu dṛṣatsu te || siddhānapaśyankṛṣṇasya gāyato guṇavaibhavam || 57 || agastyapramukhāḥ sarve parikramya munīśvarāḥ || svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ divyāṃ dadṛśurvimalodakām || 58 || tattīre vihitāvāsamapaśyacchaṅkhabhūpatim || vāṅmanaḥkāyajaṃ karma sanniveśya sthitaṃ harau || 59 || sa tānālokya sahasā munīndrānsaṃśitavratān || yathoktamakarotpūjāṃ praṇāmastutipūrvikām || 2.1.37.60 || āsīnāstatra te sarve saṃbhāvyānyo'nyamutsukāḥ || govindakīrtanaparāḥ kṛtārthatvaṃ prapedire || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye suvarṇamukharīmāhātmyapraśaṃsāyāṃ śrīveṃkaṭācalaṃ prati śaṃkhāgastyādyāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
<2.1.38>
|| athā'gastyaśaṅkhāditapastuṣṭasya bhagavata āvirbhāvaḥ || || bharadvāja uvāca || teṣāṃ harau jagannāthe samāveśitacetasām || dinatrayaṃ gataṃ tatra pūjāstotraparātmanām || 1 || tṛtīye divase prāpte te sarve nidritā niśi || ante caturthayāmasya dadṛśuḥ svapnamuttamam || 2 || śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ prasannaṃ puruṣottamam || varadānāya saṃprāptamapaśyansmeralocanam || 3 || utthāya muditātmāno gṛhānnirgatya pāvane || svāmipuṣkariṇītoye sasnurvidhivadādarāt || 4 || vidhāya vidhivatkarma sarve dinamukhocitam || gṛhānpratyāyayurdevamārādhayitumacyutam || 5 || sadyaḥ śreyaskaraṃ mārge nimittaṃ pakṣisṛcitam || dṛṣṭvā prasādaṃ devasya karasthaṃ menire tadā || 6 || tatastrilokakartāraṃ pūjayitvā janārdanam || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ pavitrairvedavarṇitaiḥ || 7 || stotrāvasāne kaunteya munīndraḥ kumbhasaṃbhavaḥ || jajāpa śaṃkhasahito mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ hareḥ || 8 || itthaṃ teṣāṃ jagatsvāminyacyute'rpitacetasām || agrabhāge prādurabhūdekaṃ tejo mahādbhutam || 9 || anekakoṭisaṃkhyānāmādityendu havirbhujām || ekībhūyāmbaratale jyotirjālamiva sthitam || 2.1.38.10 || tattejo vīkṣya te sarve'mitāntāścaryagocarāḥ || dadhyurnārāyaṇaṃ divyaṃ paramānandavigraham || 11 || vāṅmānasapathātītaṃ viśrutaiśvaryabhāsuram || sahasranetraṃ sāhasrabāhupādaiḥ samanvitam || 12 || taptakārtasvaranibhasphuratkāṃtimanoharama || daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdarśaṃ vamantaṃ dahanacchaṭāḥ || 13 || kaustubhena virājantaṃ dadhānamurasi śriyam || avicintyamanādyantamatyantabhayadāyakam || || 14 || prakāśayantaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sarvamātmani sarvagam || agastyaśaṃkhapramukhāste sarve hṛṣṭacetasaḥ || 15 || tamālokya jagannāthaṃ bhūyobhūyo vavandire || bhramanti lokarakṣārthamāyudhāni tadā hareḥ || 16 || nijatejobalopetānyājagmustaṃ niṣevitum || cakramarkaprabhaṃ divyā gadā khaṅgaśca nandakaḥ || || 17 || puṇḍarīkaṃ cograravaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ śaśiprabhaḥ || tadā brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ pūrayāmāsa nirbharaḥ || 18 || pāñcajanyasya ninadaḥ sarvāsurabhayaṃkaraḥ || pāñcajanyadhvaniṃ śrutvā nitāntāścaryabhīṣaṇam || 19 || āyayurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ svaṃsvaṃ vāhanamāsthitāḥ || brahmā rudraḥ śatamakhaḥ sanakādyāśca yoginaḥ|| || 2.1.38.20 || vasiṣṭhamukhyā munayo gandharvoragakinnarāḥ || viṣvakseno garutmāṃśca viṣṇubhṛtyā jayādayaḥ || 21 || sarūpāścaiva ye nityāḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ || sumanodrumasaṃbhūtā sumanovṛṣṭiradbhutā ||22|| papāta medurāmodamoditāśeṣamānasā || nanṛturdivyasudṛśo jaguḥ kinnarapuṅgavāḥ || 23 || tuṣṭuvurharṣataralāḥ suragandharvacāraṇāḥ || dṛṣṭvā te puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ prasannaṃ bhaktavatsalam || 24 || praṇamya toṣayāmāsuḥ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ vividhaistavaiḥ || 25 || || brahmādaya ūcuḥ || || jaya viṣṇo kṛpāsindho jaya tāmarasekṣaṇa || jaya lokaikavarada jaya bhaktārtibhañjana || 26 || anantamakṣaraṃ śāntamavāṅmanasagocaram || ko vā bhavantaṃ jānāti cidānandamayātmakam || 27 || aṇoraṇutaraṃ sthūlātsthūlaṃ sarvāntarasthitam || tvāmāmananti puruṣaṃ prakṛteḥ paramacyutam || || 28 || vedāntasārarūpaṃ tvāṃ sarvāntarbāhyavartinam || ko hi varṇayituṃ śakto māyāyatteṣu dehiṣu || 29 || bhavadīyamidaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvātibhayadāyakam || bhayodvignā vayaṃ sarve śāntaṃ rūpaṃ bhajasva ha || 2.1.38.30 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || iti stuto viriñcādyaiḥ prasanno garuḍadhvajaḥ || meghaghoṣapratimayā vācā sādaramabravīta || 31 || || atha brahmādiprārthanayā bhagavadgṛhītasaumyarūpaprakāraḥ || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || bhayāvahāmimāṃ mūrtimutsṛjyāhaṃ priyāvaham || śāntaṃ rūpaṃ bhajiṣyāmi māṃ paśyata nirākulāḥ || 32 || ityuktvāntarhito bhūtvā tasminneva kṣaṇāṃtare || vimāne ratnakhacite babhūva sukhadarśanaḥ || 33 || candrabimbānanaḥ śānto nīlotpaladaladyutiḥ || suvarṇavarṇavasano ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 34 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmalasatkaracatuṣṭayaḥ || tamālokya ramākāntaṃ bhūyo bhūyo vavaṃdire || 35 || santoṣayitvā brahmādīnabhīṣṭapratipādanaiḥ || avocadvinayānamramagastyaṃ munipuṃgavam || 36 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || tvaṃ munīndra vratairghoraiścīrṇairmāṃ prati saṃprati || parikliṣṭo'si dāsyāmi varāṃste'bhīpsitānvada || 37 || || bharadvāja uvāca || || niśamya vākyaṃ śrībhartuḥ praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ || sa romāñcitasarvāṃgaḥ kumbhajanmā vaco'bravīt || 38 || || athāgastyaprārthanayā svarṇamukharīnadyā bhagavadvattasarvādhikatvaprāptiḥ || || agastya uvāca || || yaddhutaṃ yattapastaptaṃ yadadhītaṃ śrutaṃ mayā || tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ jātamādṛto'smi yatastvayā || 39 || eṣo'hameva dharmātmā triṣu lokeṣvapi prabho || tvāṃ vicinvantamadhunā māmanviṣyāgato'si yat || 2.1.38.40 || tvatprasādātpuraivāhaṃ prāptākhilamanorathaḥ || na paśyāmi vicintyāpi prāpyaṃ saṃprati mādhava || 41 || tathāpi cāpalādetattava vijñāpyate prabho || tvatpādāmbujayorbhaktimevaṃ kuru nirantaram || 42 || avadhāraya caitattvaṃ suraprārthanayā mayā || nadī suvarṇamukharī snātāghaughavināśinī || 43 || sā bhavacchailakaṭakasamāsannā samāgatā || tāṃ kṛtārthaya lokeśa tvadanugrahavṛttibhiḥ || 44 || suvarṇamukharītoye snātvā ye veṃkaṭe sthitam || paśyaṃti bhuktimuktyostu bhūyāsurbhājanāni te || 45 || alpāyuṣo narā mūḍhā jñānayogaparicyutāḥ || na śaknuvaṃti tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ vratādhyayanakarmabhiḥ || 46 || sadāsminnāsthitaḥ śaile sarveṣāṃ ca jagadguro || prasādasumukho deva kāṃkṣitārthaprado bhava || || 47 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || yatprārthitaṃ tvayā vipra tattathaiva bhaviṣyati || nūnamapratimā loke mayi bhaktiḥ kṛtā tvayā || 48 || jāhnavīva nadī seyaṃ suvarṇamukharī mune || syādāśāsyā surāṇāṃ ca vāṃchitaśrīvidhāyinī || 49 || svāmipuṣkariṇī ceyaṃ nadī mūrtyā samanvitā || saṃkramiṣyati tāṃ divyāṃ nadīṃ tīrthaughasaṃśrayām || 2.1.38.50 || vaikuṇṭhanāmni śaile'sminnadyaprabhṛti sarvadā || kṛtāvāso bhaviṣyāmi mune prārthanayā tava || || 51 || suvarṇamukharīsnānakṣālitāghaughakardamāḥ || asminvaikuṇṭhaśaile māṃ ye paśyaṃti samāhitāḥ || 52 || bhuvi putrādisaṃpannāḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitāḥ || mṛtāstriviṣṭape bhogānākalpamanubhūya ca || 53 || punarāvṛttirahitaṃ kevalānandabhāsuram || matpadaṃ samavāpsyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || || 54 || māṃ draṣṭumāgatānsarvānpratīkṣyābhīpsitaiḥ śubhaiḥ || yojayiṣyāmi satataṃ tvadvacogauravānmune || 55 || putrārthināṃ bahūnputrāndhanāni ca dhanārthinām || tathaivārogyakāmānāṃ rogaśāṃtiṃ garīyasīm || 56 || tīvrāpatparibhūtānāṃ tathaivāpannivāraṇam || dāsyāmyabhīpsitānbhogāndurlabhānapi sarvadā || 57 || ye yānkāmānapekṣyeha prekṣante māṃ samāgatāḥ || avāpnuvanti te sarve tāṃstānkāmānna saṃśayaḥ || 58 || sthitā vā yatra kutrāpi māṃ smaranti narottamāḥ || te sarve vāñchitāṃ siddhiṃ labhante matprasādataḥ || 59 || || atha śaṅkhanṛpavarapradānapūrvakaṃ bhagavadantardhānam || || bharadvāja uvāca || || ityuktvā taṃ muniṃ devaḥ śaṃkhamālokya bhūpatim || śṛṇvatāṃ brahmamukhyānāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 2.1.38.60 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || prīto'smi śaṃkha bhaktyā te vṛṇīṣvābhīpsitaṃ varam || dadāmi varado'haṃ te kraśiṣṭhasya tapasyataḥ || 61 || || śaṃkha uvāca || || na yāce'nyanmahābāho tvatpādāmbujasevanāt || yāṃ prāpnuvaṃti tvadbhaktāstāṃ yāce gatimuttamām || 62 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || yatprārthitaṃ tvayā śaṃkha tattathaiva bhaviṣyati || matsevāyogabhavyānāmalabhyaṃ kimu vidyate || 63 || ākalpamindralokastho hyapsarogaṇasevitaḥ || bhuktvā bahuvidhānbhogāṃstato mallokameṣyasi || 64 || evaṃ dadau varāniṣṭāñchaṅkhāya pṛthivīpate || nārāyaṇo jagadyonirbhajatāṃ kalpabhūruhaḥ || 65 || tato brahmādikānsarvānvisṛjya kamalekṣaṇaḥ || saṃstūya mānasairbhaktyā tatraivāṃtardadhe prabhuḥ || 66 || || atha bharadvājavarṇitaśrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmyanigamanam || || || || bharadvāja uvāca || || veṃkaṭādreḥ prabhāvo'yamākhyāto bhavate'rjuna || narāḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyaṃte śrutvemāṃ pāvanīṃ kathām ||67|| vārāhaṃ rūpamutsṛjya brahmaṇābhyarthito hariḥ || mumodātrādbhutākāro māyayā mohayañjagat || 68 || paścādagastyaśaṃkhābhyāṃ prārthitaḥ sukhadarśanam || dadau nitāntasubhagaṃ śāntaṃ bhogātmakaṃ vapuḥ || 69 || nārāyaṇaṃ veṃkaṭādriṃ svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ tathā || imāmākhyāṃ ca saṃsmṛtya mucyaṃte pātakairjanāḥ || 2.1.38.70 || veṃkaṭādrisamaṃ sthānaṃ brahmāṇḍe nāsti kiñcana || veṃkaṭeśasamo devo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || 71 || veṃkaṭādrisamaṃ sthānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || svāmitīrthasarastulyaṃ na kutrāpi ca vidyate || 72 || prātarutthāya ye nityaṃ veṃkaṭeśaṃ smaraṃti vai || teṣāṃ karasthā mokṣaśrīrnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 73|| svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe snātvā sarvātmakaṃ harim || ye vā paśyaṃti niyatā varāhācalavāsinam ||74|| te'śvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca || prāpnuvaṃti phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 75 || veṃkaṭācalamāhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvaṃti narottamāḥ || teṣāṃ muktiśca bhuktiśca iha loke paratra ca || 76 || veṃkaṭācalamāhātmyaṃ saṃkṣipya kathitaṃ tava || ataḥ paraṃ mahānadyāḥ prabhāvaḥ kathyate'rjuna ||77|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye suvarṇamukharīmāhātmyapraśaṃsāyāmagastyaśaṅkhāditapastuṣṭaśrīveṃkaṭeśāvirbhāvādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 || cha || ||
<2.1.39>
|| atha putrārthamañjanākṛtatapaḥprakāraḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || putrahīnāñjanā pūrvaṃ duḥkhitā tapasi sthitā || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśārdūlo mataṅgo viṣṇutatparaḥ || 1 || añjanākhyāmuvācedamatyugre tapasi sthitām || 2 || || mataṃga uvāca || || samuttiṣṭhāñjane devi kimarthaṃ tapasi sthitā || vada devi mahābhāge kāryaṃ tava varānane || 3 || || aṃjanovāca || || mataṃga muniśārdūla vacanaṃ me śṛṇuṣva ha || pitā me kesarī nāma rākṣasaḥ śivatatparaḥ || 4 || śaivaṃ ghoraṃ tapaścakre putrārthaṃ tu suduṣkaram || pārvatīsahitaḥ śaṃbhurvṛṣabhopari saṃsthitaḥ || 5 || prādurāsīttadā devo dadau tasmai varaṃ śubham || 6 || || śambhuruvāca || || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi vidhinā nirmitaṃ tava || asmijanmanyaputratvaṃ tathāpyanyaddadāmi te || 7 || viśrutā sarvalokeṣu putrī tava bhaviṣyati || tasyāḥ putro mahābuddhistava prītiṃ kariṣyati || 8 || iti tasmai varaṃ dattvā tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ || māṃ labdhvā matpitā vipraḥ kṛtakṛtyo babhūvū ha || 9 || tataḥ kālāntare vipraḥ kesaryākhyo mahākapiḥ || yayācemāṃ dadasveti pitaraṃ me tataḥ pitā || || 2.1.39.10 || tasmai māṃ dattavāṃścaiva pāribarhaṃ dadau ca saḥ || gavāṃ lakṣasahasrāṇi gajalakṣaṃ mahāmanāḥ || 11 || vājināmarbudaṃ caiva rathānāmarbudaṃ tathā || vastraratnānyanekāni dāsadāsīsahasrakam || 12 || antaḥpuracarīrnārīrnṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ || dadau vāsaḥ sahasraṃ ca mayā sākaṃ mahāmate || 13 || patyā me ramamāṇāyā bhūyānkālo gato mune || aputrā duḥkhitā vipra vratāni vividhāni ca || 14 || kṛtāni ca mayā tatra kiṣkindhāyāṃ mahāpuri || māghe māsi ca viprendra vaiśākhe kārtike tathā || 15 || snānadānavratādīni cāturmāsyavrataṃ tathā || namaskārastathā vipra pradakṣiṇamanuttamam || ||16 || śālagrāmānnadānāni dīpadānaṃ tathaiva ca || godānaṃ tiladānaṃ ca vastradānaṃ mahāmune || 17 || bhūdānaṃ vāridānaṃ ca dattvā puṣpādikaṃ mune || yāni yāni ca mukhyāni vaiṣṇavāni vratāni ca || mayā kṛtāni sarvāṇi satputraphalakāṃkṣayā || 18 || śravaṇādiṣu yatproktaṃ vrataṃ vipraimahātmabhiḥ || mayā kṛtaṃ ca vipredraṃ tuṣṭyarthaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ || 19 || yāni yāni ca mukhyāni phalāni vividhāni ca || mayā dattāni sarvāṇi satputraphalakāṃkṣayā || 2.1.39.20 || mayā kṛtānyasaṃkhyāni vratāni vividhāni ca || putraṃ tathāpyalabdhvāhaṃ duḥkhitā tapasi sthitā || 21 || bhaviṣyati kathaṃ vipra putrastrailokyaviśrutaḥ || yāce'haṃ tu muniśreṣṭha praṇatā ca tavāgrataḥ || 22 || vada tvaṃ muniśārdūla dīnāhaṃ tapasi sthitā || 23 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vadantīṃ tāṃ prāha mataṅgo munisattamaḥ || śṛṇu madvacanaṃ devi putrapautrapradāyakam || 24 || ito dakṣiṇadigbhāge daśayojanadūrataḥ || ghanācala iti khyāto nṛsiṃhasya nivāsabhūḥ || 25 || tasyopari mahābhāge brahmatīrthaṃ manoharam || tasyāpi pūrvadigbhāge daśayojanamātrataḥ || 26 || suvarṇamukharī nāma nadīnāṃ pravarā nadī || tasyā evottare bhāge vṛṣabhācalanāmataḥ || 27 || tasyāgre sarasī nāmnā svāmipuṣkariṇī śubhā || gatvā dṛṣṭvā śubhaṃ toyaṃ manaḥśuddhiṃ gamiṣyasi || 28 || tatra snātvā vidhānena varāhaṃ taṃ praṇamya ca || veṅkaṭeśaṃ namaskṛtya tato gaccha varānane || 29 || uttare svāmitīrthasya siṃhaśādūlasaṃyute || cūtapunnāgapanasairbakulāmalakaḥ śubhaiḥ || 2.1.39.30 || candanāgurunimbaiśca tālahintālakiṃśukaiḥ || kapitthāśvatthabilvaiśca iṅgudaiśca varānane || 31 || etādṛśairmahāpuṇyairvṛkṣaiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || viyadgaṃgeti vikhyātaṃ tīrthamekaṃ virājate || 32 || tasmiṃstīrthe'ñjane devi saṃkalpavidhipūrvakam || snātvā pītvā śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthasyābhimukhī sthitā || 33 || vāyumuddiśya he devi tapaḥ kuru varānane || devaiśca rākṣasairviprairmanujairmunisattamaiḥ || 34 || bhṛṅgaiḥ pakṣibhirastraiśca śastraiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || avadhyo bhavitā putrastapasā te na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || iti proktāñjanā devī taṃ praṇamya punaḥpunaḥ || bhartrā sākaṃ yayāvāśu veṃkaṭācalasaṃjñakam || 36 || kāpilaṃ tīrthamāsādya snātvā nirmalamānasā || veṃkaṭādriṃ samāruhya svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ yayau | 37 || snātvā varāhamānamya veṃkaṭeśakṛtānatiḥ || mataṃgasya ṛṣervākyaṃ smarantī ca muhurmuhuḥ || 38 || viyadgaṅgāṃ yayāvāśu cāñjanā maṃjubhāṣiṇī || snātvā pītvā śubhaṃ toyaṃ tīraṃ tasya tadunmukhī || 39 || prāṇavāyuṃ samuddiśya tapaścakre yatavratā || phalāhārā jalāhārā nirāhārā tataḥ param || 2.1.39.40 || sahasrābdaṃ tapaścakre nyastanāsāgradṛṣṭikā || vayasyā vipulā nāma śuśrūṣāmakarocchubhā || 41 || varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrānte vāyurdevo mahāmatiḥ || prādurāsīttadā tāṃ vai bhāṣamāṇo mahāmatiḥ || 42 || meṣasaṃkramaṇaṃ bhānau saṃprāpte munisattamāḥ || pūrṇimākhye tithau puṇye citrānakṣatrasaṃyute || 43 || tavepsitamahaṃ dāsye varaṃ varaya suvrate || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ prāhāñjanā satī || 44 || putraṃ dehi mahābhāga vāyo deva mahāmate || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā mātariśvābravīttataḥ || 45 || putraste'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi khyātiṃ dāsye śubhānane || iti tasyai varaṃ dattvā tatraivāste mahābalaḥ || 46 || tadā brahmādayo devā indrādyā lokapālakāḥ || vasiṣṭhādyā mahātmānaḥ sanakādyāśca yoginaḥ || 47 || vyāsādayaśca vipreṃdrā lakṣmyā sākaṃ jagatpatiḥ || munipatnyo devapatnya ṛṣipatnyastathaiva ca || 48 || svaṃ svaṃ vāhanamāruhya dārabhṛtyasutādibhiḥ || āgatāste mahātmāno draṣṭuṃ tāṃ tapasi sthitām || 49 || āścaryamāścaryamiti bruvāṇā brahmādayo devagaṇāśca sarve || ālokayanto divi dūrataste sthitāstadā brahmamaheśamukhyāḥ || 2.1.39.50 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye aṃjanātapaḥkaraṇaprakārādivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 || || cha ||
<2.1.40>
|| atha vyāsaproktākāśagaṃgāsnānakālanirṇayaḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || aṃjanāpi varaṃ labdhvā bhartrā sākaṃ mumoda ha || brahmādīnāgatāndṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭamānasā || 1 || patyā sākaṃ tataḥ svasthā cāṃjanā maṃjubhāṣiṇī || brahmādibhiranujñāto vyāso vedavidāṃ varaḥ || 2 || añjanā tāmuvācedaṃ meghagambhīrayā girā || 3 || || vyāsa uvāca || || añjane śṛṇu madvākyaṃ sarvalokopakārakam || mataṅgasya ṛṣervākyaṃ śrutvā nirmalacetasā || 4 || yasmāttu veṃkaṭaṃ gatvā tapaḥ kṛtvā suduṣkaram || prasūyate tvayā putraḥ śūrastrailokyavikramaḥ || 5 || idaṃ tīrthottamaṃ tasmātpratyakṣadivase tava || gaṃgādyāni ca tīrthāni samāyāṃti jagattraye || 6 || veṃkaṭādrisamaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmāṇḍe nāsti kiñcana || tatrāpyatyantapuṇyā vai svāmipuṣkariṇī śubhā || 7 || tato'dhikamidaṃ tīrthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ divase tava || snānārthaṃ ye samāyāṃti citrāṛkṣasamanvite || 8 || meṣaṃ pūṣaṇi saṃprāpte pūrṇimāyāṃ śubhe dine || śṛṇu teṣāṃ phalaṃ devi vakṣyāmi tava suvrate || 9 || gaṃgādisarvatīrtheṣu dvādaśābdaṃ varānane || yatphalaṃ vidyate devi tatphalaṃ bhavati dhuvam || 2.1.40.10 || dānāni kurvatāṃ puṃsāṃ teṣāṃ śṛṇu phalonnatim || sthāne tūktaṃ phalaṃ devi viddhi teṣāṃ varānane || 11 || || añjanovāca || || kāryāṇi yāni dānāni veṃkaṭādrau nagottame || tāni sarvāṇi viprendra vada vedavidāṃ vara || 12 || || atha vyāsaproktaśrīveṃkaṭācalakaraṇīyadānapraśaṃsā || || vyāsa uvāca || annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ dvayametatpraśasyate || pituḥ śrāddhaṃ viśeṣeṇa veṃkaṭādrau nagottame || 13 || suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti prītaye madhughātinaḥ || sarvalokaṃ samāsādya modante munisattamāḥ || 14 || śālagrāmaśilādānaṃ ye kurvanti nagottame || aṃgabhaṃgamavāpnoti svānubhūtiṃ ca vindati || 15 || yo dadāti dvijendrāya godānaṃ ca kuṭumbine || romasaṃkhyāpramāṇena viṣṇuloke virājate || 16 || bhūmiṃ dadāti yo devi brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine || tasyāśca puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ kaḥ śakto divi vā bhuvi || 17 || kanyāṃ dadāti yo devi śrotriyāya dvijātaye || viṣṇulokaṃ samāsādya modate pitṛbhiḥ saha || || 18 || prapāṃ kurvanti ye devi śītalodakasaṃyutām || teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ śeṣeṇāpi na śakyate || 19 || tilaṃ dadāti viprāya śrotriyāya kuṭuṃbine || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 2.1.40.20 || dhānyadānaṃ praśaṃsanti viprā vedavidāṃ varāḥ || bahuputrā bhaviṣyanti dhānyadānaṃ prakurvatām || 21 || gandhacampakapuṣpādīñchatravyajanacāmarān || tāmbūlaghanasārādīnyo dadāti dvijātaye || 22 || bhuktvā bhogaṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ svargalokaṃ tato vrajet || divyavarṣasahasraṃ ca bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ || 23 || sārvabhaumastato bhūtvā tatra bhuktvā ciraṃ mahīm || tato vipratvamāsādya vedavedāntapāragaḥ || 24 || tato muktiṃ samāyāti prasādāccakrapāṇinaḥ || ityetatkathitaṃ devi veṃkaṭācalavaibhavam || 25 || ya etacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaścāpi parikīrtayet || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 26 || ityetatkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ vyāsenaiva mahātmanā || śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyati || 27 || tasyaiva vaṃśajāḥ sarve muktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ || 28 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmye'ñjanāvaralabdhyākāśagaṃgā snānakālanirṇayādivarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
<2.2.1>
|| samāptamidaṃ skāndapurāṇāntargataṃ śrīveṃkaṭācalamāhātmyam || || || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha puruṣottama(jagannātha)kṣetramāhātmya prārambhaḥ || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam || devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 1 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavansarvaśāstrajña sarvatīrthamahattvavit || kathitaṃ yattvayā pūrvaṃ prastute tīrthakīrtane || puruṣottamākhyaṃ sumahatkṣetraṃ paramapāvanam ||2|| yatrāste dāravatanuḥ śrīśo mānuṣalīlayā || darśanānmuktidaḥ sākṣātsarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ ||3|| tanno vistarato brūhi tatkṣetraṃ kena nirmitam || jyotiḥprakāśo bhagavānsākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 4 || kathaṃ dārumayastasminnāste paramapūruṣaḥ || vada tvaṃ vadatāṃ śreṣṭha sarvalokaguro mune || 5 || śrotumicchāmahe brahmanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || || jaiminiruvāca || || śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve rahasyaṃ paramaṃ hi tat || 6 || avaiṣṇavānāṃ śravaṇe bhaktistava na jāyate || yasya saṃkīrtanādeva sakalaṃ līyate tamaḥ || 7 || yadyapyeṣa jagannāthaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ || skandena kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ śrutvā śaṃbhormukhāmbujāt || saṃti kṣetrāṇi cānyāni sarvapāpaharāṇi vai || 8 || etatkṣetraṃ paraṃ cāsya vapurbhūtaṃ mahātmanaḥ || svayaṃ vapuṣmāṃstatrāste svanāmnā khyāpitaṃ hi tat ||9|| tatra ye sthātumicchaṃti tepi sarve hatāṃhasaḥ || kiṃ punastava tiṣṭhaṃto ye paśyanti gadādharam ||2.2.1.10|| aho tatparamaṃ kṣetraṃ vistṛtaṃ daśayojanam || tīrtharājasya salilādutthitaṃ vālukācitam || 11 || nīlācalena mahatā madhyasthena virājitam || ekastanamiva pṛthvyāḥ sudūrātparibhāvitam || 12 || varāharūpiṇā pūrvaṃ samuddhṛtya vasundharām || sarvataḥ susamāṃ kṛtvā parvataiḥ susthirīkṛtām || 13 || sṛṣṭvā carācaraṃ sarvaṃ tīrthāni saridabdhikān || kṣetrāṇi ca yathāsthānaṃ saṃniveśya yathā purā | 14 || brahmā vicintayāmāsa sṛṣṭibhāranipīḍitaḥ || punaretāṃ kriyāṃ gurvīṃ nārabheya kathaṃ tviti || 15 || tāpatrayābhibhūtā hi mucyaṃte jaṃtavaḥ katham || evaṃ cintayamānasya matirāsītprajāpateḥ ||16|| muktyekakāraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ stoṣye 'haṃ parameśvaram || || brahmovāca || || namaste jagadādhāra śaṅkhacakragadādhara || 17 || yannābhipaṃkajādeva jāto'haṃ viśvasṛṣṭikṛt || paramārthasvarūpaṃ te tvaṃ vai vetsi jaganmaya || 18 || yanmāyayā jagatsarvaṃ nirmitaṃ mahadādikam || yanniḥśvāsasamudbhūtaṃ śabdabrahma tridhā'bhavat || 19|| upajīvya tadevāhamasṛjaṃ bhuvanāni vai || tvatto nānyaḥ sthūlasūkṣmadīrghahrasvādi kiṃcana || 2.2.1.20 || vikārabhedairbhagavaṃstvamevedaṃ carācaram || kaṭakādi yathā svarṇaṃ guṇatrayavibhāgaśaḥ ||21|| sraṣṭā sṛjyaṃ tvamevātra poṣṭā poṣyaṃ jagatprabho || ādhāro dhriyamāṇaṃ ca dharttā tvaṃ parameśvara ||22 || tvatpreritamatiḥ sarvaścarate ca śubhā'śubham || tataḥ prāpnoti sadṛśīṃ tvayaiva vihitāṃ gatim || 23 || jagato'sya gatirbharttā sākṣī tvaṃ parameśvara || carācaraguro sarvajīvabhūta kṛpāmaya || prasīdādya jagannātha nityaṃ tvaccharaṇyasya me ||24|| || jaiminiruvāca || || evaṃ saṃstūyamānaśca brahmaṇā garuḍadhvajaḥ || nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaḥ śaṃkhacakrādicihnitaḥ || 25 || patageṃdrasamārūḍhaḥ sphuradvadanapaṃkajaḥ || āvirāsīddvijaśreṣṭhā vivakṣuḥ sphuritādharaḥ || 26 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || yadarthaṃ māṃ stuṣe brahmanna śakyaḥ pratibhāti saḥ || 27 || anādyavidyā sudṛḍhā suśchedyā karmabaṃdhanaiḥ || prabhavaṃtyāṃ kathaṃ tasyāṃ hrīyete mṛtijanmanī ||28|| tathāpi cedatra kṛte vyavasāyastavānagha || krameṇa yena hi bhavettatte vakṣyāmi kāraṇam || 29 || ahaṃ tvaṃ tvamahaṃ brahmanmanmayaṃ cākhilaṃ jagat || ciste yatra me tatra nānyatheti vicāraya || 2.2.1.30 || sāgarasyottare tīre mahānadyāstu dakṣiṇe || sa pradeśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ hi sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ ||31|| tatra ye manujā brahmannivasaṃti subuddhayaḥ || janmāṃtarakṛtānāṃ ca puṇyānāṃ phalabhāginaḥ || 32 || nālpapuṇyāḥ prajāyaṃte nābhaktā mayi padmaja || ekāmrakānanādyāvaddakṣiṇodadhitīrabhūḥ || 33 || padātpadācchreṣṭhatamaḥ kramātparamapāvanaḥ || sindhutīraṃ tu yo bahmanrājate nīlaparvataḥ ||34|| pṛthivyāṃ gopitaṃ sthānaṃ tava cāpi sudurlabham || surāsurāṇāṃ durjñeyaṃ māyayāchāditaṃ mama || 35 || sarvasaṃgaparityaktastatra tiṣṭhāmi dehabhṛt || kṣarākṣarāvatikramya vartte'haṃ puruṣottame ||36|| sṛṣṭyā layena nākrāntaṃ kṣetraṃ me puruṣottamam || yathā māṃ paśyasi brahmanrūpaṃ cakrādicihnitam || 37 || īdṛśaṃ tatra gatvaiva drakṣyase māṃ pitāmaha || nīlādreraṃtarabhuvi kalpanyagrodhamūlataḥ || 38 || vāruṇyāṃ diśi yatkuṇḍaṃ rauhiṇaṃ nāma viśrutam || tattīre nivasantaṃ māṃ paśyantaścarmacakṣuṣā || 39 || tadambhasā kṣīṇapāpā mama sāyujyamāpnuyuḥ || tatra vraja mahābhāga dṛṣṭvā māṃ dhyāyatastava || 2.2.1.40 || prakāśaṃ yāsyate tasya kṣetrasya mahimā'paraḥ || āścaryabhūtaḥ paramastavāpi ca bhaviṣyati || 41 || śrutismṛtīhāsapurāṇagopitaṃ manmāyayā tanna hi kasya gocaram || prasādato me stuvatastavādhunā prakāśamāyāsyati sarvagocaram || 42 || vrateṣu tīrtheṣu ca yajñadānayoḥ puṇyaṃ yaduktaṃ vimalātmanāṃ hi tat || aharnivāsāllabhate'tra sarvaṃ niḥśvāsa vāsātkhalu cāśvamedhikam || 43 || ityādiśya vidhiṃ viprāstadāsau puruṣottamaḥ || paśyatastasya tatraiva prabhurantaradhīyata || 44 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || cha || ||
<2.2.2>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || tato brahmāgamattūrṇaṃ yatrāste bhagavānsvayam || stavānte'sau yathā dṛṣṭastathādrākṣītprabhuṃ tadā || 1 || pratyabhijñānasaṃhṛṣṭastaṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśvaram || atyadbhutajñānanidhirbabhūvāsau dvijottamāḥ || 2 || yāvatstotuṃ samārebhe harṣasaṃphullalocanaḥ || tāvadeva samāgatya kutaścidvāyasottamaḥ || 3 || kāruṇyodakasaṃpūrṇe tasminkuṇḍe nimajya tam || vilokya mādhavaṃ nīlaratnakāṃtiṃ kṛpānidhim || 4 || kākadehaṃ samutsṛjya luṭhamāno muhuḥ kṣitau || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇistasya pārśve vyavasthitaḥ || 5 || tiraścastāṃ gatiṃ dṛṣṭvā yogīṃdrāṇāṃ sudurlabhām || mene'sau munayaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ kramātkṣīṇā bhaviṣyati || 6 || manuṣyādhikṛte muktau vedāṃte saṃśayo'bhavat|| na kiṃciddurlabhaṃ ceha viṣṇubhaktasya vidyate || 7 || pratyakṣo'bhūddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ purāṇapuruṣodite || saṃkīrtya yannāma naraḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 8 || tasya saṃdarśane viprā muktiḥ kiṃ khalu durlabhā || manasā dhyāyayanviṣṇuṃ tyajanprāṇānvimucyate || 9 || sākṣātkṛto bhagavataḥ kiṃ citraṃ muktimeti yat || puruṣottamasaṃjñasya kṣetrasya mahimādbhutaḥ || 2.2.2.10 || yatra kāko'pi ca hariṃ sākṣātpaśyati bho dvijāḥ || sudurlabhaṃ kṣetramidamajñānāṃ ca vimocanam || aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ kākasyāpi vimuktidam || kiṃ punaḥ satataṃ śāṃti vairāgyajñānasaṃyujām || 11 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || nīlākhyaṃ mādhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃ cakāra pitāmahaḥ || 12 || taddarśane kṣaṇānnaṣṭadehabandhaṃ ca vāyasam || 13 || || jaiminiruvāca || || atyadbhutamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā yāvaddhyāyati mādhavam || tāvatpitṛpatiḥ svādhikārasaṃyamanākulaḥ || 14 || dīnānano niḥśvasanvai tatra yātastvarānvitaḥ || nīlādrau mādhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā'ṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca || 15 || tuṣṭāva sa jagannāthaṃ svādhikāradṛḍhasthitau || || || yama uvāca || || namaste devadeveśa sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇa || 16 || tvayi protamidaṃ sarvaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā yathā || tvayā dhṛtaṃ tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ tvayā cāpyāyitaṃ jagat || 17 || candrasūryādirūpeṇa nityaṃ bhāsayase'khilam || viśveśvaraṃ jagadyoniṃ viśvāvāsaṃ jagadgurum || || 18 || viśvasākṣiṇamādyantavarjitaṃ praṇamāmyaham || namaḥ paramakāruṇyajalasaṃbhṛtasindhave || 19 || parāparaparātītavibhave viśvasaṃbhave || || 2.2.2.20 || bhavasaṃtāpanīhārabhānave dīnabandhave || svamāyāracitāśeṣa bhave guṇarajjave || 21 || namaḥ kamalakiṃjalka pītanirmalavāsase || mahāhavaripuskandha kṛṃtacakrāya cakriṇe || 22 || daṃṣṭroddhṛta kṣitibhṛte trayīmūrtimate namaḥ || namo yajñavarāhāya candrasūryāgnicakṣuṣe || 23 || narasiṃhāya daṃṣṭrogramūrtidrāvitaśatrave || yadapāṃgavilāsaika sṛṣṭisthityupasaṃhṛtiḥ || 24 || uccāvacātmako hyeṣa bhavaḥ saṃbhavate muhuḥ || tamamuṃ nīlameghābhaṃ nīlāśmamaṇivigraham || 25 || nīlācalaguhāvāsaṃ praṇamāmi kṛpānidhim || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ śubhadāyinam || 26 || praṇatāśeṣapāpaughadāriṇaṃ muravairiṇam || namaste kamalāpāṃga saṃgasaṃskāracakṣuṣe || 27 || śrīvatsakaustubhodbhāsi manohṛdvyūḍhavakṣase || yatpādapaṃkajadvaṃdvasaṃśrayaiśvaryabhāginī || || 28 || śrīḥ saṃśritā janaiḥ śaśvatpṛthagaiśvaryadāyinī || yā parāparasaṃbhinnā prakṛtiste sisṛkṣayā || 29 || nirvikāraṃ paraṃ brahma vikāri sasṛjeṃ'jasā|| sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā lakṣitāṃ śubhalakṣaṇaiḥ || lakṣmīśorasi nityasthā lakṣmīṃ tāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 2.2.2.30 || || jaiminiruvāca || || tadevaṃ dharmarājena śrīkāṃtaḥ paritoṣitaḥ || pārśvasthāṃ vallakīhastāṃ netrāṃtenādiśacchriyam || 31 || tena saṃbhāvitā lakṣmīrbhavaduḥkhavināśinī || śubhāya sarvalokānāṃ yamaṃ provāca līlayā 32 || || lakṣmīruvāca || || yadarthamāvāṃ saṃstauṣi kṣetresmindurlabhaṃ hi tat || atyājyamāvayoretatkṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 33 || kalpāvasānepyāvāṃ vai dhriyete parameṣṭhinā || brahmādidikprabhūṇāṃ hi svāmitvaṃ neha vidyate || 34 || neha karmaparīpākāḥ saṃbhavaṃti kadācana|| atra pravasatāṃ nṛṇāṃ tiraścāmapi duṣkṛtām|| 35 || dahyate jvalitāgnau hi tūlarāśiryathā bhṛśam || ye baddhā pāpapuṇyābhyāṃ nigaḍābhyāmaharniśam || 36 || teṣāṃ saṃyamitā tvaṃ hi yamaḥ pūrvaṃ vinirmitaḥ || atra sākṣādvapuṣmaṃtaṃ nīlendramaṇimaṃjulam || 37 || dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ mucyate karmabandhanāt || ato'nyataḥ karmabhūmau prabhutvaṃ sūryasaṃbhava || 38 || vaiklavyaṃ kṣetrarājesminmā gāstvaṃ yama saṃyame || tavāpi bhagavāneṣa vidhātā prapitāmahaḥ || 39 || tiryaṃcaṃ viṣṇusārūpyaṃ prāptaṃ paśyati kautukāt || eṣa karmaparīpākaṃ sarveṣāṃ vetti kaṃjajaḥ || 2.2.2.40 || jñātvā kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ stauti devaṃ gadādharam|| tvadvaśaṃ gaṃtumucitā neha tiṣṭhaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 41 || vaivasvata vasaṃtyatra jīvanmuktā mumukṣavaḥ || tayā saṃbodhitastvevaṃ viṣṇunā strīsvarūpiṇā || tato'haṃkāralajjābhyāṃ vinītaḥ prābravīdyamaḥ || 42 || || yama uvāca || || mātastvayā yadājñaptaṃ purā naitanmayā śrutam|| 43 || ajñānopahato vedmi rahasyaṃ kathamuttamam || yasya svarūpaṃ vedāśca na ca vetti pitāmahaḥ||44|| mahimānaṃ kathaṃ tasya vedmyahaṃkāra mohitaḥ|| yadādiṣṭaṃ sureśāni kṣetrametadvimuktidam||45|| sānnidhyādvāsudevasya īśvarecchā niraṃkuśā|| anyatra bandhado viṣṇuratra mokṣaṃ dadāti yat|| 46|| mamāpi nirayāṇāṃ ca sraṣṭāsau tridivasya ca|| mṛtānāmatra muktiścettanmāmaṃba suvistaram||47|| kṣetrasaṃsthāpramāṇaṃ hi tatra sthiti phalaṃ hi yat || tīrthāni kāni saṃtyatra kimanyadvā rahasyakam || 48 || kimadhiṣṭhātṛkaṃ kṣetraṃ tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me || tadahaṃ saṃparityajya nirbhayaḥ saṃcare yathā|| 49 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || || cha ||
<2.2.3>
|| śrīruvāca || || sādhu te buddhirutpannā viṣṇoḥ saṃnidhimāśritā || adbhutaṃ kathayāmyetatkṣetrasya ravinaṃdana || 1 || yathāhaṃ bhagavadvakṣaḥ sthalasthā dadṛśe purā || carācare jagatyasminpralīne pralaye yama || 2 || etatkṣetramahaṃ caiva dve evopasthite tadā|| sa tadā saptakalpāyurmṛkaṃḍorātmajo muniḥ||3|| praṇaṣṭe sthāvaracare nimagnaḥ pralayārṇave|| nāvasthānamavāpyaiva śarma lebhe na kutracit||4|| jalārṇave bhrāmyamāṇaḥ pralaye sa itastataḥ|| puruṣottamasādṛśye kṣetre sa vaṭamaikṣata|| 5|| utplutyotplutya mūlaṃ tu nyagrodhasya samīpataḥ|| śuśrāva bāla vacanaṃ mārkaṇḍeya mamāṃtikam || 6 || praviśya duḥkhamatulaṃ jahīhi khalu mā śucaḥ || tacchrutvā citravacanamapratarkyaṃ tadā muniḥ || 7 || vismayaṃ paramaṃ lebhe svaduḥkhaṃ nāpyacintayat || vāribhiḥ śīryate naitaddahyate kālavahninā || 8 || saṃvartakādibhirnaitacchoṣyate nāpi cālyate || ekārṇave mahāghore nauriva kṣetramīkṣyate || 9 || tatrāyaṃ yūpasadṛśo nyagrodhastiṣṭhate mahān || yaṃ gṛhītvā kṣetramidaṃ nyagrodha īśitustanuḥ || 2.2.3.10 || mahāpralaya vātena śākhā nāsya hi kampate || tasyādhastātsa hi muniḥ sthitvā caitadaciṃtayat || 11 || ekārṇave'sminpralaye naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame || bhūpradeśaḥ sthirataraḥ kathameṣa vibhāvyate || 12 || yatrāyaṃ śākhipravaraḥ komalaḥ paridṛśyate || mārkaṃḍeyāgaccha muhuriti sapraśrayaṃ vacaḥ || 13 || kuto nirāśramiyadaṃ cintayanniti sa plavan || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ nārāyaṇamalokayat || 14 || tadaṃgapadmāsanagāṃ māṃ ca vaivasvataikṣata || vivaśo jalavātābhyāṃ tadā sustho vyavasthitaḥ || 15 || hṛṣṭāṃtarātmā sa munirāvāṃ sāṣṭāṃgamānataḥ || prasādanāya devasya stotrametadudāharat || 16 || || mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || tvatpādapadmānusarānuṣaṃgaṃ rudreṃdrapadmāsanasampadāḍhyam || tvadbhaktihīnaṃ paritaḥ prataptaṃ dīnaṃ paritrāhi kṛpāṃbudhe mām || 17 || brahmādibhiryatparicaryamāṇaṃ padāmbujadvandvamaciṃtyaśakti || śvaḥ śreyasaprāptinidānatattvaṃ dīnaṃ paritrāhi kṛpāmbudhe mām || 18 || yadaṃgabhūtaṃ jagadaṇḍametadanekakoṭi praguṇaṃ vibhāti || līlāvilāsasthitisṛṣṭilīnaṃ tanmāṃ sudīnaṃ parirakṣa viṣṇo || 19 || ekaṃ suvarṇaṃ kaṭakādibhedairnānā yathā vā nabhasodito'rkaḥ || ādhāravaiṣamyajaleṣu tādṛgvibhāvyase nirguṇa eka eva || 2.2.3.20 || aśeṣasaṃpūrṇaruciprahīṇopādānasaṃkalpavivarjito'pi || dīnānukaṃpānuguṇaṃ bibharṣi yuge yuge dehamapāraśakte || 21 || tvatpādapadmaṃ jagadīśa pūrvamasevyatānātmadhiyā mayā yat || tatkarmaṇā dāruṇapākabhājaṃ dīnaṃ paritrāhi kṛpāṃbudhe mām || 22 || aśeṣalokasthitisṛṣṭilīnavilāsi yatte triguṇaṃ vibhāti || vapurmahātmanmahadādiheturhetornamaste prakṛteḥ parasya || || 23 || sarvatra gatvā bṛhadaprameyaṃ pravarddhamānaṃ tvayi bṛṃhitaṃ ca || tadbahmarūpaṃ pariṇāmahetuṃ svādhyātmaviśvātmakamāśrayāmi || 24 || ekārṇave mahāghore nāvasthātuṃ pradeśabhūḥ || asti lakṣmīpate meghavārivātaprakaṃpanāt || 25 || trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha magnaṃ saṃsārasāgare || māmuddharāsmādgoviṃda kṛpāpāṃgavilokanāta || 26 || || śrīruvāca || || stuvaṃtamevaṃ brahmarṣi sākṣānnārāyaṇo vibhuḥ || vilokyānugrahadṛśā vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 27 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || mārkaṃḍeya sudīno'si māmajñāya dvijottama || duścaraṃ tu tapastaptaṃ dīrghāyustena kevalam || 28 || śayānaṃ patrapuṭake paśya kalpavaṭordhvagama || bālasvarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ kālātmānaṃ mahāmune || praviśya vistṛtaṃ vaktraṃ tatrāvasthātumarhasi || 29 || || || śrīruvāca || || evamukto bhagavatā sa munirvismitānanaḥ || 2.2.3.30 || āruhya dadṛśe bālarūpaṃ tasyāviśanmukhe || praviṣṭaḥ kaṃṭhamārgeṇa mahāyāmaṃ mahodaram || 31 || tatrāsau dadṛśe vipro bhuvanāni caturdaśa || brahmādidikpālasurānsiddhagaṃdharvarākṣasān || 32 || ṛṣīndivyaṛṣīṃścaiva bhūtalaṃ sāgarāṃkitam || nānātīrthairnadībhiśca parvataiḥ kānanaistathā || 33 || lakṣitaṃ pattanapuraṃ grāmakharvaṭakairyutam || pātālāni tathā sapta nāgakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 34 || mahārghyamaṇisaudhaiśca sudhāpātraiḥ samujjvalaiḥ || anarghyamaṇibhirnāgaiḥ sevitaṃ paramādbhutam || || 35 || jagatāṃ dhāriṇaṃ śeṣaṃ sahasraphaṇamaṃḍitam || vyākartāramaśeṣāṇāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ śiṣyamadhyagam || 36 || brahmāṃḍodaragaṃ vastu yatkiṃcitparameṣṭhinā || sṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ dadṛśe'sau tatkukṣau sa mahāmuniḥ || 37 || nāpaśyadaṃtaṃ kukṣestu bhramamāṇa itastataḥ || tato viniṣkramya punardadṛśe ca mayā saha || 38 || pūrvamālakṣitaṃ yadvadāsthitaṃ puruṣottamam || vismayotphullanayanaḥ praṇipatyedamabravīt || 39 || || mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa kimadbhutamidaṃ prabho || mahāpralayasaṃrodhe sṛṣṭiratra vibhāvyate || 2.2.3.40 || tvanmāyā duravacchedyā kathaṃ vai jñāyate mayā || || 41 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || mune kṣetramidaṃ citraṃ śāśvataṃ me vibhāvaya || na sṛṣṭipralayāvatra vidyete na ca saṃsṛtiḥ || 42 || sadaikarūpaṃ puruṣottamākhyaṃ muktipradaṃ māmiha saṃprabudhya || atra praviṣṭo na punaḥ prayāti garbhasthitiṃ sāṃdrasukhasvarūpaḥ || 43 || ityājñapto bhagavatā mārkaṃḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || atra vāsaṃ kariṣyāmītyanyatīrthaparāṅmukhaḥ || prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ prāha praṇipatya jagadgurum || 44 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || uvāca sa tathā viṣṇuṃ bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ || anugṛhṇīṣva bhagavankṣetresminpuruṣottame || yathā sthito mṛtyuvaśaṃ na vraje puruṣottama || 45 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || atra sthitiṃ me viprarṣe kṣetre mokṣaprasādhake || 46 || kariṣyāmi na saṃdeho yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || pralayāvasāne tīrthaṃ te racayiṣyāmi śāśvatam || 47 || yattīre tapa āsthāya maddvitīyatanuṃ śivam || ārādhya madanukrośānmṛtyuṃ jeṣyasi niścitam || 48 || || jaiminiruvāca || || evaṃ purā dattavaro mārkaṃḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || nyagrodhavāyavyakoṇe khātaṃ cakreṇa vai hareḥ || 49 || pāvanaṃ gartamāsthāya pūjayitvā maheśvaram || mahatā tapasā vipro jitavānmṛtyumaṃjasā || 2.2.3.50 || munestasyaiva nāmnāyaṃ prakhyāto garta uttamaḥ || yatra snātvā śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet || 51 || || || śrīruvāca || || pañcakrośamidaṃ kṣetraṃ samudrāṃtarvyavasthitam || dvikrośaṃ tīrtharājasya taṭabhūmau sunirmalam || 52 || suvarṇavālukākīrṇaṃ nīlaparvataśobhitam || yo'sau viśveśvaro devaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakaḥ || 53 || saṃyamya viṣayagrāmaṃ samudrataṭamāsthitaḥ || upāsituṃ jagannāthaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭitamaḥ prabhuḥ || 54 || yameśvara iti khyāto yamasaṃyamanāśanaḥ || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā tu koṭiliṃgaphalaṃ labhet || 55 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<2.2.4>
|| śrīruvāca || || sīmāpratīcī kṣetrasya śaṃkhākārasya mūrddhani || sarvakāmaprado devaḥ sa āste vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 1 || śaṃkhāgre nīlakaṇṭhaḥ syādetatkrośaṃ sudurlabham || paramaṃ pāvanaṃ kṣetraṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇasya vai || 2 || siṃdhurājasya salilādyāvanmūlaṃ vaṭasya vai || śaṃkhasyodarabhāgastu samudrodakasaṃplutaḥ || 3 || yatsaṃparkātsamudro'tra tīrtharājatvamāgataḥ || yathāyaṃ bhagavānmuktiprado dṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ || 4 || tathedaṃ maraṇātkṣetraṃ siṃdhuḥ snānādvimuktidaḥ || ciccheda brahmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ rudraḥ krodhāttu pañcamam || 5 || tacchiro dustyajaṃ gṛhṇanbrahmāṃḍaṃ paribabhrame || atrāgato yadā brahmakapālaṃ parimuktavān || 6 || kapālamocanaṃ liṃgaṃ dvitīyāvartasaṃsthitam || kapālamocanaṃ paśyetpūjayetpraṇamecca yaḥ || 7 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ kaṃcukaṃ vijahātyasau || tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu maraṇaṃ bhavamocanam || 8 || tṛtīyāvartagāmādyāṃ śaktiṃ me vimalāhvayām || jānīhi dharmarāja tvaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradām || 9 || ya imāṃ pūjayedbhaktyā praṇametkīrtayettu vā || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti muktiṃ cāṃte ca viṃdati || 2.2.4.10 || nābhideśe sthitaṃ hyetattrayaṃ kuṃḍaṃ vaṭo vibhuḥ || kapālamocanādyāvadarddhāśinī pratiṣṭhitā || 11 || madhyaṃ śaṃkhasya jānīyātsuguptaṃ cakrapāṇinā || arddhamaśnāti salilaṃ mahāpralayavarddhitam || 12 || sṛṣṭyādau dharmarājeyaṃ śaktirme'rddhāṃśinī smṛtā || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamedyastu bhogānso'śnāti śāśvatān || 13 || sindhurājasya salilādyāvanmūlaṃ vaṭasya vai || kīṭapakṣi manuṣyāṇāṃ maraṇānmuktido mataḥ ||14|| antarvedī tviyaṃ puṇyā vāṃchyate tridaśairapi || yatra sthitāṃ hi paśyaṃti sarvāṃścakrābjadhāriṇaḥ ||15|| pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni gagane ca triviṣṭape || sārddhatrikoṭisaṃkhyāni svargamokṣapradāni vai || 16 || teṣāmayaṃ tīrtharājaḥ kīrtitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || sarveṣāṃ muktikṣetrāṇāmidaṃ sāyujyadaṃ matam || 17 || atra sthitā na śocaṃti jarājanmamṛtiṣvapi || kuṇḍaṃ hyetadrohiṇākhyaṃ kāruṇyākhyajalena vai || 18 || saṃbhṛtaṃ tiṣṭhate nityaṃ sparśanādbaṃdhamuktidam || atra pratiṣṭhitaṃ vāri pralaye yatpravarddhate || 19 || atraiva līyate paścāttasmādrohiṇasaṃjñitam || tasmātte mā'tra ciṃtāstu svādhikāraviparyaye || 2.2.4.20 || mokṣādhikāriṇāmatra neśvarastvaṃ paretarāṭ || dharmarājaṃ samādiśya lakṣmīrevaṃ puraḥ sthitam || 21 || brahmāṇamāha jagatāmaṃbā sapraśrayā girā || pitāmaha jagannātha viditaṃ sarvameva yat || 22 || mokṣadaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāmetatkṣetraṃ samādiśa || kāmākhyaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca vimalaṃ vā tapāsthitā || 23 || sākṣādbrahmasvarūpo'sau nṛsiṃho dakṣiṇe vibhoḥ || hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣo vidāryāyaṃ prabhojjvalaḥ || 24 || darśanādasya naśyaṃti pātakāni na saṃśayaḥ || bhuktermukteśca yogyaḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 25 || asyāgre saṃtyajanprāṇānbrahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt || yatkiṃcitkurute karma koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 26 || chāyaiṣā kalpavṛkṣasya nṛsiṃhārkeṇa bhāsitā || tasyāṃ naśyatyavidyā hi jñānato'jñānato mṛtau || 27 || vedāṃteṣu prasiddhaistairvijñānaiḥ śravaṇādibhiḥ || mūḍhānāṃ durlabhairviprā vināpyatra vimocanam || 28 || avimukte mumukṣostu karṇamūle maheśvaraḥ || diśati brahmasaṃjñānaṃ bodhopāyaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ || 29 || tena budyā samabhyasya kramānmokṣamavāpnuyāt || upadeṣṭurmahimnā hi tasya jñānaṃ na hīyate || 2.2.4.30 || atra tyajaṃti ye prāṇāṃsteṣāṃ tatkṣaṇa eva hi || svarūpājjāyate muktiḥ saṃśayo mā'stu te yama || 31 || gatāgata prasaktānāṃ karmiṇāṃ mūḍhacetasām || vaivasvata kadācinno viśvāso hyatra jāyate || 32 || utsṛjya vāri gāṃgeyaṃ svādu śītaṃ sunirmalam || pipāsuḥ palvalaṃ yāti tadvatte mūḍhacetasaḥ || 33 || bhramaṃti tīrthānyanyāni tyaktvaitatkṣetramuttamam || palāśāmodakaistṛptā labhaṃte śramajaṃ phalam || 34 || snānādabdhidṛśā devaśchāyayā kalpapādapaḥ || yatra kutrāpi ca kṣetraṃ maraṇānmuktidaṃ nṛṇām || 35 || yo yatra viṣaye bhaktyā viśvāsaṃ kurute naraḥ || sa tu tenaiva mucyeta nedṛśaṃ tīrthamasti vai || 36 || etattyaktvānyatīrthe vai vidadhāti ruciṃ tu yaḥ || nūnaṃ sa māyayā viṣṇorvaṃcito lobhalālasaḥ || || 37 || upadeśena bahunā na prayojanamasti te || pratyakṣo hyanubhūto'yaṃ karaṭo viṣṇurūpadhṛk || 38 || antarvedīrakṣaṇārthaṃ śaktayo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ || ugreṇa tapasā pūrvamahaṃ rudreṇa bhāvitā || 39 || patnyarthaṃ sā mayā sṛṣṭā gaurī tasyātha bhāvinī || sarvasauṃdaryavasatirvapuṣo me vinirgatā || 2.2.4.40 || tadādiṣṭā mayā bhadre vacanaṃ me priyaṃ kuru || antarvedī rakṣa mama paritastvaṃ svamūrtibhiḥ || 41 || sā tu tiṣṭhati matprītyā aṣṭadhā dikṣu saṃsthitā || maṃgalā vaṭamūle tu paścime vimalā tathā || 42 || śaṃkhasya pṛṣṭhabhāge tu saṃsthitā sarvamaṃgalā || arddhāṃśinī tathā laṃbā kuberadiśi saṃsthitā || 43 || kālarātrirdakṣiṇasyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ tu marīcikā || kālarātryāstathā paścāccaṃḍarūpā vyavasthitā || 44 || etābhirugrarūpābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ parirakṣitam || alpapuṇyasya puṃso hi sthānametatsudurlabham || 45 || etāsāmaṣṭaśaktīnāṃ darśanātkīrtanāttathā || naśyaṃti sarvapāpāni hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 46 || rudrāṇyāścāṣṭadhā bhedaṃ dṛṣṭvā rudro'pi śaṃkaraḥ || ātmānamaṣṭadhā bhittvā upāste parameśvaram ||47|| ārādhya tapasā viṣṇuṃ prārthayadvaramuttamam || yatra tvaṃ deva tatrāhaṃ vaseyaṃ hi yathāsukham || 48 || tvāmṛte kamalākāṃta nānyannirvāṇakāraṇam || aṃtaryāminprabho me tvaṃ tvāṃ vinā vigrahaḥ kutaḥ ||49|| mūḍhā ye tvāṃ na jānaṃti hṛṣyaṃti viṣaye'śucau || nirmalāṃbarasaṃkāśa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ||2.2.4.50|| || || jaiminiruvāca || || bhagavānapi rudraṃ taṃ kṣetrapālaṃ tathā vibhuḥ || sthāpayāmāsa paritaḥ svayaṃ madhye vyavasthitaḥ || 51 || kapālamocanaṃ nāma kṣetrapālaṃ yameśvaram || mārkaṇḍeyaṃ tatheśānaṃ bilveśaṃ nīlakaṃṭhakam || 52 || vaṭamūle vaṭeśaṃ ca liṃgānyaṣṭau maheśituḥ || yāni dṛṣṭvā tathā spṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā vimucyate || 53 || atra kṣetre mṛtā ye ca na teṣāṃ tu prabhuryamaḥ || yadarthamāgatastvaṃ hi tadanyatra prasādhaya || 54 || tathāpyasau jagannātho bhaktāyātmasamarpakaḥ || yamena toṣito bhaktyā prapannārtiharaḥ prabhuḥ || 55 || sudarśanena cakreṇa māyāṃ ca vyavadhāsyati || atyājye'sminkṣetravare svarṇavālukayā vṛte || 56 || taṃ yamaṃ vaṃcayitvā tu prasthāpayya yamālayam || sādhu matvā tataḥ prāha brahmāṇaṃ purataḥ sthitam || 57 || | | | śrīruvāca || || iṃdradyumno nāma rājā yuge satye bhaviṣyati || vaiṣṇavaḥ sarvayajñānāmāharttā śāstrakovidaḥ || 58 || atrāgatya mahābhaktiṃ kariṣyati nṛpottamaḥ || bhagavatprītaye yena vājimedhasahasrakam || 59 || kariṣyate prajānātha tadanugrahakāraṇāt || ekadārusamutpannaścaturddhā saṃbhaviṣyati || ||| 2.2.4.60 || dāravapratimānāni viśvakarmā ghaṭiṣyati || pratiṣṭhāpayitā tvaṃ hi iṃdradyumnaprasāditaḥ || 61 || asmākaṃ sadṛśānāṃ ca pratimānāṃ pitāmaha || tadrūpakā pratiṣṭhā hi ghaṭanā ca bhaviṣyati || 62 || iti śrutvā śriyo vākyaṃ caturvaktro yamaśca saḥ || svaṃsvaṃ puraṃ jagmatustau mudā paramayā yutau || 63 || kṣetrasya mahimānaṃ taṃ saṃsmṛtya ca muhurmuhuḥ || vismayena ca harṣeṇa romāṃcāṃcitavigrahau || 64 || sāṃprataṃ munayastasminniṃdradyumnaprasāditaḥ || śaṃkhacakradharaḥ śrīmānnīlajīmūtasaṃnibhaḥ || 65 || nīlācalaguhāṃtaḥstho bibhraddārumayaṃ vapuḥ || āste lokopakārāya balena ca subhadrayā |||| 66 || sudarśanena cakreṇa dāruṇā nirmitena ca || sahitaḥ praṇatārtīnāṃ nāśanaḥ karuṇārṇavaḥ || 67 || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpabaṃdhena sudṛḍhena vimucyate || || sukarmaughaparīpāko yugapatsamupasthitaḥ || 68 || paśyatāṃ bho muniśreṣṭhāstāpatrayasudhānidhim || bahavo hyavatārā hi viṣṇordivyāśca mānuṣāḥ || || 69 || atyadbhutāni karmāṇi māhātmyaṃ cāpi varṇitam || pāricityānmanuṣyāṃstu na manyaṃte surā api || 2.2.4.70 || devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ gaṃdharvoragarakṣasām || tiraścāmapi bho viprāstasmindārumaye harau || 71 || sarvātmabhūte vasati cittaṃ sarvasukhāvahe || upajīvaṃtyasya sukhaṃ yasyānanyasvarūpiṇaḥ || 72 || brahmaṇaḥ śrutivāgāhetyetadatrānubhūyate || dyati saṃsāraduḥkhāni dadāti sukhamavyayam || 73 || tasmāddārumayaṃ brahma vedāṃteṣu pragīyate || na hi kāṣṭhamayī mokṣaṃ dadāti pratimā kvacit || 74 || kṛtenākṛtatā viprāḥ kadācinnopalabhyate || akṛto hyapavargastu kṛtādvā dāruṇaḥ katham || 75 || adhiṣṭhānaṃ vinā brāhmyamaiśvaryaṃ nopalabhyate || rahasyametatparamaṃ viṣṇoḥ sthānamanuttamam || 76 || alaukikī sā pratimā laukikīti prakāśitā || kutra śrutā vā dṛṣṭā vā pratimā vyāharediti || 77 || iṃdradyumnāya sa varaṃ tadā dāruvapurdadau || dīnānāthaikaśaraṇaṃ taraṇaṃ bhavavāridheḥ || 78 || carācara sadāvaṃdya caraṇaṃ taṃ parāyaṇam || nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyoniṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtikāraṇam || 79 || mokṣaṇaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ dāraṇaṃ sakalāpadām || vibhūtīnāṃ visaraṇaṃ varaṇaṃ sarvayoginām || 2.2.4.80 || bharaṇaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ dharaṇaṃ jagatāmapi || bhāṣaṇaṃ sarvabhāṣāṇāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ sarvaduṣkṛtām || 81 || śoṣaṇaṃ sarvapaṃkānāṃ nīlādriśaraṇaṃ harim || śaraṇaṃ prayāta munayo hyananyaśaraṇaṃ vibhum || 82 || niśceṣṭo dāruvarṣmāpi divyalīlāvilāsakṛt || kṣamate svalpabhaktyāpi soparādhaśataṃ nṛṇām || 83 || atra vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi caritaṃ pāpanāśanam || līlayā dārudehasya munayaḥ paramātmanaḥ || 84 || kurukṣetre samudbhūtau brāhmaṇakṣatriyāvubhau || sakhāyau jagmatuḥ prītyā ekāhāravihāriṇau || 85 || vṛttacyutau niṣiddhānāmāharttārau vimohitau || asvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārau svadhāsvāhāvivarjitau || 66 || apātrabhūtau dharmasya mahāpātakadūṣitau || madhubhakṣau paṇyayoṣitsahavāsau mudānvitau || 87 || pāralaukikaciṃtā tu tayoḥ svapnepi nāgatā || evaṃ pravartamānau tāvāyuṣo'rddhaṃ ca ninyatuḥ || 88 || ekadā bhramamāṇau tau yajñavāṭamagacchatām || śṛṇvanto dūrataḥ stotraṃ śāstraśabdaṃ manoharam || 89 || dṛṣṭvā tāstāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ śrutisaṃcoditā dvijāḥ || tau tadā cakratuḥ śraddhāṃ dharme vartmanyadhārmikau || 2.2.4.90 || saṃsmaraṃtau svajātiṃ tau puṃḍarīkāṃbarīṣakau || niṃdantau duścaritraṃ svaṃ parasparamabhāṣatām || 91 ||| kathamāvāṃ tariṣyāvo duṣkṛtārṇavamulbaṇam || ihaiva janmanyajaraṃ buddhipūrvamupārjjitam || 92 || na tacchāstraṃ hi jānāti yadāvābhyāṃ ca duṣkṛtam ||| sañcitaṃ tasya ghorasya prāyaścittaṃ sudurllabham || 93 || tathāpi brāhmaṇānetānbrahmiṣṭhānvai sadogatān || praṇipātaprapannānvai pṛcchāvo'tra ca niṣkṛtim || || 94 || iti niścitya tau viprānabhivādyābhyapṛcchatām || yathāvatkalmaṣaṃ svaṃsvaṃ vijñāpya ca muhurmuhuḥ || 95 || te tayorvacanaṃ śrutvā mīlitākṣā dvijottamāḥ|| nābruvankiṃsvidanyonyaṃ vīkṣaṃto vismitānanāḥ || 96 || aho sughorakarmāṇi saṃcitāni durātmanoḥ || yeṣu śāstraṃ padaṃ dātuṃ prāyaścittāya na hyalam || 97 || śaknumo na vayaṃ tasmādanayorniṣkṛtāviti || teṣāṃ madhye sadomukhyaḥ kaścidvaiṣṇavapuṃgavaḥ || 98 || bhagavadbhaktimāhātmya kṣapitāśeṣakalmaṣaḥ || tānuvāca vihasyedaṃ vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ varaḥ || 99 || || vaiṣṇava uvāca || || bho dvija kṣatradāyāda pāparāśeḥ sudāruṇāt || muktiṃ cedvāṃcchatastūrṇaṃ gacchataṃ puruṣottamam || 2.2.4.100 || kṣetrottamaṃ dārumayo yatrāste puruṣottamaḥ || indradyumnasya rājarṣerbhaktyānugrahakṛdvibhuḥ || 101 || tamārādhya jagannāthaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || pāpakṣayaṃ vā muktiṃ vā svecchayā prāpsyatha dhuvam || 102 || ghoraduṣkṛtatūlaugha dāvāgnisadṛśastu saḥ || tapase tatkṣayaṃ netuṃ na śakyaṃ janmakoṭibhiḥ || 103 || yugapatsaṃkṣayaṃ yāti yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvakilbiṣam || tanmā vilaṃbaṃ kurutaṃ prayātaṃ tatra satvaraṃ || 104 || supuṇye cotkale deśe dakṣiṇārṇavatīrage || nīlādriśikharāvāsaṃ vrajataṃ śaraṇaṃ vibhum || 105 || so'bhīṣṭasiddhiṃ vāṃ devaḥ pradāsyati kṛpānidhiḥ || ityādiṣṭau tato viprakṣatriyau harṣasaṃyutau || 106 || tenaiva vartmanā viprāḥ prayātau puruṣottame || 107 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha ||
<2.2.5>
|| jaimini ruvāca || || nirviṇṇacetasau tau tu tyaktvā veśyādisaṃgatim || dhyāyaṃtau manasā viṣṇuṃ śuddhāhāravratāvubhau || 1 || kālena kiyatā prāptau nīlādrinilayaṃ hareḥ || tīrtharājajale snātvā yathāvadvidhicoditam || 2 || prāsādadvāri tiṣṭhaṃtau sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca || bhagavaṃtaṃ nirīkṣaṃtau nāpaśyatāṃ tadā dvijā || 3 || vivarṇavadanau devamadṛṣṭvā ciṃtayākulau || ārabhete hyanaśanaṃ bhagavaddarśanāvadhi || 4 || kīrtayaṃte bhagavato nāma kalmaṣanāśanam || tṛtīyasyāṃ triyāmāyāṃ jyotirekamapaśyatām || 5 || trīṇyahāni punastau ca tadopāvasatāṃ sthirau || madhye saptamarātrestu bhagavaṃtamapaśyatām || 6 || tridaśānāṃ stutīḥ śrutvā divyajñānau babhūvatuḥ || apāstapāpanirmokau sākṣāddevamapaśyatām || 7 || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇi divyālaṃkārabhūṣitam || ratnapādukayoḥ pṛṣṭhe vinyastacaraṇāṃbujam || 8 || vyākośapuṃḍarīkākṣaṃ prasannavadanaṃ vibhum || vāmapārśve sthitāṃ lakṣmīṃ vāmenāliṃgya bāhunā || 9 || nāgavallīdalaṃ baddhamādadānaṃ śriyā hṛtam || ratnavetrakarāḥ kāścitkāściccāmarapāṇayaḥ || 2.2.5.10 || gaṃdhatailapradīpāstu ratnavartipradīpikāḥ || kāściddadhānāḥ svakarairyovanāḍhyāḥ subhūṣitāḥ ||11|| paścādratnamayaṃ chatraṃ bibhratī kācidujjvalā|| dhūpapātraṃ mukhābhyāśe kṛṣṇāgurusudhūpitam || 12 || kāciddadhānā pramlocāṃ hasaṃtī vigrahaśriyā || līlālakadṛśā devānanugṛhṇaṃtamagrataḥ || 13 || baddhāṃjalipuṭānnamrakandharānstuvataḥ pṛthak || siddhānmunigaṇāndivyānsanakādīnsmitena ca || 14 || nāradādīṃśca gaṃdharvāndivyagānamanoharān || dattāvadhānaṃ śravaṇe līlayaivānukampinam||15|| prahlādādīnvaiṣṇavāgryānsvarūpaṃ dhyāyato'grataḥ || cittākarṣaṇasaṃlīnāṃ vidadhānaṃ svavigrahe || 16 || vakṣaḥsthalapravilasatkaustubhapratibiṃbitaiḥ || devādibhirviśvarūpamūrtteḥ svasyāḥ prakāśakam || 17 || uparyupari divyāyāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭeradhaḥ sthitam || śrīsannidhānavigataśriyamapsarasāṃ gaṇam || || 18 || paśyaṃtaṃ vividhaṃ nityamaṅgahāramanoharam || divyalīlāvilāsaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tau dvijabāhujau || 19 || babhūvatuḥ kṣaṇātsarvavidyānāṃ pāragau dvijāḥ || triḥ parikramya deveśaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāvubhau || sāṣṭāṃgapātapraṇatau tuṣṭuvāte mudānvitau || 2.2.5.20 || || puṇḍarīka uvāca || || namaste jagadādhāra sargasthityaṃtakāraṇa || nārāyaṇa namaste'stu paramātmanparāyaṇa || 21 || paramārthastvamevaiko bhavāpyayavivarjitaḥ || nityānandasvarūpaṃ tvāṃ vidanti dhyānacakṣuṣaḥ || 22 || cinmātraṃ jagatāmīśamadhiṣṭhānaṃ parātparam || kathaṃ nu mūḍhahṛdayāstvāṃ jānaṃti sunirmalam || 23 || kāmārthalipsāsaṃbhrātacetaso'tyaṃtaduḥkhinaḥ || gatāgatapathe śrāṃtāḥ sukhabhājaḥ kadācana || 24 || anukaṃpaya māṃ nātha sudīnaṃ śaraṇāgatam || mūḍhaṃ duṣkṛtakarmāṇaṃ patitaṃ bhavasāgare || 25 || ko'nyastvatsadṛśo bandhurbrahmāṃḍe nātha varttate || svakarttavyānapekṣo yo dīnānāthadayālukaḥ || 26 || uccāvacabhramādduḥkhaṃ jalayaṃtraghaṭīmiva || ajasramadhikarttāraṃ paritrāhi kṛpāṃbudhe || 27 || yogakṣemābhisaṃdhānā ye mūḍhāstvāmupāsate || līlāvimuktidaṃ te vai tvanmāyāparimohitāḥ || 28 | nārāyaṇeti tvannāma kīrtitaṃ tu yadṛcchayā || tvatto'dhikaṃ jagannātha caturvargaikasādhanam | 29 || tvaṃ tu taistaiḥ pṛthagyajñaistāstāḥ siddhīḥ prayacchasi || tvamekaḥ śaraṇaṃ nātha patitānāṃ bhavārṇave || 2.2.5.30 || jñānanaukāsamārūḍhaḥ karuṇākṣepaṇīkaraḥ || paraṃ pāraṃ prabho netuṃ saṃsārābdhervicetanam || 31 || tvameka īśiṣe bhaktyānanyayā pariciṃtitaḥ || ye'nye muktipradā devāḥ śāstreṣu pariniṣṭhitāḥ || 32 || duḥkhābdhikumbhayoniṃ te tvadbhaktiṃ prāpayaṃti vai || 33 || tanme prasīda bhagavanpadapaṃkaje te bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ vitara nātha bhavābdhimuccaiḥ || ghoraṃ sudustaramamuṃ hi yayā tareyamaṣṭāṃgayogajanitaśramavarjito'pi || 34 || dharmārthakāmanicayaiḥ kumatipragṛhyaiḥ kṣudrairamībhirahitālpasukhairna kāryam | ājñāpayāṃghrinalinadvayaciṃtanedya sāṃdrānuvardhitasukhārṇavamajjanaṃ me || 35 || stutvetthaṃ jagadīśasya pādapadmāṃtike dvijaḥ || papāta trāhi kṛṣṇeti vadanvāṣpārdrayā girā || tasthau sa punarutthāya kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ stuvan || 36 || || ambarīṣa uvāca || || prasīda deva sarvātmannasaṃkhyeyaśirobhuja || asaṃkhya ghrāṇanayanapāṇipāda namo'stu te || 37 || ṣaṭtriṃśattattvātīto'si niṣprapaṃca prapaṃcakaḥ || caturvidhajagaddhāma viśvamūrte namo'stu te || 38 || ekapādastripādaśca tīrthapādoṃ'tarikṣapāt || yasya pādodbhavā gaṃgā punāti bhuvanatrayam||39 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ śodhakaṃ yasya nāma vai || kīrtitaṃ sarvaśubhadaṃ namastasmai śubhātmane||2.2.5.40|| deva tvannāmakīrtyāpi jāyaṃte sarvasiddhayaḥ|| kautukāttvāṃ hi mṛgyaṃti vidvāṃso buddhiśālinaḥ|| 41|| nātha tvatpādasalilaṃ saṃśrayāttāpahārakam|| tāpatrayābhibhūtasya bhaktiṃ me'tra dṛḍhāṃ kuru|| 42|| ananyasvāmino me'dya nāstyanyatprārthanīyakam|| praṇipatya jagannātha tvāṃ prayāce sahasradhā ||43 || samastapuruṣārthasya bījaṃ tvatpādapaṃkaje || yāvatprāṇāndhārayāmi tāvadbhaktirdṛḍhāstu me ||44 || sṛṣṭiṃ vinirmame cemāṃ yayā bhaktyā pitāmahaḥ || saṃharatyakhilaṃ rudro lakṣmīścaiśvaryadāyinī || 45|| dīnānukaṃpiṃstāṃ bhaktiṃ prārthaye nānyamānasaḥ || anādya vidyāpaṃkesminsudṛḍhe dustaraṃ bhṛśam || 46 || nimagnasya jagannātha nirālaṃbaṃ praṇaśyataḥ || mahāmahimnastvadbhakternānyadasti parāyaṇam || 47 || śrutismṛtyādisaṃbhinnamārgāḥ saṃmohahetavaḥ || tvadbhaktimapahāryete na pravarttitumīśvarāḥ || 48 || ananyaśaraṇaṃ svāminnanukampaya māṃ vibho || iti stuvañjagannāthapādapadmāṃtike mudā || 49 || papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau prasīdeti vadanmuhuḥ || tataste devatāḥ sarve stutvā saṃpūjya keśavam || 2.2.5.50 || tallīlāpāṃgasaṃtuṣṭāḥ prayātāstridivaṃ punaḥ || tata unmīlitadṛśau puṇḍarīkāṃbarīṣakau || 51 || māyayā mohitau viṣṇoḥ svapnadṛṣṭamabudhyatām || yāṃ dṛṣṭvā divyalīlāṃ hi sākṣātpalalacakṣuṣā || 52 || punarmānuṣabhāvau tau divyasiṃhāsanasthitam || nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ phullapadmāyatekṣaṇam || 53 || śoṇādharaṃ cārunāsaṃ divyakuṇḍalabhūṣitam || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ vanamālinam || 54 || pīnoraskaṃ cāruhāramanarghyamukuṭojjvalam || śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ divyāṃgadavibhūṣitam || 55 || pralaṃbabāhuṃ dīnārtaparitrāṇasamudyatam || suvarṇasūtrasaṃnaddha madhyagraṃthimaṇīyutam || 56 || divya pītāṃbaradharaṃ divyasraggandhabhūṣitam || svarṇapadmāsanāsīnaṃ sarvāṃgāliṃgitaśriyam || 57 || prapannasaṃtāpaharaṃ sudhāsāgaramulbaṇam || aśeṣavāṃchāphaladaṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ supuṣpitam || 58 || dakṣapārśvasthitaṃ tasya dadṛśāte halāyudham || bibhartti yena brahmāṃḍaṃ balena mahatā vibhuḥ || 59 || | taṃ balaṃ nāgarājānaṃ phaṇāsaptakamaṃḍitam || kailāsaśikharottuṃga dhavalaṃ kuṇḍalojjvalam || 2.2.5.60 || vicitravanamālāḍhyaṃ divyanīlanicolinam || satataṃ vāruṇīkṣība ghūrṇonnayanapaṃkajam || 61 || nimnapṛṣṭhonnatoraskaṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtavigraham || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmasamujjvalacaturbhujam || 62 || nānālaṃkāraruciraṃ natakalmaṣanāśanam || tayormadhye sthitāṃ bhadrāṃ subhadrāṃ kuṃkumāruṇām || 63 || sarvalāvaṇyavasatiṃ sarvadeva namaskṛtām || lakṣmīṃ lakṣmīśahṛdayapaṃkajasthāṃ pṛthaksthitām || 64 || varābjadhāriṇīṃ devīṃ divyanepathyabhūṣaṇām || prapannakalpalatikāṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśinīn || 65 || saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ tāriṇīṃ devatāraṇīm || vāmapārśvasthitaṃ viṣṇoradrāṣṭāṃ cakramuttamam || 66 || dārvagranirmitaṃ viprāḥ svarṇabhaktisamujjvalam || caturddhāvasthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvā tau dvijabāhujau || 67 || aruṇodayavelāyāṃ śramaṃ sārthamamanyatām || saṃsmṛtya tāṃ svapnalīlāṃ vismayaṃ jagmatustadā || 68 || na dārupratimā ceyaṃ sākṣādbrahma prakāśate || sadogatānāṃ viprāṇāṃ vākyaṃ śraddadhatuśca tau || 69 || kvāvāṃ mahāpātakinau yātanākramabhāginau || kvedaṃ surasamākrāṃtasthitaṃ viṣṇoḥ pradarśanam || 2.2.5.70 || mūrkhayorāvayoraṣṭādaśavidyāpravīṇatā || yasmāttasmānna ca bhrāṃtirjñānaṃ tatsamavādinaḥ || 71 || yadūcurdāravaṃ brahma tīrtharājataṭe sthitam || vaṭamūle prakāśaṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā jaṃturvimucyate || 72 || tadevāyaṃ jagannāthaścaturddhā saṃvyavasthitaḥ|| kṣitau yadāvatarati catūrūpaḥ prakāśate|| 73|| tadāsya saṃnidhāvāvāṃ sthāsyāvaḥ prāṇadhāriṇau|| yāvannānyatra gacchāvaḥ kṣudrakāmaparāṅmukhau || 74 || iti niścitya munayo viṣṇau bhaktiparāyaṇau || nārāyaṇākhyaṃ satataṃ japantau muktimāgatau || || 75 || || jaiminiruvāca || || prasaṃgātkathitaṃ hyetadrahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam || śṛṇvaṃti ye tu caritaṃ puṇḍarīkāṃbarīṣayoḥ || 76 || satataṃ c kīrtayaṃtaśca mudā paramaya yutāḥ || vrajaṃti viṣṇunilayaṃ mudā paramayā yutāḥ || vrajaṃti viṣṇunilayaṃ te'pi nirddhūtakalmaṣāḥ || 77 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || ||
<2.2.6>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || kasmindeśe dvijaśreṣṭha tatkṣetraṃ puruṣottamam || yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāddārurūpī prakāśate || 1 || || jaimini ruvāca || || utkalonāma deśo'sti khyātaḥ paramapāvanaḥ || yatra tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ||2|| dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre sa tu deśaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || yatra sthitā vai puruṣāḥ sadācāranidarśanāḥ || 3 || vṛttādhyayanasaṃpannā yajvāno yatra bhūsurāḥ || sṛṣṭyādau kratavo vedā vedaśāstrapravartakāḥ ||4||| aṣṭādaśānāṃ vidyānāṃ nidhānaṃ saṃprakīrtitam || gṛhe gṛhe nivasati lakṣmīrnārāyaṇājñayā || 5 || lajjāśīlā vinītāśca ādhivyādhivivarjitāḥ || pitṛmātṛratāḥ satyavādino vaiṣṇavā janāḥ || 6 || na cātrāvaiṣṇavaḥ kaścinnāstiko vāpi vartate || sarve parahitāstatra na lubdhā na śaṭhāḥ khalāḥ || 7 || dīrghāyuṣastatra janāḥ striyaśca patidevatāḥ || suśīlā dharmaśīlāśca trapācāritrabhūṣitāḥ || 8 || rūpayauvanagarvāḍhyāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ || kulaśīlavayovṛttānurūpācāracaṃcavaḥ || 9 || svakarmaniratāstatra prajārakṣaṇadīkṣitāḥ || kṣatriyā dānaśauṃḍāśca śastraśāstraviśāradāḥ || 2.2.6.10 || yajaṃte kratubhiḥ sarve satataṃ bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ || dīpyaṃte cittayo yeṣāṃ yūpāḥ kāṃcanabhūṣitāḥ || 11 || yeṣāṃ gṛheṣvatithayaḥ kāmanādhikapūjitāḥ || vaiśyāśca kṛṣi vāṇijyagorakṣāvṛttisaṃsthitāḥ || 12 || devāngurūndvijānbhaktyā prīṇayaṃti dhanairapi || ekasya dvāri yāto'rthī na gacchedanyaveśmani || 13 || gītakāvyakalāśilpakuśalāḥ priyavādinaḥ || śūdrāśca dhārmikāstatra snānadānakriyāratāḥ || 14 || karmaṇā manasā vācā dhanaiśca dvijasevakāḥ || ye'nye saṃkarajātāste svesve dharme pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 15 || na viparyaṃti ṛtavo nākāle varṣate ghanaḥ || na sasyahānirna marutkṣunna pīḍayati prajāḥ || 16 || durbhikṣamarake nātra rāṣṭrabhaṃgaḥ prajāyate || nālabhyaṃ tatra vastvasti yatkiṃcitpṛthivīgatam || 17 || evaṃ sarvaguṇairyukto nānādrumalatākulaḥ || arjunāśokapunnāga tālahiṃtālaśālakaiḥ || 18 || prācīnāmalakairlodhrairbakulairnāgakeśaraiḥ || nārikelaiḥ priyālaiśca saralairdevadārubhiḥ || || 19 || dhavaiśca khadirairbilvaiḥ panasaiśca kapitthakaiḥ || caṃpakaiḥ karṇikāraiśca kovidāraiḥ sapāṭalaiḥ || 2.2.6.20 || kadaṃbaniṃbanicuralarasālāmalakaistathā || nāgaraṃgaiśca jaṃbīrairnīpakairmātuluṃgakaiḥ || 21 || maṃdāraiḥ pārijātaiśca nyagrodhāgurucaṃdanaiḥ || kharjūrāmrātakaiḥ siddhairmucukuṃdaiḥ sakiṃśukaiḥ || 22 || tiṃdukaiḥ saptaparṇaiśca aśvatthaiśca bibhītakaiḥ || anyaiśca vividhairvṛkṣaiḥ prakīrṇaḥ sumanoharaiḥ || 23 || mālatīkuṃdabāṇaiśca karavīraiḥ sitetaraiḥ || ketakīvanaṣaṃḍaiśca atimuktaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ || 24 || elālavaṃgakaṃkoladāḍimairbījapūrakaiḥ || śreṇīkṛtaiḥ pūgavanairudyānaiḥ śataśo vṛtaḥ || 25 || nānādrumalatākīrṇaḥ parvataiḥ siṃdhurbhirvṛtaḥ || sa eṣa deśapravara utkalākhyo dvijottamāḥ || 26 || ṛṣikulyāṃ samāsādya dakṣiṇodadhigāminīm || svarṇarekhāmahānadyormadhye deśaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 27 || santyatra puṇyāyatane kṣetrāṇi subahūnyapi || pūrvaṃ vastīrthayātrāyāṃ varṇitāni mayā dvijāḥ || bhūsvargaḥ sāṃprataṃ hyeṣa kathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 28 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmya oḍhradeśavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<2.2.7>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || kasminyuge sa tu nṛpa indradyumno'bhavanmune || kasmindeśe'sya nagaraṃ kathaṃ vā puruṣottamam || || 1 || gatvā ca viṣṇoḥ pratimāṃ kārayāmāsa vā katham || etatsarvaṃ vistarataḥ kathayasva mahāmune || 2 || yāthātathyena sarvajña paraṃ kautṛhalaṃ hi naḥ || 3 || || jaiminiruvāca || || sādhu sādhu dvijaśreṣṭhā yatpṛcchadhvaṃ purātanam || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham || || 4 || caritaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi tathāvṛttaṃ kṛte yuge || śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve sāvadhānā jitendriyāḥ || 5 || āsītkṛtayuge viprā indradyumno mahā nṛpaḥ || sūryavaṃśe sa dharmātmā sraṣṭuḥ paṃcamapūruṣaḥ || 6 || satyavādī sadācāro'vadātaḥ sāttvikāgraṇīḥ || nyāyātsadā pālayati prajāḥ svā iva sa prajāḥ || 7 || adhyātmavijjñānaśauṃḍaḥ śūraḥ saṃgrāmavarddhanaḥ || sadodyataḥ sadā viprapūjakaḥ pitṛbhaktimān || 8 || aṣṭādaśasu vidyāsu bṛhaspatirivāparaḥ || aiśvaryeṇa surādhīśaḥ kuberaḥ koṣasaṃcaye || 9 || rūpavānsubhagaḥ śīlī dātā bhoktā priyaṃvadaḥ || yaṣṭā samastayajñānāṃ brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ || 2.2.7.10 || vallabho naranārīṇāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī || āditya iva duṣprekṣyaḥ śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 11 || vaiṣṇavaḥ satya saṃpanno jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || rājasūyaṃ kratuvaraṃ vājimedhasahasrakam || 12 || iyāja paramaḥ śrīmānmumukṣurdharmatatparaḥ || evaṃ sarvaguṇopetaḥ sa pṛthvīṃ pālayannṛpaḥ || 13 || avaṃtīṃnāma nagarīṃ mālave bhuvi viśrutām || uvāsa sarvaratnāḍhyāṃ dvitīyāmamarāvatīm || 14 || tatra sthito narapatirviṣṇau bhaktimanuttamām || cakāra manasā vācā karmaṇā paramādbhutām || 15 || evaṃ pravartamāno'sau kadācicchrīpatervibhoḥ || pūjāsamayamāsādya devārcanagṛhāṃtare || 16 || vidvadbhiḥ kavibhiścaiva tīrthayātrāprasiddhibhiḥ || daivajñaiḥ śrotriyaiḥ sārddhaṃ purohitamavasthitam || 17 || ādṛto vyājahāreda jñāyatāṃ kṣetramuttamam || yatra sākṣājjagannāthaṃ paśyāmo'nena cakṣuṣā || 18 || evamukto nṛpāgryeṇa vaiṣṇavena purohitaḥ || tīrthayātṛvrajaṃ paśyannuvāca praśritaṃ vacaḥ || 19 || bhobhostīrthāṭanavyagrā dhārmikāstīrthakovidāḥ || yadādiśati devo'yaṃ yuṣmābhistacchrutaṃ kila || 2.2.7.20 || vijñāya tasyābhiprāyaṃ kaścitsubahutīrthagaḥ || uvāca vāggmī rājānaṃ baddhāṃjalipuṭaṃ mudā ||21|| rājannanekatīrthāni vyacāriṣamahaṃ prabho || āśaiśavātkṣititale śrutānyanyaistu yāni vai || 22 || oḍhradeśa iti khyāto varṣe bhāratasaṃjñite || dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 23 || yatra nīlagirirnāma samaṃtātkānanāvṛtaḥ|| tasyotsaṃge kalpavṛkṣaḥ samaṃtātkrośasaṃmitaḥ || 24 || tasya chāyāṃ samākramya brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || tasya paścāddiśi khyātaṃ kuṃḍaṃ rauhiṇasaṃjñitam || || 25 || tatpūrṇaṃ kāraṇāṃbhobhiḥ sparśanādeva muktidam || tasya prāktaṭamāsthāya nīleṃdramaṇinirmitā || 26 || tanuḥ śrīvāsudevasya sākṣānmuktipradāyinī || tatra kuṃḍe tu yaḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā tu puruṣottamam || 27 || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpya vimucyate || tatrāsta āśramaśreṣṭhaḥ khyātaḥ śabaradīpakaḥ || 28 || paścimasyāṃ diśi vibhorveṣṭitaḥ śabarālayaiḥ || yasmādekapadīmārgo yena viṣṇvālayaṃ vrajet || 29 || yatra sākṣājjagannāthaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || jaṃtūnāṃ darśanānmuktiṃ yo dadāti kṛpānidhiḥ || 2.2.7.30 || tatroṣitaṃ mayā rājanvarṣaṃ śrīpuruṣottame || tuṣṭyarthaṃ devadevasya vratinā vanavāsinā || 31 || pratirātraṃ bhagavato darśanāya divaukasām || āgatānāṃ mahārāja divyagaṃdho hyamānuṣaḥ || 32 || nānāstutivacaḥkalpapuṣpavṛṣṭiśca labhyate|| mahimaiṣa na kutrāpi viṣṇoḥ sthāne prakāśate || 33 || paurāṇikī pravṛttiśca śrutā tatra mahīpate || vāyaso mādhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā tiryagdeho'pi mucyate || 34 || nādhikārī puṇyakṛtye jñānahīno'pi pārthiva || tṛṣārtto rauhiṇe kuṃḍe jalaṃ pātuṃ samāgataḥ || 35 || tyaktvā kālavaśātprāṇānviṣṇusārūpyamāptavān || ahamāsaṃ purā mūrkhastatprasādāttu sāṃpratam || 36 || aṣṭādaśasu vidyāsu śeṣo vā syānmamāparaḥ || matiśca nirmalā jātā viṣṇoḥ paśyāmi nāparam || 37 || tvaṃ yasmādviṣṇubhakto'si satataṃ ca dṛḍhavrataḥ || atastavopadeśārthamāgato'haṃ tavāṃtikam || 38 || no dhanaṃ na ca bhūmiṃ ca tvattaḥ saṃprārthyate'dhunā || vyalīkametanmā buddhvā tatrasthaṃ śrīdharaṃ bhaja || 39 || evamuktvā tu jaṭilaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā || aṃtarddhānaṃ jagāmāśu rājā paramavismayam || 2.2.7.40 || avāpya vyākulamatiḥ kathaṃ me nirvahediti || purohitamuvācedaṃ tasyaivārthasya sādhane || 41 || || indradyumna uvāca || || amānuṣamidaṃ vṛttaṃ śrutvedānīmamānuṣāt || buddhistvarayate tatra yatrāste'sau gadādharaḥ || 42 || mama dharmārthakāmā hi tvadāyattā dvijottama || aviruddhāstvatprasādāttrivargaḥ sādhito mayā || 43 || idānīṃ ceddvijaśreṣṭha tvamatrārthe gamiṣyasi || caturvargastu saṃpūrṇaḥ prāptaḥ syātsāṃprataṃ mayā || 44 || || purohita uvāca || || bāḍhametatkariṣyāmi yathā drakṣyasi keśavam || varmācchāditacakṣurbhyāṃ sākṣānmuktipradaṃ vibhum || 45 || evamatra yatiṣyāmi tatra sarve yathā vayam || vatsyāmaḥ sasahāyāśca kṣetre śrīpuruṣottame ||46|| sāphalyaṃ kimato rājañjanmino janmano bhavet || puruṣaṃ tamasaḥ pāraṃ sākṣāddrakṣyasi mādhavam || 47 || bhrātā vidyāpatirnāma kanīyānme vrajiṣyati || deśabhramaṇaśīlaiśca cāraiḥ saha tavādhunā || 48 || tatra gatvā jagannāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa hi girau yathā || kaṃṭakāvāsasaṃsthānaṃ bhūpradeśaṃ pramīya ca || || 49 || tūrṇaṃ pravṛttimānetā śreyo'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā punaruvāca ha || 2.2.7.50 || || indradyumna uvāca || || sādhu brahmansamādhāya vyavasāyo vicāritaḥ || ahaṃ prathamatopyetacchrutvaiva kṛtaniścayaḥ || 51 || tatra kṣetre bhagavataḥ sannidhau nivasāmyaham || tadgacchatu tava bhrātā yatheṣṭaṃ sādhayiṣyati || 52 || ityuktvāṃtaḥpuraṃ rājā praviveśa mudānvitaḥ || purohito'pi tānsarvānyathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ||53|| rājājñayā pūjayitvā prāhiṇotsvaṃ svamāśramam || bhrātaraṃ sumuhūrte ca daivajñakṛtaniścaye || 54 || prasthāpayāmāsa tadā kṛtasvastyayanaṃ dvijaiḥ || apasarpaiḥ pratyayikaiḥ puṣpasyandanamāsthitaḥ || 55 || tataḥ saṃprasthito viprāḥ sa tu vidyāpatirdvijaḥ || manasā cintayāmāsa madhye syandanamāsthitaḥ || 56 || aho me saphalaṃ janma sukalyā śarvarī ca me || drakṣyāmi yadbhagavato mukhapadmamaghāpaham || 57 || śravaṇādyairupāyairyaṃ yatamānā aharniśam || paśyaṃti yatayaḥ cetaḥ puṃḍarīke vyavasthitam || 58 || tamadya nīlaśikhariśṛṃgasthaṃ bibhrataṃ vapuḥ || vapuḥsaṃbandhaharaṇaṃ sākṣāddrakṣyāmi cakriṇam || 59 || śruti smṛtīhāsapurāṇavākyairyadrūpamāsthāpayituṃ na śakyam || tacchrīnidhe rūpamadṛṣṭapūrvaṃ dṛṣṭvā tariṣyāmi bhavāṃburāśim || 2.2.7.60 || yannāmasaṃkīrtanatastrivāṃhaḥ saṃghaḥ praṇāśaṃ smaratāṃ prayāti || tamadya viśveśvaramaprameyaṃ sākṣātkariṣyāmi girau vasantam || 61 || yatpādapadmānanusaṃhitasya padepade duḥkhamupārjitasya || tamaḥ prakāṃḍaprabhavaṃ kadācinnātmāśritaṃ karmabhireti nāśam || 62 || ārādhya sūkṣmaṃ svaguhānivāsaṃ yaṃ pañcakoṣāvṛtamātmasaṃstham || vedāṃtagīrāha na cāpi veda vaṃde svavidyaikanivedyamādyam || 63 || brahmāṃḍamālākalitānuromaṃ sahasramūrddhāṃghridṛśaṃ purāṇam || niḥśvāsavātotthita vedarāśiṃ sarvaprapaṃceśamahaṃ prapadye || 64 || yanmāyayā nirmitakūṭametatsṛṣṭikṣayasthānavilāsi rūpam || nirūpitāropitaheyarūpasvarūpahīnaṃ praṇavasvarūpam || 65 || tiryaktṛṣāśāṃtinimittato'pi yadṛcchayā yatsavidhaṃ prayātaḥ || dehena tenaiva sarūpamuktimavāpa taṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ kariṣye || 66 || aho aho me khalu bhāgyaśaṃsī yatkoṭijanmārjitapuṇya ekaḥ || samutthito me khalu carmadṛgbhyāṃ vilokayiṣye jagadādikaṃdam || 67 || itthaṃ saṃcintayanvipraḥ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || atītaṃ bahumadhvānaṃ nābudhyadrathavegataḥ || 68 || dinamadhye vyatikrāṃte laṃbite bahuvāsare || vartmanyadṛśyatāgre tu deśo bhuvanamaṃḍanaḥ || 69 || oḍhrasaṃjñastu bho viprāḥ kṣitimaṃḍalapāvanaḥ || itthaṃ paśyanvanāṃtāni giridurgāśca mārgagān || sūryāstamanavelāyāṃ mahānadyāstaṭe'bhavat || 2.2.7.70 || avaruhya rathādvipraḥ kṛtvā cāhnikamādṛtaḥ || upāsya paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ dadhyau sa madhusūdanam|| 71 || rathapṛṣṭhe sthito rātriṃ gamayitvā tvarānvitaḥ || mahānadīṃ samuttīrya prātaḥkṛtyaṃ samāpya saḥ || 72 || ciṃtayanneva goviṃdaṃ pratasthe rathamāsthitaḥ || paśyanbhagavato mārgaṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ hi yajvanām || 73 || vahnivarcasvināṃ viprā grāmānpūgairalaṃkṛtān || vilaṃghyaikāmrakavanaṃ yāvadāyāti sa dvijaḥ || 74 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇo dadṛśe janān || janmāṃtaritamātmānaṃ bubudhe divyarūpiṇam || 75 || avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca || harṣāśrupūrṇanayano nānyatkiṃcidapaśyata || 76 || kevalaṃ manasā viṣṇuṃ paśyanbāhye ca bho dvijāḥ || evaṃ vrajanyadā vipro dhyāyanpaśyanstuvanharim || 77 || apaśyatkānanākīrṇaṃ kalpanyagrodhabhūṣitam || nīlācalaṃ likhaṃtaṃ khaṃ paśyatāṃ pāpanāśanam || 78 || atyadbhutaṃ nivasaṃti sākṣāttanubhṛto hareḥ|| upatyakāyāmārūḍhaḥ samaṃtānmārgayandvijaḥ||79|| mārgaṃ na lebhe vipro'sau mukuṃdālokanotsukaḥ|| asupyata tato bhūmau kuśānāstīrya vāgyataḥ||2.2.7.80|| darśane tasya devasya tameva śaraṇaṃ yayau|| tataḥ śuśrāva vacanaṃ gireḥ paścādamānuṣam||81|| bhagavadbhaktiviṣayaṃ saṃlāpaṃ kurvatāṃ mithaḥ|| tato vidyāpatirhṛṣṭo'nusaraṃstaṃ jagāma vai||82|| dadarśa śabarāgārairveṣṭitaṃ parito dvijāḥ|| kṣetrasya dīpasaṃsthānaṃ khyātaṃ śabaradīpakam||83|| tatra gatvā śanairvipraḥ praviśya vinayānvitaḥ|| dadarśa viṣṇubhaktāṃstāñchaṃkhacakragadādharān||84|| praṇamya śirasā viprastasthau baddhāṃjalistadā || tatoviśvāvasurnāma śabaraḥ palitāṃgakaḥ || 85 || avasāya hareḥ pūjāṃ pūjāśeṣopaśobhitaḥ || saṃprāpto girimadhyāttu tasminneva kṣaṇe dvijāḥ||86|| ālokya taṃ dvijo harṣamupayāto vyaciṃtayat|| eṣa prāpto hareḥ sthānācchrāṃto nirmālyabhūṣitaḥ||87|| vaiṣṇavāgrya ito vārtāṃ viṣṇoḥ prāpsyāmi durlabhām|| ciṃtayanneva vipro'sau śabareṇābhyabhāṣata||88|| ||śabara uvāca|| kutaḥ samāgato vipra kānanāṃtaṃ sudustaram|| kṣuttṛḍbhiratiśrāṃtaśca sukhamatrāsyatāṃ ciram||89|| pādyamāsanamarghaṃ ca dattvā viśvāvasurdvijam|| uvāca praśrayagirā prastutaṃ pratipādayan|| 2.2.7.90 || phalaiḥ pākena vā vipra prāṇayātrā bhavettava || yattubhyaṃ rocate tadvai dīyate'tra mayā dvija || 91 || bhāgyaṃ mamādya bhagavañjīvitaṃ saphalaṃ ca me || prāpto'si madgṛhaṃ vipra sākṣādviṣṇurivāparaḥ || 92 || iti bruvāṇaṃ śabaraṃ provāca dvijapuṃgavaḥ || na me phalairna pākena kāryaṃ vaiṣṇavapuṃgava || 93 || yadarthamāgataṃ dūrātsādho tatsaphalaṃ kuru || indradyumnasya nṛpateravaṃtipuravāsinaḥ || 94 || purohito'haṃ saṃprāpto viṣṇordarśanalālasaḥ || rājñāgre tairthikānāṃ hi samājāvasare śrutam || 95 || tīrthakṣetraprasaṃgena kenacitprastutaṃ tadā || tathā niveditaṃ kṣetraṃ rājāgre jaṭilena vai || 96 || ānupūrvyācca tatsarvaṃ kathayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ || etadarthamahaṃ sādho rājñā cotkaṇṭhitena vai || 97 || preṣito'haṃ hariṃ draṣṭumatrasthaṃ nīlamādhavam || dṛṣṭvā yāvannarapatervārttāṃ neṣyāmi so'pyaham || 98 || nirāhāro dhruvaṃ sādho tanmāṃ viṣṇuṃ pradarśaya || 99 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || ||
<2.2.8>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ityuktastena vipreṇa śabaraściṃtayākulaḥ || asmākamupajīvyo'sau rahasyastho janārdanaḥ || 1 || upasthitaṃ no durdaivaṃ yena syātsārvalaukikaḥ || na darśayāmi cedvipraṃ śāpaṃ me'sau pradāsyati || 2 || sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇo mānyo viśeṣādatithistvayam || yasminviphalakāme tu dvau lokau viphalau mama || 3 || evaṃ vicārayanviśvāvasuḥ śabarapuṃgavaḥ || janapravādaṃ sasmāra purāṇaṃ śabarālaye || 4 || asminnaṃtarhite deve bhūmyaṃtarlīnamādhave || indradyumno narapatiḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ || 5 || manuṣyavapuṣā yo vai brahmalokaṃ vrajedapi || so'sminprajābhirāgatya vājimedhaśatena
