ca || 6 || iṣṭvā dārumayaṃ viṣṇuṃ caturddhā sthāpayiṣyati || asya cedbhāgyamutpannaṃ brāhmaṇasyātitherbhṛśam || 7 || aṃtarddhānaṃ bhagavataḥ sannidhānamatho bhavet || tadenaṃ darśayiṣyāmi nīleṃdramaṇimacyutam || 8 || na pauruṣeyaṃ kasyāpi kartavye devanirmite || itthaṃ vicārya manasā śabaraśca punaḥpunaḥ || 9 || uvāca vipraṃ purato dhyāyaṃtaṃ viṣṇumavyayam || 2.2.8.10 || || śabara uvāca || || asmābhiḥ pūrvato'pyeṣa udaṃtaḥ śruta eva hi || iṃdradyumno narapatiratra vāsaṃ kariṣyati || 11 || tato'pi bhāgyavāṃstvaṃ hi yadagre nīlamādhavam || cakṣuṣā paśyase brahmannehi yāmo hyadhityakām || 12 || ityuktvā taṃ kare dhṛtvā vartmanā gahanaṃ yayau || uparyuparyupāruhya śilāviṣamavartmani || 13 || ekaikanaragamye ca kaṃṭakācitadurgame || tamaḥprāye pathi gataṃ bodhayanvacasā dvijam || 14 || muhūrtābhyāṃ rauhiṇasya kuṃḍasyāviśatāṃ taṭe || taṃ dṛṣṭvā so'bravīdvipraṃ kuṃḍametaddvijottama || 15 || rauhiṇākhyaṃ mahattīrthaṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvapāthasām || atra snātvā naro yāti vaikuṃṭhabhavanaṃ dvija || 16 || etasya pūrvabhāge'so kalpacchāyāvaṭo mahān || chāyāṃ yasya samākramya brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 17 || etayoraṃtare brahmannikuṃjābhyaṃtare sthitam || paśya sākṣājagannāthaṃ vedāṃtapratipāditam || 18 || dṛṣṭvā jahīhi sakalaṃ vividhaṃ pāpasaṃcayam || ita ūrdhvaṃ na śocasva patito bhavasāgare || 19 || || || jaiminiruvāca || || sa tu kuṃḍe dvijaḥ snātvā saṃpradṛṣṭamanāḥ sudhī || dūrātpraṇamya śirasā manasā vacasā harim || 2.2.8.20 || tuṣṭāva caikāgramanā harṣagadgadayā girā || 21 || || vidyāpatiruvāca || || pradhānapuruṣātīta sarvavyāpinparātpara || carācaraparīṇāma paramārtha namo'stu te || || 22 || śrutismṛtipurāṇetihāsa saṃpratipāditaiḥ || karmabhistvaṃ samārādhya eka eva jagatpate || 23 || tvatta etajjagatsarvaṃ sṛṣṭau saṃpadyate vibho || tvadādhāramidaṃ deva tvayaiva paripālyate || 24 || kalpāṃte saṃhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tvatkukṣau sāvakāśakam || sukhaṃ vasati sarvātmannaṃtaryāminnamo'stu te || 25 || namaste devadevāya trayīrūpāya te namaḥ || caṃdrasūryādirupeṇa jagadbhāsayate sadā || 26 || sarvatīrthamayī gaṃgā yasya pādābjasaṃgamāt || punāti sakalām̐llokāṃstasmai pāvayate namaḥ || 27 || havīṃṣi maṃtrapūtāni samyagdattāni vahniṣu || pariṇāmakṛte tubhyaṃ .jagajjīvayate namaḥ || 28 || yadaṃśamupajīvaṃti jagaṃtyānaṃdarūpiṇaḥ || sarvakalmaṣahīnāya tasmai brahmātmane namaḥ || 29 || nirmalāya svarūpāya śubharūpāya māyine || sarvasaṃgavihīnāya namaste viśvasākṣiṇe || 2.2.8.30 || bahupādākṣiśīrṣāsyabāhave sarvajiṣṇave || sarvajīvasvarūpāya namaste sarvarūpiṇe || 31 || namaste kamalākāṃta namaste kamalāsana || namaḥ kamalapatrākṣa trāhi māṃ puruṣottama || 32 || asārasaṃsāraparibhrameṇa nipīḍyamānaṃ khalu rogaśokaiḥ || māmuddharāsmādbhavaduḥkhajātātpādābjayoste śaraṇaṃ prapannam || 33 || || jaiminiruvāca || || iti stutvā sureśānaṃ devaṃ praṇavarūpiṇam || praṇataḥ praṇavaṃ maṃtraṃ jajāpa purato hareḥ || 34 || japāṃte śāṃtamanasaṃ kṛtāṃjalimupasthitam || manyamānaṃ kṛtārthaṃ svaṃ provāca śabaro dvijam || 35 || || viśvāvasuruvāca || || kṛtārthastvaṃ prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā sāṃprataṃ dvijapuṃgava || dināṃto'bhūdgṛhaṃ yāvaḥ kṣudhito'si śramānvitaḥ || 36 || vāso'pyaraṇye hiṃsrāṇāṃ nāsmākamucitā sthitiḥ || yāvadbhānorbhāti bhāsastāvadyāmo nijālayam || 37 || ityuktvā brāhmaṇaṃ pāṇau gṛhītvā śabaraḥ punaḥ || ājagāma dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ svāśramaṃ tvarayānvitaḥ || 38 || brāhmaṇo'pi jagannāthaṃ dhyāyannānaṃdasāgaram || kṣuttṛṣāśramajātāni duḥkhāni bubudhe na hi || 39 || śilāviṣamamārge'pi kaṃṭakotkaradurgame || vrajanna duḥkhaṃ lebhe'sau śarīrānāsthayā mudā || 2.2.8.40 || evaṃ vrajaṃtau tau vipra śabarau śabarālayam || sāyāhne tamanuprāptau vaiṣṇavāgryau tu bho dvijāḥ || 41 || tatrātithimanuprāptaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śabarottamaḥ || bhakṣyabhojya vidhānaiśca vividhaiḥ samapūjayat || 42 || tato'bhitṛptastaddattairupacārairnṛpocitaiḥ || vismayaṃ paramaṃ lebhe śabarasya sudurlabhaiḥ || 43 || śabaro'yaṃ nivasati viṣame kānanāṃtare || āraṇyakairvarttamānaḥ kathamasya gṛhāṃtare || 44 || rājārhabhakṣyabhojyāni sulabhānyadbhutaṃ mahat || iti vismayamāpannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śabarastadā || 45 || provāca snigdhavacasā vinayāvanato bhṛśam || 46 || || śabara uvāca || || bho vipra śramahīno'si kaccitkṣuttṛḍvivarjitaḥ || āraṇyakānāṃ bhavane nāgarāṇāṃ kutaḥ sukham || 47 || ajñātā nāgarī vṛttiḥ śabaraistu viśeṣataḥ || rājopajīvināṃ śreṣṭhau rājāmātyapurohitau || 48 || tayo rājasamaḥ pūjyaḥ purodhāḥ śāstrasaṃmataḥ || indradyumno narapatiḥ sārvabhaumaḥ pratāpavān || 49 || tvayi tuṣṭe sa saṃtuṣṭo dhruvaṃ vipra bhaviṣyati || ityuktavatyaraṇyasthe sa tu prītataro dvijaḥ || uvāca śabaraṃ prītyā vinayādbhutavādinam || 2.2.8.50 || || vidyāpatiruvāca || || sādho madupacārāya hṛtānyetāni yāni te || vastunyamānuṣāṇīha yānyadṛṣṭāni rājabhiḥ || 51 || citrametaddivyavastusaṃcayaḥ śabarālaye || etatkhyātuṃ kautukaṃ me sādho saṃvarddhate mahat || 52 || || śabara uvāca || || etatprakāśituṃ vipra matirnotsahate mama || tathāpi te dvijaśreṣṭhā'tithibhaktyā vadāmyaham || 53 || śakrādayo devagaṇāḥ samāyāntyanvahaṃ dvija || divyopacārānādāya pūjanāya jagatpateḥ || 54 || pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ stutvā natvā ca bhaktitaḥ || gītaśavāditranṛtyaiśca saṃtoṣya puruṣottamam || 55 || punaḥ prayāṃti satataṃ tridivaṃ surasattamāḥ || divyānyetāni vastūni nirmālyāni jagatpateḥ || 56 || dattāni tubhyaṃ viduṣe kathaṃ vismayate bhavān || viṣṇornirmālyabhogena kṣīṇarogajarā vayam || 57 || saputrabāṃdhavāḥ sarve nivasāmo'yutāyuṣaḥ || viṣṇunirmālyabhogena kṣīyate pāpasaṃhatiḥ || 58 || na taccitraṃ dvijaśreṣṭha yena syānmuktibhājanam || śrutvaitaddurlabhaṃ karma brāhmaṇo romaharṣaṇaḥ || 59 || ānaṃdāśruviluptākṣaḥ svaṃ kṛtārthamamanyata || aho śabarajanmāsau paśyatyavyayamīśvaram || 2.2.8.60 || taducchiṣṭaṃ divyabhogamupabhuṃkte divāniśam || nānyo'sya sadṛśo loke pṛthivyāṃ sacarācare || 61 || yādṛśo viṣṇubhakto'yaṃ śabaro nīlaparvate || kiṃ gatvā svagṛhe me'dya kuṭuṃbenā'sukhātmanā || 62 || anena sakhyaṃ niṣpādya sthāsyāmyatra vanāṃtare || cintayitvā ciraṃ vipraḥ śrīkṛṣṇāsaktamānasaḥ || 63 || punaḥ provāca śabaraṃ mayi te cedanugrahaḥ || sādho sakhyaṃ tvayā kāryamiti me niścayo mahān || 64 || kiṃ gatvā sevayā rājñaḥ paratrāsukhahetunā || atra sthitvā tvayā sārdhamupāsya madhusūdanam || 65 || yathā punardehabaṃdho yatiṣye na bhavenmama || sādhu mitra tvayā sārddhaṃ bhāgyānme saṃgamo'bhavat || 66 || dustāraṃ bhavasaṃsāraṃ tariṣye tvatprasādataḥ || sārametatpraśaṃsaṃti saṃsāre bhavasāgare || 67 || yadvaiṣṇavena mitratvaṃ duḥkhasaṃsārapāradam || mitrasya sahavāsena punaḥ pratyakṣameṣyati || 68 || bhagavānpuṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || iṃdradyumno narapatirmayi pratyāgate sakhe || 69 || bhagavaṃtaṃ samārāddhumihaiva sa nivatsyati || prāsādaṃ vipulaṃ cātra cikīrṣurbhagavatpriyam || 2.2.8.70 || sahasramupacārāṇāṃ pūjanāya jagatpateḥ || racayiṣyāmīti mahatpratijñāsīnmahīpateḥ || 71 || pratiśrutaṃ tatpurataḥ prītastanme'numanyatām || 72 || || || śabara uvāca || || sakhe purātanī vārttā prasiddhaivātra tādṛśī || 73 || tvayā yathaiva kathitaṃ indradyumnasamāgamaḥ || kevalaṃ mādhavaṃ tatra na drakṣyati mahīpatiḥ || 74 || acirādeva bhagavānsvarṇavālukayāvṛtaḥ || pratijajñe yamāyaitadantarddhānaṃ gamiṣyati || 75 || mahābhāgyaparīpākātpratyakṣo'yaṃ tvayā kṛtaḥ || indradyumnāgamābhyāse dhruvaṃ sa vyavadhāsyati || 76 || eṣo'rthastu tvayā mitra na vaktavyo nṛpāgrataḥ || āgatya so'tra nṛpatiradṛṣṭvā parameśvaram || 77 || prāyopaveśavratavānsvapne dṛṣṭvā gadādharam || tadādeśāddārumayaṃ prabhorliṃgacatuṣṭayam || 78 || pūjayiṣyati bhaktyā ca pratiṣṭhāya svayaṃbhuvā || sthitiratra hareryāvadāvayorvaṃśasaṃsthitiḥ || 79 || anugrahādbhagavato nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || tadatrārthe sakhe khedaṃ mā vraja kṣiprameva hi || 2.2.8.80 || nirvartsyate'cirādeva mitredānīṃ sukhaṃ svapa || prātardṛṣṭvā punardevaṃ nīlendrāśmamayaṃ vibhum || 81 || siṃdhau snātvā tasya taṭe nivāsāya mahīpateḥ || drakṣyāmaḥ sādhu saṃsthānaṃ yathābhilaṣitaṃ sakhe || 82 || ityanyāśca kathāḥ puṇyāḥ kṛtvā tau ca parasparam || śubhasthāne cāsvapatāṃ śayane pallavāstṛte || 83 || prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ tīrtharājodakena tau || snānaṃ nirvartya vidhivanmādhavaṃ praṇipatya ca || 84 || rājārhasthānaṃ nirṇīya nivāsāya gatau punaḥ || tatra mitreṇābhimantrya rājño nirdeśakāraṇāt || 85 || rathamāruhya vipraḥ sa tvavaṃtīpuramāyayau || 86 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<2.2.9>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || pratyāgate tato vipre sāyāhne surasaṃkule || mādhavārcanavelāyāṃ vātaścaṃḍagatirvavau || 1 || suvarṇavālukāścāsau vicakāra ca sarvaśaḥ || tenākuladṛśo devā na śekuravalokane || 2 || śrīkāṃtasya tadā viprā dadhyuste puruṣottamam || yāvaddhyānasthiradṛśo muhūrtaṃ te divaukasaḥ || 3 || dhyānāṃte vālukārāśiṃ dadṛśuste na mādhavam || rauhiṇaṃ ca tathā kuṃḍaṃ babhūvurvyākulendriyāḥ || 4 || ciṃtāmavāpurmahatīṃ hāheti rurudurbhṛśam || kimetanno hi durdaivamekadā samupasthitam || 5 || dṛśāṃ secanakaḥ śrīśaḥ kṣaṇādyannopalabhyate || aparādhaṃ kimasmākaṃ lakṣitaṃ puruṣottama || 6 || yugapatsevakānsarvānapahāya na dṛśyase || yeṣāmarthe jagannātha svīcakartha kalevaram || 7 || tānanāthānparityajya kānane kimupekṣase || svaśarīravibhūtīrno vihāya kamalekṣaṇa || 8 || kimakāṃḍaṃ racayasi kathāśeṣāndivaukasaḥ || tavāṃśabhūtānnaḥ sarvānyajvānaḥ prayajaṃti vai || 9 || tvatprītyai yajñapuruṣa tvadādiṣṭaphalapradān|| tvadahaṃkāravarṣmāṇastvadanugrahajīvanāḥ || 2.2.9.10 || kāṃdiśīkā kutra yāmaḥ sāṃprataṃ tvadupekṣitāḥ|| divi sthānaiśca kiṃ kāryaṃ tvāmanālokya mādhava || 11 || akṛtārthāstvayā hīnā bhaviṣyāmo vanecarāḥ || niṣkalaṃkasudhābhānuṃ suṣamāparibhāvukam || 12 || tvadāsyaṃ cenna paśyāmo na yāsyāmaḥ surālayam || tapa āsthāya paramamatraiva saṃśitavratāḥ || 13 || vartāmahe vanyavṛttyā jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇaḥ || yāvattvāṃ puṃḍarīkākṣa vilokiṣyāmahe vayam || 14 || nisargakaruṇāṃbhodhe dīnānnastrātumarhasi || anāthāndīnahadayāṃstvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatān || 15 || tvadanālokaśokaikapārāvāre nimajjataḥ || śubhadṛṣṭitaraṇyā naḥ samuddhara jagatpate || 16 || evaṃ pralapatāṃ tatra sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām || aśarīrā tadā vāṇī punaḥ prādurbabhūva ha || 17 || atrārthe bhoḥ surā yatnaṃ kartumarhatha no vṛthā || adyaprabhṛti devasya darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ bhuvi || 18 || atra sthāne'pi taṃ natvā taddarśanaphalaṃ labhet || svayaṃbhuvoṃ'tikaṃ gatvā hetuṃ jñāsyatha niścitam || 19 || tacchrutvā tridaśāḥ sarve brahmaṇoṃ'tikamāgatāḥ || yamānugrahavṛttāṃtamavatāraṃ ca dāruṇaḥ || 2.2.9.20 || śrutvā saṃtuṣṭamanasaḥ sarve te tridivaṃ gatāḥ || sa tu vidyāpatirvipro rathārūḍho'bhyaciṃtayat || 21 || mama kāryaṃ tu niṣpannaṃ yaddṛṣṭo nīlamādhavaḥ || āsamaṃtātkṣetramidaṃ paribhramyāvalokaye || 22 || adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ paramaṃ supuṇyaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ yasya malāpahāri || kṣetrottamaṃ śrīpuruṣottamākhyaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vrajāmi tūrṇam || 23 || pṛthvīpradakṣiṇaphalaṃ śatadhā bhajaṃte paryaṃti ye sakalakalmaṣadāryaraṇyam || nīlādrimaṇḍimidaṃ purupottamākhyaṃ mitraṃ mamopadiśati sma samudratīre || 24 || viciṃtyetthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ paribabhrāma vai tadā || kṣetraṃ paśyanvanaṃ caiva nānādrumagaṇānvitam || 25 || nānāpakṣigaṇāghuṣṭaṃ kūjadbhramaraguṃphitam || apraviṣṭārkakiraṇaṃ chāyātarugaṇāvṛtam || 26 || sarvartukusumopetaṃ latāgulmopaśobhitam|| nānājalāśayādhārakūjatsārasasaṃkulam|| 27 || padmakahlārakumudavikacotpalarājitam || na jalaṃ tatra kusumaparihīnaṃ latādikam || 28 || parītya vegāttatkṣetraṃ jagāmātha dvijottamaḥ || dhyāyanniraśanaḥ prājñaḥ prāpyāvantīṃ dinātyaye || 29 || dūtairāveditaṃ pūrvaṃ dūrasthasyāgataṃ dvijāḥ || śrutveṃdradyumno nṛpatiḥ praharṣaṃ paramaṃ yayau|| 2.2.9.30 || tadāgamanamākāṃkṣanpūjayitvā janārddanam|| vidvadbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ tasthau saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 31 || etasminnaṃtare viprāḥ sa tu vidyāpatirdvijaḥ|| prāveśikairvetrahastairdauvārikapuraḥsaraiḥ||32|| nirdiṣṭamārgaḥ pauraiścā'numataḥ kautukānvitaiḥ|| nirmālyamālāṃ nīlākhya mādhavasya suśobhanām||33|| nidhāya pāṇau rājāgre praviveśa tvarānvitaḥ|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpatiḥ so'tha samutthāya varāsanāt || prasīda jagadīśeti vadannaṃtikamabhyagāt || 34 || adya me jīvitaṃ jātaṃ saphalaṃ janmakarmaṇā || nirmālyamālāvapuṣaṃ yatpaśyāmīhamādhavam || 35 || mālāṃ mukundaśiraso'nupamapramodalābhādharīkṛtasuradrumakāṃtagandhām || andhīkṛtālinicayāṃ pavanaprasārigandhapraṇāśitajagatkaluṣāṃ namāmi || 36 || yatpādapaṃkajagaladrajasonuṣaṃgā brahmādayaḥ paramasaṃpadamāpurasya || viṣṇoḥ kalevarasamujjvalitāṃgarāgasaṃsaktapuṣpanilayāṃ praṇatosmi mālām || 37 || padmāṃ hṛtpadmavasatiṃ sapatnīṃ yā hasatyasau || vikasvaraiḥ sukusumairviṣṇvaṃkasthitirgarvitām || 38 || kutra sthiteyamāhārṣīnmahimānaṃ sragujvalā || yā śrīnidheḥ śarīre''bhūtsarvāṃgavyāpinī ciram || 39 || jaya nīlādriśikharabhūṣaṇāghapradṣaṇa || praṇatārttihara śrīmaṃstrāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 2.2.9.40 || iti bruvāṇaḥ kṣitipo bāṣpagadgadayā girā || jagāma śirasā bhūmiṃ sphuradromāṃcakaṃcukaḥ || 41 || so'pi vidyāpatirvipraḥ kṣapitāśeṣakalmaṣaḥ || divyadeho nṛpasyāgre dhyāyanmādhavamāsthitaḥ || 42 || tejasā sarvalokānāṃ pāpāni kṣālayansudhīḥ || anugṛhṇātu devastvāṃ nīlādriśikharālayaḥ || 43 || śrīpateriyamājñā te mālārūpā prakāśitā || draṣṭuṃ kṣetrottamagataṃ svaṃ sākṣānmuktidāyakam || || 44 || ityuccarannarapaterāmumoca gale srajam || so'pyutthāya kṣitipatirmālāṃ hṛdayalaṃbinīm || 45 || dṛṣṭvā mene śriyaḥ kāṃtaṃ sākṣāddhṛdayagāminam || nidhāya pāṇī śirasi daramīlitalocanaḥ || 46 || ānaṃdāśrujalaklinnavadanastuṣṭuve harim || 47 || || indradyumna uvāca || || jayākhilajagatsṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāraśilpakṛt || līlāviśvavapurlomasaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍabhārabhṛt || 48 || aṃtaryāminnaśeṣāṇāṃ praṇatārtihara prabho || brahmeṃdra rudramukuṭakirmīritapadāṃbuja || 49 || dīnānāthavipannaikasatatatrāṇatatpara || nirvyājakaruṇāvāripārāvāra parātpara || 2.2.9.50 || tvadekaśaraṇaṃ dīnamanādibhramanirbharam || paritrāhi jagannātha bhaktāviratavatsala || 51 || iti stuvannarapatiḥ svāsane samupāviśat || gṛhamedhibrahmacāriyativaikhānasairvṛtaḥ || || 52 || aṣṭādaśasu vidyāsu kuśalairyajvabhirdvijaiḥ || mīnaiḥ sthavirabhṛtyaiśca sārddhaṃ maṃtripuraḥsaraiḥ || 53 || vidyāpati pūjayitvā bahumānapuraḥsaram || upaveśyāgrataḥ pīṭhe pṛṣṭvā kuśalamāditaḥ || 54 || puruṣottamakṣetrasya viṣṇornīlāśmavarṣmaṇaḥ || mahimānaṃ svarūpaṃ ca papracchāvahito mudā || 55 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyeṇāsau pṛṣṭonubhavamātmanaḥ || bhilladvīpapraveśādimajjanāṃtaṃ saritpateḥ || 56 || kṣetrottamasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa vistarāt || nīlādrirohaṇaṃ nīlamādhavasya ca darśanam || 57 || snānaṃ ca rauhiṇe kuṇḍe mahimānaṃ vaṭasya ca || nṛsiṃhādyaṣṭaśaṃbhūna śaktīnāmaṣṭasaṃsthitim || 58 || rathenākramaṇāddṛṣṭau kṣetrasyāyāmavistarau || tatsarvaṃ varṇayāmāsa yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 59 || tacchrutvā citramatulaṃ tairthikāveditaṃ purā || saṃpratīto hṛṣṭamanāḥ punastaṃ kṣitipo'bravīt || 2.2.9.60 || || indradyumna uvāca || || śrutapūrvaṃ tu bhagavaṃstvatto'śrauṣaṃ sudurlabham | | kṣetrottamaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha sāṃprataṃ varṇayasva me || 61 || nīlendramaṇimūrtestu viṣṇo rūpaṃ yathātatham || || vidyāpatiruvāca || || haṃta te kathayiṣyāmi divyāṃ mūrtiṃ jagatpateḥ || 62 || yāṃ carmacakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā jāyate muktibhājanam || nīlendramaṇipāṣāṇamayī mūrtiḥ purātanī || 63 || yānvahaṃ brahmarudreṃdrapurogairarcitā suraiḥ || āropiteyaṃ divyā srakpūjāyāṃ hi suparvabhiḥ || 64 || seyaṃ na mlāyati nṛpa na ca gandhena ricyate || dine bahutithe yāte'pīdṛśī sragdharodbhavā || 65 || divyopahāraḥ nirmālyabhakṣaṇātkṣīṇakalmaṣam || māṃ na paśyasi kiṃ rājannatimānuṣavarcasam || 66 || sakṛdapyaśanādyasya kṣutpipāsābalakṣayāḥ || na bādhante nṛpaśreṣṭha dṛṣṭenādṛṣṭakalpanam || 67 || bhuktirmuktiśca vai rājann tatra yugapatsthite || na jarārogaśokādiduḥkhaṃ tatra hi vidyate || 68 || yatra sākṣājjagannāthaḥ prasannavadano vibhuḥ || phulleṃdīvarapatrākṣaḥ prapannāmṛtamuktidaḥ || 69 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekaśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīpuruṣottamamāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<2.2.10>
|| indradyumna uvāca || || janmaprabhṛti tatra tvaṃ na prayāto dvijottama || kathaṃ vidyādbhavāndivyavṛttāṃtaṃ puruṣottame || 1 || || vidyāpatiruvāca || || tatra sthito'haṃ sāyāhne bhagavaṃtamupāgamam || tasminkāle divyagandho vavau ca śiśiro marut || 2 || udyataḥ saṃkulaḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate sma viyatpathe || kramādyāhi prayāhīti sa tu varṇamayaḥ svanaḥ || 3 || diviṣṭhānāṃ patatpuṣpavṛṣṭyācchāditaparvataḥ || samāgamo'bhūtsānnidhye vaikuṃṭhasya mahīpate || 4 || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgānāṃ carcarīṇāṃ ca niḥsvanaḥ || abhūtapūrvastatrāsīddivyagānavimiśritaḥ || 5 || sahasramupacārāṇāṃ prītaye parameśituḥ || devaiḥ samarpitaṃ tatra manuṣyādṛṣṭapūrvakam || 6 || saṃpūjya vidhivaddevaṃ karamātropalakṣitāḥ || jayapūrvaiśca taṃ stotraiḥ saṃtoṣya madhusūdanam || 7 || yathāgataṃ te tridaśāḥ prayayustridaśālayam || teṣu yāteṣu śabaraḥ sakhā viśvāvasurmama || 8 || divyopahārabhojyāni mālyaṃ cedaṃ dadau mama || anarghyametadamlānaṃ śrīrājyasukhadāyakam || 9 || alakṣmīpāparakṣoghnaṃ yogyaṃ tenāhṛtaṃ mayā || śṛṇuṣva tasya saṃsthānaṃ viṣṇoryatkṣetramuttamam || 2.2.10.10 || apūrvaśilpanaipuṇyaṃ rūpaṃ cāsya manoharam || na bhūmijanmanā puṃsā śakyate gadituṃ hi tat ||1 1|| tadbhāgyapauruṣābhyāṃ tallakṣitaṃ kathayāmi te || samaṃtādgahanākīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ nīlādrinābhikam || 12 || āyāmavistṛtibhyāṃ ca vikhyātaṃ krośapaṃcakam || tīrtharājasya velāyāṃ svarṇavālukayāvṛtam || 13 || adreḥ śṛṃge mahānuccaḥ kalpasthāyī vaṭo mahān || krośāyataḥ puṣpaphalavarjitaḥ pallavojjvalaḥ || 14 || sūryāpakramaṇe tasya chāyāṃ nāpakrameta vai || tasya paścātpradeśe hi kuṃḍaṃ rohiṇasaṃjñakam || 15 || jalodgamānnīladṛṣadārohaṇavibhūṣitam || bahiḥ sphaṭikavedībhiścaturdikṣu parīvṛtam || 16 || aghasaṃghātahārībhiradbhiḥ pūrṇaṃ manoramam || tatpūrvavedikāmadhye nyagrodhacchāyaśītale || 17 || indranīlamayo deva āste cakragadādharaḥ || ekāśītyaṃgulamitaḥ svarṇapadmopari sthitaḥ || 18 || aṣṭamīcandraśakalaśobhāvijayibhālabhūḥ || smereṃdīvarayugmaśrīdhikkārodyatalocanaḥ || 19 || ānanāmṛtabhānūdyatsaṃtāpatrayamocanaḥ || nāsāpuṭadvayodbhāsitilapuṣpapraśobhanaḥ || 2.2.10.20 || vapuṣo'śmamayatve'pi susmitasrapitādharaḥ || hāsasaṃphullagaṃḍābhyāṃ ruciraṃ cibukaṃ hanuḥ || 21 || ananyapūrvaghaṭitaṃ sṛkkiṇīyugamaṃjasā|| hāsanimnādharau gaṃḍau cibukaṃ sṛkkiṇī śubhe || 22 || vahannidarśanaṃ devo viśvakarmādiśilpinām || makarāsyakarṇabhūṣāśobhiśrutiyugena saḥ || 23 || gurubhārgavayormadhye pūrṇacaṃdropahāsakaḥ || graivayaśobhājanakakaṃṭhadeśena paśyatām || 24 || dakṣiṇāvarttaśaṃkhasya muktājanmābhiśaṃkakṛt || pīnāyataskaṃdhayugajānudīrghacaturbhujaḥ || 25 || svacchanirmalahāropaśobhakoraḥsthalo vibhuḥ || dhatte caturdaśajagaddivyakaustubhabiṃbitam || 26 || nimnanābhihradāviṣṭatanuromālimaṃjulaḥ || hāraṃ trivalimadhyena sthāṇutvapariṇāmakaḥ || 27 || suratnamekhalādāmnā kiṃkiṇīmauktikasrajā || jagallāvaṇyapuṭake sphicau devasya śobhataḥ || 28 || jaghanālaṃvimuktāsrakpītacailopaśobhitam || jaṃghāstaṃbhayugaṃ mokṣamāṃgalyatoraṇāśrayam || 29 || vṛttānupūrvajānubhyāṃ mālayā prapadīnayā || ratnāḍhyavalayābhyāṃ ca śobhete caraṇau vibhoḥ || 2.2.10.30 || hārakaṃkaṇakeyūra mukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtam || jñānāhaṃkārakaiśvaryaśabdabrahmaṇi keśavaḥ || 31 || cakrapadmagadāśaṃkhapariṇāmāni dhārayan || sarvāśādyotako devo nīlādrerupari sthitaḥ || 32 || bhaktyā praṇamya dṛṣṭvā yaṃ dehabaṃdhātpramucyate || vāmapārśvagatā lakṣmīrāśliṣṭā padmapāṇinā || 33 || vallakīvādanaparā bhagavanmukhalocanā || sarvalāvaṇyavasatiḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā || 34 || tāvapaśyaṃ hi jagataḥ pitarāvacalasthitau || tūṣṇīṃbhūtau smeradṛśā'nugṛhṇaṃtau ca paśyataḥ || 35 || sajīvau tāvabudhaṃ bho dīnānugrahakāraṇāt || chatrībhūtaphaṇāvṛṃdaḥ śeṣaḥ paścādavasthitaḥ || 36 || agre vyavasthitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vapurbibhratsudarśanam || kṛtāṃjalipuṭaṃ tasya paścādgaruḍamāsthitam || 37 || evamadbhutarūpaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sākṣācchriyaḥ patim || cetorajjubhirākṛṣṭamiva tatraiva dhāvati || 38 || anekajanmasāhasraiḥ sukarmāṇyarjitāni cet || yugapatparipakvāni yasyāsau taṃ hi paśyati || 39 || tīrthasnānatapodānadevayajñavratairapi || nālamālokituṃ martyastādṛśaṃ puruṣottamam || 2.2.10.40 || ye nīlamūrtiṃ vimalāṃbarābhaṃ dhyāyaṃti viṣṇuṃ puruṣottamastham || te kṣīṇabaṃdhāḥ praviśaṃti viṣṇoḥ puraṃ hi yatprāpya na śocatīha || 41 || vidyābhiraṣṭādaśabhiḥ praṇītaṃ nānāvidhaṃ karmaphalaṃ nṛṇāṃ yat || ekatra tatsarvamamuṣya viṣṇoḥ saṃdarśanasyaiti śatāṃśamānam || 42 || kimatra vācyaṃ tvadhikaṃ kṣitīṃdra puṃso matiryāvadupaiti kāmān || labheta nīlādripatiṃ praṇamya tato'dhikaṃkṣetrabhuvo mahimnā || 43 || sa eva dātā kratubhiḥ sa yaṣṭā satyapravaktā sa tu dharmaśīlaḥ || sarvairguṇaiḥ sarvabhavairvariṣṭho nīlādrināthaḥ khalu yena dṛṣṭaḥ || 44 || tatra ye sevakāḥ saṃti mādhavasya jagatpateḥ || tebhyaḥ sakāśānmāhātmyamidaṃ jñātaṃ mayā nṛpa || 45 || tasminparaṃparāyātamādisṛṣṭeḥ purātanam || prasiddhamidamākhyānaṃ śrutvā tatrāgato hyaham || 46 || tvadājñayā tatra gatvā dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam || niveditaṃ te rājeṃdra yathecchasi tathā kuru || 47 || || iṃdradyumna uvāca || || āptavākyādbhagavataḥ śrutvā rūpamaghāpaham || kṛtakṛtyo'smi bhagavandivyanirmālyasaṃgamāt || 48 || bahujanmasvarjitāni kṣīṇāni duritāni me || adhikārī tvahaṃ jāto darśane śrīpateriha || 49 || sarvātmanāhaṃ yāsyāmi rājyena susamṛddhinā || tatrāvāsaṃ kariṣyāmi puradurgāṇi caiva hi || 2.2.10.50 || kratunā hayamedhena yakṣye prītyai muradviṣaḥ || śatopacāraiḥ śrīnāthaṃ pūjayiṣye dinedine || 51 || vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ prīṇayiṣye jagadgurum || vākyāmṛtena saṃtaptaṃ yathā māmabhiṣekṣyati || 52 || dīnānukaṃpī bhagavānsākṣānnārāyaṇo vibhuḥ || evaṃ sa śraddhayā bhaktyā saṃstute yāvadīśvaram || 53 || nāradastatra saṃprāpto bhuvanālokakautukī || tamāyāṃtamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā vaiṣṇavāgryaṃ vidheḥ sutam || 54 || āśaśaṃsa svakāryasya siddhiṃ narapatistadā || utthāya sahasā viprāḥ pādyārghyācamanīyakaiḥ || varāsanasthaṃ praṇataḥ provācedaṃ kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 55 || || indradyumna uvāca || || adya me saphalā yajñā dānamadhyayanaṃ tapaḥ || 56 || yanme gṛhaṃ samāgacchaddvitīyā brahmaṇastanuḥ || kṛtārtho yadyapi mune āgamānugrahāttava || 57 || tathāpi tvatprasādāya kimājñāṃ karavāṇi te || kiṃ prayojanamuddiśya bhavanaṃ me pavitritam || 58 || || jaiminiruvāca || || tacchrutvā nṛpatervākyaṃ bhaktipraśrayakomalam || uvāca brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ smitapūrvaṃ mahīpatim || 59 || || || nārada uvāca || || iṃdradyumna nṛpaśreṣṭha vimalaistvadguṇotkaraiḥ || prīṇitā devatāḥ siddhā munayo brahmaṇā saha || 2.2.10.60 || svapratiṣṭhā pṛthagyogyā guṇā ekaikaśastava || brahmaṇaḥ sadane sthityai paryāptāstu samīhitāḥ || 61 || avatīrṇo naraṃ draṣṭuṃ tiṣṭhaṃtaṃ badarāśrame || taddhyānāvasare jñāto vyavasāyastavedṛśaḥ || 62 || sādhu vyavasitaṃ rājanyābhūtte buddhirīdṛśī || sahasrajanmasvabhyāsādbhaktirbhavati bhūpate || 63 || nīlācalaguhāvāse mādhave jagatāṃ dhave || pitāmaho mahāprājño yamārādhya jagatpatim || 64 || vinirmame sṛṣṭimimāṃ lebhe paitāmahaṃ padam || tadanvayaprasūto'si yuktā te bhaktirīdṛśī || ||65|| caturvargaphalā bhaktirviṣṇau nālpatapaḥphalam || anādyavidyā sudṛḍhapañcakleśavivarddhinī ||66|| ekaiveyaṃ viṣṇubhaktistaducchedāya jāyate || bhavāraṇye pratipadaṃ duḥkhasaṃkaṭasaṃkule | 67 || narāṇāṃ bhramatāṃ viṣṇubhaktirekā sukhapradā || nirālaye dvaṃdvavātaprodyatesminsudustare ||68|| nimagnānāṃ bhavāṃbhodhau viṣṇubhaktistariḥ smṛtā || āśrityaikāṃ bhagavatīṃ viṣṇubhaktiṃ tu mātaram || 69 || santaḥ santuṣṭamanaso na tu śocanti jātucit || viṣṇubhaktisudhāpānasaṃhṛṣṭānāṃ mahātmanām ||2.2.10.70|| brāhmyaṃ padaṃ svalpalābho bhājanānāṃ vimuktaye || trividho yoṃ'hasā rāśiḥ sumahāñjanmināṃ nṛpa || 71 || viṣṇubhaktimahādāvavahnau sa śalabhāyate || prayāgagaṃgāpramukhatīrthāni ca tapāṃsi ca || 72 || aśvamedhaḥ kratuvaro dānāni sumahāṃti ca || vratopavāsaniyamāḥ sahasrāṇyarjitā api || 73 || samūha eṣāmekatra guṇitaḥ koṭikoṭibhiḥ || viṣṇubhakteḥ sahasrāṃśasamo'sau na hi kīrtitaḥ || || 74 || || jaiminiruvāca || || viṣṇubhaktestu māhātmyaṃ śrutvā brahmarṣiṇoditam || viṣṇubhakteḥ svarūpaṃ hi jñātukāmaḥ kṣitīśvaraḥ || 75 || nāradaṃ punarāhedaṃ vākyaṃ satkārayuktimān || 76 || | indradyumna uvāca || || mahimā viṣṇubhaktestu sādhu prokto mahāmune || tasyāḥ svarūpa jijñāsā cirānme hṛdi varttate || 77 || lakṣaṇaṃ varṇayedānīṃ bhaktervaiṣṇavapuṃgava || tvadanyo na hi vaktā syādvijñāto me mahītale || 78 || || nārada uvāca || || sādhu rājaṃstvayā pṛṣṭaṃ bhaktilakṣaṇamuttamam || kathayiṣye yathārthaṃ tvāṃ bhaktibhājanamuttamam || 79 || apātre na hi vācyeyaṃ nareṃ'dhe malināṃtare || śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanprocyamānāṃ mayānagha || 2.2.10.80 || sāmānyato viśeṣācca viṣṇorbhaktiṃ sanātanīm || atyantasukhasaṃprāptau vicchede duḥkhasaṃtateḥ || 81 || hetureko'yameveti saṃśrayādbhaktirucyate || tridhā sā guṇabhedena turīyā nirguṇā matā || 82 || kāmakrodhābhibhūtānāṃ dṛṣṭvā yānyaṃ na paśyatām || labdhaye cābhicārāya bhaktiḥ syānnṛpa tāmasī || 83 || yaśase cātiriktāya parasya sparddhayāpi vā || prasaṃgātparalokāya bhaktiḥ sā rājasī smṛtā || 84 || āmuṣmikaṃ sthirataraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvānvinaśvarān || paśyatāśramavarṇoktāndharmānnaiva jihāsatā || 85 || ātmajñānāya yā bhaktiḥ kriyate sā tu sāttvikī || jagaccedaṃ jagannātho nānyaṃ cāpi ca kāraṇam || 86 || ahaṃ ca na tato bhinno mattosau na pṛthaksthitaḥ || hīnaṃ bahirupādhīnāṃ premotkarṣeṇa bhāvanam || 87 || durlabhā bhaktiraiṣā hi muktaye'dvaitasaṃjñitā || sāttvikyā brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ rājasyā śakralokatām || 88 || prayāṃti bhuktvā bhogānhi tāmasyā pitṛlokatām || punarāgatya bhūrlokaṃ bhaktiṃ tāṃ vaiparītyataḥ || 89 || tāmaso rājasīṃ kuryādrājasaḥ sāttvikīṃ tathā || sāttviko muktimāpnoti kṛtvā cādvaitabhāvanām || 2.2.10.90 || ekāmapi samāśritya kramānmuktipathaṃ vrajet || viṣṇubhaktivihīnasya śrautasmārtāśca yāḥ kriyāḥ || 91 || prāyaścittādikaṃ tīrthaṃ yātrā kṛcchrādikaṃ tapaḥ || kule prasūtiḥ śilpāni sarvaṃ laukikabhūṣaṇam || 92 || kāyakleśaḥ phalaṃ teṣāṃ svairiṇī vyabhicāravat || kulācāravihīno'pi dṛḍhabhaktirjiteṃdriyaḥ || || 93 || praśasyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ na tvaṣṭādaśavidyakaḥ || bhaktihīno nṛpaśreṣṭha sajjātirddhārmikastathā || 94 || nālpabhāgyasya puṃso hi viṣṇau bhaktiḥ prajāyate || yāṃ tu saṃpādya yatnena kṛtakṛtyo na sīdati || 95 || yayā vetti jagannāthaṃ sā vidyā parikīrtitā || yena prīṇāti bhagavāṃstatkarmāśubhanāśanam || 96 || viṣṇubhaktaśca saṃproktastābhyāṃ yukto dṛḍhavrataḥ || yatpādapāṃsunā viśvaṃ pūyate sacarācaram || 97 || sṛṣṭisthitivināśānāṃ svecchayā prabhavatyasau || ki punaḥ kṣudrakāmānāṃ bhūmisvargādisaṃpadām || 98 || vāsudevasya bhaktasya na bhedo vidyate'nayoḥ || vāsudevasya ye bhaktāsteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam || 99 || praśāṃtacittāḥ sarveṣāṃ saumyāḥ kāmajiteṃdriyāḥ || karmaṇā manasā vācā paradrohamanicchavaḥ || || 2.2.10.100 || dayārdramanaso nityaṃ steyahiṃsāparāṅmukhāḥ || guṇeṣu parakāryeṣu pakṣapātamudānvitāḥ || 1 || sadācārāvadātāśca parotsavanijotsavāḥ || paśyāvaḥ sarvabhūtasthaṃ vāsudevamamatsarāḥ || 2 || dīnānukaṃpino nityaṃ bhṛśaṃ parahitaiṣiṇaḥ || rājopacārapūjāyāṃ lālanāḥ svakumāravat || 3 || kṛṣṇasarpādiva bhayaṃ bāhye paricaraṃti te || viṣayeṣvavivekānāṃ yā prītirupajāyate || 4 || vitanvate tu tāṃ prītiṃ śatakoṭiguṇāṃ harau || nityakartavyatābuddhyā yajaṃtaḥ śaṃkarādikān || 5 || viṣṇusvarūpāndhyāyaṃti bhaktyā pitṛgaṇeṣvapi || viṣṇoranyaṃ na paśyaṃti viṣṇuṃ nānyatpṛthaggatam || 6 || pārthakyaṃ na ca pārthakyaṃ samaṣṭivyaṣṭirūpiṇaḥ || jagannātha tavāsmīti dāsastvaṃ cāsmi no pṛthak || 7 || antaryāmī yadā devaḥ sarveṣāṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ || sevyo vā sevako vāpi tvatto nānyo'sti kaścana || 8 || iti bhāvanayā kṛtāvadhānāḥ praṇamaṃtaḥ satataṃ ca kīrttayaṃtaḥ || harimabjajavandyapādapadmaṃ prabhajaṃtastṛṇavajjagajjaneṣu || 9 || upakṛtikuśalā jagatsvajasraṃ parakuśalāni nijāni manyamānāḥ || api paraparibhāvane dayārdrāḥ śivamanasaḥ khalu vaiṣṇavāḥ prasiddhāḥ || 2.2.10.110 || dṛṣadi paradhane ca loṣṭakhaṃḍe paravanitāsu ca kūṭaśālmalīṣu || sakhiripusahajeṣu bandhuvarge samamatayaḥ khalu vaiṣṇavāḥ prasiddhāḥ || 13 || haricaraṇasarojayugmacittā jaḍimadhiyaḥ sukhaduḥkhasāmyarūpāḥ || apaciticaturā harau nijātmanatavacasaḥ khalu vaiṣṇavāḥ prasiddhāḥ || 14 || rathacaraṇagadābjaśaṃkhamudrākṛtitilakāṃkitabāhumūlamadhyāḥ || muraripucaraṇapraṇāmadhūlīdhṛtakavacāḥ khalu vaiṣṇavā jayaṃti || 15 || murajidapadhanāpakṛṣṭagandhottamatulasīdalamālyacaṃdanairye || varayitumiva muktimāptabhūṣākṛtirucirāḥ khalu vaiṣṇavā jayaṃti || 16 || vigalitamadamānaśuddhacittāḥ prasabhavinasyadahaṃkṛtipraśāṃtāḥ || naraharimamarāptabaṃdhumiṣṭvā kṣayitaśucaḥ khalu vaiṣṇavā jayaṃti || 17 || bhagavati satataṃ prabhaktibhājāṃ śubhacaritaṃ tava lakṣma nobhyadhāyi || śrutipathabhavatīrṇamāśu puṃsāṃ harati malaṃ cirasaṃcitaṃ yadetat || 16 || na hi dhanamapi mṛgyate kadācinna khalu śarīrajakhedasaṃprayogaḥ || mṛdulaghuvacasābhidhānakīrtiṃ bhajanamahaṃ tava dāsya eva ciṃtā || 19 || śubhacaritamapi dviṣaṃti puṃsāṃ svayamiha duścaritānubaṃdhacittāḥ || mahadakuśalamapyavāpya susthā bhagarasarasikā avaiṣṇavāste || 2.2.10.12 0 || paramasukhapadaṃ hṛdaṃbujasthaṃ kṣaṇamapi nānusajjaṃti mattabhāvāḥ || vitathavacanajālakairajasraṃ pidadhati nāma hareravaiṣṇavāste ||21|| parayuvatidhaneṣu nityalubdhāḥ kṛpaṇadhiyo nijakukṣibhārapūrṇāḥ|| niyataparamahattvamanyamānā narapaśavaḥ khalu viṣṇubhaktihīnāḥ ||22|| anavaratamanāryasaṃgaraktāḥ paraparibhāvakahiṃsakā'tiraudrāḥ || naraharicaraṇasmṛtau viraktā naramalināḥ khalu dūrato hi varjyāḥ || 123 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<2.2.11>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || nāradādbrahmaṇaḥ putrādbhagavadbhaktimuttamām || śrutvetthaṃ paramaprīta iṃdradyumno'pyuvāca tam || 1 || || iṃdradyumna uvāca || || sādhusaṃgastu vidvadbhirbhavavyādhivināśanaḥ || mamopadiṣṭo bhagavanso'bhūtsāṃpratameva me || || 2 || yena sākṣātkṛto viṣṇuḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ || sa tvaṃ yanmaṃdirāyātastvadanyaḥ sādhuratra kaḥ || 3 || tvatsaṃnidhānādbhagavastamo me nāśamabhyagāt || yanme tvarayate cittamarcituṃ nīlamādhavam || 4 || vetsi brahmāṃḍavṛttāṃtaṃ paryaṭansārvalaukikaḥ || tadāvāṃ rathamāsthāya paśyāvo nīlamādhavam || || 5 || puruṣottamasaṃjñasya kṣetrasyālaṃkṛtaṃ śubham || tatra tīrthāni saṃtīti bahubhiḥ kathitāni me || tvadvākyādyadi jānāmi bhaveyuḥ saphalāni me ||6|| || || nārada uvāca || || haṃta te darśayiṣyāmi kṣetraṃ kṣetrasthitāni ca || tīrthāni śaktiśaṃbhūṃśca kṣetramāhātmyameva ca || 7 || sākṣāddrakṣyasi deveśaṃ bhaktasyātmasamarpakam || tavānugrahataḥ śīghraṃ caturddhā saṃvyavasthitam||8|| yasya saṃdarśanānmartyo jāyate bhaktibhājanam || evaṃ kathāṃte tau prītāvahaḥkṛtyaṃ samāpya ca || 9 || yātrānukūlaṃ nirṇīya paṃcamyāṃ budhavāsare || jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇetare pakṣe puṣyarkṣe lagna uttame || ekatra śayitau rātriṃ ninyaturnṛpanāradau ||2.2.11.10|| tataḥ prabhāte vimala iṃdradyumno nṛpottamaḥ || ghoṣaṇāṃ kārayāmāsa rājyasya saha baṃdhubhiḥ || 11 || yathāvibhavataḥ sainyairnīlādrigamanaṃ prati || yāvajjīvaṃ tatra vāsaṃ kariṣyāmo viniścitam ||12|| yā vṛttiḥ kalpitā yasya sa tayā tatra jīvatu || rājānaḥ sāvarodhāśca sāmātyāḥ saparicchadāḥ || 13 || rathairgajaisturagaiśca koṣaiḥ saha padātibhiḥ ||14|| vrajaṃtu sajjitāstatra brāhmaṇāḥ sāgnihotriṇaḥ || vaṇijaḥ saha bhāṃḍaiśca sapaṇyāḥ paṇyajīvinaḥ|| 15 || rāṣṭrakarmaṇi niṣṇātā kuśalā rājavartmasu || jyotirvido nṛtyavido daṃḍanītau pravīṇakāḥ || 16 || nṛtyagāyanavāditracaturvidhasubuddhayaḥ || gajavājinarāṇāṃ ca bhaiṣajye śāstra uttame || 17 || kuśalā dṛṣṭakarmāṇo vidyāsvaṣṭādaśasvapi || upāṃgavidyāsu tathā kuhakārthakutūhalāḥ || 18 || vāṭasāhasikāścorāstathānye paśyatoharāḥ || vicitrakathanājīvāścāṭukārāśca māgadhāḥ || 19 || śāstropajīvinaścaiva tathānye śalyahārakāḥ || dyūtakārāśca puṃścalyo veśyā veśānugā viṭāḥ|| 2.2.11.20 || kṛṣīvalāśca gomepacchāgoṣṭrakhararakṣakāḥ || śakuṃtapālāśca kapivyāghraśārdūlarakṣakāḥ ||21|| āhituṃḍikagorakṣya śabarā mlecchajātayaḥ ||22|| anye ca ye mālavadeśajātā ājñāṃ madīyāmanupālayaṃti || te yāṃtu sarve vasatau hi nīlācale yathāsvaṃ kṛtavāstubhāgāḥ || 23 || evamājñāpya nṛpatiryātrāyāṃ ca kṛtakṣaṇaḥ || nāradena samāgamya daivajñamidamāha saḥ || 24 || sāṃvatsara muhūrttaṃ me nirṇītaṃ te yathā purā || tāvanmāṃgalikaṃ vastujātaṃ samyagupānaya || 25 || purohitamatenāsminkṣaṇe yāvadvimṛgyate || tenādiṣṭaḥ sa gaṇakaḥ purohitasahāyavān || || 26 || ājahāra samastāni māṃgalyāni dvijottamāḥ || atrāṃtare sa rājarṣirdivyasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ || 27 || yātrābhiṣekamāṃgalyaṃ vipraiḥ prāganubhāvitam || śrīsūktavahnisūktābhyāṃ sūktenābdaivatena ca || 28 || pāvamānyābdhisūktena pṛthaṅmāṃgalyavarddhakaiḥ || tīrthādbhirauṣadhībhiśca sarvagandhaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 29 || abhiṣiktastato rājā cīnāṃśukahṛtāṃbhasā || rarāja vapuṣā dīpto nirdhūmaḥ pāvako yathā || 2.2.11.30 || āmuktaśuklavasanaḥ svācāṃtaḥ sapavitrakaḥ || nāṃdīmukhānpitṛgaṇānpūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 31 || jayārāṣṭrabhṛto hutvā gaṇahomāṃśca yatnataḥ || śaṃkhadhvanisugaṃdhāḍhayaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ vidhūmakam || 32 || vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ cakre dakṣiṇāvarttagārciṣā || sākṣātkāreṇa dadataṃ jayaṃ rājñe jayārthine || 33 || navagrahamakhāṃte ca grahakuṃbhena sevitaḥ || gra hāṇāṃ dauṣṭyanāśāya sausthyasyāpi vivṛddhaye || 34 || jyotiḥśāstroditairmaṃtrairdaivajñavidhicoditaiḥ || tato māṃgalyanepathyavidhānamupacakrame ||35|| cīnāṃśukaprāvaraṇe vidhāya kavacaṃ nijam || śiroveṣṭanakaṃ śubhraṃ suratnamukuṭojjvalam|| 36 || sāvataṃse śrutiyuge ratnakuṃḍalabhūṣite || graiveyakaṃ mahārghaṃ tu hāraṃ taralabhūṣitam || 37 || dadhārātha nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ keyūrāṃgadamudrikāḥ || madhyena trivalīsaktaṃ svarṇasūtraṃ trivṛddadhau || 38 || hiraṇyakiṃkiṇīyukta muktātoraṇamālikam || nānāratnaiḥ sughaṭitāṃ dadhārātha sumekhalām || 39 || anarghye pādakaṭake pādayoḥ saṃnyaveśayat || sammukhādarśitādarśe dadṛśe svaṃ vibhūṣitam || 2.2.11.40 || maṃgalāropaṇārthāya haimapīṭhamupāviśat || prāṅmukhaḥ śrīdharaṃ devaṃ saṃsmaranmadhusūdanam || 41 || magalāyatanaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvamāṃgalyakāraṇama || smaraṇādasya naśyaṃti pātakāni bahūnyapi || 42 || saumanasyāmatho mālāmārttavīṃ gaṃdhavarṇitām || dadhāra prathamaṃ rājā maṃtritāṃ svapurodhasā || 43 || mṛdaṃ dīpaṃ phalaṃ dūrvā dadhi gorocanāṃ tataḥ || mantrābhimaṃtritānsarvānsiddhārthairabhirakṣitaḥ ||44|| ātmānaṃ dadṛśe rājā saurabheye haviṣyatha || mukure maṃtrite paścātsvaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpakesarī || 45 || bahvṛcaiḥ śāṃtighoṣeṇa samudīrṇaśubhāyatiḥ || yājuṣkaiḥ pathisūktena vrajanmārge'bhirakṣitaḥ || 46 || paurāṇairmaṃgalairvākyaiḥ kṛtavīryadhṛtirnṛpaḥ || māgadhaiḥ stutipāṭhena prādurbhūtaparākramaḥ || 47 || pārijātaharaṃ satyāsahitaṃ garuḍadhvajam|| dhyāyanhṛtpaṃkaje rājā dakṣiṇaṃ pādamuddadhau || 48 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya muniṃ nāradaṃ purataḥ sthitam || madhyadvāramupāgacchadvetrapāṇibhirāvṛtaḥ || || 49 || ādiṣṭapadamārgo'sāvagnihotrapuraḥsaraḥ || tatrāpaśyatsthitānviprānātmano dakṣiṇena vai || 2.2.11.50 || māṃgalyasūktaṃ' paṭhataḥ śubhrābhānpāṃḍurāṃśukān|| lājāḥ sapuṣpā rājāgre kṣipataḥ śaṃsataḥ śubham || 51 || vāmapārśvasthitā veśyāścāmaravyagrapāṇayaḥ || śubhrālaṃkāravasanāḥ smerapadmānanā śubhāḥ || 52 || brāhmaṇānpūjayāmāsa bhaktinamro dvijottamāḥ || vastrālaṃkāramālyaiśca sugandhairanulepanaiḥ || 53 || toṣayāmāsa tānviprānbhagavadbuddhi bhāvitān || veśyābhyo māgadhebhyaśca dīnānāthebhya eva ca || 84 || rājānumatyā sacivo yathārhaṃ pradadau dhanam || śvetānpārāvatānhaṃsāñchvetāśvaṃ śvetakuṃjaram || 55 || sacūtapallavaṃ śvetamālāphalavibhūṣitam || kadalīkāṃḍasannaddhatoraṇādhaḥ sthitaṃ nṛpaḥ || pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ sa paśyanvai maṃgalāni bahūnyapi|| sitātapatreṇa śiraḥpradeśe vāritātapaḥ ||56|| yugapatpūryamāṇaistu kaṃbubhiḥ śatasaṃkhyakeḥ|| saṃmiśritāni śuśrāva vāditrāṇi bahūni saḥ||57|| tathā maṃgalagītāni jayaśabdāṃśca bhūpatiḥ || tato viveśa prāsādaṃ nṛsiṃhamavalokitum||58|| yaṃ smṛtvā jāyate martyaḥ sarvakalyāṇabhājanam || dṛṣṭvā sa dūrānnṛhariṃ divyasiṃhāsanasthitam || 59 || praṇamya sāṣṭāvayavaṃ santoṣyopaniṣadgirā || dakṣapārśvasthitāṃ durgāṃ sarvadurgatimocinīm || 2.2.11.60 || vavaṃde caraṇābhyāśe paśyatīṃ kṛpayā nṛpaḥ || tataḥ purodhā devāṃgādavaropya śubhā srajam || 61 || āsañjayāmāma gale sugaṃdhenānvalepayat || nīrājayāmāsa rājñaḥ śiraścāveṣṭayanmudā || 52 || punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tau devau nṛpasattamaḥ || śibikāyāṃ samāropya pratasthe ca puraskṛtau || 63 || prādurbhūya bahirdvāre rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā susajjitam || turaṃgamairvātajavairdaśabhiḥ parayojitam || 64 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nṛpo nāradena samāviśat || ḍhakkāmṛdaṃganiḥsāṇabherīpaṇava gomukhāḥ || 65 || madhurīcarcarīśaṃkhā avādyaṃta sahasraśaḥ || syandanāḥ koṭiśastatra nṛpāṇāmanujīvinām || 66 || cakāśire śreṇikṛtā indradyumnarathābhitaḥ || nānāpraharaṇopetāḥ patākābhiralaṃkṛtāḥ || 67 || dhvajocchritāḥ svarṇaraupyaiḥ kiṃkiṇījāladarpaṇaiḥ || yantrairnānāvidhairyuktā gaṃbhīra snigdhaniḥsvanāḥ || 68 || padātīnāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām || pattisaṃsphoṭanairhastibṛṃhitairhayaheṣitaiḥ || 69 || bahulai rathanirghoṣairmiśritā vādyaniḥsvanāḥ || yugāṃtārṇavanisvānatulyāḥ śuśruvire janaiḥ || 2.2.11.70 || tasminkṣaṇe paurajanāḥ svasvasaṃbhārasajjitāḥ || aśvakai rāsabhairuṣṭrairvāhakaiḥ pratitasthire || 71 || āṃdolikāśca palyaṃkāḥ koṭiśaśca turaṃgakāḥ || śreṇībhūtāśca dṛśyaṃte rāṣṭraprasthānasaṃkule || 72 || rājāvarodhāḥ śataśo vṛtā varṣavaraistataḥ || nānāyānasamārūḍhāḥ pālitāścādhikāribhiḥ || 73 || mahāsainyaiśca saṃruddhā rājāgārādviniryayuḥ || yajvānaścāgnihotrāṇi śamyārūḍhāni vṛndaśaḥ || 74 || śakaṭeṣu samāropya sapatnīkāḥ pratasthire || tathā pustakabhārāṃśca devatārcākaraṃḍakān || 75 || idhmabarhikuśānpātrīḥ saṃbhārānhomasaṃbhṛtān || vāhayāmāsuranyaiśca śakaṭāvāhakadvijaiḥ || 76 || sāmantāmātyabhṛtyāśca purodhā ṛtvijaśca ye || rājñaḥ prakṛtada(?)sāśca upacāraniyoginaḥ || 77|| sarvopacārasaṃbhārānāsate'nye prayāyinaḥ || koṣāgāraniyuktāśca koṣajātamaśeṣataḥ || 78 || samādāya yayustūrṇaṃ rājño'vasarasevakāḥ || mālākārādayaḥ sarve paṇyajīvādayastathā || 79 || svaṃ svaṃ paṇyaṃ samādāya yayū rājaniyoginaḥ || śreṣṭhaśreṇyādayaḥ sarve purakharvaṭavāsibhiḥ || 2.2.11.80 || samaṃ viniryayuḥ svasvavyavahāravilāsakāḥ || indradyumnasya nṛpateryātrāsamayavāditān || 81 || bherīmṛdaṃgapaṭahānvyaśnuvānāndigaṃtaram || śrutvā janapadāvāsijanāḥ sarve sasaṃbhramāḥ || 82 || rājājñāṃ mūrdhni saṃmānya nirgatā nīlaparvatam || yasya yaśca ṛjuḥ paṃthāḥ sa ca tenaiva jagmivān || 83 || na rājamārgaṃ prajavādvyamṛgyaṃta nṛpājñayā || nīlādriprāptimārgeṇa durgameṇāpi te yayuḥ || 84 || indradyumno'pi rājendraḥ samastapuravāsibhiḥ || caturaṃgānīkinībhiḥ saharṣābhiśca veṣṭitaḥ || 85 || śreṇībhūtakṣitipatisyandanāvalimadhyage || rathe rarāja rājarṣiḥ śakratulya paricchadaḥ || 86 || purastrīmaṅgalācāragītalājaprasūnakaiḥ || maṅgalācāraśobhābhiḥ prasannaśubhacetanaḥ || 87 || vātaraṃhairhayairyuktarathena prayayau mudā || anukūlānilaprodyadghanacchāyasuśītale || 88 || nīrajaske mahīpṛṣṭhe samīkṛtacatuṣpathe || deśādhvanīnaiḥ puruṣaiḥ kānanāṃtaravedibhiḥ || 89 || ādiṣṭavartmā nṛpatirmārgasyobhayapārśvagān || deśānaraṇyāni muhuḥpaśyannānandalocanaḥ || 2.2.11.90 || sīmāmutkaladeśasya vibhajaṃtīṃ vanāṃtare || mārgasthāṃ carcikāṃ prāpa carcitāṃ muṃḍamālayā || 91 || avatīrya rathādrājā vinato nāradājñayā || sāṣṭāṃgapātaṃ tāṃ natvā tuṣṭāvānaṃdacetanaḥ ||92 || || indradyumna uvāca || || namaste tridaśeśāni sarvāpadvinivāriṇi || brahmaviṣṇuśivādyābhiḥ kalpanābhirudīrite ||93|| kāraṇaṃ jagatāmādye prasīda parameśvari || tvayā vinā jagannaitatkṣaṇamutsahate śive || 94 || siddhayaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ maṃgalāni ca śāśvate || tvatpādārādhanaphalaṃ martyaloke hi nānyathā ||95 || carācarapaterviṣṇoḥ śaktistvaṃ parameśvari || yayā sṛjatyavati ca jagatsaṃharate vibhuḥ || 96 || carācaraguruṃ devaṃ nīlācalanivāsinam || anugṛhṇīṣva māṃ devi yathā paśye svacakṣuṣā || 97 || || jaiminiruvāca || || nāradasyopadeśena stutvā devīṃ narādhipaḥ || āruroha rathaṃ tūrṇaṃ vivasvānudayaṃ yathā || 98 || tataḥ pratasthe tarasā sa rājā śrāṃtavāhanaḥ || citrotpalamahānadyāstīre viralakānane || 99 || dhātukandaravikhyāte nyaveśayadanīkinīm || aparāhṇakriyāṃ kartuṃ yāvadāhnikamādṛtaḥ ||2.2.11.1 00|| jalāvataraṇe nadyāṃ viveśa svapurodhasā || pūrvaṃ saṃśodhite prājñairviṣakaṇṭakavarjite ||1|| snātvā saṃtarpya devāṃśca pitṝnatha viśāṃpatiḥ || saṃpūjya vidhivadviṣṇuṃ nṛpatīnprakṛtīstataḥ || 2 || saṃmānayāmāsa nṛpaḥ saṃniveśāsanādibhiḥ|| nāradena saha śrīmānpraviśyāṃtaḥpuraṃ tataḥ||3|| sudhārasāni bhojyāni bubhuje prītamānasaḥ || paścimādriṃ tato yāte vivasvati viśāṃpatiḥ ||4|| sāyaṃ vidhiṃ samāpyāśu śītabhānau samudyate|| anujīviviśāṃ nāthaḥ sabhāmadhya upāviśat ||5|| tatra tasminnarapatirbabhau sātrājyalakṣaṇaḥ || saṃpūrṇamaṃḍalaścandro jyotiṣāmiva śāradaḥ||6|| kavayaḥ kavayāṃcakuḥ kīrtiṃ tasya sudhāmalām || jagurgāthāṃ sugrathitāṃ gāyakāḥ kalasusvarāḥ||7|| rūpayauvanalāvaṇyagarvitā gaṇikāstataḥ || layatānāṃgahāraiśca suśuddhairnanṛtuḥ puraḥ || 8 || māgadhāstuṣṭuvuścainaṃ lokottaraśubhākṛtim || gadyapadyaprabandhādyaiścitraiḥ padakadambakaiḥ || 9 || tataḥ sa rājā prānarca vaiṣṇavāgryānsabhāsadaḥ || susaṃmatairgaṃdhamālyatāṃbūlairatiśobhanaiḥ || 2.2.11.110 || nṛpāṃśca śataśastatra sukhāsīnānnṛpājñayā || saṃbhāvayāmāsa yathāyogyaṃ nṛpatibhājanaiḥ || 11 || athāpṛcchanmunivaraṃ nāradaṃ bhagavatpriyam || siṃhāsanārhe svāsīnaṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram || bhagavaccaritaṃ śrotuṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam || 12 || || indradyumna uvāca || || bhagavanvedavedāṃganidhāna bhagavatpriya || tvameva caritaṃ viṣṇorjānāsi jñānacakṣuṣā || 13 || hareścāritrasudhayā dṛḍhapaṃkamalīmasam || kṣālayāṃtarmama mune yadyanukrośako mayi || 14 || itthamālāpasaṃmiśre munirājñoḥ kathāṃtare || praviveśa nṛpaṃ dvāḥstha utkaleśaprasevakaḥ || 15 || uvāca devadvārāṃte tiṣṭhatyutkalabhūmipaḥ || sopāyano devapādapadmaṃ draṣṭuṃ samaulikaḥ || 16 || vijñāpitaḥ sa rājarṣi dvāsthenaivaṃ sasaṃbhramaḥ || uvāca taṃ hi bho viprāḥ śrutvā taddeśamaṇḍanam || 17 || kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣeśasya tadvārttākarṇanotsukaḥ || praveśayāvilaṃbaṃ taṃ śrīmadoḍhramahīpatim || 18 || sa hi nīlagirau viṣṇuṃ samārādhya sunirmalaḥ || yasya saṃdarśanātsarve bhaviṣyāmo hatāṃhasaḥ || 19 || śrutvā tadvacanaṃ sadyo dvārapālo mahīpatim || praveśayāmāsa sabhāmiṃdradyumnasya bhūpateḥ || 2.2.11.120 || viveśoḍhrapatistūrṇaṃ sacivaivairṣṇavaiḥ saha || nanāmāṃghriyugaṃ vandyamindradyumnasya sādaram|| 21 || yugaṃ vandyamindradyumnasya sādaram|| 21 || tamutthāpya ca rājeṃdraḥ puraskṛtya sa vaiṣṇavam || svāsanāṃte niveśyātha proce sapraśrayaṃ vacaḥ || 22 || rājansarvatra kuśalī bhavānoḍhrapate kila || api devo vijayate nīlādriśikharālayaḥ || 23 || kaccitte nirmalā buddhirbhagavatpādapadmayoḥ || upaiti samacittasya sarvabhūteṣu te harau || 24 || oḍhrādhīśastadā tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || uvāca praśritaṃ vākyaṃ harṣavismayacaṃcukaḥ || 25 || svāminsarvatra kuśalaṃ tvatpādānugrahānmama || sūrye tapatyaṃdhakāraḥ kathaṃ vā prabhaviṣyati || 26 || nisargaguṇasaṃsargavaśīkṛtamahībhujā || tvayā sanāthā pṛthivī jiṣṇunevāmarāvatī || 27 || sadā dharmaścatuṣpādastvayi śāsati medinīm || niṣedhācaraṇa rājankevalaṃ śrūyate śrutau || 28 || rājanītiṣu ye rājñāṃ guṇāḥ samuditāstvayi || ta ekaikaṃ kṣitibhujāṃ gatā dārṣṭāṃtikaṃ vibho || 29 || etāvadapi sāmrājyaṃ durlabhaṃ te nṛpottama || aṣṭādaśadvīpavatī kṣitirekagṛhopamā || 2.2.11.130 || yadi tvāṃ nāsṛjadbrahmā vatsalaṃ sarvajaṃtuṣu || kathaṃ śokavihīnāḥ syurmṛteṣvātmajabaṃdhuṣu || 31 || sādhāraṇā nṛpatayo viṣṇoraṃśā iti śrutiḥ || bhavānsākṣāttu bhagavānko'nya īdṛgguṇākaraḥ || 32 || dakṣiṇodadhi tīre'sti nīlādriḥ kānanāvṛtaḥ || na tatra lokasaṃcārastatrāste sā'pi devatā || 33 || vātyayā vālukākīrṇaḥ sāṃprataṃ śrūyate tu saḥ || tadvaśānmama rājye'pi durbhikṣamarakādikam || 34 || tvayyāgate tu sarvasminkuśalaṃ me bhaviṣyati || ityuktavaṃtaṃ nṛpatirutkaleśaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 35 || visarjayāmāsa tadā saṃniveśāya mānayan || nāradaṃ prekṣya nirviṇṇaḥ kimetaditi bho mune || 36 || yadarthaṃ me śramastaṃ ca viphalaṃ hi vitarkaye || ityuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ prāha nāradastu trikālavit || 37 || na kāryo vismayaste'tra bhāgyavānvaiṣṇavottamaḥ || vaiṣṇavānāṃ na vāṃchā hi viphalā jāyate kvacit || 38 || avaśyaṃ prekṣase rājanbibhrataṃ pārthivaṃ vapuḥ || kāraṇaṃ jagatāmādiṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || 39 || tvadanugrahahetorvai kṣitāvavatariṣyati || jagaccarācaraṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇorvaśamupāgatam||2.2.11.140|| na kasyāpi vaśe so'pi paramātmā sanātanaḥ || kevalaṃ bhaktivaśago bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || 41 || brahmādikīṭaparyaṃtaṃ suguptaṃ yasya māyayā || sa kathaṃ parataṃtraḥ syādṛte bhaktajanānnṛpa || 42 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ mūlaṃ bhaktirmuradviṣaḥ || saiva tadgrahaṇopāyastāmṛte nāsti kiṃcana || 43 || eka eva yadā viṣṇurbahudhā svasya māyayā || tamṛte paramātmānaṃ sukhaheturna vidyate || 44 || ye'pyanye śivadurgādyāstaistaiḥ karmabhirāvṛtāḥ || yacchaṃti pūjitāḥ kāmaṃ te'pi viṣṇuparāyaṇāḥ || 45 || antaryāmī sa bhagavāndevānāmapi hṛtsthitaḥ || yāvatphalaṃ prerayati tāvadeva dadatyamī || 46 || vaiṣṇavastvaṃ ca rājeṃdra padmayoneśca paṃcamaḥ || aṣṭādaśānāṃ vidyānāṃ pārago vṛttasaṃsthitaḥ || 47 || nyāyena rakṣitā pṛthvīṃ viśeṣādbrāhmaṇārcakaḥ || avaśyaṃ drakṣyasi kṣetre vaikuṇṭhaṃ carmacakṣuṣā || 48 || pitāmaho'pyatra kārye bhavato māṃ niyuktavān || sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi prāpte kṣetrottame nṛpa || 49 || sāṃprataṃ rātriśeṣo hi tṛtīyaṃ yāmamṛcchati || svāntānniveśānnirgaṃtuṃ rājña ājñāpayādhunā || 2.2.11.150 || tvamapyaṃtargṛhaṃ yāhi nidrāyā vaśamāgataḥ || 151 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣi saṃvāda ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
<2.2.12>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ukte brahmasutenetthamiṃdradyumno mahīpatiḥ|| munestuvacanaṃ śrutvā prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || vicārya parayā buddhyā śramaṃ mene phalāvaham ||1|| aho me paramaṃ bhāgyaṃ bahujanmāṃtarārjitam|| vyavasāye mamodyuktaḥ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ||2|| jīvanmuktaṃ svatanujaṃ matsahāyamakārayat || sahāyo yādṛśaḥ puṃsāṃ bhavetkāryaṃ hi tādṛśam||3|| śrutaṃ sabhāsu sarvāsu iti vṛddhānuśāsanam || sa itthaṃ ciṃtayanrājā visṛjya ca sabhāsadaḥ ||4|| tato muniṃ kare dhṛtvā viveśāṃtaḥpure dvijāḥ || tamarcayitvā vidhivatpalyaṃke saha tena vai ||5|| niśāvaśeṣaṃ nṛpatirnināya saṃlapanmithaḥ || tataḥ prabhāte vimale nityaṃ karma samāpya vai || 6 || pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ saṃtatāra mahānadīm || oḍhradeśādhipenāgre gacchatādiṣṭapaddhatiḥ|| 7 || ekāmra vanakaṃ kṣetramabhiyāto balānvitaḥ || sa gatvā kiṃcidadhvānaṃ prāpya gaṃdhavahābhidhām ||8|| nadīṃ vegavatīṃ śītatoyāmākramya vegavān || pūrvāhnapūjāsamaye koṭiliṃgeśvarasya vai || 9 || carcarīśaṃkhakāhālamṛdaṃgamurajadhvanim || vyaśnuvānaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ dūrācchuśrāva bhūpatiḥ||2.2.12.10|| manyamāno bhagavato nīlācala nivāsinaḥ || uvāca nāradaṃ prīto dhvaniḥ kutra mahāmune || 11 || nīlādriśikharāvāsaḥ prāptaḥ kiṃ parameśvaraḥ || yadarcāsamaye hyeṣa śrūyate saṃkuladhvaniḥ || 12 || utāhopyanyadevo vā nikaṭe varttate mune | iti pṛṣṭastadā rājñā provāca munipuṃgavaḥ || 13 || rājansudurlabhaṃ kṣetraṃ gopitaṃ muravairiṇā || na tatrāstīti bhagavānkairapi jñāyate nṛbhiḥ || 14 || tvaṃ hi bhāgyavatāṃ śreṣṭhastvadbhāgyātte purodhasā || dṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃcidbhagavānsaṃyateṃdriyavartmanā || 15 || tvaṃ hi tāvadbalairyuktaḥ ṣaḍaṃgainṛpasattama || sāhase'tipravṛtto'si saṃśayo me mahīpate || 16 || saṃvarttate nīlagiriryojane tu tṛtīyake || idaṃ tvekāmrakavanaṃ kṣetraṃ gaurīpatervibhoḥ || nātidūre mahīpāla bhītaḥ sa śaraṇāgataḥ || 17 || || iṃdradyumna uvāca || || kathaṃ sa bhīto gaurīśaḥ kaṃ vā śaraṇamāgataḥ || 18 || dadāha tripuraṃ ghoraṃ śareṇaikena yaḥ purā || atra me vismayo jātaḥ śrotumicchāmi durlabham || 19 || rakṣitā bhavabhītānāṃ bhavaḥ paramapāvanaḥ || kimarthaṃ bhayabhīto'sau kaḥ samartho'sya vai jaye || 2.2.12.20 || || nārada uvāca || || atra te kathayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ mahīpate || upayeme purā gaurīṃ tapasā vaśamāgataḥ || 21 || brahmacārī himagirau bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ || utsṛjya brahmacaryaṃ tu so'naṃgaśarapīḍitaḥ || 22 || tayā reme rucirayā yauvanonmattayā nṛpa || tatpiturviṣaye bhogānbubhuje devakāṃkṣitān || 23 || kadācidatha niryātī svavāsabhavanātsatī || sāmapūrvaṃ kulastrībhirmātroktā sasmitaṃ vacaḥ || 24 || ārye mahattapastaptaṃ varārthaṃ gahane vane || niṣkulo nirguṇo vṛddho varaḥ prāpto varānane || 25 || divārātriṃ na tyajasi sannidhiṃ tādṛśasya vai || ko guṇaḥ kathyatāṃ vatse kiṃ vā patyuḥ prasādajam|| 26 || bhūṣaṇācchādanaṃ prāptaṃ mamaiva gṛhavāsinī || ciraṃ tiṣṭhasi bhadre tvaṃ pitṛbhogopalālitā || 27 || trailokye yāstu kanyā vai pariṇītāḥ piturgṛhāt|| prayātyalaṃkṛtābhartrā bhartṛveśmani śuśruma || 28 || ahaṃ tu mānasī kanyā pitṛṇāṃ pitṛlokataḥ || āgatā tu mahābhāge pariṇītā himādriṇā || 29 || itthamuktā mayā hāsyānna krodhāccalalocane || jāmāturagre no vācyaṃ sa hi viṣṇusamo mataḥ || 2.2.12.30 || || nārada uvāca || || māturitthaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhartṛniṃdāprapīḍitā || kopaprasphuradoṣṭhī sā vācaṃ noce manāgapi || 31 || prayayāvaṃtikaṃ bharturnihnu(hru?)vānāṃ'bikāvacaḥ || jagāda paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ snehagarbhaṃ mitākṣaram || 32 || svāminna sāṃprataṃ caitadyadvāsaḥ śvaśurālaye || kṣaudrīyasāmapi gurostrailokyasya kathaṃ nu te || 33 || tadāvayornātra yogyā vasatirme priyā vibho || na saṃti kiṃ te vāsāya yogyā vai bhūmayaḥ prabhoḥ || 34 || ityuktaḥ śivayā so'tha bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || tayā sārddhaṃ vṛṣārūḍho madhyadeśaṃ yayau tvaran || 35 || vilaṃghya sarva tīrthāni prayāgaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat || pūrvasāgaragāminyā gaṃgāyā uttare taṭe || 36 || vārāṇasīṃ nāma purīṃ gauryā vāsāya nirmame || paṃcakrośamitāṃ ramyāṃ varaprāsādaśobhitām || 37 || aṭṭālakaśatairyuktāmasaṃkhyopavanairyutām || nānātīrthasamāyuktāṃ nānājanasamākulām || 38 || ājñayā dhūrjaṭeḥ śubhrāṃ nirmitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā || pāvanaiḥ śītalairgaṃgātaraṃgaiḥ kṣapitāṃhasām || 39 || tatra madhye pure svarṇaprākārāṭṭālaśobhite || ratnastaṃbhaiḥ sughaṭite sarvāśāparipūrake || 2.2.12.40 || tayā reme paśupatiḥ śriyeva madhusūdanaḥ || sā purī viśvanāthena kadācinnaiva mucyate || 41 || avimukteti sā khyātā nṛṇāṃ muktipradāyinī|| purāsīnmanujādhīśa sevitā bhavabhīrubhiḥ ||42|| tatroṣitā tadā gaurī tena bhartrā svalaṃkṛtā|| mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi na sasmāra mahīpate || ||43|| evaṃ bahuyuge'tīte kailāsādriṃ sa jagmivān || ātmanaḥ koṭiliṃgāni tatra saṃsthāpya vai prabhuḥ||44|| rājānaḥ pālayāmāsustāṃ purīṃ bahuśo nṛpa|| tatrāsītkāśirājākhyaḥ purā dvāparake yuge|| 45|| śaṃbhuṃ saṃtoṣayāmāsa tapasogreṇa vai prabhum|| jarāsandhapurogāṇāṃ rājñāṃ jetāramacyutam||46|| saṃgrāme prabhaviṣyāmītyabhisaṃdhāya pārthivaḥ|| prādāttasmai varaṃ so'pi pinākī pāritoṣitaḥ|| 47|| jetāsi kaṃsahaṃtāraṃ saṃgrāme tvamariṃdama|| tavārthe pramathaiḥ sārddhamahaṃ yotsye vṛṣe sthitaḥ || 48 || śaṃbhoriti varaṃ labdhvā pramattaḥ sa narādhipaḥ || śaṃkhacakradharaṃ saṃkhye harimāhvata vīryavān|| 49 || antaryāmī sa bhagavāñjñātvā vṛttāṃtamīdṛśam || cakraṃ prasthāpayāmāsa kāśirājasya sūdane || 2.2.12.50 || tadugradarśanaṃ cakraṃ sahasrādityavarcasam || kāśirājaśiraśchittvā tadbalaṃ tāṃ purīṃ tataḥ || 51 || dadāha kupitaṃ rājanviṣṇorāśayavīryavit || taddṛṣṭvā sumahatkarma kruddhaḥ paśupatistadā || 52 || gaṇairvṛto vṛṣārūḍhaḥ pinākī tadupādravat || tataḥ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ prathamaṃ puraḥ || 53 || śaṃbhuḥ pāśupatāstraṃ taccakārotpātasannibham || purā viṣṇorvaraṃ prāptaṃ śaṃbhunā bhaktitoṣitāt || 54 || balenāpyāyayiṣyāmi tavāstraṃ saṃsmṛtastvayā || mayi cetpratikūlastvaṃ bhaviṣyati ca niṣprabham || 55 || ghore pāśupate cāsminnastre ca viphalīkṛte || vārāṇasyāṃ ca dagdhāyāṃ bhayatrasto vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 56 || tuṣṭāva jagatāmadimanādiṃ puruṣottamam || 57 || || || mahādeva uvāca || || nārāyaṇa paraṃdhāma paramātmanparātpara || saccidānandavibhava nirañjana namo'stu te || 58 || jagatkāraṇasṛṣṭyādi karmakṛdguṇabhedataḥ || māyayā nijayā gupta svaprakāśa namo'stu te || 59 || nāṃtarbahirbahiścāṃtardūrastho nikaṭāśrayaḥ || gururlaghuḥ sthiro'ṇīyānsthavīyāṃśca namo'stu te || 2.2.12.60 || koṭayaścaturāsyasya palārddhaṃ mama cātula || yadapāṃgavilāsotthaṃ tasmai kālātmane namaḥ || 61 || ekaikaromākalitabrahmāṇḍagaṇasaṃvṛtam || mānātītaṃ vapuryasya tasmai viśvātmane namaḥ || 62 || svakālaparimāṇena vedhasaḥ pralayodbhavau || manvaṃtarādighaṭanākalanāya namo'stu te || 63 || sṛṣṭo'haṃ tamasā nātha tvatprabhāvānabhijñakaḥ || tatkṣamasvāparādhaṃ me trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 64 || stutimitthaṃ prakurvāṇe tasmiṃstripuradāhini || cakrarūpaṃ parityajya āvirāsīdadhokṣajaḥ || 65 || prasannavadanaḥ śrīmāñchaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || tārkṣyapadmāsanagato vanamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥ || 66 || hārakuṇḍalakeyūramukuṭādibhirujjvalaḥ || vāmotsaṃgagatāṃ lakṣmīṃ satyāṃ dakṣiṇapārśvagām || 67 || bibhrāṇaḥ kṛṣṇajīmūtakāṃtadehaṃ kṛpāmbudhiḥ || krodhāviṣṭa ivovāca bibhyataṃ girijāpatim || 68 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || kālenaitāvatā śaṃbho durbuddhiḥ kathamāgatā || hetornṛpatikīṭasya mayā yoddhumupasthitaḥ || 69 || kati vā matprabhāvāste no jñātā dhūrjaṭe tvayā || satyaṃ pāśupataṃ te'straṃ durjayaṃ sasurāsuraiḥ || 2.2.12.70 || matkrodharūpaṃ taccakraṃ tvāmapi kṣamate na yat || māmavajñāya jagati bhramati tvāmṛte hi kaḥ || 71 || tapobhirbahubhiḥ pūrvaṃ maccharīratayorjitaḥ || sāṃprataṃ cecciraṃ raṃtuṃ gauryā sārddhamihecchasi ||| 72 || purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ cemāṃ yadīcchasi cirasthitām || mannāmnā bhuvi vikhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 73 || dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre nīlācalavibhūṣitam || daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ yāvadvirajamaṇḍalam ||74|| kramaśaḥ pāvanaṃ kṣetraṃ yāvaccitrotpalā nadī || tataḥ prabhṛti yo deśo yāvatsyāddakṣiṇārṇavaḥ || 75 || padātpadācchreṣṭhatamo nīlādrirapavargadaḥ || caturdehasthito'haṃ vai yatra nīlamaṇīmayaḥ || 76 || tasyottarasyāṃ vikhyātaṃ vanamekāmrakāhvayam || pārvatyā tatra nivasa nirbhayastripurāṃtaka || 77 || sṛjatā sarvalokānāṃ mannideśātsvayaṃbhuvā || tatrāpi koṭiliṃgānāṃ rājā tvamabhiṣekṣyase ||78|| sarvatīrthamayaṃ cedaṃ tīrthaṃ yanmaṇikarṇikam || ihāhaṃkāramutsṛjya vraja tvaṃ saparicchadaḥ || 79 || || nārada uvāca || || ityukto vāsudevena tryaṃbako natakandharaḥ || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā provāca madhusūdanam || 2.2.12.80 || || mahādeva uvāca || || devadeva jagannātha praṇatārtihara prabho || tvadājñāpālanaṃ śreyaḥ kāraṇaṃ me jagatpate || 81 || yattu mūḍhatayā deva avalepaḥ kṛto mayā || tavaivānugrahastatra prabho cāṃcalyakāraṇam || || 82 || yadādiśasi deveśa prayāṇaṃ puruṣottamam || tanmūrdhni kṛtvā yāsyāmi kṣetraṃ muktipradaṃ śivam || 83 || abhisaṃdhiṃ kuruṣvādya mamānugrahakāraṇam || puruṣottamaṃ mama kṣetraṃ tvameva paripālaya || 84 || yathā punarnedṛśaṃ tadvināśamupayāsyati || itthametatpurā kṣetraṃ mahādevena nirmitam || 85 || balaśrīsahitaṃ devamarcayanpuruṣottamam || atra sākṣādumākāṃtaḥ sthāpitaḥ parameṣṭhinā || 86 || vayaṃ tatra vrajiṣyāmo drakṣyāmaḥ puranāśanam || sudṛḍhāṃtastamaḥstomabhāsvaṃtaṃ girijāpatim ||87|| yadetacchāṃbhavaṃ kṣetraṃ tamaso nāśanaṃ param || rajaḥprakṣālanaṃ śreyaḥ khyātaṃ virajamaṇḍalam || 88 || sattvodriktatayā khyātaṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam|| yāvatyanyāni kṣetrāṇi muktidāni śrutāni te||89|| tāni sarvāṇi rājeṃdra dadate muktimatra vai || etatkṣetraṃ mahārāja duṣkṛtāvilacetasām ||2.2.12.90|| na viśvāsapathaṃ yāti rahasyaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ || 91 || || jaiminiruvāca || || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahṛṣṭahṛdayo nṛpaḥ|| uvāca muniśārdūlaṃ vismayotphullalocanaḥ || sādhu me kathitaṃ brahmankṣetraṃ paramapāvanam ||92 || yatromāpatirāste'sau pālakaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || avaśyaṃ tatra gacchāmaḥ panthā yadyapi vakrabhūḥ || uddiṣṭeṣṭapariprāptau yadidaṃ kāraṇaṃ mahat || 93 || || jaiminiruvāca || || tatastau munibhūpālau madhyāhnasamaye dvijāḥ || prāpatuḥ sabalau kṣetramekāmravanasaṃjñakam || 94 || biṃdutīrthe nṛpaḥ snātvā tīrasthaṃ puruṣottamam || saṃpūjya vidhivadyātaḥ koṭīśvaramahālayam || 95 || tadvāri samyagācāṃtastatprītyai subahūni saḥ || gajāśvadhanaratnāni vastrālaṃkaraṇāni ca || 96 || dvijebhyaḥ pradadau rājā sāttvikaṃ dharmamāsthitaḥ || liṃgaṃ tribhuvaneśaṃ taṃ mahāsnānena pūjayan || 97 || atulāṃ prītimālebhe viṣṇoradvaitadarśanaḥ || stutvā praṇamya bhaktyāsau vīṇayā copagāyya ca || 98 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo devaprasādanakṛtodyamaḥ || ananyamanasā tasthau ciṃtayanvṛṣabhadhvajam || |99 || tataḥ prasanno bhagavāṃstryaṃbakaḥ parameśvaraḥ || sākṣānnṛpamuvācedaṃ spaṣṭākṣarapadaṃ dvijāḥ || 2.2.12.100 || || koṭiliṃgeśa uvāca || || indradyumna mahārāja vaiṣṇavastvādṛśo bhuvi || durlabhaḥ khalu te vāṃchā cirātsamyagbhaviṣyati ||101|| ityuktāṃtardadhe śaṃbhuḥ paśyatastu mahīkṣitaḥ|| nāradaṃ punarāhedaṃ yadādiṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā || 102 || tatkalpaya mahābhāga vājimedhapuraḥsaram || viṣṇoḥ kalevare tasminkṣetre śrīpuruṣottame || 103 || aṃtarvedī mahāpuṇyā viṣṇorhṛdayasaṃnibhā || tasyāḥ saṃrakṣaṇāyāhaṃ sthāpito viṣṇunāṣṭadhā || 104 || śaṃkhākṛteragrabhāge nīlakaṇṭho'hamāsthitaḥ || durgayā saha vipreṃdra tatremaṃ bhūpatiṃ naya || 105 || antarhitaḥ khalvidānīṃ nīlaratnatanurhariḥ || tatra śrīnarasiṃhasya kṣetraṃ kuru madājñayā || 106 || tatra naḥ sannidhau vājimedhena yajatāmayam || sahasreṇa nṛpaśreṣṭha tadante tarumadbhutam || 107 || darśayainaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha brahmarūpamakalmaṣam || catasraḥ pratimāstena viśvakarmā ghaṭiṣyati || 108 || tāsāṃ pratiṣṭhitau brahmā svayamevāgamiṣyati || yathāyaṃ kṣīṇapāpaḥ syādvājimedhairyajanharim || 109 || tiṣṭhatvabdasahasraṃ vai tadaṃte lokayiṣyati || samastajagadādhāraṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || 2.2.12.110 || dāravīṃ tanumāsthāya darśanādapavargadam || na tasya caritaṃ vetti brahmā'haṃ tvaṃ ca nārada || 111 || ājñānuṣṭhānato bhaktyā prasīdati sa kevalam|| nārado'pi mahādevaṃ praṇipatya jagadgurum|| uvāca prāṃjalirbhūtvā yadādiṣṭaṃ tvayā vibho||112|| pitāmaho'pi māmitthaṃ nirdideśāsya kalpanam|| pitāmahaśca tvaṃ nātha no bhinnau paramātmanaḥ||113|| nṛpaterasya bhāgyarddhirīdṛśī yatkṛte vibho| agocaro'si manasastryāṇāmapyanugrahaḥ||114|| yatprasaṃgena taraṇaṃ bhavābdherapi duṣkṛtām || aciṃtyamahimā hyeṣa bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ ||115 || na buddhigocare bhaktiryāvatyā prīyate hyasau || ciraṃ yataṃtastiṣṭhaṃti vedānuvacanādibhiḥ || kṣudro'pi labhate muktimanāyāsena karmaṇā ||116|| gavyopajīvyā gopyastu vanacāragṛhoṣitāḥ || araṇyajīvanāḥ prāpurmuktiṃ kāmopabhogataḥ || 117 || druhanniraṃtaraṃ prāpa śiśupālaḥ sabhāṃtare || vyādhoḥ hṛdayamāvidhya gatiṃ prāpa sudurlabhām || 118 || vastrākarṣaṃ gṛhaṃ nītvā kubjainaṃ bubhuje purā || yaṃ dhyānalayamāpannā labhaṃte na surastriyaḥ || 119 || caṃḍālāya dadau muktiṃ dūrasthāyāpi no punaḥ|| āsannāyātibhaktāya śrotriyāya purā vibhuḥ||2.2.12.120|| māyābhirvaṃcayettvāṃ hi pitāmahamapi prabhuḥ|| tiṣṭhaṃti duḥkhabahulāstapobhirdehabaṃdhanāḥ||121|| gautamādyā brahmacaryaniṣṭhāḥ kalpāntavāsinaḥ|| īdṛktādṛkparicchedagocaraṃ nāsya ceṣṭitam||122|| vyavasāyena bahunā kālena mahatā tathā|| nirṇetuṃ śakyate nāsya caritaṃ vā sumedhasaḥ || 123 || upāyā bahavaḥ saṃti ye śāstrapariniṣṭhitāḥ || viduṣāṃ mocanāyeha bahuśastairyajaṃti vai || 124 || sarveṣāmuttamopāyo vasatiḥ puruṣottame || yā'vaśyaṃ svāmisāyujyaṃ prāpayetsusakhā yathā || 125 || tadenaṃ māyinaṃ prāptumupāyo nāṃtarīyakaḥ|| svayaṃ nidhāya hariṇā yatra vāsaḥ surakṣitaḥ || 126 || iṃdradyumnaprasaṃgena jāyate sārvalaukikaḥ || tadājñāpaya deveśa gṛhītvainaṃ balānvitam ||127|| upatyakāyāṃ saṃsthāpya dīkṣayitvā mahākratau || āgamiṣyāmi pādābjasamīpaṃ te vṛṣadhvaja || 128|| || jaiminiruvāca || || tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ kṣaṇādaṃtardadhe muneḥ || so'pi rājño rathe tiṣṭhanprayayau kṣetramuttamam ||129|| dvitīye'hni kapoteśasthalīmāsedivānnṛpaḥ || dairghyāyāmasamāyuktāṃ jalāśayadrumākulām||2.2.12.130|| bilveśaḥ pūrvasīmāyāṃ samudrataṭamāsthitaḥ || senāniveśa yogyāṃ tāṃ matriṇā saṃniveditām ||131|| yathāyogyaṃ yathāsthānaṃ sthāpayitvā nṛpottamaḥ || bilveśvarakapoteśaṃ namaskṛtya prapūjya ca || 132 || rathamāsthāya matimānsahito brahmasūnunā || manasā vacasā viṣṇuṃ nīlācalanivāsinam|| ciṃtayankīrtayanviprā jagāma saṃnidhiṃ hareḥ ||133|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12||||
<2.2.13>
|| munaya ūcuḥ | || kapoteśasthalī cāpi kathaṃ khyātā mahāmune || ko vā kapotaḥ kaśceśa etanno vaktumarhasi ||1|| || jaiminiruvāca || || purā kuśasthalī sā vai asevyā sarvajaṃtubhiḥ || tīkṣṇadhāraiḥ kuśāgraistu paritaḥ kaṃṭakaiścitā ||2|| nistarurnirjalādhārā piśācavasatiryathā || yadā pūrvaṃ bhagavato nānyo devo'pi pūjyate ||3|| pūjyaḥ syāmahamapyevaṃ spardhāsīddhūrjaṭestadā || ciṃtayanniti tasyaiva viṣṇorbhaktau mano'dadhat|| 4 || sarvanirviṣaye deśe sthitvā'haṃ niṣparigrahaḥ || sumahattapa āsthāya toṣayiṣyāmi taṃ harim || 5 || kiṃ vadeyaṃ rameśāya kā stutiḥ śāradāpateḥ || sarvabrahmāṃḍanāthasya kiṃ vānyattuṣṭikārakam || 6 || tasmānna bāhyaṃ vastvanyadupayogāya tasya vai || aṃtaryāgaṃ samāsthāya nirvyalīkena cetasā || 7 || bhaktebhya ātmapradadaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim || ārādhayiṣye sarveṣāṃ pūjyaḥ syāṃ tatprasādataḥ || 8 || tata ityabhisaṃdhāya yayau puṇyāṃ kuśasthalīm || samīpe nīlagotrasya sarvadvaṃdvavivarjitaḥ || 9 || tatastepe tapastīvraṃ vāyubhakṣo maheśvaraḥ || kapota iva sūkṣmo'bhūdaṣṭamūrtirapi prabhuḥ || 2.2.13.10 || tataḥ prasanno bhagavānaiśvaryaṃ pradadau tadā || yenātmatulyaḥ saṃjātaḥ pūjāsaṃmānanādiṣu || 11 || tapaḥprabhāvāttasyāsītsthalī vṛndāvanopamā || sarastaḍāgasarasī nadībhiḥ śobhitāṃtarā || 12 || nānādrumairlatābhiśca sarvartuphalapuṣpakaiḥ || madhumattadvirephāṇāṃ jhaṃkārairmukharāśayā || 13 | nānāpakṣigaṇākīrṇā sarvajaṃtusukhāśrayā || kapotasadṛśo jāto yataḥ sa tapasā śivaḥ || 14 || murārerājñayā so'tra kapoteśvaratāṃ gataḥ || tadājñayā'tra vasati mṛḍānyā tryaṃbakaḥ sadā || 15 || ye'rcayanti kapoteśaṃ stuvanti praṇamaṃti vā || nirdhūtakalmaṣāste vai prayāṃti puruṣottamam || 16 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bilveśamahimāṃ dvijāḥ || pātālavāsinaḥ pūrvaṃ daityā bhittvā mahītalam || 17 || upadravaṃti bhūrlokaṃ bhakṣayanti janāṃstathā || bhārāvataraṇārthāya devakīgarbhasaṃbhavaḥ || 18 || pālayāmāsa pṛthivīṃ yadā sa bhagavānprabhuḥ || yādavaiḥ pāṃḍavaiḥ sārddhaṃ tadā tatsthānamāgataḥ || 19 || tīrtharājasya salile snātvā taṃ nīlamādhavam || dūrātpraṇamya manasā daityadvāramupāgataḥ || 2.2.13.20 || dṛṣṭvā tadvivaraṃ ghoramapraveśyaṃ tu mānavaiḥ || bhrāṃtyā saṃmohayam̐llokānprathayañchivapūjyatām || 93 || bailvaṃ phalaṃ samādāya tatrāvāhya trilocanam || pūjayitvā purārātiṃ tuṣṭāvāsurasūdanaḥ || 22 || ||śrī bhagavānuvāca || || namaste triguṇātīta guṇatrayavibhāgakṛt || trayīmaya trayātīta trikālajñānine namaḥ || || 23 || śaśisūryāgninetrāya brahmaṇyāya varātmane || aṣṭaiśvaryanidhānāya tubhyamaṣṭātmane namaḥ || 24 || yasya rūpaṃ tamaḥpāre tamonāśanamavyayam || ajñānānāṃ tamaśchinnaṃ tasmai vitamase namaḥ || 25 || evaṃ svamātmanātmānaṃ stutvā sa bhagavānprabhuḥ || tasya prasādādvivaraṃ supraveśamapaśyata || 26 || tena mārgeṇa pātālaṃ sasainyo'bhyagamatprabhuḥ || hatvā tatra balodagrāndaityānbhārāvatāraṇaḥ || 27 || punarāgamya tatraiva sthitvā sa vṛṣabhadhvajam || saṃpūjya bhagavāndvārarodhāya sthāpayañchivam || 28 || idamāha mahābuddhirbhaktivaśyo gadādharaḥ || dhūrjaṭe tiṣṭha prāsāde rundhāno'sura nirgamam || 29 || tvadanyaḥ kaḥ kṣamaḥ śaṃbho karbūrabalanāśane || sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ tato dvārāvatīṃ yayau || 2.2.13.30 || tataḥprabhṛti bilveśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ khyātimāgataḥ || pūrvavidhiḥ sa bilveśaḥ kṣetrarājasya bho dvijāḥ || 31 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpahaṃtāraṃ mṛḍrānīpatimavyayam || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti vipattiṃ dustarāṃ jayet || 32 || kapotabilveśvarayormāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tu vaḥ || ataḥ paraṃ bho munayaḥ kimanyacchrotumicchatha || 33 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || ||9|| ||
<2.2.14>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || rathamāruhya tau yātau yadā nāradapārthivau || kva yātau cakratuḥ kiṃ vā tanno vada mahāmune ||1|| || jaiminiruvāca || || sārddhaṃ ca vidyāpatinā purohitakanīyasā || kṣetrāṃte nīlakaṇṭhasya samīpamupajagmatuḥ || 2 || durnimittamabhūnmārge vrajato'sya mahīkṣitaḥ || vāmākṣibhujayoḥ spandaḥ sphuraṇaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ || 3 || taddṛṣṭvā nṛpaśārdūlo viṣādamupasedivān || papraccha kāraṇaṃ cāsya sarvajñānanidhiṃ munim || 4 || avyāhataṃ me sāmrājyaṃ prāptaṃ kṣetrottamaṃ tvidam || darśanārthaṃ mādhavasya yātreyaṃ tu śubhāvahā || 5 || akāryaṃ me bhavedadya kiṃ mune brūhi tattvataḥ || spandate vāmanetraṃ tu sphurate ca bhujo'sakṛt || 6 || tacchrutvā nāradaḥ prāha bhāvi kāryaṃ ca sūcayan || śrāvayankuśalaṃ vākyaṃ yaduktaṃ padmayoninā || 7 || nārada uvāca || || mā bhūdviṣādaste bhūpa savighnaṃ prāyaśaḥ śubham || vighnāṃte ca śubhaṃ puṃsāṃ punarbhāgyavatāṃ nṛpa || 8 || satyaṃ tvaṃ sārvabhaumo'si kṣetraṃ viṣṇorvapustvidam || yātrā te'tra yadartheyaṃ soz'tarddhānamupāgamat || 9 || eṣa vidyāpatirvipro dine yasmindadarśa tam || sāyaṃkāle tato'nyedyuḥ svarṇavālukayā vṛtaḥ || yayau pātālanilayaṃ martyaloke sudurlabhaḥ || 2.2.14.10 || || jaiminiruvāca || || tacchrutvā ghoravacanaṃ vavrapātasamaṃ nṛpaḥ || papāta dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe niḥsaṃjñaḥ sa dvijottamāḥ || 11 || taṃ tathā patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā purohitapurogamāḥ || snigdhāḥ sakhāyaḥ sarve te hāhākāramupādravan ||12|| karpūraśītalaṃ vāri mukhe siktvā punaḥpunaḥ || candanāgurukarpūraiḥ sarvāṃgaṃ lilipuśca te || 13 || cāmaraistālavṛṃtaiśca vījayāmāsurāśu tam || nārado'pi ca saṃbhrāṃto dhārayanyogadhāraṇām || 14 || prāṇānararakṣannarapaterjānaṃstatra śubhāyatim || so'pi rājā cirātsaṃjñāṃ lebhe yatnairanuttamaiḥ || 15 || utthāya pādayorviprā nāradasyāpatatpunaḥ || kimakārṣaṃ mune pāpaṃ kasmiñjanmāṃtare dṛḍham || 16 || yasya pākadaśāyāṃ vai duḥkhamāsītsudāruṇam || karmaṇā manasā vācā no dvijānāṃ gavāmapi || aparādhaḥ kṛtaḥ kaścitsvapne'pi munipuṃgava || 17 || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ karma yatparikīrtitam || rājñastanmuniśārdūla na tyaktaṃ vai mayā kvacit || 18 || devatātithibhṛtyānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca mahāmune || tathāśritānāṃ baṃdhūnāṃ nāpamānaḥ kṛto mayā || 19 || paṃcāśadaparādhā ye viṣṇorvaiṣṇavapuṃgava || tyaktāḥ prayatnātte sarve kruddhā iva mahoragāḥ || 2.2.14.20 || kiṃ bhāgyaṃ caritaṃ tena purohitakanīyasā || yaccarmacakṣuṣā dṛṣṭo bhagavānnīlamādhavaḥ || 21 || kimarthaṃ rājyavibhraṃśo jānataiṣa nvayā kṛtaḥ || yātrāsamaya evaitatkathaṃ vā na prakīrtitam || 22 || kimarthaṃ vā śrotriyāṇāṃ sthānabhraṃśo mayā kṛtaḥ || kathametaiḥ parityaktāścirātsaṃskṛtabhūmayaḥ || 23 || āvaṃśabhūtervṛttiryā prajābhiḥ paripālitā || madarthaṃ sā parityaktā jīviṣyaṃti kathaṃ nu tāḥ || 24 || prāṇānna dhārayiṣyāmi na drakṣyāmi yadā harim || eṣa me niścayo brahmanmayi naṣṭe kutaḥ prajāḥ || || 25 || mune sadā sakaruṇastvaṃ māṃ śāsti śubhāśubham || sāṃprataṃ matsutaṃ nītvā mālaveṣvabhiṣecaya || 26 || sa pālayatu nyāyena na śocaṃtu imāḥ prajāḥ || rājāno ye samāyātāste sarvaṃ mannideśataḥ || 27 || matsūnormālaveśasya prayāṃtu vacane sthitāḥ || prāyopaveśavidhinā ciṃtayannīlamādhavam || 28 || āyuḥśeṣaṃ kariṣyāmi saphalaṃ kṣetrasaṃsthitaḥ || 29 || || jaiminiruvāca || || vilapaṃtamindrumnaṃ rājānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || utthāpya praśrayagirā sāṃtvayannidamabravīt || 2.2.14.30 || || nārada uvāca || || rājanpaṃḍitamūrddhanyo vaiṣṇavo dhaiyasāgaraḥ || śreyaḥ savighnaṃ satataṃ kathaṃ vā nāvadhārayeḥ || 31 || idaṃ tu paramaṃ śreyaḥ puṃso janmaśatārjitam || śarīradhāriṇaṃ paśyeccarmacakṣurgadādharam || 32 || niraṃkuśā harerlīlā kena vāpyavadhāryate || jīvanmukto'pyahaṃ rājaṃstallīlāṃ nātivartaye || 33 || kiyatā vaṃcito nāhaṃ dṛḍhabhakto'ntikasthitaḥ || duratyayā tasya māyā bahujanmaśatairapi || 34 || anantā tasya māyeyaṃ durjñeyā padmayoninā || nābhipadmāsthitenāpi nityaṃ ca stutiśālinā || 35 || svabhāva evaṃ kathitastasya māyāvino nṛpa || viśeṣaṃ kathayāmyevaṃ tvaṃ tu bhāgyavatāṃ varaḥ || 36 || tisro'pi mūrtayastasya tvadanugrahabuddhayaḥ || carācarāṇāṃ sraṣṭā yaḥ sākṣāllokapitāmahaḥ || māmuvāca vrajāśu tvamiṃdradyumnasya cāṃtikam || 37 || nīlācalaṃ prayātyeṣa didṛkṣurnīlamādhavam || antarddhānaṃ gato hyeṣa yamena prārthito vibhuḥ || 38 || na tatra śokaḥ kartavyaḥ śakyate tatra nānyathā || vācyo madvacanādrājā paṃcamī mama saṃtatiḥ || 39 || tatkṛte paramātmānaṃ prasādya puruṣottamam || śvetadvīpānnayiṣyāmi sahasrāṃte mahākratoḥ || 2.2.14.40 || indradyumnaḥ sa idānīṃ kṣetre śrīpuruṣottame || aśvamedhasahasraistu yajanviṣṇuṃ sa tiṣṭhatu || 41 || tadaṃte dāravatanuṃ viṣṇuṃ drakṣyati cakṣuṣā || so'vatāro hareḥ khyātiṃ tasya dvārā gamiṣyati || 42 || tadā tu tanavo viṣṇoḥ pratiṣṭhapyā mayā dhuvam || purā sma maṇimūrtistu caturddhāvasthito hariḥ ||43|| dṛṣṭvā purodhasā tasya sākṣādagre niveditaḥ || divyadāruvapurbhūyaścaturddhāvatariṣyati || 44 || tasmānmā vyatha rājeṃdra vāṃchā te saphalā dhruvam || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho nirvyalīko vaseha vai || 45 || || jaiminiruvāca || || sāṃtvayitvā nināyetthaṃ rājānaṃ nāradastadā || viśvāsapadavīṃ viprāḥ punarvākyamuvāca ha || 46 || || nārada uvāca || || śaṃkhākṛteḥ kṣetravarasya cāgre yo nīlakaṇṭhaḥ khalu durgayā''ste || yāmo vayaṃ tatra ca vājimedhakratūpayogyā susamā sthalī sā || 47 || tasyāṃ vinirmāya sahasravarṣasthirāṃ suśālāṃ hayamedhanāya || nīlādrivāsasya nṛsiṃhamūrtiṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtārthaṃ viracayya janma || 48 || tasyaiva mūrtiṃ pratiyātanāṃ te nityārcanīyāṃ tava pūjanīyām || pratyakpratiṣṭhāpya samastavighnavināśahetoḥ phalabṛṃhaṇāya || 49 || ārapsyāmaḥ kratuvaraṃ munivaryairyathocitam || vilambo'tra na hi śreyāniti paitāmahaṃ vacaḥ || 2.2.14.50 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<2.2.15>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || tataste prasthitā viprā nīlakaṇṭhāṃtikaṃ mudā || prapūjya taṃ mahādevaṃ śrīdurgāṃ praṇipatya ca || 1 || vimucya syaṃdanavaraṃ pādacārāḥ sahānugāḥ || āroḍhuṃ nīlabhūmidhraṃ prayātāḥ saṃyatedriyāḥ || 2 || nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇākulam || śilāviṣamasaṃrodhamabhitaḥ pariveṣakam || 3 || bhramadbhramarasaṃbhūtabhramakṛdgaṃḍaśailakam|| dakṣiṇāṃbhodhikallolajalāvṛtanitaṃbakam || 4 || apratarkyaṃ sadā martyairduṣpraveśyaṃ mahoragaiḥ || mattamātaṃgakaghaṭābṛṃhitairbhīṣaṇāṃtaram || 5 || śvāpadaiścirasaṃvāsaiḥ śastrāghātamavedibhiḥ || nirbhayaiḥ paritaḥ kīrṇaṃ mṛgayūthairanekaśaḥ || 6 || praveṣṭukāmā na prāpuryadā te mārgamaṃtaram|| tadā nāradasaṃsargādviditvā tu gireḥ śiraḥ || 7 || āseduryatra vasati kṛṣṇāgurutaroradhaḥ || sarvāpadbhayasaṃhartā divyasiṃhavapurvibhuḥ || || 8 || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmahatyāyā līyante koṭayo nṛṇām || vyāttāsyaṃ bhīmadaśanamāpiṃgalasaṭākulam || 9 || ugraṃ trinetraṃ daityasya svorāvuttānaśāyinaḥ || vakṣaḥsthalaṃ dārayaṃtaṃ nakharairvajradāruṇaiḥ || 2.2.15.10 || aruṇābhaṃ lasajjihvaṃ sāṭṭahāsamukhaṃ vibhum || śaṃkhacakralasadbāhuṃ kirīṭamukuṭojjvalam |||| 11 || netrocchaladvahnikaṇasaṃtrāsitadigantaram || pracaṃḍāghātabhūmyaṃtapraviṣṭapadapaṃkajam || 12 || tamādimṛrtiṃ te dṛṣṭvā nāradāgre tadā harim || nirbhayā dadṛśurdūrātpraṇemurvigatajvarāḥ || 13 || indradyumno'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradoktau viśasvase || bhāvikārye pratyayavānidamāha mahāmunim || 14 || maharṣe kṛtakṛtyo'smi tvaṃ hi jñānanidhiḥ param || durārādhyo nṛsiho'yaṃ darśane'pi bhayāvahaḥ ||15|| bhavādṛśaiḥ susevyoyaṃ mādṛśairdūrato'pi saḥ || darśanātkṛtakṛtyo'smi saṃlīnāśeṣapātakaḥ || 16 || tvatsannidhānādevātra tiṣṭhāmo nirbhayā mune || atyugra mūrtirbhagavānsvalpavīryairnaraiḥ katham || 17 || ārādhyate daityarājaṃ trilokeśaṃ vidārayan || yasya nīlamayī mūrtiḥ kṛpāsiṃdhoḥ sthitā tu vai || 18 || kasminsthale muniśreṣṭha darśanādyā vimuktidā || tanme darśaya vipreṃdra yanme muktipradaṃ matam || 19 || ityukto nāradastasmai darśayāmāsa pāvanam || sthānaṃ yatra sthito devaḥ svarṇasaikata saṃvṛtaḥ || 2.2.15.20 || paśyaitaṃ yojanāyāmaṃ yojanadvayamucchritam || kalpāṃtasthāyinaṃ bhūpa nyagrodhaṃ muktidaṃ nṛṇām || 21 || chāyāyāḥ kramaṇādyasya mucyate pāpakaṃcukāt || asya mūle naraḥ prāṇāṃstyajanmuktimavāpnuyāt ||22|| nyagrodharūpaṃ dṛṣṭvāpi nārāyaṇamakalmaṣam || niṣpāpo jāyate martyaḥ kimuta pūjayanstuvan || 23 || asya mūlātpratīcyāṃ hi nṛsiṃhasyottare nṛpa || atiṣṭhanmādhavo yatra caturmūrtidharo vibhuḥ || 24 || anugrahītuṃ tvāmeva punaratrodbhaviṣyati || śvetadvīpe yathā viṣṇurbhogabhūmau nijālayaḥ || 25 || jaṃbūdvīpe karmabhūmau nijaṃ sthānamidaṃ smṛtam || svasyaivātirahasyatvānna prakāśosya saṃmataḥ || 26 || mokṣādhikārī jānāti sthalametanmahīpate || aviśvāsapadaṃ nṛṇāṃ duṣkṛtāṃ hi viśeṣataḥ || 27 || atra yā'nyā pratikṛtiḥ paurairviṣṇoḥ pratiṣṭhitā || sāpi muktipradā bhūpa kiṃ punaḥ sā svayaṃbhuvā || 28 || aṃtarddhānatirodhāne sunimitte jagatprabhoḥ|| anugrahārthaṃ sādhūnāṃ jāyate ca yugeyuge || 29 || nānāvatārairbhagavānmatsyakūrmādikairnṛpa || nimittanāśe ca tirodadhāti parameśvaraḥ || 2.2.15.30 || nirnimittaṃ sthito nityamiha kāruṇyasāgaraḥ || śvetadvīpādyathā viṣṇuranyatrāvataretprabhuḥ || 31 || atra sthito'pi sa dvārakākāṃcīpuṣkarādiṣu || prakāśaṃ yāti kṛpayā tarumūlaprarohavat || 32 || nānātīrtheṣu deśeṣu kṣetreṣvāyataneṣu ca || aṃśāvatārāstasyaiva mā bhūtte saṃśayo nṛpa ||33|| kṣaṇaṃ na tyajatīśānaḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetramiva svakam || tvadupajñastu bhūpāla prakāśo'nyo bhaviṣyati || 34 || iti saṃdarśitaṃ sthānaṃ nāradena mahātmanā || sāṣṭāṃgapātaṃ bhūmau tadiṃdradyumno nanāma ha || 35 || manvānastu sthitaṃ devaṃ prakāśamiva tuṣṭuve || 36 || || iṃdradyumna uvāca || || devadeva jagannātha praṇatārtivināśana || trāhi māṃ puṃḍarīkākṣa patitaṃ bhavasāgare || 37 || tvameka eva duḥkhaughadhvaṃsakaḥ parameśvara || kṣudrāḥ kṣudrānhi sevaṃte sukhaleśasya lipsayā || 38 || anāditrividhaughasya rāśeḥ svasya mahāṃhasaḥ || durucchedyasya satataṃ pūryamāṇasya janmanaḥ || 39 || kiṃ punarbhaktibhāvena sākṣānmuktipradaṃ nṛṇām|| karmādhīnaṃ tu ye mūḍhā vadaṃti tvāṃ krṛpānidhim || 2.2.15.40 || te na jānaṃti bhagavankarmaivaṃ preritaṃ tvayā || ajāmilena vipreṇa tyaktvā varṇāśramoditam || 41 || kiṃ na pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ svāminso'pi tvannāmakīrtanāt || mukto'bhūtsmaraṇādeva pāśahastairvimocitaḥ || 42 || sarve'pyupāyā deveśa kīrtitāstava darśane || tvayi dṛṣṭe hi bhidyaṃte saṃśayā hṛdi saṃsthitāḥ || 43 || niḥsaṃśayo bhavetsadyaḥ pāpapuṇyakṣayo dhuvam || tvameva śaraṇaṃ dīnamanugṛhṇīṣva māṃ vibho || 44 || niścitāni tvayā deva garbhasthasya ca yāni me || taireva me janirjātu yāce tvāṃ kevalaṃ tvidam || 45 || tiraśco muktidā mūrtiḥ sthitā te yā'tra tāṃ punaḥ || anena cakṣuṣā paśyāmīśa nānyatprayojanam ||46|| kṛtāṃjalipuṭo rājā stutvaivaṃ madhusūdanam|| punarnanāma dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe sāśruvilocanaḥ || 47 || tatoṃ'tarikṣagā vāṇī sāmasusvarabhāṣiṇī || uccacāra nabhomadhye indradyumnasya śṛṇvataḥ || 48 || mā ciṃtāṃ vraja bhūpāla vrajiṣye tvadṛśoḥ patham || paitāmahaṃ vacaḥ prāha nārado yatkuruṣva tat || 49 || tacchrutvā divyavacanaṃ nāradasya ca bhāṣitam || śraddadhe vājimedhāya bhagavatprītikārakaḥ || 2.2.15.50 || nāradaṃ ca punaḥ prāha harṣagadgadayā girā || mune tvayā yadādiṣṭaṃ caturmukhanideśataḥ || 51 || aśarīrā tviyaṃ vāṇī anujajñe tadeva hi || pitāmaho jagannātho bhedo vai nā'nayoḥ kvacit || 52 || padmayoneḥ sutastvaṃ hi vacaste bhagavadvacaḥ || tatkartavyaṃ prayatnena yacchreyaupapādakam || 53 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
<2.2.16>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || nṛpaṃ sumanasaṃ dṛṣṭvā śraddadhānaṃ mahākratau || uvāca paramaprītyā nārado lokaharṣaṇaḥ || 1 || vyavasāye sukṛtināṃ devā yāṃti sahāyatām || tatrodāharaṇaṃ tvaṃ hi yatsahāyaścaturmukhaḥ || 2 || tadehi yāmastatraiva nīlakaṃṭhasya sannidhau || sarvarākṣasasaṃhāraṃ sarvavighnanivāraṇam ||3|| sthāpayāmyagrato rājannṛsiṃhaṃ vāruṇīmukham || aṃtarhito hi bhagavānpratyakṣo'sau nṛkesarī ||4|| sannidhāvasya yāgastu phalātiśayavānbhavet || tvamagrato gaccha śīghraṃ prāsādaṃ tatra kāraya || 5 || smaraṇānmama cāgatya suto vai viśvakarmaṇaḥ || pratyaṅmukhaṃ tu prāsādaṃ sa tūrṇaṃ ghaṭayiṣyati || 6 || dakṣiṇe nīlakaṃṭhasya yo mahāṃścaṃdanadrumaḥ || dhanuḥśatāṃtare rājaṃścirarūḍhastu tiṣṭhati || 7 || tasya paścimadeśasthaṃ kṣetraṃ rājanbhaviṣyati || vājimedhasahasreṇa tasyāgre yajatāṃ bhavān || 8 || gaccha tvamahamatraiva sthāsyāmi dinapañcakam || ārādhyainaṃ divyasiṃhaṃ jyotīrūpamanantakam || 9 || pratyarcāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prāṇeṃdriyamanoyutam || dīpāddīpaṃ yathā rājannayiṣye śobhanākṛtim || 2.2.16.10 || nāradasyeti vacanaṃ pratiśrutya nṛpottamaḥ || jagāma tatra vegena candanadrumasaṃnidhim || 11 || tatrāpaśyatsughaṭakaṃ śilpaśāstraviśāradam || nāradasyājñayā prāptaṃ putraṃ vai devaśilpinaḥ || 12 || manuṣyarūpamāsthāya śastrasūtradharaṃ sthitam || rājānaṃ sa tu dṛṣṭvā vai cikīrṣaṃtaṃ surālayam || 13 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ proce devāhaṃ śilpaśāstravit || narasiṃhālayaṃ te'dya ghaṭayiṣyāmi śobhanam || rājāpi tamuvācedaṃ prahasanbho dvijottamāḥ || 14 || || indradyumna uvāca || || na śilpī tvaṃ hi sāmānyaḥ śilpaśāstrapraṇetṛkaḥ || kathito nāradenaiva tvaṣṭuḥ putro mahāyaśāḥ || 15 || nirjane'sminmahāraṇye netaḥ pūrvaṃ janāśrayaḥ || vayamadyāgatāḥ śilpinsambandhaḥ kiṃnimittakaḥ || 16 || devaśilpī bhavāneva viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || sadānudhyāyinastasya nideśavaśavartinaḥ || 17 || yena smṛtastvaṃ muninā sa evātrāgamiṣyati || pratyarcāṃ narasiṃhasya gṛhītvā tu dināṃtare || 18 || tadāśu ghaṭayasvādya saprākāraṃ satoraṇam || prāsādaṃ narasiṃhasya pratīcīvadanaṃ śubham || 19 || taṃ pūjayitvā vidhivanniyojya ghaṭane nṛpaḥ || śilāsaṃcayakānbhṛtyānbahuvittairayojayat || 2.2.16.20 || caturthe divase viprāḥ prāsādo'bhūdanuttamaḥ || bahukālaprasādhyo'pi mahimnā devaśilpinaḥ || 21 || tataḥ prabhāte vimale nityakarmāvasānataḥ || pratiṣṭhāvidhisaṃbhāraṃ gṛhītvā saparicchadaḥ || 22 || nāradāgamanaṃ prekṣya yāvattiṣṭhati bhūpatiḥ || tāvacchuśruvire śaṅkhā mṛdaṅgā murajāstathā || 23 || gītamaṅgalavādyāni ghaṃṭānāṃ kariṇāṃ svanāḥ || tathā jaya jayetyuccaiḥ śabdā ākāśamaṇḍale || 24 || tāñchrutvā vismayāpannā iṃdradyumnapurogamāḥ || rājānaḥ śrotriyā viprā vaiṣṇavāśca sahasraśaḥ || 25 || nirādhārāstvime śabdā adbhutāni na saṃśayaḥ || vicārayaṃtaste yāvattāvaddakṣiṇato marut || 26 || gandhānvitadvirephaughaśabditāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ || āvirbhūtāstripathagā vāriṇārdrīkṛtā dvijāḥ || 27 || tadanaṃtaramevāsau nārado brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || tapaḥprabhāvanirvyūḍha vimānavaraśāyinīm || 28 || ratnacāmarahastābhirdivyastrībhiḥ suśobhitām || alaṃkṛtāṃ vahuvidhairmaṇiratnaprasādhanaiḥ || 29 || divyamālyāṃbaradharāṃ divyagandhānulepanām || ramyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ ghaṭitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 2.2.16.30 || tejomaṇḍalasaṃvītāṃ parito harṣadāmapi || ādāya narasiṃhasya pratyarcāṃ pratyupasthitaḥ || 31 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣitāḥ sarve rājā rājānuyāyinaḥ || antarddhānaṃ gato devo nāradenoddhṛtaḥ kimu || 32 || menire harṣitātmānaḥ praśaśaṃsuśca taṃ munim || nirūpya saṃnidhisthāṃ tu narasiṃhākṛtiṃ dvijāḥ || ādyamūrternṛsiṃhasya pratimāmatha menire || 33 || pratyutthāya tato rājā prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya hariṃ jagāma śirasā mahīm || 34 || śraddhāsaṃpattiyogyena saṃbhāreṇa nṛpājñayā || prasthāpayāmāsa muniḥ prāsādaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam || 35 || pratimāṃ devadevasya sumuhūrte dvijottamāḥ || dharāramābhyāṃ sahitāṃ ratnavedyāṃ pratiṣṭhitām|| yogārūḍhatanuṃ rājā indradyumno'tha tuṣṭuve || 36 || vaiṣṇavairbrāhmaṇairbhūpairnāradena ca dhīmatā|| guhyopaniṣadaiḥ smārtaiḥ stotraiḥ śāstrairmudānvitaiḥ || 37 || || indradyumna uvāca || || ekānekasthūlasūkṣmāṇumūrte vyomātīta vyomarūpaikarūpa || vyomākāra vyāpaka vyomasaṃstha vyomārūḍha vyomakeśābjayone || 38 || duḥkhāṃbhodhestrāhi māṃ divyasiṃha prādurbhūtānekakoṭyarkadhāman || nityāsanno dūrasaṃstho na dūro nāsanno vā bodhyabodhātmabhāva || 39 || jñeyajñeyo jñānagamyo'pyagamyo māyātīto mānameyo'numānāt || kṛtsnasyādiḥ kṛtsnakarttānumaṃtā pātā harttā viśvasākṣinnamaste || 2.2.16.40 || duḥkhadhvaṃsasyaikahetuṃ na hetuṃ bhettuṃ chettuṃ saṃśayānagrajātam || jyotīrūpa jñānarūpa prakāśa stomavyūhākāra nirmāṇaheto || 41 || tvatpādabje bhaktimagryāṃ sadā me dehi svāminmūlabhūtāṃ caturṇām || śrautaiḥ smārtairnityayuktā janāste dīnāstiṣṭhantyatra baddhā bhavābdhau || 42 || anantapādaṃ bahuhastanetramanaṃtakarṇaṃ kakubhaughavastram || divāniśānāthasukuṇḍalāḍhyaṃ nakṣatramālā kṛtacāruhāram || 43 || tvāmadbhutaṃ divyanṛsiṃhamūrtiṃ bhakteṣṭapūrtiṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || yatpādapadma hi pitāmahasya kirīṭaratnairvikacatvameti||44|| yadīyapādābjayugāṃtabhūmau luṭhecchiro yasya hi pāṃcabhautam || taddivyapādaṃ śirasā vahaṃti surendranāryaḥ khalu taṃ namāmi || 45 || taddivyasiṃhaṃ hatapāpasaṃghaṃ pādāśritānāṃ karuṇābdhisiṃham || pādā'bjasaṃghaṭṭavighaṭṭamānabrahmāṃḍabhāṃḍaṃ praṇamāmi caṇḍam || 46 || saṭācchaṭākaṃpanaśīryamāṇaghanaughavidrāvitapāpasaṃgham || caṃḍāṭṭahāsāṃtaritābdaśabdaṃ trilokagarbhaṃ nṛhariṃ namāmi || 47 || namaste namaste namaste'dya viṣṇo paritrāhi dīnānukaṃpinnanātham || bhavaṃtaṃ samāsādya me dehabandho murāre na saṃsārakārāgṛhe'stu || 48 || hayamedhasahasrāṃte yathā tvāṃ carmacakṣuṣā || divyarūpaṃ prapaśyāmi tathānukrośaya prabho || 49 || yathā cejyāsahasraṃ me nirvighnaṃ tatsamāpyate || yajñeśa tvatprasādānme tathā sānnidhyamastu te || 2.2.16.50 || koṭayaḥ pāparāśīnāṃ kṣayaṃ yāṃti yathā prabho || dharmārthakāmā hastasthā naiṣāṃ citraṃ stuvaṃti ye || mokṣasya bhājanaṃ viṣṇo te narā ye tavāśrayāḥ || 51 || stutvetthaṃ divya siṃhaṃ taṃ bhūpatirhaṣṭamānasaḥ || daṇḍapātapraṇāmena jagāma dharaṇīṃ muhuḥ || 52 || || jaiminiruvāca || || kṣetraṃ tannarasiṃhasya brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā || indradyumnānugrahāya sarvalokahitāya ca || 53 || paśyaṃti ye nṛsiṃhaṃ taṃ śaṃbhunā saha saṃsthitam || na dehabandhaṃ te viprāḥ prāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || || 54 || manasā vāṃchitaṃ yadyatprāpnuvaṃti tato'dhikam || stotreṇānena ye divyasiṃharūpaṃ stuvaṃti vai || 55 || sarvakāmaprado devastasya muktiṃ prayacchati || jyeṣṭhaśukladvādaśī yā svātīnakṣatrasaṃyutā || 56 || tasyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ kṣetre divyasiṃho maharṣiṇā || sutena brahmaṇaḥ sākṣāttatra paśyaṃti taṃ ca ye || 57 || vājimedhasahasrasya phalaṃ sāgraṃ labhaṃti te || pañcāmṛtairvā kṣīreṇa nārikelarasena vā || 58 || snāpayaṃti narā ye vai athavā gandhavāriṇā || pūjayitvā mahāsiṃhamupacāraiḥ sapāyasaiḥ || 59 || japākusumamālyaiśca gandhamālyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ || dhūpadīpaiḥ sakarpūraistāṃbūlairatiśobhanaiḥ || 2.2.16.60 || sugīrbhiḥ stutipāṭhaiśca jayaśabdaistathoccakai || pradakṣiṇapraṇāmaiśca dānairbrāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ || santoṣya narasiṃhaṃ taṃ brahmalokamavāpnuyāt || 61 || vaiśākhasya caturdaśyāṃ saurivāre'nilarkṣake || ādyāvatāraḥ siṃhasya
