pradoṣasamaye dvijāḥ ||62|| tasyāṃ saṃpūjya vidhivannarasiṃhaṃ samāhitaḥ || janmakoṭisahasraistu pāparāśiḥ susaṃcitaḥ || dahyate tatkṣaṇādeva tūlarāśirivāgninā || 63 || dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā namaskṛtvā praṇipatya ca bhaktitaḥ || stutvā vimucyate pāpairnirmokena bhujaṃgavat || 64 || na tasya vyādhayaḥ saṃti na śokā nādhayastathā || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti hayamedhaphalaṃ tathā || 65 || samīpe tasya bho viprā yajanaṃ dānameva ca || anyāni puṇyakarmāṇi kṛtāni ca sakṛnnaraiḥ || koṭikoṭiguṇāni syurnarasiṃhaprasādataḥ || 66 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<2.2.17>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || pratiṣṭhite nārasiṃhe kṣetre tasminnarādhipaḥ || kiṃ cakāra mune brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ tu tat || 1 || || jaiminiruvāca || || indrādīṃstridaśānsarvānnyamantrayata pūrvataḥ || tataḥ sa mantrayāmāsa ṛṣīnviprānsahasraśaḥ || 2 || adhyetṝṃścaturo vedānsaṣaḍaṃgapadakramaiḥ || yajñavidyāsu kuśalānmīmāṃsāpariniṣṭhitān || 3 || sabhāṣyakalpasūtraistu pariniṣṭhitakarmiṇaḥ || aṣṭādaśasu vidyāsu kuśalāndharmakovidān || 4 || sadācārāvadātāṃśca kulīnānsatyavādinaḥ || vaiṣṇavāṃśca viśeṣeṇa maṃtrayāmāsa sādaram || 5 || trailokye ye ca rājānaḥ siddhāḥ saptarṣayo dvijāḥ || sacchūdrā vaṇijo dvīpapatayaśca nimaṃtritāḥ || 6 || krośadvayamitā viprāḥ sabhāsīttasya bhūpateḥ || pāṣāṇaghaṭitā soccā sudhayā sānulepitā || 7 || kvacidratnamayī bhūmiḥ kvacitkāṃcananirmitā || sphāṭikī rājatī caiva yathāyogyaṃ kṛtasthalī|| 8 || staṃbhai ratnamayaiḥ proccairdukūlapariveṣṭitaiḥ || cārucaṃdrātapāḍhyā tu gandhamālyaiḥ sacāmaraiḥ || 9 || muktādāmāṃtarasthaiśca cāruvātāyanā śubhā || kṛṣṇāgurusnehasiktā śrīkhaṇḍasalilokṣitā || 2.2.17.10 || sarvarttukusumākīrṇā prāṃtopavanasaṃvṛtā || vāpyaḥ sphaṭikasopānāḥ padmakadvāramaṃḍitāḥ || 11 || cakravākaiḥ plavairhaṃsaiḥ sārasairmadhurasvanaiḥ || vyāptāṃtarāḥ svacchaśītasugaṃdhamadhurāṃbhasaḥ || 12 || paritaḥ śataśastasyāḥ sukhāvataraṇā dvijāḥ || upacchāyāviracanāḥ śobhamānāḥ samaṃtataḥ || 13 || yajñaśālā maruttasya yathāsīdbho dvijottamāḥ || tatheṃdradyumnabhūpasya racitā viśvakarmaṇā || 14 || śubhe'hni śubhanakṣatre vāsayitvā sabhāsadaḥ || rājñaḥ siṃhāsanāsīnāndṛṣṭvāsīnānṛṣīnapi || 15 || sasiddhānbrahmarṣigaṇānbahumūlyakuthasthitān || devānkāṃcanapīṭhasthānyathāyogyamatha dvijān || 16 || varāsanasthānanyāṃśca yathādeśaṃ sukhasthitān || madhye nṛpāṇāṃ devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca śacīpatim || 17 || sāmrājyalakṣaṇe svasya ratnasiṃhāsane sthitam || divyairmālyaistathā gaṃdhairvāsobhirviṣṭarādibhiḥ || 18 || purodhasā samaṃ pūrvamarcayāmāsa ṛddhimat || vinīto dīnavattasya cakre pūjāṃ tathā nṛpaḥ || 19 || āścaryaṃ manyate'syāsau trailokyeśo'pi tadyathā || tataḥ siddhāndevamunīnacaryanniṃdravattadā || 2.2.17.20 || vismayaṃ janayāmāsa kuverasyāpyadhiśriyaḥ || tato devānsamānarca prabhūtasvasvasaṃpadaḥ || 21 || upacārairmahīnāthaḥ samyagavyagramānasaḥ || rājñaḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa rājayogyaiḥ paricchadaiḥ || 22 || yathā te menire bhūpā bhavāmaḥ sāṃprataṃ vayam || satyaṃ rājyaṃ kramātprāptaṃ nedṛśaśca paricchadaḥ || 23 || ānarca vaiṣṇavānbhūya upacāraiḥ samānayan|| śāṃtā api yathā citraṃ menire viṣayāgamam || 24 || tato viprānbāhujātānvaiśyānmunipuraḥsaram || samyakprapūjayāmāsa sattvodrikto mahīpatiḥ || 25 || anyāṃśca sacivadvārā pūjayitvā sasaṃbhramaḥ || dṛṣṭaḥ sa vinayānnamraḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭastathā || 26 || maheṃdramuccairāhedaṃ nāradena purodhasā || 27 || || indradyumna uvāca || || tava prasādāddeveśa icchāmīdaṃ prasīda me || kratunā hayamedhena prayakṣye yajñapūruṣam|| 28 || anujānīhi māṃ deva kratūnāmīśvaro bhavān || tvadājñāpālakāḥ sarve trailokye nivasaṃti ye || 29 || yāvatkratusahasrasya saṃsthā ca bhavati prabho || tāvattvaṃ tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ sadomadhyagato vasa || 2.2.17.30 || yaṣṭumicchāmi deveśa nāhaṃ tvatpadalipsayā || sarveṣāṃ vetsi deveśa manovṛttiṃ sadā prabho || 31 || yuṣmākaṃ pūrvadṛṣṭo'tra vapuṣmānmādhavaḥ prabhuḥ || upāsanāyāṃ so'yaṃ yo vālukābhistirodadhe || 32 || tasya bhūyaḥ prakāśārthaṃ vājimedhasahasrakam|| kariṣye vacanādiṃdra caturāsyasya śāsanāt || punaḥ prakāśite tasmiñchreyo vo'pi bhaviṣyati || 33 || iti vijñāpite rājñā maheṃdrapramukhāḥ surāḥ || antarddhānotaraṃ yā ca śrutā pūrvaṃ sarasvatī || 34 || aśarīrāṃ smaraṃtastāmidaṃ procuḥ praharṣitāḥ || indradyumna mahātmāsi satyaṃ satyavato bhuvi || 35 || tacceṣṭitaṃ purāsmābhiranvabhāvi bhaviṣyakam || sahāyāste bhaviṣyāmaḥ kārye trailokyapāvane ||36|| sraṣṭā sa jagatāṃ yatra udyuktaḥ svayameva hi || atraivovāca bhagavānasmākamapi bhūtale || 37 || praviśaṃstadanukrośavaśādbhūyaḥ prakāśanam || kariṣye dāravaṃ dehamityetatpariniṣṭhitam || 38 || nātrāsmākaṃ vyalīkaṃ tu neṃdrasya ca mahīpate || asmaddiṣṭasamudyogastava naḥ prītikārakaḥ || 39 || sukhaṃ yajasva rājeṃdra vaikuṃṭhaṃ bhaktavatsalam || kratunā hayamedhena sahasraparivartinā || 2.2.17.40 || durārādhyo hi bhagavānasmākaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ || vayamapyatra devatvaṃ tyaktvā bhakti parāyaṇāḥ || 41 || ārādhayāmaḥ kṣetresminvinītā nararūpiṇaḥ || priyaṃ hi mānuṣe loke karma siddhyati vai kṛtam || 42 || || jaiminiruvāca || || ityukte tridaśaiḥ seṃdraiḥ parituṣṭāṃtarātmanā || āraṃbhārthaṃ krato rājā bhagavaṃtamapūjayat || 43 || upacārasahasraistu yathāvatpratipāditaiḥ || tataḥ pitṛgaṇānrājā nirūpya śraddhayānvitaḥ || 44 || sadogṛhagatānviprānyājñikānsamalaṃkṛtān || kṛtveṣṭadevaṃ purato vaikuṃṭhaṃ sāgnihotrakam || 45 || ākāṃkṣankalpitaṃ lagnaṃ saṃvṛtte svastivācane || upasthitaḥ sapatnīkaḥ śuddhamāṃgalyaveṣadhṛk || 46 || svasti vācya dvijāñchuddhānpuṇyāhaṃ vṛddhikarma ca || tataḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro varayāmāsa ṛtvijaḥ || 47 || vṛtāste tu sapatnīkaṃ dīkṣayaṃto nṛpottamam || vihṛtya dīkṣaṇāyeṣṭānnyayajansabhyacoditāḥ || 48 || praṇīya taṃ prajvalaṃtaṃ vedyāmāhavanīyakam || trailokyamaṃgalakaraṃ kiṃ sākṣādvaiṣṇavaṃ mahaḥ || 49 || suprokṣitaṃ cābhimaṃtrya anujñāpya digīśvarān || mumucuste hayaṃ mukhyamaṃgeṣu śubhalakṣaṇam || 2.2.17.50 || tataḥ sa dīkṣito rājā vāgyato rauravīṃ tvacam || adhiṣṭhāya sadomadhye mṛtyuṃjaya iva sthitaḥ || 51 || nimaṃtritānāṃ muktyarthaṃ cakṣuṣā saṃdideśa vai || surāṇāṃ ratnapātrāṇi mahārghāṇi nṛpājñayā || 52 || sacivaḥ kārayāmāsa bhojanāya samṛddhimat || śuddhasauvarṇapātrāṇi munīnāṃ ca mahīkṣitām || 53 || dvijānāṃ bhojanārthāya navāni pratyahaṃ dvijāḥ || kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ viprā rājatāni śubhāni ca || 54 || kāṃsyanirmalapātrāṇi śūdrāṇāṃ bhojanāya vai || ahanyahani pātrāṇi bhojanāṃte dvijottamāḥ || 55 || ākareṣu prapātyaṃte procchiṣṭadalavajjanaiḥ || tatra yajñotsave ye vai bhojanāya nimaṃtritāḥ || 56 || teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca prapautrāścaiva saṃtatiḥ || nityaṃ paṃcarasānnāni bahumānapuraḥsaram || || 57 || ādṛtairbhojitā rājña iṃdradyumnasya śāsanāt || kuṭuṃbavatsthitāstatra saṃsthā yāvanmahākratoḥ || 58 || yaddeśīyā janāsteṣāmadhiṣṭhātā ca tānnṛpaḥ || nṛpāṇāmanusaṃdhātā iṃdradyumnaprayācitaḥ || 59 || nāradaḥ samadarśī tu paropakṛtilolupaḥ || iṃdrādīnāṃ sureṃdrāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ nṛpottamaḥ ||2.2.17.60|| svayaṃ narapatiścaryāṃ cakāra kratupūrttaye || ṣaḍvidhānyannapānāni saṃskṛtāni dvidhā naraiḥ || 61 || devānāṃ bhojane tatra maṃtrataṃtraviśāradaiḥ || martyānāṃ nala vidyāyāṃ kuśalaiḥ saṃskṛtāni vai || 62 || kṣutpipāsānabhijñā hi sudhāhārā divaukasaḥ || teṣāmapi apūrvatvādāścaryaṃ taddhi bhojanam || 63 || narāṇāṃ durlabhaṃ martya iṃdradyumnagṛhe'śanam|| indradyumnasya ceṃdrasya viśeṣo martyavāsitā || 64 || atyadbhutakaraṃ hyetatpratyahaṃ ca navaṃ navam || saṃmānanādarāvṛddhirbhojyasya dvijasattamāḥ || 65 || anyonyasparddhayaivātra pravarddhate parasparam || sugaṃdhasumanomālyakastūryādipralepanam || 66 || citrasūkṣmadukūlāni sopadhānāsanāni ca || ratnapalyaṃkikā śayyā ratnadaṃḍaprakīrṇakam || 67 || jātīlavaṃgakarpūrairnāgavallīdalāni ca || manoharāṇi gītāni nṛtyāni vividhāni ca || 68|| bharatasya muneḥ śikṣāpaṃḍitai racitāni ca || svasvavaṃśayaśo'bhijñāḥ śataśaḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ || 69 || etānyanyāni vastūni durlabhānyapi yāni vai || tridaśāścāpi martyāścānvabhujyaṃta susādaram || 2.2.17.70 || ekato'nyatra citrāṇi na ca hīnāni kutracit || pātālavāsināṃ cāpi bhojanaṃ vai sudhādhikam || 71 || yadbhuktvā nānuvāñchanti pātālagamanaṃ hi te || purāṇi yāni pātāle ratnaughālokitāni ca || 72 || vinā sūryaprakāśena tādṛśānyeva bhūpatiḥ || dadau teṣāṃ nivāsāya yeṣu pātālabuddhayaḥ || 73 || sukhāsīnāśca krīḍaṃto bhuṃjānā śerate mudā || devānāmapi nānyatra bhūmisparśanamasti vai || 74 || indradyumnapure tatra svargādapi manohare || yadṛcchayā sukhakrīḍāsaktā no tatyajurbhuvam || || 75 || abhilāṣopajātaṃ tu sukhaṃ svarge vadaṃti hi || anicchayāpi bho viprāḥ sukhaṃ sarvatra tatra vai || 76 || ādṛtya yatnānmanyaṃte bhojyaṃ te sādaraṃ narāḥ || na yācitaḥ kopi janaḥ kuto vā syātparāṅmukhaḥ || 77 || rājādhirājaveśmāni janānāṃ svagṛhaiḥ samam || tadāsītsvagṛhe teṣāṃ na sadā sarvasaṃbhavaḥ || 78 || tatra yatkāmanātītaṃ tadvastu sulabhaṃ bahu || itthaṃ pravartite yajñe yajñeśaprītaye mudā || 79 || pṛthivī hṛtasarvasvā vājimedhesya bhūpateḥ || yā pūrvaṃ sābhavadbhūyaḥ svarṇavṛṣṭisubhūṣitā || 2.2.17.80 || itthaṃ pravṛtte lokānāṃ tatra trailokyavāsinām || dānasaṃmānabhojyānāṃ vidhau vidhivato'nvaham || 81 || aśvamedhaṃ prati janā jagurgāthāḥ parasparam || nedṛgyāgasya saṃbhāro vidheḥ śāstrapracoditaḥ || 82 || iṃdradyumnasya rājarṣerna bhūto na bhaviṣyati || na yācitāro'dātāro mitho yatra nimaṃtritāḥ || 83 || na kāmabhaṃgo yatrāsīddevānāmapi bho dvijāḥ || īdṛksamṛddhiḥ kraturāṭ pravṛtto bhūpatestadā || 84 || adhiśraddhaḥ susaṃpannaḥ pūrvasmādaparo'bhavat || smṛtikārāḥ kalpakārāstathā śāstrapraṇetṛkāḥ || 85 || yajñānuṣṭhānakuśalāḥ sadācārāvataṃsakāḥ || agnyādhānādyavabhṛthapracāramanupūrvaśaḥ || 86 || kratuḥ sadasyānumate nṛpateḥ prītaye dvijāḥ || na maṃtrāḥ svarato hīnā varṇato vāpi karhicit || 87 || ye vai vidhividhātāraste vai karmapracārakāḥ || prāyaścittanimittena prāyaścittanibaṃdhanāt || 88 || karmopaghāto no tatra yoginaḥ karmayoginaḥ || yatra saptarṣayo divyāḥ sadasyāḥ kratusākṣiṇaḥ ||69|| pracārayaṃti karmāṇi guṇadoṣavibhāginaḥ || yājñavalkyādayaste'tra munayastvṛtvijo vṛtāḥ || 2.2.17.90 || sadogatāste munayaḥ parasparakathāṃtare || vākovākyāni sūktāni guhyopaniṣadāni ca || 91 || gāthāḥ paurāṇikīrviprā viṣṇubhaktipuraḥsarāḥ || caritāni hareḥ sarvakalmaṣaughaharāṇi ca || 92 || tatra saṃvartayāmāsuste sabhāyāṃ mahīkṣitaḥ || tasya yajñe haviḥ prāśuḥ pratyakṣaṃ vahnimadhyagāḥ || 93 || muditāstridaśā viprā maheṃdrapramukhāmakhe || cirapravāsino devā nāsmaraṃtāmarāvatīm || 94 || amṛtaṃ hi havisteṣāṃ kalpitaṃ brahmaṇā purā || tatprāśya muditā devā vīryavantaścirāyuṣaḥ || 95 || yāgānuṣṭhānaviṣayādanyatra viṣayānbahūn || indradyumnena racitānsamastānupabhuṃjate || 96 || tatra ye nāgarājānaḥ pātālatalavāsinaḥ || tato'dhikānmartyaloke viṣayānupabhuṃjate || 97 || pātālagamanaṃ te vai nehaṃte manasā dhuvam || itthaṃ pravartito yajñastrailokyaprītikārakaḥ || 98 || indradyumnasya nṛpateḥ kṣetre'sminpuruṣottame || jagadīśaprasādāya pitāmahanideśataḥ || 99 || ekonaṃ kramataḥ saṃsthāmavāpa pṛthivīpatiḥ || sahasraṃ hayamedhasya yathāvadvidhicoditam || 2.2.17.100 || tataḥ sāhasrike yajñe vājimedhe mahīpatiḥ || dinedine divyagatirbabhūva nṛpatistadā || 101 || sutyāyāḥ sapta divasādyā rātrirabhavatpurā || tasyāsturīyaprahare dadhyau sa viṣṇumavyayam || 102 || dhyāne tasmindadarśāsau mahābhāgyavaśānnṛpaḥ || pratyakṣamiva sa śvetadvīpaṃ sphaṭikanirmitam || 103 || samaṃtātparivāryainaṃ tiṣṭhaṃtaṃ kṣīrasāgaram || mahākalpadrumaiḥ puṣpagaṃdhāmodidigaṃtaraiḥ || 104 || phalapallavavalkeṣu bahiraṃtaśca sarvaśaḥ || śaṃkhacakrāṃkitaiḥ śubhraiḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ || 105 || mahāmaṃjiṣṭhavarṇaiśca mūrtibhistairmuradviṣaḥ || tanmadhye ghaṭitaṃ divyamaṇibhirmaṃḍapottamam || 106 || madhyasthasūryavadbhāsiratnasiṃhāsanojjvalam || kṣīrābdhiśītakallolamaṃdavātamanoharam || || 107 || tanmadhye dadṛśe devaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 108 || sarvalāvaṇyabhavanaṃ sauṃdaryaśrīniketanam || nirbhartsayaṃtaṃ vapuṣā pinaddhaṃ divyabhūṣaṇam || 109 || dakṣapārśve sthitaṃ tatra anaṃtaṃ dharaṇīdharam || koṭicandrapratīkāśaṃ himādrisadṛśaprabham || 2.2.17.110 || phaṇāmukuṭavistāracchatrībhūtaṃ manoharam || maṇikuṃḍalayugmāṃkaṃ cārunīlanicolakam || 111 || halalāṃgalaśaṃkhārisphuradbāhucatuṣṭayam|| hārakeyūravalaya mudrikābhiralaṃkṛtam || 112 || mekhalākaṭisūtrāḍhyaṃ divyaratnaprasādhanam || divyahālākṣībamūrtiṃ cāruhāsaṃ sunetrakam || 113 || dakṣapārśvasthitāṃ cāsya lakṣmīṃ tāṃ śubhalakṣaṇām || varābhayābjahastāṃ vai kuṃkumābhāṃ sulocanām || 114 || trailokyayuvatīvṛndadṛṣṭāṃtādbhutavigrahām || dadarśa padmāsanagāṃ lāvaṇyāṃbudhiputrikām || 115 || pitāmahaṃ ca dadṛśe purato'sya kṛtāṃjalim || vāmapārśvasthitaṃ cakraṃ nānāmaṇimayaṃ vibhoḥ || 116 || sanakādyairmunīṃdraistaṃ stūyamānaṃ jagadgurum || dṛṣṭvā svapne sa rājā vai prahṛṣṭo dvijasattamāḥ || 117 || adṛṣṭapūrvarūpaṃ taṃ jyotirmayamanaṃtakam || tuṣṭāva tatra dhyānastho harṣagadgadayā girā || 118 || || indradyumna uvāca || || namaste jagadādhāra jagadātmannamo'stu te || kaivalyatriguṇātīta guṇāṃjana namo'stu te || 119 || suśuddhanirmalajñānasvarūpāya namo'stu te || śabdabrahmābhidhānāya jagadrūpāya te namaḥ || 2.2.17.120 || saṃsārapatitaśrāṃta duḥkhadhvaṃsa namo'stu te || durbhedyahṛdayagraṃthibhedakāya namo'stu te || 121 || dvisaptabhuvanāgāramūlastaṃbhāya te namaḥ || brahmāṃḍakoṭighaṭanāśilpine cakriṇe namaḥ ||122|| karuṇāmṛtapāthodhisudhādhāmne namo namaḥ || dīnoddhāraikaguhyāya kṛpāpāthodhaye namaḥ || 123 || prakāśakānāṃ sūryādijyotiṣāṃ jyotiṣe namaḥ || pratisvasvanadīptāya antaḥpāpāgnaye namaḥ || 124 || pāvakāya pavitrāya pavitrāṇāṃ namo namaḥ || gariṣṭhāya variṣṭhāya drāghiṣṭhāya namo namaḥ || 125 || nediṣṭhāya daviṣṭhāya kṣodiṣṭhāya namo namaḥ || vareṇyāya supuṇyāya nārāyaṇa namo'stu te || 126 || paritrāhi jagannātha dīnabandho namo'stu te || nistīrṇo'haṃ bhavāṃbhodhiṃ prāpya tvāṃ taraṇiṃ sukhām || 127 || tvayi dṛṣṭe ramānātha kleśā vyapagatā mama || cidānaṃdasvarūpaṃ tvāṃ prāptānāṃ duḥkhasaṃkṣayaḥ || 128 || dhruvaṃ nātha samutpannaparamānaṃdahetukam || trāhi trāhi bhavāṃbhodhimagnaṃ māṃ dīnacetasam || 129 || madhyāhnārkodite vyomni kutaḥ saṃtamasodayaḥ || dhyānasthitaḥ stuvannevaṃ praṇamya jagadīśvaram || 2.2.17.130 || dhyānāvasāne sa punaḥ svayaṃ jāgradabudhyata || svapnāṃta indradyumno'pi sasmārātmānamātmanā || 131 || atyadbhutamidaṃ svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca nṛpakuṃjaraḥ || mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ hayamedhakratostathā || 132 || sahasraṃ saphalaṃ caiva svabhāgyaṃ samupasthitam || na hi devarṣivacanaṃ vṛthā bhavati karhicit || 133 || pratyakṣaṃ me kathaṃ nāthaḥ svayamatra bhaviṣyati || iti ciṃtākulo rātriśeṣaṃ nītvā viśāṃpatiḥ || 134 || śaśaṃsa nāradasyāgre yathā svapno'nvabhūyata || sa cāpi nāradaḥ prāha śokaste vigato nṛpa || 135 || aruṇodayakāle hi bhagavaṃtaṃ dadarśa yat || daśāhātphaladaḥ svapnastasminkāle nṛpottama || 136 || kratvaṃte bhagavānatra pratyakṣaste bhaviṣyati || yadāha madgirā tvāṃ hi carācaragururvidhiḥ || 137 || so'pi tvayā jagatsraṣṭā svapne'sminnavalokitaḥ || tadanuṣṭhīyatāṃ yajñaḥ parāgre na prakāśaya || 138 || svapno'yaṃ nṛpaśārdūla durbodhācarito hareḥ || kiṃtu bhāgyavatastveva svapnastādṛkprajāyate || 139 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || cha ||
<2.2.18>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || tataḥ pravavṛte sutyā nṛpatervājimedhikā || tasyāṃ trailokyamabhavadekasadmanibhaṃ dvijāḥ || 1 || śāstraiḥ stotrairdivaspṛgbhirvarṇakramasamujjvalaiḥ || yathāpadasvaranyāsairanye śabdāstirohitāḥ || 2 || dīnebhyo'vāritaṃ tatra dīyante vāñchitāni vai || naṭanarttakasūtānāṃ sābhūtkalpadrumopamā || 3 || tanmadhye'vabhṛthe snātuṃ kṛtā yatropakārikā || dakṣiṇe taṭabhūdeśe bilveśvarasamīpataḥ || 4 || niyuktāḥ sevakā rājñā sasaṃbhramamupasthitāḥ || nyavedayanta nṛpatiṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā dvijāḥ || 5 || deva dṛṣṭo mahānvṛkṣastaṭabhūmau mahodadheḥ || praviṣṭāgrasamudrāṃtaḥ kallolaplavamūlakaḥ || 6 || maṃjiṣṭhavarṇaḥ sarvatra śaṃkhacakrāṃkitaḥ plavan || snānaveśmasamīpe'sau dṛṣṭo'smābhiḥ paro'dbhutaḥ || 7 || na dṛṣṭapūrvo vṛkṣo'yamudyatsūryanibhoṃ'śunā || gaṃdhena vāsayansarvā taṭabhūmiṃ sugaṃdhinā || 8 || drumaḥ sādhāraṇo nāyaṃ lakṣyate devabhūruhaḥ || kaściddevastaruvyājādāgato lakṣyate dhuvam || 9 || niyuktānāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā rājā nāradamabravīt || tatkiṃ nimittaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ taruśreṣṭhaṃ vadaṃti te || 2.2.18.10 || nāradaḥ prahasanvākyamuvāca nṛpasattamam || pūrṇāhutiḥ samāpnotu yathā syātsaphalaḥ kratuḥ || 11 || upasthitaṃ te tadbhāgyaṃ svapne yaddṛṣṭavānpurā || śvetadvīpe viśvamūrtirdṛṣṭo yo viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 12 || tadaṃgaskhalitaṃ roma tarutvamupapadyate || aṃśāvatāraḥ sthāsnuryaḥ pṛthivyāṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 13 || tadrūpāvataraṃ yāti bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || drumo hyapauruṣo yosau bhājanaṃ nāsya darśane || 14 || tvāmṛte puruṣavyāghra pṛthivyāṃ nṛpasattama || tvadbhāgyavaśataḥ sarvalokānāṃ nayanātithiḥ || 15 || bhaviṣyati mahārāja sarvakalmaṣanāśanaḥ || samāpyāvabhṛthasnānaṃ taṭāṃte saritāṃ pateḥ || 16 || utsavaṃ sumahatkṛtvā kṛtakautukamaṃgalam || mahāvedyāṃ sthāpayātra yajñeśaṃ tarurūpiṇam || 17 || vicāryetthaṃ mudā yuktau tāvubhau nṛpanāradau || susamṛddhau tatra yātau yatrāsau bhagavaddrumaḥ || || 18 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣitāḥ sarve brahma sākṣādupasthitam || menire janmasāphalyaṃ jīvanmuktā mahodayāḥ || 19 || indradyumno'pi nṛpatirmamajjāmṛtasāgare || svapne dṛṣṭvā jagannāthaṃ yathāsau bhagavatpriyaḥ || 2.2.18.20 || tathā dadarśa taṃ vṛkṣaṃ cakṣuḥśākhaṃ caturbhujam || svakaṃ śramaṃ manyamānaḥ saphalaṃ nṛpasattamaḥ || || 21 || jahau śokaṃ nīlamaṇimādhavāṃtardhijaṃ dvijāḥ || punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyainaṃ harṣāśrunayano nṛpaḥ || 22 || dvijairāhārayāmāsa taruṃ kallolalolitam || śaṃkhakāhālamurajaḍhakkāpaṭahaniḥsvanaiḥ || 23 || gītavāditraninadairjayaśabdaiḥ sahasraśaḥ || sugaṃdhipuṣpāṃjalibhirākāśātpatitairmuhuḥ || 24|| parito dhūpapātraiśca kṛṣṇāgurusudhūpitaiḥ || veśyābhiryauvanonmattasurūpābhiḥ pracālitaiḥ || 25 || ratnadaṇḍaprakīrṇaiśca vījyamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ || patākābhirdivyapaṭṭadukūlābhiḥ suśobhitam || 26 || rājarṣirājavṛndaiśca turagaiḥ pattibhirvṛtam || māgadhairvaṃdyamānaṃ tu stūyamānaṃ maharṣibhiḥ ||27|| ṛtvigbhirbrāhmaṇaiścaiva vidvadbhiḥ śrotriyaistathā || rājanyairvaiśyakulajaiḥ sacchūdraiḥ paricāritam || 28 || stotrairbahuvidhaiḥ śrautaiḥ smārtaiḥ paurāṇikaistathā || stūyamānaṃ taruṃ viṣṇorbhūrloke pariveṣṭitam ||29|| sraggandhālaṃkṛtaṃ divyaṃ mahāvedīṃ vininyatuḥ|| vitānavaracitrāyāṃ veṣṭitāyāṃ niraṃtaram ||2.2.18.30|| vedyāṃ taṃ sthāpayāmāsuriṃdradyumnasya śāsanāt || vacasā nāradasyainaṃ pūjayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || 31 || sahasrairupacārāṇāṃ divyarūpairnṛpottamaḥ || pūjāvasāne papraccha nāradaṃ munisattamam ||32|| kīdṛśyaḥ pratimā viṣṇorghaṭayiṣyati kaḥ punaḥ || tacchrutvā taṃ muniḥ prāha aciṃtyamahimā guruḥ || 33|| ko veda tasya ceṣṭāṃ vai sarvalokottarāṃ nṛpa || sraṣṭā yo jagatāṃ tasyāpyeṣā saṃśayagocarā || 34 || vicārayaṃtau tāvitthaṃ yāvannāradapārthivau || aśarīrā tato vāṇī śuśruve cāṃtarikṣataḥ || 35 || tatra vismayamānānāṃ sarveṣāmeva śṛṇvatām || apauruṣeyo bhagavānavicārapathe sthitaḥ || 36 || suguptāyāṃ mahāvedyāṃ svayaṃ so'vatariṣyati || pracchādyatāṃ dinānyeṣā yāvatpaṃcadaśāni vai || 37 || upasthito'yaṃ yo vṛddhaḥ śastrapāṇistu varddhakiḥ || enamaṃtaḥ praveśyaiva dvāraṃ badhnaṃtu yatnataḥ || 38 || bahirvādyāni kurvaṃtu yāvattu ghaṭanā bhavet || śruto hi ghaṭanāśabdo bādhiryāṃdhatvadāyakaḥ || 39 || narake vasatiṃ caiva kuryātsaṃtānanāśanam || nāṃtaḥpraveśanaṃ kuryānna paśyecca kadācana ||2.2.18.40|| niyuktādanyaḥ paśyeccedrājño rāṣṭrasya caiva ha || draṣṭuścāpi mahābhītiraṃdhatā cakṣuṣoryuge || 41 || tasmānnāvekṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yāvatpratimanirmitiḥ || nirvyūḍhastu svayaṃ daivaḥ kṛtyāṃte tu vadiṣyati || 42 || yatkāryaṃ prayatnena sarvalokasukhāvaham || tacchrutvā nāradādyāste yathoktaṃ viṣṇunā svayam || 43 || cikīrṣaṃti tathā karttuṃ tatrāyātaśca varddhakiḥ || provāca nṛpatiṃ so'tha svapne dṛṣṭāstu yāstvayā || || 44 || tā evāhaṃ ghaṭiṣyāmi dāruṇā divyarūpiṇā || ityuktvāṃtardadhe vedyāṃ vṛddhavarddhakirūpadhṛk || 45 || vaṃcanārthaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇo vibhuḥ || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
<2.2.19>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālastathā kṛtvāṃ'tarikṣagā || yaduvāca girāṃ devī tadvatparicacāra ha || 1 || evaṃ dinedine yāte divyagaṃdho'nubhūyate || pārijātaprasūnānāṃ vṛṣṭirmartyeṣu durlabhā || 2 || divyasaṃgītanādaśca gītāni rucirāṇi ca || svargaṃgājalavṛṣṭiśca sūkṣmabiṃdusuśobhanā || 3 || airāvatādināgānāṃ madagaṃdho vanadvipaiḥ || duḥsahaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sukhakāryanubhūyate || 4 || yajñārthamāgatā devāste sarve vigatajvarāḥ || āvirbhūtaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā upāsāṃcakrire dvijāḥ || 5 || yathā hi mādhavaṃ pūrvaṃ tathā taṃ viṣṇuśākhinam || upāsanāsu devānāṃ divyacihnāni jajñire || 6 || nirvavāha svayaṃ devaḥ kramātpaṃcadaśe dine || caturmūrtiḥ sa bhagavānyathā pūrvaṃ mayoditaḥ || 7 || tādṛgāvirbabhūvāsau yuṣmākaṃ varṇitaḥ purā || divyasiṃhāsanagato balabhadrāsudarśanaiḥ || 8 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmalasadbāhurjanārdanaḥ || gadāmusalacakrābjaṃ dhārayanpannagākṛtiḥ || 9 || chatrākṛtiphaṇāsaptamukuṭojjvalakuṃḍalaḥ || subhadrā cāruvadanā varābjābhayadhāriṇī || 2.2.19.10 || lakṣmīḥ prādurbabhūveyaṃ sarvacaitanyarūpiṇī || iyaṃ kṛṣṇāvatāre hi rohiṇīgarbhasaṃbhavā || 11 || balabhadrākṛtirjātā balarūpasya ciṃtanāt || kṣaṇaṃ na sahate sā hi moktuṃ līlāvatāriṇam|| 12 || na bhedo'stīha ko viprāḥ kṛṣṇasya ca balasya ca || ekagarbhaprasūtatvādvyavahāro'tha laukikaḥ || 13 || bhaginī baladevasyetyeṣā paurāṇikī kathā || puṃrūpe strīsvarūpeṇa lakṣmīḥ sarvatra tiṣṭhati || 14 || puṃnāmnā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ strīnāmnā kamalālayā || devatiryaṅmanuṣyādau vidyate na tayoḥ param|| 15|| ko hyanyaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣādbhuvanāni caturdaśa || dhārayettu phaṇāgreṇa so'naṃto balasaṃjñitaḥ || 16 || tasya śaktisvarūpeyaṃ bhaginī śrīḥ prakīrtitā || sudarśanaṃ tu yaccakraṃ sadā viṣṇoḥ kare sthitam || 17 || śākhāgrastaṃbhamadhyasthaṃ tadrūpaṃ tatturīyakam || evaṃ tu mūrttayastena catasro vai prakāśitāḥ ||18|| nirvṛtte bhagavadrūpe caturddhā divyarūpiṇi || lokānāmupakārāya punarāhāṃtarikṣagā || 19 || paṭairācchādya sudṛḍhaṃ nṛpate pratimāstvimāḥ || svaṃ svaṃ varṇaṃ prāpayāśu varṇakaiścitrakarmaṇā || 2.2.19.20 || nīlābhraśyāmalaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaṃkheṃdudhavalaṃ balam || raktaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ subhadrāṃ kuṃkumāruṇām || 21 || nānālaṃkārarucirāṃ nānābhaṃgivibhāgaśaḥ || amī dārusvarūpeṇa dṛṣṭāḥ pāpāya hetave || 22 || gopanīyā prayatnena paṭaniryāsavalkalaiḥ || tasmātprathamamevaitāṃstarorevāsya valkalaiḥ || 23 || śilpibhiḥ karmakuśalairdṛḍhamācchādayāgrataḥ || varṣe varṣe ca saṃskāryāḥ pūrvasaṃskāra mocanāt || 24 || ṛte valkalalepaṃ tu sa tu divyaściraṃtanaḥ || pramādādya imaṃ lepamapanīyeta kaścana || 25 || durbhikṣaṃ marakaṃ rāṣṭre saṃtatiścāsya hīyate || nekṣitavyāstvayā rājankadācidapavāraṇāḥ || 26 || manuṣyaiścāpi rājeṃdra dṛṣṭāḥ syurbhayahetavaḥ || tasmātsacitrā draṣṭavyā bahulepavilepitāḥ || 27 || sucitraṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ savilāsaṃ savibhramam || dṛṣṭvā vimucyate pāpaiḥ kalpakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ || 28 || sucitrānkuru rājeṃdra citrānkāmānavāpsyati || āvirbabhūva bhagavāṃstavānugrahakāmyayā || 29 || tava prasādājjaṃtūnāṃ caturvargaṃ pradāsyati || nīlādrau kalpavṛkṣasya vāyavyāṃ śatahastataḥ || 2.2.19.30 || pradeśe sumahatsthāne prāsādaṃ sudṛḍhāyatam || uttare narasiṃhasya sahasrakaramucchritam || 31 || kārayitvā pratiṣṭhāpya tatrainaṃ viniveśaya || purā sthitaṃ parvate'sminyo'bhyarcayati mādhavam || 32 || nāmnā viśvāvasurnāma śabaro vaiṣṇavottamaḥ || purodhasaḥ sakhyamāsīttena sārddhaṃ purā ca te || 33 || tayoḥ saṃtatirevāsya lepasaṃskārakarmaṇi || niyujyatāṃ mahārāja bhaviṣyatsūtsaveṣu ca || 34 || virarāmaitadābhāṣya sā tu divyā sarasvatī || tayopadiṣṭamākarṇya prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 39 || veṣṭanaṃ mocayāmāsa mahāvedyā nṛpottamaḥ || dadṛśuste tadā sarve ratnasiṃhāsane sthitam || 36 || rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca vāsudevaṃ sudarśanam || yathopadiṣṭalepyādisaṃskāre rucirākṛtim || 37 || kṛpayā smeravadanamunnatāyatavakṣasam || dīnānāmuddhṛtau nāthaṃ pralaṃbabhujapaṃjaram || 38 || prabuddhapuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ hāsaśoṇāyatādharam || paśyatāṃ dṛṣṭimātreṇa hartāraṃ pāpasaṃcayam || 39 || padmāsanasthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ divyālaṃkārabhūṣitam|| svatejasā parivṛtaṃ dārudehe'pi nirmalam || 2.2.19.40 || nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ sarvasaṃtāpanāśanam || dadarśa baladevaṃ ca sāṭṭahāsamukhāṃbujam || 41 || phaṇāmaṇḍalavistīrṇaṃ vāruṇīghūrṇitekṣaṇam || protthitaṃ nāgarājānaṃ pīnonnatasuvakṣasam || 42 || kiṃcinnataṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe kuṇḍalīkṛtavigraham || agrasaṃphullakakubhaṃ kailāsaśikharaṃ yathā || 43 || halacakrābjamusaladhāriṇaṃ vanamālinam || hārakuṇḍalakeyūrakirīṭamukuṭojjvalam || 44 || tayormadhye sthitāṃ lakṣmīṃ subhadrāṃ bhadrarūpiṇīm || 45 || sarvadevāraṇīṃ pāpasāgarottārakāriṇīm || vikacāṃbhojavadanāṃ varābjābhayadhāriṇīm || 46 || rūpalāvaṇyavasatiṃ śobhamānāṃ prasādhanaiḥ || kuṃkumāruṇadehāṃ tāṃ sākṣāllakṣmīmivāparām || 47 || dadarśa viṣṇorvāmasthāṃ cakraśākhāgranirmitām || bālārkasadṛśīṃ tīkṣṇadhārāṃ tejomayīṃ dvijāḥ || 48 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvānandapāthodhi nimagnaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || kartavyamūḍhaḥ svatanau svayaṃ na prababhūva ha || 49 || daramīlitanetraḥ sansṛjanbāṣpāṃbu kevalam || kṛtāṃjalipuṭastasthau sthūṇākāro nṛpottamaḥ || 2.2.19.50 || uvāca taṃ munivaraḥ smitavaktraḥ kṣitīśvaram || yadarthaṃ śramamāpannastatsāṃpratamabhūttava || 51 || pratyakṣaṃ nṛpaśārdūla ekastvaṃ bhāgyavānbhuvi || amuṃ paśya jagannāthaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatekṣaṇam || 52 || bhaktānugrahapāthodhiṃ sarvajñānanidhiṃ harim || yaṃ draṣṭuṃ yogino nityaṃ yataṃti yatamānasāḥ || 53 || avadhānena mahatā kṣaṇaṃ paśyanti mānavāḥ || so'yaṃ dārumayaṃ dehaṃ samāsthāya janārdanaḥ || 54 || anugrahītuṃ tvāṃ bhūpa pratyakṣatvamupāgataḥ || bhajainaṃ dharaṇīnāthaṃ stuhi kāruṇyasāgaram || 55 || dadāti saṃstutaḥ kāmānsarvānnṛpa manogatān || 56 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāda ekonaviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
<2.2.20>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || itthaṃ prabodhitastena nāradena kṣitīśvaraḥ || tuṣṭāva jagatāṃ nāthaṃ vacobhiḥ karuṇānvitam || 1 || || indradyumna uvāca || || tvadaṃghripāthojayugaṃ murāre nopāsitaṃ janmasu pūrvajeṣu || tatkarmaṇāṃ dāruṇapākabhājaṃ dīnaṃ paritrāhi kṛpāṃbudhe mām || 2 || kva nirmalaṃ tvaccaraṇābjayugmaṃ viriṃcirudreṃdrakirīṭamagnam || kvāhaṃ kudīnaḥ śakṛdasramāṃsamūtrāsthisaṃghaiḥ pihitastvacā vai || 3 || asārasaṃsāraparibhrameṇa śramāturastvāṃ kathamīśa jāne || jānaṃti te tvāṃ khalu devadeva yeṣāṃ bhavo duḥkhabhavaprakāśaḥ || 4 || prabho mayā duḥkhamanekajanmapāpārjitaṃ bhuktamanekabhāvam || śubhārjito yaḥ sukhaleśabhāvo nidarśanaṃ yanmadhupṛktatikte || 5 || yadeva saukhyānubhavāya deva karmārjito me viṣayopabhogaḥ || sa eva duḥkhaṃ pariṇāmato me na madvidho duḥkhijano'sti cānyaḥ || 6 || vibho yadi tvāṃ manasāpi pūrvamupāstamanyadviṣamekṣaṇo'ham|| kathaṃ tadālapsyamanekajanma punaḥ punarbhogyamaśeṣaduḥkham || 7 || vibhutvadāsatvapitṛtvaputrapriyatvamātṛtvadhanitvabhāvaiḥ || vadhyatvahiṃsratvapatitvajāyābhāvaiśca tiryaktvasurādibhāvaiḥ || 8 || nīcorddhabhāvaṃ bahuśaḥ sakṛdvā bhavāṃgaṇe'smim̐nluṭhatānubhūtam || na vā murāre tava pādapadmadūrībhavasyeṣṭaphalaṃ hi caitat ||9|| kośaṃ balaṃ caitadaśeṣapṛthivīdhanairvṛtaṃ yauvanarūparūpyaḥ|| mano'nukūlāḥ śataśaḥ striyaśca niṣkaṃṭakaṃ me nṛpamaṃḍalaṃ ca|| 2.2.20.10|| sāmrājyatā cāpi bharo mahānme tvajjñānahīsya paśorivāyam|| bhārāvatāraṃ kuru me kṛpābdhe sadaiva tatrodita khedayogaḥ||11|| dīnānukaṃpinkariṇo vimuktiḥ kṛtā vibho tvatsmṛtimātrakeṇa|| bhrāṃtaṃ ghaṭīyaṃtravadatra nātha māṃ trātumarhasyanukaṃpibhāvāt||12|| na me tvadanyaḥ khalu bandhuratra pravāhavibhraṣṭatarusvabhāve || pāpīyasī buddhirupetabhāvā snehānubandhā viṣaye'bhibhedyā || 13 || aharniśaṃ me tava pādapadmānnāpaitu matprārthitametadeva || tvāṃ saccidānaṃdasupūrṇasiṃdhuṃ prāptāstu ye janmasahasrabhāgyaiḥ || 14 || kiṃ te hi paśyaṃti lavaikasaukhyamanekaduḥkhaṃ viṣayendrajālam || kva bandhanaṃ karmabhiriṣṭaleśaduḥkhākaragraṃthiśatairabhedyam || 15 || anaṃtamādyaṃtavihīnamekamānaṃdadaṃ tvatpadapaṃkajaṃ kva || māyāṃbudhau te mamatā bhramau ca kukarmanakrāyitagartamadhye || 16 || nirāśrayaṃ me patitaṃ vilāsakaṭākṣapātena nayādya tīram || svakāryasaṃsādhanayāśritānāṃ saṃpādanāyeṣṭavidherajasram|| 17 || bhrāmyaṃtamātmīyahitaṃ visṛjya māṃ trāhi mūḍhaṃ sahajānukaṃpin || kṣudrāya kāryāya bahu bhramaṃtamaprāpya mūlaṃ parameśvaraṃ tvām|| 18 || oṃ āyāsapātraṃ paramaṃ sudīnaṃ māṃ trāhi viṣṇo jagadekavaṃdya || vedāṃtavedyāvyaya viśvanātha tatvamīśiṣe haṃtumaghaugharāśīn || 19|| taṃ tvāṃ parityajya sukhaikahetuṃ kṣudrāśayaṃ māṃ paripāhi viṣṇo|| prasupta eṣo'khilabhūtasaṃghaścaturvidho yatkṛtamoharātrau||2.2.20.20|| tvajñānabhānūdayametya cāṃte prabodhyate tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye|| tvameka evākhilalokakarttā phaṇāsahasraiḥ parivītamūrtiḥ||21 || paryāyavṛttyā balināṃ variṣṭha tvāmiśitāraṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye|| yayā sṛjasyatsi jagaṃti nātha vakṣaḥsarojāsanayā svaśaktyā || 22 || tāṃ bhadrarūpāṃ jagadāśrayāṃ te devāraṇiṃ pādayuge nato'smi || yadaṃśujālapratisṛṣṭametadbrahmāṃḍajālaṃ karasaṃgi nātha||23|| sudarśanaṃ daityabalasya haṃtṛ cakrābhidhaṃ tvāṃ praṇataḥ sudarśanam|| stutvetthaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭhaḥ sāṣṭāṃga praṇanāma saḥ|| 24|| paritrāhi jagannātha magnaṃ saṃsārasāgare|| anāthabandho kṛpayā dīnaṃ māṃ tamasākulam||25|| nārada uvāca|| jaya jaya nārāyaṇa apārabhavasāgarottāraparāyaṇa sanakasanaṃdanasanātanaprabhṛti yogivaraviciṃtyamānadivyatattva svamāyāvilasitādhyāsapariṇa mitāśeṣabhūtatattva tritattva tridaṇḍadhara triṇāciketatrimadhutrisuparṇopagīyamānadivyajñāna cchandomaya svāsanasuparṇapriya bhaktapriya bhaktajanaikavatsala svamāyājālavyavahitasvarūpa viśvarūpa viśvaprakāśa viśvatomukha viśvatokṣi viśvataḥśravaṇa viśvataḥpādaśirogrīva viśvahastanāsārasanātvakkeśalomaliṃga sarvalokātmaka sarvalokasukhāvaha sarvalokopakāraka sarvalokanamaskṛta līlāvilasitakoṭipadmodbhava rudreṃdramarudaśvisādhyasiddhagaṇapraṇatāśeṣasurāsuratribhuvanaguro na kasyāpi jñānagocara namaste namaste || 26 || || jaiminiruvāca || || anye ca ye nṛpatayaḥ śrotriyā vedapāragāḥ || munayo dvijāḥ kṣatriyāśca vidvāṃso vaiśyajātayaḥ || 27 || astuvanpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ balinaṃ bhadrayā saha || sūktaiḥ stotraiḥ purāṇaiśca kavitābhiryathā tathā || 28 || atheṃdradyumnaḥ provāca purodhasamakalmaṣam || pūjārthaṃ vāsudevasya upacāropasaṃskṛtam || 29 || svayaṃ sa nṛpatiśreṣṭhaḥ pūjayāmāsa tānkramāt || nāradasyopadeśena vidhinā maṃtratastathā || 2.2.20.30 || dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa balabhadramapūjayat || yamupāsya dhruvaḥ sthānaṃ prāptavānuttamottamam || 31 || trayīprasiddhaṃ yatsūktaṃ pāvanaṃ pauruṣaṃ mahat || tena nārāyaṇaṃ bhūpaḥ pūjayāmāsa śaktitaḥ || 32 || devyāḥ sūktena bhadrāṃ tāṃ saudarśanyā sudarśanam || yathāsamṛddhi bhaktyā tānpūjayitvā nṛpottamaḥ || 33 || tatprītyai dvijamukhyebhyo dadau dānāni bhaktitaḥ || tulāpuruṣadānāni mahādānāni pārthivaḥ || 34 || aśvamedhāṃgabhūtāśca koṭiśo gā dadau tadā || alaṃkṛtāstathānyāśca dadau gā bahudakṣiṇāḥ || 35 || tāsāṃ khuroddhṛteryogādgartobhūddvijasattamāḥ || dānāṃbunā sa pūrṇo vai tīrthamāsīnmahāphalam || 36 || tasminsnātvā pitṝndevānsaṃtarpya vidhivannaraḥ || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalamāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || 37 || nāmnā khyātaṃ sarastasya indradyumnasya bhūpateḥ || nirvapatyatra piṃḍāṃśca pitṝnuddiśya mānavaḥ || 38 || kulaikaviṃśamuddhatya brahmaloke mahīyate || nātaḥ parataraṃ tīrthaṃ hayamedhāṃgasaṃbhavāt || 39 || indradyumnasya sarasaḥ syādvā tripathagā samā || tataḥ prāsādaghaṭanāmupacakrāma bhūpatiḥ || 2.2.20.40 || śubhe kāle sunakṣatre daivajñavidhicodite || samuhūrte nāradādīnbrāhmaṇāgryānprapūjya ca || 41 || svastivācaṃ ca karmarddhiṃ vācayitvā nṛpottamaḥ || arghyaṃ dadau jagannāthaṃ smaranprāsādaveśmani || 42 || vasudhāṃ prārthayitvā tu sthānamācaṃdratārakam || śilpinaḥ pūjayāmāsa vāstuyāgapuraḥsaram || 43 || mahotsavaṃ tathā cakre gītavādyaiḥ prabhūtakaiḥ || dīnānāthavipannebhyo dadau vastu yathepsitam || 44 || rājño visarjayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram || kṛtārthānavatāraṃ taṃ harerdṛṣṭvā hatāṃhasaḥ || 45 || tataḥ sa koṭiśo vittaṃ dadau pāṣāṇadārake || āhṛtau bahudeśebhyo dṛṣadāṃ pārthivottamaḥ || 46 || uvācedaṃ mudā yuktaḥ sabhāyāṃ pṛthivīdharaḥ || aṣṭādaśabhyo dvīpebhyo yanmayā pauruṣārjitam || 47 || tatsarvaṃ jagadīśasya prāsādāyāpavarjitam || jaitrayātrāprasaṃgena śramo labdhastu yo mayā || 48 || saphalo'stu sa me viṣṇoḥ prāsādāyārthayogataḥ || ataḥ paraṃ me kiṃ bhāgyaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim || 49 || prasādayiṣye saṃpattyā bhujadvaṃdvārjitaśriyā || śrīḥ sadā puṇḍarīkākṣe śriyonugrahajā mama || 2.2.20.50 || kiṃ kartumīśastasyāṃ vai devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || kaṭākṣapāto yasya syāttasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī || 51 || aṣṭādaśātmikā devī jihvāgre cāsya nṛtyati || yamārādhya jagannāthaṃ brahmatvaṃ prāptavānvidhiḥ || 52 || rudro maheśvaratvaṃ ca śakrastridivarājatām || lebhe tamarcya jagatāmarcayiṣyāmi śāśvatam|| 53 || jitaṃ tena tridhā rāśībhūtamaṃho mahātmanā || sāṃgopāṃgena vidhinā yena kṛṣṇaḥ samarcitaḥ || 54 || kalevaramidaṃ kṣetraṃ yatrāhaṃkāravānvibhuḥ || āvirbhāvatirobhāvau sthitirnityā hi yatprabhuḥ || 55 || atra sākṣādvapuṣmantaṃ saṃpūjya jagatāṃ gurum || sākṣātkṛtārtho bhavati caturvargasya bhājanam || 56 || bahuvyayā''yāsato yā rājyaṛddhirmayārjitā || asyaivānugrahātsā tu saphalāstu padāṃbuje || 57 || sarvopacāraiḥ paripūjya devaṃ dravyairhṛtaiḥ sāgaramekhalāyāḥ || yāvatsamāpnoti hi karmapākaḥ sāmrājyayātrā saphalā hi māstu || 58 || kiṃ dravyajātaṃ khalu yena viṣṇuṃ nopāharetsāṃgamapetakalmaṣaḥ || kiṃ pauruṣeyaṃ yadi vāsudevaparicchado yena na sādhito me || 59 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaimini ṛṣisaṃvāde viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
<2.2.21>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || iti bruvāṇaṃ rājarṣiṃ kaścidṛgvedapāragaḥ || vedāṃtavijjñānaśīlo dvijo vākyaṃ mudā jagau || 1 || aho tavāyaṃ khalu bhāgyarāśiryenāvirāsīdbhuvi dārumūrtiḥ || yasyātyupāstiṃ śrutirāha muktipradāmanātmajñavimohitānām|| 2 || ya eṣa plavate dāruḥ siṃdhoḥ pāre hyapauruṣam || tamupāsya durārādhyaṃ muktiṃ yāṃti sudurlabhām || 3 || brahmajñānanidhiḥ sākṣānnāradaḥ pratyuvāca yat || na hi vedāṃtavacaso'parasmājjñānamasya vai || 4 || na hi pravṛttirviṣṇostu vinā vedaṃ pravartate || pareṣāṃ svasya vā sṛṣṭau śrutiprāmāṇyavānprabhuḥ || 5 || vinā śrutiṃ pravarteccetkastatprāmāṇyamṛcchati || tasmācchrutiprasiddho'yamavatāro'tra bhūpate ||6|| vedāṃtavedyaṃ puruṣaṃ gītaṃ taṃ sāmagītiṣu || pratimāṃ na tu jānīhi niḥśreyasakaraṃ nṛṇām || 7 || darśanādeva naḥ śāṃtaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tama uttamam || saṃtyeva śrutayaḥ pūrvametadarcāprakāśikāḥ || 8 || etadarcā praśastā vai sadarthe viniyojitā || aho bhāratavarṣasthā manuṣyāḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ || 9 || apavargaprado yeṣāmāvirāsījjanārdanaḥ || tatrāpyayaṃ coḍhradeśaḥ sarveṣāmuttamottamaḥ || 2.2.21.10 || yatrasthāścarmanetreṇa paśyaṃti brahmarūpiṇam || śrutismṛtīnāṃ gahanaḥ paṃthā karmabhirākulaḥ || 11 || yena yātā bhramaṃtīha ghaṭīyaṃtravadākulāḥ || nirvyalīkapadaprāptihetureṣa sa cinmayaḥ || 12 || śrutyādibhirvinopāyaiḥ paramānaṃdamuktidaḥ || niraṃtaragatāyātaduḥsthitānāṃ durātmanām|| 13 || eṣa dāruvapurviṣṇuḥ sukhadātā subāṃdhavaḥ || śrutismṛtyuktaniyamā vartaṃte neha pārthiva || 14 || yathā tathā dṛṣṭipathamācāṃḍālādvimuktidaḥ || abhaktaścedamuṃ paśyedgatānugatiko naraḥ || 15 || aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ hyavikalaṃ labhet || bhajeccenniyamastho hi bhaktimāndṛḍhamānasaḥ || 16 || asaṃśayaṃ sa sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇā labhate naraḥ || kva duḥkhāyāsabahulamanāyāsavinaśvaram || 17 || acirasthaṃ kṣudraphalaṃ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇam || kvedaṃ dārumayaṃ brahma pāparāśidavānalam || 18 || saccidānaṃdakaivalyamuktidaṃ darśanādapi || vedānuvacanādīni duṣkarāṇi durātmanām || 19 || mahātmabhistairyatprāpyaṃ tadavyagramayaṃ dadet || anyakṣetreṣu bhagavānsudūro martyavāsinām ||2.2.21.20|| svakṣetre'sminnivasati nityaṃ muktiprado vibhuḥ || asmādatra mahābhāga tiṣṭha svabalapauruṣaḥ || 21 || vidvattamo'si bhaktaśca sāṃgopāṃgamamuṃ bhaja || 22 || || jaiminiruvāca || || dvijasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || sādhūktaṃ dvijavaryeṇa śrautamārgānusāriṇā || 23 || sṛṣṭyādau brahmaniśvāsairabhavadvedasaṃhatiḥ || tatropaniṣadartho'yaṃ sāṃprataṃ vyaktimāgataḥ || 24 || vettyetadarthaṃ bhagavānpadmayoniḥ prajāpatiḥ || ajñāsiṣaṃ ca bhūpāla sāṃprataṃ tanmukhādaham || 25 || tasyājñayā kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yathābhilaṣitaṃ tava || enamārādhya tiṣṭhātra yāmyahaṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tikam || 26 || kṛtaṃ nivedayiṣyāmi prakāśaṃ ca muradviṣaḥ || prāsādaṃ kuru bhūpāla dhanena mahatā tathā || 27 || prāsāde narasiṃhaṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpya vimucyase || 28 || || jaiminiruvāca || || tacchrutvā sa tu bhūmīṃdraḥ pratyuvāca muniṃ tadā || maharṣe'haṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ yiyāsurbrahmaṇoṃ'tikam || 29 || yatprasādājjagannāthaścake'yaṃ locanātithiḥ || nivedya taṃ ca prāsādaṃ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ muradviṣaḥ || 2.2.21.30 || vijñāpayiṣye sānnidhye prāsādasthāpanotsavam || yathā svayaṃ samāgamya brahmalokātpitāmahaḥ || 31 || mahotsavaṃ bhagavataḥ prāsāde'tra kariṣyati || tanmune māmapi vidheḥ saṃnidhiṃ prāpayasva ca || 32 || garbhapratiṣṭhāṃ prāsāde samāpyeha sthito mune || paścādāvāṃ gamiṣyāvaḥ kaṃcitkālaṃ pratīkṣa me || || 33 || tataḥ sa nṛpatiḥ sarvāñchilpaśāstraviśāradān || pāṣāṇakhaṃḍaghaṭanākarmaṇyekaikayogataḥ || 34 || satkārairdānamānaiśca yojayāmāsa sādaram || dine dine sughaṭitaḥ prāsādo vavṛdhe dvijāḥ || 35 || paritaḥ pūryamāṇastu śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī || evaṃ saṃvardhyamāno'pi prāsādaḥ parivarddhitaḥ || 36 || mahocchrayatvādalpena na kālenābhilakṣyate || pāṣāṇasaṃkhyā śakyā vā kathaṃcidghaṭanākramāt || 37 || vittavyayastu koṭīnāṃ na saṃkhyātuṃ ca śakyate || yāvanto bhārate varṣe lokāḥ samayavartinaḥ || 38 || indradyumnasya nṛpaterniyuktāste mahībhṛtaḥ || ekaikaśo niyuktā ye parasparasamanvitāḥ ||39|| te'pi cānyairniyuktāste sarve tatra pravartitāḥ || ajasraṃ tanniyuktānāṃ yo harṣottho mahāravaḥ || 2.2.21.40 || ākāśamaśnuvāno'sau diśāṃ bhāgānapūrayat || nṛpateḥ śraddhayā bhaktyā sāttvikena prasāditā || 41 || śrīḥ samṛddhābhavadviprāḥ kīrtyā saha mahīpateḥ || kvacitkāṃcanavinyastanānāratnamahojjvalaḥ || 42 || kvacitsphaṭikabhāgāṃtaśāradābhranibhacchaviḥ || kvacinnīlāśmaghaṭitā bhittiḥ kālābhramedurā || 43 || evaṃ sughaṭite viṣṇoḥ prāsāde sumanohare || garbhapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivatkṛtvā sa nṛpasattamaḥ || 44 || vajrapātādibhaṃgādivāraṇārthaṃ yathocitam || śilpaśāstreṣu maṇyādi vinyasya pauruṣāhṛtam || 45 || punaḥ prāsādaghaṭanāsaṃbhārocitameva vai || bahumūlyaṃ vastujātaṃ yatnāttatra nyaveśayat || 46 || tato viracyamāne'sminprāsāde kīrtivarddhane || manasāpi na saṃbhāvye triṣu lokeṣu bhūbhujām || 47 || devānāmapi no lakṣye dvijāḥ kalpāṃtavāsinām || prāsāda īdṛśo bhūmau kvacicca ghaṭito na hi || 48 || svarge vā itthamādityā ālapaṃti parasparam|| aho subuddhirasyoccairyeyamīdṛkparīṇatā || 49 || śraddhayā bhagavatpādapadmayoḥ sābhilāṣiṇī || alaukikāni karmāṇi paśyaṃti hi racaṃtyapi || 2.2.21.50 || ke vātra bhūmau rājāno babhūvurnītiśālinaḥ ||| sārvabhaumāstu sāmrājyajetāraḥ sarvavidviṣām || 51 || vittāni yaiḥ saṃcitāni subahūni ca koṭiśaḥ || aśvamedhasahasraṃ tu yatkṛtaṃ tridiveśituḥ || ||52|| śakyaṃ vā syādbhūbhujāṃ tu nātaḥ pūrvamanuṣṭhitam|| na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ vāpi vājimedhasahasrakam||53|| mahīkṣitānuṣṭhitaṃ vai yatra trailokya vāsinaḥ|| pṛthivyāmasya nṛpateḥ sahasthā bhogabhoginaḥ||54|| brahmaloka ivābhāti sabha yasya ca yajvinaḥ|| mūrtimaṃtastrayo vedāścatuṣpādo vṛṣastathā || 55 || surāḥ saṃkalpakāmāstu yatrādbhutadhiyo'bhavan || ayaṃ prāsādavaryo vai buddherviṣayatāṃ gataḥ || 56 || mano'pi yatra bhavati na vā trailokyavāsinām || bhūpaterdurlabhaṃ kiṃ syātsahāyo yasya nāradaḥ || 57 || pitāmahaśca jagatāṃ sraṣṭā sarvāmareśvaraḥ || athavā viṣṇubhaktasya nātidūraṃ cikīrṣitam || 58 || viṣṇostadbhaktalokasya nāṃtaraṃ vidyate dvijaḥ || tataḥ sa nāradaṃ prāha prāsādāṃte munīśvaram || 59 || sarvaṃ sapannamāsīnme yadaśakyaṃ surāsuraiḥ || sākṣādbhagavato viṣṇoradvaitopāsanārataḥ || 2.2.21.60 || bhagavadvapurābhāṣi prāsādastu ciraṃ mayi || ityuktvā pādayormūrdhnā praṇanāma sa nāradam|| 61|| nārado'pi tamutthāpya paripūjya nṛpottamam|| tvatto na bhedo nṛpate mamāsti khalu tattvataḥ||63|| yastu sākṣājjagannātha āvirbhūtaḥ kṛtena vā|| avaśyamarcayasvainaṃ jīvanmukto'si sāṃpratam||63|| tatpādapadme yādṛkte cetaḥ pra pravaṇatānvitam|| bhaktyā hyananyayā puṃsaḥ kimataḥ paramasti vai||64|| tīrthairmaṃtrairjapairdānaiḥ kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ|| vratairadhyayanairbhūpa tapobhiśca yadarjitum|| 65|| na śakyaṃ tava rājendra bhaktyā tatkaramāgatam || ataḥ paraṃ na śocasva bhaktiyoge namo'stu te || 66 || prakarṣaṃ bahurājeṃdra sthitvā cāsmiṃściraṃ bhuvi || ārādhaya jagannāthamupacārairmahotsavaiḥ || 67 || pitāmahaṃ draṣṭukāmo gaṃtā cedaṃtikaṃ vibhoḥ || upadekṣyati so'pyasya yātrāstāstā mahotsavāḥ || 68 || svayaṃ ca bhagavāneva varaṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyati || pratiṣṭhāpite prāsāde tasminkāle svayaṃbhuvā || 69 || ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi tadā saptarṣibhiḥ saha || tadāvāṃ tatra gacchāvo brahmalokamakalmaṣam || 2.2.21.70 || tvāṃ vinā bhuvi kaḥ śakto brahmalokagatiṃ prati || ityuktvā nārado bhūpaṃ samuttasthau nabhastalam || 70 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāda ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<2.2.22>
|| || jaiminiruvāca || || rājātha tamuvācedaṃ nirlakṣya gamanaṃ katham || ayaṃ puṣparatho'styeva manaso vegavānmune || 1 || enamāruhya yāsyāvaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tāvatpratīkṣyatām || yāvadetānanujñāpya prāsāde hyadhikāriṇaḥ || 2 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vibhumāyāmi munisattama || nārado'pi vacaḥ śrutvā śraddadhāno nṛpoktiṣu || 3 || kareṇa dhṛtvā rājānaṃ mahāvedīṃ praviśya ca || sahitaṃ rāmabhadrābhyāṃ natvā kṛṣṇaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || anujñāṃ prārthayāmāsa brahmalokagatiṃ prati || 4 || indradyumno'pi vacasā manasā vapuṣā harim || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya punarnatvā sāṣṭāṃgamunmanāḥ || brahmalokagatiṃ viprā yācate sma kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 5 || ubhau tau divyayānena jagmaturmunibhūbhṛtau || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya raviṃ vyomamaṇḍalamadhyagam || uparyupari jagmāte vyatītya dhruvamaṃḍalam || 6 || janalokagataiḥ siddhaiḥ satvarāvanatonmukhaiḥ || vīkṣyamāṇau mudā yuktau saṃlapaṃtau parasparam || 7 || bhagavaccaritaṃ viprā manomalaviśodhanam || jīvanmukto muniśreṣṭhaḥ sarvalokānbhramannayam || yathānupahatavrajyastathāyaṃ martyavāsyapi || 8 || bhūpatiḥ prayayau śīghraṃ viṣṇubhaktiprasādataḥ || brahmāṃḍaviṣaye naitadduṣprāpyaṃ vastu vidyate || 9 || viṣṇubhaktena yallabhyamathavā muktimeti saḥ || maharlokagataiḥ siddhaiḥ sādarābhyarcitau ca tau || 2.2.22.10 || indradyumno na sasmāra pārthivaṃ vāsamātmanaḥ || kramādūrdhvagatirgacchanpaśyansaukhyaikabhājanān || 11 || nirdvaṃdvānabhilāṣottha tatkṣaṇānekapauruṣān || kevalaṃ bhagavatprītyai karmabhūmau cakāra yat || 12 || prāsādaṃ ciṃtayāmāsa saṃpūrṇo vā na vā bhavet || mayyāgate brahmalokaṃ śatrubhirvābhibhūyate || 13 || ślathādarā vā bhūyāsuḥ sevakā dravyalobhataḥ || gṛhītavetanāḥ śilpivṛṃdā maṃdakriyāstathā || na śīghraṃ ghaṭayiṣyaṃti mayi brahmakṣayāgate || 14 || yāvadgamiṣye dhātāraṃ gṛhītvāhaṃ caturmukham || tāvanna punareva syātprāsādo mayi dūrage || 15 || ihāyātāstu ye pūrve na punaste kṣitiṃ gatāḥ || manvānā mama sāmaṃtā itthaṃ vā duṣṭamānasāḥ || rājyaṃ mamāhariṣyaṃti dviṣataḥ kimu sāṃpratam || 16 || itthaṃ suvignamanasā ciṃtayānaṃ mahīpatim || atītānāgatajñānanidhirmuniruvāca tam || 17 || kiṃ ciṃtayasi rājeṃdra tvamevaṃ dīnamānasaḥ || yatra cābhyāgatāvāvāṃ na ciṃtāviṣayo hyayam ||18|| nādhayo vyādhayaścātra prabhavaṃti kadācana || na jarā na ca vā mṛtyuḥ kimanyaduḥkhahetukam || 19 || kṛtārtho'si mahābhāga yanmānuṣavapuḥ svayam || brahmalokamihāyātaḥ pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭavānharim || 2.2.22.20 || ihāyātā na śocaṃti heye saṃsārakalpake || bruvāṇamitthaṃ bhūpālastamuvāca munīśvaram || 21 || śocāmi bhagavanrājñaḥ svajanabandhuṣu|| samārabdho bhagavataḥ prāsādo yo mayādhunā|| 22|| atrāgataṃ māṃ te jñātvā nānutiṣṭhaṃti sevakāḥ|| ārabdhasya pratiṣṭhā hi kartavyā niścitā mune|| 23|| tasyāṃtarāyaṃ saṃbhāvya duḥkhitaṃ me manaḥ prabho|| tasya tadvacaṃ śrutvā prahasya munirabravīt|| 24|| prajāpatisamatvaṃ hi na tu sāmānyabhūpatiḥ|| kenāpyapakṛtaṃ naiva bhūmau pūrvairanuṣṭhitam|| 25|| kiṃ punastava kṛtyaṃ tu yaḥ sṛṣṭisthitihānikṛt || brahmalokaṃ gatasyādya pratāpayaśasā tava || 26 || trailokye bhramato nityaṃ yathā sūryaniśākarau || yasya kāryeṣu bhagavānsahāyo'sau caturmukhaḥ || 27 || teṣu kiṃ rājaśārdūla vighnaśaṃkāpi jāyate || eṣa dūre'sti rājeṃdra pratyakṣaṃ yastava dviṣām || 28 || sadomadhya gataḥ śakraḥ sākṣāttrijagatīpatiḥ || viśeṣato jagannāthaprāsāde kaḥ pumānnṛpa || 29 || nihaṃtuṃ manasāpīcchettatra śaṃkāstu mā tava || tadagrataḥ paśya bhūpa caṃdrakoṭisamatviṣā || 2.2.22.30 || parito hlādajanakaḥ sudhāsāgarakoṭivat || yaścāyaṃ tejasāṃ rāśirjānīhi brahmasadmanaḥ || 31 || itthamālapatastau tu brahmalokāṃtikaṃ gatau || śuśruvāte sudūrāttau brahmarṣīṇāṃ mukhodgatam || 32 || svādhyāyaśabdaṃ supadaṃ spaṣṭavarṇakramasvaram || itihāsapurāṇāni cchaṃdaḥ kalpāni gāthikāḥ || 33 || asaṃkīrṇojjvalapadaṃ śrūyate pravibhāgaśaḥ || atraitadrājaśārdūla jānīhi brahmaṇaḥ puram || 34 || sabhā hi dṛśyate caiṣā yatra lokapitāmahaḥ || sārddhaṃ brahmarṣimukhyaiśca sukhāsīnaścaturmukhaḥ || 35 || nānā caitanyaśabalairjīvanmuktairupāsitaḥ || yatrāgatāni varttaṃte na saṃsārābdhisaṃkaṭe || 36 || saditi brahmaṇo nāma tasyāyaṃ bhuvanottamaḥ || satyaloka iti khyātastadūrdhvaṃ nāsti kiṃcana || 38 || asyaiva kiṃcidupari adhaścāṃḍakapālataḥ || vaikuṇṭhabhuvanaṃ rājanmuktā yatra vasaṃti vai || 38 || yatra yogīśvaraḥ sākṣādyogiciṃtyo janārdanaḥ || caitanyavapurāste vai sāṃdrānaṃdātmakaḥ prabhuḥ || 39 || yaṃ prāpya na nivarttaṃte mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani || yamupāste sadā brahmā jīvanmuktaiḥ svamuktaye || 2.2.22.40 || kalpitasyāyuṣonte'sāvebhiḥ sārddhaṃ prapadyate || sa eṣa sraṣṭā lokānāṃ matsyakūrmādirūpadhṛk || 41 || rakṣitā raudrarūpeṇa saṃharttā lokabhāvanaḥ || indradyumnaṃ vadannitthaṃ prāpa brahmaniketanam || 42 || kṣaṇena ca sabhādvāri prakoṣṭhe sa nyavartata || yatra tiṣṭhanti dikpālāḥ śakrādyāḥ paritastathā || 43 || cirakālaṃ dhyānaparāstathā manvaṃtarādhipāḥ || pṛthagjananibhā dvāḥsthaniṣiddhāṃtaḥ praveśanāḥ ||44 || indradyumnena sahitaṃ nāradaṃ pravilokya saḥ || dvārapālaḥ savinayaṃ nanāmānatakandharaḥ || 45 || caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ bhramaṇe rasika prabho || tvayā vinā śobhate no svāmiṃstava pituḥ sabhā || 46 || saṃtyeva munayaḥ śreṣṭhā brāhmaṇā brahmavidvarāḥ || gautamādyāstathāpyeṣā na ramyā brahmaṇaḥ sabhā || 47 || bahutārā surajanī caṃdreṇeva prakāśate || iti stuvandadau tasya praveśaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 48 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
<2.2.23>
|| nārada uvāca || || dauvārikāya rājarṣiriṃdradyumno mahāyaśāḥ || sārvabhaumo vaiṣṇavāgryo dhātāraṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ || 1 || yātvayaṃ puratastasya yadi tvamanumanyase || ityuktastaṃ punaḥ prāha nāradaṃ maṇikodaraḥ || 2 || svāmiṃstvayāgato yo'sau na sāmānyo hi budhyate || yatra paśyasi dikpālānpitṝnmanvaṃtarādhipān || 3 || tatrāyaṃ marttyanilayastiṣṭhedapi hi pauruṣam || bhavāngatvā padmayoniṃ vijñāpyainaṃ praveśaya || 4 || sabhādvāragato yo'sau dikpālaiḥ saha yāsyati || ekāgracitto bhagavāngāyane caturānanaḥ || 5 || asmākaṃ dvāri yuktānāṃ pratīkṣyo'vasaro dhruvam || na krodho mayi karttavyo dāse tava pituśca te ||6|| ityukto nārado gatvā brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim || natvā sāṣṭāṃgapatanaṃ vijñapto vasudhādhipaḥ || 7 || kaṭākṣeṇādiśatso'tha indradyumnapraveśanam || novāca kiṃcidbhagavāngāne dattāvadhānataḥ || 8 || divyagāyanasaṃgīte kautukāviṣṭamānasaḥ || jñātveṃgitaṃ nārado'tha iṃdradyumnaṃ nṛpottamam || praveśayāmāsa tataḥ śakrādyaiḥ sunirīkṣitaḥ || 9 || dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaṃ dūrātsraṣṭāraṃ jagatāṃ nṛpaḥ || amanyata dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sākṣāddārumayaṃ harim || 2.2.23.10 || śanaiḥ śanairyayau bhūpaḥ praṇamaṃśca kṛtāṃjaliḥ || stuvannamanpraṇipatansādhvasaskhalitaṃ vrajan || kiṃciddūre sthito bhūpo nāradasya nideśataḥ || 11 || tataḥ puṇyaṃ gīyamānaṃ caritaṃ siṃdhujāpateḥ || śṛṇvaṃścaturmukhastasthau muhūrttaṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 12 || sāvitrīśāradābhyāṃ ca vījyamānastu pārśvayoḥ || śuddhadehadharairvedaiḥ stūyamānaḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ || 13 || kalākāṣṭhānimeṣādi kalpayanyugaparyayam || na jarājanmamaraṇaṃ rūpādipariṇāmanam || 14 || yasya lokagatānāṃ vai nādhayo vyādhayastathā || manvatarādayo yatra yugāvarttādayastathā || 15 || kalpāṃtādyā na vidyaṃte sa sākṣātparameśvaraḥ || gītāvasāne taṃ bhūpamuvāca prahasanniva || 16 || iṃdradyumna mahāsattva sākṣāttvaṃ bhagavatpriyaḥ || anyasya durlabho lokaḥ satyākhyo viditastava || 17 || atrāgatiṃ hi vāṃchaṃto munayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ || taponiṣṭhāśca tiṣṭhaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 18 || caturdaśasu lokeṣu sṛṣṭānāṃ prāṇināṃ hi yat || caitanyādivicitrāṇi sarveṣāmāśrayo hyasau || 19 || jānannapi hi tatkāryaṃ mānayannṛpasattamam || uvāca paramaprīta iṃdradyumnaṃ pitāmahaḥ || 2.2.23.20 || kimarthamāgatosyatra tadbrūhi hṛdayasthitam || mayi dṛṣṭe na duṣprāpamamṛtaṃ kinnu vāṃchitam || 21 || || indradyumna uvāca || || aṃtaryāminhi bhagavaṃstvadajñātaṃ kuto bhavet|| tathāpi praśno yo nātha mayyanukrośa eva saḥ || 22 || mūrdhnyādhāya tavānujñāṃ kathitaṃ tava sūnunā || iṣṭāḥ sahasraṃ kratavastadaṃte dārudehabhṛt|| 23 || āvirbabhūva bhagavānbhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ || tvadanugrahasaṃpattivaśādevāvalokayan || 24 || tādṛśaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ yena tvallokamāgataḥ || yasyārabdho mayā deva prāsādastatra cetsvayam || 25 || gatvā devaṃ jagannāthaṃ sthāpayiṣyasi cetprabho || tvadanugrahastu saphalo bhavenme lokabhāvana ||| || 26 || etadarthaṃ jagatsvāminnāradena sahādhunā || tvatpādapadmayugalaṃ draṣṭuṃ tvallokamāgataḥ || 27 || prasīda māṃ kuruṣvedaṃ jagannāthastvameva hi || tvameva sa jagannātho na bhedo yuvayorvibho ||28 || sthāpyaḥ sthāpayitā cāsi vedyo vedayitā bhavān || 29 || || jaiminiruvāca || || evaṃ vijñāpanāṃte tu durvāsā sa mahāmuniḥ || praṇamya sāṣṭāṃgapātaṃ kṛtāṃjalirupasthitaḥ || provāca vinayānnīco dhātāraṃ jagatāṃ gurum || 2.2.23.30 || vibho dvārapraveśe'tra dauvārikanivāritāḥ || lokapālāḥ sapitarastathā manvaṃtarādhipāḥ || 31 || tiṣṭhaṃti dīnajanavatsucirāllokabhāvana || tadājñāpaya paśyaṃtu tava pādasaroruham || 32 || tacchrutvā devadevastu tadā durvāsaso vacaḥ || prahasya vacanaṃ prāha naiṣāṃ prastāva eva hi || 33 || iṃdradyumnena sparddhaṃte kiṃ tu mohavaśānugāḥ || jīvanmukto'yaṃ nṛpatiḥ kṣīṇakarmāghasaṃhatiḥ | 34 || matsaṃtateḥ paṃcamo'yaṃ vaiṣṇavo viṣṇutatparaḥ || ete hi sukhabhogāya karmaṇā prāptapauruṣāḥ || 35 || atrāgatiṃ prārthayaṃtastapastaptvā hi devatāḥ || mamānugrahata ete āyātā madupāsane || 36 || tathāpi tvadanujñātā āyāṃtu mama darśane || tataḥ praviṣṭāste devā durvāsovacanena vai || 37 || dūrātpraṇemurbrahmāṇaṃ gāyanānāṃ samīpataḥ || iṃdradyumnaṃ narapatiṃ saṃlapaṃtaṃ kṛtāṃjalim|| 38 || tām̐llokapālānpraṇatānkaṭākṣeṇa jagatprabhuḥ || anujagrāha kathayanniṃdradyumnaṃ sasādaram || 39 || rājankṛtastvayā satyaṃ prāsādo bhagavatsthitau || nāyaṃ kālastathā rājyaṃ na vā tvatsaṃtatirnṛpa || 2.2.23.40 || gītagānāvasarato bhūyānkālo gatastava || manvaṃtaro hi divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ || 41 || tava vaṃśo'pi vicchinnaḥ koṭiśaḥ kṣitipā gatāḥ || devoṃ'timaśca prāsādo dvayamatrāvaśiṣyate || 42 || dvitīyasya manorādiyugaṃ svārociṣasya tu || mamāṃtike'tra vasatomṛtyurvā na jarā tathā || 43 || viparyayamṛtūnāṃ vā na kālapariṇāmatā || tadgaccha bhūmau rājeṃdra devaṃ prāsādameva ca || 44 || ātmasaṃbaṃdhinaṃ kṛtvā punarāyāhi vegavān || athavāhaṃ prayāsyāmi tavānupadameva hi || 45 || tvamagrato dharāṃ gatvā yāvatsaṃbhāramṛddhimat || kariṣyasi mahābhāga tāvadeva vrajāmyaham || 46 || ityājñāpyeṃdradyumnaṃ taṃ bhagavānsa pitāmahaḥ || devānpuraḥsthitānāha vinayānatakaṃdharān || 47 || baddhāṃjalīnsādhvasāṃstāṃstatpādanyastavīkṣaṇān || uvāca bhagavānsnigdhagaṃbhīravacasā dvijāḥ || 48 || kimarthamāgatāḥ sarve yugapattu divaukasaḥ || yatkāryaṃ vo mayā kāryaṃ vijñāpayata mā ciram || 49 || || jaiminiruvāca || || iti śrutvā vaco dhātustridaśā vigatajvarāḥ || pratyūcurharṣitāḥ sarve bhagavaṃtaṃ pitāmaham || 2.2.23.50 || || devā ūcuḥ || || upāsitaḥ purāsmābhiryo nīlādrau maṇīmayaḥ || antarhitaḥ kathaṃ deva idānīṃ dārudehadhṛk || 51 || āvirbhūtaḥ kratoraṃta indradyumnasya bhūpateḥ || etasya kāraṇaṃ jñātuṃ bhavataḥ pādapaṃkajam || 52 || ārādhitumihāyātāḥ prasīda kathayasva tat || ityukte tridaśairdevo bhagavānpaṃkajāsanaḥ || 53 || rahasyametadbho devāḥ kasyacinnoditaṃ purā || sarve samuditā yasmādapṛcchata cirāgatāḥ || 54 || tato vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi surāṇāṃ guhyamuttamam || pūrve parārddhe bho devāḥ kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 55 || nīlāśmavapurāsthāya na tatyāja janārdanaḥ || sāṃprataṃ me dvitīyaṃ tu parārddhaṃ samupasthitam || 56 || manuḥ svāyambhuvo nāma śvetavārāhakalpake || pravarttate'yaṃ kālo vai prātarādyadinasya ca || 57 || dārumūrtirayaṃ devo bhuvanānāṃ hi madhyame || mamāyuṣaḥ pramāṇaṃ tu sthāsyate mānayanprabhuḥ || 58 || mamātmā eṣa bhagavānahametanmayaḥ surāḥ || nāvayorvidyate kiṃcidasminsthāvarajaṃgame || 59 || kṣīrodārṇavamadhye hi śvetadvīpe hi talpake || yaḥ śete yoganidrāṃ tāṃ mānayanpuruṣottamaḥ || 2.2.23.60 || sa mūlaṃ jagatāmādistasya romāṇi yāni vai || tāni kalpadrumākhyāni śaṃkhacakrāṃkitāni vai || 61 || tanmadhyastho hyayaṃ vṛkṣaścaitanyādhiṣṭhitaḥ surāḥ || svayamutpatitaḥ siṃdhoḥ salile satyapūruṣaḥ || 62 || bhogānbhoktuṃ trilokasthāndāruvarṣmā janārdanaḥ || anekajanmasāhasrairbhaktiyogena bhāvitaḥ || 63 || ghorasaṃsāranāśāya mayā pūrvaṃ prayācitaḥ || punaḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭilīnapālanodvignacetasā || 64 || aśeṣakarmanāśāya jagatāṃ sarvamuktaye || dhāraṇādhyānayogānāṃ duṣkarāṇāṃ vināpi saḥ || 65 || mokṣāya bhagavānāvirbabhūva puruṣottamaḥ || pracchannaṃ vapuretasya kṣetraṃ nāsya vicārayet || 66 || dharmigrāhapramāṇena yādṛgdṛṣṭaḥ sa eva saḥ || caturvargaprado devo yo yathā taṃ vibhāvayet || 67 || taddarśanaparikṣīṇapāpasaṃghāḥ kramādbhuvi || bhavanti nirmalātmānaḥ puruṣā muktibhājanam || 68 || || jaiminiruvāca || || etacchrutvā tu te devāḥ padmayonervacomṛtam || hṛṣṭāḥ saṃciṃtayāmāsuḥ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 69 || acirasthāyi devatvaṃ vihāyaitadbhuvaṃ gatāḥ || asminkṣetravare devamārādhyāmaḥ susaṃyatāḥ || 2.2.23.70 || harṣapraphullavadanānsurāndṛṣṭvā pitāmaha || indradyumnānugrahāya yaḥ prakāśaṃ gataḥ prabhuḥ || 71 || yātā'tra pratimā tvasya svayameva vadiṣyati || varānpradāsyati bahūnbhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || 72 || prāsādamindradyumnasya pratiṣṭhāpayituṃ vibhum || ahaṃ cāpi gamiṣyāmi yūyaṃ tatra prayāta vai || 73 || indradyumno'grato yātu pratiṣṭhāvastusaṃbhṛtau || sahāyāstatra bhavata yūyaṃ kṣīṇādhikāriṇaḥ || 74 || manvantaraṃ vyatītaṃ vai prathamaṃ sāṃprataṃ surāḥ || indradyumnena sahitāstatra gatvā surottamāḥ || 75 || prāsādapratimānāṃ ca vidhartā svāmyamasya vai || tasmātsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraḥ sasahāyo'dhunā hyasau || 76 || asya saṃtatisaṃbandhasmaraṇādapi bhūtale || madājñayā padmanidhiḥ saha yāsyati bhūtalam || 77 || pratiṣṭhāyai bhagavataḥ saṃyatau sarvavastunaḥ || indradyumno'pi hṛṣṭātmā dṛṣṭvā brāhmīṃ śriyaṃ dvijāḥ || 78 || mahadāścaryasaṃpannaḥ praṇipatya jagadgurum || tadājñāṃ śirasā dhṛtvā devaiḥ kṣīṇādhikāribhiḥ || 79 || ājagāma bhuvaṃ viprā vidhinā cānumoditāḥ || 2.2.23.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||
<2.2.24>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || āgatya ca jagannāthaṃ cirādutkaṃṭhamānasaḥ || daṃḍavatpraṇanāmāsau ghanaromāṃcakaṃcukaḥ || 1 || namo brahmaṇyadevāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca || praṇatārtivināśāya caturvargaikahetave || 2 || hiraṇyagarbhapuruṣapradhānavyaktarūpiṇe || oṃ namo vāsudevāya śuddhajñānasvarūpiṇe || 3 || ityuccaranstutiṃ bhūpaḥ sānaṃdāśruvilocanaḥ || pradakṣiṇaṃ punaḥ kurvannanāma ca punaḥpunaḥ || 4 || tato'nyā devatā yā vai tatrāgacchanmudānvitāḥ || tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatā devaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā mudā || 5 || || devā ūcuḥ || || sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt || sa bhūmiṃ sarvato vyāpya adhyatiṣṭhaddaśāṃgulam |||| 6 || yaḥ pumānparamaṃ brahma paramātmeti gīyate || bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarvaṃ puruṣa eva tat || 7 || etāvānasya mahimā jyāyāneṣa pumānprabhuḥ || pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi || 8 || chandāṃsi jajñire tvattastvatto yajñapumānapi || tvatto'śvāśca vyajāyaṃta gāvo meṣādayastathā || 9 || brāhmaṇā mukhato jātā bāhujāḥ kṣatriyāstava || viśastavorujā padbhyāṃ tathā śūdrāḥ samāgatāḥ || 2.2.24.10 || manasaścaṃdramā jātaścakṣuṣaste divākaraḥ|| karṇābhyāṃ śvasanaḥ prāṇairjihvāyā havyavāḍapi || 11 || nābhito gaganaṃ dyauśca mūrdhnaste samavarttata || pādābhyāṃ te dharā jātā diśaścāṣṭau śrutergatāḥ || 12 || saptāsanparidhayastvatta ekaviṃśatsamicca vai || carācarāḥ sarvabhāvāstvatta eva hi jajñire || 13 || tvameva jagatāṃ nāthastvameva paripālakaḥ || ugrarūpaśca saṃhartā tvameva parameśvara || 14 || tvameva yajño yajñāṃśastvaṃ yajñeśaḥ parātparaḥ || śabdabrahmaparaṃ tvaṃ hi śabdabrahmāsi viśvarāṭ || 15 || svarāṭ samrāḍjagannātha virāḍasi jagatpate || adhaścordhvaṃ ca tiryaktvaṃ tvayā vyāptaṃ jaganmaya || 16 || prāpnuvaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ tvāṃ yajaṃtaśca yājñikāḥ|| bhojyaṃ bhoktā havirhotā havanaṃ tvaṃ phalapradaḥ || 17 || samastakarmabhoktā tvaṃ sarvakarmātmakaḥ prabho || sarvakarmopakaraṇaṃ sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ || 18 || karmaprerayitā tvaṃ hi dharmakāmārthasiddhidaḥ || tvāmṛte muktidaḥ ko'nyo hṛṣīkeśa namo'stu te || 19 || namo'stvanantāya sahasramūrttaye sahasrapādākṣiśirorubāhave || sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasrakoṭīyugadhāriṇe namaḥ || 2.2.24.20 || vayaṃ cyutādhikārāstvāṃ prapannāḥ śaraṇaṃ prabho || trāhi naḥ puṃḍarīkākṣa agatīnāṃ gatirbhava || 21 || saṃsārapatitasyaiko jantostvaṃ śaraṇaṃ prabho || tvatsṛṣṭau tvādṛśo nāsti yo dīnaparipālakaḥ || 22 || dīnānāthaikaśaraṇaṃ pitā tvaṃ jagataḥ prabho || pātā poṣṭā tvameveśa sarvāpadvinivārakaḥ || 23 || trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha trāhi naḥ parameśvara || tvāmṛte kamalākāṃta kaḥ śaktaḥ parirakṣaṇe || 24 || antaryāminnamaste'stu sarvatejonidhe namaḥ || 25 || iti stuvaṃtaste devāḥ praṇipatya punaḥpunaḥ|| iṃdradyumnena sahitā bahirbhūya dvijottamāḥ || 26 || kṣetraṃ śrīnarasiṃhasya gatvā taṃ praṇipatya ca || namaskṛtya parāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛtvābhyarcya nṛkesarim || ||27|| nīlācalādreḥ śikharaṃ yatra prāsāda uttamaḥ || yayuste padmanidhinā sārddhaṃ saṃbhārakāraṇāt || 28 || dadṛśuste mahāprāṃśuṃ vyāptaṃ gaganamaṇḍale || uttiṣṭhaṃtaṃ viṃdhyagiriṃ roddhuṃ bhānorgatiṃ kimu || 29 || vyaśnuvānaṃ diśaḥ sarvā vicitraghaṭanojjvalam || bahukālavyatikrāṃtasvastibhaṃgivicitrakam |||| 2.2.24.30 || tataśca ciṃtayāmāsa indradyumnaḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ || ghaṭanārthe mayā yātaḥ satyalokamitaḥ purā || 31 || sucirāddṛṣṭipathagaḥ pūrṇaḥ prāsāda uttamaḥ || anugrahādvai devasya nātra mānuṣapauruṣam || 32 || manvaṃtarasamāptiḥ kva sūryacandreṃdrarodhikā || tathāpi tiṣṭhate cāyaṃ prāsādo hyeṣa durlabhaḥ ||| 33 || valmīkasadṛśā hyete prāsādā mānuṣaiḥ kṛtāḥ || śīryaṃti rohaṇairvṛkṣaiḥ svalpakālagatāyuṣaḥ || 34 || madanukrośabuddhyā tu rakṣitaṃ bhavanaṃ hareḥ || tatastānsa sahāyānvai jagāda praśrayaṃ vacaḥ || 35 || jānīta jagadīśasya prāsādaṃ kāritaṃ mayā || āvirbabhūva bhagavāndārurūpavapuḥ svayam || tadāṃtarikṣagā vāṇī māmuvācāśarīriṇī || 36 || sahasrapāṇisaṃmitaṃ nīlādreḥ śikharopari || prāsādaṃ kārayasveti sthitaye jagadīśituḥ || 37 || etatpratiṣṭhānavidhau svayamatrāgamiṣyati || padmayoniḥ svayaṃ sārddhaṃ siddhabrahmarṣidaivataiḥ || 38 || tadatra kriyate ko vā saṃbhāro jñāyate katham || ityuktavaṃtaṃ te procurdevā bhagnādhikāriṇaḥ || 39 || || devā ūcuḥ || || na jānīmo vayamapi tadasmākaṃ gururguruḥ || idānīṃ na vaśe'smākaṃ sa hi svargaparo hitaḥ || 2.2.24.40 || || padmanidhiruvāca || || svāminvidheranujñānādāgato'smi tvayā saha || kartavyaṃ kiṃ mayā cātra kiṃ vā vastu pratīkṣyate || 41 || || jaiminiruvāca || || iti hyālapyamānānāṃ nāradaḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ || brahmaṇā preṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 42|| sarvasaṃbhāravastūni yathāśāstraṃ mune kuru || saṃpādayiṣyati tava śāsanātpadmako nidhiḥ || 43 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā te mudā yuktā uttasthurbrahmaṇaḥ sutam || ṣaḍarghyapūjayā tasya pūjāṃ cakre nṛpottamaḥ || 44 || praṇemuste'pi taṃ devā manuṣyākāradhāriṇaḥ || ūce tamiṃdradyumno'pi pratiṣṭhāvidhivastuni || || 45 || nāhaṃ vedmi muniśreṣṭha cirāttyaktaḥ purodhasā || ādeśaya kramādbrahmansaṃpādyaṃ yadyadeva hi || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
<2.2.25>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ityukte nāradaḥ so'tha yathāśāstraṃ vicārya vai || ālekhya kramaśaḥ patre rājñe tasmai nyavedayat || 1 || rājāpi patraṃ tacchutvā so'vadhārya punaḥpunaḥ || pradadau padmanidhaye likhitānyatra yāni vai || 2 || saṃpādaya padmanidhe śālāṃ svarṇamayīṃ kuru || brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ divyaṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ ca nirmalam || 3|| iṃdrādīnāṃ surāṇāṃ ca siddhānāṃ martyavāsinām || munīṃdrāṇāṃ nivāsāya rājñāṃ pātālavāsinām || 4 || tathā ca nāgarājānāṃ nidhe trailokyavāsinām || yathāyogyāsanairyuktaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhamataṃdritaḥ || 5 || kārayāśu nidhe dravyasaṃbhāraṃ yāvadeva tu || viśvakarmāpi ca tava sāhāyyaṃ racayiṣyati || 6 || ityādiśaṃtaṃ sa muniriṃdradyumnamuvāca vai || saṃbhārānpṛthagetaddhi karttavyaṃ vyavadhānataḥ || 7 || svarṇaiḥ sughaṭitaṃ sādhurathatrayamalaṃkṛtam || dukūlaratnamālādyairbahumūlyairdṛḍhaṃ mahat || 8 || śrīvāsudevasya ratho garuḍadhvajacihnitaḥ || padmadhvajaḥ subhadrāyā rathamūrddhani dhāryatām || 9 || rathaḥ ṣoḍaśacakrastu viṣṇoḥ kāryaḥ prayatnataḥ || caturdaśa balasyaiva subhadrāyāstu dvādaśa || 2.2.25.10 || hastaṣoḍaśavistāro rathaścakradharasya tu || caturdaśa balasyaiva subhadrāyāstu dvādaśa || 11 || āsanaṃ jagatāṃ bhūyaḥ svayaṃ svāsanavigrahaḥ || tadyāne jagatāṃ nāśastato yānaṃ na vidyate || 12 || paśyeccarācaraṃ viśvaṃ jñānādaśa sunirmale || sthito hastatale nityaṃ nirmalastasya darpaṇaḥ || 13 || talasthatvādasau tālaḥ sadā tenāṃkitaḥ prabhuḥ || tataḥ sa eva śeṣasya balabhadrāvatāriṇaḥ || 14 || athavā sīriṇaḥ kāryaṃ sīrameva dhvajottamam || dhvajaḥ sunirmalaḥ kāryastasmāttāladhvajo mataḥ || 15 || na vāsitavyo devo'sāvapratiṣṭhe rathe nṛpa || prāsāde maṃḍape vāpi pure tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet || 16 || tasmātpratiṣṭhā prathamaṃ hareḥ kāryā rathasya vai || saṃbhāraḥ kriyatāṃ tasya hyanuṣṭheyā mayā tu sā || 17 || ityājñāṃ matpiturlabdhvā śīghramāyāmyahaṃ nṛpa || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ghaṭitaṃ syaṃdanatrayam || 18 || nidhisaṃpāditairdravyairekāhnādviśvakarmaṇā || svakṣaṃ sucakraṃ sustaṃbhaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ sutoraṇam || 19 || sudhvajaṃ supatākaṃ ca nānācitramanoharam || vicitrabaṃdhamithunaputtalīvalayānvitam || 2.2.25.20|| arddhahāṭakanirvyūḍhaṃ sākṣādravirathopamam || meghagaṃbhīranirghoṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā karṣaguṇairyutam || vātaraṃhohayairyuktaṃ śatasaṃkhyaiḥ sitaprabhaiḥ || 21 || yathāśāstravidhānena nāradena pratiṣṭhitam || sulagne sumuhūrte ca sutithau jyotiṣodite || 22 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavañjaimine brūhi sarvajñosi mato hi naḥ ||23|| vidhinā kena hi rathaḥ pratiṣṭhāpyo harerayam || yathāvadvada no yena jānīmo vidhivistaram || 24 || || jaiminiruvāca || || yathā pratiṣṭhitaṃ tena nāradena mahātmanā || tadvo vadiṣyāmi vidhiṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ purā mayā || 25 || rathasyeśānadigbhāge śālāṃ kṛtvā suśobhanām || tanmadhye maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ tatra sunirmalām ||26|| caturasrā caturhastamitāṃ hastocchritāṃ dvijāḥ || pratiṣṭhāpūrvadivase rātrāvuttarataḥ śubhe ||27|| muhūrte svasti vācyātha kārayedaṃkurārpaṇam || dvātriṃśaddevatābhyaśca baliṃ dattvā yathāvidhi ||28|| prātastato vedikāyāṃ madhye maṇḍalamālikhet || padmaṃ vā svastikaṃ vāpi kumbhaṃ tatra nidhāpayet || 29 || pañcadrumakaṣāyaṃ ca tanmadhye pūrayetsudhīḥ || gaṃgādipuṇyatoyāni pallavānsa samṛttikāḥ || 2.2.25.30 || sarvagaṃdhānpañcaratnasarvauṣadhigaṇaṃ tathā || pūrayitvā vidhānena ācāryaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ || 31 || viṣṇuṃ smaranpaṃcagavyaṃ paścādapi prapūrayet || dukūlaveṣṭitaṃ kaṇṭhe mālyairgaṃdhaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ || 32 || phalapallavasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtakautukamaṃgalam || pūrayettatra deveśaṃ narasiṃhamanāmayam || 33 || maṃtrarājenavidhivadupacāraistathāṃtaraiḥ || prārthayitvā prasādāya tasminnāvāhya taṃ harim || 34 || bāhyopacārairvividhaiḥ pūjayedvidhivaddvijāḥ || vāyavyāṃ tasya kumbhasya samidājyacaruṃ tathā || 35 || aṣṭottarasahasraṃ ca juhuyādvidhivadguruḥ || saṃpātānprāpayettatra kumbhamadhye tadantataḥ || 36 || rathaṃ suśobhanaṃ kṛtvā patākāgaṃdhamālyakaiḥ || sarvāṃgaṃ secayettasya gaṃdhacandanavāribhiḥ || 37 || dhūpayetkālāguruṇā śaṃkhakāhālanisvanaiḥ || dhvaje tasya nṛsiṃhasya pratiṣṭhāpya samīraṇam|| 38 || pūjayitvā vidhānena raktasraggaṃdhamālyakaiḥ || imaṃ maṃtraṃ samuccārya suparṇaṃ prārthayettataḥ || 39 || yo viśvaprāṇahetustanurapi ca hareryānaketusvarūpoyaṃ saṃcityaiva sadyaḥ svayamuragavadhūvargagarbhāḥ pataṃti || caṃcaccaṇḍorutuṃḍatruṭita phaṇivasāraktapaṃkāṃkitāsyaṃ vande chandomayaṃ taṃ khagapatimamalaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ suparṇam || 2.2.25.40 || brahmaghoṣaiḥ śaṃkhanādairnānāvādyasuvistaraiḥ || rathamūrdhni sthāpayettaṃ cārusūktaṃ samuccaran || 41 || tasyopariṣṭāttaṃ kumbhaṃ samaṃtātplāvayanratham|| triruccaranmaṃtrarājaṃ secayedbrahmaṇā saha || 42 || tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || ācāryaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyena tuṣyati tadguruḥ || 43 || brāhmaṇānbhojayedante pāyasairmadhusarpiṣā || dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa balabhadrasya kārayet || 44 || lāṃgalaṃ ca paviravanmaṃtraḥ syāllāṃgaladhvaje || athavā dviṣaḍvarṇopi mūlamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 45 || lakṣmīsūktena bhadrāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāpyo rathastathā || nābhihradānmurārestvaṃ brahmāṃḍāvalirūpadhṛk || 46 || āsanaṃ caturāsyasya śriyo vāsa sthiro bhava || ima mantraṃ samuccārya dhvajapadmaṃ samucchrayet || 47 || iyānviśeṣo haviṣā trayāṇāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak || paṃcapaṃcabhirhotavyamekaikaṃ tu vibhāgaśaḥ || 48 || itthaṃ rathānpratiṣṭhāpya suvarṇaṃ gāṃ ca vastrakam || dhānyaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsamyagdevasya bhaktitaḥ || 49 || evaṃ pratiṣṭhite tatra syaṃdane'tha subhūṣite || āropya devaṃ vidhivadbrahmaghoṣapuraḥsaram || 2.2.25.50 || jayamaṃgalaśabdaiśca nānāvādyapuraḥsaraiḥ || cāmarāṃdolanairdhūpaiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭibhireva ca || 51 || brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyairnīyate sma rathaṃ prati || hayaiḥ sulakṣaṇairdāṃtairbalīvardairathāpi vā || 52 || puruṣairviṣṇubhaktairvā netavyā hyapramādataḥ || prīṇayitvā janaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādilepanaiḥ || 53 || rathasyopari devebhyo balimantreṇa bho dvijāḥ || baliṃ gṛhṇantu bho devā ādityā vasavastathā || 54 || marutaścāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagā grahāḥ || asurā yātudhānāśca rathasthāścaiva devatāḥ || 55 || dikpālā lokapālāśca ye ca vighnavināyakāḥ || jagataḥ svasti kurvaṃtu divyā maharṣayastathā || 56 || avighnamācaraṃtvete mā saṃtu paripaṃthinaḥ || saumyā bhavaṃtu tṛptāśca daityā bhūtagaṇāstathā || 57 || tatastu nīyate devaḥ samabhūmau samuccaran || maṃtraṃ vaiṣṇavagāyatrīṃ viṣṇoḥ sūktaṃ pavitrakam || 58 || vāmadevyaiḥ pavitraiśca mānastokyai rathaṃtaraiḥ || tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa kṛtavāditraniḥsvanam || 59 || śanaiḥ śanairatho neyo rathaḥ snehāttu cakriṇaḥ || tatrotpātānpravakṣyāmi rathetra dvijasattamāḥ || 2.2.25.60 || īṣābhaṃge dvijabhayaṃ bhagne'kṣe kṣatriyakṣayaḥ || tulābhaṃge vaiśyanāśaḥ śamyā śūdrabhayaṃ bhavet ||61|| dhurābhaṃge tvanāvṛṣṭiḥ pīṭhabhaṃge prajābhayam || paracakrāgamaṃ vidyāccakrabhaṃge rathasya tu || 62 || dhvajasya patane viprā nṛpo'nyo jāyate dhuvam || pratimābhaṃgatāyāṃ tu rājño maraṇamādiśet || 63 || paryaste tu rathe viprāḥ sarvajānapadakṣayaḥ || utpanneṣvevamādyeṣu utpāteṣvaśubheṣu ca ||64|| balikarma punaḥ kuryācchāṃtihomaṃ tathaiva ca || brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhūyo dadyādvānnāni caiva hi || 65 || pūrvottare ca digbhāge rathasyāgniṃ prakalpayeta || samidbhirghṛtamadhvājyamūlāgrābhiśca homayet || 66 || pālāśābhirdvijaśreṣṭhā maṃtrarājena dīkṣitaḥ || somāyāgnaye prajābhyaḥ prajānāṃ pataye tathā || 67 || grahebhyaśca brahmaṇe ca dikpālebhyastadaṃtataḥ || yatra yatra rathe doṣāstatra tatra ca dīkṣitaḥ || 68 || juhuyātpratiṣṭhāmaṃtreṇa viśeṣaḥ sarvato bhavet || brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitaḥ kuryāddhomāṃte śāṃtivācanam ||69|| svasti bhavatu viprebhyaḥ svastirājñe'stu nityaśaḥ || gobhyaḥ svasti prajābhyastu jagataḥ śāṃtirastu vai || 2.2.25.70 || svastyastu dvipade nityaṃ śāṃtirastu catuṣpade || śaṃ prajābhyastathaivāstu śaṃ tathātmani cāstu naḥ ||71|| śāṃtirastu ca devasya bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śivaṃ tathā || śāṃtirastu śivaṃ cāstu sarvataḥ svastirastu naḥ || 72 || tvaṃ deva jagataḥ sraṣṭā poṣṭā caiva tvameva hi || prajāḥ pālaya deveśa śāṃtiṃ kuru jagatpate ||73|| yātrākāraṇabhūtasya puruṣasya ca bhūpate || duṣṭāngrahāṃstu vijñāya grahaśāṃtiṃ samācaret || 74 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<2.2.26>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || nirutpātaṃ same deśe vidhivarttanayāpi ca || prāsādanikaṭaṃ devāḥ prāpitāḥ sumuhurttake || 1 || tataḥ śālāsumahatī ratnavarṇavinirmitā || nideśādiṃdradyumnasya nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā || 2 || sabhārcanāyāṃ vastūni havīṃṣi ca samitkuśāḥ || bhojyaṃ nānāvidhaṃ gītanṛtyāṃśca vividhāṃstathā || 3 || sāmrājye yādṛśī pūrvaṃ saṃpattirabhavatkṣitau || tataḥ śreṣṭhatarā viprāḥ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ babhūva ha || 4 || gālonāma mahīpālastadā kṣititale'bhavat || sopyatra pratimāṃ kṛtvā mādhavākhyāṃ dṛṣanmayīm || 5 || sthāpayitvātra prāsāde pūjayāmāsa ṛddhimat || kanīyāṃsaṃ ca prāsādaṃ nirmāya nṛpasattamaḥ || 6 || tatra tāṃ sthāpayāmāsa tato niṣkṛṣya sādaram || tato'sya nṛpatirdūtamukhācchutvāsya karma tat || 7 || gālo'bhyāgātsasainyaḥ sankruddhastaṃ nīlaparvatam || dṛṣṭvā pratiṣṭhāsaṃbhāraṃ martyaiḥ svapne'pi durlabham || 8 || vismayāviṣṭacetāḥ sa tasthau gālo narādhipaḥ || kimetaditi vṛttāntaṃ ko vā kārayatīdṛśam || || 9 || yatnāddivyaṃ sa vijñāya indradyumnaṃ narādhipam || brahmalokādāgataṃ taṃ karttāraṃ devaveśmanaḥ || 2.2.26.10 || pratiṣṭhāpayituṃ devaiḥ sārddhaṃ saṃbhārakārakam || sahitaṃ padmanidhinā guruṇā nāradena ca || 11 || brahmāṇaṃ cāgamiṣyantaṃ pratiṣṭhāyai surottamam || śrutvā sarvaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ tadrājā divyaceṣṭitam || || 12 || mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ tadrājye paramādbhutam || itaḥ śreyaskaraṃ karma na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 13 || tadasya nikaṭe sthitvā jñātvā karmakramaṃ vidhim || utsavāṃścāpi vijñāya kariṣye prativatsaram || 14 || amuṃ dārumayaṃ sākṣādbrahmarūpaṃ janārdanam || abhāgyopacayādetāvaṃtaṃ kālaṃ na jānatā || 15 || asevyamānena kṛtaṃ janmaiva viphalaṃ mayā || tadenamiṃdradyumnaṃ vai praṇipatya jagadgurum || 16 || mahābhāgavataśreṣṭhaṃ brahmalokādihāgatam || upetya śaraṇaṃ sākṣāddṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum || 17 || pratiṣṭhitaṃ vai prāsāde muktimeṣyāmi niścayam || vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa pratiṣṭhāpya mayyevāropayiṣyati || 18 || brahmalokaṃ gato yo vai kiṃ kṣitau so'vatiṣṭhate || upacārānsamādiśya koṣaṃ saṃbhṛtya ca prabhoḥ|| || 19 || brahmaṇā sahito'vaśyaṃ punaryāsyati tatkṣayam || vicārya maṃtribhiḥ sārddhaṃ tato gālo'pi vaiṣṇavaḥ || 2.2.26.20 || indradyumnasya nikaṭaṃ vinītaḥ prayayau mudā || gatvā taṃ dūrato dṛṣṭvā praṇipātapuraḥsaram || 21 || baddhāṃjalipuṭo rājā mūrdhni vīkṣansasādhvasam || śanaiḥ śanairyayau tasya nikaṭaṃ gālapārthivaḥ || 22 || deva tvaṃ rājarājo'si martyo'si brahmalokagaḥ || kiṃ staumi nṛpakīṭo'haṃ tvāṃ jīvanmuktamīśvaram || 23 || ajñātvā mahimānaṃ te sacivairmaṃtrayanmuhuḥ || yoddhumabhyāgato deva dṛṣṭvā te pauruṣaṃ mahat || 24 || atimānuṣamāścaryaṃ padaṃ cāpi śacīpateḥ || dṛṣṭvaitanniścitaṃ deva brahmalokāgatasya hi || 25 || īdṛśaṃ hi mahatkarma yadājñākṛnmahānidhiḥ || cetaḥ prasādapravaṇaṃ mayi dhehi surottama || 26 || trailokyavāsino devā yadājñāvaśavartinaḥ || 27 || || jaiminiruvāca || || itthaṃ vijñāpayaṃtaṃ taṃ gālaṃ nṛpatikuṃjaram || smayamāna uvācedaṃ rājankiṃ bahu bhāṣase || 28|| bhavānapi harerbhaktaḥ sārvabhaumo mahīpatiḥ || sāmānyametadrājñā vai bhūsvāmyaṃ bhuvi varttatām || 29 || sāṃprataṃ hi bhavānatra pṛthivyāmekapārthivaḥ || nṛpāyattāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā martyānāṃ marutāmapi||2.2.26.30|| aṣṭadikpālakāṃśaistu brahmaṇā nirmito nṛpaḥ|| na hyalpapuṇyakṛdrājā prajāpālanatatpara || 31 || iha kīrtiṃ ca dharmaśca yatra gacchansuvartmani || prāpnoti rājaśārdūla viśeṣāttvaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaḥ ||32|| prāsāde sthāpayedyastu harerarcāṃ vidhānataḥ|| na dehabandhamāpnoti yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||33|| mādhavapratimāmetāṃ dāravīṃ śubhalakṣaṇām || sākṣānmuktipradāṃ bhūpa svayaṃ sthāpitavānasi ||34|| nirvighnaṃ karma te jātaṃ mama manvaṃtaraṃ gatam || bhavedvā saṃśayo me'tra na svataṃtraścaturmukhaḥ || 35 || pratiṣṭhāyai prārthito'yaṃ tadanyaḥ sthāpayetkatham || sākṣāddārvavatārasya prāsādasya nṛpottama || 36 || saṃnidhānena cedatra vidhātānugrahiṣyati || tadenaṃ sthāpayitvā tu catūrūpaṃ janārdanam || 37 || samarpya tvāṃ gamiṣyāmi tvamevopacariṣyasi || nityopahāraṃ yātrāśca utsavāṃśca jagatpateḥ || 38 || yānevopadiśeddevaḥ svayaṃ vā prapitāmahaḥ || tāṃstānprayatnātkurvīta rājā vai dharmapālakaḥ || 39 || tataḥ sa gālo nṛpatiḥ śrutvā tacciṃtitaṃ svayam || indradyumnādiṣṭametaditi prāpa parāṃ mudam || 2.2.26.40 || tasthau tasyāṃtike gāla ājñākāra iva svayam || tattadāśu karotyeṣa indradyumno yadādiśat || 41 || evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraḥ siṃhāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ || devaiḥ parivṛtaśceṃdradyumnaḥ śakra ivābabhau || 42 || tato'śrūyaṃta ninadā divyaduṃdubhijāḥ śubhāḥ || mṛdaṃgaveṇuvīṇādi tālakāhālaniḥsvanāḥ || 43 || airāvatādikariṇāṃ bṛṃhitāni bahūni khe || samaṃtājjayaśabdāśca puṣpavṛṣṭivimiśritāḥ || 44 || ākāśagaṃgāsalilakaṇā mandāramiśritāḥ || divya sraglepadhūpānāṃ gandhā digvyāpinastathā || vaimānikānāṃ devānāṃ kiṃkiṇījālaniḥsvanāḥ || 45 || tataśca tejasāṃ rāśī rodasīmadhyapūrakaḥ || āvirāsītkṣitigata nayanācchādako dvijāḥ || 46 || uttolitākṣimālābhiḥ prajābhirvīkṣitaḥ puraḥ || tataḥ kramātsa dadṛśe vimānāgryaṃ prajāpateḥ || || 47 || svarṇahaṃsaśataiḥ skaṃdhenohyamānaḥ samaṃtataḥ || dikpālaiścāmaravyagrahastairāsevitaḥ puraḥ || 48 || jāhnavīyamunānīraprakīrṇakakare'bhitaḥ || pārśvayoścandrasūryābhyāmubhābhyāmātapatrake || 49 || dhāryamāṇe śanairvāyorgaticaṃcalacolake || brahmarṣibhirgautamādyaiḥ stūyamāno rahasyakaiḥ || 2.2.26.50 || tanmadhyasthaḥ prajānātha iṃdradyumnādibhiḥ stutaḥ || āluloke devagaṇairjayaśabdairabhiṣṭutaḥ || 51 || raṃbhādikābhirveśyābhirnṛtyate sma sasādhvasam || hāhāhūhūprabhṛtibhirgīyamānaśca gāyakaiḥ || 52 || siddhavidyādharagaṇaiḥ sādaraṃ copavīṇitaḥ || kṛtāṃjalipuṭairdūrāttapasvibhirupāsitaḥ || 53 || sāvitrīśārade tasya vākprabaṃdhairvicitrakaiḥ || toṣamāsādayaṃtyau ca ko'nyastattoṣaṇe kṣamaḥ || 54 || jāhnavīyamunānīra prakīrṇita kalevaraḥ || ye ca gaṃdharvasiddhādyā nāradapramukhā dvijāḥ || 55 || vetrahastāḥ savinayā divyasopānadarśanāḥ || saṃmardaḥ sa mahānāsīddevānāṃ divi gacchatām || 56 || na ko'pi gaṇyate devaḥ ko vā kena pathā vrajet || ahaṃpūrvikayā teṣāṃ vrajatāṃ tridivaukasām || 57 || saṃmardātiśayātteṣāṃ vibhraṃśo'bhūtsvavāhanaiḥ || sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃharttā jagatāṃ yo jaganmayaḥ || 58 || sākṣādvrajati tatraiṣāṃ surāṇāṃ mahimā kutaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhvasānnamro bhaktyā baddhāṃjalirnṛpaḥ || 59 || tairdevairgālarājena nāradapramukhena ca || sahito dharaṇīṃ prāyātsāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca || 2.2.26.60 || utthāya parayā bhaktyā prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgaṃ svaṃ manvānaḥ kṛtārthakam || 61 || purato jagadīśasya paśyañchuddhaṃ pitāmaham || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo rājā mamajjānaṃdasāgare || 62 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
<2.2.27>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || athāṃtarikṣānniḥśreṇī ratnakāṃcananirmitā || saṃlagnā pādasaṃpīṭhe padmayonervimānagā || 1 || sā kṣitispṛṣṭamūlā vai vidhāturavarohaṇe || caturvyāyāmatāpīna sopānaśreṇisaṃyutā || 2 || rathaprāsādayormadhye śakracāpa ivāṃśumān || āvirbabhūva sahasā sādbhutaṃ vīkṣito janaiḥ || 3 || tato gaṃdharvarājaistu ratnavetrakarairdvijāḥ || eṣa paṃthāḥ prabho hyehi ityādeśitamārgakaiḥ || || 4 || durvāsaso nāradasya karayordattahastakaḥ || sopānairavatīrṇo'tha punānaścakṣuṣā jagat || 5 || smayamāno rathāndṛṣṭvā prāsādaṃ samalaṃkṛtam || digaṃtavyāpinīṃ śālāṃ ratnastaṃbhopaśobhitām || 6 || śakrasyāpyadbhutakarī sarvasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtām || avātaradvimānātsa devabrahmarṣirājabhiḥ || 7 || kirīṭadattāṃjalibhiḥ stūyamānaḥ samaṃtataḥ || kaṭākṣeṇānugṛhṇāti yāṃ diśaṃ sa pitāmahaḥ || 8 || tatrāṃjalīnāṃ saṃmardāḥ koṭayaḥ śirasā dhṛtāḥ || pādābja praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā iṃdradyumnaṃ prajāpatiḥ || 9 || uvāca praśrayagirā smitabhinnoṣṭhasaṃpuṭaḥ || aṃgulyā nirdiśandevānpitṝnbrahmarṣitāpasān || || 2.2.27.10 || siddhavidyādharānyakṣagaṃdharvāpsarasastathā || ekatra militānsarvānyugapanmodanirbharān || 11 || paśyeṃdradyumna bhāgyaṃ te sarvalokavaśīkaram || tvadarthamekadā sarve māṃ puraskṛtya saṃgatāḥ || 12 || ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ nārāyaṇarathaṃ tataḥ || praṇipatya jagannāthaṃ triḥ parītya pitāmahaḥ || 13 || ānaṃdasiṃdhusaṃmagnaḥ saromāṃcavapuḥ svayam || svamātmānaṃ nunāvātha pratyakṣaṃ svaragadgadam || 14 || || brahmovāca || || namastubhyaṃ namo mahyaṃ tubhyaṃ mahyaṃ namonamaḥ || ahaṃ tvaṃ tvamahaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || 15 || mahadādi jagatsarvaṃ māyāvilasitaṃ tava || adhyastaṃ tvayi viśvātmaṃstvayaiva pariṇāmitam || 16 || yadetadakhilābhāsaṃ tattvadajñānasaṃbhavam || jñāte tvayi vilīyeta rajjusarpādibodhavat || 17 || anirvaktavyamevedaṃ sattvātsattvavivekataḥ || advitīya jagadbhāsa svaprakāśa namo'stu te || 18 || viṣayānaṃdamakhilaṃ sahajānaṃdarūpiṇaḥ | aṃśaṃ tavopajīvaṃti yena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 19 || niṣprapaṃca nirākāra nirvikāra nirāśraya || sthūlasūkṣmāṇumahimansthaulyasūkṣmavivarjita || 2.2.27.20 || guṇātīta guṇādhāra triguṇātmannamo'stu te || 21 || tvanmāyayā mohito'haṃ sṛṣṭimātraparāyaṇaḥ || adyāpi na labhe śarma aṃtaryyāminnamostu te || 22 || tvannābhipaṃkajājjāto nityaṃ tatraiva saṃstuvan || nātikramitumīśo'smi māyāṃ te ko'nya īśvaraḥ || 23 || ahaṃ yathāṃḍamadhye'sminracitaḥ sṛṣṭikarmaṇi || tathānulomakalitā brahmāṃḍe brahmakoṭayaḥ || 24 || sārddhatrikoṭisaṃkhyānāṃ viriṃcīnāmapi prabho || naiko'pi tattvato vetti yathāhaṃ tvatpuraḥ sthitaḥ || 25 || namociṃtyamahimne te cidrūpāya namonamaḥ || namo devādhidevāya devadevāya te namaḥ || 26 || divyādivyasvarūpāya divyarūpāya te namaḥ || jarāmṛtyuvihīnāya mṛtyurūpāya te namaḥ || 27 || jvaladagnisvarūpāya mṛtyorapi ca mṛtyave || prapannamṛtyuna(?)śāya sahajānaṃdarūpiṇe || bhaktipriyāya jagatāṃ mātre pitre namo namaḥ || 28 || praṇatārtivināśāya nityodyoginnamo'stu te || namonamaste dīnānāṃ kṛpāsahajasiṃdhave || 29 || parāya pararūpāya paraṃpārāya te namaḥ || apārapārabhūtāya brahmarūpāya te namaḥ || 2.2.27.30 || paramārthasvarūpāya namaste parahetave || paraṃparā parivyāpta paratattvaparāya te || 31 || praṇatārtivināśāya namaḥ svātmaikabhānave || purā yatprārthitaṃ svāsminsṛṣṭibhārāvatāraṇe || 32 || tatkuruṣva jagannātha sahajāktadarūpabhāk || tvayi prasanne kiṃ nātha durlabhaṃ mayi vidyate || 33 || tvayaivāhaṃ pṛthaglīlābhedādbhinnaḥ kṛpāṃbudhe || ajñānatimiracchanne jagatkārāgṛhāṃtare || 34 || bhrāmyanna dvāramāpnoti tvāmṛte muktihetave || 35 || namonamaste jagadekavandya surāsurābhyarcitapādapadma || namonamastāpaharaikacaṃdra namonamaḥ śarmasubodhasāṃdra || 36 || namo namaḥ kalpakadūrabhūta duṣprāpyakāmaprada kalpavṛkṣa || dīnāśaraṇyapraṇataikaduḥkhasaṃghoddhṛtau nityasubaddhapakṣa || 37 || prasīda jagatāṃ nātha magnānāṃ duḥkhasāgare || kaṭākṣalīlāpātena trāyasva karuṇākara || || 38 || stutvetthaṃ śrījagannāthaṃ vedārthaḥ sa pitāmahaḥ || jagāma sīriṇaṃ draṣṭumavatīrṇaṃ dharādharam || 39 || praṇamya parayā bhaktyā tuṣṭāva balinaṃ mudā || nabhaḥ śiraste deveśa āpaste vigrahaḥ prabho || 2.2.27.40 || pādau kṣitirmukhaṃ vahniḥ śvasitāni samīraṇaḥ || manaste hyoṣadhīnāthaścakṣuṣī te divākaraḥ || 41 || bāhavaḥ kakubho nātha namaste jñānadarpaṇa || caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ mūlastaṃbhāya sīriṇe || 42 || padāṃbhojaprapannānāṃ namaḥ pāpaughadāriṇe || anantavaktranayanaśrotrapādākṣibāhave || 43 || namo nādimahāmūlatamaḥstomaughabhānave || trayīmaya tridhādoṣanāśāya tryavatāriṇe ||44|| phaṇāmaṇiphaṇākāra kṣitimaṇḍaladhāriṇe || namaḥ kālāgnirudrāya mahārudrāya te namaḥ || 45 || bhogatalpaphaṇācchatramadhyasuptāya te namaḥ || mahārṇavajale vṛddha ekībhūte jagattraye || 46 || tvameva śeṣo bhagavansahasraphaṇamaṃḍitaḥ || phaṇāmaṇigaṇavyājasaṃbhṛtākhilabhautikaḥ || 47 || tvameva nāthaḥ sarveṣāṃ sraṣṭā pālayitā vibho || attā dhārayitā nityaṃ madādyāstvannimittakāḥ || 48 || eṣa nārāyaṇo devo vedāṃteṣūpagīyate || tvatto na bhinno bhagavankāraṇādbhedabhāgasi || 49 || śayyā tvaṃ śayitā hyeṣa chādyaḥ saṃchādako bhavān || yo vai viṣṇuḥ sa vai rāmo yo rāmaḥ kṛṣṇa eva saḥ || 2.2.27.50 || yuvayoraṃtaraṃ nāsti prasīda tvaṃ jaganmaya || iti stavāṃte balinaṃ praṇamya parameśvaram || 51 || īśvarīṃ jagatāṃ draṣṭuṃ subhadrāsyandanaṃ yayau || jaya devi jaganmātaḥ prasīda parameśvari || 52 || kāryakāraṇakartrī tvaṃ sarvaśaktyai namo'stu te || sarvasya hṛdi saṃviṣṭe jñānamohātmike sadā || 53 || kaivalyamuktide bhadre tvāṃ namāmi surāraṇim|| devi tvaṃ viṣṇumāyāsi mohayantī carācaram|| 54 || hṛtpadmāsanasaṃsthāsi viṣṇubhāvānusāriṇī|| tvameva lakṣmīrgaurī ca śacī kātyāyanī tathā ||55|| yacca kiṃcitkvacidvastu sadasadvākhilātmike || tasya sarvasya śaktistvaṃ stotuṃ tvāṃ kastu śaktimān || ||56|| jaya bhadre subhadre tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhadradāyini || bhadrābhadrasvarūpe tvaṃ bhadrakāli namo'stu te||57|| tvaṃ mātā jagatāṃ devi pitā nārāyaṇo hi saḥ|| strīrūpaṃ tvaṃ sarvameva puṃrūpo jagadīśvaraḥ || 58 || yuvayorna hi bhedo'sti nāstyanyatparameva hi || yathā vayaṃ niyuktā hi tvayā vai viṣṇumāyayā || 59 || nideśakāriṇo nityaṃ bhramāmaḥ parameśvari || vṛttiḥ pravṛttiḥ paramā kṣudhā nidrā tvameva ca || 2.2.27.60 || āśā tvamāśāpūrṇā ca sarvāśā paripūrikā|| muktihetustvameveśi baṃdhahetustvameha hi|| 61|| sarvajñānaprade nitye bhaktānāṃ kalpavallarī|| trāhi pādābjanamraṃ māṃ kṛpāpāṃgavilokanaiḥ|| 62|| stutvetthaṃ bhadrarūpāṃ tāṃ tatsamīpasthitaṃ rathe|| cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ
