viṣṇoścaturthaṃ vapurāsthitam||63|| praṇamya parayā bhaktyā imāṃ stutimudāharat|| sudarśana mahājvāla koṭisūryasamaprabha||64|| ajñānatimirāṃdhānāṃ vaikuṇṭhādhvapradarśakaḥ|| namaste nityavilasadvaiṣṇavasvaniketana || 65|| avāryavīryaṃ yadrūpaṃ viṣṇostatpraṇamāmyaham || praṇamya stutvā devānsa rathebhyaḥ parivṛtya ca || 66 || indradyumnanāradābhyāmādiṣṭapadapaddhatiḥ || nīlācalamathārohatprāsādaṃ draṣṭumutsukaḥ || 67 || tataḥ sa gatvā prāsādasamīpaṃ daivataiḥ saha || dadarśa śālāṃ rucirāṃ svacittābhimatā dvijāḥ || 68 || tanmadhye sthāpayāmāsa daivatoragabhūpatīn || brahmarṣīnyogino viprānvaiṣṇavāṃśca tapasvinaḥ || 69 || divyasiṃhāsanavare nṛpeṇa pratipādite || sa pādapīṭhe bhagavānupaviṣṭaḥ svayaṃ vibhuḥ || 2.2.27.70 || śāṃtikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ kartuṃ bhāradvājaṃ mahāmunim || pitāmahājñayā bhūpo varayāmāsa ṛddhimat ||71|| pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu ye devā balipūjāvidhau matāḥ || homeṣu ca tathā te vai dhyānarūpamupāśritāḥ||72|| ājñayā padmayonestu caturdigbhāgamāśritāḥ || supūjitā gaṃdhapuṣpamālālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 73 || tataḥ karma pravavṛte bhāradvājena dhīmatā || pratyakṣaṃ devadevasya sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām || 74 || trailokyavāsināṃ pūjāṃ cakāra nṛpatirmudā || sāṃgopāṃgaṃ samabhyarcya jagatsraṣṭāramagrataḥ || 75 || tataḥ saṃpūjitāḥ sarve tena trailokyavāsinaḥ || paśyanto'vasthitaṃ madhye sākṣādbrahmāṇamavyayam || 76 || vapuṣmaṃtaṃ jagannāthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ brahmarūpiṇam || indradyumnaprasādena jīvanmuktatvamāpnuvan || 77 || kalevaraṃ bhagavataḥ prāsādaṃ sumanoharam || pratiṣṭhāya bharadvājaḥ samucchritamahādhvajam || 78 || vyajñāpayatatpratiṣṭhāyai jīvasyātha pitāmaham || samuttasthau tato brahmā kṛtasvastyayanaḥ svayam || 79 || ṛṣibhirnāradādyaiśca vidvadbhirbrāhmaṇaistathā || rājabhiḥ kṣatriyairnāgaiḥ sahitaḥ paramarṣibhiḥ || 2.2.27.80|| gandharvairgāyamāneṣu divyagāneṣu susvaram || māṃgalyocitarāgeṣu nṛtyantīṣvapsaraḥsu ca || 81 || śākuneṣu ca sūkteṣu paṭhyamāneṣu ca dvijaiḥ || śaṃkhakāhālamurajabherīvāditravaiṇave || 82 || śabde pramūrcchati tataḥ sarve te syandanopari || gatvāvatārayāmāsū rathātsopānavartmani || 83 || sāvadhānāḥ samādhisthā bhaktyā saṃyamitātmakāḥ || pārśvayorbhujayormūrdhni pādayornyastapāṇayaḥ || 84 || śanaiḥ śanaiḥ salīlaṃ te nārāyaṇamanāmayam || vāsaṃ vāsaṃ tūlikāsu ninyuḥ prāsādasannidhim || 85 || uparyupari saṃtānavṛṣṭipūtpatitāsu ca || jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya sarvā'ghanāśana || 86 || jaya līlādārutano jaya vāṃchāphalaprada || jaya saṃsārasaṃmagnalīloddhāra jayāvyaya || 87 || jayānukaṃpāpāthodhe jaya dīnaparāyaṇa || jayācyuta jayānanta jayeśāna namo'stu te ||88|| ebhiḥ stavaiḥ stūyamāno brahmaṇā ca svayaṃbhuvā || tuṣṭāva sa mudā yukto nāradaścopavīṇayan || 89 || ratnacchatrayuge mūrdhni dhāryamāṇe'tha pṛṣṭhataḥ || śaśinā bhāsvatā bhaktyā divyadhūpena dhūpitā ||2.2.27.90|| śreṇīkṛtā hyubhayataḥ pārśvayoścāmaragrahāḥ || salīlāṃdolanavyagrā yauvanālaṃkṛtāstathā || 91 || evaṃ ca sahitāḥ sarve kautūhalasamanvitāḥ || sudarśanaṃ subhadrāṃ ca balabhadramanaiṣiṣuḥ || 92 || prāsādadvāri racite ratnastaṃbhe'tha maṇḍape || vāsayitvābhiṣekāya saṃmukhādarśamaṇḍale || 93 || adhivāsitai ratnakuṃbhaistīrthavāryupasaṃbhṛtaiḥ || sūktābhyāṃ śrīpuruṣayorabhiṣekaṃ pitāmahaḥ || cakāra bhagavām̐llokasaṃgrahārthaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 94 || tato hyalaṃkṛtāndevāngaṃdhamālyopaśobhitān || nīrājayitvā bhagavānsa svayaṃ lokabhāvanaḥ || ratnasiṃhāsane ramye sthāpayāmāsa mantrataḥ || 95 || || brahmovāca || || aśeṣajagadādhāra sarvalokapratiṣṭhita || supratiṣṭhākhilavyāpinprāsāde susthiro bhava || 96 || tvayi pratiṣṭhite nātha vayaṃ sarve pratiṣṭhitāḥ || tvadājñayā pratiṣṭheyaṃ pūrṇā''stāṃ tvatprasādataḥ || 97 || sthāpayitvā jagannāthaṃ spṛṣṭvā tasya hṛdaṃbujam || ānuṣṭubhaṃ maṃtrarājaṃ sahasraṃ sa jajāpa ha || 98 || vaiśākhasyāmale pakṣe aṣṭamyāṃ puṣyayogataḥ || kṛtā pratiṣṭhā bho viprāḥ śobhane guruvāsare || 99 || taddinaṃ sumahatpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ sarvamakṣayyamaśnute || 2.2.27.100 || tasmindine ye paśyaṃti mānavā bhaktibhāvitāḥ || kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ ca muktibhājo na saṃśayaḥ || 101 || śuklāṣṭamī yā vaiśākhe gurupuṣyayutā yadā || tasyāmabhyarcanaṃ viṣṇoḥ koṭijanmāghanāśanam || 102 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
<2.2.28>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || tataḥ sa bhagavānmantramahimnā narakesarī || indradyumnādibhiḥ sarvaidadṛśe'dbhutadarśanaḥ || 1 || lelihāno jagatsarvaṃ samaṃtājjvalajihvayā || kālāgnirudraṃ sakalaṃ grasaṃtamiva cotthitam || 2 || rodasīkaṃdaraṃ vyāpya tejasā tapatā bhṛśam || anekākṣimukhagrīvākarapādaśrutirvibhuḥ || 3 || sarvāścaryamayo devaḥ kevalaṃ tejaso nidhiḥ || bhayatrastāḥ samudvignā neśāḥ stotumapi prabhum || 4 || taṃ tathāvidhamālokya nāradaḥ pitaraṃ tadā || papraccha bhagavannitthaṃ kathameṣa prakāśate || 5 || || nārada uvāca || || anugrahāyāvataratpratyutaiṣa bhayapradaḥ || sarve bhayātsthiratarāḥ pralayāśaṃkino'dhunā || 6 || tvameva bhagavallīlāṃ jānāsi jagatāṃ pate || 7 || tacchrutvā nāradavacaḥ padmayoniḥ smitānanaḥ || uvāca kautukaṃ vākyaṃ sarveṣāmupakārakam || 8 || || brahmovāca || || avatīrṇaṃ jagannāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā dāruvapurdharam || 9 || avajñāsyaṃti vai lokāḥ sākṣādbrahmasvarūpiṇam || atattvavedino mūḍhā mahimānaṃ vidaṃtviti || 2.2.28.10 || maṃtrito mantrarājena yenāsau parameṣṭhinā || purābhimaṃtrito yena vidadāra mahāsuram || 11 || tādṛgrūpaṃ sudurdarśaṃ prāpyameti bhayapradam || mūrtireṣā parā kāṣṭhā viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || || 12 || yāmabhyarcya gatiṃ yāṃti punarāvṛttidurlabhām || nṛsiṃhābhimukhaḥ stotramidamāha mudānvitaḥ || 13 || namo'stu te devavaraikasiṃha namo'stu pāpaughagajaikasiṃha || namo'stu duḥkhārṇavapārasiṃha namo'stu tejomaya divyasiṃha || 14 || namo'stu sarvākṛticitrasiṃha namo'stu te kleśavimuktisiṃha || namo'stu te divyavapurnṛsiṃha namo'stu te vīravaraikasiṃha || 15 || namo'stu te daityavidārasiṃha namo'stu deveṣvadhi devasiṃha || namo'stu vedāṃtavanaikasiṃha namo'stu te yogiguhaikasiṃha || 16 || namo'stu te siṃha vṛṣaikasiṃha namo'stu nīlācalaśṛṃgasiṃha || 17 || || jaiminiruvāca || || stutvetthaṃ divyasiṃhaṃ tamiṃdradyumnaṃ prajāpatiḥ || siṃhayaṃtraṃ samālekhya tasyopari niveśya ca || 18 || dīkṣayitvā mantrarājaṃ sākṣādātharvaṇoditam || āhurvaiṣṇavanirvāṇaṃ yaṃ vedāṃtaparāyaṇāḥ || 19 || yatra vedāśca catvāraḥ sākṣānnityaṃ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || yamadhītya mahāmantraṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ purā || 2.2.28.20 || sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra bhagavānprāptamasmāccaturmukhāt || aṇimādiguṇā yasya phalaṃ syādānuṣaṃgikam || 21 || eka eva mahāmantraḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || prāptuṃ kāraṇabhūto hi kiṃ punaḥ kṣudrakāmanām || 22 || eka eva mahāmaṃtraḥ sarvakratuphalapradaḥ || sarvatīrthapradaḥ sarvadānavrataphalapradaḥ || 23 || yathāyaṃ sarvapāpaughatūlarāśerdavānalaḥ || divyasiṃhākṛtirdevo maṃtrarājñastathā hyayam || 24 || enamabhyasya yatayo bhavaroga tyajaṃti hi || yasya grahaṇamātreṇa grahāpasmārarākṣasāḥ || 25 || ḍākinyo bhūtavetālapiśācā uragā grahāḥ || dūrādeva palāyaṃte neśate vīkṣituṃ ca tam || 26 || maṃtrarājaṃ tato labdhvā indradyumnaścaturmukhāt || nṛsiṃhaṃ śātavapuṣaṃ lakṣmīsaṃśritavakṣasam || 27 || cakraṃ pinākaṃ dadhataṃ caṃdrasūryāgnicakṣuṣam || jānuprasāritakarasarojadvaṃdvamunnasam || 28 || yogapaṭṭāsanārūḍhadvātriṃśaddalapadmake || maṃtravarṇamaye madhye karṇikāpraṇavojjvale || 29 || sukhāsīnaṃ sāṭṭahāsaṃ vīkṣaṃtaṃ śrīmukhāṃbujam || saṭāmaṃḍitavaktrābjaṃ divyaratnojjvalākṛti || 2.2.28.30 || phaṇāsahasraṃ vistārya paścācchatrākṛtiṃ vibhoḥ || dadarśa balabhadraṃ taṃ halalāṃgaladhāriṇam || 31 || prajaharṣa nṛpo dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ puruṣottamam || vismayāviṣṭacetāśca papraccha kamalāsanam || 32 || bhagavaṃścitrametadvai caritaṃ madhughātinaḥ || vijñātuṃ kathamasmābhiḥ śakyaḥ syāllokabhāvana || 33 || yajñāṃte tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ babhāra dārunirmitam || rathasthaṃ bhagavāneva prāsādāṃtarnyaveśayat || 34 || māmāha pūrvaṃ vāṇī sā gaganāṃtaritā tadā || apauruṣeyataruṇā caturmūrtirbhaviṣyati || 35 || idānīmeka evāsau dṛśyate supratiṣṭhitaḥ || māyā vā tattvamatha vā tattvato me vada prabho || 36 || śravaṇe yadi māṃ vetsi bhājanaṃ bhavabhāvana || śrutvaitatpratyuvācātha saṃśayānaṃ nṛpottamam || 37 || || brahmovāca || || ādyā mūrtirbhagavato nārasiṃhākṛtirnṛpa || nārāyaṇena prathitā madanugrahatastvayi || 38 || dāravī mūrtireṣeti pratimābuddhiratra vai || mā bhūtte nṛpaśārdūla paraṃ brahmākṛtistviyam || 39 || khaṃḍanātsarvaduḥkhānāmakhaṃḍānaṃdadānataḥ || svabhāvāddārureṣo hi paraṃ brahmābhidhīyate || 2.2.28.40 || itthaṃ dārumayo devaścaturvedānusārataḥ || sraṣṭā sa jagatāṃ tasmādātmānaṃ cāpi sṛṣṭavān || 41 || śabdabrahma paraṃbrahma nānayorbheda iṣyate || laye tu ekamevedaṃ sṛṣṭau bhedaḥ pravarttate || 42 || anyonyāpekṣiṇau bhūpa śabdārthau hi parasparam|| arthābhāvena śabdo'sti śabdābhāvena buddhyate || 43 || arthastasmāccaturvedāḥ śabdā hyarthāśca tādṛśāḥ || ṛgvedarūpī haladhṛksāmavedo nṛkesarī || 44 || yajurmūrttistviyaṃ bhadrā cakramātharvaṇaṃ smṛtam || vedaścaturddhā bhedo'yamekarāśirabhedataḥ || 45 || ataste saṃśayo mā bhūdekastu bahudhā vibhuḥ || avatāreṣu cānyeṣu nyāyenaitena varttate || 46 || bhedābhedau tathā khyātau jagannāthasya te nṛpa || yena te manasastuṣṭistena bhaktyā samācara || 47 || sarvarūpamayo hyeṣa sarvamaṃtramayaḥ prabhuḥ || ārādhyate yathā yena tathā tasya phalapradaḥ || 48 || yathā suśuddhaṃ kanakaṃ svecchayā ghaṭitaṃ nṛpa || tattatsaṃjñāmavāpyeha tattatsaṃtoṣakārakam || 49 || evaṃ mahimnā bhagavānatrāvirabhavannṛpa || yasya yāvāṃstu viśvāsastasya siddhistu tāvatī || 2.2.28.50 || karmaṇā manasā vācā viśuddhenāṃtarātmanā || samārādhaya goviṃdamatra dāruvapurddharam || 51 || caturvargaphalāvāptyai yathābhilaṣitaṃ tava || anena maṃtrarājena viṣṇumenaṃ samarcaya || 52 || nātaḥ parataro maṃtro na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || anenābhyarcito viṣṇuḥ prīto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 53 || dadāti svapuraṃ cāpi bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || yajñaistīrthairvratairdānaistapobhiścāpi tasya kim || 54 || nīlācalasthaṃ yo viṣṇuṃ dārumūrtimupāsti vai || tattvaṃ bravīmi te bhūpa śrutvaitadavadhāraya || 55 || nyagrodhamūle kūle'sya siṃdhornīlācale sthitam || dāruvyājāmṛtaṃ brahma dṛṣṭvā mucyenna saṃśaya || 56 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde'ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
<2.2.29>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ityuktvā nṛpaśārdūlaṃ lokasaṃgrahaṇāya vai || siṃhākṛti sa hṛdaye udvāsya kamalāsanaḥ ||1|| pūrvaṃ prakāśarūpaṃ yadviṣṇostu prakaṭīkṛtam || rathāvarohaṇe dṛṣṭāścatasro mūrttayaḥ purā || 2 || tā eva siṃhāsanagāḥ sarve te dadṛśuḥ punaḥ || dviṣaḍakṣaramantreṇa balabhadramapūjayat || 3 || sūktena pauruṣeṇainaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || devīsūktena cakraṃ ca dvādaśākṣarakeṇa ca || pūjayitvānugrahāya pārthivasya nyavedayat || 4 || || || brahmovāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa bhaktānugrahakāraka || indradyumnasya janmāni tvayi bhaktiṃ prakurvataḥ || sahasraṃ samatītāni tadante tvāmalokayat || 5 || tvaddarśanaṃ hi bhagavaṃstvayi sāyujyakāraṇam || yadyapyayaṃ bhaktiyogenecchati tvāṃ samarcitum || 6 || tadājñāpaya yena tvāṃ bhaktiyogena bhāvayet || deśakālavratādyaistu tathā nānopacārakaiḥ || 7 || tvanmukhāṃbhojagalitamājñāmṛtarasaṃ nṛpaḥ || pipāsustvāṃ jagannātha paśyatyeṣo'nimeṣakam||8 || || jaiminiruvāca || || iti vijñāpito devaḥ sākṣātkamalayoninā || dārudeho'pi vihasanprāha gaṃbhīrayā girā || 9 || || śrīpratimovāca || || indradyumna prasannaste bhaktyā niṣkāmakarmabhiḥ || tvadanyenedṛśī saṃpanna kenāpyapavarjitā || 2.2.29.10 || varaṃ dadāmi te bhūpa mayi bhaktiḥ sthirā'stu te || utsṛjya vittakoṭīstu yanmamāyatanaṃ kṛtam || 11 || bhaṃgepyetasya rājeṃdra sthānaṃ na tyajyate mayā || kālāṃtare'pi yo'pyanyaḥ prāsādaṃ kārayiṣyati || 12 || tavaiva kīrttiḥ sā nūnaṃ tvatprītyā tatra me sthitiḥ || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyameva bravīmi te || 13 || prāsāda bhaṃge tatsthānaṃ na tyakṣyāmi kadācana || anena dāruvapuṣā sthāsyāmyatra parārddhakam || 14 || dvitīyaṃ padmayonestu yāvatparisamāpyate || manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasyāsya dvitīye ca caturyuge || 15 || kṛtasya prathame jyeṣṭhe daśeti kratusaṃsthitiḥ || jyaiṣṭhyāmahaṃ cāvatīrṇastatpuṇyajanmavāsaram || 16 || tasyāṃ me snapanaṃ kuryānmahāsnānavidhānataḥ || pratyarcāyāṃ mahārāja sādhivāsaṃ samṛddhimat ||17|| pāpaṃ vināśayiṣyāmi koṭijanmabhirarjitam || sarvatīrthakratuphalaṃ sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā || 18 || paśyatāṃ cāpi rājeṃdra phalaṃ tāvatprapadyate || nyagrodhāduttare kūpaḥ sarvatīrthamayo'sti hi || 19 || snānāya pūrvaṃ nirmāya kiṃcidācchāditaṃ bhuvā || avatīrṇastvahaṃ paścāttaṃ vivicya prakāśaya || 2.2.29.20 || saṃskāryaḥ sa caturdaśyāṃ baliṃ dattvā vidhānataḥ || rakṣakakṣetrapālāya diśāṃpālebhya eva ca || 21 || kambukāhālamurajadhvaniṣu susvareṣu ca || dvijātayaḥ svarṇakumbhairuddhareyustato jalam ||22|| jyaiṣṭhyāṃ prātastane kāle brahmaṇā sahitaṃ ca mām || rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ saṃsnāpya mama lokamavāpnuyāt || 23 || snāpyamānaṃ tu yaḥ paśyenmāṃ tadā nṛpasattama || dehabandhaṃ ca nāpnoti sa punarna tu pūruṣaḥ || 24 || kārayitvā dṛḍhaṃ maṃcamaiśānyāṃ diśi maṃḍitam || vitānaśobhāracitaṃ caṃdanāṃbhaḥ samukṣitam || 25 || tatra māṃ rāmabhadrābhyāṃ snāpayitvā punarnayet || 26 || dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ yāṃtaṃ yo māṃ paśyati bhaktitaḥ || tattaddhruvamavāpnoti manasā yadyadicchati || 27 || tataḥ paṃcadaśāhāni sthāpayitvā tu māṃ nṛpa || virūpamabhirūpaṃ vā na paśyettu kadācana || 28 || jyeṣṭhasnānamidaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 29 || guṃḍicākhyāṃ mahāyātrāṃ prakurvīyāḥ kṣitīśvara || yasyāḥ saṃkīrtanādeva naraḥ pāpādvimucyate || 2.2.29.30 || māghamāsasya paṃcamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ caitraśuklake || ete kālāḥ praśastā hi guṃḍicākhyamahotsave || 31 || viśeṣānmokṣadāṣāḍhadvitīyā puṣyasaṃyutā || ṛkṣābhāve tithau kāryā sadā sā prītaye mama || 32 || āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe dvitīyā puṣyasaṃyutā || tasyāṃ rathe samāropya rāmaṃ māṃ bhadrayā saha || 33 || mahotsavapravṛttyarthaṃ prīṇayitvā dvijānbahūn || guṃḍicāmaṇḍapaṃnāma yatrāhamajanaṃ purā || 34 || aśvamedhasahasrasya mahāvedī tadābhavat || tasyāḥ puṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ pṛthivyāṃ neha vidyate || 35 || yatrājuhoḥ paṃcaśatavarṣāṇi prītaye mama || mama prītikaraṃ sthānaṃ tasmānnānyaddharāgatam || 36 || yatheyaṃ nīlaśikharā prāsādena tavādhunā || caturmukhānurodhena mahāprītikarī mama || 37 || tathā nṛsiṃhakṣetre vai mahāvedī tava kratoḥ || mamotpatteśca nilayaṃ prītikṛnmama śāśvatam || 35 || bahukālaṃ sthitaścāhaṃ tasyāṃ me prītiruttamā || ātmā me padmabhūreṣa prāsāde sthāpito'munā || 39 || asyānurodhāttvadbhaktyā hyavatiṣṭhe'tra nityadā || dināni nava yāsyāmi tathā tasmādihāgataḥ || 2.2.29.40 || tatrāsti te mahārāja sarvatīrthamayaṃ saraḥ || tattīre saptadivasānsthāsyāmyanujighṛkṣayā || 41 || tatra sthitaṃ māṃ paśyaṃto yāṃti martyā mamālayam || tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ bhuvanatraye || 42 || tāni sarvāṇi sarasi matsānnidhyādvrajaṃti te || tatra snātvā ca vidhivaddṛṣṭvā māṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ || 43 || jananījaṭhare kleśaṃ punarnānubhavaṃti hi || navame'hni samāyātaṃ dakṣiṇāśāmukhaṃ tadā || 44 || ye paśyanti pratipadamaśvamedhakratoḥ phalam || prāpya bhogāniṃdrasamānbhuktvānte māṃ viśaṃti te || 45|| mamotthānaṃ mama svāpaṃ matpārśvaparivarttanam || mārgaprāvaraṇaṃ caiva puṣyasnānamahotsavam ||46 || phālgunyāṃ krīḍanaṃ kuryāddolāyāṃ mama bhūmipa || dolāyāṃ ye'pi paśyaṃti dakṣiṇāmukhapūjitam || 47 || brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || anayormāṃ samabhyarcya dṛṣṭvā māṃ praṇipatya ca || pratyekamaṣṭasāhasraṃ vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet || 49 || caitre sitatrayodaśyāṃ kuryātkarmaprapūraṇam || caitre māsi caturdaśyāṃ damanairme prapūjanam || śuklapakṣe tu ye lokāḥ sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 2.2.29.50 || vaiśākhasya site pakṣe tṛtīyā'kṣayasaṃjñitā || tatra māṃ lepayedgandhalepanairatiśobhanaiḥ || 51 || prītaye mama ye kuryurutsavānmama śāśvatān || caturvargapradā hyete pratyekaṃ parikīrtitāḥ || 52 || || jaiminiruvāca || || iti dattvā varaṃ tasmā indradyumnāya bho dvijāḥ || brahmāṇamāha bhagavānsmerāṃbhoruhasanmukhaḥ|| 53 || caturmukha tava prītyai sarvaṃ saṃpāditaṃ mayā || tvadicchā hi mamaivecchā na bhedo hyāvayordhruvam || 54 || yanmāṃ mādhavamūrtiṃ tvaṃ purā prārthitavānasi || tasyaiva paripāko'yamavatāraḥ kṛto mayā || 55 || māmatra dṛṣṭvā tvabhyarcya prāṇānsaṃtyajya mucyate || kramātsarve tvayā sārddhaṃ bhūyaḥ sāyujyameva ca || 56 || yadvācābhilapanmartyo māmatra hi niṣevate || avaśyaṃ tadavāpnoti saṃgatyā cātra bhūpatiḥ || 57 || vrajedānīṃ satyalokaṃ tridivaṃ yāṃtu devatāḥ|| tavāyuḥpūrṇiparyaṃtamahamatra sthito dhruvam || 58 || tataste harṣitāḥ sarve brahmarṣisurasattamāḥ || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ jagmuste nilayaṃ svakam || 59 || devo'pi ca jagannāthaḥ pratimārūpadhṛktadā || tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhati sarveṣāṃ harṣamāpādayannṛṇām|| 2.2.29.60 || indradyumno'pi dharmātmā viṣṇubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ || anuvrajanpadmayoniṃ tenādiṣṭo nyavartata || 61 || yātrāḥ sarvā bhagavatā ājñaptāḥ sādhu kāraya || asmiṃstuṣṭe jagannāthe santuṣṭaṃ vai carācaram||62|| ityājñāṃ padmayonestu mūrdhnyādhāya kṣitīśvaraḥ || nāradena saha śrīmānnidhinā ca samṛddhimat || jyeṣṭhasnānādikaṃ sarvamutsavaṃ niravartayat || 63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmya ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||
<2.2.30>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || cakāra kena vidhinā janmasnānaṃ śriyaḥ pateḥ || anyānapyutsavānsarvānvidhivadbrūhi no mune || 1 || nāradena purā proktaṃ sarvaṃ te munisattama || sa hi veda tamaḥpāre brahma brahmasuto muniḥ || 2 || tatsarvaṃ brūhi tattvena mune krautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || aho bhāgyaṃ narapateriṃdradyumnasya bho mune || 3 || tasya tāvati karmāṃte atyadbhutamidaṃ mahat || na śrutā hi na dṛṣṭā hi pratimā dārunirmitā || 4 || sajīvatanuvatsākṣādvāraṃ dadyānmanuṣyavat || smāraṃsmāraṃ bhagavataścaritaṃ pāpanāśanam || 5 || caritaṃ tasya nṛpaterdurlabhaṃ martyavāsinām || na santoṣo'sti bhagavañśṛṇvatāṃ no mahāmune || 6 || tadvadānukrameṇāsmānyātrāḥ sarvāghanāśanāḥ || yāsāṃ saṃdarśanādvāso vaikuṇṭha iti niścitam || 7 || yātrāmāhātmyavaktāsau yatsākṣānmadhusūdanaḥ || tanno vada mahābhāga jagatāṃ hitakāmyayā || 8 || || || jaiminiruvāca || || jyeṣṭhasnānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munayo'dhunā || jyeṣṭhaśukladaśamyāṃ tu vrataṃ saṃkalpya vāgyataḥ || 9 || prātarutthāya kurvīta paṃcatīrthavidhānataḥ || mārkaṃḍeya vaṭaṃ gatvā ācamya prayataḥ pumān || 2.2.30.10 || prārthayecchaṃkaraṃ natvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭo'grataḥ || 11 || atitīkṣṇa mahākāya kalpāṃtadahanopama || bhairavāya namastubhyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi || 12 || tataḥ praviśya tīrthaṃ tu vaidikaiḥ paṃca vāruṇaiḥ || aghamarṣaṇasūktena trirāvṛttena vā dvijāḥ || snātvā yathāvatsnāyīta mantreṇānena cāṃtataḥ || 13 || namaḥ śivāya śāṃtāya sarvapāpaharāya ca || snānaṃ karomi deveśa mama naśyatu pātakam || 14 || saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ pāpagrastamacetanam || trāhi māṃ bhaganetraghna tripurāre namo'stu te || 15 || evaṃ snātvā bahirgatvā dhautavāsā sapuṇḍrakaḥ || devānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva tarpayitvā yathāvidhi || 16 || praviśya śaṃkarāgāraṃ spṛṣṭvā vṛṣaṇayorvṛṣam || mantreṇānena bho viprāḥ sarvakratuphalaṃ labhet || 17 || dharmaścatuṣpādyajñastvaṃ svarṇaśṛṃgastrayīvapuḥ || gopate vāharūpastvaṃ śūlinaṃ tvāṃ namāmyaham || 18 || aghoramantreṇa tataḥ pūjayedvṛṣavāhanam || pañcabrahmabhirṛgbhistu saṃspṛśelliṃgamuttamam || 19 || aṃguṣṭhena spṛśelligaṃ muṣṭinā śaktimeva ca || pūjayitvā tu vidhivatstutvā devaṃ puradviṣam || 2.2.30.20 || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam || mārkaṃḍeyavaṭe snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tu śaṃkaram || 21 || phalaṃ prāpnotyavikalaṃ rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ || ante śivasya sālokyaṃ prāpya jñānaṃ tato naraḥ || 22 || kramācca labhate muktiṃ jagannāthaprasādataḥ || tato maunī vrajeddevaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || 23 || taddakṣiṇasthitaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ nyagrodhamuttamam || darśanādapi pāpānāṃ pāpasaṃhatināśanam || 24 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇameddūrādbhāvayanpuruṣottamam || pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryādimaṃ mantramudīrayan || 25 || amarastvaṃ sadā kalpa viṣṇorāyatanaṃ mahat || nyagrodha hara me pāpaṃ viṣṇurūpa namo'stu te || 26 || namo'stvavyaktarūpāya mahāpralayasthāyine || ekāśrayāya jagatāṃ kalpavṛkṣāya te namaḥ || 27 || stuvañjapettu tadbhaktyā mūle tasya janārdanam || koṭijanmaśatodbhūtapāpādeva vimucyate || 28 || tacchāyākramaṇenāpi niṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ || tataḥ suparṇaṃ praṇamedyānarūpaṃ hareḥ puraḥ || 29 || sthito bhaktinato viṣṇoḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo mudā || chandomaya jagaddhāmanyānarūpa trivṛdvapuḥ || 2.2.30.30 || yajñarūpa jagadvyāpinprīyamāṇāya te namaḥ || stutvetthaṃ garuḍaṃ pāpānmucyate'nekajanmajāt || 31 || vāṅmanaḥkarmaniyato gacchedevaṃ viciṃtayan || praviśya devatāgāraṃ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam || 32 || pūjayenmantrarājena sūktena puruṣasya vā || dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa yatra vā jāyate ruciḥ || 33 || pūjādhikāriṇaḥ sarve brahmakṣatraviśastataḥ || anyeṣāṃ darśana bhaktyā tayornāmānukīrtanāt || 34 || paṃcopacāravidhinā pūjayetparameśvaram || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ stotramudīrayet || 35 || devadeva jagannātha saṃsārārṇavatāraka || bhaktānugrāhaka sadā rakṣa māṃ pādayornatam || 36 || jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya sarvāghanāśana || jayāśeṣajagadvaṃdya pādāṃbhoja namo'stu te || 37 || jaya brahmāṃḍakoṭīśa vedaniḥśvāsavātaka || aśeṣajagadādhāra paramātmannamo'stu te ||38|| jaya brahmeṃdrarudrādi devaughapraṇatārtinut || jayākhilajagaddhāmannaṃtaryāminnamo'stu te || 39 || jaya nirvyājakaruṇāpāthodhe dīnavatsala || dīnānāthaikaśaraṇa viśvasākṣinnamo'stu te || 2.2.30.40 || saṃsārasiṃdhusalile mohāvartte sudustare || ṣaḍūrmikuladuṣpāre kukarmagrāhadāruṇe || 41 || nirāśraye nirālaṃbe niḥsāre duḥkhaphenile || tava māyāguṇairbaddhamavaśaṃ patitaṃ tataḥ || 42 || māṃ samuddhara deveśa kṛpāpāṃgavilokanaiḥ || tatra magnaṃ suraśreṣṭha suprasādaprakāśaka || 43 || eka eva jagannātha bandhustvaṃ bhavabhīruṇām || bubhukṣā ca pipāsā ca prāṇasya manasaḥ smṛtau || 44 || śokamohau śarīrasya jarā mṛtyurvapurbhavaḥ || tvatsṛṣṭau tādṛśo nāsti yo dīnaparipālakaḥ || 45 || avatīrṇosi lokānāmanugrahadhiyā vibho || pūrṇakāmasya te nātha kimanyatkāraṇaṃ kṣitau || 46 || tvatpādapadmamāsādya na ciṃtāsti jagatpate || yataste caraṇāṃbhojaṃ caturvargekasādhanam || 47 || darśanātsarvalokānāṃ sarvavāṃchā phalapradam || tataḥ sīradhvajaṃ śeṣamantreṇa paripūjayet || 48 || dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa nāmnā vā praṇavādinā || ekāgramānaso bhūtvā praṇipatya prasādayet || 49 || jaya rāma sadārāma saccidānadavigraha || avidyāpaṃkarahita nirmalākṛtaye namaḥ || 2.2.30.50 || jayākhilajagadbhāradhāraṇaśramavarjita || tāpatrayavikarṣāya halaṃ kalayase sadā || 51 || prapannadīnatrāṇāya sphuṭanetrasaroruha || tvameveśa parāśeṣakaluṣakṣālanaprabhuḥ || 52 || prasannakaruṇāsiṃdho dīnabandho namo'stu te || carācarāphaṇāgreṇa dhṛtā yena vasundharā || 53 || māmuddharāsmādduṣpārādbhavāṃbhodherapārataḥ || parāparāṇāṃ paramaparameśa namo'stu te || 54 || stutvaivaṃ nāgarājānaṃ balaṃ musaladhāriṇam || pūjayejjagatāmādikāraṇāṃ bhadralocanām || 55 || stutvā jayāṃ tāṃ bho viprāḥ praṇipatya prasādayet || jaya devi mahādevi prasīda bhavatāriṇi || 56 || sukhāraṇi śritavatāṃ jaya saṃtuṣṭikāriṇi|| kāryaṃ kāryasvarūpāṇāṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam || 97 || dhāraṇāṃ dhāryamāṇānāṃ tvāmādiṃ praṇamāmyaham || vakṣaḥsthalasthitāṃ viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhorarddhāṃgadhāriṇīm|| 58 || padmayoni mukhābjasthāṃ praṇamāmi jagatpriyām || sṛṣṭisthitivināśādikarmaṇāṃ paramātmanaḥ || 59 || tvamekā śaktiratulā tvāṃ vinā so'pi neśvaraḥ || tvāṃ sarvalokajananīṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ tapasvinīm || 2.2.30.60 || subhadrāṃ bhadrarūpāṃ tāṃ mūlabhūtāṃ namāmyaham || tataḥ sāgarasnānāya prārthayetpuruṣottamam || 61 || namaste bhagavanviṣṇo jagadvyāpiṃścarācara || nirvighnaṃ siddhimāyātu siṃdhusnānaṃ mama prabho || 62 || namaste jagatāmīśa śaṃkhacakragadādhara || dehi deva mamānujñāṃ tava tīrthaniṣevaṇāt || 63 || tato maunaṃ vrajedviṣṇuṃ ciṃtayansaritāṃ patim || ugrasenaṃ sthitaṃ mārge anujñāpya samāhitaḥ || 64 || ugrasena mahābāho valavannugravikrama || labdhvā varaṃ suprasannātsamudrataṭamāsthitaḥ || 65 || tīrtharājakṛtasnānasusaṃpūrṇaphalaprada || siṃdhusnānaṃ kariṣyāmi anujñāṃ dātumarhasi || 66 || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ svargadvāraṃ tataḥ param || yena devāḥ samāyāṃti kṣetre'sminpuruṣottame || 67 || bhūsvarge jagadīśasya darśanāya dinedine || svargāvatāramārgeṇa tatrasthau vāṃ namāmyaham || 68 || māmapyūrdhvaṃ nayetāṃ vai sākṣiṇau karmaṇāṃ satām || sāgarāṃbhaḥ samutpannau śreṣṭhau sarvaguṇānvitau || 69 || madhyena yuvayoryāmi svargadvāramapāvṛtam || prārthayitvā tato gacchettīrtharājasya saṃnidhim || 2.2.30.70 || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā dūrataḥ pāpānmucyate mahato dhuvam || prakṣālitakarāṃghrika ācāṃtaḥ śuciviṣṭare || 71 || āsīnaḥ prāṅmukhobhūtvā likhenmaṃḍalamagrataḥ || caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ catuḥsvastikakoṇakam||72|| tanmadhye vilikhetpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanam|| tato'ṣṭākṣaramaṃtraṃ tu karayośca tanau nyaset||73|| ṣaḍbhirvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgānāṃ nyāsaḥ prokto manīṣibhiḥ|| śeṣau kukṣau ca pṛṣṭhe ca nyastavyau ca tataḥ punaḥ ||74|| pādayorjaṃghayorūrvoḥ sphicośca pārśvayoḥ punaḥ || nābhau pṛṣṭhe bāhuyugme hṛdi kaṇṭhe ca kakṣayoḥ || 75 || oṣṭhayoḥ karṇayorakṣṇorgaṃḍayornāsayostathā || bhruvorlalāṭe śirasi maṃtravarṇānyathākramam|| 76 || vinyasya vyāpakaṃ sarvairnyāsaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryānmūlena paṃcaviṃśatim|| 77|| badhnīyātkavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam || pūrve māṃ pātu goviṃdo vārijākṣastu dakṣiṇe || 78 || pradyumnaḥ paścime pātu hṛṣīkeśastathottare || āgneyyāṃ narasiṃhastu nairṛtyāṃ madhusūdanaḥ || 79 || vāyavyāṃ śrīdharaḥ pātu aiśānyāṃ ca gadādharaḥ || ūrdhvaṃ trivikramaḥ pātu adho vārāharūpadhṛk || 2.2.30.80 || sarvatra pātu māṃ devaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || nārāyaṇo manaḥ pātu caitanyaṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ || 81 || pātu me buddhyahaṃkārau triguṇātmā janārdanaḥ || iṃdriyāṇi sadā pātu daityavarganikṛntanaḥ || 82 || evaṃ baddhvā ca kavacaṃ niṣpāpo jāyate pumān || ṣoḍaśairupacāraiśca manasā kalpitairnaraḥ || 83 || puruṣottamaṃ pūjayitvā yathāvadvidhito dvijāḥ || āvāhya maṇḍale tasmindevadevamanāmayam|| 84 || pūjayitvā vidhānena yathāśaktyupabṛṃhitaiḥ || ātmānaṃ tīrtharājasya devadevasya ciṃtayan || 85 || evaṃ baddhāṃjalipuṭamimaṃ mantramudīrayet || sudarśana namaste'stu koṭisūryasamaprabha || 86 || ajñānatimirāṃdhasya viṣṇormārgaṃ pradarśaya || evaṃ saṃprārthya bho viprāstīrtharājajalāṃtike || 87 || jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā praṇamedbhaktibhāvitaḥ || tīrtharāja namastubhyaṃ jalarūpāya viṣṇave || 88 || jīvanāya ca jaṃtūnāṃ paraṃ nirvāṇahetave || 89 || agniśca te yonirilā ca dehe retodhā viṣṇoramṛtasya nābhiḥ || upaimi te rūpamananyahetumānaṃdasaṃpannamapranupraviśya || 2.2.30.90 || iti mantraṃ paṭhanviprāḥ praviśejjalamadhyataḥ || āvāhayettīrtharājaṃ bhāvayañjagatāṃpatim || 91 || jalādhīśaṃ kṛtasnānaphaladāne'taḥ sthitam || aghamarṣaṇasūktena nārāyaṇayutena ca || 92 || trirāvṛttena kurvīta pañcavāruṇakena ca || sakṛdāvāhanādīni ṣaḍaṃgānyabhiṣecane |||| 93 || āvāhanaṃ pura proktaṃ sannidhānamathocyate || snāturiṣṭaphalaprāptau sānnidhyaparikalpanam || 94 || antaḥśuddhyarthamācāmetpītvā tadabhimaṃtritam|| bāhyāvayavaśuddhyarthaṃ mārjayetkuśavāriṇā || 95 || aṃtarbahirviśuddhyarthaṃ mantrapūtena vāriṇā || trīnaṃjalīnmūrdhni siṃcetsiṃdhau nāṃtarjale japaḥ || 96 || triḥ snānāyātsvakṛtāghāni koṭijanmakṛtāni ca || plāvitāni jale tasminbhāvayannaghanāśanam || 97 || utthāyācamya vidhivatprārthayenmantramuccaran || tvamagnirjagatāṃ nātha retodhāḥ kāmadīpanaḥ || 98 || pradhānaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvānāṃ prabhuravyaya || amṛtasyāraṇistvaṃ hi devayonirapāṃpate || 99 || vṛjinaṃ hara me sarvaṃ tīrtharāja namostu te || janmakoṭisahasreṣu yatpāpaṃ pūrvamarjitam || 2.2.30.100 || tadaśeṣaṃ layaṃ yātu dehi me brahma śāśvatam|| snātvāpi ca tatastīramuttīryācamya vāgyataḥ || 101 || dhārayedvāsasī śukle puṃḍrakānujjvalākṛtīn || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmatilakāni ca bhaktitaḥ || 2 || devānpitṝnyathānyāyaṃ ciṃtayanbhagavaddhiyā || tarppayedvidhivadviprāḥ samyagavyagramānasaḥ || 3 || tataḥ pūrvavadālikhya maṇḍalaṃ cottarāmukhaḥ || pūjayenmūlamantreṇa mantrairebhiśca bhaktitaḥ || 4 || nārāyaṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || dharāramābhyāṃ sahitaṃ kevalaṃ vā dvijottamāḥ || dhyātvāṃtaryāgasaṃtuṣṭaṃ bahirāvāhayettataḥ || 5 || āgaccha paramānaṃda jagadvyāpiñjaganmaya || anugrahāya deveśa maṇḍale sannidhiṃ kuru || 6 || carācaramidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadatra pratiṣṭhitam|| tadantasthastvameveśa āsanaṃ kalpayāmi te || 7 || yasya pādāṃbuje dhaute dharmeṇa brahmarūpiṇā || punāti tadbhavā gaṃgā jagatpādyaṃ dadāmyaham || 8 || anarghyaratnaghaṭitacūḍāmaṇikarotkaraiḥ || brahmādayaḥ pādapadmaṃ ciṃtayaṃti dine dine || anarghyāyajagaddhāmne arghyametaddadāmyaham || 9 || ācāṃtastīrtharājo vai yenāgastyasvarūpiṇā || tasmai suvāsitaṃ vāri dadāmyācamanīyakam || 2.2.30.110 || yaḥ prāpya madhusaṃparkaṃ cakarṣa jalarūpiṇam || aśeṣāghavikarṣāya madhuparkaṃ dadāmyaham || 11 || yaḥ kroḍarūpamāsthāya pralayārṇavaviplutām || ujjahāra dharāmetāṃ snapayāmi tamaṃbhasā || 12 || brahmāṃḍakoṭayo yasya viśvarūpasya saṃvṛtiḥ || ācchādanāya sarveṣāṃ pradade vāsasī śubhe || || 13 || vinā yenānuṣṭhito'pi yajñaḥ syādakṛto dhruvaḥ || tasmai yajñeśvarāyedamupavītaṃ prakalpaye || 14 || yadaṃgasaṃgamāsāya śobhaṃte bhūṣaṇāni vai || viśvālaṃkṛtaye tasmai bhūṣaṇāni prakalpaye || 15 || yadaṃgasaṃsparśimarutsaṃgānmalayajā drumāḥ || sugaṃdharasasaṃpannāstasmai gaṃdhānulepanam || 16 || yasya saṃcitanādeva saumanasyaṃ hatāṃhasām || tasmai sumanasāṃ mālāṃ sugaṃdhāṃ parikalpaye || 17 || yaṃ citte sthiramādāya bhavāgniparidhūpanam || jahāti tasmai pradade sugaṃdhaṃ dhūpamuttamam|| 18 || svatejasākhilamidaṃ dīpitaṃ yasya bhāsataḥ || tasmai dīpapradīptāya dīpametaṃ dadāmyaham || 19 || carācaraṃ jagatsarvamatti yo yaśca bhāvayet || anena ca punaḥ puṣṭau tasmādannaṃ nivedaye || 2.2.30.120 || yadīyamukharāgeṇa sahajāvāsitena ca || mohitāḥ surasuṃdaryastasmai tāṃbūlamuttamam || 21 || pradakṣiṇaprakamaṇādbhavāṃgaṇavivarttanam || haṃti yaḥ karuṇāṃbhodhistaṃ namāmi jagadgurum || 22 || maṃtrāstu kathitā hyeta upacāraiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || āvāhya ciṃtayeddevaṃ bahiḥsaṃsthitamātmanaḥ || 23 || ratnasihāsanaṃ dattvā tatrāsīnaṃ viciṃtayet || pādapadmadvaye dadyātpādyaṃ śyāmākapaṃkajaiḥ || 24 || dūrvāparājitābhyāṃ ca saṃskṛtaṃ mūlamaṃtraṇāt || sauvarṇe rājate vāpi tāmre vā śaṃkha eva vā || 25 || arghyaṃ saṃskṛtya vidhivadvāricaṃdanapuṣpakaiḥ || yavadūrvākuśāgraiśca phalasiddhārthakaistilaiḥ || 26 || dūrvākuśāgrairdevasya mūrdhni siṃcettadagrataḥ || sāvaśeṣaṃ kṣipedbhūmāveṣo'rghavidhirīritaḥ || 27 || jātīphalairvā kaṃkolairlavaṃgaiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ jalam || dadyādācamanārthaṃ tu madhuparkaṃ tato dadet || || 28 || madhusarpiryutaṃ gavyaṃ dadhi kāṃsye hi nirmale || pātre sthitaṃ ca pihitaṃ pātreṇānyena tādṛśā || susaṃskṛtaṃ phalayutaṃ snapane jalamucyate || || 29 || paṭṭakauśeyakāpāsanirmite vāsasī śubhe || yathāśakti pradeye ca vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet || 2.2.30.130 || hārakeyūramukuṭagraiveyādikabhūṣaṇam || yathāśakti yathāsthānaṃ devasyāṃge niveśayet || 31 || upavītaṃ harerdadyātpaṭṭasūtravinirmitam || kārpāsamathavā viprā gaṃdhacaṃdanasaṃskṛtam || 32 || caṃdracaṃdanakastūrīkuṃkumairanulepanam || 33 || tulasīdalamālāṃ ca jātīpaṃkajacaṃpakaiḥ || aśokacchurapunnāganāgakesarakesaraiḥ || 34 || anyaiḥ sugaṃdhaiḥ kusumairmālā mālyamathāpi vā || muktakāni ca puṣpāṇi dadyāddevasya mūrddhani || 35 || mālā sā prapadīnātu mālyaṃ kaṃṭhorusaṃmitam || garbhakaṃ keśamadhye tu mūrdhni puṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣipet || 36 || saguggulvagurūśīrasitājyamadhucaṃdanaiḥ || dhūpaṃ dadyātsugaṃdhāḍhyaṃ dīpaṃ gosarpiṣā śubham || karpūragarbhayā vartyā tilatailena vā dadet|| 37 || akhaṃḍitasamuddhautaṃ śālitaṃḍulanirmitam || supakvamannaṃ surabhi sarpiṣā ca suvāsitam || 38 || saurabheyadadhikṣīrapakvaraṃbhāsitāyutam || nānāvyaṃjanasaṃkīrṇaṃ sopadaṃśaṃ sapūpakam || 39 || nānāphalayutaṃ hṛdyaṃ sugaṃdhaṃ surasaṃ navam || naivedyaṃ devadevasya prasthādūnaṃ na śasyate || 2.2.30.140 || dhūpe dīpe ca naivedye snāne'rghe madhuparkake || vastre yajñopavīte ca dadyādācamanīyakam || 41 || anyatra kevalaṃ vāri saṃskṛtaṃ tvaupacārikam| naivedyāṃte tvācamanaṃ dadyācca karaghṛṣṭikam||42|| sagaṃdhacaṃdanaṃ viprāstāṃbūlaṃ ca dadettataḥ|| sakarpūralavaṃgailājātīkramukasaṃyutam||43|| aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā mūlamaṃtramananyadhīḥ || stutvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā prārthayetpuruṣottamam || 44 || devadeva jagannātha sarvatīrthapravarttaka || sarvatīrthamayaścāsi sarvadevamaya prabho ||45|| tvatprasādānmayā tīrtharāje snānaṃ hi yatkṛtam || tadastu saphalaṃ deva yathoktaphalado bhava ||46|| siṃdhurājastvaṃ ca vibho dravarūpo'syasaṃśayam || pāpālaye nimagnaṃ māṃ paritrāhi namo'stu te || 47 || itthaṃ prapūjya deveśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || tīrtharājakṛtasnānaḥ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet ||48|| gavāṃ koṭipradānena kratukoṭikṛtena ca || koṭibrāhmaṇabhojyena mahādānaiśca koṭiśaḥ || yatpuṇyaṃ karmiṇāṃ proktaṃ tadanena hi labhyate || 49 || dhyānaṃ dānaṃ tapo jāpyaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca surapūjanam || siṃdhurāje kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 2.2.30.150 || api naḥ sa kule kaścitsiṃdhusnāyī bhaviṣyati || devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca dāsyate ca tilodakam || 51 || kraṃdaṃti sarvapāpāni saṃbhrāṃtāḥ sarvapātakāḥ || aniṣṭāni palāyante siṃdhusnānodyatasya vai || 52 || anyatīrthe kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ siṃdhutīre vinaśyati || siṃdhutīre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sidhusnāne vinaśyati || 53 || siṃdhusnānarataṃ nityaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva yamakiṅkarāḥ || diśo daśa palāyante siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā mṛgāḥ || 54 || yamo'pi bhītastaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇipatya prapūjya ca || na śaknoti tadā sthātuṃ tasyāgre puṇyakarmiṇaḥ || 55 || vāṃchaṃti devatā nityaṃ mānuṣyaṃ prāpnuyāmahe || samyakchu(chru?)ddhatanvo bhūtvā siṃdhusnānaṃ labhemahi || 56 || merumandaramātro'pi rāśiḥ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ || siṃdhusnānena dagdhaḥ syāttūlarāśirivānalāt || 57 || apsu nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ snānakāle smaretsadā || sākṣādviṣṇusvarūpe'tra siṃdhau caiva viśeṣataḥ || 58 || brahmaghno vā surāpo vā goghno vā pañcapātakī || sarve te niṣkṛtiṃ yāṃti siṃdhusnānānna saṃśayaḥ || 59 || kapilākoṭidānācca sindhusnānaṃ viśiṣyate || sakṛtsiṃdhvavagāhena kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet ||2.2.30.160|| sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarveṣvāyataneṣu ca|| tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ sindhusnānānna saṃśayaḥ || 61 || ya icchetsaphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ śrutameva vā || sa pitṝṃstarpayetsiṃdhumabhigamya surāṃstathā || 62 || catvāraḥ sulabhā vedāḥ saṣaḍaṃga padakramāḥ || sulabhāni kurukṣetre dānāni vividhāni ca || 63 || cāṃdrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tapāṃsi sulabhānyapi || agniṣṭomādayo yajñāḥ sulabhā bahudakṣiṇāḥ || 64 || sindhutoyaiśca salilairdurlabhaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || māsaṃ tarpaṇamātreṇa piṃḍānāṃ pātanena ca || 65 || sindhau vai pitaraḥ sarve vimānānsūryavarcasaḥ || sindhutarpaṇasaṃtuṣṭāḥ śrāddhapiṃḍasutarpitāḥ || āruhya sahasā yāṃti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam || 66 || ādyaṃtayorjagannāthaṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || tīrtharāje'bhiṣicya svaṃ naraḥ syānmuktibhājanam || 67 || tatastīrthavisargaṃ ca kṛtvā śuddhamanāḥ pumān || rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca natvā rūpaṃ vicintayet || 168 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
<2.2.31>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānaṃ manyamānastato vrajet || aśvamedhāṃgasaṃbhūtamiṃdradyumnasaraḥ prati || 1 || yasya tīre nivasati narasiṃhākṛtirhariḥ || narasiṃhamanuprārthya tatra snāyādyathāvidhi || 2 || narasiṃha namastubhyaṃ yasya te kṣetra uttame || sahasraṃ vājimedhasya kratoścakre nṛpottamaḥ || 3 || indradyumnaḥ prasādātte tasya kratvaṃgasaṃbhave || sarasi snātumāyāto māmanujñāpaya prabho || 4 || tatastīrthataṭaṃ gatvā kṛtaśaucācamakriyaḥ || prārthayedaṃjaliṃ kṛtvā imaṃ maṃtramudīrayet || 5 || aśvamedhāṃgagokoṭikhurakṣuṇṇamahītalaḥ || tanmūtraphenādānāṃbhaḥ pūritākhilapāvanaḥ ||6|| snātuṃ tavāgataḥ puṇye sarvatīrthamaye jale || pūrvajanmasahasrotthaṃ pāpaṃ snānādvimocaya || 7 || antaḥ praviśya ca tato vāruṇaiḥ paṃcabhirdvijāḥ || snāyādantarjale japyāttrirāvṛttyāghamarṣaṇam || 8 || aśvamedhāṃgasaṃbhūta tīrtha sarvāghanāśana || janmakoṭibhavaṃ pāpaṃ tvayi snānādvinaśyatu || 9 || imaṃ mantraṃ triruccārya triḥ snāyāttajjale dvijāḥ || saṃsmaredviṣṇugāyatryā narasiṃhākṛtiṃ harim || 2.2.31.10 || āpo nārā iti proktā yasmāttā narasūnavaḥ || ayanaṃ prathamaṃ cāsya tasmādapsu hariṃ smaret ||11|| devānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva tarpayedvidhivannaraḥ || narasiṃhaṃ tato gacchetpaścimābhimukhaṃ sthitam || 12 || siddhaṃ śaṃbhuṃ kṛtrimaṃ vā paścimābhimukhaṃ harim || dṛṣṭvā vimucyate pāpairjanmakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ || 13 || tamātharvaṇamaṃtreṇa yajecca narakesarim || nāradena purā hyeṣa maṃtrarājaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 14 || indradyumnena tenaiva cirādeṣa upāsitaḥ || narasiṃhākṛtau nānyo maṃtrastatsadṛśo dvijāḥ || 15 || yasyoccāraṇamātreṇa tuṣṭo bhavati kesarī || anena dāruvarṣmāpi brahmaṇā saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ || 16 || pūrvoktairupacāraistu pūjayennarakesarim || japāprasūnairaruṇairanyaiścaiva sugaṃdhibhiḥ || 17 || caṃdanāgarukarpūrairlepayennarakesarim || pāyasaṃ sitayā yuktaṃ saurabheyeṇa sarpiṣā || 18 || karpūrakhaṇḍasaṃyuktānmodakānghṛtapācitān || saṃyāvānghṛtapūpāṃśca phalaṃ nānāvidhaṃ tathā || 19 || śarkarādadhisaṃyuktaṃ śālyannaṃ vinivedayet || dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā namaskṛtvā saṃpūjya narakesarim || 2.2.31.20 || svānsvānabhīṣṭānāpnoti naro vai nātra saṃśayaḥ || devatvamamareśatvaṃ gaṃdharvatvaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ ||21|| īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca sārvabhaumatvameva vā || yadyatkāmayate citte tattadāpnotyasaṃśayam || 22 || paṃcatīrthīvidhānaṃ ca kathitaṃ pṛcchatāṃ dvijāḥ || dināni paṃca kṛtvaitāṃ pañcabhūtamaye punaḥ ||23|| na dehe praviśenmartyo vratī viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ || paurṇamāsyāṃ pratyuṣasi tīrtharājajale punaḥ || 24 || pūrvoktavidhinā snātvā śuddhāhāro jiteṃdriyaḥ || ekabhaktavratenaiva varttate prītaye naraḥ || yāvatpaṃca dināni syustāvatkālaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 25 || tataḥ praviśyaprāsādaṃ maṃcasthaṃ puruṣottamam || rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mucyate pāpakaṃcukaiḥ || 26 || sarvatīrthamayātkūpāduddhṛtena sugandhinā || vāriṇā snāpyamānaṃ tu yo jyaiṣṭhyāṃ paśyate harim || 27 || na tasya pāpasaṃbaṃdha ātmani prabhaviṣyati || yātrākartṛvidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ param || 28 || caturdaśyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ maṃcaṃ kārayitvā suśobhanam || tṛṇakāṣṭhamayaṃ liptaṃ sudhayā bahulaṃ śubham || 29 || athavā dārṣadaṃ kuryāccirasthāyi dvijottamāḥ || snānārthaṃ devadevasya vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet || 2.2.31.30 || nānādrumagaṇākīrṇaṃ dakṣiṇānilaśītalam || ullasatsiṃdhukallolaśāḍvalopari saṃskṛtam || 31 || samucchritamahāmūlyavitānavaraśobhitam || viralācchādanaṃ kuryāddevānāṃ darśanāya vai || 32 || āyāṃti brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ snapanāya jagatpateḥ || svargaṃgāṃbhaḥ samādāya pārijātavibhūṣitam || 33 || brahmarṣayaśca tridaśā brahmaṇā sahitā vibhum || maṃcasthaṃ snāpayantīha vacanātparameṣṭhinaḥ || 34 || jayaśabdaiśca stutibhirvaṃdyo'yaṃ tridivaukasām || tasmānmaṃcastu kartavyo maṃḍito mālyacāmaraiḥ || 35 || nānāmaṇisrajā hāridukūlakṛtatoraṇam || sugaṃdhadhūpasurabhicaṃdanābhaḥ samukṣitam || 36 || evaṃ maṃcaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tasya dakṣiṇato dvijāḥ || kūpādvāri samuddhṛtya kalaśānsvarṇanirmitān || 37 || śālāyāṃ śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā tvadhivāsayet|| 38 || suvāsitaṃ jalaṃ teṣu pāvamānyā prapūrayet || caturdaśīniśāmadhye karmaitatsamudāhṛtam || 39 || śanaiḥ śanaiśca nīyāsurhariṃ hali puraḥsaram || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā rājñā saṃmānitādṛtāḥ || 2.2.31.40 || cāmaraistālavṛntaiśca vījyamānaṃ niraṃtaram || purākṛtāmalepaṃ taṃ viṣṇoraṃgānna hāpayet || 41 || yathā sugaṃdhalepena supuṣṭāṃgo dine dine || tathā prayatnataḥ kāryaḥ kṛśāṃgo na hi puṣṭikṛt || 42 || nayeyurapramādyaṃto bhagavaṃtamānaditāḥ || pramādato yadi bhavetpatanaṃ muravairiṇaḥ || 43 || balasya vā subhadrāyā rājño rājyasya bhītikṛt || api pātayatāṃ hāniḥ saṃtaterbahuduḥkhitā || 44 || narake niyataṃ vāso bhavetteṣāṃ durātmanām || vimuhyaṃtaścirāddārumayīyaṃ pratimā katham || 45 || tiṣṭhedaviśvasaṃto ye bhagavaddrohiṇastu te || narakaṃ pratipadyaṃte sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtāḥ ||46|| mūḍhānāṃ nāstikānāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ hatātmanām || dharmakṛtyeṣu jāyaṃte aviśvāsasya yuktayaḥ||47|| adṛṣṭaṃ yasya yāvaddhi sa tu tena vinirmitaḥ || tadaṃte tasya kṣīyaṃte prāsādapratimādayaḥ ||48|| na cāyaṃ nirmitaḥ kena drumaḥ so'pi pravarddhitaḥ || varaṃ dadāti yā nūnaṃ na cāsau pratimā matā || 49 || nirmitāyāṃ pratikṛtau purā manvaṃtarādiṣu || vyatīteṣvapi varddhaṃte janānāṃ ca suparvaṇām || 2.2.31.50 || bhaktayastādṛśo viprāḥ sarveṣāṃ pṛthivīkṣitām || svārociṣeṃ'tare caiva āvirbhūtaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ || 51 || vaivasvateṃ'tare saptaviṃśe caiva caturyuge || dvāparāṃte samāyātau tadā kṛṣṇārjunāvubhau || 52 || tridināni sthitāvatra vratasthau madhusūdanam || bhaktyā saṃpūjya taṃ stutvā jagmaturdvārakāṃ punaḥ || 53 || na ke'pi tattvaṃ jānaṃti mānuṣīṃ tanumāsthitāḥ || avatārāḥ pravartaṃte viṣṇorasya yugeyuge || 54 || dharmasthāpanayā viprā līyaṃte svapade punaḥ || pūrvaṃ ca brahmaṇā proktaḥ sa cānena parasparam || 55 || sthātā parārddhaparyaṃtaṃ bhagavāndārurūpadhṛk || sadāyaṃ varado viṣṇuḥ śuddhasattvena bhāvitaḥ || 56 || yasya yāvāṃstu viśvāsastasya siddhistu tāvatī || pramādīkṛtaviśvāso bhakto dṛḍhamatiḥ pumān || 57 || yatnānurūpaṃ labhate phalamasmātsudurlabham || purā vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvamaṃbarīṣavimocanam || 58 || tatastasmiñjagannāthe paramātmasvarūpiṇi || vidhāya sudṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ vasadhvaṃ puruṣottame ||59 || ato'yaṃ bhaktito neyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇamaṃca uttamaḥ || subhadrābalabhadrau ca rājavatparicarya vai || 2.2.31.60 || uttoliteṣu cchatreṣu cāmarairvījiteṣu ca || kālāgurusudhūpāsu dikṣu gaṃbhīranādiṣu || 61 || nānāvidheṣu vādyeṣu tvagāre paripūrite || tauryatrike sādhuvṛtte dīpikā śreṇirājite || 62 || aṃdhakāre'tha sarveṣāṃ varddhamāne mahotsave || ācchanne śrīpateraṃge pramādapariśaṃkayā || 63 || paṭupaṭṭadukūleṣu nīyamāneṣu dūrataḥ || gatervegāttadottānīkṛtāsye jagatāṃ gurau || 64 || āvarttadṛṣṭayo devā divārohaṇaśaṃkinaḥ || jayasva rāma kṛṣṇeti jaya bhadreti cocire || 65 || evaṃ salīlaṃ bhagavāñjanmajyaiṣṭhyābhiṣecane || nīyate maṃcadeśaṃ tu niśīthe brāhmaṇādibhiḥ || 66 || ahaṃpūrvikaśabdastu devānāṃ śrūyate divi || devaduṃdubhayaścaiva jayaśabdavimiśritāḥ || 67 || tato maṃcasthitaṃ brahmarūpaṃ pratyarcayā saha || ācchādya sarvāṇyaṃgāni mukhavarjaṃ sucelakaiḥ || 68 || vinā nivedyaṃ saṃpūjya upacāraiḥ puroditaiḥ || adhivāsitakuṃbhaiśca śāṃtighoṣapuraḥsaram || 69 || samudajyeṣṭhāmaṃtreṇa snāpayetsurapuṃgavān || paśyatāmabhiṣektṝṇāṃ kṛtakṛtyatvahetave || 2.2.31.70 || snāpyamānaṃ tu paśyaṃti ye narāstatra saṃsthitāḥ || garbhodakena snapanaṃ na te punaravāpnuyuḥ || 71 || jyeṣṭhasnānaṃ bhagavato ye paśyaṃti mudānvitāḥ || na te bhavābdhau majjaṃti yātrāmutkaṃṭhamānasāḥ || 72 || buddhyabuddhikṛtaḥ puṃsāmanādiḥ pāpasaṃcayaḥ || tatkṣaṇānnāśamāyāti paśyatāṃ snapanaṃ hareḥ || 73 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ bravīmi dvijapuṃgavāḥ || sarvasaṃtāpaśamanamaśeṣamalanāśanam || 74 || snapanaṃ śrīpaterjyaiṣṭhyāṃ yadi bhaktyā vilokanam || prāyaścittanimittāni yāni pāpāni saṃti vai || 75 || tāni sarvāṇi kṣīyaṃte paśyatāṃ snapanaṃ hareḥ || nātaḥ parataraṃ karma hyanāyāsena mocanam || 76 || jyeṣṭhajanmadine snānaṃ hareryadavalokitam || snānadānatapaḥśrāddhajapayajñādayastu ye || 77 || vidhayaḥ koṭiguṇitāḥ koṭijanmopapāditāḥ || snānadarśanapuṇyasya hareste na tulāṃ gatāḥ || 78 || bhaktyā yaḥ snapanaṃ viṣṇorekasminvatsare'pi vā || paśyenna śocate viprā iha saṃsāramocane || 79 || teneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ puṇyaiḥ śraddhāvipuladakṣiṇaiḥ || mahādānāni dattāni bhojitāḥ koṭiśo dvijāḥ || 2.2.31.80 || śrāddhāni gayaśīrṣādau koṭiśaśca kṛtāni vai || puṇyakāle ca tīthārdau tapāṃsi caritāni ca || 81 || ardhodayādiyogeṣu koṭitīrtheṣu koṭiśaḥ || snātāni tena bho viprā yaḥ paśyetsnapanaṃ hareḥ || 82 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ bravīmi dvijapuṃgavāḥ || nātaḥ śreyaskaraṃ karma śāstradṛṣṭapathisthitam || 83 || mañcasthaṃ snāpyamānaṃ hi yaḥ paśyetpuruṣottamam || snānācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate vai na saṃśayaḥ || 84 || mañcasthitaṃ jagannāthaṃ snānārdraṃ yastu paśyati || sāṃdrānandārdracitto'sau na kiṃcitpāpamaśnute || 85 || yadeva puṇyamuditaṃ snānadarśanakarmaṇi || tattatphalamavāpnoti dṛṣṭvā mañcasthamacyutam || 86 || eka eva jagannāthastridhā tatra sthito dvijāḥ || ekaikasyāpi snapanadarśanaṃ bhuktimuktidam || 87 || jayasva rāmabhadreti jaya bhadreti yo vadet || jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jayetyuccārayenmudā || 88 || snānakāle sa vai muktiṃ prayāti dvijasattamāḥ || adhivāsādikaṃ tatra yaiḥ kṛtaṃ snānakarmaṇi || 89 || teṣāṃ śraddhāmudāyuktaḥ pradadyāddakṣiṇāḥ pṛthak || brāhmaṇebhyaśca miṣṭānnaṃ vastrālaṃkaraṇāni ca || 2.2.31.90 || pradadyācchraddhayā yukto dīnānāthāṃśca tarpayet || ye draṣṭumāgatāḥ snānaṃ jīvanmuktāstu te dhruvam || 91 || tānyathāśakti vai rājā mānayetprītaye hareḥ || snānāvaśeṣatoyena snāyādbhadrāsanasthitaḥ || 92 || nārī vā puruṣo vāpi tasya puṇyaṃ vadāmi vaḥ || kalpaḥ syāccirarogārto hyapamṛtyuṃ jayedasau || 93 || aputrā mṛtavatsā vā vandhyā vāpi labhetsutam || subhagaḥ sarvalokānāṃ nirdhano dhanavānbhavet || 94 || gurviṇī labhate putraṃ dīrghāyurguṇavattaram|| gaṃgādisarvatīrthānāṃ snānajaṃ phalamucyate || 95 || snānadarśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmātmā labhate dhruvam ||96|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmya ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||
<2.2.32>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dakṣiṇāmūrtidarśanam || padepadeśvamedhasya phalaṃ yatropalabhyate || 1 || tato nānāvidhairdivyairbhakṣyabhojyādikaistathā || yathāśaktyupacāraistu gaṃdhairmālyaiśca pūjayet || 2 || rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca gītanṛtyādikaistathā || prekṣaṇīyaiśca vividhaiḥ śraddhayā copapāditaiḥ || 3 || vastracaṃdanamālyādyaiḥ pūjayitvā dvijottamān || bhagavadbrāhmaṇāṃścaitānmahābhāgavatāṃstathā || 4 || tato nayeddakṣiṇābhimukhāṃstāṃstridaśeśvarān || utsavaṃ ca mahatkṛtvā pūrvānayanavaddhareḥ || 5 || tasminkāle hariṃ paśyedvrajaṃtaṃ dakṣiṇāmukham || samaṃ subhadrāṃ yo martyo na sa prākṛtamānuṣaḥ || 6 || snānārthamāgatā devāḥ snāpayitvā jagadgurum || ākāśe'pi sasaṃbādhāstāvatkālaṃ sthitā harim || draṣṭuṃ vrajaṃtaṃ yāmyāśāvadanaṃ bhavanāśanam || 7 || dharmaśāstreṣu yāvaṃti dharmakarmāṇi saṃti vai || tāni sarvāṇi saṃdraṣṭuṃ vrajaṃtaṃ dakṣiṇāmukham || 8 || snānadarśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ samagraṃ labhate tu saḥ || snātaṃ murāriṃ yaḥ paśyedvrajaṃtaṃ dakṣiṇāmukham|| 9 || nīrājayitvā deveśaṃ rāmeṇa saha bhadrayā || prāsādāṃtaḥ praveśyātha na paśyedvai kathaṃcana || 2.2.32.10 || etattu vistareṇoktaṃ pūrvameva mayā dvijāḥ || 11 || || || munaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavanyattvayā proktaṃ jyeṣṭhāsnānapradarśanāt || phalaṃ prāpnoti niyataṃ tanno būhi vidāṃvara||12|| || jaiminiruvāca || || haṃta vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi tadvrataṃ jyeṣṭhapaṃcakam || nātaḥ parataraṃ proktamṛṣibhiḥ śāstrapāragaiḥ ||13|| śrautasmārtapurāṇokta vratānāmidamuttamam|| idaṃ prathamataḥ proktaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā || 14 || jyeṣṭhatvādvratamukhyānāṃ khyātaṃ tajjayeṣṭhapaṃcakam || samudro jyeṣṭhaphaladaḥ prabhurjyeṣṭhaphalapradaḥ || 15 || varṣasaṃdarśanātpuṇyaṃ mañcakenaiva labhyate || maṃcakena tu yallabhyaṃ mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ tu tallabhet || 16 || yanmayoktaṃ purā viprāḥ snānadarśanajaṃ phalam || samagraṃ tadavāpnoti mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 17 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || mahājyaiṣṭhīṃ samācakṣva yatra snānaṃ mahāphalam || tatra naḥ kautukaṃ brahmanmahadvai saṃpravarttate || 18 || || || jaiminiruvāca || || jyeṣṭhasya vimale pakṣe yā vai paṃcadaśī bhavet || śakrarkṣaikāṃśagau candragurū ca guruvāsare || 19 || śubhe yoge mahājyaiṣṭhī sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || sarvakṣetraṃ sarvatīrthaṃ sapta vai sāgarāstathā || 2.2.32.20 || kratavaśca mahādānasamūhaśca tapāṃsi ca || vidyāścāṣṭādaśavidhā vratāni vividhāni ca || 21 || śāṃtipauṣṭikakarmāṇi sāṃkhyayogastathaiva ca || sarve saṃbhūya gacchaṃti kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam|| 22 || vṛndaśaḥ pravibhaktāsta ekaikaṃ kṣetragaṃ prati || kasmai vayaṃ bhāgyavate jyeṣṭhasnānāvalokane || 23 || mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ pravekṣyāmaḥ parasparamahaṃmayā || tatra yāṃti mahāyoge bhagavatkṣetramuttamam || 24 || mahājyaiṣṭhī mahāpuṇyā bhagavatprītivarddhanī || tasyāṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ jagannāthaṃ kṛpārṇavam || dṛṣṭvā ca snāpyamānaṃ taṃ pāpakośādvimucyate || 25 || ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vrataṃ tajjyeṣṭhapañcakam || vratenānena labhyaṃ yattattadeva bravīmi vaḥ || 26 || daśamyāṃ niyamaṃ kuryātprātaḥ snātvā yathāvidhi || ācāryaṃ vṛṇuyāttatra vaiṣṇavaṃ dvijapuṃgavam || 27 || itthaṃ saṃkalpamamalaṃ gṛhṇīyādvratamuttamam || 28 || devadevajagannātha saṃsārārṇavatāraka || adyārabhya vrataṃ deva yāvajjyaiṣṭhī ca sā tithiḥ || tāvadvrataṃ kariṣyāmi prītaye tava keśava ||29|| sarvatīrthābhiṣekaṃ ca pratyahaṃ vratabhojanam || mūrtīnāṃ tava paṃcānāmekasyāpi prapūjanam || 2.2.32.30 || ekasmindivase deva trisaṃdhyaṃ tvatprasādataḥ || samāpyatāṃ vratamidaṃ saphalaṃ cāstu te prabho |||| 31 || tataḥ paṃcasu tīrtheṣu snātvā ca gṛhametya ca || sthaṃḍile vilikhetpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam || 32 || tanmadhye sthāpayetkuṃbhaṃ tīrthāṃbhobhiḥ prapūritam || sacaṃdanaphalairyuktaṃ tanmukhe tāmrabhājanam || 33 || vāsasā veṣṭitaṃ kaṇṭhe pātraṃ cākṣatapūritam || tanmadhye sthāpayeddevaṃ sauvarṇaṃ madhusūdanam || || 34 || śubhāṃgāvayavaṃ śāṃtaṃ vāme śrīyutamīśvaram || 35 || dakṣiṇe ca garutmaṃtaṃ spṛśaṃtaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśataḥ || śaṃkhacakradharaṃ cordhve padmāsanagataṃ vibhum || || 36 || pūjayedupacāraistamācāryo vāpi bho dvijāḥ || nīlotpalānāṃ mālāṃ tu bhaktyā devāya dāpayet || 37 || daśamyāṃ pūjayitvaivaṃ daśakoṭyaghanāśanam || prārthayetprāṃjalirbhūtvā mantrametaṃ samuccaran || 38 || || madhusūdana deveśa namaste mādhavīpriya || kṛpāvārāṃnidhe pāhi patitaṃ māṃ bhavārṇave || 39 || ekādaśyāṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || nārāyaṇaṃ padmasaṃsthaṃ paṃcaniṣkavinirmitam || tadarddhaṃ nirmitaṃ vāpi pūjayetpadmamālayā || 2.2.32.40 || naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyātsitāṃ raṃbhāphalāni ca || nānāvidhaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dattvā saṃprārthayenmudā || 41 || nārāyaṇa namaste'stu bhavasāgaratāraṇa || trāhi māṃ puṃḍarīkākṣa śaraṇāgatavatsala || 42 || ekādaśeṃdriyakṛtaṃ pāparāśimanuttamam || anādibhavanirvyūḍhaṃ nāśayetpūjitaḥ prabhuḥ || 43 || dvādaśyāṃ yajñavārāhaṃ pūjayetsvarṇanirmitam || caṃdanāgurukarpūralepanaiścaṃpakasrajā || 44 || nānāvidhāpūpasārā bhakṣyabhojyaphalānvitāḥ || nivedya prārthayeddevaṃ stutimetāṃ samuccaran || 45 || pralayārṇavasaṃmagnāṃ dharaṇīṃ dhṛtavānasi || kinna śakto mamoddhāre patitasyāṃghripaṃkaje || tanmāmuddhara goviṃda nimagnaṃ śokasāgare || 46 || abdo dvādaśamāso vai yāvadabdakṛtāni tu || pāpāni mahadalpāni itaḥ pūrveṣu janmasu || tadvināśayate devo dvādaśyāmarcito nṛṇām || 47 || trayodaśyāṃ tu pradyumnaṃ śaṃkhacakravarābhayān || dhārayantaṃ padmagataṃ caturniṣkavinirmitam || 48 || upacārairyathāproktaiḥ pūjayedbhaktito naraḥ || aśokapāṭalīmālāṃ caṃdrapūrṇāṃ samujjvalām || 49 || naivedyaṃ caiva pakvānnaṃ phalaṃ pakvaṃ manoharam || dattvā namaskṛtiṃ kurvanprārthayetprāṃjaliḥ śuciḥ || 2.2.32.50 || deva pradyumna kāmānāṃ pūraka kāmarūpadhṛk || kāmāśca saphalāḥ saṃtu kāmapāla namo'stu te || 51 || caturdaśyāṃ narahariṃ pūjayetkanakākṛtim || vakṣaḥsthalasthayā lakṣmyā prīyamāṇaṃ saṭojjvalam || 52 || vyāttānanaṃ sāṭṭahāsaṃ yogapaṭṭābjasaṃsthitam || sutīkṣṇanakharaṃ devaṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇam || 53 || caturbhirhemaniṣkaiśca ghaṭitaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam || pūjayetpūrvavaddevaṃ sopahāraṃ subhaktitaḥ || 54 || japākusumamālāṃ ca jātīpuṣpasrajaṃ tathā || dattvā puṣpāṃjalīnpāde praṇamya sapradakṣiṇam || 55 || yathā hiraṇyakaśipuṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || vyadārayastathā pāpasaṃghaṃ nāśaya pūjitaḥ || 56 || evaṃ saṃprārthya nṛhariṃ praṇamya daṇḍavatkṣitau || nirvartya vratamevaṃ tadvratī paṃcadinātmakam || paṃca paṃca pradīpāṃstu divārātrau pradāpayet || 57 || vastrayugmānpaṃca pañca cchatropānadyugaṃ tathā || sayajñasūtrānkalaśānpañca pañca phalānvitān || 58 || bhojanāṃte dvijebhyaśca pradadyācchraddhayānvitaḥ || 59 || rātrau jāgaragītādyaistathā nānopahārakaiḥ || toṣayedvāsudevaṃ tu purāṇapaṭhanena tu || 2.2.32.60 || paurṇamāsyuṣasi snātvā śrīkṛṣṇasyāṃtikaṃ vrajet || 61 || rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || snapanaṃ kārayitvātha dṛṣṭvā vā śāstracoditam || 62 || snānaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ siṃdhau gṛhamāgatya tatra vai || yatra viṣṇormūrttayastāḥ kumbhasthā mantrapūjitāḥ || 63 || tāsāṃ paścimato vahniṃ samādhāya yathāvidhi || agnikāryaṃ prakurvīta svaiḥ svairmaṃtraiḥ purohitaḥ ||64|| praṇavādicaturthyaṃtaṃ namoṃtaṃ nāma īrayet || devānāṃ mūlamaṃtrastu svāhāṃto homakarmaṇi || || 65 || carorājyasya samidhāṃ palāśānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || ekaikaṃ devamuddiśya juhuyācca śataṃ śatam || 66 || tasya puṣpaśataṃ caiva juhuyāttadanaṃtaram || pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || 67 || ācārye dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsuvarṇaṃ dhenumeva ca || svarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ nānopakaraṇairyutām || || 68 || mahārghyavastradānāni yena tuṣyati vā guruḥ || sarvopakaraṇairyuktāḥ pratimāśca nivedayet || 69 || brāhmaṇānbhojayetsarpiḥ khaṇḍayuktaiśca pāyasaiḥ || etadvrataṃ samākhyātaṃ jyeṣṭhapaṃcakamuttamam || 2.2.32.70 || anuṣṭhāya naro bhaktyā snānadarśanajaṃ phalam || samagraṃ labhate viprāstadā naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 71 || ekādaśī yā tu madhye nirjalā sā prakīrtitā || ekāṃ tāṃ bhaktiyuktā ye yathāvidhi upāsate || 72 || yāvajjīvakṛtāḥ sarvā ekādaśyo na saṃśayaḥ || vratarājamimaṃ kṛtvā sarvavrataphalaṃ labhet || 73 || yānyānsamīhate kāmāṃstāṃstānāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || 74 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jyeṣṭhapaṃcakavratavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
<2.2.33>
|| || jaiminiruvāca || || ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi mahāvedīmahotsavam || ajñānatimirāṃdho'pi yena bhāsvatpadaṃ vrajet ||1|| vaiśākhasyāmale pakṣe tṛtīyā pāpanāśinī || svayamāviṣkṛtā caiṣā prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā || 2 || tasyāṃ saṃkalpya nṛpatirācāryaṃ varayecchuciḥ || ekaṃ trīnatha takṣāṇaṃ dṛṣṭakarmāṇamādarāt||3|| vṛṇuyādvanayāgāya vastrālaṃkaraṇādibhiḥ || takṣṇā sārddhaṃ vanaṃ gatvā sādhuvṛkṣagaṇākulam ||4|| tanmadhye vahnimādhāya maṃtrarājena maṃtravit|| aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā saṃpātājyavimiśritam || 5 || ājyaṃ tarūṇāṃ mūle tu pratyekamabhighārayet || dikpālebhyo baliṃ dattvā kṣetrapālapaśūṃstathā || 6 || vanaspataye juhuyātkṣīrodanaśatāhutim || tataḥ paraśumādāya vṛkṣamūleṣu dikṣu vai || 7 || ājyasaṃskṛtideśeṣu ācāryo maṃtramuccaran || kiṃcitkiṃcicchedayedvai ciṃtayangaruḍadhvajam || 8 || nadatsu tūryaghoṣeṣu gītamaṃgalavādiṣu || niyojya varddhakiṃ tatra ācāryaḥ svagṛhaṃ vrajet || 9 || athavā sthāna labdhāni dārūṇi rathakarmaṇi || uktasaṃskāravidhinā saṃskuryātkalpitenale || 2.2.33.10 || ārabheta rathaṃ kṛtvā vighrarājamahotsavam || ṣoḍaśāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiścakrairlohamayairdṛḍhaiḥ || 11 || yuktaṃ viṣṇo rathaṃ kuryāddṛḍhākṣaṃ dṛḍhakūbaram || vicitraghaṭanākakṣaputtalīpariveṣṭitam || 12 || nānāvicitrabahulamikṣukhaṇḍavirājitam|| catustoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam || 13 || nānāvicitrabahulaṃ hemapaṭṭavirājitam || dvāviṃśatikarocchrāyaṃ patākābhiralaṃkṛtam || 14 || gāruḍaṃ ca dhvajaṃ kuryādraktacaṃdananirmitam || dīrghanāsaṃ sthūladehaṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ vibhūṣitam || 15 || caṃcvagradaṣṭabhujagaṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitam || vitatya pakṣatī vyomni uḍḍīyaṃtamivoditam || 16 || daityadānavasaṃghasya baladarpavināśanam || sarvāṃgaṃ tasya kanakairācchādya pariśobhayet || 17 || rathameva hareḥ kuryātsvāsanaṃ supariṣkṛtam || caturdaśarathāṃgaistaṃ rathaṃ kuryācca sīriṇaḥ || 18 || cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ kuryātsubhadrāyā rathottamam || saptacchadamayaṃ kuryātsīriṇo lāṃgaladhvajam || 19 || devyāḥ padmadhvajaṃ kuryātpadmakāṣṭhavinirmitam || viracayya rathānrājā pratiṣṭhāṃ pūrvavaccaret || 2.2.33.20 || yathāmantraṃ yathāśāstraṃ viśvasedbrāhmaṇeṣu ca || brāhmaṇā jagadīśasya jaṃgamāstanavaḥ smṛtāḥ || 21 || itthaṃ sughaṭitaṃ cakritrayaṃ devatrayasya vai || āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe dine viṣṇoḥ śubhaprade || 22 || pratiṣṭhāpya samṛddhena vidhinā pūrvavadvijāḥ || rakṣaṇīyaṃ tathā tatra nārohetkaścanāśubhaḥ || 23 || pakṣī vā mānuṣo vāpi mārjāranakulādayaḥ || tato dinatrayādarvāgrathānāmuttare kṛte || 24 || maṇḍape utsavāṃge vā prakuryādaṃkurārpaṇam || adbhuteṣvatha jāteṣu śāṃtiṃ kuryātpuroditām || 25 || rathyā susaṃskṛtā kāryā mahāvedīṃ yathā vrajet || pārśvayormaṃḍalaṃ kuryātpathi gulmādibhiḥ phalaiḥ || 26 || sumanastabakairmālyairdukūlaiścāmaraistathā || yathā supuṣpitāraṇyarājī tatra virājate || 27 || bhūmiḥ samā ca kāryā vai niṣpaṃkā sukhacāraṇā || nirmalā ca sugandhā ca sudūrādvarjitotkarā || 28 || dhūpapātrāṇyanupadaṃ digāmodakarāṇi ca || caṃdanāṃbhaḥ parikṣepo yaṃtrapātotkarastathā || 29 || bahūni ṛtupuṣpāṇi puṣpavṛṣṭyarthameva hi || naṭanarttakamukhyāśca gāyanā bahavastathā || 2.2.33.30 || veśyā yauvanagarvāḍhyāḥ rūpālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ || mṛdaṃgā paṇavāścaiva bherīḍhakkādayastathā || 31 || bahavo bahudhā tatra patākāścitritāṃtarāḥ || dhvajāśca bahavastatra svarṇarājatanirmitāḥ || || 32 || vaijayaṃtyo bahuvidhā bhūmigā vāhanāstathā || hastinaśca hayāścaiva susannaddhāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ || 33 || evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraḥ kṣitipālaḥ śucivrataḥ || mudā bhaktyā ca parayā yuktaḥ kuryānmahotsavam || 34 || āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe dvitīyā puṣyasaṃyutā || aruṇodayavelāyāṃ tasyāṃ devaṃ prapūjayet || 35 || brāhmaṇairvaiṣṇavaiḥ sārddhaṃ yatibhiśca tapasvibhiḥ || vijñāpayeddevadevaṃ yātrāyai saṃskṛtāṃjaliḥ || 36 || indradyumnaṃ kṣitibhujaṃ yathājñāsīḥ purā vibho || vijayasva rathe nātha guṃḍicāmaṇḍapaṃ prati || 37 || tavāpāṃgavilokena prapunaṃtu diśo daśa || niḥśreyasapadaṃ yāṃtu sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || 38 || avatāraḥ kṛto hyeṣa lokānugrahakāmyayā || tadehi bhagavanprītyā caraṇaṃ nyasya bhūtale || 39 || tataḥ karpūracūrṇaiśca sumanobhiravākiret || pathi śākunasūktāni prapaṭhaṃti dvijātayaḥ || 2.2.33.40 || kecinmaṃgalagāthāśca kecijjaya jayeti ca || jitaṃ ta iti mantraṃ vai keciduccairjapaṃti ca || 41 || sūtamāgadhamukhyāśca kīrtiṃ puṇyāṃ mudā jaguḥ || svarṇadaṃḍaprakīrṇānāṃ śreṇī cobhayapārśvayoḥ || 42 || līlayāṃdolayaṃti sma raṇatkaṃkaṇamaṃjulam || svarṇapātraparikṣiptakṛṣṇāgurusudhūpitaiḥ || 43 || surabhīkṛtasarvāśā mukhe vyomāṃgaṇe tathā || carcarījharjharīveṇuvīṇāmādhurikādayaḥ || śabdāyaṃte sumadhuraṃ goviṃdavijayāṃtare || 44 || evaṃ pravṛtte samaye kṛṣṇaṃ rāmapuraḥsaram|| nayaṃti viprā bhadrāṃ ca kṣatriyāśca viśastathā || 45 || chatramālā samuditā muktāsrakcīnatoraṇā || ratnadhvajā hemadaṃḍāḥ pārśvayormuravairiṇaḥ || 46 || rājā caturvidhā varṇā anye ye ca pṛthagjanāḥ || dīnā mahāṃtaśca tadā samānāstatra bhāṃti vai || 47 || salīlacaraṇanyāsaṃ tūlikāstaraṇeṣu tān || vāsayaṃtaḥ kvacitchāṃtā devāṃste rathamanviyuḥ || 48 || mahotsavaṃ samāsādya gītakolāhalāni ca || kare kṛtvā jagannāthaṃ bhrāmayitvā rathottamam || 49 || rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca rathamadhye niveśayet || cārucaṃdrātapāḍhyena maṃḍapena virājite || 2.2.33.50 || kiṃkiṇīmālikābhiśca mālyacāmarabhūṣite || sasārakṛṣṇāgurujadhūpapūritagarbhake || 51 || tatastānvāsayitvā tu tūlikāsu surottamān || bhūṣayedvividhairbhaktyā vastrālaṃkāra mālyakaiḥ || 52 || pūjayedupacāraistaiḥ samṛddhairbhaktibhāvitaiḥ || nātaḥ parataraṃ viṣṇoryātrāṃtaramavekṣyate || 53 || yatra svayaṃ trilokeśaḥ syaṃdanena kutūhalāt || mānayanpūrvamājñāṃ tāṃ varṣe varṣe vrajedasau || 54 || rathasthitaṃ vrajaṃtaṃ taṃ mahāvedīmahotsave || ye paśyaṃti mudā bhaktyā vāsasteṣāṃ hareḥ pade || || 55 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ pratijāne dvijottamāḥ || nātaḥ śreyaḥ paraṃ viṣṇorutsavaḥ śāstrasaṃmataḥ || 56 || yathā rathavihāro'yaṃ mahāvedīmahotsavaḥ || yatrāgatya divo devāḥ svargaṃ yāṃtyadhikāriṇaḥ || 57 || kiṃ vacmi tasya māhātmyamutsavasya muradviṣaḥ || yasya saṃkīrtanātpāpaṃ naśyejjanma śatodbhavam || 58 || mahāvedīṃ vrajaṃtaṃ taṃ rathasthaṃ puruṣottamam || balabhadraṃ subhadrāṃ ca janmakoṭisamudbhavam || 59 || dṛṣṭvā pāpaṃ nāśayati nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || rathacchāyāṃ samākramya brahmahatyā vyapohati || 2.2.33.60 || tadreṇusaṃsaktavapustrividhāṃ pāpasaṃhatim || nāśayetsvargagaṃgāyāḥ snānajaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 61 || ghanāṃbuvṛṣṭiyogena rathamārge tu paṃkile || divyadṛṣṭyā ca kṛṣṇasya samastamalahāriṇi || 62 || tatra ye praṇipātāṃstu kurvate vaiṣṇavottamāḥ || anādivyūḍhapaṃkāṃste hitvā mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ || 63 || gavāṃ koṭipradānasya kanyānāmayutasya ca || vājimedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || 64 || anugacchaṃti kṛṣṇaṃ ye yātrākautūhalādapi || anuvrajaṃti nityaṃ vai devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || 65 || paśyaṃti ye rathaṃ yāṃtaṃ dārubrahma sanātanam || pade pade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ prakīrtitam || 66 || vedaiḥ stuvaṃti vedānāṃ vaktāro mokṣadāyinam|| itihāsapurāṇādyaiḥ stotrairvāpi svayaṃkṛtaiḥ || 67 || stuvaṃti puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ ye vai vigatakalmaṣāḥ || vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya modaṃte nāradādibhiḥ || 68 || kurvaṃti vāsudevāgre jayaśabdena vā stutim || te vai jayaṃti pāpāni vividhāni na saṃśayaḥ || 69 || layatālānabhijñopi gītamādhuryavarjitaḥ || narttanaṃ kurute vāpi gāyatyatha narottamaḥ|| vaiṣṇavottamasaṃsargānmuktiṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ ||2.2.33.70|| nāmāni kīrtayannasya tena yāti sahaiva yaḥ || anuvrajyāttatphalaṃ vai prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥ || 71 || jaya kṛṣṇa jaya kṛṣṇa jaya kṛṣṇeti yo vadet || guṃḍicānagaraṃ yāṃtaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ || na mātṛgarbhavāsasya sa ca duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ||72|| cāmarairvyajanaiḥ puṣpastabakairnīlacolakaiḥ|| rathasyāgrasthito yo vai vījayetpuruṣottamam||73|| sa vījyamānopsarobhirgaṃdharvairupaśobhitaḥ|| anuvrajadbhistridaśairmaheṃdrāsanasaṃsthitaḥ || 74 || bhunakti bhogānatulānyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || tadaṃte ca brahmalokaṃ prāpya muktimavāpnuyāt ||75 || kṛṣṇasya purato ye vai puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ prakurvate || te vai manogatānsarvānprāpnuvaṃti manorathān || 76 || sahasranāmabhiḥ puṇyaiḥ paryaṭaṃti rathaṃ tu ye || teṣāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryustridaśānatakaṃdharāḥ || 77 || vasaṃti vaikuṇṭhagṛhe viṣṇutulyaparākramāḥ || 78 || tasminkāle mahāpuṇye devarṣipitṛsevite || ekaṃ brahma tridhābhūtaṃ māyayānugataṃ svayā || 79 || sākṣāddārusvarūpeṇa mahāvedīmahotsavam||2.2.33.80|| rathārūḍhaḥ kautukavānyatrayāti jagatprabhuḥ|| tasminkāle pṛthivyāṃ tu carettatra mahotsavam || 81 || devā apyutsave tasminpuruhūtapurogamāḥ || abhimānaṃ parityajya śreṇībhūtā hi pārśvayoḥ || 82 || prakurvate mahāyātrāṃ taistairdivyaiḥ paricchadaiḥ || 83 || teṣāmagresarastatra devopi prapitāmahaḥ || caturdaśānāṃ jagatāṃ karttā yaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 84 || so'pi tatra jagannāthaṃ rathe yāṃtaṃ mahotsave || brahmalokātparāvṛtya stuvanvedamayaiḥ stavaiḥ || pade pade praṇamati bhagavaṃtaṃ sanātanam || 85 || yadyapyabjanidheḥ kṛṣṇānna bhedo'sti tathāpyayam || mahotsavasya mahimā yatra sarve'nuyāyinaḥ || 86 || nātaḥ parataro loke mahāvedīmahotsavāt || sarvapāpaharo yogaḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ || 87 || kṛṣṇamuddiśya yastatra dānaṃ dadāti vai naraḥ || yatkiṃcidakṣayaphalaṃ merudānena tatsamam ||88|| tasyāgre devadevasya vrajato guṃḍicālayam || yatkiṃcitkurute karma tattadakṣayamaśnute || 89 || upāyanāni nānā vai bhakṣyabhojyāni caiva hi || samarpayaṃti devāya tatprītyai vā dvijanmane || teṣāmakṣayapuṇyāni sarvakāmapradāni ca || 2.2.33.90 || hareragresarā ye vai paśyaṃtastanmukhāṃbujam || pade pade namaṃtaśca paṃkadhūlipariplutāḥ || 91 || vihāya pāpa kavacamabhedyaṃ koṭijanmabhiḥ || kṣaṇānmuktiphalaṃ prāpya yāṃti viṣṇoḥ śubhālayam || 92 || sarvakratūnāṃ tīrthānāṃ dānānāṃ yāṃti te phalam || bhagavadbhaktibhāvānāṃ nātaḥ puṇyatamo mahaḥ || 93 || evaṃ sa bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ subhadrārāmasaṃgataḥ || vrajansyaṃdanaśreṣṭhastho dyotayaṃśca caturdiśaḥ || 94 || śrīmadaṃgopasṛṣṭena marutā sarvadehinām || pāpāni nāśayañchrīmāndayālurbhaktabhāvanaḥ || 95 || ajñānāmapyaviśvāsabhājāṃ viśvāsahetave || nisargamuktido'pyeṣa yātrāraṃbhānkaroti vai || 96 || vrajansamṛddhyā devānāṃ martyānāṃ ca janārdanaḥ || sūrye lalāṭaṃ tapati madhyāhne mārgamadhyataḥ || 97 || śrāṃtā karṣajanastasthau mlāyanvai tadrajovṛtaḥ || tatrātapasya śāṃtyarthaṃ darpaṇeṣvabhiṣecayet || 98 || paṃcāmṛtaiḥ śītatoyaiḥ puṣpakarpūravāsitaiḥ || cāmaraiśca jalārdrāṃtaiḥ śītalairvyajanaistathā || 99 || vījayetpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ subhadrāṃ rāmameva ca || śītaiśca pānakairhadyaistathā khaṇḍavikārakaiḥ || 2.2.33.100 || kharjūrairnārikelaiśca nānāraṃbhāphalaistathā || tathā kṣīravikāraiśca panasaistṛṇarājakaiḥ || 101 || ikṣubhiḥ svāduhṛdyaiśca phalairnānāvidhaistathā || vāsitaiḥ śītatoyaiśca pakvatāṃbūlapatrakaiḥ || 102 || sakarpūralavaṃgādyaiḥ pūjayetpuruṣottamam || 103 || tasminkāle dvijaśreṣṭhā ye paśyaṃti janārdanam || pūjayaṃti yathāśakti na te saṃsārajaṃ śramam || 104 || prāpnuvaṃti dvijaśreṣṭhā brahmalokanivāsinaḥ || 105 || rathatrayasthitaṃ devatrayaṃ ye puruṣarṣabhāḥ || pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvaṃti triścatuḥ sapta eva vā || 106 || daśapraṇāmānkṛtvāṃte sthitāḥ prāṃjalayo'grataḥ || purārathasthitānbrahmā stutibhiryābhirabjabhūḥ ||107|| tuṣṭāva tābhirdeveśaṃ stuvaṃti parameśvaram || ye narā brahmalokaṃ te prayāṃti niyataṃ dvijāḥ || 108 || tato'parāhṇe deveśaṃ dakṣiṇānilavījitam || śanaiḥ śanairnayedgītaiveṃṇuvīṇādināditaiḥ || 109 || baṃdinaḥ stutipāṭhaiśca kalairmadhurikāsvanaiḥ || niraṃtaraiḥ puṣpavarṣaiścāmarāṃdolanaistathā || 2.2.33.110 || evaṃ vrajati deveśe sūryaścāstaṃgato bhavet || dīpikānāṃ sahasrāṇi jvālitāni sahasraśaḥ || 111 || tadālokaprakāśena mārgaśeṣaśca nīyate || rathāvarohaṇenaiṣāṃ maṇḍapārohaṇena ca || 112 || saṃmardaḥ sumahāṃstatra didṛkṣūṇāṃ kutūhalāt || maṇḍape vāsayeddevaṃ guṇḍicākhye manohare || 113 || cārucaṃdrātape cārumālyacāmarabhūṣite || ratnastaṃbhamaye svarṇavedikopaskṛtāṃtare || 114 || prācīravalayāvīte sudhālepasamujjvale || sādhusopānaghaṭite caturdvāropaśobhite || 115 || trailokyāṃḍabarayute mahāvedyāṃ mahākratoḥ || prādurbhāvo maheśasya yatrābhūddāruvarṣmaṇaḥ || 116 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇava khaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye guṃḍicāyātrākathanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
<2.2.34>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || aśvamedhāṃgasaraso nṛsiṃhasya ca dakṣiṇe || tatrāsīnaśca bhagavānpunaścāvataranniva || 1 || babhāse divyarūpo'sau durvibhāvyaḥ surāsuraiḥ || tadā pūjopahāraiśca bhakṣyabhojyādikaistathā || || 2 || pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ toṣayedgītanṛtyakaiḥ || puṣpopahārairvividhaiḥ sugaṃdhairanulepanaiḥ || 3 || kṛṣṇāgurujadhūpaiśca gaṃdhatailapradīpakaiḥ || toṣayejjagatāṃ nāthamanekairupahārakaiḥ || 4 || bindutīrthataṭe tasminsaptāhāni janārdanaḥ || tiṣṭhetpurā svayaṃ rājñe varametatsamādiśat || 5 || tvattīrthatīre rājeṃdra sthāsyāmi prativatsaram || sarvatīrthāni tasmiṃśca sthāsyaṃti mayi tiṣṭhati || 6 || tatra snātvā vidhānena tīrthe tīrthoghapāvane || saptāhaṃ ye prapaśyaṃti guṃḍicāmaṇḍape sthitam || 7 || māṃ ca rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ ca matsāyujyamavāpnuyuḥ || tatastasminmahāpuṇye sarvapāpapraṇāśane || 8 || sarvatīrthaikaphalade viṣṇu prītikare śubhe || snātvā saṃtarpya vidhivatpitṝndevānataṃdritaḥ || 9 || taṭasthaṃ narasiṃhaṃ taṃ pūjayitvā praṇamya ca || mahāvedīṃ naro gatvā kṛtaśaucācamakriyaḥ || 2.2.34.10 || pūjayetpūrvavadviprāḥ praṇamedvāpi bhaktitaḥ || saptāhaṃ yo naro nārī na sā prākṛtamānuṣī || 11 || viṣṇusāyujyamāpnoti śāsanānmuravairiṇaḥ || divā tadṛrśanaṃ puṇyaṃ rātrau daśaguṇaṃ bhavet || 12 || yatkiṃcitkriyate karma saṃnidhau jagadīśituḥ || svalpaṃ vāpyathavā bhūri koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet|| 13 || tulāpuruṣadānāni mahādānāni yo dadet || eke pradatte dānepi sarvaṃ dattaṃ bhaveddvijāḥ || 14 || sarvaṃ merusamaṃ dānaṃ sarve vyāsasamā dvijāḥ || mahāvedyāṃ gate kṛṣṇe yogo'yaṃ khalu durlabhaḥ || 15 || arddhodayādikā yogāḥ skandena paribhāṣitāḥ || mahāvedyākhyayogasya kalā nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 16 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pitṝṇāṃ kāryamuttamam || yāvajjīvaṃ gayāśrāddhairalabhyaṃ bhuvi yatphalam || 17 || divisthā narakasthā vā tiryagyonigatāstathā || tathā manuṣyajātisthāḥ sarve pitṛpitāmahāḥ || 18 || śataṃ puruṣavikhyātā yaṃ vāṃchaṃti sutaiḥ kṛtam|| taṃ vo vidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munayo varam || 19 || maghā vai pitṛnakṣatraṃ pitṝṇā prītidaṃ param || tatra śrāddhaṃ tu prīṇāti dattaṃ putrairmudānvitaiḥ || 2.2.34.20 || paṃcamī ca tithiḥ śreṣṭhā śrāddhebhyudayakāriṇī || ubhayoryadi saṃyogo mahāpuṇyatamā tithiḥ || 21 || yasyāṃ śrāddhe kṛte putraiḥ pitṝṇāmuddhṛtirbhavet || sarvatīrthamaye tasminsaṃnidhau muravairiṇaḥ ||22|| śrāddhaṃ cecchraddhayā kuryānnīlakaṇṭhanṛsiṃhayoḥ || madhye medhyatame deśe yoge paramadurlabhe || 23 || puruṣāñchatamuddhṛtya brahmaloke mahīyate || praśasyaḥ kutapaḥ kālo mandībhūtadivākaraḥ || 24 || pitṝnuddiśya vā dadyādaśaktaḥ kanakaṃ śuciḥ || tarpayitvā tilaiḥ samyakpaitṛkīṃ prītimuttamām || 25 || athavā bhojayaidviprānbhojyamūlyāni vā dadet || ekasmai vā guṇavate sahasraṃ bhojanaṃ dadet || 26 || guṇāguṇavivekastu nātra yoge vidhīyate || tasminsudurlabhe yoge sarve munisamā dvijāḥ || 27 || āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe paṃcamī pitṛdaivatam || nakṣatraṃ jagadīśasya mahāvedīsamāgamaḥ || 28 || ete yadā trayaḥ syuścediṃdradyumnasarovare || catuṣpādaḥ smṛto yogaḥ pitṝṇāmakṣayapradaḥ ||29|| pitṛkārye na sīdaṃti nirūpya śrāddhamatra vai || śṛṇudhvamanyadviprā vai prasaṃgācca bravīmi vaḥ || 2.2.34.30 || nabhasya darśe yaḥ kuryāccaturṣvapi yugādiṣu || śrāddhaṃ pitṝnsamuddiśyā'śvamedhāṃgasaṃbhave || 31 || gayāśrāddhasahasrasya śraddhayā vihitasya vai || phalaṃ yaddhi samaṃ tvasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 32 || dānaṃ homo japaścāpi sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ|| dināni sapta yānyatra kṛṣṇe vasati maṃḍape || 33 || ekasmāduttaraṃ śreyo yattasmāduttarottaram || āṣāḍhaśukla tṛtīyāyāṃ prātaḥsnānaṃ samācaret || 34 || iṃdradyumnataṭe deśe nṛsiṃhakṣetra uttame || vratametattu gṛhṇīyātsaṃkalpya vidhivannaraḥ || 35 || vanajāgaraṇaṃ nāma bhagavatprītivarddhanam || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavrataphalapradam || 36 || dināni sapta maunī syātkṛtatriṣavaṇakriyaḥ || kuṃbhe ca pūjayeddevaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ || 37 || goghṛtenātha tailena tilajena pradīpayet || aharniśaṃ hareragre rakṣettaṃ yatnato vratī || || 38 || divā divā vasenmaunī rātrau rātrau ca jāgṛyāt || maṃtraṃ bhāgavataṃ japyānnityakṛtyāṃtare vratī || 39 || upavāsaparo bhūtvā saptāhāni nayedvratī || aṣṭame prātarutthāya pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayeddine || 2.2.34.40 || tasminneva tīrthavare snātvāgatya gṛhaṃ punaḥ || maṃḍale sarvatobhadre pūrve kuṃbhaṃ niveśayeta || 41 || tatrāvāhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥ || tasya paścimadeśe ca sthaṃḍile vidhisaṃskṛte || 42 || agniṃ praṇīya gṛhyoktavidhinā brāhmaṇāvṛtaḥ || agnikāryaṃ prakurvīta samidājyacarūṃstathā || 43 || sahasraṃ juhuyādagnau pratyekaṃ vā śataṃ śatam || gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī yā vai tayā homavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || || 44 || saṃprāśya dakṣiṇāṃ dayāddhenuṃ vastraṃ hiraṇyakam || viprāṃśca bhojayedaṃte prītaye viśvasākṣiṇaḥ || 45 || vratarājamimaṃ kṛtvā vidhinānena bho dvijāḥ || caturvargānavāpnoti yo yaḥ kāmānabhīpsati || 46 || nārī vā śraddhayā yuktā kuryādvedīmahotsavam || sāpi tatphalamāpnoti yā kuryādvratamuttamam || 47 || yātrākartuḥ phalaṃ yādṛgvratakartuśca tatphalam || bhavate vai dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kathitaṃ vo mudānvitāḥ || 48 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || || cha ||
<2.2.35>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi ratharakṣākaraṃ vidhim|| bhūtapretādayo ghorā dāruṇānyadbhutāni ca || 1 || na bādhaṃte rathānyena munayo vaśca yanmatam || pratyahaṃ pūjayeddevānkṛṣṇādīndhvajasaṃsthitān || 2 || gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairmālyairupahārairanuttamaiḥ || gītanṛttādikaiścaiva dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ || || 3 || dikpālebhyo baliṃ dadyātpāyasānnena cānvaham || bhūtapretapiśācebhyo dadyācca balimuttamam || 4 || rakṣecca yatnatastānvai rathānārohaṇocitān || yathā na kaścidārohennaro grāmyapaśustathā || pakṣiṇaśca viśeṣeṇa yeṣāṃ vāso na śobhanaḥ || 5 || aṣṭame'hni punaḥ kṛtvā dakṣiṇābhimukhānrathān|| vibhūṣayedvastramālyapatākaiścāmarādibhiḥ || 6 || navamyāṃ vāsayeddevāṃsteṣu prātaḥ samṛddhimat || 7 || dakṣiṇābhimukhā yātrā viṣṇoreṣā sudurlabhā || yātrā prayatnataḥ sā hi bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaiḥ || 8 || yathā pūrvā tathā ceyaṃ dve ca muktipradāyike || yātrāpraveśau devasya eka evotsavo mataḥ || 9 || purāvido vadaṃtyetāṃ yātrāṃ navadinātmikām || eṣā tryavayavā yātrā saṃpūrṇā yairupāsitā || 2.2.35.10 || susaṃpūrṇaphalasteṣāṃ mahāvedīmahotsavaḥ || 11 || guṃḍicāmaṃḍapātkṛṣṇamāyāṃtaṃ dakṣiṇāmukham || rathasthaṃ balinaṃ bhadrāṃ paśyaṃto muktibhāginaḥ | 12 || uttarābhimukhāndṛdṛṣṭvā labhaṃte yādṛśa phalam || rāmādīnsyaṃdanasthānye paśyaṃtyevaṃ mahodayān || yādṛśaṃ phalamāpnuyustādṛśaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhān || || 13 || padā yāṃtaṃ rathe yāṃtaṃ yaḥ paśyeddakṣiṇāmukham || tasya janma kṛtārthaṃ syādvājimedhaḥ pade pade || 14 || stutibhiḥ praṇipātaiśca puṣpavṛṣṭibhireva ca || nānānṛttopahāraiśca vyajanacchatracāmaraiḥ || upāyanairbahuvidhairupatiṣṭhedrathāgrataḥ || 15 || nīlācalaṃ samāyāṃtaṃ rathasthaṃ dakṣiṇāmukham| ye paśyaṃti hṛṣīkeśaṃ subhadrāṃ lāṃgalāyudham || 16 || kāmakalpataruṃ puṃsāṃ darśanādeva muktidam || te vrajaṃti mahātmāno vaikuṇṭha bhavanaṃ hareḥ || 17 || rathena vicaraṃtaṃ taṃ sindhutīre janārdanam || paśyantaṃ karuṇāpāṃgaiḥ praṇatānpurato narān || 18 || dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ yāṃtaṃ prāsādaṃ nīlabhūdhare || sarvatīrthanidhiṃ sarvadānakalpataruṃ harim || 19 || stuvaṃtaḥ praṇamaṃtaśca śraddadhānāśca ye narāḥ || na te punarihāyāṃti brahmalokasthitā dhruvam|| 2.2.35.20 || munayaḥ kathito vo'yaṃ mahāvedīmahotsavaḥ || yasya saṃkīrttanādeva nirmalo jāyate naraḥ || 21 || yaścedaṃ kīrtayennityaṃ prātarutthāya mānavaḥ || śṛṇuyādapi buddhisthaḥ śakralokaṃ vrajedasau || 22 || pratyarcārūpamapi vā rathamāsthāpya yo hareḥ || kuryādyātrāmimāṃ śraddhābhaktibhāvena mānavaḥ || 23 || so'pi viṣṇoḥ prasādena guṃḍicotsavajaṃ phalam|| prāpya vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ yāti nātra vicāraṇā || 24 || paśya śrīryāvatī viprā bhaktirvā śraddhayānvitā || tāvatīyaṃ mahāyātrā yo yathā kartumicchati || 25 || idaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ vedhasoditam || kārayitvāthavā dṛṣṭvā yannaro nāvasīdati || 26 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
<2.2.36>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śayanotsavamuttamam || āṣāḍhīmavadhiṃ kṛtvā hareḥ svāpastu karkaṭe || 1 || vārṣikāṃścaturo māsānyāvatsyātkārttikī dvijāḥ || ayaṃ puṇyatamaḥ kālo harerārādhanaṃ prati || 2 || kāśyāṃ bahuyugaṃ vāsānniyamavratasaṃsthiteḥ || phalaṃ yaduktaṃ tadvidyātkṣetre śrīpuruṣottame || 3 || cāturmāsyadinaikena vasataḥ sannidhau hareḥ || vārṣikāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ tu yānyahāni vasannayet || 4 || puṇyakṣetre jagannāthasannidhau nirmalāṃtare || pratyakṣaṃ vājimedhasya sahasrasya labhetphalam || 5 || snātvā siṃdhujale puṇye dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam || cāturmāsyavrate tiṣṭhanna śocati kutaścana || 6 || cāturmāsye nivasati kṣetre śrīpuruṣottame || sākṣāddṛṣṭirbhagavatastaddvayaṃ muktisādhanam || 7 || tasmātsarvāṇi saṃtyajya śrautasmārttāni mānavaḥ || prayatnānnivasetpuṇye kṣetre śrīpuruṣottame || 8 || bhogibhogāsane suptaścāturmāsyeṣu vai prabhuḥ || sarva kṣetreṣu sānnidhyaṃ na karoti jagadguruḥ || 9 || atra sākṣānnivasati yathā vaikuṇṭhaveśmani || dvādaśasvapi māseṣu bhagavānatra mūrtimān || muktidaścakṣuṣā dṛṣṭaścāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ || 2.2.36.10 || aṣṭamāsanivāsena dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ dine dine || yadāpnoti phalaṃ taddhi cāturmāsyadinaikataḥ || 11 || cāturmāsyanivāsena kṣetre śrīpuruṣottame || dinaṃ dinaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvakṣatranivāsajam || phalaṃ dadāti bhagavānkṣetre varṣanivāsataḥ || 12 || sarvapāpaprasakto'pi sarvācāracyuto'pi ca || sarvadharmabahirbhūto nivasetpuruṣottame || 13 || cāturmāsyamathekaṃ yaḥ kuryādvai pāpakṛnnaraḥ || vihāya sarvapāpāni bahiraṃtaśca nirmalaḥ || 14 || narasiṃhaprasādena vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ vrajet || 15 || tasmānnaraḥ sarvabhāvairviṣṇoḥ śayanabhāvitān || vārṣikāṃścaturo māsānnivasetpuruṣottame || 16 || kuryādanyanna vā kuryājjanmasāphalyamṛcchati || 17 || āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ kuryātsvāpamahotsavam || maṇḍapaṃ racayettatra śayanāgāramuttamam || 18 || devasya purataḥ śayyāṃ ratnapalyaṃkikopari || svāstīrya sopadhānāṃ tu mṛducīnottaracchadām || 19 || karpūradhūlivikṣiptāṃ sādhucaṃdrātapāṃ śubhām || sarvato veṣṭitāṃ chidrarahitāṃ cadanokṣitām || 2.2.36.20 || sādhudvārāṃ samāṃ snigdhāṃ nānācitropaśobhitām|| ekaṃ svāpagṛhaṃ kṛtvā niśīthe pratimātrayam || 21 || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi rītijaṃ dārṣadaṃ tathā || yathāśraddhaṃ prakurvīta praśastaṃ cottarottaram|| 22 || tattrayāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ vai pādamūle yathātatham || nidhāya pūjūyeddevāṃstaccheṣaṃ teṣu nikṣipet || 23 || pūjāṃte bhāvayedaikya teṣāṃ kṛṣṇādibhiḥ saha || ehyehi bhagavandeva sarvalokaikajīvana || 24 || svāpārthaṃ caturo māsānsarvakalyāṇavṛddhaye || iti saṃprārthya deveśāṃstadaṃgāttatsrajāṃ trayam || 25 || pratyarcāsu vinikṣipya māṃgalyastutigītibhiḥ || nayecchayyāgṛhaddvāraṃ vāsayeddhaṭikātraye ||26|| paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayettānpṛthakpalaśatādhikaiḥ || sugandhacaṃdanairliptānvastrālaṃkaraṇādibhiḥ || 27 || pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ prāṃjalirmaṃtramuccaret || jagadvandya jagannātha jagattrāṇaparāyaṇa ||28 || hitāya jagatāmīśa cāturmāsyānghanāgamān || suptvā praśamayāriṣṭāñchakreṇa saha pūjitaḥ || 29 || ehyehi śayanāgāraṃ sukhamatra svapa prabho || iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ svāpayetpuruṣottamam || 2.2.36.30 || sudṛḍhaṃ bandhayeddvāraṃ viṣṇoḥ śayanaveśmanaḥ || svāpayitvā jagannāthaṃ labhate sukhamuttamam || || 31 || vārṣikāṃścaturo māsānprasupte vai janārdane || vratairanekairniyamairmāsānvai caturaḥ kṣipet || 32 || kalpasthāyī viṣṇuloke naro bhakto bhaveddhruvam|| niyamavratāni gadataḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munayo mama || 33 || maṃcakhaṭvādiśayanaṃ varjayedbhaktimānnaraḥ || anṛtau na vrajedbhāryāṃ māsaṃ madhu paraudanam || || 34 || paṭolaṃ mūlakaṃ caiva vārtākaṃ ca na bhakṣayet || abhakṣyaṃ varjayeddūrānmasūraṃ sitasarṣapam || 35 || rājamāṣānkulatthāṃśca āśudhānyaṃ ca saṃtyajet|| śākaṃ dadhi payo māṣācchrāvaṇādau kramādimān || 36 || rājagopayatīṃstyaktvā nāroheccarmapāduke || vārṣikāṃścaturo māsānavratena nayedyadi || tasya pāpasya śāṃtyarthaṃ kārtike vā vratī bhavet || 37 || namaḥ kṛṣṇāya haraye keśavāya namonamaḥ || namo'stu nārasiṃhāya viṣṇave pāpajiṣṇave || 38 || sāyaṃ prātardivāmadhye karmāṃteṣu ca yojayet || 39 || tasya pāpāni ghorāṇi citāni bahujanmasu || nirdahatyeva sarvāṇi tūlarāśimivānalaḥ || 2.2.36.40 || ekāhāro yatāhāro viṣṇunirmālyabhojanaḥ || āṣāḍhīmavadhiṃ kṛtvā kārtikyavadhi yo bhavet || naktabhojī bhavedvāpi svargastasyālpakaṃ phalam|| 41 || tailābhyaṃgaṃ divāsvāpaṃ mṛṣāvādaṃ ca varjayet || āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ saṃkrāṃtau karkaṭasya vā || 42 || āṣāḍhyāṃ vā naro bhaktyā gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ vratī || sarvapāpaharaṃ devaṃ prapūjya madhusūdanam || 43 || tadagre pratisaṃkalpya vratārcanajapādikam || prārthayetparamānandaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo vratī || 44 || cāturmāsyavrataṃ deva gṛhītaṃ tvatprasādataḥ || tava prasādānnirvighnaṃ siddhimāyātu keśava || 45 || vratesminyadyasaṃpūrṇe paralokagatirbhavet|| tanme bhavatusaṃpūrṇaṃ tvatprasādādadhokṣaja || 46 || iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ pūrvoktaniyame sthitaḥ || yāpayeccaturo māsānviṣṇvarpita matirvratī||47|| pāraṇaṃ pratimāsāṃte prītyai kṛṣṇasya kārayet ||48|| miṣṭānnairbhojayedviprānpūjayitvā jagatpatim || asamarthastu kārtikyāṃ pārayedvratamuttamam||49|| tasyāṃ pūjya jagannāthaṃ vahnisthaṃ tarpayettataḥ || dvijāgryānpāyasairmiṣṭairviṣṇubhaktyā prapūjayet ||2.2.36.50|| yathāśaktyā pradadyādvai kanakaṃ vastrameva ca || aśaktaḥ kārtike māsi vrataṃ kuryātpuroditam ||51|| vrataṃ ca vividhaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇaṃ tathā ||52|| payaḥ pītvā nayedyastu śākāhāreṇa vā punaḥ || bhuktvātra vipulānbhogānparaṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati||53|| tatrāpi cedaśaktaḥ syādbhīṣmapaṃcakamuttamam|| prītaye devadevasya vanyavṛttirbhavedvratī ||54|| etadvrataṃ samākhyātaṃ bhagavatprītikārakam || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ viṣṇulokagatipradam || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmaprasādhanam ||55|| munayaḥ proktametadvo rahasyaṃ śṛṇutāparam || etadvratāni cānyāni vratāni sabahūni ca || 56 || bhagavadbhaktihīnānāṃ jānīdhvaṃ viphalāni vai || phalaṃ mahākratūnāṃ yattīrthānāṃ phalamuttamam || 57 || dānānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva sāttvikānāṃ ca yatphalam || ekayā viṣṇubhaktyā tatsamagraṃ phalamaśnute || 58 || ye paśyaṃti mahātmānaḥ śayanopsavamuttamam|| māturgarbhe na svapaṃti kārayaṃti ca ye maham || 59 || utsavāṃte vrataṃ cedaṃ pratijñāya tadagrataḥ || paryāptaṃ pārayitvā tu brahmaloke mahīyate || 2.2.36.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||
<2.2.37>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dakṣiṇāyanamuttamam || saṃkrāṃteḥ pūrvakāle yāḥ kalā vai viṃśatirmatāḥ || 1 || ayanaṃ puṇyakālo'yaṃ puṇyakarmasu karmiṇām || paṃcāmṛtaistatra devaṃ snāpayetsvāpavaddvijāḥ || 2 || sarvāṃgaṃ lepayedasyāgurukarpūracaṃdanaiḥ || sugandha mālyālaṃkāraiścāruvastraiśca dīpakaiḥ || 3 || nānābhakṣyopahāraiśca pūjayetparameśvaram || karpūrālatikāmuccairmukhābhyāśe harerdadet || 4 || dūrvāṃkurākṣatairnīrājanenātha pravandayet || māṃgalyagītanṛttādyairnārī huluhulāṃ vadet || 5 || pūjitaṃ pūjyamānaṃ ca yaḥ paśyetpuruṣottamam || pūjāśataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tasmai dadyājjanārdanaḥ || 6 || ayane dakṣiṇe tasminnarcyamānaṃ śriyaḥ patim || vihāya sarvapāpāni viṣṇulokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 7 || svalpā vā mahatī yātrā sarvā muktipradā hareḥ || tasmiṃstasmindine dṛṣṭo bhagavānmuktido dhruvam || 8 || viśvāsahetormūrkhāṇāṃ yātrā hyetāḥ kṛpāvatā || viṣṇunā kathitā viprāḥ pāpināṃ kilbiṣāpahāḥ || 9 || āyāsajanitaṃ puṇyaṃ manyante ye narādhamāḥ || lakṣmīpaterbhojanāya saṃskāryo'tra mahānasaḥ || 2.2.37.10 || vaiṣṇavāgniṃ samādhāya nirupya carumuttamam || vaiśvadevaṃ prakurvīta bhagavatpākasādhanam ||11|| brahmaṇe vāstupataye prajānāṃ pataye tathā || viṣṇave viśvakartre ca śucyagnau juhuyācchuciḥ || 12 || rājñā niyukta ācāryaḥ śrautasmārtakriyāparaḥ || dvārapālapracaṃḍābhyāmaiśānyāṃ kṣetrapāline || 13 || dakṣiṇe ca virūpāya khagānāṃ pataye tathā || durgāsarasvatībhyāṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ vinivedayet || 14 || mahālakṣmīmaheṃdrābhyāṃ prācyāṃ diśi baliḥ smṛtaḥ || viṣṇu pāriṣadebhyo'tha paśūnāṃ pataye tathā || 15 || udīcyāṃ balidānaṃ tu nāradāyātha paścime || āgneyyāmagnaye dadyādvāyavyāṃ viśvasākṣiṇe || 16 || pañcaśvasanarūpebhyo viśvakartre'tha madhyataḥ || ādyaṃtayorjalaṃ dadyātpratyekaṃ balikarmaṇi || 37 || dattvā valiṃ tadagnau tu kārayetpākamuttamam || saṃdhyātraye bhagavataḥ pūjāyai carukāraṇāt || 18 || carusaṃskārakāṃgāni bhakṣyabhojyādikāni vai || na dīptānyojayettatra loke traivarṇiko nṛpaḥ || || 19 || āryānpavitrāñchūdrānvā varṇāṃśca parisevakān || laukikavyavahāro'yaṃ pacati śrīḥ svayaṃ dhruvam || 2.2.37.20 || bhuṃkte nārāyaṇo nityaṃ tayā pakvaṃ śarīravān || amṛtaṃ taddhi naivedyaṃ pāpaghnaṃ
