mūrdhni dhāraṇāt || 21 || bhakṣaṇānmadyapānādimahāduritanāśanam || āghrāṇānmānasaṃ pāpaṃ darśanāddṛṣṭijaṃ tathā || 22 || āsvādāttu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrāvaṇaṃ ca vyapohati || sparśanāttvakkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mithyābhāṣaṇajaṃ tathā || 23 || gātralepāddahetpāpaṃ śārīraṃ vai na saṃśayaḥ || 24 || mahāpavitraṃ hi harerniveditaṃ niyojayedyaḥ pitṛdevakarmasu || tṛpyaṃti tasmai pitaraḥ surāstathā prayāṃti lokaṃ madhusūdanasya te || 25 || nātḥ pavitraṃ vastvasti havyakavyeṣu bho dvijāḥ || narāṇāṃ rūpamāsthāya tadaśnaṃti divaukasaḥ || 26 || abhimāno mahāṃstatra devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || śveto nāma mahārājaḥ purā tretāyuge'bhavat || 27 || vratastho'pi mahābhaktiṃ cakāra puruṣottame || indradyumnena racitabhogamātrānusārataḥ || 28 || bhogānprakalpayāmāsa pratyahaṃ śrīpatermudā || bhakṣyabhojyānyanekāni ṣaḍrasāṃśca susaṃskṛtān || 29 || mālyāni ca vicitrāṇi sugaṃdhamanulepanam || gītavāditranṛtyāni divyāni subahūni ca || 2.2.37.30 || rājopacārā bahuśo'vasare'vasare hareḥ || bahuvittavyayāyāsa bhaktibhāvanirūpakāḥ || 31 || tattadvaiṣṇavaśāstroktacitrabhogāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ || kalpitāstena bhūpena vidvatpaṃkajabhānunā || 32 || prātaḥ pūjanavelāyāṃ hariṃ draṣṭuṃ jagāma saḥ || kasmiṃściddivase rājā pūjyamānaṃ dadarśa tam || 33 || praṇamya devadevaṃ tu baddhāṃjalipuṭo mudā || prāsādadvāranikaṭe tasthivānṛpasattamaḥ || 34 || dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ viracitānupacārānanuttamān || upāyanasahasraṃ ca hareragre prakalpitam || 35 || ciṃtayāmāsa manasā kiṃciddhyānāvalaṃbitaḥ || manuṣyakalpitaṃbhogaṃ grahīṣyati hariḥ kimu || 36 || devairdivyopacārairyo śakyate nārcanāvidhau || mānasairupahārairyaṃ pūjayaṃti yatavratāḥ || 37 || bhāvaduṣṭo bahiryāgo na mude tasya niścitam || itthaṃ saṃcitayanrājā divyāsanagataṃ vibhum || 38 || bhuṃjānamannapānāḍhyaṃ śriyā supariveṣitam || divyasrajālaṃkṛtayā divyagaṃdhadukūlayā || 39 || anarghyaratnamaṃjīrasiṃjitena surālayam || pūrayaṃtyā svarṇadarvyā dadatyā sādaraṃ rasān || 2.2.37.40 || bhagavatpratirūpaiśca bhuṃjānaiḥ pariveṣṭitam || dṛṣṭvā kṛtārthamātmānaṃ manyamānastadadbhutam || 41 || pronmīlitākṣaḥ sa punaḥ prāgdṛṣṭaṃ samavaikṣata || ataḥ prabhṛti rājāsau parāṃ nirvṛtimāptavān || 42 || niveditāśīrvratavāṃścacāra sumahattapaḥ || akālamṛtyunāśāya svarājye mṛtamuktaye || 43 || maṃtrarājaṃ japannityaṃ śritānāṃ kalpapādapam || dadarśa śatavarṣāṃte nṛhariṃ duritāpaham || 44 || yogāsanābjanilayaṃ vāmāṃgāvasthitaśriyam || divyālaṃkṛtasarvāṃgaṃ sphaṭikāmalavigraham || 45 || tridaśaiḥ siddhamuktaiśca stūyamānaṃ smitānanam || bhrāṃto vismayabhītibhyāṃ harṣagadgadayā girā || prasīda nātheti lapanpapāta dharaṇītale || 46 || tapaḥkṛśaṃ taṃ praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā manujakesarī || akalmaṣaṃ kṣitipatiṃ vivakṣurbhaktavatsalaḥ || 47 || || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || uttiṣṭha vatsa bhaktyā te prasannaṃ viddhi māṃ prabhum || mayi prasanne nālabhyaṃ varaṃ tatprārthyatāṃ bhavān ||48|| śrutvetthaṃ bhagavadvākyaṃ samuttasthau tato nṛpaḥ || baddhāṃjalipuṭo namro bhaktyovāca janārdanam || 49 || || śveta uvāca || || svāminyadi prasādaste mayi jātaḥ sudurlabhaḥ || sārūpyamatha saṃprāpya sthāsyāmi tava sannidhau || 2.2.37.50 || sthāsye yāvannṛpatve'haṃ madrājye no janaḥ kvacit || akāle mriyatāṃ jaṃtuḥ kāle cenmuktimāpnuyāt ||51|| tacchrutvā bhagavānprāha śvetarājānamuttamam ||52|| śveta te vāṃchitaṃ bhūyāttiṣṭha tvaṃ mama dakṣiṇe || bhuktvā varṣasahasraṃ tu svarājyaṃ susamṛddhimat ||53|| mama nirmālyabhogena kṣīṇaśeṣāghasaṃcayaḥ || sunirmalāṃtaḥkaraṇo matsāyujyamavāpsyasi || 54 || vaṭasāgarayormadhye muktisthāne sudurlabhe || madīyā''dyāvatārasya viṣṇormatsyasvarūpiṇaḥ||55|| saṃmukhīno vasa tvaṃ hi sphaṭikāmalavigrahaḥ || khyātiṃ yāsyasi bhūrloke śvetamādhavasaṃjñayā||56|| yuvayoraṃtarāle ye prāṇāṃstyakṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || tiryaṃco'pi ca kīṭā vā dhruvaṃ te muktimāpnuyuḥ ||57|| amarā yatra maraṇamicchaṃti kimu mānavāḥ || tavottarasyāṃ diśi yatsaraḥ pāpanibarhaṇam ||58|| tatra snātvā upaspṛśya tadīye dakṣiṇe taṭe || ubhayordṛṣṭipūtaḥsaṃtyaktvā prāṇānvimucyate || ||59|| āsamaṃtādidaṃ kṣetraṃ yatratatrāpi muktidam || mūḍhātmanāṃ viśvasituṃ pradhānaṃ sthānamīritam||2.2.37.60|| tava rājye tu ye lokā mama nirmālyabhojinaḥ|| mṛtirākālikī teṣāṃ na kadācidbhaviṣyati || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||37||
<2.2.38>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai śvetarājāya vai purā || jagāmāṃtarhito viprāḥ prāsādāṃtaḥ sthito hariḥ||1|| samastajagatāṃ yā śrīḥ sṛṣṭisthitivināśakṛt || vaiṣṇavīśaktiratulā pariveṣaṇakāriṇī || 2 || sudhopamaṃ supakvānnaṃ bhuṃkte nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || taducchiṣṭopabhogo hi sarvāghakṣayakārakaḥ || 3 || na tādṛśasamaṃ puṇyaṃ vastvasti pṛthivītale || pāpasaṃskārakartṛṇāṃ saṃparkāttu na duṣyati || 4 || padmāyāḥ sannidhānena sarve te śucayaḥ smṛtāḥ || viṣṇvālayagataṃ taddhi nirmālyaṃ patitādayaḥ || 5 || spṛśaṃti cenna duṣṭaṃ tadyathā viṣṇustathaiva tat || vratasthā vidhavāścaiva sarve varṇāśramāstathā || 6 || tatprāśanena pūyante dīkṣitāścāgnihotriṇaḥ || daridraḥ kṛpaṇo vāpi gṛhasthaḥ prabhureva vā ||7|| svadeśyāḥ paradeśyā vā sarve tatra samāgatāḥ || nābhimānaṃ prakurvīranviṣṇornirmālyabhakṣaṇe || 8 || bhaktyā lobhātkautukādvā kṣudhāsaṃśamanena vā || ākaṃṭhabhakṣitaṃ taddhi punāti sakalāṃhasaḥ || 9 || sarvarogopaśamanaṃ putrapautrapravarddhanam || dāridryaharaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vidyāyuḥśrīpradaṃ śubham || 2.2.38.10 || pakṣapāto mahāṃstatra viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || nindanti ye tadamṛtaṃ mūḍhāḥ paṃḍitamāninaḥ || 11 || svayaṃ daṃḍadharasteṣu sahate nāparādhinaḥ || yeṣāmatra sa daṇḍaśceddhruvā teṣāṃ hi durgatiḥ || 12 || kumbhīpāke mahāghore pacyante te'tidāruṇe taṃ na vikrayaḥ krayo vāpi praśastastasya bho dvijāḥ || 13 || nirmālyaṃ jagadīśasya nāśitvāśnāmi kiñcana || iti satyapratijño yaḥ pratyahaṃ tacca bhakṣayet || 14 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śuddhāṃtaḥkaraṇo naraḥ || sa śuddhaṃ vaiṣṇava sthānaṃ kramādyāti na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || cirasthamapi saṃśuṣkaṃ nītaṃ vā dūradeśataḥ || yathātathopayuktaṃ tatsarvaṃ pāpāpanodanam || 16 || kukkurasya mukhādbhraṣṭaṃ tadannaṃ patitaṃ yadi || brāhmaṇenāpi bhoktavyamitareṣāṃ tu kā kathā || 17 || upoṣya tiṣṭhatā vāpi nopavāsaṃ ca kurvatā || aśucirvāpyanācāro manasā pāpamācaran || prāptamātreṇa bhoktavyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 18 || naivedyānnaṃ jagadbhartturgāṃgaṃ vāri samaṃ dvayam || dṛṣṭeḥ svargādi saṃprāptirbhakṣaṇāccāghanāśanam || 19 || jagaddhātryā hi yatpakvaṃ vaiṣṇave'gnau susaṃskṛte || bhukte'nvahaṃ cakrapāṇiryugamanvaṃtarādiṣu || 2.2.38.20 || saptadvīpa dharāmadhye sānnidhyaṃ nedṛśaṃ hareḥ || yādṛśaṃ nīlagotre'sminvyājamānuṣaceṣṭitam || 21 || dārurūpaṃ paraṃ brahma sarvacākṣuṣagocaram || prakāśate bho munayo na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ kvacit || 22 || tasmai pravṛttirūpāya brahmaṇe paramātmane || pravṛttirūpā śaktiḥ śrīḥ pravartayati yaddhaviḥ || 23 || tadaśnāti jaga nnāthastaccheṣaṃ duritāpaham || kimatra citraṃ bho viprā yaduktaṃ muktikāraṇam || 24 || nālpapuṇyavatāṃ tatra viśvāsaśca prajāyate || vedācārapradhāneṣu yuge hyetatprakīrtitam || 25 || mahimānaṃ na vedāsya viśeṣācchrūyatāṃ kalau || ghore kaliyuge tasmiṃstripādo dharmaviplavaḥ || 26 || dharmaḥ syādekapādastu kvacittasya bhayāccaret || sarvenṛtapradhānā hi dāṃbhikāḥ śabdavṛttayaḥ || 27 || prāyaśca dharmavimukhā jihvopasthaparāyaṇāḥ || na dhyāyaṃti tapasyanti vratayaṃti kadācana || 28 || adharmabahulāḥ sarve hiṃsakā lolupāḥ param || pareṣāṃ parivādena tuṣyanti svakṛtaṃ vinā || 29 || prasaṃgātkautukādvāpi nighnaṃti parakarma vai || kṣudrakāryāśayātsvasya parakāryaprabādhakāḥ || 2.2.38.30 || dharmalabdhāṃ striyaṃ ramyāmavajñāya svaveśmani || parayoṣiti niṃdyāyāṃ prasaktāḥ paśuceṣṭitāḥ || 31 || agnihotrādikaṃ vāpi vrataṃ nānyatkvacitkvacit || jīvikā taddvijātīnāṃ yeṣāṃ vā pāralaukikam||32|| avratādhītavedena anyāyāptadhanena ca || vittaśāṭhyena ca kṛtaṃ na tathā phaladāyi tat || 33 || prāyaḥ kaliyuge bhūpāḥ prajāvanaparāṅmukhāḥ || karādānaparā nityaṃ pāpiṣṭhāścauryavṛttayaḥ || 34 || varṇasaṃkariṇaḥ sarve śūdraprāyāḥ kalau yuge || hartāraḥ pārthivā eva śūdrāśca nṛpasevakāḥ || 35 || śrautasmārtādikaṃ karma na tathā sadanuṣṭhitam || yuge caturthe bho viprāḥ paralokāya kalpite || 36 || dānadharmaḥ paro hyeṣa nānyo dharmaḥ praśasyate || karmaṇā manasā vācā hitamiccheddvijanmanām || 37 || iti hovāca bhagavānbrāhmaṇo māmakī tanuḥ || brāhmaṇā yasya saṃtuṣṭāḥ santuṣṭastasya cāpyaham || 38 || ubhayatra samo bhūyādbrāhmaṇe ca janārdane || yadvadaṃti dvijā vākyaṃ tatsvayaṃ bhagavānvadet || 39 || yathātathā vartamāno varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo guruḥ || bhagavānapi deveśaḥ sa sākṣādbrāhmaṇapriyaḥ || 2.2.38.40 || sadāvatāraṃ kurute brāhmaṇārthaṃ janārdanaḥ || tatpālanārthaṃ duṣṭānvai nigṛhṇāti yuge yuge || 41 || sasarja brāhmaṇānagre sṛṣṭyādau sa caturmukhaḥ || sarve varṇāḥ pṛthakpaścātteṣāṃ vaṃśeṣu jajñire || 42 || tasmātkaliyuge tasminbrāhmaṇo viṣṇureva ca || ubhau gatiśca sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ harirgatiḥ || 43 || harirevātra sarveṣāṃ gatiḥ prāpte kalau yuge || śālagrāmādike kṣetre smaryate kīrtyate'pi ca || || 44 || tasminnīlācale puṇye kṣetre kṣetrajñavarṣmaṇi || jīvabhūtaḥ sa sarveṣāṃ dāruvyājaśarīrabhṛt || 45 || kalikalmaṣanāśāya prāyo duṣkṛtakarmaṇām || darśanastavanocchiṣṭabhojanairmuktidāyakaḥ || 46 || ucchiṣṭena sureśasya vyāptaṃ yasya kalevaram || tadāhārastadātmā hi lipyate na sa pātakaiḥ || 47 || nivedanīyamanyāsu mūrtiṣvīśasya vartate || pāvanaṃ tadapi proktamucchiṣṭaṃ tu vimocakam || 48 || bhuṃkte tvatraiva bhagavānpaśyatyanyatra cakṣuṣā || purāyaṃ prārthito devo yogibhiḥ pariveṣṭitaiḥ || 49 || nirmālyocchiṣṭabhogena tava māyāṃ jayemahi || atyaṃtastimitākṣāṇāmanāyāsena muktidaḥ || 2.2.38.50 || śayanāsanabhogādyai ramate ca śriyā saha || atra ceṣṭā bhagavato vedārtha iti dhāryatām || 51 || samatikrāṃtavedo hi na kadācitpravartate || vedarakṣārthamevāsya saṃbhavo hi yuge yuge || 52 || pramāṇabhūto bhagavānviruddhaṃ kathamācaret || tasminviruddhaṃ carati jagadeva tathā bhavet || 53 || ācāreṇa hi vedārtho niyato dhāmatāṃ gataḥ || madhyadeśabhavaḥ pūrvamatrāgacchaddvijottamaḥ || 54 || śiṣṭācāraiḥ suvimalaḥ śāstrārthapariniṣṭhitaḥ || sadā śāṃtaḥ sadā dāṃtaḥ kāyavāṅmanasairgṛhī || 55 || sa tīrthavidhinā devaṃ samabhyarcya ca sāgnikaḥ || trirātramatroṣitavānviṣṇvarcanaparaḥ śuciḥ || || 56 || yajñaśeṣaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ bhoktavyamiti śāstrataḥ || devocchiṣṭaṃ na jagrāha anyapākābhiśaṃkayā || 57 || daivatairatra saṃskāryo devayogyaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || ayogyatvācca naiveyamagrāhyaṃ ca bhaveddhruvam ||58|| agṛhīte ca naivedye śrotriyeṇa tadā dvijāḥ || sarve ca tasyānucarā nābhuṃjaṃta niveditam || || 59 || tataḥ sa vyādhisaṃmagno vihvalībhūtavigrahaḥ || sakuṭuṃbo'bhavanmūko bhagavaddrohasaṃyutaḥ || 2.2.38.60 || manasā cintayatyevaṃ nirnimittaṃ kathaṃ nu me || kuṭumbasahitasyābhūtpīḍā sarvāṃgabhaṃjinī || 61 || evaṃ cintayamānasya trirātrāṃte'bhavanmatiḥ || nedṛśī vyādhipīḍā ca sarveṣāmekadā bhavet || || 62 || ko vā drohaḥ kṛto'smābhiretasminpuruṣottame || na buddhipūrvakaḥ kiṃ syāttato me vyādhikāraṇam || 63 || muhuritthaṃ cintayitvā dadhyau nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || dhyānāvasāne tuṣṭāva śāstratattvārthadarśakaḥ || 64 || || śāṃḍilya uvāca || || caturdaśāpi yā vidyā dhamaniṇayahetavaḥ || tāḥ sarvāstava vākyāni mukhapadmavinirgatāḥ || 65 || tābhirevācareddharmamiti śāstrārthaniścayaḥ || tasya dharmasya rakṣārthamavatāro yuge yuge || 66 || tamullaṃghya varttamāno bhavaddrohakaro dhruvam || ahaṃ te devadeveśa karmaṇā manasā girā || 67 || dharmaśāstramatikramya na vartte'pyarthakāmayoḥ || aneka janmasāhasraiḥ saṃcitaṃ pāpasaṃcayam || 68 || dagdhumatrāgato deva tvaddarśanadavāgninā || ko'parādhaḥ kṛto deva tvacchāstrapathi vartinā || sarvāṃgaṃ vādhate yasmādugro vyādhirahetukaḥ || 69 || jñānato'jñānato vāpi tvatpādasarasīruhe || kṛto'parādho yo deva taṃ kṣamasva kṛpāṃbudhe || bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmirevāvalaṃbanam || 2.2.38.70 || tvayi jātāparādhānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ prabho || tavāparādhajaṃ pāpaṃ tvameva ca kṣamasva me || 71 || vahnisaṃtāpato naśyedvahnisaṃtāpajo vraṇa || tadimāṃ durdaśāṃ deva prārabdhāṃ pāpabījajām || 72 || līlāpāṃgena śamaya apavargaikahetunā || māmuddhara jagannātha patitaṃ śokasāgare || 73 || tvaddarśanapathaṃ yātaḥ kiṃ nu śocyo bhavennaraḥ || nisargakaruṇāṃbhodhe yastvaddṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ || 74 || sadānandābdhisaṃmagno na śocati na kāṃkṣati || nālpabhāgyo hyahaṃ deva tvāmadrākṣaṃ svacakṣuṣā || 75 || apavargāṃtarāyo me dhruvameṣā vibhīṣikā || tatprasīda jagannātha sevakaṃ drohiṇaṃ sadā || 76 || sevyasevakasaṃbaṃdhādaparādhaṃ kṣamasva me || iti stavāṃte tasyāśu dehapīḍāgamattadā || 77 || dadarśa sotha govindaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ bhaktavatsalam || divyasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ divyālaṃkārabhūṣitam || 78 || ādadānaṃ śriyā dattaṃ paramānnaṃ karāṃbuje || grāsāvaśeṣaṃ pātreṣu kṣipaṃtaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ || 79|| yāvaddattaṃ vastujātaṃ tāvadaśnaṃtamatvaram || vilāsasasmitāpāṃgaṃ haste lakṣmyāpavarjitam || 2.2.38.80 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭaḥ śāṃḍilyaḥ sa dvijottamaḥ || sasmārātmakṛtaṃ drohaṃ naivedyāgrahaṇe sthitam || 81 || kvāhaṃ prādeśikaḥ prājñaḥ sarvajñānanidhirbhavān || kva tvaṃ mahadahaṃkārabhūtatattva visarjakaḥ || 82 || tvanmāyāmūḍhamanaso jānīyuḥ kathamīśa te || niraṃkuśāmanirvācyāmicchāṃ sṛṣṭilayātmikām || 83 || iti stuvaṃtaṃ nṛharistenaivocchiṣṭapāṇinā || siṣeca grāsaśiṣṭāṃśca sarvāge dvijasattamam || 84 || taiḥ siktairbrāhmaṇaḥ sadyaḥ sudhāsekopamairmudā || babhau divyavapuḥ śrīmāṃñjīvanmukto yathā muniḥ || 85 || mahimānaṃ hi bhaktestu bhaktā eva vijānate || mahatīṃ sūtipīḍāṃ tu vandhyā nānubhavetkvacit|| 86 || ityudīrya svayaṃ gātrāducchiṣṭaṃ paramātmanaḥ || bhuktvā kṛtārthamātmānaṃ mene śrotriyapuṃgavaḥ || 87 || sādhāraṇaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ kṣetre'sminna vicāryate || ayaṃ tu paramo dharmo yo devena prakīrtitaḥ || 88 || ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhuracyutaḥ || itthaṃ saṃcitayanvipraḥ kuṭumbārthe'vaśeṣitam || 89 || ājahāra svayaṃ muṣṭyā dhyānabhaṅgamavāpa ca || prabuddhaściṃtayāmāsa svapnaṃ taṃ vismitāśayaḥ || 2.2.38.90 || ayameva mama droho hyavajñāsiṣamīśvaram || naivedyāśana māhātmyamajānanparamādbhutam || 91 || aṣṭādaśa caturdaśa brahmāṃḍaṃ yatpadāṃbujam || dharmadraveṇa prakṣālya apunātsvaṃ tadaṃbunā || 92 || yamarcayaṃti śakrādyā divyabhogairanuttamaiḥ || sa mānuṣyakṛtaṃ bhuṃkte kṣetresminmahadadbhutam || 93 || ityāścaryaparastena svapnalabdhena vai dvijāḥ || naivedyena kuṭumbaṃ svaṃ mārjayāmāsa sādaram || 94 || tataḥ sarve nīrujāste suvākyāhṛṣṭamānasāḥ || punarjanma manyamānāḥ śaśaṃsuḥ kṣetramuttamam || 95 || nāstyasya sadṛśaṃ kṣetraṃ saptadvīpāvanītale || yatra svocchiṣṭadānena pāpānmocayate narān || 96 || puruṣottamamāhātmyaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham || yataḥ svargaśca bhogaśca muktiścaiva kare sthitā ||97 || ārtānāṃ bhavakāṃtāre bhāgyādatra samīyuṣām || nānābhogopatṛptānāṃ muktimārgaḥ sukhaṃ bhavet || 98 || itthaṃ te harṣamāpannāḥ pralapaṃtaḥ parasparam || yatheṣṭaṃ bhojayāmāsuranyonyaṃ ca niveditam ||99|| tataste nirmalā viprāstaruṇādityavarcasaḥ|| devā iva babhuḥ sarve niṣpāpā nirgatajvarāḥ ||2.2.38.100|| naivedyāśanamāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ vo dvijottamāḥ || śrutvāpi mahataḥ pāpānmucyate pāpakṛttamaḥ||1|| nirmālyagrahaṇasyāsya phalaṃ vaktuṃ na śaknumaḥ|| sākṣādbrahmasvarūpeṇa dhriyate vapuṣā hi tat || 2 || puṣpacaṃdanamālyādi yadaṃgairupadhāryate|| apanītaṃ yathākāle nirmālyaṃ tatprakīrtitam ||3|| dhāraṇaṃ śirasā tasya tenāṃge cāpi mārjanam || sārddhānāṃ koṭitīrthānāmabhiṣekaphalapradam || bhakṣaṇaṃ gurutalpādi pātakaughavināśanam || 4 || lepyā mūrttiriyaṃ viṣṇoranyebhyo lepa uttamaḥ || śrīkhaṃḍāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumādibhiḥ ||5 || prapiṣṭalepasnehena caṃdanāgurudāruṇā || śarīre vāsudevasya iṃdradyumnena kāritaḥ || 6 || pratyahaṃ bho dvijaśreṣṭhā varṣāṃte cāpanīyate || lepyānāṃ lepanirmoke darśanaṃ na praśasyate || 7 || aṃtarā cetpatellepaḥ piṣṭaṃ liṃpetpunaśca tam || nānyalepaḥ praśasyo hi sa viṣṇoraṃgasaṃmataḥ || 8 || caṃdanārdraśarīraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ purā kila || saugaṃdhyāllobhayāmāsa nṛpaputraḥ sa mūḍhadhīḥ || 9 || tasya prītyai niyuktastu ākṛṣyāṃgātpralepanam || dadau nṛpakumārāya sa liliṃpe hṛdi svake || 2.2.38.110 || tāvatpradeśaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vai śvetaṃ tasyābhavatkṣaṇāt || sa āsītkuṣṭhapāṇistu tasmai yo dattavānkila || 11 || tato varṣāvadhiṣṭhāyī lepaḥ puṇyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ || nirmālyānāṃ pradhānaṃ tadghrāṇādaṃhovināśanam ||12|| purā damanakaṃ daityaṃ samudrodakacāriṇam || bādhitāraṃ janānāṃ vai māyābalaparākramam||13|| bhagavānapi māyāvī pitāmahanideśataḥ || matsyāvatāreṇa vibhuḥ praviśya varuṇālayam || 14 || anviṣyākṛṣya velāyāṃ niṣpipeṣa mahītale || madhoḥ śuklacaturdaśyāṃ patito dānavottamaḥ || 15 || bhagavatkarasaṃparkātsugaṃdhirabhavattṛṇam || tasyaiva nāmnā ta samyagjagrāhāścaryamānasaḥ || 16 || mālāṃ kṛtvā hṛtpradeśa militaṃ vanamālayā || aciṃtayattasya gaṃdhaṃ yāvadvastu cirasthitam || 17 || tasyāpi gaṃdhaḥ sarveṣāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ saurabhāpahaḥ || varṇastu bhagavanmūrtestulyo'bhūtsa suśobhanaḥ || 18 || tasya mālā bhagavataḥ paramaprītikāriṇī || śuṣkā paryuṣitā vāpi na duṣṭā bhavati kvacit || 19 || tasya sugrathitāṃ mālāṃ dattvā damanakāraye || utpādayenmahāprītiṃ viṣṇoryā muktidāyinī || 2.2.38.120 || aṃgāpakarṣitāṃ mālāṃ bhaktyā yo dhārayennaraḥ || hayamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 21 || tulasīkalpitāṃ mālāṃ viṣṇoraṃgāpakarṣitām || dhārayenmūrdhni kaṃṭhe ca bhakto yo vinyaseddhadi || tāvatsaṃkhyaṃ vājimedhaphalamavyagramaśnute || 22 || nirmālyatulasīpatraṃ yāvadbhakṣayate hareḥ || tāvajjanmasahasraṃ tu viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 23 || harernaivedyamannaṃ ca tulasīdalamiśritam || pratigrāsaṃ somapānaṃ phalaṃ tatsamamaśnute ||24|| yāvajjīvaṃ tu bhuṃjāno dhruvaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||25|| arghyaśeṣādikaṃ viṣṇostathā cācamanodakam || pādodakaṃ snānavāri pratyekaṃ pāpanāśanam || 26 || sarvatīrthābhiṣekāṇāṃ phaladaṃ grahanāśanam || alakṣmīpāparakṣoghnaṃ bhūtavetālanāśanam || || 27 || śavādyamedhyasaṃsparśadoṣanāśanamuttamam || sarvadīkṣāvrataphalapradamaiśvaryavarddhanam || 28 || akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ vyādhivyūhanibarhaṇam || suropamāṃsabhakṣyādi pāpasaṃghavināśanam || 29 || etairāplutadehastu śṛṇuyādyadi sūtakam || nāśaucaṃ vidyate tasya sarvakarmādhikāriṇaḥ || 2.2.38.130 || yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñāya yastvetānyekameva vā || gṛhṇīyādbhūri vā svalpaṃ mucyedviṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ || 31 || evaṃ tatra vasandevo lokānugrahakāṃkṣayā || ramamāṇaḥ śriyā sārddhamanāyāsavimocakaḥ || 32 || nirmālyapādāṃbuni vedanīyadānaistadālokanatatpraṇāmaiḥ || pūjopahāraiśca vimuktidātā kṣetrottamesminpuruṣottamākhye || 133 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāde damanakacaritaṃnāmāṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 || || cha ||
<2.2.39>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || mune tvattaḥ śrutaṃ samyaṅmāhātmyaṃ jagadīśituḥ || nirmālyaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 1 || śrotumicchāmahe brahmanyātrāṃ taraphalāni vai || śṛṇvatāṃ tattvato brūhi yathoddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ purā || 2 || || jaiminiruvāca || sarvathā varttate lokahitāya puruṣottamaḥ || nānāguṇavikāsaiśca nānārūpaviceṣṭitaiḥ || 3 || nānārūpavilāsena nānātmā ca jaganmayaḥ|| ahaṃkāraṃ vinā karmaphalaṃ no dvijasattamāḥ||4|| ahaṃkāreṇa badhyante kārāgāre bhavābhidhe || buddhyahaṃkārayuktastu yatkarmārabhate naraḥ || 5 || tasya sadguṇamāpnoti phalaṃ śubhamathāparam || buddhistu trividhā teṣāṃ guṇabhedena bhāvitā || 6 || tatra ye sāttvikāḥ saṃtaḥ phalāvāptiparāṅmukhāḥ || bhagavatprītaye karma kurvate te mumukṣavaḥ || 7 || parasya sparddhayā kīrtyai phalamuddiśya vā punaḥ|| bahuvittavyayāyāsai rājasaṃ karma tanvate || 8 || gatānugatikā ye ca dṛṣṭārthaikaparāyaṇāḥ || prasaṃgātphalamicchaṃtastāmasaṃ karma kurvate || 9 || sāttvikānāṃ jagannāthaḥ sarvadā sarvabhāvanaḥ || dhyāto dṛṣṭaḥ smṛto vāpi muktidātā na saṃśayaḥ || 2.2.39.10 || rājasāstāmasā ye vai mūḍhātmānaḥ phalaiṣiṇaḥ || utsavādikṛtaṃ karma manyaṃte phaladāyi te || 11 || saṃbhūya bahavo viprā ārabhaṃte'lpakaṃ vidhim || bahulāyāsaduḥkhaṃ yatkarma teṣāṃ phalapradam || 12 || teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya viśvāsāya durātmanām || yātrā nānāvidhā viprā varṣe varṣe pravartayet || 13 || janmasnānaṃ mahāvedyā utsavaśca prakīrtitaḥ || mahāyātrādvayaṃ puṃsāṃ kīrtanātpāpanāśanam || 14 || darśanaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtestathā ca śayanotsavaḥ || sarvapāpaharaścaiṣāmutsavo dakṣiṇāyane || 15 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pārśvasya parivartanam || śayitasya jagadbhartuḥ parivartayituryugam ||16|| nabhasya vimale pakṣe saṃprāpte harivāsare || viṣṇoḥ svāpagṛhadvāri śanairgatvā praviśya ca ||17|| namaskṛtvā jagannāthaṃ paryaṃke śayitaṃ mudā || avacchādya śanairgatvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ || 18 || praṇamya bhaktyā tatpādau guhyopaniṣadaiḥ stuvan || mantraṃ cemaṃ paṭhandevaṃ svāpayeduttarāmukham || 19 || devadeva jagannātha kalpānāṃ parivartaka || parivṛttamidaṃ sarvaṃ yena sthāvarajaṃgamam || 2.2.39.20 || yadicchāceṣṭitaireva jāgratsvapnasuṣuptibhiḥ || jagaddhitāya supto'si pārśvena parivarttaya || 21 || parivarttanakālo'yaṃ jagataḥ pālanāya te || tavājñayā'yaṃ śakro'pi dhvaje tiṣṭhansamutsukaḥ || 22 || draṣṭuṃ tvatpādakamalaṃ vimucañjaladairjalam || mahītalaṃ plāvayati prajāpālanahetukam || 23 || iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ vīpsayā toṣayettataḥ || vyajanaiścāmaraiścaiva vījayedanukalpakṛt || 24 || sugandhacandanairasya sarvāṃgaṃ parilepayet || svādūnikṣuvikārāṃśca vikṛtaiḥ pāyasaistathā || 25 || yāvakāni ca hṛdyāni phalāni vividhāni vai || svādūpadaṃśānanyāṃśca ghṛtapūpānsapāyasān || 26 || pakvatāṃbūla patrāṇi sopaskārāṇi ca dvijāḥ || śayyāgṛhadvāri vibhoḥ śanairbhaktyā nivedayet || 27 || tasmindine hare rūpaṃ bhavedyadi mahāphalam || devamuddiśya yaḥ kuryātsarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet || 28 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homastapo jāgaraṇaṃ tathā || upavāsaśca niyamo vratāṃte dvijatarpaṇam || 29 || sāṃgaṃ vratamidaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate citte taṃ tamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 2.2.39.30 || ayaṃ vaḥ kathito viprāḥ pārśvaparyāyaṇotsavaḥ || anāyāsena lokānāmakṣayaḥ sukhadāyakaḥ || 31 || ataḥ paraṃ vai śṛṇuta utthāpanamahotsavam || pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ kaumudyākhye mahotsave || 32 || akṣakrīḍādibhiḥ puṣpavastramālyānulepanaiḥ || tatosminpaurṇamāsyāyāṃ rātrāvutsavasaṃyutam || 33 || nārikelādibhirdravyaiḥ piṣṭakairarcayeddharim || tataḥ prabhāte saṃkalpya kārttike vratamuttamam || 34 || vratena tenaiva nayedyāvadekādaśī sitā || tasyāmutthāpayeddevaṃ susuptaṃ jagadīśvaram || 35 || pūrvavatpūjayitvā tu niśāmadhye jagadgurum || utthāpayedimaṃ maṃtramāhvayañchanakairmudā || 36 || uttiṣṭha devadeveśa tejorāśe jagatpate || vīkṣasva sakalaṃ deva prasuptaṃ tava māyayā || 37 || praphullapuṃḍarīkaśrīhāriṇā nayanena vai || tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ jagadidaṃ pāvitryaṃ parameṣyati || 38 || śrautasmārttāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pravartaṃte tato dhruvam || ityutthāpya jagannāthaṃ veṇuvīṇādikasvanaiḥ || 39 || baṃdimāgadhasūtānāṃ stutibhirmaṃgalasvanaiḥ || śaṃkhakāhālamurajavādanairnṛtyagītakaiḥ || 2.2.39.40 || jayaśabdaistathā stotrairnayaṃttaṃ nṛtyamaṇḍapam || sugandhatailenābhyajya snāpayetpuruṣottamam || 41 || pañcāmṛtairnārikelarasaiḥ phalarasaistathā || sugandhāmalakenātha yavakalkena lepayet || 42 || gharṣayettulasīcūrṇairlepayedgandhacandanaiḥ || puṣpādhivāsitaistoyaistathā karpūravāsitaiḥ || 43 || kuśodakai ratnatoyaistathā gaṃdhodakaistathā || snāpyamānaṃ tathā devaṃ ye paśyaṃti mudānvitāḥ || 44 || kṣālayanti dṛḍhaṃ paṃkaṃ bahujanmopapāditam || tataḥ śrījagadīśasya kroḍe saṃvāsayeddvijāḥ ||45|| āpādānmūrdhaparyaṃtaṃ sarvāgaṃ parilepayet || kuṃkumāgurukastūrīkarpūraiścaṃdanānvitaiḥ || 46 || pāṭalodakasaṃpiṣṭaiḥ kālāgururasāplutaiḥ || dattvā ca mālatīmālā candracūrṇena saṃyutām || 47 || mahopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya viṣṇuṃ nīrājayettataḥ || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā prārthayetparayā mudā || 48 || carācaramidaṃ sarvaṃ tvadekaśaraṇaṃ vibho || anugrahāmṛtālokaiḥ pāvayasva jagadguro || || 49 || nṛtyagītaiḥ prekṣaṇakai rātriśeṣaṃ samāpayet || śayanādutthitaṃ devaṃ yaḥ paśyati gadādharam || 2.2.39.50 || nidrāṃ mohamayīṃ bhittvā jyotiḥ śāṃtaṃ vrajaṃti te || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti yānyānkāmayate hṛdi || 51 || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ sāgraṃ labheta vai || kapilālaṃkṛtādhenukoṭidānaphalaṃ tathā || 52 || puṇyaṃ cāpnoti paramaṃ sarvatīrthābhiṣekajam || kārttikyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāccāturmāsyavratasya vai || 53 || dāmodarasya pratimāṃ svarṇaniṣkeṇa nirmitām || yathāśaktikṛtāṃ vāpi śālagrāmaśilāsthitām ||54|| cakramūrtiṃ bhagavataḥ pūjayetprayatātmavān || racayenmaṇḍapaṃ śubhramekadeśaṃ gṛhasya vā || 55 || alaṃkuryātpuṣpadāmacāmaraiḥ savitānakaiḥ || bhūmibhittīḥ sudhālepaiḥ staṃbhaiścitradukūlakaiḥ || 56 || kālāgurūṇāṃ dhūpaiśca dhūpayettadgṛhaṃ śubham || tanmadhye maṇḍalaṃ kuryātsvastikaṃ varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 57 || tadantaḥ sthāpayetkhaṭvāṃ karidantamayīṃ śubhām || paṭṭatūlīṃ tadupari vāsayetpuruṣottamam ||58|| dāmodarākṛtiṃ śaṃkhapadmapāṇiṃ caturbhujam || lakṣmīmāliṃgya padmasthāṃ kroḍasthāṃ vāmapāṇinā ||59|| bhaktebhyo dātumudyaṃtaṃ varaṃ dakṣiṇapāṇinā || sunāsaṃ sulalāṭaṃ ca sunetraṃ suśrutidvayam || 2.2.39.60 || viśālavakṣasaṃ devaṃ sarvalāvaṇyasaṃyutam || sarvālaṃkāraruciraṃ divyapītanicolinam || 61 || lakṣmīṃ padmakarāṃ vāpi tāṃbūlaṃ dadatīṃ tathā || pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayitvā vāsoyugmena veṣṭayet || 62 || pūjayedupacāraistaṃ yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ || tāmradīpānmṛnmayānvā jvālayedgavyasarpiṣā ||63|| tailena vā śataṃ dīpavṛkṣāṃścaiva pradāpayet || brahmāṇaṃ nāradādīṃśca devarṣīṃstatra pūjayet ||64|| dāmodarasvarūpānvai brāhmaṇānapi pūjayet || vastrayugmairmālyagandhairbhakṣyabhojyaphalaistathā ||65|| tīrtharājābhiṣekāṃgaṃ pūjākarma yathocitam || dāmodarasya tenaiva vidhinehārcanaṃ bhavet || || 66 || tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa brahmādīnapi pūjayet || veṇuvīṇādikairgītaiḥ purāṇapaṭhanena ca || 67 || mahotsavaṃ prakurvīta tato jāgaraṇena ca || tataḥ prabhāte vimale'gnikāryaṃ ca samācaret || 68 || aṣṭākṣareṇa maṃtreṇa samidājyacarūnapi || lājānmadhusaminmiśrāñjuhuyācca tataḥ śriye ||69|| sūktenāṣṭottaraśataṃ brahmādīnāṃ tadantataḥ || aṣṭāhutīrvai juhuyātkramādekaikaśastilaiḥ || 2.2.39.70 || brahmāṇaṃ nāradaṃ dakṣaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ gautamaṃ tathā || sanatkumāramatriṃ ca bharadvājaṃ ca kaśyapam ||71|| durvāsasamagastyaṃ ca mahādevaṃ tataḥ param || vikhyātā vaiṣṇavā hyete viṣṇurūpā na saṃśayaḥ ||72|| etānsaṃpūjayanviprānviṣṇuḥ prīṇāti tatkṣaṇāt || homāṃte prāśanaṃ kṛtvā dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām ||73|| suvarṇabhūṣitāṃ dhenuṃ vastraṃ dhānyaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ || prītaye vāsudevasya bhojayeddvijapuṃgavān|| 74 || sarvopacārasahitaṃ dadyāddāmodaraṃ tataḥ || 76 || oṃ dāmodara jagannātha tvanmayaṃ viśvameva hi || tvadādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ dharmaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ||| tvatprasādādvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ tadastu me ||76|| dāmodaraḥ pradātā ca gṛhītā ca vṛṣadhvajaḥ|| pradīyate jagannāthaḥ prīyatāṃ me jagadguruḥ||77|| iti maṃtraṃ japandadyādācāryāya surottamam|| samāpya pūjayedbhaktyā stūyāttaṃ ca prasādayet || 78 || ācārye parituṣṭe tu tuṣṭo bhavati mādhavaḥ || tattaddravyāṇi ca tato dadyādviprebhya eva hi || 79 || tataḥ svayaṃ vai bhuṃjīta iṣṭaiḥ śiṣṭaiḥ svabaṃdhubhiḥ || cāturmāsyavrataṃ cedaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānataḥ || 2.2.39.80 || yathoktaphalasaṃpanno viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt || śrutismṛtipurāṇeṣu nātaḥ parataraṃ vratam || 81 || yenānuṣṭhitamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ yādṛṅna tathānyadvrataṃ dvijāḥ || 82 || tilapātrasahasraistu gavāṃ caivāyutāyutaiḥ || kṛṣṇājinaśatenāpi kanyānāmayutena ca || 83 || dattvā yatphalamāpnoti kṛtvaitadvratamuttamam || sārddhatrikoṭitīrthānāmabhiṣekaphalaṃ tathā ||84|| prāpnoti tatphalaṃ viprā yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate naraḥ || 85 || iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye cāturmāsyavratavidhirnāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||39||
<2.2.40>
|| || jaiminiruvāca || || mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāvaraṇotsavam || kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā naro bhaktyā vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 1 || vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munayo'dhunā || vāsodhivāsaṃ kurvīta paṃcamyāṃ niśi karmavit || 2 || devāgre maṃḍape kuryātpadmamaṣṭadalānvitam || dikpālānpūjayeddikṣu kṣetrapālaṃ gaṇādhipam || 3 || caṃḍapracaṃḍau ca bahiścaturdikṣu prapūjayet || madhye pātraṃ samādhāya prokṣayedvastravāriṇā || 4 || dyutānastveti maṃtreṇacchādayeddivyavāsasā || sudhūpitaṃ vastrajātamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakam || 5 || tanmadhye sthāpayenmaṃtraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca samuccaran || anyena vāsasā taddhi samācchādya prayatnataḥ ||6|| spṛṣṭvā japenmaṃtramimaṃ saṃsmaranpuruṣottamam || ācchādako yo jagatāṃ tejasā viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 7 || vasanāttasya vastra tvaṃ vasa vāse jagatpateḥ || indraghoṣastveti rakṣāṃ vidadhyāttasya sarvataḥ || 8 || pūjayedgaṃdhapuṣpābhyāṃ tato devaṃ prapūjayet || sarvalepaṃ prakurvīta nṛtyagītairnayenniśām || 9 || tato'ruṇodaye kāle prātaḥsaṃdhyāsamīpataḥ || punaḥ prapūjayeddevaṃ pūrvavatsusamāhitaḥ || 2.2.40.10 || tatastaṃ pūjitaṃ vastrasamūhaṃ bahirānayet || kārpāsapaṭṭakṣaumāḍhyaṃ tathaivācchāditaṃ dvijāḥ || 11 || chatradhvajapatākābhiścāmarāṃdolanaistathā || gītavāditranṛtyaiśca prasūnotkiraṇena ca || 12 || prāsādaṃ triḥ paribhramya devaṃ trirbhrāmayettataḥ || ācchāditaṃ tadākṛṣya saṃskuyārdvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ || 13 || saptabhiḥ saptabhirdevānvāsobhiḥ pariveṣṭayet || mukhavarjaṃ tu sarvāṃgaṃ śītaprāvaraṇairdvijāḥ || 14 || tāṃbūlaṃ ca nivedyātha karpūralatikāṃ tathā || dūrvākṣataiḥ prapūjyātha kuryānnīrājanaṃ vibhoḥ || 15 || himāgame nṛsiṃhaṃ ye prāvṛṇvaṃti sucelakaiḥ || paśyaṃti prāvṛtiṃ ye vā na teṣāṃ mohasaṃvṛtiḥ || 16 || te dvaṃdvavātaśītotthabhayaṃ nāpnuvate kvacit || viṣṇordevādhidevasya imaṃ prāvaraṇotsavam || 17 || bhaktyā ye vai prapaśyaṃti sarvānkāmānavāpnuyuḥ || bhagavaṃtaṃ samuddiśya brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāpayet || || 18 || gurubhyaścānyadevebhyo dīnānāthebhya eva ca || śītaprāvaraṇaṃ dadyātsatkṛtya parayā mudā || dadāti bhagavānprītastasmai varamanuttamam|| || 19 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye prāvaraṇotsavavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
<2.2.41>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || puṣyasnānotsavaṃ vakṣye yathoktaṃ brahmaṇā purā || puṣyarkṣeṇa ca saṃyuktā paurṇamāsī yadā bhavet || 1 || pauṣe māsi tathā kuryātpuṣyasnānotsavaṃ hareḥ || ekādaśyāṃ prakurvīta aiśānyāmaṃkurārpaṇam || 2 || tataḥ pratidinaṃ kuryātpratimāyāṃ harergṛhe || nṛtyagītopahāraiśca pratirātraṃ valiṃ haret || 3 || caturdaśīniśāyāṃ tu kuṃbhānāmadhivāsanam || ekāśītipramāṇānāṃ tathā svarṇamayāñcchubhān || 4 || gavyasarpiḥprapūrṇāṃśca sthāpayedekaviṃśatim || kārayetsarvatobhadraṃ maṃḍalaṃ purato hareḥ || 5 || tanmadhye bṛhadādhāraṃ sthāpayeddarpaṇaṃ śubham || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādgītanṛtyādivistaraiḥ || 6 || prabhāte vahnikāryaṃ ca kuryāttaddaivataṃ dvijāḥ || pālāśībhiḥ samidbhistu caruṇā sarpiṣā tathā || 7 || brahmaviṣṇuśivebhyastu pratyekaṃ tu sahasrakam || svaliṃgamantrairjuhuyāttadaṃte puruṣottamam || 8 || pūjayedupacāraistairādarśaṃ pratibiṃbitam || tataḥ puruṣasūktena kumbhāṃstānabhimantrayet || 9 || tenaivācchidradhāreṇa snāpayetpuruṣottamam|| pāvamānīyakairdevāñchrīsūktena tataḥ param || 2.2.41.10 || sarpiḥ kuṃbhaiḥ snāpayecca gāyatryā ca tataḥ param .|| vaiṣṇavyā gandhatoyena śrīsūktena samarcayet || 11 || sahasradhārayā devaṃ tato nirmālyamutsṛjet || devāṃgaṃ lepayedgandhaiścaṃdanena ca vigrahe || 12 || yathāsthānaṃ yathāśobhamalaṃkārāṃśca yojayet || sugandhasumanomālyairbhūṣayettadanaṃtaram || 13 || aṣṭāyudhāni devasya cakrādīni nyasetpuraḥ || ratnacchatraṃ samucchritya pūjayetpuruṣottamam || 14 || lakṣmyā yuktaṃ punarviprā upahāraiḥ samṛddhimat || śaṃkheṣu pūryamāṇeṣu snigdhagaṃbhīranādiṣu || 15 || cāmarāṃdolavyagrāsu veśyāsu rucirāsu ca || māṃgalyagītanṛtyādyaiḥ stutipāṭheṣu bandinām || 16 || jayaśabdaṃ prakurvatsu dvijātiṣu muhurmuhuḥ || dūrvākṣatāṃjalibhistribhiḥ saṃpūjya keśavam || 17 || gosarpirdīpakaiḥ svarṇapātrakairatinirmalaiḥ || nīrājayejjagannāthaṃ karpūrayutavartibhiḥ || 18 || svarṇapātrasthitaṃ cāru tāṃbūlaṃ supariṣkṛtam || śanaiḥśanairmukhābhyāśe pratyekaṃ vinivedayet || || 19 || ācārye dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva pūjayet || 2.2.41.20 || puṣyasnānotsavaṃ puṇyaṃ ye paśyaṃti mudānvitāḥ || saṃpūrṇasarvakāmāste vrajeyurvaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 21 || rājyabhraṣṭo labhedrājyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ ca viṃdati || aputrā mṛtavatsā vā putraṃ dīrghāyuṣaṃ labhet || 22 || dāridryanāśanaṃ dhanyaṃ brahmavarcasakāraṇam || puṣyasnānaṃ kīrtitaṃ vaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ cottarāyaṇam || 23 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye puṣyābhiṣekavidhivarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||
<2.2.42>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || mṛgarāśiṃ saṃkramati yadā bhāsvāndvijottamāḥ || uttarāśāṃ jigamiṣustadā syāduttarāyaṇam || 1 || tasya saṃkramaṇārddhaṃ ca yāvatsyurviṃśatiḥ kalāḥ || mahāpuṇyatamaḥ kālaḥ pitṛdevadvijapriyaḥ || 2 || tatra snātvā vidhānena rtārtharājajale naraḥ || nārāyaṇaṃ samabhyarcya kalpavṛkṣaṃ praṇamya ca || 3 || praviśya devatāgāraṃ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇām|| mantrarājena saṃpūjya devaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam || 4 || tathā balaṃ subhadrāṃ ca svamantreṇa prapūjayet || dṛṣṭvottarāyaṇe devaṃ mucyate dehabandhanāt || 5 || vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyābhi śṛṇudhvaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat || saṃkrāṃteḥ pūrvadivase navāṃ śāliṃ sukuṭṭitām || 6 || prāsādapūrvadeśe ca sthāpayitvādhivāsayet || navena vāsasāveṣṭya dūrvāsarṣapapuṣpakaiḥ || 7 || pūjayitvā mantrayedvai kṛṣṇastvāmabhirakṣatu || tasminneva niśāyāme vyatīte jagadīśituḥ || 8 || pratyarcāṃ sannidhau nītvā bhāvayedekatādhiye || upacārāvaśiṣṭābhyāṃ pūjayedvai samāhitaḥ || 9 || tato nirmālyavasanamālāmasyāṃ nidhāpayet || mahāsamṛddhyā tāmarcāṃ trirdevānbhrāmayettataḥ || 2.2.42.10 || āṃdolikāyāmāropya prāsādadvāramānayet || trivikramaṃ trikrameṇa trailokyakramaṇaṃ vibhum || 11 || viḍaṃbayaṃtaṃ tāṃ līlāṃ prāsādaṃ bhrāmayecca tam || triraṃte punaraṃke ca susamṛddhyā śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 12 || dīpikāśatasaṃruddhatamasovaraṇāṃtare || chatradhvajapatākābhirnṛtyavāditragītakaiḥ || 13 || taddarśanaparikṣīṇapātakānāṃ mahātmanām || na ca cihnaṃ śarīre'sya navāṃge bhramaṇaṃ tataḥ || 14 || anuyāṃti tadā ye taṃ mahe yāṃtaṃ trivikramam || labhaṃte vājimedhasya phalaṃ te vai pade pade || 15 || prathamabhramaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pañcapātakaiḥ || malinīkaraṇairmucyeddvitīyaṃ bhramaṇaṃ dvijāḥ || 16 || apātrīkaraṇairdṛṣṭvā tṛtīyaṃ bhramaṇaṃ dhruvam || upapātakapāpaiśca caturthaṃ mucyate tataḥ || 17 || punaḥ prabhāte deveśaṃ praliṃpedgandhacandanaiḥ || vastrālaṃkāramālyaiśca bhūṣayitvā yathāvidhi || 18 || pūjayedupacāraistaṃ yathāśakti samṛddhimat || nīrājayitvā deveśaṃ taṃdulānadhivāsitān | 19 || sthālīṣu śātakuṃbhāsu dadhikhaṃḍājyamiśritān || sanārikelaśakalācchṛṃgavera dalānvitān || 2.2.42.20 || prāsādaṃ triḥ paribhramya nayeddevasamīpataḥ || paṃktiśaḥ sthāpayedagre gandhapuṣpākṣatānvitān || 21 || jīvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ janakastvaṃ jagatprabho || tvanmayāḥ śālayo hyete tvayaiva janitāḥ prabho || 22 || lokānugrahaṇārthāya gṛhītocitavigraha || tava prītyai kṛtānetāngṛhāṇa parameśvara || 23 || tvayi tuṣṭe jagatsarvamanena prabhaviṣyati || svāhākārasvadhākāravaṣaṭkārā divaukasām || 24 || āpyāyanā bhaviṣyaṃti tairevāpyāyitaṃ jagat || rakṣa sarvaṃ jagannātha tvanmayaṃ sacarācaram || 25 || iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ śālistaṃbānnivedayet || tanmayānbhakṣabhojyāṃśca dadhikuṃbhānsugaṃdhinaḥ || 26 || karpūrakhaṃḍamaricacūrṇayuktānnivedayet || brāhmaṇānpūjayedbhaktyā devadevapuraḥsthitān || 27 || tebhyaḥ pradadyādbhaktyā tāñchālyādīnbhagavaddhiyā || imaṃ mahotsavaṃ viprāḥ purā kalpe ca kaśyapaḥ || 28 || sa ca sṛṣṭiṃ vinirmāya bhagavatprītaye'karot || ye paśyantyutsavaṃ cainaṃ kaśyapena vinirmitam || 29 || sarvadā sarvakāmaiste pūrṇāḥ śocaṃti na dvijāḥ || uṣitvā tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ kalpāṃte mokṣamāpnuyuḥ || 2.2.42.30 || mahānasasya saṃskāraṃ vahneḥ saṃskārameva ca || atrāpi kuryānmunayo vaiśvadevaṃ dinedine || 31 || ādhānasaṃskṛte vahnau bhagavadbhuktaye ramā || pratyahaṃ pākamādhatte divyarūpā tirohitā || 32 || asminmahāpuṇyatama utsave paramātmanaḥ || tulāpuruṣadānādi koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet|| 33 || snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam || sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti hyutsave cottarāyaṇe || 34 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye makarasaṃkramavidhivarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 42 ||
<2.2.43>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || phālgune māsi kurvīta dolārohaṇamuttamam || yatra krīḍati goviṃdo lokānugrahaṇāya vai || 1 || pratyarcāṃ devadevasya goviṃdākhyāṃ tu kārayet || prāsādapurataḥ kuryātṣoḍaśa staṃbhamucchritama|| 2 || caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ maṇḍapaṃ vedikānvitam || cārucaṃdrātapaṃ mālyacāmaradhvajaśobhitam || 3 || bhadrāsanaṃ vedikāyāṃ śrīparṇīkāṣṭhanirmitam || phalgūtsavaṃ prakurvīta pañcāhāni tryahāṇi vā || 4 || phālgunyāṃ pūrvato viprāścaturdaśyāṃ niśāmukhe || vahnyutsavaṃ prakurvīta dolāmaṇḍapapūrvataḥ || 5 || goviṃdānugṛhītaṃ tu yātrāṃgaṃ tatprakīrtitam|| ācāryavaraṇaṃ kṛtvā vahniṃ nirmathanodbhavam || 6 || bhūmiṃ saṃskṛtya vidhivattṛṇarāśiṃ mahocchrayam|| susamaṃ kārayitvā tu vahniṃ tatra vinikṣipet|| 7 || pūjayitvā vidhānena kūṣmāṃḍavidhinā hunet || goviṃdaṃ pūjayitvā tu bhrāmayetsa tata vibhum || 8 || yatnāttaṃ rakṣayedvahniṃ yāvadyātrā samāpyate || prātaryāme caturdaśyāṃ goviṃdapratimāṃ śubhām || 9 || vāsayitvā hareragre pūjayetpuruṣottamam || upacārāvaśiṣṭaistu pratyarcāmapi pūjayet || 2.2.43.10 || tato'varopya vasanaṃ mālāṃ ca dvijasattamāḥ || arcāyāṃ vinyasenmaṃtrī paraṃ jyotirvibhāvayan || 11 || tataḥ sā pratimā sākṣājjāyate puruṣottamaḥ || ratnāṃdolikayā tāṃ vai nayetsnānasya maṃḍapam || || 12 || tatra nānā tūryanādaiḥ śaṃkhadhvanipuraḥsaram|| jayaśabdaistathā stotraiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭibhireva ca || 13 || chatradhvajapatākābhiścāmarairvyajanaistathā || niraṃtaraṃ dīpikābhistadā kuryānmahotsavam || 14 || āgacchaṃti tadā devāḥ pitāmahapurogamāḥ || draṣṭuṃ carṣigaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ goviṃdasya mahotsavam || || 15 || bhadrāsane'dhivāsyaiva pūjayedupacārakaiḥ || mahāsnānasya vidhinā snapanaṃ tasya kārayet || 16 || paṃcāmṛtaiśca sarvaiśca teṣāmanyatamena vā || snānāṃte gaṃdhatoyena śrīsūktenābhiṣecayet || 17 || saṃprokṣya bhūṣayeddevaṃ vastrālaṃkāramālyakaiḥ || nīrājayitvā saṃpūjya prāsādaṃ pariveṣṭayet || 18 || saptakṛtvastato devaṃ dolāmaṃḍapamānayet || susaṃskṛtāyāṃ rathyāyāṃ patākātoraṇādibhiḥ || adhodeśe maṃḍapaṃ taṃ saptaśo bhrāmayetpunaḥ || 19 || ūrddhvadeśe punaḥ sapta staṃbhavedyāṃ ca sapta vai || yātrāvasāne ca punarbhrāmayedekaviṃśatim || 2.2.43.20 || iyaṃ līlā bhagavataḥ pitāmahamukheritā || rājarṣiṇeṃdradyumnena kāritā pūrvameva hi || 21 || phalapuṣpopanamraiśca śākhibhiḥ parikalpite || vṛṃdāvanāṃtare ramye mattabhramararāviṇi || 22 || kokilārāvamadhure nānāpakṣigaṇākule || nānopaśobhāracitanānāgurusudhūpite || 23 || praphullaketakīṣaṃḍagaṃdhāmodidigaṃtare || mallikāśokapunnāgacaṃpakairupaśobhite || 24 || tatkānanāṃtarghaṭite maṃḍape cārutoraṇe || bhūṣite mālyavasanacāmarairupaśobhite || 25 || ratnakhaṭvāṃdolikāyāṃ tanmadhye vāsayetprabhum || sadratnamukuṭaṃ tārahāraśobhitavakṣasam || 26 || anarghyaratnaghaṭitakuṃḍalodbhāsitaśrutim || yathāsthānaṃ yathāśobhaṃ divyālaṃkāramaṃjulam || 27 || vikacāṃbujamadhyasthaṃ viśvadhātryā śriyā yutam || 28 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ vanamālinam || suprasannaṃ sunāsaṃ taṃ pīnavakṣaḥsthalojjvalam || 29 || puro vyomasthitairdevairbrahmādyairnatamastakaiḥ || kṛtāṃjalipuṭairbhaktyā jayaśabdairabhiṣṭutam || 2.2.43.30 || gaṃdharvairapsarobhiśca kinnaraiḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ || hāhāhūhūprabhṛtibhiḥ satvaraṃ divyagāyanaiḥ || 31 || ahaṃpūrvikayā nṛtyagītavāditrakāribhiḥ || netrāṃbujasahasraiśca pūjyamānaṃ mudānvitaiḥ || 32 || kiradbhiḥ sarvatodikṣu gaṃdhacaṃdanajaṃ rajaḥ || upaveśyātha goviṃdaṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥ || 33 || ballavīvṛṃdamadhyasthaṃ kadaṃbatarumūlagam || hāvahāsyavilāsaiśca krīḍamānaṃ vanāṃtare || 34 || gopībhiścaiva gopālairlīlāṃdolitayānagam || ciṃtayitvā jagannāthaṃ vikiredgaṃdhacūrṇakaiḥ || 35 || sakarpūrai raktapītaśuklairdikṣu samaṃtataḥ || divyairvastrairdivyamālyairddivyairgaṃdhaiḥ sudhūpakaiḥ || 36 || cāmarāṃdolanairgītaiḥ stutibhiśca samarcitam || āṃdolayeddolikāsthaṃ saptavārāñchanaiḥ śanaiḥ || ||37|| tadā paśyaṃti ye kṛṣṇaṃ muktisteṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ paṃcakānāṃ kṣayo bhavet || 38 || trirevaṃ dolayeddevaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam || bhaktyānugrāhakaṃ puṃsāṃ bhuktimuktyekakāraṇam || 39 || līlāviceṣṭitaṃ yasya kṛtrimaṃ sahajaṃ tathā || aṃhaḥsaṃghakṣayakaraṃ mūlāvidyānivarttakam || 2.2.43.40 || paśyandvitīyaṃ harati gohatyādyupapātakam || haratyaśeṣapāpāni tṛtīye nātra saṃśayaḥ ||41|| dṛṣṭvā dolāyitaṃ devaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || ādhyātmikairādhibhautairādhidaivairvimucyate || 42 || imāṃ yātrāṃ kārayitvā cakravartī bhavennṛpaḥ || brāhmaṇastu caturvedī jñānavāñjāyate dhruvam ||43|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye dolārohaṇaṃnāma trayaścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||43||
<2.2.44>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || atra vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi vrataṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ param|| saṃvatsarasyādidine paurṇamāsyāṃ tu phālgune||1|| anādidevasya harermūrttayo dvādaśaiva yāḥ|| viṣṇvādināmaprathitāḥ pratimāsaṃ prapūjayet||2|| ekaikāṃ mūrtimetāsāṃ māseṣu dvādaśasvapi || pratyahaṃ pūjayetpuṣpaiḥ phalairdvādaśabhistathā ||3|| aśoko mallikā caiva pāṭalaṃ ca kadaṃbakam || karavīraṃ jātipuṣpaṃ mālatīśatapatrakam ||4 || utpalaṃ caiva vāsaṃtī kuṃdaṃ punnāgakaṃ tathā|| etāni kramaśo dadyātkusumāni harermudā || 5 || dāḍimaṃ nārikelaṃ ca āmraṃ ca panasaṃ tathā || kharjūraṃ tṛṇarājaṃ ca prācīnāmalakaṃ tathā || 6 || śrīphalaṃ nāgaraṃgaṃ ca kramukaṃ karamaṅgakam || jātīphalaṃ ca kramaśaḥ phalānyetāni vai dadet || 7 || bhakṣyabhojyāni coṣyāṇi lehyāni madhurāṇi ca || āsanādyupacārāṃśca dattvā stutvā jagadgurum || 8 || sarvavyāpiñjagannātha bhūtabhavyabhavatprabho || trāhi māṃ puṃḍarīkākṣa viṣṇo saṃsārasāgarāt || 9 || ekārṇavajale raudre nirālaṃbe purā madhum||| avadhīrviśvarakṣārtha madhusūdana rakṣa mām ||2.2.44.10|| trīnvikramānkramitvā yo hatvā daityabalaṃ mahat|| trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa trivikrama namostu te ||11|| kṛtvā vāmanakaṃ rūpamṛgyajuḥsāmagarbhakam || mohayitvādbhutaṃ rūpaṃ tasmai māyāvine namaḥ || 12 || yaḥ śriyaṃ dhārayennityaṃ hṛdi bhaktebhya eva ca || dadātyapi śriyaṃ tasmai śrīdharāya namo'stu te || 13 || iṃdriyāṇāmadhiṣṭhātā yaḥ sarveṣāṃ sadā prabhuḥ || sukhaikaheturbhaktānāṃ hṛṣīkeśa namo'stu te || 14 || yannābhipadmasaṃbhūtaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || vidhāturāsanaṃ nityaṃ padmanābha namo'stu te || 15 || yasyaitattriguṇairbaddhaṃ jagadetaccarācaram|| dāmnā baddhaḥ sa gopyā tu dāmodara namo'stu te || 16 || trailokyaviplavakaraṃ hatavānkeśidānavam|| īśitā sarvasaukhyānāṃ trāhi keśava māṃ prabho || 17 || sraṣṭā sasarja bhūtāni jagatāmādikāraṇam || aciṃtyamahimanviṣṇo nārāyaṇa namo'stu te ||18|| māyayā yasya viśvaṃ vai mohitaṃ yadanādyayā || sarvadharmasvarūpāya mādhavāya namo namaḥ || 19 || jñānināṃ jñānagamyastvamagatīnāṃ gatipradaḥ || saṃpūrṇamastu goviṃda tvatprasādādvrataṃ mama || 2.2.44.20 || pratimāsaṃ pūjanāṃte maṃtrairetaiḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ || prārthayetparayā bhaktyā bhajanāṃtaṃ janārdanam || 21 || evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ nītvā vrataṃ vai mūrtipaṃjaram || saṃpūrṇaphalasiddhyarthaṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhimācaret || 22 || suvarṇanirmitā viṣṇormūrtayo dvādaśaiva tu || yathāśakti kṛtāḥ sthāpyāḥ kuṃbheṣu dvādaśasvapi || 23 || āmrapātrācchāditeṣu sākṣātteṣu pṛthakpṛthak || śvetavastrāvanaddheṣu gaṃdhapallavavāriṣu || 24 || aṣṭadikṣu caturdikṣu sarvatobhadramaṃḍale || sthāpanīyāśca te kuṃbhāsteṣu pūjyāśca mūrtayaḥ || 25 || dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa upacāraiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || paṃcāmṛtaiśca snapanaṃ sarveṣāmādito dvijāḥ ||26|| gītavāditranṛtyādyaistathā brāhmaṇapūjanaiḥ || vastrayugmairdvādaśabhiśchatropānadyugaistathā ||27|| vyajanairudakuṃbhaiśca śayanīyaiḥ sapīṭhakaiḥ || gaṃdhairmālyaiḥ sutāṃbūlairmudrikākuṃḍalaistathā || 28 || pradīpāḥ sarpiṣā jvālyā dvādaśadvādaśa kramāt || nītvā triyāmāmitthaṃ vai prabhāte vahnikarma ca || 29 || samidājyacarūṇāṃ vai pratidevaṃ śatatrayam|| aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu tilairvyāhṛtibhistataḥ || 2.2.44.30 || homāṃte prāśanaṃ kṛtvā dadyādācāryadakṣiṇām || kapilā dhenavo deyāḥ sālaṃkārāśca dvādaśa ||31|| śataṃ catuścatvāriṃśadbrāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ || taddevavṛṃdaṃ saghaṭaṃ savitānaṃ sacāmaram || 32 || sarvopacārasahitamācāryāya nivedayet|| vratarājamimaṃ kṛtvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||33|| guṃḍicādyāstu yā yātrā viṣṇordvādaśa kīrtitāḥ || tāsāṃ darśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ vratenānena labhyate || 34|| aiṃdraṃ padaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ cakravartitvameva ca || aṣṭaiśvaryamavāpnoti devadevaprasādataḥ || 35 || etanmahāpuṇyatamaṃ nāradaḥ kṛtavānvratam || kṛtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi jīvanmukto'bhavanmuniḥ || 36 || anye ca vaiṣṇavā ye vai cakruste bahuśaḥ purā || vrataṃ nātaḥ parataraṃ bhagavatprītikārakam || 37 || dharmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vaṃśavarddhanam|| bhavaṃto'pi yatātmānaḥ kurvaṃti vratamuttamam|| 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye jyeṣṭhapaṃcakavratavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
<2.2.45>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || mune vratamidaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutaṃ vai mūrtipaṃjaram || antaḥpramodajananaṃ mahimnā ca mahattaram || 1 || yātrā dvādaśa puṇyā yā uddiṣṭā bhagavatpriyāḥ || tāsāṃ dve avaśiṣṭe naḥ kathayasva mahāmune || 2 || || jaiminiruvāca || || vāsaṃtikāṃ samākhyāsye yātrāṃ damanabhaṃjikām|| yasyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ dṛṣṭāyāṃ prīṇāti puruṣottamaḥ || 3 || purā yatkathitaṃ viprāstṛṇaṃ damanakāhvayam || caitraśuklatrayodaśyāmāharettatsamūlakam || 4 || tanmadhye maṃḍalaṃ kuryātsuśubhaṃ padmasaṃjñitam || tadaṃtarvāsayeddevapratyarcāṃ pratipūjitām || 5 || yuktāṃ śrīsatyabhāmābhyāṃ pūjayedvidhivacca tāḥ || arddharātre tu karmedaṃ devadevasya kārayet || 6 || purā niśīthe'pi vibhurbabhaṃja damanāsuram || bhaṃktvā lebhe parāṃ prītiṃ tadaṃgotthaṃ ca tattṛṇam ||7|| tasyāmeva trayodaśyāṃ tṛṇaṃ daityaṃ vibhāvayet || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā vākyaṃ cedamudāharet || 8|| avadhīrdamanaṃ daityaṃ purā trailokyakaṃṭakam || sa evetthaṃ pariṇataḥ puratastava tiṣṭhati || 9 || asyotpattau tadā prītirāsīdyā tava mādhava || adhunāpi tathaivāstāṃ prītirdamanabhaṃjane || 2.2.45.10 || ityuktvā tṛṇameke tu kare devasya dāpayet || tato'vaśiṣṭāṃ rātriṃ ca nṛtyagītādibhirnayet || 11 || tataścābhyudite sūrye devaṃ tṛṇapuraḥsaram || nayecca jagadīśasya samīpaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 12 || upacārairjagannāthaṃ pūjayetpūrvavattataḥ || hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā hyantramālāṃ tadaṃgajām || 13 || kṛtvā kaṇṭhe yathā'prīṇāstathedaṃ damanaṃ tṛṇam || tava prītyai tu bhagavanmayā dattaṃ tavāṃgake || 14 || ityuccārya harermūrdhni dadyādgaṃdhatṛṇaṃ śubham || tadā dṛṣṭvā harervaktrapadmaṃ prītikaraṃ mudā || bhavaduḥkhaparikṣīṇaḥ sukhamāpnotyanuttamam || 15 || gṛhītvā mūrdhni tacchākhāṃ viṣṇumūrdhno'pakāṣatām || sarvapāpavinirmukto vasedviṣṇupure dhruvam || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye damanakabhaṃjanavidhivarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
<2.2.46>
|| jaiminiruvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yātrāmakṣayamokṣadām || anāyāsena mūḍhānāṃ vāsanābaddhacetasām || 1 || vaiśākhasyāmale pakṣe dvitīyārātrimadhyataḥ || maṇḍapaṃ ca catuṣkoṇaṃ sudhāliptaṃ savedikam || 2 || sudhautavāsasā kuryātpratisīrāsamaṃ tataḥ || sādhusopānasaṃyuktaṃ cārucaṃdrātapānvitam|| 3 || tanmadhye vinyasennūnaṃ sādhu bhadrāsanottamam || tasminnicolasaṃchanne vinyasetsvarṇabhājanam || 4 || tasya paścimabhāge vai svāsīno brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ || pātrāṃtare tu gṛhṇīyāccaṃdanaṃ pacaviṃśatim || 5 || supiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇasnehasya gṛhṇīyācca palādhikam || agurvarddhaṃ kuṃkumaṃ syātkuṃkumārddhaṃ ca sihlakam || 6 || kastūrikākarpurayoḥ pramāṇaṃ sihlasaṃmitam || sarvamekatra saṃpiṣyātpāṭalodbhavavāriṇā || 7 || paladvayaṃ tato dadyādagurusnehamuttamam || ekatra loḍitāṃ kṛtvā pūrvapātre nidhāpayet || 8 || ācchādya ketakīpatrairveṣṭayeccīnavāsasā || gandhaste somamaṃtreṇa rakṣedgaruḍamudrayā || 9 || evaṃ tu maṇḍape tasminsādhivāsaṃ nidhāpayet || aruṇodayakāle'tha nayetkṛṣṇasya sannidhim || 2.2.46.10 || śaṃkhacāmarachatrādyairbhrāmayitvā surālayam || devāgre sthāpayitvā ca pūjayetpuruṣottamam|| 11 || uddhāṭayettato vastre divyadṛṣṭyāvalokayet || prokṣitaṃ maṃtrarājena saṃkuryāttāḍanādibhiḥ || 12 || gaṃdhapuṣpākṣataiḥ pūjyaḥ śriyaḥ sūktena lepayet || śrīśasya sarvagātreṣu mṛdusparśaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 13 || vaiṣṇavā jayaśabdaistaṃ varddhayaṃti tadā harim || nānāsūktopaniṣadairvidvāṃsastaṃ stuvaṃti vai || 14 || veṇuvīṇādikairnṛtyagītavādyairanekaśaḥ || vyajanaiścāmaraicchatrairanyairnānopahārakaiḥ || 15 || saṃtoṣayañjagannāthaṃ tṛtīyādau vilepayet || yasya ciṃtanamātreṇa tāpā naśyaṃti dehinām || || 16 || so'sau saṃdarśanāttāpānnṛṇāṃ haṃti tadā dvijāḥ || acintyo mahimā viṣṇorīdṛktādṛktayā sadā || 17 || tataḥ sūkṣmāṃbarairmālyairbhakṣyabhojyādipānakaiḥ || dravyairnānāvidhairhṛdyairgavyairāvartitaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 18 || tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ tāṃbūlaiśca susaṃskṛtaiḥ || tasminkāle tu ye kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktyā paśyaṃti mānavāḥ || 19 || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || viṣṇoḥ svarūpamāsādya viṣṇuloke vasaṃti vai || 2.2.46.20 || purā kaliyuge viprā dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ || ādhyātmikādisaṃtāpaiḥ sudīnānvīkṣya mānavān || 21 || tatra gatvā kṛpāyukto mahimānaṃ cakāra vai || yathāvidhi mayā proktaṃ sa eva prathamaṃ dvijāḥ || 22 || pralipya candanenāṃge mādhavāmalapakṣake || tṛtīyāyāṃ jagannāthaṃ stutimetāṃ mudā jagau ||23|| || dakṣa uvāca || || devadeva jagannātha sahajānaṃdanirmala || saṃsārārṇavasaṃmagnāṃstrāhi naḥ parameśvara || 24 || nānāvidhaiśca saṃtāpaiḥ saṃtaptānmānavānimān || mamānukrośabuddhyā vai śubhadṛṣṭyā'mṛtena ca ||25|| saṃtarpaya tṛṇāñchuṣkānkṛṣṇa me'gha namo'stute || kalikalmaṣasaṃmūḍhānuddhartuṃ jagatāṃ pate || 26 || avatāro'yametasminnīlācalaguhāṃtare || cirakālaprarūḍhānāṃ dustyajānāṃ mahāṃhasām ||27|| rāśiṃ dagdhuṃ tvameveśo dīnānāthakṛpākara || tvaddarśanamahāyoge yamādyaṣṭāṃgavarjite || 28 || yeṣāṃ matiḥ samutpannā caturvargaikasādhane || na te śocaṃti duṣpāre bhavāraṇye mahābhaye || 29 || karmānapekṣaṃ deveśa nātmajñānaṃ vimocakam || idaṃ te darśanaṃ nātha vinā karmāpi mocayet || 2.2.46.30 || jaya kṛṣṇa jayeśāna jayākṣara jayāvyaya || prasīdānugṛhāṇemāndīnānmūḍhānvicetasaḥ || 31 || iti stutvā daṃḍapātaṃ papāta caraṇāṃbuje || prasīdeśa prasīdeśa prasīdeśeti ghoṣayan || 32 || tato jagāda bhagavānsusvareṇa prajāpatim || uttiṣṭha vatsa te dattaṃ durlabhaṃ yadvaraṃ tvayā || 33 || kāṃkṣitaṃ matprasādena bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || madanugraho'lpapuṇyānāṃ durlabho viditastava || || 34 || madaṃgajāto'sti bhavānmāṃ tvaṃ prārthitavānasi || mamotsavena santoṣya tataste pradadāmyaham || 35 || imāmakṣayayātrāṃ ye bhaktyā paśyaṃti harṣitāḥ || tasminkāle yadicchaṃti manasā tadavāpnuyuḥ || 36 || yathā saṃtāpaharaṇaṃ candanenānulepanam || tathotsavo'yaṃ me dakṣa saṃtāpatrayanāśanaḥ || 37 || matpreritamatistvaṃ hi utsavaṃ kṛtavānasi || saṃkalpito'yaṃ manasā dīnoddhṛtyai mayā dhruvam || 38 || tvayābhikākṣitaṃ sarvaṃ dāsyāmyeva prajāpate || dvādaśaitā mahāyātrā guṇḍicādyāstu pāvanāḥ || 39 || ekaikā muktidā sarvā dharmakāmārthavarddhanāḥ || 2.2.46.40 || tāsāmekatamāṃ vāpi yo bhaktyā cāvalokayet || ekayāpi bhavābdhiṃ sa tīrtvā viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet || 41 || || jaiminiruvāca || || ityudīrya prajānāthaṃ bhagavānsa tirodadhe || 42 || dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ so'pi śraddadhānastadājñayā || saṃvatsaraṃ girau sthitvā saṃdadarśa mahotsavān || 43 || sarvajño brāhmaṇo bhūtvā kauśikasya kulottame || lokānpravartayāmāsa yathāvidhi maheṣu saḥ || 44 || viśvāsāyālpabuddhīnāṃ yātrā vai parikīrtitāḥ || ayaṃ ca sākṣātparamabrahmarūpī jagadguruḥ || prasāditaḥ sureśena lokānugrahaṇāya vai || 45 || yathā tathā dṛṣṭipathaṃ yāto muktiprado dhuvam || sarvānkāmāndadātyeva nārīṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 46 || satyapratijño bhagavāṃstatrāste madhusūdanaḥ || śokaṃ tarati yaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavapāthodhisaṃbhavam || kiṃ vrataiḥ kiṃ tapodānaiḥ kiṃ kṛcchraiḥ kratubhistathā || 47 || kimaṣṭāṃgena yogena kiṃ sāṃkhyena pareṇa ca || 48 || tīrtharājajale snātvā kṣetre śrīpuruṣottame || nyagrodhamūlavasatau vasantaṃ carmacakṣuṣā || dṛṣṭvā dārumayaṃ brahma dehabaṃdhātpramucyate || 49 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||
<2.2.47>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavansarvaśāstrajña śrutaṃ paramamadbhutam || yātrārūpaṃ bhagavato māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || 1 || yathāhaṃ pūjito devaḥ kāmibhiḥ sarvakāmadaḥ || bhūtyupāsanayā bhūtiprado brūhi tathā hi naḥ ||2|| ||jaiminiruvāca|| sarvā vibhūtayo viṣṇorjagatyasmiṃścarācarāḥ|| bhūtiprado vibhūtiśca sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ||3|| yathāyathopa carati tathā vai jāyate naraḥ|| etāvadasya mahimā parimātuṃ na śakyate||4|| yo yathā samupāste taṃ tathā vai phalamāpnuyāt|| ekaḥ paṃthāścaturṇāṃ vai dharmādīnāṃ sa dāravaḥ || 5 || dharmasya pathā gahanaḥ saṃkīrṇo vahuśāsanaiḥ || tattvāvadhāraṇe nāsya kṣamaḥ ko'pi dvijottamāḥ || 6 || arthakāmau hi tanmūlāvitthaṃ sthūlagatī sadā || teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ bhagavānanāyāsena vṛddhikṛt || 7 || dharmo hi bhagavānviṣṇurdharmamūlamidaṃ jagat || dharmasya jagataścāpi prabhureṣa janārdanaḥ || 8 || puruṣārthamaye tasminbhaktiryasya pratiṣṭhitā || sa sarvakāmatṛptātmā na śocati na kāṃkṣati || 9 || trailokyaiśvaryadātāsau śakrarūpo hyupāsitaḥ || bhāvito dhātṛrūpeṇa vaṃśavṛddhikaro hariḥ || 2.2.47.10 || sanatkumārarūpeṇa dīrghamāyuḥ prayacchati || vṛttisaṃpatprado hyeṣa pṛthurūpeṇa bhāvitaḥ || 11 || gaṅgāditīrthaphalado vācaspatirupāsitaḥ || aṃtastamaḥ praṇudati bhāsvadrūpeṇa bhāvitaḥ || 12 || saubhāgyamatulaṃ dadyādamṛtāṃśurupāsitaḥ || vidyāṣṭādaśatattvajño vākpatitvena bhāvayan || 13 || vājimedhādiyajñānāṃ phalado'yaṃ sanātanaḥ || yajñeśvarasvarūpeṇa bhāvito'yaṃ jaganmayaḥ || 14 || dhyātaḥ kuberarūpeṇa samṛddhimatulāṃ dadet || 15 || evaṃ dayāṃbudhirasau tasminnīlācale vasan || dīnānāthānugrahāya dāruvyājaśarīravān || 16 || prayāta tatra bho viprā vasadhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || śrīśapādābjayugalaṃ śaraṇaṃ tatprapadyata || 17 || aihikāmuṣmikānbhogānvāñchadhvaṃ yadi śāśvatān || ante muktiṃ ca kaivalyāṃ yathecchaṃ tatra prāpnuta || 18 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
<2.2.48>
|| munaya ūcuḥ || || prāsādasya pratiṣṭhāṃta indradyumnāya yadvarān || ājñāpayāmāsa hariryātrāstā dvādaśāpi ca || 1 || tvatsakāśācchutaṃ sarvaṃ tataḥ sa pṛthivīpatiḥ || kiṃ cakāra mahābuddhirviṣṇubhakto'pyavasthitaḥ || || 2 || || jaiminiruvāca || || varām̐llabdhvā jagannāthātsākṣādbrahmasvarūpiṇaḥ || kṛtakṛtyaṃ sa mene vā ātmānaṃ narapuṃgavaḥ || 3 || yathājñaṃ kārayitvā vai yātrāstāḥ puṇyamokṣadāḥ || bahūpacārairbahudhā samabhyarcya jagadgurum || 4 || gālarājaṃ samādiśya devasyājñāṃ yathāvidhi || idaṃ provāca madhuraṃ dharmanyāyasamāyutam || 5 || || indradyumna uvāca || || rājanbahuśruto'si tvaṃ dharmaniṣṭhāmupāgataḥ || bhagavatyapi bhaktiste karmaṇā manasā girā || || 6 || na hyekasyopadaśāya bhagavānanuśāsti vai || carācaragururhyeṣa viśvaṃ tacchiṣyatāṃ gatam || 7 || mamānugrahalakṣyeṇa avatīrṇo jagatpatiḥ || uddhṛtyai dīnamanasāmatrāpi sthāsyate cirāt || 8 || bhaktyā ca śraddhayā yukta etadājñāṃ pravarttaya || pratimāvyavahāreṇa nainaṃ jānīhi bhūmipa || 9 || pratyakṣaṃ te yathā jātaṃ trailokyaṃ bhūmimāgatam || prāsādāṃtaḥ praveśe hi yasyāsya jagadīśituḥ || 2.2.48.10 || pitāmahādyāstridaśāḥ sarve yugapadāgatāḥ || viśvamūrtyā vayaṃ sarve jātā vai naṣṭacetanāḥ || 11 || carācaramayo hyeṣa sākṣāddārusvarūpadhṛk || kalpavṛkṣamimaṃ viddhi bhūgataṃ sarvakāmadam || 12 || upāsyainaṃ hi labhate yo yathā kāmanāphalam || yataṃto bahudhā yaṃ hi yatayo na vidanti vai || tamaḥpāre pratiṣṭhataṃ kiṃsvijjyotiḥ svarūpiṇam || 13 || yatīnāṃ dharmaniṣṭhānāṃ śuddhānāmūrdhvaretasām || ananyabhaktiyuktānāmekaḥ paṃthāstu yoginām || 14 || grīṣme śīta gabhīre vai nimajjya salilāśaye || parāṃ nirvṛtimāpnoti tathāsminkaruṇāṃbudhau || 15 || tritāpaduḥkhaṃ tyajati saṃprāpte puruṣottame || 16 || na mātā na pitā mitraṃ na patnī na sutastathā || śaraṇāgatadīnānāṃ yathāyamupakārakaḥ || 17 || tadenaṃ parisevasva bhuktimuktiphalapradam || pauraiḥ prajābhiryātrāstāḥ samṛddhaṃ parivarttaya || 18 || sādhāraṇo dharmapaṃthā nṛpāṇāṃ nṛpasattama || pravartitaśca pūrveṇa pālyate'naṃtareṇa saḥ || 19 || nṛsiṃhaṃ bhaja rājeṃdra upacārairmaharddhibhiḥ || pūjayasva trisaṃdhyaṃ taṃ paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnuhi || 2.2.48.20 || svakṛtāduttamaṃ prāhuḥ parakṛtyoparakṣaṇam|| pālayetparadattaṃ yaḥ svadattāduttamaṃ hi tat || 21 || || jaiminiruvāca || || kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ so'tha śveto nṛpatisattamaḥ || mūrdhni jagrāha tadvākyaṃ mālāmiva guṇānvitām || 22 || iṃdradyumno'pi rājarṣiḥ prasādya puruṣottamam || saha śrīmānbrahmalokaṃ jagāma ha || || 23 || etadvaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam || tatra nityoṣitasyāpi māhātmyaṃ brahmadāruṇaḥ || 24 || yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā vācyamānaṃ dvijottamāḥ || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ so'vikalaṃ labhet || 25 || arddhodayastu yo yogaḥ skaṃdena parikīrtitaḥ || tatkoṭiguṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ viṣṇormāhātmyakīrtanāt || 26 || prātaḥ prātaryaḥ śṛṇuyātkapilāśatado bhavet || gāṃgaiḥ puṣkarajaistoyairabhiṣekaphalaṃ labhet || 27 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃtānavarddhanam|| svargapratiṣṭhāgatidaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam || 28 || etadrahasyamākhyātaṃ purāṇeṣu sugopitam || vaiṣṇavebhyo vinā'nyeṣu na tu vācyaṃ kadācana ||29|| kutarkopahatā ye ca duradhītaśrutāgamāḥ || nāstikā dāṃbhikā nityaṃ paradoṣopadarśinaḥ || avaiṣṇavā moghajīvāstebhyo gopyaṃ sadaiva hi || 2.2.48.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetramāhātmye'ṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 || ||
<2.2.49>
||munaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavañjaimine sarvaṃ vedavedāṃgapāraga || tvadanugrahato'smābhirmāhātmyaṃ jagadīśituḥ || 1 || kṣetrarājasya tasyaiva yātrāṇāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ || bhagavadbhojanocchiṣṭaprāśanādiphalaṃ tathā || 2 || iṃdradyumnasya rājño vai vṛttāṃtamatidurlabham || nīlamādhavarūpaṃ tu dārubrahmaprakāśanam || || 3 || śrutaṃ tvadvadanāṃbhojādgalitaṃ tadyathāvidhi || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmastvatto hi vadatāṃ vara || 4 || sarvaṃ vistarato brahmanvayaṃ sarve mudānvitāḥ || purāṇaśravaṇasyaiva yaduktaṃ phalameva tat || 5 || ko vā tasya vidhiścaiva kena vā syāttu sāṃgakam|| asmāsu cedanukrośo yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 6 || || || jaiminiruvāca || || sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭhā yatpṛṣṭaṃ parayā mudā || tatra me prītiratulā jātā romāṃcakāriṇī || 7 || tadvaḥ sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ sāvadhānataḥ || purāṇaśravaṇāraṃbhe yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ || 8 || ādau saṃkalpya vidhivadbrāhmaṇaṃ śuddhavaṃśajam || avyaṃgāvayavaṃ śāṃtaṃ svaśākhaṃ svapurodhasam || 9 || sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñaṃ bhūṣaṇairatiśobhanaiḥ || vastracaṃdanamālyādyairvṛṇuyātpāṭhasaṃśrutau || 2.2.49.10 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā tataḥ saṃprārthayeddvijam || tvaṃ viṣṇurviṣṇureva tvaṃ na tu bhedaḥ kadācana || 11 || nirvighnaṃ me bhavatveva tvatprasādātprasīda ca || tato vṛtaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca bahumūlyāsane śubhe || || 12 || vāsayitvā ca tasyaiva gale mālāṃ vinikṣipet || mastake puṣpagarbhaṃ ca caṃdanairanulepayet || 13 || yasmāttasmiṃśca samaye vipro vyāsasamo mataḥ || tenaiva brāhmaṇenaiva pustake viṣṇurūpake || 14 || kārayedvyāsapūjāṃ ca śrīkhaṇḍāgurupuṣpakaiḥ || nānopacārai rucirairbhakṣyabhojyādikairapi || 15 || bhaktyā cāsanadānādividhiḥ kāryo dine dine || sāṃprataṃ kathayāmyevaṃ śrūyatāṃ śrotṛlakṣaṇam || 16 || gatānugatikānāṃ ca nivāsārthaṃ tathā dvijāḥ || āsanāni yathāyogyaṃ racayitvā svayaṃ tathā || 17 || śubhāsanāṃtarastho hi bhavedutkaṇṭhamānasaḥ || athavā saṃskṛte deśe sarvaiḥ saha vasedbhuvi || 18 || vyāsasyāgre nivasatirāsane nocca eva ca || kṛtasnāno mudā yukto dhārayaṃñchuklavāsasī || 19 || ācāṃtaḥ śaṃkhacakrāditilakānvitavigrahaḥ || manasā bhāvayedviṣṇuṃ viśvāsaṃ kārayedbhṛśam || 2.2.49.20 || purāṇe brāhmaṇe caiva deve ca maṃtrakarmaṇi || tīrthe vṛddhasya vacane viśvāsaḥ phaladāyakaḥ || 21 || ato munivarāḥ sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ viśvāsakāraṇam || pāṣaṃḍādikasaṃbhāṣaṃ vṛthālāpaṃ prayatnataḥ || 22 || purāṇaśravaṇe kāle sarvaciṃtāṃ ca varjayet || anena vidhinā viprāḥ pratyahaṃ śṛṇuyānmudā || 23 || tataḥ pāṭhe samāpte ca karatālādikairmuhuḥ || jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha hara ityādināmabhiḥ || 24 || vistārayedyathākāśe śrūyate śabda eva saḥ || evaṃ ca pratyahaṃ kuryātprītaye muravairiṇaḥ || 25 || tato graṃthasamāptau ca viṣṇuprīṇanatatparaḥ || viśeṣādvastramālyādicaṃdanairbhūṣaṇaistathā || bhūṣayetparayā bhaktyā vipraṃ vyāsasamaṃ dvijāḥ || 26 || ātmaśaktyā pradadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ vai yathāvidhi || ye ye pradadyuryadyacca mattastacchṛṇutādhunā || 27 || rājānaḥ kariṇo dadyuḥ sālaṃkārānsulakṣaṇān || kṣatriyā evamevaṃ ca te vai rājasamā matāḥ || 28 || brāhmaṇāḥ pustakāṃścaiva viṣṇorarcākaraṃḍikāḥ || kanakaṃ rajataṃ caiva dhānyaṃ vastraṃ svabhaktitaḥ || 29 || viśaśca ratnabhūṣāḍhyānsindhudeśodbhavānapi || gāśca lakṣaṇasaṃyuktāḥ savatsāśca payasvinīḥ || 2.2.49.30 || anyacca kanakādyaṃ ca tyajeyurdharmatatparāḥ || śūdrāḥ pradadyuḥ parayā mudā saṃyuktamānasāḥ || 31 || vāsāṃsi ca suvarṇaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ratnāni gāstathā || nānālaṃkārayuktāśca ghaṭoghnīrbālagarbhiṇīḥ || 32 || evaṃ vai dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyena saṃtuṣyate guruḥ || ātmanaḥ śaktito viprā vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet || 33 || śāṃtikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva vratodvāhādi karma ca || mokṣasya sādhakaṃ karma purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tathā || 34 || yajñādikaṃ ca dānaṃ ca vrataṃ nānāvidhaṃ tathā || yadi ceddakṣiṇāhīnaṃ tadā bhavati niṣphalam||35|| asurāḥ karmaṇastasya haraṃti phalameva tat || yathā strīṇāṃ ca lāvaṇyaṃ bhartṛsnehavivarjitam || 36 || yuddhātpalāyitānāṃ ca pṛṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā dhanuṣmatām || vinā dhāvanamaśvānāṃ duṣṭatvaṃ hi yathā dvijāḥ || 37 || mūkatveneva pāṃḍityaṃ sarvaśāstravipaścitām || hīnaṃ dakṣiṇayā yadyatkarma tadvacca niṣphalam ||38|| dānena kṣīyate yasmāduritānāṃ kadaṃbakam || dakṣiṇeti tathā viprā gīyate śāstravedibhiḥ || 39 || tato viprānbhojayedvai yathāśaktiprakalpitaiḥ || karpūreṇa ca khaṃḍena sarpiṣā pāyasairyutaiḥ ||2.2.49.40 || ṣaḍvidhairannapānādyaiḥ susvādairamṛtopamaiḥ || tebhyopi svarṇavastrādi yathāśaktyā pradāpayet|| 41 || etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ purāṇaśravaṇasya ca || sāṃgopāṃgavidhānaṃ ca yena syātsaphalaṃ tvidam || idānīṃ bho muniśreṣṭhāḥ kimanyajjñātumicchatha ||42|| || munaya ūcuḥ || || aho'smākaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ yatpāpaughavināśanam || purāṇaśravaṇasyaiva phalamasmābhireva ca || 43 || sāṃgopāṃgavidhānaṃ ca śrutaṃ tvanmukhapaṃkajāt || dhanyāḥ sma kṛtapuṇyāḥ sma saṃsāre vigatajvarāḥ || 44 || idānīmātmaśaktyā vai dīyate bhavate mune || dakṣiṇā phalasaṃprāptyai prasannastvaṃ gṛhāṇa ca || 45 || ityuktavaṃto munayo hyakiṃcanāḥ samitkuśaṃ puṣpaphalākṣatādikam || klṛptvā ca tasmai munayaḥ sumuktāḥ kṣetrottamaṃ jagmuratipraharṣitāḥ || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe puruṣottamakṣetra māhātmye jaiminiṛṣisaṃvāda ekonapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 || || || || || || iti vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe dvitīyaṃ śrīpuruṣottama(jagannātha)kṣetramāhātmyaṃ samāptam || (2.2) ||
<2.3.1>
|| śrībadarīnāthāya namaḥ || || śaunaka uvāca || || sūtasūta mahābhāga sarvadharmavidāṃ vara || sarvaśāstrārthatattvajña purāṇe pariniṣṭhita || 1 || vyāsaḥ satyavatīputro bhagavānviṣṇuravyayaḥ || tasya yatpriyaśiṣyastvaṃ tvatto vettā na kaścana || 2 || prāpte kaliyuge ghore sarvadharmabahiṣkṛte || janā vai duṣṭakarmāṇaḥ sarvadharmavivarjitāḥ ||3|| kṣudrāyuṣaḥ kṣudraprāṇabalavīryatapaḥkriyāḥ || adharmaniratāḥ sarve vedaśāstravivarjitāḥ || 4 || tīrthāṭanatapodānaharibhaktivivarjitāḥ || kathameṣāmalpakānāmuddhāro'lpaprayatnataḥ || 5 || tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ tathā || mumukṣūṇāṃ kutaḥ siddhiḥ kutra vā ṛṣisaṃcayaḥ ||6 || kutra vālpaprayatnena tapo mantrāśca siddhidāḥ || kutra vā vasati śrīmāñjagatāmīśvareśvaraḥ|| bhaktānāmanuraktānāmanugrahakṛpālayaḥ|| 7 || etadanyacca sarvaṃ me parārthaikaprayojanam || brūhi bhadrāya lokānāmanugrahavicakṣaṇa || 8 || || sūta uvāca || || sādhu sādhu mahābhāga bhavānparahite rataḥ || haribhaktikṛtāsaktiprakṣālitamanomalaḥ || 9 || atha me devakīputro hṛtpadmamadhirohati || prasaṃgāttava viprarṣe durllabhaḥ sādhusaṃgamaḥ || 2.3.1.10 || harati duṣkṛtasaṃcayamuttamāṃ gatimalaṃ tanute tanumāninām || adhikapuṇyavaśādavaśātmanāṃ jagati durlabhaḥ sādhusamāgamaḥ || 11 || harati hṛdayabandhaṃ karmapāśārditānāṃ vitarati padamuccairalpajalpaikabhājāma || jananamaraṇakarmaśrāṃtaviśrāṃtihetustrijagati manujānāṃ durllabhaḥ satprasaṃgaḥ || 12 || || sūta uvāca || || ayaṃ praśnaḥ purā sādho skandenākāri sarvataḥ || kailāsaśikhare ramya ṛṣīṇāṃ pariśṛṇvatām || purato girijābhartuḥ kartuṃ niḥśreyasaṃ satām||13|| || skaṃda uvāca|| || bhagavansarvalokānāṃ karttā harttā pitā guruḥ || kṣemāya sarvajaṃtūnāṃ tapase kṛtaniścayaḥ || 14 || kalikāle hyanuprāpte vedaśāstravivarjite || kutra vā vasati śrīmānbhagavānsātvatāṃ patiḥ || 15 || kṣetrāṇi kāni puṇyāni tīrthāni saritastathā || kena vā prāpyate sākṣādbhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || śraddadhānāya bhagavankṛpayā vada me pitaḥ || 16 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || bahūni saṃti tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi ca ṣaḍānana || harivāsanivāsaikaparāṇi paramārthinām || 17 || kāmyāni kānicitsaṃti kānicinmuktidānyapi || ihāmutrārthadānyeva bahupuṇyapradāni vai || 16 || gaṃgā godāvarī revā tapatī yamunā sarit || kṣiprā sarasvatī puṇyā gautamī kauśikī tathā || 19 || kāverī tāmraparṇī ca caṃdrabhāgā maheṃdrajā || citrotpalā vetravatī sarayūḥ puṇyavāhinī || 2.3.1.20 || carmaṇvatī śatadrūśca payasvinyatrisaṃbhavā || gaṃḍikā bāhudā sarvāḥ puṇyāḥ siṃdhuḥ sarasvatī || 21 || bhuktimuktipradāścaitāḥ sevyamānā muhurmuhuḥ || ayodhyā dvārakā kāśī madhurāvaṃtikā tathā || ||22|| kurukṣetraṃ rāmatīrthaṃ kāṃcī ca puruṣottamam || puṣkaraṃ darduraṃ kṣetraṃ vārāhaṃ vidhinirmitam || badaryyākhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvārthasādhanam || 23 || ayodhyāṃ vidhivaddṛṣṭvā purīṃ muktyekasādhanīm || sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ prayāṃti harimaṃdiram || 24 || vividhaviṣṇuniṣevaṇapūrvakācaritapūjananartanakīrtanāḥ || gṛhamapāsya hareranuciṃtanājjitagṛhārjitamṛtyuparākramāḥ || 25 || svargadvāre naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā rāmālayaṃ śuciḥ || na tasya kṛtyaṃ paśyāmi kṛtakṛtyo bhavedyataḥ || 26 || dvārikāyāṃ hariḥ sākṣātsvālayaṃ naiva muṃcati || adyāpi bhavanaṃ kaiścitpuṇyavadbhiḥ pradṛśyate || 27 || gomatyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamukhāṃbujam || muktiḥ prajāyate śeṣo vinā sāṃkhyaṃ ṣaḍānana || 28 || asīvaruṇayormadhye paṃcakrośyāṃ mahāphalam || amarā mṛtyumicchaṃti kā kathā itare janāḥ || 29 || maṇikarṇyāṃ jñānavāpyāṃ viṣṇupādodake tathā || hrade paṃcanade snātvā na mātuḥ stanapo bhavet || 2.3.1.30 || prasaṃgenāpi viśveśaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāśyāṃ ṣaḍānana || muktiḥ prajāyate puṃsāṃ janmamṛtyuvivarjitā || 31 || bahunā kimihoktena naitatkṣetrasamaṃ kvacit || tapopavāsanirato mathurāyāṃ ṣaḍānana || janmasthānaṃ samāsādya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 32 || viśrāṃtitīrthe vidhivatsnātvā kṛtvā tilodakam || pitṝnuddhṛtya narakādviṣṇulokaṃ pragacchati || 33 || yadi kuryātpramādena pātakaṃ tatra mānavaḥ || viśrāṃte snānamāsādya bhasmībhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 34 || avaṃtyāṃ vidhivatsnātvā śiprāyāṃ mādhave narāḥ || piśācatvaṃ na paśyaṃti janmāṃtaraśatairapi || 35 || koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā bhojayitvā dvijottamān|| mahākālaṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 36 || muktikṣetramidaṃ sākṣānmama lokaikasādhanam || dānāddaridratāhāniriha loke paratra ca || 37 || kurukṣetre rāmatīrthe svarṇaṃ dattvā svaśaktitaḥ || sūryoparāge vidhivatsa naro muktibhāgbhavet || 38 || ye tatra pratigṛhṇaṃti narā lobhavaśaṃgatāḥ || puruṣatvaṃ na teṣāṃ vai kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 39 || harikṣetre hariṃ dṛṣṭvā snātvā pādodake janaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto hariṇā saha modate || 2.3.1.40 || khagagaṇā vividhā nivasaṃtyaho ṛṣigaṇāḥ phalamūladalāśanāḥ || pavanasaṃyamanakramanirjiteṃdriyaparākramaṇā munayastviha || 41 || viṣṇukāṃcyāṃ hariḥ sākṣācchivakāṃcyāṃ śivaḥ svayam || abhedādubhayorbhaktyā muktiḥ karatale sthitā || vibhedajananātpuṃsāṃ jāyate kutsitā gatiḥ || 42 || sakṛddṛṣṭvā jagannāthaṃ mārkaṃḍeyahrade plutaḥ || vinā jñānena yogena na mātuḥ stanapo bhavet || 43 || rohiṇyāmudadhau snātvā iṃdradyumnahrade tathā || bhuktvā nieveditaṃ viṣṇorvaikuṃṭhe vasatiṃ labhet|| 44|| daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ śaṃkhopari sthitam|| caturbhujatvamāyāṃti kīṭā api na saṃśayaḥ|| 45|| kārttikyāṃ puṣkare snātvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā sadakṣiṇam|| bhojayitvā dvijānbhaktyā brahmaloke mahīyate||46|| sakṛtsnātvā hrade tasminyūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāhitaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto jāyate dvijasattamaḥ || 47 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi yogābhyāsena yatphalam || saukare vidhivatsnātvā pūjayitvā hariṃ śuciḥ ||48 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || tīrtharājaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrthaniṣevitam || 49 || kāmināṃ sarvajaṃtūnāmīpsitaṃ karmabhirbhavet || veṇyāṃ snātvā śucirbhūtvā kṛtvā mādhavadarśanam || bhuktvā puṇyavatāṃ bhogānante mādhavatāṃ vrajet || || 2.3.1.50 || māghe māsi naraḥ snātvā triveṇyāṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ || badarīkīrtanātpuṇyaṃ tatsamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 51 || daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ daśayajñaphalapradam || saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ putra kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 52 || || skaṃda uvāca || || badaryyākhyaṃ hareḥ kṣetraṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham || kṣetrasya smaraṇādeva mahāpātakino narāḥ || vimuktakilviṣāḥ sadyo maraṇānmuktibhāginaḥ || 53 || anyatīrthe kṛtaṃ yena tapaḥ paramadāruṇam || tatsamā badarīyātrā manasāpi prajāyate || 54 || bahūni saṃti tīrthāni divi bhūmau rasātale || badarīsadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 55 || aśvamedha sahasrāṇi vāyubhojye ca yatphalam || kṣetrāṃtare viśālāyāṃ tatphalaṃ kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 56 || kṛte muktipradā proktā tretāyāṃ yogasiddhidā || viśālā dvāpare proktā kalau badarikāśramaḥ || 57 || sthūlasūkṣmaśarīraṃ tu jīvasya vasatisthalam || tadvināśayati jñānādviśālā tena kathyate || 58 || amṛtaṃ sravate yā hi badarītaruyogataḥ || badarī kathyate prājñairṛṣīṇāṃ yatra saṃcayaḥ || 59 || tyajetsarvāṇi tīrthāni kālekāle yugeyuge || badarīṃ bhagavānviṣṇurna muñcati kadācana || 2.3.1.60 || sarvatīrthāvagāhena tapoyogasamādhitaḥ || tatphalaṃ prāpyate samyagbadarīdarśanādguha || 61 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi yogābhyāsena yatphalam || vārāṇasyāṃ dinaikena tatphalaṃ badarīṃ gatau || 62 || tīrthānāṃ vasatiryatra devānāṃ vasatistathā || ṛṣīṇāṃ vasatiryatra viśālā tenakathyate || 63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe badarikāśramamāhātmye śivakārttikeyasaṃvāde badarikāśramasya sarvatīrthādhikatvavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<2.3.2>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || kathametatsamutpannaṃ kairvā kṣetraṃ niṣevitam || ko vā tasyāpyadhīśaḥ syādetadvistarato vada || 1 || || śiva uvāca || || anādisiddhametattu yathā vedā harestanūḥ || adhiṣṭhātā hariḥ sākṣānnāradādyairniṣevitam || 2 || purā kṛtayugasyādau svīyāṃ duhitaraṃ vidhiḥ || rūpayauvanasaṃpannāṃ sa tāṃ yabhitumudyataḥ || 3 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ roṣācchiraḥ khaḍgena pañcadhā || cicchedā'haṃ kapālaṃ tadbrahmahatyāsamudyate || 4 || haste kṛtvā jagāmāśu tatra tīrthāni sevitum || divi bhūmau ca pātāle tapaścaraṇapūrvakam || 5 || na gatā brahmahatyā me kapālaṃ tādṛśaṃ kare || tadā vaikuṇṭhamagamaṃ draṣṭuṃ lakṣmīpatiṃ harim || 6 || vinayāvanato bhūtvā namaskṛtya punaḥ punaḥ || sarvamākhyātavāṃstasmai vyasanaṃ karuṇātmane || 7 || tasyopadiṣṭamādāya badarīṃ samupāgataḥ || tatkṣaṇādbrahmahatyā me vepamānā muhurmuhuḥ || 8 || aṃtarhitaṃ kapālaṃ tatkarādvigalitaṃ mama || tataḥprabhṛti tatkṣetraṃ pārvatyā saha sādaram ||9|| tiṣṭhāmi tapa āsthāya ṛṣīṇāṃ prītimāvahan || vārāṇasyāṃ yathā prītiḥ śrīśailaśikhare tathā || 2.3.2.10 || kailāse śivayā sārddhaṃ tatonaṃtaguṇādhikā || anyatra bharaṇānmuktiḥ svadharmavidhipūrvakāta || 11 || badarī darśanādeva muktiḥ puṃsāṃ kare sthitā || hareścaraṇasānnidhyaṃ yatra vaiśvānaraḥ svayam || 12|| tatra kedārarūpeṇa mama liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || kedāradarśanātsparśādarccanādbhaktibhāvataḥ|| 13|| koṭijanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhasmībhavati tatkṣaṇāt || kalāmātreṇa tiṣṭhāmi tatra kṣetre viśeṣataḥ || 14|| kalā paṃcadaśaivātra mūrtimadhye hyavasthitam || 15|| jitakṛtāṃtabhayāḥ śivayoginaḥ kṛtamṛgājinakṛttisuvāsasaḥ || varavibhūtijaṭānvitabhūṣaṇāḥ svayamupāsata eva jaṭādharam || 1 6|| phaladalāṃbusamīraṇatoṣitāḥ śivamanojitamṛtyupariśramāḥ || girivarasthitanirjitamānasāḥ prasaranirmmalabuddhimahodayāḥ || 17 || kamalakomalakāṃtimukhāṃbujāḥ śivakṛpājitanirbharavairiṇaḥ || karadhṛtāṃjalimauliśivekṣaṇāḥ śivamupāsata eva niśāmukhe || 18 || karadhṛtajapamālāḥ śāṃtisaṃtoṣabhājaḥ kṛtanatiparanityaprārthanāścandramaulau || haracaraṇasarojadhyānavijñānamūrtivyathitajanamanojāḥ sarvabhāvānnitāṃtam || 19 || vārāṇasyāṃ mṛtānāṃ ca tārakaṃ brahmasaṃjñakam || janānāṃ pūjanāttatra mama liṃgasya jāyate || 2.3.2.20 || vahnitīrthaṃ paribhrājadbhagavaccaraṇāṃtike || kedārākhyaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā no janmabhāgbhavet || 21 || || skanda uvāca || || kathaṃ vaiśvānaraḥ śrīmānsarvalokaikakāraṇam || badarīmanusaṃtasthau tanme vada mahāmate || 22 || || || śiva uvāca || || purā samājaḥ samabhūdṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām || gaṃgā bhagavatī yatra kāliṃdyā saha saṃgatā ||23|| daśāśvamedhikaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || babhūva tatra bhagavānhutabhukpraśrayānataḥ || ṛṣīṇāmagrataḥ sthitvā praṣṭuṃ samupacakrame || 24 || || vaiśvānara uvāca || || dṛṣṭvā ihaikadṛgjñānā bhavanto brahmavittamāḥ || dīnārthe karuṇāpūrṇā hṛdayārdrā dayālavaḥ || 25 || sarvadurlakṣaṇodbhūtapātakāliptacetasaḥ || kathaṃ syānnirayānmuktirmama brahmaviduttamāḥ || 26 || sarveṣāmṛṣivaryyāṇāmājagāma munīśvaraḥ || gaṃgāṃbhasi samāplutya vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 27 || || vyāsa uvāca || || astyekaḥ paramopāyo bhavataḥ pāpaniṣkṛtau || sarvabhakṣākhyadoṣasya badarīṃ śaraṇaṃ śraya || 28 || yatrāste bhagavānsākṣāddevadevo janārddanaḥ || bhaktānāmapyabhaktānāmaghahā madhusūdanaḥ || 29 || tatra gaṃgāṃbhasi snātvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃ hareḥ || daṃḍavatpraṇipātena sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 2.3.2.30 || tato vyāsamukhācchrutvā ṛṣīṇāmanuvādataḥ || uttarābhimukho vahnirgaṃdhamādanamāyayau || 31 || tato badarikāṃ prāpya snātvā gaṃgāṃbhasi svayam|| nārāyaṇāśramaṃ gatvā natvā provāca bhaktimān || 32 || || agniruvāca || || viśudavijñānaghanaṃ purāṇaṃ sanātanaṃ viśvasṛjāṃ patiṃ gurum || anekamekaṃ jagadekanāthaṃ namāmyanaṃtāśritaśuddhabuddhim || 33 || māyāmayīṃ śaktimupetya viśvakarttāramuddiśya rajopayuktam || sattvena cāsya sthitihetumugramatho tamobhigrasitāramīḍe ||34|| avidyayā viśvavimohitātmā vidyaikarūpaṃ vitataṃ trilokyām || vidyāśritatvātsakalajñamīśaṃ tvavidyayā jīvamahaṃ prapadye || 35 || bhaktecchayāviṣkṛtadehayogamābhogabhogārpitayogayogam || kauśeyapītāmbarajuṣṭaśaktiṃ vicitraśaktyaṣṭamayeṣṭamīḍe || 36 || atha prasanno bhagavānstutaḥ sarvairhṛdi sthitaḥ || provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ pāvakaṃ pāvanārthinam || 37 || || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varado'hamupāgataḥ || stavenānena tuṣṭo'smi vinayena tavānadha || 38 || || agniruvāca || || jñātaṃ bhagavatā sarvaṃ yadarthamahamāgataḥ || tathāpi kathayāmyetadīśvarājñānupālanam || 39 || sarvabhakṣo bhavāmyeva niṣkṛtistu kathaṃ bhavet || atyantabhayasaṃpattiretasmājjāyate mama || 2.3.2.40 || || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || || kṣetradarśanamātreṇa prāṇināṃ nāsti pātakam || matprasādātpātakaṃ tu tvayi māstu kadācana || 41 || tataḥ prabhṛti bhūtātmā pāvakaḥ sarvato bhṛśam || kalayāvasthitaścātra sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ || 42 || ya etatprātarutthāya śṛṇoti śrāvayecchuciḥ || agnitīrthakṛtasnānaṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrībadarikāśramamāhātmye'gnikṛtabhagavatstutivarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<2.3.3>
|| skanda uvāca || || bhagavansarvabhūteṣu sarvadharmaviśārada || agnitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ kṛpayā vada me pitaḥ || 1 || || śiva uvāca || || atiguhyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthaniṣevitam || saṃkṣepātkathayāmyetattavādaravaśādaham|| 2 || mahāpātakino ye ca atipātakinastathā || snānamātreṇa śuddhyaṃti vināyāsena putraka || 3 || prāyaścittena yatpāpaṃ na gacchenmaraṇāṃtikam|| snānamātreṇa tīrthasya pāvakasya viśuddhyati || 4 || atyaṃtamalasaṃbaddhaṃ yathā śuddhyati hāṭakam || tathāgnitīrthamāsādya dehī pāpairviśuddhyati || 5 || kuśāgreṇodabiṃduṃ ca pītvā varṣatrayaṃ naraḥ || anyakṣetre tapaḥ kṛtvā tadatra snānamātrataḥ || 6 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvāsminyathāvibhavasaṃbhavaiḥ || daridratā kule teṣāṃ na kadācitprajāyate ||7 || upavāsena yaḥ prāṇānvahnitīrthe tyajennaraḥ || sa bhittvā sūryalokādīnviṣṇulokaṃ prapadyate ||8|| cāṃdrāyaṇasahasraistu kṛcchraiḥ koṭibhireva ca || yatphalaṃ labhate martyastatsnānādvahnitīrthataḥ || 9 || paṃcadhā ye prakurvaṃti pāpamasminṣaḍānana || japena pavanāyāmairviśuddhiriti me matiḥ || 2.3.3.10 || jñānena mohavaśataḥ pāpaṃ kurvanti ye'dhamāḥ || paiśācīṃ yonimāyāmati yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || 11 || anāśramī cāśramī vā yāvaddehasyadhāraṇam || na tīrthe pāvake kuryātpātakaṃ buddhipūrvakam || 12 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ saṃdhyā devārcanaṃ tathā || atrānaṃtaguṇaṃ proktamanyatīrthātṣaḍānana || 13 || bahūni saṃti tīrthāni pāvanāni mahāṃtyapi || vahnitīrthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 14 || na brahmā na śivaḥ śeṣo na devā na ca tāpasāḥ || śaknuvaṃti phalaṃ nālaṃ vaktuṃ pāvakatīrthajam ||15|| kiṃ teṣāṃ bahubhiryajñaiḥ kiṃ dānairniyamairyamaiḥ|| yeṣāṃ pāvakatīrthe'sminsnānaṃ daśadinaṃ bhavet || 16 || upavāsena yaḥ prāṇānvahnitīrthe jayennaraḥ || upavāsatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā janārddanam|| naraḥ pāvakatīrthe'sminsa bhavetpāvakopamaḥ || 17 || śilāpaṃcakamadhyasthaṃ sānnidhyaṃ nityadā hareḥ || tatraiva pāvakaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||18 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kathaṃ tatra śilāḥ paṃca kena vā tatra nirmitāḥ || kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tāsāṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ || 19 || || śiva uvāca || || nāradī nārasiṃhī ca vārāhī gāruḍī tathā || mārkaṃḍeyīti vikhyātāḥ śilāḥ sarvārthasiddhidāḥ || 2.3.3.20 || nārado bhagavāṃstepe tapaḥ paramadāruṇam|| darśanārthaṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ śilāyāṃ vāyubhojanaḥ || 21 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śilāyāṃ vṛkṣavṛttimān|| tadāsau bhagavānviṣṇustatra brāhmaṇarūpadhṛk || 22 || jagāma puratastasya kṛpayā munisattamam || uvāca vacanaṃ cāru kimiti kliśyate hyṛṣe || kiṃ vā tavepsitaṃ brūhi tapasā kṣīṇakalmaṣa || 23 || || nārada uvāca || || ko bhavānvijane'raṇye mamānugrahatatparaḥ || manaḥ prasannatāmeti darśanātte dvijottama || 24 || ityukto nāradenāsau śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || pītāṃbaralasatpadmavanamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥ || 25 || śrīvatsakaustubhabhrājatkamalāvimalālayaḥ || sunaṃdanapramukhyaiḥ sa stūyamāno janārddanaḥ || 26 || darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ svaṃ nāradāya kṛpārditaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya tanuṃ prāṇa ivāgataḥ || 27 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā namaskṛtya punaḥ punaḥ || tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā jagatāmīśvareśvaram || 28 || || nārada uvāca || || yaḥ sarvasākṣī jagatāmadhīśvaro bhaktecchayā jātaśarīrasaṃpadaḥ || kṛpāmahāṃbhonidhirāśritānāṃ prasīdatāṃ pāvanadivyamūrtiḥ || 29 || hitāya lokasya satāṃ punarmanaḥ sutoṣaṇāyāciramutkalādibhiḥ || prasannalīlāhasitāvalokanaḥ prasīdatāṃ sattvanikāyamūrtimān || 2.3.3.30 || kaṃdarppalāvaṇyavilāsasuṃdaraḥ prasannagaṃbhīragireṃdirotsavaḥ || svamāśritānāṃ varakalpapādapaḥ prasīdatāṃ dīnadayārdramānasaḥ || 31 || yadaṃghripadmārcananirmalāṃtarā jñānāsinā śātitabaṃdhahetavaḥ || vidaṃti yadbrahmasukhaṃ gataklamāḥ prasīdatāṃ dīnadayārdramānasaḥ ||32|| saṃsāravārāṃnidhibaddhaseturyaḥ sṛṣṭipālāṃtavidhānahetuḥ || upāṃtanāmā guṇalabdhamūrtiḥ prasīdatāṃ brahmasukhānubhūtiḥ || 33 || ya iṃdriyādhiṣṭhitabhūtasūkṣmādvikāsaheturdyutimadvariṣṭhaḥ || jīvātmatāṃ gacchati māyayā svayā sa eka īśo bhagavānprasīdatām || 34 || svadṛgguṇairyena vilipyate mahānguṇāśrayaṃ yena ca pāñcabhautikam|| eko'pi nānāguṇasaṃprayuktaḥ prasīdatāṃ dīnadayāluvaryaḥ || 35 || yasyānuvartino devā vipadāṃ padamaṃbudhim || kṛtvā vatsapadaṃ svarge nirātaṃkā vasaṃti hi ||36|| namaste vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || pradyumnāyāniruddhāya sarvabhūtātmane namaḥ || 37 || adya me jīvitaṃ dhanyamadya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ || adya me saphalaṃ jñānaṃ darśanātte janārdana || 38 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || tuṣṭo'haṃ tapasānena stotreṇa tava nārada || tvatto bhakto na me kaścittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 39 || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varado'haṃ tavāgrataḥ || maddarśanātte kāmaḥ syātsaṃsiddho viddhi nārada|| 2.3.3.40 || || nārada uvāca || || varado yadi me deva varārho yadi vāpyaham || bhaktiṃ tava padāṃbhoje niścalāṃ dehi me vibho || 41 || pacchilāsannidhānaṃ ca na tyājyaṃ te kadācana || mattīrthadarśanātsparśātsnānādācamanāttathā || dehairna yujyate deyastatīyastu varo mama || 42 || || śrībhagavānuvāca|| || evamastu tava snehāttava tīrthe vasāmyaham || carācarāṇāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ videhāya na saṃśayaḥ || 43|| evamuktvā hariḥ sākṣāttatraivāṃtaradhīyata || nārado'pi mahātejā dināni katicitsaha || badarīmāvasanhṛṣṭo yayau madhupurīṃ tataḥ || 44 || || skaṃda uvāca || || mārkaṃḍeyaśilāyāstu mahimānaṃ vadasva me || kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tasyāḥ saṃjñā ca tādṛśī katham ||45|| ||śiva uvāca || || purā tretāyugasyāṃte mṛkaṃḍutanayo mahān || svalpāyuṣaṃ nijaṃ jñātvā jajāpa paramaṃ japam || 46 || dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa pūjito hariravyayaḥ || saptakalpāyuṣaṃ jñātvā tatraivāṃtarato yayau || 47 || mārkaṃḍeyastataḥ śrutvā tīrthāṭanapariśramam || darśanaṃ nāradasyāsīnmathurāyāṃ ṣaḍānana || 48 || pūjito vaṃditastena nārado munisattamaḥ || kathayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ badaryā yatra keśavaḥ || 49 || || nārada uvāca || || kimiti kliśyate sādho tīrthāṭanapariśramaiḥ || badaryākhyaṃ mahākṣetraṃ sānnidhyaṃ nityadā hareḥ || 2.3.3.50 || tatra yāhi yatra sākṣāddhariṃ paśyasi cakṣuṣā || tacchrutvā vismayopeto viśālāmāyayāvṛṣiḥ || 51 || snātvā śilāmupaviśañjajāpāṣṭākṣaraṃ param || tataḥprasanno bhagavām̐strirātryaṃte janārdanaḥ || 52 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvibhūṣaṇam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya premagadgadayā girā || tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā mārkaṃḍeyo janārdanam || 53 || || mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || aśāśvate ca saṃsāre sāre te caraṇāṃbuje || samuddhāraḥ kathaṃ nṛṇāṃ trāhi māṃ parameśvara ||54|| tāpatrayapariśrāṃtamanekājñānajṛṃbhitam || saṃsārakuhare bhrāṃtaṃ trāhi māṃ kṛpayā'cyuta || 55 || anekayoniyaṃtreṣu niḥsṛtestanuvedanām || garbhavāsakṛtāṃ prāptaṃ trāhi māṃ karuṇāṃbudhe ||56|| kṛmibhakṣitasarvāṃgaṃ kṣutpipāsākulaṃ ca hi || āṃtramālākulegarbhe trāhi māṃ madhusūdana || 57|| amedhyādibhirāliptaṃ niśceṣṭaśramamākulam|| smaraṃtaṃ nijakarmotthaṃ trāhi māṃ madhusūdana || 58 || vacanādānaniḥśvāsāśaktaṃ bhayamupāgatam|| garbhavāsamahāduḥkhaṃ trāhi māṃ madhusūdana || 59 ||
