jarāmaraṇabālyādiduḥkhasaṃsārapīḍitam || duḥkhābdhau sukhabuddhiṃ māṃ kṛpāsiṃdho prapālaya || 2.3.3.60 || kadācitkṛmitāṃ prāptaṃ kadācitsvedajanmitām|| kadācidudbhijjatvaṃ ca kadācinnaratāṃ gatam ||61|| sarvayonisamāpannaṃ vipannaṃ vigataprabham|| anāthaṃ tvāṃ samāpannaṃ trāhi māṃ kṛpayā'cyuta||62|| evaṃ stutastataḥ kṛṣṇo mārkaṇḍeyena dhīmatā || prītastamāha viprarṣe varaṃ me vriyatāmiti ||63|| || śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo bhavānmahyaṃ bhagavandīnavatsala || niścalāṃ dehi me bhaktiṃ pūjāyāṃ darśane tava || śilāyāṃ tava sānnidhyameṣa eva varo mama |||| 64 || || sūta uvāca || || tathetyuktvā mahāviṣṇuryayāvaṃtarhitaṃ dvija || mārkaṃḍeyastatastuṣṭo jagāma piturāśramam || 65 || upasthānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || śṛṇuyācchrāvayenmartyo govinde labhate gatim || 66 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śivakārtikeyasaṃvāde agnitīrthanāradaśilāmārkaṇḍeyaśilāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<2.3.4>
|| skanda uvāca || vainateyaśilāyāstu māhātmyaṃ vada me pitaḥ || kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ cāsya anubhāvaṃ ca kiṃ bhavet || 1 || || śiva uvāca || || kaśyapādvinatāgarbhe mahābalaparākramau || garuḍāruṇau prajātau dvāvaruṇaḥ sūryasārathiḥ || 2 || badaryyā dakṣiṇe bhāge gandhamādanaśṛṅgake || garuḍastapa ātepe harivāhanakāmyayā || 3 || phalamūlajalāhāro nirdvaṃdvo japatāṃ varaḥ || padaikenopasaṃkramya bhuvi jepe nirāmayaḥ || 4 || triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi haridarśana lālasaḥ || tatastu bhagavānsākṣātpītavāsā nijāyudhaḥ || 5 || āvirāsīdyathā prācyāṃ diśīṃduriva puṣkalaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ samyaṅmeghagaṃbhīranisvanaḥ || 6 || tathāpi na bahirvṛttirdadhmau daravaraṃ tataḥ || tathāpi na bahirvṛttirgaruḍasya mahātmanaḥ || 7 || tataḥ praviśya bhagavānaṃtaraṃ pavanakramāt || bahirunmukhatāṃ caiva racayanbahirābabhau || 8 || bhagavaṃtaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā garuḍo gatasādhvasaḥ || pulakāṃkita sarvāṃgastuṣṭāva vihitāṃjaliḥ || 9 || || garuḍa uvāca || || jayajaya tribhuvanajanamanobhavana vidalitāghaguṇa sakalagīrvāṇavaṃdita caraṇakamalayugalaparimalabahalaripuvanavibhaṃjana vidyotamāna sakalasurāsuramukuṭakoṭivilasita nijapīṭhakamalanirasita nijajanahṛdayatimirapaṭalabahala himakara iva trividhasaṃtāpasaṃdohaharaṇacaraṇa jagadudayasthitilayavilāsavilasita trividhamūrtikīrtivisphūrjita jagadudayasaṃdoha dinakara iva nijajanamānasasarojaṣaṭpadavidita sakalavedavidyotamāna mānasa nijajanamunijanavandita padanakhanīrapavitrīkṛta gīrvāṇamunimānasavaṃdita caraṇarajaḥprasādasārabhūta jagatāmadhīśa namaste namaste || || 2.3.4.10 || api ca || aṣṭaśaktisahito vanamālī pītacailakusumāvaliśobhaḥ || paṃkajākaravirājitapādaḥ pātu māmavahitendriyavargaḥ || 11 || bhaktahṛtkamalarājitamūrtirduṣṭadaityadalanotthitakīrtiḥ || baddhaseturavitāśritalokaḥ pātu māmanudinaṃ bhuvaneśaḥ || 12 || sthiracalatrividhatāpahimāṃśurbhāsamānataraṇipratibhāsaḥ || eka eva bahudhā kṛtaveṣo māyayāvatu mahāmatirīśaḥ || 13 || bhaktaciṃtanakṛte kṛtarūpaḥ śaiśavena bahuśāsitabhūpaḥ || vedamārga urudhā hitakārī rītirīśituriyaṃ guṇaśālī || 14 || yajñabhugghṛdayabaṃdhanadhārī viśvamūrtirabalāṃśukahārī|| pālane'pi mahatāṃ bahudeho rāsa eṣa tanumānavatānnaḥ ||15|| premabhaktipuruṣairupalabhyaḥ pūruṣaḥ kṛtasamastanivāsaḥ || dāsyavṛṃdahṛṣito nijadāsaḥ prekṣaṇaikakaruṇovatu viśvam || 16 || kaṃṭhalaṃbitatarakṣunakhāgrakruṣṭagoparamaṇīkucabhāraḥ|| līlayā yuvatibhiḥ kṛtaveṣaḥ śeṣa eṣa bhavatādupaśāṃtyai||17|| daṃḍapāṇirayameva janānāṃ śāsitātmaniyamoktahitānām|| pāvanāya mahatāmanuśālī viśvaduḥkhaśamano bhavatānnaḥ ||18|| evaṃ stutastataḥ sākṣādgaruḍena mahātmanā || pūjārthamājuhāvaināṃ gaṃgāṃ tripathagāminīm ||19|| tataḥ paṃcamukhī sākṣādāvirāsīnnagopari|| tenodakena pādārghaṃ cakāra vinatāsutaḥ ||2.3.4.20|| vriyatāṃ vara ityukto garuḍo hariṇā tataḥ || tavaikavāhanaḥ śrīmānbalavīryaparākramaḥ || ajeyo devadaityānāṃ syāmahaṃ te prasādataḥ || 21 || iyaṃ mannāmavikhyātā sarvapāpaharā śilā || etasyāḥ smaraṇātpuṃsāṃ viṣavyādhirna jāyatām||22|| evamuktvā tatastūṣṇīṃ babhūva vinatāsutaḥ || omityuktvā tato viṣṇuruvācedaṃ vaco hitam ||23|| badarīṃ tvaṃ prayāhīti nāradena niṣevitām || snānaṃ nāradatīrthādāvupavāsatrayaṃ śuciḥ || kṛtvā maddarśanaṃ tatra sulabhaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 24 || ityuktvāṃtarddadhe viṣṇustaḍitsaudāmanī yathā || garuḍastu tataḥ śīghramāgatya badarīṃ mudā || 25 || vahnitīrthaṃ samāsādya śilāmāśritya tatparaḥ || snātvā nāradatīrtheṣu vratacaryāmathākarot || 26 || tatastu nārade tīrthe dṛṣṭvā bhagavataḥ sthitim || namaskṛtya vidhānena tadājñātaḥ puraṃ yayau || 27 || tataḥ prabhṛti trailokye gāruḍīti śilocyate || 28 || || skaṃda uvāca || || vārāhyā vada māhātmyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ hīśvareśvara || kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tasyā abhidhānaṃ tathā katham || 29 || || śiva uvāca || || rasātalātsamuddhṛtya mahīṃ daivatavairiṇam || hiraṇyākṣaṃ raṇe hatvā badarīṃ samupāgataḥ || 2.3.4.30 || ākalpāṃtaṃ mahādevo yogadhāraṇayā sthitaḥ || badaryāḥ sauṣṭhavādeva vidadhe sthitimātmanaḥ || 31 || śilārūpeṇa bhagavānsthitiṃ tatra cakāra ha || tatra gatvā tu manujaḥ snātvā gaṃgājale'male || 32 || dānaṃ dattvā svaśaktyā vai gaṃgāṃbhaḥ śāṃtamānasaḥ || ahorātre sthito bhūtvā japedekāgramānasaḥ || 33 || śilāyāṃ devadṛṣṭiśca tasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate || bahunā kimihoktena yadvadiṣyati sādhakaḥ || 34 || tattasya sidhyati kṣipraṃ yadyapi syātsuduṣkaram || 35 || || || skaṃda uvāca || || nārasiṃhīśilāyāstu māhātmyaṃ vada me prabho || tvatprasādānmahādeva durllabhaṃ śrutavānaham ||36|| || śiva uvāca || || hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā nakhāgreṇaiva līlayā || krodhāgninā pradīptāṃgaḥ pralayānalasannibhaḥ || 37 || tadā devaiḥ samāgatya sthitvā dūre dayālubhiḥ || stuto'sau bhagavāndevo līlayā dhṛtavigrahaḥ || 38 || tadā prasanno harirugravikramaḥ svatejasā vyāptasurāsurottamaḥ || uvāca matto varamāvṛṇīdhvaṃ gīrvāṇanirvāṇa sukhaikahetum || 39 || tadāsurāṇāmadhipaḥ svayaṃbhūruvāca vākyaṃ smitaśobhitānanaḥ || rūpaṃ tavātyugramaśeṣadehināṃ bhayāvahaṃ saṃhara nārasiṃha || 2.3.4.40 || anekadhaitadvidhivadvidhāya nidhāya śailādiṣu divyamūrtim || uvāca kiṃ vaḥ prakaromi kṛtyamahaṃ prasannastridaśāḥ paraṃtapāḥ || 41 || tatomarā ūcuranena caiva rūpeṇa saṃkṣobhitaviśvamūrte || praśāṃtamaṃtaḥsukhahetubaṃdhi caturbhujatvaṃ varamīpsitaṃ naḥ || 42 || tato harirvīkṣya nirīkṣaṇena divyena viśvaṃ prayayau viśālām|| gaṃgājale krīḍati viṣṭacetāḥ surāsurebhyo bhagavānuvāca || 43 || tato'marāḥ śāṃtabhayā athainaṃ nirīkṣya devaṃ jalamadhyasaṃstham || || natvā parikramya tadā samāyayurnirūḍhabhāvāḥ svapuraṃ tataḥ kramāt || 44 || tataḥ samastā ṛṣayastapodhanāḥ samāyayurbhaktibharāvanamrāḥ || nṛsiṃhamatyadbhutavikamaṃ hariṃ samīḍire baddhakarā vacobhiḥ || 45 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || namonamaste jagatāmadhīśa viśveśa viśvābhaya viśvamūrte || kṛpāṃburāśe bhajanīyatīrtha pādāṃbuja śrīśa dayāṃ vidhehi || 46 || eko'si nānā nijamāyayā svayā ghaṭe payo yadvadupādhibhinnam || bhaktecchayopāttavicitravigraha prasīda viśvānana viśvabhāvana || 47 || tataḥ prasanno bhagavānnṛsiṃhaḥ siṃhavikramaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ cāru varaṃ me vriyatāmiti || 48 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || yadi prasanno bhagavankṛpayā jagatāṃ pate || viśālā na parityājyā varo'smākamabhīpsitaḥ || 49 || evamastu tataḥ sarve svāśramaṃ hyṛṣayo yayuḥ || nṛsiṃho'pi śilārūpī jalakrīḍāparo'bhavat || 2.3.4.50 || upavāsatrayaṃ kṛtvā japadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || nṛsiṃharūpiṇaṃ sākṣātpaśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 51 || ya etacchraddhayā martyaḥ śṛṇoti śrāvayañchuciḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto vaikuṃṭhe vasatiṃ labhet||52|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe badarikāśramamāhātmye śivakārttikeyasaṃvāde garuḍaśilā vārāhīśilā nārasiṃhīśilāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4 ||
<2.3.5>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || kimarthaṃ bhagavāṃstatra vasati śraddhayā punaḥ || kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tasya darśanasparśanādibhiḥ || 1 || naivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ cāpi mahāpūjākṛtestathā || pradakṣiṇasya ca phalaṃ brūhi me kṛpayā pitaḥ || 2 || || śiva uvāca || || purā kṛtayugasyādau sarvabhūtahitāya ca || mūrtimānbhagavāṃstatra tapoyogasamāśritaḥ || 3 || tretāyuge hyṛṣigaṇairyogābhyāsaikatatparaḥ || dvāpare samanuprāpte jñānaniṣṭho hi durlabhaḥ || 4 || ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca durdarśo bhagavānabhūt || tato hyṛṣigaṇā devā alabhya bhagavadgatim || 5 || svāyaṃbhuvaṃ padaṃ yātā vismayākulacetasaḥ || tatra gatvā namaskṛtya ūcurlokeśvaraṃ mudā || bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 6 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namaste sarvalokānāmāśrayaḥ śaraṇārtihā || vṛttidaḥ karuṇāpūrṇaḥ pitāmaha sureśvara || nivedanīyā vipadaḥ samuddhartā pitāsi naḥ || 7 || || brahmovāca || || kimarthamāgatā yūyaṃ vismayākulamānasāḥ || militā ṛṣibhiḥ sākaṃ brūtāgamanakāraṇam || 8 || || devā ūcuḥ || || dvāpare samanuprāpte viśālāyāṃ viśāladhīḥ || bhagavāndṛśyate naiva tatra kiṃ kāraṇaṃ vada || 9 || viśālā kiṃ parityaktā tato vā kva gataḥ svayam || aparādhādutāsmākaṃ kathaṃ cāsau prasīdati || 2.3.5.10 || || brahmovāca || || nāhametadvijānāmi śrutaṃ cādya mukhāddhi vaḥ || ko heturdṛkpathātīto bhagavānbhavatāṃ surāḥ || āgacchata vayaṃ yāmastīraṃ kṣīrapayonidheḥ ||11|| ityuktāste purodhāya brahmāṇaṃ tridivaukasaḥ || yayuḥ kṣīrāṃbudhestīramṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ||12|| tatra gatvā jagannāthaṃ devadevaṃ vṛṣākapim || gīrbhiścitrapadārthābhistuṣṭuvurjagadīśvaram || 13 || || brahmovāca || || namaste puruṣādhyakṣa sarvabhūtaguhāśaya || vāsudevākhilādhāra jagaddheto jaganmaya || 14 || tvameva sarvabhūtānāṃ hetuḥ patirutāśrayaḥ || māyāśaktimupāśritya vicarasyekasundara || 15 || eko nānāyate yo'sau naṭavajjāyate'vyayaḥ || vyāpako'pi kṛpālutvādbhaktahṛtpadmaṣaṭpada || dadāti vividhānaṃdaṃ taṃ vaṃde jagatāṃ patim || 16 || || || devā ūcuḥ || || vipadvanāṃte hutabhugjanānāṃ gṛhītasattvastridaśāvanīśaḥ || carācarātmā bhagavānanaṃtaḥ kṛpākaṭākṣairavalokatāṃ naḥ || 17 || sakṛdyannāmapīyūṣarasapānaparaḥ pumān || niḥśreyasaṃ tṛṇamiva manyate taṃ hariṃ bhaje|| 18 || avidyāpratibiṃbatvājjīvabhāvamupāgataḥ || vijñatvādupaśāṃtātmā sa punātu jagattrayam ||19|| || gaṃdharvā ūcuḥ || || pibaṃti ye hareḥ padāṃbusaṃgaleśataḥ payaḥ payo na te punaḥpunaḥ pibaṃti māturaṃkataḥ || prasaṃgato yadā bhidhāsudhāṃ nipīya mānavā mṛtā'mṛtaṃ vrajaṃtyadho na jātu yāṃtyaśaṃkitāḥ || 2.3.5.20 || tataḥ stuto hariḥ sākṣātsiṃdhorutthāya cābravīt || alakṣito'parairbrahmā paraṃ tadveda nāparaḥ || 21 || brahmā tadupadhāryātha natvā tasmai divaukasa || bodhayāmāsa sakalaṃ surāḥ śṛṇuta sādaram || 22 || aṃtarhito'sau bhagavāndṛṣṭvā lokānkumedhasaḥ || śrutvetthaṃ vacanaṃ tasya sarve devā divaṃ yayuḥ ||23|| tato'haṃ yatirūpeṇa tīrthānnāradasaṃjñakāt || uddhṛtya sthāpayiṣyāmi hariṃ lokahitecchayā || 24 || yasya darśanamātreṇa pātakāni mahāntyapi || vilīyaṃte kṣaṇādeva siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛgā iva || 25 || dharmādharmānvijityātha badarīśaṃ vibhuṃ harim || dṛṣṭvā muktimupāyāṃti vinā''yāsaṃ ṣaḍānana || 26 || tyaktaprāyāṇi tīrthāni hariṇā kalikālataḥ || badarīṃ samanuprāpya sākṣādevāvatiṣṭhate || 27 || kalikālamanuprāpya muktiryeṣāmabhīpsitā || draṣṭavyā badarī taistu hitvā tīrthānyaśeṣataḥ || 28 || vinā jñānena yogena tīrthāṭanapariśramaiḥ || ekena janmanā jaṃtuḥ kaivalyaṃ padamaśnute || 29 || janmāṃtarasahasraistu yena cārādhito hariḥ || sa gacchedbadarīṃ draṣṭuṃ yatra jaṃturna śocati || 2.3.5.30 || badarībadarītyuktvā prasaṃgānmanujottamaḥ || saṃsāratimirābādhe dīpamujvālayatyasau || 31 || yathā dīpāvalokena tamobādhā na jāyate || tathaiva badarīṃ dṛṣṭvā puṃso mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ ||32|| darśanādyasya pāpāni rudaṃtyavyāhatāni ca || muktimārgamupālakṣya taṃ vaṃde badarīpatim || ||33|| saśailakānanā bhūmirdaśadhā dakṣiṇīkṛtā || hareḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ tadvadbadaryāṃ tatpadepade || 34 || aśvamedhe tu yatpuṇyaṃ vājapeyaśatena ca || hareḥ pradakṣiṇāttadvadbadaryāṃ tatpadepade || 35 || caturmāse tu yatpuṇyaṃ brahmāṃḍadānatastathā || hareḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ tadvadbadaryāṃ tatpadepade || 36 || atikṛcchrairmahākṛcchraiśchāṃdasaiḥ sukṛtaṃ bhavet || hareḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ tadvadbadaryāṃ tatpadepade || 37 || badaryāṃ viṣṇunaivedyaṃ sikthamātraṃ ṣaḍānana || aśanācchodhayetpāpaṃ tuṣāgniriva kāṃcanam || 38 || yadannaṃ bhagavānatti ṛṣibhirnnāradādibhiḥ || tatsattvaśuddhaye sarvairbhoktavyamavicāritam || 39 || amarā api yannūnaṃ vyājenecchanti sarvataḥ || bhoktuṃ badarikāṃ viṣṇornaivedyaṃ yāṃti tatparāḥ || 2.3.5.40 || bhojanānaṃtaraṃ viṣṇoḥ pragacchanti svamālayam || prahlādapramukhā bhaktāḥ praviśaṃti hareḥ padam || 41 || bālyayauvanavārddhakye yatpāpaṃ jñānataḥ kṛtam || naivedyabhakṣaṇādviṣṇorbadaryāṃ tadvilīyate || 42 || prāṇāṃtaṃ yasya pāpasya prāyaścittaṃ prakīrtitam || viṣṇorniveditaṃ bhuktvā badaryyāṃ tannivarttate ||46|| tīrthāṃtareṣu yatnena muktiṃ gacchati mānavaḥ || naivedyabhakṣaṇādviṣṇoḥ sālokyaṃ labhate naraḥ ||44|| hṛdi rūpaṃ mukhe nāma naivedyamudare hareḥ || pādodakaṃ sanirmālyaṃ mastake yasya so'cyutaḥ||45|| brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ || naivedyabhakṣaṇādviṣṇorbadaryāṃ yāṃti saṃkṣayam || 46 || badarīsadṛśaṃ kṣetraṃ naivedyasadṛśaṃ vasu || nāradīyasamaṃ kṣetraṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||47|| badarī yatnato gamyā bhoktavyaṃ tanniveditam || draṣṭavyo bhagavānvahnitīrthe snānaṃ sudurlabham || 48 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni vratāni niyamāstathā || pādodakaṃ viśālāyāṃ pāvanaṃ purato bhavet || 49 || kiṃ tasya dānaistapasā tīrthāṭanapariśramaiḥ || badaryāṃ viṣṇupādodabiṃdumātraṃ labhedyadi || 2.3.5.50 || prāyaścittāni jalpaṃti tāvadeva ṣaḍānana || yāvanna labhyate viṣṇorbadaryāṃ caraṇodakam || 51 || anāyāsena yeṣāṃ vā icchā muktipathe nṛṇām || karttavyaṃ taiḥ prayatnena viṣṇornaivedyabhakṣaṇam || 52 || ye narāḥ pratigṛhṇaṃti pāpāḥ saṃsārabhāginaḥ || yātrākṛtaṃ phalaṃ teṣāṃ na kadācitprajāyate || || 53 || naivedyaniṃdanādviṣṇorniṃdyaṃte te tamogatāḥ || naivedyabhakṣaṇātsattvaśuddhireva na saṃśayaḥ || 54 || naivedyaṃ svayamānīya brāhmaṇānbhojayaṃti ye || tulāpuruṣadānena kiṃ phalaṃ te kṛtārthinaḥ || 55 || kurukṣetre samāsādya rāhugraste divākare || mahādānena yatpuṇyaṃ badaryyāṃ grāsamātrataḥ || 56 || badarīkṣetramāsādya grāsamātraṃ prayatnataḥ || upāyo'yaṃ mahāṃstatra badaryāṃ haritoṣaṇe || yatibhyo bhojanādviṣṇoraparādhyapi vallabhaḥ || 57 || na viṣṇoḥ sadṛśo devo na viśālā samā purī || na bhikṣusadṛśaṃ pātramṛṣitīrthasamaṃ na hi || 58 || cāturmāsyaṃ prakurvaṃti ye narāḥ puṇyaśālinaḥ|| teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ brahmaṇāpi na śakyate || 59 || bhikṣukāṇāṃ phalāvāptirviśeṣādiha kīrtyate || vedāṃtaśravaṇātpuṇyaṃ daśadhā yatprakīrtitam || 2.3.5.60 || badarī dṛṣṭimātreṇa bhikṣukāṇāṃ tadiṣyate || cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa kaivalyaphalabhāginaḥ || 61 || nyāsino badarīsthāne vināyāsena putraka || ye mūrkhā jāḍyamāpannā dambhakāṣāyavāsasaḥ || badarīdarśanātteṣāṃ muktiḥ karatale sthitā || 62 || jñānino'jñānino vāpi nyāsino niyatavratā || draṣṭavyā badarī taistu phalāni samabhīpsubhiḥ || 63 || śrutvā'dhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ prasaṃgenāpi mānavaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe badarikāśramamāhātmye śivakārttikeyasaṃvāde paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<2.3.6>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || karādvigalitaṃ yatra kapālaṃ te maheśvara || tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ kṛpayā vada me pitaḥ || 1 || || || śiva uvāca || || atiguhyamidaṃ tīrthaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam || brahmahā'pi naro yatra snānamātreṇa śuddhyati || 2 || paṃca tīrthāni tiṣṭhaṃti kapāle pāpamocane || tatra snānaṃ tapo dānaṃ sarvamakṣayamiṣyate || 3 || piṃḍaṃ vidhāya vidhivannarakāttārayetpitṝn || pitṛtīrthamidaṃ proktaṃ gayāto'ṣṭaguṇādhikam || 4 || tilatarppaṇato yāṃti pitaraḥ svargamuttamam || 5 || ahorātraṃ sthiro bhūtvā japaniṣṭhaḥ samāhitaḥ || tasyeṣṭasiddhirmahatī tatkṣaṇādeva jāyate || 6 || pāralaukikakarmāṇi sarvāṇyavyāhatāni ca || kapālamocane tīrthe nādhikaṃ pitṛkarmaṇi || 7 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kutra vā brahmatīrthaṃ vai phalaṃ vā kīdṛśaṃ bhavet || ke vā tatra vasaṃtīha kṛpayā vada me pitaḥ || 8 || śiva uvāca || || ekadā viṣṇunābhyambhoruhasthasya prajāpateḥ || vedānmukhāṃbujāddhṛtvā jagmaturmadhukaiṭabhau || 9 || tato hyutthāya śayanātsisṛkṣurabjasaṃbhavaḥ || sraṣṭuṃ vinā'gamaṃ loke na śaśāka hṛtasmṛtiḥ || 2.3.6.10 || tadā badarikāmetya hariṇā pratipālitām || tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā bhagavaṃtaṃ sanātanam || 11 || tataḥ kuṃḍātsamudbhūto hayaśīrṣo nijāyudhaḥ || pītāṃbaradharaḥ śuklaścaturbāhuḥ sudṛptadṛk || 12 || atyadbhutaḥ prakaṭakaṭhoralocanaścalacchaṭāvicchuritameghaḍaṃbaraḥ || svatejasā hatanikhilaprabhākulaḥ kṛpānvito druhiṇapuraḥsaro'bhavat || 13 || nirīkṣya taṃ vidhirapi vismayākulaḥ praṇamya ca stutimakarotprasannadṛk || 14 || || || brahmovāca || || namaḥ kamalanābhāya namaste kamalāśraya || namaste kamalāvāsaviśālavanamāline || 15 || namo vijñānabhātrāya guhāvāsa nivāsine || hṛṣīkeśāya śāṃtāya tubhyaṃ bhagavate namaḥ || 16 || svabhaktarakṣaṇakṛte dhṛtadehāya śārṅgiṇe || anaṃtakleśanāśāya gadine brahmaṇe namaḥ |||| 17 || saṃsāravividhāsāranivṛttikṛtakarmaṇe || rakṣitre sarvajaṃtūnāṃ viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ || 18 || namo viśvaṃbharāśeṣanivṛttaguṇavṛttaye || surāsuravarastaṃbhanivṛttisthitikīrtaye ||19|| itīritaḥ surapatinā maheśvaro hṛdisthito'khilavidaśeṣakarmabhiḥ || tato'ntaraṃ sapadi gato nibadhya tau suradruhau kila nijaghāna līlayā || 2.3.6.20 || tato nigamamādāya brahmaṇoṃ'tikamāyayau|| dattvā svanigamaṃ tasmai svastho'bhūtsa samīḍitaḥ || 21 || tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ brahmaṇā prakaṭīkṛtam || brahmakuṃḍamiti khyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 22 || yasya darśanamātreṇa mahāpātakino janāḥ || vimuktakilbiṣāḥ sadyo brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 23 || snānaṃ kurvaṃti ye lokā vratacaryāmathāpi vā || brahmalokamatikramya viṣṇulokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 24 || || skaṃda uvāca || || tataḥ kimakaroddhātā labdhvā vedāñjanārddanāt || etadanyacca sarvaṃ me kṛpayā vada sāṃpratam || 25 || || mahādeva uvāca || || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ dṛṣṭvā badarikāśramam || matirna jāyate gaṃtuṃ brahmaṇā saha putraka || 26 || tatastu vikalaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇaṃ janavāsinaḥ || siddhāstu vidhivatstutvā praṇipatyedamabruvan || 27 || || siddhā ūcuḥ || || ājñā bhagavataḥ kāryā sarvaiḥ sthāvarajaṃgamaiḥ || bhagavānsarvajaṃtūnāṃ karttā hartā pitā guruḥ || 28 || sthitirbrahmāṃtike vaśca hariṇaivānukalpitā || nivṛttirvartate caiṣā tathāpyetannirāmayam ||29|| ekāṃte dravarūpeṇa mūrtirvo'trāvatiṣṭhatām || dvitīyā brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ brahmalokaṃ vrajetpunaḥ || 2.3.6.30 || tataḥ sahṛdayā vedā dvaidhīkṛtātmarūpakāḥ || brahmaṇā brahmalokaṃ te yayuḥ sārddhaṃ praharṣitāḥ || 31 || tatastrilokaṃ vidhivatsasarja caturānanaḥ || dravarūpeṣu vedeṣu snānadānatapaḥkriyāḥ || kṛtā viccheditā na syuryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 32 || phalamuddiśya kurvaṃti upavāsatrayaṃ narāḥ || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ vyākhyātāro na saṃśayaḥ || 33 || anukrameṇa tiṣṭhaṃti vedāścatvāra eva ca || ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyā bhagavatpārśvavartinaḥ || 34 || ye puṇyavaṃto'kaluṣā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ || te vedaghoṣaṃ viralāḥ śṛṇvaṃtyapi kalau yuge || 35 || caturṇāmapi vedānāmudagasti sarasvatī || japtātha sā nṛṇāṃ haṃti jaḍatāṃ jalarūpiṇī || 36 || sarasvatyā jale sthitvā japaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ || manostasya na vicchedaḥ kadācidapi jāyate || 37 || vedavyāso'pi bhagavānyatprasādādudāradhīḥ || purāṇasaṃhitārthajño'bhavadatra na saṃśayaḥ || 38 || trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ hitāya jagatāṃ patiḥ || sthāpayāmāsa vidhinā vāṇīṃ vāgvibhavapradām || 39 || darśanasparśanasnānapūjāstutyabhivandanaiḥ || sarasvatyā na vicchedaḥ kule tasya kadācana || 2.3.6.40 || mantrasiddhirviśeṣeṇa sarasvatyāstaṭe nṛṇām || japatāmaciraṇaiva jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||41|| bahunā kimihoktena vāṇī vāgvibhavapradā || dravarūpadharā nṛṇāṃ darśanātpūtirujjvalā || 42 || tato'rvāgdakṣiṇe bhāge dravadhāreti viśrutam || tīrthamiṃdrapadaṃ yatra tapaścakre puraṃdaraḥ || 43 || sudāruṇaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā paritoṣya janārddanam || padamaiṃdraṃ samālebhe surāsuranamaskṛtam || 44 || tapo dānaṃ japo homo vratāni niyamā yamāḥ || tatrānantaguṇaṃ proktaṃ tattīrthamatidurlabham || 45 || pratimāse trayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ haritoṣaṇe || snātvā sutīrthe sutrāmācchandaṃ copetya saṃgataḥ || 46 || upavāsadvayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā janārddanam || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śakraloke mahīyate || 47 || tatraiva mānasodbhedaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || durlabhaḥ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ yatra te syurmaharṣayaḥ || 48 || mānasaṃ cidacidgranthimudgrathnaṃti ca sarvataḥ || mānasodbheva ityākhyā ṛṣibhiḥ parigīyate || 49 || bhiṃdaṃti hṛdayagraṃthīśchiṃdanti bahusaṃśayam || karmāṇi kṣapayantyasmānmānasodbheda ityabhūt || 2.3.6.50 || yadi bhāgyavaśādatra biṃdumātraṃ labhennaraḥ || tatkṣaṇānmuktimāpnoti kimatastvadhikaṃ bhavet || 51 || giridarīnilaye nivasatyamī ṛṣigaṇāḥ phalamūlajalāśanāḥ || jitamanoviṣayāḥ śitabuddhayaḥ kalibhayādiva pāpabhayākulāḥ || 52 || phalasamīraṇagahvaranirjharāśramabharādupalabdhapaṭottamāḥ || triṣavaṇakramanirjitadurjayendriyaparākramaṇā munayastvamī || 53 || sādhanāni bahūnyeva kāyakleśakarāṇyaho || sulabhaṃ sādhanaṃ loke mānasodbhedadarśanam || 54 || yasmindine jalaṃ caitallabhate puṇyavāñjanaḥ || bhavati vyāsasadṛśo yamapitṛsamaḥ kramāt || 55 || kāmyatīrthamidaṃ nṝṇāṃ kāmanāvaśakṛtpunaḥ || akāmatastu muktiḥ syādubhayoreṣa niścayaḥ || 56 || yadi kaścitpramādena kāmanāṃ kurute naraḥ || phalaṃ bhuktvā punarmuktirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||57|| maharādiṣu lokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān || bhoge bhukte punaryāti kāmanāvaśato janaḥ ||58|| puruṣārthasamāvāptyai yatanīyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || mānasodbhedane tīrthe nāpetyatreti me matiḥ || 59 || mānasodbhedanātpratyagdiśi sarvamanoharam || vasudhāreti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyadurlabham || || 2.3.6.60 || trilokyāṃ sarvatīrthebhyaḥ śreṣṭho badarikāśramaḥ || śrutvā tannāradātsarve vasavaḥ samupāgatāḥ || 61 || triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi tapaḥ paramadāruṇam || dalāṃbuprāśanāścakrustataḥ siddhimupāyayuḥ || 62 || bhagavaddarśanātprāptānaṃdanirvṛttaviklamāḥ || hṛdayānandasaṃdohapraphullitamukhāṃbujāḥ || 63 || dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ varaṃ labdhvā manoramam|| haribhaktisukhaiśvaryyaṃ paraṃ labdhvā mudaṃ yayuḥ||64|| atra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā pūjayitvā janārddanam|| iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyaṃte paramaṃ padam ||65|| atra puṇyavatāṃ jyotirdṛśyate jalamadhyataḥ|| yaddṛṣṭvā na punarbhūyo garbhavāsaṃ prapadyate || 66 || ye'śuddhapitṛjāḥ pāpāḥ pāṣaṃḍamativṛttayaḥ || na teṣāṃ śirasi prāyaḥ pataṃtyāpaḥ kadācana || 67 || dinatrayaṃ śucirbhūtvā pūjayitvā janārdanam || upoṣya bhagavadbhaktyā siddhānpaśyaṃti sādhavaḥ ||68|| ye tatra capalāstathyaṃ na vadaṃti ca lolupāḥ || parihāsaparadravyaparastrīkapaṭāgrahāḥ ||69|| malacailāvṛtā'śāṃtā'śucayastyaktasatkriyāḥ || teṣāṃ malinacittānāṃ phalamatra na jāyate || 2.3.6.70 || ye tatra sādhakāḥ śāṃtā viralā vidhivartmagāḥ || teṣāṃ japastapohomo dānavratajapakriyāḥ || || 71 || kriyamāṇā yathāśaktyā hyakṣayyaphaladāyakāḥ || 72 || yatkiṃcicchubhakarmāṇi kriyamāṇāni dehinām || mahadādiphalaṃ dadyurniḥśreyasamanuttamam || 73 || śrāvaṇīyamiha kiṃ phalādhikaṃ yatra yāṃti vibudhāḥ phalārthinaḥ || pūjitādanu hareḥ priyārthinaḥ svargamārganiratāḥ pramodinaḥ || 74 || yatra saṃti na ca vighnakāriṇaḥ karmaṇāṃ haribhayātsusidhyati || nirviśaṃti ca phalaṃ vivekinaḥ karmamārganiratāḥ sudehinaḥ || 75 || ye paṭhaṃtyatha ca pāṭhayaṃtyaho puṇyatīrthaviṣayaṃ prakāśitam || bhaktibhāvasamalaṃkṛtāśca te saṃprayānti harimaṃdiraṃ śubham || 76 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe badarikāśramamāhātmye śivakārttikeyasaṃvāde vasudhārātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || ||
<2.3.7>
|| śiva uvāca || || tato nairṛtyadigbhāge paṃcadhārāḥ pataṃtyadhaḥ || prabhāsaṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva gayāṃ naimiṣameva ca || kurukṣetraṃ vijānīhi dravarūpaṃ ṣaḍānana || 1 || purā te brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ gatā malinarūpiṇaḥ || pāpināṃ pāpadoṣeṇa vikṛtāḥ kṛtabuddhayaḥ || 2 || tatra gatvā namaskṛtya brahmāṇaṃ lokabhāvanam || ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarve nijāgamanakāraṇam || 3 || tacchrutvā dhyānamālaṃbya prahasya jagadīśvaraḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ cāru smṛtvā badarīkāśramam || 4 || mā bhaiṣṭa gacchata kṣipraṃ harerbadarikāśramam || yasya nirdeśamātreṇa sadyaḥ puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||5|| tataste harṣavegena namaskṛtya pitāmaham || jagmurutphullanayanā viśālāmamitaprabhām || 6 || yasya nirveśamātreṇa tatkṣaṇādvigatenasaḥ || tato dvirūpamāsthāya svasthānaṃ yayurutsukāḥ || 7 || dravarūpeṇa cānyena paṃca tiṣṭhaṃti nirmalāḥ || teṣu snātvā vidhānena kṛtvā nityakriyāṃ śuciḥ || 8 || tattattīrthaphalaṃ labdhvā yātyaṃte paramaṃ padam || paṃcopavāsa nirataḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam || 9 || iha bhogānbahūnbhuktvā hareḥ sālokyamāpnuyāt || 2.3.7.10 || tatastu vimalaṃ tīrthaṃ somakuṃḍābhidhaṃ param || tapaścakāra bhagavānsomo yatra kalānidhiḥ || 11 || || skanda uvāca || || somakuṇḍasya māhātmyaṃ vada me vadatāṃ vara || tvatprasādādahaṃ śrotumicchāmi parameśvara || 12 || || śiva uvāca || || purātritanayaḥ śrīmānsomaḥ saṃprāpya yauvanam|| śrutvā svarvāsināṃ saukhyaṃ gaṃdharvebhyo muhurmuhuḥ || tadā svapitaraṃ prāyātpraṣṭuṃ tallabhate katham || 13 || || soma uvāca || || bhagavansarvadharmajña karuṇāmṛtasāgara || kathaṃ vā labhyate svargaḥ sarveṣāmuttamottamaḥ || 14 || grahanakṣatratārāṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ patiḥ prabho || syāmahaṃ yena taṃ yatnaṃ kṛpayā vada me pitaḥ || 15 || || atriruvāca || || tapasārādhya goviṃdaṃ yamairvā niyamaiḥ suta || kiṃ durllabhaṃ tu sādhūnāmiha loke paratra ca || 16 || tatastu nāradācchrutvā kṣetraṃ paramanirmalam || jagāma badarīṃ natvā pitaraṃ diśamuttarām || 17 || tatra gatvā phalairmedhyairviṣṇoḥ pūjāmakalpayat || jajāpa paramaṃ jāpyamaṣṭākṣaraṃ manoharam || 18 || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi bhagavatparam || tapastepe'tiparamaṃ sarvalokabhayāvaham || 19 || tatastuṣṭaḥ samāgatya bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || uvāca somaṃ vidhivadvaraṃ varaya suvrata ||2.3.7.20|| tataḥ somaḥ samutthāya namaskṛtya punaḥpunaḥ || grahanakṣatratārāṇāmoṣadhīnāmahaṃ patiḥ || dvijānāmapi sarveṣāṃ bhūyāsaṃ te prasādataḥ || 21 || || hariruvāca || || varamanyaṃ vṛṇuṣvāto durllabhaṃ tvaṃ bhavādṛśām || varānno varayāmāsa tadā taṃ himajātmaja || 22 || tato'tivimanāḥ somaḥ punastepe tapo mahat || triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi devamānena putraka ||23|| tadāsau karuṇāpūrṇahṛdayo bhagavānagāt || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varado'haṃ tavāgrataḥ || somastu tādṛśaṃ vavre tacchrutvāntarddadhe hariḥ||24|| tato'tivimanāḥ somaḥ punastepe tapo mahat|| catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ suduṣkaram ||25|| tatastuṣṭo hariḥ sākṣācchaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ cāru somaṃ śrāṃtaṃ taponidhim ||26|| uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya suvrata || tapasārādhito nūnaṃ tvayāhaṃ tapasāṃ nidhiḥ || 27 || || soma uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo bhavānmahyaṃ bhagavānvaradarṣabhaḥ || grahanakṣatratārāṇāmādhipatyaṃ prayaccha me || tathauṣadhīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ yāminyāśca jagatpate || 28 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || durllabhaṃ prārthitaṃ vatsa vitarāmi tathāpyaham || evamastu tataḥ sarve samāgatya divau kasaḥ || abhiṣiktavaṃto vidhivatsomaṃ rājānamādṛtāḥ || 29 || tato vimānamārūḍho rathena śubhravāsasā || abhiṣṭutaḥ surairabhūddivaṃ gato niśākaraḥ || || 2.3.7.30 || tataḥ prabhṛti tīrthaṃ tatsomakuṃḍeti durllabham || yaddṛṣṭimātrānmanujā gatadoṣā bhavaṃti hi || 31 || yadupasparśanādyāṃti somalokaṃ viniṃditāḥ || yatra snātvā vidhānena saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||32|| somalokaṃ vinirbhidya viṣṇulokaṃ prapadyate || upavāsatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā janārddanam || || 33 || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || trirātreṇa sthito bhūtvā pūjayitvā janārddanam || japaṃ kurvanviśeṣeṇa maṃtrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || || 34 || karmaṇā manasā vācā yatkṛtaṃ pātakaṃ nṛbhiḥ || tatsarvaṃ kṣayamāyāti somakuṃḍekṣaṇādiha || 35 || tatastu dvādaśādityatīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ param || yatra taptvā punaḥ kṛcchraṃ kāśyapaḥ sūryatāṃ yayau || 36 || durllabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu tapaḥsiddhyekakāraṇam || ravivāreṣu saptamyāṃ saṃkrātyāṃ vidhivannaraḥ || saptajanmakṛtātpāpātsnānamātreṇa śuddhyati || 37 || pārākaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā pūjanīyo janārddanaḥ || sūryaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || || 38 || mahārogābhibhūtastu snātvā pītvā jalaṃ śuciḥ || rogamukto'cirādeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 39 || catuḥsrotaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ vilocanamanoharam || dharmārthakāmamokṣāste tiṣṭhaṃti dravarūpiṇaḥ || 2.3.7.40 || harerājñānusāreṇa kṣetre'sminvaiṣṇave svayam || puruṣārthā dravībhūtā bhūtānāṃ muktihetavaḥ || || 41 || pūrvādidikṣu kramasanniviṣṭā dharmapradhānā iva rūpabhājaḥ || bhajaṃti ye tānkramasanniviṣṭānprasannataiṣāṃ satataṃ bhaveddhi || 42 || nānyatra kṣetre militāḥ kathaṃciccatvāra ete tridaśairalabhyāḥ || tānagrimaṃ janma javena labdhvā paśyaṃti pūrvārjitapuṇyapuṃjāḥ || 43 || ye durjanā durjanasaṃgabhājaḥ kṣamārjavaprāṇajayapradhānāḥ || krīḍāmṛgā grāmyavadhūjanānāṃ na te prapaśyaṃtyacirātpumarthān||44|| tathaiva paśyaṃtyacireṇa tattvajñānaikahetūnapi tānpumarthān || 45 || atra brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ || parvaṇi prayatāḥ snātuṃ samāyāṃti ṣaḍānana || 46 || tataḥ satyapadaṃnāma tīrthaṃ sarvamanoharam || trikoṇākāramevaitatkuṃḍaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam || ekādaśyāṃ haristatra svayamāyāti pāvane ||47|| tatpaścādṛṣayaḥ sarve munayaśca tapodhanāḥ || snātumāyāṃti vidhivatkuṃḍe satyapadābhidhe ||48|| gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ yatra madhyāhne harivāsare || gānaṃ śṛṇvaṃti viralāḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ || 49 || darśanādyasya tīrthasya pātakāni mahāṃtyapi || palāyaṃte bhayenaiva siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛgā iva ||2.3.7.50|| svaśākhoktavidhānena snānaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || satyalokamavāpnoti tato naiḥśreyasaṃ padam || 51 || ahorātraṃ śucirbhūtvā upoṣya ca janārddanam || pūjayitvā yathāśaktyā sa jīvanmuktibhājanaḥ || 52 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca trikoṇasthāḥ samāhitāḥ || tapaḥ kurvaṃtyanudinaṃ sarvalokāditoṣaṇam || 53 || trikoṇamaṃḍitaṃ tīrthaṃ nāmnā satyapadapradam || darśanīyaṃ prayatnena sarvapāpamumukṣubhiḥ || 54 || japaṃ tapo haristotraṃ pūjāṃ stutyabhivaṃdanam || māhātmyaṃ kurvatāṃ vaktuṃ brahmaṇāpi na śakyate || 55 || tato'tivimalaṃ nāma naranārāyaṇāśramam || dvividhaṃ dṛśyate tatra pāthaḥ paramanirmalam || 56 || ubhābhyāmubhayoḥ prītirbhavatīti viniścitam || tatra snātvā prayatnena pūjayitvā janārddanam || sarvapāpavinirmuktastatkṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 57 || tato nārāyaṇāvāsaśikhare vimalākṛti || tīrthaṃ pavitramurvaśyā abhivyaktikaraṃ bhavet || 58 || || skanda uvāca || || abhivyaktiḥ kathaṃ tasyā urvaśyāḥ śikhare pitaḥ || kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tatra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ vada ||59|| || śiva uvāca || || dharmasyapatnī mūrtyāsīttasyāṃ jātau ṣaḍānana || naranārāyaṇau sākṣādbhagavāneva kevalam || 2.3.7.60 || pitrorājñāmanuprāpya tapo'rdhaṃ kṛtamānasau || ubhayornagayostau tu tapomūrtī iva sthitau || 61 || tau dṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ śakraḥ preṣayāmāsa manmatham || sagaṇaṃ tapaso dhvaṃso yathā syādgandhamādanam || 62 || vikramya vidhivatte tu nārāyaṇabalodayam || jñātvā hatamanaskāstānuvāca jagatīpatiḥ || 63 || || hariruvāca || || kimarthamāgatā yūyamātithyaṃ gṛhyatāmiti || 64 || ityuktvā phalamūlāni tebhyo dattvorvaśīṃ tathā || dattvāntardhimagādeva paśyatāṃ vighnakāriṇīm || 65 || te tu gatvā divaṃ bhīte śakrāyocurbalaṃ hareḥ || śakrastāmurvaśīṃ prāpya harṣaṇaikayuto'bhavat || 66 || tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamurvaśī nāmataḥ pṛthak || prasiddhaṃ yatra bhagavānsvayamāste tapomayaḥ || 67 || tatra snātvā vidhānena upoṣya rajanidvayam || pūjayitvā haristatra naro nārāyaṇo bhavet || 68 || urvaśīkuṇḍamāsādya kāmanāvaśato naraḥ || urvaśīlokamāpnoti snānamātreṇa putraka || 69 || sadaiva bhagavāṃstatra urvaśīkuṃḍa sannidhau || bhūtānāṃ bhāvayanbhavyaṃ tapomūrtirvyavasthitaḥ || 2.3.7.70 || āmodaṃ tadupari vai prabhañjano'pi śrībharturvahati padāṃbujaikalabdham || yatsaṃgātkaliyugakalmaṣāturāṇāmutsaṃge na bhavati pāpabhārapākaḥ || 71 || yatsaṃgāddharṣamupāvahatpadaśrīnirviṇṇo girivivarecyutaikasevī || śrībhartuścaraṇayugaṃ vahansamantādabhyeti praśamamahastapaḥsamīre ||72|| gīrvāṇānupahasati svaghena pūrṇaḥ kīṭo'pipraśamitadurnayo nirīhaḥ|| yatrasthaḥ kusumanivedamātmayogaparyuṣṭaṃ jahadupayāsyate padaṃ tat || 73 || yatretvā munimatayo bahiḥpadārthānnāpaśyannihitapadāṃbujaikabhājaḥ || yatrasthaḥ svayamapi gopatirjanānāmādhatte svapadamanukramāgatānām || 74 || bahūni saṃti tīrthāni girau nārāyaṇāśrite || sarvapāpaharāṇyāśu tānyahaṃ veda no janaḥ || 75 || saṃsārakuhare ghore yatra sthagitamātmanaḥ || urvaśīkuṇḍamāsādya dinamekaṃ vasennaraḥ || 76 || urvaśīdakṣiṇe bhāge āyudhāni jagatpateḥ || vidyaṃte darśanātteṣāṃ na śastrabhayabhāgbhavet || 77 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sālokyaṃ labhate hareḥ ||78|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe badarikāśramamāhātmye śivakārttikeyasaṃvāde pañcadhārāditīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptamodhyāyaḥ || 7 || || ||
<2.3.8>
|| śiva uvāca || || brahmakuṇḍāddakṣiṇato narāvāsagirirmahān || yatra bhagavatā meruḥ sthāpito lokasundaraḥ || 1 || || skanda uvāca || || kathaṃ bhagavatā meruḥ sthāpito narasannidhau || mahatkautūhalaṃ tāta kathyatāṃ yadi rocate || 2 || || mahādeva uvāca || || yadā bhagavato vāso viśālāyāṃ samāgataḥ || devā maharṣayaḥ siddhāḥ savidyādharacāraṇāḥ ||3|| vihāya meruśṛṃgāṇi bhagavaddarśanotsukāḥ || bhagavaddarśanāhlādatiraskṛtasurālayāḥ || 4 || tadā tu bhagavāṃsteṣāṃ sukhahetoḥ ṣaḍānana || utpādya meruśṛṃgāṇi kareṇaikena līlayā || sthāpayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ bhagavānprītivarddhanaḥ ||5|| tataḥ sarve samālokya giriṃ kāṃcananirmitam || prasannāstuṣṭuvuḥ sarve nārāyaṇamanāmayam||6|| ||devā ūcuḥ|| || yosmatsukhāya bhavaviśramaṇāya bibhrallīlātanūḥ kanakaśailamihānināya || jetā surārddanaśataṃ tridaśaikapakṣastasmai vidhema nama ugratapaḥśriyāya||7|| yadyatkaroti kṛpayā kṛpaṇārtitūlaśailāgnirāśritakṛdekavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥ|| svenaiva tena karaṇena sa tuṣyatāṃ no yasyānvakāri puruṣeṇa na kenacidvai ||8|| asmākamunnatadhiyāṃ vidadhāti samyakchikṣāṃ piteva karuṇo nijalābhapūrṇaḥ|| trailokyarakṣaṇavicakṣaṇadṛṣṭipātapūrṇāmṛtāṃbudhirasau vipadaḥ prapāyāt || 9 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || yenādhyastaṃ bhāti samastaṃ jagadekaṃ krīḍābhāṃḍaṃ satyatayā'jasya vibhūmnaḥ || bhānāṃ vṛdaṃ yadvadanepyāśritamūrtistasmai nityaṃ śāśvata tubhyaṃ praṇamāma || 2.3.8.10 || || siddhā ūcuḥ || || yatkṛpālavata eva mahāṃtaḥ siddhimīyuritare bhavabhājaḥ || te'cireṇa bhavabhīmapayodhiṃ tīrṇavaṃta iti naḥ sumanīṣā ||11|| || vidyādharā ūcuḥ|| || vibho sadguṇagrāma kalyāṇamūrte pareśāna saṃmānasaṃtānaheto || bhavatpādapadmāsavasvādamattāḥ kṛtārthā na citraṃ bhavatyatra kiṃcit ||12|| tatastuṣṭo'tha bhagavāṃsteṣāmāsīddivaukasām || varaṃ vṛṇudhvamityuktāste procurvaradarṣabham||13|| parituṣṭo bhavānsākṣāddevadevo ramāpatiḥ|| badarī na tvayā tyājyā na ca meruḥ kadācana||14|| meruśṛṃgaṃ prapaśyaṃti ye janāḥ puṇyabhāginaḥ || teṣāṃ vai tvatprasādena merau vāsaḥ prajāyatām||15|| tatra bhuktvā cirādbhogānbhūyādante layastvayi|| evamastviti cābhāṣya tatraivāṃtarhito hariḥ || 16 || tataḥ prabhṛti te sarve meruśṛṃgavihāriṇaḥ || naranārāyaṇasyāṃte pālyamānā muhurmuhuḥ||17|| kadāciddivi tiṣṭhaṃti kadācinmerumadhyataḥ|| nirviśaṃkā nirudvegā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ||18|| bhagavānapi tatraiva nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati|| dhanurbāṇadharaḥ śrīmāṃstapasā pāvakopamaḥ|| ānaṃdamṛṣivṛṃdasya janayaṃstapa āsthitaḥ || 19 || tatastu paramaṃ tīrthaṃ lokapālābhivaṃditam || yatra saṃsthāpayāmāsa lokapālānhariḥ svayam ||2.3.8.20|| || skaṃda uvāca || || kathaṃ bhagavatā tatra lokapālāśca sthāpitāḥ || mahatkautūhalaṃ tāta kathayasva mahāmate || 21 || || śiva uvāca || || ekadā merumadhyasthāśrayāniha haranhariḥ|| devānāmṛṣimukhyānāṃ caritaṃ draṣṭumudyataḥ ||21|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya namaskṛtya divaukasaḥ || ūcuste vinayātsarve prasīda bhagavanvibho || 23 || kṣaṇaṃ viśrāmya vidhivaddṛṣṭvā tāṃ viralāṃ bhuvam || sānnidhyamṛṣidevānāmayuktaṃ bhāvayanmithaḥ || 24 || tataḥ prahasya bhagavānuvāca madhusūdanaḥ || lokapālānsamāhūya nātra stheyaṃ bhavadvidhaiḥ || 25 || ṛṣayastāpasāḥ siddhāḥ sastrīkā nivasaṃti hi || bhavadvidhānāmāsthānaṃ pureva kalpitaṃ mayā ||26|| tataḥ sa tvarito gatvā ramye girivare hariḥ || lokapālānsamāhūya sthāpayāmāsa tānguha || 27 || tatraiva śailadaṃḍena hatvāgniṃ jalakāṃkṣayā || krīḍāpuṣkaraṇīṃ teṣāṃ nirmame sumanoharāma || 28 || sastrīkā yatra gīrvāṇā vicaraṃti nijecchayā || gāyaṃti svanumodaṃti gaṃdharvāstridivaukasām || 29 || vanāni kusumāmodaramyāṇi paritoṣataḥ || dināni yatra gacchaṃti kṣaṇaprāyāṇi dehinām || 2.3.8.30 || bhagavānapi tatraiva teṣāmānaṃdamāvahan|| dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca svayamāyāti majjane || 31 || tatpaścādṛṣayaḥ sarve munayaśca tapodhanāḥ || yatra snātvā vidhānena guha madhyāhnakālataḥ || asaṃgaṃ paramaṃ jyotirjale paśyaṃti cakṣuṣā || 32 || sarvatīrthāvagāhena yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam || tatphalaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva daṇḍapuṣkariṇīkṣaṇāt || || 33 || yatra kāmyāni karmāṇi saphalāni manīṣiṇām || yatra piṃḍapradānena gayāto'ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam ||34|| yajño dānaṃ tapaḥ karma sarvamakṣayamucyate|| dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya jyeṣṭhe māsi ṣaḍānana || 35 || tatra snātvā vidhānena kṛtakṛtyo bhavedyataḥ || badarītīrthamadhye tu guptametatsurottamaiḥ || na vācyaṃ yatra kutrāpi tava prītyā mayoditam ||36|| vaktavyaṃ kimiha bahu prabhūtapuṇyāḥ paśyaṃti prathitamidaṃ suraikaguptam || nānyeṣāṃ kathamapi cetasi prasaṃgāddevaiḥ syādanudinaciṃtitaṃ guhaitat || 37 || yeṣāṃ vai bhagavati cetsamagrakarma svādhyāyābhyasanavidhikrameṇa jātam || paśyaṃti tribhuvanadurllabhaṃ sutīrthaṃ daṃḍodaṃ na bhavati cānyathā sudṛṣṭam ||38|| daṃḍodakātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na viṣṇoḥ sadṛśo'maraḥ || viśālāsadṛśaṃ kṣetraṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||39|| sevanīyā prayatnena viśālā ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ || ya icchetsatataṃ dhāma bhagavatpārśvavarti vai || 2.3.8.40 || || skaṃda uvāca || || gaṃgāmāśritya tīrthāni kāni saṃtīha satpade || śreyaskarāṇi bhūrīṇi saṃkṣepāttāni me vada || 41 || || mahādeva uvāca || || gaṃgāyāṃ yatra saṃyogo mānasodbhedasannidhau || tattīrthaṃ vimalaṃ puṇyaṃ prayāgādadhikaṃ mahat || 42 || triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi vāyubhojanato bhavet || tatphalaṃ snānamātreṇa gaṃgāyāḥ saṃgame nṛṇām || 43 || saṃgamāddakṣiṇe bhāge dharmakṣetraṃ prakīrtitam || yatra mūrtyā śrutau jātau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ||44|| tatkṣetraṃ pāvanaṃ martye sarveṣāmuttamottamam || dharmastatraiva bhagavāṃścatuṣpādavatiṣṭhati || 45 || yatra yajñāstapo dānaṃ yatkiṃcitkriyate nṛbhiḥ || tatpuṇyasya kṣayo nāsti kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 46 || tato dakṣiṇadigbhāga urvaśī saṃgamābhidham || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṃsāṃ snānamātreṇa dehinām || 47 || kūrmoddhārastataḥ sākṣāddharibhaktyekasādhanam || snānamātreṇa bhūtānāṃ sattvaśuddhiḥ prajāyate || 48 || brahmāvarttastataḥ sākṣādbrahmalokaikakāraṇam || darśanādeva tīrthasya sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 49 || bahūni saṃti tīrthāni durgamyānīha dehinām || saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ vatsa tavādaravaśādidam || 2.3.8.50 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ viṣṇoḥ prapadyate |||| 51 || rājā vijayamāpnoti sutārthī labhate sutam || kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ kanyā viṃdati satpatim || 52 || dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti sarvakāmaikasādhanam || 53 || māsamātraṃ naro bhaktyā śṛṇuyādyaḥ samāhitaḥ || tasyābhīṣṭasamāvāptirdurlabhopi na saṃśayaḥ || 54 || ādhivyādhibhayaṃ ghoraṃ dāridrya kalahaṃ tathā || yasya geheṣu māhātmyaṃ tatraitāni na karhicit || 55 || nāpamṛtyurna sarpādi daurbhāgyaṃ cāpi vartate || duḥsvapnagrahapīḍā ca pararāṣṭrabhayaṃ tathā || 56 || yuddhe yātrāprayāṇe ca paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || vivāhe ca vivāde ca śubhakarmaṇi yatnataḥ || 57 || pūrṇaṃ vā'dhyāyamātraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || sarvakāryaprasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 58 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe badarikāśramamāhātmye śivakārttikeyasaṃvāde badarikāśrame merusaṃsthāpanatīrthalokapālatīrthadaṃḍapuṣkariṇītīrthadharmakṣetrādivividhatīrthakṣetramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || || cha || iti śrīskāṃde dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe tṛtīyaṃ badarikāśramamāhātmyaṃ samāptam || (2.3) || ||
<2.4.1>
|| || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha kārttikamāsamāhātmyaprārambhaḥ || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam || devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayamudīrayet || 1 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta naḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyamāśvinasya ca || bhūyo'nyacchrotumicchāmaḥ kārtikasya ca vaibhavam || 2 || kalau kaluṣacittānāṃ narāṇāṃ pāpakarmaṇām || saṃsārābdhau nimagnānāmanāyāsena kā gatiḥ || 3 || ko dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāmadhiko mokṣasādhakaḥ || ihā'pi muktido nṛṇāmetattvaṃ kathaya prabho || 4 || || sūta uvāca || || bhavadbhiryadahaṃ pṛṣṭastadetatpṛṣṭavānmuniḥ || nārado brahmaṇaḥ putro brahmāṇaṃ tu jagadgurum || 5 || tathaiva satyabhāmā ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ jagadīśvaram || apṛcchatkārtikasyaiva vaibhavaṃ śravaṇotsukā ||6|| vālakhilyaiśca ṛṣibhiryaduktamṛṣisaṃsadi || śrīsūryāruṇasaṃvādarūpeṇā'timanoharam || 7 || kailāse śaṃkareṇaiva kārtikasya ca vaibhavam || varṇitaṃ ṣaṇmukhasyāgre nānākhyānasamanvitam || 8 || pṛthuṃ prati nāradena kathitaṃ ca mahātmyakam || kārtikasya ca vipreṃdrā śrutvā brahmamukhātpurā || 9 || ekadā nārado yogī satyalokamupāgataḥ || papraccha vinayenaiva sarvalokapitāmaham || 2.4.1.10 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || pāpeṃdhanasya ghorasya śuṣkārdrasya ca bhūriśaḥ || ko vahnirdahate brahmaṃstadbhavānvaktumarhati || 11 || nājñātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu brahmāṃḍāṃtargatasya yat || vidyate tava deveśa trividhasya suniścitam || 12 || māsānāṃ pravaro māso devānāmuttamottamaḥ || tīrthāni tadviśeṣeṇa kathayasva pitāmaha || 13 || || brahmovāca || || māsānāṃ kārtikaḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ madhusūdanaḥ || tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇākhyaṃ hi tritayaṃ durlabhaṃ kalau || 14 || || nārada uvāca || || bhagavaṃstava dāso'smi bhakto'smi harivallabha || vaiṣṇavānbrūhi me dharmānsarvajño'si pitāmaha || 15 || ādau kārtikamāhātmyaṃ vaktumarhasi me prabho || dīpadānasya māhātmyaṃ vratināṃ niyamāṃstathā || 16 || gopīcaṃdanamāhātmyaṃ tulasyāśca tathā vibho || dhātryāścaiva ca māhātmyaṃ vidhiṃ snānādikasya ca || vratāraṃbhaḥ kadā kāryaṃ udyāpanavidhiṃ tathā || 17 || yatkiṃcidvaiṣṇavaṃ dharmaṃ tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi || yenā'haṃ tvatprasādena padaṃ yāsyāmyanāmayam |||| 18 || || sūta uvāca || || iti putravacaḥ śrutvā brahmā harṣasamanvitaḥ || rādhādāmodaraṃ smṛtvā provāca tanujaṃ prati || 19 || || brahmovāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā putra lokoddharaṇahetave || kathayāmi na saṃdehaḥ kārtikasya ca vaibhavam || 2.4.1.20 || ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni sarve yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ || || kārtikasya tu māsasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 21 || ekataḥ puṣkare vāsaḥ kurukṣetre himālaye || ekataḥ kārtikaḥ putra sarvapuṇyādhiko mataḥ || || 22 || svarṇāni merutulyāni sarvadānāni caikataḥ || ekataḥ kārtiko vatsa sarvadā keśavapriyaḥ || 23 || yatkiṃcitkriyate puṇyaṃ viṣṇumuddiśya kārtike || tasya kṣayaṃ na paśyāmi mayoktaṃ tava nārada || 24 || sopānabhūtaṃ svargasya mānuṣyaṃ prāpya durlabham || tathātmānaṃ samādadyānna bhraśyeta yathā punaḥ || 25 || duṣprāpyaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ kārtikoktaṃ carenna yaḥ || dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha sa mātāpitṛghātakaḥ || 26 || kārtikaḥ khalu vai māsaḥ sarvamāseṣu cottamaḥ || puṇyānāṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanānāṃ ca pāvanam || 27 || asminmāse trayastriṃśaddevāḥ sannihitā mune || atra snānānidānāni bhojanāni vratāni ca || 28 || tiladhenuṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca rajataṃ bhūmivāsasī || gopradānāni kurvaṃti sarvabhāvena nārada || 29 || tāni dānāni dattāni gṛhṇaṃti vidhivatsurāḥ || yatkiṃca dattaṃ vipreṃdra tapaścaiva tathā kṛtam || 2.4.1.30 || tadakṣayyaphalaṃ proktaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || || pāpānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ caiva kārtike māsi śasyate || 31 || tasmādyatnena vipreṃdra kārtike māsi dīyate || yatkiṃcitkārtike dattaṃ viṣṇumuddiśya mānavaiḥ || 32 || tadakṣayaṃ hi labhate annadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || yathā nadīnāṃ vipreṃdra śailānāṃ caiva nārada || 33 || udadhīnāṃ ca viprarṣe kṣayo naivopapadyate || dānaṃ kārtikamāse tu yatkiṃciddīyate mune |||| 34 || na tasyāsti kṣayo vipra pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā || saṃprāptaṃ kārtikaṃ dṛṣṭvā parānnaṃ yastu varjayet ||35|| dinedine'tikṛcchrasya phalaṃ prāpnotyayatnataḥ || na kārtikasamo māso na kṛtena samaṃ yugam ||36|| na vedasadṛśaṃ śāstraṃ na tīrthaṃ gaṃgayā samam || na cānnasadṛśaṃ dānaṃ na sukhaṃ bhāryayā samam || 37 || nyāyenopārjitaṃ dravyaṃ durlabhaṃ dānakāriṇām || durlabhaṃ martyadharmāṇāṃ tīrthe ca pratipādanam || 38 || kārtike muniśārdūla śāligrāmaśilārcanam || smaraṇaṃ vāsudevasya kartavyaṃ pāpabhīruṇā || 39 || etādṛśaṃ kārtikaṃ ca akṛtenaiva yo nayet || pūrvaṃ kṛtasya puṇyasya kṣayamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 2.4.1.40 || || nārada uvāca || || aśaktena kathaṃ kāryaṃ kārtikavratamuttamam || yena tatphalamāpnoti tanme vada pitāmaha || 41 || || brahmovāca || || aśaktastu yadā martyastadaivaṃ vratamācaret || anyasmai draviṇaṃ dattvā kārayetkārtikavratam || 42 || tasmātpuṇyaṃ pragṛhṇīta dānasaṃkalpapūrvakam || dravyadāne'pyaśaktaścedyadā devarṣisattama || 43 || tadā tena prakartavyaṃ pānaṃ tīrthajalasya ca || tatrāpyaśakto yo martyastena nityaṃ harermudā || 44 || smaraṇaṃ ca prakartavyaṃ nāmnā niyamapūrvakam || akhaṃḍitaṃ tadā tena kārtikavratajaṃ phalam || 45 || viṣṇoḥ śivasya vā kuryādālaye harijāgaram || śivaviṣṇvorgṛhābhāve sarvadevālayeṣvapi ||46|| durgāṭavyāṃ sthito vā'tha yadivā''padgato bhavet || kuryādaśvatthamūle tu tulasīnāṃ vaneṣvapi || 47 || viṣṇunāmaprabaṃdhānāṃ gāyanaṃ viṣṇusannidhau || gosahasrapradānasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 48 || vādyakṛtpuruṣaścāpi vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet|| sarvatīrthāvagāhotthaṃ nartakaḥ phalamāpnuyāt || 49 || sarvametallabhetpuṇyameteṣāṃ dravyadaḥ pumān|| śravaṇāddarśanādvāpi ṣaḍaṃśaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 2.4.1.50 || āpadgato yadāpyaṃbho na labhetkutracinnaraḥ || vyādhito vāthavā kuryādviṣṇornāmnā'pi mārjanam || 51 || udyāpanavidhiṃ kartumaśakto yo vratasthitaḥ || brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścādvratasaṃpūrtihetave || 52 || aśakto dīpadānāya paradīpaṃ prabodhayet || tasya vā rakṣaṇaṃ kuryādvātādibhyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 53 || śrīviṣṇoḥ pūjanā'bhāve tulasīdhātripūjanam || sarvā'bhāve vratī kuryādbrāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmapi || tasyāpyabhāve manasi viṣṇornāmānukīrtanam || 54 || || nārada uvāca || || brahmanbrūhi viśeṣeṇa dharmānkārtikasaṃbhavān || 55 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye kārtikavratapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || cha ||
<2.4.2>
|| || brahmovāca || || atha kārtikamāsasya dharmānvakṣyāmi nārada || saṃprāptaṃ kārtikaṃ dṛṣṭvā parānnaṃ yastu varjayet || 1 || sa tu mokṣamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || sarveṣāmeva dharmāṇāṃ gurupūjā parā matā || guruśuśrūṣayā sarvaṃ prāpnoti ṛṣisattama ||2|| gurau tuṣṭe ca tuṣṭāḥ syurdevāḥ sarve savāsavā || gurau ruṣṭe ca ruṣṭāḥ syurdevāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ || 3 || kārtikaṃ māsi saṃprāpte kṛtvā karmāṇi bhūriśaḥ || 4 || akṛtvā guruśuśrūṣāṃ narakāneva viṃdati || 4 || yatkiṃcidvā samādiṣṭo guruṇā tatsamācaret ||5|| ājñapto guruṇā vipra na tadvākyaṃ tu laṃghayet || yadi duḥkhādikaṃ prāptaṃ guruṃ tu śaraṇaṃ vrajet || 6 || mātṛtve ca pitṛtve ca gurumeva smaredbudhaḥ || gurau na prāpyate yattannānyatrā'pi hi labhyate || 7 || guruprasādātsarvaṃ tu prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ || medhāvī kapilaścaiva sumatiśca mahātapāḥ || gautamasya guroḥ samyaksevayā'maratāṃ gatāḥ || 8 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kārtike viṣṇutatparaḥ || gurusevāṃ prakurvīta tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 9 || narebhyo vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmaṃ yo dadāti dvijottamaḥ || sasāgaramahīdāne tatpuṇyaṃ labhate hi saḥ || 2.4.2.10 || tiladhenuṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca rajataṃ bhūmivāsasī || gopradānāni dāsyaṃti sarvabhāvena suvrata || 11 || sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ kanyādānaṃ viśiṣyate || sahasrameva dhenūnāṃ śataṃ cānaḍuhāṃ samam || 12 || daśānaḍutsamaṃ yānaṃ daśayānasamo hayaḥ || hayadāna sahasrebhyo gajadānaṃ viśiṣyate || 13 || gajadānasahasrāṇāṃ svarṇadānaṃ ca tatsamam || svarṇadānasahasrāṇāṃ vidyādānaṃ ca tatsamam || 14 || vidyādānātkoṭiguṇaṃ bhūmidānaṃ viśiṣyate || bhūmidānasahasreṇa gopradānaṃ viśiṣyate || 15 || gopradānasahasrebhyo hyannadānaṃ viśiṣyate || annādhāramidaṃ proktaṃ tasmāddeyaṃ tu kārtike || 16 || parānnavarjanādeva labheccāṃdrāyaṇaṃ phalam || dinedine'tikṛcchrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 17 || kārtike varjayenmāṃsaṃ sandhānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || rākṣasīṃ yonimāpnoti sakṛnmāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt || 18 || pravṛttānāṃ tu bhakṣyāṇāṃ kārtike niyame kṛte || avaśyaṃ viṣṇurūpatvaṃ prāpyate mokṣadaṃ padam || 19 || brāhmaṇebhyo mahīṃ dattvā grahaṇe sūryacaṃdrayoḥ || yatphalaṃ labhate vatsa tatphalaṃ bhūmiśāyinaḥ || 2.4.2.20 || bhojanaṃ dvijadaṃpatyoḥ pūjanaṃ ca vilepanaiḥ || kaṃbalāni ca ratnāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || 21 || tūlikāśca pradātavyāḥ pracchādanapaṭaiḥ saha || upānahāvātapatraṃ kārtike dehi suvrata || 22 || kārtike kṣitiśāyī ca hanyātpāpaṃ yugārjitam || jāgaraṃ kārtike māsi yaḥ karotyaruṇodaye || 23 || dāmodarāgre devarṣe gosahasraphalaṃ labhet || nadīsnānaṃ kathā viṣṇorvaiṣṇavānāṃ ca darśanam || 24 || na bhavetkārtike yasya haretpuṇyaṃ daśābdikam || puṣkaraṃ yaḥ smaretprājñaḥ karmaṇā manasā girā || 25 || kārtike muniśārdūla lakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || prayāgo māghamāse tu puṣkaraṃ kārtike tathā || 26 || avantī mādhave māsi hanyātpāpaṃ yugārjitam || dhanyāste mānavā loke kalikāle viśeṣataḥ || 27 || ye kurvaṃti narā nityaṃ prītyarthaṃ haripūjanam || tāritāstaiśca pitaro narakācca na saṃśayaḥ || 28 || kṣīrādisnapanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kriyate pitṛkāraṇāt || kalpakoṭiṃ divaṃ prāpya vasanti tridivaiḥ saha || 29 || kārtike nārcito yaistu kṛṣṇastu kamalekṣaṇaḥ || janmakoṭiṣu viprendra na teṣāṃ kamalā gṛhe || 2.4.2.30 || aho muṣṭā vinaṣṭāste patitāḥ kalikandare || yairnārcito harirbhaktyā kamalairasitaiḥ sitaiḥ || 31 || padmenaikena deveśaṃ yo'rcayetkamalāpatim || varṣāyutasahasrasya pāpasya kurute kṣayam || puṣkarārcanayogena śveto muktimavāpa ha || 32 || aparādhasahasrāṇi tathā saptaśatāni ca || padmenaikena deveśaḥ kṣamate praṇato'rcitaḥ ||33|| tulasīpatralakṣeṇa kārtike yo'rcayeddharim || patrepatre muniśreṣṭha mauktikaṃ labhate phalam || 34 || mukhe śirasi dehe tu kṛṣṇottīrṇāṃ tu yo vahet || tulasī kṛṣṇanirmālyairyo gātraṃ parimārjayet || sarvarogaistathā pāpairmukto bhavati mānavaḥ || 35 || śaṃkhodakaṃ harerbhaktirnirmālyaṃ pādayorjalam || candanaṃ dhūpaśeṣaṃ ca brahmahatyāpahārakam || 36 || kārtike māsi viprendra prātaḥsnānaparāyaṇaḥ || viprebhyaścānnadānaṃ tu kuryācchaktyanusārataḥ || 37 || sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannadānaṃ viśiṣyate || annena jāyate loko hyannenaivā'bhivarddhate || 38 || annaṃ hi sarvabhūtānāṃ prāṇabhūtaṃ paraṃ viduḥ || annadaḥ sarvado loke sarvayajñādikṛdbhavet || 39 || tīrthasnānena kiṃ tasya devayātrādinā'pi kim || sarvaṃ saṃpādyate brahmannannadānānna saṃśayaḥ || 2.4.2.40 || satyaketurdvijaḥ pūrvaṃ cānnadānena kevalam || sarvapuṇyaphalaṃ prāpya mokṣaṃ prāpa sudurlabham || 41 || kārtikavrataniṣṭhastu kuryādgodānamuttamam|| vrataṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti godānena na saṃśayaḥ || 42 || godānātparamaṃ dānaṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakam || nāsti nārada loke'sminsuśarmā brāhmaṇo yathā || 43 || kārtike māsi vipreṃdra dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ || harismṛtivihīnaścenna punaṃti kadācana || 44 || nāmasmaraṇamāhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || puṣkareṇa yathā pūrvaṃ nārakīyāśca mocitāḥ || 45 || goviṃda goviṃda hare murāre goviṃda goviṃd mukuṃda kṛṣṇa || goviṃda goviṃda rathāṃgapāṇe goviṃda dāmodara mādhaveti || 46 || ślokārddhaṃ ślokapādaṃ vā nityaṃ bhāgavatodbhavam || kārtike yaḥ paṭhanmartyaḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ || 47 || yairna śrutaṃ bhāgavataṃ purāṇaṃ nārādhito vai puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ || hutaṃ mukhe naiva dharāmarāṇāṃ teṣāṃ vṛthā janma gataṃ narāṇām || 48 || kārtike māsi vipreṃdra yastu gītāṃ paṭhennaraḥ || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ mama śaktirna vidyate || 49 || gītāyāstu samaṃ śāstraṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || sarvapāpaharā nityaṃ gītaikā mokṣadāyinī || 2.4.2.50 || ekenā'dhyāyapāṭhena sarvapāpakṛto'pi ca || mucyaṃte narakādghorājjaḍo vai brāhmaṇo yathā || 51 || śāligrāmaśilādānaṃ yaḥ kuryātkārtike mune || tasya puṇyasya viśrāṃtirviṣṇunā na nirūpitā || 52 || śāligrāmaṃ samabhyarcya śrotriyāya mahāmune || dānaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 53 || saptasāgaraparyaṃtaṃ bhūdānādyatphalaṃ bhavet || śāligrāmaśilādānāttatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt || 54 || śāligrāmaśilādānātkārtike brāhmaṇī yathā || vidhavā sadhavā jātā vivāhe paṃcame'hani || 55 || tasmāttu kārtike māsi snānadānapuraḥsaram || śāligrāmaśilādānaṃ kartavyaṃ nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 56 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye kārtikavratadharmanirūpaṇaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || || cha || ||
<2.4.3>
|| || brahmovāca || || bhūyaḥ śṛṇuṣva vipreṃdra kārtikasya ca vaibhavam || daśamīdinamārabhya daśamyāṃ tu samāpayet || 1 || paurṇamāsīṃ samārabhya paurṇamāsyāṃ samāpayet || āśvinasya haridinīṃ samārabhya tu bhaktimān || 2 || dāmodaraṃ namaskṛtya kuryātsaṃkalpamāditaḥ || dāmodara namaste'stu sarvapāpavināśana || 3 || kārtikasya vrataṃ kartumanujñāṃ dātumarhasi || nirvighnaṃ kuru deveśa āmāsaṃ puruṣottama || 4 || iti saṃprārthya vidhinā kārtikavratamācaret || anūruṃ vadatā proktaṃ bhāskareṇa śrutaṃ mayā || kalau ca svargagamanakāraṇaṃ śrūyatāṃ hi tat || 5 || || sūrya uvāca || || dvādaśānāṃ tu māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'tipuṇyadaḥ || 6 || tasmātpuṇyaphalaḥ prokto vaiśākho narmadātaṭe || tato lakṣaguṇaḥ proktaḥ prayāge māghamāsakaḥ || || 7 || tasmānmahāphalaḥ proktaḥ kārtiko jalamātrake || ekataḥ sarvadānāni vratāni niyamāstathā || 8 || ekataḥ kārtikasnānaṃ brahmaṇā tulayā dhṛtam || saṃtatiścaiva saṃpattiḥ kalau yeṣāṃ prajāyate || 9 || avaśyaṃ taiḥ kṛtaṃ viddhi kārtikasnānamādarāt || snānaṃ ca dīpadānaṃ ca tulasīvanapālanam || 2.4.3.10 || bhūmiśayyā brahmacaryyaṃ tathā dvidalavarjanam || viṣṇusaṃkīrtanaṃ satyaṃ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tathā || 11 || kārtike māsi kurvaṃti jīvanmuktāsta eva hi || na kārtikasamaṃ dharmyamarthyaṃ no kārtikātparam || 12 || na kārtikasamaṃ kāmyaṃ mokṣadānaṃ na kārtikāt || yudhiṣṭhireṇa dharmārthamarthārthaṃ ca dhruveṇa ca ||13 || śrīkṛṣṇena tu kāmārthaṃ mokṣārthaṃ nāradena ca || kṛtametadvrataṃ tasmācchreṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇapriyaṃ ca hi || 14 || || || aruṇa uvāca || || brūhi bhāskara sarvātmankadā''rabhya vrataṃ kṛtam|| saphalaṃ jāyate samyakkā ca pūjyā'tra devatā ||15|| || bhāskara uvāca || ahaṃ viṣṇuśca śarvaśca devī vighneśvarastathā || eko'haṃ paṃcadhā jāto nāṭye sūtradharo yathā || 16 || asmākaṃ sarva evaite bhedā viddhi khageśvara || tasmātsauraiśca gāṇeśaiḥ śāktaiḥ śaivaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ || 17 || kartavyaṃ kārtikasnānaṃ sarvapāpāpanuttaye || sūryasya prītaye kāryaṃ tulāsaṃsthe divākare||18|| iṣapūrṇāṃ samārabhya yāvatkārtikapūrṇimā || tāvatsnānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ śivasaṃtuṣṭaye naraiḥ || 19|| devīpakṣaṃ samārabhya mahārātricaturdaśī || tāvatsnānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ devī saṃprīyatāmiti|| 2.4.3.20|| gaṇapakṣaṃ samārabhya kṛṣṇā yā kārtike bhavet|| caturthī tāvadeva syātsnānaṃ gaṇapatuṣṭaye||21|| ekādaśīṃ samārabhya āśvinasyā'sitetarām || ekādaśyāṃ kārtikasya śuklāyāṃ paripūryate || kṛtaṃ yena tu tasya syātparituṣṭo janārdanaḥ || 22 || na kārtikasamo māso na kāśīsadṛśī purī || na prayāgasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na devaḥ keśavātparaḥ || 23 || prasaṃgādvā balātkārairjñātvājñātvā kṛtaṃ bhavet || snānaṃ kārtikamāsasya na paśyedyamayātanām || 24 || snānārthaṃ cenna sāmarthyaṃ datvānyasmai dhanādikam || snātasya tasya hastasya grahaṇā puṇyabhāgbhavet || 25 || athavā kārtikasnānaṃ ye kurvaṃti dvijātayaḥ || teṣāṃ prāvaraṇaṃ dattvā snānajaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ||26|| rādhādāmodaraḥ pūjyaḥ kārtike tu viśeṣataḥ || 27 || svarṇasya vātha raupyasyā'pyabhāve śulbajāmapi || mṛjjāṃ vā citrajātāṃ vā'tha vā piṣṭavicitritām || 28 || dāmodarasya rādhāyāstulasyadho'rcayaṃti ye || mūrtiṃ te tu narā jñeyā jīvanmuktā na saṃśayaḥ ||29|| api pāpasahasrāḍhyaḥ kārtikasnānato naraḥ || mukto'vaśyaṃ sa bhavati nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || 2.4.3.30 || tulasyabhāve kartavyā pūjā dhātrītale khaga || mukhyapūjāvidhānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sūryamaṃḍale || 31 || apratyakṣāḥ sarvadevāḥ pratyakṣo bhagavānayam || sarve devāḥ kālavaśāḥ kālakālo divākaraḥ ||32|| etadārādhane'śaktaḥ pratimāṃ pūjayennaraḥ || pratimāto'dhikaṃ puṇyaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu pūjane || 33 || daridro dānapātraṃ syādvidyāvāṃstu viśeṣataḥ || viprābhāve pūjanīyā gāvaḥ kṛṣṇā manoharāḥ || 34 || viṣṇormūrtirjaṃgamataḥ sthāvarā tu praśasyate || śūdrasthāpitamūrtīnāṃ namaskāraṃ karoti yaḥ || pitṛbhirnirayaṃ yāti daśapūrvairdaśāparaiḥ || 35 || śūdrārcitasya saṃsparśāddahedāsaptamaṃ kulam || 36 || tasmādvicāryya viprairyā sthāpitā tāṃ samarcayet || tato'pi yā devatābhiḥ kṛtā sā bhuktimuktidā || 37 || mūrtyabhāve pūjanīyo'śvattho vā'tha vaṭo'tha vā || aśvattharūpī viṣṇuḥ syādvaṭarūpī śivo yataḥ || 38 || kārtike tulasīśākaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ vā narādhamaḥ || ajñānājjñānato vā'pi bhuñjāno nirayaṃ vrajet || 39 || śāligrāmaśilācakre nityaṃ sannihito hariḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena śāligrāmaṃ prapūjayet || 2.4.3.40 || rudraśāpavaśādgāvo viṣṭhābhakṣaṇatatparāḥ || tathā'pi tāḥ pūjanīyā lokadvayaphalapradāḥ || 41 || brahmāṃ'śakasamudbhūte pālāśe yastu bhojanam || kuryātkārtikamāse'sau viṣṇulokaṃ prayāsyati || 42 || aśvattharūpī bhagavānvaṭarūpī sadāśivaḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kārtike'śvatthamarcayet || 43 || yā nārī kārtike māsi lakṣaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇāḥ || rādhādāmodaraṃ pūjya mandavāre ca tattale || 44 || dampatī bhojayedrādhādāmodarasvarūpiṇau || bhojayitvā sapatnīkānpaścādbhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ || 45 || vandhyā'pi labhate putramitarāsāṃ tu kā kathā || sadā sannihito viṣṇurdvipatsu brāhmaṇe yathā || 46 || bodhidrume pādapeṣu śāligrāme śilāsu ca || tasmādaśvatthamūle vai kartavyaṃ viṣṇupūjanam || 47 || aśvatthapūjā sparśena karttavyā śanivāsare || anyavāre'śvatthasaṃgāddaridro jāyate naraḥ ||48|| snānaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ dīpaṃ tulasīvanapālanam || kārtike māsi kurvaṃti te narā viṣṇumūrtayaḥ || 49 || saṃmārjanaṃ viṣṇugṛhe svastikādinivedanam || viṣṇoḥ pūjāṃ ca ye kuryurjīvanmuktāstu te narāḥ || 2.4.3.50 || snānakālaṃ pravakṣyāmi tīrthādiṣu ca yatphalam || snānadharmāśca ye kecittānsarvānme nibodhata || 51 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye kārtikavaibhavavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha || ||
<2.4.4>
|| brahmovāca || || nāḍīdvayāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ rātryāṃ gacchejjalāśayam || tulasīmṛttikāyuktaḥ savastrakalaśo mune || 1 || āgatya toyanikaṭe tīre saṃsthāpya pātrakam || pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā deśakālādi coccaret || 2 || smaredgaṃgādikā nadyo viṣṇuśarvādidevatāḥ || nābhimātre jale sthitvā maṃtrametamudīrayet || 3 || kārtike'haṃ kariṣyāmi prātaḥsnānaṃ janārdana || prītyarthaṃ tava deveśa dāmodara mayā saha || 4 || nitye naimittike kṛtvā kārtike pāpanāśana || snānaṃ cārghaṃ pradāsyāmi nirvighnaṃ kuru keśava || 5 || tīrthādidevatābhyaśca kramādarghyādi dāpayet || gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rādhayā sahito hare || 6 || namaḥ kamalanābhāya namaste jalaśāyine || namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || 7 || vratinaḥ kārtike māsi snātasya vidhivanmama || gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ danujeṃdraniṣūdana || 8 || kiraṇā dhūtapāpā ca puṇyatoyā sarasvatī || gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva paṃcanadyaḥ punaṃtu mām || 9 || anyāsāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca dadyādarghyaṃ yathāvidhi || jāhnavīsmaraṇaṃ kuryātsarvatīrtheṣu mānavaḥ || 2.4.4.10 || nānyattīrthaṃ tu jāhnavyāṃ smaraṇīyaṃ kadācana || etānmaṃtrānsamuccārya malasnānaṃ samācaret || 11 || mṛtsnānaṃ ca pitṛsnānaṃ gurusnānaṃ tataḥ param || tatastu pāvamānībhirabhiṣiṃcetsvamastakam || 12 || aghamarṣaṇakaṃ kṛtvā snānāṃgaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā || tataḥ puruṣasūktena jalaṃ śirasi siṃcayet || 13 || tatastu bahirāgatya tīrthaṃ śirasi nikṣipet|| tīrthaṃ pītvā trivāraṃ tu tulasīṃ gṛhya pāṇinā|| 14 || tato jalādviniṣkramya cāṃcalaṃ pīḍayedbahiḥ|| yanmayā dūṣitaṃ toyaṃ śārīramalasaṃcayaiḥ || 15 || taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ yakṣmaṇaṃ tarpayāmyaham || vastraniṣpīḍanaṃ kṛtvā kuryācca tilakādikam |||| 16 || || sūta uvāca || || śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve kārtikasnānajaṃ phalam || aruṇaṃ prati sūryeṇa yaduktaṃ ca savistaram || 17 || || aruṇa uvāca || || kasmiṃstīrthe viśeṣeṇa phalaṃ kārtikasaṃbhavam || kṣetre vā etadā''khyāhi bhagavansnānayogataḥ || 18 || || sūrya uvāca || yatra kutrā'pi kartavyaṃ jale snānaṃ tu kārtikaṃ || uṣṇodakena kartavyaṃ snānaṃ kutrā'pi kārtike || 19 || tato daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śītatoyanimajjanāt || tataḥ śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bahiḥ kūpodake kṛtam|| 2.4.4.20 || kūpātsahasraguṇitaṃ phalaṃ vāpīniṣekataḥ || tato'yutaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ taḍāgasnānato bhavet || 21 || tato daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ nirjhareṣu nimajjanāt || tato'dhikataraṃ puṇyaṃ nadīsnānasya kārtike || 22 || nadyā daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ khagottama || tato daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ nadyoryatra ca saṃgamaḥ ||23|| nadītrayasya saṃyoge puṇyasyāṃ'to na vidyate || siṃdhuḥ kṛṣṇā ca veṇī ca yamunā ca sarasvatī || 24 || godāvarī vipāśā ca narmadā tamasā mahī || kāverī śarayūḥ śiprā tathā carmaṇvatī nadī || 25 || vitastā vedikā śoṇo vetravatyaparājitā|| gaṃḍakī gomatī pūrṇā brahmaputrā sarovaram || 26 || vāgmatī ca śatadruśca tathā badarikāśramaḥ || durlabhāḥ kārtike tvete tīrthānyatha nibodha me || 27 || sarvebhyaśca sthalebhyaśca āryāvartaṃ tu puṇyadam || kolhāpurī tataḥ śreṣṭhā tataḥ kāṃcīdvayaṃ smṛtam || || 28 || anaṃtasenavasatirvarāhakṣetrameva ca || cakrakṣetraṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ muktikṣetraṃ tato'dhikam || 29 || avaṃtikā tataḥ śreṣṭhā tato badarikāśramaḥ || ayodhyā ca tataḥ śreṣṭhā gaṃgādvāraṃ tato'dhikam || 2.4.4.30 || tataḥ kanakhalaṃ tīrthaṃ tato madhupurī varā || eko'pi kārtiko māso mathurāyamunājale || || 31 || yaiḥ snātaste tu vaikuṃṭhe bahukālaṃ vasaṃti hi || rādhādāmodarastatra svayaṃ snātastu kārtike || 32 || ato madhupurī śreṣṭhā yamunā ca viśeṣataḥ || 33 || dvārāvatī tataḥ śreṣṭhā pratyahaṃ snāti keśavaḥ || ṣoḍaśastrīsahasreṇa sārddhaṃ yādavasaṃyutaḥ || 34 || dvārakāyāṃ mṛttikāyāstilako yena mastake || dhāryate'sau naro jñeyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ || dvārakāsnānamāhātmyaṃ na vaktuṃ śakyate mayā || 35 || goviṃdārpitacittānāṃ jāyate puṇyabhāskarā || tato bhāgīrathī śreṣṭhā yatra viṃdhyena saṃgatā || 36 || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrtharāje'tra jāyate || 37 || kalau daśasahasrāṃ'te viṣṇustyakṣyati medinīm|| tadarddhaṃ jāhnavītoyaṃ tadardhaṃ devatāgaṇāḥ || 38 || yāvattiṣṭhati gaṃgā'tra tāvattīrthāni saṃti ca || svasvasthāne nṛṇāṃ pāpaṃ tāvadeva haraṃti ca || 39 || yadaiva gaṃgā naṣṭā syātko vā tatpāpamāharet || vicāryaivaṃ sutīrthāni gamiṣyaṃti dharātale || 2.4.4.40 || tasmānmunīśvarāḥ sarve yāvattiṣṭhati jāhnavī || tāvacca kriyatāṃ dharmastato bhūmau nilīyatām || 41 || samādhiṃ gṛhya sudṛḍhāṃ yāvatkṛtayugaṃ bhavet || anyathā kalikālena bhraṃśanīyo bhavetsudhīḥ || 42 || tataḥ śreṣṭhatarā kāśī yasyā nāśo na jāyate || yadāśrayeṇa gaṃgāpi sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati || 43 || kāśikāyā naiva nāśo brahmaṇyapi mṛte sati || yaddarśanārthaṃ gaṃgā'pi jātā cottaravāhinī || tasyāṃ paṃcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam|| 44 || āgate kārtike māsi rauravaṃ narakaṃ gatāḥ || ākrośaṃte tu pitaro vaṃśe'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati || 45 || kaścidbhāgyavatāṃ śreṣṭho gatvā paṃcanade śubhe || asmākaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryānnarakārṇavatārakam || 46 || tīrtharājāditīrthāni prāpte kārtikamāsake || snānārthaṃ pañcagaṃgaṃ tu samāyāṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 47 || kṛtvā tu lakṣapāpāni snātvā paṃcanade śubhe || biṃdumādhavamabhyarcya vilayaṃ yāṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 48 || yaiḥ snātaṃ kārtike māsi sakṛtpaṃcanade śubhe || sarvatīrthakṛtāsnānātphalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 49 || || brahmovāca || || kārtike māsi kāveryyāṃ yaḥ snānaṃ kartumicchati || tāvatā vai vimuktā'gho viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt || 2.4.4.50 || kāveryyāścaiva māhātmyaṃ ko vadetparamuttamam || atra te varṇayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam || 51 || kāveryā viṣaye brahmansāvadhānamanāḥ śṛṇu || gautamyā uttare tīre viṣṇupādābjasaṃbhavā || 52 || gaṃgā trailokyapāpaghnī vartate lokapūjitā || sā gaṃgā ciṃtayāmāsa kadācitpāpaśaṃkitā || 53 || sarvalokāḥ samāgatya mayi pāpaṃ tyajaṃti hi || tatpāpaṃ tu kathaṃ gacchediti cintāparā tadā || 54 || praṣṭuṃ jagāma kailāsaṃ girijāvallabhaṃ bhavam || tatra dṛṣṭvā mahārudraṃ provāca haripādajā || 55 || || gaṅgovāca || || mahārudra namaste'stu tvāṃ praṣṭumahamāgatā || sarve lokāḥ samāgatya mayi pāpaṃ tyajaṃti hi || 56 || tatpāpaṃ tu mayā soḍhuṃ na śakyaṃ pārvatīpate || yenopāyena tatpāpaṃ nā''gacchenmama tadvada || 57 || evaṃ gaṃgāvacaḥ śrutvā pratyāha parameśvaraḥ || || rudra uvāca || || pāpanirharaṇāyādau padmanābhāṃghripaṃkajāt||58|| prādurbhūtā'si tvaṃ devi kimarthaṃ tapyate tvayā || pāpaprahārā''dhipatyaṃ kalpitaṃ tava viṣṇunā || 59 || tathā'pi pāpanirhāra upāyaṃ te bravīmyaham|| kaveśca tanayā devī kāverī saritāṃ varā || 2.4.4.60 || sarvotkṛṣṭā ca sarveṣāṃ harerbalavaśāttu sā || sarvapāpapraharaṇe sāmarthyaṃ tatra vartate || 61 || kārtike māsi kāveryāṃ yaḥ snānaṃ kurute naraḥ || sa tu pāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || 62 || tasmāttāṃ gaccha devi tvaṃ tataḥ pāpādvimokṣyase || ityuktā sā tadāgacchatkāverīṃ pāpahāriṇīm ||63|| tajjalasparśamātreṇa kārtike viṣṇupādajā || nirdhūtapātakā gaṃgā jagāma svaniketanam ||64|| kārtike prativarṣaṃ tu gaṃgā trailokyapāvanīm || snātuṃ bhaktyā samāyāti kāverīṃ pāpahāriṇīm ||65|| tajjalasparśamātreṇa kārtike viṣṇupādajā || nirdhūtapātakā gaṃgā jagāma svaniketanam ||66|| tasmācchastaṃ tulāsnānaṃ kāveryyāṃ śasyate budhaiḥ || yaḥ kāveryāṃ tulāsnānaṃ bhaktyā tu kurute mune||67|| vimuktaduritaḥ sadyastato yāti parāṃ gatim || tasmātsnānaṃ tu kāveryāṃ kārtike māsi śasyate || 68 || itihāsamimaṃ śrutvā kārtikavratatatparaḥ || sa kāverī snānaphalaṃ prāpnoti ca parāṃ gatim || 69 || rātriśeṣe bhavetsnānamuttamaṃ viṣṇutuṣṭikṛt || sūryodaye madhyamaṃ syādyāvannā''stā tu kṛttikā || 2.4.4.70 || tāvadeva bhavetsnānamanyathā tanna kārtikam || snānaṃ strībhirvidhātavyaṃ gṛhītvā''jñāṃ dhavasya ca ||71|| apṛṣṭvā yatkṛtaṃ dharmyaṃ bhartāraṃ tatkṣayaṃ nayet || strīṇāṃ nāstyaparo dharmo bhartāraṃ projjhya kaścana || 72 || kuryātsahasrapāpāni bhartrā''jñāṃ yā samācaret || saiṣā dharmavatī loke na jāyeta vratādinā || 73 || daridraḥ patito mūrkho dīno'pi yadi cetpatiḥ || tādṛśaḥ śaraṇaṃ strīṇāṃ tattyāgānnirayaṃ vrajet || 74 || kalau vatsa manuṣyāṇāṃ śaithilyaṃ snānakarmaṇi || tathāpi kathayiṣyāmi snānaṃ kārtikamāghayoḥ || 75 || yasya hastau ca pādau ca vāṅmanaśca susaṃyatam|| vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalabhāṅnaraḥ || 76 || aśraddadhānaḥ pāpātmā nāstikaśchinnamānasaḥ || hetuvādī ca paṃcaite na tīrthaphalabhāginaḥ || 77 || prātarutthāya yo viprastīrthasnāyī sadā bhavet || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmā'dhigacchati || 78 || snānaṃ caturvidhaṃ proktaṃ snānavidbhirmanīṣibhiḥ|| vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ divyaṃ brāhmaṃ ceti tathā smṛtam ||79|| vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥsnānaṃ vāruṇaṃ sāgarādiṣu || brāhmaṃ brāhmaṇamaṃtroktaṃ divyaṃ meghāṃ'bu bhāskaram || 2.4.4.80 || snānānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tatra vāruṇam || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo maṃtravatsnānamācaret || 81 || tūṣṇīmeva hi śūdrasya strīṇāṃ caiva tathā smṛtam || bālā ca taruṇī vṛddhā naranārīnapuṃsakāḥ || 82 || pāpaiḥ sarvaiḥ pramucyaṃte snānātkārtikamāghayoḥ || snātā vai kārtike lokāḥ prāpnuvaṃtīpsitaṃ phalam || 83 || puṣkare tīrthavarye tu naṃdāyāḥ saṃgame purā || prabhaṃjanaśca muktobhūttadaiva vyāghrajanmataḥ || 84 || naṃdāyā vacanenaiva kārtike sā paraṃ yayau || evaṃ snānavidhiḥ proktaḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 85 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye kārtikasnānavidhinirūpaṇaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha ||
<2.4.5>
|| nārada uvāca || || kadā snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ kathaṃ stheyaṃ dināvadhi || āhnikaṃ tatsamācakṣva viśeṣeṇa pitāmaha ||1|| || || brahmovāca || || rātryāṃ turyāṃśaśeṣāyāmuttiṣṭhetsarvadā vratī || viṣṇuṃ stutvā bahustotrairdinakāryaṃ vicārayet || 2 || grāmanairṛtyadigbhāge malotsargaṃ yathāvidhi || brahmasūtraṃ dakṣakarṇe sthāpya tatra udaṅmukhaḥ || 3 || aṃtardhāya tṛṇaṃ bhūmau śiraḥ prāvṛtya vāsasā|| vaktraṃ niyamya vastreṇā'saṃgaḥ sodakabhājanaḥ || 4 || kuryānmūtrapurīṣaṃ tu rātrau ceddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || tata utthāya cā''gacchetsamīpaṃ kalaśasya hi || 5 || gaṃdhalepakṣayakaraṃ mṛttikāśaucamācaret || ekā liṃge kare tisra ubhayormṛddvayaṃ smṛtam ||6|| mūtraśauce tvidaṃ jñeyaṃ viṣṭhāśaucamataḥ śṛṇu || paṃcāpāne'thavā sapta daśa vāmakare tathā || 7 || ubhayoḥ sapta dātavyāḥ pādayormṛttikātrayam || etacchaucaṃ gṛhasthasya dviguṇaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ || 8 || vānaprasthasya triguṇaṃ yatīnāṃ ca caturguṇam || etacchaucaṃ divā proktaṃ rātrāvarddhaṃ samācaret || 9 || mārgasthasya tadardhaṃ syātstrīśūdrāṇāṃ tadardhakam || śaucakarmavihīnasya samastā niṣphalāḥ kriyāḥ || 2.4.5.10 || daṃtajihvāviśuddhiṃ ca tataḥ kuryādataṃdritaḥ || āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca || || 11 || brahma prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvaṃ no dehi vanaspate || daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ tu gṛhṇīyāddvādaśāṃgulasaṃmitam || 12 || kṣīravṛkṣasya na grāhyaṃ kārpāsasya tathaiva ca || kaṃṭakasya ca vṛkṣasya dagdhavṛkṣasya caiva hi || 13 || sadvāsanaṃ mṛdutaraṃ daṃtadhāvanamāditaḥ || 14 || upavāse navamyāṃ ca ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śrāddhadine ravau || grahaṇe pratipaddarśe na kuryāddaṃtadhāvanam || kuryāddvādaśagaṃḍūṣānanukte daṃtadhāvane || 15 || daṃtānviśodhya vidhivanmukhaṃ saṃmārjya vāriṇā || lalāṭe cordhvapuṃḍraṃ tu dhṛtvā cācamya vāriṇā || 16 || devālaye nadītīre rājamārge viśeṣataḥ || dattvā cākāśadīpaṃ tu tulasīsannidhāvatha || 17 || gṛhītvārcanasāmagrīmiṣṭadevagṛhaṃ vrajet || tato gāyeta nṛtyeta pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu buddhimān || 18 || paṭhitvā viṣṇunāmāni kuryyānnīrājanaṃ hareḥ | nāḍīdvayāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ rātryāṃ gacchejjalāśayam || 19 || tatroktavidhinā snānaṃ kuryādvai kārtikavratī || vastraniṣpīḍanaṃ kṛtvā kuryācca tilakaṃ tathā || 2.4.5.20 || tataḥ saṃdhyāmupāsīta svasūtroktena vartmanā || tataḥ kāryo japo devyā yāvadakoṃdayo bhavet || 21 || etatproktaṃ rātriśeṣakṛtyaṃ dainamathocyate || yasminkṛte kārtiko'yaṃ sakalaḥ saphalo bhavet || 22 || viṣṇoḥ sahasranāmā''dyaṃ saṃdhyāṃte ca paṭhettataḥ || devālaye samāgatya punaḥ pūjanamārabhet || 23 || nṛtyagānādikāryeṣu praharaṃ divasaṃ nayet || tataḥ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ yāmārdhaṃ samyagācaret || 24 || paurāṇikasya pūjāṃ tu tulasīpūjanaṃ tathā || kṛtvā mādhyāhnikaṃ karma bhuṃjīta dvidalojjhitam || 25 || balidānaṃ vaiśvadevamatithīnāṃ samarpaṇam || kṛtvā bhuṃkte tu yo martyaḥ kevalaṃ cā'mṛtaṃ hi tat || 26 || yathāśakti dvijā bhojyāḥ pratyahaṃ vā'tha parvaṇi || haviṣyabhojanaṃ kuryādāmiṣaṃ parivarjayet || 27 || bhakṣayettulasīṃ vaktraśuddhyarthaṃ tīrthavāriṇā || saṃsāravyavahāreṇa dinaśeṣaṃ samāpayet ||28|| sāyaṃkāle punargacchedviṣṇordevālayaṃ prati || saṃdhyāṃ kṛtvā prayuṃjīta tatra dīpanyathābalam|| 29 || viṣṇuṃ praṇamya haraye kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ śubham || stotrapāṭhādikaṃ kurvannādyayāme tu jāgaram || || 2.4.5.30 || yāme tu prathame'tīte nidrāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || brahmacaryavrataṃ kuryādbhāryāmīyādṛtau tathā || 31 || tayā kāmayamāno vā bhāryāṃ gacchenna doṣabhāk || evaṃ pratidinaṃ kuryādāmāsaṃ tu yathāvidhi || 32 || evaṃ tu kārtike māsi yaḥ kuryātparamaṃ vratam || sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ salokatām || 33 || rogāpahaṃ pātakanāśakṛtparaṃ sadbuddhidaṃ putradhanādisādhakam || mukternidānaṃ nahi kārtikavratādviṣṇupriyādanyadihā'sti bhūtale || 34 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye nityakarmakathanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || || cha ||
<2.4.6>
|| brahmovāca || || śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi kārtikasya vrataṃ mahat || yacchutvā sarvapāpebhyo mukto mokṣamavāpsyasi || 1 || kārtike māsi saṃprāpte niṣiddhāni ca varjayet || tailābhyaṃgaṃ parānnaṃ ca tathā vai tailabhojanam || 2 || phalāni bahubījāni dhānyāni dvidalānyapi || varjayetkārtike māsi nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || 3 || alābuṃ gṛṃjaraṃ caiva vṛṃtākaṃ bṛhatīphalam || annaṃ paryuṣitaṃ vā'pi bhissaṭaṃ ca masūrikam || 4 || punarbhojanaṃ mādhvaṃ ca parānnaṃ kāṃsyabhojanam || nakhaṃ carma ca chatrākaṃ kāṃji durgaṃdhameva ca || 5 || gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca tathā vai grāmayājinaḥ || śūdrānnaṃ śadrasaṃparkaṃ sūtakānnaṃ tathaiva ca || 6 || śrāddhānnamṛtuśāṃtyāśca jātakaṃ nāmakaṃ tathā || śleṣmātakaphalaṃ caiva varjayetkārtikavratī || 7 || niṣiddheṣu ca patreṣu bhojanaṃ naiva kārayet || madhupālāśakadalījaṃbūplakṣamakūṭikāḥ || etatpatreṣu bhoktavyaṃ puṣkare na kadācana || 8 || kārtike māsi saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryādvanabhojanam || sa yāti paramaṃ lokaṃ viṣṇordevasya cakriṇaḥ || 9 || prātaḥsnānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tathaiva haripūjanam || kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ caiva kārtike śasyate mune || 2.4.6.10 || gopīcaṃdanadānaṃ tu godānaṃ śrotriyāya ca || kartavyaṃ kārtike māsi tena mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 11 || kadalīphaladānaṃ tu dānaṃ dhātrīphalasya ca || vastradānaṃ tathā kuryācchītārtāya dvijanmane || 12 || śākādidānaṃ kurvīta cānnadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || śāligrāmasya dānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tu dvijanmane || 13 || paurāṇikāya yo dadyādāmānnaṃ ghṛtapāyasam || sa caiśvaryamavāpnoti śatabrāhmaṇabhojanāt || 14 || kamalaiḥ pūjayedyastu kārtike kamalāpriyam || sa tu puṇyamavāpnoti nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || 15 || kārtike tulasīpatraṃ yo bhaktyā viṣṇave'rpayet || saṃsārācca vinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || 16 || kārtike ketakīpuṣpairarcayedgaruḍadhvajam || pūjito janmasāhasraṃ nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || 17 || śaṃkhadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttathā cakrāṃkitasya ca || tasya pāpāni naśyaṃti dānamātrānna saṃśayaḥ || 18 || gītāpāṭhaṃ tu yaḥ kuryātkārtike viṣṇuvallabhe || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nā'laṃ varṣaśatairapi || 19 || śrīmadrāgavatasyā'pi śravaṇaṃ yaḥ samācaret || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati || 2.4.6.20 || ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāramupavāsaṃ karoti yaḥ || pūrvajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 21 || śāligrāmasya naivedyaṃ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet || anyadevasya naivedyaṃ bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret || 22 || pūjākāle tu devasya ghaṇṭānādaṃ karoti yaḥ || harestṛptiṃ parāṃ yāti manujo nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 23 || parānnaṃ varjayedyastu kārtike viṣṇutuṣṭaye || dāmodarasya prītiṃ sa samyakprāpnoti mānavaḥ || 24 || adhvagaṃ tu pariśrāṃtaṃ kāle ca gṛhamāgatam || yo'tithiṃ pūjayedbhaktyā janmasāhasranāśanam || 25 || niṃdāṃ kurvaṃti ye mūḍhā vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām || pataṃti pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ mahāraurava saṃjñake || 26 || dṛṣṭvā bhāgavatānviprānsanmukho na ca yāti hi || na gṛhṇāti haristasya pūjāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm || 27 || niṃdāṃ bhagavataḥ śṛṇvaṃstatparasya janasya ca || tato nā'paiti yaḥ so'pi hareḥ priyatamo nahi || 28 || pradakṣiṇāṃ tu yaḥ kuryātkārtike keśavasya hi || padepade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || 29 || daṃḍapraṇāmaṃ yaḥ kuryātkārtike keśavā'grataḥ || rājasūyā'śvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || 2.4.6.30 || kuṭumbabhojanaṃ caiva kārtike bhaktisaṃyutaḥ || kārayedvipraśārdūla tasya puṇyamanaṃtakam || 31 || parastrīsaṃgamaṃ yastu kārtike kurute naraḥ || tasya pāpasya viśrāṃtiryāvadvaktuṃ na śakyate || 32 || tulasīmṛttikāpuṃḍraṃ lalāṭe yasya dṛśyate || yamastaṃ nekṣituṃ śaktaḥ kimu dūtā bhayaṃkarāḥ || 33 || śākaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ vā'pi yatkiṃcidvā bhaviṣyati || taddeyaṃ kārtike māsi prītyarthaṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ || 34 || ityādyā bahavo dharmāḥ kārtike viṣṇuvallabhāḥ || yathāśaktyā prakurvīta dharmaṃ devasya tuṣṭidam || 35 || harisaṃtuṣṭaye kāryastyāgo vā sveṣṭavastunaḥ|| māsāṃte dvijavaryāya dadyāttadvratapūrtaye || 36 || sarvavratāni caikatra satyavratamathaikataḥ|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena satyaṃ bhāṣeta sarvadā || 37 || anyadharmeṣvadhikṛtiḥ kulajātivibhāgataḥ || adhikārī kārtike tu sarva eva jano bhavet || 38 || gogrāsaḥ kārtike māsi viśeṣādyaistu dīyate || teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na śaknoti pitāmahaḥ || 39 || viṣṇudevālayaṃ prātaḥ saṃmārjayati kārtike || tasya vaikuṃṭhabhavane jāyate sudṛḍhaṃ gṛham || 2.4.6.40 || dadyātkārtikamāse tu dharmakāṣṭhāni bhūriśaḥ || na tatpuṇyasya nāśosti kalpakoṭiśatairapi ||41|| sudhādi lepayedyastu kārtike viṣṇumaṃdire || citrādikaṃ likhedvā'pi modate viṣṇusannidhau ||42|| devālaye vā tīrthe vā kṛto duṣṭairnṛpaiḥ karaḥ || taṃ mocayaṃti ye lokāsteṣāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ|| 43 || kārtike māsi yo vipro gabhastīśvarasannidhau || śatarudrījapaṃ kuryānmaṃtrasiddhiḥ prajāyate ||44|| vārāṇasyāṃ tu yaiḥ sthitvā trivarṣaṃ kārtikavratam || sopāṃgaṃ sāṃgaṃ yairmartyaiḥ kṛtaṃ bhaktyaikatatparaiḥ ||45|| iha loke phalaṃ teṣāṃ pratyakṣaṃ jāyate kila || saṃpattyā caiva saṃtatyā yaśobhirdharmabuddhibhiḥ ||46|| palāṃḍuṃ śṛṃgaṃ māṃsaṃ ca śayyāṃ sauvīrakaṃ tathā || rājikonmādikaṃ cā'pi cipiṭānnaṃ ca varjayet || 47 || dhātrīphalaṃ bhānuvāre paradeśāgamaṃ tathā || tīrthaṃ vinā sadaiveha varjayetkārtikavratī || 48 || devavedadvijātīnāṃ gurugovratināṃ tathā || strīrājamahatāṃ niṃdāṃ varjayetkārtikavratī || 49 || narakasya caturdaśyāṃ tailābhyaṃgaṃ ca kārayet || anyatra kārtike māsi tailasnānaṃ vivarjayet || nālikāṃ mūlakaṃ caiva kūṣmāṃḍaṃ ca kapitthakam || || 2.4.6.50 || rajasvalāṃtyaja mleccha patita'vratikaistathā || dvijadviḍvedabāhyaiśca na vadetsarvadā vratī||51|| ebhirdṛṣṭaṃ ca kākaiśca sūtikānnaṃ ca yadbhavet || dviḥpācitaṃ ca dagdhānnaṃ naivādyādvaiṣṇavavratī || 52 || kramātkūṣmāṃḍabṛhatītaruṇīmūlakaṃ tathā || śrīphalaṃ ca kaliṃgaṃ ca phalaṃ dhātrībhavaṃ tathā || 53 || nārikelamalābuṃ ca paṭolaṃ bṛhatīphalam || carmavṛṃtākacavalīśākaṃ tulasijaṃ tathā || 54 || śākānyetāni varjyāni kramātpratipadādiṣu || evameva hi māghe'pi kuryyācca niyamānvratī || 55 || kārtikavratinaḥ puṇyaṃ yathoktavratakāriṇaḥ || na samartho bhavedvaktuṃ brahmā'pīha caturmukhaḥ || 56 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye kārtikavratanirūpaṇaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6|| ||
<2.4.7>
|| nārada uvāca || || bhagavankṛtakṛtyo'smi tava pādasamāśrayāt || śrotavyaṃ neha bhūyo me vidyate devasattama || 1 || tathāpi bhagavankiṃcitpraṣṭavyaṃ me hṛdi sthitam|| tvadvākyāmṛtapītasya na me tṛptirhi jāyate ||2|| dīpadānasya māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi te prabho || yena cā'pi purā dattastadvadasva caturmukha ||3|| || brahmovāca || || prātaḥ snātvā śucirbhūtvā dīpaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ || tena pāpāni naśyeyustamāṃsīva bhagodaye ||4|| ājanma yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ striyā vā puruṣeṇa ca || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti kārtike dīpadānataḥ || 5 || atra te varṇayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam || śravaṇātsarvapāpaghnaṃ dīpadānaphalapradam || 6 || purā draviḍadeśe tu brāhmaṇo buddhanāmakaḥ || tasya bhāryā'bhavadduṣṭā anācāraratā mune || 7 || tasyāḥ saṃsargadoṣeṇa kṣīṇā''yurmṛtimāptavān || patyau mṛte'pi sā patnī anācāre viśeṣataḥ || 8 || ratābhūnna hi tasyāstu lajjā lokāpavādataḥ || sutabaṃdhuvihīnā sā sadābhikṣānnabhojanā || 9 || na saṃskārānnamalpaṃ vā bhuktvā paryuṣitāśinī || parapākaratā nityaṃ tīrthayātrādivarjitā || || 2.4.7.10 || kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ caiva na śrutaṃ tu tayā dvija || ekadā brāhmaṇaḥ kaścittīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ || 11 || tasyā gṛhaṃ samāgacchadvidvānvai kutsanāmakaḥ || anācāraratāṃ tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā brahmarṣisattamaḥ || kopena raktacakṣuḥ saṃstāmuvācā'satīṃ striyam || 12 || || kutsa uvāca || || vakṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ mūḍhe madvākyamavadhāraya || 13 || duḥkhahetumimaṃ dehaṃ pūyaśoṇitapūritam || paṃcabhūtātmakaṃ caiva kiṃ ca puṣṇāsi dūtike || 14 || jalabudbudavaddeho nāśamāyāti niścitam || anityaṃ dehamāśritya nityaṃ tvaṃ manyase hṛdi || 15 || tasmādaṃtaḥsthitaṃ mohaṃ tyaja mūḍhe vicārataḥ || smara sarvottamaṃ devaṃ kuru śravaṇamādarāt || 16 || kārtike māsi saṃprāpte snānadānādikaṃ kuru || dāmodarasya prītyarthaṃ dīpadānaṃ tathā kuru || 17 || lakṣavartyādikaṃ caiva lakṣapadmādikaṃ tathā || pradakṣiṇāṃ tu devasya namaskāraṃ tathaiva ca || 18 || dhāraṇaṃ pāraṇaṃ caiva kuru bhaktyā hi kārtike || vidhavānāṃ vratamidaṃ sadhavānāṃ tathaiva ca || 19 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam || tatrā'pi kārtike māsi dīyatāṃ dīpa uttamaḥ || 2.4.7.20 || dīpo hareḥ priyakaraḥ kārtike māsi niścitam || mahāpātakakṛdvāpi dīpadānātpramucyate || 21 || purā kaściddvijavaro nāmnā harikaro hyabhūt || adharmaviṣayāsaktaḥ śaśvadveśyārato dvijaḥ || 22 || pitṛvittakṣayakaro vaṃśacchede kuṭhārakaḥ || kadācittena vidhave dyūte pitṛdhanaṃ mahat || 23 || hāritaṃ duṣṭasaṃsargāttato duḥkhī sa cā'bhavat || kadācitsādhusaṃsargāttīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ || 24 || ayodhyāmāgato vatse mahāpāpakaro dvijaḥ || kārtike māsi saṃprāptaḥ śrīmaddvijagṛhe sadā ||25|| dyūtavyājena tenā''śu dīpo datto hareḥ puraḥ || tataḥ kālāṃtare vipro mṛto mokṣamavāptavān || 26 || mahāpātakakṛdvā'pi gatavānabhayaṃ harim || tasmāttvaṃ kārtike māsi dīpadānaṃ tathā kuru || 27 || tathā'nyānyapi dānāni kuru bhaktisamanvitā || ityādiśyātha tāṃ kutso jagāmā'nyagṛhaṃ dvijaḥ || 28 || sā'pi kutsavacaḥ śrutvā paścāttāpena saṃyutā || vrataṃ tu kārtike māsi kariṣyāmīti niścitā || 29 || pataṃgodayavelāyāṃ kārtike snānamaṃbhasi || dīpadānaṃ vata caiva māsamekaṃ cakāra sā || 2.4.7.30 || tataḥ kālāṃtare caiva gatāyurmṛtimāgatā || dīpadānasya māhātmyānmahāpāpakṛdapyasau || 31 || svargamārgaṃ gatā sā strī kāle mokṣamavāpa ha || tasmānnārada māhātmyaṃ dīpadānasya ko vadet || 32 || kārtike dīpadānaṃ tu mahāpuṇyaphalapradam || kārtikavrataniṣṭho yo dīpadānādikṛnnaraḥ || 33 || dīpadānasyetihāsaṃ śṛṇvanvai mokṣamāpnuyāt || 34 || dīpadānasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ keneha śakyate || paradīpaprabodhasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu nārada || 35 || svasyā'pi śaktirāhitye parasyā'pi prabodhanam || yaḥ kuryāllabhate so'pi nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || 36 || dīpārthaṃ vartikāṃ tailaṃ pātraṃ vā yo dadāti hi || sahāyaṃ vā'tha kurute dadatāṃ dīpamuttamam || 37 || sa tu mokṣamavāpnoti nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || kārtike dīpadānasya māhātmyaṃ ko nu varṇayet || 38 || svasyāpi śaktirāhitye paradīpaṃ prabodhayet || so'pi tatphalamāpnoti nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || 39 || veśyā cendumatīnāma tasyā gehe'tha mūṣikā || paradīpaprabodhena mokṣaṃ prāpa sudurlabham || 2.4.7.40 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena paradīpaṃ prabodhayet || tena mokṣamavāpnoti mūṣikāvanna saṃśayaḥ || 41 || paradīpaprababodhasya phalamīdṛgvidhaṃ mune || sākṣāddīpapradānasya māhātmyaṃ kena varṇyate || 42 || || nārada uvāca || || kārtike dīpadānasya māhātmyaṃ ca mayā śrutam || paradīpa prabodhasya māhātmyamapi vai śrutam || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vyomadīpasya vaibhavam || 43 || || brahmovāca || || ākāśadīpa māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu putra samāhitaḥ || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa dīpadāne matirbhavet || 44 || saṃprāpte kārtike māsi prātaḥsnānaparāyaṇaḥ || ākāśadīpaṃ yo dadyāttasya puṇyaṃ vadāmyaham || 45 || sarvalokādhipo bhūtvā sarvasaṃpatsamanvitaḥ || iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cāṃte mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 46 || snānadānakriyāpūrvaṃ harimaṃdiramastake || ākāśadīpo dātavyo māsamekaṃ tu kārtike || kārtike śuddhapūrṇāyāṃ vidhinotsarjayecca tam || 47 || yaḥ karoti vidhānena kārtike vyomni dīpakam || na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 48 || atra te varṇayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa vyomadīpaphalaṃ labhet || 49 || purā tu niṣṭhuronāma lubdhako lokakaṃṭakaḥ || yamunātīravāsī ca
