|| tadapāsya sa śūlena taṃ vakṣasyahanadbalī || 6 || sa śūlabhinnahṛdayo hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || adreḥ śikharamāmucya śailādiṃ so'pyapātayat ||7 || atha śumbho gaṇeśaśca rathamūṣakavāhanau || yudhyamānau śaravrātaiḥ parasparamavidhyatām || 8 || gaṇeśastu tadā śumbhaṃ hṛdi vivyādha patriṇā || sārathiṃ ca tribhirbāṇaiḥ pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 9 || tato'tikruddhaḥ śumbho'pi bāṇaṣaṣṭyā gaṇādhipam || mūṣakaṃ ca tribhirviddhvā nanāda jaladasvanaḥ || 2.4.19.10 || mūṣakaḥ śarabhinnāṃgaścacāla dṛḍhavedanaḥ || laṃbodaraśca patitaḥ padātirabhavannṛpa || 11 || tato laṃbodaraḥ śumbhaṃ hatvā paraśunā hṛdi || apātayattadā bhūmau mūṣakaṃ cāruhatpunaḥ || 12 || kālanemirniśuṃbhaścā'pyubhau laṃbodaraṃ śaraiḥ || yugapajjaghnatuḥ krodhāttotrairiva mahādvipam || 13 || taṃ pīḍayamānamālokya vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ || abhyadhāvata vegena bhūtakoṭiyutastadā || 14 || kūṣmāṃḍabhairavāścā'pi vetālā yoginīgaṇāḥ || piśācayoginīsaṃghā gaṇāścā'pi tamanvayuḥ || 15 || tataḥ kilakilāśabdaiḥ siṃhanādaiḥ sughargharaiḥ || bherītālamṛdaṃgaiśca pṛthivī samakaṃpata || 16 || tato bhūtānyadhāvaṃta bhakṣayaṃtisma dānavān|| utpataṃtyāpataṃti sma nanṛtuśca raṇāṃgaṇe || 17 || nandī ca kārtikeyaśca samāśvasya tvaratvitau || nijaghnatū raṇe daityānniraṃtaraśaravrajaiḥ || 18 || chinnabhinnā hatairdetyaiḥ patitairbhakṣitaistadā || vyākulā sā'bhavatsenā viṣaṇṇavadanā tadā || 19 || pravidhvastāṃ tadā senāṃ dṛṣṭvā sāgaranaṃdanaḥ || rathenā'tipatākena gaṇānabhiyayau balī || 2.4.19.20 || hastyaśvarathasaṃhrādāḥ śaṃkhabherīsvanāstathā || abhavansiṃhanādāśca senayorubhayostadā || 21 || jalaṃdharaśaravrātairnīhārapaṭalairiva || dyāvāpṛthivyorācchinnamaṃtaraṃ samapadyata || 22 || gaṇeśaṃ paṃcabhirviddhvā śailādiṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ || vīrabhadraṃ ca viṃśatyā nanāda jaladasvanaḥ || 23 || kārtikeyastadā daityaṃ śaktyā vivyādha satvaraḥ || yuyudhe śaktinirbhinnaḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ || 24 || tataḥ krodhaparītākṣaḥ kārtikeyaṃ jalaṃdharaḥ || gadayā tāḍayāmāsa sa ca bhūmitale'patat || 25 || tathaiva naṃdinaṃ vegādapātayata bhūtale || tato gaṇeśvaraḥ kruddho gadāṃ paraśunā'hanat || 26 || vīrabhadrastribhirbāṇairhṛdi vivyādha dānavam || saptabhiśca hayānketuṃ dhanuśchatraṃ ca cicchide || 27 || tato'tikruddho daityeṃdraḥ śaktimudyamya dāruṇām || gaṇeśaṃ pātayāmāsa rathaṃ cā'nyamathā''ruhat ||28|| abhyayādatha vegena vīrabhadraṃ ruṣānvitaḥ || tatastau sūryasaṃkāśau yuyudhāte parasparam || 29 || vīrabhadraḥ punastasya hayānbāṇairapātayat || dhanuściccheda daityeṃdraḥ pupluve parighāyudhaḥ || 2.4.19.30 || sa vīrabhadraṃ tvarayā'bhigamya jaghāna daityaḥ parigheṇa mūrdhni || sa cā'pi vīraḥ pravibhinnamūrddhā papāta bhūmau rudhiraṃ samudgiran|| 31 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye jalaṃdharopākhyāne vīrabhadrapatananāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || || cha ||
<2.4.20>
|| || nārada uvāca || || patitaṃ vīrabhadraṃ tu dṛṣṭvā rudragaṇā bhayāt || agamaṃste raṇaṃ hitvā krośamānā maheśvaram || 1 || atha kolāhalaṃ śrutvā gaṇānāṃ caṃdraśekharaḥ || abhyayādvṛṣabhārūḍhaḥ saṃgrāmaṃ prahasanniva || 2 || rudramāyāṃtamālokya siṃhanādairgaṇāḥ punaḥ || nivṛttāḥ saṃgare daityānnirjaghnuḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ || 3 || daityāśca bhīṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve caiva vidudruvuḥ || kārtikavratinaṃ dṛṣṭvā pātakānīva tadbhayāt ||4|| jalaṃdharotha tāndaityānnivṛttānprekṣya saṃgare || roṣādadhāvaccaṃḍīśaṃ muṃcanbāṇānsahasraśaḥ || 5 || śuṃbho niśuṃbho'śvamukhaḥ kālanemirbalāhakaḥ || khaḍgaromā pracaṃḍaśca ghasmarādyāḥ śivaṃ yayuḥ || 6 || bāṇāṃdhakārasaṃchannaṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇabalaṃ śivaḥ || bāṇajālamavācchidya svabāṇairāvṛṇonnabhaḥ || 7 || daityāṃśca bāṇavātyābhiḥ pīḍitānakarottadā || pracaṃḍabāṇajālaughairapātayata bhūtale || 8 || khaḍgaromṇaḥ śiraḥ kāyāttadā paraśunā'cchinat || balāhakasya ca śiraḥ khaṭvāṃgenā'karoddvidhā || 9 || baddhvā ca ghasmaraṃ daityaṃ pāśenābhyahanadbhuvi || vṛṣabheṇa hatāḥ kecitkecidbāṇairnipātitāḥ || 2.4.20.10 || na śekurasurāḥ sthātuṃ gajāḥ siṃhārditā iva || tataḥ krodhaparītātmā vegādrudraṃ jalaṃdharaḥ ||11|| āhvayāmāsa samare tīvrāśanisamasvanaḥ || || jalaṃdhara uvāca || || yudhyasva ca mayā sārddhaṃ kimebhirnihitaistava || 12 || yacca kiṃcidbalaṃ te'sti taddarśaya jaṭādhara || ityuktvā bāṇasaptatyā jaghāna vṛṣabhadhvajam || 13 || tānprāptānniśitairbāṇaiściccheda prahasanniva|| tato hayāndhvajaṃ chatraṃ dhanuściccheda śaktibhiḥ||14|| sa cchinnadhanvā viratho gadāmudyamya vegavān || abhyadhāvacchivastāvadgadāṃ bāṇairdvidhā'cchinat ||15|| tathā'pi muṣṭimudyamya yayau rudraṃ jighāṃsayā || tāvacchivena bāṇaughaiḥ krośamātramapākṛtaḥ||16|| tato jalaṃdharo daityo matvā rudraṃ balādhikam || sasarja māyāṃ gāṃdharvīmadbhutāṃ rudramohinīm || 17 || tato jaguśca nanṛturgaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || tālaveṇumṛdaṃgādyānvādayaṃti sma cā'pare || 18 || taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ rudro nādavimohitaḥ || patitānyapi śastrāṇi karebhyo na viveda saḥ || ||19|| ekāgrībhūtamālokya rudraṃ daityo jalaṃdharaḥ || kāmārtaḥ sa jagāmāśu yatra gaurī sthitā'bhavat ||2.4.20.20|| yuddhe śuṃbhaniśuṃbhākhyau sthāpayitvā mahābalī || daśadordaṃḍapacāsyastrinetraśca jaṭādharaḥ ||21|| mahāvṛṣabhamārūḍhaḥ sa babhūva jalaṃdharaḥ || atho rudraṃ samāyāṃtamālokya bhavavallabhā||22|| abhyāyayau sakhīmadhyāttaddarśanapathe'bhavat || yāvaddadarśa cārvaṃgī pārvatī danujeśvaraḥ || 23 || tāvatsvavīryaṃ mumuce jaḍāṃgaścā'bhavattadā || atha jñātvā tadā gaurī dānavaṃ bhayavihvalā || 24 || jagāmā'ntarhitā vegātsā tadottaramānase || tāmadṛṣṭvā tato daityaḥ kṣaṇādvidyullatāmiva || 25 || javenā''gātpunaryuddhaṃ yatra devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ || pārvatyapi bhayādviṣṇuṃ sasmāra manasā tadā || 26 || tāvaddadarśa taṃ devaṃ sūpaviṣṭaṃ samīpagam || || pārvatyuvāca|| || viṣṇo jalaṃdharo daityaḥ kṛtavānparamādbhutam ||27|| tatkiṃ na viditaṃ te'sti ceṣṭitaṃ tasya durmateḥ || || viṣṇuruvāca || || tenaiva darśitaḥ paṃthā vayamapyanvayāmahe || 28 || nā'nyathā sa bhavedvadhyaḥ pātivratyasurakṣitḥ || || nārada uvāca || || jagāma viṣṇurityuktvā punarjālaṃdharaṃ puram || 29 || atha rudraśca gaṃdharvā'nugataḥ saṃgare sthitaḥ || aṃtardhānaṃ gatāṃ māyāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa bubudhe tadā || 2.4.20.30 || tato bhavo vismitamānasaḥ punarjagāma yuddhāya jalaṃdharaṃ ruṣā || sa cā'pi daityaḥ punarāgataṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaraughaiḥ samavākiradraṇe || 31 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye jalaṃdharopākhyāne śivajalaṃdharayuddhavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||20|| ||
<2.4.21>
|| nārada uvāca || || viṣṇurjalaṃdharaṃ gatvā taddaityapuṭabhedanam || pātivratyasya bhaṃgāya vṛṃdāyāścā'karonmatim || 1 || atha vṛṃdārakā devī svapnamadhye dadarśa ha || bhartāraṃ mahiṣā''rūḍhaṃ tailābhyaktaṃ digaṃmbaram || 2|| kṛṣṇaprasūnabhūṣāḍhyaṃ kravyādagaṇasevitam || dakṣiṇāśāgataṃ muṇḍaṃ tamasāpyā''vṛtaṃ tadā || 3 || svapuraṃ sāgare magnaṃ sahasaivā''tmanā saha || tataḥ prabuddhā sā bālā tatsvapnaṃ pravicinvatī || 4 || dadarśoditamādityaṃ sacchidraṃ niṣprabhaṃ muhuḥ || tadaniṣṭamiti jñātvā rudatī bhayavihvalā || 5 || kutracinnā'labhaccharma gopurāṭṭālabhūmiṣu || tataḥ sakhīdvayayutā nagarodyānamāgamat || 6 || tatrā'pi sā'bhramadbālā nā'labhatkutracitsukham || vanādvanāṃtaraṃ yātā naiva vedātmanastadā || 7 || tataḥ sā bhramatī bālā dadarśā'tīvabhīṣaṇau || rākṣasau siṃhavadanau daṃṣṭrā''nanavibhīṣaṇau || 8 || tau dṛṣṭvā vihvalā'tīva palāyanaparā'bhavat || dadarśa tāpasaṃ śāṃtaṃ saśiṣyaṃ maunamāsthitam || 9 || tatastatkaṇṭhamāvṛtya nijāṃ bāhulatāṃ bhayāt || mune māṃ rakṣa śaraṇamāgatā'smītyabhāṣata || 2.4.21.10 || munistāṃ vihvalāṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasā'nugatāṃ tadā || huṃkāreṇaiva tau ghorau cakāra vimukhau ruṣā || 11 || tau huṃkārabhayatrastau dṛṣṭvā ca vimukhau gatau || praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau vṛndā vacanamabravīt || 12 || || vṛndovāca || || rakṣitāhaṃ tvayā ghorādbhayādasmātkṛpānidhe || kiṃcidvijñastumicchāmi kṛpayā tanniśāmaya || 13 || jalaṃdharo hi madbhartā rudraṃ yoddhuṃ gataḥ prabho || sa tatrā'ste kathaṃ yuddhe tanme kathaya suvrata || 14 || || nārada uvāca || || munistadvākyamākarṇya kṛpayordhvamavaikṣata || tāvatkapī samāyātau praṇamya cāgrataḥ sthitau || 15 || tatastadbhrūlatāsaṃjñāniyuktau gaganaṃ gatau || gatvā kṣaṇārddhādāgatya praṇatāvagrataḥ sthitau || śiraḥkabandhe hastau ca gṛhītvā samupasthitau || 16 || śiraḥkabaṃdhe hastau ca dṛṣṭvā'bdhitanayasya sā || papāta mūrchitā bhūmau bhartṛvyasanaduḥkhitā || 17 || kamaṃḍalūdakaiḥ siktvā muninā''śvāsitā tadā || svabhartṛbhāle sā bhālaṃ kṛtvā dīnā ruroda ha || 18 || || vṛndovāca || || yaḥ purā sukhasaṃvāde vinodayasi māṃ prabho || sa kathaṃ na vadasyadya vallabhā māmanāgasam || 19 || yena devāḥ sagaṃdharvā nirjitā viṣṇunā saha || sa kathaṃ tāpasenā'dya trailokyavijayī hataḥ || 2.4.21.20 || || nārada uvāca || || ruditveti tadā vṛndā taṃ muniṃ vākyamabravīt || || vṛndovāca || || kṛpānidhe muniśreṣṭha jīvayainaṃ mama priyam ||21|| tvamevāsya mune śakto jīvanāya mato mama || nārada uvāca || || iti tadvākyamākarṇya prahasanmunirabravīt || 22 || || muniruvāca || || nā'yaṃ jīvayituṃ śakto rudreṇa nihato yudhi || tathā'pi tvatkṛpāviṣṭa enaṃ saṃjīvayāmyaham || 23 || || nārada uvāca || || ityuktvāṃtardadhe viprastāvatsāgaranaṃdanaḥ || vṛṃdāmāliṃgya tadvaktraṃ cucuṃba prītamānasaḥ || 24 || atha vṛndā'pi bhartāraṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣitamānasā || reme tadvanamadhyasthā tadyuktā bahuvāsaram || 25 || kadācitsuratasyāṃte dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ tameva ca || nirbhartsya krodhasaṃyuktā vṛndā vacanamabravīt || 26 || || vṛṃdovāca || || dhiktvadīyaṃ hare śīlaṃ paradārābhigāminaḥ || jñāto'si tvaṃ mayā samyaṅmāyāpracchannatāpasaḥ || 27 || yau tvayā māyayā dvāḥsthau svakīyau darśitau mama || tāveva rākṣasau bhūtvā bhāryāṃ tava hariṣyataḥ ||28|| tvaṃ cā'pi bhāryāduḥkhārto vane kapisahāyavān || bhrama sarpeśvareṇā'yaṃ yaste śiṣyatvamāgataḥ || 29|| ityuktvā sā tadā vṛndā prāviśaddhavyavāhanam || viṣṇunā vāryamāṇā'pi tasyāmāsaktacetasā ||2.4.21.30|| tato haristāmanusaṃsmaranmuhurvṛṃdānvitobhasmarajovaguṃṭhitaḥ || tatraiva tasthau surasiddhasaṃghaiḥ prabodhyamāno'pi yayau na śāṃtim ||31|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye jalaṃdharopākhyāne vṛndāgnipraveśavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || || cha ||
<2.4.22>
|| nārada uvāca || || tato jalaṃdharo dṛṣṭvā rudramadbhutavikramam || cakāra māyayā gaurīṃ tryaṃbakaṃ mohayanniva || 1 || rathopari ca tāṃ baddhāṃ rudantīṃ pārvatīṃ śivaḥ || niśuṃbhapramukhādyaiśca vadhyamānāṃ dadarśa saḥ || 2 || gaurīṃ tathāvidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā śivo'pyudvignamānasaḥ || avāṅmukhaḥ sthitastūṣṇīṃ vismṛtya svaparākramam || 3 || tato jalaṃdharo vegāttribhirvivyādha sāyakaiḥ || āpuṃkhamagraistaṃ rudraṃ śirasyurasi codare || 4 || tato jajñe sa tāṃ māyāṃ viṣṇunā ca prabodhitaḥ || raudrarūpadharo jāto jvālāmālā'tibhīṣaṇaḥ || 5 || tasyā'tīva mahāraudraṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāsurāḥ || na śekuḥ saṃmukhe sthātuṃ bhejire te diśo daśa ||6|| tataḥ śāpaṃ dadau rudrastayoḥ śuṃbhaniśuṃbhayoḥ || mama yuddhādapakrāṃtau gauryā badhyau bhaviṣyathaḥ || 7 || punarjalaṃdharo vegādvavarṣa niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || bāṇāṃdhakāraiḥ saṃchannaṃ tadā bhūmitalaṃ mahat || 8 || yāvadrudraśca ciccheda tasya bāṇagaṇaṃ javāt || tāvatsa parigheṇā''śu jaghāna vṛṣabhaṃ balī || 9 || vṛṣastena prahāreṇa parāvṛtto raṇāṃgaṇāt || rudreṇā''kṛṣyamāṇo'pi na tasthau raṇabhūmiṣu || 2.4.22.10 || tataḥ paramasaṃkuddho rudro raudravapurdharaḥ || cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ vegāccikṣepā''dityavarcasam || 11 || pradahadrodasī vegātpapāta vasudhātale || jahāra tacchiraḥ kāyānmahadāyatalocanam || 12 || rathātkāyaḥ papātā'sya nādayanvasudhātalam || tejaśca nirgataṃ dehāttadrudre layamāgamat || 13 || vṛndādehodbhavaṃ tejastadgauryāṃ vilayaṃ gatam || atha brahmādayo devā harṣādutphullalocanāḥ || 14 || praṇamya śirasā rudraṃ śaśaṃsurviṣṇuceṣṭitam || || devā ūcuḥ || || mahādeva tvayā devā rakṣitāḥ śatrujādbhayāt || 15 || kiṃcidanyatsamudbhūtaṃ tatra kiṃ karavāmahe || vṛndālāvaṇyasaṃbhrāṃto viṣṇustiṣṭhati mohitaḥ || 16 || || īśvara uvāca || || gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ devā viṣṇormohāpanuttaye || śaraṇyāṃ mohinīṃ māyāṃ sā vaḥ kāryaṃ kariṣyati || 17 || || nārada uvāca || || ityuktvāṃtardadhe devaḥ sarvabhūtagaṇaistadā || devāśca tuṣṭuvurmūlaprakṛtiṃ bhaktavatsalām || 18 || || devā ūcuḥ || || yadudbhavāḥ sattvarajastamoguṇāḥ sargasthitidhvaṃsanidānakāriṇaḥ || yadicchayā viśvamidaṃ bhavā'bhavau tanoti mūlaprakṛtiṃ natāḥ sma tām || 19 || yā hi trayoviṃśatibhedaśabditā jagatyaśeṣe samadhiṣṭhitā parā || yadrūpakarmāṇi jaḍāstrayo'pi devā na vidyuḥ prakṛtiṃ natāḥ sma tām || 2.4.22.20 || yadbhaktiyuktāḥ puruṣāstu nityaṃ dāridryabhīmohaparābhavādīn || na prāpnuvaṃtyeva hi bhaktavatsalāṃ sadaiva mūlaprakṛtiṃ natāḥ sma tām || 21 || || nārada uvāca || || stotrametattrisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedekāgramānasaḥ || dāridyamohaduḥkhāni na kadācitspṛśaṃti tam ||22|| itthaṃ stuvaṃtaste devāstejomaṇḍalamāsthitam || dadṛśurgaganaṃ tatra jvālāvyāptadigaṃtaram || 23 || tanmadhyādbhāratīṃ sarve śuśruvurvyomacāriṇīm || || śaktiruvāca || || ahameva tridhā bhinnā tiṣṭhāmi trividhairguṇaiḥ || || 24 || gaurī lakṣmī svarā ceti rajaḥsattvatamoguṇaiḥ || tatra gacchata tāḥ kāryaṃ vidhāsyati ca vaḥ surāḥ || 25 || || nārada uvāca || || śṛṇvatāmiti tāṃ vācamaṃtardhānamagānmahaḥ || devānāṃ vismayotphullanetrāṇāṃ tattadā nṛpa || 26 || tataḥ sarve'pi te devā gatvā tadvākyanoditāḥ || gaurīṃ lakṣmīṃ svarāṃ caiva praṇemurbhaktitatparāḥ || 27 || tatastāstānsurāndṛṣṭvā praṇatānbhaktavatsalāḥ || bījāni pradadustebhyo vākyānyūcuśca bhūmipa || 28 || || devya ūcuḥ || || imāni tatra bījāni viṣṇuryatrā'vatiṣṭhate || nirvapadhvaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ bhavatāṃ siddhimeṣyati || 29 || || || nārada uvāca || || tatastu hṛṣṭāḥ surasiddhasaṃghāḥ pragṛhya bījāni vicikṣipuste || vṛṃdānvito bhūmitale sa yatra viṣṇuḥ sadā tiṣṭhati saukhyahīnaḥ || 2.4.22.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye jalaṃdharamuktikathanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || cha ||
<2.4.23>
|| nārada uvāca || || kṣiptebhyastatra bījebhyo vanaspatyastrayo'bhavan || dhātrī ca mālatī caiva tulasī ca nṛpottama || 1 || dhātryudbhavā smṛtā dhātrī mābhavā mālatī smṛtā || gaurībhavā ca tulasī tamaḥsattvarajoguṇāḥ || 2 || strīrūpiṇyau vanaspatyau dṛṣṭvā viṣṇustadā nṛpa || uttasthau saṃbhramādvṛṃdā rūpātiśayavibhramaḥ ||3|| dṛṣṭvā ca yācate mohātkāmāsaktena cetasā || taṃ cā'pi tulasīdhātryau rāgeṇaiva vyalokatām||4|| yacca lakṣmyā purā bījamīrṣyayaiva samarpitam || tasmāttadudbhavā nārī tasminnīrṣyāparā'bhavat || 5 || ataḥ sā barbarītyākhyāmavāpā'dha vigarhitām || dhātrītulasyau tadrāgāttasya prītiprade sadā || 6 || tato vismṛtaduḥkho'sau viṣṇustābhyāṃ sahaiva tu || vaikuṇṭhamagamaddhṛṣṭaḥ sarvadeva namaskṛtaḥ || 7 || kārtikodyāpane viṣṇostasmātpūjā vidhīyate || tulasīmūladeśe'sya prītidā sā yataḥ smṛtā || 8 || tulasīkānanaṃ rājangṛhe yasyā'vatiṣṭhate || tadgṛhaṃ tīrtharūpaṃ tu nā''yāṃti yamakiṃkarāḥ || 9 || sarvapāpaharaṃ nityaṃ kāmadaṃ tulasīvanam || ropayaṃti narāḥ śreṣṭhāste na paśyaṃti bhāskarim || 2.4.23.10 || darśanaṃ narmadāyāstu gaṃgāsnānaṃ tathaiva ca || tulasīvanasaṃsargaḥ samameva trayaṃ smṛtam || 11 || ropaṇātpālanātsekāddarśanātsparśanānnṛṇām || tulasī dahate pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃcitam || 12 || tulasīmaṃjarībhiryaḥ kuryāddhariharā'rcanam || na sa garbhagṛhaṃ yāti muktibhāgī na saṃśayaḥ || 13 || puṣkarādyāni tīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā || vāsudevādayo devāstiṣṭhaṃti tulasīdale || 14 || tulasīmaṃjarīyukto yastu prāṇānvimuṃcati || yamo'pi nekṣituṃ śakto yuktaṃ pāpaśatairapi || 15 || viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ nṛpottama || tulasīkāṣṭhajaṃ yastu caṃdanaṃ dhārayennaraḥ || 16 || taddehaṃ na spṛśetpāpaṃ kriyamāṇamapīha yat || tulasīvipinacchāyā yatrayatra bhavennṛpa || 17 || tatra śrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam || dhātrīphalavimiśraiśca tulasīpatramiśritaiḥ || 18 || jalaiḥ snāti narastasya gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ smṛtam || devārcanaṃ naraḥ kuryāddhātrīpatraiḥ phalaistathā || 19 || suvarṇamaṇimuktaughairarcanasyāpnuyātphalam || tīrthāni munayo devā yajñāḥ sarve'pi kārtike || || 2.4.23.20 || nityaṃ dhātrīṃ samāśritya tiṣṭhaṃtyarke tulāsthite || dvādaśyāṃ tulasīpatraṃ dhātrīpatraṃ tu kārtike || 21 || lunāti sa naro gacchennirayānatigarhitān|| dhātrītulasyormāhātmyamapi devaścaturmukhaḥ || na samartho bhavedvaktuṃ yathā devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 22 || dhātrītulasyudbhavakāraṇaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti yaḥ śrāvayate ca bhaktyā || vidhūtapāpmā saha pūrvajaiḥ svaiḥ svargaṃ vrajatyagryavimānasaṃsthaiḥ ||23|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye dhātrītulasyutpattivarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 23 || || cha ||
<2.4.24>
|| pṛthuruvāca || || yadūrjavratinaḥ puṃsaḥ phalaṃ mahadudādṛtam || tatpunarbrūhi māhātmyaṃ kena cīrṇamidaṃ śubham || 1 || || nārada uvāca || || āsītsahyādriviṣaye karavīrapure purā || brāhmaṇo dharmavitkaściddharmadatteti viśrutaḥ || 2 || viṣṇuvratakaraḥ samyagviṣṇupūjārataḥ sadā || kadācitkārtike māsi harijāgaraṇāya saḥ || 3 || rātryāṃ turyāvaśeṣāyāṃ jagāma harimadiram|| haripūjopakaraṇānpragṛhya vrajatā tadā ||4|| tena dṛṣṭā samāyātā rākṣasī bhīmadarśanā || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayavitrastaḥ kaṃpitāvayavastadā || 5 || pūjopakaraṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ payobhiścāhanadbhayāt || saṃsmṛtya taddharernāma tulasīyuktavāriṇā || tena vai hatamātre tu pāpaṃ tasyā hyagāllayam || 6 || atha saṃsmṛtya sā pūrvajanmakarmavipākajām || svāṃ daśāmabravīdvipraṃ daṃḍavacca praṇamya vai || 7 || || kalahovāca || || pūrvakarmavipākena daśāmetāṃ gatāsmyaham || tatkathaṃ nu punarvipra prayāsyāmyuttamāṃ gatim || 8 || || nārada uvāca || || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇatāṃ samyagvadamānāṃ svakarma tat || atīva vismito viprastadā vacanamabravīt || 9 || || || dharmadatta uvāca || || kena karmavipākena tvaṃ daśāmīdṛśīṃ gatā || kutratyā kā ca kiṃ śīlā tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me ||2.4.24.10|| || kalahovāca || || saurāṣṭranagare brahmanbhikṣurnāmā'bhavaddvijaḥ || tasyāhaṃ gṛhiṇī pūrvaṃ kalahākhyā'tiniṣṭhurā || 11 || na kadācinmayā bharturvacasā'pi śubhaṃ kṛtam || nā'rpitaṃ tasya miṣṭānnaṃ bharturvacanaśīlayā ||12|| kalahapriyayā nityaṃ mayodvignamanā yadā || pariṇetuṃ yadā'nyāṃ sa matiṃ cakre patirmama || 13 || tato garaṃ samādāya prāṇāstyaktā mayā dvija || atha baddhvā badhyamānāṃ māṃ ninyuryamakiṃkarāḥ || 14 || yamaśca māṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā citraguptamapṛcchata || || 15 || || yama uvāca || || anayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ karma citragupta vilokaya || prāpnotveṣā ca tatkarma śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || 16 || || || kalahovāca || || citraguptastadā vākyaṃ bhartsayanmāmuvāca saḥ || || citragupta uvāca || || anayā tu kṛtaṃ karma śubhaṃ kiṃcinna vidyate || 17 || miṣṭānnaṃ bhuṃjamāneyaṃ na bhartari tadarpitam || ataśca valgulīyonyāṃ svaviṣṭhādā'vatiṣṭhatu || 18 || bharturdveṣāttadāpyeṣā nityaṃ kalahakāriṇī || viṣṭhādāṃ sūkarīṃ yoniṃ tasmāttiṣṭhatviyaṃ hare || 19 || pākabhāṃḍe sadā bhuṃkte bhuṃkte caikā yatastataḥ || tasmādeṣā biḍālyastu svajātā'patyabhakṣiṇī || 2.4.24.20 || bhartāramapi coddiśya hyātmaghātaḥ kṛto'nayā || tasmātpretaśarīre'pi tiṣṭhatvekā'tiniṃditā || 21 || ataścaiṣā maruddeśaṃ prāpitavyā bhaṭairiyam || tatra pretaśarīrasthā ciraṃ tiṣṭhatviyaṃ tataḥ || 22 || ūrdhvaṃ yonitrayaṃ caiṣā bhunaktvaśubhakāriṇī||23|| || kalahovāca || || sāhaṃ paṃcaśatābdāni pretadehe sthitā kila|| kṣutṛḍbhyāṃ pīḍitā''viśya śarīraṃ vaṇijasya ca|| āyātā dakṣiṇaṃ deśaṃ kṛṣṇāveṇyośca saṃgamam || 24 || tattīraṃ saṃśritā yāvattāvattasya śarīrataḥ || śivaviṣṇugaṇairdūramapakṛṣṭā balādaham || 25 || tataḥ kṣutkṣāmayā dṛṣṭo mayā hi tvaṃ dvijottama || tvaddhastatulasīvārisaṃsargagatapāpayā ||26|| tatkṛtyaṃ kuru vipreṃdra kathaṃ muktimiyāmyaham|| yonitrayādagrabhavādasmācca pretadehataḥ ||27|| itthaṃ viciṃtya kalahāvacanaṃ dvijāgryastatkarmapākabhayavismayaduḥkhayuktaḥ || tadglānidarśanakṛpācalacittavṛtti dhyātvā ciraṃ sa vacanaṃ nijagāda duḥkhāt || 28 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye dharmadattetihāsakathanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || cha ||
<2.4.25>
|| dharmadatta uvāca || || vilayaṃ yāṃti pāpāni tīrthe dānavratādibhiḥ || pretadehasthitāyāste teṣu naivā'dhikāritā || 1 || tvadglānidarśanādasmātkhinnaṃ ca mama mānasam || na vai nirvṛtimāyāti tvāmanuddhṛtya duḥkhitām || 2 || tasmādājanmacaritaṃ yanmayā kārtikavratam || tatpuṇyasyārddhabhāgena sadgatiṃ tvamavāpnuhi || 3 || || nārada uvāca || ityuktvā dharmadatto'sau yāvattāmabhyaṣecayat || tulasīmiśratoyena śrāvayandvādaśākṣaram || 4 || tāvatpretatvanirmuktā jvaladagniśikhopamā || divyarūpadharā jātā lāvaṇyena yatheṃdirā || 5 || tataḥ sā daṃḍavadbhūmau praṇanāmātha taṃ dvijam || uvāca sā tadā vākyairharṣagadgadabhāṣiṇī || 6 || || || kalahovāca || || tvatprasādāddvijaśreṣṭha vimuktā nirayādaham || pāpābdhau majjamānāyāstvaṃ naubhūto'si me dhruvam || 7 || || nārada uvāca || || itthaṃ vadantī sā vipraṃ dadarśā''yātamaṃbarāt || vimānaṃ bhāsvaraṃ yuktaṃ viṣṇurūpadharairgaṇaiḥ || 8 || atha sā tadvimānā'gryaṃ dvāḥsthābhyāmavaropitā || puṇyaśīlasuśīlābhyāmapsarogaṇasevitā || 9 || tadvimānaṃ tadā'paśyaddharmadattaḥ savismayaḥ|| papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau dṛṣṭvā tau viṣṇurūpiṇau || 2.4.25.10 || puṇyaśīlasuśīlau ca tamutthāpyā''nataṃ dvijam || abhinandya tato vākyamūcaturdharmasaṃyutam || 11 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || sādhusādhu dvijaśreṣṭha yastvaṃ viṣṇurataḥ sadā || dīnā'nukampī sarvajño viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ ||12|| ā bālatvācchubhaṃ tvetadyattvayā kārtikavratam || kṛtaṃ tasyā'rddhadānena puṇyaṃ dvaiguṇyamāgamat||13|| janmāṃtaraśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ tadvilayaṃ gatam|| snānaireva gataṃ pāpaṃ yadasyāḥ pūrvakarmajam ||14|| harijāgaraṇādyaiśca vimānamidamāsthitā|| vaikuṇṭhe nīyate sādho nānābhogayutā tviyam ||15|| dīpadānabhavaiḥ puṇyaistejaḥsārūpyamāsthitā || tulasīpūjanādyaiśca kārtikavratakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || viṣṇusānnidhyagā jātā tvayā dattaiḥ kṛpānidhe ||16|| tvamapyasya bhavasyāṃte bhāryābhyāṃ saha yāsyasi || vaikuṇṭha bhuvanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sānnidhyaṃ ca sarūpatām || 17 || te dhanyāḥ kṛtakṛtyāste teṣāṃ ca saphalo bhavaḥ|| yairbhaktyārādhito viṣṇurdharmadatta yathā tvayā || || 18 || samyagārādhito viṣṇuḥ kiṃ na yacchati dehinām || auttānacaraṇiryena dhruvatve sthāpitaḥ purā || 19|| yannāmasmaraṇādeva dehino yāṃti sadgatim || 2.4.25.20 || grāhagrasto hi nāgeṃdro yannāmasmaraṇātpurā || vimuktaḥ saṃnidhiṃ prāpto jāto'yaṃ jayasaṃjñakaḥ || 21 || yatastvayā'rcito viṣṇustatsānnidhyaṃ prayāsyasi || bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi bhāryādvayayutaḥ kila || 22 || tataḥ puṇyakṣayejāte yadā yāsyasi bhūtalam || sūryavaṃśodbhavo rājā vikhyātastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 23 || nāmnā daśarathastatra bhāryādvayayutaḥ punaḥ || tṛtīyayā'nayā cā'pi yā te puṇyārddhabhāginī || 24 || tatrā'pi tava sānnidhyaṃ viṣṇuryāsyati bhūtale || ātmānaṃ tava putratve prakalpyā'marakāryakṛt || 25 || tava janmavratādasmādviṣṇusaṃtuṣṭikārakāt || na yajñā na ca dānāni na tīrthānyadhikāni vai || 26 || dhanyo'si viprāgrya yatastvayaitadvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tuṣṭikaraṃ jagadguroḥ|| yadardhabhāgātsaphalā murāreḥ praṇīyate'smābhiriyaṃ salokatām||27|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye dharmadattopākhyāne kalahāmokṣakathanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || || cha ||
<2.4.26>
|| nārada uvāca || || itthaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmadattaḥ savismayaḥ || praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau vākyametaduvāca ha || 1 || || || dharmadatta uvāca || || ārādhayaṃti sarve'pi viṣṇuṃ bhaktā'rtināśanam || yajñairdānairvrataistīrthaistapobhiśca yathāviṣi ||2|| viṣṇuprītikaraṃ teṣāṃ kiṃcitsānnidhyakārakam || yatkṛtvā tāni cīrṇāni sarvāṇyapi bhavaṃti hi || 3 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vipra śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ || setihāsakathāṃ puṇyāṃ kathyamānāṃ purābhavām || 4 || kāṃcipuryāṃ purā colaścakravartī nṛpo'bhavat || yasyākhyayaiva te deśāścolā iti prathāṃ gatāḥ || 5 || yasmiñchāsati bhūcakraṃ daridro vā'pi duḥkhitaḥ|| pāpabuddhiḥ sarugvāpi naiva kaścidabhūnnaraḥ ||6|| yasyāpyunnatayajñasya tāmraparṇyāstaṭāvubhau || suvarṇayūpaiḥ śobhāḍhyāvāstāṃ caitrarathopamau || 7 || sa kadācidagādrājā hyanaṃtaśayanaṃ dvija || yatrā'sau jagatāṃ nātho yoganidrāmupāśritaḥ|| 6 || tatra śrīramaṇaṃ devaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivannṛpaḥ || maṇimuktāphalairdivyaiḥ svarṇapuṣpaiśca śobhanaiḥ || 9 || praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmāvupaviṣṭaḥ sa tatra vai || tāvadbrāhmaṇamāyātamapaśyaddevasannidhau || 2.4.26.10 || devārcanārthaṃ pāṇau tu tulasyudakadhāriṇam|| svapurīvāsinaṃ tatra viṣṇudāsāhvaya dvijam || 11 || sa tatrābhyetya viprarṣirdevadevamapūjayat || viṣṇusūktena saṃsnāpya tulasīmaṃjarīdalaiḥ || 12 || tulasīpūjayā tasya ratnapūjāṃ purā kṛtām || ācchāditāṃ samālokya rājā kuddho'bravīdidam|| 13 || || cola uvāca || || māṇikyasvarṇapūjā'tra śobhāḍhyā yā kṛtā mayā || viṣṇudāsa kathaṃ seyamācchannā tulasīdalaiḥ || 14 || viṣṇubhaktiṃ na jānāsi varāko'si mato mama || yastvimāmatiśobhāḍhyāṃ pūjāmācchādayasyaho || || 15 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sakrodhaḥ sa dvijottamaḥ || rājño gauravamullaṃghya jagāda vacanaṃ tadā || 16 || || viṣṇudāsa uvāca || || rājanbhaktiṃ na jānāsi garvito'si nṛpaśriyā || kiyadviṣṇuvrataṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ vadasva tat || 17 || ||gaṇāvūcatuḥ|| tadbrāhmaṇavacaḥ śrutvā prahasya sa nṛpottamaḥ|| viṣṇudāsaṃ tadā garvāduvāca vacanaṃ dvijam|| 18|| ||rājovāca|| itthaṃ cedvadase vipra viṣṇubhaktyā'tigarvitaḥ|| bhaktiste kiyatī viṣṇordaridrasyā'dhanasya ca ||19|| yajñadānādikaṃ naiva viṣṇostuṣṭikaraṃ kṛtam || nā'pi devālayaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ vipra tvayā kvacit || 2.4.26.20 || īdṛśasyā'pi te garva eṣa tiṣṭhati bhaktitaḥ || tacchṛṇvaṃtu vaco me'dya sarve'pyete dvijātayaḥ || 21 || sākṣātkāramahaṃ viṣṇoreṣa vādo gamiṣyati || paśyaṃtu sarve'pi tato bhaktiṃ jñāsyaṃti cāvayoḥ || 22 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || ityuktvā sa nṛpo'gacchannijarājagṛhaṃ tadā || ārabhadvaiṣṇavaṃ satraṃ kṛtvā''cāryaṃ tu mudgalam || 23 || ṛṣisaṃghasamājuṣṭaṃ bahvannaṃ bahudakṣiṇam || yacca brahmakṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ gayākṣetre samṛddhimat || 24 || viṣṇudāso'pi tatraiva tasthau devālaye vratī || yathoktaniyamānkurvanviṣṇostuṣṭikarānsadā || 25 || māghorjayorvrataṃ samyaktulasīvanapālanam || ekādaśyāṃ harerjāpyaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā || 26 || upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirnṛtyagītādimaṃgalaiḥ || nityaṃ viṣṇostathā pūjāṃ vratānyetāni so'karot || 27 || nityaṃ saṃsmaraṇaṃ viṣṇorgacchanbhuvi svapannapi || sarvabhūtasthitaṃ viṣṇumapaśyatsamadarśanaḥ || || 28 || māghakārtikayornityaṃ viśeṣaniyamānapi || akarodviṣṇutuṣṭyarthaṃ sodyāpanavidhiṃ tathā || 29 || evaṃ samārādhayatoḥ śriyaḥ patiṃ tayośca coleśvaraviṣṇudāsayoḥ || agāddhi kālaḥ sumahānvratasthayostanniṣṭhasarveṃdriyakarmaṇostadā || 2.4.26.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye colarājaviṣṇudāsabrāhmaṇavivādakathanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
<2.4.27>
|| nārada uvāca || || kadācidviṣṇudāso'tha kṛtvā nityavidhiṃ dvija || sa pākamakarottāvadaharatko'pyalakṣitaḥ || 1 || tamadṛṣṭvā'pyasau pākaṃ punarnaivā'karottadā || sāyaṃkālā'rcanasyā'sau vratabhaṃgabhayāddvijaḥ || 2 || dvitīye'hni punaḥ pākaṃ kṛtvā yāvatsa viṣṇave || upahārārpaṇaṃ kartuṃ gataḥ ko'pyaharatpunaḥ || 3 || evaṃ saptadinaṃ tasya pākaṃ ko'pyaharannṛpa || tataḥ savismayaścātha manasyevamadhārayat || 4 || aho nityaṃ samabhyetya kaḥ pākaṃ harate mama || kṣetrasaṃnyāsinaḥ sthānaṃ na tyājyaṃ mama sarvathā || 5 || punaḥ pākaṃ vidhāyā'tra bhujyate yadi cenmayā || sāyaṃkālā'rcanaṃ caiva parityājyaṃ kathaṃ bhavet||6|| yadi pākaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ bhoktavyaṃ tu mayā na tat|| anivedya harau sarvaṃ vaiṣṇavairnaiva bhujyate|| 7 || upoṣito'haṃ saptā'haṃ tiṣṭhāmyatra vratasthitaḥ || adyasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ samyakpākasyā'tra karomyaham || 8 || iti pākaṃ vidhāyā'sau tatraivā'lakṣitaḥ sthitaḥ || tāvaddadarśa caṃḍālaṃ pākānnaharaṇe sthitam ||9|| kṣutkṣāmaṃ dīnavadanamasthicarmā'vaśeṣitam || tamālokya dvijāgryo'bhūtkṛpayā'nvitamānasaḥ ||2.4.27.10|| vilokyā'nnaharaṃ viprastiṣṭhatiṣṭhetyabhāṣata|| kathamaśnāsi tadrūkṣaṃ ghṛtametadgṛhāṇa bhoḥ||11|| itthaṃ vadaṃtaṃ viprāgryamāyāṃtaṃ sa vilokya ca || vegādadhāvattadbhītyā mṛrcchitaśca papāta ha ||12|| bhītaṃ saṃmūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā caṃḍālaṃ sa dvijāgraṇīḥ || vegādabhyetya kṛpayā svavastrāṃtairavījayat || 13 || athotthitaṃ tamevāsau viṣṇudāso vyalokayat || sākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam |||| 14 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sāttvikairbhāvairāvṛto dvijasattamaḥ || stotuṃ caiva namaskartuṃ tadā nā'laṃ babhūva saḥ || 15 || atha śakrādayo devāstatraivābhyāyayustadā || gaṃdharvāpsarasaścā'pi jaguśca nanṛturmudā || 16 || vimānaśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ devarṣiśatasaṃkulam || gītavāditranirghoṣaṃ sthānaṃ tadabhavattadā || || 17 || tato viṣṇuḥ samāliṃgya svabhaktaṃ sāttvikavratam || sārūpyamātmano dattvā'nayadvaikuṇṭhamaṃdiram || 18 || vimānavarasaṃsthaṃ taṃ gacchaṃtaṃ viṣṇusannidhim || dīkṣitaścolanṛpatirviṣṇudāsaṃ dadarśa saḥ || 19 || vaikuṇṭhabhuvanaṃ yāṃtaṃ viṣṇudāsaṃ vilokya saḥ || svaguruṃ mudgalaṃ vegādāhūyetthaṃ vaco'bravīt || 2.4.27.20 || || cola uvāca || || yatsparddhayā mayā caiva yajñadānādikaṃ kṛtam || sa viṣṇurūpadhṛgvipro yāti vaikuṇṭhamaṃdiram || || 21 || dīkṣitena mayā samyaksatre'sminvaiṣṇave tvayā || hutamagnau kṛtā viprā dānādyaiḥ pūrṇamānasāḥ || 22 || naivā'dyāpi sa me devaḥ prasanno jāyate dhruvam || viṣṇudāsasya bhaktyaiva sākṣātkāraṃ dadau hariḥ || 23 || tasmāddānaiśca yajñaiśca naiva viṣṇuḥ prasīdati || bhaktireva paraṃ tasya nidānaṃ darśane vibhoḥ || 24 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || ityuktvā bhāgineyaṃ svamabhyaṣiṃcannṛpāsane || ābālyāddīkṣito yajñe hyaputratvamagādyataḥ|| 25 || tasmādadyā'pi taddeśe sadā rājyāṃ'śabhāginaḥ || svasreyā eva jāyaṃte tatkṛtāvadhivartinaḥ || 26 || yajñavāṭaṃ tato'bhyetya yajñakuṇḍāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || triruccairvyājahārā''śu viṣṇuṃ saṃbodhayaṃstadā || 27 || viṣṇo bhaktiṃ sthirāṃ dehi manovākkāya karmabhiḥ || ityuktvā so'patadvahnau sarveṣāmeva paśyatām || 28 || mudgalastu tadā krodhācchikhāmutpāṭayatsvakām || tatastvadyāpi tadgotre mudgalā viśikhā babhuḥ || 29 || tāvadāvirabhūdviṣṇuḥ kuṇḍāgnau bhaktavatsalaḥ || tamāliṃgya vimānāgryaṃ samārohayadacyutaḥ || 2.4.27.30 || tamāliṃgyā''tmasārūpyaṃ dattvā vaikuṇṭhamaṃdiram|| tenaiva saha deveśo jagāma tridaśairvṛtaḥ || 31 || || nārada uvāca || || yo viṣṇudāsaḥ sa tu puṇyaśīlo yaścolabhūpaḥ sa suśīlanāmā || etāvubhau tatsamarūpabhājau dvāḥsthau kṛtau tena ramāpriyeṇa || 32 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye colaviṣṇudāsamuktikathanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || || cha || ||
<2.4.28>
|| dharmadatta uvāca || || jayaśca vijayaścaiva viṣṇordvāsthau śrutau mayā || kiṃ nu tābhyāṃ purā cīrṇaṃ tasmāttadrūpadhāriṇau || 1 || || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || tṛṇabiṃdostu kanyāyāṃ devahūtyāṃ purā dvija || kardamasya tu dṛṣṭyaiva putrau dvau saṃbabhūvatuḥ || 2 || jyeṣṭho jayaḥ kaniṣṭho'bhūdvijayaścaiva nāmataḥ || tasyāmevā'bhavatpaścātkapilo yogadharmavit || 3 || jayaśca vijayaścaiva viṣṇubhaktiratau sadā || tau tanniṣṭhendriyagrāmau dharmaśīlau babhūvatuḥ || 4 || nityamaṣṭākṣarījāpyau viṣṇuvratakarāvubhau || sākṣātkāraṃ dadau viṣṇustayornityārcane sadā || 5 || maruttena kadācittāvāhūtau yajñakarmaṇi || jagmaturyajñakuśalau devarṣigaṇapūjitau || 6 || jayastatrābhavadbrahmāyājako vijayo'bhavat || tato yajñavidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca cakratuḥ || 7 || marutto'vabhṛthasnātastābhyāṃ vittaṃ dadau bahu || tatsamādāya tau vittaṃ jagmatuḥ svāśramaṃ prati || 8 || yajanāya pṛthagviṣṇostuṣṭyarthaṃ tau tato munī || taddhanaṃ vibhajaṃtau tu paspardhāte parasparam || 9 || jayo'bravītsamo bhāgaḥ kriyatāmiti tatra saḥ || vijayaścābravīnnaitadyallabdhaṃ yena tasya tat || 2.4.28.10 || tato'śapajjayaḥ krodhādvijayaṃ lubdhamānasam || gṛhītvā na dadāsyetattasmādgrāho bhaveti tam || || 11 || vijayastasya taṃ śāpaṃ śrutvā sopyaśapacca tam || madabhrāṃto'śapastvaṃ māṃ tasmānmātaṃgatāṃ vraja || 12 || tattadācakhyaturviṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvā nityārcane vibhum || śāpayośca nivṛttiṃ tau yayācāte ramāpatim || 13 || || jayavijayāvūcatuḥ || || bhaktāvāvāṃ kathaṃ deva grāhamātaṃgayonigau || bhaviṣyāvaḥ kṛpāsiṃdho tacchāpo vinivartyatām || 14 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || madbhaktayorvaco'satyaṃ na kadācidbhaviṣyati || mayā'pi nānyathā kartuṃ śakyate tatkadācana || 15 || prahlādavacasā staṃbhe'pyāvirbhūto hyahaṃ purā || tathāṃ'barīṣavākyena jāto garbhe svayaṃ kila || 16 || tasmādyuvāmimau śāpāvanu'bhūya svayaṃkṛtau || labhethāṃ matpadaṃ nityamityuktvāṃ'tardadhe hariḥ || 17 || || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || tatastau grāhamātaṃgāvabhūtāṃ gaṃḍakītaṭe || jātismarau tu tadyonyāmapi viṣṇuvrate sthitau || 18 || kadācitsa gajaḥ snātuṃ kārtike gaṃḍakīṃ gataḥ || tāvajjagrāha taṃ grāhaḥ saṃsmarañcchāpakāraṇam || 19 || grāhagrasto hyasau nāgaḥ sasmāra śrīpatiṃ tadā || tāvadāvirabhūdviṣṇuścakraśaṃkhagadādharaḥ || 2.4.28.20 || tatastau grāhamātaṃgau cakraṃ kṣiptvā samuddhṛtau || dattvaiva nijasārūpyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamanayadvibhuḥ || 21 || tataḥprabhṛti tatsthānaṃ harikṣetramitismṛtam || cakrasaṃgharṣaṇādyasmingrāvāṇo'pi hi lāṃchitāḥ || 22 || tāvubhau viśrutau loke jayaśca vijayastathā || nityaṃ viṣṇupriyau dvāḥsthau pṛṣṭau yau hi tvayā dvija || 23 || atastvamapi dharmajña nityaṃ viṣṇuvrate sthitaḥ || tyaktamātsaryadaṃbho'pi bhavasva samadarśanaḥ || || 24 || tulāmakarameṣeṣu prātaḥsnāyī sadā bhava || ekādaśīvrate tiṣṭha tulasīvanapālakaḥ || 25 || brāhmaṇānatha gāścā'pi vaiṣṇavāṃśca sadā bhaja || masūrikāmāranālaṃ vṛṃtākānyapi khāda mā || 26 || evaṃ tvamapi dehāṃte tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || prāpnoṣi dharmadatta tvaṃ tadbhaktyaiva yathā vayam || 27 || tāvajjanma vratādasmādviṣṇusaṃtuṣṭikārakāt || na yajñā na ca dānāni na tīrthānyadhikāni vai || 28 || dhanyo'si viprāgrya yatastvayaitadvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tuṣṭikaraṃ jagadguroḥ || yadardhabhāgā''ptaphalā murāreḥ praṇīyate'smābhiriyaṃ salokatām || 29 || || nārada uvāca || || itthaṃ tau dharmadattaṃ tamupadiśya vimānagau || tayā kalahayā sārddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ gatau || 2.4.28.30 || dharmadatto hyasau jātapratyayastadvrate sthitaḥ || dehāṃ'te tadvibhoḥ sthānaṃ bhāryābhyāṃ saṃyuto'bhyayāt || 31 || itihāsamimaṃ purābhavaṃ śṛṇute śrāvayate ca yaḥ pumān || harisannidhikāraṇīṃ matiṃ labhate'sau kṛpayā jagadguroḥ || 32 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye dharmadattamokṣaprāptikathanaṃnāmā'ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || cha || ||
<2.4.29>
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pṛthurvismitamānasaḥ || saṃpūjya nāradaṃ samyagvisasarja tadā priye ||1|| purā'vaṃtīpure kaścidvipra āsīddhaneśvaraḥ || brahmakarmaparibhraṣṭaḥ pāpakarmā sudurmatiḥ ||2|| deśāddeśātaraṃ gacchankrayavikrayakāraṇāt || māhiṣmatīpurīmāgātkadācitsa dhaneśvaraḥ||3|| mahiṣeṇa kṛtā pūrvaṃ tasmānmāhiṣmatīti sā || yasyā vapragatā bhāti narmadā pāpanāśinī || 4 || kārtikavratinastatra nānādeśā''gatānnarān || sa dṛṣṭvā vikrayaṃ kurvanmāsamekamuvāsa saḥ || 5 || sa nityaṃ narmadātīre bhramanvikrayakāraṇāt || dadarśa brāhmaṇānsnānajapadevārcane sthitān || || 6 || kāṃścitpurāṇaṃ paṭhataḥ kāṃścicca śravaṇe ratān || nṛtyagāyanavāditraviṣṇuśravaṇatatparān ||7|| udyāpanavidhau saktānkāṃścijjāgaraṇe ratān || vipragopūjanaratāndīpadānaratāṃstathā || 8 || dadarśa kautukāviṣṭastatratatra dhaneśvaraḥ || nityaṃ paribhramaṃstatra darśanasparśabhāṣaṇāt || 9 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ tathā viṣṇornāmaśrāvādi so'labhat || evaṃ māsaṃ sthitastasyā narmadāyāstaṭe dvijaḥ || 2.4.29.10 || tāvatkṛṣṇā'hinā daṣṭo vihvalaḥ sa papāta ha || atha dehaparityaktaṃ taṃ vaddhvā yamakiṃkarāḥ || 11 || yamājñayā kuṃbhipāke cikṣipustaṃ dhaneśvaram || yāvatkṣiptaśca tatrāsau tāvacchītalatāṃ yayau || || 12 || kuṃbhīpāko yathā vahniḥ prahlādakṣepaṇātpurā || yamastu kautukaṃ dṛṣṭvā papracchānīya taṃ tataḥ || 13 || tāvadabhyāgatastatra nāradaḥ prāha satvaram || || nārada uvāca || || naivā'yaṃ nirayānbhoktumarho hyaruṇanaṃdana || 14 || yasmādaṃte'sya saṃjātaṃ karma yannirayāpaham || yaḥ puṇyakarmiṇāṃ kuryāddarśanasparśabhāṣaṇam || 15 || tataḥ ṣaḍaṃśamāpnoti puṇyasya niyataṃ naraḥ || sakhyaṃ tu taistu saṃsargaṃ kṛtavānvai dhaneśvaraḥ || 16 || kārtikavratibhirmāsaṃ teṣāṃ puṇyāṃśabhāgayam || 17 || tasmādakāmapuṇyo hi yakṣayonisthito hyayam || vilokya nirayānsarvānpāpabhogapradarśakān || 18 || || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca|| || ityuktvā gatavati nārade sa sauristadvākyaśravaṇavibuddhatatsukarmā|| taṃ vipraṃ punaranayatsvakiṃkareṇa tānsarvānnirayagaṇānpradarśayiṣyan || 19 || tato dhaneśvaraṃ nītvā nirayānpretapo'bravīt || darśayiṣyaṃstu tānsarvānyamānujñākarastadā || 2.4.29.20 || || pretapa uvāca || || paśyemānnirayānghorāndhaneśvara mahābhayān || eṣu pāpakarā nityaṃ pacyaṃte yamakiṃkaraiḥ ||21|| akāmātpātakaṃ śuṣkaṃ kāmādārdramudāhṛtam || ārdraśuṣkādibhiḥ pāpairdviprakārānavasthitān || 22 || caturāśītisaṃkhyākaiḥ pṛthagbhedairavasthitān || yatprakīrṇamapāṃkteyaṃ malinīkaraṇaṃ tathā || 23 || jātibhraṃśakaraṃ tadvadupapātakasaṃjñakam || atipāpaṃ mahāpāpaṃ saptadhā pātakaṃ smṛtam || 24 || ebhiḥ saptasu pacyaṃte nirayeṣu yathākramam || kārtikavratibhiryasmātsaṃsargo hyabhavattava || 25 || tatpuṇyopacayādete nirhṛtā nirayāḥ khalu || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || darśayitveti nirayānpretapastamathāharat || 26 || dhaneśvaraṃ yakṣalokaṃ yakṣaścā'bhūtsa tatra hi || dhanadasyā'nugaḥ so'yaṃ dhanayakṣeti viśrutaḥ || 27 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktvā vāsudevo'sau satyabhāmāmatipriyam || sāyaṃsaṃdhyāvidhiṃ kartuṃ jagāma jananīgṛham || 28 || || brahmovāca || || evaṃprabhāvaḥ khalu kārtiko'yaṃ muktiprado bhuktikaraśca yasmāt || prayāṃtyanekā'rjitapātakāni vratasya saṃdarśayato'pi muktim || 29 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye dhaneśvarayakṣajanmaprāptivarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || || cha ||
<2.4.30>
|| nārada uvāca || || adbhuto'yaṃ tvayā prokto mahimā kārtikasya tu || svasya kartumasāmarthyaṃ kathametatkṛtaṃ bhavet || 1 || || brahmovāca || || nāsti kartuṃ svasāmarthyamupāyātprāpyate phalam || dravyaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya gṛhṇīyātphalamuttamam || 2 || śiṣyādvā bhṛtyavargādvā strībhyo vā''ptācca kārayet || tasmādapi phalaṃ gṛhṇanphalabhāgjāyate naraḥ || 3 || || nārada uvāca || || adattānyapi puṇyāni prāpyaṃte kenacitkvacit || etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ kautukaṃ mama vartate || 4 || || brahmovāca || || adattānyapi puṇyāni labhaṃte pātakānyapi || yenopāyena tadvacmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā dvija || 5 || sukṛtaṃ vā duṣkṛtaṃ vā kṛtamekena yatkṛte || jāyate tasya tadrāṣṭre tretāyāṃ tu puro bhavet || 6 || dvāpare vaṃśamadhye tu kalau kartaiva kevalam|| ājñānādyatkṛtaṃ karma bālye svapne tu tatphalam || 7 || ajñānādyacca tāruṇye bālye tasya phalaṃ bhavet || jñānapūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma ājanmāṃtaṃ ca tatphalam || 8 || ṣaṇmāsaṃ pāpisaṃgena naraḥ pāpī prajāyate || pāpināṃ vā dharmiṇāṃ vā saṃsargāddaśamāsikam || 9 || bhojanādekapaṃktau ca viṃśāṃśaḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ || ekāsane dvayorvāsātsahasrāṃśena lipyate || 2.4.30.10 || yo vai yasyānnamaśnāti sa bhuṃkte tasya kilbiṣam || japādau pāpisaṃsargātṣoḍaśāṃ'śo vinaśyati || 11 || parasya stavanādyānādekapātrasthabhojanāt || ekaśayyāprāvaraṇātṣaṣṭhāṃśaḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ || 12 || puruṣo harate sarvaṃ bhāryāyā aurasasya ca || arddhaṃ śiṣyāccaturthāṃśaṃ pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ tathaiva ca || 13 || bharturājñākarī nārī bharturarddhaṃ vṛṣaṃ haret || yaddhastapakvaṃ bhujīyāddaśāṃśaṃ tadaghaṃ haret || 14 || varṣā'śanaṃ tu yo datte tadarddhāghasya bhāgayam || varṣāśanārddhaṃ puṇyaṃ tu bhuṃkte varṣāśanī naraḥ || 15 || purohitasya ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ pāpaṃ vā puṇyameva vā || yajamāno bhunaktyeva taddaśāṃśaṃ purohitaḥ || 16 || udyogī cānumantā ca yaścopakaraṇapradaḥ || ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ puṇyapāpānāmupadraṣṭā daśāṃśakam || 17 || yaddhastātkāryate karma nānnamasmai prayacchati || vinā bhṛtakaśiṣyābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ puṇyamāharet|| 18 || vyavahārāttathā prītyā nityaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇādibhiḥ || daśāṃśaṃ puṇyapāpānāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 19 || saṃsargapuṇyayogena ekadanto dvijādhamaḥ || narakānvividhāndṛṣṭvā svargaṃ prāpa tadaiva hi || 2.4.30.20 || || || nārada uvāca || || īdṛśaṃ kārtikavratamalpāyāsaṃ mahatphalam || na kurvaṃti janāḥ kecitkimarthaṃ vai pitāmaha || 21 || || brahmovāca || || svasṛṣṭivṛddhaye vedhā dharmā'dharmau sasarja ha || dharmamevā'nutiṣṭhaṃtaḥ prāpnuvaṃti śubhāṃ gatim || 22 || adharmamanutiṣṭhaṃto yāṃti te'dhogatiṃ narāḥ || puṇyakarmaphalaṃ nāko narakastadviparyayaḥ || 23 || tayoḥ pālanakartārau dvāveva vidhinā kṛtau || śatakratuyamau tau ca puṇyapāpānusāriṇau || 24 || gurutalpādayaḥ putrāḥ kāmasya prathitā bhuvi || krodhasya pitṛghātādyā lobhasya tanayāñchṛṇu || 25 || brahmasvaharaṇādyāśca ete narakanāyakāḥ || kṛtā yamena tairvyāptā manujā na hi kurvate || 26 || vratādidharmakṛtyaṃ yaistairmuktāste hi kurvate || 27 || śraddhā medhā vighātinyau vartete bhuvi sarvadā || tābhyāṃ vyāptastu manujaḥ śrīviṣṇoḥ śravaṇādikam || 28 || na karoti sudurmedhā yenāṃdhaṃ yāti vai tamaḥ || kṛṣṇena satyabhāmāyai yaduktaṃ tadvadāmi te || 29 || adhyāpanādyājanādvā'pyekapaṃktyaśanādapi || turyāṃśa puṇyapāpānāṃ parokṣaṃ labhate naraḥ || 2.4.30.30 || ekāsanādekayānānniśvāsasyāṃgasaṃgataḥ || ṣaḍaṃśaṃ phalabhāgī syānniyataṃ puṇyapāpayoḥ || 31 || sparśanādbhāṣaṇādvā'pi parasya stavanādapi || daśāṃśaṃ puṇyapāpānāṃ nityaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 32 || darśanaśravaṇābhyāṃ ca manodhyānāttathaiva ca || parasya puṇyapāpānāṃ śatāṃśaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 33 || parasya niṃdāṃ paiśunyaṃ dhikkāraṃ ca karoti yaḥ || tatkṛtaṃ pātakaṃ prāpya svapuṇyaṃ pradadāti saḥ || 34 || kurvataḥ puṇyakarmāṇi sevāṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ || patnībhṛtakaśiṣyebhyo yadanyaḥ ko'pi mānavaḥ || 35 || tasya sevā'nurūpaṃ ca dravyaṃ kiṃcinna dīyate || so'pi sevānurūpeṇa tatpuṇyaphalabhāgbhavet || 36 || ekapaṃktisthitaṃ yastu laṃghayetpariveṣaṇam || tatpuṇyasya ṣaḍaṃśaṃ ca labhedyastu vilaṃghitaḥ || 37 || snānasaṃdhyādikaṃ kurvanyaḥ spṛśedvā'tha bhāṣate || sa karmapuṇyaṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ dadyāttasmai viniścitam || 38 || dharmoddeśena yo dravyamaparaṃ yācate naraḥ || tatpuṇyakarmajaṃ tasya dhanadastvāpnuyātphalam || 39 || apahṛtya paradravyaṃ puṇyakarma karoti yaḥ || karmakṛtpāpabhāktatra dhaninastadbhavaṃ phalam || 2.4.30.40 || nāpakṛtya ṛṇaṃ yastu parasya mriyate naraḥ || dhanī tatpuṇyamādatte taddhanasyā'nurūpataḥ || 41 || buddhidātā'numantā ca yaścopakaraṇapradaḥ || balakṛccāpi ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ prāpnuyātpuṇyapāpayoḥ || 42 || prajābhyaḥ puṇyapāpānāṃ rājā ṣaṣṭhāṃśamuddharet || śiṣyādguruḥ striyo bhartā pitā putrāttathaiva ca || 43 || svapaterapi puṇyasya yoṣidardhamavāpnuyāt || cittasyā'nuvratā śaśvadvartate tuṣṭikāriṇī || 44 || parahastena dānādi kurvataḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ || vinā bhṛtakaputrābhyāṃ kartā ṣaṣṭhāṃśamuddharet ||45|| vṛttido vṛttisaṃbhoktuḥ puṇyaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃśamuddharet || ātmano vā parasyā'pi yadi sevāṃ na kārayet || || 46 || itthaṃ hyadattānyapi puṇyapāpānyāyāṃti nityaṃ parasaṃcitāni || kalau tvayaṃ vai niyamo na kāryaḥ kartaiva bhoktā khalu puṇyapāpayoḥ || || 47 || kalau jñānaṃ dṛḍhaṃ nāsti kalau garveṇa satkriyā || kalau dambhā'nvito yogo naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||48|| taponiṣṭhaḥ purā dambhī satī śuddhaprabhāvataḥ || pitroḥ pūjādarśanena corjasevī paraṃ gataḥ || 49 || || || nārada uvāca || || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam || vidhiṃ māsopavāsasya phalaṃ cāsya yathocitam ||2.4.30.50 || || || brahmovāca || || sādhu nārada sarvaṃ te yatpṛṣṭaṃ prabruve'nagha || bhaktyā matimatāṃ śreṣṭha śṛṇuṣva gadato mama || 51 || surāṇāṃ ca yathā viṣṇustapatāṃ ca yathā raviḥ || meruḥ śikhariṇāṃ yadvadvainateyaśca pakṣiṇām || 52 || śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavratānāṃ tu tadvanmāsopavāsanam || sarvavrateṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu caiva hi || 53 || sarvadānodbhavaṃ caiva yajñaiśca bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ || na tatpuṇyamavāpnoti yanmāsaparilaṃghanāt || 54 || gurorājñāṃ tato labdhvā kuryānmāsopavāsanam || atikṛcchraṃ ca pārākaṃ kṛtvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ tataḥ || 55 || māsopavāsaṃ kurvīta jñātvā dehabalā'balam || vānaprastho yatirvāpi nārī vā vidhavā mune || 56 || māsopavāsaṃ kurvīta gurorviprājñayā tataḥ || āśvinasyā'male pakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ || 57 || vratametattu gṛhṇīyādyāvattriṃśaddināni tu || acyutasyā''laye bhaktyā trikālaṃ pūjayeddharim || 58 || naivedyadhūpadīpādyaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhairapi || manasā karmaṇā vācā pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam || 59 || naraḥ svadharmanirataḥ sadhavā ca jitendriyā || nārī vā vidhavā sādhvī vāsudevaṃ samarcayet || 2.4.30.60 || vastvālokanagandhādisvāditaṃ parikīrtitam || anyasya varjayedvāsaṃ grāsānāṃ saṃpramokṣaṇam ||61|| gātrābhyaṃgaṃ śirobhyaṃgaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ savilepanam || vratastho varjayetsarvaṃ yaccā'nyacca nirākṛtam || 62 || na vratasthaḥ spṛśetkaṃcidvikarmasthaṃ na cālapet|| devatāyatane tiṣṭhangṛhasthaścā''caredvratam ||63|| kṛtvā māsopavāsaṃ tu yathoktavidhinā naraḥ || anyūnādhikamevaṃ tu vrataṃ triṃśaddinairiti || || 64 || tato'rcayedeva puṇyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ garuḍadhvajam || vastradānādibhiścaiva bhojayitvā dvijottamān ||65|| dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyaḥ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet|| viprānkṣamāpayitvā tuvisṛjyā'bhyarcya pūjya ca || 66 || evaṃ māsopavāsāṃte vṛtvā viprāṃstrayodaśa || kārayedvaiṣṇavaṃ yajñamekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ || 67 || tato'nubhojayedviprānnamaskārapuraḥsaram || tāṃbūlavastrayugmāni bhojanā''cchādanāni ca || 68 || yogapaṭṭāni sūtrāṇi śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tathā || dattvā caiva dvijāgryebhyaḥ pūjayitvā visarjayet || 69 || vidhirmāsopavāsasya yathāvatparikīrtitaḥ || ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi navamyāditithau vidhi || 2.4.30.70 || ṛṣibhyo vālakhilyaiśca proktaṃ taṃ śṛṇu nārada || 71 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye dattapuṇyapāpaphalaprāptivarṇanapūrvaka māsopavāsavratavidhikathanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
<2.4.31>
|| vālakhilyā ūcuḥ || || kārtike śuklanavamī tatrā'bhūddvāparaṃ yugam || pūrvā'parāhṇagā grāhyā kramāddānopavāsayoḥ || 1 || atra kūṣmāṃḍakonāma hato daityastu viṣṇunā || tadromabhiḥ samudbhūtā vallyaḥ kūṣmāṃḍasaṃbhavāḥ ||2 || tasmātkūṣmāṃḍadānena phalamāpnoti niścitam || asyāmeva navamyāṃ tu kuryātkṛṣṇotsavaṃ naraḥ || 3 || svaśākhoktena vidhinā tulasyāḥ karapīḍanam || kanyādānaphalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4 || kārtike śuklanavamīmavāpya vijiteṃdriyaḥ|| hariṃ vidhāya sauvarṇaṃ tulasyā sahitaṃ śubham || 5|| pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā vratī tatra dinatrayam || evaṃ yathoktavidhinā kuryādvaivāhikaṃ vidhim || 6 || grāhyaṃ trirātramatraiva navamyādyanurodhataḥ || madhyāhnavyāpinī grāhyā navamī pūrvavedhitā || 7 || dhātryaśvatthau ya ekatra pālayitvā samudvahet|| na naśyate tasya puṇyaṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi ||8|| kanakasya sutā pūrvamekādaśyāṃ kiśorikā || cakāra bhaktitaḥ sāyaṃ tulasyudvāhajaṃ vidhim||9|| tena vaidhavyadoṣeṇa nirmuktā''sītsulocanā|| tasmātsāyaṃ prakartavyastulastudvāhajo vidhiḥ ||2.4.31.10|| avaśyameva kartavyaḥ prativarṣaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaiḥ|| vidhiṃ tasya pravakṣyāmi yathā sāṃgā kriyā bhaveta|11|| viṣṇostu pratimāṃ kuryātpalasya svarṇajāṃ śubhām|| tadarddhārddhaṃ tadarddhārddhaṃ yathāśaktyā prakalpayet || 12 || prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvaiva tulasīviṣṇurūpayoḥ || tata utthāpayeddevaṃ pūrvoktaiśca stavādibhiḥ ||13|| upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayetpuruṣoktibhiḥ || deśakālau tataḥ smṛtvā gaṇeśaṃ tatra pūjayet || 14 || puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha nāṃdīśrāddhaṃ samācaret || vedavādyādinirghoṣairviṣṇumūrtiṃ samānayet || 15 || tulasīnikaṭe sā tu sthāpyā cāṃ'tarhitā paṭaiḥ || āgaccha bhagavandeva arcayiṣyāmi keśava || ||16|| tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi tulasīṃ sarvakāmaprado bhava|| dadyāttrivāramarghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ viṣṭarameva ca||17|| tata ācamanīyaṃ ca triruktvā ca pradāpayet|| tato dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ kāṃsyapātrapuṭīkṛtam || 18 || madhuparkaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ vāsudeva namostu te|| haridrālepānābhyaṃgakāryaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāya ca || 19 || godhūlisamaye pūjyau tulasīkeśavau punaḥ|| pṛthakpṛthaktathā kāryau saṃmukhau maṃgalaṃ paṭhet || 2.4.31.20 || īṣaddṛśye bhāskare tu saṃkalpaṃ tu samuccaret || svagotrapravarānuktvā tathā tripuruṣādikam || 21 || anādimadhyanidhana trailokyapratipālaka || imāṃ gṛhāṇa tulasīṃ vivāhavidhineśvara || 22 || pārvatībījasaṃbhūtāṃ vṛṃdābhasmani saṃsthitām || anādimadhyanidhanāṃ vallabhāṃ te dadāmyaham ||23|| payoghaṭaiśca sevābhiḥ kanyāvadvardhitā mayā || tvatpriyāṃ tulasīṃ tubhyaṃ dadāmi tvaṃ gṛhāṇa bhoḥ || 24 || evaṃ dattvā ca tulasīṃ paścāttau pūjayettataḥ|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādvivāhotsavapūrvakam ||25|| tataḥ prabhātasamaye tulasīṃ viṣṇumarcayet || vahnisaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśākṣaravidyayā || 26 || pāyasā''jyakṣaudratilairjuhyādaṣṭottaraṃśatam || tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvā dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ || ācāryaṃ ca samabhyarcya homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 27 || caturo vārṣikānmāsānniyamo yena yaḥ kṛtaḥ || kathayitvā dvijebhyastattathā'nyatparipūrayet || 28 || idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva kṛtaṃ prītyai tava prabho || nyūnaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yātu tvatprasādājjanārdana || 29 || revatīturyacaraṇe dvādaśīsaṃyute naraḥ || na kuryātpāraṇaṃ kurvanvrataṃ niṣphalatāṃ nayet || 2.4.31.30 || tato yeṣāṃ padārthānāṃ varjanaṃ tu kṛtaṃ bhavet || cāturmāsye'thavā corje brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samarpayet || tataḥ sarvaṃ samaśnīyādyadyattyaktaṃ vrate sthitam || 31 || daṃpatibhyāṃ sahaivā'tra bhoktavyaṃ ca dvijaiḥ saha ||32|| tato bhuktyuttaraṃ yāni galitāni dalāni ca || tāni bhuktvā tulasyāśca svayaṃ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 33 || ikṣudaṇḍaṃ tathā dhātrīphalaṃ koliphalaṃ tathā || bhuktvā tu bhojanasyāṃ'te tasyocchiṣṭaṃ vinaśyati || 34 || eṣu triṣu na bhuktaṃ cedekaikamapi yena tu || jñeya ucchiṣṭa āvarṣaṃ naro'sau nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 35 || tataḥ sāyaṃ punaḥ pūjyāvikṣudaṇḍaiśca śobhitaiḥ || tulasīvāsudevau ca kṛtakṛtyo bhavettataḥ || 36 || tato visarjanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā dāyādikaṃ hareḥ || vaikuṇṭhaṃ gaccha bhagavam̐stulasīsahitaḥ prabho || matkṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ gṛhya saṃtuṣṭo bhava sarvadā || 37 || gacchagaccha suraśreṣṭha svasthāne parameśvara || yatra brahmādayo devāstatra gaccha janārdana || 38 || evaṃ visṛjya deveśamācāryāya pradāpayet || mūrtyādikaṃ sarvameva kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || 39 || prativarṣaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttulasīkarapīḍanam || bhaktimāndhanadhānyaiḥ sa yukto bhavati niścitam || ihaloke paratrā'pi vipulaṃ ca yaśo labhet || 2.4.31.40 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye kūṣmāṃḍanavamītulasīvivāhavidhivarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 || ||
<2.4.32>
|| vālakhilyā ūcuḥ || || kārtikasyā'male pakṣe snātvā samyagyatavrataḥ || ekādaśyāṃ tu gṛhṇīyādvrataṃ paṃcadinātmakam || 1 || śarapaṃjarasuptena bhīṣmeṇa tu mahātmanā || rājadharmā mokṣadharmā dānadharmāstataḥ param || kathitā pāṃḍudāyādaiḥ kṛṣṇenā'pi śrutāstadā || 2 || tataḥ prītena manasā vāsudevena bhāṣitam || dhanyadhanyo'si bhīṣma tvaṃ dharmāḥ saṃśrāvitāstvayā || 3 || ekādaśyāṃ kārtikasya yācitaṃ ca jalaṃ tvayā || arjunena samānītaṃ gāṃgaṃ bāṇasya vegataḥ || 4 || tuṣṭāni tava gātrāṇi tasmādadyadināvadhi || pūrṇāṃtaṃ sarvalokāstvāṃ tarpayaṃtvarghyadānataḥ || 5 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena mama saṃtuṣṭikārakam || etadvrataṃ prakurvaṃtu bhīṣmapaṃcakasaṃjñitam || 6 || kārtikasya vrataṃ kṛtvā na kuryādbhīṣmapaṃcakam || samagraṃ kārtikavrataṃ vṛthā tasya bhaviṣyati || 7 || aśaktaścennaro bhūyādasamarthaśca kārtike || bhīṣmasya paṃcakaṃ kṛtvā kārtikasya phalaṃ labhet || 8 || satyavratāya śucaye gāṃgeyāya mahātmane || bhīṣmāyaitaddadāmyarghyamājanmabrahmacāriṇe || || 9 || savyenā'nena maṃtreṇa tarpaṇaṃ sārvavarṇikam || 2.4.32.10 || vratāṃgatvātpūrṇimāyāṃ pradeyaḥ pāpapūruṣaḥ || aputreṇa prakartavyaṃ sarvathā bhīṣmapañcakam || 11 || yaḥ putrārthaṃ vrataṃ kuryātsastrīko bhīṣmapañcakam || pradattvā pāpapuruṣaṃ varṣamadhye sutaṃ labhet || 12 || avaśyameva kartavyaṃ tasmādbhīṣmasya paṃcakam || viṣṇuprītikaraṃ proktaṃ mayā bhīṣmasya pañcakam || 13 || || sūta uvāca || || śṛṇvaṃtu ṛṣayaḥ sarve viśeṣo bhīṣmapañcake || kārtikeyāya rudreṇa purā proktaḥ savistarāt || 14 || || īśvara uvāca || || pravakṣyāmi mahāpuṇyaṃ vrataṃ vratavatāṃ vara || bhīṣmeṇaitadyataḥ prāptaṃ vrataṃ pañcadinātmakam || 15 || sakāśādvāsudevasya tenoktaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam || vratasyā'sya guṇānvaktuṃ kaḥ śaktaḥ keśavādṛte || || 16 || kārtike śuklapakṣe tu śṛṇu dharmaṃ purātanam || vasiṣṭhabhṛgugargādyaiścīrṇaṃ kṛtayugādiṣu || 17 || ambarīṣeṇa bhogādyaiścīrṇaṃ tretāyugādiṣu || brāhmaṇairbrahmacaryeṇa japahomakriyādibhiḥ || 18 || kṣatriyaiśca tathā vaiśyaiḥ satyaśaucaparāyaṇaiḥ || duṣkaraṃ satyahīnānāmaśakyaṃ bālacetasām ||19|| duṣkaraṃ bhīṣmamityāhurna śakyaṃ prākṛtairnaraiḥ || yasmātkaroti vipreṃdra tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet || 2.4.32.20 || vrataṃ caitanmahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || ato naraiḥ prayatnena kartavyaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam || 21 || kārtikasyā'male pakṣe snātvā samyagvidhānataḥ || ekādaśyāṃ tu gṛhṇīyādvrataṃ paṃcadinātmakam || 22 || prātaḥ snātvā viśeṣeṇa madhyāhne ca tathā vratī || nadyāṃ nirjharatoye vā samālabhya ca gomayam || 23 || yavavrīhitilaiḥ samyakpitṝnsaṃtarpayetkramāt || snātvā maunaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā dhautavāsā dṛḍhavrataḥ || 24 || bhīṣmāyodakadānaṃ ca arghyaṃ caiva prayatnataḥ || pūjā bhīṣmasya kartavyā dānaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ || 25 || paṃcaratnaṃ viśeṣeṇa dattvā viprāya yatnataḥ || vāsudevo'pi saṃpūjyo lakṣmīyuktaḥ sadā prabhuḥ || 26 || pañcake pūjayitvā tu koṭijanmāni tuṣyati || 27 || yatkiṃciddadate martyaḥ paṃcadhātuprakalpitam || saṃvatsaravratānāṃ sa labhate sakalaṃ phalam || || 28 || kṛtvā tūdakadānaṃ tu tathā'rghyasya ca dāpanam || mantreṇānena yaḥ kuryānmuktibhāgī bhavennaraḥ || 29 || vaiyāghrapādagotrāya sāṃkṛtya pravarāya ca || anapatyāya bhīṣmāya udakaṃ bhīṣmavarmaṇe || 2.4.32.30 || vasūnāmavatārāya śaṃtanorātmajāya ca || arghyaṃ dadāmi bhīṣmāya ājanmabrahmacāriṇe || 31 || || ityarghyamaṃtraḥ || || anena vidhinā yastu paṃcakaṃ tu samāpayet || aśvamedhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥ || 32 || paṃcā'hamapi kartavyaṃ niyamaṃ ca prayatnataḥ || niyamena vinā yatra na bhāvyaṃ varavarṇinā|| 33 || uttarāyaṇahīnāya bhīṣmāya pradadau hariḥ || uttarāyaṇahīne'pi śuddhalagnaṃ sutoṣitaḥ || 34 || tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ harim|| anaṃtaraṃ prayatnena kartavyaṃ bhīṣmapaṃcakam || 35 || snāpayeta jalairbhaktyā madhukṣīraghṛtena ca || tathaiva paṃcagavyena gandhacaṃdanavāriṇā || 36 || candanena sugandhena kumakumenā'tha keśavam|| karpūrośīramiśreṇa lepayedgaruḍadhvajam || 37 || arcayedruciraiḥ puṣpairgaṃdhadhūpasamanvitaiḥ || gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dadetkṛṣṇāya bhaktimān || 38 || dīpakaṃ tu divā rātrau dadyātpaṃca dināni tu || naivedyaṃ devadevasya paramānnaṃ nivedayet|| 39 || evamabhyarcayeddevaṃ saṃsmṛtya ca praṇamya ca || oṃ namo vāsudevāyeti japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 2.4.32.40 || juhuyācca ghṛtābhyaktaistilavrīhiyavādibhiḥ || ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa svāhākārā'nvitena ca || 41 || upāsya paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam || japitvā pūrvavanmantraṃ kṣitiśāyī bhavetsadā ||42|| sarvametadvidhānaṃ tu kāryaṃ pañca dināni tu || viśeṣo'tra vrate hyasminyadanyūnaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat || 43 || prathame'hni hareḥ pādau pūjayetkamalairvratī || dvitīye bilvapatreṇa jānudeśaṃ samarcayet ||44|| tato'nupūjayecchīrṣaṃ mālatyā cakrapāṇinaḥ || kārtikyāṃ devadevasya bhaktyā tadgatamānasaḥ || 45 || arcitvā taṃ hṛṣīkeśamekādaśyāṃ samāsataḥ || niḥprāśya gomayaṃ samyagekādaśyāmupāvaset || 46 || gomūtraṃ mantravadbhūmau dvādaśyāṃ prāśayedvratī || kṣīraṃ caiva trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathā dadhi || 47 || saṃprāśya kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ laṃghayitvā caturdinam || paṃcame divase snātvā vidhivatpūjya keśavam || bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām|| 48 || pāpabuddhiṃ parityajya brahmacaryeṇa dhīmatā || madyaṃ māṃsaṃ parityājyaṃ maithunaṃ pāpakāraṇam || 49 || śākāhāreṇa munyannaiḥ kṛṣṇārcanaparo naraḥ || tato naktaṃ samaśnīyātpaṃcagavyapuraḥsaram || 2.4.32.50 || evaṃ samyaksamāpyaṃ syādyathoktaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 51 || madyapo yaḥ pibenmadyaṃ janmano maraṇāṃ'tikam || etadbhīṣmavrataṃ kṛtvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || 52 || strībhirvā bhartṛvākyena kartavyaṃ dharmavardhanam || vidhavābhiśca kartavyaṃ mokṣasaukhyā'tivṛddhaye || 53 || ayodhyāyāṃ purā kaścidatithirnāma vai nṛpaḥ || vasiṣṭhavacanātkṛtvā vratametatsudurlabham || bhuktveha nikhilānbhogānaṃte viṣṇupuraṃ yayau || 54 || itthaṃ kuryādvrataṃ nityaṃ pañcakaṃ bhīṣmasaṃjñitam || niyamenopavāsena pañcagavyena vā punaḥ || payomūlaphalā''hārairhaviṣyairvratatatparaḥ || 55 || paurṇamāsīdine prāpte pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvavat || brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā gāṃ ca dadyātsavatsakām || 56 || yadbhīṣmapañcakamiti prathitaṃ pṛthivyāmekādaśīprabhṛti paṃcadaśīniruddham || uktaṃ na bhojanaparasya tadā niṣedhastasminvrate śubhaphalaṃ pradadāti viṣṇuḥ || 57 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye bhīṣma pañcakavratamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || || cha ||
<2.4.33>
|| īśvara uvāca || || prabodhinyāśca māhātmyaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyavardhanam || muktidaṃ tattvabuddhīnāṃ śṛṇuṣva surasattama || 1 || tāvadgarjati senānīrgaṃgā bhāgīrathī kṣitau || yāvatprayāti pāpaghnī kārtike haribodhinī || 2 || tāvadgarjaṃti tīrthāni āsamudrasarāṃsi vai || yāvatprabodhinī viṣṇostithirnā''yāti kārtike || 3 || aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca || ekenaivopavāsena prabodhinyā yathā'bhavat || 4 || durlabhaṃ caiva duṣprāpyaṃ trailokye sacarācare || tadapi prārthitaṃ vipra dadāti pratibodhinī || 5 || aiśvaryaṃ saṃtatiṃ jñānaṃ rājyaṃ ca sukhasaṃpadaḥ || dadātyupoṣitā vipra helayā haribodhinī || 6 || merumaṃdaratulyāni pāpānyupārjitāni ca || ekenaivopavāsena dahate haribodhinī || 7 || upavāsaṃ prabodhinyāṃ yaḥ karoti svabhāvataḥ || vidhinā naraśārdūla yathoktaṃ labhate phalam || 8 || pūrvajanmasahasreṣu pāpaṃ yatsamupārjitam || jāgareṇa prabodhinyāṃ dahyate tṛlarāśivat || 9 || śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha vakṣyāmi jāgarasya ca lakṣaṇam || tasya vijñānamātreṇa durlabho na janārdanaḥ ||2.4.33.10|| gītaṃ vādyaṃ ca nṛtyaṃ ca purāṇapaṭhanaṃ tathā || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ puṣpagaṃdhā'nulepanam ||1 1|| phalamarghyaṃ ca śraddhā ca dānamiṃdriyasaṃyamam || satyā'nvitaṃ viniṃdaṃ ca mudā yuktaṃ kriyānvitam || 12 || sāścaryaṃ caiva protsāhamālasyādivivarjitam || pradakṣiṇādisaṃyuktaṃ namaskārapuraḥsaram || 13 || nīrājanasamāyuktamanirviṇṇena cetasā || yāmeyāme mahābhāga kurvannīrājanaṃ hareḥ || 14 || etairguṇaiḥ samāyuktaṃ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vibhoḥ || ekāgramanasā yastu na punarjāyate bhuvi || 15 || ya evaṃ kurute bhaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || jāgaraṃ vāsare viṣṇorlīyate paramātmani || 16 || puruṣasūktena yo nityaṃ kārtike'thārcayeddharim || varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi pūjitastena keśavaḥ || 17 || yathoktena vidhānena paṃcarātroditena vai || kārtike tvarcayennityaṃ muktibhāgī bhavennaraḥ || 18 || namo nārāyaṇāyeti kārtike yorcayeddharim || sa mukto nārakairduḥkhaiḥ padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam || 19 || harernāmasahasraṃ ca gajarājasya mokṣaṇam || kārtike paṭhate yastu punarjanma na viṃdati || 2.4.33.20 || yugakoṭisahasrāṇi manvaṃtaraśatāni ca || dvādaśyāṃ kārtike māsi jāgarī vasate divi || 21 || kule tasya ca ye jātāḥ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ || prāpnuvaṃti padaṃ viṣṇostasmātkurvīta jāgaram || 22 || kārtike paścime yāme stavaṃ gānaṃ karoti yaḥ || śvetadvīpe tu vasate pitṛbhiḥ saha suvrata || 23 || naivedyadānaṃ haraye kārtike dinasaṃkṣaye || yugāni vasate svarge tāvaṃti munisattamāḥ || 24 || akṣayaṃ muniśārdūla mālatīkamalārcanam || arcayeddevadeveśaṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam || 25 || kārtike śuklapakṣe tu kṛtvā hyekādaśīṃ naraḥ || prātardattvā śubhānkuṃbhānsa yāti mama maṃdiram || 26 || atraiva tu prakartavyaḥ prabodhastu hareḥ khaga || hataḥ śaṃkhāsuro daityo nabhasaḥ śuklapakṣake || 27 || ekādaśyāṃ tato viṣṇuścāturmāsye prasuptavān || kṣīrāṃbhodhau jāgṛto'sāvekādaśyāṃ tu kārtike || 28 || ataḥ prabodhanaṃ kāryamekādaśyāṃ tu vaiṣṇavaiḥ || uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha goviṃda uttiṣṭha garuḍadhvaja || uttiṣṭha kamalākāṃta trailokyaṃ maṃgalaṃ kuru || 29 || ityuktvā śaṃkhabheryādi prātaḥkāle tu vādayet || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgādi nṛtyagītādi kārayet ||2.4.33.30|| utthāpayitvā deveśaṃ pūjāṃ tasya vidhāya ca || sāyaṃkāle prakartavyastulasyudvāhajo vidhiḥ || 31 || sarvadaikādaśī puṇyā viśeṣātkārtikī smṛtā || yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca || ||32|| annamāśritya tiṣṭhaṃti saṃprāpte harivāsare|| sa kevalamaghaṃ bhuṃkte yo bhuṃkte harivāsare ||33|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena kuryādekādaśīvratam || na kuryādyadi mohena upavāsaṃ narādhamaḥ ||34|| narake niyataṃ vāsaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha tasya vai || sūtake mṛtake vā'pi nopavāsaṃ tyajedbudhaḥ||35|| daśamīvedhasaṃyuktā tyājyā caikādaśī vrate || gāṃdhāryā'pi purā tasyāmupavāsaḥ kṛto guha || 36 || tasyāḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ tasmāttāṃ vadhajāṃ tyajet || ekādaśīmupavasetsnānadānapuraḥsaram || 37 || rukmāṃgado'pi rājarṣirmohinyāḥ saṃgamena ca || iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cāṃ'te viṣṇupuraṃ yayau || 38 || || || iti prabodhotsavaḥ || || atha dvādaśīmāhātmyam || || dvādaśī puṇyadā proktā sarvā'ghaughavināśinī || kiṃ dānaiḥ ki tapobhiśca kimu poṣyairvrataiśca kim || 39 || kimiṣṭaiścaiva putraiśca dvādaśī yena sevitā || gaṃgāyāṃ caiva durbhikṣe pratyahaṃ koṭibhojanāt || 2.4.33.40 || yatphalaṃ tadavāpnoti dvādaśyāmekabhojanāt || yaddattaṃ cārhate dānaṃ dvādaśyāṃ tu site śubhe || 41 || sikthesikthe ca vaikasya katibrāhmaṇabhojanam || tadahaṃ naiva jānāmi mahimānaṃ hi suvrata || 42 || śāligrāmaśilādānaṃ yaḥ kuryāddvādaśīdine || saptadvīpavatīṃ bhūmiṃ gaṃgāyāṃ ca ravigrahe || dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ |||| 43 || paṃcāmṛtaistu yo viṣṇuṃ bhaktyā saṃsnāpayeddvija || sa sarvakulamuddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 44 || śukle kārtikamāsasya dvādaśyāṃ paramotsave || prātarārabhya yaḥ kuryātsnānadānādikaṃ tathā || sa tu mokṣamavāpnoti nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || 45 || dvādaśyāṃ kārtike māsi snānasaṃdhyādikarma ca || kṛtvā dāmodaraṃ pūjya bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 46 || yastasyāṃ sūpanaivedyaṃ na dadāti narādhamaḥ || narake niyataṃ vāso bhavatītyanuśuśruma || 47 || tasmātsūpasya naivedyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ kārtike śubhe || dadyādbhaktiyuto brahmaṃścānyathā narakaṃ vrajet || 48 || yastasyāṃ daṃpatīnāṃ tu bhojanaṃ kurute naraḥ || na tasya phalaviśrāṃtirmayā vaktuṃ tu śakyate ||49|| dhātrīcchāyāṃ gato yastu dvādaśyāṃ pūjayeddharim || tatraiva bhojanaṃ yastu brāhmaṇānāṃ tu kārayet || 2.4.33.50 || svayaṃ ca tatra bhuṃkte yaḥ sūpabhakṣyādikaṃ tathā || na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || || 51 || evaṃ prātarvidhāyā'tha pūjāṃ dāmodarasya hi || rātrau punaḥ prakartavyaṃ pūjākarma harerdvija || 52 || tulasīsannidhau kṛtvā patākādhvajaśobhitam || puṣpamālāsamākīrṇaṃ nānāratnopaśobhitam || 53 || muktādāmabhirācchannaṃ kṛtvā maṃḍapamuttamam || pūjayedviṣṇumavyagrastadgataikāgramānasaḥ || || 54 || paṃcarātroktamārgeṇa gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || navanītaṃ dadhikṣīraṃ tathaiva ca ghanaṃ ghṛtam || 55 || vividhaiḥ khādyanaivedyairjalena ca sugaṃdhinā || yuktaṃ nivedayedviṣṇostāṃbūlaṃ salavaṃgakam || 56 || puṣpāṇi ca vicitrāṇi sugandhīni bahūni ca || prokṣayitvā ca vidhivadarpayitvā dalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 57 || tulasyāścāpi dhātryāśca phalaiścā'pi prapūjayet || nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā maṃtrapuṣpaṃ samarpayet || 58 || abhiṣekaṃ vinā sarvapūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || viṣṇoḥ pūjāṃ samāpyā'tha brāhmaṇānāṃ prapūjanam || 59 || kuryādbhaktiyuto vipra dadyāccaiva phalādikam|| tāṃbūlaṃ ca tato dattvā dakṣiṇāṃ śaktito'rpayet || 2.4.33.60 || tato vṛddhānpitṝnmātṝn pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || tataḥ svayaṃ svabhāryābhirnaivedyaṃ bhakṣayetsudhīḥ || 61 || ityevaṃ tu vidhānena yaḥ kuryāddvādaśīvratam || na tasya lokāḥ kṣīyaṃte kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 62 || putrapautraiḥ parivṛto bhuktvā bhogānmanoharān || bhogāṃte ca vrajenmokṣamatītakulasaptakaiḥ || 63 || tasmānnārada māhātmyaṃ dvādaśyāḥ kārtikasya ca || na mayā śakyate vaktuṃ kimanyairmanujairapi || 64 || dvādaśyā hyuttamaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ || śṛṇuyādvā muniśreṣṭha sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 65 || rājarṣirambarīṣo'pi cakāraitadvrataṃ śubham || yathāvidhi taponiṣṭhastena mokṣamavāptavān || 66 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye prabodhotsavadvādaśītithikṛtyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 || || cha ||
<2.4.34>
|| nārada uvāca || || vratānāmapi sarveṣāṃ brahmannudyāpanaṃ śrutam || abhāve tūdyāpanasya phalaṃ naivā''pnuyātkvacit || 1 || kṛtavrataphalāptyarthaṃ kuryādudyāpanaṃ budhaḥ || anyathā niṣphalaṃ yāti kṛtaṃ vratamanuttamam || 2 || kārtike'pi kṛtaṃ deva vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam || na tasyodyāpanā'bhāve vratoktaphalamāpnuyāt || 3 || tasmātkārtikamāsasya codyāpanavidhiṃ prabho || vada me śiṣyavaryāya prapannāyā'nuvartine || 4 || || brahmovāca || || athorjodyāpanaṃ vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || tacchṛṇuṣva mahābhaktyā savidhānaṃ samāsataḥ || 5 || ūrje śuklacaturdaśyāṃ kuryādudyāpanaṃ vratī|| vratasaṃpūraṇārthāya viṣṇuprītyarthahetave || 6 || tulasyā upariṣṭāttu kuryānmaṃḍapikāṃ śubhām|| kadalīstaṃbhasaṃyuktāṃ nānādhātuvicitritām ||7|| dīpamālā caturdikṣu kāryā tatra suśobhanā || sutoraṇāścaturdvāraḥ puṣpacāmaraśobhitāḥ||8|| dvāreṣu dvārapālāśca pūjayenmṛnmayānpṛthak || jayaśca vijayaścaiva caṇḍaścaiva pracaṃḍakaḥ || 9 || nandaścaiva sunaṃdaśca kumudaḥ kumudākṣakaḥ || etāṃścaturṣu dvāreṣu pūjayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 2.4.34.10 || tulasīmūladeśe tu sarvatobhadrasaṃjñitam || caturbhirvarṇakaiḥ samyakchobhāḍhyaṃ samalaṃkṛtam || 11 || tasyopariṣṭātkalaśaṃ pūrṇaratnasamanvitam || tatra saṃpūjayeddevaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || 12 || kauśeyapītavasanaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ prapūjayet || indrādilokapālāṃśca maṃḍape pūjayedvratī || || 13 || tasyāmupavasedbhaktyā śāṃtaḥ praṇatamānasaḥ || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādgītavādyādimaṃgalaiḥ || 14 || gītaṃ kurvaṃti ye bhaktyā jāgare cakrapāṇinaḥ || janmāṃtaraśatodbhūtaiste muktāḥ pāpasaṃcayaiḥ ||15|| tatastu pūrṇimāyāṃ tu sapatnīkāndvijottamān || triṃśanmitānathaikaṃ vā brāhmaṇāṃśca nimaṃtrayet || 16 || prātaḥsnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā devapūjāṃ tathaiva ca || sthaṃḍile ca tataḥ kṛtvā samādhāyā'gnimatra hi || 17 || ato deveti maṃtreṇa juhuyāttilapāyasam || prītyarthaṃ devadevasya devānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak || 18 || homaśeṣaṃ samāpyātha brāhmaṇānpūjya bhaktitaḥ || brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśaktyā pradadyāddakṣiṇāṃ naraḥ || 19 || tato gāṃ kapilāṃ tatra pūjayedvidhivadvratī || savatsāṃ gāṃ tathā dadyādviprāya ca kuṭumbine || 2.4.34.20 || guruṃ vratopadeṣṭāraṃ vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || sapatnīkaṃ samabhyarcya tāṃśca viprānkṣamāpayet || 21 || yuṣmatprasādāddeveśaḥ prasanno'stu sadā mama || vratādasmācca yatpāpaṃ saptajanmakṛtaṃ mayā || 22 || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyātu sthirā me cā'stu saṃtatiḥ || manorathāstu saphalāḥ saṃtu bhaktirharau bhavet || 23 || satāṃ samāgamo bhūyānmama janmanijanmani || iti kṣamāpya tānviprānprasādya ca visarjayet || 24 || pratimāṃ tāṃ gurordadyātsavastrāṃ munipuṃgava || tataḥ suhṛdguruyutaḥ svayaṃ bhuṃjīta bhaktimān || 25 || dvādaśyāṃ pratibuddho'sau trayodaśyāṃ yutaḥ suraiḥ || dṛṣṭorccitaścaturdaśyāṃ tasmātpūjyastithāviha || 26 || pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ sauvarṇaṃ gurvanujñayā || parā'tra paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yātrā syātpuṣkarasya tu || 27 || varāndattvā yato viṣṇurmatsyarūpo'bhavattataḥ || tasyāṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tadakṣayyaphalaṃ bhavet || 28 || kārtike māsi kartavyo vidhireṣa hi nārada || evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyakkārtikasya vrataṃ naraḥ || 29 || yatphalaṃ tadavāpnoti vrataṃ kṛtvā tu kārtike || te dhanyāste sadā pūjyāsteṣāṃ vai saphalodayaḥ || 2.4.34.30 || viṣṇubhaktiratā ye syuḥ kārtike vratacāriṇaḥ || dehasthitāni pāpāni vilayaṃ yāṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 31 || kva yāmo'dya bhavatyeṣa yadūrjavratakṛnnaraḥ || iti sarvāṇi pāpāni raṭantīha punaḥpunaḥ || 32 || tasmātkārtikamāsasya sadṛśaṃ nahi vidyate || sarvapāpasya dahane agneḥ sadṛśa ucyate ||33|| ūrjodyāpanamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyācchraddhayā'nvitaḥ || śrāvayedvā pumānyastu viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt || 34 || || nārada uvāca || || ūrje vratodyāpanādāvaśaktaḥ siddhibhākkatham || kathaṃ vimucyate jaṃturduḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt || 35 || || || brahmovāca || || śṛṇuyādūrjamāhātmyaṃ niyamena śuciḥ pumān || udyāpanaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇuloke vasecca saḥ || 36 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye vratodyāpanavidhikathanaṃnāma catu'striṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || ||
<2.4.35>
|| brahmovāca || || vaikuṇṭhākhyacaturdaśyā māhātmyaṃ te vadāmyaham || vālakhilyaiḥ purā proktaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa śṛṇuṣva tat || 1 || || vālakhilyā ūcuḥ || || kārtikasya site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ samāgamat || vaikuṇṭheśastu vaikuṇṭhādvārāṇasyāṃ kṛte yuge || 2 || rātryāṃ turyāṃśaśeṣāyāṃ snātvā'sau maṇikarṇike || gṛhītvā hemapadmānāṃ sahasraṃ vai tato'vrajat || 3 || atibhaktyā pūjayituṃ śivayā sahitaṃ śivam || vidhāya pūjāṃ vaiśveśīṃ tataḥ padmairapūjayat || 4 || sahasrasaṃkhyāṃ kṛtvādāvekanāmnā tataḥ param || ārabdhaṃ pūjanaṃ tena śivastadbhaktimaikṣata || 5 || ekaṃ padmaṃ padmamadhyānnilīyā''ttaṃ hareṇa tu || tataḥ pūjitavānviṣṇurekonaṃ kamalaṃ tvabhūt || 6 || itastatastena dṛṣṭaṃ padmaṃ tiṣṭhati na kvacit || kamaleṣu bhramo jāto'thavā nāmasu me bhramaḥ || 7 || kṣaṇaṃ vicārya sa harirna me nāmabhramo'bhavat || padme caiva bhramo jāto vicāryaivaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 8 || sahasrapadmasaṃkalpaḥ pūjārthaṃ tu kṛto mayā || arcyaḥ kathaṃ mahādeva ekonakamalairmayā || 9 || yadyānetuṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaṃgaḥ syādāsanasya tu || ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ vidheyaṃ cintodvigno haristadā || 2.4.35.10 || ekaḥ prakāra utpanno hṛdaye'sya munīśvarāḥ || puṇḍarīkākṣa ityevaṃ māṃ vadaṃti munīśvarāḥ || 11 || netraṃ me padmasadṛśe padmārthe tvarpayāmyaham || iti niścitya manasā dattvā tarjanikāṃ sa tu || 12 || netramadhyāttadutpāṭya mahādevastu pūjitaḥ || tato maheśvarastuṣṭo vākyametaduvāca ha || 13 || || mahādeva uvāca || || tvatsamo nāsti madbhaktastrailokye sacarācare || rājyaṃ dattaṃ trilokyāste bhava tvaṃ lokapālakaḥ || 14 || anyaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varaṃ yanmanasepsitam || avaśyameva dāsyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 15 || madbhaktiṃ tu samālaṃbya ye dviṣaṃti janārdanam || te maddveṣyā narā viṣṇo vrajeyurnarakaṃ dhruvam || 16 || || || viṣṇuruvāca || || trailokyarakṣākaraṇaṃ mamādiṣṭaṃ maheśvara || dumardāśca mahāsattvā daityā māryāḥ kathaṃ mayā ||17||| || śiva uvāca || || etatsudarśanaṃ cakraṃ mahādaityanikṛṃtanam || gṛhāṇa bhagavanviṣṇo mayā tubhya niveditam ||18|| anena sarvadaityānāṃ bhagavankadanaṃ kuru || evaṃ cakraṃ harerdattvā tato vacanamabravīt || 19 || || śiva uvāca || || varṣe ca hemalaṃbākhye māse śrīmati kārtike || śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāmaruṇābhyudayaṃ prati ||2.4.35.20|| mahādevatithau brāhme muhūrte maṇikarṇike || snātvā vaiśveśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ vaikuṇṭhādetya pūjitam||21|| sahasrakamalaistasmādbhaviṣyati mama priyā || vikhyātā sarvalokeṣu vaikuṇṭhākhyā caturdaśī ||22|| anyaṃ varaṃ prayacchāmi śṛṇu viṣṇo vaco mama || pūrvarātreṣu te pūjā kartavyā sarvajātibhiḥ ||23|| upavāsaṃ divā kuryātsāyaṃkāle tavārcanam || paścānmamārcanaṃ kāryamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 24 || grāhyā tu haripūjāyāṃ rātrivyāptā caturdaśī || aruṇodayavelāyāṃ śivapūjāṃ samācaret || 25 || sahasrakamalairviṣṇurādau yaiḥ pūjito naraiḥ|| paścācchivaḥ pūjitaścejjīvanmuktāsta eva hi || 26 || sāyaṃ snātvā paṃcanade biṃdumādhavamarcayet || snātvā yo viṣṇukāṃcyāṃ vā'naṃtasenaṃ samarcayet || 27 || rudrakāṃcyāṃ tataḥ snātvā praṇaveśaṃ samarcayet || ādau snātvā vahnitīrthe yajennārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ || 28 || retodake tataḥ snātvā kedāreśaṃ samarcayet || ādau snātvā sūryaputryāṃ veṇīmādhavamarcayet || 29 || jāhnavyāṃ ca tataḥ snātvā saṃgameśaṃ prapūjayet || sarvāḥ śriyastasya vaśyāḥ satyaṃ viṣṇo mayoditam || 2.4.35.30 || evaṃ tasmai varāndattvā hyaṃtardhānaṃ yayau śivaḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjyau hariharāvubhau || 31 || kalau daśasahasrāṇi viṣṇustyajati medinīm || tadarddhaṃ jāhnavītoyaṃ tadarddhaṃ grāmadevatāḥ || 32 || kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu kuryāttraipuramutsavam || dīpo deyo'vaśyameva sāyaṃkāle śivālaye || 33 || tripuro nāma daityeṃdraḥ prayāge tapa āsthitaḥ || tapasā tasya saṃtuṣṭo dadau brahmā varaṃ param|| 34 || devāsuramanuṣyebhyo na te mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || iti labdhavaro daityo viśvakarmavinirmitam || 35 || tripurākhyaṃ vimānaṃ tamāruhya bhuvanatrayam || yadā vai pīḍayāmāsa tadā devaiḥ stuto haraḥ || 36 || tripuraṃ ghātayāmāsa bāṇenaikena śatruhā || kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu sarve devāḥ pratuṣṭuvuḥ || 37 || tasmindine sarvadevairdīpā dattā harāya ca || sarvathaiva pradeyāśca dīpāstu haratuṣṭaye || 38 || viṃśatiḥ saptaśatakāḥ sahitā dīpavartayaḥ || dadaddīpaṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 39 || paurṇamāsyāṃ tu saṃdhyāyāṃ kartavyastripurotsavaḥ || dadyādanena mantreṇa pradīpāṃśca surālaye || 2.4.35.40 || kīṭāḥ pataṃgā maśakāśca vṛkṣā jale sthale ye vicaraṃti jīvāḥ || dṛṣṭvā pradīpaṃ na ca janmabhāgino bhavaṃtu nityaṃ śvapacā hi viprāḥ || 41 || kāryastasmātpaurṇamāsyāṃ tripurāya mahotsavaḥ || kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yaḥ kuryātsvāmidarśanam || || 42 || sapta janma bhavedvipro dhanāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ || atra kṛtvā vṛṣotsargaṃ naktācchaivapuraṃ vrajet || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye vaikuṇṭhacaturdaśī tripurīpūrṇimāvratavidhānakathanaṃnāma paṃcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
<2.4.36>
|| || brahmovāca || || yāstisrastithayaḥ puṇyā aṃtike śuklapakṣake || kārtike māsi vipreṃdra pūrṇimāṃtāḥ śubhavahāḥ || 1 || aṃtipuṣkariṇī saṃjñā sarvapāpakṣayāvahā || kārttike māsi saṃpūrṇaṃ yo vai snānaṃ karoti ha || 2 || tithiṣvetāsu saḥ snānātpūrṇameva phalaṃ labhet || sarve vedāstrayodaśyāṃ gatvā jantūnpunaṃti hi || 3 || caturdaśyāṃ sayajñāśca devā jaṃtūnpunaṃti hi || pūrṇimāyāṃ sutīrthāni viṣṇunā saṃsthitāni hi || 4 || brahmaghnānvā surāpānvā sarvāñjaṃtūnpunaṃti hi || uṣṇodakena yaḥ snāyātkārttikyādidinatraye || 5 || rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || āmāsaniyamāśaktaḥ kuryādetaddinatraye || 6 || tena pūrṇaphalaṃ prāpya modate viṣṇumaṃdire || yo vai devānpitṝnviṣṇuṃ gurumuddiśya mānavaḥ || 7 || na snānādi karotyaddhā sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam || kuṭuṃbabhojana yastu gṛhasthastu dinatraye || || 8 || sarvānpitṝnsamuddhṛtya sa yāti paramaṃ padam || gītāpāṭhaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādaṃtime ca dinatraye || 9 || dinedine'śvamedhānāṃ phalameti na saṃśayaḥ || sahasranāmapaṭhanaṃ yaḥ kuryāttu dinatraye || 2.4.36.10 || na pāpairlipyate kvā'pi padmapatramivāṃ'bhasā || devatvaṃ manujaiḥ kaiścitkaiścitsiddhatvameva ca || 11 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ kaḥ śakto divi vā bhuvi || yo vai bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ śṛṇoti ca dinatrayam || 12 || kaiścitprāpto brahmabhāvo dinatrayaniṣevaṇāt || brahmajñānena vā muktiḥ prayāgamaraṇena vā || 13 || atha vā kārttike māsi dinatrayaniṣevaṇāt || kārttike haripūjāṃ tu yaḥ karoti dinatraye || 14 || na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || kārttike māsi vipreṃdra sarvamaṃtyadinatraye || 15 || puṇyaṃ tatrā'pi vaiśeṣyaṃ rākāyāṃ vartate'nagha|| prātaḥkāle samutthāya śaucaṃ snānādikaṃ caret || 16 || samāpya sarvakarmāṇi viṣṇupūjāṃ samācaret || udyāne vā gṛhe vā'pi kārttikyāṃ viṣṇutatparaḥ || 17 || maṃḍapaṃ tatra kurvīta kadalīstaṃbhamaṃḍitam || cūtapallavasaṃvītamikṣudaṃḍaiḥ sumaṃḍitam|| 18 || citravastraiḥ svalaṃkṛtya tatra devaṃ prapūjayet || cūtapallavapuṣpāḍhyaiḥ phalādyaiḥ pūjayeddharim || 19 || śṛṇuyādūrjamāhātmyaṃ niyamena śuciḥ pumān || saṃpūrṇamatha vā'dhyāyamekaślokamathā'pi vā || 2.4.36.20 || muhūrtaṃ vā'pi śṛṇuyātkathāṃ puṇyāṃ dinedine || yadi pratidinaṃ śrotumaśaktaḥ syāttu mānavaḥ || 21 || puṇyamāse'thavā puṇyatithau saṃśṛṇuyādapi || tena puṇyaprabhāvena pāpānmukto bhavennaraḥ || 22 || purāṇajñaḥ śucirdakṣaḥ śāṃto vigatamatsaraḥ || sādhuḥ kāruṇiko vāggmī vadetpuṇyāṃ kathāṃ sudhīḥ || 23|| vyāsāsanaṃ samārūḍho yadā paurāṇiko bhavet || āsamāpteḥ prasaṃgasya namaskuryānna kasyacit || 24 || na durjanasamākīrṇe na śūdraśvāpadāvṛte || deśe na dyūtasadane vadetpuṇyakathāṃ sudhīḥ ||25|| śraddhābhaktisamāyuktā nā'nyakāryeṣu lālasā || vāgyatāḥ śucayo dakṣāḥ śrotāraḥ puṇyabhāginaḥ || 26 || abhaktā ye kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śṛṇvaṃti manujā'dhamāḥ || teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ nā'sti duḥkhaṃ syājanmajanmani || 27 || paurāṇikaṃ ca māsāṃte pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ || gandhamālyaistathā vastrairalaṃkārairdhanena ca || 28 || śṛṇvaṃti ca kathāṃ bhaktyā na daridrā na pāpinaḥ || 29 || kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ ye gacchaṃtyanyato narāḥ || bhogāṃtare praṇaśyaṃti teṣāṃ dārāśca saṃpadaḥ || 2.4.36.30 || uccāsanasamārūḍho na naraḥ praṇato bhavet || viṣavṛkṣastathā svāpe vane cā'jagaro bhavet || 31 || kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ vighnaṃ kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || koṭyabdanarakānbhuktvā bhavaṃti grāmasūkarāḥ || 32 || ye śrāvayaṃti manujāḥ kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām || kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tiṣṭhaṃti brahmaṇaḥ pade || 33 || āsanārthe prayacchati purāṇajñasya ye narāḥ || kambalājinavāsāṃsi maṃcaṃ phalakameva vā || 34 || paridhānīyavastrāṇi prayacchaṃti ca ye narāḥ || bhūṣaṇādi prayacchaṃti vaseyurbrahmasadmani || 35 || vācake parituṣṭe tu tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || ataḥ saṃtoṣayedbhaktyā bhaktiśraddhānvitaḥ pumān || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 36 || yatphalaṃ sarvayajñeṣu sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || sakṛtpurāṇaśravaṇāttatphalaṃ viṃdate naraḥ ||37|| kalau yuge viśeṣeṇa purāṇaśravaṇādṛte || nāsti dharmaḥ paraḥ puṃsāṃ nāsti muktipathaḥ paraḥ || purāṇaśravaṇādviṣṇornāsti saṃkīrtanātparam || 38 || ya etadūrjamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyācchrāvayedapi || sa tīrtharāja badarīgamanasya phalaṃ labhet || 39 || sarvarogāpahaṃ sarvapāpanāśakaraṃ śubham || 2.4.36.40 || śrutvā caikapade yo vai agamyāgamane rataḥ || kanyāsvasrorvikrayiṇamubhayaṃ tu vimocayet || 41 || māhātmyametadākarṇya pūjayedyastu pāṭhakam || gobhūhiraṇyavastraiśca viṣṇutulyo yato hi saḥ || 42 || dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ ca vedavidyādikaṃ ca yat || pustakaṃ vācakāyaiva dātavyaṃ dharmamicchatā || purāṇavidyādātāro hyanaṃtaphalabhoginaḥ || || 43 || idaṃ yaḥ paṭhate bhaktyā śrutvā caivā'vadhārayet || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 44 || na kasyā'pīdamākhyeyaṃ śraddhāhīnāya durmateḥ || 45 || apūjayitvā gurumagrabuddhyā dharmapravaktāramananyabuddhiḥ || bhuktvā tu bhogānnarakeṣu caiva tato hi janmāntara duḥkhabhogī || 46 || tasmātsaṃpūjayedbhaktyā guruṃ tattvāvabodhakam || māhātmyasya ca leśo'yaṃ tava cokto mayā'nagha || 47 || na śakyate hi saṃpūrṇaṃ vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi || purā kailāsaśikhare pārvatyai proktavāñcchivaḥ || 48 || kārtikasya tu māhātmyaṃ yāvadvarṣaśataṃ vadan || tathāpi nāṃtamagamadaśakto virarāma ha || 49 || putrārthī ca dhanārthī ca rājyārthī svaphalaṃ labhet || kimatra bahunoktena mokṣārthī mokṣamāpnuyāt || 2.4.36.50 || || sūta uvāca || || ityukto brahmaṇā caiva nāradaḥ premanirbharaḥ || bhūyobhūyo namaskṛtya yayau yādṛcchiko muniḥ || 51 || kathitaṃ śaṃkareṇā'pi putrāya hitakāmyayā || pitustadvākyamākarṇya ṣaṇmukho harṣanirbharaḥ || 52 || kṛṣṇena satyabhāmāyai kārtikasya ca vaibhavaḥ || kathitastena saṃtuṣṭā satyā vratamathā'karot ||53|| ṛṣayo vālakhilyebhyaḥ śrutvā māhātmyamuttamam || ūrjavrataparā jātāstasmādūrjo'tivallabhaḥ || 54 || adhītya sarvaśāstrāṇi payaḥsāramivoddhṛtam || nā'nena sadṛśaṃ śāstraṃ viṣṇuprītikaraṃ śubham || 55 || || vyāsa uvāca || || ityuktvā tānṛṣīnsarvānsūto vai dharmavittamaḥ || virarāma tataste tu pūjāṃ cakrustadāsya ca || 56 || te punaḥ svāśramaṃ gatvā hṛṣṭāste paramarṣayaḥ || yathā sūtenopadiṣṭaṃ tathā cakrurvrataṃ śubham || 57 || anena vidhinā ye vai kurvaṃti kārtikavratam || te sarvapāpanirmuktā gacchaṃti viṣṇumaṃdiram || 58 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe kārtikamāsamāhātmye puṣkariṇīsaṃjñikāṃtimatithitrayamāhātmyakathanapūrvakapurāṇa śravaṇamahimavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||cha||| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe saṭīkaṃ kārtikamāsamāhātmyaṃ samāptam ||
<2.5.1>
|| || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha mārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmyaprārambhaḥ || || sūta uvāca || || devakīnandanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jagadānandakārakam || bhuktimuktipradaṃ vande mādhavaṃ bhaktavatsalam || 1 || śvetadvīpe sukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ ramāpatim || caturvaktro namaskṛtya papraccha pitaraṃ tadā || 2 || || brahmovāca || || hṛṣīkeśa jagaddhātaḥ puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana || pṛṣṭaṃ yadbrūhi deveśa sarvajña sakaleśvara || 3 || māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'hamityuktaṃ bhavatā purā || tasya māsasya māhātmyaṃ jñātumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 4 || ko devastasya kiṃ dānaṃ kathaṃ snānaṃ vidhiśca kaḥ || puruṣaistatra kiṃ kāryaṃ bhoktavyaṃ kiṃ ramāpate || 5 || vaktavyaṃ kiṃ tathā pūjādhyānamaṃtrādikaṃ ca yat || tatra yatkriyate karma tatsarvaṃ brūhi me'cyuta || 6 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā brahmansarvalokopakāriṇā || yasminkṛte kṛtaṃ sarvamiṣṭāpūrtādikaṃ bhaveta || 7 || sarvayajñeṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti mārgaśīrṣe kṛte suta || 8 || tulāpuruṣadānādyairyatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || tatphalaṃ prāpyate putra māhātmyaśravaṇātkila || 9 || yajñādhyayanadānādyaiḥ sarvatīrthāvagāhanaiḥ || saṃnyāsena ca yogena nā'haṃ vaśyo'bhavaṃ nṛṇām || 2.5.1.10 || snānena dānena ca pūjanena dhyānena maunena japādibhiśca || vaśyo yathā mārgaśire ca māsi tathā na cānyeṣu ca guhyamuktam || 11 || anyairdharmādibhiḥ kṛtvā gopitaṃ mārgaśīrṣakam || matprāpteḥ kāraṇaṃ matvā devaiḥ svarganivāsibhiḥ || 12 || ye kecitpuṇyakarmāṇo mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || teṣāmavaśyaṃ kartavyo mārgaśīrṣo madāpanaḥ || 13 || mārgaśīrṣaṃ na kurvaṃti ye narā bhāratā'jire || pāparūpāśca te jñeyāḥ kalikālavimohitāḥ || 14 || aṣṭasvapi ca māseṣu yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || tatphalaṃ prāpyate vatsa māghe makarage ravau || 15 || māghācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vaiśākhe māsi labhyate || tasmātsahasraguṇitaṃ tulāsaṃsthe divākare || 16 || tasmātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛścikasthe divākare || mārgaśīrṣo'dhikastasmātsarvadā ca mama priyaḥ || 17 || uṣasyutthāya yo martyaḥ snānaṃ vidhivadācaret || tuṣṭo'haṃ tasya yacchāmi svātmānamapi putraka || 18 || atrāpyudāharantīdaṃ śṛṇu putra kathānakam || nandagopo mahātmā vai khyāto yo bhūtale'bhavat || 19|| tasya vai gokule ramye gopakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || tāsāṃ cittaṃ ca madrūpe lagnamāsītpurā'nagha || 2.5.1.20 || tāsāṃ buddhirmayā dattā māgaśīrṣā'vagāhane || tatastābhiḥ kṛtaṃ snānaṃ prātaḥkāle yathāvidhi || 21 || pūjā kṛtā haviṣyānnaṃ bhuktaṃ tābhiḥ kṛtā natiḥ || evaṃ kṛtena vidhinā prasanno'haṃ tato'nagha || 22 || varo datto mayā''tmā hi tāsāṃ tuṣṭena vai kila || tasmānnaraistu kartavyo mārgaśīrṣo yathāvidhi || 23 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye gopīkṛtamārgaśīrṣasnānaphalakathanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ |||| 1 || || cha ||
<2.5.2>
|| brahmovāca || || tvayokto vidhisaṃyukto mārgaśīrṣo madāpanaḥ || ko vidhistasya deveśa sarvaṃ me brūhi keśava || 1 || || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || rātrāvante samutthāya upaspṛśya yathāvidhi ||
