namaskṛtyā guruṃ svīyaṃ saṃsmarenmāmataṃdritaḥ || 2|| sahasranāmabhirbhaktyā kīrtayedvāgyataḥ śuciḥ || bahirgrāmātsamutsṛjya malamūtraṃ yathāvidhi || 3 || śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyamācamya prayataḥ śuciḥ || daṃtadhāvanapūrvaṃ ca snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 4 || ādāya tulasīmūlamṛdaṃ tatpatrasaṃyutām || mūlamaṃtreṇā'bhimaṃtrya gāyatryā vā mahāmate || 5 || maṃtreṇaivā'nuliptāṃgaḥ snāyādapsvaghamarṣaṇam || anuddhṛtairuddhṛtairvā jalaiḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate || 6 || tīrthaṃ prakalpayedvidvānmantreṇā'nena mantravit || oṃnamo nārāyaṇāyeti mūlamantra udāhṛtaḥ || 7 || darbhapāṇistu vidhinā ācāṃtaḥ purataḥ śuciḥ || caturhastasamāyuktaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ || prakalpyā''vāhayedgaṃgāmebhirmaṃtrairvicakṣaṇaḥ || 8 || viṣṇupādaprasūtā'si vaiṣṇavī viṣṇudevatā || trāhi nastvamaghādasmādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt || 9 || tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ vāyurabravīt || divi bhuvyaṃtarikṣe ca tāni te saṃti jāhnavi || 2.5.2.10 || naṃdinītyeva te nāma deveṣu nalinīti ca || dakṣaputrī ca vihagā viśvagā yogināṃ matā || 11 || vidyādharī suprasannā tathā lokaprasādinī || kṣemā ca jāhnavī caiva śāṃtā śāṃtipradāyinī ||12|| etāni puṇyanāmāni snānakāle sadā paṭhet || sadā saṃnihitā tatra gaṃgā tripathagāminī || 13 || saptavārābhijaptena karasaṃpuṭayojitam || mūrdhnā kṛtāṃjalirbhūyastricatuḥ paṃca sapta vā || snānaṃ kuryānmṛdā tadvadāmaṃtryā'nuvidhānataḥ || 14 || aśvakrāṃte rathakrāṃte viṣṇukrāṃte vasundhare || mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 15 || uddhṛtā'si varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā || namaste sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhavā'raṇi suvrate || 16 || evaṃ snātvā tataḥ paścādācamya ca vidhānataḥ|| utthāya vāsasī śukle kūle vai paridhāya ca || 17 || ācamya tapayeddevānpitṝṃścaiva ṛṣīṃstathā || niṣpīḍya vastramācamya dhautavastreṇa veṣṭitaḥ || 18 || vimalāṃ mṛttikāṃ ramyāmādāya dvijasattama || mantreṇaivā'bhimaṃtryā'tha lalāṭādiṣu vaiṣṇavaḥ || dhārayedūrdhvapuṇḍrāṇi yathāsaṃkhyamataṃdritaḥ || 19 || brahmandvādaśapuṇḍrāṇi brāhmaṇaḥ satataṃ vahet || catvāri bhūbhṛtāṃ putra puṇḍrāṇi dve viśāṃ smṛte || ekaṃ puṃḍraṃ ca nārīṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca vidhīyate || 2.5.2.20 || lalāṭa udare caiva vakṣo vai kaṇṭhakūbare || kukṣyorbāhvoḥ karṇayośca pṛṣṭhe trike ca vai śiraḥ || tilakā dvādaśa proktā brāhmaṇasya sadā'nagha ||21|| lalāṭe hṛdi bāhvośca kṣātraḥ puṃḍrāṇi dhārayet|| lalāṭe hṛdaye vaiśyo bhāle vai śūdrayoṣitām||22|| lalāṭe keśavaṃ dhyāyennārāyaṇamathodare|| vakṣaḥsthale mādhavaṃ ca goviṃdaṃ kaṇṭhakūbare||23|| viṣṇuṃ ca dakṣiṇe kukṣau bāhau ca madhusūdanam || trivikramaṃ karṇamūle vāmanaṃ vāmapārśvake ||24|| śrīdharaṃ vāmabāhau ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ ca karṇake || pṛṣṭhe tu padmanābhaḥ syāttrike dāmodaraṃ nyaset||25|| tatprakṣālanatoyena vāsudevaṃ tu mūrdhani|| evaṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyasyopadhārayet||26|| lalāṭe keśavaṃ dhyāyeddhṛdaye mādhavaṃ tathā || bāhvośca ubhayorvatsa smaredvai madhusūdanam ||27|| kṣatriyasya vidhiḥ prokto vaiśyakṛtyaṃ niśāmaya || lalāṭe keśavaṃ dhyāyeddhṛdaye mādhavaṃ tathā || 28 || yoṣicchūdrau smaretāṃ ca keśavaṃ bhāladeśake || anena vidhinā kuryātpuṃḍrāṇi mama tuṣṭaye || 29 || śyāmaṃ śāṃtikaraṃ proktaṃ raktaṃ vaśyakaraṃ tathā || śrīkaraṃ pītamityāhuḥ śvetaṃ mokṣakaraṃ śubham||2.5.2.30|| ekāṃtino mahābhāgāḥ sarvalokahite ratāḥ || sāṃ'tarālaṃ prakurvaṃti puṇḍraṃ haripadākṛtim ||31|| madhye chidreṇa saṃyuktametaddhi harimaṃdiram || ūrdhvaṃ saumyamṛjuṃ sūkṣmaṃ supārśvaṃ sumanoharam|| 32 || niraṃtarālaṃ yaḥ kuryādūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ dvijā'dhamaḥ || sa hi tatra sthitaṃ lakṣmyā saha māṃ ca vyapohati || 33 || acchidramūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ tu ye kurvaṃti dvijādhamāḥ || tairlalāṭe śunaḥ pādaṃ nikṣiptaṃ vai na saṃśayaḥ || 34 || tasmācchidrānvitaṃ puṃḍraṃ mahacchidraṃ śubhānvitam || dhārayedbrāhmaṇo nityaṃ harisālokyasiddhaye || 35 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye tripuṃḍradhāraṇavidhikathanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<2.5.3>
|| brahmovāca || || puṃḍraṃ katividhaṃ kāryaṃ prabrūhi mama keśava || puṃḍrāṇāṃ śravaṇe'tīva kautukaṃ mama jāyate || 1 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi puṃḍraṃ ca trividhaṃ smṛtam || tulasīmṛtsnayā sārdhaṃ śrīgopīcaṃdanena ca || 2 || haricaṃdanataḥ kāryaṃ puṃḍraṃ tatra vicakṣaṇaiḥ || śrīkṛṣṇatulasīmūlamṛdamādāya bhaktimān || dhārayedūrdhvapuṃḍrāṇi haristatra prasīdati || 3 || gopīcaṃdana māhātmyaṃ nibodha gadato mama || 4 || yo mṛttikāṃ dvāravatīsamudbhavāṃ kare samādāya lalāṭapaṭṭake || karoti nityaṃ nara ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ kriyāphalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tadā bhavet|| 5|| kriyāvihīnaṃ yadi mantrahīnaṃ śraddhāvihīnaṃ yadi kālavarjitam|| kṛtvā lalāṭe yadi gopicaṃdanaṃ prāpnoti tatkarmaphalaṃ sadā'vyayam||6|| gopīcaṃdanasaṃbhavaṃ suruciraṃ puṃḍraṃ lalāṭe dvijo nityaṃ dhārayate yadi pratidinaṃ rātrau divā sarvadā|| yatpuṇyaṃ kurujāṃgale ravigrahe māgha prayāge tathā tatprāpnoti tato'dhikaṃ mama gṛhe saṃtiṣṭhate devavat || 7 || yasmingṛhe tiṣṭhati gopicaṃdanaṃ bhaktyā lalāṭe manujo bibharti cet || tasmingṛhe'haṃ nivasāmi sarvadā śriyānvitaḥ kaṃsanihā caturmukha || 8 || yo dhārayedddvāravatīsamudbhavāṃ mṛtsnāṃ pavitrāṃ kalikalmaṣāpahām || nityaṃ lalāṭe mama mantrasaṃyutāṃ yamaṃ na paśyedapi pāpasaṃyutaḥ || 9 || yasyāṃ'takāle suta gopicaṃdanaṃ bāhvorlalāṭe hṛdi mastake ca || prayāti loke kamalāpatermama gobālaghātī yadi brahmahā syāt || 2.5.3.10 || grahā na pīḍyaṃti na rakṣasāṃ gaṇā yakṣāḥ piśācoragabhūtanāyakāḥ || lalāṭapaṭṭe suta gopicaṃdanaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate yasya mama prabhāvāt || 11 || ūrdhvapuṃḍramṛjuṃ saumyaṃ lalāṭe yasya dṛśyate || sa caṃḍālo'pi śuddhātmā pūjya eva na saṃśayaḥ ||12|| asnāto yaḥ kriyāḥ kuryādaśuciḥ pāpasaṃyutaḥ || gopīcaṃdanasaṃparkātpūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 13 || aśucirvāpyanācāro mahāpāpaṃ samācaret || śucireva bhavennityamūrdhvapuṃḍrāṃ'kito naraḥ ||14|| matpriyārthaṃ śubhārthaṃ vā rakṣārthaṃ caturānana || matpūjāhomake caiva sāyaṃ prātaḥ samāhitaḥ|| madbhakto dhārayennityamūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ bhavāpaham|| 15 || ūrdhvapuṃḍradharo martyo mriyate yadi kutracit || śvapāko'pi vimānastho mama loke mahīyate || 16 || ūrdhvapuṃḍradharo martyo yadā yasyānnamaśnute || tadā viṃśatkulaṃ tasya narakāduddharāmyaham || 17 || vīkṣyā''darśe jale vā'pi yo vidadhyātprayatnataḥ || ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ mahābhāga sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 18 || anāmikā śāṃtidoktā madhyamā''yuṣkarī bhavet || aṃguṣṭhaḥ puṣṭidaḥ proktastarjanī mokṣadāyinī |||| 19 || gopīcaṃdanakhaṃḍaṃ tu yo dadāti ca vaiṣṇave || kulamaṣṭottaraṃ tena tāritaṃ vai bhavecchatam || 2.5.3.20 || yajño dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam || vyarthaṃ bhavati tatsarvamūrdhvapuṇḍravinākṛtam || 21 || yaccharīraṃ manuṣyāṇāmūrdhvapuṇḍravinākṛtam || tanmukhaṃ naiva paśyāmi śmaśānasadṛśaṃ hi tat|| 22 || ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ prakurvīta matsyakūrmādidhāraṇam || kuryādviṣṇuprasādārthaṃ mahāviṣṇoratipriyam || 23 || yatpunaḥ kalikāle tu matpurīsaṃbhavāṃ mṛdam || matsyakūrmāṃ'kitaṃ cihnaṃ gṛhītvā kurute naraḥ || 24 || dehe tasya praviṣṭaṃ māṃ jānīhi tridaśottama || tasya me nāṃtaraṃ kiṃcitkartavyaṃ śreya icchatā || 25 || mamāvatāracihnāni dṛśyaṃte yasya vigrahe || martyo martyo na vijñeyaḥ sa nūnaṃ māmakī tanuḥ || 26 || pāpaṃ sukṛtarūpaṃ tu jāyate tasya dehinaḥ || mamā''yudhāni dṛśyaṃte likhitāni kalau yuge || 27 || ubhābhyāmapi cihnābhyāṃ yoṃ'kito matsyamudrayā || kūrmayā māmakaṃ tejo vikṣiptaṃ tasya vigrahe || 28 || śaṃkha ca padmaṃ ca gadāṃ rathāṃgaṃ matsyaṃ ca kūrmaṃ racitaṃ svadehe || karoti nityaṃ sukṛtasya vṛddhiṃ pāpakṣayaṃ janmaśatārjitasya || 29 || nārāyaṇāyudhairnityaṃ cihnito yasya vigrahaḥ || pāpakoṭiprayuktasya tasya kiṃ kurute yamaḥ || 2.5.3.30 || śaṃkhoddhāre ca yatproktaṃ vasatā koṭijanmabhiḥ || tatphalaṃ labhate śaṃkhe pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇe bhuje || 31 || yatphalaṃ puṣkare proktaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣadarśanāt || śaṃkhopari kṛte padme tatphalaṃ koṭisaṃmitam ||32 || vāme bhuje gadā yasya likhitā dṛśyate kalau|| gadādharo gayāpuṇyaṃ pratyahaṃ tasya yacchati|| 33|| yaccānaṃdapure proktaṃ cakrasvāmisamīpataḥ || gadācakre ca likhite tatphalaṃ liṃgadarśane || 34 || mamāyudhāṃ'kitaṃ dehaṃ gopīcandanamṛtsnayā || prayāgādiṣu tīrtheṣu sa gatvā kiṃ kariṣyati || 35 || yadāyadā prapaśyeta dehaṃ śaṃkhādicihnitam || tadātadā prasannohaṃ pāpaṃ tasya dahāmi vai || 36 || tiṣṭhate yasya dehe tu ahorātraṃ dine dine || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmalikhitaṃ sa madātmakaḥ ||37|| nārāyaṇāyudhairyuktaṃ kṛtvātmānaṃ kalau yuge || yatpuṇyaṃ karma kurute merutulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ||38|| śaṃkhāyudhāṃ'kito bhaktyā yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute suta || vidhihīnaṃ tu saṃpūrṇaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam ||39|| yathā'gnirdahate kāṣṭhaṃ vāyunā preṣito bhṛśam || tathā dahyaṃti pāpāni dṛṣṭvā ma āyudhāni vai || 2.5.3.40 || mama nāmāṃkitāṃ mudrāmaṣṭākṣarasamanvitām || śaṃkhādisvāyudhairyuktāṃ svarṇaraupyamayīmapi ||41|| dhatte bhagavato yastu kalikāle viśeṣataḥ || prahrādasya samo jñeyo nānyathā mama vallabhaḥ ||42|| yasya nārāyaṇī mudrā dehaṃ śaṃkhādicihnitam || dhātrīphalaiḥ kṛtā mālā tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavā ||43|| dvādaśākṣaramaṃtrastu niyuktāni kalevare || āyudhāni ca viprasya matsamaḥ sa ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ||44|| śaṃkhāṃkitatanurvipro bhuṃkte vai yasya veśmani || tadannaṃ svayamaśnāmi pitṛbhiḥ saha putraka ||45|| kṛṣṇāyudhāṃ'kitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sanmānaṃ na karoti yaḥ || dvādaśābdārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ bāṣkaleyāya gacchati || 46 || kṛṣṇāyudhāṃ'kito yastu śmaśāne mriyate yadi || prayāge yā gatiḥ proktā sā gatistasya mānada ||47|| mamā''yudhaiḥ kalau nityaṃ maṃḍito yasya vigrahaḥ || tatrā''śramaṃ prakurvaṃti vibudhā vāsavādayaḥ || 48 || yaḥ karoti ca me pūjāṃ mama śastrāṃkito naraḥ || aparādhasahasrāṇi nityaṃ tasya harāmyaham || 49 || kṛtvā kāṣṭhamayaṃ biṃbaṃ mama śastraiḥ sucihnitam || yo vā aṃkayate dehaṃ tatsamo nāsti vaiṣṇavaḥ || 2.5.3.50 || aṣṭākṣarāṃ'kitā mudrā yasya dhātumayī kare || śaṃkhapadmādibhiryuktā pūjyate'sau surāsuraiḥ ||51|| dhṛtā nārāyaṇī mudrā prahrādena purā kare || vibhīṣaṇena balinā dhruveṇa ca śukena ca || māṃdhātrā hyaṃbarīṣeṇa mārkaṃḍeyamukhairdvijaiḥ || 52 || śaṃkhādicihnitaiḥ śastrairdehaṃ kṛtvā ca mānada || evamārādhya māṃ prāptaṃ samīhitaphalaṃ mahat || 53 || gopīcaṃdanamṛtsnayā likhito yasya vigrahaḥ || śaṃkhacakrādipadmāṃ'ko dehe tasya vasāmyaham || 54 || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyamāyasameva ca || cakraṃ kṛtvā tu medhāvī dhārayīta vicakṣaṇaḥ || dvādaśāraṃ tu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ valitrayavibhūṣitam || 55 || evaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ kārayīta vicakṣaṇaḥ || upavītādivaddhāryāḥ śaṃkhacakragadāḥ sadā || 56 || brāhmaṇaiśca viśeṣeṇa vaiṣṇavaiśca viśeṣataḥ || upavītaṃ śikhā yadvaccakraṃ lāṃchana saṃyutam || 57 || cakralāṃchanahīnasya viprasya viphalaṃ bhavet || mama cakrāṃ'kito dehaḥ pavitra iti vai śrutiḥ || 58 || cakrāṃ'kitāya dātavyaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || mama cakrāṃ'kakavacamabhedyaṃ devadānavaiḥ || ajeyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ śatrūṇāṃ rakṣasāmapi || 59 || mama cakrāṃ'kakavacaṃ śarīre yasya tiṣṭhati || nā'śubhaṃ vidyate tasya gṛhaputrādikasya hi || 2.5.3.60 || dakṣiṇe ca bhuje vipro bibhṛyādvai sudarśanam || savye ca śaṃkhaṃ bibhṛyāditi vedavido viduḥ || 61 || tattanmaṃtreṇa maṃtrajñaḥ pratiṣṭhāpya pṛthakpṛthak || 62 || lalāṭe ca gadā dhāryā mūrdhni cāpaṃ śarastathā || naṃdakaṃ caiva hṛnmadhye śaṃkhacakre bhujadvaye || 63 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena cakrādīndhārayetsadā || dhāraṇānantaraṃ brūyāttatra caivaṃ dvijottamaḥ || 64 || putramitrakalatrādiryaḥ kaścinmatparigrahaḥ || saha dehena sarvo'sau viṣṇuprītyai mayā'rpitaḥ || 65 || paścātsvadharmamāsthāya tiṣṭhedājīvanaṃ mama || bhaktyā cāvyabhicāriṇyā sarvadā''ptamanorathaḥ || 66 || śaṃkhacakrāṃkitaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye niṃdaṃti narādhamāḥ || avalokya mukhaṃ teṣāmādityamavalokayet || śrīkṛṣṇanāma coccārya śuddho bhavati nānyathā || 67 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde gopīcandanādiśaṃkha cakrādyāyudhadhāraṇatattanmudrādhāraṇaprakārakathanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha ||
<2.5.4>
|| brahmovāca || || taptacakāṃkitaṃ kṛtvā hyātmānamatha dīkṣitam || padmākṣatulasīmālaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ brūhi keśava || 1 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtāṃ yo mālāṃ vahate dvijaḥ || apya'śauco'pyanācāro māmevaiti na saṃśayaḥ || 2 || dhātrīphalakṛtā mālā tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavā || dṛśyate yasya dehe tu sa vai bhāgavato naraḥ || 3 || tulasīdalajāṃ mālāṃ kaṇṭhasthāṃ vahate tu yaḥ || mamottīrṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa sa namasyo divaukasām || 4 || tulasīdalajāṃ mālāṃ dhātrīphalakṛtāmapi || dadāti pāpināṃ muktiṃ kiṃ punarmama sevinām || 5 || tulasīdalajāṃ mālāṃ mamottīrṇāṃ vahettu yaḥ || patrepatre'śvamedhānāṃ daśānāṃ labhate phalam || 6 || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtāṃ yo mālāṃ vahate naraḥ|| phalaṃ yacchāmyahaṃ vatsa pratyahaṃ dvārakodbhavam || 7 || nivedya bhaktyā māṃ mālāṃ tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavām || vahate yo naro bhaktyā tasya vai nāsti pātakam || 8 || sadā prītamanāstasya ahaṃ prāṇavaro hi saḥ || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtāṃ yo mālāṃ vahate naraḥ || prāyaścittaṃ na tasyā'sti nā'śaucaṃ tasya vigrahe ||9|| tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtaṃ śirasaḥ kāṣṭhabhūṣaṇam || bāhau kare ca martyasya dehe yasya sa me priyaḥ || 2.5.4.10 || tulasīkāṣṭhamālābhirbhūṣitaḥ puṇyamācaret || pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 11 || tulasīkāṣṭhamālāṃ tu pretarājasya dūtakāḥ || dṛṣṭvā naśyaṃti dūreṇa vātoddhūtaṃ yathā dalam || 12 || yadgṛhe tulasīkāṣṭhaṃ patraṃ śuṣkamathā''rdrakam || bhavaṃti tadgṛhe naiva pāpaṃ saṃkramate kalau || 13 || tulasī kāṣṭhamālābhirbhūṣito rbhramate bhuvi || duḥsvapnaṃ durnimittaṃ ca na bhayaṃ śātravaṃ kvacit ||14|| dhārayaṃti na ye mālāṃ haitukāḥ pāpabuddhayaḥ || narakānna nivartaṃte dagdhāḥ kopāgninā mama || 15 || tasmāddhāryā prayatnena mālā tulasisaṃbhavā || padmākṣanirmitā bhaktyā phalairdhātryā supuṇyadā || 16 || tadūrdhvapuṃḍraśaṃkhādyairyuktastulasimūlake || sandhyopāstyādikaṃ kuryātkuśapāṇirhiṃ māṃ smaran || 17 || kṛtasandhyādiko bhaktastataḥ saṃpūjayecca mām || guruścettatra varteta ādau gatvā namedgurum || 18 || kiṃciddattvopāyanaṃ ca daṇḍavatpraṇamenmudā || ācamyaikāgramanasā pūjāmaṇḍapamāviśet || 19 || upaviśyā''sane ramye kṛṣṇājinakuśottare || samyakpadmāsanāsīno bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret || 2.5.4.20 || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā mantreṇa ca jiteṃdriyaḥ || udaṅmukhastataḥ kṛtvā hṛtpaṃkajamanuttamam|| vikāsaṃ tasya kurvīta vijñānaraviṇā hṛdi || 21 || karṇikāyāṃ nyaseccārkaṃ śaśinaṃ cāgnimeva ca || trayaṃ trayātmake tasmiściṃtayedvaiṣṇavo naraḥ || nānāratnamayaṃ pīṭhaṃ teṣāmupari vinyaset || 22 || tasminmṛduślakṣṇataraṃ bālārkasadṛśadyuti || aṣṭaiśvaryadalaṃ padmaṃ mantrākṣaramayaṃ nyaset || 23 || tasmindevaṃ samāsīnaṃ koṭiśītāṃśusannibham || caturbhujaṃ mahāpadmaśaṃkhacakragadādharam || 24 || padmapatraviśālākṣaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ pītavastrānvitaṃ ca mām || 25 || vicitrābharaṇairyuktaṃ divyamaṃḍanamaṃḍitam || divyacandanaliptāṃgaṃ divyapuṣpopaśobhitam || 26 || tulasīkomaladalavanamālāvibhūṣitam || koṭibālārkasadṛśaṃ kāntaṃ divyaśriyā saha || 27 || sarvalakṣaṇalakṣiṇyā samāśliṣṭatanuṃ śivam || evaṃ dhyātvā japenmaṃtraṃ samāhitamanāḥ śuciḥ || 28 || sahasraṃ śatavāraṃ vā yathāśakti japenmanum || manasaivā'rcanaṃ kṛtvā tato vidhivadācaret || 29 || saṃpradāyā'nurodhena śaṃkhaṃ sthāpya mamāgrataḥ || dūrvāṃkuraiśca puṣpaiśca gaṃdhodena ca pūritam || 2.5.4.30 || dakṣiṇe gaṃdhapuṣpāṇāṃ pātraṃ sthāpya ca deśikaiḥ || vāmabhāge nyasetkuṃbhaṃ vastrapūtaṃ suvāsitam || 31 || purato mama ghaṃṭāṃ ca dikṣu dīpānniyojayet || anyatsarvaṃ sādhanaṃ ca yathāsthāneṣu vinyaset ||32|| arghyapādyā''camanīyamadhuparkasya kāraṇāt || vinyasetpurato mahyaṃ catvāryamatrakāṇi vai || 33 || siddhārthā'kṣatapuṣpāṇi kuśāgraṃ tilacaṃdanam || phalaṃ yavāścaturvaktra arghyapātre viniḥkṣipet ||34|| dūrvā viṣṇupadī śyāmā padmaṃ caiva caturthakam || pādyapātre nyasetputra deśiko mama tuṣṭaye || 35 || kaṃkolaṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ ca phalaṃ mālatisaṃbhavam || kuryādvai śraddhayā putra pātra ācamanīyake || 36 || gavyaṃ payo dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ khaṃḍa samanvitam || madhuparkasya pātre vai dadyādvai śraddhayā'rcakaḥ || 37 || uktānāṃ dravyajātīnāmalābhe patrapuṣpayoḥ || tattadbhāvanayā kuryātsarvadā vidhikovidaḥ || 38 || karanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryādaṃganyāsaṃ tathaiva ca || paṃcāṃgaṃ vā ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vā vinyasetsaṃpradāyataḥ || 39 || mamā'nusmaraṇaṃ kāryamātmānaṃ matsamaṃ smaret || pūjāraṃbhe caturvaktraṃ maṃgalaṃ tu paṭhennaraḥ || 2.5.4.40 || atha saṃpūjayecchaṃkhaṃ pāṃcajanyaṃ mama priyam || yasya saṃpūjanādvatsa ānaṃdaḥ paramo mama || śaṃkhasya pūjane vatsa maṃtrānetānudīrayet || 41 || tvaṃ purā sāgarotpanno viṣṇunā vidhṛtaḥ kare || nirmitaḥ sarvadevaiśca pāṃcajanya namo'stu te || 42 || tava nādena jīmūtā vitrasaṃti surā'surāḥ || śaśāṃkā'yutadīptābha pāṃcajanya namo'stu te ||43|| garbhā devārinārīṇāṃ vilīyaṃte sahasradhā || tava nādena pātāle pāṃcajanya namo'stu te || 44 || darśanenaiva śaṃkhasya kiṃ punaḥ sparśane kṛte || vilayaṃ yāṃti pāpāni himavadbhāskarodaye || 45 || natvā śaṃkhaṃ kare dhṛtvā maṃtrairebhistu vaiṣṇavaḥ || yaḥ snāpayati māṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyamanaṃtakam || 46 || suvāsitena tailena kuryādabhyaṃjanaṃ tataḥ || kastūryā caṃdanenaiva kuryādudvartanādikam|| 47|| sugaṃdhavāsitaistoyaiḥ snāpya maṃtrayutaiḥ śubhaiḥ || arghyaṃ dattvā tato vatsa pādyamācamanīyakam || madhuparkaṃ tato dadyādatha sarvopacārakān || 48 || vastrairābharaṇairdivyairalaṃkṛtya yathāvidhi || puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayetpīṭhaṃ tatra devaṃ nidhāya ca ||49|| vastrā'laṃkāragaṃdhādīnarpayecchraddhayā mama || naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyātpāyasā'pūpamiśritam || sakarpūraṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ bhaktyā caiva nivedayet || 2.5.4.50 || surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi bhaktyā samyaṅnivedayet|| dhūpaṃ daśāṃgamaṣṭāṃgaṃ dīpaṃ ca sumanoharam || 51 || pariṇīya praṇamyātha stutvā stutibhirādarāt || śāyayitvā tu paryaṃke magalārghyaṃ nivedayet|| 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye śaṃkhapūjāvidhikathanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<2.5.5>
|| brahmovāca || || paṃcāmṛtasya snapanādyatphalaṃ labhate hareḥ|| śaṃkhodakena yatkiṃcittanme brūhyajitā'cyuta ||1|| || || śrībhagavānuvāca|| || kṣīrasnānaṃ prakurvaṃti ye narā mama mūrddhani|| śatāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ biṃdunā biṃdunā smṛtam||2|| kṣīrāddaśaguṇaṃ dadhnā ghṛtenaiva daśottaram|| madhunā taddaśaguṇaṃ sitayā tu tato'dhikam || gaṃdhapuṣpodake maṃtraṃ sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ praśasyate ||3|| dvādaśyāṃ paṃcadaśyāṃ vā gavyena payasā mama || snāpanaṃ devaśārdūla mahāpātakanāśanam|| 4 || dadhyādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ kṣīrataḥ saṃbhavo yathā || tathaiva śeṣakāmānāṃ kṣīrasnapanato mama || 5 || kṣīrasnānena saubhāgyaṃ dadhnā miṣṭānnabhojanam|| ghṛtena snāpayedyo māṃ naro mama puraṃ vrajet || 6 || madhunā sitayā yastu kārayenmārgaśīrṣake || sa rājā jāyate loke punaḥ svargādihāgataḥ ||7|| gajāśvarathasaṃpūrṇaṃ sa rājyaṃ labhate bhuvi || kārayenmārgaśīrṣe vai yaḥ kṣīrasnāpanaṃ mama || 8 || svarge loke sa jayati caṃdreṃdrarudramārutān || kṣīrasnānaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mārgaśīrṣe ca putraka || 9 || kṣīrasnapanamāhātmyaṃ varcaskaṃ puṣṭivardhanam || daurbhāgyaṃ vilayaṃ yāti kṣīrasnānena me suta || 2.5.5.10 || snāpayenmārgaśīrṣe māṃ yo vai paṃcā'mṛtenatu || sa na śocyo bhavejjaṃturbaṃdhunā bhuvi mānada || 11 || kapilākṣīramādāya yaḥ snāpayati māṃ suta || kapilāśatadānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 12 || śaṃkhe tīrthodakaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ snāpayati deśikaḥ || biṃdunā'pi sahomāse svakulaṃ tārayeddhi saḥ ||13|| kāpilaṃ kṣīramādāya śaṃkhe kṛtvā ca mānavaḥ || yaḥ snāpayati māṃ bhaktyā sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet ||14|| śaṃkhe kṛtvā tu pānīyaṃ sākṣataṃ kuśasaṃyutam || yaḥ snāpayetsahomāse sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 15 || śaṃkhāṣṭakena yaḥ snānaṃ kārayenmārgaśīrṣake || bhaktyā bhagavataḥ śreṣṭho mama loke mahīyate || 16 || śaṃkhaṣoḍaśakenātha yaḥ snāpayati me suta || sa pāpamuktaḥ suciraṃ svargaloke mahīyate || 17 || caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākaiḥ śaṃkhairyaḥ snāpayecca mām || iṃdraloke ciraṃ sthitvā sa rājā bhuvi jāyate || 18 || śaṃkhā'ṣṭottaraśatenaiva snāpayenmārgaśīrṣake || śaṃkheśaṃkhe suvarṇasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 19 || mārgaśīrṣe bhaktimānyaḥ kṛtvā śaṃkhadhvaniṃ hi mām || snāpayetpitarastasya svargaṃ tāvatpratiṣṭhitāḥ || 2.5.5.20 || aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu śaṃkha snānaṃ tu yaścaret || sa gaṇo muktimāpnoti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 21 || nityaṃ saṃsnāpayedyo māṃ śaṃkhena surasattama || gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ prāpya nityaṃ naṃdati devavat || 22 || śaṃkhetoyaṃ samādāya yaḥ snāpayati māṃ suta || namo nārāyaṇetyuktvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 23 || kṛtvā pādodakaṃ śaṃkhe vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām || yo dadāti tilonmiśraṃ cāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || 24 || nādyaṃ taḍāgajaṃ vā'pi vāpīkūpādikaṃ ca yat || gāṃgeyaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ jalaṃ śaṃkhakṛtaṃ ca yat ||25|| gṛhītvā mama pādāṃbu śaṃkhe kṛtvā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ || yo vahecchirasā nityaṃ sa munistapatāṃ varaḥ ||26|| trailokye yāni tīrthāni mama caivājñayā suta || śaṃkhe tāni vasaṃtīha tasmācchaṃkho varaḥ smṛtaḥ || 27 || sāṃbuṃ śaṃkhaṃ kare dhṛtvā maṃtrairetaistu vaiṣṇavaḥ || yaḥ snāpayenmārgaśīrṣe tuṣṭastasya bhavāmyaham || 28 || śaṃkhādau caṃdradaivatyaṃ kukṣau varuṇadevatā || pṛṣṭhe prajāpatiścaiva agre gaṃgā sarasvatī || 29 || teṣāmuccārapūrvaṃ tu snāpayenmāmataṃdritaḥ || tasya puṇyasya saṃkhyāṃ vai kartuṃ naiva surāḥ kṣamāḥ|| 2.5.5.30 || purato mama deveśa sapuṣpaḥ sajalākṣataḥ|| śaṃkhastvabhyarcitastiṣṭhettasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī || 31 || vilepanena saṃpūrṇaṃ śaṃkhaṃ kṛtvā tu māṃ bhajet || tadā me paramā prītirbhavedvai śatavārṣikī || 32 || śaṃkhe kṛtvā tu pānīyaṃ sapuṣpaṃ sajalākṣatam || arghyaṃ dadāti yo māṃ vai tasya puṇyamanaṃtakam || 33 || arghyaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ śaṃkhe yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā || 34 || bhrāmayitvā ca me mūrdhni maṃdiraṃ śaṃkhavāriṇā || prokṣayedvaiṣṇavo yastu nāśubhaṃ tadgrahe bhavet || 35 || nādhayo na klamastasya nārakaṃ na bhayaṃ kvacit || yasya pādodakaṃ śaṃkhe kṛtaṃ mūrdhānamālabhet || 36 || grahā rakṣāṃsi kūṣmāṃḍapiśācoragadānavāḥ || dṛṣṭvā śaṃkhodakaṃ mūrdhni vidravaṃti diśo daśa || 37 || vāditraninadairuccairgītamaṃgalaniḥsvanaiḥ || yaḥ snāpayati māṃ bhaktyā jīvanmukto bhaveddhi saḥ || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye śaṃkhapūjanaphalakathanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<2.5.6>
|| || brahmovāca || || ghaṇṭānādasya māhātmyaṃ caṃdanasya tathā'cyuta || yatphalaṃ labhate svāmiṃstatsarvaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ || 1 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || snānārcanakriyākāle ghaṃṭānādaṃ karoti yaḥ || purato mama deveśa tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 2 || varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi varṣakoṭiśatāni ca || vasate māmake loke apsarogaṇasevitaḥ || 3 || sarvavādyamayī ghaṇṭā sarvadevamayī yataḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena ghaṇṭānādaṃ tu kārayet || 4 || sarvavādyamayī ghaṇṭā sarvadā mama vallabhā || vādanāllabhate puṇyaṃ yajñakoṭiśatodbhavam || 5 || ghaṃṭānādaḥ sadā kāryaḥ pūjākāle viśeṣataḥ || manvaṃtarasahasrāṇi manvataraśatāni ca || 6 || prīto bhavāmi satataṃ ghaṃṭānādena putraka || bherīśaṃkhaninādena ghaṃṭānādānvitena ca || 7 || mṛdaṃgaśaṃkhena yutaṃ praṇavena samanvitam || arcanaṃ mama deveśa satataṃ mokṣadaṃ nṛṇām || 8 || yatra tiṣṭheta purato ghaṃṭā nādānvitā mama || arcitā vaiṣṇavairyatra tatra māṃ viddhi putraka || 9 || vainateyāṃ'kitā ghaṃṭā sudarśanayutā'thavā || mamāgre sthāpayedyastu tasya pāpaṃ harāmyaham || 2.5.6.10 || madīyārcanavelāyāṃ ghaṃṭānādaṃ karoti yaḥ || naśyaṃti tasya pāpāni śatajanmārjitānyapi || 11 || svāpakāle prakurvīta ghaṇṭānādaṃ svabhaktitaḥ || mamaivārcanavelāyāṃ phalaṃ koṭiguṇodbhavam || 12 || ye māmarcaṃti deveśa suparṇoparisaṃsthitam || śaṃkhapadmagadāyuktaṃ sacakraṃ ca śriyā yutam || 13 || kiṃ kariṣyaṃti te tīrthairdevatānāṃ ca darśanaiḥ || kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ vratairvāpi kiṃ dānaiḥ kimupoṣaṇaiḥ ||14|| mūrtirnārāyaṇī yaiśca māmakī garuḍopari || sthāpitā te kalau yāṃti kalpakoṭiṃ padaṃ mama || 15|| mamā'gre sthāpayedyastu prāsāde'tha gṛhe'thavā || tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇi tatra tiṣṭhaṃti devatāḥ || 16 || yastu pūjayate dhanyo garuḍoparisaṃsthitam|| ekādaśyāṃ tathā rātrau vāsanāsaṃyuto mama || kṛtvā gītaṃ ca nṛtyaṃ ca tārayennarakātpitṝn || 17 || punaśca kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu ghaṃṭāmahaṃ suta || 18 || mama nāmāṃkitā ghaṇṭā purato yā ca tiṣṭhati || arcitā vaiṣṇavī yatra tatra māṃ viddhi putraka || 19 || yastu vādayate ghaṃṭāṃ vainateyavicihnitām|| dhūpe nīrājane snāne pūjākāle vilepane || 2.5.6.20 || mamāgre pratyahaṃ vatsa pratyekaṃ labhate phalam || makhāyutaṃ go'yutaṃ ca cāṃdrāyaṇaśatodbhavam|| 21 || vidhibāhyakṛtā pṛjā saphalā jāyate nṛṇām || ghaṇṭānādena tuṣṭo'haṃ prayacchāmi svakaṃ padam || 22 || nāgā'ricihnitā ghaṃṭā rathāṃgena samanvitā || vādanātkurute nāśaṃ janmakoṭibhayasya vai || 23 || garuḍenāṃ'kitāṃ ghaṃṭāṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ pratyahaṃ mudā || prītiṃ karomi deveśa lakṣmīṃ prāpya yathā'dhanaḥ || 24 || ghaṃṭādaṇḍasya śirasi sucakraṃ sthāpayettu yaḥ || matpriyaṃ vainateyaṃ vā sthāpitaṃ bhuvanatrayam || 25 || ghaṃṭānādaṃ sacakraṃ ca aṃtakāle śṛṇoti yaḥ || pāpakoṭiyutasyā'pi naśyaṃti yamakiṃkarāḥ || 26 || sarvadoṣāḥ praṇaśyaṃti ghaṃṭānādena vai suta || devatānāṃ sarudrāṇāṃ pitṝṇāmutsavo bhavet || 27 || abhāve vainateyasya cakrasyā'pi na saṃśayaḥ || ghaṃṭānādena bhaktānāṃ prasādaṃ prakaromyaham || 28 || gṛhe yasminbhavennityaṃ ghaṇṭā nāgārisaṃyutā || sarpāṇāṃ na bhayaṃ tatra nāgnividyutsamudbhavam || 29 || yasya ghaṃṭā gṛhe nāsti śaṃkho na purato mama || kathaṃ bhāgavato jñeyaḥ kathaṃ bhavati vallabhaḥ || 2.5.6.30 || caṃdanasya pravakṣyāma māhātmyaṃ tava putraka || yasminkṛte bhavetprītirmamātyaṃtaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || || 31 || sacaṃdanaṃ sakusumaṃ karpūrāgarumiśritam || mṛganābhisamāyuktaṃ jātīphalasamanvitam || 32 || tulasīcaṃdanopetaṃ mamātyaṃtasukhāvaham || yo dadāti hi māṃ nityaṃ tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavam|| 33 || yugāni vasate svarge hyanaṃtāni narottamaḥ || mahāviṣṇoḥ kalau bhaktyā dattvā tulasicaṃdanam || ||34|| arcayenmālatīpuṣpairna bhūyaḥ stanapo bhavet || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtaṃ caṃdanaṃ yacchate mama ||35|| dahāmi pātakaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvajanmaśataiḥ kṛtam || sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ tulasīkāṣṭhacaṃdanam||36|| pitṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa sadā'bhīṣṭaṃ yathā mama ||37|| śrīkhaṃḍaṃ caṃdanaṃ tāvacchreṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṃ tathā || yāvanna dīyate mahyaṃ tulasīkāṣṭhacaṃdanam|| 38 || tāvatkastūrikā''modaḥ karpūrasya sugaṃdhitā || yāvanna dīyate mahyaṃ tulasīkāṣṭhacaṃdanam ||39|| kalau yacchaṃti ye mahyaṃ tulasīkāṣṭhacaṃdanam|| mārgaśīrṣaśubhemāse te kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ || 2.5.6.40 || yo hi bhāgavato bhūtvā kalau tulasicaṃdanam || nārpayedvai sahomāse nā'sau bhāgavato naraḥ ||41|| kuṃkumāguruśrīkhaṇḍakardamairmama vigraham || ālipedvai sahomāse kalpakoṭiṃ vaseddivi ||42|| karpūrāgurumiśreṇa caṃdanenā'nuliṃpayet || mṛgadarpaṃ viśeṣeṇa abhīṣṭaṃ ca sadā mama||43|| vilepayati yo māṃ vai śaṃkhe kṛtvā tu caṃdanam || mārgaśīrṣe tadā prītiṃ karomi śatavārṣikīm ||44|| sevate tulasīpatrairnityamāmalakaiśca yaḥ || mārgaśīrṣe sadā bhaktyā sa labhedvāṃchitaṃ phalam || 45 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye bhagavate tulasīkāṣṭhacaṃdanārpaṇaphalakathanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<2.5.7>
|| brahmovāca || || māhātmyaṃ vada deveśa puṣpajātisamudbhavam || yenayena ca puṣpeṇa yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || 1 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ puṣpasaṃbhavam|| yena puṣpeṇa me prītirbhavetsamyaṅna saṃśayaḥ || 2 || mallikā mālatī caiva yūthikā cātimuktakā || pāṭalā karavīraṃ ca jayantī vijayā tathā || 3 || kubjakastabakaścaiva karṇikāraṃ kuraṃṭakaḥ || caṃpakaścātakaḥ kundo bāṇaḥ karcūramallikā || 4 || aśokastilakaścaiva tathaivā'parayūthikaḥ || amī puṣpaprakārāstu śastā me pūjane suta || 5 || ketakīpatrapuṣpaṃ ca bhṛṃgarājastathaiva ca || tulasīpatrapuṣpaṃ ca sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ mama|| 6 || padmānyaṃbusamutthāni raktanīlotpale tathā || sitotpalaṃ sahomāse mamā'tyantaṃ hi vallabham || 7 || tānyeva ca praśastāni kusumāni ca me suta || yāni syurvarṇayuktāni rasagandhayutāni ca || 8 || nirgaṃdhānyapi śastāni kusumāni matāni me || surabhīṇi tathā'nyāni varjayitvā tu ketakīm || 9 || bāṇaṃ ca caṃpakā'śokaṃ karavīraṃ ca yūthikā || pāribhadraṃ pāṭalā ca bakulaṃ giriśālinī || 2.5.7.10 || bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ patraṃ bhṛṃgirajasya ca || tamālāmalakīpatraṃ śastaṃ me pūjane suta || 11 || puṣpairaraṇyasaṃbhūtaiḥ patrairvā girisaṃbhavaiḥ || aparyuṣitaniśchidraiḥ prokṣitairjaṃtuvarjitaiḥ|| 12 || athārāmodbhavairvāpi puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayecca mām || puṣpajātiviśeṣeṇa bhavetpuṇyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||13|| tapaḥśīlaguṇopete pātre vedasya pārage || daśa dattvā suvarṇāni yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ sahe kusumadānataḥ || 14 || droṇapuṣpe tathaikasminmahyaṃ ca vinivedite || daśa dattvā suvarṇāni phalaṃ tadadhikaṃ suta || 15 || puṣpātpuṣpāṃtare bhedo yathā''sīttannibodha me || 16 || droṇapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ khādiraṃ tu viśiṣyate || khādirātpuṣpasāhasrācchamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 17 || śamīpuṣpasahasrebhyo bilvapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || bilvapuṣpasahasrebhyo bakapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate ||18|| bakapuṣpasahasrebhyo naṃdyāvartaṃ viśiṣyate || naṃdyāvartasahasrāddhi karavīraṃ viśiṣyate || 19 || karavīrasahasrasya kusumaṃ śvetamuttamam || karavīraśvetapuṣpātpālāśaṃ puṣpamuttamam || 2.5.7.20 || pālāśapuṣpasāhasrātkuśapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || kuśapuṣpasahasrāddhi vanamālā viśiṣyate || 21 || vanamālā sahasrāddhi caṃpakaṃ ca viśiṣyate || caṃpakasya puṣpaśatādaśokaṃ puṣpamuttamam || 22 || aśokapuṣpasāhasrācchevantīpuṣpamuttamam || śevantīpuṣpasāhasrātkujakaṃ puṣpamuttamam || 23 || kujapuṣpasahasrāddhi mālatīpuṣpamuttamam || mālatīpuṣpasāhasrātsandhyāpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 24 || sandhyā puṣpasahasrāddhi trisaṃdhyāpuṣpamuttamam || 25 || trisaṃdhyāraktasāhasrāttrisaṃdhyāśvetamuttamam || trisandhyāśvetasāhasrātkundapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || || 26 || kundapuṣpasahasrāddhi jātīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || sarvāsāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃ jātīpuṣpamihottamam || 27 || jātīpuṣpasahasreṇa yacchenmālāṃ suśobhanām || mahyaṃ yo vidhivaddadyāttasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 28 || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca || matpure vasate nityaṃ mamatulya parākramaḥ || 29 || yeṣāṃ saṃti ca puṣpāṇi praśastāni mamā'rcane || teṣāṃ patrāṇi śastāni tadabhāve phalāni ca || 2.5.7.30 || etaiḥ patraiśca puṣpaiśca phalaiścā'pi tathāhi mām || arcandaśasuvarṇasya pratyekaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 31 || etābhiḥ puṣpajātībhiḥ sahomāse'rcayaṃti ye || bhaktiṃ dadāmi teṣāṃ vai tuṣṭaḥ sannātra saṃśayaḥ || 32 || dhanaṃ putrāṃstathā dārānyatkiṃcidvāṃchate hi saḥ || tattaddadāmi deveśa puṣpairebhiḥ pratoṣitaḥ || 33 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye jātīpuṣpaśraiṣṭhyakathanapūrvakaṃ viṣṇukaṇṭhe tatsahasrapuṣpāṃkitamālāsthāpanaphalayovarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || || cha ||
<2.5.8>
|| brahmovāca|| || śrīmattulasimāhātmyaṃ yathāvadvarṇaya prabho || yasyāḥ sannidhimātreṇa prītirbhavati te'dhikā || 1 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || maṇikāṃcanapuṣpāṇi tathā muktāmayāni ca || tulasīpatradānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 2 || tulasīmaṃjarībhiryaḥ kuryādvai mama pūjanam || na sa garbhagṛhaṃ yāyānmuktibhāgī bhavennaraḥ || 3 || āropya tulasīṃ vatsa pūjayettaddalaiśca mām || divi saṃmodamānaḥ sa śvetadvīpe ca me gṛhe || 4 || śrīmattulasyārcayate sakṛddhi māṃ patraiḥ sugandhairvimalairakhaṃḍitaiḥ || yastasya pāpaṃ paṭasaṃsthitaṃ tadā nirīkṣayitvā parimārjayedyamaḥ || 5 || tulasī na yeṣāṃ mama pūjanārthaṃ saṃpāditaikādaśipuṇyavāsare || dhigyauvanaṃ jīvitamarthasantatisteṣāṃ sukhaṃ neha ca dṛśyate pare || 6 || liṃgamabhyarcitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahomāse ca māmakam || tulasīpatranikarairmucyate brahmahatyayā || 7 || nityamabhyarcayedyo vai tulasyā māṃ rameśvaram || mahāpāpāni naśyaṃti kiṃ punaścopapātakam ||8|| varjyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ puṣpaṃ varjyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ jalam || na varjyaṃ tulasīpatraṃ na varjyaṃ jāhnavījalam || 9 || tāvadgarjaṃti puṣpāṇi mālatyādīni bhoḥ suta || yāvanna prāpyate puṇyā tulasī mama vallabhā || 2.5.8.10 || sakṛdabhyarcayedyo māṃ bilvapatreṇa mānavaḥ || muktibhāgī nirātaṃko mama pārśvagato bhavet || 11 || bilvapatrācchamīpatrājjātīpatrātsaroruhāt || vallabhaṃ tulasīpatraṃ kaustubhādadhikaṃ mama||12|| abhinnapatrā tulasī hṛdyā maṃjarisaṃyutā || kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūtā padmeveyaṃ sadā mama ||13|| akṛṣṇā'pyathavā kṛṣṇā tulasī mama vallabhā || sitā vā'pyasitā vāpi dvādaśī vallabhā yathā ||| 14 || gṛhītvā tulasīpatraṃ bhaktyā yo māṃ samarcayet || arcitaṃ tena sakalaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || || 15 || tāvadgarjaṃti ratnāni kaustubhādīnyanantaśaḥ || yāvanna prāpyate kṛṣṇa tulasīkṛṣṇamaṃjarī || 16 || kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇatulasyā hi yo bhaktyā pūjayennaraḥ || sa yāti bhuvanaṃ śubhraṃ yatra viṣṇuḥ śriyā saha || 17 || mamā'rcanārthaṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ yacchaṃti tulasīdalam || anyeṣāmapi bhaktānāṃ yāṃti te padamavyayam|| 18 || tulasī kṛṣṇagaurā yā tayā yo māṃ samarcayet || naro yāti tanuṃ tyaktvā vaiṣṇavīṃ śāśvatīṃ gatim || 19 || || brahmovāca || || dhūpadānasya māhātmyaṃ dīpasyā'pi ca keśava || yatphalaṃ labhate martyastanme brūhi yathārthataḥ || 2.5.8.20 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi dhūpadānasya yatphalam || dīpadānasya māhātmyaṃ mama prītikaraṃ param ||21|| aguruṃ ca sakarpūraṃ divyacaṃdanasaurabham || dattvā māṃ vai sahomāse kulānāṃ tārayecchatam || 22 || kṛṣṇāgurusamutthena dhūpena ca mamā'layam || dhūpayedvaiṣṇavo yastu sa mukto narakā'rṇavāt || 23 || māhiṣaṃ guggulaṃ yastu ājyayuktaṃ saśarkaram || dhūpaṃ dadāti yo vai māṃ tasyecchāṃ pradadāmyaham || 24 || guggulo haṃtyaśeṣāṇi ariṣṭāni ca dhūpitaḥ || kāmānnānāvidhāṃścaiva aguruḥ saṃprayacchati || 25 || dehaṃ gehaṃ punātyeva dhūpastvagurusaṃbhavaḥ || nāśayedyakṣarakṣāṃsi dhūpaḥ sarjarasodbhavaḥ || 26 || jātipuṣpamathailā ca guggulaśca harītakī || kūṭaḥ sarjarasaścaiva guḍaḥsailācchaḍastathā || nakhayuktāni caitāni daśāṃgo dhūpa ucyate || 27 || dhūpaṃ daśāṃgaṃ yadi cetkaroti māse sahe me ativallabhe ca || dadāmi kāmānatidurlabhānapi balaṃ ca puṣṭiṃ sutadārabhaktim || 28 || mustādhūpe mānuṣāṇāṃ priyatvaṃ māṃgalyakaṃ vaśyakaraṃ guḍasya || kuryātsahomāsi mamāgrato yo vihāya pāpāni sa māṃ samāpnuyāt || 29 || na bhayaṃ vidyate tasya divyabhaumāṃtarikṣajam || mama dhūpāvaśeṣeṇa yasyāṃ'gaṃ parimārjitam || 2.5.8.30 || na cāpadvidyate tasya bhavaṃti saṃpado'khilāḥ || dhūpe kṛte sahomāse mamāgre śraddhayā'niśam ||31 || dhūpaḥ surūpatāṃ dhatte dhūpaḥ pāvanamuttamam || vanaspatiraso divyaḥ paramaḥ pāvanaḥ śuciḥ || 32 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dīpamāhātmyamuttamam || yasminkṛte naro yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 33 || bahuvartisamāyuktaṃ ghṛtapūrasamanvitam || kuryādārārtikaṃ yo vai kalpakoṭiṃ divaṃ vaset || 34 || nīrājanaṃ tu yaḥ paśyetsahomāse mamā'grataḥ || saptajanma bhavedvipro hyaṃte ca paramaṃ padam || 35 || karpūreṇa tu yaḥ kuryādbhaktyā caiva mamāgrataḥ || ārārtikaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha praviśenmāmanaṃtakam || 36 || mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ yatkṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ mama || sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇatāmeti kṛte nīrājane suta|| 37 || yaḥ karoti sahomāse karpūreṇa ca dīpakam || aśvamedhamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet || 38 || mamā'gre vai dvijānāṃ ca dīpaṃ dadyāccatuṣpathe || medhāvī jñānasaṃpannaścakṣuṣmāñjāyate naraḥ || 39 || ghṛtena vā'tha tailena dīpaṃ prajvālayennaraḥ || sahomāse mamā'gre ca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 2.5.8.40 || vihāya sakalaṃ pāpaṃ sahasrādityasannibhaḥ || jyotiṣmatā vimānena mama loke mahīyate || 41 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena dīpaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || taṃ ca dattvā vihiṃsedyaḥ sa patennarake dhuvam || 42 || dīpaṃ yo vai haretpāpī lobhāddveṣāddvijottama || taddīpaharaṇātso'pi mūkoṃ'dhaśca prajāyate || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye dīpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<2.5.9>
|| brahmovāca || || naivedyasya vidhiṃ brūhi deva me tattvataḥ prabho || annaṃ katividhaṃ ceṣṭaṃ vyaṃjanādīnyaśeṣataḥ || 1 || ||śrībhagavānuvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vatsa mama prītikaraṃ param || vakṣyāmi te'nnapānādivyaṃjanādīnyaśeṣataḥ || 2 || ādau hiraṇmayaṃ pātraṃ tadabhāve ca rājatam || tadabhāve ca pālāśaṃ vistīrṇaṃ bahusundaram || 3 || kacolāḥ śataśaḥ kāryāḥ pātre vai parito'nagha || tanmadhye vyaṃjanā deyā nānāphalamayāḥ śubhāḥ || 4 || pāyasaṃ candrasaṃkāśaṃ pātre vai śarkarāyutam || bhaktaṃ kumudasaṃkāśaṃ mudgānkācaprabhāñchubhān || 5 || nānāvyaṃjanasaṃruddhaṃ tribhiḥ paṃktibhireva ca || niṃbūrasena caṃdreṇa phalamūlayutena ca || 6 || vaikṛtāśca tadā kāryāḥ śataśo bhojane mama || drākṣāstu miśritāścūtakaramarda kṛtāḥ śubhāḥ || 7 || marīcapippalīsārdrakailācaṃdrakasaṃyutāḥ || kvāthitāḥ kathikāḥ kāryāḥ śataśo bhojane mama || 8 || pralehanāstathā kāryāḥ kacolaśatasaṃkulāḥ || nānākusumasaṃmodayuktāḥ sahasi me priyāḥ || 9 || maṃḍakā vartulā ramyāḥ samāḥ sarvatra biṃduvat || sitayā sahitenā'tha dugdhena kvathitena ca || 2.5.9.10 || madhuvarṇena gavyena yukte tasminsubhojane || kacole suprabhe vatsa sthitaṃ kāṃcanasuprabham || 11 || ghṛtaṃ suvāsitaṃ prītyā deyaṃ hi mama bhojane || tatra godhūmapātreṇa caṃdrakeṇa hi cojjvalam || 12 || sauvāhlikāḥ pūrikāstu śatacchidrāḥ saveṣṭikāḥ || apūpāśca tathā kṣīraṃ prakārāṃstu prakārayet || 13 || maṇayaḥ sūtrasaṃjñāśca mālatīkusumādayaḥ || parpaṭā varpaṭā ramyā māṣakūṣmāṃḍasaṃbhavāḥ || 14 || vaṭakānnavadhā ramyānkuryānmāse sahe mama || dvidhā jātīmarīcaiśca pūritā droṇake śubhāḥ || 15 || yuktena lavaṇenā'tiśuddhatailena pūritāḥ || kuṃkumābhāḥ snehahīnāḥ sakṣatā iva durjanāḥ || 16 || dadhidugdhayutāḥ kecicciṃciṇīcūtasaṃbhavāḥ || drākṣārasayutāḥ kecittathaivekṣurasairyutāḥ || 17 || rājikā jalamadhyasthāstathā'nye sitayā saha || rasaiścaturvidhaiścānyairvaṭakā navadhā matāḥ || 18 || vajraprabhā'nukaṇikācārabījasukhārikaiḥ || śakalairnārikelasya lavaṃgaśatasaṃyutāḥ || 19 || ghṛtakṣīrasitādyāstāḥ kaṭāhe supraloḍitāḥ || labdhāsitādikṛsararamyāḥ snigdhāśca pheṇikāḥ || 2.5.9.20 || parākikāsu vai pakvāḥ kṛtāścaṃdreṇa polikāḥ || modakāstatra vai kāryāścārabījabhavāḥ pare || 21 || sitayā sahitāḥ kāryā anye dugdhena nirmitāḥ || nārikelaphalaiścā'nye vṛkṣaniryāsanirmitāḥ || 22 || badāmaiśca śubhāścā'nye tilaiśca kaṇabījakaiḥ || īdṛśānmodakāṃścānyāṃstuṣṭyarthaṃ mama kārayet || 23 || arśoghnaṃ mocanīkaṃdaṃ tathā''rdraṃ karamardakam || nāriṃgaṃ ciṃciṇīkaṃ ca kaṃkolaphalameva ca || 24 || daśāraṃ tripurījātaṃ śubhaṃ niṃbaphalaṃ bisam || tiṃdūphalaṃ lavaṃgaṃ ca śrīphalaṃ tilakaṃ luti || 25 || valkalaṃ vaṃśakārīraṃ tathā kāyaphalaṃ balam || drākṣāphalaṃ cūtaphalaṃ ramyaṃ kaṃṭakinīphalam || 26 || dhātrīphalaṃ śuktibhavaṃ phalamaṃbāḍavaṃ tathā || raṃbhāphalaṃ pippalī ca marīcāśca manoharāḥ || 27 || śuddhasarṣapatailena lavaṇena suvedhitam || tathā rājikayā viddhaṃ tribhirvarṣairghaṭe sthitam || 28 || evaṃvidhāni jātāni vyaṃjanāni ca mānada || kartavyāni sahomāse mama prītikarāṇi vai || 29 || etādṛśe bhojane cedasāmarthyaṃ bhavedyadi || evaṃ kāryaṃ tadā tena saṃkṣepeṇa śṛṇuṣva me || 2.5.9.30 || laḍḍūkamekaṃ ghṛtapūramekaṃ phenadvayaṃ kokarasatrayaṃ ca || ghṛtaplutaṃ maṃḍakaṣoḍaśānāṃ vaṭāṣṭadāyī narakaṃ na paśyet || 31 || āḍhakaṃ suciraparyuṣitaṃ ca dugdhaṃ khaṃḍasya ṣoḍaśapalāni śaśiprabhasya || sarpiṣpalaṃ madhupalaṃ maricaṃ dvikarṣaṃ śuṃṭhyāḥ palārdhamathavā'rdhapalaṃ caturṇām || 32 || ślakṣṇe paṭe lalanayā mṛdupāṇighṛṣṭāṃ karpūradhūlidhavalīkṛtabhāṃḍasaṃsthām || etāṃ śubhāṃ rasavatīṃ prakaroti yo vai kāmāndadāmi sakalānmanujasya tasya || 33 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye naivedyavidhikathanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<2.5.10>
|| brahmovāca || || naivedyānaṃtaraṃ tāta kiṃ kartavyaṃ nṛbhiḥ prabho || yatkartavyaṃ sahomāse tatsarvaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ || 1 || śrībhagavānuvāca || || atha bhuktavate dattvā jalaiḥ karpūravāsitaiḥ || ācamanaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ caṃdanaṃ karamārjanam || 2 || puṣpāṃjaliṃ tataḥ kuryādbhaktyā''darśaṃ pradarśayet || nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ kārpūraṃ vibhave sati || 3 || samarpya mukuṭādīni bhūṣaṇāni vicakṣaṇaḥ || tataḥ paścānmahābhāga prakalpya cchatracāmare ||4|| prasādasumukhaṃ dhyātvā śyāmasuṃdaravigraham || japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ stuvīta stutibhiḥ prabhum ||5|| śaṃkharaupyamayī mālā kāṃcanī ca viśeṣataḥ || padmākṣaiścaiva subhagairvidrumairmaṇimauktikaiḥ || 6 || raciteṃdrākṣakairmālā tathaivāṃguliparvabhiḥ || putrajīvamayī mālā śastā vai japakarmaṇi || 7 || na ca kramanna ca hasanna pārśvamavalokayan || na padā padamākrāmya karaprāptaśirāstathā ||8|| nottiṣṭhanmanmanuṃ vidvānna japedvyagramānasaḥ || japakāle na bhāṣeta vratahomārcanādiṣu ||9|| gṛheṣvekaguṇaṃjāpyaṃ goṣṭhe daśaguṇaṃ bhavet || nadītīre śataṃ vidyādagnyagāre daśā'dhikam || 2.5.10.10 || tīrthādiṣu sahasraṃ syādanaṃtaṃ mama sannidhau || evaṃ kṛtvā sahomāse yaḥ kuryācca pradakṣiṇām || 11 || saptadvīpavatīpuṇyaṃ labhate sa padepade || paṭhannāmasahasraṃ tu athavā nāma kevalam || 12 || ekā pradakṣiṇā bhaktyā dahetpāpaṃ sadā''hnikam || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā || 13 || dinasaptodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ mama tisraḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ || tatkṣaṇānnāśayaṃtyeva pāpaṃ dehe daśā''hnikam || 14 || kṛtāḥ pradakṣiṇā yena ekaviṃśati bhaktitaḥ || bhrūṇahatyādipāpāni nāśamāyāṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 15 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ yena kṛtā bhaktyā pradakṣiṇāḥ || teneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ sarvaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ || 16 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena tāvadvāraṃ vasundharā || mātuḥ pradakṣiṇāstadvadbhūtadhātrīpradakṣiṇāḥ || 17 || śāligrāmaśilāyāśca samametattrayaṃ smṛtam || eko daṃḍaprapātaśca sahe saptapradakṣiṇāḥ || 18 || samametaddvayaṃ no vā daṃḍapāto viśiṣyate || pradakṣiṇe daṃḍapātaṃ yaḥ karoti sadā mama || 19 || sahomāse viśeṣeṇa ākalpaṃ sa vaseddivi || kalpādanaṃtaraṃ tāta cakravartī prajāyate || 2.5.10.20 || cirāyurdhanavānbhogī dānavāndharmavatsalaḥ || sahasranāmapaṭhanātpāpaṃ naśyettridhā kṛtam || 21 || atha kiṃ bahunoktena śṛṇu guhyaṃ ca me suta || dāmodareti nāmnā vai bhavetprītirmamā'tulā || 22 || guṇasaṃbaṃdhi mannāma kṛtaṃ mātrā yaśodayā || yadā me dadhibhāṃḍasya sphoṭanaṃ gokule kṛtam|| 23 || tadā yaśodayā gāḍhaṃ baddho dāmnā hyulūkhale || tataḥ prabhṛti me nāma khyātaṃ dāmodareti ca||24|| namo dāmodarāyeti japedyaḥ susamāhitaḥ || sūryodaye śucirbhūtvā trisahasraṃ dinedine || 25 || sārddhalakṣatrayaṃ yāvattata udyāpayedbudhaḥ || tarpaṇaṃ havanaṃ caiva brahmabhojyaṃ daśāṃśataḥ || 26 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā tasya yacchāmi vāṃchitam || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā dārānputrāṃścānyacca vāṃchitam || 27 || trisatyena mayā coktaṃ śraddhatsva tvaṃ mahāmate || maṃtrarājamimaṃ putra kṛpayā me prakāśitam || 28 || dāmodarāyeti paṭhannityaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam|| daṃḍapātaṃ tathā putra aṣṭāṃgena samanvitam || 29 || padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāmurasā śirasā tathā || manasā vacasā dṛṣṭavā praṇāmoṣṭāṃga ucyate || 2.5.10.30 || śiro matpādayoḥ kṛtvā bāhubhyāṃ ca parasparam|| prapannaṃ pāhi māmīśa bhītaṃ mṛtyugrahā'rṇavāt || 31 || paścāccheṣāṃ mayā dattāṃ śirasyādhāya sādaram || evaṃ brūyāttato vatsa mama pūjāprapūrttaye || 32 || maṃtrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ janārdana || yatpūjitaṃ mayā deva paripūrṇaṃ tadastu me || 33 || mṛdaṃgavādyena samaṃ praṇavena susaṃyutam || evaṃ kāryaṃ sahomāse nṛtyaṃ puṇyapradaṃ nṛṇām || 34 || gītaṃ vādyaṃ ca nṛtyaṃ ca tathā pustakavācanam || pūjākāle caturvaktra sarvadā mama ca priyam ||35|| gītavādyādyabhāve ca mama nāmasahasrakam || stavarājaṃ tathā putra gajeṃdrasya ca mokṣaṇam ||36|| anusmṛtiśca gītā ca stavanaṃ paṃcadhā matam || paṃcastavaṃ mahābhāga mama prītikaraṃ param||37|| pādodakaṃ pibedyo vai śāligrāmasamudbhavam || paṃcagavyasahasraistu prāśitaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam||38|| śāligrāmaśilātoyaṃ yaḥ pibedbiṃdunā samam || mātuḥ stanyaṃ punarnaiva sa pibenmuktibhāgnaraḥ|| 39 || āśaucaṃ naiva vidyeta sūtake mṛtake'pi ca || yeṣāṃ pādodakaṃ mūrdhni prāśanaṃ ye prakurvate || 2.5.10.40 || aṃtakāle'pi yasyedaṃ dīyate pādayorjalam || so'pi sadgatimāpnoti sadācārabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 41 || apeyaṃ pibate yastu bhuṃkte yadyapyabhojanam || agamyāgamano yo vai pāpācāraśca yo naraḥ || 42 || so'pi pūto bhavatyāśu sadyaḥ pādāṃbudhāraṇāt || cāṃdrāyaṇātpādakṛcchrādadhikaṃ pādayorjalam ||43|| aguruṃ kuṃkumaṃ vā'pi karpūraṃ cā'nulepanam || mama pādāṃbusaṃspṛṣṭaṃ tadvai pāvanapāvanam ||44|| dṛṣṭipūtaṃ tu yattoyaṃ bhavedvai viprasattama || tadvai pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ kiṃ punaḥ pādayorjalam || 45 || priyastvaṃ me'grajaḥ putro viśeṣeṇa ca matpriyaḥ || tadarthaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ yacca me sthitam ||46|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṃḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmye pūjāvidhisamāpanaṃ tadudyāpanaṃ tatphalakathanayogonāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<2.5.11>
|| brahmovāca || || ekādaśyāśca māhātmyaṃ mūrtīnāṃ ca vidhānakam || sarvaṃ brūhi mama svāminkṛpayā bhūtabhāvana || 1 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || śṛṇuṣva dvijaśārdūla kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || yāṃ śrutvā yāti vilayaṃ pāpaṃ brahmavadhādikam || 2 || kāṃpilye nagare rājā vīrabāhuriti smṛtaḥ || satyavādī jitakrodho brahmajño mama tatparaḥ || 3 || bhāvavānsa dayāśīlorūpavānbalavānnaraḥ || bhakto bhāgavatānāṃ ca sadā mama kathāruciḥ || 4 || sadā mama kathā''saktaḥ sadā jāgaraṇapriyaḥ || dātā vidvānkṣamāśīlo vikramī vijiteṃdriyaḥ || 5 || vijayī raṇaśīlaśca ṛddhyā ca dhanadopamaḥ|| putravānpaśumāṃścaiva svadāraniratastathā ||6|| tasya bhāryā kāṃtimatī rūpeṇā'pratimā bhuvi || pativratā mahāsādhvī mama bhaktiratā sadā || 7 || tayā saha viśālākṣo bubhuje medinīṃ yuvā || muktvaikaṃ māṃ mahābāho nānyajjānāti daivatam || ||| 8 || ekasmindivase putra bhāradvājo mahāmuniḥ || samāgato gṛhe tasya vīrabāhormahātmanaḥ || 9 || dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ dūrādbhāradvājaṃ mahāmunim || svāgataṃ kārayāmāsa dattvārghyaṃ vidhivattadā || 2.5.11.10 || āsanaṃ kalpayāmāsa svayameva mahīpatiḥ || praṇamya parayā bhaktyā tasthau munivarāgrataḥ ||||| 11 || || rājovāca || || adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ dinam || adya me saphalaṃ rājyamadya me saphalaṃ gṛham || 12 || prasanno mama viprarṣe paramātmā janārdanaḥ || yattvaṃ samāgato hyadya gṛhe yogivarastathā || 13 || mukto'haṃ pāpakoṭyādya yattvayā'haṃ nirīkṣitaḥ || rājyaṃ lakṣmīrgajā'śvāśca mayā tubhyaṃ niveditāḥ || 14 || vaiṣṇavo'si muniśreṣṭha nāstyadeyaṃ mayā tava || merutulyaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ vaiṣṇavasya varāṭikā || || 15 || nā''yāti hi gṛhe yasya vaiṣṇavo vai dvijottamaḥ || taddinaṃ viphalaṃ tasya kathitaṃ brāhmaṇairmama ||16|| viṣṇubhaktāśca ye kecitsarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ || kathitaṃ mama gārgyeṇa gautamena sumaṃtunā || 17 || ye tvabhaktā hṛṣīkeśe piśācāste hi mānavāḥ || mahāpātakaliptāste ye bhuṃjaṃti harerdine || || 18 || śivavratasahasraistu saurairbrāhmaiśca koṭibhiḥ || yatphalaṃ kavibhiḥ proktaṃ vāsaraikena taddhareḥ || 19 || garvamudvahate tāvattithirbrāhmī ca śāṃkarī || yāvannāyāti vipreṃdra dvādaśī ca mama priyā || 2.5.11.20 || tāvatprabhāvastārāṇāṃ yāvannodayate śaśī || tithistathā ca vipreṃdra yāvannāyāti dvādaśī || 21 || nāradena purā proktaṃ vasiṣṭhena mamāgrataḥ || tvaṃ vettā sarvadharmāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahāmune || 22 || || bhāradvāja uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahābhāga yattvaṃ bhakto'si vaiṣṇavaḥ || sā suprajā mahī dhanyā yattvaṃ rakṣasi bhūmipa || 23 || tasminrāṣṭre na vastavyaṃ yatra rājā na vaiṣṇavaḥ || varaṃ vāso vane tīrthe na tu rāṣṭre tvavaiṣṇave || 24 || yatra bhāgavato rājā saṃpraśāsti ca medinīm || vaikuṇṭhamiti maṃtavyaṃ tadrāṣṭraṃ pāpavarjitam || 25 || cakṣurhīnaṃ yathā dehaṃ patihīnā yathā striyaḥ || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 26 || yathā putro mahīpāla mātāpitrorapoṣakaḥ || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 27 || dānahīno yathā rājā brāhmaṇo rasavikrayī || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 28 || daṃtahīno yathā hastī pakṣahīno yathā khagaḥ || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 29 || pratigrahārthaṃ vedādi dravyārthaṃ sukṛtaṃ yathā || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 2.5.11.30 || darbhahīnā yathā saṃdhyā yathā śrāddhamadakṣiṇam || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 31 || saśikhaśca yathā śūdrā kapilākṣīrapāyakaḥ || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 32 || śūdraśca brāhmaṇīgāmī hemaghno dharmadūṣakaḥ || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 33 || harisūryādivṛkṣāṇāṃ yathā chedo narottama || dvādaśī daśamī yuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 34 || yathā''hutirmaṃtrahīnā mṛtavatsāpayo yathā || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 35 || sakeśā vidhavā yadvadvrataṃ snānavivarjitam || dvādaśī daśamīyuktā tathā rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam || 36 || sa rājā procyate sadbhiryo bhakto madhusūdane || tadrāṣṭraṃ vardhate nityaṃ sukhī bhavati saprajaḥ || 37 || dṛṣṭirme saphalā rājanyanmayā tvaṃ nirīkṣitaḥ || adya me saphalā vāṇī jalpate yā tvayā saha || 38 || dūrameva hi gaṃtavyaṃ śrūyate yatra vaiṣṇavaḥ || darśanāttu bhavetpuṇyaṃ tīrthasnānasamudbhavam || 39 || sa tvaṃ rājanmayā dṛṣṭo viṣṇubhaktirataḥ śuciḥ || svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sukhī bhava narādhipa || 2.5.11.40 || etasminnaṃtare rājñyā kāṃtimatyā namaskṛtaḥ || bhāradvājo muniśreṣṭhaḥ pravaraḥ sarvayoginām || 41 || avaidhavyaṃ varārohe bhaktā bhava svabharttari || niścalā keśave bhaktiḥ sadā bhavatu te śubhe || 42 || etasminnaṃtare rājā bhāradvājaṃ mahāmunim || uvāca prīṇayanvācā meghanādagabhīrayā || 43 || || rājovāca || || vipulā me kathaṃ lakṣmīḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvajanmani || sarvaṃ brūhi muniśreṣṭha kṛpā yadi mamopari || 44 || etanmayā kathaṃ prāptaṃ rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam || putro vai guṇavāñcchreṣṭhaḥ priyā ca sumanoharā || 45 || maccittā madgataprāṇā ciṃtayantī janārdanam || ko'haṃ mune kathaṃ caiṣā kaśca dharmo mayā kṛtaḥ || 46 || kiṃ cā'nayā'pi cārvaṃgyā mama patnyā kṛtaṃ mune || kena puṇyena me lakṣmīrmṛtyuloke sudurlabhā || 47 || aśeṣā bhūmipālā vai vartaṃte yasya me vaśe || vikramaṃ cā'pratihataṃ śarīrārogyatā tathā || 48 || mamā'pi vipulaṃ tejo na kaścitsahate mune || icchāmyadya pratijñātuṃ yathā ceyamaniṃditā || 49 || mayā'pi sukṛtaṃ vipra kiṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvajanmani || iti pṛṣṭo nareṃdreṇa pūrvajanmaviceṣṭitam || 2.5.11.50 || svapatnyāśceṣṭitaṃ caiva saṃpadāṃ caiva kāraṇam || yogotthaṃ suciraṃ kālaṃ tathāviṃdata mānase || 51 || vijñātametannṛpate pūrvajanmaviceṣṭitam || tava patnyāśca rājarṣe śṛṇuṣva kathayāmyaham || 52 || ||bhāradvāja uvāca || || śṛṇu bhūpāla sakalaṃ yasyedaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam || tvamāsīḥ śūdrajātīyo jīvahiṃsāparāyaṇaḥ || 53 || nāstiko duṣṭacāritraḥ paradārapradharṣakaḥ || kṛtaghno durvinītaśca suṣṭhvācāravivarjitaḥ || 54 || iyaṃ yā bhavato bhāryā pūrvamapyāyatekṣaṇā || karmaṇā manasā vācā nānyadasyāstvayā vinā || || 55 || pativratā mahābhāgā bhajamānā nirantaram || bhāvaṃ na kurute duṣṭaṃ tavopari tathā sati || 56 || sakhibhistvaṃ parityakto bandhubhiḥ pāpakarmakṛt || kṣayaṃ jagāma cā'rtho yaḥ sañcitastava pūrvajaiḥ || 57 || naṣṭe dravye phalā''kāṃkṣī tvamāsīrjagatīpate || pūrvakarmavipākena kṛṣiśca viphalā gatā || || 58 || tato vitte parikṣīṇe parityaktaśca bāṃdhavaiḥ || kṣīyamāṇā'pi sādhvīyamatyajattvāṃ na bhāminī || 59 || tvaṃ bhagnaḥ sarvakāmebhyo gatavānnirjane vane || hatvā jīvānanekāṃśca cakārātmavipoṣaṇam ||2.5.11.60 || evaṃ pravṛttasya tava saha patnyā tadā nṛpa || gatāni bahuvarṣāṇi pāpavṛttyā mahītale||61|| anyasminvāsare rājanmārgabhraṣṭo mahāmuniḥ || na diśaṃ vidiśaṃ vetti devaśarmā dvijottamaḥ || 62 || kṣuttṛṣāpīḍito'tyarthaṃ madhyāhnagadivākare || patito vanamadhye tu mārgabhraṣṭo mahīpate || 63 || dayā jātā ca te bhūpa dṛṣṭvā duḥkhena pīḍitam || brāhmaṇaṃ vṛddhamajñātaṃ gṛhītvā tu kareṇa vai || 64 || utthāpya patitaṃ bhūmau tvayoktaṃ hi tadā nṛpa || prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣa āgaccha tvaṃ mamā''śramam || 65 || jalapūrṇaṃ taḍāgaṃ ca padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam || vṛkṣairmanoharairyuktaṃ phalaiḥ puṣpairmanoramaiḥ || 66 || snātvā suśītale toye kṛtvā karma ca naityakam || kuru vipra phalāhāraṃ piba vāri suśītalam || 67 || sukhena kuru viśrāmaṃ mayā saṃrakṣitaḥ svayam || viprendra tṛptiparyaṃtaṃ vasa tvaṃ ca mamāśrame || 68 || uttiṣṭha tvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || labdhasaṃjñastadā vipraḥ śrutvā śūdrasya bhāṣitam || 69 || kare jagrāha taṃ śūdraṃ gato yatra jalāśayaḥ || upaviṣṭo mahābāho chāyāmāśritya tattaṭe || 2.5.11.70 || snānaṃ cakāra vidhivatpūjayāmāsa keśavam || tarpayitvā pitṝndevānpapau nīraṃ suśītalam || 71 || viśrāṃto vṛkṣūmūle'bhūddevaśarmā dvijottamaḥ || sāṣṭāṃgaṃ munaye kṛtvā namaskāraṃ saha striyā || 72 || śūdrastu parayā bhaktyā provāca munisannidhau || āvayostaraṇārthāya atithistvaṃ samāgataḥ || 73 || darśanāttava viprarṣe jātaḥ pāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ || priye phalāni svādūni prayacchāsmai dvijātaye || mṛdūni rasayuktāni supakvāni priyāṇi ca || 74 || || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || tvāmahaṃ naiva jānāmi svajñātiṃ kathayasva me || nājñātasya hi bhoktavyaṃ brāhmaṇasyā'pi putraka || 75 || || śūdra uvāca || || śūdro'haṃ dvijaśārdūla na kāryaḥ saṃśayastvayā || ātmajairdurjanairvipra parityaktaḥ svabandhubhiḥ || 76 || tayoḥ saṃvadatorevaṃ śūdrapatnyā phalāni ca || dattāni tasmai viprāya tena bhuktāni tāni vai || 77 || abhūtprītamanā vipraḥ pītvā nīraṃ suśītalam || sukhaṃ saṃprāpya sa munirviśrāṃtastarumūlake || 78 || sa ca śūdraḥ sapatnīko bhuktvā ca punarāgataḥ || svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha kutastvamiha cā''gataḥ || 79 || śūnyāṭavīṃ dvijaśreṣṭha duṣṭasattvabhayākulām || nirmanuṣyāṃ duḥkhayuktāṃ divārātraṃ bhayānakām || 2.5.11.80 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || brāhmaṇo'haṃ mahābhāga prayāgagamanaṃ prati || ahamajñātamārgeṇa praviṣṭo dāruṇe vane || 81 || mama puṇyaprabhāveṇa jātosi varabāṃdhavaḥ || jīvitaṃ me tvayā dattaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || 62 || bhavānapi kutaḥ prāpto nirmanuṣye vane khalu || ko bhavānkāraṇaṃ kiṃsvitkathayasva mamā'grataḥ || 83 || || śūdra uvāca || || vidarbhanagarī rājñā bhīmasenena rakṣitā || vāso mama mahārāṣṭre śūdro'haṃ pāpalaṃpaṭaḥ || 84 || svakarmavihito dharmo mayā tyakto dvijottama || tyakto'haṃ bandhuvargeṇa tato'haṃ vanamāgataḥ || 85 || kṛtvā jīvavadhaṃ nityaṃ jīve'haṃ bhāryayā saha || sāṃprataṃ pātakātsamyaṅ nirviṇṇosmi mahāmune || 86 || kuruṣvā'nugrahaṃ kiñcitpāpayuktasya me prabho || mama puṇyaprabhāveṇa āgatastvaṃ dvijottama || 87 || na paśyāmi yathā sauriṃ patnyā saha mahāmune || upadeśaprabhāveṇa prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 88 || nānyadicchāmyahaṃ kiñcinmuktvā devaṃ janārdanam || kuruṣvā'nugrahaṃ me'dya prasādamṛṣisattama || 89 || || bhāradvāja uvāca || || iti tena samāpṛṣṭo devaśarmā dvijāgraṇīḥ || śūdreṇa parayā bhaktyā prahasanvākyamabravīt || 2.5.11.90 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāhātmya ekādaśyākhyānaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || cha ||
<2.5.12>
|| devaśarmovāca || || || tavedṛśī matirjātā sahasā keśavopari || etasmānme gataṃ pāpaṃ pūrvajanmaśatodbhavam || 1 || vinā vratairvinā tīrthairmuktastvaṃ pāpakoṭibhiḥ || mamātithyena bhaktyā ca jātaṃ tava hareḥ padam || 2 || tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa matirjātā tavedṛśī || dhyātvā saṃciṃtya manasā jñātaṃ pūrvaviceṣṭitam || 3|| pūrvajanmani viprastvamavaṃtyāṃ dharmatatparaḥ || sadā'dhyayanaśīlaśca suśīlaśca sadā vratī || 4 || ekā tu dvādaśī viṣṇoḥ kṛtā ca daśamīyutā || tatpāpasya prabhāveṇa samastaṃ sukṛtaṃ gatam || 5 || sarvaṃ tadviphalaṃ jātaṃ yathā śūdrāpatirdvijaḥ || bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi prāptā narakayātanāḥ|| 6 || tasmādevaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ duṣṭaṃ ciraṃ bahu || kṛtā tu daśamīmiśrā tithirviṣṇormahātmanaḥ || 7 || tena śūdro bhavāñjātaḥ pāpe tava matistathā || dharme na ramate cittaṃ daśamīvedhadūṣitam|| 8 || vidarbhanagare vatsa asti te putrikāsutaḥ || kṛtaṃ tena vidhānoktaṃ harerekādaśīvratam || 9 || pradattaṃ tena tatpuṇyamakhaṇḍaikāśīvratam|| dharmopari matirjātā jātaḥ pāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ || 2.5.12.10 || tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa ekādaśyā vratena ca || daśamīvedhajaṃ pāpaṃ yamena parimārjitam || 11 || iha janmani yatpāpaṃ janmāyutakṛtāni ca || mārjitāni yamenaiva pāpāni tava sāṃpratam || 12 || tayorvivadatorevaṃ viṣvaksenaḥ samāgataḥ || varṇāvara svāgataṃ te tuṣṭastehaṃ janārdanaḥ || 13 || viprasyā''tithyahetutvājjātaḥ pāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ || paradattena puṇyena ekādaśyā vratena ca || 14 || daśamīvedhajaṃ pāpaṃ tava śūdra layaṃ gatam || vrataṃ kṛtvā dadau puṇyaṃ dauhitrastena tāritaḥ || 15 || patnyā saha mahābhāga vainateyaṃ samāruha || ityuktvā devadevena vimāne sthāpitastadā || 16 || svargaṃ tataḥ sapatnīkaḥ śūdratvena nṛpottama || devaśarmā tu vipro vai tīrtharājaṃ yayau punaḥ || 17|| etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchitam || akhaṇḍaikādaśīpuṇyātprāptasyā''tithyakāraṇāt || viṣṇubhaktimatī bhāryā rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam || || 18 || || rājovāca || || brahmannakhaṇḍaikādaśyā vidhiṃ samyaksamādiśa || viṣṇoḥ samprīṇanārthāya prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 19 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || śṛṇuṣva nṛpaśārdūla ekādaśyā vidhiṃ śubham || purā''sīdbhagavānviṣṇurnāradāya yaduktavān || 2.5.12.20 || tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi udyāpanavidhiṃ śubham || mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu dvādaśīṣu narottama || 21 || vrataṃ śubhamidaṃ kāryamakhaṇḍaikādaśīvratam || daśamyāṃ caiva naktaṃ ca ekādaśyāmupoṣaṇam || || 22 || dvādaśyāmekabhuktaṃ ca akhaṃḍā iti kathyate || divasasyāṣṭame bhāge mandībhūte divākare || 23 || taddhi naktaṃ vijānīyānna naktaṃ niśi bhojanam || kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrāṃśca caṇakānkodravāṃstathā || 24 || śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune || viṣṇubhakto naro vā'pi daśamyāṃ daśa varjayet || 25 || daśamyā vidhirukto'yamekādaśyāstathā śṛṇu || asakṛjjalapānaṃ ca hiṃsā śaucamasatyatā || 26 || tāṃbūlaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca divāśayanamaithune || dyūtaṃ krīḍā niśi svāpaḥ patitaiḥ saha bhāṣaṇam || ekādaśyāṃ daśaitāni viṣṇubhaktastu varjayet || 27 || adya me strīsukhaṃ nāsti bhojanaṃ nāsti keśava || prītyarthaṃ tava deveśa niyamastu divāniśi || 28 || suptendriyaistu vaiklavyaṃ bhojanaṃ yacca maithunam || dantāṃtaravilagnānnaṃ kṣamasva puruṣottama || 29 || upāvṛttastu pāpebhyo yastu vāso guṇaiḥ saha || upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyo na śarīrasya śoṣaṇam || 2.5.12.30 || pūrvoktāni daśaitāni parānnaṃ ca tathā madhu || dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇubhakto vai varjayenmardanādikam ||31|| adya me dvādaśī puṇyā pavitrā pāpanāśinī || pāraṇaṃ ca kariṣyāmi prasīda garuḍadhvaja || 32 || viṣṇoḥ saṃtoṣaṇārthāya yo mayā niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ || adyāhaṃ bhojayiṣyāmi tvatprasādāddvijottamam || 33 || anena vidhinā kuryādyāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate || saṃpūrṇe tu tato varṣe kuryādudyāpanaṃ budhaḥ || 34 || ādau madhye tathā cāṃte vratasyodyāpanaṃ smṛtam || udyāpanaṃ na kuryādyaḥ kuṣṭhī cāṃdhaśca jāyate || 35 || tasmādudyāpanaṃ kuryādyathāvibhavasārataḥ || kriyate śuklapakṣe ca māse mārgaśire śubhe || 36 || āmaṃtrya dvādaśamitānbrāhmaṇānvidhikovidān || trayodaśaṃ sapatnīkamācāryaṃ vidhikovidam || 37|| yajamānaḥ śuciḥ snātvā śraddhāyukto jitendriyaḥ || pādaśaucārdhavastrādyairācāryādīṃstato'rcayet || 38 || ācāryastu tataḥ kṛtvā maṇḍalaṃ varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || cakrābjaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ śvetavastreṇa veṣṭitam || 39 || jalapūrṇaṃ ca kumbhaṃ tu pañcaratnasamanvitam || pañcapallavasaṃyuktaṃ karpūrāguruvāsitam || 2.5.12.40 || veṣṭitaṃ raktavastreṇa tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam || veṣṭitaṃ puṣpamālābhirmaṃḍalopari vinyaset || 41 || tasyopari nyaseddevaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ nṛpa || sauvarṇī pratimā kāryā ekakarṣapramāṇataḥ || 42 || vāhanā''yudhasaṃyuktā pramāṇaṃ caturaṃgulam || kiṃvā śaktyā prakurvīta vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet || 43 || tataḥ saṃsthāpayenmūrtiṃ maṃḍale dvādaśaiva hi || māsānāmadhipaḥ pūjyaścākhaṃḍavratahetave ||44|| maṃḍalātpūrvadigbhāge śaṃkhaṃ saṃsthāpayecchubham || tvaṃ purā sāgarotpanno viṣṇunā vidhṛtaḥ kare || nirmitaḥ sarvadevaistvaṃ pāṃcajanya namo'stu te || 45 || tatastu sthaṃḍilaṃ kāryaṃ maṃḍalāduttarāṃ diśam || saṃkalpya havanaṃ kāryaṃ mantrairvedoktavaiṣṇavaiḥ || 46 || svasthāne sthāpayedviṣṇuṃ sthāpayecca hariṃ prati || pūjayetpuruṣasūktena mantraiḥ paurāṇikaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 47 || naivedyārthaṃ ca vai kāryā modakā bahavo'pi ca || dhūpadīpopahārāṇi kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ tataḥ || 48 || yakṣakardamena saṃpūjya tataḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇām || svastivācanakairviprairnamaskāraṃ tato nṛpa || 49 || tatastu brāhmaṇaiḥ kārya ācāryakramaśo japaḥ || japaśca pāvamānīyo maṃḍalabrāhmaṇaṃ madhu || 2.5.12.50|| tejo'si śukrajaṃ vācaṃ brahmasāmādanaṃtaram || pavitravaṃtaṃ sūryasya viṣṇormahasi saṃhitām || 51 || japāṃte kalaśe viṣṇuṃ sopāṃgamupari nyaset || divasasyodaye caiva homaṃ kuryādanukramam || 52 || saṃsthāpya prathamaṃ pātraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || stavanaṃ ca tato homaḥ kartavyaścarupūrvakaḥ || 53 || svagṛhyoktavidhānena yajanāgnikriyāparaḥ || carudvayaṃ ca kurvīta pāyasaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ carum || 54 || juhuyātpuruṣasūktena caroḥ ṣoḍaśa cāhutīḥ || tathā caturgṛhītena ghṛtayuktāvarāhutim || 55 || prādeśamātrāḥ pālāśasamidhaśca ghṛtaplutāḥ|| idaṃ viṣṇviti maṃtreṇa hotavyāḥ karmasiddhaye ||56|| śatamekaṃ tu juhuyāddviguṇāśca tilā''hutīḥ || kṛte ca vaiṣṇave home grahayajñaṃ samārabhet || 57 || samidbhiścaruhomaṃ ca tilahomaṃ krameṇa tu || ubhayoḥ svastikaṃ vācyaṃ tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret || 58 || ṛtvijāṃ ca tato dadyāddhenvādigrahadakṣiṇāḥ || devasya tṛptyai dadyācca brāhmaṇāya yathāvidhi || 59 || gāṃ vai payasvinīṃ dadyādvṛṣabhaṃ ca suśobhanam || brāhmaṇānāṃ tato dadyāttrayodaśa padāni ca ||2.5.12.60|| ācāryaṃ tu sapatnīkaṃ vastraiśca paritoṣayet || toṣayitvā mahādānaistaṃ sārthaṃ ca samarpayet || 61 || pañcaviṃśatikumbhāṃśca sodakānvastraveṣṭitān || brāhmaṇāṃśca tato dadyātkṛte pāraṇake niśi || 62 || bhūridānaṃ ca dātavyaṃ baṃdhūnāmiṣṭabhojanam || pūrṇapātraṃ tato dadyādācāryāya sadakṣiṇam || 63 || pūrṇapātrapradānena kāryaṃ saṃpūritaṃ bhavet || upavāsavrataṃ caiva snānaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ bhavet || 64 || vipraiḥ saṃbhāṣitaṃ tasya saṃpūrṇaṃ tadbhavetphalam || vitta śaktirgṛhe nāsti kṛtaṃ caikādaśīvratam || 65 || svaśaktyā caiva kartavyaṃ tathā codyāpanādikam || etatte sarvamākhyātamakhaṇḍaikādaśīvratam || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmye'khaṇḍaikādaśīvratakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || cha ||
<2.5.13>
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || || śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi jāgarasya ca lakṣaṇam || yena vijñātamātreṇa sulabho'haṃ sadā kalau || 1 || gītaṃ vādyaṃ ca nṛtyaṃ ca purāṇapaṭhanaṃ tathā || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ puṣpaṃ gandhānulepanam || 2 || phalārpaṇaṃ ca śraddhāṃ ca dānamiṃdriyasaṃyamam || satyānvitaṃ vinidraṃ ca mudā madyajanānvitam || 3 || sāścaryaṃ caiva sotsāhaṃ pāpālasyādivarjanam || pradakṣiṇāsamāyuktaṃ namaskārapuraḥsaram || 4 || nīrājanasamāyuktamatihṛṣṭena cetasā || yāmeyāme mahābhāga kuryādārārtikaṃ mama || 5 || ṣaḍviṃśadguṇasaṃyuktamekādaśyāṃ ca jāgaram || yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā na punarjāyate bhuvi || 6 || ya evaṃ kurute bhaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || jāgaraṃ parayā bhaktyā sa līno jāyate mayi || 7 || daṣṭāḥ kalibhujaṃgena svapante ye dine mama || kurvaṃti jāgaraṃ naiva māyāpāśavimohitāḥ || 8 || prāptāpyekādaśī yeṣāṃ kalau jāgaraṇaṃ vinā || te vinaṣṭā na saṃdeho yasmājjīvitamadhruvam || 9 || uddhṛtaṃ netrayugmaṃ ca dattvā vai hṛdaye padam || kṛtaṃ ye naiva paśyaṃti pāpino mama jāgaram || 2.5.13.10 || abhāve vācakasyā'tha gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca kārayet || vācake sati deveśa purāṇaṃ prathamaṃ paṭhet || 11 || aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca || puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ putra mama jāgaraṇe kṛte || 12 || pitṛpakṣe mātṛpakṣe bhāryāpakṣe ca mānada || kulānyuddharate caitanmama jāgaraṇe kṛte || || 13 || upoṣaṇadine vighne prārabdhe jāgare sati || vihāya sthānaṃ tatrāhaṃ śāpaṃ dattvā vrajāmyaham || 14 || aviddhavāsare ye me prakurvaṃti hi jāgaram || teṣāṃ madhye prahṛṣṭaḥ sannṛtyaṃ vai prakaromyaham || 15 || yāvaddināni kurute jāgaraṃ mama sannidhau || yugā'yutāni tāvaṃti vasate mama veśmani |||| 16 || na gayāpiṃḍadānena na tīrthairbahubhirmakhaiḥ || pūrvajā muktimāyāṃti vinaikādaśijāgarāt || 17 || yaḥ kuryājjāgare pūjāṃ kusumairmama vāsare | puṣpepuṣpe'śvamedhasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ||1|| yaḥ kuryāddīpadānaṃ ca rātrau jāgaraṇe mama || nimiṣe nimiṣe putra labhate go'yutaṃ phalam || 19 || yo dadyājjāgare putra haviṣyānnasamudbhavam || naivedyaṃ labhate puṇyaṃ śāliśailasamudbhavam || 2.5.13.20 || pakvānnāni ca yo dadyātphalāni vividhani ca || jāgare me caturvaktra labhate gośataṃ phalam || 21 || karpūreṇa ca tāṃbūlaṃ dadāti mama jāgare || madbhakto matprasādena saptadvīpā'dhipo bhavet|| 22 || jāgare mama deveśa yaḥ kuryātpuṣpamaṇḍapam || sa puṣpakavimānena krīḍate mama sadmani || 23 || jāgare me tu yo dhūpaṃ sakarpūraṃ saguggulam|| dadāti dahate pāpaṃ janmalakṣasamudbhavam || 24 || snāpayejjāgare yo māṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtāṃbukaiḥ || bhogāniha labhedvai sa hyante ca paramāṃ gatim || 25 || divyāṃ'barāṇi yo dadyātphalāni vividhāni ca || sa ciraṃ vasate svarge taṃ tu saṃkhyāsamāni vai || 26 || dadyādābharaṇaṃ yo me hemajaṃ ratnasaṃbhavam || saptakalpāni vasate sotsaṃge matpriyo mama || 27 || ghṛtena dīpakaṃ yo me gavyena ca viśeṣataḥ || jvālayejjāgare rātrau nimiṣe goyutaṃ phalam || 28 || jāgare me caturvaktra karpūreṇa ca dīpakam || yo jvālayeta nīrājaṃ kapilādānajaṃ phalam|| 29 || yaḥ punaḥ kurute dīpaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca pūjanam || śatakratusamaṃ puṇyaṃ vratairdānaśatairapi || 2.5.13.30 || svayaṃ yaḥ kurute gītaṃ vilajjo nṛtyate yadi || sa labhennimiṣārdhena koṭiyajñakṛtaṃ phalam || 31 || nivārayati yo gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ jāgaraṇe mama || ṣaṣṭiyugasahasrāṇi pacyate rauravādiṣu || 32 || nṛtyamānasya martyasya ye kecinnikaṭe gatāḥ || vimuktā dharmarājena muktā yāṃti ca matpadam ||33|| nṛtyamānasya martyasya upahāsaṃ karoti yaḥ || jāgare yāṃti nirayaṃ yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || || 34 || jāgare mama yaḥ kuryādbhaktyā pustakavācanam || ślokasaṃkhyāyugānyeva sa vasenmama sannidhau || 35 || pradakṣiṇāpradānena yatphalaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ || na tatkoṭimakhaiḥ puṇyaṃ yugasaṃkhyairavāpyate || 36 || dīpamālā mamāgre vai yaḥ kuryājjāgare suta || vimānakoṭisaṃyukta ākalpaṃ vasate divi |||| 37 ||| mama bālacaritrāṇi jāgare paṭhate hi yaḥ|| yugakoṭisahasrāṇi śvetadvīpe vasennaraḥ||38|| tasmājjāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ || 39|| yo gītāṃ paṭhate rātrau mama nāmasahasrakam|| vedoktānāṃ purāṇānāṃ jāgarātpuṇyamāpnuyāt|| 2.5.13.40|| dhenudānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryājjāgare mama putraka|| labhate nātra saṃdehaḥ saptadvīpavatīphalam || 41 || sarveṣāmeva puṇyānāṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ mahītale || dvādaśījāgaraṃ putra prasiddhaṃ bhuvanatraye || 42 || jāgaraṃ ye ca kurvaṃti karmaṇā manasā girā || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirmama lokātkathaṃcana || 43 || protsāhayitvā lokānyaḥ kurute jāgaraṃ niśi || prāpnoti cakravartitvaṃ satyaṃ me vyāhṛtaṃ suta ||44 || saṃmānitāḥ kakutsthena rātrau jāgarakāriṇaḥ|| svaśaktyā caiva dānena prāptaṃ rājyaṃ sudurlabham|| 45|| ye kecidgāyakā viprā vādakā nartakāśca ye || nartakīsahitā yāṃti mama loke sanātane||46|| duryoniṣu gataiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ mama|| saṃprāptaṃ pṛthivīśatvaṃ kāmukairmunisattama||47|| niṣkāmā muktimāpannāḥ śvapacādyāśca jāgarāt|| viveko nāsti varṇānāṃ mama jāgarakāriṇām|| || 48 || na kalau pāvanaṃ dhyānaṃ na kalau jāhnavījalam || na kalau pāvanaṃ jāpyaṃ muktvaikaṃ jāgaraṃ mama || 49 || dvādaśīdivase prāpte ye kurvaṃti hi jāgaram || te dhanyāste kṛtārthā vai kalikāle na saṃśayaḥ || 2.5.13.50 || na bhūyānmānuṣe loke dvādaśīvimukho naraḥ || atītānāgatānvā'pi pātayennarake hi saḥ || 51 || varameko guṇairyuktaḥ kiṃ jātairbahubhiḥ sutaiḥ || dvādaśījāgarātsarvāṃstārayedyo hi pūrvajān || 52 || māhātmyaṃ paṭhate bhaktyā mayoktaṃ jāgarodbhavam || dvādaśīsaṃbhavaḥ putraḥ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam || 53 || agamyāgamane pāpamabhakṣyasyāpi bhakṣaṇe || pāpaṃ vilayamāyāti kṛte jāgaraṇe suta || 54 || ajñānādyatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ jñātvā yatpātakaṃ kṛtam || pūrvajanmārjitaṃ pāpamiha janmani yatkṛtam || || 55 || siddhyaṃti sarvakāryāṇi manasā ciṃtitānyapi || dvādaśyāṃ vai caturvaktra rātrau jāgaraṇe kṛte || 56 || dvādaśījāgareṇaiva muktiṃ gacchaṃti mānavāḥ || 57 || na tatpuṇyaṃ kurukṣetre prayāge vasatāṃ kalau || māhātmyaṃ vasatāṃ puṃsāṃ yatphalaṃ dvādaśīṣu ca || 58 || nā'śvamedhasahasraistu tīrthakoṭyavagāhanāt || tatphalaṃ prāpyate putra dvādaśījāgare kṛte || 59 || paṭhedvā śṛṇuyādvā'pi māhātmyaṃ dvādaśībhavam || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sa labhecchāśvatīṃ gatim || 2.5.13.60 || sarve duṣṭāḥ samastāśca saumyāstasya sadā grahāḥ || saṃtaterna viyogastu dvādaśī yasya kāraṇam || 61 || mama kīrtirucirnityaṃ na vipadyeta karhicit || raṇe rājakule caiva sarvadā vijayī bhavet || 62 || dharmopari matirnityaṃ bhaktirmayi sunirmalā || pātakaṃ naiva lipyeta dvādaśībhaktito naram || 63 || pretatvaṃ naiva tasyā'sti kṛte jāgaraṇe mama || ekādaśyā vihīnasya paralokagatirnahi || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kalau kāryaṃ hi taddinam || 64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇu saṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmya ekādaśīvratajāgaraṇaphalakathanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<2.5.14>
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || || tataḥ prabhāte dvādaśyāṃ kāryo matsyotsavo budhaiḥ || mārgaśīrṣe śuklapakṣe yathāvidhyupacārataḥ || 1 || atha mārgaśire māse daśamyāṃ niyatātmavān || kṛtvā devārcanaṃ dhīmānagnikāryaṃ yathāvidhi || 2 || śucivāsāḥ prasannātmā havyamannaṃ susaṃskṛtam || paktvā paṃcapade gatvā punaḥ śaucaṃ tu pādayoḥ || 3 || kṛtvā'ṣṭāṃgulamānaṃ tu kṣīravṛkṣe samudbhavam || bhakṣayeddaṃtakāṣṭhaṃ tu tataścācamya yatnataḥ || 4 || dṛṣṭvā''kāśāni sarvāṇi dhyātvā vai māṃ gadādharam || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇikirīṭaṃ pītavāsasam || 5 || prasannavadanāṃ'bhojaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || dhyātvā punarjalaṃ haste gṛhītvā bhānumadhyagam || 6 || dhyātvā'rghyaṃ dāpayettatra karatoyena mānavaḥ || evamuccārayedvācaṃ tasminkāle caturmukha||7|| ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvā'hani pare hyaham || bhokṣyāmi puṃḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavā'cyuta || 8 || evamuktvā tato rātrau mama mūrteśca sannidhau || japennārāyaṇāyeti svayaṃ tatra vidhānataḥ || 9 || tataḥ prabhāte vimalāṃ nadīṃ gatvā samudragām || itarāṃ vā taḍāgaṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ||2.5.14.10|| ānīya mṛttikāṃ śuddhāṃ maṃtreṇā'nena mānavaḥ|| vaṃdayeddevadeveśaṃ tadā śuddho bhavennaraḥ || 11 || dhāraṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ tvatto bhūtānāṃ devi sarvadā || tena satyena me pāpaṃ yāvanmocaya suvrate ||12|| brahmāṃḍodaratīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni daivataiḥ || tenemāṃ mṛttikāṃ spṛṣṭā mā''labhāmi tvayoddhṛtām || 13 || tvayi nityaṃ rasāḥ sarve sthitā varuṇa sarvadā || tenemāṃ mṛttikāṃ plāvya pūtāṃ kuruṣva māciram ||14|| evaṃ mṛdaṃ tathā toyaṃ prasādyā''tmānamālabhet || triḥkṛtvā'śeṣamṛdayā piṃḍamālipya vai jale || 15 || tasminnaraḥ sadā samyaṅnakrakacchapadūrataḥ || snātvā cāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā punarmama gṛhaṃ vrajet || 16 || tatrā''rādhya mahāyogindevaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || keśavāya namaḥ pādau kaṭiṃ dāmodarāya ca ||17|| jānuyugmaṃ nṛsiṃhāya uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe || kaṃṭhe kaustubhanābhāya vakṣaḥ śrīpataye tathā || 18 || trailokyavijayāyeti bāhuṃ sarvātmane śiraḥ || rathāṃgadhāriṇe vaktraṃ śrīkarāyeti vārijam || 19|| gaṃbhīrāyeti ca gadāmaṃbhojaṃ śāṃtamūrtaye || evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 2.5.14.20 || punastasyā'grataḥ kuṃbhāṃścaturaḥ sthāpayedbudhaḥ || jalapūrṇānsamālyāṃśca sitacaṃdanalepitān || 21 || cūtapallavasaṃyuktānsitavastrāvaguṃṭhitān || chāditāṃstāmrapātraiśca tilapūrṇaiḥ sakāṃcanaiḥ ||22|| catvārastu samudrāśca kalaśāḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ || teṣāṃ madhye śubhaṃ pīṭhaṃ sthāpayedvastragarbhitam ||23|| tasminsuvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ vā tāmraṃ vā dāravaṃ tathā || alābhe sarvapātrāṇāṃ pālāśaṃ pātramiṣyate || 24 || toyapūrṇaṃ ca tatkṛtvā tasminpātre tato nyaset || sauvarṇaṃ matsyarūpaṃ ca kṛtvā devaṃ janārdanam ||25|| devadevāṃgasaṃyuktaṃ śrutismṛtivibhūṣitam || tatrā'nekavidhairbhakṣyaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca śobhitam ||26|| gandhairdhūpaiśca vastraiśca arcayitvā yathāvidhi || rasātalagatā vedā yathādeva tvayoddhṛtāḥ || 27 || matsyarūpeṇa tadvanmāṃ bhavāduddhara keśava || evamuccārya tasyāgre jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet || || 28 || yathāvibhavasāreṇa prabhāte vimale tathā || caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca caturo dāpayedghaṭān || 29 || pūrvaṃ ca bahvṛce dadyācchāṃdogye dakṣiṇaṃ tathā || yajuḥśākhānvite dadyātpaścimaṃ ghaṭamuttamam || 2.5.14.30 || uttaraṃ kāmato dadyādeṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || ṛgvedaḥ prīyatāṃ pūrvaṃ sāmavedastudakṣiṇe || 31 || yajurvedaḥ paścimato hyatharvaścottareṇa tu || anena kramayogena prīyatāmiti vācayet || 32 || matsyarūpaṃ tu sauvarṇamācāryāya nivedayet || gandhadhūpādi vastraistu saṃpūjya vidhivatkramāt || 33 || yastvimaṃ sarahasyaṃ ca mantreṇaivopapādayet || vidhānaṃ vidhivaddattvā dātā koṭiguṇottaram || 34 || pratipadya guruṃ yastu mohādvipratipadyate || sa janmakoṭiṃ narake pacyate puruṣādhamaḥ || 35 || vidhānasya pradātā yo gururityucyate budhaiḥ || evaṃ datvā vidhānena dvādaśyāṃ māṃ samarcayet || 36 || viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dadyādyathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇām || bhūriṇā paramānnena tataḥ paścātsvayaṃ naraḥ || 37 || bhuñjīta sahito viprairvāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ || anena vidhinā yastu kuryānmatsyotsavaṃ naraḥ || 38 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ cāgre śṛṇu satyavatāṃ vara || yadi vaktra sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi bhavaṃti hi || 39 || āyuśca brahmaṇā tulyaṃ labhedyadi mahāvrata || tadā vai hyasya dharmasya phalaṃ kathayituṃ bhavet || 2.5.14.40 || ya imaṃ śrāvayedbhaktyā dvādaśīkalpamuttamam || śṛṇoti vā sa pāpaistu sarvaireva vimucyate || 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmye matsyotsavakathanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || || cha ||
<2.5.15>
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || || ye tvayā vai kṛtāḥ praśnāḥ pūrvaṃ praśnavidāṃ vara || tānvarṇayiṣye kramaśo niśāmaya suniścitam ||1 || sahomāse ca devo vai kīrtiyukto hi keśavaḥ || tasya pūjā prakartavyā yathāpūrvaṃ prabhāṣitam || 2 || brāhmaṇaṃ keśavaṃ smṛtvā tatpatnīṃ kīrtimeva ca || daṃpatī vidhivatpūjyau vastrābharaṇadhenubhiḥ || 3 || dampatī pūjitau vatsa pūjito'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| tasmādavaśyaṃ saṃpūjyau daṃpatī mama tuṣṭidau ||4|| dānaṃ ca vividhaṃ kāryaṃ mama tuṣṭikaraṃ param || godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca svarṇadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||5|| vastradānaṃ tathā śayyā tathā'laṃkaraṇāni ca || sadmadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ mama santoṣakārakam || 6 || sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ viśeṣaṃ ca trikaṃ smṛtam || vasundharā tathā dhenurvidyādānaṃ tathaiva ca ||7|| datte dānatrike vatsa bhavetprītirmamā'tulā || tasmānnaraistu kartavyaṃ sahomāse trikaṃ śubham || 8 || snānasya ca vidhiḥ samyakpuraivokto mayā'nagha || pūjāsnānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca vidhireṣa na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || mārgaśīrṣaṃ samagraṃ tu ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet || bhojayedyo dvijānbhaktyā sa mucyedvyādhikilviṣaiḥ||2.5.15.10|| kṛṣibhāgī bahudhano bahudhānyaśca jāyate || kimatra bahunoktena śṛṇu guhyaṃ para mama || 11 || hutabhugbrāhmaṇaścaiva vadanaṃ mama mānada || brāhmaṇākhyaṃ mukhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ na tathā havyavāhanaḥ || 12 || brāhmaṇākhye mukhe putra hutaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || agnyākhyaṃ brāhmaṇādhīnaṃ svataṃtrā brāhmaṇāḥ kila || 13 || saśarkaraṃ ghṛtayutaṃ pāyasaṃ śaśisannibham || hotavyaṃ brāhmaṇamukhe mama tuṣṭikaraṃ suta || 14 || śubhamaṃḍalamodakakokarasaṃ suta phenikayā ghṛtapūrayutam || yaja vipramukhe mama tuṣṭikaraṃ yadi cecchasi dārasutādisukham ||15|| kumudena samaprabhasaurabhadaṃ śubhabhaktayutaṃ tvatha mudgayutam || surabhīkṛtapuṣkalasarpisamaṃ kuru vipramukhe havanaṃ hi sahe || 16 || payasā saha sarpiṣi ca kvathitaṃ bahukhārikacāraphalaiḥ sitayā || saha karpuranāriphalena samaṃ yutasīkarakaṃ suta śubhrakaram || 17 || vyaṃjanāni ca śubhrāṇi manojñāni priyāṇi ca || karttavyāni sahomāse brāhmaṇārthe caturmukha || 18 || priyā śikhariṇī kāryā cānyatteṣāṃ priyaṃ ca yat || kṛtvaivaṃ bhojayedviprāñchraddhayā parayā suta || 19 || rasāsvādanapūrvaṃ hi bhuñjate vai yathāyathā || tathātathā mama prītirjāyate bhuvi durlabhā ||2.5.15.20|| tasmāttattattathā kāryaṃ yathā tuṣyaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ || tuṣṭaistaiścāpyahaṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmīha na saṃśayaḥ || 21 || śraddhatsva tvaṃ caturvaktra na te mithyā bravīmyaham || etadguhyaṃ mayā proktaṃ śreyorthaṃ tava mānada || 22 || ākrośayaṃti yadi te athavā praharaṃti cet || tathāpi te namasyā vai mama prītyā hi mānada || 23 || evaṃ kāryaṃ sadā putra mārgaśīrṣe viśeṣataḥ || yaduktaṃ bhavatā brahmanbhoktavyaṃ kiṃ śṛṇuṣva tat || 24 || bhoktavyaṃ mama cocchiṣṭaṃ mama bhaktiparāyaṇaiḥ || pavitrakaraṇaṃ putra pāpināmapi muktidam ||25|| mamāśanasya śeṣaṃ ca yo bhunakti dinedine || sikthesikthe bhavetpuṇyaṃ cāṃdrāyaṇaśatodbhavam || 26 || avaśiṣṭaṃ tathocchiṣṭaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhojanadvayam || nā'nyadvai bhojanaṃ teṣāṃ bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret || 27 || anarpayitvā yo bhuṃkte annapānādikaṃ ca yat || śvānaviṣṭhāsamaṃ cānnaṃ pānaṃ ca madirāsamam || || 28|| tasmānmāmarpayetputra annapānādi cauṣadham || bhakṣayetparayā bhaktyā aśuceḥ śucikārakam || 29 || tīrthayajñādikaphalaṃ kalidoṣavināśanam || mamocchiṣṭaṃ sugatidamapi duṣkṛtakarmaṇām || 2.5.15.30 || anyeṣāṃ daivatānāṃ ca na gṛhṇīyācca bhakṣitam || abhaktānāṃ ca pakvānnaṃ bhuktvā ca narakaṃ vrajet || 31 || vaktavyameva yatproktaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ || kathayiṣye tava prītyā api guhyataraṃ mama || 32 || mama nāma pravaktavyaṃ sahe caiva viśeṣataḥ || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti vaktavyaṃ mama prītikaraṃ param ||33|| pratijñaiṣā ca me putra na jānaṃti surāsurāḥ || manasā karmaṇā vācā yo me śaraṇamāgataḥ || || 34 || sa hi sarvāmavāpnoti kāmanāmiha laukikīm || sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ matpriyāṃ kamalāmapi || 35 || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ || jalaṃ bhittvā yathā padmaṃ narakāduddharāmyaham||36|| vinodenā'pi daṃbhena mauḍhyāllobhācchalādapi || yo māṃ bhajatyasau vatsa madbhakto nā'vasīdati || 37 || ye vai paṭhaṃti kṛṣṇeti maraṇe paryupasthite || yadi pāpayutāḥ putra na paśyaṃti yamaṃ kvacit || 38 || pūrve vayasi pāpāni kṛtānyapi ca kṛtsnaśaḥ || aṃtakāle ca kṛṣṇeti smṛtvā māmetyasaṃśayam || 39 || namaḥ kṛṣṇāya mahate vivaśo'pi vadedyadi || dhruvaṃ padamavāpnoti maraṇe paryupasthite || 2.5.15.40 || śrīkṛṣṇeti kṛtoccāraiḥ prāṇairyadi viyujyate || dūrasthaḥ paśyati ca taṃ svargataṃ pretanāyakaḥ || 41 || śmaśāne yadi rathyāyāṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti jalpati || mriyate yadi cetputra māmevaiti na saṃśayaḥ || 42 || darśanātmama bhaktānāṃ mṛtyumāpnoti yaḥ kvacit || vinā matsmaraṇātputra muktimeti sa mānavaḥ || 43 || pāpānalasya dīptasya bhayaṃ mā kuru putraka || śrīkṛṣṇanāmameghotthaiḥ sicyate nīrabiṃdubhiḥ || 44 || kalikālabhujaṃgasya tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrasya kiṃ bhayam || śrīkṛṣṇanāmadārūtthavahnidagdhaḥ sa naśyati || 48 || pāpapāvakadagdhānāṃ karmaceṣṭāviyoginām || bheṣajaṃ nāsti martyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ vinā ||46|| prayāge vai yathā gaṃgā śuklatīrthe ca narmadā || sarasvatī kurukṣetre tadvacchrīkṛṣṇakīrtanam ||47|| bhavāṃbhodhinimagnānāṃ mahāpāpormipātinām || na gatirmānavānāṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ vinā || 48 || mṛtyukāle'pi martyānāṃ pāpināṃ tadanicchatām || gacchatāṃ nā'sti pātheyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ vinā || 49 || tatra putra gayā kāśī puṣkaraṃ kurujāṃgalam || pratyahaṃ maṃdire yasya kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kīrtanam || 2.5.15.50 || jīvitaṃ janmasāphalyaṃ sukhaṃ tasyaiva sārthakam || satataṃ rasanā yasya kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti jalpati || 51 || sakṛduccaritaṃ yena harirityakṣaradvayam || baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gamanaṃ prati || 52 || nāmno'sya yāvatī śaktiḥ pāpanirdahane mama || tāvatkartuṃ na śaknoti pātakaṃ pātakī janaḥ || 53 || nā'paviddhaṃ bhavettasya śarīraṃ naiva mānasam || na pāpaṃ na ca vaiklavyaṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kīrtanāt || 54 || śrīkṛṣṇeti vacaḥ pathyaṃ na tyajedyaḥ kalau naraḥ || pāpāmayo vai na bhavetkalau tasyaiva mānase || 55 || śrīkṛṣṇeti prajalpaṃtaṃ dakṣiṇāśāpatirnaram || śrutvā mārjayate pāpaṃ tasya janmaśatārjitam || 56 || cāṃdrāyaṇaśataiḥ pāpaṃ parākāṇāṃ sahasrakaiḥ || yannāpayāti tadyāti kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kīrtanāt || || 57 || nānyābhirnāmakoṭībhistoṣo mama bhavetkvacit || śrīkṛṣṇeti kṛtoccāre prītirevā'dhikādhikā || 58 || caṃdrasūryoparāgaistu koṭībhiryatphalaṃ smṛtam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kīrtanāt || 59 || gurudārābhigamanaṃ hemasteyādi pātakam || śrīkṛṣṇakīrtanādyāti gharmataptaṃ himaṃ yathā || 2.5.15.60 || yukto yadi mahāpāpairagamyāgamanādibhiḥ || mucyate cāṃtakāle'pi sakṛcchrīkṛṣṇakīrtanāt || || 61 || aviśuddhamanā yastu vināpyācāravartanāt || pretatvaṃ so'pi nāpnoti ante śrīkṛṣṇakīrtanāt || 62 || mukhe bhavatu mā jihvā'satī yātu rasātalam || na sā cetkalikāle yā śrīkṛṣṇaguṇavādinī || 63 || svavaktre paravaktre ca vaṃdyā jihvā prayatnataḥ || kurute yā kalau putra śrīkṛṣṇa guṇakīrtanam || 64 || pāpavallī mukhe tasya jihvārūpeṇa kīrtyate || yā na vakti divārātrau śrīkṛṣṇaguṇakīrtanam || 65 || patatāṃ śatakhaṇḍā tu sā jihvā rogarūpiṇī || śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti śrīkṛṣṇeti na jalpati || 66 || śrīkṛṣṇanāmamāhātmyaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet || tasyā'haṃ śreyasāṃ dātā bhavāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 67 || śrīkṛṣṇanāmamāhātmyaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ hi paṭhettu yaḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sa mṛtaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 68 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmye śrīkṛṣṇanāmamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15|| ||cha||
<2.5.16>
||śrībhagavānuvāca|| || śṛṇu dhyānaṃ caturvaktra vakṣyāmi prītamānasaḥ || śrutenaiva ca saubhāgyaṃ labhate mānavo bhuvi ||1|| atha śrīmadudyānasaṃvītahaimasthalodbhāsiratnasphuranmaṃḍapāṃtaḥ || lasatkalpavṛkṣoditoddīptaratnasthalādhiṣṭhitāṃbhojapīṭhā'dhirūḍham || 2 || mahānīlanīlābhamatyaṃtabālaṃ guḍasnigdhavaktrāṃtavisrastakeśam || alivrātaparyākulotphullapadmapramugdhānanaṃ śrīmadiṃdīvarākṣam || 3 || calatkuṃḍalollāsitotphullagallaṃ sughoṇaṃ suśoṇādharaṃ susmitāsyam || anekollasatkaṃṭhabhūṣālasaṃtaṃ vahaṃtaṃ nakhaṃ pauṃḍarīkaṃ sunetram || 4 || samuddhūsaroraḥsthalaṃ dhenudhūlyā supuṣṭāṃgamaṣṭāpadākalpadīptam || kaṭīrasthale cārujaṃghoruyugme pinaddhaṃ kvaṇatkiṃkiṇījāladāmnā || 5 || hasaṃtaṃ lasadbaṃdhujīvaprasūnaprabhāpāṇipādāṃbujodārakāṃtyā || kare dakṣiṇe pāyasaṃ vāmahaste dadhānaṃ navaṃ śuddhahaiyaṃgavīnam || 6 || mahībhārabhūtā'marārātiyūthā'nalaṃ pūtanādīnnihaṃtuṃ pravṛttam || prabhuṃ gopikāgopavṛṃdena vītaṃ surendrādibhirvaṃditaṃ devadevam || 7 || prage pūjayitvā tvanusmṛtya kṛṣṇaṃ bhujaṃgeṃdravajrādibhirbhaktinamraḥ || sitāṃbhojahaiyaṃgavīnaiśca dadhnā vimiśreṇa dugdhena saṃprīṇayettam || 8 || iti prātarevā'rcayedatyutaṃ yo naraḥ pratyahaṃ śaśvadāstikyayuktaḥ || labhetso'cireṇaiva lakṣmīṃ samagrāmiha pretya śuddhaṃ paraṃ dhāma bhūyāt || 9 || mantraścoktaḥ purā putra ādau lokamanoharaḥ || śrīmaddāmodarākhyo hi śṛṇu tasyādhikāriṇaḥ || 2.5.16.10 || ayogyāya na dātavyo maṃtrarājastvayā suta || yatnena gopanīyaṃ ca rahasyaṃ śīghrasiddhidam || 11 || alasaṃ malinaṃ kliṣṭaṃ daṃbhamohasamanvitam || daridraṃ rogiṇaṃ kruddhaṃ rāgiṇaṃ bhogalālasam || 12 || asūyāmatsaragrastaṃ śaṭhaṃ paruṣavādinam || anyāyenā'rjitadhanaṃ paradārarataṃ sadā || 13 || viduṣāṃ vairiṇaṃ nityamajñaṃ paṃḍitamāninam || bhraṣṭavrataṃ kliṣṭavṛttiṃ piśunaṃ
