duṣṭamānasam || 14 || bahvāśinaṃ krūraceṣṭamagragaṇyaṃ durātmanām || kṛpaṇaṃ pāpinaṃ raudramāśritānāṃ bhayaṃkaram || 15 || evamādiguṇairyuktaṃ śiṣyaṃ naiva parigrahet || gṛhṇīyādyadi taddoṣaḥ prāyo gurumupaspṛśet || 16 || amātyadoṣo rājānaṃ jāyādoṣaḥ patiṃ yathā || tathā śiṣyakṛto doṣo guruṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 17 || tasmācchiṣyaṃ gururnityaṃ parīkṣyaiva parigrahet || kāyena manasā vācā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratam || 18 || asteyavṛttimāstikyayuktaṃ mokṣakṛtodyamam || brahmacaryarataṃ nityaṃ dṛḍhavratamakalmaṣam || 19 || prasannahṛdayaṃ śuddhamaśaṭhaṃ vimalāśayam || paropakāranirataṃ svārthe ca vigataspṛham || 2.5.16.20 || svacittavittadehaistu paritoṣakaraṃ guroḥ || āśritānāṃ tathā putra paritoṣakaraṃ śucim || 21 || īdṛgvidhāya śiṣyāya maṃtraṃ dadyācca nānyathā || yadyanyathā vadettasmindevatāśāpa āpatet || 22 || śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi gurorapi ca lakṣaṇam || ebhistu lakṣaṇairyukto gurureva bhavennṛṇām || 23 || samacetāḥ praśāṃtātmā vimanyuśca suhṛnnṛṇām || sādhurmahānsamo loke sa guruḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 24 || mama vratadharo nityaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ susaṃmataḥ || madāśrayakathāsakto mamotsavarataḥ sadā || 25 || kṛpāsindhuḥ supūrṇārthaḥ sarvasattvopakārakaḥ || niḥspṛhaḥ sarvataḥ siddhaḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ || 26 || sarvasaṃśayasaṃchettā'nalaso gururādṛtaḥ || brāhmaṇaḥ sarvakālajñaḥ kuryātsarveṣvanugraham || 27 || pūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktaḥ śiṣya īdṛgvidhādguroḥ || gṛhṇīyātputra tanmaṃtraṃ mārgaśīrṣe madāyane || 28 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ vratānāṃ ca kuryātsvīkaraṇaṃ budhaḥ || matpriyaṃ śṛṇuyācchaśvacchrīmadbhāgavataṃ param ||29|| śrīmadbhāgavataṃnāma purāṇaṃ lokaviśrutam || śṛṇuyācchraddhayā yukto mama santoṣakāraṇam || 2.5.16.30 || nityaṃ bhāgavataṃ yastu purāṇaṃ paṭhate naraḥ || pratyakṣaraṃ bhavettasya kapilādānajaṃ phalam || 31 || ślokārdhaṃ ślokapādaṃ vā nityaṃ bhāgavatodbhavam || paṭhate śṛṇuyādyastu gosahasraphalaṃ labhet || 32 || yaḥ paṭhetprayato nityaṃ ślokaṃ bhāgavataṃ suta || aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 33 || nityaṃ mama kathā yatra tatra tiṣṭhanti vaiṣṇavāḥ || kalibāhyā narāste vai ye'rcayanti sadā mama || 34 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu śāstrāṇi ye'rcayanti gṛhe narāḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktā bhavaṃti suravanditāḥ || 35 || ye'rcayanti gṛhe nityaṃ śāstraṃ bhāgavataṃ kalau || āsphoṭayaṃti valganti teṣāṃ prīto bhavāmyaham || 36 || yāvaddināni he putra śāstraṃ bhāgavataṃ gṛhe || tāvatpibaṃti pitaraḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakam || 37 || yacchaṃti vaiṣṇave bhaktyā śāstraṃ bhāgavataṃ hi ye || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi mama loke vasaṃti te || 38 || ye'rcayanti sadā gehe śāstraṃ bhāgavataṃ narāḥ || prīṇitāstaiśca vibudhā yāvadā''bhūtasaṃplavam || 39 || ślokārdhaṃ ślokapādaṃ vā varaṃ bhāgavataṃ gṛhe || śataśo'tha sahasraiśca kimanyaiḥ śāstrasaṃgrahaiḥ || 2.5.16.40 || na yasya tiṣṭhate śāstraṃ gṛhe bhāgavataṃ kalau || na tasya punarāvṛttiryāmyapāśātkadācana ||41 || kathaṃ sa vaiṣṇavo jñeyaḥ śāstraṃ bhāgavataṃ kalau || gṛhe na tiṣṭhate yasya śvapacādadhiko hi saḥ || 42 || sarvasvenā'pi lokeśa kartavyaḥ śāstrasaṃgrahaḥ || vaiṣṇavastu sadā bhaktyā tuṣṭyarthaṃ mama putraka || 43 || yatra yatra bhavetpuṇyaṃ śāstraṃ bhāgavataṃ kalau || tatra tatra sadaivā'haṃ bhavāmi tridaśaiḥ saha || 44 || tatra sarvāṇi tīrthāni nadīnadasarāṃsi ca || yajñāḥ saptapurī nityaṃ puṇyāḥ sarve śiloccayāḥ || 45 || śrotavyaṃ mama śāstraṃ hi yaśodharmajayārthinā || pāpakṣayārthaṃ lokeśa mokṣārthaṃ dharmabuddhinā || 46 || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ puṇyamāyurārogyapuṣṭidam || paṭhanācchravaṇādvā'pi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 47 || na śṛṇvaṃti na hṛṣyaṃti śrīmadbhāgavataṃ param || satyaṃsatyaṃ hi lokeśa teṣāṃ svāmī sadā yamaḥ || 48 || na gacchati yadā martyaḥ śrotuṃ bhāgavataṃ suta || ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa nā'sti pāparatastataḥ || 49 || ślokaṃ bhāgavataṃ cā'pi ślokārdhaṃ pādameva vā || likhitaṃ tiṣṭhate yasya gṛhe tasya vasāmyaham || 2.5.16.50 || sarvā''śramā'bhigamanaṃ sarvatīrthā'vagāhanam || na tathā pāvanaṃ nṝṇāṃ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ yathā || 51 || yatra yatra caturvaktra śrīmadbhāgavataṃ bhavet || gacchāmi tatratatrā'haṃ gauryathā sutavatsalā || 52 || matkathāvācakaṃ nityaṃ matkathāśravaṇe ratam || matkathāprītamanasaṃ nā'haṃ tyakṣyāmi taṃ naram || 53 || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ puṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā nottiṣṭhate hi yaḥ || sāṃvatsaraṃ tasya puṇyaṃ vilayaṃ yāti putraka || 54 || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ dṛṣṭvā pratyutthānābhivādanaiḥ || sanmānayeta taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavetprītirmamā'tulā || 55 || dṛṣṭvā bhāgavataṃ dūrātprakrametsaṃmukhaṃ hi yaḥ || padepade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 56 || utthāya praṇamedyo vai śrīmadbhāgavataṃ naraḥ || dhanaṃ putrāṃstathā dārānbhaktiṃ ca pradadāmyaham || 57 || mahārājopacāraistu śrīmadbhāgavataṃ suta || śṛṇvaṃti ye narā bhaktyā teṣāṃ vaśyo bhavāmyaham|| 58 || mamotsaveṣu sarvepu śrīmadbhāgavataṃ param || śṛṇvaṃti ye narā bhaktyā mama prītyai ca suvrata || 59 || vastrālaṃkaraṇaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpopahārakaiḥ || vaśīkṛto hyahaṃ taiśca satstriyā satpatiryathā || 2.5.16.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmye bhāgavataśraiṣṭhyamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma poḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || || cha ||
<2.5.17>
|| brahmovāca || || kasminkṣetre hi deveśa mārgaśīrṣo'dhikaḥ smṛtaḥ || kiṃ phalaṃ ca bhavettasminnetatsarvaṃ vada prabho || 1 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || madhureti suvikhyātamasti kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama || suramyā ca praśastā ca janmabhūmiḥ priyā mama || 2 || padepade tīrthaphalaṃ madhurāyāṃ caturmukha || yatrayatra naraḥ snāto mucyate ghorakilbiṣāt || 3 || sarvadharmavihīnānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ durātmanām || narakārtiharā putra madhurā pāpanāśinī || 4 || kṛtaghnaśca surāpaśca cauro bhagnavratastathā || madhurāṃ prāpya manujo mucyate ghorapātakāt || 5 || sūryaudaye tamo naśyedyathā vajrabhayānnagāḥ || tārkṣyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā sarpā meghā vātahatā yathā || 6 || tattvajñānādyathā duḥkhaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā gajāḥ || tathā pāpāni naśyaṃti mathurādarśanātsuta || 7 || śraddhayā bhaktiyuktastu dṛṣṭvā madhupurīṃ naraḥ || brahmahā'pi viśudhyeta kiṃ punastvanyapātakī || 8 || mathurāṃ snātukāmasya gacchatastu padepade || nirāśāni vrajaṃtyeva pāpāni ca śarīrataḥ || 9 || anuṣaṃgeṇa gacchaṃti vāṇijyenā'pi sevayā || madhurāsnānamātreṇa divaṃ yāṃti gatāṃhasaḥ || 2.5.17.10 || nāmā'pi gṛhṇatāmasyāḥ sadā muktirna saṃśayaḥ || sadā kṛtayugaṃ tatra sadā caivottarāyaṇam || 11 || yaḥ śṛṇoti caturvaktra mādhuraṃ mama maṃdiram || anyenoccārite sadyaḥ so'pi pāpātpramucyate || 12 || trirātramapi ye tatra vasaṃti manujāḥ suta || teṣāṃ punaṃti sahṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭāścaraṇareṇavaḥ || 13 || yathā tṛṇasamūhaṃ tu jvalayaṃti sphuliṃgakāḥ || tathā mahāṃti pāpāni dahate mathurā purī || 14 || snānena sarvatīrthānāṃ yaḥ syātsukṛtasaṃcayaḥ || tato'dhikataraṃ proktā mathurā sarvamaṃḍale || 15 || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ puṇyamadhyayanācca yat || tatpuṇyaṃ jāyate tatra mathurāṃ smaratāṃ nṛṇām || 16 || anyatra hi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthamāsādya naśyati || tīrtheṣu yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepo bhaviṣyati || 17 || mathurāyāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mathurāyāṃ praṇaśyati || dharmārthakāmamokṣākhyaṃ sthitvā tatra labhennaraḥ || 18 || anyatra daśabhirvarṣaiḥ prārabdhaṃ bhujyate hi yat || kilviṣaṃ ca caturvaktra māthure daśabhirdinaiḥ ||19|| divi naiva na pātāle nāṃtarikṣe na mānuṣe || samaṃ tu mathurāyāṃ hi priyaṃ mama sadaiva hi || 2.5.17.20 || sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ māthuraṃ paramaṃ mahat || bālakrīḍanarūpāṇi kṛtāni saha gopakaiḥ || 21 || triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi triṃśadvarṣaśatāni ca || yatphalaṃ bhārate varṣe tatphalaṃ mathurāṃ smaran || 22 || sannihatyāṃ tu yatpuṇyaṃ rāhugraste divākare || tatodhikaṃ labhetputra mathurāyāṃ dinedine || 23 || pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu tīrtharāje tu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ labhate putra sahomāse madhoḥ pure || 24 || pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu vārāṇasyāṃ ca yatphalam || tatphalaṃ labhate putra mathurāyāṃ saho dine || 25 || godāvarīdvārakayornaro yaḥ kṣetre kurūṇāṃ kṣitidāyako yaḥ || ṣaṇmāsakātsādhayate gayāyāṃ samaṃ bhavenno dinamekamāthuram || 26 || na dvārakā kāśikāṃcī na māyā gadādharo yasya samaṃ na tīrtham || saṃtarpitā yadyamunājalena vāṃchaṃti no vai pitaraḥ piṃḍadānam || 27 || mathurāyāṃ prakurvaṃti purīsādhāraṇīdṛśam || ye narāste'pi vijñeyāḥ pāparāśibhiranvitāḥ || 28 || na dṛṣṭā mathurā yena didṛkṣā yasya jāyate || yatra tatra mṛtasyā'pi māthure janma jāyate || 29 || bhūme rajāṃsi gaṇayetkālenā'pi caturmukha || māthure yāni tīrthāni teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || 2.5.17.30 || kuru bhoḥ kuru bho vāsaṃ mathurākhyāṃ purīṃ prati || vasāmi satataṃ tasyāṃ gopakanyābhirāvṛtaḥ || 31 || rere saṃsāramagnāśca śiṣyā me śṛṇutā'pare || yadīcchatha sukhaṃ sāṃdraṃ vāsaṃ kuruta matpurīm || 32 || aho loko mahānaṃdo netrayukto na paśyati || māthure vidyamāne'pi saṃsṛtiṃ bhajate sadā || 33 || mānuṣīṃ yonimatulāṃ labdhvā bhāgyasya yogataḥ || vṛthaivāyurgataṃ teṣāṃ na dṛṣṭā mathurāpurī || 34 || aho mateḥ sudaurbalyamaho bhāgyasya durvidhiḥ || aho mohasya mahimā mathurā naiva sevyate || 35 || mathurāṃ tu parityajya yo'nyatra kurute matim || mūḍho bhramati saṃsāre mohito mama māyayā || 36 || mathurāmapi saṃprāpya yo'nyatra kurute spṛhām || durbuddhestasya kiṃ jñānaṃ so'jñānena vijṛṃbhitaḥ || || 37 || mātrā pitrā parityaktā ye tyaktā nijabaṃdhubhiḥ || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ mama purī gatiḥ || 38 || pāparāśibhirākrāṃtā ye dāridrya parājitāḥ || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ mama purī gatiḥ || 39 || sārātsārataraṃ sthānaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ param || gatimanveṣamāṇānāṃ mathurā paramā gatiḥ || 2.5.17.40 || na tatpuṇyairna taddānairna tapobhirna tu stavaiḥ || na labhyaṃ vividhairyogairlabhyaṃ madanubhāvataḥ || 41 || mayi yeṣāṃ sthirā bhaktirbhūyasī yeṣu matkṛpā || teṣāmeva hi dhanyānāṃ mathurāyāṃ bhavedgatiḥ || 42 || yā gatiryogayuktasya brahmajñasya manīṣiṇaḥ || sā gatistyajataḥ prāṇānmathurāyāṃ narasya ca || 43 || kāśyādipuryo yadi saṃti loke tāsāṃ tu madhye mathuraiva dhanyā || yā janmamauṃjīvratamuktidānairnṛṇāṃ caturdhā vidadhāti muktim || || 44 || na yogairyā gatirlabhyā manvaṃtaraśatairapi || anyatra helayā sā'tra labhyate matprasādataḥ ||45|| na pāpebhyo bhayaṃ yatra na bhayaṃ yatra vai yamāt || na garbhavāsabhīryatra tatkṣetraṃ ko na saṃśrayet|| 46|| mathurāyāṃ ca yatpuṇyaṃ tatpuṇyasya phalaṃ śṛṇu || mathurāyāṃ samāsādya mathurāyāṃ mṛtā hi ye || 47 || api kīṭapataṃgādyā jāyaṃte te caturbhujāḥ || kūlātpataṃti ye vṛkṣāste'pi yāṃti parāṃ gatim || 48 || mūkā jaḍāṃdhabadhirāstaponiyamavarjitāḥ || kālenaiva mṛtā ye ca mama lokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 49 || sarpadaṣṭāḥ paśuhatāḥ pāvakāṃbuvināśitāḥ|| labdhā'pamṛtyavo ye ca māthure mama lokagāḥ || 2.5.17.50 || satyaṃ satyaṃ muniśreṣṭha bruve śapathapūrvakam || sarvā'bhīṣṭapradaṃ nānyanmathurāyāḥ samaṃ kvacit || 61 || trivargadā kāmināṃ yā mumukṣūṇāṃ ca muktidā || bhaktīcchorbhaktidā kastāṃ mathurāṃ nā''śrayedbudhaḥ || 52 || etādṛśī madhupurī karttavyā mārgaśīrṣake || tadabhāve puṣkaraṃ hi kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 53 || jyeṣṭhaṃ hi brahmaṇaḥ kuṇḍaṃ madhyaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam || kaniṣṭhaṃ rudradaivatyamiti jānīhi buddhiman ||54|| eṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam || pūjā ca mahatī kāryā mama prītikarā suta || 55 || pūrṇā yā tu bhavetputra sahomāse mama priyā || tasyāṃ yatkriyate puṇyaṃ mama prītikaraṃ bhavet || 56 || godānamannadānaṃ ca hemadānaṃ ca putraka || dharādānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ pūrṇāyāṃ vidhipūrvakam || 57 || sahomāse hi pūrṇāyāṃ sadmadānaṃ ca kārayet || yatkiṃcitkriyate pūrṇaṃ tadakṣayyaphalaṃ bhavet || 58 || brahmabhojyaṃ hi kartavyaṃ yathāvibhavasārataḥ || pūrṇāyāmeva kartavya utsavo vratapūrttaye || 59 || yādṛśī mathurā putra sahomāse mama priyā || na tathā tīrtharājādyāstadabhāve ca puṣkaram || 2.5.17.60 || puṣkare mathurāyāṃ vai pūrṇā kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || yatra kutrāpi vā kāryā vidhiyuktā ca pūrṇimā || 61 || snānaṃ dānaṃ tathā pūjāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ na karoti yaḥ || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi pacyate rauravādiṣu || 62 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena mānyā pūrṇā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || mārgaśīrṣeṇa saṃyuktā anaṃtaphaladāyinī || 63 || yathā te kathitaṃ vatsa mārgaśīrṣaṃ mama priyam || karoti yo naro bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 64 || tīrthāyuteṣu yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ vratakoṭibhiḥ || sarvayajñeṣu yatpuṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnuyāt || 65 || aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano dhanameva ca || vidyārthī ca tathā vidyāṃ rūpārthī rūpamāpnuyāt || 66 || brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasvī kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet || vaiśyo nidhipatitvaṃ ca śūdraḥ śuddhyeta pātakāt || 67 || yaddurlabhaṃ ca duṣprāpyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu mānada || tatsarvaṃ prāpnuyānmartyaḥ sahomāse na saṃśayaḥ || 68 || yadyapyeteṣu kāmeṣu saktā ye mānavāḥ suta || tuṣṭā hyaṃte caturvaktra na kāmārhā mahābhuja || 69 || sudurlabhā hi sadbhaktirmama vaśyakarī śubhā || sā vai saṃprāpyate putra sahomāse śrute tathā || 2.5.17.70 || mama prītikaraṃ māsaṃ sarvadā mama vallabham || sarvaṃ saṃprāpyate'muṣmānmatprasādāccaturmukha || 71 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇusaṃvāde mārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmye mathurāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || cha || || cha || || cha || || cha || || cha || || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe paṃcamaṃ śrīmārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmyaṃ saṃpūrṇam || (2.5) ||
<2.6.1>
|| śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu || || || || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha śrīmadbhāgavatamāhātmyaṃ prārabhyate || || vyāsa uvāca || || śrīsaccidānandaghanasvarūpiṇe kṛṣṇāya cānantasukhābhivarṣiṇe || viśvodbhavasthānanirodhahetave numo vayaṃ bhaktirasāptaye'niśam || 1 || naimiṣe sūtamāsīnamabhivādya mahāmatim || kathāmṛtarasāsvādakuśalā ṛṣayo'bruvan || 2 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || vajraṃ śrīmāthure deśe svapautraṃ hastināpure || abhiṣicya gate rājñi tau kathaṃ kiṃ ca cakratuḥ || 3 || || sūta uvāca || || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam || devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 4 || mahāpathaṃ gate rājñi parīkṣitpṛthivīpatiḥ || jagāma mathurāṃ viprā vajranābhadidṛkṣayā || 5 || pitṛvyamāgataṃ jñātvā vajraḥ premapariplutaḥ || abhigamyābhivādyātha nināya nijamandiram || 6 || pariṣvajya sa taṃ vīraḥ kṛṣṇaikagatamānasaḥ || rohiṇyādyā hareḥ patnīrvavandāyatanāgataḥ || 7 || tābhiḥ sammānito'tyarthaṃ parīkṣitpṛthivīpatiḥ || viśrāntaḥ sukhamāsīno vajranābhamuvāca ha || 8 || || śrīparīkṣiduvāca || || tāta tvatpitṛbhirnūnamasmatpitṛpitāmahāḥ || uddhṛtā bhūriduḥkhaughādahaṃ ca parirakṣitaḥ || 9 || na pārayāmyahaṃ tāta sādhu kṛtvopakārataḥ|| tvāmataḥ prārthayāmyaṅga sukhaṃ rājye'nuyujyatām || 2.6.1.10 || kośasainyādijā cintā tathāridamanādijā || manāgapi na kāryā te susevyāḥ kintu mātaraḥ || 11 || nivedya mayi kartavyaṃ sarvādhiparivarjjanam || śrutvaitatparamaprīto vajrastaṃ pratyuvāca ha || 12 || || śrīvajranābha uvāca || || rājannucitametatte yadasmāsu prabhāṣate || tvatpitropakṛtaścāhaṃ dhanurvidyāpradānataḥ || 13 || tasmānnālpāpi me cintā kṣātraṃ dṛḍhamupeyuṣaḥ || kintvekā paramā cintā tatra kiñcidvicāryyatām || 14 || māthure tvabhiṣikto'pi sthito'haṃ nirjane vane || kva gatā vai prajā'tratyā yatra rājyaṃ prarocate || 15 || ityukto viṣṇurātastu nandādīnāṃ purohitam || śāṃḍilyamājuhāvāśu vajrasaṃdehanuttaye || 16 || athoṭajaṃ vihāyāśu śāṃḍilyaḥ samupāgataḥ || pūjito vajranābhena niṣasādāsanottame || 17 || upodghātaṃ viṣṇurātaścakārāśu tatastvasau || uvāca paramaprītastāvubhau parisāntvayan || 18 || || śrīśāṃḍilya uvāca || || śṛṇutaṃ dattacittau me rahasyaṃ vrajabhūmijam || vrajanaṃ vyāptirityuktyā vyāpanādvraja ucyate || 19 || guṇātītaṃ paraṃ brahma vyāpakaṃ vraja ucyate || sadānandaṃ paraṃ jyotirmuktānāṃ padamavyayam || 2.6.1.20 || tasminnandātmajaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sadānandāṃgavigrahaḥ || ātmārāmaścāptakāmaḥ premāktairanubhūyate || 21 || ātmā tu rādhikā tasya tayaiva ramaṇādasau || ātmārāmatayā prājñaiḥ procyate gūḍhavedibhiḥ || 22 || kāmāstu vāñchitāstasya gāvo gopāśca gopikāḥ || nityāḥ sarve vihārādyā āptakāmastatastvayam || 23 || rahasyaṃ tvidametasya prakṛteḥ paramucyate || prakṛtyā khelatastasya līlā'nyairanubhūyate || 24 || sargasthityapyayā yatra rajaḥsattvatamoguṇaiḥ || līlaivaṃ dvividhā tasya vāstavī vyāvahārikī || 25 || vāstavī tatsvasaṃvedyā jīvānāṃ vyāvahārikī || ādyāṃ vinā dvitīyā na dvitīyā nādyagā kvacit || 26 || āvayorgocareyaṃ tu tallīlā vyāvahārikī || yatra bhūrādayo lokā bhuvi māthuramaṇḍalam || 27 || atraiva vrajabhūmiḥ sā yatra tattvaṃ sugopitam || bhāsate premapūrṇānāṃ kadācidapi sarvataḥ || || 28 || kadāciddvāparasyānte raholīlādhikāriṇaḥ || samavetā yadā'tra syuryathedānīṃ tadā hariḥ || 29 || svaiḥ sahāvataretsveṣu samāveśārthamīpsitāḥ || tadā devādayo'pyanye'vataranti samantataḥ || 2.6.1.30 || sarveṣāṃ vāñchitaṃ kṛtvā harirantarhito'bhavat || tenātra trividhā lokāḥ sthitāḥ pūrvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 31 || nityāstallipsavaścaiva devādyāśceti bhedataḥ || devādyāsteṣu kṛṣṇena dvārikāṃ prāpitāḥ purā || 32 || punarmauśalamārgeṇa svādhikāreṣu cāpitāḥ || tallipsūṃśca sadā kṛṣṇaḥ premānandaikarūpiṇaḥ || 33 || vidhāya svīyanityeṣu samāveśitavāṃstadā || nityāḥ sarve'pyayogyeṣu darśanābhāvatāṃ gatāḥ || 34 || vyāvahārikalīlāsthāstatra yannādhikāriṇaḥ || paśyantyatrāgatāstasmānnirjjanatvaṃ samantataḥ || 35 || tasmāccintā na te kāryā vajranābha madājñayā || vāsayātra bahūngrāmānsaṃsiddhiste bhaviṣyati || 36 || kṛṣṇalīlānusāreṇa kṛtvā nāmāni sarvataḥ || tvayā vāsaya tā grāmānsaṃsevyā bhūriyaṃ parā || 37 || govarddhane dīrghapure mathurāyāṃ mahāvane || nandigrāme bṛhatsānau kāryā rājyasthitistvayā || 38 || nadyadridroṇikuṇḍādikuñjānsaṃsevatastava || rājye prajāḥ susaṃpannāstvaṃ ca prīto bhaviṣyasi || 39 || saccidānandabhūreṣā tvayā sevyā prayatnataḥ || tava kṛṣṇasthalānyatra sphurantu madanugrahāt || 2.6.1.40 || vajra saṃsevanādasyā uddhavastvāṃ miliṣyati || tato rahasyametasmātprāpsyasi tvaṃ samātṛkaḥ ||41|| evamuktvā tu śāṇḍilyo gataḥ kṛṣṇamanusmaran || viṣṇurāto'tha vajraśca parāṃ prītimavāpatuḥ || 42 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīmadbhāgavatamāhātmye śāḍilyopadiṣṭavrajabhūmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || || cha || ||
<2.6.2>
|| śrīṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || śāṃḍilye tau samādiśya parāvṛtte svamāśramam || ki kathaṃ cakratustau tu rājānau sūta tadvada || 1 || || || śrīsūta uvāca || || tatastu viṣṇurātena śreṇīmukhyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || indraprasthātsamānāyya mathurāsthānamāpitāḥ || 2 || māthurānbrāhmaṇāṃstatra vānarāṃśca purātanān || vijñāya mānanīyatvaṃ teṣu sthāpitavānsvarāṭ || 3 || vajrastu tatsahāyena śāṇḍilyasyā'pyanugrahāt || govindagopagopīnāṃ līlāsthānānyanukramāt || 4 || vijñāyā'bhidhayā''sthāpya grāmānāvāsayadbahūn || kuṇḍakūpādipūrtena śivādisthāpanena ca || 5 || govindaharidevādisvarūpā''ropaṇena ca || kṛṣṇaikabhaktiṃ sve rājyaṃ tatāna ca mumoda ha || 6 || prajāstu muditāstasya kṛṣṇakīrtanatatparāḥ|| paramānandasampannā rājyaṃ tasyaiva tuṣṭuvuḥ || 7 || ekadā kṛṣṇapatnyastu śrīkṛṣṇavirahāturāḥ || kālindīṃ muditā vīkṣya papracchurgatamatsarāḥ || 8 |||| || śrīkṛṣṇapatnya ūcuḥ || || yathā vayaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyastathā tvamapi śobhane || vayaṃ virahaduḥkhārtāstvaṃ na kālindi tadvada || 9 || tacchrutvā smayamānā sā kālindī vākyamabravīt || sāpatnyaṃ vīkṣya tattāsāṃ karuṇāparamānasā || 2.6.2.10 || || śrīkālindyuvāca || || ātmārāmasya kṛṣṇasya dhruvamātmāsti rādhikā || tasyā dāsyaprabhāveṇa viraho'smānna saṃspṛśet || 11 || tasyā evāṃśavistārāḥ sarvāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanāyikāḥ || nityasaṃbhoga evāsti tasyāḥ sāmmukhyayogataḥ || 12 || sa eva sā sa saivāsti vaśī tatpremarūpikā || śrīkṛṣṇanakhacandrālisaṃgāccandrāvalī smṛtā || 13 || rūpāntaraṃ ca gṛhṇānā tayoḥ sevātilālasā || rukmiṇyādisamāveśo mayātraiva vilokitaḥ || 14 || yuṣmākamapi kṛṣṇena viraho naiva sarvataḥ || kintu evaṃ na jānītha tasmādvyākulatāmitāḥ || 15 || evamevātra gopīnāmakrūrāvasare purā || virahābhāsa evāsīduddhavena samāhitaḥ || 16 || tenaiva bhavatīnāṃ cedbhavedatra samāgamaḥ || tarhi nityaṃ svakāntena vihāramapi lapsyatha || 17 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamuktāstu tāḥ patnyaḥ prasannāṃ punarabruvan || uddhavālokanenātmapreṣṭhasaṃgamalālasāḥ || 18 || || śrīkṛṣṇapatnya ūcuḥ || || dhanyāsi sakhi kāntena yasyā naivāsti vicyutiḥ || yataste svārthasaṃsiddhistasyā dāsyo babhūvima || 19 || parantūddhavalābhe syādasmatsarvārthasādhanam || tathā vadasva kālindi tallābho'pi yathā bhavet || 2.6.2.20 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamuktā tu kālindī pratyuvācātha tāstathā || smarantī kṛṣṇacandrasya kalāṣoḍaśarūpiṇī || 21 || sādhanabhūmirbadarī vrajatā kṛṣṇena maṃtriṇe proktā || tatrāste sa tu sākṣāttadvayunaṃ grāhayam̐llokān || 22 || phalabhūmirvrajabhūmirdattā tasmai puraiva sarahasyam || phalamiha tirohitaṃ sattadihedānīṃ sa uddhavo'lakṣyaḥ || 23 || govarddhanagirinikaṭe sakhīsthale tadrajaḥkāmaḥ || tatratyāṅkuravallīrūpeṇāste sa uddhavo nūnam || 24 || ātmotsavarūpatvaṃ hariṇā tasmai samarpitaṃ niyatam || tasmāttatra sthitvā kusumasaraḥparisare savajrābhiḥ || 25 || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgaiḥ kīrtanakāvyādisarasasaṃgītaiḥ || utsava ārabdhavyo hariratalokānsamānāyya || 26 || tatroddhavāvaloko bhavitā niyataṃ mahotsave vitate || yauṣmākīṇāmabhimatasiddhiṃ savitā sa eva savitānām || 27 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || iti śrutvā prasannāstāḥ kālindīmabhivandya tat || kathayāmāsurāgatya vajraṃ prati parīkṣitam || 28 || viṣṇurātastu tacchrutvā prasannastadyutastadā || tatraivāgatya tatsarvaṃ kārayāmāsa satvaram || 29 || govardhanādadūreṇa vṛndāraṇye sakhīsthale || pravṛttaḥ kusumāmbhodhau kṛṣṇasaṃkīrtanotsavaḥ || 2.6.2.30 || vṛṣabhānusutākāntavihāre kīrtanaśriyā || sākṣādiva samāvṛtte sarve'nanyadṛśo'bhavan || 31 || tataḥ paśyatsu sarveṣu tṛṇagulmalatācayāt || ājagāmoddhavaḥ sragvī śyāmaḥ pītāmbarāvṛtaḥ || 32 || guñjāmālādharo gāyanballavīvallabhaṃ muhuḥ || tadāgamanato reje bhṛśaṃ saṃkīrtanotsavaḥ || 33 || candrikāgamato yadvatsphāṭikāṭṭālabhūmaṇiḥ || atha sarve sukhāmbhodhau magnāḥ sarvaṃ visasmaruḥ || 34 || kṣaṇenāgatavijñānā dṛṣṭvā śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇam || uddhavaṃ pūjayāṃcakruḥ pratilabdhamanorathāḥ || 35 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīmadbhāgavatamāhātmye govarddhanaparvatasamīpe parīkṣidādīnāmuddhavadarśanavarṇanonāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<2.6.3>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || athoddhavastu tāndṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇakīrtanatatparān || satkṛtyātha pariṣvajya parīkṣitamuvāca ha || 1 || || uddhava uvāca || || dhanyo'si rājankṛṣṇaikabhaktyā pūrṇo'si nityadā || yastvaṃ nimagnacitto'si kṛṣṇasaṃkīrtanotsave || 2 || kṛṣṇapatnīṣu vajre ca diṣṭyā prītiḥ pravartitā || tavocitamidaṃ tāta kṛṣṇadattāṃga vaibhava || 3 || dvārakāstheṣu sarveṣu dhanyā ete na saṃśayaḥ || yeṣāṃ vrajanivāsāya pārthamādiṣṭavānprabhuḥ || 4 || śrīkṛṣṇasya manaścaṃdro rādhāsyaprabhayānvitaḥ || tadvihāravanaṃ gobhirmaṇḍayanrocate sadā || 5 || kṛṣṇacandraḥ sadā pūrṇastasya ṣoḍaśa yāḥ kalāḥ || citsahasraprabhābhinnā atrāste tatsvarūpatā || 6 || evaṃ vajrastu rājendra prapannabhayabhañjakaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇadakṣiṇe pāde sthānametasya vartate || 7 || avatāre'tra kṛṣṇena yogamāyā'ti bhāvitā || tadbalenātmavismṛtyā sīdantyete na saṃśayaḥ || 8 || ṛte kṛṣṇaprakāśaṃ tu svātmabodho na kasyacit || tatprakāśastu jīvānāṃ māyayā pihitaḥ sadā || 9 || aṣṭāviṃśe dvāparānte svayameva yadā hariḥ || utsārayennijāṃ māyāṃ tatprakāśo bhavettadā || 2.6.3.10 || sa tu kālo vyatikrāṃtastenedamaparaṃ śṛṇu || anyadā tatprakāśastu śrīmadbhāgavatādbhavet || 11 || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ yatra bhāgavatairyadā || kīrtyate śrūyate cāpi śrīkṛṣṇastatra niścitam || 12 || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ yatra ślokaṃ ślokārddhameva ca || tatrāpi bhagavānkṛṣṇo ballavībhirvirājate || 13 || bhārate mānavaṃ janma prāpya bhāgavataṃ na yaiḥ || śrutaṃ pāpaparādhīnairātmaghātastu taiḥ kṛtaḥ || 14 || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ nityaṃ yaiḥ parisevitam || piturmātuśca bhāryāyāḥ kulapaṃktiḥ sutāritā || 15 || vidyāprakāśo viprāṇāṃ rājāṃ śatrujayo viśām || dhanaṃ svāsthyaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ śrīmadbhāgavatādbhavet || 16 || yoṣitāmapareṣāṃ ca sarvavāṃchitapūraṇam || ato bhāgavataṃ nityaṃ ko na seveta bhāgyavān || 17 || anekajanmasaṃsiddhaḥ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ labhet || prakāśo bhagavadbhakterudbhavastatra jāyate || 18 || sāṃkhyāyanaprasādāptaṃ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ purā || bṛhaspatirdattavānme tenāhaṃ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || 19 || ākhyāyikā ca tenoktā viṣṇurāta nibodha tām || jñāyate saṃpradāyo'pi yatra bhāgavataśruteḥ || 2.6.3.20 || || śrībṛhaspatiruvāca || || īkṣāṃcakre yadā kṛṣṇo māyāpuruṣarūpadhṛk || brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaścāpi rajaḥsattvatamoguṇaiḥ ||21|| puruṣāstraya uttasthuradhikārāṃstadādiśat || utpattau pālane caiva saṃhāre prakrameṇa tān || 22 || brahmā tu nābhikamalādutpannastaṃ vyajijñapat || || śrībrahmovāca || || nārāyaṇādipuruṣa paramātmannamo'stu te || 23 || tvayā sarge niyukto'smi pāpīyānmāṃ rajoguṇaḥ || tvatsmṛtau naiva bādheta tathaiva kṛpayā prabho || 24 || || śrībṛhaspatiruvāca || || yadā tu bhagavāṃstasmai śrīmadbhāgavataṃ purā || upadiśyābravīdbrahmansevasvainatsvasiddhaye || 25 || brahmā tu paramaprītastena kṛṣṇāptaye'niśam || saptāvaraṇabhaṃgāya saptāhaṃ samavartayat || 26 || śrībhāgavatasaptāhasevanāptamanorathaḥ || sṛṣṭiṃ vitanute nityaṃ sasaptāhaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ||27|| viṣṇurapyarthayāmāsa pumāṃsaṃ svārthasiddhaye || prajānāṃ pālane puṃsā yadanenāpi kalpitaḥ || 28 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || prajānāṃ pālanaṃ deva kariṣyāmi yathocitam || pravṛttyā ca nivṛttyā ca karmajñānaprayojanāt ||29|| yadāyadaiva kālena dharmaglānirbhaviṣyati || dharmaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi hyavatāraistadā tadā || 2.6.3.30 || bhogārthibhyastu yajñādiphalaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam || mokṣārthibhyo viraktebhyo muktiṃ pañcavidhāṃ tathā || 31 || ye'pi mokṣaṃ na vāñchanti tānkathaṃ pālayāmyaham || ātmānaṃ ca śriyaṃ cāpi pālayāmi kathaṃ vada || 32 || tasmā api pumānādyaḥ śrībhāgavatamādiśat || uvāca ca paṭhasvainattava sarvārthasiddhaye || || 33 || tato viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā paramārthakapālane || samartho'bhūcchriyā māsimāsi bhāgavataṃ smaran || 34 || yadā viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ vaktā lakṣmīśca śravaṇe ratā || tadā bhāgavataśrāvo māsenaiva punaḥpunaḥ || 35 || yadā lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ vaktrī viṣṇuśca śravaṇe rataḥ || māsadvayaṃ rasāsvādastadātīva suśobhate || 36 || adhikāre sthito viṣṇurlakṣmīrniścintamānasā || tena bhāgavatāsvādastasyā bhūri prakāśate || 37 || atha rudro'pi taṃ devaṃ saṃhārādhikṛtaḥ purā || pumāṃsaṃ prārthayāmāsa svasāmarthyavivṛddhaye || 38 || || śrīrudra uvāca || || nitye naimittike caiva saṃhāre prākṛte tathā || śaktayo mama vidyante devadeva mama prabho || 39 || ātyaṃtike tu saṃhāre mama śaktirna vidyate || mahadduḥkhaṃ mamaitattu tena tvāṃ prārthayāmyaham || 2.6.3.40 || || śrībṛhaspatiruvāca || || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ tasmā api nārāyaṇo dadau || sa tu saṃsevanādasya jigye cāpi tamoguṇam || 41 || kathā bhāgavatī tena sevitā varṣamātrataḥ || laye tvātyaṃtike tenāvāpa śaktiṃ sadāśivaḥ || 42 || || uddhava uvāca || || śrībhāgavatamāhātmya imāmākhyāyikāṃ guroḥ || śrutvā bhāgavataṃ labdhvā mumude'haṃ praṇamya tam || 43 || tatastu vaiṣṇavīṃ rītiṃ gṛhītvā māsamātrataḥ || śrīmadbhāgavatāsvādo mayā samyaṅniṣevitaḥ || 44 || tāvataiva babhūvāhaṃ kṛṣṇasya dayitaḥ sakhā || kṛṣṇenātha niyukto'haṃ vraje svapreyasīgaṇe ||45|| virahārttāsu gopīṣu svayaṃ nityavihāriṇā || śrībhāgavatasaṃdeśo manmukhena prayojitaḥ || 46 || taṃ yathāmati labdhvā tā āsanvirahavarjjitāḥ || nājñāsiṣaṃ rahasyaṃ taccamatkārastu lokitaḥ || 47 || svarvāsaṃ prārthya kṛṣṇaṃ ca brahmādyeṣu gateṣu me || śrīmadbhāgavate kṛṣṇastadrahasyaṃ svayaṃ dadau ||48|| purato'śvatthamūlasya cakāra mayi taddṛḍham || tenātra vrajavallīṣu vasāmi badarīṃ gataḥ || 49 || tasmānnāradakuṇḍe'tra tiṣṭhāmi svecchayā sadā || kṛṣṇaprakāśo bhaktānāṃ śrīmadbhāgavatādbhavet ||2.6.3.50|| tadeṣāmapi kāryyārthaṃ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ tvaham || pravakṣyāmi sahāyo'tra tvayaivānuṣṭhito bhavet ||51|| || śrīsūta uvāca || || viṣṇurātastu śrutvā taduddhavaṃ praṇato'bravīt|| || || śrīparīkṣiduvāca || || haridāsa tvayā kāryyaṃ śrībhāgavatakīrtanam ||52|| ājñāpyo'haṃ yathākāryyaṃ sahāyo'tra mayā tathā || ||śrīsūta uvāca || śrutvaitaduddhavo vākyamuvāca prītamānasaḥ || 53 || || uddhava uvāca || || śrīkṛṣṇena parityakte bhūtale balavānkaliḥ || kariṣyati paraṃ vighnaṃ satkārye samupasthite || 54 || tasmāddigvijayaṃ yāhi kalinigrahamācara || ahaṃ tu māsamātreṇa vaiṣṇavīṃ rītimāsthitaḥ || 55 || śrīmadbhāgavatāsvādaṃ pracārya tvatsahāyataḥ || etānsamprāpayiṣyāmi nityadhāmni madhudviṣaḥ || 56 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śrutvaivaṃ tadvaco rājā muditaścintayāturaḥ || tadā vijñāpayāmāsa svābhiprāyaṃ tamuddhavam || 57 || || śrīparīkṣiduvāca || || kaliṃ tu nigrahīṣyāmi tāta te vacasi sthitaḥ || śrībhāgavatasaṃprāptiḥ kathaṃ mama bhaviṣyati || 58 || ahaṃ tu samanugrāhyastava pādatale śritaḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śrutvaitadvacanaṃ bhūyo'pyuddhavastamuvāca ha || 59 || || || uddhava uvāca || || rājaṃścintā tu te kā'pi naiva kāryyā kathaṃcana || tavaiva bhagavacchāstre yato mukhyādhikāritā || 2.6.3.60 || etāvatkālaparyyantaṃ prāyo bhāgavataśruteḥ || vārtāmapi na jānanti manuṣyāḥ karmatatparāḥ || 61 || tvatprasādena bahavo manuṣyā bhāratājire || śrīmadbhāgavataprāptau sukhaṃ prāpsyanti śāśvatam || 62 || nandanandanarūpastu śrīśuko bhagavānṛṣiḥ || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ tubhyaṃ śrāvayiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ ||63|| tena prāpsyasi rājaṃstvaṃ nityaṃ dhāma vrajeśituḥ || śrībhāgavatasaṃcārastato bhuvi bhaviṣyati || 64 || tasmāttvaṃ gaccha rājendra kalinigrahamācara || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ityuktastaṃ parikramya gato rājā diśāṃ jaye ||65|| vajrastu nijarājyeśaṃ pratibāhuṃ vidhāya ca || tatraiva mātṛbhiḥ sākaṃ tasthau bhāgavatāśayā ||66|| atha vṛndāvane māsaṃ govarddhanasamīpataḥ || śrīmadbhāgavatāsvādastūddhavena pravartitaḥ || 67|| tasminnāsvādyamāne tu saccidānandarūpiṇī || pracakāśe harerlīlā sarvataḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca || 68 || ātmānaṃ ca tadantaḥsthaṃ sarve'pi dadṛśustadā || vajrastu dakṣiṇe dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇapādasaroruhe || 69 || svātmānaṃ kṛṣṇavaidhuryyānmuktastadbhuvyaśobhata || tāśca tanmātaraḥ kṛṣṇe rāsarātriprakāśini || 2.6.3.70 || caṃdre kalāprabhārūpamātmānaṃ vīkṣya vismitāḥ || svapreṣṭha virahavyādhivimuktāḥ svapadaṃ yayuḥ || 71 || ye'nye ca tatra te sarve nityalīlāntaraṃ gatāḥ || vyāvahārikalokebhyaḥ sadyo'darśanamāgatāḥ || 72 || govarddhananikuñjeṣu goṣu vṛndāvanādiṣu || nityaṃ kṛṣṇena modante dṛśyante prematatparaiḥ || 73 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ya etāṃ bhagavatprāptiṃ śṛṇuyāccāpi kīrtayet || tasya vai bhagavatprāptirduḥkhahāniśca jāyate || 74 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe parīkṣiduddhavasaṃvāde śrībhāgavatamāhātmye tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha ||
<2.6.4>
|| śrīṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sādhu sūta ciraṃ jīva ciramevaṃ praśādhi naḥ || śrībhāgavatamāhātmyamapūrvaṃ tvansukhācchrutam || 1 || tatsvarūpapramāṇaṃ ca vidhiṃ ca śravaṇe vada || tadvakturlakṣaṇaṃ sūta śrotuścāpi vadādhunā || 2 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śrīmadbhāgavatasyātha śrīmadbhagavataḥ sadā || svarūpamekamevāsti saccidānandalakṣaṇam || 3 || śrīkṛṣṇāsaktabhaktānāṃ tanmādhuryyaprakāśakam || samujjṛmbhati yadvākyaṃ viddhi bhāgavataṃ hi tat || 4 || jñānavijñānabhaktyaṅgacatuṣṭayaparaṃ vacaḥ || māyāmardana dakṣaṃ ca viddhi bhāgavataṃ ca tat || 5 || pramāṇaṃ tasya ko veda hyanaṃtasyākṣarātmanaḥ || brahmaṇe hariṇā taddikcatuḥślokyā pradarśitā || 6 || tadānaṃtyāvagāhena svepsitāvahanakṣamāḥ || ta eva saṃti bho viprā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || 7 || mitabuddhyādivṛttīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ hitāya ca || parīkṣicchukasaṃvādo yo'sau vyāsena kīrtitaḥ || 8 || grantho'ṣṭādaśasāhasro yo'sau bhāgavatābhidhaḥ || kaligrāhagṛhītānāṃ sa eva paramāśrayaḥ || 9 || śrotāro 'tha nirūpyante śrīmadviṣṇukathāśrayāḥ || pravarā avarāścati śrotāro dvividhā matāḥ || 2.6.4.10 || pravarāścātako haṃsaḥ śuko mīnādayastathā || avarā vṛkabhūruṇḍavṛṣoṣṭrādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 11 || akhilopekṣayā yastu kṛṣṇaśāstraśrutau vratī || sa cātako yathāmbhodamukte pāthasi cātakaḥ || 12 || haṃsaḥ syātsāramādatte yaḥ śrotā vividhācchrutāt || dugdhenaikyaṃ gatāttoyādyathā haṃso'malaṃ payaḥ || 13 || śukaḥ suṣṭu mitaṃ vakti vyāsaṃ śrotṛṃśca harṣayan || supāṭhitaḥ śuko yadvacchikṣakaṃ pārśvagānapi || 14 || śabdaṃ nānimiṣo jātu karotyāsvādayanrasam || śrotā snigdho bhavenmīno mīnaḥ kṣīranidhau yathā || 15 || yastudanrasikāñcchrotṝnvirautyajño vṛko hi saḥ || veṇusvanarasāsaktānvṛko'raṇye mṛgānyathā || 16 || bhūruṇḍaḥ śikṣayedanyāñcchrutvā na svayamācaret || yathā himavataḥ śṛṃge bhūruṇḍākhyo vihaṃgamaḥ || 17 || (bhāruṇḍa) sarvaṃ śrutamupādatte sārāsārāndhadhīrvṛṣaḥ || svādu drākṣāṃ khaliṃ cāpi nirviśeṣaṃ yathā vṛṣaḥ || 18 || sa uṣṭro madhuraṃ muñcanviparīte rameta yaḥ || yathā nimbaṃ caratyuṣṭro hitvā''mramapi tadyutam || 19 || anye'pi bahavo bhedā dvayorbhṛṃgakharādayaḥ || vijñeyāstattadācāraistattatprakṛtisaṃbhavaiḥ || 2.6.4.20 || yaḥ sthitvā'bhimukhaṃ praṇamya vidhivattyaktānyavādo harerlīlāḥ śrotumabhīpsate'tinipuṇo namro 'tha klṛptāñjaliḥ || śiṣyo viśvasito'nucintanaparaḥ praśne'nuraktaḥ śucirnityaṃ kṛṣṇajanapriyo nigaditaḥ śrotā sa vai vaktṛbhiḥ || 21 || bhagavanmatiranapekṣaḥ suhṛdo dīneṣu sānukampo yaḥ || bahudhābodhanacaturo vaktā saṃmānito munibhiḥ || 22 || atha bhāratabhūsthāne śrībhāgavatasevane || vidhiṃ śṛṇuta bho viprā yena syātsukhasaṃtatiḥ || 23 || rājasaṃ sāttvikaṃ cāpi tāmasaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā || caturvidhaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ śrībhāgavata sevanam || 24 || saptāhaṃ yajñavadyattu saśramaṃ satvaraṃ mudā || sevitaṃ rājasaṃ tattu bahupūjādiśobhanam ||25|| māsena ṛtunā vāpi śravaṇaṃ svādasaṃyutam|| sāttvikaṃ yadanāyāsaṃ samastānandavarddhanam || 26 || tāmasaṃ yattu varṣeṇa sālasaṃ śraddhayā'yutam || vismṛtismṛtisaṃyuktaṃ sevanaṃ tacca saukhyadam || 27 || varṣamāsadinānāṃ tu vimucya niyamāgraham || sarvadā premabhaktyaiva sevanaṃ nirguṇaṃ matam || 28 || pārīkṣite'pi saṃvāde nirguṇaṃ tatprakīrtitam|| tatra saptadinākhyānaṃ tadāyurdinasaṃkhyayā || 29 || anyatra triguṇaṃ cāpi nirguṇaṃ ca yathecchayā || yathā kathaṃcitkartavyaṃ sevanaṃ bhagavacchruteḥ || 2.6.4.30 || ye śrīkṛṣṇavihāraikabhajanāsvādalolupāḥ || muktāvapi nirākāṃkṣāsteṣāṃ bhāgavataṃ dhanam || 31 || ye'pi saṃsārasaṃtāpanirviṇṇā mokṣakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || teṣāṃ bhavauṣadhaṃ caitatkalau sevyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 32 || ye cāpi viṣayārāmāḥ sāṃsārikasukhaspṛhāḥ || teṣāṃ tu karmamārgeṇa yā siddhiḥ sā'dhunā kalau || || 33 || sāmarthyadhanavijñānābhāvādatyantadurllabhā || tasmāttairapi saṃsevyā śrīmadbhāgavatī kathā || 34 || dhanaṃ putrāṃstathā dārānvāhanādi yaśo gṛhān || asāpatnyaṃ ca rājyaṃ ca dadyādbhāgavatī kathā || 35 || iha loke varānbhuktvā bhogānvai manasepsitān || śrībhāgavatasaṃgena yātyante śrīhareḥ padam || 36 || yatra bhāgavatī vārtā ye ca tacchravaṇe ratāḥ || teṣāṃ saṃsevanaṃ kuryāddehena ca dhanena ca || 37 || tadanugrahato'syāpi śrībhāgavatasevanam || śrīkṛṣṇavyatiriktaṃ yattatsarvaṃ dhanasaṃjñitam || 38 || kṛṣṇārthīti dhanārthīti śrotā vaktā dvidhā mataḥ || yathā vaktā tathā śrotā tatra saukhyaṃ vivarddhate || 39 || ubhayorvaiparītye tu rasābhāse phalacyutiḥ|| kintu kṛṣṇārthināṃ siddhirvilambenāpi jāyate || 2.6.4.40 || dhanārthinastu saṃsiddhirvidhisaṃpūrṇatāvaśāt || kṛṣṇārthino'guṇasyāpi premaiva vidhiruttamaḥ || 41 || āsamāpti sakāmena kartavyo hi vidhiḥ svayam || snāto nitya kriyāṃ kṛtvā prāśya pādodakaṃ hareḥ || 42 || pustakaṃ ca guruṃ caiva pūjayitvopacārataḥ || brūyādvā śṛṇuyādvāpi śrīmadbhāgavataṃ mudā || 43 || payasā vā haviṣyeṇa maunaṃ bhojanamācaret || brahmacaryyamadhaḥsuptiṃ krodhalobhādivarjjanam || 44 || kathānte kīrtanaṃ nityaṃ samāptau jāgaraṃ caret || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu dakṣiṇābhiḥ pratoṣayet || 45 || gurave vastrabhūṣādi dattvā gāṃ ca samarpayet || evaṃ kṛte vidhāne tu labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam || 46 || dārāgārasutānrājyaṃ dhanādi ca yadīpsitam || parantu śobhate nātra sakāmatvaṃ viḍambanam || 47 || kṛṣṇaprāptikaraṃ śaśvatpremānandaphalapradam || śrīmadbhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ kalau kīreṇa bhāṣitam || 48 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīmadbhāgavatamāhātmye caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || cha || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrībhāgavatamahāpurāṇamāhātmyaṃ samāptam || 2.6||
<2.7.1>
|| || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha vaiśākhamāsamāhātmya prāraṃbhaḥ || || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam || devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 1 || || sūta uvāca || || bhūyo'pyaṃgabhuvaṃ rājā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || puṇyaṃ mādhavamāhātmyaṃ nāradaṃ paryapṛcchata || 1 || || || aṃvarīṣa uvāca || || sarveṣāmapi māsānāṃ tvatto māhātmyamaṃjasā || śrutaṃ mayā purā brahmanyadā coktaṃ tadā tvayā || 2 || vaiśākhaḥ pravaro māso māseṣveteṣu niścitam || iti tasmādvistareṇa māhātmyaṃ mādhavasya ca || 3 || śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ brahmankathaṃ viṣṇupriyo hyasau || ke ca viṣṇupriyā dharmā māse mādhavavallabhe || 4 || tatrāpyasya tu kartavyāḥ ke dharmā viṣṇuvallabhāḥ || kiṃ dānaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tasya kamuddiśyā''caredimān || || 5 || kairdravyaiḥ pūjanīyo'sau mādhavo mādhavāgame || etannārada vistārya mahyaṃ śraddhāvate vada || 6 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || mayā pṛṣṭaḥ purā brahmā māsadharmānpurātanān || vyājahāra purā proktaṃ yacchriyai paramātmanā || 7 || tato māsā viśiṣyoktāḥ kārtiko māgha eva ca || mādhavasteṣu vaiśākhaṃ māsānāmuttamaṃ vyadhāt || 8 || māteva sarvajīvānāṃ sadaiveṣṭa pradāyakaḥ || dānayajñravratasnānaiḥ sarvapāpavināśanaḥ || 9 || dharma yajñakriyāsārastapaḥsāraḥ surārcitaḥ || vidyānāṃ vedavidyeva maṃtrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā || 2.7.1.10 || bhūruhāṇāṃ suratarurdhenūnāṃ kāmadhenuvat || śeṣavatsarvanāgānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā || 11 || devānāṃ tu yathā viṣṇurvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā || prāṇavatpriyavastūnāṃ bhāryeva suhṛdāṃ yathā || 12 || āpagānāṃ yathā gaṃgā tejasāṃ tu raviryathā || āyudhānāṃ yathā cakraṃ dhātūnāṃ kāṃcanaṃ yathā || 13 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā rudro ratnānāṃ kaustubho yathā || māsānāṃ dharmahetūnāṃ vaiśākhaścottamastathā || 14 || nānena sadṛśo loke viṣṇuprītividhāyakaḥ || vaiśākhasnānanirate meṣe prāgaryamodayāt || 15 || lakṣmīsahāyo bhagavānprītiṃ tasminkarotyalam || jaṃtūnāṃ prīṇanaṃ yadvadannenaiva hi jāyate || 16 || tadvadvaiśākhasnānena viṣṇuḥ prīṇātyasaṃśayam || vaiśākhasnānaniratāñjanāndṛṣṭvā'numodate || 17 || tāvatāpi vimukto'ghairviṣṇuloke mahīyate || sakṛtsnātvā meṣasaṃsthe sūrye prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ || || 18 || mahāpāpairvimukto'sau viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt || snānārthaṃ māsi vaiśākhe pādamekaṃ caredyadi || 19 || so'śvamedhāyutānāṃ ca phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam || athavā kūṭacittastu kuryātsaṃkalpamātrakam || 2.7.1.20 || so'pi kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhedeva na saṃśayaḥ || yo gaccheddhanurāyāmaṃ snātuṃ meṣagate ravau || 21 || sarvabaṃdhavinirmukto viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt || trailokye yāni tīrthāni brahmāṃḍāṃtargatāni ca || 22 || tāni sarvāṇi rājendra saṃti bāhye'lpake jale || tāvallikhitapāpāni garjaṃti yamaśāsane || 23 || yāvanna kurute jaṃturvaiśākhe snānamaṃbhasi || tīrthādidevatāḥ sarvā vaiśākhe māsi bhūmipa || 24 || bahirjalaṃ samāśritya sadā sannihitā nṛpa || sūryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvatṣaḍghaṭikāvadhi || 25 || tiṣṭhaṃti cā''jñayā viṣṇornarāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā || tāvannāgacchatāṃ puṃsāṃ śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam || svasthānaṃ yāṃti rājendra tasmātsnānaṃ samācaret || || 26 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde vaiśākhamāsa praśaṃsāpūrvaka vaiśākhasnānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<2.7.2>
|| || nārada uvāca || || na mādhavasamo māso na kṛtena yugaṃ samam || na ca vedasamaṃ śāstraṃ na tīrthaṃ gaṃgayā samam || 1 || na jalena samaṃ dānaṃ na sukhaṃ bhāryayā samam || na kṛṣestu samaṃ vittaṃ na lābho jīvitātparaḥ || 2 || na tapo'naśanāttulyaṃ na dānātparamaṃ sukham || na dharmastu dayātulyo na jyotiścakṣuṣā samam|| 3 || na tṛptiraśanāttulyā na vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣeḥ samam || na dharmeṇa samaṃ mitraṃ na satyena samaṃ yaśaḥ || 4 || nārogyasamamutthānaṃ na trātā keśavātparaḥ || na mādhavasamaṃ loke pavitraṃ kavayo viduḥ || 5 || mādhavaḥ paramo māsaḥ śeṣaśāyipriyaḥ sadā || avratena kṣipedyastu māsaṃ mādhavavallabham || 6 || tiryagyoniṃ sa yātyāśu sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || avratena gato yeṣāṃ mādhavo martyadharmiṇām || 7 || iṣṭāpūrte vṛthā teṣāṃ dharmodharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || pravṛttānāṃ tu bhakṣyāṇāṃ mādhave'niyame kṛte || 8 || avaśyaṃ viṣṇusāyujyaṃ prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ || saṃtīha bahuvittāni vratāni vividhāni ca || 9 || dehā''yāsakarāṇyeva punarjanmapradāni ca || vaiśākhasnānamātreṇa na punarjāyate bhuvi || 2.7.2.10 || sarva dāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti mādhave jaladānataḥ || 11 || jaladānāsamarthena parasyāpi prabodhanam || kartavyaṃ bhūtikāmena sarvadānādhikaṃ hitam || 12 || ekataḥ sarvadānāni jaladānaṃ hi caikataḥ || tulāmāropitaṃ pūrvaṃ jaladānaṃ viśiṣyate || 13 || mārge'dhvagānāṃ yo martyaḥ prapādānaṃ karoti hi|| sa koṭikulamuddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyate|| 14|| devānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ rājasattama|| atyaṃta prītidaṃ satyaṃ prapādānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| 15|| prapādānena saṃtuṣṭā yenā'dhvaśramakarṣitāḥ|| toṣitāstena devāśca brahmaviṣṇuśivādaya ||16 || salilaṃ salilecchūnāṃ chatraṃ chāyāmapīcchatām || vyajanaṃ vyajanecchūnā vaiśākhe māsi bhūmipa || 17 || jalaṃ chatraṃ ca vyajanaṃ dānaṃ yeṣāṃ viśiṣyate || mādhave māsi saṃprāpte brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine || 18 || adattvodakakumbhaṃ ca cātako jāyate bhuvi || 19 || yo dadyācchītalaṃ toyaṃ tṛṣārtāya mahātmane || tāvanmātreṇa rājeṃdra rājasūyāyutaṃ labhet || 2.7.2.20 || gharmaśramārtaviprāya vījayedvyajanena yaḥ || tāvanmātreṇa niṣpāpo vihagādhipatirbhaveta || 21 || adattvā vyajanaṃ bhūpa vaiśākhe tu dvijātaye || vātarogaśatākīrṇo narakāneva viṃdati || 22 || yo vījayetpaṭenā'pi pathi śrāṃtaṃ dvijottamam || tāvatātha vimukto'sau viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt ||23|||| yāstālavyajanaṃ vā'pi dattvā śuddhena cetasā|| vidhūya sarvapāpāni brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati|| 24|| sadyaḥ śramaharaṃ puṇyaṃ na dadyādvyajanaṃ naraḥ|| nārakīṃ yātanāṃ bhuktvā kaśmalo jāyate bhuvi|| 25|| ādhyātmikādiduḥkhānāṃ śāṃtaye manujeśvara || chatraṃ dadyātprayatnena vaiśākhe māsi vāsakṛt || 26 || acchatrado naro yastu vaiśākhe mādhavapriye|| chāyāhīno mahākrūraḥ piśāco bhuvi jāyate || 27 || yo dadyātpāduke divye mādhave mādhavapriye || yamadūtau tiraskṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 28 || pādatrāṇaṃ tu yo dadyādvaiśākhe mādhavāgame || na tasya nārako loko na kleśā aihikāśca ye ||29|| pāduke yācamānāya yo dadyādbrāhmaṇāya ca || sa bhūpālo bhavedbhūmau koṭijanmasvasaṃśayam||2.7.2.30|| anāthamaṃḍapaṃ mārge śramahāri karoti yaḥ || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ brahmaṇā'pi na śakyate ||31|| madhyāhne brāhmaṇaṃ prāptamatithiṃ bhojayedyadi || na tasya phalaviśrāṃtirbrahmaṇā'pi nirūpitā || 32 || sadyaḥ svāpyāyanaṃ nṛṇāmannadānaṃ narādhipa || tasmānnānnena sadṛśaṃ dānaṃ lokeṣu vidyate | 33 || mārgaśrāṃtāya viprāya praśrayaṃ pradadāti yaḥ || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ brahmaṇā'pi na śakyate || || 34 || dārāpatyagṛhādīni vāso'laṃkārabhūṣaṇam || asahyaṃ nāśnataḥ puṃsaḥ sahyaṃ bhuktavato dhruvam || 35 || tasmādannasamaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || vaiśākhe yena cādattaṃ mārgaśrāṃte ca bhūsure||36|| sa piśāco bhavedbhūmau svamāṃsānyeva khādati || yathāvibhūti dātavyaṃ tasmādannaṃ dvijātaye || 37 || annado mātṛpitrādīnvismārayati bhūmipa || tasmādannaṃ praśaṃsaṃti lokāstrailokyavartinaḥ || 38 || mātaraḥ pitaraścāpi kevalaṃ janmahetavaḥ || annadaṃ pitaraṃ loke vadanti ca manīṣiṇaḥ ||39|| annade sarvatīrthāni annade sarvadevatāḥ || annade sarvadharmāśca tiṣṭhaṃtyaridharājaya ||2.7.2.40|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde dānanirūpaṇaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || ||cha||
<2.7.3>
|| nārada uvāca || || yo martyo dvijavaryāya paryaṃkaṃ tu dadāti hi || yatra svasthaḥ sukhaṃ śete śītānilaniṣevitaḥ || 1 || dharmasādhanabhūte hi dehe nairujyamāpnute || taṃ dattvā sakalaṃ tāpaṃ nirasya gatakalmaṣaḥ || 2 || akhaṇḍapadavīṃ yāti yogināmapi durlabhām || vaiśākhe gharmataptānāṃ śrāntānāṃ tu dvijanmanām ||3|| dattvā śramāpahaṃ divyaṃ paryaṃkaṃ manujeśvara || na jātu sīdate loke janmamṛtyujarādibhiḥ||4|| gṛhītvā brāhmaṇo yatra śete cājīvamāsthitaḥ || āsīne sakalaṃ pāpaṃ jñānato'jñānataḥ kṛtam || 5 || vilayaṃ yāti rājeṃdra karpūra iva cāgninā || śayane brahmanirvāṇaṃ sa naro yāti niścitam || 6 || yo dadyātkaśipuṃ māse vaiśākhe snānavallabhe || sarvabhogasamāyuktastasminneva hi janmani || 7 || sānvayo vartate nūnaṃ rogādibhiranāhataḥ || āyuṣyaṃ paramārogyaṃ yaśo dhairyaṃ ca viṃdati || 8 || nādhārmikaḥ kule tasya jāyate śatapauruṣam || bhuktvā tu sakalānbhogāṃstataḥ pañcatvameṣyati || 9 || nirdhūtākhilapāpastu brahmanirvāṇamṛcchati || śrotriyāya dvijeṃdrāya yo dadyādupabarhaṇam || 2.7.3.10 || sukhaṃ nidrā vinā yena na nṛṇāṃ jāyate kvacit || sarveṣāmāśrayo bhūtvā bhuvi sāmrājyamaśnute || 11 || punaḥ sukhī punarbhogī punardharmaparāyaṇaḥ || āsaptajanma rājeṃdra jāyate sarvato jayī || 12 || paścātsaptakulairyukto brahmabhūyāya kalpate || tārṇaṃ kaṭaṃ tu yo dadyātkaṭamanyadathāpi vā || 13 || tatra śete svayaṃ viṣṇuryatrasthaḥ parameśvaraḥ || yathā jalagatā corṇā na jalairbhidyate kvacit || 14 || tathā saṃsārago jantuḥ saṃsāre na ca badhyate || āsane śayane saktaḥ kaṭadaḥ sarvataḥ sukhī || 15 || praśraye śayanārthāya yo dadyātkaṭakaṃbalam || tāvanmātreṇa muktaḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 16 || nidrayā hīyate duḥkhaṃ nidrayā hīyate śramaḥ || sā nidrā kaṭasaṃsthasya sukhaṃ saṃjāyate dhuvam || 17 || yo dayātkaṃbalaṃ rājanvaiśākhe mādhavā''game || apamṛtyoḥ kālamṛtyormukto jīvati vai śatam || 18 || dadyādvastraṃ sūkṣmataraṃ dvijeṃdre gharmakarśite || pūrṇamāyuḥ samāpnoti paratra ca parāṃ gatim || 19 || atastāpaharaṃ divyaṃ karpūraṃ tu dvijātaye || dattvā mokṣamavāpnoti duḥkhaśāṃtiṃ ca viṃdati || 2.7.3.20 || kusumāni ca yo dadyātkukumaṃ ca dvijātaye || sārvabhaumo bhavedrājā sarvalokavaśaṃkaraḥ || 21 || putrapautrādibhogāṃśca bhuktvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt || tvagasthigatasaṃtāpaṃ sadyo harati candanam || 22 || tāpatrayavinirmuktastaddattvā mokṣamāpnuyāt || auśīraṃ cāṣakaṃ kauśaṃ yo dadyājjalavāsitam || 23 || sarvabhogeṣu rājeṃdra sa tu devasahāyavān || pāpahāniṃ duḥkhahāniṃ prāpya nirvṛtimāpnuyāt || 24 || gorocaṃ mṛganābhiṃ ca dadyādvaiśākhadharmavit || tāpatrayavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati || 25 || tāṃbūlaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ yo dadyānmeṣage ravau || sārvabhaumasukhaṃ bhuktvā paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati || 26 || śatapatrīṃ ca yūthīṃ ca meṣamāse dadannaraḥ || sa sārvabhaumo bhavati paścānmokṣaṃ ca viṃdati ||27|| ketakīṃ mallikāṃ vā'pi yo dadyānmādhavā''game || sa tu mokṣamavāpnoti madhuśāsanaśāsanāt || 28 || pūgīphalaṃ tu yo dadyātsugandhaṃ tu dvijātaye || nārikelaphalaṃ rājaṃstasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || || 29 || sapta janma bhavedvipro dhanāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ || paścātsaptakulairyukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 2.7.3.30 || viśrāmamaṇḍapaṃ yastu kṛtvā dadyāddvijanmane || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nāhaṃ śaknomi bhūpate || 31 || succhāyāmaṇḍapaṃ yastu sikatā''kīrṇamañjasā || saprapaṃ kārayedyastu sa tu lokādhipo bhavet || 32 || mārgodyānaṃ taḍāgaṃ vā kūpaṃ maṇḍapameva ca|| yaḥ karoti sa dharmātmā tasya putraistu kiṃ phalam || 33 || kūpastaḍāgamudyānaṃ maṇḍapaṃ ca prapā tathā || saddharmakaraṇaṃ putraḥ saṃtānaṃ saptadhocyate || 34 || eteṣvanyatamābhāve nordhvaṃ gacchaṃti mānavāḥ || sacchāstra śravaṇaṃ tīrthayātrā sajanasaṃgatiḥ || 35 || jaladānaṃ cānnadānamaśvatthāropaṇaṃ tathā || putraśceti ca saṃtānaṃ sapteme'tivido viduḥ || 36 || nāsaṃtatirlabhellokānkṛtvā dharmaśatānyapi || tasmātsaṃtānamanvicchetsaṃtāneṣvekato vrajet || 37 || paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva mṛgāṇāṃ caiva bhūruhām || nordhvalokaṃ sukhaṃ yāti manuṣyāṇāṃ tu kā kathā || 38 || pūgīphalasamāyuktaṃ nāgavallīdalairyutam || kapūrāgurusaṃyuktaṃ dadattāṃbūlamuttamam || 39 || śārīraiḥ sakalaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || tāṃbūlado yaśo dhairyaṃ śriyamāpnoti niścitam || 2.7.3.40 || rogī dattvā virogaḥ syādarogī mokṣamāpnuyāt || vaiśākhe māsi yo dadyāttakraṃ tāpavināśanam || 41 || vidyāvāndhanavānbhūmau jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || na takrasadṛśaṃ dānaṃ gharmakāleṣu vidyate || 42 || tasmāttakraṃ pradātavyamadhvaśrāṃtadvijātaye || jaṃbīrasurasopetaṃ lasallavaṇamiśritam||43|| yastakramarucighnaṃ tu dattvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt || yo dadyāddadhikhaṃḍaṃ tu vaiśākhe gharmaśāṃtaye || 44 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nāhaṃ śaknomi bhūmipa || yo dadyāttaṃḍulāndivyānmadhusūdanavallabhe || 45 || sa labhetpūrṇamāyuṣyaṃ sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet || yo ghṛtaṃ tejaso rūpaṃ gavyaṃ dadyāddvijātaye || so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya modate viṣṇumaṃdire || 46 || urvāruguḍasaṃmiśraṃ vaiśākhe meṣage ravau || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śvetadvīpe vaseddhruvam || 47 || yaścekṣudaṃḍaṃ sāyāhne divā tāpopaśāntaye || brāhmaṇāya ca yo dadyāttasya puṇyamanaṃtakam || 48 || vaiśākhe pānakaṃ dattvā sāyāhne śramaśāntaye || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt ||49|| saphalaṃ pānakaṃ meṣamāse sāyaṃ dvijātaye || dadyāttena pitṝṇāṃ tu sudhāpānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ||2.7.3.50|| vaiśākhe pānakaṃ cūtasupakvaphalasaṃyutam || tasya sarvāṇi pāpāni vināśaṃ yāṃti niścitam || 51 || yo dadyāccaitradarśe tu kumbhaṃ pūrṇaṃ tu pānakaiḥ || gayāśrāddhaśataṃ tena kṛtameva na saṃśayaḥ || 52 || kastūrī karpuropetaṃ mallikośīrasaṃyutam || kalaśaṃ pānakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ caitradarśe tu mānavaḥ || dadyātpitṝnsamuddiśya sa ṣaṇṇavatido bhavet || 53 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde dānanirūpaṇaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha ||
<2.7.4>
|| nārada uvāca || || tailābhyaṅgaṃ divāsvāpaṃ tathā vai kāṃsya bhojanam || khaṭvā nidrāṃ gṛhe snānaṃ niṣiddhasya ca bhakṣaṇam || 1 || vaiśākhe varjayedaṣṭau dvibhu'ktaṃ naktabhojanam|| padmapatre tu yo bhuṃkte vaiśākhe bratasaṃsthitaḥ || 2 || sa tu pāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati || vaiśākhe māsi madhyāhne śrautānāṃ tu dvijanmanām || pādāvanejanaṃ kuryāttadvrataṃ suvratottamam || 3 || adhvaśrāntaṃ dvijaṃ yastu madhyāhne svagṛhāgatam || upaveśyāsane ramye kṛtvā pādāvanejanam || 5 || dhṛtvā śirasi tāścāpo vidhvastākhilabaṃdhanaḥ || gaṃgādisarvatīrtheṣu snāto bhavati niścitam|| 6|| asnāyī vā'pyapatrāśī vaiśākhaṃ tu nayedyadi || rāsabhī yonimāsādya paścādaśvataro bhavet || 7 || dṛḍhāṅgo rogahīnaśca tathā svastho'pi mānavaḥ || vaiśākhe tu gṛhe snātvā cāṃḍālīṃ yonimāpnuyāt || 8 || vaiśākhe māsi rājendra meṣasaṃsthe divākare || na karoti bahiḥsnānaṃ śvānayoniśataṃ vrajet || 9 || asnātvā cāpyadattvā ca vaiśākho yena nīyate || sa piśāco bhavennūnamavaiśākhādatho vrajet || 2.7.4.10 || yo na dadyājjalaṃ cānnaṃ vaiśākhe lobhamānasaḥ || pāpahāniṃ duḥkhahāniṃ naivāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || nadīsnānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādvaiśākhe viṣṇutatparaḥ || janmatrayārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 12 || samudraganadīsnānaṃ kuryātprātarbhagodaye || saptajanmārjitaiḥ pāpaistatkṣaṇādeva mucyate || 13 || kuryāduṣasi yaḥ snānaṃ saptagaṅgāsu mānavaḥ || koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14 || jāhnavī vṛddhagaṅgā ca kāliṃdī ca sarasvatī || kāverī narmadā veṇī saptagaṃgāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 15 || devakhāteṣu yaḥ kuryātprātarvaiśākhamajjanam || janmārabhya kṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 16 || vaiśākhe māsi saṃprāpte yo vāpīṣvavagāhanam || prātaḥ kuryānmahārāja mahāpātakanāśanam || 17 || api goṣpadamātreṣu bahiḥstheṣu jaleṣu ca || tiṣṭhaṃti saritaḥ sarvā gaṃgādyā iti niścayaḥ || iti jānansamāpnoti sarvatīrthādhikaṃ phalam || 18 || kṣīraṃ rasādhikaṃ kṣīrādadhikaṃ dadhi bhūmipa || dadhno'dhikaṃ ghṛtaṃ yadvadūrjo māso'dhikastathā || 19 || kārtikādadhiko māgho māghādvaiśākha uttamaḥ || tasminmāse kṛto dharmo varddhate vaṭabījavat || 2.7.4.20 || āḍhyo vā'tidaridro vā parataṃtro'tha vā naraḥ || yadvastu labhate tena taddātavyaṃ dvijātaye || 21 || kandamūlaphalaṃ śākaṃ lavaṇaṃ guḍameva ca || kolaṃ patraṃ jalaṃ takramānaṃtyāyopakalpate || || 22 || nādattaṃ labhate kvāpi brahmādyaistridaśairapi || 23 || dānena hīno hi bhavedakiṃcano niṣkiñcanatvācca karoti pāpam || pāpādavaśyaṃ narakaṃ prayāti dātavyamasmātsukhamicchatā tadā || 24 || yathā gṛhaṃ sarvaguṇopapannaṃ paricchadairhīnamaśobhanaṃ tathā || māseṣu dharmaḥ sakaleṣvanuṣṭhito vaiśākhahīnastu vṛthaiva yāti || 25 || yathaiva kanyā sakalaiśca lakṣaṇairyuktā'pi jīvatpatilakṣaṇā na hi || kriyā'pi sāṃgā sakalā'pi rājanvaiśākhahīnā tu vṛthaiva tāṃ viduḥ || 26 || dayāvihīnāstu yathā guṇā vṛthā vaiśākhadharmeṇa vinā tathā kriyāḥ || śākaṃ tu yadvallavaṇena hīnaṃ na rocate sarvaguṇopapannam || 27 || vaiśākhahīnaṃ tu tathaiva puṇyaṃ na sādhusevyaṃ na phalāptihetuḥ || yadvanna bhūṣāsahitā'pi śobhate vastreṇa hīnā lalanā surūpā || kriyākalāpaḥ sukṛto'pi puṃbhirna bhāsate tanmadhumāsahīnam || 28 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena yena kenā'pi jantunā || dharmo vaiśākhamāse tu kartavya iti niścayaḥ || 29 || madhusūdanamuddiśya meṣasaṃsthe divākare || prātaḥ snātvā'rcayadviṣṇumanyathā narakaṃ vrajet || 2.7.4.30 || kaścinmahīratho rājā kāmāsakto jitendriyaḥ || vaiśākhasnānayogena vaikuṇṭhaṃ gatavānsvayam || 31 || vaiśākhaḥ saphalo māso madhusūdanadaivataḥ || tīrthayātrātapoyajñadānahomaphalādhikaḥ || 32 || || || prārthanāmaṃtraḥ || || madhusūdana deveśa vaiśākhe meṣage ravau || prātaḥ snānaṃ kariṣyāmi nirvighnaṃ kuru mādhava ||33|| || arghyamaṃtrāḥ || || vaiśākhe meṣage bhānau prātaḥsnānaparāyaṇaḥ || arghyaṃ te'haṃ pradāsyāmi gṛhāṇa madhusūdana || 34 || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāstīrthāni ca hradāśca ye || pragṛhṇīta mayā dattamarghyaṃ samyakprasīdatha || 35 || ṛṣabhaḥ pāpināṃ śāstā tvaṃ yamaḥ samadarśanaḥ || gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ yathoktaphalado bhava || 36 || iti cārghyaṃ samarpyātha paścātsnānaṃ samācaret || vāsasī paridhāyātha kṛtvā karmāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 37 || madhusūdanamabhyarcya prasūnairmādhavodbhavaiḥ || śrutvā viṣṇukathāṃ divyāmetanmāsapraśaṃsinīm || 38 || koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmukto mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 39 || na jātu khidyate bhūmau na svarge na rasātale || na garbhe jāyate kvāpi na bhūyaḥ stanapo bhavet || 2.7.4.40 || vaiśākhe kāṃsyabhojī yastathā cāśrutasatkathaḥ || na snāto nāpi dātā ca narakāneva gacchati || 41 || brahmahatyāsahasrasya pāpaṃ śāmyetkathaṃcana || vaiśākhe yena na snātaṃ tatpāpaṃ naiva gacchati || 42 || svādhīnena svakāyena jale svātaṃtrya vartini || svādhīnajihvayoccāryaṃ harirityakṣaradvayam || 43 || na kuryādyadi vaiśākhe prātaḥsnānaṃ narādhamaḥ || jīvanneva sa paṃcatvamāgato nātra saṃśayaḥ || 44 || yena kenāpyupāyena mādhave madhusūdanam|| nārcayedyadi mūḍhātmā śaukarīṃ yonimāpnuyāt || 45 || yo'rcayettulasīpatrairvaiśākhe madhusūdanam || nṛpo bhūtvā sārvabhaumaḥ koṭijanmasu bhogavān || paścātkoṭikulairyukto viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt|| || 46 || vividhairbhaktimārgaiśca viṣṇuṃ seveta yau vrataiḥ || saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vā'pi nityaṃ dhyāyedananyadhīḥ || 47 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde vaiśākhadharmapraśaṃsā nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<2.7.5>
|| || ambarīṣa uvāca || || vaiśākhaḥ sarvadharmebhyastapodharmebhya eva ca || sa kathaṃ sarvamāsebhyo dānebhyo'pyadhiko'bhavat || 1 || || nārada uvāca || || tadvakṣyāmi mahāprājña śṛṇu caikamanā bhava || kalpāṃte devarāḍviṣṇuḥ śeṣaśāyī mahāprabhuḥ || 2 || kukṣistha lokasaṅgho'yaṃ sa śete pralayārṇave || aneko hyekatāṃ prāpya bhūtibhiryogamāyayā || 3 || nimeṣasyāvasāne tu śrutibhirbodhitastataḥ || kukṣisthajīvasaṃghānāṃ rakṣāṃ cakre dayānidhiḥ || 4 || tattatkarmaphalaprāptyai sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ mano dadhe || tasya nābherabhūtpadma sauvarṇaṃ bhuvanāśrayam || 5 || brahmāṇaṃ janayāmāsa vairājaṃ puruṣāhvayam || tasminsasarja bhagavānbhuvanāni caturdaśa || 6 || bhinnakarmāśayānprāṇisaṅghāṃśca vividhānbahūn || triguṇānprakṛtiṃ loke maryādāścādhipāṃstathā || 7 || varṇāśramavibhāgāṃśca dharmaklṛptiṃ ca so'karot || vedaiścaturbhistatraiśca sahitānsmṛtibhistathā || 8 || purāṇairitihāsaiśca svājñārūpairmaheśvaraḥ || ṛṣīnpravartakāṃścakre dharmaguptyai mahāprabhuḥ || 9 || taiḥ pravartitadharmāstu varṇāśramavibhāgajāḥ || prajāḥ śraddadhire sarvāḥ svocitānviṣṇutoṣadān || 2.7.5.10 || tāṃstu pravartamānāṃstu svāśramāndraṣṭumīśvaraḥ || hṛdistho'pyavyayaḥ sākṣādvibhīṣārthaṃ parīkṣayā || 11 || anūnānkuśalānyatra dharmānkurvaṃti vai prajāḥ || sa kālaḥ ko bhavedvidvāniti sarcitayatprabhuḥ || 12 || varṣākālo mayā sṛṣṭaḥ sīdaṃtyastā imāḥ prajāḥ || tatrānūnānna kurvaṃti dharmānpaṃkādyupadrutāḥ ||13|| tāndṛṣṭvā kopa eva syātteṣu tuṣṭirna me bhavet || mayekṣitā na sīdaṃtu tasmāttānavalokaye ||14|| śaradyapi tathā pūrtiḥ karṣaṇānnaiva jāyate || kecitpakvaphalāsaktāḥ kecidvṛṣṭibhirarditāḥ ||15|| kecicchītārditāścaiva tāndṛṣṭvā roṣa eva me || vaiguṇyaṃ paśyataścaiva na me toṣo'bhijāyate || 16 || utthāpanaṃ tu necchaṃti prātarhemaṃta āgate || kopo me'nutthitāndṛṣṭvā prātaḥ sūryodaye sati || || 17 || śiśire'pi tathaivārtāḥ prātaḥkāla imāḥ prajāḥ || tathā pakvaphalādānāśaktā hyaniśamaṃjasā || 18 || punaḥ śītārditāḥ prātaḥsnānārthamiti ciṃtitāḥ || teṣāṃ tu karmalopaḥ syānnaiva pūrtiḥ kathaṃcana || 19 || prekṣāyāḥ samayo nā'yamiti ciṃtā''kulo vibhuḥ || vasaṃta samayaṃ mene sarvāpattinivārakam || 2.7.5.20 || snāne dāne tathā yāge kriyāyāṃ bhoga eva ca || nānādharmavidhāne ca hyanukūlastvayaṃ hyṛtuḥ || 21 || aprayāsena labhyāni dravyāṇyasubhṛtāṃ dhuvam || yena kenāpi dravyeṇa tuṣṭistanubhṛtāṃ bhavet || 22 || viṣṇorādhārabhūtānāṃ taddravyaṃ dharmasādhanam || vasaṃte sakalaṃ dravyaṃ prāṇināṃ tu sukhāvaham || 23 || dānayogyaṃ dharmayogyaṃ bhogayogyaṃ tu sarvaśaḥ || nirdhanānāṃ tu paṅvādi vikalānāṃ mahātmanām|| 24 || dravyāṇi ca sulabhyāni jalādīni na saṃśayaḥ || dravyairetaiḥ svātmahitaṃ dharmaṃ kurvaṃti matpriyāḥ || 25 || patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairanyaiḥ śākaiścāpi priyoktibhiḥ || sraktāṃbūlaiścandanādyaiḥ pādaprakṣālanādibhiḥ || 26 || praśrayādyairaho teṣāṃ varado'hamitīrayan || saṃciṃtya bhagavānviṣṇuḥ pratasthe ramayā saha|| 27 || vanāni sarvataḥ paśyanvikasatkusumāni ca || hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṃ mattālidvijasevitam || 28 || āśramāṇāṃ mahārhāṇāṃ vanagrāmanivāsinām|| prāṃgaṇādīni ramyāṇi hyudyānāni sthalāni ca || 29 || ramāyai darśayanviṣṇuḥ saha devairmunīśvaraiḥ || siddhacāraṇagandharvakinnaroragarākṣasaiḥ || 2.7.5.30 || stūyamāno'bhyagādgehānvarṇāśramanivāsinām || mīnādikarkaṭāṃtaṃ vai sa tiṣṭhanramayā suraiḥ || 31 || sārddhaṃ pratīkṣya puruṣānkṛtākṛta saparyayā || tatra dharmavatāṃ puṃsāṃ dadātīṣṭānmanorathān || 32 || mattānna sahate puṃso haratyāyurdhanādikam || yadi kurvaṃti vaiśākhe saparyā paramātmanaḥ || 33 || tatrāpi calamūrtīnāṃ sādhūnāṃ yatra vai vibhuḥ || māsevanyeṣu yajjātaṃ karmalopaṃ sahiṣyati || 34 || yathā deśāgataṃ bhūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā jānapadāḥ prajāḥ || yadi taṃ copatiṣṭhanti praśrayādyairmahārhaṇaiḥ || 35 || tadā karādikaṃ nyūnaṃ pūrṇaṃ jānāti pārthivaḥ || punarapyadhikaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tuṣṭo dāsyati niścitam || 36 || tadā tvakṛtapūjānāṃ daṇḍaṃ teṣāṃ karoti ca || tathā viṣṇuḥ svakīyānāṃ vaiśākhe mādhavāgame || 37 || saparyāṃ kurvatāṃ puṃsāṃ dadātīṣṭānmanorathān || akurvatāṃ tathā puṃsāṃ dhanādīni haratyalam || 38 || dharmagopturmahāviṣṇordevadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || parīkṣākāla evā'yaṃ tasmānmāsottamo hyayam || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāṃvarīṣasaṃvāde vaiśākhaśreṣṭhatvanirūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcamodhyāyaḥ || 5 || || cha || ||
<2.7.6>
|| || nārada uvāca || || vaiśākhe'dhvagataptānāṃ tṛṣārtānāṃ mahīpate || jaladānamakurvāṇastirśayonimavāpnuyāt || 1 || atraivodāhara ntīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || viprasya gṛhagodhāyāḥ saṃvādaṃ paramādbhutam || 2 || purā cekṣvākuvaṃśe'bhūddhemāṃga iti bhūmipaḥ || brahmaṇyaśca vadānyaśca jitāmitro jitendriyaḥ || 3 || yāvatyo bhūmikaṇikā yāvanto jalabiṃdavaḥ || yāvantyuḍūni gagane tāvatīradadātsa gāḥ || 4 || yeneṣṭayajñadarbhaiśca bhūmirbarhiṣmatī śubhā || gobhūtilahiraṇyādyaistoṣitā bahavo dvijāḥ || 5 || tenādattāni dānāni na vidyanta iti śrutam|| tenādattaṃ jalaṃ caikaṃ sukhalabhyadhiyā nṛpa || 6 || bodhito brahmaputreṇa vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā || amaulyaṃ sarvato labhyaṃ taddātā kiṃ phalaṃ labhet ||7 || durbuddhyā hetuvādaiśca na jalaṃ dattavāndvije || alabhyadāne puṇyaṃ syāditi vākyaṃ suyuktimat || 8 || sa ānarca dvijānvyaṅgāndaridrānvṛttikarśitān || nārcayacchrotriyānviprāṃstattvajñānbrahmavādinaḥ || 9 || prakhyātānpūjayiṣyaṃti sarve lokā mahārhaṇāḥ || anāthānāmavidyānāṃ vyaṃgānāṃ ca dvijanmanām ||2.7.6.10|| daridrāṇāṃ gatiḥ kā vā tasmātte me dayāspadam || iti durdhīrapātreṣu dattavānkimapi svayam || 11 || tena doṣeṇa mahatā cātakatvaṃ trijanmasu || ekajanmani gṛdhratvaṃ śvā'bhavatsaptajanmasu ||12|| paścānnṛpagṛhe jāto bhūpo'yaṃ gṛhagodhikā || śrutakīrtyākhyabhūpasya mithilādhipaternṛpa ||13|| gṛhadvārapratolyāṃ ca vartate kīṭakāśanā || saptāśītiṣu varṣeṣu sthitaṃ tena durātmanā || 14 || videhādhipatergehe kadācidṛṣisattamaḥ || śrutadeva iti khyātaḥ śrauto madhyāhna āgataḥ || 15 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya jātaharṣo narādhipaḥ || madhuparkādibhiḥ pūjya tasya pādāvanejanīḥ || 16 || apo mūrdhnā vahankṣipraṃ tadotsiktaiśca biṃdubhiḥ || daivopadiṣṭakālena prokṣitā gṛhagodhikā || 17 || sadyo jātasmṛtirabhūtsmṛtakarmādiduḥkhitā || trāhitrāhīti cukrośa brāhmaṇaṃ gṛhamāgatam || 18 || tiryagjaṃturavaṃ śrutvā brāhmaṇo vismito'vadat || kutaḥ krośasi godhe tvaṃ daśeyaṃ kena karmaṇā || 19 || tvaṃ devaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścinnṛpo vā'tha dvijo'tha vā || kastvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga tvāmadyāhaṃ samuddhare || 2.7.6.20 || ityuktaḥ sa nṛpaḥ prāha śrutadevaṃ mahāmatim || ahamikṣvākukulajo vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 21 || yāvatyo bhūmikaṇikā yāvantastoyabiṃdavaḥ || yāvaṃtyuḍūni gagane tāvatīradadaṃ sma gāḥ || 22 || sarve yajñā mayā ceṣṭāḥ pūrtānyācaritāni me || dānanyapi ca dattāni dharmarājastvanuṣṭhitaḥ || 23 || tathāpi durgatirjātā mama cordhvagatiṃ vinā || trivāraṃ cātakatvaṃ me gṛdhratvaṃ caikajanmani || 24 || saptajanmasvalarkatvaṃ prāptaṃ pūrvaṃ mayā dvija || siṃcatā'nena bhūpena tvapaḥ pādāvanejanīḥ || 25 || biṃdavo dūramutkṣiptāstaiḥ sikto'haṃ kathaṃcana || tena janmasmṛtirabhūtsarvapāpmā hataśca me || 26 || godhā janmāni bhāvyāni hyaṣṭā viṃśatikāni me | dṛśyante daivasṛṣṭāni bibhye tairjanmabhirbhṛśam || 27 || na kāraṇaṃ prapaśyābhi tanme vistarato vada || ityuktaḥ sa ṛṣiḥ prāha jñātvā vijñānacakṣuṣā ||28|| śṛṇu bhūpa pravakṣyāmi tava duryonikāraṇam || na jalaṃ tu tvayā dattaṃ vaiśākhe mādhavapriye ||29|| tajjalaṃ sulabhaṃ matvā hyamūlyamiti niścitam || nādhvagānāṃ dvijātīnāṃ gharmakāle'pyajānatā || 2.7.6.30 || tathā pātraṃ samutsṛjya hyapātre pratidattavān || jvalantamagnimutsṛjya nahi bhasmani hūyate || 31 || bahudhā varṇitasyā'pi saugandhyādiyutasya ca || kaṇṭakānvitavṛkṣasya na kurvaṃti samarcanam ||32|| viśiṣṭānāṃ pādapānāmaśvatthaḥ sevyatāṃ gataḥ || tulasīṃ tu samutsṛjya bṛhatī pūjyate nu kim|| 33 || anāthatvaṃ pūjyatāyāṃ na prayojakatāmiyāt || paṃgvādyā ye'pyanāthā hi dayāpātraṃ hi kevalam || 34 || taponiṣṭhā jñānaniṣṭhāḥ śrutiśāstraviśāradāḥ || viṣṇurūpāḥ sadā pūjyā netare tu kadācana || 35 || tatrāpi jñānino'tyarthaṃ viprā viṣṇoḥ sadaiva hi || jñānināmapi bhūpāla viṣṇureva sadā priyaḥ || tasmājjñānī sadā pūjyaḥ pūjyātpūjyataraḥ smṛtaḥ|| 36 || avajñā sādhuvṛttānāmihā'mutra ca duḥkhadā || sevā vai mahatāṃ puṃsāṃ pumarthānāṃ hi kāraṇam || 37 || koṭayo'pyandhajātīnāṃ na paśyaṃti yathā'yatham || evaṃ mandāyutānāṃ tu saṃgatirnārthadā bhavet || 38 || nahyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ || te punaṃtyurukālena darśanādeva sādhavaḥ || 39 || na sādhusevanātkvāpi sīdante taiḥ suśikṣitāḥ || janmamṛtyujarādyairvā sudhayā''pyāyitā yathā || 2.7.6.40 || na jalaṃ tu tvayā dattaṃ sādhavo vā na sevitāḥ || tena te durgatiśceyaṃ prāptā cekṣvākunaṃdana || 41 || vaiśākhe matkṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi śāntaye || bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavadyena karmajātaṃ vije ṣyasi || 42 || ityuktvā'pa upaspṛśya dadau puṇyamanuttamam ||43 || yadā dattaṃ brāhmaṇena snānaṃ caikadine kṛtam || tena dhvastā'khilāghastu tyaktvā tāṃ gṛhagodhikām || 44 || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya divyasragvastrabhūṣaṇaḥ || paśyatāmeva bhūtānāṃ maithilasya gṛhāṃtare || 45 || baddhāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā parikramya praṇamya ca || anujñāto yayau rājā stūyamāno'marairdivam || 46 || tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānvarṣāyutamatandritaḥ || sa eva cekṣvākukule kākutstho'bhūnmahāprabhuḥ || 47 || saptadvīpavatīpālo brahmaṇyaḥ sādhusaṃmataḥ || devendrasya sakhā viṣṇoraṃśa eva mahāprabhuḥ || 48 || bodhitastu vasiṣṭhena vaiśākhoktānmanoramān || anuṣṭhāyākhilāndharmāṃstena dhvastākhilā'śubhaḥ || 49|| divyaṃ jñānaṃ samāsādya viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāptavān|| vaiśākhaḥ śubhadastasmātpuṃbhiḥ sarvairanuṣṭhitaḥ ||2.7.6.50|| āyuryaśaḥpuṣṭido'yaṃ mahāpāpaughanāśanaḥ || pumarthānāṃ nidānaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ prīṇātyanena tu || 51 || cāturvarṇyanaraiḥ sarvaiścaturāśramavartibhiḥ || anuṣṭheyo mahādharmo vaiśākhe mādhavāgame || 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmvarīṣasaṃvāde gṛhagodhikākhyānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<2.7.7>
|| nārada uvāca || || rājā tadadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā maithilo dharmavittamaḥ || kṛtāñjaliḥ sukhāsīnaṃ vismito vākyamabravīt || ||1|| || maithila uvāca || || dṛṣṭametanmahāścaryaṃ sādhūnāṃ caritaṃ tathā || yena dharmeṇa mukto'bhūdrājā cekṣvākunandanaḥ ||2 || taṃ dharmaṃ vistareṇaiva śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || mahyaṃ śraddhāvate vidvatkṛpayā vistarādvada || 3 || iti rājñā susaṃpṛṣṭaḥ śrutadevo mahāmanāḥ || sādhusādhviti saṃbhāṣya vyājahāra nṛpottamam || 4 || || śrutadeva uvāca || || samyagvyavasitā buddhistava rājarṣisattama || vāsudevapriyāndharmāñchrotuṃ yasmānmatistava || 5 || bahujanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ vinā kasyāpi dehinaḥ || vāsudevakathālāpe matinaivopajāyate || 6 || yūne rājādhirājāya jāteyaṃ matirīdṛśī || śuddhaṃ bhāgavataṃ manye tena tvāṃ sādhusattamam || 7 || tasmāttubhyaṃ bruve saumya dharmānbhāgavatāñcchubhān || yāñjñātvā mucyate jaṃturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt|| 8 || yathā śaucaṃ yathā snānaṃ yathā sandhyā ca tarpaṇam || agnihotraṃ yathā śrāddhaṃ tathā vaiśākhasatkriyāḥ || 9 || vaiśākhe mādhave dharmānakṛtvā nordhvago bhavet || na vaiśākhasamo dharmo dharmajāteṣu vidyate || 2.7.7.10 || saṃtyeva bahavo dharmāḥ prajāścārājakā iva || upadravaiśca lupyaṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 11 || sulabhāḥ sakalā dharmāḥ kartuṃ vaiśākhacoditāḥ || udakumbhaṃ prapādānaṃ pathicchāyādinirmitiḥ || 12 || upānatpādukādānaṃ chatravyajanayostathā|| tilayuktamadhordānaṃ gorasānāṃ śramāpaham|| 13 || vāpīkūpataḍāgādikaraṇaṃ pathikāśrayam|| nārikelekṣukarpūrakastūrīdānameva ca ||14|| gandhānulepanaṃ śayyā khaṭvā dānaṃ tathaiva ca || tathā cūtaphalaṃ ramyamurvāruka rasāyanam || 15 || dānaṃ damanapuṣpāṇāṃ tathā sāyaṃ guḍodakam || citrāṇyannāni pūrṇāyāṃ dadhyannaṃ pratyahaṃ tathā || 16 || tāṃbūlasya sadā dānaṃ caitradarśe karīrakam || ravāvanudite sūrye prātaḥ snānaṃ dinedine || 17 || madhusūdanapūjā ca kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ tathā || abhyaṃgavarjane caiva tathā vai patrabhojanam ||18|| madhyemadhye śramārtānāṃ vījanaṃ vyajanena ca || sugaṃdhaiḥ komalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pratyahaṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ ||19|| phalaṃ dadhyanna naivedyaṃ dhūpadīpau dinedine || gogrāsaṃ vṛṣapatnīnāṃ dvijapādāvanejanam || 2.7.7.20 || guḍanāgaradānaṃ ca dhātrīpiṣṭapradāpanam || pathikānāṃ praśrayaṃ ca dānaṃ tandula śākayoḥ || ete dharmāḥ praśastā hi vaiśākhe mādhavapriye || 21 || tathā ca viṣṇauḥ kusumārpaṇaṃ hareḥ pūjā ca kālocita pallavādyaiḥ || dadhyannanaivedyanivedanaṃ ca samastapāpaugha vināśahetuḥ || 22 || nārī puṣpairmādhavaṃ nārcayedyā kālotpannairmandire vā gṛhe vā || putraṃ saukhyaṃ kvā'pi nāpnoti haṃti cāyurbhartuḥ svātmano vā mahātman || 23 || ramāsahāye mādhave māsi viṣṇau parīkṣāyai dharmasetoḥ prajānām || gṛhaṃ yāte munibhirdaivataiśca kāle puṣpairnārcayedyastu mūḍhaḥ || 24 || sa mūḍhātmā rauravaṃ prāpya paścādyāyādyoniṃ rākṣasīṃ pañcavāram || jalaṃ cānnaṃ sarvadā deyamasminkṣudhārtānāṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇahetuḥ || 25 || tiryagjaṃturjāyate vāryadānādannādānājjāyate vai piśācaḥ || annādāne cānubhūtāṃ kathāṃ te hyahaṃ vakṣye cādbhutāṃ bhūmipāla ||26|| revātīre matpitā'bhūtpiśācaḥ svamāṃsāśī kṣuttṛṣāśrāṃtagātraḥ || chāyāhīne śālmalīvṛkṣamūle hyannābhāvānnaṣṭacaitanya eṣaḥ || 27 || kṣudhā tṛṣā karmaṇā yasya bahvī sūkṣmaṃ chidraṃ kaṇṭhanālasya cā'sīt || māṃsaṃ cāntaḥkaṇṭhamadhye niṣaṇṇaṃ kuryātpīḍāṃ prāṇaparyantameva || 28 || jalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kālakūṭaprakalpaṃ kaupyaṃ śītaṃ vā'pi kāsārasaṃstham || tasyāstīre cāgataṃ daivayogādgaṅgāyātrākāraṇānmārgamadhye || 29 || dṛṣṭvā'dbhutaṃ śālmalī vṛkṣamūle truṭavā truṭvā bhakṣayantaṃ svamāṃsam || krośantaṃ taṃ bahudhā śocamānaṃ kṣudhātṛṣāvyādhitaṃ karmabhiḥ svaiḥ || 2.7.7.30 || sa māṃ hantuṃ prādravatpāpakarmā mattejasā nihato dudruve ca || taṃ cā'bravaṃ kṛpayā klinnacitto mā bhaiṣṭa tvaṃ hyabhayaṃ me hi dattam || 31 || kastvaṃ tāta brūhi sadyo'tra hetuṃ kṛcchrādasmānmocaye mā viṣīda || ityukto māṃ prāha putraṃ tvajānanpurānarte bhūvarākhye pure ca || 32 || nāmnā maitraḥ sāṃkṛtergotrajo'haṃ tapovidyādānayajñādiniṣṭhaḥ || mayā'dhītādhyāpitāḥ sarvavidyāḥ kṛto mayā sarvatīrthā'vagāhaḥ || 33 || dattaṃ nā'nnaṃ māsi vaiśākhasaṃjñe lobhādbhikṣāmātramapyeva kāle || śoce cā'haṃ prāpya paiśācayoniṃ nā'nyo hetuḥ satyamevoktamaṅga || 34 || putro'dhunā vartate madgṛhe ca bhūrikhyātiḥ śrutadevā'bhidhānaḥ || vācyā tasmai maddaśā cā''tmajāya vaiśākhānnādānato'bhūtpiśācaḥ || 35 || dṛṣṭastīre te pitā narmadāyā nordhvaṃ gato vartate vṛkṣamūle || khādanmāṃsaṃ svīyamevā'nvakhidyatpiturmuktyai māsi vaiśākhasaṃjñe || 36 || prātaḥ snātvā pūjayitvā ca viṣṇuṃ nirvyājānmāṃ tarpayitvā jalaiśca || deyaṃ cā'nnaṃ dvijavarye guṇāḍhye mukto yo vai yāti viṣṇoḥ padaṃ ca ||37|| itthaṃ coktaṃ tvatpurastādvadeti dayā caiṣā matkṛte nā'tra śaṃkā || bhadraṃ bhūyātsarvato maṃgalaṃ te śrutvā cā'haṃ bhāṣitaṃ me pituśca || 38 || duḥkhātkāyaṃ daṃḍavatpātayitvā bhṛśārto'haṃ pādayorbhūrikālam || nidannidanbhūryahaṃ bāṣpanetraḥ putro'haṃ te tāta daivā''gato'ham || 39 || karmabhraṣṭo bhūsurāṇāṃ vinindyo nā'bhūdyasmātkleśamokṣaḥ pitṝṇām || ākhyāhi tvaṃ karmaṇā kena mukto bhavitā vai tatkaromi dvijeṃdra || 2.7.7.40 || tataḥ prāha prītasarvāntarātmā yātrāṃ kṛtvā śīghramāgatya geham || prāpte māse meṣasaṃsthe ca bhānau nivedyā'nnaṃ viṣṇave tvaṃ guṇāḍhyam || 41 || dānaṃ dehi dvijavarye mahātmaṃstasmānmokṣo bhavitā sānvayasya || pitrā''diṣṭaḥ kṛtayātraḥ svagehe prāpyā'karaṃ mādhave cā'nnadānam ||42|| tasmānmukto matpitā māṃ sametya yānārūḍho hyabhinaṃdyā''śiṣā ca || gato lokaṃ śrīpaterdurvibhāvyaṃ yasmingatā na nivartaṃti bhūyaḥ ||43|| tasmāddānaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu coktaṃ tubhyaṃ proktaṃ dharmasāraṃ sudharmyam || kimanyatte śrotumicchā vadasva śrutvā sarvaṃ te vadāmīti satyam || 44 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde piśācamokṣaprāptirnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || || cha || ||
<2.7.8>
|| maithila uvāca || || brahmannikṣvākutanayo jalā'dānācca cātakaḥ || trivāramabhavatpaścānmadgṛhe godhikā tathā || 1 || karmānuguṇametaddhi yuktaṃ tasyākṛtātmanaḥ || satāmasevanāttasya gṛdhratvaṃ sārameyatā || 2 || saptavāramiti proktaṃ tanme bhāti ca nocitam || saṃto na dūṣitāstena na tathā kṛpaṇā api || 3 || tasmādasevinastasya phalā'bhāvo bhaveddhruvam || nānarthakaraṇābhāvādidaṃ hi parapīḍanam || 4 || animittamidaṃ kasmātkuyonitvamavāptavān || tadetaṃ saṃśayaṃ chiṃdhi śiṣyasyā''tmapriyasya ca || 5 || iti rājñā susaṃpṛṣṭaḥ śrutadevo mahāyaśāḥ || sādhusādhviti saṃbhāṣya vaco vyāhartumādadhe || 6 || || śrutadeva uvāca || || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi yatpṛṣṭaṃ tu tvayā'nagha || śivāyai ca śivenoktaṃ kailāsaśikhare'male || 7 || sṛṣṭvemānsakalām̐llokānpaścātteṣāmavasthitim || āmuṣmikīmaihikīṃ ca dvividhāṃ paryakalpayat || 8 || hetutrayaṃ ca pratyekaṃ hetusthityai mahāprabhuḥ || jalasevā cānnasevā sevā caivauṣadhasya ca || 9 || yatra caite mahābhāga hyaihikasthiti hetavaḥ || evamāmuṣmike rājaṃstraya everitāḥ śrutau || 2.7.8.10 || sādhusevā viṣṇusevā sevā dharmapathasya ca || purā sampāditā hyete paralokasya hetavaḥ || 11 || gṛhe saṃpāditaṃ yadvatpātheyaṃ paddhatau yathā || aihikā hetavo rājansadyaḥ saṃ(?)pāditārthadāḥ || 12 || kiṃ ceṣṭamapi sādhūnāṃ manaso yadi dussaham || kutaścitkāraṇādrājaṃstaccānarthāya kalpate || 13 || apriyaṃ kimu vaktavyaṃ duḥkhaheturiti sphuṭam || atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ||14|| pāpaghnaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ romaharṣaṇam || yajñadīkṣāmupagataḥ purā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 15 || āhvānārthaṃ bhūtapateragamadrajatācalam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā notthitaḥ śaṃbhustasyaiva hitakāmyayā || 16 || sarvāmaraguruścā'haṃ chandogamyaḥ sanātanaḥ || bhṛtyā hyete baliharāścandrendrādyāḥ sureśvarāḥ || 17 || svāmī bhṛtyāya nottiṣṭhetsvabhāryāyai patistathā || guruḥ śiṣyāya nottiṣṭhediti śāstravidāṃ matam ||18 || na saṃbandho gurutve ca kāraṇaṃ tviti vai śrutiḥ || balaṃ jñānaṃ tapaḥ śāṃtiryatra caivā'dhikaṃ bhavet || 19 || sa guruścetareṣāṃ ca nīcā īyuśca preṣyatām || uttiṣṭhanti ca svāmyādyā bhṛtyādīnyadi cā''grahāt || 2.7.8.20 || āyurvittaṃ yaśasteṣāṃ sadyo naśyati santatiḥ || tasmādahaṃ tu nottiṣṭhe priyo'yaṃ śvaśuro mama || 21 || iti tasya hitānveṣī noccacālā''sanādvibhuḥ || notthitaṃ tu mṛḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā kupito'bhūtprajāpatiḥ || 22 || aniṃdadbahudhā tasmai purato girijāpateḥ || aho darpamaho darpaṃ daridrasyā'kṛtātmanaḥ || 23 || yasya vittaṃ bahuvayā vṛṣaścarmāvaśeṣitaḥ || ata eva kapālāsthidharaḥ pākhaṇḍagocaraḥ || 24 || vṛthā'haṃkāriṇo daivaṃ kuto dāsyati maṃgalam || loke kṛtyena karmāṇi śucīnīti vido viduḥ || 25 || dhatte daridraḥ śītārtaḥ pavitraṃ ca gajājinam || veśma śmaśānaṃ yasya syādbhujaṃgaḥ kila bhūṣaṇam || 26 || na dhīratā'pi ca jñānaṃ vṛkāttasmātpalāyite || bhūtapretapiśācādi durjanaiḥ saṃgato'niśam || 27 || na kulaṃ śrūyate kvā'pi nā'sau vai sādhusa mmataḥ || vṛthā viśraṃbhitaḥ pūrvaṃ nāradena durātmanā || 28 || yenā'haṃ bodhitaḥ prādāṃ kanyāṃ caitāṃ satīṃ mama || pṛthagdharmagatā caiṣā sukhaṃ vasatu tadgṛhe || 29 || nāsmābhiḥ ślāghanīyo'sau matsutā'pi kathaṃcana || yathā kulālakalaśaścaṃḍālasya vaśaṃ gataḥ || 2.7.8.30 || iti dakṣo vimūḍhātmā hyumāṃ nāhūya taṃ mṛḍam|| bahudhā taṃ vinirbhartsya tūṣṇīmeva gṛhaṃ yayau || 31 || yajñavāṭaṃ tato gatvā ṛtvigbhirmunibhiḥ saha|| īje yajñavidhānena niṃdanneva mahāprabhum || 32 || brahmaviṣṇū vihāyaiva sarve devāḥ samāgatāḥ || siddhacāraṇagandharvā yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ || 33 || tadā devī satī puṇyā strīcāñcalyātpralobhitā || utsukā cotsavaṃ draṣṭuṃ bandhūṃstatra samāgatān || 34 || nivāryamāṇā rudreṇa taralā strīsvabhāvataḥ || pratyuktā'pi punaścaiva gantavyamiti niścitā || 35 || sa nindati sabhāmadhye sadā māṃ varavarṇini || taccāsahyaṃ ca tvaṃ śrutvā kāyaṃ satyaṃ prahāsyasi || 36 || asahyamapi soḍhavyaṃ mayā'pi gṛhamicchatā || mayā yathā kṛtaṃ devi tathā tvaṃ naiva vartase ||37| tasmānmā gaccha śālāṃ vai na śubhaṃ tu bhaveddhruvam|| ityevaṃ bodhitā devī cāpalyaṃ punarāgamat || 38 || niścakrāma satī gehādekākī pādacāriṇī || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣabhastūṣṇīṃ pṛṣṭhe devīmuvāha saḥ || 39 || koṭiśo bhūtasaṃghāśca hyanujagmuḥ satīṃ tadā || yajñavāṭaṃ tu sā gatvā patnīśālāṃ yayau purā || 2.7.8.40 || tūṣṇīmāsa satīṃ dṛṣṭvā khedāttasmādvinirgatā || pativākyaṃ tu saṃsmṛtya jagāmottaravedikām || 41 || pitā sabhyāśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sthitāstūṣṇīṃ hatāśiṣaḥ || sā rudrāhutiparyaṃtaṃ paśyantī pitṛceṣṭitam || tyaktvā rudraṃ ca juhvaṃtamuvācā'śrukulekṣaṇā || 42 || || devyuvāca || || mahadullaṃghanaṃ puṃsāṃ na prāyaḥ śreyase bhavet || lokakartā lokabhartā sarveṣāṃ prabhuravyayaḥ || 43 || evaṃbhūtasya rudrasya kathaṃ no dīyate haviḥ || jātāṃ na kiṃ te durbuddhiṃ haraṃtyanye samāgatāḥ || 44 || na cedṛśā mahātmānaḥ kimeṣāṃ vimukho vidhiḥ || 45 || ityevaṃ bhāṣamāṇāṃ tāṃ pūṣā devo jahāsa ha || śmaśrūṇāṃ cālanaṃ cakre bhṛgurhataśubhastathā || 46 || bhujapādorukakṣā ṇāṃ sphālanaṃ cakrire pare || bahudhā nindanaṃ cakre tatpitā hatabhāgyavān || 47 || tacchrutvā rudrabhāryā sā kopākulitamānasā || prāyaścittaṃ śruteḥ kartuṃ dehaṃ tatyāja sā satī || homāgnau vedikāmadhye sarveṣāmeva paśyatām || 48 || hāhākāro mahānāsīddudruvuḥ pramathā drutam || ācakhyurdevadevāya vṛttāntamakhilaṃ tadā || 49 || tacchrutvā sahasotthāya rudraḥ kālāṃtakopamaḥ || jaṭāmutpāṭya hastena bhūtale tāmatāḍayat || 2.7.8.50 || tato'bhavanmahākāyo vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ || sahasrabāhurabhavatkālāṃtakasamaprabhaḥ || 51 || baddhāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā vyājahāra haraṃ tadā || matsṛṣṭistu yadarthaṃ te tadarthaṃ mā niyojaya || 52 || ityuktaḥ prāha taṃ kruddho dhūrjaṭiśca puraḥ sthitam || ||53|| hana tvaṃ nindakaṃ dakṣaṃ yadarthe matpriyā hatā || bhūtasaṃghāstu gacchantu sahaitena mahābalāḥ || 54 || ityādiṣṭā bhagavatā yayuryajñasabhāṃ tadā || jaghnuḥ sarvānmahāvīrāndevāsuranarādikān ||55|| pūṣṇaśca hasato daṃtāñjaṭābhūśca babhañja ha || śmaśrūṇyutpāṭayāṃcakre bhṛgostasya durātmanaḥ ||56|| yadyadāsphālitaṃ pūrvaṃ tattacciccheda vīryavān || tato dakṣaśiro hartuṃ bahūdyogaṃ cakāra ha || 57 || munimaṃtrapraguptaṃ tu naiva kṛṃtati tadbalāt || haro jñātvā tu ciccheda svayametya durātmanaḥ || 58 || evaṃ makhagatānhatvā sā'nugaḥ svālayaṃ yayau || hatāvaśiṣṭāḥ kecittu brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || || 59 || tairanvito yayau brahmā kailāsaṃ tu śivālayam || tato rudraṃ sāntvayitvā vacobhirvividhairapi || 2.7.8.60 || tenaiva sahitaḥ prāgādyajñavāṭaṃ mahāprabhuḥ || tenaivojjīvayāmāsa sarvānyajñasamāgatān || 61 || khyātyai prādādajamukhaṃ dakṣasya tu tadā śivaḥ || ajaśmaśrūṇyadācchaṃbhurbhṛgave tu mahātmane || 62 || pūṣṇaśca daṃtānna prādātpiṣṭādaṃ ca cakāra ha || tadaṅgānāṃ vyatikaraṃ keṣāṃcidapi vai śivaḥ || 63 || śivamāpuśca te sarve brahmaṇā ca śivena ca || punaḥ pravartito yajño yathāpūrvaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 64 || yajñānte sarvadevāśca jagmuste svasvamālayam || naiṣṭhikaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tu kṛtvā rudro mahātapāḥ || 65 || tepe gaṃgātaṭe rudraḥ punnāgatarumūlagaḥ || dakṣātmajā satī devī tyaktadehā pativratā || 66 || jajñe himādrermenakyāṃ vavṛdhe tasya veśmani|| etasminneva kāle tu tārakākhyo mahāsuraḥ || 67 || sa tīvratapasā''rādhya brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam || avadhyatvaṃ varaṃ vavre devāsuranaroragaiḥ || 68 || āyudhairastrasaṃghaiśca sarvaireva mahābalaiḥ || rudraputraṃ vinā daitya hyavadhyaḥ sakalairapi || 69 || iti tasmai varaṃ prādādbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || astrīkatvādaputratvādrudrasyeti tathāstviti || 2.7.8.70 || varaṃ gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ prāpya lokānbabādha ha || dāsā devā mārjanādau dāsyo devyaśca tadgṛhe || 71 || tatastatpīḍitā devā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || taiḥ pīḍāṃ varṇitāṃ śrutvā vedhāḥ prāha surānidam || 72 || varapradānakāle'haṃ rudraputraṃ vinā surāḥ || nakhyaivadhya iti prādāṃ varaṃ tasmai durātmane || 73 || purā satī rudrapatnī satre tyaktakalevarā || jātā himavataḥ putrī pārvatīti ca yāṃ viduḥ ||74|| rudro himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe tapaścarati duścaram || yojayadhvaṃ ca pārvatyā rudraṃ lokeśvaraṃ prabhum || || 75 || punardevendrasadane saṃgatairamareśvaraiḥ || dhiṣaṇenā'pi sammaṃtrya deveṃdraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ || 76 || sasmāra ca sa kāryārthaṃ nāradaṃ smarameva ca || tatrā''gatau tatastau tu balabhidvākyamabravīt || 77 || himavantaṃ bhavāngatvā vacasā taṃ nibodhaya || putrī tava prāgdakṣasya harapatnī sutā satī || || 78 || tapaścarati te śṛṃge viyuktā daśakanyayā || mṛḍastasya saparyāyai viniyojaya tatpriyām || 79 || tasyaiva patnī bhavitā sa eva bhavitā patiḥ || ityā''diṣṭo maghonā ca nāradopetya taṃ girim || 2.7.8.80 || tathaiva kārayāmāsa devendreṇoditaṃ yathā || paścātkāmaṃ samāhūya maghavānida māha ca || 81 || devānāṃ ca hitārthāya tathā mṛḍahitāya ca || vasantena samāyukto gatvā rudratapovanam || 82 || guṇānvijṛmbha yitvā tu vāsaṃ tānhṛcchayāvahān || yadā sannihitā devī pārvatī tu mṛḍasya ca || 83 || tadā prayujya tvaṃ vāṇānmohayasva mahāprabhum || tayostu saṃgame jāte kāryaṃ no'ddhā bhaviṣyati || 84 || ityādiṣṭaḥ smarastūrṇaṃ pratasthe bāḍhamityatha || savasaṃtaḥ saratikaḥ sānugastadvanaṃ yayau || 85 || akāle tu vasaṃtartuṃ jṛṃbhayitvā svaśaktitaḥ || tadvane sarvato ramye mandā'nilaniṣevite || 86 || kadāciddevadevo'pi pārvatyāśca saparyayā || prītaḥ svāṅkaṃ samāropya kiṃcidvyāhartumārabhat || 87 || prāṇapriyā saṅgamasya kālo'yamiti niścitaḥ || peśalaṃ dhanurādāya sa tasthau harapṛṣṭhataḥ || || 88 || kṛtvā javanikāṃ vṛkṣaṃ bāṇamekaṃ mumoca ha || dvitīyamapi saṃdhāya cakre moktuṃ mahodyamam || 89 || atha kṣubdhamanā bhūtvā mṛḍaściṃtāmavāpa ha || na me manaścaletkvāpi kena vā kaśmalīkṛtam || 2.7.8.90 || iti cintākulo vāme pārśve kāmaṃ dadarśa ha || kruddhonmīlya lalāṭākṣaṃ svāṅkāddevīmapāsya ca || 91 || tasyākṣṇaḥ samabhūdagnistīkṣṇo lokavibhīṣaṇaḥ || tena dagdho'bhavatsadyo manmathaḥ saśarāsanaḥ || 92 || kāryasiddhiṃ ca paśyaṃto dudruvuścāmarā divam || śaṃkamānāḥ svadaṇḍaṃ ca vasanto ratireva ca || 93 || nimīlya locane bhītā devī dūraṃ pradudruve || sannidhānaṃ striyo hartuṃ mṛḍopyaṃtaradhīyata || 94 || rudrasyeṣṭaṃ prakurvāṇo devaśca manaso hitam || lebhe'narthamanirvṛttaṃ vipriyaṃ kurvatastu kim || 95 || tasmādikṣvākutanayaḥ sādhūnāmapriyaḥ sadā || tasmādātmahitāṃ sevāṃ nā'karonmandadhīḥ satām || 96 || anubhūtaṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ tasmādduryonireva ca || tasmātkuryāttu sādhūnāṃ sevāṃ sarvārthasādhinīm || 97 || rudrasyā'priyakāritvātsmaro bhāvini janmani || duḥkhaṃ tu bahulaṃ lebhe janmakāle mahāprabhuḥ || 98 || itihāsamimaṃ puṇyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti divāniśam || janmamṛtyujarādibhyo mucyaṃtenā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 99 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde dākṣāyaṇyapamāne dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsapūrvakapārvatī janmādikāmadahanavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || || cha ||
<2.7.9>
|| || maithila uvāca || || tasya dagdhasya kāmasya kasmājjanmā'bhavadvibho || kiṃ duḥkhamabhavattasminkarmaṇaḥ saha laṃghanāt || 1 || etadācakṣva me brahmañcchrotu kautūhalaṃ hi me || || śrutadeva uvāca || || kumārajanma vakṣyāmi śravaṇātpāpanāśanam || 2 || yaśasyaṃ putradaṃ dharmyaṃ sarvarogavināśanam || śaṃbhunā tu hate kāme tatpatnī ratisaṃjñikā ||3|| mumoha purato dṛṣṭvā patiṃ bhasmāvaśeṣitam|| jātasaṃjñā muhūrtena vilalāpa ca citradhā || 4 || yadvilāpādvanaṃ cāpi samaduḥkhamabhūttadā || taccitāgnau svakāyaṃ tu tyaktukāmā ca mādhavam|| 5 || patyuḥ sakhāyaṃ sasmāra kartuṃ tātkālikīṃ kriyām || sa āgataścitiṃ karttuṃ vīrapatnyā mahāprabhuḥ || 6 || sa tu trastaḥ sakhīṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāparo'bhavat || ratiṃ tu sāntvayāmāsa sāntvairbahuvidhairapi || 7 || putratulyo'smi te bhadre sthite mayi ca nā'rhasi || kāyaṃ tyaktuṃ dharmahetumityādyairbahudhā'pi sā || 8 || naiva sthātuṃ manaścakre tena saṃstabhitā ratiḥ || dṛṣṭvā dārḍhyaṃ vasanto'pi citiṃ cakre sarittaṭe || 9 ||
