sā'vagāhya dyunadyāṃ ca kṛtvā kāryāṇi sarvaśaḥ || sanniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ niveśyātmani vai manaḥ || 2.7.9.10 || citimāroḍhumārebhe tato jātā'śarīravāk || mā praveśaya kalyāṇi vahniṃ patiparāyaṇā || || 11 || bhaviṣyati ca te patyurharādviṣṇośca yādavāt || janmadvayaṃ krameṇaiva tatra cottarajanmani || 12 || bhaiṣmyāṃ kṛṣṇānmahāviṣṇoḥ pradyumnākhyo bhaviṣyati || vasiṣyasi tvaṃ ca śāpādbrahmaṇaḥ śaṃbarālaye || 13 || pradyumnākhyena te patyā saṃgatiśca bhaviṣyati || ityuktvā virarāmā'tha vāṇī cā''kāśagocarā || 14 || śrutvā tāṃ tu nivṛttā'bhūnmaraṇe kṛtaniścayā || tato devāḥ samājagmuḥ svārthe kāme hate harāt|| 15 || ratyā kṛtaṃ prapaśyanto gurvindrāgnipurogamāḥ || tāṃ te nivartayāmāsurvareṇa mahatā satīm || 16 || anaṃgo'pi bhavetsā'ṅgo mṛta evā'kṣigo bhavet || iti tāṃ tu vinirvartya dharmaṃ copadideśire || 17 || pūrvakalpe tvayaṃ rājā suṃdarākhyo mahāprabhuḥ || tvameva patnī tatrā'pi rajaḥsaṃkarakāriṇī || 18 || teneyañca daśābhūtte kurvidānīṃ ca niṣkṛtīm || maṃdākinyāṃ tu vaiśākhe prātaḥsnānaṃ tadā kuru || 19 || madhusūdanamabhyarcya kathāṃ divyāṃ tathā śṛṇu || aśūnyaśayanaṃ nāma vratamārabha bhāmini || 2.7.9.20 || dharmeṇā'nena te bhadre vratenā'pi ca mādhave || nūnaṃ ta bhavitā patyurupalabdhirna saṃśayaḥ || 21 || iti tasyai varaṃ dattvā devā jagmuryathā''gatāḥ || tathā kṛcchrānnivṛttā sā devī kāmasatī tathā || 22 || gaṃgā'vagāhanaṃ cakre meṣasaṃsthe divākare || aśūnyaśayanaṃ nāma vrataṃ cā'pi mahāmanāḥ || 23 || tena puṇyaprabhāvena sadyaḥ kāmo'kṣigocaraḥ || abhūttasyai mahārāja loke cāvārya vīryavān || 24 || pūrvakalpe'pyayamapi rājā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ || vaiśākhoktānmahādharmānnākarottena vai smaraḥ||25|| dehahāniṃ prapede'sau putro'pi paramātmanaḥ || vṛthā nīte tu vaiśākhe meṣasaṃsthe divākare || 26 || avastheyaṃ ca devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tu kā kathā || tryaṃbakeṃ'tarhite paścānnirāśā girikanyakā || 27 || tūṣṇīṃ sthitāṃ tadā bhrāṃtāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā himavāngiriḥ || cakitaḥ svagṛhaṃ ninye dorbhyāṃ tāṃ parirabhya ca || 28 || rūpaudāryaguṇāndṛṣṭvā harasyaiva mahātmanaḥ || sa eva me patirbhūyāditi tanniṣṭhamānasā || 29 || gaṃgopakūlamāpede tapastaptuṃ dhṛtavratā || nivāritā'pi sā devī pitrā mātrā svakairjanaiḥ || 2.7.9.30 || arcayantī mahāliṃgaṃ nirāhārā jaṭādharā || divyavarṣasahasrānte pratyakṣo'bhūnmaheśvaraḥ || 31 || bhūtvā varṇyapi sāyāhne parṇaśālāmukhe vibhuḥ || svaniṣṭhamanaso dārḍhyaṃ vākyairnānāvidhairapi || 32 || jñātvā varādaraṃ bhadre varayeti mahāprabhuḥ || sā vavre'tha patiṃ rudraṃ tvaṃ bhaveti varānanā ||33|| sa tathaiva varaṃ dattvā ṛṣīnsasmāra sapta ca || ājagmuste'pi munayaḥ sthitāḥ prāñjalayaḥ puraḥ ||34|| ṛṣīṇāṃ jñāpayāmāsa kanyāṃ praṣṭuṃ himālayam || tathā''diṣṭā bhagavatā kanyārthaṃ himavadgṛham ||35|| prāpurvihāyasā sarve dyotayanto diśo daśa || pratyujjagāma sa giriḥ saptaitānbrahmavittamān || 36 || saṃpūjya vidhivatsarvānsukhāsīnānapṛcchata || dhanyo'smi kṛtakṛtyo'smi yadbhavato gṛhā''gatāḥ || 37 || bhavadāgamanaṃ manye mama janmaphalaṃ tviti || na kṛtyaṃ vidyate'smābhiḥ pūrṇārthānāṃ mahātmanām || 38 || tathā'pi brūta kāryaṃ vo yatkartavyaṃ mayā'dhunā || ityuktāste tathā procurhimavaṃtaṃ mahāgirim || 39 || tvayā svasadṛśaṃ vākyamuktaṃ giripate dṛḍham || asmadāgamane hetuṃ vakṣyāmaste mahodaye || 2.7.9.40 || kanyā te pārvatī nāma pūrvaṃ dakṣātmajā satī || jātā tava kumārī yā yajñe tyaktakalevarā || 41 || asyāḥ pāṇigrahe dakṣaḥ śaṃbhurnā'nyo jagattraye || deyā sā śaṃbhave devī bhavatā''naṃtyamicchatā || 42 || pūrvajanmasahasreṣu bhavatā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam || idānīṃ tava diṣṭyā tu paripākamupāgatam || 43 || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃhṛṣṭā''tmā mahāgiriḥ || vyājahāra punarvākyaṃ putrī valkaladhāriṇī || 44 || gaṃgātīre nirāhārā tapastapati duścaram|| kāṅkṣamāṇā patiṃ śaṃbhuṃ tasyā iṣṭamidaṃ tviti||45|| dattā kanyā mayā tasmai tryaṃbakāya mahātmane || śīghraṃ gatvā bhavaṃtastu yatra śambhurmahāprabhuḥ || 46 || prītyā himavatā dattāṃ gṛhāṇeti nivedya ca || bhavaṃta eva kurvaṃtu caitadvaivāhikīṃ kriyām || 47 || ityuktāste himavatā tamāmaṃtrya śivaṃ yayuḥ || lakṣmyādyā yoṣitaḥ sarvā viṣṇvādyā devatā api || 48 || ṣaṇmātaro'tha munayo draṣṭuṃ jagmurmahotsavam || śivaḥ sarvāmaragaṇairmunibhirmātṛbhistathā || 49 || anvito vṛṣabhārūḍhaḥ pramathānāṃ gaṇairvṛtaḥ || bherīśaṃkhamṛdaṃgādyaiḥ kāhalīpaṭahādikaiḥ || || 2.7.9.50 || brahmaghoṣairbaṃdibhiśca prāviśaddhimavatpurīm || sumuhūrte śubhe lagne śubhagrahanirīkṣite || 51 || vivāhamakarocchailaḥ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || mahotsavastadā cā''sīttrilokyāṃ prāṇināṃ nṛpa || 52 || mahotsave nivṛtte tu śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ || reme svacchaṃdayā devyā lokadharmānanuvrataḥ|| || 53 || ṛddhimaddhimavadgehe deveṃdrabhavanopame || śarvaryāṃ naṃdinītīre vanarājiṣu śaṃkaraḥ || 54 || mattālidvijasannādamayūraravamaṃḍite || divyavarṣasahasrāṇi reme svacchaṃdayā vibhuḥ || 55 || strīṇāmiṃdravarābhāvāttasminkāle nṛpottama || puṃsaḥ saṃgātpunargarbho nārīṇāṃ sravati dhuvam || 56 || pratyahaṃ ramaṇāddevyāṃ nābhūdgarbho harādbata || devānāmabhavaccintā putrālābhādvarādvibho || 57 || sarve saṃgatya saṃmaṃtrya mitha evaṃ babhāṣire || kāmīvā'bhūdratau nityaṃ sakto devyā haraḥ svarāṭ || 58 || nā'smākaṃ siddhyate kāryaṃ nityaṃ garbhasya saṃsravāt || punā ratiryathā nā'bhūttathā'smābhirvidhīyatām || 59 || mitha evaṃ tu saṃbhāṣya vyacinvankṣaṇamatra te || agniṃ kṛtye viniścitya hyūcurmānapuraḥsaram || 2.7.9.60 || agne mukhaṃ tvaṃ devānāṃ tvaṃ bandhurgatireva ca || idānīmapi gaccha tvaṃ ramate yatra vai haraḥ || 61 || ratyante darśayā''tmānaṃ punā ratiryathā na vai || tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍitā devī tataścāpasareddhruvam || 62 || śiṣyo bhūtvā tu ratyante pṛccha tattvaṃ smarāntakam || tattvasampraśnavyājena kālaṃ bahu naya prabho || 63 || bahukāle gate devī kumāraṃ prasaviṣyati || devairevaṃ prārthito'gniromityuktvā haraṃ yayau || 64 || vīryotsargātpūrvameva gato vahnī ratāṃtare || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍitā devī vivastrā vimanā yayau || 65 || rati vihāya tvarayā tato rudro'tikopitaḥ || vahniṃ prāha gṛhāṇedamabhisṛṣṭaṃ tu durmate || 66 || madvīryaṃ duḥsahaṃ pāpa ratau vighnastvayā'bhavat || utsṛjāmi ca madvīryaṃ tvanmukhe havyavāhana || 67 || ityuktvotsṛṣṭavānvīryaṃ havyavāhamukhe haraḥ || taddhṛtvā dahyamānaḥ sansvodare vīryamulbaṇam || 68 || ciṃtayāno yayau dhāma devānāṃ yajñapūruṣaḥ || kathaṃcitprāṇato mukto devebhyastannyavedayat || 69 || devā vahnīritaṃ śrutvā harṣaśokau samāyayuḥ || sthitaṃ vīryamiti hrādaṃ kathaṃ tu prasavo bhavet || 2.7.9.70 || iti duḥkhaṃ tadā cā''sīdvahneḥ kukṣau tu śāṃbhavam || vavṛdhe teja ākṣiptaṃ daśa māsā gatāstadā || 71 || nā'paśyatprasavopāyaṃ bahuduḥkhaparāyaṇaḥ || devānvai śaraṇaṃ prāpa garbhamocanahetave || 72 || te devā vahninā sākaṃ prāpurgaṃgāṃ yaśasvinīm || gaṃgā stotreṇa te stutyā prārthayāmāsuraṃjasā || 73 || tvaṃ mātā sarvadevānāṃ tvameva jagatāṃ patiḥ || devatārthaṃ tu tvaṃ bhadre dhatsva tejastu śāṃbhavam ||74|| tadvahnervarddhate garbho nāstrītvātprasavo'sya ca || tasmādenaṃ ca naḥ sarvānsamuddhara dayāṃ kuru ||75 || ityevaṃ prārthitā devī tathāstviti vaco'bravīt || devāstu vahnaye prāhurmaṃtraṃ garbhavimocanam || 76 || tanmaṃtrādgarbhamākṛṣya vyasṛjaddhavyavāhanaḥ || gaṃgāyāṃ śāṃbhavaṃ tejo bhāsvallokasuduḥsaham || 77 || sā coḍhvā katicinmāsānna śaśāka tataḥ param || nirjalā tatprabhāveṇa sphuṭadraktakalevarā || 78 || bahuduḥkhā''kulā devī pātivratyaprabhāvataḥ || ujjahāra svodarasthaṃ garbhaṃ lokaikapāvanī || 79 || śarakāṃḍe tu cikṣepa dahyamānaṃ samantataḥ || śarakāṃḍaistu saṃbhinnaḥ ṣoḍhā bhinno babhūva ha || 2.7.9.80 || ṣaṭkṛ'ttikāḥ samājagmurbrahmaṇā coditāstadā || śarakāṃḍe vinirbhinnaṃ ṣoḍhā saṃdhāya śāṃbhavam || 61 || ṣaṇmukhaṃ puruṣaṃ kṛtvā tvekadehamiti sphuṭam || kṛttikā vidhinā''jñaptāstaṃ tathā cakrire dṛḍham || 82 || taddehaṃ puruṣākāraṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ śarakāṃḍagam || arakṣyamāṇamevāsīccharakāṃḍeṣu vai ciram || 83 || ekadā vṛṣabhā'rūḍhau pārvatīparameśvarau || śrīśailaṃ gaṃtumanasau tatsthalaṃ parijagmatuḥ || 84 || tadāsītpārvatī devī sadyaḥ snutapayodharā || vismitā cāvadadrudraṃ snutau kasmātpayodharau || 85 || kāraṇaṃ brūhi viśvātmannityuktastu haro'bravīt || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi putro'dho vartate tava || 86 || tvayi vīryamanutsṛṣṭaṃ prāgevā''gāddhavirvahaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍitā tvaṃ vai praviṣṭā ca sthalāntaram || 87 || mayā kopādvahni mukhe visṛṣṭaṃ vīryamulbaṇam || devānāṃ ca prasādena gaṃgāyāṃ vyasṛjadvibhuḥ || 88 || gaṃgā ca dahyamānā sā vyakṣipañca śarāntaraṃ || tatra ṣoḍhā prabhinnaṃ tu mātṛbhiśca dṛḍhīkṛtam || 89 || puruṣākṛtimāpede taṃ dṛṣṭvā te stanau sutau || pālanīyaṃ mahāvīryaṃ viṣṇunā samavikramam || 2.7.9.90 || ayame vaurasaḥ putrastava bhāti viniścitam || tasmādgṛhāṇa śīghraṃ tvaṃ tenā''khyātiratīva te || 91 || ityā''jñaptā śaṃbhunā sā tamādāyā'rbhakaṃ drutam || aṃkamāropya taṃ devī pāyayāmāsa sā stanau || 92 || devena mohitā devī putrasnehaparā'bhavat || punaḥ kailāsamagamatprabhuṇā saha śāṃkarī || 93 || lālayaṃtī sutaṃ devī saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ yayau || evaṃ kumārajananaṃ varṇitaṃ te mayā'dbhutam || 94 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ kumārajananaṃ śubham || putrapautrābhivṛddhiṃ tu labhate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 95 || mahadduḥkhaṃ tu janane harasyā'pi yato'bhavat || prītyānuśrutavaiśākhadharmo'pyapratimo bhavet || 96 || tasmādvaiśākhadharmo hi sarvāghaughavināśanaḥ || avaidhavyapradaḥ puṇyaḥ sarvasaṃpadvidhāyakaḥ ||97|| anaṃgopi hi sāṃgatvaṃ yatprabhāvātsamāptavān || asnātvā cāpyadattvā ca vaiśākho yasya vai gataḥ ||98|| api dharmakṛto vā'pi bhavedduḥkhaparaṃparā || sarvadharmo hitaḥ syācca yadyeko'yamanuṣṭhitaḥ || 99 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāṃbarīṣasaṃvāde kumārotpattikathanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || ||cha||| ||
<2.7.10>
|| maithila uvāca || || yatkāmapatnīcaritamaśūnyaśayanaṃ vratam || devopadiṣṭaṃ tasyā'sya vidhānaṃ brūhi bhūsura || 1 || kiṃ dānaṃ ko vidhistasya pūjanaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tathā || etadācakṣva bhūdeva śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 2 || || śrutadeva uvāca || || śṛṇu bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || aśūnyaśayanaṃ nāma ramāyai hariṇoditam || 3 || yena cīrṇena deveśo jīmūtā''bhaḥ prasīdati || lakṣmībhartā jagannāthaḥ samastā'ghaughanāśanaḥ || 4 || akṛtvā yastvidaṃ rājanvrataṃ pātakanāśanam || gārhasthyamanuvarteta tasyedaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 5 || śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣe tu dvitīyāyāṃ mahīpate || aśūnyaśayanākhyaṃ tadgrāhyaṃ vratamanuttamam ||6|| cāturmāsye tu saṃprāpte haviṣyāśī bhavennaraḥ || caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ samyaṅniṣpādyate prabho ||7|| lakṣmīyukto jagannāthaḥ pūjanīyo janārdanaḥ || pāraṇe divase prāpte bhakṣyaṃ caiva caturvidham|| 8 || upāyanaṃ ca dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine || sauvarṇīṃ rājatīṃ cāpi mūrtiṃ kuryānmanoramām || 9 || pītāmbaradharāṃ divyāṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitām || śuklapuṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhaiśca pūjayetpuruṣottamam || 2.7.10.10 || śayyādānairvastradānairviprāṇāṃ bhojanaistathā || dampatyorbhojanaiścaiva dakṣiṇābhiḥ prapūjayet || 11 || evaṃ tu caturo māsānpūjayitvā janārdanam || mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu pūjayetpūrvavaddharim|| 12 || rakravarṇaṃ hariṃ dhyāyedrukmiṇīsahitaṃ tathā || caitrādīṃścaturo māsānevaṃ saṃpūjayettataḥ || 13 || bhūmyā saha sthitaṃ devamarcayedbhaktipūrvakam || sanaṃdanādyairmunibhiḥ stūyamānamakalmaṣam || 14 || āṣāḍhasya ca māsasya dvitīyāyāṃ samāpayet || aṣṭākṣareṇa maṃtreṇa juhuyādanale śubhe || 15 || mārgaśīrṣādimāsānāṃ pāraṇe bhūmipālaka || juhuyādviṣṇugāyatryā caitrādīnāṃ nibodhaya || 16 || pauruṣeṇa ca maṃtreṇa juhuyādanale śubhe || pañcāmṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ ca hyapūpaṃ ghṛtapācitam || 17 || evaṃ krameṇa dravyāṇi pratimāsu nibodhaya || sauvarṇī pratimāṃ dadyāllakṣmīnārāyaṇasya ca || 18 || sauvarṇīṃ madhyame dadyātkṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || rājatīṃ tvaṃtime dadyādvarāhasya mahātmanaḥ || 19 || brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścānnāmabhiḥ keśavādibhiḥ || vastrayugmairalaṃkārairyathāvittānusārataḥ || 2.7.10.20 || arcayitvā tato dadyādapūpānghṛtapācitān || upāyanārthe viprebhyo dvādaśabhyo nivedayet || 21 || ācāryāya tato dadyātpratimāṃ pūrvakalpitām || śayyāṃ saṃkalpitāṃ pūrṇāṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām || 22 || tasyāmabhyarcya vidhivallakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ param || kāṃsyapātreṇa sahitāmapūpairbahubhistathā || 23 || vastrālaṃkārasahitāṃ dakṣiṇābhistathaiva ca || brāhmaṇāya viśiṣṭāya vaiṣṇavāya kuṭuṃbine || || 24 || dātavyā vidhivatpūjya brāhmaṇāṃścāpi bhojayet || || dānamantraḥ || || lakṣmyā aśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ yathā tava janārdana ||25|| śayyā mamāpyaśūnyā syāddānenā'nena keśava || evaṃ samprārthya deveśaṃ svayaṃ bhojanamācaret || 26 || puruṣo vā satī vā'pi vidhavā vā samācaret || aśūnyaśayanārthaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vratamuttamam || 27 || evaṃ tava mayā khyātaṃ vistarānnṛpasattama || suprasanne jagannāthe bhaveyurvividhāḥ prajāḥ || 28 || tasmiṃstuṣṭe tu deveśe devānāmapi durlabhāḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena vratametatsamācaret || 29 || avaśyaṃ gantukāmena tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || evamuktaṃ mayā sarvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 2.7.10.30 || ityuktastena rājarṣiḥ punarapyāha taṃ munim || vaiśākhe chatradānasya māhātmyaṃ vistarādvada || 31 || śṛṇvato'pi na tṛptirme vaiśākhoktāñcchubhāvahān || 32 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā yaśasyaṃ puṇyavarddhanam || pratyuvāca mahābhāgaṃ śrutadevo mahāyaśāḥ ||33 || || śrutadeva uvāca || || vaiśākhe gharmataptānāṃ mānavānāṃ mahātmanām || ye kurvantyātapatrāṇaṃ teṣāṃ puṇyamanaṃtakam || 34 || atraivodāharantīmamiti hāsaṃ purātanam || vaiśākhadharmamuddiśya purā kṛtayuge kṛtam || 35 || vaṅgadeśe purā kaściddhemakānta iti śrutaḥ || kuśaketoḥ suto dhīmānrājā śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || ekadā mṛgayā''sakto gahanaṃ vanamāviśat || 36 || tatra nānāvidhānhatvā mṛgānkroḍādikānbahūn|| śrāṃto madhyāhnavelāyāṃ munīnāmāśramaṃ yayau || 37 || tadā śatarcinonāma ṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || samādhisthā na jānanti bāhyakṛtyaṃ ca kiṃcana || 38 || tāndṛṣṭvā niścalānviprānkruddho haṃtuṃ mano dadhe || bhūpaṃ nivārayāmāsa śiṣyāṇāmayutaṃ tadā || 39 || durbuddha śṛṇu no vākyaṃ guravastu samādhigāḥ || no jānanti bahiḥkṛtyaṃ tasmātkrodhaṃ na cārhasi || 2.7.10.40 || tataḥ śiṣyānuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ krodhavihvalaḥ || yūyaṃ kurudhvamātithyamadhvaśrāṃtasya me dvijāḥ|| 41 || evamuktāśca bhūpena śiṣyā ūcustadā nṛpam || nā''jñaptā gurubhirbhūpa vayaṃ bhikṣāśinaḥ punaḥ || 42 || gurutantrāḥ kathaṃ kartumātithyaṃ te vayaṃ kṣamāḥ || pratyākhyāto nṛpaḥ śiṣyaistānhaṃtuṃ dhanurādade || 43 || mṛgadasyubhayādibhyo bahudhā rakṣitā mayā || te māmevopaśikṣaṃti mayā dattapratigrahāḥ || 44 || ete māṃ na vijānaṃti kṛtaghnā bhūrimāninaḥ || ghnatopi me na doṣaḥ syādetānvai hyātatāyinaḥ || 45 || evaṃ vikruddhamānaḥ sañcharānmuṃcañccharāsanāt || tānvidrutānanudrutya jaghne śiṣyaśatatrayam ||46|| dudruvurbhayataḥ sarve vihāyā''śramamañjasā || vidrāviteṣu śiṣyeṣu balādāśramasaṃsthitān || 47 || saṃbhārāñjagṛhuḥ śīpraṃ sainikāḥ pāpabuddhayaḥ || yatheṣṭaṃ bhojanaṃ cakrurnṛpeṇaivānumoditāḥ || 48 || tataḥ senā''vṛto rājā purīmāgāddinātyaye || kuśaketustataḥ śrutvā tanayasya viceṣṭitam|| 49 || purānniryātayāmāsa garhayangarhayansutam || rājyānarhaṃ kṣamāhīnaṃ svadeśādapi bhūmipa || 2.7.10.50 || pitrā tyaktastato rājā hemakāṃto'tivihvalaḥ || vanaṃ viveśa gahanaṃ hatyābhiśca supīḍitaḥ || 51 || bahukālamavāsīcca gahvare nirjane vane || āhāraṃ kalpayāmāsa vyādhadharmamupāśritaḥ || 52 || na kvā'pi sthitimāpede hatyayā'bhidruto bhṛśam || aṣṭāviṃśativarṣāṇi gatānyasya durātmanaḥ || 53 || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena trito nāma mahāmuniḥ || tasminnaraṇye vaiśākhe ravau madhyaṃdine gate || 54 || gacchannātapaviklāṃtastṛṣayā cā'pi pīḍitaḥ || kvacidvṛkṣavihīne tu pradeśe mūrcchito'bhavat || 55 || daivāddṛṣṭvā hemakāṃtastritaṃ nāma mahāmunim || tṛṣārtaṃ mūrchitaṃ śrāṃtaṃ kṛpāṃ cakre nṛpādhamaḥ ||56|| brahmapatraistadā chatraṃ kṛtvā cā''tapavāraṇam|| munerjagrāha śirasi hyalābusthaṃ jalaṃ dadau || 57 || labdhasaṃjño'bhavattena hyupacāreṇa vai muniḥ || patracchatraṃ kṣatradattaṃ gṛhītvā gataviklamaḥ || 58 || grāmaṃ kvacicchanaiḥ prāpya kiñcidāpyāyitendriyaḥ || tena puṇyaprabhāvena brahmahatyāśatatrayam || 59 || vinaṣṭamabhavattasya kṣaṇādeva mahātmanaḥ || tato vismayamāpanno hemakānto mahārathaḥ ||2.7.10.60|| bahudhā pīḍyamānasya brahmahatyāḥ kathaṃ gatāḥ || kenā'pi niṣkṛtā hyetāḥ kva gatāḥ kena hetunā ||61|| ityevaṃ cintayāmāsa brahmahatyāvimocanam|| evaṃ cā'jñasthite rājñi yamadūtā athā''gaman||62|| netumenaṃ mahātmānaṃ hemakāṃtaṃ vane sthitam || grahaṇīṃ janayāmāsuḥ prāṇānhartuṃ mahātmanaḥ||63|| tadā prāṇaviyogārtaḥ puruṣāṃstrīndadarśa ha || yamadūtānmahāghorānūrdhvakeśānbhayaṃkarān || 64 || cintayānaḥ svakarmāṇi tūṣṇīmāsīttadā nṛpaḥ || chatradānaprabhāvena jātā viṣṇusmṛtirnṛpa || 65 || tena smṛto mahāviṣṇurviṣvaksena svamaṃtriṇam || uvāca tūrṇaṃ tvaṃ gaccha yamadūtānnivāraya ||66|| vaiśākhadharmanirataṃ hemakāṃtaṃ tu pālaya || niṣpāpamenaṃ madbhaktaṃ pitre dehi puraṃ gataḥ || 67 || madīritena vākyena kuśaketuṃ ca bodhaya || sarvadharmmojjhito vāpi brahmacaryādivarjitaḥ || 68 || vaiśākhadharmanirato matpriyaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ|| kṛtāgāścā'pi tvatputro munitrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ || 69 || vaiśākhe chatradānena niṣpāpo nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || tena puṇyaprabhāvena śāṃto dāntaścirāyuṣaḥ || 2.7.10.70 || śauryodāryaguṇopetastvatsamo'yaṃ guṇairapi || tasmādenaṃ rājyabhāre saṃsthāpaya mahābalam || 71 || viṣṇunaiva samājñaptamityādiśya nṛpottamam || piturvaṃśe hemakāṃtaṃ sthāpyā''yāhi ca māṃ punaḥ || 72 || ityādiṣṭo bhagavatā viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ || hemakāntaṃ samāsādya yamadūtānnivārya ca || 73 || pāṇinā śaṃtamenaiva pasparśāṃgeṣu bhūmipam || bhagavadbhaktasaṃsparśāddhatavyādhiḥ kṣaṇādabhūt || 74 || viṣvaksenastatastena saha tasya purīṃ yayau || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito bhūtvā kuśaketurmahāprabhuḥ || 75 || nanāma śirasā bhaktyā daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi || gṛhaṃ praveśayāmāsa pārṣadaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 76 || stutvā ca vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ pūjayāmāsa vaibhavaiḥ || tasmai prītamanāḥ prāha viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ || || 77 || hemakāntaṃ samuddiśya yaduktaṃ viṣṇunā purā || tacchrutvā kuśaketuśca putraṃ rājye niveśya ca || 78 || viṣvaksenābhyanujñātaḥ sabhāryo vanamāviśat || viṣvakseno hemakāntamanumaṃtryābhipūjya ca || 79 || śvetadvīpaṃ yayau dhīmānviṣṇupārśve mahāmanāḥ || hemakāṃtastato rājā vaiśākhoktāñcchubhāvahāna||2.7.10.80|| viṣṇuprītikarāndharmānprativarṣaṃ cakāra ha || brahmaṇyo dharmamārgasthaḥ śānto dānto jitendriyaḥ || 81 || dayāluḥ sarvabhūteṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ || pravṛddhaḥ sarvasampadbhiḥ putrapautrādibhirvṛtaḥ || 82 || bhuktvā bhogānsamastāṃśca viṣṇulokamavāptavān || 83 || nekṣe tu vaiśākhasamāṃśca dharmānsukhaprayatnānbahupuṇyahetūn || pāpendhanādyagninibhānsulabhyāndharmādimokṣāntapumarthahetūn || 84 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṃḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde chatradānapraśaṃsane hemakāṃtasya brahmahatyādi pāpaśamanavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha ||
<2.7.11>
|| maithila uvāca || || vaiśākhadharmāḥ sulabhāḥ puṇyarāśividhāyakāḥ || viṣṇuprītikarāḥ sadyaḥ pumarthānāṃ tu hetavaḥ || 1 || na prakhyātāḥ kathaṃ loke śāśvatāḥ śruticoditāḥ || prakhyātā rājasā dharmāstāmasā api bhūriśaḥ || 2 || durghaṭā vahuyatnāśca vahudravyavyayāvahāḥ || kecinmāghaṃ praśaṃsanti cāturmāsyānpare jaguḥ || 3 || vyatīpātādidharmāśca varṇayantīha bhūriśaḥ || etadvivekaṃ vistārya śrotukāmāya me vada || 4 || || śrutadeva uvāca || || śṛṇu bhūpa pravakṣyāmi na prakhyātā ime katham || itareṣāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ kathaṃ khyātiśca bhūtale || 5 || rājasāstāmasā bhūmau bahavaḥ kāmukā janāḥ || icchaṃtyaihikabhogāṃste putrapautrādisaṃpadaḥ || 6 || kvacitkathaṃcana kvā'pi janeṣveko'tikṛcchrataḥ || svargāya yatate loke tasmādyajñādisatkriyāḥ || 7 || kurute'tiprayatnena mokṣaṃ nopāsate naraḥ || kṣudrāśā bhūrikarmāṇo janāḥ kāmyānupāsate || 8 || prakhyātā rājasā dharmāstāmasā api tena vai || na khyātāḥ sāttvikā dharmā hariprītikarā ime || 9 || niṣkāmikā ime dharmā hyaihikā''muṣmikapradāḥ || na jānanti janā mūḍhā mohitā devamāyayā || 2.7.11.10 || yathā''dhipatye saṃprāpte sarvasiddho manorathaḥ || mohanārthaṃ sthalaṃ prāptamādhipatyena hīyate || 11 || kāraṇaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi gopane bhūtaleṃ'jasā || yadvaiśākhoktadharmāṇāṃ sāttvikānāṃ nṛṇāmiha || 12 || sārvabhaumaḥ purā kāśyāmikṣvākukulabhūṣaṇaḥ || kīrtimāniti vikhyāto nṛgaputro mahāyaśāḥ || 13 |'| jiteṃdriyo jitakrodho brahmaṇyo rājasattamaḥ || ekadā mṛgayāsakto vasiṣṭhāśramamāyayau || 14 || gacchanmārge dadarśā'sau vaiśākhe gharmaniṣṭhure || bhūyobhūyaḥ kāryamāṇāñcchiṣyāṃstasya mahātmanaḥ || 15 || kvacitprapāṃ prakurvanti chāyāmaṇḍapameva ca || taṭaprapātaṃ nistīrya vāpīṃ kurvanti nirmalām || 16|| sūpaviṣṭānkvacidvṛkṣe vyajanairvījayanti ca || kvaciddadyurhīkṣudaṇḍānkvacidgandhānkvacitphalam||17|| madhyāhne chatradānaṃ ca sāyāhne pānakasya ca || kvacidyacchaṃti tāmbūlaṃ netre karpūralepanam || 18 || succhāye ca vane kecitsusaṃmṛṣṭāṃ'gaṇeṣu ca || kecidāstarayaṃtyaddhā vālukāni hitāni ca|| 19 || kurvantyāṃdolikāṃ rājanvṛkṣaśākhāvalaṃbinīm || ke yūyamiti papraccha vāsiṣṭhā iti te'bruvan || 2.7.11.20 || kimetaditi papraccha dharmā vaiśākhacoditāḥ || pumarthahetava ime kriyante'smābhirañjasā || 21 || vasiṣṭhasyā''jñayā ceti te'buvannṛpasattamam || etadācaraṇe puṃsāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ kastu tuṣyati ||22|| etadvistārya me brūta yūyaṃ samyagyathāśrutam || iti rājñā tu saṃpṛṣṭāḥ pratyūcuste mahīpatim || 23 || gurorājñākrameṇaiva kurvatāṃ pathisatkriyāḥ || nāsmākamavakāśo'tra guruṃ pṛccha yathocitam || 24 || sa vetti tattvato nūnaṃ dharmānetānmahāyaśāḥ || iti śiṣyairvasiṣṭhasya pratyuktastu drutaṃ yayau ||25|| vasiṣṭhasyā'śramaṃ puṇyaṃ vidyāyogopabṛṃhitam || samāyāntaṃ nṛpaṃ vīkṣya vasiṣṭhaḥ prītamānasaḥ ||26|| ātithyaṃ vidhivaccakre sānugasya mahātmanaḥ|| sūpaviṣṭaḥ kṛtā'tithyaḥ prītaḥ papraccha taṃ gurum || 27 || || rājovāca || || mārge dṛṣṭaṃ mahāścaryaṃ tvacchiṣyaiśca kṛtaṃ śubham || mayā pṛṣṭaṃ ca tairnoktaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ śubhāvaham || 28 || nāsmākamavakāśo'tra hyetaddharmapraśaṃsane || kartabyā ca kriyā'smābhirguruṇā yā ca coditā || 29 || guruṃ gaccheti tairukta āgato'haṃ tavāṃtikam || mṛgayā''saktacittena śrāṃtenātithyamicchatā || 2.7.11.30 || dṛṣṭaṃ mārge tvidaṃ puṇyaṃ tava śiṣyaiśca kāritam || jijñāsā''sīttataḥ śrotuṃ dharmānetānmunīśvara || 31 || tvamādirādimāndharmānsamācarasi vai yataḥ || tāndharmāñcchrotukāmāya śiṣyāya praṇatāya ca || 32 || śraddadhānāya me brūhi vistarānmunipuṃgava || itīkṣvākukulīnena rājñā pṛṣṭo mahāyaśāḥ || 33 || manasā toṣamāpede samyakpṛṣṭo'dhunā'munā || aho vyavasitā buddhī rājaste'dya suśikṣitā || 34 || yasmādviṣṇukathāyāṃ ca taddharmācaraṇe'pi ca || matirātyaṃtikī jātā sukṛtaṃ phalitaṃ tava || 35 || iti saṃbhāṣya rājānaṃ jātaharṣastamabravīt || śṛṇu bhūpa pravakṣyāmi yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayādhunā || 36 || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || sarvadharmānparityajya vartate viṣayātmakaḥ ||37|| vaiśākhasnānanirataḥ sa priyo madhuvidviṣaḥ || sāṃgāndharmānanuṣṭhāya vaiśākho yena nādṛtaḥ || 38 || snānadānārcanaiḥ puṇyaistasya dūrataro hariḥ || asnāpya cā'pyadattvā ca vaiśākho yena nīyate || 39 || karmaṇā sa tu caṇḍālo nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || vaiśākhoktairmahādharmairyena cā''rādhito hariḥ || 2.7.11.40 || taiśca toṣaṃ samāyāti pradadāti samīhitam || lakṣmībharttā jagannātho hyaśeṣāghaughanāśanaḥ || 41 || dharmaiḥ sūkṣmaiśca prīṇāti na prayāsairdhanairapi || bhaktyā saṃpūjito viṣṇuḥ pradadāti samīhitam || 42 || tasmādrājansadā bhaktiḥ kartavyā madhuvidviṣaḥ || jalenā'pi jagannāthaḥ pūjitaḥ kleśahā hariḥ || 43 || paritoṣaṃ vrajatyāśu tṛṣārtaḥ salilairyathā || mahadapyalpadaṃ karma tathā hyalpaṃ ca bhūridam || 44 || karmaṇā'lpatvabhūritve na hetū mahadalpake || kintu karmasvarūpaṃ ca gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ || 45 || vaiśākhoktā ime dharmāḥ svalpā''yāsakṛtā api || bahuvyayavināśāśca viṣṇoḥ prītikarā śubhāḥ || 46 || tasmāttvamapi bhūpāla vaiśākhoktānsamācara|| tvadrāṣṭrīyairjanaiḥ sarvaiḥ kārayemāñcchubhāvahān||47|| na karoti ca yo dharmānvaiśākhoktānnarādhamaḥ || bahudhā śiṣyamāṇo'pi sa daṇḍyastava bhūpate ||48|| ityāvaśyakatāṃ samyakchāstrairvyutpādya tasya ca || paścādvaiśākhanirdiṣṭāndharmānprovāca sarvaśaḥ||49|| śrutvā tānsakalāndharmānguruṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ || sa rājā gṛhamāgatya sarvāndharmāṃścakāra ha || 2.7.11.50 || bhaktimānkeśave rājandevadeve nirañjane || nā'nyaṃ paśyati deveśātpadmanābhānmahīpatiḥ || 51 || bherīmudvāhya mātaṃgaṃ svarāṣṭre'ghoṣayadbhaṭaiḥ || aṣṭavarṣādhiko martyo hyaśītirnahi pūryate || 52 || prātarna snāti meṣasthe sūrye sarvo'pi yo janaḥ || sa me daṃḍyaśca vadhyaśca niryāsyo viṣayāddhruvam || 53 || pitā vā yadi vā putro bhāryā vā'tha suhṛjjanaḥ || vaiśākhadharmahīnaśca nirgrāhyo dasyuvanmayā || 54 || dātavyaṃ vipramukhyebhyaḥ snātvā prātarjale śubhe || prapādānādidharmāṃśca kurudhvaṃ śaktito'naghāḥ || 55 || vipraṃ ca dharmavaktāraṃ grāmegrāme nyaveśayat || pañcānāmapi grāmāṇāmakarodadhikāriṇam || 56 || daṇḍārthaṃ tyaktadharmāṇāṃ daśavājiniṣevitam || evaṃ pravṛttaḥ sarvatra sārvabhaumasya śāsanāt || 57 || pravṛddho dharmavṛkṣoyaṃ sarvadeśeṣu vistarāt || ye kecinnidhanaṃ yāṃti bhūpālaviṣaye narāḥ || 58 || pramādācca nṛpaśreṣṭha te yāṃti harimandiram || avaśyaṃ vaiṣṇavo lokaḥ prāpyate mānavairdrutam || 59 || vyājenā'pi sakṛtsnātaḥ prātarmeṣagate ravau || sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || 2.7.11.60 || na prāpnoti yamaṃ dharmaṃ sakṛdvaiśākhasnānataḥ || vailekhyamagamadrājā ravisūnustadā nṛpa || 61 || lekhyakarmaṇi viśrāntaścitragupto'bhavattadā || mārjitāni ca lekhyāni purā pāpodbhavāni ca || 62 || gacchadbhirvaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ svakarmasthairjanaiḥ kṣaṇāt || śūnyāstu narakāḥ sarve pāpiprāṇivivarjitāḥ || 63 || bhagnayāno'bhavanmārgo vaiśākhasya prabhāvataḥ || sarve'pi vimalākārā janā yānti hareḥ padam || 64 || divaukasāṃ tu ye lokāḥ śūnyāḥ sarve tathā'bhavan || śūnye triviṣṭape jāte śūnyeṣu nara keṣu ca || 65 || nārado dharmarājānaṃ gatvā cedamuvāca ha || nākrandaḥ śrūyate rājanprākcchruto narake yathā || 66 || tathā na kriyate lekhyaṃ kiṃcidduṣkṛtakarmaṇām|| citragupto muniriva sthito'yaṃ maunasaṃsthitaḥ || 67 || kāraṇaṃ brūhi rājeṃdra na yānti tava mandiram || manuṣyāḥ pāpakarmāṇo māyādambhavivardhitāḥ || 68 || evamukte tu vacane nāradena mahātmanā || prāha vaivasvato rājā kiṃciddainyasamanvitaḥ || 69 || yo'yaṃ nārada bhūpālaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sāṃprataṃ sthitaḥ || so'tibhakto hṛṣīkeśe purāṇapuruṣottame || 2.7.11.70 || prabodhayati vaiśākhadharme bherīsvanena ca || aṣṭavarṣādhiko martyo hyaśītirna hi pūryate || 71 || yo vai hyakṛtavaiśākhaḥ sa me daṇḍyo na saṃśayaḥ || tadbhayāddhi janāḥ sarve nollaṃghaṃti kadācana || 72 || gacchaṃti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma karmaṇā tena nārada || vaiśākhasevanāllokā yāsyaṃti harimaṃdiram || 73 || tena rājñā muniśreṣṭha mārgo lupto mamā'dhunā || kṛtā hi narakāḥ śūnyā lokāścāpi divaukasām || 74 || viśrāṃto lekhako lekhe likhitaṃ mārjitaṃ janaiḥ || vaiśākhamāsadharmasya māhātmyaṃ tvīdṛśaṃ mune || 75 || brahmahatyādipāpāni vimuktāni janairdvija || kṛtvā vaiśākhakṛtyāni yāṃti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || 76 || so'haṃ kāṣṭhasamo jāto na kaścinmama gocaraḥ || yuddhaṃ kṛtvā tu taṃ hanmi sarvathā'dya mahābalam || 77 || akṛtvā svāmikāryaṃ tu nirvyāpāro yadi sthitaḥ || tasya vittaṃ samaśnāti sa yāti narakaṃ dhuvam || || 78 || yadi devādavadhyo'yaṃ tadā brahmāṇametya ca || nivedya tasmai tatsarvaṃ paścātsvasthasthitirbhavam || 79 || ityuktvā dvijamāmaṃtrya sānugaḥ prayayau bhuvam || sa kālo mahiṣārūḍho daṇḍamudyamya bhīṣaṇam || 2.7.11.80 || mṛtyurogajarādyaiśca pārṣadaiśca mahotkaṭaḥ || pañcāśatkoṭisaṃkhyākairyamadūtairvṛtastataḥ || 81 || sa tūrṇaṃ tasya rājarṣe rurodha sakalāṃ purīm || śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau mahāghoraṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkaram || 82 || tacchutvā sa tu rājarṣi rjñātvā vaivasvataṃ yamam || sa sajjīkṛtasarvasvaḥ pattanānniryayau ruṣā || 83 || tayoryuddhamabhūttatra bhīṣaṇaṃ romaharṣaṇam || mṛtyuṃ kālaṃ tathā rogaṃ yamaṃ dūtapatiṃ tathā || 84 || jitvā kṣaṇena rājarṣirdrāvayāmāsa roṣataḥ || tataḥ kruddho yamo rājā svayamabhyetya taṃ ruṣā || 85 || yuyodha bahubhirbāṇaiḥ siṃhanādaṃ cakāra ha || cakarta rājā tasyā'pi kārmukaṃ viśikhaistribhiḥ || 86 || punaścarmāsimādāya yamo haṃtumathā''gamat || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu nṛpaḥ kruddhaḥ punaśchittvā'sicarmaṇī || 87 || nicakhāna lalāṭe ca śaraṃ kāloragaprabham || yamastenā''hataḥ kruddhastato daṃḍamupādade || brahmāstreṇa ca saṃmaṃtrya daṇḍaṃ tasmai mumoca ha || 88 || hāhākāro mahānāsījjanānāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā || tadā viṣṇuḥ svabhaktasya rakṣāyai prāhiṇodari || 89 || viṣṇumuktaṃ tadā cakraṃ śīghramāgatya tadraṇe || yamadaṇḍena saṃyudhya tadbrahmāstraṃ nivārya ca ||2.7.11.90|| yamaṃ haṃtumathārebhe sahasrāraṃ mahādbhutam || devabhaktastato bhītastadā'stauccakramañjasā ||91|| sahasrāra namaste'stu viṣṇupāṇivibhūṣaṇa || tvaṃ sarvalokarakṣāyai hariṇā ca dhṛtaṃ purā || 92 || tvāṃ yāce'dya yamaṃ trātuṃ viṣṇubhaktaṃ mahābalam || 93 || nṛṇāṃ devadruhāṃ kālastvameva hi na cā'paraḥ|| tasmādenaṃ yamaṃ rakṣa kṛpāṃ kuru jagatpate || 94 || nṛpeṇaivaṃ stutaṃ cakraṃ yamaṃ hitvā nṛpāṃtikam || punaryayau mahārāja devānāṃ paśyatāṃ divi || 95 || tato yamo'tinirviṇṇo brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ yayau || sa dadarśa samāsīnaṃ mūrtāmūrtajanairvṛtam ||96|| dhuvāśrayaṃ jagadbījaṃ sarvalokapitāmaham|| upāsyamānaṃ vibudhairlokapālairdigīśvaraiḥ || 97 || itihāsapurāṇādyairdevairvigrahasaṃsthitaiḥ || mūrtimadbhiḥ samudraiśca nadībhiśca sarovaraiḥ || 98 || dehavadbhistathā vṛkṣairaśvatthādyairaśeṣitaiḥ || vāpīkūpataḍāgaiśca mūrtimadbhiśca parvataiḥ || 99 || ahorātraistathā pakṣairmāsaiḥ saṃvatsaraistathā || kalākāṣṭhā nimeṣaiśca ṛtubhiścā'yanairyugaiḥ || 2.7.11.100 || saṃkalpaiśca vikalpaiśca nimiṣonmeṣaṇaistathā || ṛkṣairyogaiśca karaṇaiḥ pūrṇimābhiḥ susaṃkṣayaiḥ || 101 || sukhairduḥkhairbhayaiścaiva lābhā'lābhairjayājayaiḥ|| sattvena rajasā caiva tamasā ca samanvitam ||102|| śāṃtamūḍhā'tiprauḍhaiśca vikāraiḥ prākṛtairapi || vāyunā devadevena śleṣmapittādibhirvṛtam || 103 || teṣāṃ madhye'viśatsauriḥ savrīḍā ca vadhūryathā || vilokayandharāpṛṣṭhaṃ mlānavaktraṃ vyadarśayat ||104|| saṃpraviṣṭaṃ yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakāśasthaṃ sahānugam || vismitāste mithaḥ procuḥ kimarthaṃ bhāskaristviha || 105 || saṃprāpto lokakartāraṃ draṣṭuṃ devaṃ pitāmaham || nirvyāpāraḥ kṣaṇamapi yo'yaṃ nāsti raveḥ sutaḥ || 106 || so'yamabhyāgataḥ kasmātkaccitkṣemaṃ divaukasām || āścaryā'tiśayo'yaṃ ca saṃmārjitapaṭastvayam ||107|| lekhakastamanuprāpto dainyena mahatā'nvitaḥ || na kadācitpaṭo hyasya mārjito dharmabhīruṇā ||108|| yanna dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vā'pi tadihā'dya prapadyate || evamuccaratāṃ teṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhūtaśāsanaḥ || niṣpapātā'grato bhūmau brahmaṇo ravinaṃdanaḥ ||109|| kṛttamūlo yathā śākhī trāhitrāhīti vai rudan|| paribhūto'smi deveśa saṃmārjitapaṭaḥkṛtaḥ ||2.7.11.110|| tvayi nāthe na viphalaṃ paśyāmi kamalāsana || 111 || evamuktvā hi niśceṣṭo babhūva nṛpasattama || tataḥ kolāhalaḥ śabdaḥ sabhāyāṃ samajāyata || || 112 || yo hi khedayate martyānsarvānsthāvarajaṃgamān || sa vai rudati duḥkhārtaḥ kasmādvaivasvato yamaḥ || 134|| janasaṃtāpakarttā yaḥ socirādyātyaśobhanam || nahi duṣkṛtakarttā hi naraḥ prāpnoti śobhanam || 114 || tato nivārayāmāsa vāyusteṣāṃ vacastadā || lokānāṃ samavetānāṃ mataṃ jñātvā sa vedhasaḥ || 115 || nivārya lokānmārtaṃḍi śanairutthāpayanmarut || bhujābhyāṃ śālapīnābhyāṃ lokasūtra udāradhīḥ ||116|| vihvalaṃ taṃ parāyattamāsane saṃnyaveśayat || āsanasthamuvācedaṃ vyomasūnū raveḥ sutam || 117 || kena tvamabhibhūto'si kena sthānānnivāritaḥ || kenā'yaṃ mārjito deva paṭo lekhapaṭastava ||118|| brūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇa kuto haitostvamāgataḥ || yaḥ prabhustāta sarveṣāṃ sa te kartā mamā'pi ca || api kasmācca mārtaṃḍe duḥkhaṃ hṛdayasaṃsthitam ||119|| sa evamuktaḥ śvasanena satyamādityasūnurvacanaṃ babhāṣe || vilokya vaktraṃ kuśaketusūnoḥ sagadgadaṃ cedamaho'tidīnam || 2.7.11.120 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde kīrtimadvijayavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || cha ||
<2.7.12>
|| yama uvāca || || śṛṇu me vacanaṃ nātha lopito'haṃ pitāmaha || maraṇādadhikaṃ manye matpadasya ca khaṇḍanam || 1 || niyogī na niyogaṃ hi karoti kamalāsana || prabhorvittaṃ samaśnāti sa bhavetkāṣṭhakīṭakaḥ || 2 || yo'śnāti lobhādvittāni prajñāvāṃśca mahīpate || sa tiryagyoni narake yāti kalpaśatatrayam || 3 || niḥspṛho nā''caredyastu niyogaṃ padmasaṃbhava || bhuktvā tu narakānghorānsa pumānvāyaso bhavet || 4 || ātmakāryaparo yastu svāmikāryaṃ viluṃpati || bhavedveśmani pāpātmā ākhuḥ kalpaśatatrayam || 5 || niyogī yaśca bhūtvā vai tiṣṭhannityaṃ svaveśmani || śaktastu kāryakaraṇe mārjāro jāyate naraḥ || 6 || so'haṃ deva tavādeśātprajā dharmeṇa sādhaye || puṇyena puṇyakartāraṃ pāpaṃ pāpena karmaṇā || 7 || samyagvicārya munibhirdharmaśāstrānvitaiḥ prabho || kalpādau vartamānasya yātanā dāpayanmama || 8 || kartuṃ niyogamevaṃ hi tvadīyo naiva śaknuyām || rājñā kīrtimatā bhagno niyogastava ca kṣitau || 9 || bhayādasya jagannātha pṛthivīṃ sāgarāmbarām || vaiśākhadharmasahitāṃ pālayanvartate kvacit || 2.7.12.10 || vihāya sarvadharmāṃśca vihāya pitṛpūjanam || vihāyā'gnisaparyāṃ tu tīrtha yātrādisatkriyāḥ || 11 || yogasāṃkhyāvubhau tyaktvā tyaktvā prāṇanirodhanam || tyaktvā homaṃ ca svādhyāyaṃ kṛtvā pāpāni bhūriśaḥ || 12 || prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ kṛtvā vaiśākhasatkriyāḥ || manujāḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ tathaiva ca pitāmahaiḥ ||13|| teṣāmatītapitaraḥ pitṝṇāṃ pitarastathā || tathā mātāmahā yāṃti teṣāṃ vai janakādayaḥ || 14 || teṣāmapi ca netāro janitrīṇāṃ ca pūrvajāḥ || etadduḥkhaṃ punardeva mama mastakabhedanam ||15|| priyāyāḥ pitaro yānti mārjayitvā lipiṃ mama || pitṝṇāṃ bījajo yastu dhātryā kukṣau dhṛto vibho || 16 || yadaṃkena kṛtaṃ karma tadekenaiva bhujyate || tannirasya kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jānaṃstvekaḥ kule tu yaḥ || 17 || tārayettāvubhau pakṣau ṣaḍviṃśoparyalaṃ vibho || priyāyāścā'pi vai tāta sarve vai kukṣisaṃbhavāḥ || 18 || te'pi sarve jagannātha yānti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || na me prayojanaṃ deva niyogenedṛśena vai || 19 || vaiśākhadharmanirataḥ sa māṃ tyaktvā vrajeddharim || triḥsaptakulamuddhatya tyaktapāpo'tiśobhanaḥ || 2.7.12.20 || sa tyaktvā mama mārgaṃ hi prayāti harimaṃdiram || na yajñaistādṛśairdeva gatiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 21 || sarvatīrthairna dānādyairna tapobhiśca na vrataiḥ || api vā sakalairdharmairyukto nā'pnoti tāṃ gatim|| 22 || | prayāgapātādraṇamadhyapātādbhṛgośca pātānmaraṇācca kāśyām || na tāṃ gatiṃ yāṃti janāśca sarve vaiśākhaniṣṭhena ca yā prapadyate || 23 || prātaḥ snātvā devapūjāṃ ca kṛtvā śrutvā kathāṃ māsamāhātmyasaṃjñām || dharmānkṛtvā cocitānvaiṣṇavāṃśca sa vai bhavedviṣṇulokaikanāthaḥ || 24 || apramāṇamahaṃ manye lokaṃ viṣṇorjagatpateḥ || yo na pūryeta koṭyoghaiḥ sarvataḥ kamalāsana || 25 || mādhavāvasatheneha samastena pitāmaham || vikarmasthā'vikarmasthāḥ śucayo'śucayastathā ||26|| kṛtvā vaiśākhakṛtyāni lokā yānti nṛpā''jñayā || yo'smākaṃ hi mahacchatrurbhavatāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ||27|| nigrāhyo jagatāṃ nātha bhavatā'sau mahīpatiḥ || hitvā hi sakalāndharmānsakṛdvaiśākhasnānataḥ || 28 || asaṃskṛtajanā yāṃti vaikuṇṭhaṃ harimaṃdiram || asmābhistu kṛtopekṣo liṇupādaikasaṃśrayaḥ || 29 || samastaṃ neṣyate lokaṃ pārthivo nātra saṃśayaḥ || eṣa daṇḍapaṭo hyadya tava padbhyāṃ niveditaḥ |2.7.12.30|| lokapālatvamatulamarjitaṃ tena bhūbhujā|| kimapatyena jātena mātuḥ kleśaṃkareṇa vai||31|| yo na pātayate śatruṃ jyeṣṭhamāsīva bhāskaraḥ || vṛthāsutā hi yuvatirjātā ceddhi kuputriṇī ||32|| na tasyāḥ sphurate kīrtirghanasyeva śatahradā || yatpiturnoddharetpāpādvidyayā vā balena vā ||33|| māturjaṭharajo rogaḥ sa prasūto dharātale || dharme cā'rthe ca kāme ca yatpratīpo bhavetsutaḥ || 34 || mātṛhā hyucyate sadbhiḥ sa putraḥ puruṣādhamaḥ || tanmātā nṛpapatnī ca lokavikhyātasatkriyā || 35 || ekaiva vīrasūrloke vīraḥ sa nātra saṃśayaḥ || yathā vai kīrtimāñjāto mallipermārjanāya vai || || 36 || nedaṃ vyavasitaṃ deva kenacitkṣatriyeṇa hi || purāṇeṣu jagannātha na śrutaṃ paṭamārjanam || 37 || so'haṃ na jānāmi jagatpatīśa ṛte kṣitīśaṃ haritatparaṃ tam || pracodayantaṃ paṭahaṃ sughoṣādvilopayānaṃ mama veśmamārgam || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde yamaduḥkhanirūpaṇaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || cha || ||
<2.7.13>
|| || brahmovāca || || kimāścaryaṃ tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ kimarthaṃ khidyate bhavān || sadgaṇeṣu kṛtastāpaḥ sa tāpo maraṇāṃtikaḥ ||1|| tasyoccāraṇamātreṇa prāpyate paramaṃ padam || na gacchaṃti harerlokaṃ kathaṃ bhūpasya śāsanāt || 2 || eko'pi govindakṛtaḥ praṇāmaḥ śatāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ || yajñasya karttā punareti janma hareḥ praṇāmo na punarbhavāya || 3 || kurukṣetreṇa kiṃ tasya sarasvatyā ca kiṃ tathā || jihvāgre vartate yasya harirityakṣaradvayam || 4 || brāhmaṇaḥ śvapacīṃ bhuṃjanviśeṣeṇa rajasvalām || yadi viṣṇuṃ sa maraṇe smarennāpnoti tatpadam || 5 || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇājjātaṃ vihāyāghasya saṃcayam || prayāti viṣṇusāyujyaṃ yato viṣṇupriyā smṛtiḥ || 6 || evaṃ viṣṇupriyo māso vaiśākho nāma vai yama || yaddharmaśravaṇādeva mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 7 || yātīti kimu vaktavyaṃ tasyānuṣṭhānatatparaḥ || yasminsaṃgīyate yo hi prīyate puruṣottamaḥ || 8 || kathaṃ na yāti ca gatiṃ tasyā'nuṣṭhānata tparaḥ || asmākaṃ jagatāṃ nātho janitā puruṣottamaḥ || 9 || tasyeṣṭānmādhave māsi dharmānetānkarotvayam || tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā sahāye sarvadā sthitaḥ || 2.7.13.10 || na tasya bhūpateḥ saure samarthastvaṃ ca śikṣaṇe || na vāsudevabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit || janmamṛtyujarāvyādhi bhayaṃ naivopajāyate || 11 || niyogī svāmikāryeṣu yāvacchakti samīhate || tāvatā sa kṛtārthaḥ syānnarakānnaiva gacchati || 12 || kārye śakti viniṣkrānte svāmine ca nivedayet || anṛṇastāvatā bhṛtyo niyogī sukhamaśnute || 13 || tasmānniveditārthasya na ṛṇaṃ na ca pātakam || yatne kṛte svakartavye nāparādhosti dehinaḥ || 14 || tasmādaśakyakārye'sminna viśocitumarhasi || 15 || ityukto brahmaṇā sauriḥ punaratyaṃtakhinnadhīḥ || uvāca dīnayā vācā galadvāṣpā''kulekṣaṇaḥ || 16 || prāptaṃ tāta mayā sarvaṃ tvadaṃghribhajanena vai || nā'haṃ yāsye punaḥ kartuṃ niyogaṃ padmasaṃbhava || 17 || praśāsati mahāvīrye bhūpe'sminbhūmimaṇḍale || cālayitvā svadharmāṃśca tamekaṃ bhūpatiṃ vibho ||17|| kṛtakṛtyo'smi tanayo gayāyāṃ piṇḍado yathā|| kṛpālo tadidaṃ kāryaṃ sādhayasva mamāvyayam || 19 || vijvarastu tato bhūyaḥ śāsanaṃ te karomyaham || śrutvā brahmā yamenoktaṃ punaściṃtāparāyaṇaḥ || || 2.7.13.20 || tamuvāca punarbrahmā sāṃtvayanbahudhāpyamum || || brahmovāca || || na nirgrāhyastvayā rājā viṣṇudharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 21 || yadi cchalayase kopādgacchāmo hyaṃtikaṃ hareḥ || nivedya sakalaṃ tasmai karma paścāttadīritam || 22 || sa eva karttā lokasya dharmasya paripālakaḥ || sa ca daṇḍadharo'smākaṃ śāstā karttā niyāmakaḥ ||23|| na tadukte'sti pratyuktirasmākaṃ vihitā vṛṣa || na rājoktestu pratyuktirdṛśyate kvā'pi bhūtale|| 24 || ityāśvāsya yamaṃ tena sākaṃ kṣīrāṃbudhiṃ yayau || brahmā tuṣṭāva cinmātraṃ nirguṇaṃ parameśvaram || 25 || sāṃkhyayogairadvitīyamekaṃ taṃ puruṣottamam || āvirāsīttadā viṣṇurbrahmaṇā saṃstuto hariḥ || 26 || praṇāmaṃ cakratustasmai yamo brahmā ca satvaram || tāvuvāca mahāviṣṇurmeghagaṃbhīrayā girā || || 27 || kasmādyuvāmihā''yātau kiṃ duḥkhaṃ danujairabhūt || mlānaṃ yamamukhaṃ kasmātkena vā natakaṃdharaḥ || 28 || etadvadasva me brahmannityuktaścāha kaṃjajaḥ || tvaddāsavarye bhūpāle bhūmiṃ śāsati vai narāḥ || 29 || vaiśākhadharmaniratā yāṃti te paramavyayam || tato yamapurī śūnyā tena cā'tīvaduḥkhitaḥ || 2.7.13.30 || tena yuddhaṃ cakārā'sau haṃtuṃ daṃḍamathā'dade || tvaccakreṇa parābhūto yayāvadya mamāntikam || 31 || na ca śakto vayaṃ daṃḍaṃ tvadbhaktānāṃ mahātmanām || tasmāttvāmeva śaraṇaṃ vayaṃ prāptā mahāvibho || 32 || tasmādbhūpaṃ daṃḍayitvā pālayainaṃ yamaṃ svakam || ityuktaḥ prahasanprāha brahmāṇaṃ yamameva ca || 33 || lakṣmīṃ vā'pi parityakṣye prāṇāndehamathā'pi vā || śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ mālāṃ vaijayaṃtīmathā'pi vā ||34|| śvetadvīpaṃ ca vaikuṃṭhaṃ kṣīrasāgarameva ca|| śeṣaṃ ca garuḍaṃ caiva na bhaktaṃ tyaktumutsahe || 35 || vissṛjya sakalānbhogānmadarthe tyaktajīvitān || madātmakānmahābhāgānkathaṃ tāṃstyaktumutsahe || 36 || tasmāttvadduḥkhaśamane hyupāyaṃ kalpayāmyaham || tasya cāyurmayā dattamayutaṃ bhūpaterbhuvi || 37 || gatānyaṣṭau sahasrāṇi tatredānīṃ narāṃtaka || āyuḥśeṣe tena nīte matsāyujyaṃ gate'pi ca||38|| bhaviṣyati tato rājā veno nāma durātmavān|| sa luṃpati mahādharmānsarvānetāñchrutīritān ||39|| tadā vaiśākhadharmāśca vicchinnā syurna saṃśayaḥ || svakṛtenaiva pāpena veno dagdho bhaviṣyati ||2.7.13.40|| paścādahaṃ pṛthurbhūtvā punardharmānpravartaye || tadā janeṣu prakhyātānvaiśākhoktānkaromyaham ||41|| madbhakto madgataprāṇo yastu vinyastasaṃgrahaḥ || ekaḥ sahasre bhavitā tasya prakhyāpayeddhi tān || 42 || kaścideva hi jānātu dharmānetānkṣitau mama || tataste bhavitā kāryaṃ mā viṣīda narāṃtaka || 43 || dāpayiṣyāmi te bhāgaṃ māse'sminmādhave'pi ca || naraiḥ sarvaiśca vaiśākhadharmaniṣṭhairmahātmabhiḥ || 44 || bhūpenā'pi ca kālena khedaṃ śamaya tena ca || vīryaśulkaṃ tu te bhāgaṃ śatrorbhuṃkte balādhikāt|| 45 || gṛhṇangṛhṇansvakaṃ bhāgaṃ na bhāgī duḥkhamarhati || tvāmuddiśya na kurvaṃti pratyahaṃ ye narā bhuvi ||46|| snānaṃ cārghyaṃ sodakuṃbhaṃ dadhyannaṃ cāṃtime dine || vaiśākhe sakalaṃ karma teṣāṃ ca viphalaṃ bhavet || 47 || tasmātkrodhaṃ tyaja nṛpe bhāgade matparāyaṇe || ye ke cā'pi ca kurvaṃti loke te bhāgadā narāḥ || 48 || vaiśākhokte mahādharme teṣāṃ vighnaṃ ca mā kuru || māmeva ye yajaṃtyaddhā tvāṃ hitvā dharmapālakam || 49 || madājñayā mahābhāga tadā daṃḍaṃ ca tvaṃ kuru || nṛpādbhāgaṃ dāpayituṃ sunaṃdaṃ preṣayāmi ca ||2.7.13.50 || macchāsanātsa vai gatvā bhāgaṃ te dāpayiṣyati || tiṣṭhatyevaṃ yame svasya sannidhau garuḍāsanaḥ || 51 || sunandaṃ preṣayāmāsa nṛpaṃ bodhayituṃ vibhuḥ || so'pi gatvā bodhayitvā pārśvaṃ ca punarāgamat || 52 || ityāśvāsya yamaṃ viṣṇustatraivāntaradhīyata || yamaṃ svayaṃ sāṃtvayitvā samanujñāpya vegataḥ || 53 || ativismayamāpanno yayau dhāma sahānugaiḥ || yamo'pi svapurīṃ prāyātkiṃcitsaṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 54 || paścādviṣṇornideśena sunandaparibodhitaḥ || bhāgadāḥ sakalā lokā ye vaiśākhaparāyaṇāḥ || 55 || dharmarājaṃ puraskṛtya ye na kurvaṃti mānavāḥ || teṣāṃ hi svayamādatte puṇyaṃ vaiśākhasaṃbhavam || 56 || kuryācca pratyahaṃ snānaṃ dadyādarghyaṃ yamāya vai || vaiśākhe sakalaṃ puṇyamanyathā viphalaṃ bhavet || 57 || sodakumbhaṃ ca dadhyannaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca mādhave || dharmarājaṃ samuddiśya dātavyaṃ prathamaṃ janaiḥ || 58 || paścātpitṝnsamuddiśya gurumuddiśya vai naraḥ || madhusūdanamuddiśya paścāddevaṃ janārdanam || 59 || śītalodakadadhyannaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ ca sadakṣiṇam || saphalaṃ kāṃsyapātrasthaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 2.7.13.60 || dadyācca pratimāṃ divyāṃ madhusūdanadevatām || māsadharmapravaktre ca dadyādviprāya sīdate || 61 || tameva dharmavaktāraṃ pūjayedvibhavaiḥ svakaiḥ || ityādiṣṭaḥ sunandena tathā rājā cakāra ha || 62 || sa nītvā cāyuṣaḥ śeṣaṃ bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān || putrapautrādibhiryukto jagāma harimaṃdiram || 63 || vaikuṇṭhasthe nṛpe tasminveno rājā'dhamo'bhavat || sarve dharmāśca vaiśākhadharmā api viśeṣataḥ || 64 || durātmanā ca tenaiva luptā eva babhūvire || na prakhyātāḥ punarbhūmau bhūriśo mokṣahetavaḥ || 65 || yaḥ kaścinnaiva jānāti vaiśākhoktānimāñcchubhān || bahujanmārjite puṇyaparipāka upāgate || || 66 || vaiśākhokteṣu dharmeṣu matirātyantikī bhavet || || maithila uvāca || || pūrvamanvaṃtarastho hi veno rājā durātmavān || 67 || ayaṃ vaivasvatastho hi rājā cekṣvākunaṃdanaḥ || iti śrutaṃ mayā pūrvamidānīṃ cocyate tvayā || 68 || ayaṃ vaikuṇṭhagaḥ paścādveno rājā bhaviṣyati || ityetaṃ saṃśayaṃ chiṃdhi śrutadeva mahāmate || 69 || || śrutadeva uvāca || || purāṇeṣu ca vaiṣamyaṃ yugakalpavyavasthayā || na cāprāmāṇyaśaṃkā te kathāyā vyatyaye kvacit || 2.7.13.70 || gate dainaṃdine kalpe yathaiṣā śāśvatī śubhā || mārkaṇḍeyena me proktā sā coktā tava bhūpate || 71 || tasmānna khyātimāyānti dharmā vaiśākhasaṃbhavāḥ || kaścideva hi jānāti virakto viṣṇutatparaḥ || 72 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāṃbarīṣasaṃvāde yamaduḥkhasāṃtvanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || || cha ||
<2.7.14>
|| śrutadeva uvāca || || yaḥ prātaḥ snāti vaiśākhe meṣasaṃsthe divākare || madhusūdanamabhyarcya kathāṃ śrutvā harerimām || 1 || sa tu pāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || vācyamānāṃ kathāṃ hitvā yo'nyāṃ seveta mūḍhadhīḥ ||2 || rauravaṃ narakaṃ prāpya paiśācīṃ yonimāpnuyāt || atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || 3 || pāpaghnaṃ pāvanaṃ dharmyaṃ sadyo vaṃdyaṃ purātanam || purā godāvarītīre kṣetre brahmeśvare śubhe || 4 || durvāsaśiṣyau paramahaṃsau brahmaikaniṣṭhitau || sadaivopaniṣadvidyāniṣṭhitau nirapekṣitau || 5 || bhikṣāmātrāśinau puṇyau tau guhāvāsināvubhau || satyaniṣṭhataponiṣṭhāviti khyātau jagattraye || 6 || tayormadhye satyaniṣṭhaḥ sadā viṣṇukathāparaḥ || śrotṝṇāmapyabhāve ca vyākhyātṝṇāṃ tathā nṛpa || 7 || tadā karmakalā nityāḥ karotyaddhā munīśvaraḥ || śrotā cedasti yaḥ kaścittasmai vyākhyā tyaharniśam || 8 || yadi vyākhyāti kaścidvā puṇyāṃ viṣṇukathāṃ śubhām || tadā saṃkucya karmāṇi śṛṇoti śravaṇe rataḥ || 9 || atidūrasthatīrthāni devatāyatanāni ca || hitvā kathāvirodhīni tathā karmāṇi bhūriśaḥ || 2.7.14.10 || śṛṇoti ca kathāṃ divyāṃ śrotṛbhyo vakti vai svayam || vinā kathāṃ na jānāti sevyamanyannareśvara || 11 || vyākhyāti ca gṛhe svasya vaktā rogādyupadrutaḥ || kūpasnānaparo bhūtvā śṛṇotyeva kathāṃ muniḥ || 12 || kathāyāśca virāme tu svakṛtyaṃ sādhayatyalam || kathāṃ vai śṛṇvataḥ puṃso janmamabandho na vidyate || 13 || sattvaśuddhistato viṣṇāvaratiścaiva gacchati || ratiśca jāyate viṣṇau sauhṛdaṃ caiva sādhuṣu || 14 || nīrajaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma sadyo hṛdyavarudhyate || jñānahīnasya vai puṃsaḥ karma vai niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 15 || bahudhā caritaṃ cā'pi yathaivāṃdhakadarpaṇam || karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni bahudhā śocitātmabhiḥ || 16 || sattvaśuddhyai bhavaṃtyeva sattvaśuddhyā śrutiṃ vrajet || śrutestu jñānamāsādya jñātvā dhyānāya kalpate || 17 || bahudhā śravaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ mananaṃ śruticoditam || yatra viṣṇukathā nāsti yatra sādhujanā nahi || 18 || sākṣādgaṃgātaṭaṃ vā'pi tyājyameva na saṃśayaḥ || yaddeśe tulasī nāsti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma vā śubham|| 19 || yatra viṣṇukathā nāsti mṛtastatra tamo vrajet || yadgrāme vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma nāsti kṛṣṇamṛgo'pi vā ||2.7.14.20|| yatra viṣṇukathā nāsti sādhavo vā tadāśrayāḥ || mṛtastatra pumānkṣipraṃ śvānayoniśataṃ vrajet ||21|| vicāryopaniṣadvidyāmiti niścitya vai muniḥ || sadā viṣṇukathā''sakto viṣṇusmṛtiparāyaṇaḥ || 22 || na kiṃcidadhikaṃ jātu manyate śravaṇātparam || itarastu taponiṣṭhaḥ karmaniṣṭho durāgrahī || 23 || na vyākhyāti svayaṃ vā'pi na śṛṇoti ca satkathām || vācyamānāṃ kathāṃ hitvā tīrthasnānāya gacchati ||24 || tīrthe'pi ca pravṛttāyāṃ kathāyāṃ bhūmipālaka || karmalopabhayāddūraṃ yāti cāṃcalyaśaktitaḥ ||25|| vrajaṃti gṛhakṛtyārthaṃ saṃgamātparato janāḥ || na śrotāro na vaktārastasya pārśve tu karmiṇaḥ ||26|| durātmanastu durbuddheḥ kāla evaṃ kṣayaṃ gate || jihvāṃ śrutiṃ ca na kvāpi saṃprāptā hi kathā vibhoḥ ||27|| aśrotṛtvādavaktṛtvāddurbuddhitvāddurāgrahāt || paścātpaṃcatvamāsādya sadyo dharmeṇa vai muniḥ || 28 || piśāco'bhūcchamīvṛkṣe cchinnakarṇāhvayo'balaḥ || nirāśrayo nirāhāraḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ ||29|| evaṃ vai khidyamānasya samā divyāyutā gatāḥ || nāpaśyatsvasya trātāraṃ nirāhāro'tiduḥkhitaḥ || 2.7.14.30 || svakṛtaṃ ciṃtayānaśca mattonmatta ivābhramat || kṣudhayā paryaṭanvā'pi nirvṛtiṃ nāpa mūḍhadhīḥ || 31 || kṛśānusadṛśo vāyuraṃgaṃ spṛṣṭvā kṛtātmanaḥ || kālāgnitulyā āpaśca phalapuṣpādikaṃ viṣam || 32 || na kvāpi sukhamāpede karmaṭho dīnadhīrayam || evaṃ vyavasite tasminnaraṇye janavarjite || 33 || kathayā rahite kṣetre svāśraye sādhuvarjite || daivādāyātsatyaniṣṭhastadā paiṭhinasīṃ purīm || 34 || gacchanmārge dadarśā'sau chinnakarṇaṃ vahuvyatham || dṛṣṭvā''tmānaṃ drāvayantaṃ rudaṃtaṃ kṣudhayā''turam || 35 || mā bhaiṣīriti cābhāṣya ko'sītyāha munīśvaraḥ || daśedṛśī ca kasmātte na te duḥkhamataḥ param|| || 36 || ityāśvasto'munā cchinnakarṇaḥ prāhātivihvalaḥ || taponiṣṭho yatirahaṃ śiṣyo durvāsasaḥ param || 37 || brahmeśvarakṣetravāsī karmaniṣṭho durāgrahī || karmalopabhayānmauḍhyānmayā durbuddhinā mune || 38 || sādhubhirvācyamānā'pi nādṛtā viṣṇusatkathā || na vyākhyātā ca śrotṛbhyaḥ kathā karmanikṛtaṃnī || 39 || tena karmavipākena mahatā'haṃ mṛtiṃ gataḥ || chinnakarṇo'bhavaṃ nāmnā piśāco duḥkhavihvalaḥ || 2.7.14.40 || na paśyāmi ca trātāraṃ duḥkhādasmātkathaṃcana || tava dṛṣṭipathaṃ yāto diṣṭayā'haṃ gatakalmaṣaḥ || 41 || adya me devatāstuṣṭā guravaḥ sādhavaśca ye || hariśca me prasanno'bhūdyataste darśanaṃ mama || 42 || papāta pādayorbhūmau trāhitrāhīti vai rudan || tatastu kṛpayā''viṣṭaḥ satyaniṣṭho mahāyaśāḥ ||43|| dorbhyāmutthāpayāmāsa śaṃtamābhyāṃ munīśvaraḥ || tatastvapa upaspṛśya dadau puṇyamanuttamam ||44|| vaiśākhamāsamāhātmyaśravaṇasya muhūrtajam || tena puṇyaprabhāvena sadyo dhvastākhilāśubhaḥ || 45 || piśācadehanirmukto divyadehadharo'bhavat || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya taṃ praṇamya mahāmunim ||46|| āmaṃtrya ca parikramya yayau viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || satyaniṣṭhastato dhīmānyayau paiṭhinasīṃ purīm || 47 || māhātmyaśravaṇasyaivaṃ ciṃtayānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || || śrutadeva uvāca || || yatra viṣṇukathā puṇyā śubhā lokamalā'pahā || 48 || tatra sarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi vividhāni ca || yatra pravahate puṇyā śubhā viṣṇukathā''pagā || 49 || taddeśavāsināṃ muktiḥ karasaṃsthā na saṃśayaḥ || 2.7.14.50 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde kathāpraśaṃsāyāṃ piśācamuktiprāptirnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || || cha ||
<2.7.15>
|| śrutadeva uvāca || || bhūyaḥ śṛṇuṣva bhūpāla māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || vaiśākhasya ca māsasya vallabhasya madhudviṣaḥ || 1 || purā pāṃcāladeśe tu rājā puruyaśo'bhavat || tanayo bhūriyaśasaḥ puṇyaśīlasya dhīmataḥ || 2 || pitaryuparate bhūpa rājyastho dharmalālasaḥ || śauryaudāryaguṇopeto dhanurvidyāviśāradaḥ || 3 || śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ svadharmeṇa mahāmatiḥ || pūrvajanmajalādānāddoṣeṇa mahatā vṛtaḥ || 4 || saṃpaddhānimavāpā'sau kālena kiyatā'nagha || hayā gajā mṛtiṃ yātā mahadrogeṇa pīḍitāḥ || 5 || durbhikṣamatulaṃ cāsīnnirmānuṣyavidhāyakam || rājyaṃ kośaṃ tadā cā''sīdgajabhuktakapitthavat || 6 || balahīnaṃ nṛpaṃ jñātvā kośarāṣṭravivarjitam || taṃ jetumeṣa samaya iti niścitamānasāḥ || 7 || ājagmuḥ śataśo bhūpā ripavastasya bhūpateḥ || jigyuryuddhena taṃ bhūpaṃ pāṃcālaviṣayādhipam || 8 || parājitastato rājā viveśa girigahvare || śikhinyā bhāryayā sākaṃ dhātryādigaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 9 || ajñātapaddhatiścānyairbahuduḥkhasamākulaḥ || tripaṃcāśatsamāścaiva nītāstena vilīyatā || 2.7.15.10 || cintayāmāsa bhūpālaḥ kimetaditi bhūriśaḥ || karmaṇā janmaśuddho'haṃ mātṛpitṛhite rataḥ || 11 || gurubhaktaḥ sadākṣiṇyo brahmaṇyo dharmatatparaḥ || dayāvānsarvabhūteṣu devabhakto jitendriyaḥ|| 12 || na bhrātā me na putro me na ca me suhṛdo hitāḥ || dayāpauruṣavikhyātāḥ kulīnasyā'pi me kutaḥ || 13 || kena vā karmaṇā cāptaṃ dāridryaṃ bhūriduḥkhadam || kena vā'pajayo me'dya kena vā vanavāsitā || 14 || iti cintākulo rājā guruṃ sasmāra khinnadhīḥ|| yājopayājakau nāma sarvajñau munisattamau || 15 || ājagmaturmunīdrau tau rājñāhūtau mahāmatī || tau dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya rājā pāṃcālavallabhaḥ || 16 || nanāma śirasā bhaktyā pravāsenā'tipīḍitaḥ || rājacihnavihīnaśca kenāpyajñātapaddhatiḥ || 17 || tūṣṇīṃ tasthau muhūrtaṃ hi patitvā bhuvi pādayoḥ || dorbhyāmutthāpitastābhyāṃ parimṛṣṭā'śrulocanaḥ || 18 || vidhivatpūjayāmāsa vanyairevā'rhaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ || sūpaviṣṭau tu tau viprau papracchā''natakandharaḥ 511 || brāhmaṇau vadataṃ duḥkhakāraṇaṃ ca kṣitīśituḥ || karmaṇā janmaśuddhasya pitṛdevapriyasya ca || 2.7.15.20 || pāpabhīroḥ kṛpālośca gurubhaktasya me kutaḥ || dāridryaṃ kośahāniśca ripubhiśca parābhavaḥ || 21 || kasmādaraṇyavāsaśca kuta ekākitā mama || na putro na ca me bhrātā na hitāḥ suhṛdaśca me || || 22 || durbhikṣaṃ vā kutaścāsīddeśe matpālite'naghe || etadvistārya me brūtaṃ kāraṇaṃ munipuṃgavau || 23 || ityuktau tau muniśreṣṭhau bhūtenātyantaduḥkhinā || pratyūcaturmahātmānau kiṃciddhyānaparāyaṇau || 24 || || yājopayājakāvūcatuḥ || || śṛṇu bhūpa pravakṣyāvastava duḥkhasya kāraṇam || purā bhūpa mahāpāpī vyādhastvaṃ daśajanmasu ||25|| niṣṭhuraḥ sarvalokānāṃ sadā hiṃsāparāyaṇaḥ || dharmaleśākaraḥ kvāpi na damo na ca vai śamaḥ ||26|| na jihvā vakti nāmāni viṣṇorvāpi kathaṃcana || cetaḥ smarati govindacaraṇāṃburuhadvayam || 27 || na praṇāmaḥ kṛtaḥ kvāpi śirasā paramātmane || navajanmāni te bhūpa gatānyevaṃ durātmanaḥ || 28 || daśame janmani prāpte vyādhastvaṃ sahya bhūdhare || niṣṭhuraḥ sarvalokānāṃ narāṇāṃ tvaṃ narāṃtakaḥ || 29 || dayāhīnaḥ śastrajīvī sadā hiṃsāparāyaṇaḥ || nirguṇaḥ sakalatrastvaṃ mārgapīḍākaraḥ śaṭhaḥ|| 2.7.15.30 || prajānāṃ gauḍadeśyānāṃ rākṣaso mānuṣāśanaḥ || evaṃ cā bdānyatītāni naijaṃ hitamajānataḥ || 31 || bālāpatyamṛgāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇāṃ ca vadhāttava| || dayāhīnasya durbuddherjanmanyasminnaputratā || 32 || viśvāsaghātakatvena bhrātaro naiva sodarāḥ || mārgapīḍākaratvena suhṛjjanavivarjitaḥ || 33 || sādhūnāṃ ca tiraskārācchatrubhiste parājayaḥ || kadāpyadattadoṣeṇa dāridyaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe || 34 || sadaivodvegakāritvātpravāsaste durāsadaḥ || sarveṣāmapriyatvācca duḥkhamatyaṃtaduḥsaham || 35 || nirāhāropyataḥ pūrvaṃ sadā krūreṇa karmaṇā || tasmādrājyāpahāraste janmanyasminmahāmate || 36 || atha te satkulīnatve hetūṃścāpi bravīmyaham || yadā'bhūrgauḍadeśīyo hyaṃtime vyādhajanmani || 37 || svakarmanirate krūre vipine kaṇṭakāvile || tiṣṭhatyevaṃ dayāhīne sarvabhūtāṃtake pathi || 38 || vaiśyāvājagmaturdivyau dhanāḍhyau gharmapīḍitau || muniśca karṣaṇonāma vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || 39 || jaṭācīradharaḥ puṇyaḥ kamaṇḍaluparigrahaḥ || tāndṛṣṭvā dhanurādāya mārgaṃ ruddhvā vyavasthitaḥ || 2.7.15.40 || anudrutya śarī vaiśyau kṛtvā chinnaśarīrakau || tayorekaṃ ca tvaṃ hatvā gṛhītvā'khila tatpaṇam || 41 || aparaṃ hantumudyukte sa dudrāva bhayāddrutam || paṇaṃ gulme vinikṣipya bhītaḥ prāṇaparīpsakaḥ || || 42 || karṣaṇo'pi muniḥ śīghraṃ vyādhānmṛtiviśaṃkayā || ātape dhāvamānaḥ saṃstṛṣāgharmaprapīḍitaḥ || 43 || mūrcchāmāpa galatsvedaḥ saṃjñāmātrāvaśeṣitaḥ || vihāyainaṃ dudruve ca vaiśyo jīvanatatparaḥ || 44 || tvaṃ tāvanudrutau dṛṣṭvā mūrchitaṃ pathi bhūsuram || paṇaṃ kutra vinikṣiptaṃ kiyaddūraṃ gato vaṇik || 45 || iti pṛṣṭaṃ dvijaṃ śrāṃtamujjīvayitumudyataḥ || phūtkṛtvā karṇayostasya nāgaraṃ smṛtikāraṇam || 46 || palvalasthodakenaiva kṛmikardamasaṃyujā || netre saṃmṛjya śrāṃtasya parṇaiḥ saṃvījya tanmukhe || 47 || sasaṃjñaṃ ca muniṃ kṛtvā tvamāttha svasthamānasaḥ || mā śaṃkā te mune kāryā mattaḥ śastrabhṛto vane || 48 || niṣkiṃcanaḥ sukhī loke kutaste bhayamulbaṇam || bhinnapātreṇa jīrṇena na me kiṃcidbhaviṣyati || 49 || etāvadvada me vidvanvaṇikkutra palāyitaḥ || kutra gulme dhanaṃ kṣiptaṃ tena śīghraṃ palāyatā || 2.7.15.50 || anyathā tvāṃ haniṣyāmi yadi mithyā vadiṣyasi || || || karṣaṇa uvāca || || dhanaṃ gulme vinikṣiptaṃ mārgādasmātpalāyitaḥ ||51|| iti prāha bhayātsopi pṛṣṭaḥ prāṇaparīpsayā|| gaccha vipra sukhaṃ mārgaṃ matto bhītiṃ vihāya va || 52 || ito vidūre salilaṃ taḍāge vartate śubham || tatpītvā salilaṃ puṇyaṃ gaccha grāmaṃ gataśramaḥ || 53 || adhunaivāgamiṣyaṃti rājakīyāḥ pathā janāḥ || matpadānveṣaṇe saktāḥ śrutvā rāvaṃ vaṇikpateḥ || 54 || tṛṣārtamanugaṃtuṃ me na śakyaṃ tvāṃ tato dvija || vījayānena parṇena gharmaḥ kiṃcidgamiṣyati || 55 || tasmai dattvā palāśaṃ ca tvamāgā vipinaṃ punaḥ || tena puṇyaprabhāvena vaiśākhe gharmagharghare || 56 || svakāryārthaṃ kṛtenāpi munestrāṇāya paddhatau || janmāsītte mahāpuṇye rājavaṃśe'tivistṛte || 57 || yadīcchasi sukhaṃ rājyaṃ dhanadhānyādisaṃpadaḥ || svargāpavargau yadi vā sāyujyaṃ vā hareḥ padam || 58 || kuru vaiśākhadharmāṃstvaṃ sarvasaukhyamavāpsyasi || māso'yaṃ mādhavo nāma tṛtīyā cākṣayāhvayā || 59 || gāṃ ca sakṛtprasūtākhyāṃ dehi viprāya sīdate || tena te kośapūrtiḥ syācchayyāṃ dehi sukhaṃ bhavet || 2.7.15.60 || kuru cchatrapradānaṃ ca sāmrājyaṃ te bhaviṣyati || snānaṃ kuru yathānyāyaṃ tathaivārcaya mādhavam || 61 || dehi tvaṃ pratimāṃ divyāṃ kṛtvā tena jayo bhavet || ātmatulyaguṇānputrānyadi kāmayase nṛpa || 62 || sarvabhūtahitārthāya prapādānaṃ ca tvaṃ kuru || vaiśākhoktānimāndharmānsamyagācara bhūmipa || 63 || tena te sakalā lokā vaśaṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ || niṣkāmakena cittena yadi dharmānkariṣyasi || 64 || vaiśākhe puṇyamāse'sminprītaye madhughātinaḥ || pratyakṣo bhavitā viṣṇustavanirmalacetasaḥ || 65 || yena cācaritāḥ puṃsā dharmāhyete śubhāvahāḥ || teṣāṃ ca hyakṣayā lokāḥ purāṇe kavayo viduḥ|| || 66 || etatsarvaṃ tava proktaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam || iti rājānamāmaṃtrya brāhmaṇau ca purodhasau || 67 || yājopayājakaunāma jagmatustau yathāgatau || tato rājā mahāvīryaḥ purodhobhyāṃ ca bodhitaḥ || 68 || vaiśākhadharmātsakalāṃścakāra śraddhayā'nvitaḥ || yathopadiṣṭaṃ ca tathā madhusūdanamarcayat || 69 || tato labdhaprabhāvaḥ sanbaṃdhubhiḥ sakalairvṛtaḥ || pāṃcālanagarīṃ prāpa hataśeṣabalānvitaḥ || 2.7.15.70 || tatastu śatravo bhūpā upaśrutya ca bhūpateḥ || praveśaṃ ca purasyā'tha punarājagmuruddhatāḥ || 71 || tadā pāṃcālabhūpena nṛpāṇāmabhavadraṇam|| jigye sarvānmahābāhūneka eva mahārathaḥ || 72 || palāyiteṣu bhūpeṣu nānādeśapathiṣvapi || rājñāṃ kośagajānaśvānsvayaṃ jagrāha vīryavān || 73 || aśvānāṃ nirbudaṃ caiva gajānāṃ ca trikoṭikam || rathānāmarbudaṃ caiva dīrghagrīvāyutaṃ tathā || 74 || rāsabhāṇāṃ trilakṣāṇi prāpayāmāsa tāṃ purīm || vaiśākhadharmamāhātmyātkṣaṇātsarve ca bhūbhṛtaḥ || 75 || karadā bhagnasaṃkalpāḥ pādākrāṃtā babhūvire || subhikṣamatulaṃ cāsītpāṃcālaviṣayeṣu ca || 76 || ekacchatramabhūdrājyaṃ prasādānmadhughātinaḥ || putrāḥ paṃcā'pi tasyāsañcchauryyaudāryaguṇānvitāḥ || || 77 || dhṛṣṭakīrtirdhṛṣṭaketurdhṛṣṭadyumnastathā'pare || vijayaścitraketuśca mayūradhvajasannibhāḥ || 78 || anuraktāḥ prajāścāsandharmeṇa pratipālitāḥ || vaiśākhasya pratāpena pratyayastatkṣaṇādabhūt || 79 || punaścakāra tāndharmānpāṃcālanagarīśvaraḥ || akāmukena cittena prītaye madhughātinaḥ || 2.7.15.80 || dharmeṇānena saṃtuṣṭo bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || akṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ pratyakṣaḥ samajāyata || 81 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito bhūtvā paramātmānamacyutam || nārāyaṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṃkhacakagadādharam || 82 || pītāṃbaradharaṃ devaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || salakṣmīkaṃ sānugaṃ ca garuḍopari saṃsthitam || 83 || nirīkṣya duḥsahaṃ tejaḥ sadyo mīlitalocanaḥ || utpatansaṃpatanharṣānmattonmatta iva bhraman || || 84 || pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgo galadvāṣpākulekṣaṇaḥ || tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā prāṃjaliḥ praṇato bhuvi || 85 || iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsa māhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde pāṃcāladeśādhipaterjayaprāpti daridranāśavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || || cha ||
<2.7.16>
|| || śrutadeva uvāca || || taddarśanāhlādapariplutāśayaḥ sadyaḥ samutthāya nanāma mūrdhnā || ciraṃ nirīkṣyā''kulalocano hyamuṃ viśvātmadevaṃ jagatāmadhīśam || 1 || dadhāra pādāvavanijya tajjalaṃ yatpādajā''brahma jagatpunāti || samarcayāmāsa mahāvibhūtibhirmahārhavastrābharaṇānulepanaiḥ || 2 || sragdhūpadīpāmṛtabhakṣaṇādibhistvaggātravittātmasamarpaṇena || tuṣṭāva viṣṇuṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ nirguṇamadvitīyam || 3 || niraṃjanaṃ viśvasṛjāmadhīśaṃ vande paraṃ padmabhavādivaṃditam || yanmāyayā tattvaviduttamā janā vimohitā viśvasṛjāmadhīśvaram || || 4 || muhyaṃti māyācariteṣu mūḍhā guṇeṣu citraṃ bhagavadviceṣṭitam || anīha etadbahudhaika ātmanā sṛjatyavatyatti na sajjate'pyatha || 5 || samastadevāsurasaukhyaduḥkhaprāptyai bhavānpūrṇamanoratho'pi || tatrā'pi kāle svajanābhiguptyai bibharṣi sattvaṃ khalanigrahāya || 6 || tamoguṇaṃ rākṣasa bandhanāya rajoguṇaṃ nirguṇa viśvamūrte || diṣṭyā tvadaṃghriḥ praṇatāghanāśanastīrthāspadaṃ hṛdi dhṛtaḥ suvipakvayogaiḥ || 7 || utsiktabhaktyupahṛtāśaya jīvabhāvāḥ prāpurgatiṃ tava padasmṛtimātrato ye || bhavākhyakāloragapāśabandhaḥ punaḥpunarjanmajarādiduḥkhaiḥ || 8 || bhramāmi yoniṣvahamākhubhakṣyavatpravṛddhatarṣastava pādavismṛteḥ || nūnaṃ na dattaṃ na ca te kathā śrutā na sādhavo jātu mayā'pi sevitāḥ || 9 || tenāribhirdhvastaparārdhyalakṣmīrvanaṃ praviṣṭaḥ svaguruhyaghaṃ smaran || smṛtau ca tau māṃ samupetya duḥkhātsaṃbodhayāṃcakraturārtabaṃdhū || 2.7.16.10 || vaiśākhadharmaiḥ śruticoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ svargāpavargādi pumarthahetubhiḥ || tadbodhato'haṃ kṛtavānsamastāñcchubhāvahānmādhavamāsadharmān || 11 || tasmādabhūnme paramaḥ prasādastenākhilāḥ saṃpada ūrjitā imāḥ || nāgnirna sūryo na ca candratārakā na bhūrjalaṃ khaṃ śvasano'tha vāṅmanaḥ || 12 || upāsitāste'pi haratyaghaṃ cirādvipaścito ghnanti muhūrtasevayā || yānmanyase tvaṃ bhavino'pi bhūriśastyakteṣaṇāṃstvatpadanyastacittān|| 13 || namaḥ svataṃtrāya vicitrakarmaṇe namaḥ parasmai sadanugrahāya || tvanmāyayā mohito'haṃ guṇeṣu dārārtharūpeṣu bhramāmyanarthadṛk || 14 || tvatpādapadme sati mūlanāśane samastapāpāpaharaṃ sunirmalam || sukhecchayānarthanidānabhūtaiḥ sutātmadārairmamatābhiyuktaḥ || 15|| na kvāpi nidrāṃ labhate na śarma pravṛddhatarṣaḥ punareva tasmin || labdhvā durāpaṃ naradevajanma tvaṃ yatnataḥ sarvapumarthahetuḥ ||16|| padāravindaṃ na bhajāmi deva saṃmūḍhacetā viṣayeṣu lālasaḥ || karomi karmāṇi suniṣṭhitaḥ sanpravṛddhatarṣastadapekṣayā dadat || 17 || punaśca bhūyāmahamadya bhūyāmityeva cintāśatalolamānasaḥ|| tadaiva jīvasya bhavetkṛpā vibho duraṃtaśaktestava viśvamūrte || 18 || samāgamaḥ syānmahatāṃ hi puṃsāṃ bhavāṃbudhiryena hi goṣpadāyate || satsaṃgamo deva yadaiva bhūyāttarhīśa deve tvayi jāyate matiḥ ||19|| samastarājyāpagamaṃ hi manye hyanugrahaṃ te mayi jātamañjasā || yathārya te brahmasurāsurādyairnivṛttatarṣairapi haṃsayūthaiḥ || 2.7.16.20 || itaḥ smarāmyacyutameva sādaraṃ bhavāpahaṃ pādasaroruhaṃ vibho || akiṃcanaprārthyamamandabhāgyadaṃ na kāmaye'nyattava pādapadmāt || || 21 || ato na rājyaṃ na sutādikośaṃ dehena śaśvatpatatā rajobhuvā || bhajāmi nityaṃ tadupāsitavyaṃ pādāraviṃdaṃ munibhirvicintyam || 22 || prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa smṛtiryathā syāttava pādapadme || saktiḥ sadā gacchatu dārakośaputrātmacihneṣu gaṇeṣu me prabho|| 23 || bhūyānmanaḥ kṛṣṇapadāravindayorvacāṃsi te divyakathānuvarṇane || netre mameme tava vigrahekṣaṇe śrotre kathāyāṃ rasanā tadarpite || 24 || ghrāṇaṃ ca tvapādasarojasaurabhe tvadbhaktagandhādivilepane sakṛt || syātāṃ ca hastau tava mandire vibho saṃmārjjanādau mama nityadaiva || 25 || pādau vibho kṣetrakathā'nusarpaṇe mūrdhā ca me syāttava vandane'niśam || kāmaśca me syāttava satkathāyāṃ buddhiśca me syāttava ciṃtane'niśam || 26 || dināni me syustava satkathodayairudgīyamānairmunibhirgṛhāgataiḥ || hīnaḥ prasaṃgastava me na bhūyātkṣaṇaṃ nimeṣārddhamathā'pi viṣṇo || 27 || na pārameṣṭhyaṃ na ca sārvabhaumaṃ na cāpavargaṃ spṛhayāmi viṣṇo || tvatpādasevāṃ ca sadaiva kāmaye prārthyāṃ śriyā brahmabhavādibhiḥ suraiḥ || 28 || iti rājñā stuto viṣṇuḥ prasannaḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ || meghagambhīrayā vācā tamuvāca kṣitīśvaram || 29 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || jāne tvāṃ dāsavaryaṃ me niṣkāmukamakalmaṣam || athā'pi te pradāsyāmi varaṃ daivatadurlabham || 2.7.16.30 || āyuṣyaṃ cāyutaṃ divyaṃ saṃpadaśca nareśvara || bhaktirmayi dṛḍhā bhūyādante sāyujyameva ca || 31 || tvayā kṛtena stotreṇa māṃ stuvanti ca ye bhuvi || teṣāṃ tuṣṭaḥ pradāsyāmi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 32 || tṛtīyaiṣā'kṣayānāma bhuvi khyātā bhaviṣyati || yasyāṃ tava prasanno'haṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ || 33 || ye kurvaṃti narā mūḍhāḥ snānadānādikāḥ kriyā || vyājenā'pi svabhāvādvā yāṃti matpadamavyayam || 34 || ye cā'kṣayatṛtīyāyāṃ pitṝnuddiśya mānavāḥ || śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃti teṣāṃ vai tadānaṃtyāya kalpate || 35 || na cānayā tithirloke samā vā nādhikā bhuvi|| asyāṃ kṛtaṃ svalpamapi tadakṣayyaphalaṃ bhavet || 36 || yo gāṃ dadyānnṛpaśreṣṭha brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine || sarvasaṃpatpravarṣākhyā bhuktimuktiḥ kare sthitā || 37 || yo hi dadyādanaḍvāhaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam || kālamṛtyuvimuktaḥ sandīrghāyuṣyamavāpnuyāt || 38 || vaiśākhamāse yo dharmānkurute matpriyāvahān || teṣāṃ mṛtyujarājanmabhayaṃ pāpaṃ harāmyaham || 39 || yathā vaiśākhadharmaistu tuṣṭaḥ syāṃ sakalairapi || māsadharmairna tuṣṭaḥ syāṃ māso me mādhavaḥ priyaḥ || || 2.7.16.40 || sarvadhamojjhitā vāpi brahmacaryavivarjitāḥ|| vaiśākhamāsaniratā yāṃti matpadamavyayam ||41|| yaddurāpaṃ tapobhiśca sāṃkhyayogairmakhairapi || taddhāma paramaṃ yāṃti vaiśākhaniratā narāḥ || 42 || api pāpasahasraṃ vā māso'yaṃ harate'nagha || prāyaścittavihīnaṃ vā matpādasmaraṇaṃ yathā ||43|| gurūpadiṣṭaḥ kāṃtāre vaiśākhe nirato bhavān || samārādhya jagannāthaṃ tenāptamakhilaṃ nṛpa || 44 || dharmeṇānena saṃprītaḥ pratyakṣo'haṃ bhavāmi te || bhuktvā bhogānyathākāmāndevairapisudurlabhān || 45 || iti tasmai varaṃ dattvā devadevo janārdanaḥ || paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 46 || tato bhūpālavaryo'sau babhūvātyaṃtavismitaḥ || hṛṣṭapuṣṭatanurbhūpa labdhanaṣṭadhano yathā || 47 || tataḥ śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ taccittastatparāyaṇaḥ || mahadbhirbodhito nityaṃ gurubhiśca niraṃtaram || 48 || nānyaṃ priyatamaṃ mene vāsudevamṛte nṛpaḥ || yatsaṃparkātpriyā āsandārāmātyasutādayaḥ || 49 || sarvāndharmāṃścakārā'sau vaiśākhoktānpunaḥpunaḥ || tena puṇyaprabhāvena putrapautrādibhirvṛtaḥ || 2.7.16.50 || bhuktvā manorathānsarvāndevānāmapi durlabhān || aṃte jagāma sāyujyaṃ viṣṇordevasya cakriṇaḥ || 51 || ya idaṃ paramākhyānaṃ śṛṇvanti śrāvayaṃti ca || te sarve pāpanirmuktā yāṃti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||52|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmvarīṣasaṃvāde pāṃcālādhipateḥ sāyujyaprāptirnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || || cha || ||
<2.7.17>
|| śrutakīrtiruvāca || || vaiśākhadharmānakhilānihāmutra phalapradā|| bhūyo'pi śṛṇvataścāsīttṛptirnā'dyāpi mānada ||1|| yatra cākaitavo dharmo yatra viṣṇukathā śubhāḥ || tacchāstraṃ śṛṇvato naiva tṛptiḥ karṇarasāyanam || 2 || pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ diṣṭyā pāramupāgatam || ātithyavyapadeśena yadbhavāngṛhamāgataḥ || 3 || vaco'mṛtaṃ mukhāṃbhojaniḥsṛtaṃ paramādbhutam || pītvā tṛptaḥ pārameṣṭhyaṃ mokṣaṃ vā ca na kāmaye ||4|| tasmāttāneva dharmānme bhuktimuktipradāyakān || viṣṇuprītikarāndivyānbhūyo vistarato vada || 5 || ityuktastu purā rājñā śrutadevo mahāyaśāḥ|| saṃhṛṣṭā''tmā śubhāndharmānpunarvyāhartumārabhat || 6 || || śrutadeva uvāca || || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || vaiśākhadharmaviṣayāṃ bhāvitāṃ munibhirmuhuḥ||7|| paṃpātīre dvijaḥ kaścicchaṃkhonāma mahāyaśāḥ || gurau siṃhagate cāgānnadīṃ godāvarīṃ śubhām ||8|| tīrtvā bhīmarathīṃ puṇyāṃ kāṃtāre kaṇṭakācale || nirjale nirjane ghore vaiśākhe tapakarṣitaḥ || 9 || vṛkṣe copaviveśā'sau madhyāhnasamaye dvijaḥ || tadā kaściddurācāro vyādhaścāpadharaḥ śaṭhaḥ ||2.7.17.10|| nirghṛṇaḥ sarvabhūteṣu kālāṃtaka ivā'paraḥ || taṃ kuṇḍaladharaṃ vipraṃ dīkṣitaṃ bhāskaropamam || 11 || dṛṣṭvā baddhvā sa jagrāha kuṇḍalādikamugradhīḥ || upānahau ca cchatraṃ ca akṣamālāṃ kamaṇḍalum || 12 || paścādvisṛjya taṃ vipraṃ gacchetyāha vimūḍhadhīḥ || 13 || tataḥ sa cchanpathi śarkarā''vile sūryāṃśutapte jalavarjite khare || saṃtaptapādastṛṇachādite sthale kvaciccacāropavasannūrdhvaretāḥ || 14 || sa vai drutaṃ saṃpatankvāpi tuṣyanhāheti vādī sa jagāma tūrṇam || dṛṣṭvā muniṃ khidyamānaṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyaṃ gate pūṣṇi dayā babhūva || 15 || vyādhasya dharmavimukhasya ca pāpabuddhestasmai dadāmi sukhadāṃ khalu pādarakṣām || 16 || cauryeṇaiva svadharmeṇa yā gṛhītā vanāṃtare || tadīyameva tatsarvaṃ vyādhānāṃ dharmanirṇayaḥ || tasmādupānahau dāsye muhurduḥkhāpanuttaye || 17 || tena śreyo bhavedyacca tadbhavenmama pāpinaḥ || jīrṇe copānahau dve ca vartete pādayormama || na tābhyāmasti me kṛtyaṃ tasmātte vai dadāmyaham|| || 18 || iti niścitya manasi tūrṇaṃ gatvā dadau ca te || śarkarātaptapādāya dvijavaryāya sīdate || 19 || upānahau gṛhītvā te nirvṛtiṃ ca parāṃ yayau || sukhī bhaveti taṃ vyādhamāśīrbhirabhinandya ca || 2.7.17.20 || nūnaṃ supakvapuṇyo'yaṃ vaiśākhe dattavānamū || vyādhasyāpi ca durbuddheḥ prāyo viṣṇuḥ prasīdati || 21 || sarvasyā''ptyā ca bhūyo'pi yatsukhaṃ tadabhūnmama || tato'bhiśrutya tadvākyaṃ kimetaditi vismitaḥ || 22 || vyājahāra punarvipraṃ brahmiṣṭhaṃ brahmavādinam || tvadīyaṃ tu mayā dattaṃ kathaṃ puṇyaṃ bhavenmama || 23 || praśaṃsasi ca vaiśākhaṃ haristuṣṭo bhavediti || etadācakṣva me brahmanko vaiśākhastu ko hariḥ || 24 || ko dharmaḥ kiṃ phalaṃ tasya śuśrūṣorme dayānidhe || iti vyādhavacaḥ śrutvā śaṃkhastuṣṭamanā abhūt || 25 || praśaṃsansa ca vaiśākhaṃ punarvismitamānasaḥ || idānīṃ dattavānpādatrāṇe me lubdhakaḥ śaṭhaḥ ||26|| yaddurbuddheśca vaiṣamyaṃ jātaṃ citramaho vata || sarveṣāmeva dharmāṇāṃ phalaṃ janmāṃtareṣu vai || 27 || vaiśākhamāsadharmāṇāṃ phalaṃ sadyaḥ kṣaṇe nṛṇām || pāpācārasya durbuddhervyādhasyāpi durātmanaḥ || 28 || daivādupānahordānātsattvaśuddhirabhūdaho || yacca viṣṇoḥ priyaṃ karma yattatsantoṣanirmalam || 29 || tadeva dharmamityāhurmanvādyā dharmavittamāḥ || dharmā mādhavamāsīyāḥ priyā viṣṇoratīva te || 2.7.17.30 || dharmairmādhavamāsīyairyathā tuṣyati keśavaḥ || na tathā sarvadānaiśca tapobhiśca mahāmakhaiḥ || 31 || nānena sadṛśo dharmaḥ sarvadharmeṣu vidyate || mā gayāṃ yāṃtu mā gaṃgāṃ mā prayāgaṃ tu puṣkaram || 32 || mā kedāraṃ kurukṣetraṃ mā prabhāsaṃ syamantakam || mā godā mā ca kṛṣṇāṃ ca mā setuṃ mā marudvṛdham || 33 || vaiśākhadharmamāhātmyaṃ śaṃsaṃtī ca kathā''pagā || tatra snātasya vai viṣṇuḥ sadyo hṛdyavarudhyate || 34 || māse mādhavasaṃjñe'sminyastvalpenaiva sādhyate || na tadbahuvyayairdānairna dharmairvā'pi vai makhaiḥ || || 35 || māso'yaṃ mādhavonāma vyādha puṇyavivarddhanaḥ || tasminmahyaṃ tvayā datte pāduke tāpanāśane || 36 || tena te pūrvakālīnaṃ puṇyaṃ pākamupāgatam || tuṣṭastu bhagavānprāyaḥ śreyo vyādha vidhāsyati || 37 || anyathā te kathaṃ bhūyādbuddhiretādṛśī śubhā || munāvevaṃ bruvāṇe ca mṛtyunā prerito balī || 38 || siṃho vyāghravadhārthāya prādravatkrodhavihvalaḥ || madhye dṛṣṭvā ca mātaṅgaṃ daivāddevena kalpitam || 39 || taṃ haṃtumudyato'gacchatpadākrāṃtaṃ vyavasthitam || tayoryuddhamabhūdrājansiṃhamātaṃgayorvane || 2.7.17.40 || śrāṃtau yuddhācca viratau nirīkṣaṃtau ca tasthatuḥ || vyādhamuddiśya yaccoktaṃ muninā ca mahātmanā || 41 || samastapātakadhvaṃsi daivācchuśruvatuśca tau || tenaiva māsamāhātmyaśravaṇenāmalāśayau || 42 || śāpānmuktau ca tau dehātsadyo muktau divaṃ gatau || divyarūpadharau divyau divyagaṃdhānulepanau || 43 || divyaṃ vimānamārūḍhau divyanārīniṣevitau || sadyo'vanatamūrddhānau prāṃjalī copatasthatuḥ || 44 || munīṃdro dharmavaktā ca vyādhamuddiśya vai pathi || tau dṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ prāha kau yuvāmiti niścalaḥ || 45 || duryonau tu kuto janma yuvayorvā kathaṃ mṛtiḥ || ahetorvipine cā'snmiparasparavadhodyatau || 46 || etatsarvaṃ suvistārya samyagvadata me'naghau || ityuktau muninā tena vacaḥ pratyūcatuḥ punaḥ || 47 || mataṃgasya muneḥ putrau daṃtilaḥ kohalo'paraḥ || śāpadoṣeṇa tau jātau nāmnā daṃtilakohalau || 48 || rūpayauvanasaṃpannau sarvavidyāviśāradau || āvāmuddiśya provāca pitā dharmārthakovidaḥ || 49 || mataṃgonāma brahmarṣiḥ sarvadharmaviduttamaḥ || vaiśākhe māsi tanayau madhusūdanavallabhe || 2.7.17.50 || prapāṃ kuruta mārge ca janānvījayataṃ kṣaṇam|| mārge chāyā vidhattāṃ ca bhūryannaṃ śītalāṃbu ca || 51 || kurutaṃ snānamuṣasi tathaivārcayataṃ vibhum || kathāṃ ca śṛṇutaṃ nityaṃ yayā bandho nivartate || 52 || evaṃ ca bahubhirvākyairbodhitāvapi durmatī || kuddho'bhavaṃ daṃtilo'haṃ matto'haṃ kohalāhvayaḥ || 53 || kruddhaḥ śaśāpa tau sadyaḥ pitā dharmeṣu lālasaḥ || 54 || putraṃ ca dharmavimukhaṃ bhāryāṃ cā'priyavādinīm || abrahmaṇyaṃ ca rājānaṃ tyajetsadyo na cetpatet || || 55 || dākṣiṇyādarthalobhādvā saṃsargaṃ ye prakurvate || te sarve narakaṃ yāṃti yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || iti jñātvā śaśāpāvāṃ madakrodhapariplutau ||56|| kuddho'yaṃ daṃtilo bhūyātsiṃhaḥ krodhapariplutaḥ || mattastu kohalo bhūyānmatto mātaṃgayūthapaḥ ||57|| kṛtānutāpau paścāttu prārthayāvo vimocanam|| āvābhyāṃ prārthito bhūyo viśāpaṃ ca dadau pitā || 58 || yuvāṃ prāpya ca duryoniṃ kiyatkālāṃtare'pi ca || saṃgamo bhavitā tatra parasparavadheṣiṇoḥ || 59 || tasminneva hi samaye saṃvādo vyādhaśaṃkhayoḥ || vaiśākhadharmaviṣayo daivādvāṃ śravaṇe'pi ca || 2.7.17.60 || gamiṣyati kṣaṇādeva tasmānmuktirbhaviṣyati || śāpānmuktau pūrvameva rūpamāsthāya putrakau || 61 || māmeva prāpya vasataṃ nānyathā me vaco bhavet|| iti śaptau ca guruṇā duryoniṃ prāpya durmatī || 62 || prāpya daivātsaṃgatiṃ ca parasparavadhaiṣiṇau || saṃvādaṃ yuvayordivyaṃ śubhaṃ taṃ śuśruvāvahe || 63 || tena sadyo vimuktiśca kṣaṇādevā''vayorabhūt || iti sarvaṃ samākhyāya praṇamya ca munīśvaram || 64 || samāmaṃtryābhyanujñātau jagmatuḥ pituraṃtikam|| tadevaṃ saṃpradṛśyāha munirvyādhaṃ dayānidhiḥ || 65 || paśya vaiśākhamāhātmyaśravaṇasya phalaṃ mahat || muhūrtaśravaṇādeva tayormuktiḥ kare sthitā || 66 || iti bruvāṇaṃ munipuṃgavaṃ taṃ dayānidhiṃ niḥspṛhamagryabuddhim || viśuddhasattvaṃ sukṛtaikapātraṃ sa nyastaśastraḥ punarāha vyādhaḥ || 67 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde daṃtilakohalamuktiprāptivṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || cha ||
<2.7.18>
|| vyādha uvāca || || bhavatā'nugṛhīto'smi mune pāpo'tiduṣṭadhīḥ || dayālavo mahāṃto hi svabhāvādeva sādhavaḥ || 1 || kva vyādhaścā'kulīno'haṃ kva ca vā matirīdṛśī || kevalaṃ bhavatāmeva manye'nugrahamuttamam ||2|| atha sādho ca śiṣyosmi kṛpāpātrosmi mānada || anugrāhyo'smi putro'smi kṛpāṃ kuru dayānidhe ||3|| yathā me na punarbhūyādasanmatiranarthadā || sadbhistu saṃgateḥ kvāpi nabhūyo duḥkhamaśnute ||4|| tasmādbodhaya māṃ vipra sūktaistairvṛjināpahaiḥ || yena cāddhā tariṣyaṃti saṃsārābdhiṃ mumukṣavaḥ ||5|| sādhūnāṃ samacittānāṃ tathā bhūtadayāvatām || na ca hīnottamaḥ kvāpi nātmīyo hi parastathā ||6|| aikāgryeṇa viciṃtyātha cittaśuddhiṃ ca pṛcchati || sarvadoṣayuto vāpi sarvadharmojjhito'pi vā || 7 || kṛtānutāpaśca yadā yadā pṛcchati vai gurūn|| tadaivopadiśaṃtyaddhā jñānaṃ saṃsāramocakam || 8 || yathā gaṃgā manuṣyāṇāṃ pāpanāśasya bhāvinī || tathā mandasamuddhārasvabhāvāḥ sādhavaḥ smṛtāḥ || 9 || mā vicāraya māṃ boddhuṃ dayālo bhaktavatsala || śuśrūṣutvānnatatvācca śuddhatvāttava saṃgateḥ || 2.7.18.10 || iti vyādhavacaḥ śrutvā punarvismitamānasaḥ || sādhusādhviti saṃbhāṣya dharmānetānuvāca ha || 11 || || śaṃkha uvāca || || viṣṇuprītikarāndivyānsaṃsārābdhivimocakān || kuru dharmāṃśca vaiśākhe yadi vyādha śamicchasi || || 12 || ātapo bādhate ghoro na cchāyā nāṃbu cātra ca || tasmātsthalāṃtaraṃ yāvo yatra cchāyā tu vartate || 13 || tatra gatvā jalaṃ pītvā succhāyāṃ ca samāśritaḥ || tatra te varṇayiṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || 14 || viṣṇormādhavamāsasya yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam|| ityukto muninā tena vyādhaḥ prāha kṛtāñjaliḥ || 15 || ito vidūre salilaṃ vartate ca sarovare || kapitthāstatra vai saṃti phalabhāreṇa pīḍitāḥ || 16 || gacchāvastatra saṃtuṣṭirbhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ || vyādhenaivaṃ samādiṣṭastena sākaṃ yayau muniḥ || 17 || kiyaddūraṃ tato gatvā dadarśāgre sarovaram || baka kāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam || 18 || haṃsasārasakrauṃcādyaiḥ samaṃtātpariśobhitam || kīcakaiśca sughoṣaiśca kūjitaṃ bhramarairapi ||19|| nakrakacchapamīnādyairvagāhyaṃ sumanoharam || kumudotpalakahlāra puṃḍarīkādibhirmahat || 2.7.18.20 || śatapatraiḥ kokanadaiḥ samantātpariśobhitam || pakṣiṇāṃ ca kalārāvairmukhara nayanotsavam || 21 || taṭe kīcakagulmaiśca tathā vṛkṣaiśca śobhitam || vaṭaiḥ karaṃjairnīpaiśca ciṃciṇībhistathaiva ca || 22 || nimbaplakṣapriyālaiśca caṃpakairbakulaiḥ śubhaiḥ || punnāgaistuṃbaraiścaiva kapitthāmalakairapi || 23 || niṣpeṣaṇaiśca jaṃbūbhiḥ samaṃtātpariśobhitam || vanyamātaṃgasāraṃga varāhamahiṣādibhiḥ || 24 || śaśaiśca śallakaiścaiva gavayairupaśobhitam || khaṅganābhimṛgādyaiśca vyāghraiḥ siṃhairvṛkairapi || 25 || kharāṃtakaiśca śarabhaiśca marībhiḥ sumaṃḍitam || śākhāśākhāṃtaraṃ śīghraṃ plavamānaiḥ plavaṃgamaiḥ || 26 || mārjāraiścaiva bhallūkairbhīṣaṇaṃ rurubhistathā || jhillīśabdaiśca kreṃkāraiḥ kīcakānāṃ ravaistathā ||27|| ghoravāyuvinirghātadārubhāraiḥ samanvitam || etādṛśaṃ saro divyaṃ vyādhenaiva pradarśitam ||28|| dadarśa muniśārdūlastṛṣayā bādhito bhṛśam || snātvā madhyāhnavelāyāṃ sarasyasminmanorame ||29|| vāsasī paridhāyā'tha kṛtvā mādhyāhnikīḥ kriyāḥ || devapūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhuktvā phalamatandritaḥ || 2.7.18.30 || vyādhopanītaṃ susvādu kapitthaṃ śramahāri ca || sukhopaviṣṭaḥ papraccha vyādhaṃ dharmarataṃ punaḥ || 31 || kiṃ vaktavyaṃ mayā hyadya tavādau dharmatatpara || dharmāśca bahavaḥ saṃti nānāmārgāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ || 32 || tatra vaiśākhamāsoktāḥ sūkṣmā api mahārthadāḥ || sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāmihā'mutra phalapradāḥ || 33 || yatpraṣṭavyaṃ manasi te yaccādau tacca pṛcchatām || ityukto muninā tena vyādhaḥ prāṃjalirabravīt || 34 || || vyādha uvāca || || kena vā karmaṇā cā''sīdvyādhajanma tamomayam || kena vā cedṛśī buddhiḥ saṃgatirvā mahātmanaḥ || 35 || etaccānyatsamācakṣva yadi māṃ manyase prabho || ityuktaḥ punarapyāha śaṃkho nāma mahāmuniḥ || 36 || meghagaṃbhīrayā vācā smayamānamukhāṃbujaḥ || || śaṃkha uvāca || || śākale nagare pūrvaṃ dvijastvaṃ vedapāragaḥ || 37 || staṃbo nāma mahātejāstathā śrīvatsagotrajaḥ || taveṣṭā gaṇikā kācidāsīttatsaṃgadoṣataḥ || 37 || tyaktvā nityakriyā nityaṃ śūdravadgṛhamāgataḥ || śūnyācārasya duṣṭasya parityaktakriyasya ca ||39|| brāhmaṇī ca tadā cā''sīdbhāryā kāṃtimatī tava || sā tvāṃ paryacaratsubhrūḥ saveśyaṃ brāhmaṇādhamam || 2.7.18.40 || ubhayoḥ kṣālayaṃtī ca pādāṃstvatpriyakāriṇī || ubhayorapyadhaḥ śete ubhayorvacane ratā || 41 || veśyayā vāryamāṇā'pi pātivratyavratasthitā || evaṃ śuśrūṣayaṃtyā hi bhartāraṃ veśyayā saha || 42 || jagāma sumahānkālo duḥkhitāyā mahītale || aparasmindine bhartā māṣaṃ ca mūlakānvitam ||43|| abhakṣayacchūdradharmānnipāvāṃstilamiśritān || tadapathyamaśitvā tu vamaṃścaiva virecayan ||44|| apathyāddāruṇo rogo vyajāyata bhagaṃdaraḥ || sa dahyamāno rogeṇa divārātraṃ tu bhūriśaḥ || 45 || yāvadāste gṛhe vittaṃ tāvadveśyā ca saṃsthitā || gṛhītvā tasya sā vittaṃ paścānnovāsa maṃdire || 46 || anyasya pārśvamāsādya gatā ghorā sunirghṛṇā || tataḥ sa dīnavacano vyādhibādhāsupīḍitaḥ || 47 || uktavānsa rudanbhāryāṃ rujā vyākulamānasaḥ || paripālaya māṃ devi veśyā''saktaṃ suniṣṭhuram || 48 || na mayopakṛtaṃ kiṃcittvayi suṃdari pāvani || ko bhāryāṃ praṇatāṃ pāpo nānumanyeta garhitaḥ || 49 || sa ṣaṃḍho bhavitā bhadre daśa janmasu paṃcasu || divārātraṃ mahābhāge nimaditaḥ sādhubhirjanaiḥ || || 2.7.18.50 || pāpayonimavāpsyāmi tvāṃ sādhvīmavamanya vai || ahaṃ krodhena dagdho'smi tavāpamānajena vai || 51 || evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ bhartāraṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭā'bravīt || na dainyaṃ bhavatā kāryaṃ na vrīḍā kāṃta māṃ prati || 52 || na cā'pi tvayi me krodho yena dagdho vadasyatha || purā kṛtāni pāpāni duḥkhānīha bhavaṃti hi || 53 || tāni yā kṣamate sādhvī puruṣo vā sa uttamaḥ || yanmayā pāpayā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ vai pūrvajanmani || 54 || tadbhuṃjatyā na me duḥkhaṃ na viṣādaḥ kathaṃcana || ityevamuktvā bhartāraṃ sā subhrūstamapālayat || 55 || ānīya janakādvittaṃ baṃdhubhyo varavarṇinī || kṣīrodavāsinaṃ devaṃ bharttāraṃ sā tvaciṃtayat || 56 || śodhayantī divārātrau purīṣaṃ mūtrameva ca || nakhena karṣatī bharttuḥ kṛmīnkaṣṭācchanaiḥśanaiḥ || 57 || na sā svapiti rātrau tu na divā varavarṇinī || bhartturduḥkhena saṃtaptā duḥkhitedamavocata || 58 || devāśca pātu bhartāraṃ pitaro ye ca viśrutāḥ || kurvaṃtu rogahīnaṃ me bharttāraṃ gatakalmaṣam || 59 || caṃḍikāyai pradāsyāmi raktamāṃsasamudbhavam || suṣṭhavannaṃ māhiṣopetaṃ bhartturārogyahetave || 2.7.18.60 || modakānkārayiṣyāmi vighneśāya mahātmane || mandavāre kariṣyāmi copavāsāndaśaiva tu || 61 || nopabhuṃjāmi madhuraṃ nopabhuṃjāmi vai ghṛtam || tailābhyaṃgavihīnāhaṃ sthāsye naivātra saṃśayaḥ ||62|| jīvatādrogahīno'yaṃ bharttā me śaradāṃ śatam || evaṃ sā vyāharaddevī vāsare vāsare gate ||63|| tadā cā''gānmuniḥ kaścinmahātmā devalāhvayaḥ || vaiśākhe māsi gharmārtaḥ sāyāhne tasya vai gṛham || 64 || tadā vai bhāryayā coktaṃ bhiṣagvai gṛhamāgataḥ || tena vai rogahāniḥ syāttasyā''tithya karomyaham || 65 || jñātvā tvāṃ dharmavimukhaṃ bhiṣagvyājena vaṃcitaḥ || pādāvanejanaṃ kṛtvā tajjalaṃ mūrdhni sākṣipat || 66 || pānakaṃ ca dadau tasmai gharmārtāya mahātmane || tvayā'numoditā sāyaṃ gharmatāpanivārakam || 67 || sa prātarudite sūrye muniḥ prāyādyathā''gataḥ || atha cālpena kālena sannipāto'bhavattava ||68|| trikaṭvyāṃ nīyamānāyāṃ bharttāṃgulimakhaṃḍayat || ubhayordaṃtayoḥ śleṣaḥ sahasā samapadyata || 69 || tatkhaṃḍamaṃgulervaktre sthitaṃ bhartuḥ sukomalam || khaṇḍayitvāguliṃ bhartā paṃcatvamagamattadā || 2.7.18.70 || śayyāyāṃ sumanojñāyāṃ smaraṃstāṃ puṃścalī śubhām || mṛtaṃ vijñāya bharttāraṃ bhāryā kāṃtimatī tava ||71|| vikrīya cā'pi valayaṃ gṛhītvā ceṃdhanaṃ bahu || cakre citiṃ tena sādhvī madhye kṛtvā patiṃ tadā || 72 || avaguhya bhujābhyāṃ ca pādau cāśliṣya pādayoḥ || mukhe mukhaṃ vinikṣipya hṛdayaṃ hṛdaye tathā || 73 || jaghane jaghanaṃ devī hyātmānaṃ sanniveśya ca || dāhayāmāsa kalyāṇī bhartṛdehaṃ rujānvitam || ātmanā saha kalyāṇī jvalite jātavedasi ||74|| vimucya dehaṃ sahasā jagāma patiṃ samāliṃgya murārilokam || pānīyadānena ca mādhave'sminpādāvanejādapi yogigamyam||75|| tvamaṃtakāle gaṇikāviciṃtayā dehaṃ tyaktvā muktasamastakilbiṣaḥ || janma vyādhyaṃ prāpyase ghorarūpaṃ hiṃsāsaktaḥ sarvadodvegakārī || 76 || dattā tvayā pānakasyā'pi dāne māse'nujñā mādhave sādhujāne || vyādho jātastena jātā subuddhirdharmānpraṣṭuṃ sarvasaukhyaikahetūn || 77 || dhṛtaṃ mūrdhnā pādaśaucāvaśiṣṭaṃ jalaṃ muneḥ sarvapāpāpahāri || teneyaṃ te saṃgatirme vane'sminyayā bhūyaḥ saṃpadaḥ santatiśca || 78 || ityetatsarvamākhyātaṃ pūrvajanmani yatkṛtam || karma puṇyaṃ pāpakaṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā || 79 || gopyaṃ vā te pravakṣyāmi yadbhavāñchrotumicchati || jātā te cittaśuddhirvai svasti bhūyānmahāmate || 2.7.18.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāṃbarīṣa saṃvāde vyādhopākhyāne vyādhasya pūrvajanmakathanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || || cha ||
<2.7.19>
|| vyādha uvāca || || viṣṇumuddiśya kartavyā dharmā bhāgavatāḥ śubhāḥ || tatrā'pi mādhavīyāśca ityuktaṃ tu tvayā purā || 1 || sa viṣṇuḥ kīdṛśo brahmankiṃ vā tasya hi lakṣaṇam || kiṃ mānaṃ tasya sadbhāvaiḥ kairjñeyo bhagavānvibhuḥ || 2 || kīdṛśā vaiṣṇavā dharmāḥ kenā'sau prīyate hariḥ || etadācakṣva me brahmankiṃkarāya mahāmate ||3|| iti pṛṣṭastu vyādhena punaḥ prāha sa vai dvijaḥ|| praṇamya
