jagatāmīśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam|| 4|| śaṃkha uvāca|| || śṛṇu vyādha pravakṣyāmi viṣṇurūpamakalmaṣam || yadacintyaṃ viriṃcyādyairmunibhirbhāvitātmabhiḥ || 5 || pūrṇaśaktiḥ pūrṇaguṇo nirdiṣṭaḥ sakaleśvaraḥ || nirguṇo niṣkalo'naṃtaḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥ || 6 || yadetadakhilaṃ viśvaṃ carācaramanīdṛśam || sādhiśaṃsā''śrayaṃ yacca yadvaśe niyataṃ sthitam || 7 || atha te lakṣaṇaṃ vacmi brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ || utpattisthitisaṃhārā hyāvṛttirniyamastathā || 8 || prakāśau bandhamokṣau ca vṛttiryasmādbhavaṃtyamī || sa viṣṇurbrahmasaṃjño'sau kavīnāṃ saṃmato vibhuḥ || 9 || sākṣādbrahmeti taṃ prāhuḥ paścādbrahmādikānapi || brahmaśabdaṃ sopapadaṃ brahmādiṣu vido viduḥ || || 2.7.19.10 || nānyeṣāṃ brahmatā kvā'pi tacchaktyekāṃśabhāginām || tadetacchāstragamyaṃ hi janmādyasya mahāvibhoḥ || 11 || śāstraṃ ca vedāḥ smṛtayaḥ purāṇaṃ vai tadātmakam || itihāsaḥ paṃcarātraṃ bhārataṃ ca mahāmate || 12 || etaireva mahāviṣṇurjñeyo nānyaiḥ kathaṃcana || nāvedavidamuṃ viṣṇuṃ manute ca naraḥ kvacit || 13 || neṃdriyairnānumānaiśca na tarkaiḥ śakyate vibhum || jñātuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ vedavedyaṃ sanātanam || 14 || asyaiva janmakarmāṇi guṇāñjñātvā yathāmati || mucyaṃte jīvasaṃghāśca sadā tadvaśavartinaḥ || 15 || kramādviṣṇośca māhātmyaṃ yathā sātiśayaṃ bhavet || ekaikasminsthitā śaktirdevarṣipitṛmātṛke || 16 || pratyakṣeṇā''gamenāpi tathaivā'numayā'pi ca || ādau narottamaṃ vidyādbale jñāne sukhe tathā || 17 || tasmādbhūtaṃ śataguṇaṃ vidyājjñānādibhirvṛtam || bhūtānmanuṣyagaṃdharvānvidyācchataguṇādhikān || 18 || tattvābhimānino devāstebhyo vidyācchatādhikān || tattvābhimānidevebhyaḥ saptaiva ṛṣayo varāḥ ||19|| saptarṣibhyo varo hyagniragneḥ sūryādayastathā || sūryādgururguroḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇādiṃdro mahābalaḥ || 2.7.19.20 || indrācca girijā devī devyāḥ śaṃbhurjagadguruḥ || śaṃbhorbuddhirmahādevī buddheḥ prāṇo balādhikaḥ || 21 || na prāṇātparamaṃ kiṃcitprāṇe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || prāṇājjātamidaṃ viśvaṃ prāṇātmakamidaṃ jagat || 22 || prāṇe protamidaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇādeva hi ceṣṭate || sarvādhāramimaṃ prāhuḥ sūtraṃ nīlāṃbudaprabham ||23|| lakṣmīkaṭākṣamātreṇa prāṇasyāsya sthitirbhavet || sā lakṣmīrdevadevasya kṛpāleśaikabhājinī || 24 || na viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ kiṃcinna samo vā kathaṃcana || || vyādha uvāca || || kathaṃ jīveṣvayaṃ prāṇaḥ sūtranāmā'dhiko'bhavat||25|| nirṇayo vā kathaṃ hyasya prāṇādhikyaṃ kathaṃ vibho || etadācakṣva me brahmankathaṃ prāṇādvibhuḥ paraḥ ||26|| || śaṃkha uvāca || śṛṇu vyādha pravakṣyāmi yatpṛṣṭo nirṇayastathā || prāṇādhikyaṃ samuddiśya jīvaiśca sakalairapi||27|| purā nārāyaṇo devaḥ padmasṛṣṭau sanātanaḥ || sṛṣṭvā brahmādikāndevānidaṃ prāha janārdanaḥ || 28 || sāmrājye'haṃ sthāpayeyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vaḥ patiṃ prabhum || yo yuṣmāsvadhiko devo yauvarājye sureśvarāḥ || || 29 || taṃ sthāpayata śīlāḍhyaṃ śauryaudāryaguṇānvitam || ityuktā vibhunā devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ ||2.7.19.30|| evaṃ vivadire'nyonyamahaṃ bhūyāmahaṃ tviti || sarve vivadamānāśca sūryaṃ kecitparaṃ viduḥ || 31 || śakraṃ kecitparaṃ kāmaṃ kecittūṣṇīṃ tu tasthire || te nirṇayamapaśyaṃtaḥ praṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yayuḥ || 32 || namaskṛtya punaḥ prāhuḥ sarve prāṃjalayo'marāḥ || vicāritaṃ mahāviṣṇo sarvairasmābhiraṃjasā || 33 || asmāsu devamadhikaṃ naiva vidmaḥ kathaṃcana || tvameva nirṇayaṃ brūhi devāḥ saṃśayinaḥ khalu || 34 || iti pṛṣṭo'maraiḥ sarvaiḥ prahasannidamabravīt || dehādasmācca vairājādyasminniṣkrāmati hyayam|| 35 || patiṣyati praviṣṭe tu yasminvai hyutthito bhavet || sa devo hyadhiko nūnaṃ nāparastu kathaṃcana || 36 || ityuktāste tataḥ sarve tathāstviti vaco'bruvan || niścakrāma jayaṃtāhvaḥ pādātpūrvaṃ sureśvaraḥ || 37 || tadā paṃgumamuṃ prāhurna dehaḥ patitastadā || śṛṇvanpibanvadañjighranpaśyannāste'calannapi || 38 || paścādguhyādviniṣkrāṃto dakṣonāma prajāpatiḥ || tadā ṣaṃḍhamamuṃ prāhurna dehaḥ patitastadā || 39 || śṛṇvanpibanvadañjighranpaśyannāste calannapi || paścāddhastādviniṣkrāṃta indraḥ sarvāmareśvaraḥ || 2.7.19.40 || hastahīnamamuṃ prāhurna dehaḥ patitastadā || śṛṇvanpibanvadañjighranpaśyannāste calannapi || 41 || locanābhyāṃ viniṣkrāṃtaḥ sūryastejasvināṃ varaḥ || tadā kāṇamamuṃ prāhurna dehaḥ patitastadā || 42 || śṛṇvanpibanvadañjighranpaśyannāste calannapi || prāṇātpaścādviniṣkrāṃtau nāsatyau viśvabheṣajau || ajighrāṇamamuṃ prāhurna dehaḥ patitastadā || || 43 || śṛṇvanpibanvadannaiva jighrannāste'calannapi || śrotrāddiśo viniṣkrāṃtā na dehaḥ patitastadā || tadāmuṃ badhiraṃ prāhurmṛtaṃ naiva kathaṃcana||44|| pibanvadannapi tadā hyaśṛṇvannacalannapi || varuṇo rasanāyāstuviniṣkrāṃtastataḥ param || tadā'rasajñamevāhurna dehaḥ patitastadā || 45 || jīvaṃścalannadannāste tathā jānañcchavasannapi || tato vāco viniṣkrāṃto vahnirvāgīśvaro vibhuḥ || 46 || tadā mūkamamuṃ prāhurna dehaḥ patitastadā || jīvaṃścalannadannāste tathā jānañchvasannapi ||47|| paścādrudro viniṣkrāṃto manaso bodhanātmakaḥ|| tadā jaḍamamuṃ prāhurna dehaḥ patitastadā ||48|| jīvaṃścalannadannāste tathā jānañchvasannapi || paścātprāṇo viniṣkrāṃto mṛtamenaṃ tadā viduḥ || punarevaṃ tadā prāhurdevā vismitamānasāḥ || 49 || dehamutthā payedyastu punarevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || sa eva hyadhiko'smāsu yuvarājā bhaviṣyati || 2.7.19.50 || ityevaṃ tu pratiśrutya viviśuśca yathākramam || jayaṃtaḥ prāviśatpādau nottasthau tatkalevaram || 51 || guhyaṃ ca prāviśaddakṣo nottasthau tatkalevaram || indro hastau viveśā'tha nottasthau tatkalevaram || || 52 || cakṣuḥ sūryaḥ praviṣṭo'bhūnnottasthau tatkalevaram || diśaḥ śrotre praviviśurnottasthau tatkalevaram|| 53 || varuṇaḥ prāviśajihvāṃ nottasthau tatkalevaram || nāsāṃ viviśaturdasrau nottasthau tatkalevaram || 54 || vahniśca prāviśadvācaṃ nottasthau tatkalevaram || manaśca prāviśadrudro nottasthau tatkalevaram || 55 || paścātprāṇo viveśāsau tadottasthau kalevaram || tadā devā viniścitya prāṇaṃ devādhikaṃ vibhum|| 56 || bale jñāne ca dhairye ca vairāgye prāṇane'pi ca || tato'bhiṣecayāṃcakruryauvarājye mahāprabhum ||57 || utkṛṣṭasthitihetutvādukthamekaṃ tadā jaguḥ || tasmātprāṇātmakaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamam || 58 || aṃśaiḥ pūrṇairbalāḍhyaiśca pūrṇo'yaṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ ||59|| na prāṇahīnaṃ jagadasti kiṃcitprāṇena hīnaṃ na ca vai samedhate || na prāṇahīnaṃ sthitamatra kiṃcitprāṇena hīnaṃ na ca kiṃcidasti || tasmātprāṇaḥ sarvajīvādhiko'bhūdbalādhikaḥ sarvajīvāṃtarātmā || 2.7.19.60 || prāṇātko'pi hyadhiko vā samo vā śāstre dṛṣṭaḥ śrutapūrvo na cā''ste || 61 || tattatkāryānugaḥ prāṇo hyeko devo hyanekadhā || tasmātprāṇaṃ varaṃ prāhuḥ prāṇopāsanatatparāḥ || līlayaiva jagatsraṣṭuṃ hantuṃ pālayituṃ prabhuḥ || 62 || śeṣā'hiśivaśakrādyāścetanāśca jaḍā api || vāsudevādṛte ko'pi nainaṃ paribhaviṣyati || 63 || sarvadevātmakaḥ prāṇaḥ sarvadevamayo vibhuḥ || vāsudevā'nugo nityaṃ tathā viṣṇuvaśasthitaḥ || 64 || vāsudevapratīpaṃ tu na śṛṇoti na paśyati || devāḥ pratīpaṃ kurvaṃti rudrādyāḥ sureśvarāḥ || 65 || pratīpaṃ kvā'pi kurute na prāṇaḥ sarvagocaraḥ || tasmātprāṇo mahāviṣṇorbalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ||66|| evaṃ jñātvā mahāviṣṇormāhātmyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tathā || pūrvabandhānugaṃ liṃgaṃ jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragaḥ || 67|| visṛjya paramaṃ yāti nārāyaṇamanāmayam || śrutvā śaṃkhoditaṃ vākyaṃ punarvyādhaḥ prasannadhīḥ || 68 || praśrayā'vanato bhūtvā punaḥ papraccha taṃ munim || brahmanmahānubhāvasya prāṇasyā'sya jagadguroḥ || 69 || na khyāto mahimā loke kathaṃ sarveśvarasya vai || devānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca bhūpānāṃ ca mahātmanām || 2.7.19.70 || mahimā śrūyate loke purāṇeṣu sahasraśaḥ || etadācakṣva me brahmañchrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 71 || || śaṃkha uvāca || || purā prāṇo hariṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || aśvamedhairyaṣṭukāmo gaṅgātīraṃ yayau mudā || 72 || halaiścakāra bhūśuddhiṃ nānāmunigaṇairyutaḥ || antarvalmīkalīnastu kaṇvo nāma samādhigaḥ || 73 || halotkṛṣṭo viniṣkrāṃtaḥ krodhādidamuvāca ha || dṛṣṭvā puraḥ sthitaṃ prāṇaṃ śaśāpa ha mahāvibhum || 74 || adyaprabhṛti na khyātiṃ mahimā bhuvanatraye || tava prāpnoti deveśa bhūloke tu viśeṣataḥ || 75 || prakhyātāste bhaviṣyaṃti hyavatārā jagattraye || ityukto muninā tena vāyuḥ kodhāttamabravīt || 76 || vināparādhaṃ śapto'smi titikṣuṃ māṃ nirāgasam || tasmātkaṇva mahābāho gurudrohī bhavā''śu ca || 77 || loke ninditavṛttiśca bhavetyāha sadāgatiḥ || tataḥ prabhṛti loke'sminprāṇasyā'sya mahāprabho || 78 || na khyāto mahimā loke bhūloke tu viśeṣataḥ || śāpātkaṇvo guruṃ jagdhvā sūryaśiṣyo'bhavattadā || 79 || ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ tu tvayā'dhunā || yacchrotavyamito vyādha pṛccha māṃ mā vicāraya || 2.7.19.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde vāyuśāpakathanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || || cha || ||
<2.7.20>
|| vyādha uvāca || || kiṃ jīvā vibhunā sṛṣṭāḥ koṭiśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || dṛśyaṃte bhinnakarmāṇo nānāmārgāḥ sanātanāḥ || 1 || naikasvabhāvā ete hi kuta eva mahāmate || sarvaṃ tatpṛcchate mahyaṃ vistarāttattvato vada || 2 || || śaṃkha uvāca || || trividhā jīvasaṃghā hi rajaḥsattvatamoguṇāḥ || rājasā rājasaṃ karma tāmasāstāmasaṃ tathā || 3 || sāttvikāḥ sāttvikaṃ karma kurvaṃtyete yathākramam || kvacicca guṇavaiṣamyameteṣāṃ saṃsṛtau bhavet || 4 || tenaivoccāvacaṃ karma kurvaṃtaḥ phalabhāginaḥ || kvacitsukhaṃ kvacidduḥkhaṃ kvaciccobhayameva ca||5|| guṇānāmeva vaiṣamyātprāpnuvanti narā ime|| prakṛtisthā ime jīvā baddhā etairguṇaistribhiḥ || 6 || guṇakarmā'nurūpeṇa karmaṇāṃ vyatyayaḥ phalam || guṇānuguṇyaṃ bhūyaste prakṛtiṃ yāṃtyamī janāḥ || || 7 || prakṛtisthāḥ prākṛtikā guṇakarmā'bhimūrchitāḥ || gatiṃ prākṛtikīṃ yāṃti vyatyayaḥ prakṛterna hi || 8 || tāmasā duḥkhabahulāḥ sadā tāmasavṛttayaḥ || nirdayā niṣṭhurā loke sadā dveṣaikajīvinaḥ || 9 || rākṣasādyāḥ piśācāṃtāstāmasīṃ yāṃti vai gatim || rājasā miśramatayaḥ kartāraḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ || 2.7.20.10 || puṇyātsvargaṃ prāpnuvanti kvacitpāpācca yātanām || ata ete mandabhāgyā āvartaṃte punaḥ punaḥ || 11 || dharmaśīlā dayāvantaḥ śraddhāvanto'nasūyakāḥ || sāttvikāḥ sāttvikīṃ vṛttimanutiṣṭhaṃta āsate || 12 || te cordhvaṃ yāṃti vimalā guṇāpāye mahaujasaḥ || vibhinnakarmaṇāṃ cātaḥ pṛthagbhāvāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ || 13 || guṇakarmānurūpeṇa teṣāṃ viṣṇurmahāprabhuḥ || karmāṇi kārayatyaddhā svasvarūpāptaye vibhuḥ || 14 || viṣṇorvaiṣamyanairghṛṇye pūrṇakāmasya vai nahi || sṛṣṭiṃ sthitiṃ hṛtiṃ caiva samāmeva karotyayam || 15 || svaguṇādeva te sarve karmaṇaḥ phalabhāginaḥ || ārāmoptānyathā sarvānsamaṃ varṣayati drumān || 16 || ekakulyājalā hyaṃga drumāśca prakṛtiṃ gatāḥ || nārāmoptari vaiṣamyaṃ nairghṛṇyaṃ vā kathaṃcana || 17 || || vyādha uvāca || || janānāṃ pūrṇabhogānāṃ kadā muktirbhavenmune || sṛṣṭikāle'thavā hyaṃtakāle vā sthāpanasya ca || 18 || kvacicca sṛṣṭikālasya saṃhārasyā'pi vai sthiteḥ || etadvistārya me brahmanbhagavacceṣṭitaṃ vada || 19 || || || śaṃkha uvāca || || caturyugasahasrāṇi brahmaṇo dinamucyate|| rātriśca tāvatī tasya hyahorātraṃ dinaṃ bhavet || 2.7.20.20 || daśapaṃcadinānyāhuḥ pakṣaṃ māso dvayātmakaḥ || māsadvayamṛtuṃ prāhurayanaṃ ca ṛtutrayam || 21 || ayane dve vatsaraḥ syāttādṛkcchatasamā yadi || gacchaṃti brahmaṇo hyasya brahmakalpaṃ tadā viduḥ || 22 || tāvānhi pralayaḥ kāla iti vedavidāṃ matam || pralayastrividhaḥ prokto mānavo mānavātyaye || 23 || dainaṃdino dvitīyo hi brahmaṇo divasātyaye || brahmaṇo'tha laye paścādbrāhmaṃ ca pralayaṃ viduḥ || 24 || brahmaṇastu muhūrte tu manostu pralayaṃ viduḥ || pralayeṣu vyatīteṣu caturdaśasu vai kramāt || 25 || dainaṃdinalayaṃ prāhuḥ pralayānāṃ sthitiṃ punaḥ|| trayāṇāmeva lokānāṃ layo manvaṃtare bhavet || 26 || cetanānāṃ tadā nāśo na lokānāṃ kṣayo bhavet || udakaireva pūrtiśca yathā pūrvaṃ tathā punaḥ || 27 || manvaṃtarāṃte bhūyāttu cetanānāṃ punarbhavaḥ || dainaṃdinalaye vyādha sarvasyāpi kṣayo bhavet || 28 || satyalokaṃ vinā sarve lokā naśyaṃti sādhipāḥ || sacetanāḥ sādhibhūtāḥ prasupte caturānane || 29 || tattvābhimānino devāḥ kecicca munayastathā || śiṣyaṃti suptāḥ sarve'pi satyalokavyavasthitāḥ || 2.7.20.30 || tiṣṭhaṃti suptimāpannā yāvatkalpamatīṃdriyāḥ || punarniśātyaye brahmā yathāpūrvamakalpayat || 31 || ṛṣīndevānpitṝm̐llokāndharmānvarṇānpṛthakpṛthak || punardaśāvatārā hi viṣṇordevasya cakriṇaḥ || 32 || niyamena bhavaṃtyete tathānye'pi ca bhūriśaḥ || devatā ṛṣayaścaiva ākalpaṃ ca girāṃ pateḥ || 33 || punarevā'bhivartaṃte brahmaṇā saha muktigāḥ || bhūpāśca sādhavo ye ca siddhiṃ prāptāḥ paraṃ gatāḥ || 34 || tenaiva cābhivartaṃte satyalokavyavasthitāḥ || tadrāśigāḥ punaryāṃti tannāmnā śrutisaṃsthitāḥ || 35 || tattadgotreṣu jāyaṃte tattatkarmaratāḥ sadā || daityānāmapi sarveṣāṃ yadā kaliyugātyayaḥ || 36 || kalinā saha gacchaṃti svāṃ gatiṃ nirayālayāḥ || teṣāṃ ca rāśisaṃsthā ye tannāmāno'pare'pi ca ||37|| jāyaṃte karmaṇā svena tattatkarmavidhāyakāḥ|| sṛṣṭikālaṃ pravakṣyāmi muktikālaṃ tathaiva ca || 38 || brahmādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ samāhitamanā bhava || nimeṣo devadevasya brahmakalpasamo mataḥ || 39 || tasyāvasāne conmeṣo devadevaśikhāmaṇeḥ || nimeṣāṃ'te bhavedicchā sraṣṭuṃ lokāṃśca kukṣigān || 2.7.20.40 || so'paśyatsvodare sarvāñjīvasaṃghānanekaśaḥ || sṛjyānmuktānamṛnsarvām̐ liṃgabhaṃgamupāgatān || 41 || suptāḥ sṛtisthāḥ sarve'pi tamogā api sarvaśaḥ || pūrvakalpe liṃgabhaṃgamāpannā vidhipūrvakāḥ || 42 || mānavāṃtā jīvakośā jīvanmuktāśca muktigāḥ || pūrvakalpe vimuktāśca brahmādyā mānavāṃtakāḥ || 43 || dhyānasaṃsthā hi tiṣṭhaṃti viṣṇukukṣigatā api || unmeṣasyādime bhāge caturvyūhātmako vibhuḥ || 44 || bhūtvā tu pūrvasādguṇyādvāsudevācca vyūhagāt || dattvā tu brahmaṇo muktiṃ sāyujyākhyāṃ mahāvibhuḥ || 45 || dattvā tadanu sāyujyaṃ tattvajñānaṃ mahātmanām || sārūpyaṃ caiva keṣāṃcitsāmīpyaṃ ca tathā vibhuḥ || 46 || sālokyaṃ ca tathā'nyeṣāṃ dattvā devo janārdanaḥ || aniruddhavaśe sarvānsthitām̐llokānalokayat || 47 || pradyumnasya vaśe dattvā sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe || māyāṃ jayāṃ kṛtiṃ śāṃtimupayeme svayaṃ hariḥ || 48 || caturvyūhaiḥ pūrṇaguṇairvāsudevādikaiḥ kramāt || tābhiryukto mahāviṣṇuścaturvyūhātmako vibhuḥ || 49 || bhinnakarmāśayaṃ lokaṃ pūrṇakāmo vyajījanat || unmeṣāṃte punarviṣṇuryogamāyāṃ samāśritaḥ || 2.7.20.50 || saṃkarṣaṇādvyūhagācca haratyetaccarācaram || tadetatsarvamākhyātaṃ kāryaṃ ciṃtyaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 51 || yadaciṃtyaṃ durvibhāvyaṃ brahmādyairapi yogibhiḥ || || vyādha uvāca || || ke vā bhāgavatā dharmāḥ kairviṣṇuśca prasīdati || 52 || tānahaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāṃprataṃ vada no mune || || śaṃkha uvāca || || yena cittaviśuddhiḥ syādyaḥ satāmupakārakaḥ || 53 || taṃ viddhi sāttvikaṃ dharmaṃ yaśca kenāpya niṃditaḥ || śrutismṛtyudito yastu yadi niṣkāmiko bhavet || 54 || yastu lokā'viruddho'pi taṃ dharmaṃ sāttvikaṃ viduḥ || caturvidhā hi te dharmā varṇāśramavibhāgataḥ || 55 || nityanaimittikāḥ kāmyā iti te ca tridhā matāḥ || te sarve svasvadharmāśca yadā viṣṇoḥ samarpitāḥ || 56 || tadā vai sāttvikā jñeyā dharmā bhāgavatāḥ śubhāḥ || devatāṃtaradaivatyāḥ sakāmā rājasā matāḥ || 57 || yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācādidaivatyā lokaniṣṭhurāḥ || hiṃsātmakā niṃditāśca dharmāste tāmasāḥ smṛtāḥ || 58 || sattvasthāḥ sāttvikāndharmānviṣṇuprītikarāñcchubhān || kurvaṃtyanīhayā nityaṃ te vai bhāgavatāḥ smṛtāḥ || 59 || yeṣāṃ cittaṃ sadā viṣṇau jihvāyāṃ nāma vai vibhoḥ || pādau ca hṛdaye yeṣāṃ te vai bhāgavatāḥ smṛtāḥ || 2.7.20.60 || sadācāra ratā ye ca sarveṣāmupakārakāḥ || sadaiva mamatāhīnāste vai bhāgavatāḥ smṛtāḥ || 61 || yeṣāṃ ca śāstre viśvāso gurau sādhuṣu karmasu || ye viṣṇu bhaktāḥ satataṃ te vai bhāgavatāḥ smṛtāḥ || 62 || yeṣāṃ hi saṃmatā dharmāḥ śāśvatā viṣṇuvallabhāḥ || śrutismṛtyuditā ye ca te dharmāḥ śāśvatā matāḥ || 63 || aṭanaṃ sarvadeśeṣu vīkṣaṇaṃ sarvakarmaṇām || śravaṇaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ viṣayā''saktacetasām || 64 || akiṃcitkarameteṣāṃ ṣaṃḍhasyeva varastriyaḥ || sādhūnāṃ darśanenaiva mano dravati vai satām || 65 || caṃdrasya kaumudīsaṃgāccaṃdrakāṃtaśilā yathā || kvacitsacchāstraśravaṇādviṣayai rahitaṃ manaḥ || 66 || tiṣṭhatyeva satāṃ puṃsāṃ tejorūpaṃ hyakalmaṣam || padmabandhoḥ prabhāsaṃgātsūryakāṃtaśilā yathā || 67 || niṣkāmairhi janairyaistu śraddhayā samupāśritaḥ || yo viṣṇuvallabho nityaṃ dharmo bhāgavato mataḥ || 68 || tairdṛṣṭā vahavo dharmā ihā'mutra phalapradāḥ || viṣṇuprītikarāḥ sūkṣmāḥ sarvaduḥkhavimocakāḥ || 69 || dadhnaḥ sāramivoddhṛtya dharmaṃ vaiśākhasaṃbhavam || ramāyai bhagavānāha kṣīrābdhau hitakāmyayā || 2.7.20.70 || mārgacchāyāvinirmāṇaṃ prapādānaṃ ca vai tathā || vyajanairvyajanaṃ caiva praśrayāṇāṃ samarpaṇam || 71 || chatrasyopānahordānaṃ dānaṃ karpūragandhayoḥ || vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ nirmāṇaṃ vibhave sati || 72 || sāyāhne pānakasyāpi dānaṃ tu kusumasya ca || tāṃbūladānaṃ pāpaghnaṃ gorasānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 73 || lavaṇānvitatakrasya dānaṃ śrāṃtāya vai pathi || abhyaṃgakaraṇaṃ caiva dvijapādāvanejanam || 74 || kaṭakambalaparyaṃkadānaṃ godānameva ca || madhuyuktatilānāṃ ca dānaṃ pāpavināśanam || 75 || sāyāhne cekṣudaṇḍānāṃ dānamurvārukasya ca || rasāyanapradānaṃ ca pitṛnirvāpaṇaṃ tathā || 76 || ete dharmā pi(?)śiṣyoktā māse'sminmādhavapriye || prātaḥ sūryodaye snātvā śṛṇvandvijakuleritam ||77|| nityakarmāṇi kṛtvaivaṃ madhusūdanamarcayet || kathāṃ mādhavamāsīyāṃ śṛṇuyācca samāhitaḥ||78|| tailābhyaṃgaṃ varjayecca kāṃsyapātre tu bhojanam || niṣiddhabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva vṛthā''lāpaṃ tu varjayet || 79 || alābuṃ gṛṃjaraṃ caiva laśunaṃ tilapiṣṭakam || āranālaṃ bhissaṭaṃ ca ghṛtakośātakīṃ tathā ||2.7.20.80|| upodakīṃ kaliṃgaṃ ca śigruśākaṃ ca varjayet || niṣpāvāni kulitthāni masūrāṇi ca varjayet|| || 81 || vṛṃtākāni kaliṃgāni kodravāṇi ca varjayet || taṃdulīyakaśākaṃ ca kausumbhaṃ mūlakaṃ tathā || 82 || auduṃbaraṃ bilvaphalaṃ tathā śleṣmā takīphalam || sarvathā varjayedvidvānmāse'sminmādhavapriye || 83 || eteṣvanyatamaṃ bhuktvā sa caṃḍālo bhaveddhruvam || tiryagyoniśataṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 84 || evaṃ māsavrataṃ kuryātprītaye madhughātinaḥ || evaṃ vrate samāpte tu pratimāṃ kārayedvibhoḥ || 85 || madhusūdanadaivatyāṃ savastrāṃ ca sadakṣiṇām || svarcitāṃ vibhavaiḥ sarvairbrāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 86 || vaiśākhasitadvādaśyāṃ dadyāddadhyannamaṃjasā || sodakumbhaṃ satāṃbūlaṃ saphalaṃ ca sadakṣiṇam||87|| dadāmi dharmarājāya tena prīṇātu vai yamaḥ|| apasavyātsamuccārya nāmagotre pitustataḥ||88|| dadyāddadhyannamakṣayyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave || gurubhyaśca tathā dadyātpaścāddadyācca viṣṇave||89|| śītalodakadadhyannaṃ kāṃsyapātrasthamuttamam|| sadakṣiṇaṃ satāṃbūlaṃ sabhakṣyaṃ ca phalānvitam ||2.7.20.90|| dadāmi viṣṇave tubhyaṃ viṣṇulokajigīṣayā || iti dattvā yathāśaktyā gāṃ ca dadyātkuṭuṃbine || 91 || evaṃ māsavrataṃ kuryādyo daṃbhena vivarjitaḥ || sa sarvaiḥ pātakairhīnaḥ kulamuddhṛtya vai śatam || 92 || paśyatāmeva bhūtānāṃ bhittvā vai sūryamaṃḍalam || yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ dhāma yogināmapi durlabham||93|| vyākhyātyevaṃ dvijakulavare mādhavīyāṃśca || dharmānviṣṇvādīṣṭānatimahitarānvyādhapṛṣṭānsamastān ||94|| vaṭaḥ sadyaḥ paśyatāmeva bhūmau papātāho paṃcaśākhī drumo'yam || vṛkṣāttasmātkoṭare saṃsthito hi vyālaḥ kaściddīrghadehī karālaḥ || hitvā dehaṃ pāpayoniṃ ca sadyaḥ sa vai tasthau prāṃjalirnamramūrdhā || 95 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṃḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde bhāgavatadharmakathanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || || cha ||
<2.7.21>
|| śrutadeva uvāca || || tatastu vismito bhūtvā śaṃkho vyādhasamanvitaḥ || ko bhavāniti taṃ prāha daśaiṣā ca kutastava || 1 || kena vā karmaṇā saumya matistava śubhāvahā || akasmātte kathaṃ muktiretadācakṣva vistarāt || 2 || śaṃkhenaiva tadā pṛṣṭo daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi || praśrayā'vanato bhūtvā prāṃjalirvākyamabravīt || 3 || ahaṃ purā dvijaḥ kaścitprayāge bahubhāṣaṇaḥ || rūpayauvanasaṃpanno vidyāmadasugarvitaḥ || 4 || dhanāḍhyo bahuputrāḍhyaḥ sadā'haṃkāradūṣitaḥ|| kusīdasya muneḥ putro nāmnā rocana ityaham|| 5 || āsanaṃ śayanaṃ nidrā vyavāyo'kṣaparikriyāḥ || lokavārtā kusīdaṃ vā vyāpārāste mamā'bhavan || 6 || taṃtumātrāṇi karmāṇi lokanindāviśaṃkitaḥ || sadaṃbhaśca sadā kurve na śraddhā me kadācana || 7 || durbuddhermama duṣṭasya kiyatkālo gato'bhavat || tadā vaiśākhamāse'smiñjayaṃtonāma vai dvijaḥ || 8 || śrāvayāmāsa tanmāsadharmānbhāgavatapriyān || tatkṣetre vāsināṃ puṇyakarmaṇāṃ ca dvijanmanām || 9 || nārīnarāḥ kṣatriyāśca vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ sahasraśaḥ || prātaḥ snātvā samabhyarcya madhusūdanamavyayam || 2.7.21.10 || kathāṃ śṛṇvaṃti satataṃ jayantena samīritām || śucibhūtvā maunadharā vāsudevakathāratāḥ || 11 || vaiśākhadharmaniratā daṃbhālasyavivarjitāḥ || tāṃ sabhāṃ ca praviṣṭo'haṃ kautukācca didṛkṣayā || 12 || soṣṇīṣeṇa mayā mūrdhnā namaskāro'pi na kṛtaḥ || tāṃbūlaṃ ca mukhe kṛtvā kaṃcukaṃ ca mayā dhṛtam ||13|| kathāvikṣepamacaraṃ lokavārtābhiraṃjanāt || sarveṣāṃ cittacāṃcalyamabhūdvai lokavārtayā || 14 || kvacidvāsaḥ prasāryāhaṃ kvacinniṃdankvaciddhasan || evaṃ kālo mayānītaḥ kathā yāvatsamāpyate || 15 || paścāttenaiva doṣeṇa sadyo'lpāyurvinaṣṭadhīḥ || sannipātena pañcatvaṃ prāpto'haṃ ca pare dine ||16|| taptasīsajalaiḥ pūrṇaṃ nirayaṃ ca halāhalam|| prāpya bhuktvā yātanāṃ ca manvantāni caturdaśa ||17|| yukteṣvatha ca lakṣeṣu tathā caturaśītibhiḥ || kramādyoniṣu jāto'hamidānīṃ cāvasandrume ||18|| daśayojanavistīrṇe śatayojanamunnate || vyālo'haṃ tāmasaḥ krūraḥ saptayojanakoṭare ||19|| bhūtvā vasāmi viprarṣe karmaṇā bādhitaḥ purā || ayutaṃ ca samā yātā nirāhārasya koṭare || 2.7.21.20 || daivāttava mukhāṃbhojasamīritakathāmṛtam || śrutvā cakṣurdvayenāhaṃ sadyo dhvastāśubho mune ||21|| vyālayoniṃ visṛjyā'haṃ divyarūpadharaḥ pumān || prāṃjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā pādau te śaraṇaṃ gataḥ||22|| kasmiñjanmani tvaṃ badhurna jāne munisattama || na mayopakṛtaṃ kvā'pi sānukampaḥ kutaḥ satām || 23 || sādhūnāṃ samacittānāṃ sadā bhūtadayāvatām || paropakāraprakṛtirna caiṣāmanyathā matiḥ || 24 || māmadyānugṛhāṇa tvaṃ yathā dharme matirbhavet || na bhūyādvismṛtiḥ kvā'pi viṣṇordevasya cakriṇaḥ || 25 || mahatāṃ sādhuvṛttānāṃ saṃga tiśca sadā bhavet || dāridyamekameva syānmadāṃdhaparamāṃjanam || 26 || iti taṃ bahudhā stutvā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ || prāṃjaliḥ praṇatastasthau tūṣṇīmeva tadagrataḥ||27|| śaṃkho dorbhyāṃ samutthāpya pūrṇapremapariplutaḥ|| pasparśa pāṇinā cāṃgaṃ śaṃtamena gatādhvasaḥ || 28 || cakre so'nuhgrahaṃ tasmindivyarūpadhare dvije || prāha taṃ kṛpayā''viṣṭo bhāvivṛttāntamañjasā || || 29|| dvija tvaṃ māsamāhātmyaśravaṇācca harerapi || māhātmyaśravaṇātsadyo vidhvastā'khilabaṃdhanaḥ || 2.7.21.30 || atihāya kalaṃkaṃ ca kramādgatvā punarbhuvi || daśārṇe viṣame puṇye bhavitā tvaṃ dvijottamaḥ || 31 || vedaśarmeti vikhyātaḥ sarvavedaviśāradaḥ || tatra te bhavitā jātismṛtirātyaṃtikī śubhā ||32|| tathā smṛtānubandhastvaṃ tyaktasarveṣaṇaḥ śubhaḥ|| karoṣi sakalāndharmānvaiśākhoktānharipriyān || 33 || nirdvandvo niḥspṛho'saṃgo guru bhakto jitendriyaḥ || sadā viṣṇukathālāpo bhavitā tatra janmani ||34|| tataḥ siddhiṃ samāpyātha vidhvastā'khilabandhanaḥ || prāpnoṣi paramaṃ dhāma yogairapi durāsadam ||35|| mā bhaiṣīḥ putra bhadraṃ te bhavitā matprasādataḥ || hāsyādbhayāttathā krodhāddveṣātkāmādathā'pi vā||36|| snehādvā sakṛduccārya viṣṇornāmā'ghahāri ca|| pāpiṣṭhā api gacchanti viṣṇordhāma nirāmayam ||37|| kimu tacchraddhayā yuktā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ || dayāvantaḥ kathāṃ śrutvā gacchaṃtīti dvijottama ||38|| kecitkevalayā bhaktyā kathālāpaikatatparāḥ || sarvadharmmojjhitā vā'pi yāṃti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam||39|| dveṣādinā ca bhaktyā vā kecidviṣṇumupāsate || te'pi yāṃti paraṃ dhāma pūtanevāsuhāriṇī || 2.7.21.40 || mahadbhiḥ saṃgato nityaṃ vāgvisargastadāśrayaḥ || mumukṣūṇāṃ ca kartavyaḥ sa vidhiḥ śruticoditaḥ || 41 || sa vāgvisargo janatā'ghaviplavo yasminpratiślokamabaddhavatyapi || nāmānyanaṃtasya yaśoṃkitāni yacchṛṇvanti gāyanti gṛṇaṃti sādhavaḥ || 42 || yaḥ kaṣṭasevāṃ na ca kāṃkṣate vibhurna vāsanaṃ bhūri na rūpayauvane || smṛtaḥ sakṛdgacchati dhāma bhāsvaraṃ kaṃ vā dayāluṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajeta || 43 || tameva śaraṇaṃ yāhi nārāyaṇamanāmayam || bhaktavatsalamavyaktaṃ cetogamyaṃ dayānidhim || 44 || kuru sarvānimāndhamānvaiśākhoktānmahāmate || tena tuṣṭo jagannāthaḥ śarma te ca vidhāsyati || 45 || ityuktvā virarāmātha vyādhaṃ dṛṣṭvā suvismitaḥ|| sa divyaḥ puruṣaḥ prāha punastaṃ munipuṃgavam || 46 || || divyapuruṣa uvāca || || dhanyosmyanugṛhīto'smi tvayā śaṃkha dayālunā || diṣṭyā gatā me duryoniryāmi caiva parāṃ gatim||47|| iti taṃ ca parikramya hyanujñāto divaṃ yayau|| tataḥ sāyamabhūdrājañcchaṃkho vyādhena toṣitaḥ || 48 || saṃdhyāṃ sāyantanīṃ kṛtvā rātriśeṣaṃ nināya ca || nānākhyāneśca bhūpānāṃ devānāṃ ca mahātmanām || 49 || līlābhiravatārāṇāṃ dṛṣṭago ṣṭhibhireva ca || brāhme muhūrte cotthāya pādau prakṣālya vāgyataḥ || 2.7.21.50 || dhyāyaṃśca tārakaṃ brahma kṛtvā śaucādisatkriyām || vaiśākhe meṣage sūrye snātvā prākca bhagodayāt || 51 || kṛtvā saṃdhyādikaṃ karma tathā saṃtarpya cā'khilān || vyādhamāhūya hṛṣṭātmā mūrdhni prokṣya nirīkṣya ca || 52 || rāmeti dvyakṣaraṃ nāma dadau vedādhikaṃ śubham || viṣṇorekaikanāmā'pi sarvavedādhikaṃ matam || 53 || tebhyaścā'naṃtanāmabhyo'dhikaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasrakam || tādṛṅnāmasahasreṇa rāmanāma samaṃ matam || 54 || tasmādrāmeti tannāma japa vyādha niraṃtaram || dharmānetānkuru vyādha yāvadāmaraṇāṃtikam || 55 || tataste bhavitā janma valmīkasya ṛṣeḥ kule || vālmīkiriti nāmnā ca bhūmau khyātimavāpsyasi || 56 || iti vyādhaṃ samādiśya pratasthe dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || vyādho'pi taṃ parikramya praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ || 57 || kiṃciddūrānugo bhūtvā sa rudanvirahāturaḥ || yāvaddṛṣṭipathaṃ tāvatpaśyaṃstasya gatiṃ punaḥ || 58 || punarnivavṛte kṛcchrāttameva hṛdi ciṃtayan || vanaṃ nirmāya tanmārge prapāṃ kṛtvā sunirmalām || 59 || atiyogyānimāndharmānvaiśākhoktāṃścakāra ha || vanyaiḥ kapitthapanasairjaṃbūcūtādibhiḥ phalaiḥ || 2.7.21.60 || mārgānāṃ śramārtānāmāhāraṃ parikalpayan || upānadbhiścaṃdanaiśca chatraiśca vyajanairapi ||61|| vālukāstaraṇopetacchāyābhiśca kvacitkvacit || ājahārātha pāṃthānāṃ śramaṃ svedodbhavaṃ tathā ||62|| prātaḥ snātvā divārātraṃ japanrāmeti vai manum || vyādhajanmani nāmā'sau valmīkasya suto'bhavat || 63 || kṛṇurnāma muniḥ kaścittasminneva sarovare || tapo vai dustaraṃ tepe bāhyavyāpāravarjitaḥ || 64 || valmīkamabhavaddehe tasya kālena bhūyasā || valmīka iti taṃ prāhurato vai munipuṃgavam || 65 || paścāttapovirāmāṃte kṛṇau smṛtipathaṃ gate || striyo'nusmarato rājanskhalitaṃ ceṃdriyaṃ muneḥ || 66 || jagrāha śailuṣī kācittasyāṃ jajñe vanecaraḥ || vālmīkiriti vikhyāto bhuvaneṣu mahāyaśāḥ || 67 || yo vai rāmakathāṃ divyāṃ svaiḥ prabaṃdhairmanoharaiḥ || loke prakhyāpayāmāsa karmabandhanikṛṃtanīm || 68 || || śrutadeva uvāca || || paśya vaiśākhamāhātmyaṃ bhūpālādyā'pi bhūtidam || vyādhopyupānahau dattvā ṛṣitvaṃ prāpa durlabham || 69 || ya idaṃ paramākhyānaṃ pāpaghnaṃ romaharṣaṇam || śṛṇuyācchrāvayedvā'pi na bhūyaḥ stanapo bhavet || 70|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde vyādhopākhyāne vālmīkerjanmakathanannāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || || cha || ||
<2.7.22>
|| maithileya uvāca || || kā hyasmiṃstithayaḥ puṇyā māse vaiśākhasaṃjñake || kāni dānāni śastāni tāsu tāsu viśeṣataḥ || 1 || kāḥ prakhyātāśca vai loka etadācakṣva vistarāt || || śrutadeva uvāca || || triṃśacca tithayaḥ puṇyā vaiśākhe meṣage ravau || 2 || ekādaśyāṃ kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam || 3 || samavāpnoti vaiśākha ekādaśyāṃ jalāplutaḥ || snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homo devatārcanasatkriyāḥ || 4 || kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ caiva sadyo muktividhāyakam || rogādyupahato yastu dāridryeṇā'pi pīḍitaḥ || 5 || śrutvā kathāmimāṃ puṇyāṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || asnātvā cāpyadattvā ca yena nītā imāḥ śubhāḥ || 6 || sa goghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca pitṛghnaśca mahānsmṛ taḥ || jalāśayāśca svādhīnāḥ svādhīnaṃ ca kalevaram ||7|| mādhavo manasā sevyaḥ kālaśca suguṇottamaḥ || sādhavaśca dayāvaṃtaḥ ko na seveta mādhavam || 8 || daridraiśca dhanāḍhyaiśca paṃgubhiścāṃdhakaistathā || ṣaṃḍhaiśca vidhavābhiśca nārībhiśca naraistathā || 9 || kumārayuvavṛddhaiśca rogārtairapi bhūmipa || atīvasukhasādhyo hi dharmo vaiśākhagocaraḥ || 2.7.22.10 || māsamenamanuprāpya dharmānkuru imāñcchubhān || ko na yatnaṃ ca kurute tasmātko nvaparaḥ śubhaḥ || 11 || yo'tīva sulabhāndharmānna karoti narā'dhamaḥ || tasyaiva sulabhā lokā nārakā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 12 || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tasminmāse ca kottamā || tāṃ tithiṃ sarvapāpaghnīṃ dadhnaḥ sāramivoddhṛtām ||13|| caitre māsi mahāpuṇye meṣasaṃsthe divākare || pāpaghnī pitṛdaivatyā gayākoṭiphalapradā || 14 || atraiva śrūyate puṇyā pitṛgāthā purātanī || śṛṇu tāṃ satkathāṃ rājansāvarṇau śāsati kṣitim || 15 || triṃśatkaliyugasyāṃte sarvadharmavivarjite || ānarte tu dvijaḥ kaściddharmavarṇa iti śrutaḥ || 16 || dṛṣṭvā kaliyuge rājañjanānpāparatānmuniḥ || tasyaiva prathame pāde varṇadharmavivarjite ||17|| sa kadācitsatrayāgaṃ munīnāṃ tu mahātmanām || agamatpuṣkare kṣetre kurvatāṃ maunadhāriṇām ||18|| tatra cāsanpuṇyakathā ṛṣīṇāṃ śāstragocarāḥ|| tatra kecitkaliyugaṃ praśaśaṃsurdhṛtavratāḥ ||19|| kṛte yadvatsarātsādhyaṃ puṇyaṃ mādhavatoṣaṇam || tretāyāṃ māsataḥ sādhyaṃ dvāpare pakṣato nṛpa || 2.7.22.20 || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kalau viṣṇusmṛterbhavet || atyalpamapi vai puṇyaṃ kalau koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 21 || dayā puṇyavihīne tu dānadharmavivarjite || dayādānaṃ ca kurute sakṛduccārya vai harim || 22 || sa eva cordhvago nūnaṃ durbhikṣe cānnadastathā || etatprasaṃgāvasare nārado'bhyetya vai muniḥ || 23 || kareṇaikena śiśnaṃ ca jihvāṃ caikena vai hasan || pragṛhyonmattavattatra nanarta munisattamaḥ || 24 || sabhyāstadā tamityūcuḥ kimetaditi nārada || pratyuvāca sa tānsarvānnṛtyaṃ kurvanhasansudhīḥ || 254 saṃtoṣādyadiha proktaṃ nṛtyadbhirbhāvitātmabhiḥ || siddhā vayaṃ na saṃdehaḥ puṇyo'yaṃ kalirāgataḥ || 26 || tatsatyaṃ na ca saṃdeho bahu svalpena sādhyate || smaraṇāttoṣamāyāti keśavaḥ kleśanāśanaḥ || 27 || tathāpi vaḥ pravakṣyāmi durghaṭaṃ ca dvayaṃ dhuvam || śiśnasya nigrahaḥ putrā jihvāyā api nityaśaḥ || 28 || dvayaṃ yaddhi bhavedyasya sa eva syājjanārdanaḥ || bhavadbhirnātra sthātavyaṃ tasmātkaliyugāgame || 29 || pākhaṃḍaṃ bhārataṃ hitvā saṃcaradhvaṃ yathāsukham || yatra kutrāpi deśeṣu mano yatra prasīdati || 2.7.22.30 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || satraṃ samāpya sahasā yayuste ca yathāsukham || 31 || dharmavarṇo'pi tacchrutvā tyaktuṃ bhūmiṃ mano dadhe || sa vrataṃ cordhvatejaskaṃ dhṛtvā daṇḍakamaḍalū || 32 || jaṭāvalkaladhārī ca bhūtvā caivaṃ yayau punaḥ || kalau yuge tvanācārāndraṣṭuṃ vismitamānasaḥ || 33 || tatrā'paśyajjanānghorānpāpācāraratānkhalān || pākhaṇḍino dvijāḥ sarve śūdrāḥ pravrājinastathā || 34 || bhartāraṃ dveṣṭi bhāryā ca śiṣyo dveṣṭi guruṃ tathā || bhṛtyaśca svāmihaṃtā ca putraḥ pitṛvadhe rataḥ || 35 || śūdraprāyā dvijāḥ sarve bastaprāyāśca dhenavaḥ || gāthāprāyāstathā vedāḥ kriyāsāmyāḥ śubhāḥ kriyāḥ || 36 || bhūtapretapiśācādyāḥ phaladāstatra devatāḥ || tā eva śraddhayā'rcaṃti janāḥ pāparatāḥ śitāḥ || 37 || sarve vyavāyaniratāstadarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ || kūṭasākṣyapravaktāraḥ sadā kaitavamānasāḥ || 38 || manasyekaṃ vacasyekaṃ karmaṇyekaṃ sadā kalau || sarveṣāṃ haitukī vidyā sā pūjyā nṛpamaṃdire || 39 || gītādyāśca kalā vidyā nṛpāṇāṃ ca priyāvahāḥ || hīnāśca pūjyatāṃ yāṃti nottamāśca kalau yuge || 2.7.22.40 || śrotriyāśca dvijāḥ sarve daridrāḥ syuḥ kalau yuge || viṣṇubhaktirnarāṇāṃ tu prāyaśo naiva vartate ||41|| prāyaḥ pākhaṃḍabhūyiṣṭhaṃ puṇyakṣetraṃ bhaviṣyati || śūdrā dharmapravaktāro jaṭilāstāpasāḥ kalau ||42|| sarve cālpāyuṣo martyā dayāhīnā śaṭhā janāḥ || sarve dharmapravaktāraḥ sarve ca grahaṇotsavāḥ || 43 || svārcanaṃ cā'pi hīcchaṃti vṛthā nindāparāyaṇāḥ || asūyāniratāḥ sarve prabhoḥ svagṛhamāgate || 44 || bhrātā ca bhaginīgaṃtā pitā putrīṃ ca vai kalau || sarve'pi śūdrīniratāḥ sarve vārāṃganāratāḥ || 45 || sādhūnnaiva vijānaṃti bahupāpāṃśca manyate || vyaktīkurvaṃti sādhūnāṃ doṣamekaṃ durāgrahāḥ || 46 || pāpānāṃ doṣajātāni guṇatvena vadanti hi || doṣameva pragṛhṇaṃti kalau tu viguṇā janāḥ ||47|| jalaukā dharmasaṃyuktā raktaṃ pivati no payaḥ || auṣadhyaḥ sattvahīnā hi ṛtūn vyatyayāstathā || 48 || durbhikṣaṃ sarvarāṣṭreṣu kanyā kāle na sūyate || naṭanartakavidyāsu prītimanto narāḥ kalau || 49 || vedavedāṃtavidyāsu niratā ye guṇādhikāḥ || bhṛtyānpaśyaṃti tānmūḍhāste bhraṣṭāścākhilā nṛpa || 2.7.22.50 || tyaktaśrāddhakriyāḥ sarve tyaktavedoditakriyāḥ || jihvāyāṃ viṣṇunāmāni na vartaṃte kadācana || śṛṃgārarasa nirvāṇāstadgītānyeva te jaguḥ ||51|| na viṣṇusevā na ca śāstravārtā na yāgadīkṣā na vicāraleśaḥ || na tīrthayātrā na ca dānadharmāḥ kalau jane kvā'pi babhūva citram || 52 || tāndṛṣṭvā gharmavarṇo'pi subhīto'tyantavismitaḥ || vaṃśaṃ pāpātkṣayaṃ yāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvīpāṃtaraṃ yayau || 53 || sa caransarvadvīpeṣu lokeṣveva tu sarvaśaḥ || pitṛlokaṃ yayau dhīmānkadācitkautukānvitaḥ || 54 || tatrā'paśyanmahāghorāñcchrāmyamāṇāṃśca karmabhiḥ ||55|| dhāvato rudamānāṃśca patataḥ patitānapi || tatrāpaśyaccāndhakūpe patitānsvānpitṝnadhaḥ || 56 || dūrvāgralaṃbino dīnāndūrvācchede hi śaṃkitān || tadā prāptaḥ ko'pi cākhurdūrvāmūlaṃ tadāśrayam || 57 || tena bhāgatrayaṃ cāttameko bhāgovaśeṣitaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā te kṣīyamāṇaṃ mūlaṃ duḥkhena karṣiṇaḥ || || 58 || adho dṛṣṭvā cāṃ'dhakūpaṃ taṭapātādibhīṣaṇam || duruttāraṃ mahāghoraṃ karmaṇāptaṃ suduḥkhitāḥ || 59 || agre cā'pi duruttāramavalaṃbavivarjitam || tāndraṣṭvā vismito bhūtvā dayālurvākyamabravīt ||2.7.22.60|| ke yūyaṃ patitā hyasminkena dustarakarmaṇā || kasya gotre samutpannāḥ kathaṃ vo muktirūrjitā || 61 || etadyūyaṃ vadadhvaṃ me śarma vo'tha bhaviṣyati || ityevamuditāstena pitaro'tha suduḥkhitāḥ || 62 || tamūcuḥ karuṇāṃ vācaṃ dharmaśruti puraḥsarāḥ || || pitara ūcuḥ || || vayaṃ śrīvatsagotrīyā bhuvi santānavarjitāḥ || 63 || piṃḍaśrāddhavihīnāśca tena pacyāmahe vayam || niḥsantāno'pi no vaṃśo jātaḥ pāpaiḥ kalau yuge ||64|| nā'smākaṃ piṃḍadaścāsti vaṃśe pāpātkṣayaṃ gate|| tenāṃ'dhakūpe patanaṃ nistaṃtūnāṃ durātmanām ||65|| eko hi vartate vaṃśe dharmavarṇo mahāyaśāḥ || sa viraktaścaranneko na gārhasthamupeyivān || 66 || taṃtunā tena bibhrāmo dūrvānālāvalaṃbitāḥ || nistaṃtutvācca tanmūlamākhuḥ khādati pratyaham || 67 || ekasyaivā'vaśiṣṭatvātkiṃcinnalo'vaśeṣitaḥ || ākhunā khādyamānaśca vartate saumya paśyatām || || 68 || tasya cā''yuḥkṣaye tāta śeṣamākhurhariṣyati || paścātkūpe patiṣyāmo duruttāreṃ'dhatāmase || 69 || tasmāttvaṃ ca bhuvaṃ gatvā dharmavarṇaṃ prabodhaya || asmadvākyairdayāpātrairgārhasthyaṃ vimukhaṃ munim || 2.7.22.70 || pitaraste bhṛśā'rtā hi narake patitā mayā || andhakūpe duruttāre dṛṣṭā dūrvāvalaṃbitāḥ || 71 || sā dūrvā vaṃśarūpā hi tanmūlaṃ satataṃ mune || kālākhyo mūṣakastasya mūlaṃ khādati pratyaham || 72 || vaṃśanāśo'nukramata ekastvaṃ tvavaśeṣitaḥ || tena mūlasya dūrvāyā naṣṭaṃ bhāgatrayaṃ mune ||73|| eko bhāgo'vaśiṣṭo'tra yatastvaṃ vartase bhuvi || kiṃcitkhādati vai tvā''khustava cā''yuḥkṣayakramāt || 74 || parete tvayi cā'smākaṃ tavā'pi patanaṃ bhavet || kūpa evāndhatāmisre saṃtāne'pi kṣayaṃ gate || 75 || tasmādgārhasthyamāsādya kuru saṃtativardhanam|| tenā'smākaṃ tavā'pi syādgatirūrdhvā na saṃśayaḥ || 76|| eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko'pi gayāṃ vrajet || yajeta vā'śvamedhaṃ ca nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet || 77 || yadyeko'pi ca vaiśākhe māghe vā kārtike'pi ca || asmānuddiśya vai snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ kariṣyati || 78 || tena cordhvagatirbhūyānnarakāduddhṛtiśca naḥ || eko vā viṣṇubhaktaḥ syādeko vā harivāsarī || 79 || eko vā śṛṇuyādviṣṇoḥ kathāṃ pāpavināśanīm || tasyātītaṃ kulaśataṃ bhāvi cā'pi kulaṃ śatam || 2.7.22.80 || api pāpavṛtaṃ kvā'pi narakaṃ naiva paśyati || kimanyairbahubhiḥ putrairdayādharmavivarjitaiḥ || 81 || ye jātā nārcayaṃtyaddhā viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kule || nā'putrasya hi loko'sti sarvametajjanā viduḥ ||82|| tatrā'pi ca dayāyuktaṃ tatsaṃtānaṃ ca durlabham || iti taṃ bodhayitvā tu vākyairetaiśca sūnṛtaiḥ || 83 || viraktasyordhvaretasya gārhasthye tvaṃ matiṃ kuru || pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dharmavarṇo'tivismitaḥ ||84|| praṇamya prāṃjaliḥ prāha rudanvai jātavepathuḥ || nāmnāhaṃ dharmavarṇaśca yuṣmadvaṃśyo durāgrahī || || 85 || satre śrutvā tu vacanaṃ nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || jihvādārḍhyaṃ guhyadārḍhyaṃ na kasyā'pi kalau yuge || 86 || dṛṣṭvā bhuvi ca pāpiṣṭhāṃstāñjanānapi śaṃkitaḥ || bhīto durjanasaṃgatyā carandvīpāṃtare vasan || 87 || pādāstrayo gatā hyasya kaleḥ pādeṃ'tyake'pi ca || gatāḥ sārddhatrayo bhāgā idānīṃ janakā ime || 88 || nā'haṃ vedmi bhavadduḥkhaṃ vṛthā janma gataṃ mama || yasminkule tvahaṃ jāta ṛṇaṃ pitrorna vai hṛtam || 89 || kiṃ tena jātamātreṇa bhūbhāreṇā'tra śatruṇā || yo jāto nārcayedviṣṇuṃ pitṝndevānṛṣīṃstathā || 2.7.22.90 || yuṣmadājñāṃ kariṣyāmi māmā''jñāpayata kṣitau || yathā na kalibādhā syāttatra saṃsārato'pi vā || 91 || kartavyānyapi kṛtyāni mayā putreṇa bhūtale || ityuktāstena vaṃśyena dharmavarṇena dhīmatā ||92|| kiṃcidāśvastamanasa idamūcurmahīpate || putra paśya daśāmetāṃ pitṝṇāṃ te mahātmanām || 93 || saṃtatyabhāvātpatatāṃ dūrvāmātrāvalaṃbinām || tvaṃ gārhasthyamupālabhya saṃtatyāsmānsamuddhara || 94 || ye ca viṣṇukathāraktā ye smaraṃtyaniśaṃ harim || ye sadācāraniratā na tānvai bādhate kaliḥ || || 95 || śāligrāmaśilā yasya gṛhe tiṣṭhati mānada || athavā bhārataṃ gehe na taṃ vai bādhate kaliḥ || 96 || yaśca vaiśākhanirato māghasnānaparaśca yaḥ || kārtike dīpadātā yo na taṃ vai bādhate kaliḥ ||97|| pratyahaṃ śṛṇuyādyastu kathāṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ || pāpaghnīṃ mokṣadāṃ divyāṃ na taṃ vai bādhate kaliḥ ||98|| yadgṛhe vaiśvadevaśca yadgṛhe tulasī śubhā|| yadaṃgaṇe śubhā gauśca na taṃ vai bādhate kaliḥ||99|| tasmānno bhītirastīha yuge pāpātmake'pi ca || śīghraṃ gaccha bhuvaṃ putra māso'yaṃ mādhavāhvayaḥ || 2.7.22.100 || sarveṣāmupakārāya meṣasaṃsthe divākare || triṃśacca tithayaḥ puṇyā meṣasaṃsthe divākare || 101 || ekaikasyāṃ kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || tatrā'pi caitrabahulo darśo nṛṇāṃ ca muktidaḥ || 2 || priyaśca pitṛdevānāṃ sadyo muktividhāyakaḥ || ye vai pitṝnsamuddiśya śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃti taddine ||3|| sodakuṃbhaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ tadakṣayyaphalaṃ labhet || ye ca kurvaṃti vai śrāddhamamāyāṃ ca madhau suta || 4 || taiḥ kṛtaṃ tu gayākṣetre śrāddhaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || yadi śrāddhaṃ madhau darśe śākenā'pi karoti ca|| 5 || koṭiśrāddhaṃ gayāyāṃ tu kṛtaṃ tena na saṃśayaḥ || kuṃbhaṃ ca pānakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ karpūrāguruvāsitam || 6 || yo na dadyānmadhau darśe sa pitṛghno na saṃśayaḥ || yo dadyācca madhau darśe sapānīyaṃ karīrakam || 7 || śrāddhaṃ ca bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ kurute ca kuloddhatim || pitṝṇāṃ ca tathā loke nadī cā'mṛtavarṣiṇī || 8 || kuṃbhadānātprasarati śrāddhadānādidāyinām || annasūpaghṛtāpūpalehyapāyasakardamān || 9 || tasmājjhaṭiti tvaṃ gaccha yadā vā 'mā bhaviṣyati || kuru śrāddhaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ sodakumbhaṃ mahāmate ||2.7.22.110|| sarveṣāmupakārāya gārhasthyaṃ ca samāśraya || dharmārthakāmaiḥ saṃtuṣṭaḥ prāpya saṃtānamuttamam || 11 || punaśca munivṛttistvaṃ sukhaṃ dvīpe susaṃcara || ityādiṣṭaḥ pitṛbhiśca tūrṇaṃ bhūmiṃ yayau muniḥ || 12 || caitre māse meṣasaṃsthe puṇye māsi divākare || prātaḥ snātvā ca saṃtarjya pitṝndevānṛṣīṃstathā || 13 || sodakuṃbhaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā pāpavināśanam || tena dattvā pitṝṇāṃ ca muktimāvṛttivarjitām || 14 || svayaṃ vivāhamakarotsaṃtatiṃ prāpya vai satīm || loke prakhyāpayāmāsa tāṃ tithiṃ pāpanāśanīm ||15|| svayaṃ punarmudā bhaktyā gandhamādanamāyayau || 16 || tasmātpuṇyatamā caiṣā madhordarśāhvayā tithiḥ|| nānayā sadṛśī loke tithirdṛṣṭā śrutā'pi vā || || 117 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmvarīṣasaṃvāde kalidharmanirūpaṇe pitṛmuktirnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || || cha ||
<2.7.23>
|| || śrutadeva uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || akṣayyāyāstṛtīyāyāḥ site pakṣe ca mādhave || 1 || ye kurvaṃti ca tasyāṃ vai prātaḥ snānaṃ bhagodaye || te sarve pāpanirmuktā yāṃti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || 2 || devānpitṝnmunīnyastu kuryāduddiśya tarpaṇam || tenā'dhītaṃ ca teneṣṭaṃ tena śrāddhaśataṃ kṛtam || 3 || madhusūdanamabhyarcya kathāṃ śṛṇvaṃti ye narāḥ || akṣayyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ te narā muktibhāginaḥ || || 4 || ye dānaṃ tatra kurvaṃti madhudviṭprītaye śubham || tadakṣayyaṃ phalatyeva madhuśāsanaśāsanāt || 5 || devarṣipitṛdaivatyā tithireṣā mahāśubhā || trayāṇāṃ tṛptidātrī ca kṛte dharme sanātane || 6 || prakhyātiśca titherasyāḥ kena cāsti tadapyaham|| vakṣyāmi nṛpaśārdūla sāvadhānamanāḥ śṛṇu || || 7 || purā puraṃdarasyā''sīdyuddhaṃ ca balinā saha || devānāṃ caiva daityānāṃ dvaṃdvaṃ yuddhamabhūttataḥ || 8 || sa nirjitya baliṃ daityaṃ pātālatalavāsinam|| punarbhuvaṃ samāsādya cotathyasyā''śramaṃ yayau || 9 || tatrāpaśyacca tatpatnīṃ gurviṇīṃ maṃdagāminīm|| calacchroṇitaṭābaddha kāṃcīdāmnā sumaṃḍitām || 2.7.23.10 || kvaṇatkaṃkaṇanirghoṣa jitamattālikokilām || valgucitrāṃbarāṃ rāmāṃ maṃjuvācaṃ śucismitām || 11 || lasatkuṃbhasthalābhyāṃ ca kucābhyāmupaśobhitām || hasatpadmamukhāṃ divyāṃ nīlotpalasulocanām|| 12 || ketakyudarapāṃḍubhyāṃ gaṃḍābhyāṃ ca manoramām || śramocchvasaṃtīṃ dīnākṣīṃ parṇaśālāmukhe sthitām || 13 || svapatīṃ śayane kvā'pi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mohamāgataḥ || balātkāreṇa bubhuje gurviṇīṃ pākaśāsanaḥ||14 || garbhasthastu tadā piṃḍaḥ svasya pātaviśaṃkayā || chādayāmāsa vai yoniṃ dvāre pādena duḥkhitaḥ || 15 || tataścaskanda vīryaṃ tadbhūmāveva balidviṣaḥ || garbhasthāya cukopāsau bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ || 16 || taṃ śaśāpa ca garbhasthaṃ ruṣā tāmrāṃtalocanaḥ || jātyandho bhava durbuddhe mā'vamaṃsthā yataḥ padā || 17 || pracchādya yonidvāraṃ ca tato dīrghatapāhvayaḥ || padā praskaṃditādvīryājjālataḥ samajāyata || 17 || paścādiṃdro yayau śīghramṛṣeḥ śāpa viśaṃkitaḥ || palāyaṃtaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā jahasurbaṭavo'khilāḥ || 19 || tatastu vrīḍito bhūtvā yayau merorguhāṃ śubhām || tatra līnaścacārā'sau dustaraṃ vai tapo mahat || 2.7.23.20 || merau vilīya vasati devendre lajjayā'nvite || gūḍhairvijñāya tāṃ vārtāṃ daiteyā balipūrvakāḥ || 21 || surānākramya bubhujurbalīṃdraścāmarāvatīm || dikpālānāṃ vibhūtīśca śaṃbarādyā balīyasaḥ || 22 || balādbubhujire hīnanāthe rāṣṭre divaukasām || rakṣitāramajānaṃto devāścāgnipurogamāḥ || 23 || papracchurdhiṣaṇaṃ devaṃ devācāryamakalmaṣam || papracchuriṃdravṛttāṃtaṃ kva svittiṣṭhati naḥ prabhuḥ || 24 || daityākrāṃtamidaṃ rāṣṭraṃ hīnanāthaṃ divaukasām || kuto nā''yāti devo'sau bhūyānkālo gato vibho || 25 || taṃ yāmo yatra dhiṣaṇa prārthayāmaśca taṃ vibhum || iti pṛṣṭastadā devairdhiṣaṇastānuvāca ha || 26 || rasātale baliṃ jitvā cotathyasyā''śramaṃ yayau || bhuktvā patnīṃ ca dārḍhyena tacchiṣyaireva ninditaḥ || 27 || vrīḍitastu divaṃ yātuṃ guhāṃ merorviveśa ha || tatraivā''ste śacīyuktaḥ svakṛtaṃ cintayanvibhuḥ || 28 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devā agnipurogamāḥ || guhāṃ meroryayuḥ śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā prārthayituṃ vibhum || 29 || tatra dṛṣṭvā guhālīnaṃ devendraṃ pākaśāsanam || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraistadvīryairlokaviśrutaiḥ || 2.7.23.30 || iṃdra tubhyaṃ namaste'stu sarvadevā'dhipāya te || vayaṃ daityairarditāśca tvayā hīnā bhṛśārditāḥ || 31 || sthānabhraṣṭāścarāmoṃ'ga nānādeśeṣu duḥkhitāḥ || tasmādāgatya devendra jahi śatrūnariṃdama || 32 || iti stutastadā devairniścakrāma guhāmukhāt || lajjayā 'vanato bhūtvā paśyanbhūmiṃ ca cakṣuṣā || 33 || na kiṃcidapi covāca duḥkhādgadgadabhāṣaṇaḥ || ta''jñātvā dhiṣaṇaḥ prāha taṃ surendraṃ bhayānakam ||34|| mā śaṃkā te surapate karmādhīnamidaṃ jagat|| mānāmānau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ lābhālābhau jayājayau|| 35|| pūrvakarmānurodhena bhavaṃtyete na saṃśayaḥ|| jīvaḥ karmānugo duḥkhaṃ diṣṭaṃ daivena kālataḥ|| 36|| prājñāḥ prāyo na śocaṃti na prahṛṣyaṃti vai sukhāt|| tasmātprārabdhataḥ prāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ cedaṃ tava prabho|| || 37 || tatprāpya maghavanduḥkhaṃ naiva śocitumarhasi || ityukto guruṇā cāha maghavānamarādhipān || 38 || || indra uvāca || parastrīsaṃgadoṣeṇa balaṃ vīryaṃ yaśo'malam || maṃtraśaktiḥśāstraśaktirvidyāśaktiśca mānada || 39 || abhavannaṣṭavīryaṃ me tūṣṇīṃ tena vasāmyaham || pākaśāsanavākyaṃ tu śrutvā svācāryasaṃyu'tāḥ || 2.7.23.40 || maṃtrayāmāsurekānte punastasya balāptaye || tadā guruśca tānprāha karuṇaṃ ca viduttamaḥ || 41 || bṛhaspatiruvāca|| māso vaiśākhanāmā'yaṃ priyo vai madhughātinaḥ|| sarvāśca tithayaḥ puṇyā māse'sminmādhavapriye||42|| tatrā'pi ca site pakṣe māse'sminnakṣayāhvayā || yā tasyāṃ snānadānādi śraddhayā ca karoti vai ||43|| tasya pāpasahasrāṇi naśyaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ|| anavadyaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ balaṃ dhairyaṃ bhavaṃti ca ||44|| tasmāttasyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ hariṇā balavidviṣā || snānadānādisaddharmānkārayāmo hitā''ptaye ||45|| bhaviṣyati ca sā śaktirvidyāyā mantraśāstrayoḥ || balaṃ dhairyaṃ yaśaścaiva yathāpūrvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 46 || ityevaṃ tu vicāryātha gururdevaiḥ samāhitaḥ || indreṇa kārayāmāsa dharmānetānharipriyān|| 47 || akṣayyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradān || tena pūrvavadevā''sīdbalaṃ dhairyādikaṃ vibhoḥ || || 48 || parastrīsaṃgadoṣo'pi sadya eva vyalīyata || paścāddhatāśubhaḥ śakro rāhormukta ivoḍupaḥ || 49 || devatānāṃ tathā madhye śuśubhe ca hariryathā || paścāddevaiḥ samāyukto vinirjitya tathā'surān || 2.7.23.50 || tṛtīyāyāśca māhātmyādbhāgyayukto'marāvatīm || viveśa vibhavaiḥ sārddhaṃ śaṃkhatūryādiniḥsvanaiḥ || 51 || anujñātāśca śakreṇa svadhāmāni yayuḥ surāḥ || tataste yajñabhāgāṃśca lebhire ca yathā purā || 52 || piṃḍabhāgāṃśca pitaro yathāpūrvaṃ prapedire || svādhyāye munayastuṣṭā daityānāṃ ca parājayaḥ || 53 || tadā prabhṛti loke'smiṃstṛtīyā cā'kṣayā''hvayā || prakhyātā sarvalokeṣu devarṣipitṛtuṣṭidā ||54|| tasmātpuṇyatamā caiṣā sarvakarmanikṛṃtanī || bhuktimuktipradā nṛṇāṃ tṛtīyā cā'kṣayā''hvayā || 55 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde'kṣayyatṛtīyāyāḥ śreṣṭhatvakathanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||23|| |||cha||
<2.7.24>
|| śrutadeva uvāca || || tithiṣvetāsu puṇyāsu dvādaśī sitapakṣiṇī || vaiśākhamāse rājeṃdra sarvāghaughavināśinī ||1|| kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca kimupoṣyairvrataiśca kim || kimiṣṭaiścaiva pūrtaiśca dvādaśī yairna sevitā || 2 || gaṃgāyāmuparāge tu yo dadyādgosahasrakam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti prātaḥ snātvā harerdine || 3 || yaddattaṃ cā'rhate cā'nnaṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca site śubhe || sikthesikthe bhavettasya koṭibrāhmaṇabhojanam|| || 4 || yo dadyāttilapātraṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ madhusaṃyutam || nirdhūtā'khilabaṃdhastu viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 5 || ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe kuryyājjāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ || sa jīvanneva muktaḥ syāttuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 6 || koṭīṃdusūryagrahaṇe tīrthānyutplāvya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti prātaḥ snātvā harerdine| ||7|| tulasyāḥ komalaiḥ patrairdvādaśyāṃ viṣṇumarcayet || samastakulamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokā'dhipo bhavet ||8|| (kṣepakaḥ tulasīpatrapuṣpaiśca vaiśākhe'śvatthapūjanam || puṣpādyabhāve dhānyairvā pūjayenmadhusūdanam ||1||) yamaṃ pitṝngurūndevānviṣṇumuddiśya mānavaḥ || mādhave śukladvādaśyāṃ sodakuṃbhaṃ sadakṣiṇam|| 9 || dadhyannaṃ caiva yo dadyāttasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu|| prayāge pratyahaṃ caiva kuryādyaḥ koṭibhojanam || 2.7.24.10 || yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ puṇyaṃ ṣaḍrasānnairmanoramaiḥ || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti madhuśāsanaśāsanāt ||11|| śāligrāmaśilādānaṃ yaḥ kuryāddvādaśīdine || vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||12|| dvādaśyāṃ payasā yastu snāpayenmadhusūdanam || rājasūyā'śvamedhābhyāṃ yatphalaṃ parijāyate || 13 || trayodaśyāṃ yajedviṣṇuṃ payodadhivimiśritaiḥ || śarkarāmadhubhirdravyairmadhusūdanaprītaye || 14 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gaṃgāyāṃ nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || paṃcāmṛtaiśca yo viṣṇuṃ bhaktyā saṃsnāpayedvibhum || || 15 || sa sarvakulamuddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyate || yo dadyātpānakaṃ hyasyāṃ sāyāhne prītaye hareḥ || 16 || jīrṇapāpaṃ jahātyāśu jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragaḥ || sāyāhne caiva yo dadyādurvārukarasāyanam ||17|| bhavenmuktaḥ karmabaṃdhādurvārukarasāyanāt || ikṣudaṇḍaṃ cūtaphalaṃ dadyāddrākṣāphalāni ca ||18|| na vicchittiḥ saṃtateḥ syāttasya vai śatapūruṣam || yo dadyādgaṃdhalepaṃ tu sāyāhne dvādaśīdine ||19|| bāhyopaghātaiḥ sakalairmucyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || yatkiṃcitkurute puṇyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ rājasattama||2.7.24.20|| mādhave tu site pakṣe tadakṣayyaphalaṃ bhavet || prakhyātimasyā vakṣyāmi yena jāteti bhūmipa || 21 || sarveṣāṃ sarvapāpaghnīṃ sarvamaṃgaladāyinīm || purā kāśmīradeśe tu dvijo devavratā''hvayaḥ || 22 || tasyā''sīnmālinī nāma tanayā cārurūpiṇī || dadau tāṃ satyaśīlāya vipravaryāya dhīmate ||23|| tāmudvāhya yayau dhīmānsvadeśaṃ yavanā''hvayam || rūpayauvanasaṃpannā tasya naiva priyā'bhavat|| 24 || sadā vidveṣasaṃyuktastasyāṃ tiṣṭhati niṣṭhuraḥ|| nā'nyasya kasyaciddveṣṭi tāṃ vinā nṛpate patiḥ || 25 || tasminsā krodhasaṃyuktā vaśīkaraṇalaṃpaṭā|| apṛcchatpramadā rājanyāstyaktāḥ patibhiḥ purā ||26|| tābhiruktā tu sā bhūpa vaśyo bharttā bhaviṣyati|| asmākaṃ pratyayo jāto bhartṛtyāgāvamāninām ||27|| prayujya bheṣajaṃ vaśyaṃ nītā hi patayaḥ purā || yoginīṃ tvaṃ tu gacchā'dya dāsyate bheṣajaṃ śubham || ||28|| na vikalpastvayā kāryo bhavitā dāsavatpatiḥ || yoginīmaṃdire gatvā tāsāṃ vākyena bhūpate || 29 || prasādamatulaṃ tasyā lebhe duścāriṇī satī|| śatastaṃbhasamāyuktāṃ kuṭīṃ bheje tvarānvitā ||2.7.24.30|| suvistṛtāṃ suvarcaskāṃ tathaivā'yātayāmikām || prāvṛtā dīrghavastreṇa sannidhiṃ tena yoginī || 31 || dīrghābhiśca saṭābhistu prāvṛtā dīptisaṃyutā || paricārasamopetā vīkṣamāṇā śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 32 || akṣasūtrakarā sā tu japaṃtī prārthitā tayā || dadau vaśyakaraṃ maṃtraṃ kṣobhakaṃ pratyayātmakam || 33 || tataḥ sā praṇatā bhūtvā dadyāddravyāṃ'gulīyakam || vajramāṇikyasaṃyuktamatiraktaprabhānvitam ||34|| mṛdukāṃcanasaṃyuktaṃ bhānuraśmisamadyuti || tato dṛṣṭvā tu saṃtuṣṭā pādasthaṃ cāṃgulīyakam ||35|| hṛdayaṃ ca tayā jñātaṃ tatpateravamānajam || tadoktā hi tayā bhūpa tāpasyāhitayuktayā||36|| cūrṇo rakṣānvito hyeṣa sarvabhūtavaśaṃkaraḥ|| cūrṇaṃ bhartari saṃyujya rakṣāṃ grīvāśrayāṃ kuru||37|| bhaviṣyati patirvaśyo nā'nyāṃ yāsyati sundarīm|| nā'priyaṃ vadati kvā'pi duścāriṇyāstavā'pi ca||38|| cūrṇarakṣāṃ gṛhītvā sā prāpa bhartṛgṛhaṃ punaḥ || pradoṣe payasā yuktaścūrṇo bhartari yojitaḥ || 39 || grīvāyāṃ hi kṛtā rakṣā na vicāraḥ kṛtastayā || tadā sa pītacūrṇastu bharttā nṛpavarottama || 2.7.24.40 || taccūrṇātkṣayarogo'bhūtpatiḥ kṣīṇo dinedine || guhye tu kṛmayo jātā ghorā duṣṭavraṇodbhavāḥ || || 41 || dinaiḥ katipayai rājanpatyurnaiva vyavasthitiḥ || uvāsa svecchayā sā'pi puṃścalī duṣṭacāriṇī || 42 || hatatejāstato bhartā tāmuvācā''kulendriyaḥ || krandamāno divārātrau dāso'smi tava śobhane || 43 || trāhi māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ necche'hamaparāṃ striyam || tattasya viditaṃ jñātvā bhītā sā medinīpate || 44 || alaṃkārakṛte patyurjīvanecchurna vai hitā || yoginīṃ ca yayau śīghraṃ tasyai sarvaṃ nyavedayat || 45 || tayā ca bheṣajaṃ dattaṃ dvitīyaṃ dāhaśāṃtaye || datte ca bheṣaje tasminsvastho'bhūttatkṣaṇātpatiḥ || 46 || tiṣṭhatyupapatirgehe gṛhakṛtyā'padeśataḥ || sarvavarṇasamudbhūtā jārāstiṣṭhaṃti vai gṛhe || 47 || na kiṃcidvacane śaktirbharturjātā kathaṃcana || tatastenaiva doṣeṇa sarvāṃgeṣu ca jajñire || 48 || kṛmayaścāsthibhettāraḥ kālāṃtakayamopamāḥ || tairnāsājihvayoścā''sīcchedaḥ karṇadvayasya ca ||49|| stanayoścāṃgulīnāṃ ca paṃgutvaṃ cā'pi cā''gatam || tena paṃcatvamāpannā gatā narakayātanāḥ || 2.7.24.50 || tāmrabhāṃḍe ca sā dagdhā'yutāni daśa paṃca ca || śvānayoniṣu saṃjātā śatavāraṃ punaḥpunaḥ || || 51 || chinnanāsā chinnakarṇā kṛmimūrddhā niraṃtaram || chinnapucchā bhagnapādā tāḍitā ca gṛhegṛhe || 52 || paścātsauvīradeśeṣu padmabandhordvijasya ca || dāsyā gṛhe śunī jātā bahuduḥkhasamākulā || 53 || chinnakarṇā chinnanāsā chinnapucchāṃghrirāturā || kṛmipūrṇaśirā nityaṃ kṛmiyoniśca tiṣṭhati || 54 || evaṃ triṃśadgatā varṣā asmiñjanmani bhūmipa || daivātkarmavipākena vaiśākhe meṣage ravau || 55 || śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ padmabaṃdhostanūdbhavaḥ || nadyāṃ snātvā śucirbhūtvā sārdravastro gṛhaṃ yayau || 56 || tulasīvedikāṃ prāpya pādāvavanije nijau || vedikāyāmadho deśe sā śunī svāpamāgatā || 57 || prāksūryodayavelāyāṃ pādodakapariplutā || sadyo dhvastā'śubhā jātā jātismṛtirabhūtkṣaṇāt || 58 || smṛtvā karma kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ sā śunī tāpasaṃ sadā || cukrośa karuṇā dīnā mune trāhīti vai punaḥ||59|| svakarma ca munīṃdrāya smṛtvācakhyau bhayā''kulā|| bharturviṣaprayogaṃ tu svasya duścaritaṃ tathā ||2.7.24.60|| yā'nyāpi yuvatī brahmanbharturvaśyaṃ samācaret || vṛthādharmā durācārā pacyate tāmrabhājane ||61|| bhartā nātho gururbhartā bhartā daivatamuttamam || vikriyāṃ kṛtya sādhvī sā kathaṃ sukhamavāpnuyāt ||62|| tiryagyoniśataṃ yāti kṛmikoṭiśatāni ca || tasmādbhūsura kartavyaṃ strībhirbharturvacaḥ sadā || 63 || sā'haṃ paśye punaryoniṃ kutsitāṃ yātanānvitām || yadi noddharase brahmannadya tvaddṛṣṭisaṃmukhām ||64|| tasmāduddhara māṃ brahmanduṣkṛtāṃ pāpacāriṇīm || sukṛtasya pradānena vaiśākhe śuklapakṣake || 65 || yā kṛtā tu tvayā brahmandvādaśī puṇyavarddhinī || tasyāṃ tvayā kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānānnabhojanaiḥ || 66 || duścāriṇyā api brahmaṃstena muktirbhaviṣyati || yasyāṃ tu bhūsuraḥ snātaḥ svagṛhe manujaḥ kila || 67 || sarvatīrthaphalāvāptiṃ labhate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || taptaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ yatra kṛtaṃ devārcanādi yat ||68|| tadakṣayyaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ yatkṛtaṃ dvādaśīdine || evaṃvidhaphalaṃ yatsyāttaddehi sakalaṃ mama || 69 || dvādaśyāmupavāsena trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇāt || yatphalaṃ syāttadapyaddhā tena muktirbhaviṣyati|| || 2.7.24.70 || dayāṃ kuru mahābhāga dīnāyāṃ dīnavatsala || dīnanātho jagannātho yuṣmannātho janārdanaḥ || 71 || tadīyāstādṛśā eva yathā rājā tathā prajāḥ || vaivasvatapadadhvaṃsinparitrāhi suduḥkhitām || 72 || tvadvāravāsinīṃ dīnāṃ śunīṃ māṃ dīnavatsala || brahmahatyāsahasraṃ vā gohatyānāṃ sahasrakam || 73 || agamyānāṃ ca koṭīśca dahatyeva śubhā tithiḥ || tasyāṃ kṛtaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahyaṃ dattvā mahāmune || 74 || māmuddhara samudvignāṃ dīnāṃ nātha samuddhara || ante tubhyaṃ dvijedrāya namauktiṃ vadāmyaham || 75 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā śunīmāha muneḥ sutaḥ || svakṛtaṃ jaṃtavośnaṃti sukhaduḥkhātmakaṃ śuni || 76 || tasmātkimu tvayā kāryaṃ kṣudrayā pāpaśīlayā || yayā bhartā vaśaṃ nīto rakṣācūrṇādibhirdvijaḥ || 77 || sādhubhyo yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ svasya duḥkhakaraṃ bhavet || sādhubhyo yatkṛta puṇyaṃ svasya duḥkhaharaṃ bhavet || 78 || ubhayaṃ bhraṃśatāmeti pāpebhyo yatkṛtaṃ bhavet || śarkarāmiśritaṃ kṣīraṃ kādraveyaniveditam||79|| viṣavṛddhikaraṃ dṛṣṭamevaṃ pāpakaraṃ bhaveta || vadatyevaṃ munisute śunī duḥkhaikarūpiṇī || 2.7.24.80 || punaścukośordhvasvaraṃ tatpitre bahubhāṣiṇī || padmabandho paritrāhi śunī taddvāravāsinīm || 81 || tvaducchiṣṭāśinī nityaṃ tvaṃ pāhīti punaḥpunaḥ || strapoṣyā ye hi vartaṃte gṛhasthasya mahātmanaḥ || || 82 || teṣāmuddharaṇaṃ kāryamiti vedavidāṃ matam || caṇḍālā vāyasāścaiva sārameyāśca nityaśaḥ || 83 || gṛhasthānāṃ dayāpātraṃ pratyahaṃ balibhojinaḥ || aśaktaṃ noddharetpoṣyaṃ rogādyupahataṃ yadi || 84 || so'dhaḥ patenna saṃdeha iti vedavidāṃ matam ||85|| kartāramekaṃ jagatāṃ hi kartā kṛtvātmanā pāti samastajaṃtūn || dārādirūpavyapadeśato haristasmāttadājñā khalu poṣyarakṣā || 86 || svapoṣyarakṣāṃ parihṛtya jaṃturdevena klṛptyā yadi vartate'nyadhīḥ || sa devadrogdhā sakalasya haṃtā kīnāśalokānanu saṃprayāti || 87 || kartavyatvāddayālutvādetāmuddhara durmatim || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā duḥkhārtāyā gṛhe sutaḥ || niścakrāma gṛhāttūrṇaṃ padmabaṃdhurdayānidhiḥ || 88 || kimetaditi tāṃ prāha putraḥ sarvaṃ nyavedayat || sa tu putravacaḥ śrutvā tamevaṃ prāha vismitaḥ || 89 || || padmabandhuruvāca || || mamātmaja kathaṃ vākyamīdṛśaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ tvayā || na sādhūnāmidaṃ vākyaṃ bhavatīha varānana || 2.7.24.90 || ātmasaukhyakarāḥ pāpā bhavaṃti paribhāvitā || paśya putra janāḥ sarve paropakaraṇāya vai || 91 || śaśī sūryo'tha pavano rajanī hutabhugjalam || caṃdanaṃ pādapāḥ saṃtaḥ paropakaraṇe sthitāḥ || 92 || asthidānaṃ kṛtaṃ putra kṛpayā hi dadhīcinā || devānāmupakārāya jñātvā daityānmahābalān || 93 || kapotā'rthe svamāṃsāni śibinā bhūbhujā purā || pradattāni mahābhāga śyenāya kṣudhitāni vai || 94 || jīmūtavāhano rājā purā''sītkṣitimaṃḍale || tenā'pi jīvitaṃ dattaṃ garuḍāya mahātmane || 95 || tasmāddayālunā bhāvyaṃ bhūsureṇa vipaścitā || śuddhe varṣati devastu kimaśuddhe na varṣati || 96 || kinna dīpayate candraścaṃḍālānāṃ gṛhe sadā || tasmādahaṃ śunīmetāṃ yācaṃtīṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ || 97 || uddhariṣye nijaiḥ puṇyaiḥ paṃkamagnāṃ ca gāṃ yathā || iti putraṃ nirākṛtya pratijajñe mahāmatiḥ || 98 || dattaṃ dattaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ dvādaśīdinasaṃbhavam || śuni gaccha harerdhāma nirdhūtā'khilakalmaṣā || 99 || tadvākyātsahasā bhūpa divyā''bharaṇabhūṣitā || vimucya dehaṃ jīrṇaṃ tu divyarūpadharā śubhā || 2.7.24.100 || śatā''dityaprabhā jātā sāvitrīpratimā yathā || jagāmā''maṃtrya taṃ vipraṃ dyotayantī diśo daśa ||1|| bhuktvā divi mahābhogānpaścājātā mahītale || naranārāyaṇāddevādurvaśīnāma nāmataḥ || 2 || vaiśākhaśuddhadvādaśyāḥ prabhāveṇa varāṃganā || devānāṃ ca priyā jātā apsarastvaṃ ca sā yayau || 3 || yadyogigamyaṃ hutabhukprakāśaṃ varaṃ vareṇyaṃ paramārtharūpam || yatprāpya santo'pi hi yāṃti mohaṃ tatprāpa rūpaṃ ca śunī hi devī ||4|| paścātsa padmabaṃdhurhi tāṃ tithiṃ puṇyavarddhinīm || loveṭīṃ khyāpayāmāsa madhudviṭprāṇavallabhām ||5|| koṭīṃdusūryagrahaṇādhikā sā samastarūpādhikapuṇyarūpā || yajñaiḥ samastairatiricyamānā dvijena khyātā bhuvanatraye ca || 106 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde śunīmokṣaprāptirnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || |||cha||
<2.7.25>
|| śrutadeva uvāca || || yāstisrastithayaḥ puṇyā aṃtimāḥ śuklapakṣake || vaiśākhamāsi rājeṃdra pūrṇimāṃtāḥ śubhāvahāḥ || 1 || antyāḥ puṣkariṇīsaṃjñāḥ sarvapāpakṣayāvahāḥ || mādhave māsi yaḥ pūrṇaṃ snānaṃ karttuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ || 2 || tithiṣvetāsu sa snāyātpūrṇa meva phalaṃ labhet || sarve devāstrayodaśyāṃ sthitvā jaṃtūnpunaṃti hi || 3 || pūrṇāyāḥ parvatīrthaiśca viṣṇunā saha saṃsthitāḥ || caturdaśyāṃ sayajñāśca devā etānpunaṃti hi || 4 || brahmaghnaṃ vā surāpaṃ vā sarvānetānpunaṃti hi || ekādaśyāṃ purā jajñe vaiśākhyāmamṛtaṃ śubham || 5 || dvādaśyāṃ pālitaṃ tacca viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || trayodaśyāṃ sudhāṃ devānpāyayāmāsa vai hariḥ || 6 || jaghāna ca caturdaśyāṃ daityāndevavirodhinaḥ || pūrṇāyāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sāmrājyā''ptirbabhūva ha || 7 || tato devāḥ susaṃtuṣṭā etāsāṃ ca varaṃ daduḥ || tisṛṇāṃ ca tithīnāṃ vai prītyotphullavilocanāḥ || 8 || etā vaiśākha māsasya tisraśca tithayaḥ śubhāḥ || putrapautrādiphaladā narāṇāṃ pāpahānidāḥ || 9 || yo'sminmāse ca saṃpūrṇe na snāto manujādhamaḥ || tithitraye tu sa snātvā pūrṇameva phalaṃ labhet || 2.7.25.10 || tithitrayepyakurvāṇaḥ snānadānādikaṃ naraḥ || cāṃḍālīṃ yonimāsādya paścādrauravamaśnute || 11 || uṣṇodakena yaḥ snāti mādhave ca tithitraye || rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa ||12|| pitṛndevānsamuddiśya dadhyannaṃ na dadāti yaḥ || paiśācīṃ yonimāsādya tiṣṭhatyābhūtasaṃplavam || 13 || pravṛttānāṃ ca kāmānāṃ mādhave niyame kṛte || avaśyaṃ viṣṇusāyujyaṃ yujyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 14 || āmāsaṃ niyamāsaktaḥ kuryādyadi dinatraye || tena pūrṇaphalaṃ prāpya modate viṣṇumaṃdire || 15 || yo vai devānpitṝnviṣṇuṃ gurumuddiśya mānavaḥ || na snānādi karotyaddhā'muṣya śāpapradā vayam || 16 || niḥsaṃtāno nirāyuśca niḥśreyasko bhavediti || iti devā varaṃ dattvā svadhāmāni yayuḥ purā || 17 || tasmāttithitrayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāghaughavināśanam || aṃtyaṃ puṣkariṇīsaṃjñaṃ putrapautravivarddhanam || 18 || yā nārī subhagā''pūpapāyasaṃ pūrṇimādine || brāhmaṇāya sakṛddadyātkīrtimaṃtaṃ sutaṃ labhet || 19 || gītāpāṭhaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādaṃtime ca dinatraye || dinedine'śvamedhānāṃ phalameti na saṃśayaḥ || 2.7.25.20 || sahasranāmapaṭhanaṃ yaḥ kuryyācca dinatraye || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ kaḥ śakto divi vā bhuvi || 21 || sahasranāmabhirdevaṃ pūrṇāyāṃ madhusūdanam || payasā snāpya vai yāti viṣṇulokamakalmaṣam || 22 || samastavibhavairyastu pūjayenmadhusūdanam || na tasya lokāḥ kṣīyante yuga kalpādi vyatyaye || 23 || asnātvā cāpyadattvā ca vaiśākhaśca mato yadi || sa brahmahā gurughnaśca pitṝṇāṃ ghātakastathā|| 24 || ślokārddhaṃ ślokapādaṃ vā nityaṃ bhāgavatodbhavam || vaiśākhe ca paṭhanmartyo brahmatvaṃ copapadyate || 25 || yo vai bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ śṛṇotyetaddinatraye || na pāpairlipyate kvā'pi padmapatramivāṃbhasā || 26 || devatvaṃ manujaiḥ prāptaṃ kaiścitsiddhatvameva ca || kaiścitprāpto brahmabhāvo dinatrayaniṣevaṇāt ||27|| brahmajñānena vai muktiḥ prayāgamaraṇena vā || athavā māsi vaiśākhe niyamena jalāpluteḥ || 28 || nīlavṛṣaṃ samutsṛjya vaiśākhyāṃ ca jalāpluteḥ || samastabaṃdhanirmuktaḥ pumānyāti paraṃ padam || 29 || gāṃ savatsāṃ dvijeṃdrāya sīdate ca kuṭumbine || ihāpamṛtyunirmuktaḥ paratra ca paraṃ vrajet || 2.7.25.30 || snānadānavihīnastu vaiśākhī caiva yo nayet || śvānayoniśataṃ prāpya viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ || 31|| tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca tīrthāni bhuvanatraye || saṃbhūya maṃtrayāṃcakruḥ pāpasaṃghātaśaṃkitāḥ || 32 || janā asmāsu pāpiṣṭhā visṛjanti svakaṃ malam || tadasmākaṃ kathaṃ gacchediti ciṃtāsamanvitāḥ ||33|| tīrthapādaṃ hariṃ jagmuḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vibhum || stutvā ca bahubhiḥ stotraiḥ prārthayāmāsuraṃjasā || 34 || devadeva jagannātha sarvāghaughavināśana || janā asmāsu pāpiṣṭhāḥ snātvā pāpāni sarvaśaḥ || 35 || visṛjya tvatpadaṃ yāṃti tvadājñādhāriṇo bhuvi || asmākaṃ caiva tatpāpaṃ kathaṃ gacchejjanārdana || 36 || tadupāyaṃ vadāsmākaṃ tvatpādaśaraṇaiṣiṇām || iti tīrthaiḥ prārthitastu bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ || 37 || prahasanprāha tīrthāni meghagambhīrayā girā || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || site pakṣe meṣasūrye vaiśākhāntedinatraye || 38 || sarvatīrthamaye puṇye mamā'pi prāṇavallabhe || yūyaṃ bhagodayātpūrvaṃ bahiḥsaṃsthajalāplutāḥ || 39 || vimuktāghāḥ puṇyarūpā bhavaṃtvāśu sunirmalāḥ || bhavadbhiśca vimuktāghairye na snātā dinatraye || 2.7.25.40 || teṣu tiṣṭhaṃtu tatpāpaṃ janairyuṣmadvirecitam || iti tīrthapado viṣṇustīrthānāṃ ca varaṃ dadau || 41 || anujñāpya ca tānyogāttatraivāṃtaradhīyata || svadhāmāni punaḥ prāpya tāni tīrthāni nityaśaḥ || 42 || prativarṣaṃ tu vaiśākhe tathaivāṃtyadinatraye || tenāghaughaṃ vimucyaiva yāṃti nirmalatā maho || 43 || ye tu snānaṃ na kurvaṃti vaiśākhāṃtadinatraye || te bhavantu samastānāṃ janānāṃ pātakā''śrayāḥ ||44|| iti śāpaṃ ca tīrthāni hyasnātānāṃ vadanti ca || na tena sadṛśaḥ pāpo yo na snāto dinatraye || 45 || vicāriteṣu śāstreṣu na dṛṣṭo na ca vai śrutaḥ || tasmāddinatraye kāryaṃ snānadānārcanādikam || 46 || anyathā narakaṃ yāti yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || ityetatsarvamākhyātaṃ śrutakīrte mahāmate || 47 || pṛṣṭaṃ vaiśākhamāhātmyaṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam || māhātmyasya ca lekho'yaṃ mādhavasya ca varṇitaḥ || 48 || kārtsnyādvaktuṃ ca brahmā'pi nālaṃ varṣaśatairapi || purā kailāsaśikhare pārvatyai śaṃkaraḥ svayam ||49|| āha mādhavamāhātmyaṃ pṛcchaṃtyai śatavatsaram || tathāpi nāṃtamagamadaśakto virarāma ha ||2.7.25.50|| ko nu varṇayituṃ śaktaḥ kārtsnyānmāhātmyamuttamam || vinā viṣṇuṃ jagannāthaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || 51 || purā sarve'pi ṛṣayo māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || leśasya leśaṃ vyācakhyurjanānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 52 || nāṃtaḥ kenāpi vyākhyāto hyaśaktatvānmahīpate || tvaṃ ca māse tu vaiśākhe kuru dānādisatkriyāḥ ||53|| tena bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca saṃprāpnoṣi na saṃśayaḥ || iti taṃ bodhayitvā ca maithilaṃ janakāhvayam || 54 || śrutadevastamāmaṃtrya gantuṃ cakre manastataḥ || jātāhlādaḥ sa rājarṣirgaladvāṣpākulekṣaṇaḥ || 55 || utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa svābhivṛddhyai manoramam || grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śibikāmadhiropya tam || 56 || caturaṃgabalairyuktaḥ svayaṃ pṛṣṭhamathā'nvagāt || punaścāṃtaḥpuraṃ prāpya sakalairvibhavairapi || 57 || vastrairābharaṇaiścaiva gobhūtilahiraṇyakaiḥ || praṇamya ca parikramya tasthau prāṃjaliragrataḥ || 58 || tataḥ sa tu mahātejāḥ śrutadevo mahāyaśāḥ || santuṣṭaḥ paramaprīto yayau dhāma svakaṃ muniḥ || 59 || trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca mādhave || snānaṃ dānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca kathāśravaṇameva ca || 2.7.25.60 || vaiśākhadharmanirataḥ sa vai mokṣamavāpnuyāt || dhanaśarmā brāhmaṇaśca pretāścaiva yathā purā || 61 || || nārada uvāca || || ityetatparamākhyānamaṃbarīṣa tavoditam || śravaṇātsarvapāpaghnaṃ sarvasaṃpadvidhāyakam || 62 || tena bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca jñānaṃ mokṣaṃ ca viṃdati || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā aṃvarīṣo mahāyaśāḥ || 63 || prahṛṣṭāṃtaravṛttiśca bāhyavyāpāravarjitaḥ || praṇanāma tathā mūrdhnā daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi || 64 || vibhavairakhilaiścā'pi pūjayāmāsa taṃ punaḥ || saṃpūjitastamāmaṃtrya nārado bhagavānmuniḥ || 65 || lokāṃtaraṃ yayau dhīmāñcchāpānnaikatra saṃsthitiḥ || ambarīṣo'pi rājarṣirnāradoktānimāñcchubhān || 66 || dharmānkṛtvā vilīno'bhūtpare brahmaṇi nirguṇe || || sūta uvāca || || ya idaṃ paramākhyānaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyavardhanam || 67 || śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvā'pi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || likhitaṃ pustakaṃ yeṣāṃ gṛhe tiṣṭhati mānadāḥ || 68 || teṣāṃ muktiḥ karasthā hi kimu tacchravaṇātmanām || 69 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmye nāradāmbarīṣasaṃvāde phalaśrutikathanaṃnāma paṃcaviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || || cha || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vaiśākhamāsamāhātmyaṃ saṃpūrṇam || (2.7)||
<2.8.1>
|| || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ayodhyāmāhātmyaṃ prārabhyate || || jayati parāśarasūnuḥ satyavatīhṛdayanaṃdano vyāsaḥ || yasyāsyakamalagalitaṃ vāṅmayamamṛtaṃ jagatpibati || 1 || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam|| devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayamudīrayet || 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || himavadvāsinaḥ sarve munayo vedapāragāḥ || trikālajñā mahātmāno naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || 3 || ye'rbudāraṇyaniratā daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ || mahendrādriratā ye vai ye ca vindhyanivāsinaḥ || 4 || jaṃbūvanaratā ye ca ye godāvarivāsinaḥ || vārāṇasīśritā ye ca mathurāvāsinastathā || 5 || ujjayinyāṃ ratā ye ca prathamāśramavāsinaḥ || dvārāvatīśritā ye ca badaryyāśrayiṇastathā|| 6 || māyāpurīśritā ye ca ye ca kāntīnivāsinaḥ || ete cānye ca munayaḥ saśiṣyā bahavo'malāḥ || 7 || kurukṣetre mahākṣetre satre dvādaśavārṣike || vartamāne ca rāmasya kṣitīśasya mahātmanaḥ || samāgatāḥ samāhūtāḥ sarve te munayo'malāḥ || 8 || sarve te śuddhamanaso vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ || tatra snātvā yathānyāyaṃ kṛtvā karma japādikam || 9 || bhāradvājaṃ puraskṛtya vedavedāṃgapāragam || āsaneṣu vicitreṣu bṛṣyādiṣu hyanukramāt || 2.8.1.10 || upaviṣṭāḥ kathāścakrurnānātīrthāśritāstadā || karmāṃtareṣu satrasya sukhāsīnāḥ parasparam || 11 || kathāṃteṣu tatasteṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || ājagāma mahātejāstatra sūto mahāmatiḥ || 12 || vyāsaśiṣyaḥ purāṇajño samaḥ harṣaṇasaṃjñakaḥ || tānpraṇamya yathānyāyaṃ munīnupaviveśa saḥ || upaviṣṭo yathānyāyaṃ munīnāṃ vacanena saḥ || 13 || vyāsaśiṣyaṃ munivaraṃ sūtaṃ vai romaharṣaṇam || taṃ papracchurmunivarā bhāradvājādayo'malāḥ || 14 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || tvattaḥ śrutā mahābhāga nānātīrthāśritāḥ kathāḥ || sarahasyāni sarvāṇi purāṇāni mahāmate || 15 || sāṃprataṃ śrotumicchāmaḥ sarahasyaṃ sanātanam || ayodhyāyā mahāpuryā mahimānaṃ guṇojjvalam || 16 || kīdṛśī sā sadā medhyā'yodhyā viṣṇupriyāpurī || ādyā sā gīyate vede purīṇāṃ muktidāyikā || 17 || saṃsthānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tasyāstasyāṃ ke ca mahībhujaḥ || kāni tīrthāni puṇyāni māhātmyaṃ teṣu kīdṛśam || 18 || ayodhyāsevanānnṛṇāṃ phalaṃ syātsūta kīdṛśam || kiṃ caritraṃ sūta tasyāḥ kā nadyaḥ ke ca saṃgamāḥ ||19|| tatra snānena kiṃ puṇyaṃ dānena ca mahāmate || tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmastvattaḥ sūta guṇādhika|| 2.8.1.20 || etatsarvaṃ krameṇaiva tathyaṃ tvaṃ vettha sāṃpratam|| ayodhyāyā mahāpuryyā māhātmyaṃ vaktumarhasi || 21 || || sūta uvāca || || vyāsaprasādājjānāmi purāṇāni tapodhanāḥ || setihāsāni sarvāṇi sarahasyāni tattvataḥ || 22 || taṃ praṇamya pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ bhavadagrataḥ || ayodhyāyā mahāpuryā yathāvatsarahasyakam || 23 || vidyāvantaṃ vipulamatidaṃ vedavedāṃgavedyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śāntaṃ śamitaviṣayaṃ śuddhatejoviśālam || vedavyāsaṃ satatavinataṃ viśvavedyaikayoniṃ pārāśaryyaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ sarvadā'haṃ namāmi ||24|| oṃ namo bhagavate tasmai vyāsāyāmitatejase || yasya prasādājjānāmi hyayodhyāmahimāmaham ||25|| śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve sāvadhānāḥ saśiṣyakāḥ || māhātmyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi ayodhyāyā mahodayam || 26 || udīritamagastyāya skandenāśrāvi nāradāt || agastyena purā proktaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāya tat ||27|| kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāccaitanmayā prāptaṃ tapodhanāḥ || tadahaṃ vacmi yuṣmabhyaṃ śrotukāmebhya ādarāt || 28 || namāmi paramātmānaṃ rāmaṃ rājīvalocanam|| atasīkusumaśyāmaṃ rāvaṇāṃtakamavyayam ||29|| ayodhyā sā parā medhyā purī duṣkṛtidurllabhā || kasya sevyā ca nā'yodhyā yasyāṃ sākṣāddhariḥ svayam || 2.8.1.30 || sarayūtīramāsādya divyā paramaśobhanā || amarāvatīnibhā prāyaḥ śritā bahutapodhanaiḥ ||31|| hastyaśvarathapattyāḍhyā saṃpaduccā ca saṃsthitā || prākārāḍhyapratolībhistoraṇaiḥ kāṃcanaprabhaiḥ || 32 || sānūpaveṣaiḥ sarvatra suvibhaktacatuṣṭayā || anekabhūmiprāsādā bahubhittisuvikriyā ||33|| padmotphullaśubhodābhirvāpībhirupaśobhitā|| devatāyatanairdivyairvedaghoṣaiśca maṇḍitā ||34 || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgādiśabdairutkṛṣṭatāṃ gatā| śālaistālairnālikeraiḥ panasāmalakaistathā|| 35|| tathaivāmrakapitthādyairaśokairupaśobhitā || ārāmairvividhairyuktā sarvartuphalapādapaiḥ|| 36 || mālatījātibakulapāṭalīnāgacaṃpakaiḥ || karavīraiḥ karṇikāraiḥ ketakībhiralaṃkṛtā || 37 || nimbajaṃvīrakadalīmātuliṃgamahāphalaiḥ || lasaccaṃdanagaṃdhāḍhyairnāgarairupaśobhitā ||38|| devatulyaprabhāyuktairnṛpaputraiśca saṃyutā || surūpābhirvarastrībhirdevastrībhirivāvṛtā|| 39|| śreṣṭhaiḥ satkavibhiryuktā bṛhaspatisamairdvijaiḥ|| vaṇigjanaistathā pauraiḥ kalpavṛkṣairivāvṛtā|| 2.8.1.40|| aśvairuccaiḥśravastulyairdaṃtibhirdiggajairiva|| iti nānāvidhairbhāvairupetendrapurī samā||41 || yasyāṃ jātā mahīpālāḥ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavāḥ|| ikṣvākupramukhāḥ sarve prajāpālanatatparāḥ|| 42|| yasyāstīre puṇyatoyā kūjadbhṛṃgavihaṃgamā || sarayūrnāma taṭinī mānasaprabhavollasā ||43|| dharmadravaparītā sā ghargharottamasaṃgamā || munīśvarāśritataṭā jāgarti jagaducchritā || 44 || dakṣiṇāccaraṇāṃguṣṭhānniḥsṛtā jāhnavī hareḥ || vāmāṃguṣṭhānmunivarāḥ sarayūrnirgatā śubhā || 45 || tasmādime puṇyatame nadyau devanamaskṛte || etayoḥ snānamātreṇa brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 46 || tāmayodhyāmatha prāpto'gastyaḥ kumbhodbhavo muniḥ || yātrārthaṃ tīrthamāhātmyaṃ jñātvā skandaprasādataḥ || || 47 || āgatya tu itaḥ so'pi kṛ'tvā yātrāṃ krameṇa ca || yathoktena vidhānena snātvā saṃtarpya tānpitṝn || 48 || pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ devatāḥ sakalā api || sarvāṇyapi ca tīrthāni namaskṛtya yathāvidhi ||49|| kṛtakṛtyorjjitānandastīrthamāhātmyadarśanāt || abhūdagastyo rūpeṇa pulakāṃ citavigrahaḥ || 2.8.1.50 || sa trirātraṃ sthitastatra yātrāṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || stuvannayodhyāmāhātmyaṃ pratasthe munisattamaḥ || 51 || tamāyāṃtaṃ vilokyāśu bahulānandasundaram || kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāsaḥ papracchānaṃdakāraṇam || 52 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kutaḥ samāgato brahmansāṃprataṃ munisattamaḥ || paramānaṃdasaṃdohaḥ samabhūtsāṃprataṃ tava || 53 || kasmādānaṃdapoṣo'bhūttava brahmanvadasva me || mamāpi bhavadānaṃdātpramodo hṛdi jāyate || 54 || || || agastya uvāca || || aho mahadathāścaryyaṃ vismayo munisattama || dṛṣṭvā prabhāvaṃ me'dyābhūdayodhyāyāstapodhana || 55 || tasmādānaṃdasaṃdohaḥ samabhūnmama sāṃpratam || tacchrutvāgastyavacanaṃ vyāsaḥ provāca taṃ munim || 56 || || vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavanbrūhi tattvena vistarātsarahasyakam || ayodhyāyā mahāpuryā mahimānaṃ guṇādhikam || 57 || kaḥ kramastīrthayātrāyāḥ kāni tīrthāni ko vidhiḥ || ki phalaṃ snānatastatra dānasya ca mahāmune || etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vistarādvadatāṃ vara || 58 || || agastya uvāca || || aho dhanyatamā buddhistava jātā tapodhana || dṛśyate yena pṛcchā te hyayodhyāmahimāśritā || 59 || akāro brahma ca proktaṃ yakāro viṣṇurucyate || dhakāro rudrarūpaśca ayodhyānāma rājate || 2.8.1.60 || sarvopapātakairyuktairbrahmahatyādipātakaiḥ || nāyodhyā śakyate yasmāttāmayodhyāṃ tato viduḥ || 61 || viṣṇorādyā purī yeyaṃ kṣitiṃ na spṛśati dvija || viṣṇoḥ sudarśane cakre sthitā puṇyakarī kṣitau || 62 || kena varṇayituṃ śakyo mahimā'syāstapodhana || yatra sākṣātsvayaṃ devo viṣṇurvasati sādaraḥ || 63 || sahasradhārāmārabhya yojanaṃ pūrvato diśi || pratīci diśi tathaiva yojanaṃ samatovadhiḥ || 64 || dakṣiṇottarabhāge tu sarayūtamasāvadhiḥ || etatkṣetrasya saṃsthānaṃ harerantargṛhaṃ sthitam || matsyākṛtiriyaṃ vipra purī viṣṇorudīritā || 65 || paścime tasya mūrddhā tu gopratārāsitā dvija || 66 || pūrvataḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgo hi dakṣiṇottaramadhyamaḥ || tasyāṃ puryyāṃ mahābhāga nāmnā viṣṇurhariḥ svayam || pūrvaṃdṛṣṭaprabhāvo'sau prādhānyena vasatyapi || 67 || || vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavankiṃ prabhāvo'sau yo'yaṃ viṣṇuharistvayā || kīrtito muniśārdūla prasiddhiṃ gatavānkatham || etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vistareṇa mamāgrataḥ || 68 || || || agastya uvāca || || viṣṇuśarmeti vikhyātaḥ purābhūdbrāhmaṇottamaḥ || vedavedāṃgatattvajño dharmakarmasamāśritaḥ || 69 || yogadhyānarato nityaṃ viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || sa kadācittīrthayātrāṃ kurvanvaiṣṇavasattamaḥ || ayodhyāmāgato viṣṇurviṣṇuḥsākṣādvasediti || 2.8.1.70 || ciṃtayanmanasā vīrastapaḥ kartuṃ samudyataḥ || sa vai tatra tapastepe śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ || 71 || grīṣme paṃcāgnimadhyastho hyatapatsa mahātapāḥ || vārṣike ca nirālambo hemante ca sarovare || 72 || snātvā yathoktavidhinā kṛtvā viṣṇostathārcanam || vaśīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ viśuddhenāṃtarātmanā || 73 || mano viṣṇau samāveśya vidhāya prāṇasaṃyamam || oṃkāroccāraṇāddhīmānhṛdi padmaṃ vikāsayan || 74 || tanmadhye ravisomāgnimaṇḍalāni yathāvidhi || kalpayitvā hariṃ mūrtaṃ yasmindeśe sanātanam || 75 || pītāṃbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || taṃ ca puṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya manastasminniveśya ca || 76 || brahmarūpaṃ hariṃ dhyāyañjapanvai dvādaśākṣaram || vāyubhakṣaḥ sthitastatra viprastrīnvatsarānvasan || 77 || tato dvijavaro dhyātvā stutiṃ cakre harerimām || praṇipatya jagannāthaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim || viṣṇuśarmātha tuṣṭāva nārāyaṇamataṃdritaḥ || 78 || || viṣṇuśarmmovāca || || prasīda bhagavanviṣṇo prasīda puruṣottama || prasīda devadeveśa prasīda kamalekṣaṇa || 79 || jaya kṛṣṇa jayāciṃtya jaya viṣṇo jayāvyaya || jaya yajñapate nātha jaya viṣṇo pate vibho || 2.8.1.80 || jaya pāpaharānaṃta jaya janmajvarāpaha || namaḥ kamalanābhāya namaḥ kamalamāline ||81|| namaḥ sarveśa bhūteśa namaḥ kaiṭabhasūdana || namastrailokyanāthāya jaganmūla jagatpate || 82 || namo devādhidevāya namo nārāyaṇāya vai || namaḥ kṛṣṇāya rāmāya namaścakrāyudhāya ca || 83 || tvaṃ mātā sarvalokānāṃ tvameva jagataḥ pitā || bhayārttānāṃ suhṛnmitraṃ tvaṃ pitā tvaṃ pitāmahaḥ || 84 || tvaṃ havistvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ prabhustvaṃ hutāśanaḥ || karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ karttā tvameva parameśvaraḥ || 85 || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇe māṃ samuddhara mādhava || 86 || prasīda maṃdaradhara prasīda madhusūdana || prasīda kamalākānta prasīda bhuvanādhipa || 87 || || agastya uvāca || || ityevaṃ stuvatastasya manobhaktyā mahātmanaḥ || āvirbabhūva viśvātmā viṣṇurgaruḍavāhanaḥ || 88 || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ pītāṃbaradharo'cyutaḥ || uvāca sa prasannātmā viṣṇuśarmāṇamavyayaḥ || 89 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || tuṣṭo'smi bhavato vatsa mahatā tapasā'dhunā || stotreṇānena sumate naṣṭapāpo'si sāṃpratam ||2.8.1.90|| varaṃ varaya viprendra varado'haṃ tavāgrataḥ || nā'taptatapasā draṣṭuṃ śakyaḥ kenāpyahaṃ dvija || 91 || || viṣṇuśarmmovāca || || kṛtakṛtyo'smi deveśa sāṃprataṃ tava darśanāt || tvadbhaktimacalāmekāṃ mama dehi jagatpate || 92 || || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || bhaktirastvacalā me vai vaiṣṇavī muktidāyinī || atraivāstvacalā me vai jāhnavī muktidāyinī || 93 || idaṃ sthānaṃ mahābhāga tvannāmnā khyātimeṣyati || 94 || || agastya uvāca || || ityuktvā devadeveśaścakreṇotkhāya tatsthalam || jalaṃ prakaṭayāmāsa gāṃgaṃ pātālamaṃḍalāt || 95 || jalena tena bhagavānpavitreṇa dayāṃbudhiḥ || nīrajastu bhūmitalaṃ kṣaṇāccakre kṛpāvaśāt || 96 || cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti taddvija || jātaṃ trailokyavikhyātamaghaughadhvaṃsakṛcchubham || 97 || tatra snānena dānena viṣṇulokaṃ vrajennaraḥ || 98 || tataḥ sa bhagavānbhūyo viṣṇuśarmāṇamacyutaḥ || kṛpayā parayā yukta uvāca dvijavatsalaḥ || 99 || ||śrībhagavānuvāca || || tvannāmapūrvikā vipra manmūrtiriha tiṣṭhatu || viṣṇuharīti vikhyātā bhaktānāṃ muktidāyinī ||2.8.1.100|| || agastya uvāca || || iti śrutvā vaco vipro vāsudevasya buddhimān|| svanāmapūrvikāṃ mūrtiṃ sthāpayāmāsa cakriṇaḥ ||101|| tataḥ prabhati vipreśa śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || pītavāsāścaturbāhurnāmnā viṣṇuhariḥ sthitaḥ||102|| kārtike śuklapakṣasya prārabhya daśamī tithim || pūrṇimāmavadhiṃ kṛtvā yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || 103 || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate || 104 || pitṝnuddiśya yastatra piṃḍānnirvāpayiṣyati || tṛptāstu pitaro yānti viṣṇulokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 105 || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuhariṃ vibhum || sarvapāpakṣayaṃ prāpya nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate || 106 || svaśaktyā tatra dānāni dattvā niṣkalmaṣo naraḥ || viṣṇuloke vaseddhīmānyāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 107 || anyadāpi narastatra cakratīthe jiteṃdriyaḥ || dṛṣṭvā sakṛddhariṃ devaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 108 || iti sakalaguṇābdhirdhyeyamūrtiścidātmā haririha paramūrtyā tasthivānmuktihetoḥ || tamiha bahulabhaktyā cakratīrthābhiṣekī vasati sukṛtimūrttiryo'rcayedviṣṇuloke || || 109 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṃḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye viṣṇuharimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || || cha ||
<2.8.2>
|| sūta uvāca || || agastyamunirityuktvā cakratīrthāśrayāṃ kathām || vibhorviṣṇuhareścāpi punarāha dvijottamāḥ || 1 || || || agastya uvāca || || purā brahmā jagatsraṣṭā vijñāya harimacyutam || ayodhyāvāsinaṃ devaṃ tatra cakre sthitiṃ svayam || 2 || āgatya kṛtavāṃstatra yātrāṃ brahmā yathāvidhi || yajñaṃ ca vidhivaccakre nānāsaṃbhārasaṃyutam || 3 || tataḥ sa kṛtavāṃstatra brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || kuṇḍaṃ svanāmnā vipulaṃ nānādevasamanvitam || 4 || vistīrṇajalakallolakalitaṃ kaluṣāpaham || kumudotpalakahlārapuṃḍarīkakulākulam || 5 || haṃsasārasacakrāhva vihaṃgamamanoharam || taṭāṃtaviṭapollāsi patattrigaṇasaṃkulam || 6 || tatra kuṇḍe surāḥ sarve snātāḥ śuddhisamanvitāḥ || babhūvuraddhā vigatarajaskā vimalatviṣaḥ || 7 || tadāścaryyaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā te sarve sahasā surāḥ || brahmāṇaṃ praṇipatyocurbhaktyā prāṃjalayastadā || 8 || || devā ūcuḥ || || bhagavanbrūhi tattvena māhātmyaṃ kamalāsana || asya kuṇḍasya sakalaṃ khātasya vimalatviṣaḥ || 9 || atra snānena sarveṣāmasmākaṃ vigataṃ rajaḥ || mahadāścaryametasya dṛṣṭvā kuṃḍasya vismitāḥ || sarve vayaṃ suraśreṣṭha kṛpayā tvamato vada || 2.8.2.10 || || brahmovāca || || śṛṇvantu sarve tridaśāḥ sāvadhānāḥ savismayāḥ || kuṇḍasyaitasya māhātmyaṃ nānāphalasamanvitam || 11 || atra snānena vidhivatpāpātmāno'pi jaṃtavaḥ || vimānaṃ haṃsasaṃyuktamāsthāya rucirāṃbarāḥ || nivasaṃti brahmaloke yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 12 || atra dānena homena yathāśaktyā surottamāḥ || tulāśvamedhayoḥ puṇyaṃ prāpnuyurmunisattama || 13 || mamāsminsarasi śrīmāñjāyate snānato naraḥ || tasmādatra vidhānena snānaṃ dānaṃ japādikam || 14 || sarvayajñasamaṃ syādvai mahāpātakanāśanam|| brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātimito yāsyatyanuttamām||15|| asminkuṇḍe ca sāṃnidhyaṃ bhaviṣyati sadā mama || kārttike śuklapakṣasya caturdaśyāṃ surottamāḥ || 16 || yātrā bhaviṣyati sadā surāḥ sāṃvatsarī mama || śubhapradā mahāpāparāśināśakarī tadā || 17 || svarṇaṃ caiva sadā deyaṃ vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || nijaśaktyā prakartavyā surāstṛptirdvijanmanām||18|| || agastya uvāca || || ityuktvā devadevo'yaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || antardadhe suraiḥ sārddhaṃ tīrthaṃ dṛṣṭvā tapodhana || 19 || tadāprabhṛti tatkuṇḍaṃ vikhyātaṃ paramaṃ bhuvi || cakratīrthācca pūrvasyāṃ diśi kuṇḍaṃ sthitaṃ mahat || 2.8.2.20 || || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktvā sa taporāśiragastyaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ || punaḥ pṛṣṭo munivaro vyāsāyāvīvadatkathām || 21 || || agastya uvāca || || anyacchṛṇu mahābhāga tīrthaṃ duṣkṛtidurllabham || ṛṇamocanasaṃjñaṃ tu sarayūtīrasaṃgatam || 22 || brahmakuṇḍānmunivara dhanuḥsaptaśatena ca || pūrvottaradiśābhāge saṃsthitaṃ sarayūjale || 23 || tatra pūrvaṃ munivaro lomaśo nāma nāmataḥ || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena snānaṃ cakre vidhānataḥ || 24 || tataḥ sa ṛṇanirmukto babhūva gatakalmaṣaḥ || tadāścaryaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā munīnsānandamabravīt || 25 || paśyantvetasya mahato guṇāṃstīrthavarasya vai || bhujāvūrdhvaṃ tathā kṛtvā harṣeṇāhā'śrulocanaḥ || 26 || || lomaśa uvāca || || ṛṇamocanasaṃjñaṃ tu tīrthametadanuttamam || yatra snānena jaṃtūnāmṛṇaniryātanaṃ bhavet || 27 || aihikaṃ pāralaukikyaṃ yadṛṇatritayaṃ nṛṇām || tatsarvaṃ snānamātreṇa tīrthe'sminnaśyati kṣaṇāt |||| 28 || sarvatīrthottamaṃ caitatsadyaḥ pratyayakārakam || mayā cāsya phalaṃ samyaganubhūtamṛṇādiha || 29 || tasmādatra vidhānena snānaṃ dānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ || karttavyaṃ śraddhayā yuktaiḥ sarvadā phalakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 2.8.2.30 || snātavyaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca deyaṃ vastrādi śaktitaḥ || 31 || || || agastya uvāca || || ityuktvā tīrthamāhātmyaṃ lomaśo munisattamaḥ || antardadhe muniśreṣṭhaḥ stuvaṃstīrthaguṇānmudā || 32 || ityetatkathitaṃ vipra ṛṇamocanasaṃjñakam || yatra snānena jantūnāmṛṇaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt || ṛṇamocanatīrthaṃ tu pūrvataḥ sarayūjale || 33 || dhanurdviśatyā tīrthaṃ ca pāpamocanasaṃjñakam|| sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā tatra snānena mānavaḥ || jāyate tatkṣaṇādeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 34 || mayā tatra muniśreṣṭha dṛṣṭaṃ māhātmyamuttamam || 35 || pāṃcāladeśasaṃbhūto nāmnā naraharirdvijaḥ || asatsaṃgaprabhāvena pāpātmā samajāyata || 36 || nānā vidhāni pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca || kṛtavānpāpisaṃgena trayīmārgavinindakaḥ || 37 || sa kadācitsādhusaṃgāttīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ || ayodhyāmāgato vipra mahāpātakakṛddvijaḥ || 38 || pāpamocanatīrthe tu snātaḥ satsaṃgato dvijaḥ || pāparāśirvinaṣṭo'sya niṣpāpaḥ samabhūtkṣaṇāt || 39 || divaḥ papāta tanmūrdhni puṣpavṛṣṭirmunīśvara || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya viṣṇuloke gato dvijaḥ || 2.8.2.40 || taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ mayā ca dvijapuṃgava || śraddhayā parayā tatra kṛtaṃ snānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||41|| māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ tatra snānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || dānaṃ ca manujaiḥ kāryyaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ||42|| anyadā(?) tu kṛte snāne sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 43 || pāpamocanatīrthe tu pūrvaṃ tu sarayūjale || dhanuḥśatapramāṇena varttate tīrthamuttamam || 44 || sahasradhārāsaṃjñaṃ tu sarvakilbiṣanāśanam || yasminrāmājñayā vīro lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā || prāṇānutsṛjya yogena yayau śeṣātmatāṃ purā || 45 || sārddhaṃhastatrayeṇaiva pramāṇaṃ dhanuṣo viduḥ || caturbhirhastakaiḥ saṃkhyā daṇḍa ityabhidhīyate || 46 || || sūta uvāca || || itthaṃ tadā samākarṇya kumbhayonimunestadā || kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāsaḥ punaḥ papraccha kautukāt || 47 || || vyāsa uvāca || || sahasradhārāmāhātmyaṃ
