vistarādvada suvrata || śṛṇvaṃstīrthasya māhātmyaṃ na tṛpyati mano mama || 48 || || agastya uvāca || || sāvadhānaḥ śṛṇu mune kathāṃ kathayato mama || sahasradhārātīrthasya samutpattiṃ mahodayāt || 49 || purā rāmo raghupatirdevakāryaṃ vidhāya vai || kālena saha saṃgamya maṃtraṃ cakre nareśvaraḥ || 2.8.2.50 || āvāṃ mantrayamāṇau hi yaḥ paśyedantikāgataḥ||49|| mayā tyājyo bhavetkṣipramitthaṃ cakre sa saṃvidam ||51|| tasminmaṃtrayamāṇe hi dvāre tiṣṭhati lakṣmaṇe || āgataḥ sa taporāśirdurvāsāstejasāṃ nidhiḥ || 52 || āgatya lakṣmaṇaṃ śīghraṃ prītyovāca kṣudhā''kulaḥ|| 53 || || durvāsā uvāca || || saumitre gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ rāmāgre māṃ nivedaya || kāryārthinamidaṃ vākyaṃ nānyathā kartumarhasi || 54 || || agastya uvāca || || śāpādbhītaḥ sa saumitrirdrutaṃ gatvā tayoḥ puraḥ || muniṃ nivedayāmāsa rāmāgre darśanārthinam || durvāsasaṃ taporāśimatrinandanamāgatam || 55 || rāmo'pi kālamāmaṃtrya prasthāpya ca bahiryayau || dṛṣṭvā muniṃ taṃ praṇataḥ saṃbhojya prabhurādarāt || 56 || durvāsasaṃ munivaraṃ prasthāpya svayamādarāt || satyabhaṃgabhayādvīro lakṣmaṇaṃ tyaktavāṃstadā || 57 || lakṣmaṇo'pi tadā vīraḥ kurvannavitathaṃ vacaḥ || bhrāturjyeṣṭhasya sumatiḥ sarayūtīramāyayau || 58 || tatra gatvātha ca snātvā dhyānamāsthāya satvaram || cidātmani manaḥ śāntaṃ saṃgamyāvasthitastadā || 59 || tataḥ prādurabhūttatra sahasraphaṇamaṇḍitaḥ || śeṣaścakṣuḥśravāḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṣitiṃ bhittvā sahasradhā || suralokātsurendro'pi samāgādamaraiḥ saha || 2.8.2.60 || tataḥ śeṣātmatāṃ yātaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ satyasaṃgaram || uvāca madhuraṃ śakraḥ surāṇāṃ tatra paśyatām || 61 || || || indra uvāca || || lakṣmaṇottiṣṭha śīghraṃ tvamāroha svapadaṃ svakam || devakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ vīra tvayā ripuniṣūdana || 62 || vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuhi tvaṃ sanātanam || bhavanmūrtiḥ samāyātaḥ śeṣo'pi vilasatphaṇaḥ || 63 || sahasradhā kṣitiṃ bhittvā sahasraphaṇamaṇḍalaiḥ || kṣiteḥ sahasracchidreṣu yasmādbhittvā samudgatāḥ || 64 || phaṇasāhasramaṇibhirdagdhāḥ śeṣasya suvrata || tasmādetanmahātīrthaṃ sarayūtīragaṃ śubham || khyātaṃ sahasradhāreti bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 65 || etatkṣetrapramāṇaṃ tu dhanuṣāṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || atra snānena dānena śrāddhena śraddhayānvitaḥ || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇulokaṃ vrajennaraḥ || 66 || atra snāto naro dhīmāñcheṣaṃ saṃpūjya cāvyayam || tīrthaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadviṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt || 67 || tasmādatra prakartavyaṃ snānaṃ vidhipuraḥsaram || śeṣarūpāhivaddhyeyāḥ pūjyā viprā viśeṣataḥ || 68 || svarṇaṃ cānnaṃ ca vāsāṃsi deyāni śraddhayānvitaiḥ || snānaṃ dānaṃ hareḥ pūjā sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet || 69 || tasmādetanmahātīrthaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || kṣitau bhaviṣyati sadā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 2.8.2.70 || śrāvaṇe śuddhapakṣasya yā tithiḥ pañcamī bhavet || tasyāmatra prakartavyo nāgānuddiśya yatnataḥ || 71 || utsavo vipulaḥ sadbhiḥ śeṣapūjāpuraḥsaram || utsave tu kṛte tatra tīrthe mahati mānavaiḥ || 72 || santoṣya ca dvijānbhaktyā nāgapūjāpurassaram || santuṣṭāḥ phaṇinaḥ sarve pīḍayanti na mānuṣān || 73 || vaiśākhamāse ye snānaṃ kurvaṃtyatra samāhitāḥ || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 74 || tasmādatra prakartavyaṃ mādhave yatnato naraiḥ || snānaṃ dānaṃ hariḥ pūjyo brāhmaṇāśca viśeṣataḥ || tīrthe kṛte'tra manujaiḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 75 || viṣṇumuddiśya yo dadyātsālaṃkārāṃ payasvinīm || savatsāmatra sattīrthe satpātrāya dvijanmane || 76 || tasya vāso bhavennitya viṣṇuloke sanātane || akṣayaṃ svargamāpnoti tīrtha snānena mānavaḥ || 77 || atra pūjyau viśeṣeṇa naraiḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ || vaiśākhe māsyalaṃkārairvastraiśca dvijadaṃpatī || 78 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇaprītyai lakṣmīprātyai viśeṣataḥ || vaiśākhe māsi tīrthāni pṛthivīsaṃsthitāni vai || 79 || sarvāṇyapi ca saṃgatya sthāsyaṃtyatra na saṃśayaḥ || tasmādatra viśeṣeṇa vaiśākhe snānato nṛṇām || sarvatīrthāvagāhasya bhaviṣyati phalaṃ mahat || 2.8.2.80 || || agastya uvāca || || ityuktvā munirājeṃdro lakṣmaṇaṃ surasaṃ gatam || śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpya tattīrthe bhūbhāraharaṇakṣamam || lakṣmaṇaṃ yānamāropya pratasthe divamādarāt || 81 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vikhyātiṃ paramāṃ yayau || vaiśākhe māsi tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam || 82 || pañcamyāmapi śuklāyāṃ śrāvaṇasya viśeṣataḥ || anyadā parvaṇi śreṣṭhaṃ viśeṣaṃ snānamācaret || sahasradhārātīrthe ca naraḥ svargamavāpnuyāt|| 83 || vidhivadiha hi dhīmānsnānadānāni tīrthe naravara iha śaktyā yaḥ karotyādareṇa || sa iha vipulabhogānnirmalātmā ca bhaktyā bhajati bhujagaśāyiśrīpaterātmanaikyam || 84 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye brahmakuṇḍasahasradhārātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || || cha ||
<2.8.3>
|| sūta uvāca || || iti śrutvā vaco dhīmānādarātkuṃbhajanmanaḥ || provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavannadbhutamidaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam|| śrutvā tvatto mama manaḥ paramānaṃdamāyayau || 2 || anyattīrthavaraṃ brūhi tattvena mama śṛṇvataḥ || na tṛptirasti manasaḥ śṛṇvato mama suvrata || 3 || || || agastya uvāca || || śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi tīrthamanyadanuttamam || svargadvāramiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ sadā || 4 || svargadvārasya māhātmyaṃ vistarādvaktumīśvaraḥ || nahi kaścidato vatsa saṃkṣepācchṛṇu suvrata || 5 || sahasradhārāmārabhya pūrvataḥ sarayūjale || ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikā proktā dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṭśatī mitiḥ || 6 || svargadvārasya vistāraḥ purāṇajñairviśāradaiḥ || svargadvārasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 7 || satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ nāsatyaṃ mama bhāṣitam|| svargadvārasamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti brahmāṇḍagolake || 8 || hitvā divyāni bhaumāni tīrthāni sakalānyapi || prātarāgatya tiṣṭhanti tatra saṃśritya suvrata || 9 || tasmādatra prakartavyaṃ prātaḥ snānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || sarvatīrthāvagāhasya phalamātmana īpsatā || 2.8.3.10 || tyajaṃti prāṇinaḥ prāṇānsvargadvārāṃtare dvija || prayāṃti paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇoste nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11 || muktidvāramidaṃ paśya svargaprāptikaraṃ nṛṇām || svargadvāramiti khyātaṃ tasmāttīrthamanuttamam || 12 || svargadvāraṃ suduṣprāpyaṃ devairapi na saṃśayaḥ || yadyatkāmayate tatra tattadāpnoti mānavaḥ || 13 || svargadvāre parā siddhiḥ svargadvāre parā gatiḥ || japtaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat || dhyānamadhyayanaṃ sarvaṃ dānaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 14 || janmāṃtarasahasreṇa yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam|| svargadvārapraviṣṭasya tatsarvaṃ vrajati kṣayam || 15 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā vai varṇasaṃkarāḥ|| kṛmimlecchāśca ye cānye saṃkīrṇāḥ pāpayonayaḥ|16|| kīṭāḥ pipīlikāścaiva ye cānye mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ|| kālena nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ svargadvāre śṛṇu dvija ||17|| kaumodakīkarāḥ sarve pakṣiṇo garuḍadhvajāḥ || śubhe viṣṇupure viṣṇurjāyate tatra mānavāḥ || 18 || akāmo vā sakāmo vā api tīrthagatopi vā || svargadvāre tyajanprāṇānviṣṇuloke mahīyate || 19 || munayo devatāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyā yakṣā marudgaṇāḥ || yajñopavītamātreṇa vibhāgaṃ cakrire tu ye || 2.8.3.20 || madhyāhne'tra prakurvaṃti sānnidhyaṃ devatāgaṇāḥ || tasmāttatra prakurvaṃti madhyāhne snānamādarāt || 21 || kurvaṃtyanaśanaṃ ye tu svargadvāre jiteṃdriyāḥ || prayāṃti paramaṃ sthānaṃ ye ca māsopavāsinaḥ || 22 || annadānaratā te ca ratnadā bhūmidā narāḥ || govastradāśca viprebhyo yāṃti te bhavanaṃ hareḥ ||23|| yatra siddhā mahātmāno munayaḥ pitarastathā || svargaṃ prayāṃti te sarve svargadvāraṃ tataḥ smṛtam || 24 || caturddhā ca tanuṃ kṛtvā devadevo hariḥ svayam || atra vai ramate nityaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rāghavaḥ || 25 || brahmalokaṃ parityajya caturvaktraḥ sanātanaḥ || atraiva ramate nityaṃ devaiḥ saha pitāmahaḥ || 26 || kailāsanilayāvāsī śivastatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 27 || merumandaramātro'pi rāśiḥ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ || svargadvāraṃ samāsādya sa sarvo vrajati kṣayam || 28 || yā gatirjñānatapasāṃ yā gatiryajñayājinām|| svargadvāre mṛtānāṃ tu sā gatirvihitā śubhā || 29 || ṛṣidevāsuragaṇairjapahomaparāyaṇaiḥ || yatibhirmokṣakāmaiśca svargadvāro niṣevyate || 2.8.3.30 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi kāśīvāseṣu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ nimiṣārddhena kalau dāśarathīṃ purīm || 31 || yā gatiryogayuktānāṃ vārāṇasyāṃ tanutyajām|| sā gatiḥ snānamātreṇa sarayvāṃ harivāsare || 32 || svargadvāre mṛtaḥ kaścinnarakaṃ naiva paśyati || keśavānugṛhītā hi sarve yāṃti parāṃ gatim || 33 || bhūloke cāṃtarikṣe ca divi tīrthāni yāni vai || atītya vartate tāni tīrthānyetaddvijottama || 34 || viṣṇubhaktiṃ samāsādya ramante tu suniścitāḥ || saṃhṛtya śaktitaḥ kāmaṃ viṣayeṣu hi saṃsthitam ||35 || śaktitaḥ sarvato yuktvā śaktistapasi saṃsthitā || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 36 || hanyamāno'pi yo vidvānvasecchastraśatairapi || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati ||37|| svargadvāre viyujyeta sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vāpi ayanaṃ na vikalpayet || 38 || sarvasteṣāṃ śubhaḥ kālaḥ svargadvāraṃ śrayaṃti ye || snānamātreṇa pāpāni vilayaṃ yāṃti dehinām || 39 || yāvatpāpāni dehena ye kurvaṃti janāḥ kṣitau || ayodhyā paramaṃ sthānaṃ teṣāmīritamādarāt || || 2.8.3.40 || jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe paṃcadaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || tasya sāṃvatsarī yātrā devaiścandrahareḥ smṛtā || 41 || tasminnudyāpanaṃ candrasahasraṃ vratayogibhiḥ || kāryaṃ prayatnato vipra sarvayajñaphalādhikam|| 42 || tasminkṛte mahāpāpakṣayātsvargo bhavennṛṇām || 43|| || śrīvyāsa uvāca || || bhagavanbrūhi tattvena tasya candrahareḥ śubhām|| utpattiṃ ca tathā caṃdravratasyodyāpane vidhim || 44 || || agastya uvāca || || ayodhyānilayaṃ viṣṇuṃ natvā śītāṃśurutsukaḥ || āgacchattīrthamāhātmyaṃ sākṣātkartuṃ sudhānidhiḥ || atrāgatya ca candro'tha tīrthayātrāṃ cakāra saḥ || 45 || krameṇa vidhipūrvaṃ ca nānāścaryasamanvitaḥ || samārādhya tato viṣṇuṃ tapasā duścareṇa vai || 46 || tatprasādaṃ samāsādya svābhidhānapurassaram || hariṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa tena caṃdrahariḥ smṛtaḥ || 47 || vāsudevaprasādena tatsthānaṃ jātamadbhutam || taddhi guhyatamaṃ sthānaṃ vāsudevasya suvrata || 48 || sarveṣāmiva bhūtānāṃ bharturmokṣasya sarvadā || asminsiddhāḥ sadā vipra goviṃdavratamāsthitāḥ || 49 || nānāliṃgadharā nityaṃ viṣṇulokābhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || abhyasyaṃti paraṃ yogaṃ muktātmāno jiteṃdriyāḥ ||2.8.3.50|| yathā dharmamavāpnoti anyatra na tathā kvacit || dānaṃ vrataṃ tathā homaḥ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajeta ||51|| sarvakāmaphalaprāptirjāyate prāṇināṃ sadā || tasmādatra vidhātavyaṃ prāṇibhiryatnataḥ kramāt || dānādikaṃ viprapūjā daṃpatyośca viśeṣataḥ || 52 || sarvayajñādhikaphalaṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanam || sarvadevāvalokasya yatpuṇyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || 53 || tatsarvaṃ jāyate puṇyaṃ prāṇināmasya darśanāt || tasmādetanmahākṣetraṃ purāṇādiṣu gīyate || 54 || udyāpanavidhiścātra nṛbhirdvijapurassaram || agre caṃdrahareścandra sahasravratasaṃjñakaḥ || 55 || gate varṣadvaye sārddhe paṃcapakṣe dinadvaye || divasasyā'ṣṭame bhāge patatyeko'dhimāsakaḥ || 56 || tryadhike vā aśītyabde caturmāsayute tataḥ || bhaveccandrasahasraṃ tu tāvajjīvati yo naraḥ || udyāpanaṃ prakarttavyaṃ tena yātrā prayatnataḥ || 57 || yatpuṇyaṃ paramaṃ proktaṃ satataṃ yajñayājinām|| satyavādiṣu yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ hemadāyini || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate vipra sahasrābdasya jīvibhiḥ || 58 || sarvasaukhyapradaṃ tādṛkpuṇyavratamihocyate || 59 || caturdaśyāṃ śuciḥ snātvā dantadhāvanapūrvakam || caritabrahmacaryyaśca jitavākkāyamānasaḥ || paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā kṛtvā caṃdrapūjāṃ ca kārayet || 2.8.3.60 || pūrvaṃ ca mātaraḥ pūjyā gauryādikakrameṇa ca || ṛtvijaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā vṛddhiśrāddhapurassaram || 61 || prayataiḥ pratimā kāryā caṃdramaṃḍalasannibhā || sahasrasaṃkhyā hyathavā tadarddhaṃ vā tadarddhakam || nijavittānumānena tadardhena tadarddhikam || 62 || tataḥ śraddhānumānādvā kāryā vittānumānataḥ || athavā ṣoḍaśa śubhā vidhātavyāḥ prayatnataḥ || 63 || caṃdrapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryādāgamoktavidhānataḥ || māṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kāryā pratyekaṃ pratimā śubhā || 64 || somamaṃtreṇa homastu kāryo vittānumānataḥ || pratimāsthāpanaṃ kuryātsomamaṃtramudīrayet || 65 || somotpattiṃ somasūktaṃ pāṭhayecca prayatnataḥ || caṃdrapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryādāgamoktavidhānataḥ || 66 || caṃdranyāsaṃ kalānyāsaṃ kārayenmaṃḍale jalam || ekādaśeṃdriyanyāsaṃ tathaiva vidhipūrvakam || 67 || caṃdrabiṃbanibhaṃ kāryyaṃ maṃḍalaṃ śubhataṃḍulaiḥ|| madhye ca kalaśaḥ sthāpyo gavyena payasāplutaḥ || 68 || caturasreṣu saṃpūrṇānkalaśānsthāpayedbahiḥ || maṃḍale caṃdrapūjā ca kartavyā nāmabhiḥ kramāt || 69 || himāṃśave namaścaiva somacaṃdrāya vai namaḥ || 54 || caṃdrāya vidhave nityaṃ namaḥ kumudabaṃdhave || 2.8.3.70 || sudhāṃśave ca somāya oṣadhīśāya vai namaḥ || namo'bjāya mṛgāṃkāya kalānāṃ nidhaye namaḥ || 71 || namo nakṣatranāthāya śarvarīpataye namaḥ || jaivātṛkāya satataṃ dvijarājāya vai namaḥ || 72 || evaṃ ṣoḍaśabhiścaṃdraḥ stotavyo nāmabhiḥ kramāt || 73 || tato vai prayato dadyādvidhivanmaṃtrapūrvakam || śaṃkhatoyaṃ samādāya sapuṣpaṃ phalacaṃdanam || 74 || namaste māsamāsāṃte jāyamāna punaḥpunaḥ || gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śaśāṃka tvaṃ rohiṇyā sahito mama ||75|| evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivacchaśinaṃ praṇato bhavet || ṣoḍaśānye ca kalaśā dugdhapūrṇāḥ saratnakāḥ ||76|| savastrācchādanāḥ śāṃtyai dātavyāste dvijanmane || abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryātpāyasena jalena tu || 77 || ṛtvijāṃ manasastuṣṭiḥ kāryā vittānumānataḥ || brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayettatra sakuṭuṃbaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 78 || pūjanīyau prayatnena vastraiśca dvijadaṃpatī || kartavyaṃ ca tato bhūridakṣiṇādānamuttamam || 79 || pratimāśca pradātavyā dvijebhyo dhenupūrvikāḥ || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ tathānnaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || dātavyaṃ caṃdrasuprītyai harṣādevaṃ dvijanmane || 2.8.3.80 || upavāsavidhānena dinaśeṣaṃ nayetsudhīḥ || anaṃtare ca divase kuryādbhagavadarcanam || bāṃdhavaiḥ saha bhuñjīta niyamaṃ ca visarjjayet || 81 || evaṃ ca kurute caṃdrasahasraṃ vratamuttamam || brahmaghno'pi surāpo'pi steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ || vratenānena śuddhātmā caṃdralokaṃ vrajennaraḥ || 82 || yādṛśaśca bhavedvipra priyo nārāyaṇasya ca || evaṃ karoti niyataṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || 83 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye candrasahasravratodyāpanavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha ||
<2.8.4>
|| agastya uvāca || || tasmāccaṃdraharisthānādāgneyyāṃ diśi saṃsthitaḥ || devo dharmaharirnnāma kalikalmaṣanāśakaḥ || 1 || vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ svakarmapariniṣṭhitaḥ || purā samāgato dharmastīrthayātrācikīrṣayā || 2 || āgatya ca cakāroccairyātrāṃ tatrādareṇa saḥ || dṛṣṭvā māhātmyamatulamayodhyāyāḥ savismayaḥ || 3 || vidhāya svabhujāvūrdhvau vipro'vocanmudānvitaḥ || aho ramyamidaṃ tīrthamaho māhātmyamuttamam || 4 || ayodhyāsadṛśī kāpi dṛśyate nāparā purī || yā na spṛśati vasudhāṃ viṣṇucakrasthitā'niśam |||| 5 || yasyāṃ sthito hariḥ sākṣātseyaṃ kenopamīyate || aho tīrthāni sarvāṇi viṣṇulokapradāni vai || 6 || aho viṣṇuraho tīrthamayodhyā'ho mahāpurī || aho māhātmyamatulaṃ kiṃ na ślāghyamihāsthitam || 7 || ityuktvā tatra bahuśo nanarta pramadākulaḥ || dharmo māhātmyamālokya ayodhyāyā viśeṣataḥ || 8 || taṃ tathā nartamānaṃ vai dharmaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpānvitaḥ || āvirbabhūva bhagavānpītavāsā hariḥ svayam || taṃ praṇamya ca dharmo'tha tuṣṭāva harimādarāt || 9 || || dharma uvāca || || namaḥ kṣīrābdhivāsāya namaḥ paryaṃkaśāyine || namaḥ śaṃkarasaṃspṛṣṭadivyapādāya viṣṇave || 2.8.4.10 || bhaktyārccitasupādāya namo'jādipriyāya te || śubhāṃgāya sunetrāya mādhavāya namo namaḥ || 11 || namo'ravindapādāya padmanābhāya vai namaḥ || namaḥ kṣīrābdhikallolaspṛṣṭagātrāya śārṅgiṇe || 12 || oṃ namo yoganidrāya yogarkṣairbhāvitātmane || tārkṣyāsanāya devāya govindāya namonamaḥ || 13 || sukeśāya sunāsāya sulalāṭāya cakriṇe || suvastrāya suvarṇāya śrīdharāya namonamaḥ || 14 || subāhave namastubhyaṃ cārujaṃghāya te namaḥ || suvāsāya sudivyāya suvidyāya gadābhṛte || 15 || keśavāya ca śāṃtāya vāmanāya namonamaḥ || dharmapriyāya devāya namaste pītavāsase || 16 || || agastya uvāca || || iti stuto jagannātho dharmeṇa śrīpatirmudā || uvāca sa hṛṣīkeśaḥ prīto dharmamudāradhīḥ || 17 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || tuṣṭo'haṃ bhavato dharma stotreṇānena suvrata || varaṃ varaya dharmajña yaste syānmanasaḥ priyaḥ || 18 || stotreṇānena yaḥ stauti mānavo māmatandritaḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti pūjitaḥ śrīyutaḥsadā|| 19 || || dharma uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭosi bhagavandevadeva jagatpate || tvāmahaṃ sthāpayāmyatra nijanāmnā jagadguro || 2.8.4.20 || || agastya uvāca || || evamastviti saṃprocyābhavaddharmaharirvibhuḥ || smaraṇādeva mucyeta naro dharmaharervibhoḥ || 21 || sarayūsalile snātvā suciṃtākulamānasaḥ || devaṃ dharmahariṃ paśyetsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 22 || atra dānaṃ tathā homaṃ japo brāhmaṇabhojanam || sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti viṣṇuloke nivāsakṛt || 23 || ajñānājjñānato vāpi yatkiṃcidduṣkṛtaṃ bhavet || prāyaścittaṃ vidhātavyaṃ tannāśāya prayatnataḥ || 24 || prāyaścittena vidhinā pāpaṃ tasya praṇaśyati|| tasmādatra prakarttavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhānataḥ || 25 || ajñānājjñānato vāpi rājādernigrahāttathā || nityakarmanivṛttiḥ syādyasya puṃso'vaśātmanaḥ || tenāpyatra vidhātavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ prayatnataḥ || 26 || atra sākṣātsvayaṃ devo viṣṇurvasati sādaraḥ || tasmādvarṇayituṃ śakyo mahimā na hi mānavaiḥ || 27 || āṣāḍhe śukla pakṣasya ekādaśyāṃ dvijottama || tasya sāṃvatsarī yātrā kartavyā tu vidhānataḥ || 28 || svargadvāre naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā dharmahariṃ vibhum || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇuloke vasetsadā || 29 || tasmāddakṣiṇadigbhāge svarṇasya khaniruttamā || yatra cakre svarṇadṛṣṭiṃ kubero raghujādbhayāt || 2.8.4.30 || || || vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavanbrūhi tattvajña svarṇavṛṣṭirabhūtkatham || kuberasya kathaṃ bhītirutpannā raghubhūpateḥ || 31 || etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vistarānmama suvrata || śrutvā kathārahasyāni na tṛpyati mano mama || 32 || || agastya uvāca || || śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi svarṇasyotpattimuttamām || yasya śravaṇato nṛṇāṃ jāyate vismayo mahān || 33 || āsītpurā raghupatirikṣvākukulavarddhanaḥ || raghurnijabhujodāravīryaśāsitabhūtalaḥ || 34 || pratāpatāpitārātivargavyākhyātasadyaśāḥ || prajāḥ pālayatā samyaktenanītimatā satā ||35|| yaśaḥpūreṇa samaliptā diśo daśa sitatviṣā || sa cakre prauḍhavibhavasādhanāṃ vijayakramāt || 36 || nānādeśānsamākramya caturaṃgabalānvitaḥ || bhūtāni vaśamānīya vasu jagrāha daṇḍataḥ||37|| utkṛṣṭānnṛpatīnvīro daṃḍayitvā balādhikān || ratnāni vividhānyāśu jagrāhātibalastadā ||38|| sa vijitya diśaḥ sarvā gṛhītvā ratnasaṃcayam|| ayodhyāmāgato rājā rājadhānīṃ ca tāṃ śubhām|| 39 || tatrāgatya ca kākutstho yajñāyotsukamānasaḥ || cakāra nirmalāṃ buddhiṃ nijavaṃśocitakriyāma||2.8.4.40|| vasiṣṭhaṃ munimājñāya vāmadevaṃ ca kaśyapam || 41 || anyānapi muniśreṣṭhānnānātīrthasamāśritān || samānayadvinītena dvijavaryeṇa bhūpatiḥ || 42 || dṛṣṭvā sthitānsa tānsarvānpradīptāniva pāvakān || tānāgatānviditvātha raghuḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ || niścakrāma yathānyāyaṃ svayameva mahāyaśāḥ || 43 || tato vinītavatsarvānkākutstho dvijasattamān || uvāca dharmayuktaṃ ca vacanaṃ yajñasiddhaye || 44 || || raviruvāca || munayaḥ sarva evaite yūyaṃ śṛṇuta madvacaḥ || yajñaṃ vidhātumicchāmi tatrājñāṃ dātumarhatha || 45 || sāṃprataṃ māmako yajño yuktaḥ syānmunisattamāḥ || etadvicāryya tattvena brūta yūyaṃ munīśvarāḥ || || 46 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || rājanviśvajidākhyāto yajñānāṃ yajña uttamaḥ || sāṃprataṃ kuru taṃ yatnānmā vilaṃbaṃ vṛthā kṛthāḥ || 47 || || || agastya uvāca || nṛpaścakre tato yajñaṃ viśvadigjayasaṃjñitam || nānāsaṃbhāramadhuraṃ kṛtasarvasvadakṣiṇam || 48 || nānāvidhena dānena munisaṃtoṣaharṣakṛt || sarvasvameva pradadau dvijebhyo bahumānataḥ ||49|| teṣu viśveṣu yāteṣu pūjiteṣu gṛhānsvakān || bandhuṣvapi ca tuṣṭeṣu muniṣu praṇateṣu ca || 2.8.4.50 || tena yajñena vidhivadvihitena nareśvaraḥ || śuśubhe śobhanācāraḥ svarge deveṃdravatkṣaṇāt || 51 || tatrāṃtare samabhyāyānmuniryamavatāṃ varaḥ || viśvāmitramuneraṃtevāsī kautsa iti smṛtaḥ || 52 || dakṣiṇārthaṃ gurorddhīmānpāvituṃ taṃ nareśvaram || caturdaśasuvarṇānāṃ koṭīrāhara satvaram || || 53 || maddakṣiṇeti guruṇā nirbandhādyācito ruṣā || āgataḥ sa muniḥ kautsastato yācitumādarāt || raghuṃ bhūpālatilakaṃ dattasarvasvadakṣiṇam || || 54 || tamāgatamabhipretya raghurādaratastadā || utthāya pūjayāmāsa vidhivatsa paraṃtapaḥ || saparyyāsīttasya sarvā mṛtpātravihitakriyā || 55 || pūjāsaṃbhāramālokya tādṛśaṃ taṃ munīśvaraḥ || vismito'bhūnnirānando dakṣiṇā''śāṃ parityajan || uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vākyajñānaviśāradaḥ || || 56 || || kautsa uvāca || || rājannabhyudayaste'stu gacchāmyanyatra sāṃpratam || 57 || gurvarthāharaṇāyaiva dattasarvasvadakṣiṇam || tvāṃ na yāce dhanābhāvādato'nyatra vrajāmyaham || 58 || || agastya uvāca || || ityuktastena muninā raghuḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ || kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā'bravīdenaṃ vinayādvihitāṃjaliḥ || 59 || || raghuruvāca || || bhagavaṃstiṣṭha me harmye dinamekaṃ munivrata || yāvadyatiṣye bhagavanbhavadarthārthamuccakaiḥ || 2.8.4.60 || || agastya uvāca || || ityuktvā paramodāravaco munimudāradhīḥ || pratasthe ca raghustatra kuberavijigīṣayā || 61 || tamāyāṃtaṃ kubero'tha vijñāpya vacanoditaiḥ || prasannamanasaṃ cakre vṛṣṭiṃ svarṇasya cākṣayām || 62 || svarṇavṛṣṭirabhūdyatra sā svarṇakhaniruttamā || sa muniṃ darśayāmāsa khaniṃ tena niveditām|| 63 || tasmai samarpayāmāsa tāṃ raghuḥ khanimuttamām || munīndro'pi gṛhītvāśu tato gurvarthamādarāt || 64 || rājñe nivedayāmāsa sarvamanyadguṇādhikaḥ || varānatha dadau tuṣṭaḥ kautso matimatāṃ varaḥ || 65 || || kautsa uvāca || || rājam̐llabhasva satputraṃ nijavaṃśaguṇānvitam || iyaṃ svarṇakhanistūrṇaṃ manobhīṣṭaphalapradā || 66 || bhūyādatra paraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ sadā || atra snānena dānena nṛṇāṃ lakṣmīḥ prajāyate || 67 || vaiśākhe śukladvādaśyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī smṛtā || nānābhīṣṭaphalaprāptirbhūyānmadvacasā nṛṇām || 68 || || agastya uvāca || || iti dattvā varānrājñe kautsaḥ saṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ || pratasthe nijakāryārthe gurorāśramamutsukaḥ || 69 || rājā sa kṛtakṛtyo'tha śeṣaṃ saṃgṛhya taddhanam|| dvijebhyo vidhivaddattvā pālayāmāsa vai prajāḥ || 2.8.4.70 || evaṃ svarṇakhanerjātaṃ māhātmyaṃ ca munīśvarāt || 71 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye dharmaharisvarṇakhanimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha || ||
<2.8.5>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || bhagavanbrūhi tattvena kathaṃ nirbaṃdhato muniḥ || viśvāmitro nijaṃ śiṣyaṃ kautsaṃ krodhena tādṛśam || 1 || duṣprāpyamarthaṃ yatnena bahu prārthitavāṃstadā || etatsarvaṃ ca kathaya mayi yadyasti te kṛpā || 2 || || agastya uvāca || || śṛṇu dvija kathāmetāṃ sāvadhāneṃdriyaḥ svayam || viśvāmitro muniśreṣṭhaḥ sa divyajñānalocanaḥ || 3 || nijāśrame tapo durgaṃ cakāra prayato vratī || ekadā tamatho draṣṭuṃ durvāsā munirāgataḥ || 4 || āgatya ca kṣudhākrāṃta uccaiḥ provāca sa dvijaḥ || bhojanaṃ dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ kṣudhāpīḍitacetase || pāyasaṃ śuci coṣṇaṃ ca śīghraṃ kṣudhārttine dvija || 5 || iti śrutvā vacaḥ kṣipraṃ viśvāmitraḥ prayatnataḥ || sthālyāṃ pāyasamādāya taṃ samarpya tataḥ svayam|| 6 || tadādāyotthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā durvāsāstaṃ vilokayan || uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ muniṃ lakṣaṇatatparaḥ || 7 || kṣaṇaṃ sahasva viprendra yāvatsnātvā vrajāmyaham || tiṣṭhatiṣṭha kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha āgacchāmyeṣa sāpratam || 8 || ityuktvā sa jagāmaiva durvāsāḥ svāśramaṃ tadā || 9 || viśvāmitrastaponiṣṭhastadā sānurivā'calaḥ || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa tasthau sthiramatistadā || 2.8.5.10 || tasya śuśrūṣaṇaparo muniḥ kautso yatavrataḥ || babhūva paramodāramatirvigatamatsaraḥ || 11 || punarāgatya sa munirdurvāsā gatakalmaṣaḥ || bhuktvā ca pāyasaṃ sadyaḥ sa jagāma nijāśramam || 12 || tasmingate munivare viśvāmitrastaponidhiḥ || kautsaṃ vidyāvatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ visasarja gṛhānprati || 13 || sa visṛṣṭo guruṃ prāha dakṣiṇā prārthyatāmiti || viśvāmitrastu taṃ prāha kiṃ dāsyasi dakṣiṇām || dakṣiṇā tava śuśrūṣā gṛhaṃ vraja yatavrata || 14 || punaḥpunarguruṃ prāha śiṣyo nirbandhavānyadā || tadā gururgurukruddhaḥ śiṣyaṃ prāha ca niṣṭhuram || 15 || suvarṇasya suvarṇasya caturdaśa samāhara || koṭīrme dakṣiṇā vipra paścādgaccha gṛhaṃ prati || 16 || ityukto guruṇā kautso vicārya samupāgamat || kākutsthaṃ digvijetāraṃ yayāce gurudakṣiṇām|| 17 || ityuktaṃ te munivara tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ hi yatpunaḥ || ato'nyacchṛṇu te vacmi tīrthakāraṇamuttamam || 18 || tasmāddakṣiṇadigbhāge saṃbhedaḥ siddhasevitaḥ || tilodakīsarayvośca saṃgatyā bhuvi saṃśrutaḥ || 19 || tatra snātvā mahābhāga bhavanti virajā narāḥ || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ kṛtānāṃ yatphalaṃ bhavet || tadāpnoti sa dharmātmā tatra snātvā yatavrataḥ || 2.8.5.20 || svarṇādikaṃ ca yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe vedapārage || śubhāṃ gatimavāpnoti agnivaccaiva dīpyate || 21 || tilodakīsarayvośca saṃgame lokaviśrute || dattvānnaṃ ca vidhānena na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate || 22 || upavāsaṃ ca yaḥ kṛtvā viprānsaṃtarpayennaraḥ || sautrāmaṇeśca yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 23 || ekāhārastu yastiṣṭhenmāsaṃ tatra yatavrataḥ || yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sahasā tasya naśyati || 24 || nabhasya kṛṣṇāmāvasyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || rāmeṇa nirmitā pūrvaṃ nadī siṃdhurivāparā || 25 || siṃdhujānāṃ turaṃgāṇāṃ jalapānāya suvrata || tilavacchyāmamudakaṃ yatastasyāṃ sadā babhau || 26 || tilodakīti vikhyātā puṇyatoyā sadā nadī || saṃgamādanyato yasyāṃ tilodakyāṃ śucivrataḥ || snāto vimucyate pāpaiḥ saptajanmārjitairapi || 27 || tasmāttilodakīsnānaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ mune || karttavyaṃ suprayatnena prāṇibhirdharmakāṃkṣibhiḥ || snānaṃ dānaṃ vrataṃ homaṃ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet || 28|| iti vividhavidhānaistīrthayātrāṃkrameṇa prathitaguṇavikāsaḥ prāptapuṇyovidhāya || harimupahṛtabhāvaḥ pūjayansarvatīrthaṃ vrajati paramadhāma nyastapāpaḥ kathañcit || 29 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yoyāmāhātmye tilodarkāprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || || cha ||
<2.8.6>
|| agastya uvāca || || tasmātsaṃgamato vipra paścime diktaṭe sthitam || sītākuṇḍamitikhyātaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 1 || yatra snātvā naro vipra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || sītayā kila tatkuṇḍaṃ svayameva vinirmitam || rāmeṇa varadānācca mahāphalanidhīkṛtam || 2 || || śrīrāma uvāca || || śṛṇu sīte pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ bhuvi yādṛśam || tvatkuṇḍasyāsya subhage tvatprītyā kathayāmyaham|| 3 || atra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japo homastapo'thavā|| sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti vidhānena śucismite || 4 || mārgakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ tatra snānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || sarvapāpaharaṃ devi sarvadā snāyināṃ nṛṇām || 5 || iti rāmo varaṃ prādātsītāyai ca prajāpriyaḥ || tadāprabhṛti sarvatra tattīrthaṃ bhuvi varttate || 6 || sītākuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ janānāṃ paramādbhutam || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā nūnaṃ rāmamavāpnuyāt || 7 || tatra snānena dānena tapasā ca viśeṣataḥ || gandhairmālyairdhūpadīpairnnānāvibhavavistaraiḥ || rāmaṃ saṃpūjya sītāṃ ca muktaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 8 || mārge māsi ca snātavyaṃ garbhavāso na jāyate || anyadāpi naraḥ snātvā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 9 || vibhorviṣṇuharervipra ramye paścimadiktaṭe || devaścakraharirnāma sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ || 2.8.6.10 || tasya cakraharervipra mahimā na hi mānavaiḥ || śakyo varṇayituṃ dhīrairapi buddhimatāṃ varaiḥ||11|| tataḥ paścimadigbhāge nāmnā puṇyaṃ harismṛti || viṣṇorāyatanaṃ khyātaṃ paramārthaphalapradam|| yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 12 || tayordarśanato yāṃti teṣāṃ pāpāni dehinām || tāni pāpāni yāvaṃti kurvate bhuvi ye narāḥ || 13 || purā devāsure jāte saṃgrāme bhṛśadāruṇe || daityairvaramadotsiktairdevā yudhi parājitāḥ || 14 || teṣāṃ palāyamānānāṃ devānāmagraṇīrharaḥ || saṃstabhya caiva tānsarvānpuraskṛtyāṃbujāsanam || 15 || kṣīrodaśāyinaṃ viṣṇuṃ śeṣaparyyaṃkaśāyinam || lakṣmyopaviṣṭaṃ pārśve ca caraṇāṃbujahastayā || 16 || nāradādyairmunivarairudgītagugauravam || garuḍena puraḥsthenāniśamaṃjalinā stutam || 17 || kṣīrābdhijalakallolamadabindvaṃkitāmbaram || tārakotkaravisphāratārahāravirājitam || || 18 || pītāṃbaramatismeravikāśadbhāvabhāvitam || bibhrataṃ kuṇḍalaṃ sthūlaṃ karṇābhyāṃ mauktikojjvalam || 19 || ratnavallīmiva svacchāṃ śvetadvīpanivāsinīm || kirīṭaṃ padmarāgāṇāṃ valayaṃ dadhataṃ param || 2.8.6.20 || mitrasya rāhuvitrāsanivarttanamivāparam || sakaustubhaprabhācakraṃ bibhrāṇaṃ pravalāruṇam || 21 || parāṃ caturmukhotpattikalpasaṃkalpanāmiva || śaraṇaṃ sa jagāmāśu vinītātmā stuvanniti || 22 || tasminnavasare śaṃbhuḥ sarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha || tuṣṭāva prayato bhūtvā viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ suradviṣām || 23 || || īśvara uvāca || || saṃsārārṇavasaṃtārasuparṇasukhadāyine || moha tīvratamo hāri candrāya haraye namaḥ || 24 || sphuratsaṃvinmaṇiśikhāṃ cittasaṃgaticaṃdrikām || prapadye bhagavadbhaktimānasodyānavāhinīm || 25 || helollasatsamutsāhaśaktiṃ vyāptajagattrayām || yā pūrvakoṭirbhāvānāṃ sattvānāṃ vaiṣṇavīti vā || 26 || pavanāṃdolitāṃbhojadalaparvāṃtavarttinām || patatāmiva jantūnāṃ sthairyamekā harismṛtiḥ || 27 || namaḥ sūryyātmane tubhyaṃ saṃvitkiraṇamāline || hṛtkuśeśayakoṣaśrīsamunmeṣavidhāyine || 28 || namastasmai yamavate yogināṃ gataye sadā || parameśāya vai pāre mahasāṃ tamasāṃ tathā || 29 || yajñāya bhuktahaviṣa ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpiṇe || namaḥ sarasvatīgītadivyasadgaṇaśāline || 2.8.6.30 || śāṃtāya dharmanidhaye kṣetrajñāyāmṛtātmane || śiṣyayogapratiṣṭhāya namo jīvaikahetave || ghorāya māyāvidhaye sahasraśirase namaḥ || 31 || yoganidrātmane nābhipadmodbhūtajagatsṛje || namaḥ salilarūpāya kāraṇāya jagatsthiteḥ || 32 || kāryameyāya baline jīvāya paramātmane || goptre prāṇāya bhūtānāṃ namo viśvāya vedhase || 33 || dṛptāya siṃhavapuṣe daityasaṃhārakāriṇe || vīryāyānaṃtamanase jagadbhāvabhṛte namaḥ || 34 || saṃsārakāraṇājñānamahāsaṃtamasacchide || acintyadhāmne guhyāya rudrāyātyudvije namaḥ || 35 || śāntāya śāntakallolakaivalyapadadāyine || sarvabhāvātiriktāya namaḥ sarvamayātmane || 36 || indīvaradalaśyāmaṃ sphūrjatkiṃjalkavibhramam|| bibhrāṇaṃ kaustubhaṃ viṣṇuṃ naumi netrarasāyanam || 37 || || agastya uvāca || || iti stutaḥ prasannātmā varado garuḍadhvajaḥ || vavarṣa dṛṣṭisudhayā sarvāndevānkṛpānvitaḥ || uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ praśrayāvanatānsurān || || 38 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || jānāmi vibudhāḥ sarvamabhiprāyaṃ samādhitaḥ || daiteyairvikramākrāntaṃ padaṃ samaradarpitaiḥ || 39 || sabalairbalahīnānāṃ pratāpo vijitaḥ paraiḥ || sāṃprataṃ tu vidhāsyāmi tapo yuṣmadbalāya vai || 2.8.6.40 || ayodhyānagare gatvā kariṣye tapa uttamam || gupto bhūtvā bhavattejovivṛddhyai daityaśāntaye || 41 || bhavanto'pi tapastīvraṃ kurvaṃtvamalamānasāḥ || ayodhyāṃ prāpyatāṃ devā daityanāśāya satvaram || 42 || || || agastya uvāca || || ityuktvāṃtardadhe devāndevo garuḍavāhanaḥ || ayodhyāmāgataḥ kṣipraṃ cakāra tapa uttamam || 43 || gupto bhūtvā yadā vidvansuratejobhivṛddhaye || tena guptaharirnāma devo vikhyātimāgataḥ || 44 || āgatasya hareḥ pūrvaṃ yatra hastatalāccyutam || sudarśanākhyaṃ taccakraṃ tena cakrahariḥ smṛtaḥ || 45 || tayordarśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || harastena prabhāveṇa devāḥ prabalatejasaḥ || 46 || jitvā daityānraṇaiḥ sarvānsaṃprāpya svapadānyatha || rejire vipulānaṃdairasurānārdayaṃstataḥ || 47 || tataḥ sarve sametyāśu bṛhaspatipurassarāḥ || devāḥ sarve'namanmaulimālārccita padāmbujam || hariṃ draṣṭumathāgacchannayodhyāyāṃ samutsukāḥ || 48 || āgatya ca tataḥ śrutvā nānāvidhaguṇādaram || bhāvaiḥ puṇyaiḥ samabhyarcya natvā prāṃjalayastadā || harimekāgramanasā dhyāyanto dhyānaniṣṭhitāḥ || 49 || tānāgatānsamālokya padabhaktyā kṛtānatīn || prasannaḥ prāha viśvātmā pītavāsā janārdanaḥ || 2.8.6.50 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || bhobho devā bhavantaśca cirāddiṣṭayādyasaṃgatāḥ || adhunā bhavatāmicchāṃ kāṃ karomi surā aham || tadbrūta tvaritā mahyaṃ kiṃ vilaṃbena nirbhayāḥ || 51 || devā ūcuḥ || || bhagavandevadeveśa tvayā saṃprati sarvaśaḥ || sarvaṃ samabhavatkāryaṃ niṣpannaṃ vai jagatpate || 52 || tathāpi sarvadā bhāvyaṃ nityaṃ deva tvayā vibho || asmadrakṣārthamatraiva vijitendriyavartmanā ||53|| evameva sadā kāryaṃ śatrupakṣavināśanam ||54|| || śrībhagavānuvāca || || evametatkariṣyāmi bhavatāmarisaṃjayam || śrīmatāṃ tejaso vṛddhiṃ kariṣyāmi sadāsurāḥ || katheyaṃ ca sadā khyātiṃ loke yāsyati cottamām || 55 || ayaṃ nāmnā guptaharirdevo bhuvanaviśrutaḥ || madīyaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ sthānaṃ khyātiṃ sameṣyati ||56 || atra yaḥ prāṇināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pūjāyajñajapādikam || karoti parayā bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim|| 57|| atra yaḥ kurute dānaṃ yathāśaktyā jitendriyaḥ || sa svargamatulaṃ prāpya na śocati kadācana || 58 || atra matprītaye devāḥ prāṇibhirdharmakāṃkṣibhiḥ || dātavyā gauḥ prayatnena savatsā vidhipūrvakam || || 59 || svarṇaśṛṃgī raupyakhurī vastradvayasamāvṛtā || kāṃsyopadohanā tāmrapṛṣṭhī bahuguṇānvitā|| 2.8.6.60|| ratnapucchā dugdhavatī ghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣitā || arcitā gaṃdhapuṣpādyaiḥ suprasannā'mṛtaprajā || 61 || dvijāya vedavijñāya guṇine nirmalātmane || viṣṇubhaktāya viduṣe ānṛśaṃsyaratāya ca || 62 || brāhmaṇāya ca gaurdeyā sarvatrasukhamaśnute || na deyā dvijamātrāya dātāraṃ so'vapātayet || 63 || matprītaye'tra dātavyā nirmalenāṃtarātmanā || 64 || snātaṃ yaiśca viśuddhyarthamatra madbhaktitatparaiḥ || teṣāṃ svargatayo nityaṃ muktiḥ karatale sthitā || 65 || tathā cakrahareḥ pīṭhe matprītyai dānamuttamam || japahomādikaṃ cāpi karttavyaṃ yatnato naraiḥ || 66 || bhavanto'pi vidhānena yātrāṃ kurvaṃtu sattamāḥ || asmādguptahareḥ sthānānnikaṭe saṃgame śubhe || 67 || pratyagbhāge gopratārādyojanatrayasaṃmite || ghargharāṃbutaraṃgiṇyā sarayūḥ saṃgatā yataḥ || 68 || atra snātvā vidhānena draṣṭavyo'tra prayatnataḥ || devo guptaharirnāma sarvakāmārthasiddhidaḥ || 69 || || agastya uvāca || || ityuktvāṃtardadhe devaḥ pītāmbaradharo'cyutaḥ || devā api vidhānena kṛtvā yātrāṃ prayatnataḥ || ayodhyāyāṃ sthitā nityaṃ harerguṇavimohitāḥ || 2.8.6.70 || tadāprabhṛti vipreṃdra tatsthānaṃ bhuvi paprathe || kārtikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || 71 || vibhorguptaharestatra saṃgamasnānapūrvikā || gopratāre ca tīrthe'sminsarayūghargharāśrite || snātvā devo'rcanīyo'yaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 72 || tathā cakrahareryātrā karttavyā suprayatnataḥ || mārgaśārṣasya viśade pakṣe haritithau naraiḥ || 73 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute yātrāṃ viṣṇuloke sa modate ||74 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamuktvā tu virate munau kalaśajanmani || kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāsaḥ punarāha savismayaḥ || 75 || || vyāsa uvāca || || atyāścaryyamayīṃ brahmankathāmetāṃ tapodhana || uktavānasi yenaitatsāścaryyaṃ mama mānasam || 76 || vistareṇa mama brūhi māhātmyaṃ paramādbhutam || 77 || śṛṇu saṃgamamāhātmyaṃ vipreṃdra paramādbhutam || skandadevācchrutaṃ samyakkathayāmi tathā tava || 78 || daśakoṭisahasrāṇi daśakoṭiśatāni ca || tīrthāni sarayūnadyā ghargharodakasaṃgame || nivasaṃti sadā vipra skandādavagataṃ mayā ||79 || devatānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca siddhānāṃ yogināṃ tathā || brahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca sānnidhyaṃ sarvadā sthitam || 2.8.6.80 || tasminsaṃgamasalile naraḥ snātvā samāhitaḥ || saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca dattvā dānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 81 || hutvā vaiṣṇavamaṃtreṇa śuciryatphalamāpnuyāt || tadihaikamanā vipra śṛṇu yatkathayāmi te || 82 || aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca || kurukṣetre mahākṣetre rāhugraste divākare || 83 || suvarṇadāne yatpuṇyamahanyahani tadbhavet || 84 || amāvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ dvādaśyorubhayorapi || ayane ca vyatīpāte snānaṃ vaiṣṇavalokadam || 85 || tiṣṭhedyugasahasraṃ tu pādenaikena yaḥ pumān || vidhivatsaṃgame snāyātpauṣyāṃ tadaviśeṣataḥ || 86 || laṃbate'vākchirā yastu yugānāmayutaṃ pumān || snātānāṃ śucibhistoyaiḥ saṃgame prayatātmanām || 87 || vyuṣṭirbhavati yā puṃsāṃ na sā kratuśatairapi || 88 || pauṣe māsi viśeṣeṇa snānaṃ bahuphalapradam || 89 || pauṣe māsi viśeṣeṇa yaḥ kuryātsnānamādṛtaḥ || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā varṇasaṃkaraḥ || sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam ||2.8.6.90 || pauṣe māse tu yo dadyādghṛtāḍhyaṃ dīpamuttamam || vidhivacchraddhayā vipra śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam ||91|| nānājanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ svalpaṃ bahvapi vā bhavet || tatsarvaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ toyasthaṃ lavaṇaṃ yathā || || 92 || āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ saṃtatīḥ saukhyamuttamam || prāpnoti phaladaṃ nityaṃ dīpadaḥ puṇyabhāṅnaraḥ || 93 || yastu śuklatrayodaśyāṃ pauṣe'tra prayato vratī || jāgaraṃ kurute dhīraḥ sa gacchedbhavanaṃ hareḥ || 94 || jāgaraṃ vidadhadrātrau dīpaṃ dattvā tu sarvaśaḥ || homaṃ ca kārayedvipro niyatātmā śucivrataḥ || 95 || vaiṣṇavo viṣṇupūjāṃ ca kurvañchṛṇvanhareḥ kathām || gītavāditranṛtyaiśca viṣṇutoṣaṇakārakaiḥ || kathābhiḥ puṇyayuktābhirjāgṛyāccharvarīṃ naraḥ || 96 || tataḥ prabhāte vimale snātvā vidhivadādarāt || viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya viprāṃśca deyaṃ svarṇādi śaktitaḥ || 97 || svarṇaṃ cānnaṃ ca vāsāṃsi yo dadyācchraddhayā'nvitaḥ || saṃgame vidhivadvidvānsa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 98 || varṣevarṣe tu kartavyo jāgaraḥ puṇyatatparaiḥ || 99 || hariḥ pūjyo dvijāḥ samyaksaṃtoṣyāḥ śaktito naraiḥ || tena viṣṇoḥ parā tuṣṭiḥ pāpāni viphalāni ca || bhavaṃti nirviṣāḥ sarpā yathā tārkṣyasya darśanāt || || 2.8.6.100 || tatra snāto divaṃ yāti atra snātaḥ sukhī bhaveta || 101 || triṣu lokeṣu ye kecitprāṇinaḥ sarva eva te || tarpyamāṇāḥ parāṃ tṛptiṃ yāṃti saṃgamajairjalaiḥ || 102 || bhūtānāmiha sarveṣāṃ duḥkhopahatacetasām || gatimanveṣamāṇānāṃ na saṃgamasamā gatiḥ || 103 || saptāvarānsaptaparānpuruṣaścātmanāsaha || puṃsastārayate sarvānsaṃgame snānamācaran || 104 || jātyaṃdhairiha te tulyāstathā paṃgubhireva ca || sametyātra ca na snānti sarayūghargharasaṃgame || 105 || varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yadvattathā tīrtheṣu saṃgamaḥ || sarayūghargharāyoge vaiṣṇavastho naraḥ sadā || 106 || atra snānena dānena yathā śaktyā jiteṃdriyaḥ || homena vidhipuktena naraḥ svargamavāpnuyāt || 107 || naro vā yadi vā nārī vidhivatsnānamācaret || svargalokanivāso hi bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ || 108 || yathā vahnirdahetsarvaṃ śuṣkamārdramathāpi vā || bhasmībhavaṃti pāpāni tatsamāgamamajjanāt || 109 || ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni nānāvidhiphalāni vai || sarayūghargharotpannasaṃgamastvadhiko bhavet || 2.8.6.110 || sarvatīrthāvagāhasya phalaṃ yādṛksmṛtaṃ śrutau || tādṛkphalaṃ nṛṇāṃ samyagbhavetsaṃgamamajjanāt || 111 || gopratārābhidhaṃ tīrthamaparaṃ vartate'nagha || sannidhau saṃgamasyaiva mahāpātakanāśanam || 112 || yatra snānena dānena na śocati naraḥ kvacit || gopratārasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 113 || vārāṇasyāṃ yathā vidvanvarttate maṇikarṇikā || ujjayinyāṃ yathā vipra mahākālaniketanam || 114 || naimiṣe cakravāpī tu yathā tīrthatamā smṛtā || ayodhyāyāṃ tathā vipra gopratārābhidhaṃ mahat || 115 || yatra rāmājñayā vidvansāketanagarījanāḥ || avāpuḥ svargamatulaṃ nimajjya paramāṃbhasi || 116 || || vyāsa uvāca || || avāpuste kathaṃ svargaṃ sāketanagarījanāḥ || kathaṃ ca rāghavo vidvannetatkathaya suvrata || 117 || || agastya uvāca || || sāvadhānaḥ śṛṇu mune kathāmetāṃ suvistarāt || yathājagāma rāmo'sau svargaṃ sa ca purījanaḥ || 118 || purā rāmo vidhāyaiva devakāryyamataṃdritaḥ || svargaṃ gaṃtuṃ manaścakre bhrātṛbhyāṃ saha vīradhīḥ || 119 || tato niśamya cāreṇa vānarāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || ṛkṣagopuccharakṣāṃsi samutpeturanekaśaḥ || 2.8.6.120 || devagaṃdharvaputrāśca ṛṣiputrāśca vānarāḥ || rāmakṣayaṃ viditvā tu sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 121 || te rāmamanugatyocuḥ sarve vānarayūthapāḥ || tavānugamane rājansaṃprāptāḥ sma ihānagha || 122 || yadi rāma vināsmābhirgacchestvaṃ puruṣarṣabha || sarve khalu hatāḥ syāma daṇḍena mahatā nṛpa || 123 || śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāmṛkṣavānararakṣasām|| vibhīṣaṇamuvācātha rāghavastatkṣaṇaṃ girā || 224 || yāvatprajā dhariṣyaṃti tāvadeva vibhīṣaṇa || kārayasva mahadrājyaṃ laṃkāṃ tvaṃ pālayiṣyasi || 125 || śādhi rājyaṃ ca khalvetannānyathā me vacaḥ kuru || prajāstvaṃ rakṣa dharmeṇa nottaraṃ vaktumarhasi || 126|| evamuktvā tu kākutstho hanumaṃtamathābravīt || vāyuputra ciraṃ jīva mā pratijñāṃ vṛthā kṛthāḥ || 127 || yāvallokā vadiṣyaṃti matkathāṃ vānararṣabha || tāvattvaṃ dhāraya prāṇānpratijñāṃ pratipālayan || 128 || maindaśca dvividaścaiva amṛtaprāśanāvubhau || yāvallokā dhariṣyaṃti tāvadetau dhariṣyataḥ || 129 || putrapautrāśca ye'smākaṃ tānrakṣantviha vānarāḥ || evamuktvā tu kākutsthaḥ sarvānatha ca vānarān || mayā sārdhaṃ prayāteti tadā tānrāghavo'bravīt || 2.8.6.130 || prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryyāṃ pṛthuvakṣā mahābhujaḥ || rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ purodhasamathābravīt || 131 || agnihotrāṇi yāṃtvagre dīpyamānāni sarvaśaḥ || vājapeyātirātrāṇi niryātu ca mamāgrataḥ || 132 || tato vasiṣṭhastejasvī sarvaṃ niścitya cetasā || cakāra vidhivatkarma mahāprāsthānikaṃ vidhim || 133 || tataḥ kṣaumāmbaradharo brahmacaryasamanvitaḥ || kuśānādāya pāṇibhyāṃ mahāprasthānamudyataḥ || || 134 || na vyāharacchubhaṃ kiṃcidaśubhaṃ vā nareśvaraḥ || niṣkramya nagarāttasmātsāgarādiva caṃdramāḥ || 135 || rāmasya savyapārśve tu sapadmā śrīḥ samāśritā || dakṣiṇe hrīrviśālākṣī vyavasāyastathāgrataḥ || 136 || nānāvidhāyudhānyatra dhanurjyāprabhṛtīni ca || anuvrajaṃti kākutsthaṃ sarve puruṣa vigrahāḥ || 137 || vedo brāhmaṇarūpeṇa sāvitrī savyadakṣiṇe || oṃkāro'tha vaṣaṅkāraḥ sarve rāmaṃ tadā'vrajan || 138 || ṛṣayaśca mahātmānaḥ sarve caiva mahīdharāḥ || anugacchanti kākutsthaṃ svargadvāramupasthitam || 139 || tathānuyāṃti kākutsthamaṃtaḥpuragatāḥ striyaḥ || savṛddhābāladāsīkāḥ saparṣaddvārarakṣakāḥ || 2.8.6.140 || sāntaḥpuraśca bharataḥ śatrughnasahito yayau || rāmaṃ vrajaṃtamāgamya raghuvaṃśamanuvratāḥ || 141 || tato viprā mahātmānaḥ sāgnihotrāḥ samaṃtataḥ || saputradārāḥ kākutsthamanugacchati sarvaśaḥ || 142 || maṃtriṇo bhṛtyayuktāśca saputrāḥ sahabāṃdhavāḥ || sarve te sānugāścaiva hyanu gacchaṃti rāghavam || 143 || tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtāḥ || gacchaṃtamanugacchaṃtirāghavaṃ guṇaraṃjitāḥ || 144 || tathā prajāśca sakalāḥ saputrāśca savabāṃdhavāḥ || rāghavasyānugāścāsandṛṣṭvā vigatakalmaṣam || 145 || snātāḥ śuklāmbaradharāḥ sarve prayatamānasāḥ || kṛtvā kilakilāśabdamanuyātāśca rāghavam || 146 || na kaścittatra dīno'bhūnna bhīto nātiduḥkhitaḥ || prahṛṣṭā muditāḥ sarve vabhūvuḥ paramādbhutāḥ || 147 || draṣṭukāmāśca nirvāṇaṃ rājño janapadāstathā || saṃprāptāste'pi dṛṣṭvaiva nabhomārgeṇa cakriṇam || 148 || ṛkṣavānararakṣāṃsi janāśca puravāsinaḥ || āgatya parayā bhaktyā pṛṣṭhataḥ samupāyayuḥ || 149 || tāni bhūtāni nagare hyantardhānagatānyapi || rāghavaṃ te'pyanuyayuḥ svargadvāramupasthitam || 2.8.6.150 || yāni paśyaṃti kākutsthaṃ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || sattvāni svargagamane matiṃ kurvaṃti tānyapi || 151 || nāsītsattvamayodhyāyāṃ susūkṣmamapi kiṃcana || yadrāghavaṃ nānuyāti svargadvāramupasthitam || 152 || athārddhayojanaṃ gatvā nadīṃ paścānmukho yayau || sarayūṃ puṇyasalilāṃ dadarśa raghunaṃdanaḥ|| 153 || atha tasminmuhūrte tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || sarvaiḥ parivṛto devairṛṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ || āyayau tatra kākutsthaṃ svargadvāramupasthitam || 154 || vimānaśatakoṭībhirdivyābhiḥ sarvato vṛtaḥ || dīpayansarvato vyoma jyotirbhūtamanuttamam || 155 || svayaṃprabhaiśca tejobhirmahadbhiḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ || puṇyā vātā vavustatra gandhavaṃtaḥ sukhapradāḥ || 156 || sapuṇyapuṣpavarṣaṃ ca vāyuyuktaṃ mahājavam || gandharvairapsarobhiśca tasminsūryaupasthitaḥ ||157 || śarayūsalilaṃ rāmaḥ padbhyāṃ sa samupāspṛśat || tato brahmā surairyuktaḥ stotuṃ samupacakrame ||158|| tvaṃ hi lokapatirdeva na tvāṃ jānāti kaścana || ahaṃ te vai viśālākṣa bhūtapūrvaparigrahaḥ || 159 || tvamaciṃtyaṃ mahadbhūtamakṣayaṃ lokasaṃgrahe || yāmicchasi mahāvīrya tāṃ tanuṃ praviśa svakām || 2.8.6.160 || pitāmahasya vacanādidamevāviśatsvayam || sudivyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥ saṃsāraṃ sa sahānujaḥ || tato viṣṇutanundevāḥ pūjayantaḥ surottamam || 161 || sādhyā marudgaṇāścaiva sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ || ye ca divyā ṛṣigaṇā gandharvāpsarasastathā || suparṇā nāgayakṣāśca daityadānavarākṣasāḥ || 162 || devāḥ prahṛṣṭā muditāḥ sarve pūrṇamanorathāḥ || sādhusādhviti te sarve tridivasthā babhāṣire || 163 || atha viṣṇurmahātejāḥ pitāmahamuvāca ha || eṣāṃ lokaṃ janaughānāṃ dātumarhasi suvrata || 164 || ime tu sarve matsnehādāyātāḥ sarvamānavāḥ || bhaktāśca bhaktimantaśca tyaktātmāno'pi sarvaśaḥ || 165 || tacchrutvā viṣṇukathitaṃ sarvalokeśvaro'bravīt || lokaṃ santānikaṃ nāma saṃsthāsyaṃti hi mānavāḥ || 166 || svargadvāre'tra vai tīrthe rāmamevānucintayan || prāṇāṃstyajati bhaktyā vai sa saṃtānaṃ paraṃ labhet || 167 || sarve saṃtānikaṃnāma brahmalokādanantaram || vānarāśca svakāṃ yoniṃ rākṣasāścāpi rākṣasīm||168|| yasyā viniḥsṛtā ye vai surāsuratanūdbhavāḥ || ādityatanayaścaiva sugrīvaḥ sūryamaṇḍalam || 169 || ṛṣayo nāgayakṣāśca prayāsyanti svakāraṇam || tathā bruvati deveśe gopratāramupasthitam || 2.8.6.170 || tajjalaṃ sarayūṃ bheje paripūrṇaṃ tato jalam || avagāhya jalaṃ sarve prāṇāṃstyaktvā prahṛṣṭavat || 171 || mānuṣaṃ dehamutsṛjya te vimānānyathāruhan || tiryagyonigatā ye ca praviśya sarayūṃ tadā || 172 || dehatyāgaṃ ca te tatra kṛtvā divyavapurddharāḥ || tathānyānyapi sattvāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || 173 || prāpya cottamadehaṃ vai devalokamupāgaman || tasmiṃstatra samāpanne vānarā ṛkṣarākṣasāḥ || te'pi praviviśuḥ sarve dehānnikṣipya vai tadā || 174 || tadā svargaṃ gatāḥ sarve smṛtvā lokaguruṃ vibhum || jagāma tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ rāmo hṛṣṭo mahāmatiḥ || 175 || atastadgopratārākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ vikhyātimāgatam || gopratāre paro mokṣo nānyatīrtheṣu vidyate || 176 || janmāntaraśatairvipra yogo'yaṃ yadi labhyate || muktirbhavati tattvekajanmanā labhyate na vā || 177 || gopratāre na sandeho harirbhaktyā suniṣṭhitaḥ || ekena janmanānyo'pi yogamokṣaṃ ca vindati || 178 || gopratāre naro vidvānyo'pi snāti suniścitaḥ || viśatyasau paraṃ sthānaṃ yogināmapi durlabham || || 179 || kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa snātavyaṃ vijitendriyaiḥ || kārtike māsi viprarṣe sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || snātumāyāntyayodhyāyāṃ gopratāre viśeṣataḥ || 2.8.6.180 || gopratārasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || yatra prayāgarājo'pi snātumāyāti kārtike || 181 || niṣpāpaḥ kaluṣaṃ tyaktvā śuklāṃgaḥ sitakaṃcukaḥ || śuddhyarthaṃ sādhukāmo'sau prayāge munisattamaḥ || 182 || yāni kāni ca tīrthāni bhūmau divyāni suvrata || kārtikyāṃ tāni sarvāṇi gopratāre vasanti vai || 183 || gopratāre japo homaḥ snānaṃ dānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ || sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti śraddhayā niyamavratam || 184 || kārtike prāpya tadyanti tīrthāni sakalānyapi || gopratāraṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ pāpaṃ tyaktumitīcchayā || 185 || gopratāre kṛtaṃ snānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || gopratāre naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā guptahariṃ vibhum || sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 186 || viṣṇumuddiśya viprāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || karttavyaṃ śraddhayā yuktaiḥ snānapūrvaṃ yatavrataiḥ || 187 || payasvinī ca gaurdeyā sālaṃkārā ca śaktitaḥ || viprāya vedaviduṣe niyamavrataśāline || brāhmaṇāyātiśucaye viṣṇuprītyai yatātmanā || 168 || annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ hema vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || dātavyāni hareḥ prāptyai bhaktyā paramayā yutaiḥ || 189 || sūryagrahe kurukṣetre narmadāyāṃ śaśigrahe || tulādānasya yatpuṇyaṃ tadatra dīpadānataḥ || 2.8.6.190 || ghṛtena dīpako yasya tilataile na vā punaḥ || jvalate muniśārdūla hayamedhena tasya kim || 191 || teneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ tīrthāvagāhanam || dīpadānaṃ kṛtaṃ yena kārttike keśavāgrataḥ || 192 || nānāvidhāni tīrthāni bhuktimuktipradāni ca || gopratārasya tānyatra kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 193 || svarṇamalpaṃ ca yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe vedapārage || śubhāṃ gatimavāpnoti hyagnivaccaiva dīpyate ||194|| gopratārābhidhe tīrthe trilokīviśrute dvija || dattvānnaṃ ca vidhānena na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate || 195 || tatra snānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādviprānsaṃtarpayennaraḥ || sautrāmaṇeśca yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 196 || ekāhārastu yastiṣṭhenmāsaṃ tatra yatavrataḥ || yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sahasā tasya naśyati || 197 || agnipraveśaṃ ye kuryurgopratāre vidhānataḥ || te viśaṃti padaṃ viṣṇorniḥsaṃdagdhaṃ tapodhana || 198 || kurvaṃtyanaśanaṃ ye'tra viṣṇubhaktyā suniścitāḥ || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 199 || arcayedyastu goviṃdaṃ gopratāre hi mānavaḥ || daśasauvarṇikaṃ puṇyaṃ gopratāre prakathyate || 2.8.6.200 || agnihotraphalo dhūpo goviṃdasya samarpitaḥ || bhūmidānena sadṛśaṃ gaṃdhadānaphalaṃ smṛtam || 201 || atyadbhutamidaṃ vidvansthānametatprakīrtitam || kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa atra snātvā śucivrataḥ || 202 || svargadvāre naraḥ snātvā daśasvarṇaphalaṃ labhet || svarṇadaḥ svargavāsī ca yo dadyācchraddhayānvitaḥ || 203 || sutīrthe parvaṇi śreṣṭhe daśasvarṇaphalaprade || jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 204 || upoṣitaḥ śuciḥ snāto viṣṇupūjanatatparaḥ || dīpaṃ dadyātprayatnena nānāphalavidhāyinam || 205 || tāvadgarjaṃti puṇyāni svarge martye rasātale || yāvaddadyājjale dīpaṃ kārttike keśavāgrataḥ || 206 || paurṇamāsyāṃ prabhāte tu snātvā nirmalamānasaḥ || hariṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadvidhāya śrāddhamādarāt || 207 || dattvānnaṃ ca yathāśaktyā saṃtoṣya brāhmaṇāṃstataḥ || vastrādibhiralaṃkāraiḥ saṃpūjya dvijadaṃpatī || 208 || vibhuṃ guptahariṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya tu viśeṣataḥ || namaskṛtyānu tattīrthaṃ śucistadgatamānasaḥ || 209 || svargadvāre ca vidhivanmadhyāhne snānamācaret || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 2.8.6.210 || iti paramavidhānairgopratāre vidhāya prathitasukṛtamūrttiḥ snānamuccaiḥ prayatnāt || kalitanikhilapāpaḥ pūjayitvādareṇācyutamamalavikāśo viṣṇusāyujyameti || 211 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye svargadvāragopratāratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<2.8.7>
|| agastya uvāca || || tīrthamanyatpravakṣyāmi kṣīrodakamiti smṛtam || sītākuṇḍācca vāyavye varttate guṇasundaram || puṇyaikanicayasthānaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanam || 1 || purā daśaratho rājā putreṣṭināma nāmataḥ || cakāra vidhivadyajñaṃ putrārthaṃ yatra cādarāt || 2 || kratuṃ samāpayāmāsa sānando bhūridakṣiṇam || yajñānte kratubhuktatra mūrtimānsamadṛśyata || 3 || haste kṛtvā hemapātraṃ haviḥpūrṇamanuttamam || tasminhaviṣi saṃkīrṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ teja uttamam || caturvidhaṃ vibhajyaiva patnībhyo dattavānnṛpaḥ || 4 || yatra tatkṣīrasaṃprāptirjātā paramadurlabhā || kṣīrodakamiti khyātaṃ tatsthānaṃ pāpanāśanam || udakenābhivyaktaṃ ca uttamaṃ ca phalapradam || 5 || tatra snātvā naro dhīmānvijitendriya ādarāt || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti putrāṃśca subahuśrutān || 6 || āśvine śuklapakṣasya ekādaśyāṃ jitavrataḥ || tatra snātvā vidhānena dattvā śaktyā dvijanmane || 7 || viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || putrānavāpnuyādviddhi dharmāṃśca vidhivannaraḥ || 8 || tasmātkṣīrodakasthānānnairṛte digdale śritam || khyātaṃ bṛhaspateḥ kuṇḍamuddaṃḍācaṃḍamaṃḍitam || 9 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ puṇyāmṛtataraṃgitam || yatra sākṣātsuragururnivāsaṃ kila nirmame || 2.8.7.10 || yajñaṃ ca vidhivaccakre bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ || nānāmunigaṇairyuktaṃ ramyaṃ bahuphalapradam || suparṇacchāyasaṃpannaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tatpāpidurllabham || 11 || indrādayo'pi vibudhā yatra snātvā prayatnataḥ || manobhīṣṭaphalaṃ prāptāḥ sauṃdaryaudāryatuṃdilāḥ || 12 || yatra snānena dānena naro mucyeta kilbiṣāt || 13 || bhādre śukle tu paṃcamyāṃ yātrā tatra phalapradā || anyadāpi gurorvāre snānaṃ bahuphalapradam || 14 || bṛhaspatestathā viṣṇoḥ pūjāṃ tatra ya ācaret || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke sa modate || 15 || bhavedbṛhaspateḥ pīḍā yasya gocaravedhataḥ || tenātra vidhivatsnānaṃ kāryaṃ saṃkalpapūrvakam || 16 || homaṃ kṛtvā gurormūrtiḥ suvarṇena vinirmitā || sthitvā jale pradeyā vai pītāṃbarasamanvitā || 17 || vedajñāyātiśucaye snātvā pīḍāpanuttaye || homaṃ ca kārayettatra grahajāpyavidhānataḥ || 18 || evaṃ kṛte na saṃdeho grahapīḍā praṇaśyati || 19 || taddakṣiṇe muniśreṣṭha rukmiṇīkuṇḍamuttamam || cakāra yatsvayaṃ devī rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā || 2.8.7.20 || tatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ cakre nivāsaṃ salile tadā || varapradānātsnehena bhāryāyāḥ praguṇīkṛtam || 21 || tatra snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ homaṃ vaiṣṇavamaṃtrakam || dvijapūjāṃ viṣṇupūjāṃ kurvīta prayato naraḥ || 22 || tatra sāṃvatsarī yātrā karttavyā suprayatnataḥ || ūrjakṛṣṇanavamyāṃ ca sarvapāpāpanuttaye || || 23 || putravāñjāyate vandhyo yātrāṃ kṛtvā na saṃśayaḥ || nārībhirvā narairvāpi karttavyaṃ snānamādarāt || 24 || bhuktvā bhogānsamagrāṃśca viṣṇuloke sa modate || lakṣmīkāmanayā tatra snātavyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 25 || sarvakāmamavāpnoti tatra snānena mānavaḥ || rukmiṇīśrīpatiprītyai dātavyaṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ || 26 || karttavyā vidhivatpūjā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || dhyeyo lakṣmīpatistatra śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 27 || pītāṃbaradharaḥ sragvī nāradādibhirīḍitaḥ || tārkṣyāsano mukuṭavānmahendrādivibhūṣitaḥ || 28 || sarvakāmaphalāvāptyai vakṣolakṣitakaustubhaḥ || atasīkusumaśyāmaḥ kamalāmalalocanaḥ || 29 || evaṃ kṛte na saṃdehaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā hariloke sa modate || 2.8.7.30 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tīrthamanyadaghāpaham || kalikilviṣasaṃhārakārakaṃ pratyayātmakam || 31 || paraṃ pavitramatulaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidam || dhanayakṣaitikhyātaṃ paraṃ pratyayakārakam || 32 || rukmiṇīkuṇḍavāyavyadigdale saṃsmṛtaṃ śubham || hariścandrasya rājarṣerāsīttatra dhanaṃ mahat || 33 || tasya rakṣārthamatyarthaṃ rakṣito yakṣauccakaiḥ || viśvāmitro muniḥ pūrvaṃ yadā caiva parājayat || 34 || hariścaṃdraṃ narapatiṃ rājyasūyakaraṃ param || rājyaṃ jagrāha sakalaṃ caturaṃgabalānvitam || || 35 || tadvaśe'dācca sa munirdhanaṃ sakalamuttamam || tadrakṣāyai prayatnena yakṣaṃ sthāpitavānasau || 36 || pramaṃthura iti khyātaṃ pramodānandamaṃdiram || rakṣāṃ vidadhatastasya bahuyatnena sarvaśaḥ || 37 || tutoṣa sa munirddhīmānkadācidvijitendriyaḥ || uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ prītyā paramayā yutaḥ || 38 || || viśvāmitra uvāca || varaṃ varaya dharmajña kṣiprameva vimatsaraḥ|| bhaktyā paramayā dhīra saṃtuṣṭo'smi viśeṣataḥ||39|| ||yakṣa uvāca |||| varaṃ prayacchasi yadi vipravarya madīpsitam|| mamāṃgamatidurgaṃdhi śāpācca nṛpaterabhūt|| sugandhayituṃ brahmarṣe tatprasīda munīśvara ||2.8.7.40|| || agastya uvāca || || evamukte tu yakṣeṇa munirdhyānasthalocanaḥ|| taṃ vivicyānayā bhaktyā abhiṣekaṃ cakāra saḥ||41|| tīrthodakena vidhivatkṛtvā saṃkalpamādarāt|| tataḥ so'bhūtkṣaṇenaiva sugandhottaravigrahaḥ || 42 || tathābhūtaḥ sa madhuraṃ provāca prāṃjalistataḥ || punaḥ puraḥ sthito dhīmānvinayāvanatastadā ||43|| || yakṣa uvāca || || tvatkṛpābhirahaṃ dhīra jātaḥ surabhivigrahaḥ|| etatsthānaṃ yathā khyātiṃ yāti sarvajña tatkuru || 44 || tvatprasādena viprarṣe tathā yatnaṃ vidhehi vai || 45 || || agastya uvāca || || evamuktaḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā muniḥ stimitalocanaḥ || yakṣaṃ prati prasannātmā hyuvāca ślakṣṇayā girā || 46 || || viśvāmitra uvāca || || prasiddhimatulāṃ yakṣa etatsthānaṃ gamiṣyati || dhanayakṣa iti khyātimetattīrthaṃ gamiṣyati || 47 || sauṃdaryyadaṃ śarīrasya paraṃ pratyayakārakam || yatra snātvā vidhānena daurgaṃdhyaṃ tyajati kṣaṇāt || tatra snānaṃ prayatnena karttavyaṃ puṇyakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 48 || dānaṃ śraddhāsvaśaktibhyāṃ lakṣmīpūjā viśeṣataḥ || tatra snānena dānena lakṣmīprītyai viśeṣataḥ || 49 || pūjayā tu nidhīnāṃ ca navānāmapi suvrata || iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā paraloke sa modate || 2.8.7.50 || mahāpadmastathā padmaḥ śaṃkho makarakacchapau || mukundakuṃdanīlāśca kharvaśca nidhayo nava || 51 || eteṣāmapi kuṇḍe'tra saṃnidhirbhavitā'nagha || eteṣāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa pūjā bahuphalapradā||52|| jalamadhye prakarttavyaṃ nidhilakṣmīprapūjanam||53|| annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ deyaṃ vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca||54|| suvarṇādi yathāśaktyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet || guptaṃ dānaṃ prayatnena karttavyaṃ suprayatnataḥ ||55|| phalāni ca suvarṇāni deyāni ca viśeṣataḥ ||56|| kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snānaṃ bahuphalapradam || śraddhayā parayā yuktaiḥ karttavyaṃ śraddhayādhikam || 57 || māghe kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || tatra snānaṃ pitṝṇāntu tarpaṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 58 || ābrahmastambaparyaṃtaṃ jagattṛpyatviti bruvan || apasavyena vidhivattarppayedaṃjalitrayam || 59 || evaṃ kurvannaro yakṣa na muhyati kadācana || atra snāto divaṃ yāti atra snātaḥ sukhī bhavet ||2.8.7.60|| atra snātena te yakṣa karttavyaṃ pūjanaṃ puraḥ || tvatpūjanena vidhivannṛṇāṃ pāpakṣayo bhavet || 61 || namaḥ pramatharājeti pūjāmantra udāhṛtaḥ || tīrthamadhye prakarttavyaṃ pūjanaṃ śravaṇādikam || 62 || nidhilakṣmyo tathā yakṣa tava pūjā viśeṣataḥ || evaṃ yaḥ kurute dhīraḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||63|| dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti putrārthī putramāpnuyāt || mokṣārthī mokṣamāpnoti tatkiṃ na yadihāpyate || 64 || yastu mohānnaro yakṣa snānaṃ na kurute kila || tasya sāṃvatsaraṃ puṇyaṃ tvaṃ grahīṣyasi sarvaśaḥ || 65 || iti dattvā varāṃstasmai viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ|| antardadhe munivarastadā sa ca taponidhiḥ ||66|| tadāprabhṛti tatsthānaṃ paramāṃ khyātimāyayau || tasya tīrthasya sakalā bhūmiḥ svarṇavinirmitā ||67 || divyaratnaughakhacitā samaṃtādupaśobhitā || evaṃ yaḥ kurute vidvansa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 68 || dhanayakṣāduttarasmindigbhāge saṃsthitaṃ dvija || vasiṣṭhakuṇḍaṃ vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpāpahaṃ sadā || 69 || vasiṣṭhasya sadā tatra nivāsaḥ sutaponidheḥ || arundhatī sadā yasya vartate nirmalavratā || 2.8.7.70 || atra snānaṃ viśeṣeṇa śrāddhapūrvamataṃdritaḥ || yaḥ kuryātprayato dhīmāṃstasya puṇyamanuttamam || 71 || vāmadevasya tatraiva saṃnidhirvartate'nagha || vaśiṣṭhavāmadevau tu pūjanīyau prayatnataḥ || 72 || pativratā pūjanīyā'rundhatī ca viśeṣataḥ || snātavyaṃ vidhinā samyagdātavyaṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ || 73 || sarvakāmaphalaprāptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || atra yaḥ kurute snānaṃ sa vaśiṣṭhasamo bhavet || 74 || bhādre māsi site pakṣe paṃcamyāṃ niyatavrataḥ || tasya sāṃvatsarī yātrā karttavyā vidhipūrvikā || 75 || viṣṇupūjā prayatnena kartavyā śraddhayātra vai || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 76 || vasiṣṭhakuṇḍādvipreṃdra pratyagdigdalamāśritam || vikhyātaṃ sāgaraṃ kuṇḍaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidam || yatra snānena dānena sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt || 77 || paurṇamāsyāṃ samudrasya snānādyatpuṇyamāpnuyāt || tatpuṇyaṃ parvaṇi snāto naraścākṣayamāpnuyāt || 78 || tasmādatra vidhānena snātavyaṃ putrakāṃkṣayā || āśvine paurṇamāsyāṃ tu viśeṣātsnānamācaret || 79 || evaṃ kurvannaro vidvānsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || atra snātvā naro dattvā yathāśaktyā divaṃ vrajet || 2.8.7.80 || sāgarānnairṛte bhāge yoginīkuṇḍamuttamam || yatrā''sate catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginyo jalasaṃsthitāḥ || 81 || sarvārthasiddhidāḥ puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ || parasiddhipradāḥ sarvāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ || 82 || āśvine śuklapakṣasya aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || snātavyaṃ ca prayatnena yoginīprītaye nṛbhiḥ || 83 || atra snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ sarvaṃ saphalatāṃ vrajet || yakṣiṇīprabhṛtayaḥ siddhā bhavaṃtyatra na saṃśayaḥ || || 84 || yoginīkuṃḍataḥ pūrvamurvaśīkuṇḍamuttamam || yatra snāto naro vidvannurvaśīṃ divi saṃśrayet || 85 || purā kila munirdhīro raibhyo nāma tapodhanaḥ || cacāra himavatpārśve nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ || 86 || tattapo vipulaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītaḥ surapatistataḥ || urvaśīṃ preṣayāmāsa tapovighnāya cādarāt || 87 || tataḥ sā preṣitā tenājagāma gajagāminī || uvāsa himavatpārśve raibhyāśramamanuttamam || 88 || vanaphullalatākuñje mañjukūjadvihaṃgame || kinnarīkelisaṃgītastimitāṃgakuraṃgake || 89 || punnāgakeśarāśokacchinnakijalkapiṃjare || kalpite kāṃcanagirau dvitīya iva vedhasā || 2.8.7.90 || sā babhau kāṃtisarvasvakośaḥ kusumadhanvanaḥ || urvaśyanalpasāmānyalāvaṇyāmṛtavāhinī || 91 || aṃgaprabhāsuvarṇena sitamauktikaśobhitā || tāruṇyaruciratvena tāruṇyena vibhūṣitā || 92 || vilomalocanāpāṃgataraṃgadhavalatviṣā || navapallavasacchāyaṃ kalpayantī nijādharam || 93 || karṇopalambisaṃghuṣyadbhṛṅgāḍhyacūtamañjarī || sudhāgarbhasamudbhūtā pārijātalatā yathā || 94 || tanumadhyā pṛthuśroṇirvarṇodbhinnapayodharā || niḥśāṇitaśarasyeva śaktiḥ kusumadhanvanaḥ || 95 || apaśyadāśrame tasminmunirāyatalocanām || nayanānaladāhena vidagdhena manobhuvā || 96 || trinetravaṃcanāyaiva kalpitāṃ lalanātanum || tāmāśramalatāpuṣpakāṃcīracitakuṇḍalām || 97 || vilokya tāṃ viśālākṣīṃ munirvyākulitendriyaḥ || babhūva roṣasaṃtaptaḥ śaśāpa ca bahu jvalan ||98|| || raibhya uvāca || || kurūpatāṃ vraja kṣipraṃ yā tvaṃ sauṃdaryagarvitā || samāgatā tapovighnahetave mama sannidhau || 99 || || agastya uvāca || || iti śaptā ruṣā tena muninā sā śubhekṣaṇā || uvāca vanitā bhūtvā prāṃjalirmunimādarāt |||| 2.8.7.100 || || urvaśyuvāca || || bhagavanme prasīda tvaṃ parādhīnā yatastvaham || tvacchāpasya kathaṃ muktirbhavitā niyatavrata || 101 || || raibhya uvāca || || ayodhyāyāmasti tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ paramaṃ mahat || tatra snānaṃ kuruṣvādya sauṃdaryaṃ paramāpnuhi || 102 || tvannāmnaiva ca vikhyātiṃ toyaṃ yāsyati taddhruvam || 103 || || agastya uvāca || || evaṃ sā vipravacasā vidadhe sarvamādarāt || sundarī sā'bhavatkṣipraṃ tatsthānaṃ khyātimāyayau ||104|| atra snānaṃ muniśreṣṭha yaḥ kuryādvidhivajjanaḥ || sauṃdaryaṃ paramaṃ tasya bhavettatra na saṃśayaḥ ||105|| bhādre śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || viṣṇuratra janaiḥ pūjyaḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 106 || evaṃ kurvannaro vidvānviṣṇuloke vasetsadā || naro vā yadi vā nārī sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || ||107|| ghoṣārkakuṃḍaṃ paramamurvaśīkuṃḍadakṣiṇe || vartate muniśārdūla sarvapāpāpahaṃ sadā ||108|| yatra snānena dānena sūryaloke mahīyate || etattīrthasya sadṛśaṃ nāparaṃ vidyate kvacit || 109 || vraṇī kuṣṭhī daridrī vā duḥkhākrāṃto'pi yo naraḥ || karoti vidhivatsnānaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 2.8.7.110 || ravivāre viśeṣeṇa karttavyaṃ snānamādarāt || bhādre māsi tathā māghe śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prayatnataḥ || 111 || karttavyaṃ vidhivatsnānaṃ sūryalokābhikāṃkṣayā || pauṣe māsi tathā snānaṃ sūryavāre viśeṣataḥ || 112 || saptamyāṃ raviyuktāyāṃ snānaṃ bahuphalapradam || ghoṣābhidho'bhavatpūrvaṃ sūryavaṃśe nareśvaraḥ || 113 || samudramekhalāmekaḥ pṛthivīṃ samapālayat || yasya kīrtyā prakāśaṃte trilokīmaṃḍalāni vai || 114 || yaḥ pratāpātsphunbhāti prabhākara ivāparaḥ || pracaṃḍataradordaṃḍakhaṃḍitārātimaṃḍalaḥ || 115 || sa kadācitprajāpālo maṃttrivinyastabhūtalaḥ || babhrāma mṛgayāsakto vane'tigahanadrume || 116 || sa rājā pūrvajanmotthapāpairaśubhasūcakaiḥ || kṛmivyāptakarāṃbhojaḥ sundaropi gatasmayaḥ || 117 || mṛgayāyāmabhūdekaḥ kadācitparyaṭanvane || varāhasiṃhahariṇānnighnangacchannitastataḥ || 118 || tṛṣākrānto mlānatanuḥ saro'paśyatpuro nṛpaḥ || dadarśa tatra ca munīnsnānasaṃdhyāditatparān || 119 || tato vidhivadācamya snānaṃ cakre nareśvaraḥ || tato divyaśarīro'bhūdānaṃdāmalamānasaḥ || 2.8.7.120 || munibhistīrthamājñāya cakre sūryyastutiṃ priyām || 121 || || || rājovāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa namastubhyaṃ cidātmane || namaḥ savitre sūryāya jagadānaṃdadāyine || 122 || prabhāgehāya devāya trayībhūtāya te namaḥ || vivasvate namastubhyaṃ yogajñāya sadātmane ||123|| parāya parameśāya trilokītimiracchide || acintyāya sadā tubhyaṃ namo bhāskaratejase || || 124 || yogapriyāya yogāya yogajñāya sadā namaḥ || oṃkārāya vaṣaṭkārarūpiṇe jñānarūpiṇe || 125 || yajñāya yajñamānāya haviṣe ṛtvije namaḥ || rogaghnāya svarūpāya kamalānaṃdadāyine || 126 || atisaumyātitīkṣṇāya surāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ || satrāśāya namastubhyaṃ bhaktatrāya priyātmane || 127 || prakāśakāya satataṃ lokānāṃ hitakāriṇe || prasīda praṇatāyādya mahyaṃ bhaktikṛte svayam || 128 || || agastya uvāca || || ityevaṃ bruvatastasya sa prasanno raviḥ svayam || āvirbabhūva sahasā bhaktasya priyakāmyayā || uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ praśrayānatamūrddhajam || 129 || || || raviruvāca || || varaṃ varaya rājeṃdra prasanno'smi tavāgrataḥ || dadāmi tadvaraṃ te'dya yattvayā manasepsitam || 2.8.7.130 || || rājovāca || || bhagavanbhāskarānaṃta prayacchasi varaṃ yadi || mannāmnā kṛtamūrttiste tiṣṭhatvatra sadā vibho || 131 || || raviruvāca || || evamastu manuṣyeṃdra tava vāṃchā manoharā || etatstotraṃ tvayoktaṃ me ye paṭhiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || 132 || tebhyastuṣṭaḥ pradāsyāmi sarvānkāmānnareśvara || etatsthānaṃ parāṃ khyātiṃ tvannāmnā yāsyati kṣitau || 133 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti yo'tra snānaṃ samācaret|| madbhaktena sadā rājankarttavyaṃ snānamatra vai || 134 || yaṃyaṃ kāmamiheccheta taṃtaṃ kāmamavāpnuyāt || 135 || || agastya uvāca || || iti dattvā varaṃ devaḥ kṛpayā parayā yutaḥ || bhāsvānsahasrakiraṇastadāntarddhānamāyayau || 136 || rājā bhāskaradehotthāṃ ravimūrttimanuttamām || tatra saṃsthāpayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa ca svayam || 137 || ghoṣārkakuṇḍaṃ tannāmnā tatra khyātiṃ jagāma ha || yatra snānānnaro rājansūryyaloke vasetsadā || 138 || iti ruciravidhānaistūrṇamādityamūrttiṃ vimalaparamabhaktyā pūjayitvā''dareṇa || tadamṛtamayakuṇḍe snānamādau vidhāya pracuravimalakīrtiḥ sūryaloke vasetsaḥ || 139 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye bṛhaspatikuṇḍarukmiṇīkuṇḍadhanayakṣatīrtha vasiṣṭhakuṇḍasāgarakuṇḍa yoginīkuṇḍorvaśīkuṇḍaghoṣārkakuṃḍa māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || || cha ||
<2.8.8>
|| agastya uvāca || || ghoṣārkatīrthādviprarṣe paścime diktaṭe sthitam || ratikuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ sadā || 1 || yatra snānena dānena parāṃ kāṃtimavāpnuyāt || tatpaścimadiśābhāge kusumāyudhanāmakam || 2 || kuṃḍaṃ prasiddhamatulaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || yatra snānena dānena kandarpasadṛśākṛtim || labhate nā vidhānena mune nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 3 || ratikuṃḍe tathā vipra kusumāyudhakuṇḍake || śraddhayā kurute snānaṃ sa saukhyaparamo bhavet || 4 || kuṇḍadvaye'tra mithunaṃ yatsnānaṃ kurute kila || ratikāmāviva khyātau sadā tau suṃdarau tadā || 5 || tasmādatra vidhānena snātavyaṃ dharmakāṃkṣibhiḥ || dānaṃ deyaṃ yathāśaktyā ratikaṃdarpatuṣṭaye || 6 || bhavetāṃ niyataṃ tasya saṃtuṣṭau ratimanmathau || māghe viśadapaṃcamyāṃ yatra snānaṃ śubhapradam || 7 || ratikuṃḍe puraḥ snātvā paścātkaṃdarppakuṃḍake || snātavyaṃ taddine vipra mithunena prayatnataḥ || 8 || ratikaṃdarppayoḥ pūjā vidhātavyā viśeṣataḥ || vastrādibhiralaṃkāraiḥ saṃpūjyau dvijadaṃpatī || 9 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 2.8.8.10 || caṃdanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumādibhiḥ || vāsobhirvividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayeddvijadampatī || 11 || evaṃ kṛte na saṃdeho ratikaṃdarpatuṣṭaye || tadvrajenmiśrunaṃ vipra ratikaṃdarppatulyatām || 12 || kusumāyudhakuṃḍāttu pratīcyāṃ diśi saṃsthitam || mantreśvara iti khyātaṃ tatsthānaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 13 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā mantreśvaraṃ vibhum || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 14 || purā rāmo devakāryaṃ vidhāyāmalakarmakṛt || kālena saha saṃgamya mantraṃ cakre nareśvaraḥ || 15 || svargaṃ prati prayāṇāya yatra snātau jiteṃdriyaḥ || tatraiva sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ mantreśvara iti śrutam || 16 || taduttare saro ramyaṃ kumudotpalamaṃḍitam || tatra snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ nānāphaladamuttamam || 17|| caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī smṛtā || tatra snānena dānena brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanāt || akṣayaṃ svargamāpnoti tatra kāryā vicāraṇā || 16 || maṃtreśvarasya mahimā nahi kenāpi śakyate || samyagvarṇayituṃ vipra ya uttamaphalapradaḥ || maṃtreśvarasamaṃ liṃgaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 19 || sugaṃdhipuṣpadhūpādikusumādyanulepanaiḥ || pūjanīyaḥ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhidaḥ || 2.8.8.20 || evaṃ kṛte na saṃdeho muktistasya kare sthitā || tatraivottarabhāge tu śītalā vartate'nagha || 21 || tāṃ saṃpūjya naro vidvānsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || sarvadā pūjanaṃ tasyāḥ somavāre viśeṣataḥ || karttavyaṃ suprayatnena nṛbhiḥ sarvārthasiddhaye || 22 || visphoṭakādikabhaye naraiśca samupasthite || kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ samyagrogādibhayanāśanam || 23 || taduttare tu tatraiva devī vandīti viśrutā || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa nigaḍādibhayaṃ nahi ||24|| rājñā kruddhena ye baddhāḥ śṛṃkhalānigaḍādibhiḥ || bandī saṃsmṛtya devīṃ tu muktāḥ syustatkṣaṇāddhi te ||25|| yātrā tasyāḥ prayatnena kartavyā yatnato naraiḥ || maṃgale hi viśeṣeṇa sarvakāmārthasiddhidā ||26|| gaṃdhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairapi ca suvrata || naivedyairvividhairvāpi pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ || 27 || bandīprītyai muniśreṣṭha deyaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanam || evaṃ kṛte na saṃdehaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 28 || taduttarasmiṃstatraiva cuḍakī bhuvi kīrtitā || vartate paramā siddhirūpiṇī smaraṇānnṛṇām || 29 || susaṃdigdheṣu kāryeṣu bhaye ca samupasthite || yasyāḥ smaraṇato nṝṇāṃ sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 2.8.8.30 || agre tasyāḥ sadā kāryā nṛbhiraṃguṣṭhato dhvaniḥ || dīpadānaṃ prayatnena karttavyaṃ niyatātmabhiḥ || 31 || sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ dīpadānaṃ praśasyate || caturdaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tasyā yātrā vinirmitā || 32 || tataḥ pūrvadiśābhāge varttate tīrthamuttamam || mahāratna iti khyātaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam || 33 || yatra snānena dānena pūjayā ca dvijanmanām || sarvakarmārthasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 34 || bhādre kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī smṛtā || yātrā''ste kila mukhyā'sya mahāratnā iti śrutā || 35 || mahāratna iti khyātaṃ tasmāttīrthamanuttamam || tatra dānaṃ prakarttavyaṃ dvijasaṃtoṣakārakam || 36 || nārībhirapi viprarṣe karttavyo jāgarotsavaḥ || vīryasaubhāgyasaṃpannasarvasaukhyāya sarvadā || tatra snānaṃ prayatnena karttavyaṃ śraddhayā naraiḥ || 37 || tato naiṛtyadigbhāge durbharākhyaṃ sarā śubham || vartate sukṛtodāraṃ mahābharasarastathā || 38 || tatra snānādavāpnoti sadā svargapadaṃ naraḥ || dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ deyaṃ vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || || 39 || śivapūjā prakarttavyā snātvā kuṇḍadvaye naraiḥ || nānāvidhena bhāvena bhaktyā paramayā yutaiḥ || 2.8.8.40 || gandhādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ puṣpairarccanīyo maheśvaraḥ || nīlakaṃṭhoṃ'dhakārātirārādhyo yogināmapi || 41 || iti dhyātvā śivaṃ sārddhaṃ niṣpāpaṃ prayato naraḥ || sarvakāmānavāpyāśu śivaloke vasetsadā || 42 || evaṃ kṛtvā naro vipra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || mahābhare vare tīrthe tathā durbharasaṃjñake || 43 || bhādrakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ kuryyācchraddhayā'nvitaḥ || śivapūjāṃ ca vidhivaddvijapūjāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 44 || yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā śivaloke sa saṃvaset || evaṃ kurvannaro vidvānna muhyati kadācana || 45 || viṣṇurudrau ca tasyātisuprasannau sanātanau || tayoḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 46 || ataḥ kiṃ bahunoktena vipratīrthamanuttamam || sarvapāpaughaśamanaṃ sarvābhīṣṭakaraṃ sadā || 47 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tīrthamanyacchubhāvaham || yatra yātrā tathā dānaṃ vinā bhāgyaṃ na saṃbhavet || 48 || īśāne durbharasthānānmahāvidyābhidhaṃ mahat || tasya darśanato nṝṇāṃ siddhayaḥ syuḥ kare sthitāḥ || 49 || tadagre sarasi snātvā mahāvidyāṃ tu yo naraḥ || paśyati śraddhayā bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 2.8.8.50 || siddhapīṭhaṃ tathā khyātaṃ samyakpratyayakārakam || tatra pūjā vidhātavyā bhaktyā paramayā dvija || 51 || maṃtraṃ yaḥ śraddhayā vipra śaivaṃ śāktamathāpi vā || gāṇapatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vā tatra yaḥ prayato naraḥ || 52 || ekāgramānaso vidvannārādhyāvartayetsadā || tasya siddhirbhavennityaṃ camatkāro bhaveddvija || 53 || tasmādatra prakartavyaṃ japādikamataṃdritaiḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca yātrā syātpratimāsikī || 54 || deyānyannāni bahuśo nānāvidhaphalāni ca || kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kāryaṃ pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ || 55 || uccāṭanādīnyapi ca mohanādi viśeṣataḥ || atra sthāne viśeṣeṇa duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati || 56 || siddhasthāne paraṃ mokṣaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || japo homastathā dānaṃ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet || 57 || āśvine śuklapakṣasya navarātriṣu suvrata || yatra gatvā naro vipra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 58 || yadā pūrvaṃ vinirjitya rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam || samāgato raghupatiḥ sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 59 || yatra gatvā padā vīro bharato rāmakāṃkṣayā || sthitaḥ sānucaraḥ śrīmāñchriyā paramayā yutaḥ || 2.8.8.60 || tatrāgamatsuragavī prādurbhūtā sravatstanī || tatstanebhyaḥ prasusrāva dugdhaṃ bahuguṇādhikam || 61 || tadbhūmipatitaṃ dugdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vānararākṣasāḥ || vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ prapapuste carācaram || 62 || kimetaditi rājeṃdra tānuvāca raghūdvahaḥ || vasiṣṭho vetti tatsarvaṃ pṛcchāmastaṃ muniṃ vayam || 63 || ityuktāstu tataḥ sarve vasiṣṭhapramukhe sthitāḥ || te papracchuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ kṛtvā cāgresaraṃ nṛpam || 64 || vasiṣṭho'pi kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā tamuvāca nirākulam || rāghavaṃ prati saṃbodhya sarveṣāmagrato muniḥ || 65 || || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || śṛṇu rāma mahābāho kāmadhenuriyaṃ śubhā || samāgatā tava snehātprasravaṃtī stanātpayaḥ || 66 || dugdhamadhye samudbhūto rudrastvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ || niṣpannakāryyaṃ devānāṃ nirjitārātimuttamam || 67 || imaṃ saṃpūjaya kṣiprametatkuṇḍasya sannidhau || śīghraṃ tvamapi yatnena pūjayemaṃ śivaṃ śubham || dugdheśvaramiti khyātaṃ kṣīrakuṇḍe pavitrakam || 68 || || agastya uvāca || || tato raghupatiḥ śrīmānvasiṣṭhoktavidhānataḥ || pūjayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ dugdheśvaramiti smṛtam ||69|| sītayā satkṛtaṃ yasmāttatkuṇḍaṃ kṣīrasaṃgamam || sītākuṃḍamiti khyātiṃ jagāmānupamāṃ tataḥ||2.8.8.70 || sītākuṇḍe narāḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā dugdheśvaraṃ prabhum || sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyaṃte nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||71|| atra snānaṃ japo homo dānaṃ cākṣayatāṃ vrajet || sītākuṃḍe tu saṃpūjya sītārāmau salakṣmaṇau ||72|| dugdheśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || jyeṣṭhe māsi caturdaśyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī smṛtā||73|| evaṃ yo vidhivatkuryāddayādharmaviśāradaḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati || 74 || tatra pūrvadiśābhāge sugrīvaracitaṃ mahat || tīrthaṃ taponidhestatra vartate sannidhau śubham || 75 || yatra snātvā ca dattvā ca rāmaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || tasminneva dine tatra sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 76 || tatpratyagdiśi vai sthānaṃ hanumatkuṇḍamityapi || tasya paścimato vipra vibhīṣaṇasaraḥ dūrara || 77 || tayoḥ snānena dānena rāmasaṃpūjanena ca || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti tasminneva vidhānataḥ || iyaṃ sā paramā medhyā'yodhyā dharmanidhiḥ smṛtā || 78 || ityuktāstu tataḥ sarve vasiṣṭhamunimādarāt || papracchurvinayātkṣipraṃ vibhīṣaṇapuraḥsarāḥ || kathayasva taporāśe kathāmetāṃ sudurlabhām || 79 || ayodhyāyāḥ paraṃ vipra māhātmyaṃ kathayaṃti yat || tatsarvaṃ kathaya kṣipraṃ śrutvā māhātmyamuttamam || 2.8.8.80 || yathā yātrāṃ vidhāsyāmaḥ krameṇa ca vidhānataḥ || tadasmāsu kṛpāṃ kṛtvā kathayasva taponidhe || 81 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve ayodhyāmahimādbhutam || yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśaya || || 82 || idaṃ guhyataraṃ kṣetramayodhyābhidhamuttamam || sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ heturmokṣasyaḥ sarvadā || 83 || asminsiddhāḥ sadā devā vaiṣṇavaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ || nānāliṃgadharā nityaṃ viṣṇulokābhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 84 || abhyasyaṃti paraṃ yogaṃ yuktaprāṇā jitendriyāḥ || nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇe nānāvihagavāsini || 85 || kamalotpalaśobhāḍhye sarobhiḥ samalaṃkṛte || apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe sarvadā sevite śubhe || 86 || rocate hi sadā vāsaḥ kṣetre nityaṃ hareriha || manyamānā viṣṇubhaktā viṣṇau sarve'rpitakriyāḥ||87|| yathā mokṣamihāyāṃti nānyatra hi tathā kvacit || ataḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ kṣetraṃ yasmācca vasatirhareḥ || mahākṣetramidaṃ yasmādayodhyābhidhamuttamam || 88 || naimiṣe ca kurukṣetre gaṃgādvāre ca puṣkare || snānātsaṃsevanādvāpi na mokṣaḥ prāpyate tathā || 89 || iha saṃprāpyate yadvattata eva viśiṣyate || prayāge vā bhavenmokṣa iha vā harisaṃśrayāt || sarvasmādapi tīrthāgryādidameva mahatkṛtam || 2.8.8.90 || avyaktaliṃgairmunibhiḥ sarvaiḥ siddhairmaharṣibhiḥ || iha saṃprāpyate mokṣo durllabho'nyatra yo mataḥ || || 91 || tebhyaḥ prayacchati hariryogamaiśvaryyamuttamam || ātmanaścaiva sāyujyamīpsitaṃ sthānamuttamam || 92 || brahmā devarṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ śrīśca vāyurdivākaraḥ || devarājastathā śakro ye cānye'pi divaukasaḥ || 93 || upāsate mahātmānaḥ sarvatra harimādarāt || anyepi yoginaḥ siddhāḥ kṣetrarūpā mahāvratāḥ || ananyamanaso bhūtvā sarvadopāsate harim || 94 || viṣayāsaktacitto'pi tyaktadharmaratirnaraḥ || iha kṣetre mṛtaḥ sopi saṃsārī na punarbhavet || 95 || ye punarnigamādhīnāḥ satrasthā vijiteṃdriyāḥ || vratinaśca nirāraṃbhāḥ sarve te haribhāvitāḥ || 96 || dehabhaṃgaṃ samāpadya dhīmaṃtaḥ saṃgavarjitāḥ || gatāste ca paraṃ mokṣaṃ prasādātsarvadā hareḥ || 97 || janmāntarasahasreṣu yuñjanyogī na cāpnuyāt || tamihaiva paraṃ mokṣaṃ maraṇādapi gacchati || 98 || etatsaṃkṣepato vacmi kṣetrasya mahimādbhutam || etadeva paraṃ sthānametadeva paraṃ padam || etādṛṅnāparaṃ sthānaṃ punaranyatra dṛśyate || 99 || atra gatvā prayatnena yātrā puṇyābhikāṃkṣibhiḥ || kartavyā vidhivaddhīrāḥ krameṇa śraddhayānvitaiḥ || || 2.8.8.100 || prathame'hani karttavya upavāso yatātmabhiḥ || niyamena tataḥ snānaṃ dānaṃ caiva svaśaktitaḥ || 101 || upāvṛttastu pāpebhyo yasya vāso guṇaiḥ saha || upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ || 102 || upavāsaṃ vidhāyāsau cakratīrthe naraḥ kṛtī || upavāsadine snāyāddadyāccaiva svaśaktitaḥ || 103 || vipraṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatpaśyedviṣṇuhariṃ vibhum || svargadvāre naraḥ snātvā viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || 104 || kṣauraṃ ca kārayettatra vratī dharmābhidhe tataḥ || pāpamocanake snānamṛṇamocanake tataḥ || 105 || snātvā sahasradhārāyāṃ śeṣaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || dṛṣṭvā caṃdrahariṃ devaṃ tato dharmahariṃ vibhum|| 106 || tataścakrahariṃ dṛṣṭvā dadyāccaiva svaśaktitaḥ || brahmakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || mahāvidyāsamīpe tu rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 107 || tataḥ prabhāte vimale punarutthāya sadvratī || svargadvāre prayatnena vidhivatsnānamācaret || 108 || śrāddhaṃ ca vidhivatkṛtvā dattvā caiva svaśaktitaḥ|| viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadviprānapi punaḥpunaḥ ||109|| daṃpatī ca prayatnena pūjyau vastrādibhistathā || śraddhayā parayā yuktairdātavyā bhūridakṣiṇā || 2.8.8.110 || viprānsaṃpūjya vidhivadbhuṃjīta prayato naraḥ || 111 || anyedyurapi cotthāya śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || rukmiṇīprabhṛtīnyatra paśyettīrthāni ca kramāt || 112 || tatratatra naraḥ snātvā dattvā caiva svaśaktitaḥ || viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya yatnena manovākkāyanirmalaḥ || 113 || yātrāṃ samāpayetsamyaṅniyatātmā śucivrataḥ || yatra kvāpi mṛto dhīraḥ paraṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 114 || || agastya uvāca || || vasiṣṭhoktamiti śrutvā kṛtvā caiva yathāvidhi || vibhīṣaṇapurogāste babhūvurnirmalāstadā || 115 || iti bahulavidhānaistīrthayātrāṃ vidhāya pracurasukṛtapūrṇāste ca sugrīvamukhyāḥ || gatamalinasudehāḥ svargacaryāprayatnādupaguṇitaguṇaughāste babhūvuḥ samastāḥ || 116 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṃḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye mahāratnatīrthadurbharamahābharatīrthamahāvidyātīrtha siddhapīṭhakṣīreśvarasītākuṇḍa sugrīvatīrthahanumatkuṇḍa vibhīṣaṇasarastīrthāyodhyāyātrāvidhikramavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || || cha ||
<2.8.9>
|| agastya uvāca || || jaṭākuṇḍata āgneyadigdala saṃśritaṃ mahat || gayākūpamiti khyātaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam || 1 || yatra snātvā ca dattvā ca yathāśaktyā jiteṃdriyaḥ || sarvakāmamavāpnoti śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā dvijottamaḥ || 2 || narakasthāśca ye kecitpitaraśca pitāmahāḥ || viṣṇuloke tu gacchanti tasmiñcchrāddhe kṛte tu vai || 3 || tasmiñchrāddhe kṛte vipra pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet || śaktibhiḥ piṃḍadānaṃ tu sayavaiḥ pāyasena ca || 4 || karttavyamṛṣinirdiṣṭaṃ piṇyākena guḍena vā || śrāddhaṃ tattīrthake proktaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭikārakam || 5 || tatra śrāddhaṃ prakarttavyaṃ naraiḥ śraddhāsamanvitaiḥ || tuṣyaṃti pitarasteṣāṃ tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 6 || tuṣṭeṣu pitṛṣu śrīmāñjāyateputravām̐stathā || śrāddhena pitarastuṣṭāḥ prayacchaṃti sutānbahūn || 7 || śriyaṃ ca vipulānbhogāñchrāddhakṛdbhayo na saṃśayaḥ || tasmādatra vidhānena vidhātavyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 8 || śrāddhaṃ śraddhāyutaiḥ samyagabhīṣṭaphalakāṃkṣibhiḥ || gayākūpe viśeṣeṇa pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam || 9 || somavāreṇa saṃyuktā amāvāsyā yadā bhavet || tatrānaṃtaphalaṃ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam || 2.8.9.10 || anyadā somavāreṇa tatra śrāddhaṃ vidhānataḥ || pitṛsaṃtoṣadaṃ nityaṃ tatra dattākṣayo bhavet || 11 || tatra pūrvadiśābhāge tīrthaṃ sarvottamottamam || piśācamocanaṃnāma vidyate ca phalapradam || 12 || tatra snātvā ca dattvā ca piśāco naiva jāyate || tatra snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ || karttavyaṃ ca prayatnena naraiḥ śraddhāsamanvitaiḥ || 13 || mārgaśīrṣe śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || snānaṃ tatra prakarttavyaṃ piśācatvavimuktaye || 14 || tatsaṃnidhau pūrvabhāge mānasaṃnāma nāmataḥ || tīrthaṃ puṇyanivāsāgryaṃ snātavyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || tatra snānena dānena sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 15 || nānāvidhāni pāpāni merutulyāni vai punaḥ || tatra snānātkṣayaṃ yāṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 16 || yatkiñcidvidyate pāpaṃ mānasaṃ kāyikaṃ tathā || vācikaṃ ca tathā pāpaṃ snānato vilayaṃ vrajet || 17 || prauṣṭhapadyāṃ sadā kāryyā paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || yātrā tasya nṛbhirvipra puṇyavadbhiḥ kriyāparaiḥ || 18 || tasmāddakṣiṇadigbhāge varttate sukṛtaikabhūḥ || tamasānāma taṭinī mahāpātakanāśinī || 19 || yatra snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ sadā || yasyāstaṭe tathā ramye sarvadā phaladāyake || 2.8.9.20 || nānāvidhāni sthānāni munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || māṇḍavyasya muneḥ sthānaṃ varttate pāpanāśanam || 21 || yasyāstīre muniśreṣṭha sarvatra sumanoharam || tasyāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ nānāvṛkṣamanoharam || 22 || yasmātsthānātsamudbhūtā tamasā sutaraṃgiṇī || tadvanaṃ puṇyamadhikaṃ pāvanaṃ padamuttamam || 23 || yasya darśanato nṝṇāṃ sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 24 || praphullanānāvidhagulmaśobhitaṃ latāpratānāvanataṃ manoharam || virūḍhapuṣpaiḥ paritaḥ priyaṃgubhiḥ suṣuṣpitaiḥ kaṇṭakitaiśca ketakaiḥ || 25 || tamālagulmairnicitaṃ sugaṃdhibhiḥ sakarṇikārairbakulaiśca sarvataḥ || aśokapunnāgavaraiḥ supuṣpitairdvirephamālākula puṣpasaṃcayaiḥ || 26 || kvacitpraphullāṃbujareṇubhūṣitairvihaṃgamaiścāruphalapracāribhiḥ || vināditaṃ sārasamutkulādibhiḥ pramattadātyūhakulaiśca valgubhiḥ || || 27 || kvacicca cakrāhvaravopanāditaṃ kvacicca kādambakadambakairyutam || kvacicca kāraṇḍavanādanāditaṃ kvacicca mattālikulākulīkṛtam || 28 || madākulābhirbhramarībhirārānniṣevitaṃ cārusugaṃdhipuṣpavat || kvacicca puṣpaiḥ sahakāravṛkṣairlatopagūḍhaistilakadrumaiśca || 29 || prahṛṣṭanānāvidhapakṣisevitaṃ pramattahārītakulopanāditam || samaṃtataḥ sundaradarśanīyatāṃ samudvahattadvanamullasanmahat || 2.8.9.30 || nibiḍaniculanīlaṃ nīlakaṇṭhābhirāmaṃ madamuditavihaṃgīvṛndanādābhirāmam|| kusumitataruśākhālīnamattadvirephaṃnavakisalayaśobhāśobhitaṃ satphalāḍhyam || 31 || ityādibahuśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvadikṣu manoharam || yatra māṃḍavyamuninā tapastaptaṃ mahatkila || yatprabhāvādabhūttīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ tatsadā mahat || 32 || tatpūrvaṃ gautamasyarṣerāśramaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat || tatpūrvaṃ cyavanasyarṣeḥ parāśaramuneridam || prathamaṃ te muniśreṣṭha pituḥ kila taponidheḥ || 33 || nānāvidhāni tīrthāni cāśramāścaiva sarvaśaḥ || vartaṃte tāpasānāṃ ca yasyāstīre samaṃtataḥ || 34 || tamasānāma sā jñeyā vartate taṭinī śubhā || yajñayūpānsamutkhāya śobhitā bahuśo'bhitaḥ || 35 || tatra snānena dānena śrāddhena ca viśeṣataḥ || sarvakāmārthasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 36 || mārgaśīrṣe śuklapakṣe pañcadaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || snānaṃ tasya phalaprāptidāyakaṃ sarvadā nṛṇām|| 37 || tasmādatra prakartavyaṃ snānaṃ nirmalamānasaiḥ || prayatnato muniśreṣṭha sarvakāmārthasiddhidam || 38 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tamasāparamaṃ śubham|| sītākuṃḍamitikhyātaṃ śrīdugdheśvarasannidhau || 39 || bhādre śuklacaturthyāṃ tu tasya yātrā śubhāvahā || sarvakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ pūjyo vipreśvarastathā || tasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvavighnavināśanam || 2.8.9.40 || tasmāddakṣiṇadigbhāge bhairavo nāma nāmataḥ || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 41 || rakṣito vāsudevena kṣetrarakṣārthamādarāt || tasya pūjā vidhātavyā prayatnena yathāvidhi || manobhīṣṭaphalaprāptirbhairavasya sadā''darāt || 42
