|| mārgaśīrṣasya kṛṣṇāyāmaṣṭamyāṃ tasya nirmitā || yātrā sāṃvatsarī tatra sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 43 || paśūpahārasaṃbhūti kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ janaiḥ || sarvakāmaphalaprāptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 44 || nirvighnaṃ tīrthavasatirbhairavasya prasādataḥ || jāyate tena kartavyā pūjā tasya prayatnataḥ || 45 || etasminnuttare bhāge ramyaṃ bharatakuṇḍakam || yatra snātvā naraḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 46 || tatra snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet || annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ deyaṃ vāsāṃsi vividhānyapi || 47 || yatnato devatāḥ pūjyā vastrādibhiralaṃkṛtaiḥ || naṃdigrāme vasanpūrvaṃ bharato raghuvaṃśajaḥ || 48 || rāmacandraṃ hṛdi dhyāyannirmalātmā jitendriyaḥ || tataḥ sthitvā prajāḥ sarvā rarakṣa kṣitivallabhaḥ || 49 || tatra cakre mahatkuṇḍaṃ bharato nāma bhūpatiḥ || rāmamūrtiṃ ca saṃsthāpya cacāra vijitendriyaḥ || 2.8.9.50 || tatkuṃḍe sumahatpuṇyaṃ nānāpuṇyasamanvitam || kumudotpalakahlārapuṇḍarīkasamanvitam || 51 || haṃsasārasacakrāhva vihaṃgamavirājitam || udyānapādapacchāyāsacchāyamamalaṃ sadā || 52 || tatra snānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ pramodānandanirmalam || tatra snānaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya kurvataḥ || pitarastasya tuṣyaṃti tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 53 || svarṇaṃ cānnaṃ vidhānena dātavyaṃ ca dvijanmane || śraddhāpūrvakametattu kartavyaṃ prayatairnaraiḥ || 54 || tatpaścimadiśābhāge jaṭākuṇḍamanuttamam || yatra rāmādibhiḥ sarvairjaṭāḥ parihṛtā nijāḥ || 55 || jaṭākuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam|| yatra snānena dānena sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 56|| pūrvakuṇḍeṣu saṃpūjyo bharataḥ śrīsamanvitaḥ || jaṭākuṇḍeṣu saṃpūjyau sasītau rāmalakṣmaṇau || caitrakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || 57 || iti paramavidhānaiḥ pūjayedrāmasīte tadanu bharatakuṇḍe lakṣmaṇaṃ ca prapūjya || vidhivadamṛtakuṇḍe dvaṃdvaṃsamajjanena vasati sukṛtimūrtirvaiṣṇave tatra loke || 58 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye gayākūpa piśācamocana mānasatīrtha tamasānadī māṇḍavyādyāśrama sītākuṇḍa dugdheśvara bhairavabhāratakuṇḍa jaṭākuṇḍa māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || || cha || || ||
<2.8.10>
|| agastya uvāca || || nirāhāro naro bhūtvā kṣīrāhāro'pi vā punaḥ || ajitaṃ pūjayedvipra tasya siddhiḥ kare sthitā || 1 || mahotsavastu kartavyo gītavāditrasaṃyutaḥ || evaṃ yaḥ kurute dhīmānsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 2 || etasmāduttare vidvanvīrasya śubhasūcakam || sthānaṃ mattagajendrasya vartate niyatavrata || 3 || tadagre sarasi snātvā vasettatra suniścitam || pūrṇā siddhimavāpnoti yāmavāpya na śocati || 4 || ayodhyārakṣako vīraḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhidaḥ || navarātriṣu paṃcamyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || 5 || gaṃdhapuṣpādidhūpādi naivedyādividhānataḥ || pūjanīyaḥ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhidaḥ || yaṃyaṃ kāmamiheccheta taṃtaṃ kāmamavāpnuyāt || 6 || etasmāddkṣiṇebhāge surasānāma rākṣasī || viṣṇubhaktā sadā vipra vartate siddhidāyikā || 7 || tāṃ saṃpūjya naro bhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 8 || laṃkāsthānādihānītā rāmeṇotkṛṣṭakarmaṇā || ayodhyāyāṃ sthāpitā sā rakṣārthaṃ niyatavrataiḥ || 9 || saṃpūjya vidhivattasyā darśanaṃ kāryamādarāt || sarvakāmārthasiddhyarthamutsavo'pi śubhapradaḥ || karttavyaḥ suprayatnena gītavāditrasaṃyutaiḥ || 2.8.10.10 || navarātre tṛtīyāyāṃ yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || sarvadā sukhasaṃtānasiddhaye paramārthadā || nānāsaṃgītavāditranṛtyotsavamanoharā || 11 || evaṃ kṛte na saṃdehaḥ sarvadā rakṣito bhavet || 12 || etatpaścimadigbhāge vartate paramo mune || piṃḍāraka iti khyāto vīraḥ paramapauruṣaḥ || pūjanīyaḥ prayatnena gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 13 || yasya pūjāvaśānnṝṇāṃ siddhayaḥ karasaṃśritāḥ || tasya pūjāvidhānena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ naraiḥ || 14 || sarayūsalile snātvā piṃḍārakaṃ ca pūjayet || pāpināṃ mohakarttāraṃ matidaṃ kṛtināṃ sadā || 15 || tasya yātrā vidhātavyā sapuṣyā navarātriṣu || tatpaścimadiśābhāge vighneśaṃ kila pūjayet || 16 || yasya darśanato nṝṇāṃ vighnaleśo na vidyate || tasmādvighneśvaraḥ pūjyaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 17 || tasmātsthānata aiśāne rāmajanma pravarttate || janmasthānamidaṃ proktaṃ mokṣādiphalasādhanam || 18 || vighneśvarātpūrvabhāge vāsiṣṭhāduttare tathā || laumaśātpaścime bhāge janmasthānaṃ tataḥ smṛtam || 19 || yaddṛṣṭvā ca manuṣyasya garbhavāsajayo bhavet || vinā dānena tapasā vinā tīrthairvinā makhaiḥ || 2.8.10.20 || navamīdivase prāpte vratadhārī hi mānavaḥ || snānadānaprabhāveṇa mucyate janmabandhanāt || 21 || kapilāgosahasrāṇi yo dadāti dinedine || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti janmabhūmeḥ pradarśanāt || 22 || āśrame vasatāṃ puṃsāṃ tāpasānāṃ ca yatphalam || rājasūyasahasrāṇi prativarṣāgnihotrataḥ || 23 || niyamasthaṃ naraṃ dṛṣṭvā janmasthāne viśeṣataḥ || mātāpitrorgurūṇāṃ ca bhaktimudvahatāṃ satām || 24 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti janmabhūmeḥ pradarśanāt || 25 || || atha sarayūvarṇanam || || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirgayāśrāddhādhikaṃ phalam || 26 || manvaṃtarasahasraistu kāśīvāseṣu yatphalam .|| tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sarayūdarśane kṛte || 27 || gayāśrāddhaṃ ca ye kṛtvā puruṣottama darśanam || kurvaṃti tatphalaṃ proktaṃ kalau dāśarathīṃ purīm || 28 || mathurāyāṃ kalpamekaṃ vasate mānavo yadi || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sarayūdarśane kṛte |||| 29 || puṣkareṣu prayāgeṣu māghe vā kārttike tathā || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sarayūdarśane kṛte || 2.8.10.30 || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi hyavantīvāsato hi yat || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sarayūdarśane kṛte || 31 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi bhāgīrathyavagāhajam || tatphalaṃ nimiṣārddhena kalau dāśarathīṃ purīm || || 32 || nimiṣaṃ nimiṣārddhaṃ vā prāṇināṃ rāmacintanam || saṃsārakāraṇājñānanāśakaṃ jāyate dhuvam || 33 || yatra kutra sthito yastu hyayodhyāṃ manasā smaret|| na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpāṃtaraśatairapi || 34 || jalarūpeṇa brahmaiva sarayūrmokṣadā sadā || naivātra karmaṇo bhogo rāmarūpo bhavennaraḥ || || 35 || paśupakṣimṛgāścaiva ye cānye pāpayonayaḥ || te'pi muktā divaṃ yāṃti śrīrāmavacanaṃ yathā || 36 || ityuktvā virate tasminmunau kalaśajanmani || kṛṣṇadvaipāyanavyāsaḥ punarūce tapodhanaḥ || 37 || durlabhā sarvajantūnāṃ kathā vistarataḥ kramāt || yātrākramo'pi ca mayā śruta āgacchatāṃ nṛṇām|| 38 || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kṣetrasthānaṃ yathāvidhi || yātrākramaṃ muniśreṣṭha samyaktvastapodhana || 39 || phalaṃ brūhi krameṇaiva vistarātpṛcchato mama || yadyasti mayi te vidvankṛpā kāruṇikottama || 2.8.10.40 || yathā śrutvā krameṇaiva yātrāṃ viśvavidāṃ vara || karomi tvatprasādena tathā kuru yatavrata || 41 || || agastya uvāca || || śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tattvena yātrākramamathāditaḥ || ayodhyāṃ saptatīrthānāṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || || 42 || manovākkāyaśuddhena nirdoṣeṇāṃtarātmanā || mānaseṣu sutīrtheṣu snātvā kila jiteṃdriyaḥ || yaḥ karoti vidhiṃ samyaksa tīrthaphalamaśnute || || 43 || || vyāsa uvāca || || mānasānyeva tīrthāni kathayasva tapodhana || yeṣu snātavatāṃ nṝṇāṃ viśuddhirmanaso bhavet || 44 || || || agastya uvāca || || śṛṇu tīrthāni gadato mānasāni mamānagha || yeṣu samyaṅnaraḥ snātvā prayāti paramāṃ gatim || 45 || satyatīrthaṃ kṣamātīrthaṃ tīrthamiṃdriyanigrahaḥ || sarvabhūtadayātīrthaṃ tīrthānāṃ satyavāditā || 46 || jñānatīrthaṃ tapastīrthaṃ kathitaṃ tīrthasaptakam || sarvabhūtadayātīrthe viśuddhirmanaso bhavet|| 47 || na toyapūtadehasya snānamityabhidhīyate || sa snāto yasya vai puṃsaḥ suviśuddhaṃ mano matam || bhaumānāmapi tīrthānāṃ puṇyatve kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu || 48 || yathā śarīrasyoddeśāḥ kecinmadhyottamāḥ smṛtāḥ || tathā pṛthivyāmuddeśāḥ kecitpuṇyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ || 49 || tasmādbhaumeṣu tīrtheṣu mānaseṣu ca saṃvaset|| ubhayeṣu ca yaḥ snāti sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 2.8.10.50 || tasmāttvamapi vipreṃdra viśuddhenāṃtarātmanā || yātrāṃ kuru prayatnena yātrā vai noditā mayā || taṃ tu vakṣyāmi vipreṃdra tīrthayātrāvidhiṃ kramāt || 51 || jāyante ca jaleṣveva mriyaṃte ca jalaukasaḥ || na ca gacchaṃti te svargamaśuddhamanaso malāḥ || 52 || viṣayeṣvaniśaṃ rāgo manaso mala ucyate || teṣveva hi na saṃgamya nairmalyaṃ samudāhṛtam || 53 || cittamantargataṃ duṣṭaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ na śudhyati || śataśo'pi jalairdhaute surābhāṇḍamapāvanam || 54 || dānamijyā tapaḥ śaucaṃ tīrthasevā śrutistathā || sarvāṇyetāni tīrthāni yadi bhāvena nirmalaḥ || 55 || nigṛhīteṃdriyagrāmo yatraiva vasate naraḥ || tatra tasya kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || 56 || etatte kathitaṃ vipra mānasaṃ tīrthalakṣaṇam || snāte yasminkriyāḥ sarvāḥ saphalāḥ syuḥ kriyāvatām || 57 || prātarutthāya matimānsaṃgame snānamācaret || vibhuṃ viṣṇuhariṃ dṛṣṭvā snāyādvai brahmakuṇḍake || 58 || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā cakrahariṃ vibhum || tato dharmahariṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 59 || ekādaśyāmekādaśyāmiyaṃ yātrā śubhāvahā || prātarutthāya matimānsvargadvārajalaplutaḥ || 2.8.10.60 || vidhāya nityajaṃ karma ayodhyāṃ ca vilokayet || sarayūṃ tu tato dṛṣṭvā paśyenmattagajaṃ tataḥ || 61 || baṃdīṃ ca śītalāṃ caiva vaṭukaṃ ca vilokayet || tadagrasarasi snātvā mahāvidyāṃ vilokayet || 62 || piṇḍārakaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā tato bhairavadarśanam|| aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmeṣā yātrā phalapradā || 63|| aṃgārakacaturthyāṃ tu pūrvoktā devatā api || vighneśaṃ ca tataḥ paśyetsarvakāmārthasiddhaye|| 64 || prātarutthāya matimānbrahmakuṇḍajale plutaḥ || viṣṇuṃ viṣṇuhariṃ dṛṣṭvā manovākkāyaśuddhimān||||65|| maṃtreśvaraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā mahāvidyāṃ vilokayet || ayodhyāṃ ca tato dṛṣṭvā sarvakāmārthasiddhaye||66|| svargadvāre naraḥ snātvā sacailo vijiteṃdriyaḥ || nānāvidhāni pāpāni bahujanmakṛtāni ca || sacailasnānato yāṃti tasmātsacailamācaret || 67 || eṣā vai gaditā yātrā sarvapāpaharā śubhā || || 68 || ya evaṃ kurute yātrāṃ nityaṃ śubhaphalapradām || na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 69 || tasmāttvamapi vipraṃdra ayodhyāṃ vraja mā ciram || tatra gatvā krameṇaiva yātrāṃ kuru yateṃdriyaḥ || 2.8.10.70 || ayodhyā paramaṃ sthānamayodhyā paramaṃ mahat || ayodhyāyāḥ samā kācitpurī naiva pradṛśyate || 71 || ayodhyā paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇucakre pratiṣṭhitam || 72 || ityetatkathitaṃ vipra mayā pṛṣṭaṃ hi yattvayā || samāśraya mune tāṃ tvamanujānīhi māmataḥ || 73 || || sūta uvāca || || ityetaduktvā virate munau kalaśajanmani || uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vyāsaḥ sa tapasāṃ nidhiḥ || 74 || || || vyāsa uvāca || || dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi kṛtakṛtyo'smyahaṃ mune || satyaṃ śaucaṃ śrutaṃ vipra suśīlaṃ ca kṣamārjavam || sarvaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ tasya ayodhyāṃ nāgato yadi || 75 || yasminmayi prasannena tvayokto dharmanirṇayaḥ || idānīmapi gacchāmi hyayodhyāṃ nirmalāṃ purīm|| tvamapi vraja vipreṃdra svamāśramapadaṃ nijam || 76 || || sūta uvāca || || ityaivamuktvā kramaśo yātrāvidhimanuttamam|| jagāma tapasāṃ rāśiragastyaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ || 77 || svamāśramapadaṃ dhīro vismayotphullalocanaḥ || vyāso'pi mahasāṃ rāśirjagāma vijitendriyaḥ || 78 || ayodhyāmāgato vipraḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || āgatyaitadvidhānena kṛtvā yātrāṃ yathākramam || 79 || dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryakaraṃ kāraṇaṃ tīrthamuttamam || ānaṃdatuṃdilastatra samyagācamya buddhimān|| 2.8.10.80 || tato jagāma vipreṃdraḥ svamāśramapadaṃ muniḥ || vyāsena kathitaṃ mahyaṃ māhātmyaṃ kramaśastadā || 81 || mayā śrutvā ca māhātmyaṃ yātrāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || kurukṣetre samāgatya bhavadagre nirūpitam || 82 || idaṃ māhātmyamatulaṃ yaḥ paṭhetprayato naraḥ || śraddhayā yaśca śṛṇuyātsa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 83 || tasmādetatprayatnena śrotavyaṃ ca janaiḥ sadā || dvijapūjā viṣṇupūjā vidhātavyā prayatnataḥ || 84 || dātavyaṃ ca suvarṇādi yathāśaktyā dvijanmane || putrārthī labhate putrāndharmmārthī dharmamāpnuyāt || 85|| ativipulavidhānairvarṇitaṃ dharmyamādyaṃ kalayati parabhaktyā kṣetramāhātmyametat || ya iha manujavaryaḥ śrīsanāthaḥ sa samyagvrajati harinivāsaṃ sarvabhogāṃśca bhuktvā || 86 || yaḥ pāṭhakasyāpi kadācideva dadāti vittaṃ ca yathātmaśaktyā || pātrāṇi vastrāṇi manoharāṇi raupyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca gavīḥ sa mucyet || 87 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yodhyāmāhātmye'gastyavyāsasaṃvāde'yodhyāyātrāvidhikramavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe'yodhyāmāhātmyaṃ sampūrṇam || (2.8) ||
<2.9.1>
|| śaunaka uvāca || || jīvānāṃ śreyase saute bahudhā sādhanāni te || dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ yogādīnyuditāni naḥ || 1 || itihāsairbahuvidhairvispaṣṭārthāni tāni ca || sarvāṇyapi mahābuddhe śrutānyasmābhirādarāt || 2 || sarveṣāṃ manujānāṃ tu duṣkarāṇyeva tāni tu || bāhulyāccāntarāyāṇāṃ tatsiddhirapi durllabhā || 3 || prayatnenāti mahatā puruṣaiddheṃryyaśālibhiḥ || sādhitānyapi sidhyanti tāni kālena bhūyasā || 4 || ato bhavāndvijātīnāmāśramāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || bravītu sukaropāyaṃ strīśūdrāderapīha naḥ || 5 || kṛtena yenāpyalpena yena kenāpi dehinā || antarāyairavihataṃ mahadeva phalaṃ bhavet || 6 || mokṣasya sādhanaṃ tādṛksuvicāryya mahāmate || hitāya sarvajīvānāṃ kṛpayā vaktumarhasi || 7 || prasādādbaladevasya vyāsasya janakasya ca || jānāsi sarvameva tvaṃ tanno brūhi bubhutsataḥ || 8 || sautiruvāca || maharṣirapi sāvarṇirevameva hi śaunaka || vinītaḥ skandamaprākṣītpunaḥ śaṅkaranandanam || 9 || sāvarṇiruvāca || śrutā nānāvidhā dharmmāḥ sāṅkhyajñānaṃ ca naikadhā || yogādīni tvaduktāni sādhanāni mayā guha || 2.9.1.10 || suduṣkarāṇi manye'haṃ tāni tvasmādṛśāṃ kila || mahatāmapi cānyeṣāṃ kṛcchrasādhyāni vai cirāt || 11 || ato varṇāśramavatāṃ śreyaskṛtsukaraṃ ca yat || sādhanaṃ tacchreṣṭhatamaṃ vaktumarhasi me'dhunā || 12 || sautiruvāca || iti pṛṣṭo munīndreṇa tena jijñāsunā guhaḥ || vāsudevaṃ hṛdi dhyāyankārttikeyaḥ sa ūcivān || 13 || skanda uvāca || śṛṇu brahmanpravakṣye'haṃ śrutaṃ pitṛmukhānmayā || sarveṣāmapi jīvānāṃ sukaraṃ mokṣasādhanam || 14 || devatāprīṇanasamaṃ sveṣṭasiddhimabhīpsatām || nāstyanyasādhanaṃ kiñcidvarṇāśramavatāmiha || 15 || apyalpaṃ sukṛtaṃ karmma devasaṃbandhataḥ kṛtam || phalaṃ dadāti nirvighnaṃ mahadeva hi tannṛṇām || 16 || daivaṃ pitryaṃ svadharmmaśca kāmyaṃ karmmāpi yacca tat || devatāyāstu saṃbandhātsadyaḥ syādiṣṭasiddhidam || 17 || sāṅkhyayoga virāgādi prāguktaṃ yacca duṣkaram || tadapi syāddhi sukaramanenaivāśu siddhidam || 18 || devasyārādhanenaiva yataḥ siddhyati vāñchitam || ataḥ sarvairyyathāśakti prītyārādhyaḥ sa mānavaiḥ || 19 || sāvarṇiruvāca|| devā vahuvidhā proktāstvayā ṣaṇmukha me purā || nānāvidhā varṇitāśca tadārādhanarītayaḥ||2.9.1.20|| tatphalāni ca sarvāṇi tvayoktāni pṛthakpṛthak || svargādiprāptimukhyāni kālagrastāni tāni tu ||21|| nivṛttidharmmiṇāṃ brahmā hyupāsteryyogināṃ guha || janādilokāptiphalaṃ dviparārddhāntanaśvaram||22|| duṣkarāṇīha saṃsādhya karmmāṇi purukṛcchrataḥ|| kṣayiṣṇuphalalābhaścettarhi kiṃ tadupārjanaiḥ||23|| kālena nāśyate yeṣāṃ vapuḥ sthānabalādikam|| teṣāṃ na rocate mahyamupāsā'tra divaukasām||24|| yaḥ svayaṃ nirbhayo'nyeṣāṃ bhayaharttā sanātanaḥ || nityadhāmā'kṣayaphalapradātā bhaktavatsalaḥ || 25 || yasya prasādātsarveṣāṃ sarva eva manorathāḥ || siddhyeyuścāñjasaivā'tra taṃ devaṃ vada me guha || 26 || tadārādhanarītiṃ ca sukarāṃ śiṣṭasaṃmatām || brūhi sarvāṃ viśeṣeṇa jijñāsāmīdamañjasā || 27 || sautiruvāca || itthaṃ maharṣiṇā tena saṃpṛṣṭo bhagavānguhaḥ || suprasanna uvācedaṃ mānayaṃstamudāradhīḥ || 28 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye sāvarṇipraśno nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<2.9.2>
|| skanda uvāca || mahāntaṃ praśnavitpraśnaṃ pṛcchasi tvami hā'nagha || nāsyottaraṃ varṣaśatairvaktuṃ śakyaṃ svatarkataḥ || ṛte devaprasādādvai brahmañjñānivarairapi || 1 || vāsudevaprasādāttu mayā jñātaṃ vadāmi te || anākhyeyaṃ na te kiñciddharmaniṣṭhāya sanmate || 2 || evameva hi papraccha nivṛtte bhārate raṇe || ajātaśatrurnṛpatirbhīṣmaṃ dharmmavidāṃvaram || 3 || śayitaṃ śaraśayyāyāṃ dhyānaprāptācyutena ca || prāptamaikātmyamavyagraṃ nigamāgamapāragam || 4 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || caturṣu tāta varṇeṣu caturṣvapyāśrameṣu yaḥ || iccheccaturvargasiddhiṃ devatāṃ kāṃ yajeta saḥ||5|| nirvighrena ca kā siddhiḥ kathaṃ syādalpakālataḥ || kathaṃ cāpyalpasukṛtī padavīṃ mahatīmiyāt|| etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chindhi sarvajñastvaṃ pitāmaha||6|| skanda uvāca || evaṃ dharmmātmanā tena pṛṣṭaḥ śāntanavo mune|| kiñcijjahāsa vīkṣyaiva śrīkṛṣṇa mukhapaṅkajam || 7 || dṛśā sa preritastena naranārāyaṇoditam || śrīvāsudevamāhātmyaṃ pituḥ śrutamuvāca tam || 8 || tataḥ śrutvā nāradopi kurukṣetraṃ gataḥ punaḥ || kailāsa etya tatprāha pitaraṃ me sa cāpi mām || 9 || tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi niśchadma paripṛcchate || mahāsadasi nirṇītaṃ munivaryā'pasaṃśayam||2.9.2.10|| vāsudevaḥ paraṃ brahma śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || devo'kāmaiḥ sakāmaiśca pūjyo muktairnarairapi || 11 || dvijātīnāṃ cāśramāṇāṃ strīśūdrādeśca sarvathā || svasvadharmaireṣa eva toṣaṇīyosti bhaktitaḥ || 12 || tasmātkarmākhilamapi daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca sarvadā || tatprītyā eva karttavyaṃ vedoktaṃ ca yathocitam || 13 || sukhāptaye nṛbhiyadyatkarmā'tra kriyate śubham || api svanuṣṭhitaṃ taccetkṛṣṇasaṃbandhavarjitam || tadā kṣayiṣṇvalpaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ tacca guṇātmakam|| 14 || phalavaiguṇyakṛttaccā'śubhadeśādiyogataḥ || bahuvighnaṃ ca tannṝṇāṃ naiva vāñchitasiddhidam || 15 || karmaitadeva śrīkṛṣṇaprīṇanāya kriyeta cet || tatsaṃbandhena tarhyetadbhavetsarvaṃ hi nirguṇam || 16 || svavāñchitādapyadhikaṃ dadāti phalamakṣayam || asaddeśādisaṃbandhāttadvaiguṇyabhavenna ca ||17|| vighnastu kopi brahmarṣe pratāpāccakrapāṇinaḥ || tasminna prabhavetkvāpi tatsyādīpsitasiddhidam ||18|| yadyapyalpaṃ svasukṛtaṃ tathāpi paramātmanaḥ || sākṣātsaṃbandhato brahmanbhavatyeva mahattaram || 19 || yathā sphuliṅgamātropi vanyakāṣṭhaughayogataḥ || anivāryo bhaveddāvastathaitaddhariyogataḥ || 2.9.2.20 || pravṛtte vā nivṛtte vā tasmāddharme sthitairnnaraiḥ || upāstavyo vāsudevastatsamyaksiddhimīpsubhiḥ || 21 || atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam|| nāradasya ca saṃvādamṛṣernārāyaṇasya ca || 22 || yo vāsudevo bhagavānnityaṃ brahmapure sthitaḥ || dākṣāyaṇyāmāvirāsīddharmāllokahitāya saḥ || 23 || kṛte yuge dvijavara purā svāyambhuvāntare || naro nārāyaṇaśceti dvirūpaḥ prādurāsa saḥ || 24 || dharmāśramāttapastaptuṃ kṣemāyaiva nṛṇāṃ bhuvi || naranārāyaṇau tau ca badaryāśramamīyatuḥ ||25|| tatrādyau lokanāthau tau kṛśau dhamanisaṃtatau || tepāte tejasā svena durnirīkṣyau surairapi || 26 || yasya prasādaṃ kurvāte sa vai tau draṣṭumarhati || śakyate nānyathā draṣṭumapi taddhāmavāsibhiḥ || 27 || ekadā nārado yogī tābhyāmeva didṛkṣitaḥ || antarātmatayā cāntarhṛdayepi pracoditaḥ || 28 || merormahāgireḥ śṛṅgātsadyo gaganavartmanā || taṃ deśamāgamadbrahmanbadaryāśramasaṃjñitam || 29 || tayorāhnikavelāyāmāgatastatra sa drutam || ādyāśramakriyāsaktau tau dadarśa ca dūrataḥ || 2.9.2.30 || dṛṣṭvaiveśvaracaryāṃ tā tasya kautūhalaṃ tvabhūt || aho etau jagatpūjyāvīśvarau sarvadehinām || etau hi paramaṃ brahma kā'nayorāhnikī kriyā || 31 || pitarau sarvabhūtānāṃ devatānāṃ ca daivatam || kāṃ devatāṃ tu yajataḥ pitṝnvaitau mahāmatī || 32 || iti saṃcintya manasā bhakto nārāyaṇasya saḥ || tatsamīpamupetyā'tha tasthau natvā kṛtāñjaliḥ || 33 || kṛte daive ca pitrye ca tatastābhyāṃ nirīkṣitaḥ || pūjitaścaiva vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena so'nagha || 34 || taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryyamapūrvaṃ vidhivistaram|| upopaviṣṭaḥ suprīto nāradobhūcca vismitaḥ || 35 || nārāyaṇaṃ saṃnirīkṣya prayatenāntarātmanā || namaskṛtya ca taṃ devamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 36 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmya ātyantikaśreyaḥsādhananirūpaṇe nārāyaṇanāradasamāgamo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<2.9.3>
|| nārada uvāca || vedeṣu sapurāṇeṣu sāṃgopāṃgeṣu gīyase || tvameva śāśvato dhātā niyantāmṛtamacyuta || tvaṃ vidhātā ca satataṃ tvayi sarvamidaṃ jagat || 1 || catvāro hyāśramā deva sarve varṇāśca karmabhiḥ || yajante tvāmaharaharnnānāmūrttisamāsthitam || 2 || pitā mātā ca sarvasya daivataṃ tvaṃ hi śāśvatam || kaṃ tvaṃ ca yajase devaṃ pitaraṃ vā na vidmahe || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || naitadrahasyaṃ vaktavyamātmaguhyamathāpi te || mayi bhaktimate brahmanpravakṣyāmi yathātatham || 4 || satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ yo brahmeti śrutivarṇitaḥ || triguṇavyatiriktaśca puruṣo divyavigrahaḥ ||5|| mahāpuruṣa ityukto vāsudevaśca yaḥ prabhuḥ || nārāyaṇa ṛṣirviṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaśca bhagavāniti ||6|| ekaḥ sa eva devo nau pitarau ceti viddhi bhoḥ || āvābhyāṃ pūjyate'sau hi daive pitrye ca kalpite ||7|| nāsti tasmātparataraḥ pitā devo'tha vā dvija || ] ātmā hi nau sa vijñeyaḥ kṛṣṇo brahmapureśvaraḥ ||8|| tenaiṣā prathitā brahmanmaryādā lokabhāvanī|| daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca kartavyamiti lokahitaiṣiṇā || 9|| pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvedhā karmāsti vaidikam || yathādhikāraṃ vihitaṃ puruṣārthopalabdhaye ||2.9.3.10|| tantravedoktavidhinā svocitastrīparigrahaḥ || vittārjanaṃ ca nyāyena dravyayajñāḥ sakāmanāḥ || 11 || vāso grāme ca nagare pūrtamiṣṭaṃ ca karma yat || pravṛttaṃ tattu sakalamaśāntikṛdudīritam || 12 || strīdravyayoḥ parityāgaḥ kāmalobhakrudhāṃ tathā || vanavāsaśca vairāgyaṃ tapaḥ kṣāntiḥ śamo damaḥ || 13 || brahmayajñā yogayajñā jñānayajñāśca sarvaśaḥ || japayajñāśceti mune nivṛttaṃ karma kīrtitam || 14 || trilokyāṃ gatayo dharmaṃ pravṛttamanutiṣṭhatām || svargalokāvadhi mune manuṣyāṇāṃ bhavanti vai|| 15 || indracandrāgnilokādau svasvapuṇyaphalaṃ ca te || bhogaiśvaryaṃ vahuvidhamabhīṣṭaṃ bhuñjate khalu || 16 || yāvatpuṇyaṃ tāvadeva bhuktvā tatte surā'stataḥ || kṣīṇe tu sukṛte bhūyaḥ patanti vivaśā bhuvi || 17 || bhogaiśvaryādināśo hi kālavegena jāyate || anicchatāmapi mune teṣāṃ puṇyakṣaye sati || 18 || ādhikārikadevānāmapi brahmadine muhuḥ || iṣṭabhogaiśvaryanāśo jāyate kālaraṃhasā ||19|| nivṛttadharmaniṣṭhā ye yoginaśca tapasvinaḥ || janādīnyānti lokāṃstrīṃste tu trailokyato bahiḥ ||2.9.3.20|| tattallokaiśvaryabhogānbhuñjate te nijepsitān || dainandinepi pralaye varttante te yathāsukham || 21 || brahmaṇo dviparārddhānte tadbhogaiśvaryasaṃpadaḥ || naśyanti kālaśaktyaiva lokāsteṣāṃ ca nārada || 22 || athaitadvividhaṃ karma guṇātmakamapi dvija || kṛtaṃ cedviṣṇusaṃbaddhaṃ nirguṇaṃ syāttadā tu tat || 23 || tatphalaṃ cākṣayaṃ syāddhi sveṣṭādapyadhikaṃ nṛṇām || bhaktāste bhagavaddhāma yāntyaṣṭāvṛttitaḥ param || 24 || ato vivekino nityaṃ viṣṇubhaktyanvitāḥ kriyāḥ || pravṛttā vā nivṛttā vā kurvate sakalā api || 25 || brahmā sthāṇurmanurddakṣo bhṛgurddharmastathā yamaḥ || marīciraṅgirāścātriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || 26 || vaibhrājaśca vasiṣṭhaśca vivasvānsoma eva ca || kaśyapaḥ karddamādyāśca prajānāṃ patayo mune || 27 || devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarve sarve varṇāstathāśramāḥ || pūjayanti tameveśaṃ pravṛttaṃ dharmamāsthitāḥ || 28 || sanaḥ sanatsujātaśca sanakaḥ sa sanandanaḥ || sanatkumāraḥ kapila āruṇiśca sanātanaḥ || 29 || ṛbhuryatiśca haṃsādyā munayo naiṣṭhikavratāḥ || tameva pūjayantīśaṃ nivṛttaṃ dharmamāsthitāḥ || 2.9.3.30 || vāsudevasyāṅgatayā bhāvayitvā surānpitṝn || ahiṃsapūjāvidhinā yajante cānvahaṃ hi te || 31 || yathādhikāramete hi tena yatra niyojitāḥ || pravṛtte vā nivṛtte vā dharme te pālayanti tam || tasya devasya maryādāṃ na krāmantyubhayepi te || 32 || caturvarge teṣu yasya yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet || tattatsaṃpūrayatyeva sarva śaktipatiḥ prabhuḥ || 33 || bhaktyā kṛtasyāpyalpasya bhagavānpuṇyakarmaṇaḥ || prīto dadātyeva phalaṃ mahadakṣayamīpsitam || 34 || teṣu tadbhaktito loke ye tvekāntitvamāsthitāḥ || vāsudevaṃ vinānyatra saṃkṣīṇāśeṣavāsanāḥ || 35 || dehānte te tu saṃprāpya tasya dhāma tamaḥparam || dehairaprākṛtaireva premṇā paricaranti tam || 36 || anye tu bhaktāḥ kālena tadupāsanadārḍhyataḥ || vāsanānāṃ kṣaye jāte yāntyekāntikavaddhi tam || 37 || yena kenāpi bhāvena tena saṃbadhyate tu yaḥ || saṃsṛtiṃ na prayātyeva sa tu kvāpyanyajīvavat || 38 || karmayogasya saṃsiddhirjñānayogasya cepsitā || tasyāśrayādeva nṛṇāṃ nirvighnaṃ bhavati drutam|| 39 || tasmātsa eva bhagavānsavarraipi janairiha || svābhīṣṭaphalasiddhyarthaṃ prītyopāsyo yathāvidhi || 2.9.3.40 || brahmaikyamāptā nirvighnā api brahmaśivādayaḥ || śrīviṣṇoḥ kurvate bhaktiṃ santītthaṃ tanmahāguṇāḥ || 41 || iti guhyasamuddeśastava nārada kīrttitaḥ || atipremṇā hi satataṃ mayi bhaktimato'khilaḥ || 42 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye śrīvāsudevasarvopāsyatvanirūpaṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<2.9.4>
|| skanda uvāca || sa evamuktotmavidāṃ variṣṭho nārāyaṇenottamapūruṣeṇa || jagāda vākyaṃ jagatāṃ gariṣṭhaṃ tamacyutaṃ lokahitādhivāsam || 1 || nārada uvāca || śrutaṃ mayā deva samaṃ tvayoktamṛṣyākṛticchāditabhūridhāmnā || tavaiva līlā sakaleyamīśa sarveśvarasyeti vidāmi citte || 2 || tvaddarśanenaiva hi pūrṇakāmo bhavāmi bhūmansvahṛdīpsitena || tathāpyahaṃ tattava pūrvarūpaṃ prabho didṛkṣāmi hi kautukaṃ me || 3 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || na tatsvarūpaṃ mama dānayajñayogaiśca vaidestapasāpi dṛśyam || ekāntikairbhaktavaraistu bhaktyā hyananyayā nārada dṛśyate tat || 4 || bhaktistava tvasti mayi hyananyā jñānaṃ ca vairāgyayutaṃ svadharmaḥ || ataśca taddarśanamāpsyasi tvaṃ sureśvarādyairapi yaddurāpam || 5 || tvadīyabhaktyā'titarā prasannastvājñāpayāmyadya tadīkṣaṇāya || sitāntarīpaṃ vraja tatra te'yaṃ manorathaḥ setsyati vipravarya || 6 || skanda uvāca || śrutveti vācaṃ parameṣṭhiputraḥ sopyarccayitvā tamṛṣiṃ purāṇam || khamutpapātottamayogayuktastatodhimerau sahasā nipete || 7 || tasyāvatasthe ca munirmuhūrttamekāntamāsādya gireḥ sa śṛṃge || ālokayannuttarapaścimena dadarśa cātyadbhutamantarīpam || 8 || kṣīrodadheruttarato hi dvīpaḥ śvetaḥ sa nāmnā prathito viśālaḥ || dedīpyamāno vitatena sarvato jyotiścayenātisi tena nityam || 9 || āmrairanekairasanairaśokairāmrātakairnimbakadambanīpaiḥ || bilvairmadhūkaiḥ suradārubhiśca plakṣairvaṭaiḥ kiṃśukacandanaiśca || 2.9.4.10 || sarjjaiśca śālaiḥ panasaistamālairmunidrumaiḥ ketakacampakaiśca || kundaiśca jātīsuramallikābhidrumairvṛtaḥ puṣpaphalāvanamraiḥ || 11 || kalpadrumāṇāṃ bahubhiśca vṛndaiḥ suvarṇarambhākramukālibhiśca || mahadbhirudyānavarairanekaiḥ saritsarobhirvikacāmbujaiśca || haṃsādibhiḥ pakṣivaraiḥ suśabdairgaṇairmṛgāṇāṃ ruciraiścaladbhiḥ || 12 || sarvepi jīvāḥ kila yatra muktā vasanti ca sthāvarajaṅgamāśca || taṃ vīkṣamāṇena ca tena dṛṣṭā bhaktottamāḥ śrīpuruṣottamasya || 13 || atīndriyā nirgatasarvapāpā niṣyandahīnāśca sugandhinaśca || dvibāhavaḥ kepi caturbhujāśca śvetāśca kecinnavanīradābhāḥ|| || 14 || padmacchadākṣāḥ samamānagātrāḥ surūpadivyāvayavāḥ susārāḥ || vikīrṇakeśāśca sadā kiśorā sadbhiśca cihnairnnikhilairupetāḥ || 15 || sarojarekhāṅkitapāṇipādāḥ ṣaḍūrmihīnā mihirātitejasaḥ || sitāṃśukā dhyānaparāśca saumyāḥ kālopi yebhyo bhayameti nityam|| 16 || sāvarṇiruvāca || atīndriyā nirātaṅkā aniṣyandāḥ sugandhinaḥ || ke te narāḥ kathaṃ jātāstādṛśāḥ kā ca tadgatiḥ || 17 || śvetadvīpaḥ payombhodhau varttate hi dharātale || tadvāsināmapi kathaṃ proktā'tīndriyatā tvayā ||18|| ye brahmaṇyakṣare dhāmni saccidānandarūpiṇi|| sthitāḥ syuścinmayā muktāste tathā syurnnahītare || 19 || etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || tvaṃ hi sarvakathābhijñastatastvāmāśritosmayaham || 2.9.4.20 || skanda uvāca || ekāntopāsanenaiva prākkalpeṣu ramāpateḥ || ye brahmabhāvaṃ saṃprāptā ajarāmaratāṃ gatāḥ || 21 || akṣarākhyāḥ pumāṃsaste śvetadvīpe'tra dhāmani || sevituṃ vāsudevaṃ taṃ sthitā devarṣiṇekṣitāḥ ||22 || prāpte pralayakāle tu punaścākṣaradhāmani || sthāsyanti te svatantrāśca kālamāyābhayojjhitāḥ || 23 || atrāpi puruṣā ye tu māyājātā ataḥ kṣarāḥ || tepi sadbhiḥ sādhanairvai jāyante tādṛśāḥ kila || 24 || ahiṃsayā ca tapasā svadharmeṇa virāgataḥ || vāsudevasya māhātmyajñānenaivātmaniṣṭhayā || 25|| bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ prasaṅgena mahātmanām || harisevāvihīnānāṃ muktīnāmapyanicchayā || 26 || siddhīnāmaṇimādīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ cāpyakāṃkṣayā || anyonyaṃ śrutikīrtibhyāṃ śrīharerjanmakarmaṇām || bhavanti tādṛśā nūnaṃ puruṣā munisattama || 27 || jagatsarge jāyamānepyete kālavaśātkvacit || na jāyante svataṃtratvānna naśyanti laye'nyavat || 28 || atra te kathayiṣyāmi kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ mune || yathātratyopi manujastathā bhāvamupeyivān|| 29 || vistīrṇaiṣā kathā brahmañchrutā me pitṛsannidhau || saiṣādya tava vaktavyā kathāsāro hi sa smṛtaḥ || 2.9.4.30 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye śvetadvīpamuktavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<2.9.5>
|| skanda uvāca || āsīdrājoparicaro vasunāmā purā mune || bhūbhartturāyostanayaḥ khyātaścāsāvamāvasuḥ || ākhaṇḍalasakho bhaktiṃ prāpto nārāyaṇe prabhau || 1 || dhārmikaḥ pitṛbhaktaśca pitṝndevāṃśca tarpayan || sadācārarato dakṣaḥ kṣamāvānanasūyakaḥ || 2 || sarvopakārakaḥ śānto brahmacaryarataḥ śuciḥ || akrodhanaśca mitabhuṅmṛdurnirvyasano muniḥ || 3 || nirdvandvo nirvikāraśca nirmāno dhīra ātmavit || nirddambho mānado yogī tapasvī vijitendriyaḥ || 4 || dhanaputrakalatreṣu viraktaḥ svajanādiṣu || nārāyaṇamanuṃ bhaktyā sa jajāpānvahaṃ nṛpaḥ || 5 || tasmai tuṣṭo'tha bhagavānvāsudevaḥ svayaṃ dadau || sāmrājyaṃ so'tha nāsaktastatra bheje tamādarāt || 6 || tatroktena vidhānena pañcakālasamāhitaḥ || pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ taccheṣeṇa surānpitṝn||7|| teṣāṃ śeṣeṇa viprāśca saṃvibhajyāśritāṃśca saḥ || śeṣānnabhuksatyaparaḥ sarvabhūteṣvahiṃsakaḥ|| || 8 || bhakṣaṇe doṣamavidatprāṇimātrāmiṣasya tu || mahāpātakavadrājā svaprajāśca tathā'vadat || 9|| sarvabhāvena bheje'sau devadevaṃ janārdanam || anādimadhyanidhanaṃ lokakarttāramavyayam||2.9.5.10|| śrīvāsudevapadayoḥ sa cakāra manaḥ sthiram || śrotre ca nityaṃ bhagavatkathāyāḥ śravaṇe nṛpaḥ ||1 1|| nayane sve mukundasya tadbhaktānāṃ ca darśane|| guṇagāne harervāṇīṃ cakre bhūmipatiḥ sa tu||12|| nārāyaṇāṃghrisaṃspṛṣṭa tulasīpuṣpasaurabhe|| prāṇaṃ cakāra ca nṛpo nānyagandheṣu karhicit|| 13 || śrīśopabhuktavastrādi sparśane ca tvacaṃ nijām|| cakāra rasanāmanne nārāyaṇanivedite|| 14 || bhagavanmandirakṣetrasadantikagatautathā|| cakāra caraṇau rājā sevāyāṃ ca karau hareḥ||15|| uttamāṃgaṃ ca cakre'sau viṣṇupādābhivandane|| sakhyaṃ cakāra paramaṃ mahābhāgavateṣu saḥ||16|| ekopi na kṣaṇastasya vinā bhaktiṃ ramāpateḥ || jagāma kila rājarṣestadīya vratacāriṇaḥ ||17 || mahadbhireva saṃbhārairviṣṇorjjanmadinotsavān || cakre tadarthamudyānamaṃdiropavanāni ca || 18 || itthaṃ nārāyaṇe bhaktiṃ vahato brāhmaṇottama || ekaśayyāsanaṃ tasya dattavāndevarāṭ svayam || 19 || vaijayantīṃ dadau mālāṃ tasmā indro'tiśobhanām || amlānapaṅkajamayīṃ tathā ratnāni bhūriśaḥ || 2.9.5.20 || ātmā rājyaṃ dhanaṃ caiva kalatraṃ vāhanādi ca || yattadbhagavataḥ sarvamiti tatprekṣitaṃ sadā || 21 || kāmyā naimittikājasraṃ yajñiyāḥ paramāḥ kriyāḥ || sarvāḥ sātvatamāsthāya vidhiṃ cakre samāhitaḥ || 22 || pañcarātravido mukhyāstasya gehe mahātmanaḥ || prāyaṇaṃ bhagavatprattaṃ bhuñjatesmāgrato dvijāḥ || 23 || tasya praśāsato rājyaṃ dharmeṇā'mitraghātinaḥ || nānṛtā vāksamabhavanmano duṣṭaṃ na cā'bhavat || na ca kāyena kṛtavānsa pāpaṃ paramaṇvapi || 24 || pañcarātraṃ mahātantraṃ bhagavadbhaktipuṣṭaye || śuśrāvānudinaṃ rājā bhagavadbhaktavaktrataḥ || 25 || dharmaṃ saṃsthāpayañchuddhaṃ rañjayansakalāḥ prajāḥ || pālayāmāsa pṛthivīṃ divamākhaṇḍalo yathā || 26 || api saptavidhastasya rājye palalabhakṣakaḥ || pumānkopyabhavannaiva na ca pāṣaṇḍaveṣiṇaḥ || 27 || asādhyo yoṣitaścaiva puruṣāḥ pāradārikāḥ || na śrutāstasya rājye ca dharmasaṃkarakāriṇaḥ || 28 || ekādaśavidhaṃ madyaṃ trividhāṃ ca surāmapi || nājighradapi kopīha tasminrājyaṃ praśāsati || 29 || evaṃguṇaḥ sa tu kvāpi pakṣapātāddivaukasām || mithyālāpāddivo bhraṣṭaḥ praviveśa mahītalam || 2.9.5.30 || antarbhūmigataścāsau satataṃ dharmavatsalaḥ || nārāyaṇaparo bhūtvā tanmaṃtramajapatsthiraḥ || 31 || tasyaiva ca prasādena punarevotthitastu saḥ || divaṃ prāpya sukhaṃ tatra manobhīṣṭaṃ samanvabhūt || 32 || punaścedipatirbhūtvā bhuvyasau pitṛśāpataḥ || pañcarātroktavidhinā bheje harimatandritaḥ || 33 || svargalokaṃ tataḥ prāpaddivyadehena bhūpatiḥ || upāsanāṃ ca tatratyaiḥ paramarṣigaṇaiḥ saha || 34|| dṛḍhīkurvanbhagavataḥ kañcitkālamuvāsa tat || paraṃ padamatha prāpadvāsudevasya nirbhayam||35|| || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmya uparicaravasusadguṇavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<2.9.6>
|| sāvarṇiruvāca || sa hi bhakto bhagavata āsīdrājā mahānvasuḥ || kiṃ mithyā'bhyavadadyena divo bhūvivaraṃ gataḥ || 1 || kenoddhṛtaḥ punarbhūmeḥ śapto'sau pitṛbhiḥ kutaḥ || kathaṃ muktastato bhūpa ityetatskanda me vad || 2 || skanda uvāca || śṛṇu brahmankathāmetāṃ vasorvāsa varociṣaḥ || yasyāḥ śravaṇataḥ sadyaḥ sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 3 || svāyambhuvāntare pūrvamindro viśvajidāhvayaḥ || ārarambhe mahāyajñamaśvamedhābhidhaṃ mune || 4 || nibaddhāḥ paśavo'jādyāḥ krośantastatra bhūriśaḥ || sarve devagaṇāścāpi rasalubdhāstadāsata || 5 || kṣemāya sarvalokānāṃ vicaranto yadṛcchayā || maharṣaya upājagmustatra bhāskaravarccasaḥ || 6|| saṃmānitā suragaṇaiḥ pādyārghyasvāgatādibhiḥ || te bṛhanmunayo'paśyanmedhyāṃstānkrośataḥ paśūn || 7 || sāttvikānāmapi ca taṃ devānāṃ yajñavistaram || hiṃsāmayaṃ samālokya te'tyāścaryaṃ hi lebhire || 8 || dharmavyatikramaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā te dvijottamāḥ || mahendrapramukhānūcurdevāndharmadhiyastataḥ || 9 || maharṣaya ūcuḥ || devaiśca ṛṣibhiḥ sākaṃ mahendrā'smadvacaḥ śṛṇu || yathāsthitaṃ dharmatattvaṃ vadāmo hi sanātanam || 2.9.6.10 || yūyaṃ jagatsargakāle brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā || sattvena nirmitāḥ stho vai catuṣpāddharmadhārakāḥ || 11 || rajasā tamasā cāsau manūṃścaiva narādhipān || asurāṇāṃ cādhipatīnasṛjaddharmadhāriṇaḥ || 12 || sarveṣāmatha yuṣmākaṃ yajñādividhibodhakam || sasarja śreyase vedaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam || 13 || ahiṃsaiva paro dharmastatra vede'sti kīrttitaḥ || sākṣātpaśuvadho yajñe nahi vedasya saṃmataḥ || 14 || catuṣpādasya dharmasya sthāpane hyeva sarvathā || tātparyamasti vedasya na tu nāśe'sya hiṃsayā || 15 || rajastamodoṣavaśāttathāpyasurapā nṛpāḥ || medhyenājena yaṣṭavyamityādau matijāḍyataḥ || chāgādimarthaṃ bubudhurvrīhyādiṃ tu na te viduḥ || 16 || sāttvikānāṃ tu yuṣmākaṃ vedasyārtho yathā sthitaḥ || grahītavyonyathā naiva tādṛśī ca kriyocitā || 17 || yādṛśo hi guṇo yasya svabhāvastasya tādṛśaḥ || svasvabhāvānusāreṇa pravṛttiḥ syācca karmaṇi || 18 || sāttvikānāṃ hi vo devaḥ sākṣādviṣṇū ramāpatiḥ || ahiṃsayajñe'sti tato'dhikārastasya tuṣṭaye || 19 || pratyakṣapaśumālabhya yajñasyācaraṇaṃ tu yat || dharmaḥ sa viparīto vai yuṣmākaṃ surasattamāḥ || 2.9.6.20 || rajastamoguṇavaśādāsurīṃ saṃpadaṃ śritāḥ || yuṣmākaṃ yājakā hyete santyavedavido yathā || 21|| tatsaṅgādeva yuṣmākaṃ sāmprataṃ vyatyayo mateḥ || jātastenedṛśaṃ karma prārabdhamiti niścitam || 22 || rājasānāṃ tāmasānāmāsurāṇāṃ tathā nṛṇām || yathāguṇaṃ bhairavādyā upāsyāḥ santi devatāḥ || 23 || svaguṇānuguṇātmīyadevatātuṣṭaye bhuvi || hiṃsrayajñavidhānaṃ yatteṣāmevocitaṃ hi tat || 24 || tatrāpi viṣṇubhaktā ye daityarakṣonarādayaḥ || teṣāmapyucito nāsti hiṃsrayajñaḥ kutastu vaḥ || 25 || yajñaśeṣo hi sarveṣāṃ yajñakarmānutiṣṭhatām || anujñāto bhakṣaṇārthaṃ nigamenaiva vartate || 26 || sāttvikānāṃ devatānāṃ surāmāṃsāśanaṃ kvacit || asmābhistvīkṣitaṃ naiva na śrutaṃ ca satāṃ mukhāt || 27 || tasmādvrīhibhirevāsau yajñaḥ kṣīreṇa sarpiṣā || medhyairannarasaiścā'nyaiḥ kāryo na paśuhiṃsayā || 28 || tatrāpi bījairyaṣṭavyamajasaṃjñāmupāgataiḥ || trivarṣakālamuṣitairnna yeṣāṃ punarudgamaḥ || 29 || adrohaścāyalobhaśca damo bhūtadayā tapaḥ || brahmacaryaṃ tathā satyamadambhaśca kṣamā dhṛtiḥ || 2.9.6.30 || sanātanasya dharmasya rūpametadudīritam || tadatikramya yo varteddharmaghnaḥ sa patatyadhaḥ || 31 || || skanda uvāca || itthaṃ vedarahasyajñairmahāmunibhirādarāt || bodhitā api sannītyā svapratijñāvighātataḥ || tadvākyaṃ jagṛhurnaiva tatprāmāṇyavidopi te || 32 || mahadvyatikramāttarhi mānakrodhamadādayaḥ || viviśusteṣvadharmasya vaṃśyāśchidragaveṣiṇaḥ || 33 || ajaśchāgo na bījānītyādi vādiṣu teṣvatha || vimanassvṛṣivaryeṣu punastānbodhayatsu ca || 34 || rājoparicaraḥ śrīmāṃstatraivāgādyadṛcchayā || tejasā dyotayannāśā indrasya paramaḥ sakhā || 35 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntaṃ vasuṃ te tvantarikṣagam || ūcurdvijātayo devāneṣa cchetsyati saṃśayam || 36 || eṣa bhūmipatiḥ pūrvaṃ mahāyajñānsahasraśaḥ || cakre sātvatatantroktavidhināraṇyakena ca || 37 || yeṣu sākṣātpaśuvadhaḥ kasmiṃścidapi nā'bhavat || na dakṣiṇānukalpaśca nāpratyakṣasurārccanam || 38 || ahiṃsādharmarakṣābhyāṃ khyātosau sarvato nṛpaḥ || agraṇīrviṣṇubhaktānāmekapatnīmahāvrataḥ || 39 || īdṛśo dhārmikavaraḥ satyasandhaśca vedavit || kathaṃcinnānyathā brūyādvākyameṣa mahānvasuḥ || 2.9.6.40 || evaṃ te saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā vibudhā ṛṣayastathā || apṛcchansahasā'bhyetya vasuṃ rājānamutsukāḥ || 41 || devamaharṣaya ūcuḥ || bho rājankena yaṣṭavyaṃ paśunā hosvidauṣadhaiḥ || etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ chindhi pramāṇaṃ no bhavānmataḥ || 42 || skanda uvāca || sa tānkṛtāñjalirbhūtvā paripapraccha vai vasuḥ || kasya vaḥ ko mataḥ pakṣo brūta satyaṃ samāhitāḥ || 43 || maharṣaya ūcuḥ || dhānyairyaṣṭavyamityeva pakṣo'smākaṃ narādhipa || devānāṃ tu paśuḥ pakṣo mataṃ rājanvadātmanaḥ || 44 || skanda uvāca || devānāṃ tu mataṃ jñātvā vasustatpakṣasaṃśrayāt || chāgādipaśunaivejyamityuvāca vacastadā || 45 || evaṃ hi mānināṃ pakṣamasantaṃ sa upāśritaḥ || dharmajñopyavadanmithyā vedaṃ hiṃsāparaṃ nṛpaḥ ||46|| tasminnaiva kṣaṇe rājā vāgdoṣādantarikṣataḥ || adhaḥ papāta sahasā bhūmiṃ ca praviveśa saḥ|| mahatīṃ vipadaṃ prāpa bhūmimadhyagato nṛpaḥ|| smṛtistvenaṃ na prajahau tadā nārāyaṇāśrayāt||48|| mocayitvā paśūntsarvāṃstataste tridivaukasaḥ || hiṃsābhītā divaṃ jagmuḥ svāśramāṃśca maharṣayaḥ||49|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇava khaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye vedasyahiṃsāparatvoktyā uparicaravasoradhaḥpātavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
<2.9.7>
|| skanda uvāca || bhūmadhyagaḥ sa rājā'tha svakṛtaṃ karma garhayan || anutapyamānaśca bhṛśaṃ mānayaṃstābṛhanmunīn || jajāpa bhagavanmantraṃ tryakṣaraṃ manasā sadā || 1 || tatrāpi parayā bhaktyā pañcakālaṃ svacetasā || ayajaddhariṃ surapatiṃ bhūmervivara ādarāt || 2 || tato'sya tuṣṭo bhagavānvāsudevo jagatpatiḥ || āpadyapi yathākālaṃ yathāśāstraṃ svamarcataḥ || 3 || varado bhagavānviṣṇuḥ samīpasthaṃ dvijottamam || garutmantaṃ mahāvegamābabhāṣe svayaṃ tataḥ || 4 || śrībhagavānuvāca || dvijottama mahābhāga gamyatāṃ vacanānmama || samrāḍrājā vasurnāma dharmātmā māṃ samāśritaḥ || 5 || brahmātikramadoṣeṇa praviṣṭo vasudhātalam || tanmānanā kṛtā tena tadgacchādya tadantikam || 6 || bhūmervivarasaṃguptaṃ garuḍainaṃ mamājñayā || adhaścaraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ khecaraṃ kuru mā ciram || 7 || skanda uvāca || garutmānatha vikṣipya pakṣau mārutavegavān || viveśa vivaraṃ bhūmyā yatrāste vāgyato vasuḥ || 8 || tata enaṃ samutkṣipya svacañcvā vinatā sutaḥ || utpapāta nabhastūrṇaṃ tatra cainamamuñcata || 9 || tasminmuhūrtte saṃjajñe rājoparicaraḥ punaḥ || saśarīro gataḥ svargaṃ paramaṃ sukhamāptavān || 2.9.7.10 || evaṃ tenāpi brahmarṣe vāgdoṣātsadavajñayā || prāptā gatirayajvārhā dharmajñena mahātmanā || 11 || kevalaṃ puruṣastena sevito harirīśvaraḥ || tataḥ śīghraṃ jahau pāpaṃ svargalokamavāpa ca || 12 || bhuñjāno vividhaṃ saukhyaṃ manobhīṣṭaṃ ca tatra saḥ || uvāsānyo yathā śakro gīyamānayaśāḥ suraiḥ || 13 || tamekadā vimānena carantaṃ sūryasannibham || adrikāpsarasā yuktamacchodā samavaikṣata || 14 || sā hi somapadasthānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ mānasī sutā || agniṣvāttābhidhānānāmamūrttānāṃ mahātmanām || 15 || amūrttatvātpitṝnsvānsā na jānantī śucismitā || taṃ vasuṃ pitaraṃ mene sa ca tāmātmajāmiva || 16 || tau tataḥ pitaraḥ śepurbhāvaṃ dṛṣṭvedṛśaṃ tayoḥ || kanye tvamasya nṛpaterbhuvi kanyā bhaviṣyasi || 17 || vaso tvaṃ mānuṣo bhūtvā sutāmenāṃ svayoṣiti || asyāmevāpsarāyāṃ tvaṃ janayiṣyasi niścitam || 18 || itthaṃ tau pitṛbhiḥ śaptau śāpamokṣāya tāstataḥ || prārthayāmāsaturnnatvā tadocuste kṛpālavaḥ || 19 || avaśyamitthaṃ bhāvitvādyuvābhyāmupalambhitaḥ || śāpo'yaṃ tatra yuvayoḥ śreya eva bhaviṣyati || 2.9.7.20 || aṣṭāviṃśe dvāpare tu vaso tvaṃ bhuvi bhūpateḥ || kṛtayajñasya tanayo bhavitāsi mahātmanaḥ || 21 || tatrāpi ca yathedānīṃ tathā tvaṃ sakalairguṇaiḥ || juṣṭaśca khacaro bhāvyo mahābhāgavatāgraṇīḥ || 22 || pañcarātroktavidhinā viṣṇumabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ || taccheṣeṇa surāṃścāsmānarcayiṣyasi saprajaḥ || 23 || tatastvaṃ divyadehena svargalokamavāpsyasi || divyānbhogāṃstatra bhuktvā prāpsyase vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || || 24 || acchode tvamapi kṣoṇyāṃ nāmnā kālīti viśrutā || svāṃśena matsyadehāyāmadrikāyāṃ janiṣyase || 25 || parāśarāttatra sutaṃ kanyeva prāpsyase harim || prasādādeva tasya tvaṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca lapsyase || 26 || skanda uvāca || itthaṃ sa pitṛbhiḥ śapto'nugṛhītaśca bhūpatiḥ || kṛtayajñādiha janiṃ prāpyā'bhūdviśruto guṇaiḥ || 27 || yathā pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇabhakto daivapitryavidhānavit || sakhye tasmai mahendraśca prādātpracurasaṃpadaḥ || 28 || śvetadvīpe vāsudevātprāpto yo vijayadhvajaḥ || purā svenārināśārthaṃ tasmā indrastamapyadāt ||29|| antarikṣagatī rājā bhaumānbhogānsudurlabhān || bhuktvānte svargalokaṃ ca divyadehena labdhavān || 2.9.7.30 || prākpuṇyaśeṣasya phalaṃ bhuñjansvamanasepsitān|| tatra bhogānbahuvidhāṃstīvraṃ vairāgyamāptavān || 31 || meroḥ śṛṅge'tha vijane śuciḥ kṛtadṛḍhāsanaḥ || dadhyau svahṛdayāmbhoje sveṣṭadevaṃ ramāpatim || 32 || tyaktvā devavapuḥ so'tha yogadhāraṇayā muniḥ || tataḥ sūkṣmaśarīreṇa prāpa bhāskaramaṇḍalam || yadāhurnaiṣṭhikānāṃ ca muktidvāraṃ hi yoginām || 33 || tattejodagdhasūkṣmāṅgaḥ saccidūpo'tinirmalaḥ|| sa babhūva mahābhāgaḥ saṃkṣīṇāśeṣavāsanaḥ||34|| tatastanmaṇḍalagatairātivāhikadaivataiḥ|| sa ninye vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma śvetadvīpākhyamadbhutam || 35 || sa hi dvīpo bhuvisthopi bhavatyaprākṛto mune || haribhaktajanāvāsaḥ prāpya ekāntabhaktibhiḥ || 36 || sa golokabrahmapuravaikuṇṭhānāṃ ca suvrata || dvārabhūtosti bhaktānāṃ tallipsūnāṃ mahātmanām || 37 || yasya yaddhāmna icchā syādbhajatastaṃ tadeva hi || prāpayanti śvetamuktā mune prāguktalakṣaṇāḥ || 38 || divyadeho'bhavattatra dhāmnya'sau śvetamuktavat || prāpya golokadhāmā'tha paramānandamāptavān || 39 || itthamekāntikenaiva dharmeṇārādhayanti ye || nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ brahma śvetamuktā bhavaṃti te || 2.9.7.40 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ pṛṣṭavānyadbhavānmune || sthitirekāṃtabhaktānāṃ śvetadhāmnaśca lakṣaṇam || 41 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmya upīracaravasumokṣanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<2.9.8>
sāvarṇiruvāca || maharṣivāritairddevaistyakte hiṃsāmaye makhe || punaḥ kathaṃ saṃpravṛttā makhāḥ sarvatra tādṛśāḥ || 1 || deveṣvṛṣiṣu bhūpeṣu prācīnādhunikeṣu ca || sanātanaḥ śuddhadharmo viparyāsaṃ kathaṃ gataḥ || 2 || atra me saṃśayo bhūyānsaṃjāto'dya ṣaḍānana || tvaṃ sarvaśāstratattvajñastamapākarttumarhasi || 3 || skanda uvāca || kālo balīyānbalināṃ bhidyante tena buddhayaḥ || kāmakrodharasāsvādalobhamānavatāṃ mune || 4 || atikrameṇa mahatāṃ yathārthahitabhāṣiṇām || krodhamānavaśātpuṃsāṃ naśyantyeva ca saddhiyaḥ || 5 || akāryamapi te kartuṃ tadānīṃ tu budhā api || pravarttante'nutapyante bambhramyante'tha saṃsṛtau || 6 || kāmādibhirvihīnā ye sātvatāḥ kṣīṇavāsanāḥ || teṣāṃ tu buddhibhedāya kvāpi kālo na śaknute ||7|| anāśritastu saddharmaṃ pumānkaścana karhicit || saṃsṛtermmucyate naiva satyametadvaco mama || 8 || pravṛttiṃ hiṃsrayajñāderatha te dvijasattama || kathayāmi yathā pūrvaṃ mayā'śrāvi piturmukhāt ||9|| atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || nārāyaṇasya māhātmyaṃ yatra lakṣmyāśca kīrtitam || 2.9.8.10 || munīnāṃ bṛhatāṃ teṣāmatikramaṇadoṣataḥ || indrasyāsīdviśvajitaḥ sadbuddhivilayo mune || 11 || durvāsāḥ śaṃkarasyāṃśastapasvī munirekadā || caranyadṛcchayā lokānpuṣpabhadrāṃ nadīṃ yayau || 12 || jalakrīḍārthamāyāṃtīṃ svargāttatra sakhīvṛtām || vidyādharasya sumateraṅganāṃ sa samaikṣata || 13 || svargaṅgāhemakamalairgrathitāmatisaurabhām || dadhatīṃ dakṣiṇe pāṇau srajaṃ madakalābhidhām || 14 || tāmavekṣya munistasyāḥ samīpamupagamya saḥ || unmattavadyayāce tāṃ srajaṃ vidyādharīdhṛtām|| || 15 || sāpi praṇamya taṃ sadyo māhātmyaṃ tasya jānatī || tatkaṃṭhe dhārayāmāsa mālāṃ tāṃ paramādarāt || 16 || tataḥ prītamanā gacchangāyannunmattavanmuniḥ || dadarśa pathi devendramāyāntaṃ tāṃ mahānadīm || 17 || apsarobhiśca gandharvaiḥ satālaṃ madhurasvaram || upagīyamānavijayamadhirūḍhaṃ gajādhipam || 18 || rambhāmadhurasaṃgītaśravaṇānandanirvṛtam || tanmukhābjasthiradṛśaṃ chatracāmaraśobhitam || 19 || anavekṣamāṇamātmānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā so'trinandanaḥ || svakaṇṭhasthāṃ srajaṃ tasmiṃścikṣeponmattavaddhasan || 2.9.8.20 || indropyadharmasargeṇa samāviṣṭaḥ puraiva yat || tatastadā kāmavaśastāṃ nyadhādgajakumbhayoḥ || tatsaurabhākṛṣṭacetāḥ karīndraḥ śuṇḍayā'kṛṣat || 21 || karātsā patitā bhūmau tāṃ ca gacchankarī padā || mamardda paśyatastasya maharṣestapasāṃ nidheḥ || 22 || tataḥ kruddhaḥ sa durvāsāḥ pralayāgnyaruṇekṣaṇaḥ || prāhendraṃ matta duṣṭātmanstabdhosi kāmalampaṭa || 23 || śriyo dhāma srajaṃ prītyā maddattāṃ nābhinandasi || praṇāmamapi re mūḍha na karoṣi tvamunmadaḥ || 24 || na vīkṣase māmapi tvaṃ tvādṛṅmattaikaśikṣakam || trailokyarājyaprāptāndhyaḥ samyaktvāṃ śikṣaye'dhunā ||25|| yasyāḥ prasādāttrailokyarājyasaukhyaṃ tvamāptavān || saiva śrīḥ satrilokaṃ tvāṃ hitvā līnā'stu sāgare || 26 || vajrapātopamaṃ vākyaṃ tanniśamyaiva tatkṣaṇam || gajādutplutya vimadastadaṃghryornyapataddhari || 27 || prārthayāmāsa ca muhuḥ praṇamaṃstaṃ savepathuḥ || prasādaṃ mayi dāse tvaṃ kṛpālo kartumarhasi || 28 || taṃ prāhā'tha sa re śakra nāhaṃ vai gautamo muniḥ || akṣamāsārasarvasvaṃ durvāsasamavehi mām || 29 || anye te munayo duṣṭāstāvakāste'nuvarttinaḥ || ahaṃ tu tvādṛśānkīṭāngaṇaye naiva niḥspṛhaḥ || 2.9.8.30 || jvalajjaṭākalāpācca bhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇāt || ko vā na bibhiyānmatto brahmāṇḍe pāpakarmakṛt || 31 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye devendraśāpo nāmā'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<2.9.9>
skanda uvāca || bhāvidharmaviparyāsakālavegavaśo'tha saḥ || nāhaṃ kṣamiṣya ityuktvā kailāsaṃ prayayau mune || 1 || trailokyācchrīrapi tadā samudrentarddhimāyayau || indraṃ vihāyāpsarasaḥ sarvaśaḥ śriyamanvayuḥ || 2 || tapaḥ śaucaṃ dayā satyaṃ pādaḥ saddharmaṛddhayaḥ || siddhayaśca balaṃ sattvaṃ sarvataḥ śriyamanvayuḥ || 3 || gajādīni ca yānāni svarṇādyābhūṣaṇāni ca || cikṣipurmaṇiratnāni dhātūpakaraṇāni ca || 4 || annānyauṣadhayaḥ snehāḥ kālenālpena cikṣiyuḥ || na kṣīraṃ dhenumahiṣīpramukhānāṃ staneṣva'bhūt || 5 || navāpi nidhayo naṣṭāḥ kuberasyāpi mandirāta || indraḥ sahāmaragaṇairāsīttāpasasannibhaḥ || 6 || sarvāṇi bhogadravyāṇi nāśamīyustrilokataḥ || devā daityā manuṣyāśca sarve dāridyapīḍitāḥ || 7 || kāntyā hīnastataścandraḥ prāpāmbutvaṃ mahodadhau|| anāvṛṣṭirmahatyāsīddhānyabījakṣayaṃkarī || 8 || kvānnaṃ kvānneti jalpantaḥ kṣutkṣāmāśca nirojasaḥ || tyaktvā grāmānpuraścoṣurvaneṣu ca nageṣu ca ||9|| kṣudhārttāste paśūnhatvā grāmyānāraṇyakāṃstathā || paktvā'paktvāpi vā kecitteṣāṃ māṃsānyabhuñjata || 2.9.9.10 || vidvāṃso munayaścā'tha ye vai saddharmacāriṇaḥ || mriyamāṇāḥ kṣudhā'thāpi nāśnanta palalāni tu || 11 || tadā tu vṛddhā ṛṣayastāndṛṣṭvā'naśanādṛtān || manubhiḥ saha vedoktamāpaddharmamabodhayan || 12 || munayaḥ prāyaśastatra kṣudhā vyākulitendriyāḥ || parokṣavādavedārthānviparītānprapedire || 13 || arthaṃ cājādiśabdānāṃ mukhyaṃ chāgādimeva te || bubudhuścā'tha te prāhuryajñān kuruta bho dvijāḥ || 14 || yā vedavihitā hiṃsā na sā hiṃsāsti doṣadā || uddiśya devānpitṝṃśca tato ghnata paśūñchubhān|| 15 || prokṣitaṃ devatābhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca niveditam || bhuñjata svepsitaṃ māṃsaṃ svārthaṃ tu ghnata mā paśūn ||16|| tato devarṣibhūpālā narāśca svasvaśaktitaḥ || cakrustairbodhitā yajñānṛte hyekāntikānhareḥ||17|| gomedhamaśvamedhaṃ ca naramedhamukhānmakhān || cakruryajñāvaśiṣṭāni māṃsāni bubhujuśca te||18|| vinaṣṭāyāḥ śriyaḥ prāptyai kecidyajñāṃśca cakrire || strīputramaṃdirādyarthaṃ kecicca svīyavṛttaye || 19|| mahāyajñeṣvaśaktāstu pitṝnudiśya bhūriśaḥ || nihatya śrāddheṣu paśūnmāṃsānyādaṃstathā''dayan || 2.9.9.20 || kecitsaritsamudrāṇāṃ tīreṣvevāvasañjanāḥ || matsyāñjālairupādāya tadāhārā babhūvire ||21|| svagṛhāgataśiṣṭebhyaḥ paśūneva nihatya ca || nivedayāmāsurete gochāgapramukhānmune || 22 || sajātīyavivāhānāṃ niyamaśca tadā kvacit || nābhavaddharmasāṃkaryādvittaveśmādyabhāvataḥ ||23|||| brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyādīnāṃ kṣatrādyā brahmaṇāṃ sutāḥ || upayemire kālagatyā svasvavaṃśavivṛddhaye || 24 || itthaṃ hiṃsāmayā yajñāḥ saṃpravṛttā mahāpadi || dharmastvābhāsamātro'sthātsvayaṃ tu śriyamanvagāt || 25 || adharmaḥ sānvayo lokāṃstrīnapi vyāpya sarvataḥ || avarddhatā'lpakālena durnivāryo budhairapi || 26 || daridrāṇāmathaiteṣāmapatyāni tu bhūriśaḥ || teṣāṃ ca vaṃśavistāro mahām̐llokeṣvavarddhata || 27 || vidvāṃsastatra ye jātāste tu dharmaṃ tameva hi || menire mukhyamevā'tha granthāṃścakruśca tādṛśān || 28 || te paramparayā granthāḥ prāmāṇyaṃ pratipedire || ādye tretāyuge hītthamāsīddharmasya viplavaḥ || 29 || tataḥprabhṛti lokeṣu yajñādau paśuhiṃsanam || babhūva satye tu yuge dharma āsītsanātanaḥ || 2.9.9.30 || kālena mahatā sopi saha devaiḥ surādhipaḥ || ārādhya saṃpadaṃ prāpa vāsudevaṃ prabhuṃ mune || 31 || tato dharmaniketasya śrīpateḥ kṛpayā hareḥ || yathāpūrvaṃ ca saddharmastrilokyāṃ saṃpravarttata || 32 || tatrāpi kecinmunayo nṛpā devāśca mānuṣāḥ || kāmakrodharasāsvādalobhopahatasaddhiyaḥ || tamāpaddharmamadyāpi prādhānyenaiva manvate || 33 || ekāntino bhāgavatā jitakāmādayastu ye || āpadyapi na te'gṛhṇaṃstaṃ tadā kimutā'nyadā || 34 || itthaṃ brahmannādikalpe hiṃsrayajñapravarttanam || yathāsīttanmayākhyātamāpatkālavaśādbhuvi || 35 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye hiṃsrayajñapravṛttihetunirūpaṇaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<2.9.10>
sāvarṇiruvāca || kathaṃ prāptā punaḥ skanda śrīrindreṇa gatāmbudhim || etāṃ kathaya me sarvāṃ kathāṃ nārāyaṇāśrayām || 1 || skanda uvāca || śriyā vihīno devendraḥ śrīhīnairapi dānavaiḥ || parājito hṛtasthāno naṣṭāśeṣaparicchadaḥ || 2 || girigahvarakuñjeṣu kānaneṣu tatastataḥ || paribabhrāma sahito digīśairvaruṇādibhiḥ || 3 || valkalājina vastrāśca paśupakṣyāmiṣāśanāḥ || devā daityā narā nāgāstulyācāraparicchadāḥ ||4|| pātrāṇi mṛnmayānyeva sarveṣāmapi veśmasu || āsanvarākāḥ sarvepi piśācya iva ca striyaḥ || 5 || ādāvabhūdanāvṛṣṭirbhuvi dvādaśavārṣikī || tato varṣe kvacidvṛṣṭirāsītsvalpā kvacinna ca || 6 || itthaṃ dāridryaduḥkhānāṃ teṣāṃ varṣaśataṃ gatam || baliṣṭhārabdhakarmāṇaste'tiduḥkhepi no mṛtāḥ || 7 || ajīvanta mṛtaprāyā narakeṣviva nārakāḥ || yatantopi śriyaḥ prāptyai yajñādyairnnā'labhanta tām || 8 || tataḥ sahasravarṣānte merau śaraṇamāyayuḥ || śāpāddurvāsaso devāḥ sarve durvāsaso vidhim || 9 || praṇamya tasmai duḥkhaṃ svaṃ vāsavādyā nyavedayan || ādāveva hi so'jñāsītsarvajñatvātsurāpadam || 2.9.10.10 || upālabhya tataścendraṃ viriñcaḥ sahaśaṃkaraḥ || tadduḥkhavāraṇā kalpo viṣṇumaicchatprasāditum || 11 || ārādhayiṣyaṃstapasā tato'sau taṃ tapaḥpriyam || sarvadevagaṇopeta upāyātkṣīrasāgaram || 12 || tasyottare taṭe ramye sarve te'naśanavratāḥ || ekapādasthitā ūrddhvabāhavaścakrire tapaḥ || 13 || keśavaṃ hṛdi te dadhyuḥ sarvakleśavināśanam || lakṣmīpatiṃ vāsudevamekāgrakṛtamānasāḥ || 14 || śatābdānte tato viṣṇuḥ śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || atyāpanneṣu dīneṣu kṛpāṃ deveṣu so'karot|| || 15 || adṛśyamūrtirātmajñairapi bhūritapasvibhiḥ || tatrāvirāsītkṛpayā niyutāhaskaradyutiḥ || 16 || tejomaṇḍalamevādau sahasā sphuritaṃ mahat || dadṛśurvibudhāḥ sarve sitaṃ ghanamanaupamam || 17 || brahmā śivaśca tanmadhye dadṛśāte ramāpatim || ghanaśyāmaṃ caturbāhuṃ gadābjābjāridhāriṇam || 18 || kirīṭakāñcīkaṭakakuṇḍalādivibhūṣitam || pītakauśeyavasanaṃ divyasundaravigraham || 19 || harṣavihvalitānmānau daṇḍavattau praṇematuḥ || tadicchayā'tha devāśca dṛṣṭvā taṃ ca mudā''naman || 2.9.10.20 || babhūvuratihṛṣṭāste nidhiṃ prāpyā'dhanā iva || baddhāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve bhaktyā taṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ surāḥ || 21 || devā ūcuḥ || oṃnamo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya dhīmahi || pradyumnāyāniruddhāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || 22 || oṃkārabrahmarūpāya tredhāviṣkṛtamūrtaye || brahmāṇḍasargasthityantahetave nirguṇāya ca || 23 || nayanānandarūpāya praṇatakleśanāśine || keśavāya namastubhyaṃ svataṃtreśvaramūrtaye || 24 || moditāśeṣabhaktāya kālamāyādimohine || sadānaṃdāya kṛṣṇāya namaḥ saddharmavarttine|| || 25 || bhavāmbudhinimagrānāmuddhṛtikṣamakīrtaye || darśanīyasvarūpāya ghanaśyāmāya te namaḥ || 26 || gadābjadaracakrāṇi bibhrate dīrghabāhubhiḥ || suragovipradharmāṇāṃ goptre tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ || 27 || vareṇyāya prapannānāmabhīṣṭavaradāyine || nigamāgamavedyāya vedagarbhāya te namaḥ ||28 || tejomaṇḍalamadhyastha divyasundaramūrtaye || namāmo viṣṇave tubhyaṃ parātparatarāya ca||29|| vāṇīmanoviprakṛṣṭamahimne'kṣararūpiṇe|| sarvāntaryāmiṇe tubhyaṃ bṛhate ca namonamaḥ || 2.9.10.30 || sukhadosi tvamevaikaḥ svāśritānāmato vayam || mahāpadadhikakliṣṭāḥ śaraṇaṃ tvāmupāgatāḥ || 31 || devādhidevabhaktasya tava durvāsaso vayam || atikramācchriyā hīnāḥ prāptāḥ smo durdaśāmimām || 32 || vāsonnapānasthānādihīnāndharmopi naḥ prabho || tyaktvā saha śriyā yātastānpātuṃ tvamasīśvaraḥ || 33 || yato vayaṃ ca dharmaśca tvadīyā iti viśrutāḥ || yathāpūrvaṃ sukhīkarttuṃ tvamevārhasyato hi naḥ || 34 || skanda uvāca || iti saṃprārthito devairbhagavānsa dayānidhiḥ || uvācānandayanvācā meghagambhīrayā surān || 35 || śrībhagavānuvāca || viditaṃ me surāḥ sarvaṃ kaṣṭaṃ vaḥ sadatikramāt || upāyaṃ kurutādyaiva vacmi yattannivṛttaye || 36 || oṣadhīrambudhau sarvāḥ kṣiptvā mandarabhūbhṛtā || nāgarājavaratreṇa maṃthadhvamasuraiḥ saha || 37 || ādau saṃdhāya danujaiḥ kurutāmbudhimanthanam || sāhāyaṃ vaḥ kariṣyāmi khedaḥ kāryo na tatra vaḥ || 38 || amṛtaṃ ca śriyo dṛṣṭiṃ prāpya pūrvādhikaujasaḥ || bhavitāro madvimukhā daityāstu kleśabhāginaḥ || 39 || skanda uvāca || ityuktvāṃtardadhe viṣṇurbhaktasaṅkaṭanāśanaḥ || devāstasmai namaskṛtya taduktaṃ kartumārabhan || 2.9.10.40 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇava khaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye śrīvāsudevaprasādanirūpaṇaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
<2.9.11>
|| skanda uvāca || brahmarudrau mahendrādīnsaṃdhānāyā'suraiḥ saha|| ājñāpya jagmatuḥ svaṃsvaṃ dhāma devā rasāṃ mune || 1 || samayocitabhāṣāvidvāsavo nītiyuktibhiḥ || pralobhya phalabhāgena sandhiṃ cakre'suraiḥ saha || || 2 || tato devāsuragaṇā militā vāridhestaṭe || mahauṣadhīrupānīya bahuśo nidadhurdrutam || 3 || mandarādrimupetyā'tha nānauṣadhivirājitam || mūlādutpāṭya te sarve netumabdhiṃ samudyatāḥ || 4 || ekādaśasahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ bhuvi sthitam || noddhartumaśakaṃste taṃ tadānīṃ tuṣṭuvurharim || 5 || etadviditvā bhagavānsaṃkarṣaṇamahīśvaram || ajijñapattamuddhartuṃ baddhamūlaṃ mahīdharam || 6 || phūtkāramātreṇaikena sa tu sadyastamīśvaraḥ || bahiścikṣepa tatsthānādyojanadvitayāntare || 7 || atyāścaryaṃ tadālokya hṛṣṭāḥ sarve surāsurāḥ || tadantikamupājagmurddhāvantaśca kṛtāravāḥ || 8 || balino yatnavantopi parighopamabāhavaḥ || uddhṛtya netuṃ no śekurviṣaṇṇā viphalaśramāḥ || 9 || jñātvā suragaṇānkhinnānbhagavānsarvadarśanaḥ || tārkṣyamājñāpayāmāsa netuṃ tamudadhiṃ drutam || 2.9.11.10 || sahāvaraṇamapyaṇḍaṃ līlayā dharttumīśvaraḥ || manovegaḥ sa tatretya nijatroṭyaiva taṃ girim || utpāṭya sāgarataṭe nidhāya harimāyayau || 11 || tataḥ saṃhṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve kaśyapanandanāḥ || vāsukiṃ cāhvayāmāsuḥ sudhābhāgapratijñayā || 12 || sa tatrāgādatho sarve te'bdhiṃ manthitumudyatāḥ || tānapānnidhirāgatya mūrttimānabravīdvacaḥ || 13 || yadi dāsyatha me yūyamamṛtāṃśaṃ surāsurāḥ || soḍhāsmi vipulaṃ tarhi mandarabhramaṇārddanam || 14 || tatheti te pratijñāya kṣiptvādāvoṣadhīlatāḥ || parivivyurnnāgarājaṃ tasminkāñcanaparvate || 15 || tato devā hṛdi hariṃ sasmaruḥ kāryasiddhaye || smṛtamātraḥ sa tatrā'gādacyutaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ || 16 || tamālokyāmaragaṇā muditāḥ phaṇināṃ pateḥ || purobhāgaṃ gṛhītvaiva tasthustenānumoditāḥ || 17 || devatāpakṣapātitvaṃ sūcayansvasya ca prabhuḥ || yatra devāstatra tasthau tato daityāstu cukrudhuḥ || 18 || tapovidyāvayojyeṣṭhā adhobhāgamamaṅgalam || kathaṃ tiraśco gṛhṇīmo nedṛṅmūrkhā vayaṃ tviti || 19 || saha devaistato viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ tānmānayanniva || prahasya dattvā prāgbhāgaṃ surānpucchamajigrahat || 2.9.11.20 || mahāhiviṣaphūtkāradāhādamararakṣaṇam || caritrametacchrībharturiti daityā na te viduḥ || 21 || tata uttolayāmāsuḥ svarṇasānvālibhāsvaram || mandaraṃ kāśyapeyāste carmikābaddhakacchakāḥ || 22 || dvāviṃśatisahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ tamucchritam || ambhonidhau nidadhire krośantotyarthamutsukāḥ || 23 || dhāryamāṇopyanādhārastairadriratigauravāt || yayāvadhastalaṃ sadyastadāsaṃste'tivihvalāḥ || 24 || tadā sa bhagavānsākṣātsarvathā bhaktakāryakṛt || stūyamānomarairadrimuddaghre kamaṭhākṛtiḥ || 25 || utthitaṃ tamavekṣyāśu sarve phullahṛdānanāḥ || babhūvuśca sthiraḥ so'bhūtkūrmapṛṣṭhetivistṛte || 26 || tato mamanthustarasā yāvadbalamapāṃnidhim || śramaphūtkāravadanā devādayo'dayam || 27 || bhrāmyamāṇāttatastvadrerbahavonyapatandumāḥ || ūrddhvadrugharṣajo vahnistatstha siṃhādimādahat || 28 || tatra nānā jalacarā vinipiṣṭā mahādriṇā || vilayaṃ samupājagmuḥ śataśaḥ kṣīravāridhau || 29 || sāṃvarttakamahāmeghasaṅghagarjjitavanmahān || āsīnmaṃthananādaśca pratidhvanivivarddhitaḥ || 2.9.11.30 || atyākarṣaṇakhinnāṅgavāsukarmmukhakṛtkṛtaiḥ || hataujaso'tikhinnāśca daityā niṅgālavadbabhuḥ || 31 || aviṣahyaṃ viṣāgniṃ ca marṣanti bahudhā muhuḥ || lambante smāhirājasya sahasraṃ vadanānyadhaḥ || 32 || dadhāra sahasā tāni bhagavanprerito vibhuḥ || saṃkarṣaṇo mahātejāḥ sahamāno viṣānalam || 33 || sahasramekaṃ varṣāṇāṃ mathyamānātpayonidheḥ || hālāhalaṃ viṣamabhūdutsarpadvidiśo diśaḥ || 34 || yadāhuḥ kālakūṭākhyaṃ sarvalokātidāhakam || tena dandahyamānāṅgāste tu cakruḥ palāyanam || 35 || tato brahmā prajeśāśca devāḥ sarvepyumāpatim || prārthayaṃstasya pānārthaṃ stuvantaḥ stutibhirmune ||36|| bhagavānatha taṃ prāha surāṇāmagrajo bhavān || bhavatītyagrajaṃ vārddhergṛhāṇedaṃ viṣaṃ śiva || 37 || devānāṃ sa bhayaṃ dṛṣṭvā karuṇaścājñayā hareḥ || ākarṣadyogakalayā viṣaṃ pāṇitale'khilam || 38 || papau tatkaṇṭhamadhye ca śoṣayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam || nīlakaṇṭha iti khyātaḥ śaṃkarākhyaśca pa'bhavat|| 39 || pāsyatastasya pāṇerye patitā bhuvibindavaḥ || tānnāgā vṛścikādyāśca jagṛhuḥ kāścanauṣadhīḥ || 2.9.11.40 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye'mṛtamanthane viṣotpattirnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<2.9.12>
|| skanda uvāca || tato hṛṣṭāḥ kāśyapeyā manthasthānamupetya te || punarvarṣasahasraṃ ca manthanti sma payonidhim || 1 || mathyamānāttathā sindhoḥ sarvestairapi kiñcana || nāsīcca śithilā āsanmaṃthitāraḥ śvasanmukhāḥ || 2 || vāsukiśca mahāsarpaḥ prāṇavaiklavyamāptavān || manthakāle mandaropi naikatrāsītsthirasthitiḥ || 3|| sarvāndṛṣṭvā nirutsāhānpradyumno viṇvanujñayā || devāsurāhirājeṣu praviśya balamādadhau || 4 || aniruddhopi tarhyeva tamākramya nagādhipam|| sahasrabāhubhistasthau mahācala ivā'paraḥ || 5 || tato mamanthustarasā saṃprāptaparamojasaḥ || savismayā mahābdhiṃ te surāsuragaṇā mudā || 6 || nārāyaṇānubhāvena nāpurddevādayaḥ śramam || śuśubhe manthanaṃ tacca samamākarṣaṇāttadā || 7 || mathyamāne mahāmbhodhau susruvuḥ paritastadā || mahādrumāṇāṃ niryāsā bahavaścauṣadhīrasāḥ || 8 || tathābhūtādambunidherāvirāsītkalānidhiḥ || kāntyauṣadhīnāmadhyakṣaḥ sarvāsāṃ ya udīryate || 9 || tato gavāmadhiṣṭhātrī sarvāsāmapi kāmadhuk || havirddhānyabhavaddhenuḥ śītāṃśusadṛśadyutiḥ || 2.9.12.10 || aśvaḥ śveto'thāvirāsīddhayānāmadhidevatā || airāvataśca nāgendraścaturddantaḥ śaśiprabhaḥ || 11 || pārijāto divyatarustarurājastato'bhavat || maṇiratnaṃ kaustubhākhyaṃ padmarāgamabhūttataḥ || 12 || tato'bhavannapsaraso rūpalāvaṇyabhūmayaḥ || surā devī tato jajñe sarvamādakadevatā || 13 || āsīdatha dhanuḥ śārṅgaṃ sarvaśastrādhidaivatam || vādyādhidaivataṃ śaṃkhaḥ pāñcajanyastato'bhavat || 14 || tatra candraḥ pārijātastathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇaḥ || ādityapathamāśritya tasthurete tu tatkṣaṇam || 15 || vāruṇīmaśvarājaṃ ca daityeśā jagṛhurdrutam || airāvataṃ devarājo jagrāhānumatāddhareḥ || 16 || kaustubhaśca dhanuḥ śaṃkho viṣṇumeva prapedire || havirddhānīṃ tu te sarve tāpasebhyo dadustadā || 17 || mathyamānātpunaḥ sindhoḥ sākṣācchrīrabhavatsvayam || ānandayantī svadṛśā trilokīṃ hatavarcasam || 18 || tāṃ grahītuṃ tu sarvepi surāsuranarādayaḥ || aicchaṃstasyāḥ pratāpāttu śekentyetuṃ na kaścana || 19 || tatastāṃ padmahastatvācchrīṃ viditvaiva vāsavaḥ || ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpa brahmādyā ye ca tadvidaḥ ||2.9.12.20|| tāvattatrāmbudhiḥ sākṣādetya tāṃ haima āsane|| kanyā mameyamityuktvā gṛhītvāṅka upāviśat||21|| punarabdhermathyamānādadhikaṃ balibhiśca taiḥ || sudhārthibhirddhairyavadbhirapi naivābhavatsudhā || 22 || tadā śithilayatnāste nirāśā amṛtodbhave || pramlānavaktrāḥ khinnāśca babhūvuḥ kāśyapā mune || 23 || dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhāṃstāṃśca bhagavānkaruṇānidhiḥ || udyuktobhūtsvayaṃ brahmanmanthanāya hasanvibhuḥ || 24 || ratnakāñcīdṛḍhābaddhakakṣapītāmbaradyutiḥ || dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmahiṃ madhye dorbhyāmubhayatograhīt || 25 || dhṛtāhivadanā daityāstasthurekata eva te || ekato dhṛtatatpucchā devāstasthustadākhilāḥ || 26 || tanmadhyagaśca bhagavānmamanthābdhiṃ sa līlayā || dadāno nayanānanda cañcatkaravibhūṣaṇaḥ || 27 || brahmā saharṣipravarairantarikṣasthitastadā || avākirattaṃ kusumaiḥ kurvañjayajayadhvanim || 28 || mathyamānāttataḥ sindhorjjajñe dhanvantariḥ pumān || viṣṇoraṃśena gaurāṃgaḥ sudhākumbhaṃ kare dadhat || 29 || ghṛtādīnāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ rasānāṃ sāramuttamam || amṛtaṃ tadgṛhītvā'sau śriyontikamupāyayau || 2.9.12.30 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye'mṛtamanthane caturdaśaratnotpattirnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<2.9.13>
|| skanda uvāca || utprekṣanto jāyamānaṃ maṃthitāro'tha te'khilāḥ || āyāṃtaṃ dadṛśurddūrādanti dhanvantariṃ śriyaḥ || 1 || sudhābhṛtaṃ hemakumbhaṃ dṛṣṭvā cā'sya kare dhṛtam || asurāḥ sahasā brahmannutplutya jagṛhuśca tam ||2|| tatrāpi balino ye te gṛhītvā dudruvustataḥ || tāndurbalā nyaṣedhanta nītivākyairanudrutāḥ || 3 || aho naivamadharmo vaḥ kāryo dharmaparāyaṇaiḥ || samaśramebhyo devebhyo dattvā peyaṃ na cānyathā ||4|| anādṛtyeti tadvākyaṃ yayurdūraṃ tvarānvitāḥ || tatrāpi teṣāmanyonyaṃ karākṛṣṭirmahatyabhūt||5|| ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvaṃ na tvaṃ na tvaṃ pibāmyaham || itthaṃ vivadamānāste nāpustatprāśanakṣaṇam || 6 || atha devā mlānavaktrā dṛṣṭvā daityairhṛtā sudhām || aśaktāstatpratīkāre śaraṇaṃ prāpuracyutam || 7 || pāhipāhi jagannātha naṣṭaṃ sarvasvameva naḥ || daityairhṛtā sudhā sarvā kā gatirnno bhaviṣyati ||8|| sudhāpānādṛtepyete hantumasmānalaṃ kṣamāḥ || pīte'mṛte tu tairadya kiṃ kariṣyāmahe vayam || 9 || skanda uvāca || niśamya dainyaṃ devānāṃ bhagavānbhaktakāryakṛt || mā bhaiṣṭeti surānuktvā sudhāmāditsadāsurāt || 2.9.13.10 || strīrūpamadbhutaṃ dhṛtvā sarvalokavimohanam || daityāntikamupāgatya cakre kandukakhelanam || 11 || te tu tadrūpamālokya mohitāḥ kāmavihvalāḥ || tyaktvā parasparonmarddaṃ tāmupetyābruvanvacaḥ || 12 || sudhākumbhamimaṃ bhadre gṛhītvā tvaṃ vibhajya naḥ || sarvānpāyaya suśroṇi vayaṃ kaśyapasūnavaḥ || 13 || ityuktvā taṃ dadustasmai te'nicchantyā api striyai || sā prāha mama viśrambho na kāryaḥ svairiṇī hyaham ||14|| akāryaṃ vaḥ kṛtaṃ hyetadvibhajiṣye nijecchayā|| ityuktā api te mūḍhā yatheṣṭaṃ kurviti bruvan||15|| tatastadājñayā sarve devā daityāśca vāsukiḥ || niṣeduḥ paṃktiśastatra svasvamaṇḍalamāśritāḥ || 16 || paṃktibaṃdhodyateṣveṣu mohinī sā tu dūrataḥ || sammukhaṃ devapaṃktīnāṃ hemāsana upāviśat ||17|| svāṃtike cāmṛtaghaṭaṃ nidhāya straiṇalīlayā || itastato vīkṣamāṇā tasthau niḥspṛhavatkṣaṇam ||18|| vipracittimukhāstarhi ye vai dānavayūthapāḥ || saṃdigdhacittā mohinyāmāsandevāṃtikasthiteḥ || 19 || śanairupetya taddṛṣṭiṃ vañcayitvā sudhāghaṭam || jahruḥ punardurātmāno raho gatvā pipāsavaḥ || 2.9.13.20 || naranārāyaṇau tatra munibhiḥ saha cāgatau || āstāṃ tau dadṛśāte tāndānavānharato'mṛtam || 21 || nārāyaṇenerito'tha narastānsahasāruṇat || balādācchidya tatkumbhaṃ mohinyai sa dadau drutam || 22 || tato naraṃ hantukāmā āttaśastrāstu dānavāḥ || āpatanpaṃktivikṣepo hyasurāṇāmabhūnmahān || 23 || tadā naropi bhagavāndevadaityanarairapi || ajeyo nirbhayo hyekaḥ sākaṃ tairyuyudhe balī || 24 || etasminnantare devānpaṃktisthānmohinīvapuḥ || apāyayatsudhāṃ viṣṇuḥ sarvaśo laghucaṅkramaḥ || 25 || tatrāpi dānavo rāhuḥ sūryācandramasāntare || praviśya devatāpaṃktāvupāviśadalakṣitaḥ || 26 || tatrāgatāyāṃ mohinyāṃ siñcantyāṃ tanmukhe sudhām || dṛśā'sūsucatāṃ tasyai puṣpavantāvubhau ca tam || 27 || smṛtyāgatena cakreṇa tarhyevā'sya ca sāmṛtam || śiraścicchedātimahanmāyāyoṣidvapuḥ prabhuḥ || 28 || tacchailaśṛṅgapratimaṃ grasallokānnadadbhṛśam || grahatve sthāpayāmāsa lokānāṃ śāntaye hariḥ || 29 || devānsudhāṃ pāyayitvā jagṛhe pauruṣīṃ tanum || bhagavānatha devāstu yuyudhuḥ saha dānavaiḥ || 2.9.13.30 || udanvatastaṭe yuddhaṃ devānāmasuraiḥ saha || sudhāpānātibalināmāsīdviṣṇusahāyinām || 31 || tasmiṃstu tumule yuddhe nareṇendrādibhiśca te || nihanyamānā asurāḥ palāyya viviśū rasām || 32 || sūryaścāstaṃ gatastāvatsarve devagaṇāstataḥ || śriyontikamupājagmustaddarśanamahotsavāḥ || 33 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye devatāmṛtapānavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||13||
<2.9.14>
|| skanda uvāca || brahmā prajeśvarāḥ śambhurmanavaśca maharṣayaḥ || ādityavasurudrāśca siddhagandharvacāraṇāḥ || 1 || sādhyāśca marutaścaiva viśvedevā digīśvarāḥ || dasrau vahniścandramāśca svayaṃ dharmaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 2 || suparṇaḥ kinnarāścaiva ye cānye gaṇadevatāḥ || śepādyā vaiṣṇavā nāgā devapatnyaśca sarvaśaḥ || 3 || sāvitrī pārvatī caiva pṛthivī ca sarasvatī || śacī gaurī śivā saṃjñā ṛddhiḥ svāhā ca rohiṇī || dhūmorṇā cāditirddharmapatnyo mūrtidayādayaḥ || 4 || arundhatī śāṇḍilī ca lopāmudrā tathaiva ca || anasūyādayaḥ sādhvya ṛpipatnyaśca sarvaśaḥ || 5 || gaṅgā sarasvatī revā yamunā tapatī tathā || candrabhāgā vipāśā ca śatadrurdevikā tathā || 6 || godāvarī ca sarayūḥ kāverī kauśikī tathā || kṛṣṇā veṇī bhīmarathā tāmraparṇī mahānadī || 7 || kṛtamālā vitastā ca nirvindhyā surasā tathā|| carmaṇvatī payoṣṇī ca viśvādyā nadya āyayuḥ || 8 || rambhā ghṛtācī viśvācī menakā ca tilottamā || urvaśīpramukhāstatra sarvāpsarasa āyayuḥ ||9 || vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ sarve tathā golokavāsinaḥ || pārṣadapravarā viṣṇostatrājagmuḥ praharṣitāḥ || 2.9.14.10 || aṇimādyāḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau śaṃkhapadmādayo nava || nidhayo mūrtimantaśca samājagmuḥ śriyontike || 11 || pūrṇaḥ śāradacandropi tadānīṃ prītaye śriyāḥ || naiśaṃ tamo'haratsarvaṃ babhūvurnirmalā diśaḥ || 12 || tato'bhiṣekamārebhe tasyā brahmājñayā vṛṣā || maṇḍapaṃ racayāmāsa sadyastvaṣṭātiśobhanam || 13 || ratnastambhasahasrāṇāmāyatābhiśca paṃktibhiḥ || citrairanekairullocaiḥ śobhitaṃ kadalīdrumaiḥ || 14 || sugandhipuṣpanamrābhirdivyakalpadrumālibhiḥ || juṣṭaṃ nānāvidhairaṅgairdarśanīyaṃ manoharam || 15 || koṭiśo ratnadīpānāṃ paṃktibhiḥ śuddharociṣām || bhrājamānaṃ toraṇaiśca muktāhāraiśca lambibhiḥ || 16 || ratnasiṃhāsane tatra gītavādyapurassaram || upāveśya śriyaṃ cakrurabhiṣekaṃ maharṣayaḥ || 17 || airāvataḥ puṇḍarīko vāmanaḥ kumudoñjanaḥ || puṣpadantaḥ sārvabhaumaḥ supratīkaśca diggajāḥ || 18 || kurvanto bṛṃhitānyete hemakumbhoddhṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥ || catuḥsindhusamānītairabhyaṣiñcanta vāribhiḥ || 19 || mūrtimatyo mahānadyastatrājahurjalāni ca || maṃtrānuccārayaṃti sma mūrtā vedāḥ saharṣibhiḥ || 2.9.14.20 || jaguḥ sukaṇṭhā gaṃdharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || vādyāni vādayāmāsuranye devagaṇāstadā || 21 || mahānabhūttadānaṃdastrilokyāṃ sarvadehinām || śrīsūktādi dvijāḥ peṭhurjagurgītāni ca striyaḥ || || 22 || kāṃsyatālamṛdaṅgāṃśca paṇavānakagomukhān || vādayāmāsurambhodā divi duṃdubhayo'nadan || 23 || āsītkusumavṛṣṭiśca sākaṃ jayaravaistadā || āsaṃstatparicaryāyāṃ dharmapatnyaśca siddhayaḥ || 24 || susnātāyai tatastasyai kauśeye pītavāsasī || dadāvanarghye jaladhī ratnabhūṣāśca bhūriśaḥ || 25 || upaveśocitaṃ tasyā iṃdra āsanamāharat || viśvakarmā kaṅkaṇāni dadau sadratnamudrikāḥ || 26 || sudhākarastu tadbhrātā nāsābhūṣaṇamuttamam || dadau tasyai keśabhūṣā sadratnanicitā tathā || 27 || padmajanmā dadau padmaṃ muktāhāraṃ sarasvatī || nāgāśca śeṣapramukhāstasyai ratneṃdrakuṇḍale || 28 || añjanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ cādāddurgā sobhāgyalakṣaṇam || lalāṭikāṃ ca sāvitrī śacī tāmbūlapātrikām || 29 || vasaṃtaḥ kausumānhārānkaṇṭhasūtraṃ ca śaṃkaraḥ || vaijayaṃtīṃ srajaṃ pāśī kubero ratnadarpaṇam || 2.9.14.30 || anarghyāṃ kaṃcukīṃ vahniryamo'dādvyajanaṃ śubham || dadustasyai cāparepi bhūṣāstatsamayocitāḥ || 31 || tataḥ svalaṃkṛtāṃ kanyāṃ kasmai dadyāmimāmiti || siṃdhuḥ papraccha brahmāṇaṃ tadovāca sa sarvavit ||32 || kanyā taveyamambhodhe mātā mama śivasya ca || devānāmatha sarveṣāṃ lokānāmasti niścitam || 33 || nārāyaṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ paraṃ brahmākhileśvaram || puruṣottamamevaikaṃ vināsyā nāparaḥ patiḥ || 34 || ataḥ sākṣādbhagavate trailokyasukhahetave || āgatāyopaviṣṭāya dehyasmai vidhināmbudhe || 35 || kuruṣva janmasāphalyaṃ pāvayitvā nijaṃ kulam || samuddhara bhavāmbhodherdattvemāṃ paramātmane ||36|| ekastvaṃ saptabhī rūpaiḥ saptadvīpa vibhāgataḥ || viśruto'tha vidhāyaitanmahatīṃ kīrttimāpsyasi ||37|| ityukto brahmaṇā hṛṣṭaḥ samudraḥ pulakāñcitaḥ || manyamāno nijaṃ dhanyamaditsadviṣṇave sutām ||38|| tataḥ sahaiva vidhinā sa saṃprārthya tamīśvaram || vāgdānādi vidhāyaiva cakre vaivāhikaṃ vidhim ||39|| dhanvaṃtariścandramāśca vāsavādyāśca devatāḥ || āsansamudrasya pakṣe tatra vaivāhikotsave ||2.9.14.40|| vastrābharaṇayānādi dāne bhojanakarmaṇi || sanmānane ca janyānāṃ mukhyā āsaṃsta eva hi || 41 || lakṣmyāśca māṃgalyavidhau mukhyāstatra tu yoṣitaḥ || āsangaṃgādayo nadyaḥ śacyādyāśca surāṃganāḥ || 42 || menādyā nagapatnyaśca siddhayaścāṇimādayaḥ || candrapatnī tathā kāntiḥ sarvāścāpsaraso mune || 43 || nārāyaṇasyātha vibhorlīlāṃ vaivāhikīṃ vidhiḥ || śobhayanpitarau cakre mūrtidharmau vicārya ca || 44 || dharmo'sau jagadādhāra pūjyaścākhiladehinām || pitā'sya bhavituṃ yogyo hyasmiṃśca prītimānbhṛśam || 45 || iyaṃ ca mūrttiḥ prakhyātā sarvasadguṇajanmabhūḥ || dākṣāyaṇī dharmapatnī mātā bhavitumarhati || 46 || tato dharmasyāpi pakṣe mukhyāḥ kāryeṣvime'bhavan || nandīśvaragaṇeśābhyāṃ sahitaḥ śaṃkaro mune || 47 || maharṣayo marīcyādyāḥ prajeśā nārado muniḥ || vainateyaśca nandādyāḥ śrīdāmādyāśca pārṣadāḥ || 48 || durgā ca vedasūrvāṇī strīṣu mukhyā babhūvire || ṛṣipatnyo'nasūyādyā dharmapatnyaśca sarvaśaḥ || 49 || saha vedādibhirbrahmā tvāsīdubhayapakṣayoḥ || brāhmaṇā vaidikā ye ca vivāhavidhikovidāḥ || 2.9.14.50 || athābdhiḥ sarvasaṃbhārāñchriyā eva prasādataḥ || sadyaḥ saṃpādayāmāsa janayandevavismayam || 51 || yadyatsaṃkalpayāmāsa hṛdi tattadupāhṛtam || sadyaḥ svāṃtika evaikṣattatobhūdatiharṣitaḥ || 52 || madhye tu maṇḍapasyāsāvagnisthāpanavedikām || kārayāmāsa vidhivadbrāhmaṇairvedavedibhiḥ || 53 || alaṃcakāra tāṃ vediṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || nānāvidhaiḥ śubhai raṅgaiḥ sāṅkuraiḥ karakaistathā || 54 || tato mahāmaṅgalavādyaghoṣaiḥ samantrakaṃ saṃsnapito munīndraiḥ || anarghyavāsāṃsi ca ratnabhūṣā dadhāra viṣṇurmukuṭaṃ ca divyam|| 55 || vāditranidhvānanināditāśaṃ nṛtyatsurastrīkalagītaśobhanam || taṃ maṇḍapaṃ so'tha suraiḥ stuvadbhiḥ sahetya haime niṣasāda pīṭhe || 56 || prakṣālayāmāsa tadaṅghripaṅkajaṃ svapreṣṭhapatnyā jaladhiḥ sagaṃgayā || bhṛṅgārasiktottamavāridhārayā tadambu śīrṣṇā ca dadhāra sānvayaḥ |||| 57 || tataḥ paṭhanmaṃgalamuccakaiḥ śriyaṃ prādāpayaccāmbudhinā'cyutāya || prajvālya vahniṃ vidhinā vidhātā sākaṃ bṛhadbhirmunibhirjuhāva || 58 || pradāya tasmai tanayāṃ manojñāṃ tatpādapadmaikanibaddhadṛṣṭim || vāsāṃsi ratnābharaṇāni cādādbhūyāṃsi bhūmne sa samaṃ duhitrā || 59 || hutasya tasyā'tha hutāśanasya pradakṣiṇāṃ cāpi saha śriyaiva || cakāra cetāṃsi nijekṣakāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca puṃsāṃ ca haranhariḥ saḥ || 2.9.14.60 || ekāsane tau saha sanniviṣṭau brahmāṇḍamātāpitarau manojñau || saṃpūjayāmāsuranarghyavastravibhūṣaṇairdevagaṇāḥ sayoṣāḥ || 61 || tadā ca gītāni sumaṃgalāni śriyaśca viṣṇorguṇavarṇanāni || durgādayaścā'tha pulomajādyā devyo jaguḥ sasmitacāruvaktrāḥ || 62 || dvidhā vibhaktāni surāṃganānāṃ vṛndānyupāviśya ca sammukhāni || taddampatiprekṣaṇakautukāni tathā jaguḥ premabhareṇa tāni || 63 || yathā tadākarṇya surāḥ samastā maharṣayaścā'khilayoṣitopi || svāṃtastamaikṣaṃta saha śriyeśaṃ sphuraṃtamāsannanu citravacca||64 || praṇamya bhaktyā ca varākṣatādi samarpya tābhyāṃ vibudhā mudaiva || pṛthakpṛthaktuṣṭuvurūrjitābhirvāgbhiśca tau prāñjalayo vinītāḥ || 65 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye lakṣmīnārāyaṇavivāhotsavanirūpaṇaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<2.9.15>
|| brahmovāca || vicāryyā'haṃ vedānmuhurupagato niścayamimaṃ ramārāme bhaktistvayi dṛḍhatarā yarhyasubhṛtām || bhavettarhyevaiṣāṃ kṣayavirahitā bhoganikarāstathā syurlokā vai paramapuruṣātyaṃtikagatiḥ || || 1 || ajānantastvitthaṃ bhṛtarajatamaskānapi hare bhajantyasmāndevānbahuvidhataporccāsaraṇibhiḥ || ta evoktā mūḍhāḥ kṣayarahitasaukhyaṃ na kuhacillabhante'tastvāṃ vai nijahṛdi dadhe keśavamaham ||2|| śaṃkara uvāca || trayī sāṃkhyavedāṃtayogāḥ purāṇaṃ tathā pañcarātraṃ prabho dharmaśāstram || tavaivātimāhātmyamekasya nityaṃ prakārairanekairhi gāyaṃti bhaktyā ||3|| tvadeveśa śāstrāṇi caitāni bhūmno babhūvustvadekāśrayāṇyādikalpe|| ramāsevyapādāmbujaṃ śāstrayoniṃ tamādyaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaje vāsudevam || 4 || dharma uvāca || kathā tvadīyā bhavapāśamocanī sudhaiva tāpatrayataptadehinām || anekajanmāghacayāpahāriṇī tanoti bhaktiṃ vayunaṃ tavāñjasā || 5 || sadaiva sā karṇapathena hṛddarī viśatvanantābhidha sammukhodgatā || mama tvadanyā haratācca vāsanā dayābdhaye te prabhaviṣṇave namaḥ || 6 || prajāpataya ūcuḥ || dhanyā ete kalpavṛkṣā yadīyāṃ chāyāmetāmāśritastvaṃ sahaśrīḥ || dhanyaḥ kartā maṇḍapasyāsya te vai dhanyaiṣā bhūryatra pīṭhaṃ taveśa || 7 || dhanyo loke nūnameṣomburāśiḥ sākṣāttubhyaṃ yena dattā svakanyā || dhanyāścaite tvāṃ vayaṃ vīkṣamāṇā dhanyeśānaṃ śrīpatiṃ tvāṃ natāḥ smaḥ || 8 || manava ūcuḥ || dharmaḥ khalu sa hi paramo dharmebhyo mādhava sakalebhyopi || bhaktirbhavati yato vai dharmabhuvi tvayi hi niravadyā || 9 || dharmātmānaṃ bhagavandharmadhurīṇaṃ ca dharmapātāram || sarvātipriyadharmaṃ numastvāṃ dharmasaṃbhūtim || 2.9.15.10 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || bhaktyā hīnastvadvimukho vayunārthī śrāmyanbhūyopyasya na siddhiṃ samupaiti || tarhyāsaktaḥ karmaṇi kāmye tu kutosau saukhyaṃ yāyādakṣayamānandamahābdhe || 11 || bhaktyā nityaṃ tvāmata eva vayaṃ vai śraddhāyuktā dharmataponigamādyaiḥ || māyātītaṃ kālaniyantāramudāraṃ dhyāyāmaḥ śrīkāntaparātparamekam || 12 || indra uvāca || bhagavannuruduḥkhitā vayaṃ nanu durvāsasa eva helanāt || na bhavantamṛte'vituṃ hi no vidhirudrapramukhā ime'śakan || 13 || vigatākhilasaṃpado nirannāḥ samabhāvaṃ bhuvi pāmarairupetāḥ || bhavataiva vayaṃ hṛtāpadaḥ smaḥ sapadi śrīharaye namostu tubhyam || 14 || agniruvāca || gīrvāṇadānavanarādyupajīvanānnaṃ yannirmitaṃ hi bhavataiva tato budhāstu || yajñeṣu tena yajanaṃ tava kurvate'tho tvaccheṣamanyadiviṣadbhya upānayanti || 15 || kāmyeṣu karmasu ratā api yājñikāste tatkarmabandhanata āśu vimucya yānti || brāhmīṃ gatiṃ taditare tu bhavanti caurāḥ śrīyajñapūruṣamahaṃ praṇamāmi taṃ tvām || 16 || maruta ūcuḥ || bhaktā ekāntikāste'kṣaraparamapade sevayā te tu hīnaṃ vāsaiśvaryādi necchantyatiśayitasukhaṃ nāpi kaivalyamokṣam || tadyuktaṃ tvātmanopi śvapacakulajanurmānayantyuttamaṃ vai taṃ tvāmekāntadharmāśrayaṇamupagatāḥ śrīmahāpūruṣaṃ smaḥ || 17 || siddhā ūcuḥ || naikabrahmāṇḍasargādikāraṇaṃ tvāmakāraṇam || tatsthaṃ tadvyatiriktaṃ ca niyantāraṃ namāmahe|| || 18 || rudrā ūcuḥ || māyāyāḥ sarvamohinyā mohanaṃ mohavarjitam || mahākālasyāpi kālaṃ tvāṃ namaḥ puruṣottamam || 19 || ādityā ūcuḥ || prakāśitā yena vayaṃ jaganti prakāśayāmo bhavatā rameśa || svayaṃprakāśaṃ tamuruprakāśaṃ prakāśamūrttiṃ praṇatā bhavantam || 2.9.15.20 || sādhyā ūcuḥ || śāstā nṛpāṇāṃ ca mahoragāṇāṃ daityādhipānāṃ ca surādhipānām || tvaṃ vai manūnāṃ ca prajāpatīnāṃ rājādhirājāya namostu tubhyam || || 21 || vasava ūcuḥ || bhavati bhuvi yadāyadā'surāṃśaiḥ prathitasanātanadharmadhārmikāṇām || kadanamuru tadātadā svayaṃ te hyavatarate praṇamāma dharmagoptre || 22 || cāraṇā ūcuḥ || caritraṃ śubhaṃ te dhṛtānekamūrtteḥ prabandhairanekairhi gāyanti bhaktāḥ || yadu śrotṛvaktṝnpunātyeva sadyo vayaṃ taṃ natāḥ puṇyakīrttiṃ bhavantam || 23 || gandharvāpsarasa ūcuḥ || ye kathāste vihāyānyagāthāḥ prabho kīrttayante'tha śṛṇvanti vā te janāḥ || duḥkhitāḥ syuśca saṃsārapāśaiḥ sitāstaṃ natāḥ smaḥ śaraṇyaṃ bhavantaṃ vayam || 24 || samudra uvāca || ajita tavā'tha tāvakajanasya mudā'lpamapi draviṇa jalānnavastranamanānyatamena sakṛt || carati ha sevanaṃ sa padavīṃ mahatīṃ mahatāṃ vrajati janolpakopi tamahaṃ praṇataḥ karuṇam || 25 || pārṣadā ūcuḥ || pitaro tvamasi svajanastvamasi tvamasīṣṭaguruḥ suhṛdātmapatiḥ || tvamasīśvara eva ca naḥ paramastvamasi draviṇaṃ sakalaṃ tvamasi || || 26 || mūrttiruvāca || yatsaṃbandhata eva yānti padavīmuccāṃ mahadbhirnnutāṃ strīśūdrāsuranīcapakṣipaśavaḥ pāpātmajīvā api || yaddhīnā vibudheśvarā api bhavantyarccojjhitāstatkṣaṇaṃ golokādhipatiṃ tameva hṛdaye nityaṃ bhaje tvāmaham || 27 || sāvitryuvāca || tvaṃ sargakāle prakṛtiṃ ca pūruṣaṃ dṛṣṭyā svayotthāpya tatastadātmanā || tattvāni sṛṣṭvā mahadādimānitairnnaikānvirājo bahudhā sasarjitha || 28 || vairājarūpeṇa jagadvidhātṛtāṃ svīkṛtya devāsuramānuṣoragān || tvaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamamīśa nirmame tvāmādikartāramupāśritāsmyaham || || 29 || durgovāca || priyatayā'dhikayā hṛdi cintanaṃ vidadhate tava ye bhuvi te vibho || na parameṣṭhisukhaṃ na divaḥ sukhaṃ na kamayanti dharaikanareśatām || 2.9.15.30 || prasabhamarpitamapyatulaṃ tvayā sukhamidaṃ samavāpya ca tatra te || tadapahāya na śaktikṛtaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tamu namāmi ca sātvatanāyakam || 31 || nadya ūcuḥ || varada namanamātraṃ nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ vā vidadhati tava ye vai jñānato'jñānato vā || janimṛtiyamabhītestānapi trāyamāṇaṃ narasakhamupayātāḥ smo'dya nārāyaṇaṃ tvām || 32 || devapatnya ūcuḥ || bhuvi dhṛtākṛterjanma maṅgalaṃ caritamadbhutaṃ lokapāvanam || bhavati nirguṇaṃ sarvameva te bhavasi nirguṇabrahma yatparam || 33 || tava samāśrayāttāmasā janā api ca rājasāḥ sāttvikāśca ye || nanu bhavanti te nirguṇāstato vayamupāsmahe tvāṃ hi nirguṇam || 34 || ṛṣipatnya ūcuḥ || ārtānāmuruvṛjinaistridhā ca tāpaiḥ sarvāpatpraśamanamekameva viṣṇoḥ || pādābjaṃ tava bhavatīti tadvayaṃ vai prāptāḥ smaḥ śaraṇamananta devadeva || 35 || pṛthivyuvāca || pūrṇaśāradasudhākarānanaṃ śāradābjadaladīrghalocanam || śrīviyogabahudhārtimocanaṃ vā'sudevamahamekamāśraye || 36 || sarasvatyuvāca || nayane mamācyuta tavātisundare mukhaśītarociṣi cakoratāṃ gate || na hi gacchato'nyata itīyameva me hṛdi mūrtirastu satataṃ nahītarā || 37 || skanda uvāca || iti stuto'khilairdevaiḥ sobhinandya dṛśaiva tān || prāha śriyaṃ śubhe paśya devādīṃstvamimāniti || 38 || tataḥ samīkṣitāḥ prītyā tayā madhurayā dṛśā || trilokīvāsinaḥ sarve ṛddhā āsanyathā purā || 39 || lebhire svasvaṛddhiṃ te gṛhiṇastyāginopi ca || dharmādayaśca sānandaṃ pracaranti sma pūrvavat || 2.9.15.40 || tasyāḥ śriyaśca bhagavāndadau sthānamuraḥ svakam || tatra sthitvaiva sā vyāpattrailokyaṃ saṃpadātmanā || 41 || tato ratnākaraḥ svasmācchrījaneranubhāvataḥ || babhūvānvarthasaṃjño vai saṃpūrṇakṣayaratnavān || 42 || caturvidhairbahurasaiḥ sadannairamṛtopamaiḥ || sarvānsamāgatāṃstatra tarpayāmāsa sādaram || 43 || anarghyāṇi ca vastrāṇi ratnabhūṣāḥ paricchadān || devādibhyo dadau prītyā sarvebhyopi pṛthakpṛthak || 44 || jāmātustuṣṭaye svasya tadīyebhyastadāmbudheḥ || nāsītkimapyadeyaṃ vai ghanavaddhanavarṣiṇaḥ || 45 || bhagavānapi taddattaṃ yautakaṃ ca dhanaṃ bahu || brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāyaiva śriyā saha tirodadhe || 46 || lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhyāṃ te bhṛśamānanditāḥ surāḥ || indrādayo divaṃ jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ dhāmā'pare yayuḥ || 47 || adhikāraṃ ca saṃprāpya yathāpūrvaṃ nijaṃnijam || sarvepi sukhino jātāḥ prasādātkamalāpateḥ || 48 || mandaraṃ ca giriṃ tārkṣyaḥ punarbhagavadājñayā || svasthānaṃ samupānīya sthāpayāmāsa līlayā || 49 || evamindreṇa brahmarṣe naṣṭā brāhmaṇaśāpataḥ || upalabdhā punaḥ saṃpannārāyaṇaprasādataḥ || 2.9.15.50 || ya etāṃ śṛṇuyātpuṇyāṃ kathāṃ bhagavato mune || kīrtayetprayato vāpi saṃpadaṃ prāpnuto hi tau || 51 || gṛhiṇāṃ dhanasiddhiḥ syāttyāgināṃ ca yathepsitā || bhaktijñānavirāgāderbhavetsiddhiranena vai || 52 || iti te kathitaṃ brahmanyathendraḥ prāpa saṃpadam || nāradopi yathā śvetaṃ dvīpaṃ sa gatavānṛṣiḥ || tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikena caitasā || 53 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye lakṣmīnārāyaṇastutinirūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
<2.9.16>
|| skanda uvāca || meruśṛṃgaṃ samārūḍho nārado divyayā dṛśā || śvetadvīpaṃ ca tatrasthānpaśyanmuktānsahasraśaḥ || 1 || vāsudeve bhagavati dṛṣṭimābadhya tatkṣaṇam || utpapāta mahāyogī sadyaḥ prāpa ca dhāma tat || 2 || prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || dadarśa bhaktāṃstāneva śvetāṃścandraprabhāñchubhān || 3 || pūjayāmāsa śirasā manasā taiśca pūjitaḥ || didṛkṣurbrahma paramaṃ sa ca kṛcchraparaḥ sthitaḥ || 4 || bhaktamekāntikaṃ viṣṇorbuddhvā bhāgavatāstu te || tamūcustuṣṭamanaso japantaṃ dvādaśākṣaram || 5 || śvetamuktā ūcuḥ || munivarya bhavānbhaktaḥ kṛṣṇasyā'sti yato'tra naḥ || dṛṣṭavāndevadurdṛśyānkimicchannatha tapyati || 6 || nārada uvāca || bhagavantaṃ paraṃ brahma sākṣātkṛṣṇamahaṃ prabhum || draṣṭumutko'smi bhaktendrāstaṃ darśayata tatpriyāḥ ||7|| skanda uvāca || tadaikaḥ śvetamuktastu kṛṣṇena prerito hṛdi || ehi te darśaye kṛṣṇamityuktvā puratobhavat ||8|| prahṛṣṭo nāradastena sākamākāśavartmanā || paśyandhāmāni devānāṃ tata ūrddhvaṃ yayau muniḥ || 9 || saptarṣīṃśca dhruvaṃ dṛṣṭvā'nāsaktaḥ kutracitsa ca || maharjanatapolokānvyatīyāya dvijottama||2.9.16.10|| brahmalokaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā śvetamuktānugo muniḥ || kṛṣṇasyaivecchayā'dhvānaṃ prāpāṣṭāvaraṇeṣvapi||11|| bhūmyaptejonilākāśāhammahatprakṛtīḥ kramāt || krāntvā daśottaraguṇāḥ prāpa golokamadbhutam ||12|| dhāma tejomayaṃ taddhi prāpyamekāntikairhareḥ|| gacchandadarśa vitatāmagādhāṃ virajāṃ nadīm||13|| gopīgopagaṇasnānadhautacandanasaurabhām|| puṇḍarīkaiḥ kokanadai ramyāmindīvarairapi||14|| tasyāstaṭaṃ manohāri sphaṭikāśmamayaṃ mahat|| prāpa śvetaharidraktapītasanmaṇirājitam||15|| kalpavṛkṣālibhirjjuṣṭaṃ pravālāṅkuraśobhitam|| syamantakendranīlādimaṇīnāṃ khanimaṇḍitam || 16 || nānāmaṇīndranicitasopānatatiśobhanam || kūjadbhirmadhuraṃ
