juṣṭaṃ haṃsakāraṇḍavādibhiḥ || 17 || vṛndaiḥ kāmadughānāṃ ca gajendrāṇāṃ ca vājinām || pibadbhirnnirmalaṃ toyaṃ rājitaṃ sa vyatikramat || 18 || uttīryā'tha dhunī divyāṃ tatkṣaṇādīśvarecchayā || taddhāmaparikhābhūtāṃ śataśṛṅgāgamāpa saḥ || 19 || hiraṇmayaṃ darśanīyaṃ koṭiyojanamucchritam || vistāre daśakoṭyastu yojanānāṃ manoharam || 2.9.16.20 || sahasraśaḥ kalpavṛkṣaiḥ pārijātādibhirdrumaiḥ || mallikāyūthikābhiśca lavaṅgailālatādibhiḥ || 21 || svarṇarambhādibhiścānyaiḥ śobhamānaṃ mahīruhaiḥ || divyairmṛgagaṇairnnāgaiḥ pakṣibhiśca sukūjitaiḥ || 22 || durgāyitasya taddhāmnastasya ramyeṣu sānuṣu || manojñānvitatānaikṣadbhagavadrāsamaṇḍapān || 23 || vṛtānudyānatatibhiḥ phullapuṣpasugandhibhiḥ || kapāṭai ratnanicitaiścaturdvārasuśobhanān || 24 || citratoraṇasaṃpannai ratnastambhaiḥ sahasraśaḥ || juṣṭāṃśca kadalīstambhairmuktālambairvitānakaiḥ || 25 || dūrvālājākṣataphalairyuktānmāṅgalikairapi || candanāgurukastūrīkeśarokṣita catvarān || 26 || suśrāvyavādyaninadairhṛdyānbahuvidhairapi || teṣu yūthāni gopīnāṃ koṭiśaḥ sa dadarśa ha || 27 || anarghyavāsobhūṣābhiḥ sadratnamaṇikaṅkaṇaiḥ || kāñcīnūpurakeyūraiḥ śobhitānyaṅgulīyakaiḥ || 28 || tāruṇyarūpalāvaṇyaiḥ svaraiścā'pratimāni hi || rādhālakṣmīsavarṇāni śṛṅgārikakarāṇi ca || 29 || bhogadravyairbahuvidhairmaṇḍapeṣu yuteṣu ca || vilasanti ca gāyanti manojñāḥ kṛṣṇagītikāḥ || 2.9.16.30 || upatyakāsu tasyādreratha vṛndāvanābhidham || vanaṃ mahattadadrākṣītsāvarṇe nārado muniḥ || 31 || kṛṣṇasya rādhikāyāśca priyaṃ tatkrīḍanasthalam|| kalpadrumālibhī ramyaṃ sarobhiśca sapaṅkajaiḥ || 32 || āmrairāmrātakairnīpairbadarībhiśca dāḍimaiḥ || kharjūrīpūganāraṃgairnnālikeraiśca candanaiḥ || 33 || jambūjambīrapanasairakṣodaiḥ suradārubhiḥ || kadalībhiścampakaiśca drākṣābhiḥ svarṇaketakaiḥ || 34 || phalapuṣpabharānamrairnnānāvṛkṣairvirājitam || mallikā mādhavīkundairllavaṃgairyūthikādibhiḥ || 35 || mandaśītasugandhena sevitaṃ mātariśvanā || śataśṛṅgasnutairārdraṃ nirjharaiśca samantataḥ || 36 || sadā vasanta śobhāḍhyaṃ ratnadīpālimaṇḍitaiḥ || śṛṅgārikadravyayutaiḥ kuñjairjuṣṭamanekaśaḥ || 37 || gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca kṛṣṇasaṃkīrttanairmuhuḥ || govatsa pakṣininadairnnānābhūṣaṇanisvanaiḥ || dadhimanthanaśabdaiśca sarvato nāditaṃ mune || 38 || phullapuṣpaphalānamranānādrumasuśobhanaiḥ || dvātriṃśatavanairanyairyuktaṃ paśyamanoharaiḥ || 39 || tadvīkṣya hṛṣṭaḥ sa prāpa golokapuramujvalam || vartulaṃ ratnadurgaṃ ca rājamārgopaśobhitam || 2.9.16.40 || rājitaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ vimānaiḥ koṭibhistathā || rathai ratnendrakhacitaiḥ kiṃkiṇījālaśobhitaiḥ || 41 || mahāmaṇīndranikarai ratnastambhālimaṇḍitaiḥ || adbhutaiḥ koṭiśaḥ saudhaiḥ paṃktisaṃsthairmanoharam || 42 || vilāsamaṇḍapai ramyai ratnasāravinirmitaḥ || ratnendradīpatatibhiḥ śobhanaṃ ratnavedibhiḥ || 43 || kesarāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitam || dadhidūrvālājapūgai rambhābhiḥ śobhitāṅgaṇam || 44 || vāripūrṇairhemaghaṭaistoraṇaiḥ kṛtamaṃgalam || maṇikuṭṭimarājādhvacaladbhūrigajāśvakam || 45 || śrīkṛṣṇadarśanāyātairnnaikabrahmāṇḍanāyakaiḥ || viriñciśaṃkarādyaiśca balihastaiḥ susaṃkulam ||46|| vrajadbhiḥ kṛṣṇavīkṣātha gopagopīkadambakaiḥ || susaṃkulamahāmārgaṃ mumodālokya tanmuniḥ ||47|| kṛṣṇamandiramāpā'tha sarvāścaryaṃ manoharam || nandādivṛṣabhānvādigopasaudhālibhirvṛtam || 48 || caturdvāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdurgaiḥ saparikhairyutam|| koṭigopavṛtaikaikadvārapālasurakṣitaiḥ || 49 || ratnastambhakapāṭeṣu dvārṣu svāgrasthiteṣu saḥ || upaviṣṭānkrameṇaiva dvārapālāndadarśa ha ||2.9.16.50|| vīrabhānuṃ candrabhānuṃ sūryabhānuṃ tṛtīyakam || vasubhānuṃ devabhānuṃ śakrabhānuṃ tataḥ param || 51 || ratnabhānuṃ supārśvaṃ ca viśālamṛṣabhaṃ tataḥ || aṃśuṃ balaṃ ca subalaṃ devaprasthaṃ varūthapam || 52 || śrīdāmānaṃ ca natvā'sau praviṣṭoṃtastadājñayā || mahācatuṣke vitate tejo'paśyanmahoccayam || 53 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye golokavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||16||
<2.9.17>
|| skanda uvāca || tattvekakālasaṃbhūtakoṭikoṭyarkasannibham || sa vyacaṣṭa mahattejo divyaṃ sitataraṃ mune ||1|| diśaśca vidiśaḥ sarvā ūrddhvādho vyāpnuvacca yat|| akṣaraṃ brahma kathitaṃ saccidānandalakṣaṇam || 2 || prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ cobhau tatkāryāṇyapi sarvaśaḥ || vyāptaṃ yadyogasaṃsiddhāḥ ṣaṭcakrāṇi nijāntare || vyatītya mūrdhni paśyanti vāsudevaprasādataḥ || 3 || yadbhāsā bhāsitaḥ sūryo vahnirinduśca tārakāḥ || bhāsayanti jagatsarvaṃ svaprakāśaṃ tathāmṛtam || 4 || yadbrahmapuramityāhurbhagavaddhāma sātvatāḥ || yasyāntikeṣu paritastiṣṭhantyarcakakoṭayaḥ || 5 || brahmaśaṃkara vṛndāni hyuparyupari saṃbhramāt || patanti balihastāni gopagopīvrajāśca yat || 6 || kṛṣṇasyānugraho yasminsa tejasi tamīkṣate || kevalaṃ teja evānye paśyanti na tu taṃ mune || 7 || tasmindadarśādbhutadivyamandiraṃ vicitraratnendramayaṃ manojñam || ratnojjvalastambhasahasrakāntaṃ mahāsabhā maṇḍapadarśanīyam || 8 || saudhālibhirbhūribhirujjvalābhiḥ svopāsakānāṃ parito virājitam || vicitrasūkṣmāmbararatnabhūṣāvibhūṣitānāṃ hi nṛṇāṃ ca yoṣitām || 9 || siṃhāsanaṃ tatra maṇīndrasārai ratnendrasāraiśca vinirmitaṃ saḥ || āścaryakṛnprekṣakamānasānāṃ divya muniḥ praikṣata bhūriharṣaḥ ||2.9.17.10|| tatrā'tha kṛṣṇaṃ bhagavantamaikṣannārāyaṇaṃ nirguṇamāsthitaṃ saḥ || sarvajñamīśaṃ puruṣottamaṃ ca yaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca vadanti sātvatāḥ || 11 || yaṃ kecidāhuḥ paramātmasaṃjñaṃ kecitparaṃ brahma parātparaṃ ca || brahmeti kecidbhagavantameke viṣṇuṃ ca bhaktāḥ parameśvaraṃ ca||12|| kandarpasāhasramanoharāṅgaṃ sadā kiśoraṃ karuṇānidhānam || atipraśāṃtākṛtidarśanīyaṃ kṣarākṣarebhyaśca paraṃ svatantram || 13 || naikāṇḍasargasthitināśalīlāvidhāyakāpāṃganirīkṣaṇaṃ ca || anekakoṭyaṇḍamahādhirājaṃ viśvaikavandyaṃ naṭavaryaveṣam || 14 || anarghyadivyottamapītavāsasamanekasadratnavibhūṣaṇāḍhyam || navīnajīmūtasamānavarṇaṃ karṇollasatsanmakarābhakuṇḍalam || 15 || nijāṃganiryatsitabhūritejaścayāvṛtatvātsitavarṇamuktam || sadratnasārojjvalasatkirīṭaṃ śaratsarojacchadacārunetram || 16 || sugandhisaccandanacarcitāṃgaṃ śrīvatsalakṣmāṅkitahṛtkapāṭam || ninādayantaṃ madhuraṃ ca veṇuṃ kṛtvā mukhāgrembujacārudorbhyām || 17|| jayāsuśīlālalitāmukhānāṃ vṛndaiḥ sakhīnāṃ saha rādhayā ca || samarcyamānaṃ ramayā ca bhāmā kalindajā jāmbavatīmukhānām ||18|| dharmeṇa vedairakhilairbhagaiśca jñānādibhiḥ saṃyatapāṇiyugmaiḥ || niṣevyamāṇaṃ ca sudarśanādyairnijāyudhairmūrtidharairanekaiḥ || 19 || masāramāṇikyasuvarṇavarṇaiḥ sitaiśca kaiścinnijapārṣadāgryaiḥ || upāsitaṃ cakragadābjaśaṅkhalasadbhujairnandasunandamukhyaiḥ || 2.9.17.20 || śrīdāmamukhyairatha gopaveṣairbhaktyāvanamrairdvibhujairanekaiḥ || upāsyamānaṃ garuḍena cāgrato vibhūtibhiścāṣṭabhirānatābhiḥ || 21 || mūrtyā ca śāntyā dayayā ca sevitaṃ puṣṭyā ca tuṣṭyā hyatha medhayā ca || śraddhākriyā hyunnatibhiśca maitryā tathā titikṣāsmṛtibuddhibhiśca || 22 || dṛṣṭvā tamatyadbhutadivyamūrtti tadrūpasaurabhyahṛtākhilendriyaḥ || ānandavāripratiruddhadṛṣṭiḥ premṇorddhvaromā sukhasaṃbhṛto'bhūt || 23 || daṇḍavattaṃ namaskṛtya nāradaḥ premavihvalaḥ || baddhāñjalipuṭastasthau vīkṣamāṇastadānanam || 24 || taṃ mānayāmāsa hariḥ pṛṣṭvā svāgatamādarāt || bhaktamekāntikaṃ svasya svenaiva ca didṛkṣitam || 25 || bhagavadvākyapīyūṣāsvādaprāptātmasaṃsmṛtiḥ || taddarśanamahānando bhaktyā tuṣṭāva taṃ muniḥ || 26 || nārada uvāca || jaya śrīkṛṣṇa bhagavannārāyaṇa jagatprabho || vāsudevā'khilāvāsa sadaikāntikavallabha || 27 || apyāścaryārcanīyāṅghre rādhikākamalādibhiḥ || tvamevātyantikaṃ śreyo'bhīpsatāṃ paramā gatiḥ || 28 || nityānāmātmanāṃ nitya ātmā cetanacetanaḥ || kṣarākṣarebhyaśca parastvaṃ brahma paramaṃ hare || 29 || yathā viśuddhiḥ siddhiśca bhaktyā paramayā tava || tathā na syānnṛṇāmanyaiḥ sādhanaistapa ādibhiḥ || 2.9.17.30 || tvadaṅghridivyajyotsnaikā mumukṣūṇāṃ hṛdi sthitam || mahatsantamasaṃhartuṃ sadyaḥ śaktāsti satpate || 31 || sarvairvedaistvamevejya upāsyo jñeya eva ca || nirūpitosi bhagavansarvakāraṇakāraṇam || 32 || ekaikasminromakūpe yattavāsti sitaṃ mahaḥ || śāntamānaṃdarūpaṃ ca tatkoṭīnduprabhādhikam || 33 || asmiṃstvamakṣare dhāmni nirguṇe'mṛtasañjñake || mahaḥpuñje sadaivāsse nirguṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 34 || brahmāṇḍabhayadātkālānmāyāyāśca mahābhayāt || muktā bhaktā bhavantyeva tvadīyopāsanābalāt || 35 || taṃ tvāmahamupetosmi śaraṇaṃ jagadīśvaram || sarvātmānaṃ vibhuṃ brahma mahāpuruṣamacyutam || 36 || yathā tvaccaraṇāmbhoje bhaktirme niścalā sadā || bhavettathaiva deveśa karttumarhasyanugraham || 37 || || skanda uvāca || itthaṃ devarṣiṇā bhaktyā saṃstutaḥ parameśvaraḥ || tamāhānandayanvācā sudhāsaṃmitayā munim || 38 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye śrīvāsudevadarśanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<2.9.18>
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || darśanaṃ mama yajjātaṃ tava tattu mahāmune || nityaikāntikabhaktatvānnirdambhatvānmadicchayā || 1 || ahiṃsā brahmacaryaṃ ca tvayi nityaṃ ca taddvayam || svadharmopaśamau caiva vairāgyaṃ cātmavedanam || 2 || satsaṅgo'ṣṭāṅgayogaśca sarvathendriyanigrahaḥ || munyannavṛttiśca tapaḥ sarvavyasanahīnatā || 3 || madekāntikabhaktiśca mahātmyajñānapūrvikā || varttate tena māmatra paśyasi tvaṃ hi suvrata || 4 || īdṛglakṣaṇasaṃpannā ye syuranyepi mānavāḥ || tepi māmīdṛśaṃ vipra paśyantyekāntikapriyam || 5 || asāvahamiha brahmannasminnakṣaradhāmani || rādhālakṣmīyuto nityaṃ vasāmi svāśritaiḥ saha || 6 || vāsudevasvarūpohaṃ sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ || antaryāmitayā vartte svatantraḥ sarvadehinām || 7 || vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ mahādhāmni lakṣmyā saha caturbhujaḥ || vasāmi nandagaruḍamukhyaiḥ sākaṃ ca pārṣadaiḥ || 8 || dhāmni tejomaye divye śvetadvīpe'nvahaṃ bhuvi || dadāmi śvetamuktebhyaḥ pañcakālaṃ svadarśanam || 9|| kurve'niruddhapradyumnasaṃkarṣaṇasamāhvayaiḥ || svarūpairnaikakoṭyaṇḍasargasthityapyayānaham ||2.9.18.10|| sargārambhe mayā brahmā sṛṣṭo nābhisaroruhāt || tapasārādhayāmāsa sa māṃ yajñaiśca nārada ||11|| tatastasmai prasanno'haṃ prādadāmīpsitānvarān || brahmanprāsyasi sāmarthyaṃ prajānāṃ tvaṃ visarjane || 12 || ājñāyāmeva tāḥ sarvāstava sthāsyanti madvarāt || vedāścāpi sphuriṣyanti tava buddhau sanātanāḥ || 13 || jñānaṃ ca matsvarūpasya yathāvatte bhaviṣyati || tvayā kṛtāṃ ca maryādāṃ nātikraṃsyati kaścana || 14 || surāsuragaṇānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca mahātmanām || tvameva varado brahmanvarepsūnāṃ bhaviṣyasi || 15|| asādhye yatra kārye ca mohameṣyasi tattvaham|| prādurbhūya kariṣyami smṛtamātrastvayā vidhe || 16 || sṛjyamāne tvayā viśve naṣṭāṃ pṛthvīṃ mahārṇave || ānayiṣyāmi svaṃ sthānaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ || hiraṇyākṣaṃ nihatyaiva daiteyaṃ balagarvitam || 17 || dinānte tava matsyohaṃ bhūtvā kṣoṇīṃ tarīmiva || sahauṣadhiṃ dhārayiṣye manvādīṃśca niśāvadhi || 18 || sudhāyai mathnatāmabdhiṃ kāśyapānāṃ nirāśrayam || manthānaṃ kūrmarūpohaṃ dhāsye pṛṣṭhe ca mandaram || 19 || nārasiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā hiraṇyakaśipuṃ vidhe || surakārye haniṣyāmi yajñaghnaṃ ditinandanam || 2.9.18.20 || virocanasya balavānbaliḥ putro mahāsuraḥ || bhaviṣyati sa śakraṃ ca svārājyāccyāvayiṣyati || 21 || trailokye'pahṛte tena vimukhe ca śacīpatau || adityāṃ dvādaśaḥ putraḥ saṃbhaviṣyāmi kaśyapāt || 22 || tato rājyaṃ pradāsyāmi devendrāya divaḥ punaḥ || devatāḥ sthāpayiṣyāmi sveṣu sthāneṣvahaṃ vidhe || baliṃ caiva kariṣyāmi pātālatalavāsinam ||23|| kardamāddevahūtyāṃ ca bhūtvā'tha kapilābhidhaḥ || pravartayiṣye kālena naṣṭaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ virāgayuk ||24|| datto bhūtyā'nasūyayāmatrerānvikṣikīṃ tataḥ || prahlādāyopadekṣyāmi vidyāṃ ca yadave vidhe || 25 || merudevyāṃ suto nābherbhūtvāhamṛṣabho bhuvi || dharmaṃ pāramahaṃsyākhyaṃ vartayiṣye sanātanam || 26 || tretāyuge bhaviṣyāmi rāmo bhṛgukulodvahaḥ || kṣatraṃ cotsādayiṣyāmi bhagnasetukadadhvagam|| || 27 || sandhau tu samanuprāpte tretāyā dvāparasya ca || kauśalyāyāṃ bhaviṣyāmi rāmo daśarathādaham || 28 || sītābhidhānā lakṣmīśca bhavitrī janakātmajā || udvahiṣyāmi tāmaiśaṃ bhaṃktvā dhanurahaṃ mahat ||29|| tato rakṣaḥpatiṃ ghoraṃ devarṣidrohakāriṇam || sītāpahāriṇaṃ saṃkhye haniṣyāmi sahānujam || 2.9.18.30 || tasya me tu caritrāṇi vālmīkyādyā maharṣayaḥ || tadā gāsyanti bahudhā yacchruteḥ syādaghakṣayaḥ || 31 || dvāparasya kaleścaiva sandhau paryavasānike || bhūbhārāsuranāśārthaṃ pātuṃ dharmaṃ ca dhārmikān || vasudevādbhaviṣyāmi devakyāṃ mathurāpure || 32 || kṛṣṇohaṃ vāsudevākhyastathā saṃkarṣaṇo balaḥ || pradyumnaścā'niruddhaśca bhaviṣyanti yadoḥ kule || 33 || gopasya vṛṣabhānostu sutā rādhā bhaviṣyati || vṛndāvane tayā sākaṃ vihariṣyāmi padmaja || 34 || lakṣmīśca bhīṣmakasutā rukmiṇyākhyā bhaviṣyati || udvahiṣyāmi rājanyānyuddhe nirjitya tāmaham || 35 || dharmadruho'surānhatvā tadāviṣṭāṃśca bhūpatīn || dharmaṃ saṃsthāpayanneva kariṣye nirbharāṃ bhuvam || 36 || yena kenāpi bhāvena yasya kasyāpi mānasam || mayi saṃyokṣyate taṃtaṃ neṣye brahmagatiṃ parām || 37 || dharmaṃ bhuvi sthāpayitvā kṛtvā yadukulakṣayam || paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāmantarddhāsye bhuvastataḥ || || 38 || kṛṣṇasya mama vīryāṇi kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādayaḥ || gāsyanti bahudhā brahmansadyaḥ pāpaharāṇi hi || 39 || kṛṣṇadvaipāyano bhūtvā parāśaramuneḥ sutaḥ || śākhāvibhāgaṃ vedasya kariṣyāmi taroriva || 2.9.18.40 || vaidikaṃ vidhimāśritya trilokīparipīḍakān || chalena mohayiṣyāmi bhūtvā buddho'surānaham|| 41 || mayā kṛṣṇena nihatāḥ sārjunena raṇeṣu ye || pravartayiṣyantyasurāste tvadharmaṃ yadā kṣitau ||42|| dharmadevāttadā bhaktādahaṃ nārāyaṇo muniḥ|| janiṣye kośale deśe bhūmau hi sāmago dvijaḥ||43|| muniśāpānnṛtāṃ prāptānṛṣīṃstāta tathoddhavam|| tato'vitāsurebhyo'haṃ saddharmaṃ sthāpayannaja||44|| janānmlecchamayānbhūmau kalerante mahainasaḥ || kalkī bhūtvā haniṣyāmi vicarandivyavājinā|| 45|| yadā yadā ca vedokto dharmo nāśiṣyate'suraiḥ|| prādurbhāvo bhaviṣyo me tadrakṣāyai tadā tadā || 46 || tasmāccintāṃ vihāyaiva prajāḥ sṛja yathā purā || etāndattvā varāṃstasmā ahamantarhito'bhavam || 47 || yathā tasmai varā dattāstathaiva ca mayā kṛtam || kurve kariṣye ca mune nijaśaktibhirañjasā || 48 || evaṃvidhasya me brahmannīśituḥ sarvadehinām || darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ jātaṃ tavaikāntikabhaktitaḥ || 49 || varaṃ varaya mattastvaṃ svābhīṣṭaṃ munisattama || prasannosmi bhṛśaṃ tubhyaṃ nāphalaṃ mama darśanam||2.9.18.50|| skanda uvāca || śrutveti bhagavadvākyaṃ nārado munisattamaḥ || manyamāno nijaṃ dhanyaṃ tamuvāca prabhuṃ mune||51|| darśanādeva te svāminsaṃpūrṇo me manorathaḥ || idaṃ hi durlabhaṃ manye sarveṣāmapi dehinām || 52 || ataste ca tvadīyānāṃ tvaddhāmnosyā'mṛtasya ca || sākṣātsamīkṣaṇādanyatprāpyaṃ me nāsti vāṃchitam || 53 || itonyaddurlabhaṃ kvāpi nāsti brahmāṇḍagolake || yadahaṃ parituṣṭātte prārthayeyamihācyuta || 54 || lokāntarasukhaṃ yattadvaidikaireva karmabhiḥ || daivaiḥ pitryaiśca labhyeta taccāpyasti hi naśvaram || 55 || necchāmi tadahaṃ kiñcitsukhaṃ tvattaḥ paraṃ prabho || varamekaṃ tu yāce tvatsvepsitaṃ varadarṣabhāt || 56 || tavā'tha tava bhaktānāṃ sadaiva guṇagāyane || atyutsukāstu me buddhistvayi prītivivarddhinī || 57 || || skanda uvāca || tathāstviti pratiśrutya kṛṣṇasteneti yācitam || gānopayuktāṃ mahatīṃ vīṇāṃ dattvā'bravītpunaḥ || 58 || śrībhagavānuvāca || adhunā gaccha devarṣe viśālāṃ badarīmitaḥ || tatra dharmātmajaṃ bhaktyā māmārādhaya suvrata || 59 || tvaṃ hyekāntikabhaktosi mama niṣkapaṭāntaraḥ || tena tvāmadhikaṃ manye vidherapi pitustava || 2.9.18.60 || yādṛśo'haṃ ca yadrūpo yāvāṃśca mahimā mama || vidustatsarvamapi me bhaktā ekāntikā mune |||| 61 || hṛdi cintyohamevāsmi satāṃ teṣāṃ ca te mama || teṣāmiṣṭaṃ na matto'nyanmama tebhyo na kiñcana || 62 || yathā pativratā nāryo vaśīkurvanti satpatim || nijairguṇaistathā bhaktā vaśīkurvanti māmapi || 63 || anuyāmi śriyā sākaṃ tānahaṃ paravāniva || yatrayatra ca te santi tatratatrāhamasmi hi || 64 || satsaṃgādeva matprāptirbhavedbhuvi mumukṣatām || nānyopāyena devarṣe satyamityavadhāraya || 65 || māmeva yarhi śaraṇaṃ mānuṣāḥ prāpnuvanti ye || tarhyeva te vimucyante māyāyā jīvabandhanāt || 66 || māṃ prapannastu puruṣo yena kenāpi bhāvataḥ || yatheṣṭaṃ sukhamāpnoti na tu saṃsṛtimanyavat || 67 || skanda uvāca || evamukto bhagavatā prāpto'nugrahamīpsitam || praṇamya sāśrunayanaḥ paryāvartata nāradaḥ || 68 || tameva vīṇayā gāyañchvetamuktamapaśyata || prāgvatsvāgre calantaṃ tamanvagacchad dvijarṣabha || 69 || sadyaḥ śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ prāpya śvetānpraṇamya tān || nivṛtto nārado brahmaṃstarasā merumāgamat || 2.9.18.70 || tato meroḥ pracakrāma parvataṃ gandhamādanam || nipapāta ca khāttūrṇaṃ viśālāṃ badarīmanu ||71|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye śrīvāsudevāvatārādikathanaṃnāmā'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||
<2.9.19>
|| skanda uvāca || tataḥ sa dadṛśe devau purāṇāvṛṣisattamau || tapaścarantau sumahadātmaniṣṭhau mahāvratau ||1|| tejasāpyadhikau sūryātsarvalokavirocanāt || śrīvatsalakṣaṇau pūjyau jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇau ||2|| padmacihnabhujau tau ca pādayoścakralakṣaṇau|| vyūḍhoraskau dīrghabhujau sitasūkṣmaghanāṃśukau || 3 || svāsyau pṛthulalāṭau ca subhruvau śubhanāsikau || śubhalakṣaṇasaṃpannau divyamūrttī ghanaprabhau || 4 || vinayenāntikaṃ prāpya tayoḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || bhaktyā praṇamya sāṣṭāṅgaṃ tasthau prāñjaliragrataḥ || 5 || tatastau tapasāṃ vāsau yaśasāṃ tejasāmapi || ṛṣī paurvāhṇikasyānte vidhermaunaṃ vihāya ca || 6 || prītyā nāradamavyagrau pādyārghyābhyāṃ samārcatām || pīṭhayorupaviṣṭau tau kauśayornāradaśca saḥ|| ||7|| teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu sa deśobhivyarājata || ājyāhutimahājvālairyajñavāṭognibhiryathā || 8 || atha nārāyaṇastatra nāradaṃ vākyamabravīt || sukhopaviṣṭaṃ viśrāntaṃ kṛtātithyaṃ susatkṛtam || 9 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || api brahmansa bhagavānparamātmā sanātanaḥ || brahmadhāmni tvayā dṛṣṭa āvayo kāraṇaṃ param || 2.9.19.10 || nārada uvāca || bhagavaṃstvatprasādena tamahaṃ parameśvaram || vāsudevaṃ samāloke sthitamakṣaradhāmani || 11 || iha caivāgatastena visṛṣṭo vāṃ niṣevitum || āsiṣye tatparo bhūtvā yuvābhyāṃ saha nityaśaḥ || 12 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || dhanyosyanugṛhītosi yatte dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || nahi taṃ dṛṣṭavānbrahmankaściddevopi vā ṛṣiḥ ||13|| bhaktyaikāntikayā tasya prāptā akṣarasāmyatām|| ye hi bhaktāsta evainaṃ paśyantyakhilakāraṇam||14|| sa divyamūrttirbhagavāndurddarśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || nāradaitaddhi me satyaṃ vacanaṃ samudāhṛtam || 15|| nānyo bhaktātpriyataro loke tasyāsti kaścana || tataḥ svayaṃ darśitavāṃstavātmānaṃ dvijottama || 16 || tejaḥpuñjābhiruddhāṃgo guṇātītādbhutākṛtiḥ || akhaṇḍānandarūpaśca sadā śuddho'cyutosti saḥ || 17 || rūpavarṇavayovasthāḥ prākṛtā naiva tasya hi || sarvaṃ tasyāsti taddivyaṃ sarvopakaraṇāni ca || ekāntikānāṃ bhaktānāṃ sa eva paramā gatiḥ || 18 || ātmabrahmaikyasaṃpannairvinivṛttaguṇairapi || kriyate vāsudevasya bhaktiritthaṃguṇo hi saḥ || 19|| māhātmyamasya ko vaktuṃ śaknuyātparamātmanaḥ || acintyānantaśaktīnāmadhipasya mahāmune || 2.9.19.20 || ātmātmā cākṣarātmā ca hyeṣa ākāśanirmalaḥ || divyadṛgīkṣyaḥ sanmātraḥ puruṣo vasudevajaḥ || 21 || samastakalyāṇaguṇo nirguṇaśceśvareśvaraḥ || parayā vidyayā vedya upāsyo brahmavitprabhuḥ || 22 || divyamūrttiṃ tamīśānaṃ tapasaikāntikena ca || yaḥ prīṇayati dharmeṇa sa dhanyatama ucyate || 23 || tasmāttvamapi devarṣe dharmeṇaikāntikena tam || ārādhayannihaivāṃga kaṃcitkālaṃ tapaḥ kuru || 24 || tapasaivā'tiśuddhātmā māhātmyaṃ tasya satpateḥ || yathāvajjñāsyati bhavānprocyamānaṃ mayā'khilam || 25 || sarvārthasādhanaṃ viddhi tapastaddhṛdayaṃ mune || nātaptabhūritapasā sa vaśīkriyate prabhuḥ || 26 || || skanda uvāca || evamukto bhagavatā naranārāyaṇena saḥ || prītastapaḥ karttumiccham̐stamuvāca mahāmatiḥ ||27|| iti śrīskande mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsu'devamāhātmye nāradanaranārāyaṇasamāgamo nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||19||
<2.9.20>
|| nārada uvāca || bhagavanbrūhi me dharmamekāntaṃ tava saṃmatam || prīyate yena viśvātmā vāsudevaḥ sa sarvadā || 1 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā brahmanmatiste vimalā kila || mayi snigdhāya bhaktāya tubhyaṃ guhyamapi bruve || || 2 || dharma eṣa mayā proktaḥ kalpasyādau vivasvate || tameva kathaye tubhyaṃ sanātanamahaṃ mune ||3|| svadharmajñānavairāgyaiḥ saha lakṣmīvadīśvare || tasminnananyā bhaktiryā dharma ekāntikaḥ sa vai || 4 || tenaivātiprasannaḥ syādgolokādhipatiḥ svayam || jāyate sa ca bhaktopi paripūrṇamanorathaḥ || 5 || || nārada uvāca || lakṣaṇāni bubhutsāmi svadharmādeḥ pṛthakpṛthak || śāstrayonerahaṃ tvatto vaktuṃ tāni tvamarhasi || 6 || nigamāgamaśāstrāṇāṃ sarveṣāmapi satpate || mūlaṃ tvameka evāsi yeṣu dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 7 || tvameva sākṣādbhagavānvāsudevo'kṣarātparaḥ || śreyase sarvabhūtānāṃ vartase'tra dayānidhiḥ || 8 || tvatto'nye tu svasvabhāvaguṇatantrā hyajādayaḥ || yathāvanna vijānīyurddharmādīṃstvamato vada || 9 || skanda uvāca || iti devarṣiṇā pṛṣṭo bhagavāndharmanandanaḥ || svadharmādīnkrameṇaiva kathayāmāsa sarvavit || 2.9.20.10 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca sadācāraḥ pṛthakpṛthak || sāmānyaḥ saviśeṣaśca svadharmaḥ sa udīryate || 11 || nṛṇāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ dharmaṃ sarveṣāmāditaḥ śṛṇu || ahiṃsā paramo dharmastatrādima udāhṛtaḥ || 12 || svamukhyadharmavṛtyorapyadroho manasāpi yaḥ || sati gatyantare prāṇimātrasyāpīti sā matā || 13 || satyā vāgbhūtamātrasya droho na syādyayā tathā || tapaśca śāstravihitabhogasaṃkocalakṣaṇam || 14 || bāhyamābhyantaraṃ ceti dvividhaṃ śaucakarma ca || anādānaṃ parasvasya parokṣaṃ vā chalena ca || 15 || yathocitaṃ brahmacaryakāmalobhakrudhāṃ jayaḥ || mudā vittārpaṇaṃ pātre tuṣṭirlabdhena daivataḥ || 16 || tīrthe kṣetre ca yajñādau caturvargāptayepi vā || ātmano vā parasyāpi sarvathā ghātavarjanam || 17|| jātibhraṃśakarāṇāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ parivarjanam || pāṇipādodaropasthavācāṃ saṃyamanaṃ tathā || 18 || sarveṣāṃ vyasanānāṃ ca varjanaṃ madyamāṃsayoḥ || vyabhicārānnivṛttiśca kulasaddharmapālanam || 19 || ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ yamaiḥ sākamupoṣaṇam || harerjanmadinānāṃ ca vratācaraṇamañjasā || 2.9.20.20 || ārjavaṃ sādhusevā ca vibhajyā'nnādibhojanam || bhaktirbhagavataśceti dharmāḥ sādhāraṇā nṛṇām || 21 || brahmakṣatraviśaḥ śūdrā varṇāścatvāra īritāḥ || teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthagdharmānviśeṣānvacmi te mune ||22|| śamo damaḥ kṣamā śaucamāstikyaṃ bhaktirīśituḥ || tapo jñānaṃ ca vijñānaṃ vipradharmaḥ svabhāvajaḥ || 23 || śūratvaṃ dhairyamaudārya balaṃ tejaḥ śaraṇyatā|| goviprasādhurakṣejyā dharmāḥ kṣatrasya kīrttitāḥ || 24 || rājñastvete'tha nītyaiva prajānāṃ paripālanam || dharmasaṃsthāpanaṃ bhūmau dharmā daṇḍārhadaṇḍanam || 25 || āstikyaṃ dānaniṣṭhā ca sādhubrāhmaṇasevanam || atuṣṭirarthopacaye dharmā vaiśyasya codyamaḥ || 26 || dvijātīnāṃ ca devānāṃ sevā niṣkapaṭaṃ gavām || viśeṣadharmaḥ kathitaḥ śūdrasya munisattama || 27 || adhyāpanaṃ yājanaṃ ca viśuddhācca pratigrahaḥ || viprasya jīvikā proktā tatrāntyā tvāpadi smṛtā || 28 || yājane'dhyāpane vāpi doṣadarśī dvijottamaḥ || yastasyā'nyāpi vihitā vṛttirasti caturvidhā || 29 || śiloñcha nityayācñā ca śālīnaṃ cocitā kṛṣiḥ || śreyasī pūrvapūrvā'tra jñātavyā dvijasattamaiḥ || 2.9.20.30 || vipro jīvedvaiśyavṛttyā satyāmāpadi nārada || atha vā kṣatravṛttyāpi śvavṛttyā na tu karhicit || 31 || śastreṇa jīvetkṣatraṃ tu sarvato dharmarakṣayā || āpanno vaiśyavṛttyaiva viprarūpeṇa vā caret || 32 || karādānādinṛpateraviprādvṛttirīritā || deśakālānusāreṇa rañjayitvā'khilāḥ prajāḥ || 33 || āpatkālepi kṣatrasya brāhmaṇasyeva sarvathā || vigarhitā nīcasevā svatejaḥkṣayakāriṇī || 34 || kṛṣivāṇijyagorakṣā turīyā vṛddhijīvanam || vaiśyasya jīvikā proktā śūdravṛttistathāpadi || 35 || śūdro jīveddvijātīnāṃ sevālabdhadhanena ca || āpatkāle tu kārvāderjīvikāvṛttimāśrayet || 36 || āpanmuktastu sarvopi prāyaścittaṃ yathocitam || vidhāya svasvavṛttyaiva punarvartteta mukhyayā || 37 || cāturvarṇyaṃ satāṃ saṃgaṃ kuryānna tvasatāṃ kvacit || muktipradosti satsaṃgaḥ kusaṃgo nirayapradaḥ || 38 || kāmaṃ krodhaṃ rasāsvādaṃ jitvā mānaṃ ca matsaram || nirdambhaṃ viṣṇubhaktā ye te santaḥ sādhavo matāḥ || 39 || striyāṃ straiṇe rasāsvāde saktāśca dhanagṛdhnavaḥ || hiṃsrā dambhakṛtāṭopā bhaktābhāsā hyasādhavaḥ || 2.9.20.40 || asādhuṣvāsurī saṃpaddaivī saṃpattu sādhuṣu || sahajāstīti niścitya sevyā santaḥ sukhepsubhiḥ || 41 || yādṛśāṃ yasya saṃgaḥ syācchāstrāṇāṃ vā nṛṇāmapi || buddhiḥ syāttādṛśī tasya kāryo'to nāsatāṃ hi saḥ || 42 || ye sādhusevārucayaḥ puruṣā nijaśaktitaḥ || aprāpyaṃ nāsti teṣāṃ vai kimapyaiśvaryamūrjitam || 43 || svadharmasthā api satāṃ drohiṇo ye tu mānavāḥ || sadgatiṃ naiva te yānti kvāpi kenāpi karmaṇā || 44 || mahāpūjāratā viṣṇorbhaktā api satāṃ yadi || drohaṃ kuryustadā teṣu na prasīdati sa kvacit || 45 || saddrohiṇastu dehānte yāṃyāṃ yoniṃ brajanti ca || tatratatra kṣudhārogaiḥ pīḍyante jīvitāvadhi || 46 || satāmatikramādeva puṇyānāṃ mahatāmapi || sadyaḥ kṣayaḥ syātsarveṣāmāyuṣaḥ saṃpadāmapi || 47 || tasmātsevā satāṃ kāryā sarvairapi sukhepsubhiḥ || puṇyatīrthāni sevyāni pūjyā viprāśca dhenavaḥ || 48 || tīrthāni devapratimā nindeyurye kubuddhayaḥ || teṣāṃ tu jārajātānāṃ vaṃśocchedo bhaveddhruvam || 49 || ekasmiṃstarpite vipre sadbhojyairdakṣiṇādibhiḥ || tarpitaṃ syājjagatsarvaṃ haristuṣyati ca svayam || 2.9.20.50 || ekasminbrāhmaṇe drugdhe drugdhaṃ syātsakalaṃ jagat|| tasmācchaktyā pūjanīyā brāhmaṇā viṣṇurūpiṇaḥ||51|| gavāmaṃgeṣu tiṣṭhanti sarve devagaṇā api|| tathā sarvāṇi tīrthāni tāsu tiṣṭhanti sarvadā || 52 || gavyarccitāyāmekasyāṃ sarve devāḥ samarccitāḥ || kṛtāni syuśca sarvāṇi tīrthānyapi ca nārada || 53 || ekasyā api gordrohe kṛte kvāpi pramādataḥ || drugdhāḥ syurdevatāḥ sarvāstīrthānyapi ca kṛtsnaśaḥ || 54 || tasmāccāturvarṇya janairyathoktavidhisaṃsthitaiḥ || bhavitavyaṃ prayatnena tretavyaṃ ca niṣedhataḥ||55|| cāturvarṇyetare ye tu teṣāṃ vṛttiḥ kulocitā || cauryahiṃsādyadharmeṇa rahitaiva hitāvahā || 56 || varṇadharmā iti proktāḥ saṃkṣepeṇa mayā mune || caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ ca dharmānatha vadāmi te || 57 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye cāturvarṇyadharmanirūpaṇaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
<2.9.21>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā || eta āśramiṇaḥ proktāścatvāro munisattama || 1 || saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛto yastu śuddhayonirdvijātitām || prāptaḥ sa hi brahmacārī taddharmānādito bruve || 2 || varṇī vedamadhīyīta vasangurugṛhe śuciḥ || jitendriyo jitakrodho vinītastathyabhāṣaṇaḥ || 3 || sāyaṃ prātaścareddhomaṃ bhikṣācaryāṃ ca saṃyataḥ || kuryāttrikālaṃ saṃdhyāṃ ca viṣṇupūjāṃ tathānvaham || 4 || gurvājñayaiva bhuñjīta mitamannamanākulaḥ || gurusevāparo nityaṃ bhavedvyasanavarjitaḥ || 5 || snāne ca bhojane home jape maunamupāśrayet || chindyānna nakharomāṇi dantānnaivātidhāvayet || 6 || nātidhāvecca vāsāṃsi bhavenniṣkapaṭo gurau || āhūtodhyayanaṃ kuryādādāvante ca taṃ namet || 7 || aspṛśyānna spṛśeccāsau nā'saṃbhāṣyāṃśca bhāṣayet || abhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayennaiva nā'peyaṃ ca pibetkvacit || 8 || mekhalāmajinaṃ daṇḍaṃ bibhṛyācca kamaṇḍalum || site dve vāsasī brahmasūtraṃ ca japamālikām || 9 || darbhapāṇiśca jaṭilaḥ keśasaṃskāravarjitaḥ || aṅgarāgaṃ puṣpahārānbhūṣaṇāni ca varjayet || 2.9.21.10 || tailābhyaṅgaṃ na kurvīta kajjale nāñjanaṃ tathā || varjayecca prayatnena saṃsargaṃ madyamāṃsayoḥ || 11 || strīṇāṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ sparśaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ krīḍanādi ca || varjayetsarvathā varṇī striyāścāpyavalekhanam || 12 || vinā ca devapratimāṃ kāṣṭhacitrādiyoṣitam || api naiva spṛśeddhīmānna ca buddhyāvalokayet || 13 || prāṇimātraṃ ca mithunībhūtaṃ nekṣeta karhicit || strīṇāṃ guṇāścāpyaguṇāñchṛṇuyānnaiva no vadet || 14 || aspṛśanneva vandeta gurupatnīmapi svakām || jananyāpi na tiṣṭheta rahaḥsthāne tu karhicit || 15 || evaṃvṛtto vasettatra yāvadvidyāsamāpanam || tato virakto nyāsī syādvarṇī vā naiṣṭhiko bhavet || anadhikāritā proktā naiṣṭhikavratināṃ kalau || 16 || na saṃdhāviti vijñeyaṃ kalīti śabdasaṃgrahāt || vanī syādatha vā brahmannavirakto bhavedgṛhī || 17 || prājāpatyaṃ ca sāvitraṃ brāhmaṃ naiṣṭhikameva ca || caturvidhaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tatraikaṃ śaktitaḥ śrayet || 18 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye brahmacāridharmanirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<2.9.22>
|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || gṛhī bubhūṣurgurave dakṣiṇāṃ svasya śaktitaḥ || dattvā tadājñayaivā'sau samāvarttanamācaret || 1 || tataḥ kulocitāṃ yoṣāṃ vayasonāmarogiṇīm || pum̐llakṣaṇena rahitāmapāpāṃ vidhinodvahet || 2 || svādhikārānusāreṇa kṛṣṇasaṃprītaye'nvaham || devarṣipitṛbhūtāni yajeta vidhinā tataḥ|| || 3 || snānaṃ saṃdhyāṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ viṣṇupūjanam || tarpaṇaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ ca kuryāccātithyamanvaham || 4 || kuryātpuṇyaṃ yathāśakti nyāyārjitadhanena ca || anāsaktaḥ poṣyavargaṃ puṣṇīyānna tu pīḍayet || 5 || dehaṃ ca daihikānvāsāvuddiśya paśuvatparaiḥ || vairaṃ na kuryāddehādāvahantāṃ mamatāṃ tyajet ||6|| kuryādbhāgavatānāṃ ca satāṃ saṃgamatandritaḥ || na straiṇānāṃ vyasanināṃ saṃgaṃ kuryānna lobhinām ||7|| kāmabhāvena nekṣeta parayoṣāṃ tu karhicit || śrāddhaparvavratāhādau nopeyācca svayoṣitam || 8 || prāptopi puruṣaḥ sāṃkhye yoge ca paripakvatām|| putryā api prasaṃgena rahaḥsthāne tu muhyati || 9 || ato mātrā bhaginyā vā duhitrāpi rahaḥsthale || saha nāsīta matimānyuvatyā kimutā'nyayā || 2.9.22.10 || amaṅgalānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidhavā hyatyamaṃgalam || taddarśanaṃ ca tatsparśo nṝṇāṃ sukṛtahṛttataḥ ||11|| prayāṇakāle vidhavādarśanaṃ sanmukhe yadi || syāttadā naiva gantavyamanyathā maraṇaṃ dhuvam || 12 || āśiṣo vidhavāstrīṇāṃ samāḥ kālāhiphūtkṛtaiḥ || tataśca bibhiyāttābhyo rākṣasībhyo yathā gṛhī || 13 || madyaṃ māṃsaṃ mādakaṃ ca dyūtādīndūratastyajet || na drohaṃ prāṇimātrasya kuryādvācāpi karhicit || 14 || avatāracaritrāṇi śṛṇuyādanvahaṃ hareḥ || sarvā api kriyāḥ kuryādvāsudevārthamāstikaḥ || 15 || ūrje māghe ca vaiśākhe cāturmāsye malimluce || anyeṣu puṇyakāleṣu viśeṣaniyamāṃścaret || 16 || puṇyadeśe puṇyakāle satpātre vidhinā gṛhī|| dadyāddānaṃ yathāśakti dayāṃ kurvīta jantuṣu || 17 || puṇyāndeśānpuṇyakālānpuṇyapātrāṇi cānagha || kathayāmi viśeṣeṇa dharmavṛddhikarāṇi te || 18 || deśaḥ sarvottamastveṣa bhuvi yo madadhiṣṭhitaḥ || mahāmunigaṇā yatra tapasyanti mahāvratāḥ|| || 19 || haritadbhaktamāhātmyāddeśānāmasti puṇyatā || gaṃgādvāraṃ madhupurī naimiṣāraṇyameva ca || 2.9.22.20 || kurukṣetramayodhyā ca prayāgaśca gayāśiraḥ || purī vārāṇasī caiva puṇyaśca pulahāśramaḥ ||21 || kapilāśramaḥ śrīraṃgaḥ prabhāsaśca kuśasthalī || kṣetraṃ siddhapadākhyaṃ ca pauṣkaraṃ ca mahatsaraḥ || 22 || krīḍāsthānaṃ bhagavataḥ saśriyo raivatācalaḥ || tathā govarddhanagiriḥ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam || 23 || mahendramalayādyāśca saptāpi kulaparvatāḥ || bhāgīrathī mahāpuṇyā yamunā ca sarasvatī || 24 || godāvarī ca sarayūḥ kāverī gomatīmukhāḥ || purāṇaprathitāḥ puṇyā mahānadyo nadāstathā || 25 || mahotsavairbhavedyatra bhagavatpratimārcanam || prabhorananyabhaktāśca bhaveyuryatrayatra ca || 26 || ahiṃsrāśca svadharmasthā yatra syurbrāhmaṇottamāḥ || mṛgādyāḥ paśavo yatra vicareyuśca nirbhayāḥ || 27 || yatrayatrāvatārāśca harervāsaśca yatra vā || ete puṇyatamā deśā bhuvi santi viśeṣataḥ || 28 || alpopyeṣu kṛto dharmaḥ syātsahasraguṇo nṛṇām || puṇyavṛddhikarānkālāñchṛṇvatho vacmi nārada || 29 || ayane dve ca viṣuvaṃ grahaṇaṃ sūryasomayoḥ || dinakṣayo vyatīpātaḥ śravaṇarkṣāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 2.9.22.30 || dvādaśya ekādaśyaśca manvādyāśca yugādayaḥ || puṇyāḥ syustithayaḥ sarvā amāvāsyā ca vaidhṛtiḥ || 31 || māsarkṣayukpaurṇamāsyaścatasropyaṣṭakāstathā || svajanmarkṣāṇi ca harerjanmotsavadināni ca || 32 || svasya striyāścārbhakāṇāṃ saṃskārobhyudayastathā || satpātralabdhiśca yadā kālāḥ puṇyatamā ime || 33 || devapitṛdvijasatāmeṣāṃ śaktyā samarcanam || snānadānajapādīni syuranantaphalāni hi || 34 || satpātraṃ tu svayaṃ sākṣādbhagavāneva nārada || śākhānāmiva mūlāmbu yaddattaṃ sarvatuṣṭikṛt ||35|| ahiṃsā vedavidyābhistuṣṭiḥ saddharmabhaktibhiḥ || hṛdi viṣṇuṃ dadhīranye te satpātrāṇi vai dvijāḥ || 36 || ekāntikāśca bhagavadbhaktā baddhavimocakāḥ || satpātrāṇīti jānīhi yeṣvāste bhagavānsvayam || 37 || āḍhyastu kārayedviṣṇormandirāṇi dṛḍhāni ca || pūjāpravāhasiddhyarthaṃ tadvṛttīścāpi kārayet || 38 || jalāśayānvāṭikāśca viṣṇvarthamupakalpayet || sadannaiḥ surasaiḥ sādhūnbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva tarpayet || 39 || ahiṃsānvaiṣṇavānyajñānkuryācchaktyā yathāvidhi || vratajanmotsavānviṣṇoḥ saṃbhāreṇa ca bhūyasā || 2.9.22.40 || prauṣṭhapadāsitepakṣe kṣayāhe tīrthaparvasu || pitroḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta tadbandhūnāṃ ca śaktitaḥ || 41 || daive karmaṇi pitrye ca bhaktānbhagavato dvijān || pūjayeta svadharmasthānbhojayedbhagavaddhiyā || 42 || daive dvau bhojayedviprau trīṃśca pitrye yathāvidhi || ekaikaṃ vobhayatrāpi naiva śrāddhe tu vistaret || 43 || deśakāladravyapātrapūjopakaraṇāni ca || vistareṇa yathāśāstraṃ na syādeveti niścitam || 44 || na śrāddhe kvāpi māṃsaṃ tu dadyānnā'dyācca mānavaḥ || munyannaiḥ kṣīrasarpirbhyāṃ tṛpyanti pitaro bhṛśam || 45 || ahiṃsā prāṇimātrasya manovāktanubhistu yā || tayaiva pitaraḥ sarve tṛpyantyatidayālavaḥ || 46 || tasmātkusaṅgataḥ kvāpi śāstrahārdamabudhya ca || śrāddhe māṃsaṃ naiva dadyādvāsudevaparaḥ pumān || 47 || vratāni kuryādviṣṇośca brahmacaryādibhiryamaiḥ || sahaiva tatparo nānyatkāryaṃ kuyācca taddine || 48 || svasaṃbandhijanānāṃ cāpyāśaucaṃ janināśayoḥ || yathāśāstraṃ pālayeta grahaṇe cārkacandrayoḥ || 49 || vyāvahārikakāryāṇāṃ vivāde nirṇayepi ca || gṛhītarāstyāgino ye te na kāryā na cādhavāḥ || 2.9.22.50 || yatraite syurnna tatkāryaṃ sidhyetkvāpi dvijottama || sarvasvanāśastatra syādityevaṃ tvasti nirṇayaḥ || 51 || dharmā ete gṛhasthānāṃ mayā saṃkṣepatoditāḥ || yadanuṣṭhānato nṝṇāṃ syātsveṣṭasukhamakṣayam || 52 || śilādijīvikāvṛttibhedena gṛhiṇo dvijāḥ || caturvidhāḥ prakīrtyante tattannāmnā ca nārada || 53 || strīṇāmatha pravakṣyāmi dharmānrdharmavatāṃ vara || yeṣu sthitāḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ prāpnuvantīpsitaṃ sukham || 54 || suvāsinībhirnnārībhiḥ svapatirdevavatsadā || sevanīyo'nuvarttyaśca jaranrugṇo'dhanopi vā || 55 || tadbandhavaścānuvartyāḥ sevanena yathocitam || ujjvalāni vidheyāni gṛhopakaraṇāni ca || 56 || gṛhaṃ mārjanasekādyaiḥ svacchaṃ kāryaṃ dinedine || priyaṃ satyaṃ ca vaktavyaṃ stheyaṃ śucitayā sadā || 57 || cāñcalyamatilobhaśca krodhaḥ steyaṃ ca hiṃsanam || adhārmikāṇāṃ saṅgaśca varjyaḥ strīṇāṃ tathā nṛṇām || 58 || bhavitavyaṃ tatparābhirddharmakāryeṣu sarvadā || tyaktvauddhatyaṃ vinītābhiḥ stheyaṃ jitvendriyāṇi ca || 59 || pātivratye sthitābhiśca dharme tābhī ramāpateḥ || bhaktiḥ kāryā svatantrābhirbhavitavyaṃ na kutracit || 2.9.22.60 || vidhavā tu sadā viṣṇuṃ seveta patibhāvataḥ || kāmasaṃbandhinīrvārttā na śṛṇvīta na kīrtayet|| 61 || āsannasaṃbandhavato vinānyānpuruṣānkvacit || anāpadi spṛśennaiva paśyennaiva ca kāmataḥ || 62 || stanapasya tu nuḥ sparśādvṛddhasya ca na duṣyati || kārya āvaśyake tābhyāṃ bhāṣaṇe ca vibhartṛkā || 63 || vyāvahārikakārye ca vivādamadhikaṃ naraiḥ || na kurvītāvaśyakārye tairbhāṣeta vinā rahaḥ || 64 || nekṣeta midhunībhūtaṃ budyā paśvādyapi kvacit || tyajecca sakalānbhogānsyātsakṛnmitabhuktathā || 65 || sadhātusūkṣmavāsāṃsi nālaṃkārāṃśca dhārayet || na divā śayanaṃ kuryānna khaṭvāyāmanāpadi || 66 || tāmbūlabhakṣaṇaṃ naiva kuryānnābhyaṅgamañjanam || pumprasaṃgācca bibhiyātkṛṣṇāheriva nityadā || 67 || samīkṣya puruṣaṃ nārī yā na mohamupāvrajet || tādṛśī tu vinā lakṣmīmekāṃ nānyāsti kutracit || 68 || dharmaniṣṭhā tato nārī svaniḥśreyasamicchatī || nekṣeta puruṣākāraṃ buddhipūrvaṃ ca na spṛśet || 69 || kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādīni nairantaryeṇa bhaktitaḥ || vratāni kuryācca sadā bhavenniyamatatparā || 2.9.22.70 || pitrā putrādinā vāpi taruṇī taruṇena ca || saha tiṣṭhenna rahasi kusaṅgaṃ sarvathā tyajet || 71 || sadhavā vidhavā vā strī svarajodarśanaṃ kvacit || na gopayettrirātraṃ tu manuṣyādīṃśca na spṛśet || 72 || prathame'hani caṇḍālī dvitīye brahmaghātinī || tṛtīye rajakī proktā sā caturthe'hni śuddhyati || 73 || iti strīṇāṃ mayā dharmāḥ saṃkṣepātkathitāstava || yuktā yairyoṣito yāyurihāmutra mahatsukham || 74 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye gṛhasthadharmanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvāviṃśodhyāyaḥ||22||
<2.9.23>
|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || vānaprasthasya vakṣyāmi niyamānatha te mune || tṛtīya āyuṣo bhāge tṛtīyāśrama īritaḥ ||1 || anukūlā svasevāyāṃ viraktā ca tapaḥpriyā || yadi patnī bhavettarhi tayā saha vanaṃ viśet || 2 || anyathā tu sutādibhyastasyāḥ poṣaṇarakṣaṇam || ādiśya svayamekākī virakto vanamāviśet || 3 || nirbhayo nivasettatra taporuciratandritaḥ || kuryāduṭajamagnyarthaṃ svayaṃ tu bahirāvaset || 4 || bhavetpañcatapā grīṣma udavāsaśca śaiśire || āsāraṣāṭca varṣāsu jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ || 5 || vāsaśca tārṇaṃ pārṇaṃ vā vasītājinavalkalam || bhuñjīta ṛṣidhānyāni vanyaṃ kandaphalādi vā || 6 || agnipakvaṃ vārkapakvamapakvaṃ vāpi bhakṣayet || abhāve tveṣa dantānāmaśmolūkhalakuṭṭitam || 7 || svayamevāharedannaṃ yathākālaṃ dinedine || kāle parāhṛtaṃ vāpi gṛhṇīyānnānyadā kvacit|| 8 || kālepi kṛṣṭapacyaṃ tu na gṛhṇīyādanāpadi || vanyairevāgnikāryaṃ ca dhānyaiḥ kurvīta pūrvavat || 9 || rakṣetkamaṇḍaluṃ daṇḍamagnihotraparicchadān|| keśaromaśmaśrunakhāndhārayenmalināndataḥ || 2.9.23.10 || aṃgānyamardayansnāyādbhūtale ca śayīta saḥ || deśakāla balāvasthānusāreṇa tapaścaret || 11 || phenapāścaudumbarāśca vālakhilyāstathaiva ca || vaikhānaseti kathitāścaturddhā vanavāsinaḥ || 12 || yathāśakti dvādaśābdānaṣṭau vā caturo vane || vaseddvāvekamevāpi tataḥ saṃnyāsamāśrayet || 13 || yadi syāttīvravairāgyaṃ tarhi nyāso hitāvahaḥ || vasettatraivā'nyathā tu yāvajjīvaṃ vane dvijaḥ || 14 || yathāvidhi kṛtatyāgasturīyāśramamāsthitaḥ || sācchādanaṃ tu kaupīnaṃ kanthāmekāṃ ca dhārayet|| || 15 || daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ cāmbugālanaṃ bibhṛyācca saḥ || sadācāradvijagṛhe kāle bhikṣāṃ samācaret || 16 || na kuryātpratyahaṃ bhikṣāmekasyaiva gṛhe yatiḥ || rasalubdho bhavenneva sakṛcca mitabhugbhavet || 17 || vanasthāśramiṇo bhikṣāṃ prāyo gṛhṇīta bhikṣukaḥ || tadandhasātiśuddhena śuddhyatyevā'sya yanmanaḥ || 18 || ghrāṇepi māṃsasurayoḥ pārākaṃ vratamācaret || śaucācāraviśuddhaḥ syācchūdrādīṃścāpi na spṛśet || 19 || nityaṃ kuryādviṣṇupūjā madyādviṣṇornniveditam|| dvādaśārṇaṃ japedviṣṇoraṣṭākṣaramanuṃ ca vā || 2.9.23.20 || asadvādaṃ na kurvīta vṛttyarthaṃ nācaretkathām || asacchāstre na saktaḥ syānnopajīvecca jīvikām || 21 || sacchāstramabhyaseccāsau bandhamokṣānudarśanam || maṭhādīnnaiva badhnīyādahantāmamate tyajet || 22 || cāturmāsyaṃ vinaikatra vasennā'sāvanāpadi || ātmanaśca hare rūpaṃ vidyājjñānena tattvataḥ || 23 || kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ vairaṃ dhanadhānyādisaṃgraham || naiva kuryātpālayeta yamāṃśca niyamānyatiḥ || 24 || tīvrajñānavirāgābhyāṃ saṃpannopi yatirdhruvam || strīvittabhūṣāsadvastrasaṃsargādbhraṣṭatāṃ vrajet || 25 || puṣpa candanatailādisugandhidravyavarjanam || tyāgī kurvītānyathā tu bhaveddehātmadhīḥ sa vai || 26 || āhāro yasya yāvāṃstaṃ tāvānstrīkāma āviśet || ato mitaṃ nīrasaṃ ca bhojanaṃ tyāgino hitam || 27 || na śrāvyā grāmyavārttā ca mokṣasiddhimabhīpsatā || naśyedyacchravaṇānnṝṇāṃ sadyo viṣṇukathā ruciḥ || 28 || api citramayīṃ nārīṃ tyāgī nekṣeta na spṛśet || stryākāradarśanādeva bhraṣṭā bhūri tapasvinaḥ || 29 || kuṭīcako bahūdaśca haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsakaḥ || evaṃ caturddhā kathito yatirvairāgyabhedataḥ || 2.9.23.30 || kāṣāyavāsaso ye me bhaviṣyāḥ sādhavaśca taiḥ || kāryaṃ madarthapākādi turyāśramasthitairapi || 31 || śrīvāsudevabhaktā ye tīvravairāgyaśālinaḥ || teṣāṃ dharmastu tatsevā proktāhassu ca rātriṣu || 32 || ekopi ca kṣaṇasteṣāṃ jñānavijñānabhūyasām || bhaktiṃ navavidhāṃ viṣṇorvinā vyartho na vai bhavet || 33 || sarverguṇairupetopi bhagavadvimukho yadi || svajanopi bhavettaṃ tu jahyureva hi vaiṣṇavāḥ || 34 || prāsādikaṃ harerannaṃ prokṣitaṃ tatpadāmbunā || bhuñjīraṃstulasīmiśraṃ pratyahaṃ sātvatā janāḥ || 35 || strīṇāṃ ca strīṣu saktānāṃ prasaṃgo viṣṇucintakaiḥ || sarvathaiva parityājyo bhavettaddhyānamanyathā || 36 || bhagavantaṃ vāsudevaṃ vinaikamitaraḥ pumān || kopi nāstyeva yo nārīṃ samīkṣya na vimuhyati ||37|| yatra sthityā muhuḥ strīṇāṃ syātāṃ śabdaśrutīkṣaṇe || tyāgī tatra vasennaiva vasandharmacyuto bhavet ||38|| kāmo lobho rasāsvādaḥ sneho mānastathā ca ruṭ || ete tyājyāḥ prayatnena ṣaḍdoṣāḥ saṃsṛtipradāḥ || 39|| prokteṣu dharmeṣveteṣu yasyayasya cyutirbhavet|| yathāśakti yathāśāstraṃ kāryā tattasya niṣkṛtiḥ||2.9.23.40|| itthaṃ caturṇāṃ varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca nārada|| dharmāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ proktā vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca te mayā||41|| varṇī yatiśca dharmastho brahmalokamupaiti vai|| ṛṣilokaṃ vanasthaśca gṛhasthaḥ svargamāpnuyāt || 42 || bhaktyā sahaitāñchrīviṣṇorācareyustu ye janāḥ || te tu sarvepi dehānte viṣṇulokamavāpnuyuḥ || 43 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye vanasthayatidharmanirūpaṇaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||
<2.9.24>
|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || atha jñānasvarūpaṃ te vacmi sāṃkhyena niścitam || kṣetrādi jñāyate yena tajjñānaṃ hi nirucyate || 1 || vāsudevaḥ paraṃ brahma bṛhatyakṣaradhāmani || ādāveko'dvitīyo'bhūnnirguṇo divyavigrahaḥ || 2 || sa kāryamūlaprakṛtiḥ sakālā'kṣaratejasi || prakāśe'rkasya rātrīva tirobhūtā tadā'bhavat || 3 || sisṛkṣāthābhavattasya brahmāṇḍānāṃ yadā tadā || sakālāvirbabhūvādau mahāmāyā tato hi sā || 4 || tāṃ kālaśaktimādāya vāsudevo'kṣarātmanā || sisṛkṣayaikṣata yadā sā cukṣobha tadaiva hi || 5 || tasyāḥ pradhānapuruṣakoṭayo jajñire mune || yujyante sma pradhānaiste puruṣāścecchayā prabhoḥ || 6 || pumāṃso nidadhurgarbhāṃsteṣu tebhyaśca jajñire || brahmāṇḍāni hyasaṅkhyāni tatraikaṃ tu vivicyate || 7 || ādau jajñe mahāṃstasmātpuṃso vīryāddhiraṇmayāt || ahaṅkārastatastasmādguṇāḥ sattvādayastrayaḥ || 8 || tamasaḥ pañca tanmātrā mahābhūtāni jajñire || daśendriyāṇi rajaso buddhyā saha mahānasuḥ ||9|| sattvādindriyadevāśca jāyante sma manastathā || sāmānyatastattvasaṃjñā ete devāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 2.9.24.10 || preritā vāsudevena svasvāṃśairaiśvaraṃ vapuḥ || ajījananvirāṭsañjñaṃ te carācarasaṃśrayam || 11 || sa ca vairājapuruṣaḥ svasṛṣṭāsvapsvaśeta yat || tena nārāyaṇa iti procyate nigamādibhiḥ || || 12 || tannābhipadmādbrahmāsīdrājaso'tha hṛdambujāt || jajñe viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇo lalāṭāttāmaso haraḥ || 13 || etebhya eva sthānebhyastisra āsaṃśca śaktayaḥ || tatrāsīttāmasī durgā sāvitrī rājasī tathā || sāttvikī śrīśceti sarvā vastrālaṃkāraśobhitāḥ || 14 || tā vairājājñayā trīṃśca brahmādīnpratipedire || durgā rudraṃ ca sāvitrī brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumantimā || 15 || caṇḍikādyāśca durgāyā aṃśenāsansahasraśaḥ || trayīmukhyāśca sāvitryāḥ śaktayoṃśena jajñire || dussahāpramukhāścāsannaṃśenaiva śriyo mune || 16 || tatrādito yo brahmāsīdvairājanābhipadmataḥ || ekārṇave tadabjasthaḥ sa kaścidapi naikṣata || 17 || visargabuddhimaprāpto nātmānaṃ ca viveda saḥ || kohaṃ kuta iti dhyāyannadidṛkṣatkajāśrayam || 18 || nālaṃ praviśyā'dho yātustanmūlaṃ ca vicinvataḥ || saṃvatsaraśataṃ yātaṃ tasya nāntaṃ tu solabhat || 19 || ūrdhvaṃ punarupetyā'tha śrāntaśca niṣasāda saḥ || adṛśyamūrtirbhagavānūce tapatapeti tam || 2.9.24.20 || tacchrutvā tatpravaktāramadṛṣṭvā ca sa sarvataḥ || gurūpadiṣṭavattepe divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam ||21|| padme tapasyate tasmai tapaḥ śuddhātmane tataḥ || samādhau darśayāmāsa dhāma vaikuṇṭhamacyutaḥ || 22 || prādhānikā guṇā yatra trayopi rajaādayaḥ || na bhavantyalpamapi yatkālamāyābhayaṃ na ca||23|| sahoditārkāyutavadbhāsvare tatra tejasi || vāsudevaṃ dadarśā'sau ramyadivyāsitākṛtim||24|| caturbhujaṃ gadāpadmaśaṃkhacakradharaṃ vibhum || pītāmbaraṃ mahāratnakirīṭādivibhūṣaṇam|| 25 || nandatārkṣyādibhirjjuṣṭaṃ pārṣadaiśca caturbhujaiḥ || siddhibhiścāṣṭabhiḥ ṣaḍbhirbaddhāñjalipuṭairbhagaiḥ ||26|| siṃhāsane śriyā sākamupaviṣṭaṃ tamīśvaram || praṇamya prāñjalistasthau viriñco hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||27|| taṃ prāha bhagavānbrahmaṃstuṣṭohaṃ tapasā tava || varaṃ varaya mattastvaṃ svābhīṣṭaṃ yatpriyosi me || 28 || ityuktastena taṃ jānaṃstapasi prerakaṃ prabhum || svaṃ ca viśvasṛjaṃ brahmā yayāce'bhimataṃ varam || 29 || prajāvisargaśaktiṃ me dehi tubhyaṃ namaḥ prabho || tatrāpi ca na baddhyeyaṃ yathā kuru tathā kṛpām || 2.9.24.30 || tatastaṃ bhagavānūce setsyate te manorathaḥ || vairājena mayātmaikyaṃ bhāvayitvā samādhinā || prajāḥ sṛjā'tha svāsādhye kārye smaryohamiṣṭadaḥ || 31|| ityuktvāntardadhe viṣṇurbrahmāpyekasamādhinā || vairājenā'tha lokānprāglīnānsarvānsva aikṣata || 32 || visargaśaktiṃ saṃprāpya sa sargāya mano dadhe || brahmajyotirmayastāvadādityaḥ prādurāsa ha || 33 || sthāpayitvāṇḍamadhye taṃ tataḥ sa manasā'sṛjat || tapobhaktiviśuddhena munīnādyāṃścatuḥsanān || 34 || prajāḥ sṛjata cetyūce tāṃstadā te tu tadvacaḥ || na jagṛhurnnaiṣṭhikendrāstebhyaścukrodha viśvasṛṭ || 35 || kruddhasya tasya bhālācca rudra āsīttamomayaḥ || manyuṃ niyamya manasā prajeśānso'sṛjattataḥ || 36 || marīcimatriṃ pulahaṃ pulastyaṃ ca bhṛguṃ kratum || vasiṣṭhaṃ kardamaṃ caiva dakṣamaṃgirasaṃ tathā || 37 || dharmaṃ tataḥ sa hṛdayādadharmaṃ pṛṣṭhatastathā || manasaḥ kāmamāsyācca vāṇīṃ krodhaṃ bhruvo'sṛjat || 38 || śaucaṃ tapo dayā satyamiti dharmapadāni ca || caturbhyo vadanebhyaśca catvāri sasṛje tataḥ || 39 || ṛgvedaṃ vadanātpūrvādyajurvedaṃ ca dakṣiṇāt || sasarja paścimātsāma saumyāccātharvasaṃjñitam||2.9.24.40|| itihāsapurāṇāni yajñānvipraśataṃ tathā || vasvādityamarudviśvānsādhyāṃśca mukhato'sṛjat ||41|| bāhubhyaḥ kṣatriyaśatamūrubhyāṃ ca viśāṃ śatam || padbhyāṃ śūdraśataṃ caitānsasarja saha vṛttibhiḥ || 42 || brahmacaryaṃ ca hṛdayādgārhasthyaṃ jaghanasthalāt || vanāśramaṃ tathorastaḥ saṃnyāsaṃ śiraso'sṛjat || 43 || vakṣaḥsthalātpitṛgaṇānasurāñjaghanasthalāt || sasarja ca gudānmṛtyuṃ nirṛtiṃ nirayāṃśca saḥ || 44 || gandharvāṃścāraṇānsiddhānsarpānyakṣāṃśca rākṣasān || nagānmeghānvidyutaśca samudrānsaritastathā || 45 || vṛkṣānpaśūnpakṣiṇaśca sarvānsthāvarajaṅgamān || svāṅgebhya eva sosrākṣīdbrahmā nārāyaṇātmakaḥ || 46 || sṛṣṭimetāṃ vilokyāpi nātiprīto yadā tadā || hariṃ dhyātvā sa sasṛje tapovidyāsamādhibhiḥ || ṛṣīnsvāyambhuvādīṃśca manūṃśca manujānapi || 47 || tataḥ prītaḥ sa sarveṣāṃ nivāsāya yathocitam|| svarlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ bhūrlokaṃ samakalpayat || 48 || yeṣāṃ tu yādṛśaṃ karma prākkālīnaṃ hi tānvidhiḥ || saṃsthāpya tādṛśe sthāne vṛttīsteṣāmakalpayat || 49 || devānāmamṛtaṃ nṝṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ cānnamoṣadhīḥ || yakṣarakṣosuravyāghrasarpādīnāṃ surāmiṣam || caklṛpe gomṛgādīnāṃ vṛttiṃ sa yavasādi ca || 2.9.24.50 || sa devānāṃ tu viśveṣāṃ havyaṃ vṛttimakalpayat || amūrtānāṃ ca mūrtānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ kavyameva ca || 51 || durgodbhavānāṃ śaktīnāṃ tadupāsanatatparaiḥ || daityarakṣaḥpiśācādyairdattaṃ madyāmiṣādi ca || 52 || tathā sāvitryudbhavānāṃ śaktīnāṃ tadupāsakaiḥ || dattamṛṣyādibhiryajñe munyannaṃ cānnamoṣadhīḥ || 53 || śrījātānāṃ ca śaktīnāṃ tadupāstiparāyaṇaiḥ || dattaṃ devāsuranaraiḥ pāyasājyasitādi ca || 54 || prajāpatīnāṃ sa patistataḥ prāhā'khilāḥ prajāḥ || ijyā devāśca pitaro havyakavyātmakairmakhaiḥ || 55 || iṣṭāḥ saṃpūrayiṣyanti hyete yuṣmanmanorathān || etānye nārcayiṣyanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 56 || itthaṃ kṛtā hi maryādā tena nārāyaṇātmanā || daivaṃ pitryamato nityaṃ janaiḥ kāryaṃ yathāvidhi || 57 || tato brahmā sa sarveṣāṃ dharmasetvavanāya ca || tattajjātiṣu ye mukhyāstānmanūṃścāpyatiṣṭhipat || 58 || vāsudevecchayaivetthaṃ vairājādbrahmarūpiṇaḥ || kalpekalpe bhavatyeva sṛṣṭirbahuvidhā mune||59|| prākkalpe yādṛśī saṃjñā vedāḥ śāstrāṇi ca kriyāḥ|| kalpe'nye tādṛśāḥ sarve dharmāḥ syuścā'dhikāriṇaḥ|| 2.9.24.60|| viṣṇuryaḥ kathitaḥ sopi vairājapuruṣātmakaḥ|| poṣayatyakhilām̐llokānmaryādāḥ paripālayan|| 61|| manvādibhiḥ pālyamānāḥ setavastvasurairyadā || kāmarūpairvibhidyante vāsudevastadā svayam || brahmādibhiḥ prārthyamānaḥ prādurbhavati bhūtale || 62 || avatārā bhagavato bhūtā bhāvyāśca santi ye || kartuṃ na śakyate teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ saṃkhyāviśāradaiḥ || 63 || saddharmadevasādhūnāṃ guptyai taddrohimṛtyave || śreyase sarvabhūtānāmāvirbhāvosti satpateḥ || 64 || sa vāsudevaḥ prakṛtau puṃsi kāryeṣu caitayoḥ || anvitaśca pṛthakcāste sarvādhīśaḥ svadhāmani || 65 || vyāpya svāṃśairimām̐llokānyathāgnivaruṇādayaḥ || svastyāsate svasvaloke tathaiṣa bhagavānmune || 66 || sargātprāksaccidānandaḥ śuddha ekaśca nirguṇaḥ || yathāsīttādṛgevāsāvanvitopyasti nirmalaḥ || 67 || vāyutejojalakṣmāsu tattatkāryeṣu khaṃ yathā || anvīyāpyasti nirlepaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ tathaiṣa hi || 68 || sarvopāsyo niyantā ca vyāpakaścaiṣa kīrtitaḥ || ātyantike laye'thaiṣa bhavatyeva yathā purā || 69 || vairājaḥ puruṣo yo'tra prokto'sāvīśvarābhidhaḥ || jñeyaḥ svatantraḥ sarvajño vaśyamāyaśca nārada || 2.9.24.70 || etasyaiva svarūpāṇi brahmaviṣṇuśivāstrayaḥ || rajaādiguṇopetāḥ svaguṇānuguṇakriyāḥ || 71 || brahmaṇo ye samutpannā devāsuranarādayaḥ || te jīvasaṃjñā hyalpajñāḥ paratantrā bhavanti ca || 72 || jīvānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca tanavaḥ kṣetrasañjñakāḥ || mahadāditattvamayyaḥ kṣetrajñākhyāstu tadvidaḥ || 73 || kṣetrāṇāṃ ca kṣetravidāṃ pradhānapuruṣasya ca || māyāyāḥ kālaśakteścā'kṣarasya ca parātmanaḥ || pṛthakpṛthaglakṣaṇairyajjñānaṃ tajjñānamucyate || 74 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye jñānasvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ nāma caturviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
<2.9.25>
|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || vairāgyasyātha te vacmi lakṣaṇaṃ munisattama || kṣayiṣṇuvastuṣvaruciḥ sarvatheti tadīritam || 1 || ārabhya māyāpuruṣātsarvā hyākṛtayastu yāḥ || kālaśaktyā bhagavato nāśyante tāśca tadvaśāḥ || 2 || pratyakṣeṇānumānena śābdena ca vivekibhiḥ || asatyatā kṛtīnāṃ ca niścitā satyatātmanām || 3 || nityena pralayenaiṣa kālo naimittikena ca || prākṛtikena rūpeṇa caratyātyantikena ca || 4 || dehidehā ime nityaṃ kṣīyante pariṇāminaḥ || krameṇa dṛśyate yatra bālyatāruṇyavārddhakam || 5 || sūkṣmatvānnekṣyate tattu gatirdīpārciṣo yathā || phalavṛddhirvā'nupadaṃ jāyamānā drume yathā || 6 || tasyāṃtasyāmavasthāyāṃ duḥkhaṃ ca mahadīkṣyate || jāgradādiṣvavasthāsu duḥkhaṃ caiva punaḥpunaḥ || 7 || duḥkhamādhyātmikaṃ bhūri dṛśyate cādhibhautikam || ādhidaivikamapyatra duḥkhamevāsti dehinām || 8 || hāhā mamāra matputro hā patnī mriyate mama || tātaṃ me'bhakṣayadvyāghro daṣṭā sarpeṇa me vadhūḥ || 9 || mahāsaudhogninā dagdho hāhā sopaskaro'dya me || svakuṭumbaṃ kathaṃ pokṣye nāvarṣatpākaśāsanaḥ || 2.9.25.10 || sasyaiḥ samṛddhaṃ matkṣetraṃ hāhā dagdhaṃ himāgninā || hriyante taskarairgāvaḥ sarvasvaṃ mama luṇṭhitam || 11 || nṛpeṇa daṇḍito'tyarthaṃ śatruṇā hā'titāḍitaḥ || kiṃ karomi ca kaṃ brūyāṃ mātā me vyabhicāriṇī || 12 || viṣaṃ pāsyāmi hāhā'dya matpatnīṃ śatrurākṛṣat || hā svasā me hṛtā mlecchairhāhā'riḥ prāpa marmabhit || 13 || priye jvarātivyathayā yamadūtā ime hahā || itthaṃ rorūyamāṇā hi dṛśyante sarvato janāḥ || 14 || avasthānāṃ śarīrasya janmamṛtyū pratikṣaṇam || kālena prāpnuvadbhiḥ svaṃ prārabdhaṃ duḥkhamaśyate || 15 || prārabdhānte mṛtyuduḥkhaṃ bhavatyapratimaṃ hi tat || mṛtvāpi ca mahadduḥkhaṃ prāpyate yamayātanāḥ || 16 || tato jarāyujodbhijjasvedajāṇḍajayoniṣu || bhūtvābhūtvā yathākarma mriyate duḥkhitaiḥ punaḥ || 17 || nityaḥ pralaya evaṃ te kīrttitaḥ sūkṣmayā dṛśā || sa jñeyo'tha mune vacmi layaṃ naimittikābhidham|| 18 || nimittīkṛtya rajanīṃ bhavedviśvasṛjastu yaḥ || naimittikaḥ sa kathito layo dainaṃdinaśca saḥ || 19 || caturyugānāṃ sāhasraṃ dinaṃ viśvasṛjo mune || niśā ca tāvatī tasya taddvayaṃ kalpa ucyate || 2.9.25.20 || ekaikasmindine tasya caturdaśa caturdaśa || bhavanti manavo brahmandharmasetvabhirakṣakāḥ || 21 || ādyaḥ svāyambhuvastatra manuḥ svārociṣastataḥ || uttamastāmasaścā'tha raivataścākṣuṣastataḥ || 22 || śrāddhadevaśca sāvarṇi bhautyo raucyastataḥ param || brahmasāvarṇināmā ca rudrasāvarṇireva ca || 23 || merusāvarṇisaṃjño'tha dakṣasāvarṇirantimaḥ || caturdaśaite manavaḥ proktā brahmaikavāsare || 24 || ekaikasya manoḥ kālo yugānāṃ caikasaptatiḥ || divyairdvādaśasāhasrairyugakālaśca vatsaraiḥ || 25 || caturdaśasyaiva manorantarentamupeyuṣi || sāyaṃsaṃdhyā viśvasṛjo jāyate munisattama || 26 || dināvasāne vairājaḥ śaktīrākarṣati sthiteḥ || vairājātmā tadā rudrastrilokīṃ hartumīhate || 27 || ādau bhavatyanāvṛṣṭiratyugrā śatavārṣikī || tadālpasārasattvāni kṣīyante sarvaśo bhuvi ||28|| sāṃvarttakasya cārkasya raśmayo'tyulbaṇā rasam || āpātālātpibantyāśu dharaṇyāṃ sarvameva hi || 29 || sārasaṃ caiva nādeyaṃ sāmudraṃ cāmbu sarvaśaḥ || śoṣayitvā'khilām̐llokānso'rko nayati saṃkṣayam || 2.9.25.30 || tato bhavati niḥsnehā naṣṭasthāvarajaṅgamā || kūrmapṛṣṭhopamā bhūmiḥ śuṣkā saṃkucitā bhṛśam || 31 || kālāgnirudraḥ śeṣasya mukhādutpadyate tataḥ || adholokānsaptabhūmiṃ bhuvaḥ svaśca dahatyasau || 32 || nirdagdhalokadaśako jvālāvarttabhayaṃkaraḥ || udvāsitamaharlokaḥ kālāgniḥ parivarttate || 33 || gatādhikārāstridaśā bhuvaḥsvarganivāsinaḥ || maharlokājjanaṃ yānti vahnijvālābhṛśārditāḥ || 34 || nivṛttidharmā ṛṣayaḥ prāptāḥ siddhadaśāṃ tu ye || bhūtalāttepi tarhyeva ṛṣilokaṃ prayānti ca || 35 || uttiṣṭhanti tato ghorā vyomni sāṃvarttakā ghanāḥ || mahāgajakulaprakhyāstaḍitvanto'tinādinaḥ || 36 || dhūmravarṇāḥ pītavarṇā kecitkumudasannibhāḥ || lākṣārasanibhāḥ keciccāṣapatranibhāstathā || 37 || śamayitvā mahāvahniṃ śataṃ varṣāṇyaharnniśam || varṣamāṇāḥ sthūladhārāḥ stanantaste ghanā ghanāḥ || brahmāṇḍasyāntarālaṃ ca pūrayanti dhruvāvadhi || 38|| ekārṇavajale tasminvairājapuruṣaḥ sa tu|| aniruddhātmakaḥ śete nāgendraśayane prabhuḥ ||39|| tadā devāśca ṛṣayo rajaḥsattvatamovaśāḥ || ye te saha viriñcena svakīyaguṇakarṣitāḥ || praviśya tasya jaṭhare śerate dīrghanidrayā || 2.9.25.40 || ye tu brahmātmaikyabhāvā vaśīkṛtaguṇatrayāḥ || nivṛttenaiva dharmeṇa vāsudevamupāsate || 41 || maharādiṣu lokeṣu te caturṣu kṛtālayāḥ || taṃ vairājaṃ saṃstuvanto nivasanti yathāsukham || 42 || nārāyaṇaḥ sa bhagavānsvarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ || cintayanvāsudevākhyaṃ śete vai yoganidrayā || 43 || niśānte brahmaṇā sākaṃ sarve te tasya jāṭharāḥ || utpadyante yathāpūrvaṃ yathākarmādhikāriṇaḥ || 44 || evaṃ naimittiko nāma trilokīkṣayalakṣaṇaḥ || pralayaḥ kathitastubhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ kīrttayāmyatha|| 45|| ya eṣa kalpaḥ kathitastādṛśānāṃ śatatrayam || ṣaṣṭyādhikaṃ ca yaḥ kālo vedhasaḥ sa tu vatsaraḥ || 46 || pañcāśatā taiḥ parārddho brahmāyustaddvayaṃ matam || parākhyakāle saṃpūrṇe mahānbhavati saṃkṣayaḥ || 47 || saṃhārarudrarūpeṇa saṃhṛtya svaṃ virāḍvapuḥ || svaparaṃ nirguṇaṃ rūpaṃ vairājo yātumicchati || 48 || tadā bhavatyanāvṛṣṭiḥ pūrvavacchatavārṣikī || sāṅkarṣaṇaśca kālāgnirdahatyaṇḍamaśeṣataḥ || 49 || sāṃvarttakāstato meghā varṣantyati bhayānakāḥ || śataṃ varṣāṇi dhārābhirmusalākṛtibhirmune || 2.9.25.50 || mahadādervikārasya viśeṣāntasya saṃkṣayaḥ || sarvasyāpi bhavatyeva vāsudevecchayā tataḥ || 51 || āpo grasanti vai pūrvaṃ bhūmergandhātmakaṃ guṇam || āttagandhā tato bhūmiḥ pralayatvāya kalpate || 52 || grasatembuguṇaṃ tejo rasaṃ tallīyate tataḥ || rūpaṃ tejoguṇaṃ vāyurgrasate līyate'tha tat || 53 || vāyorapi guṇaṃ sparśamākāśo grasate tataḥ || praśāmyati tadā vāyuḥ khaṃ tu tiṣṭhatyanāvṛtam || 54 || bhūtādistadguṇaṃ śabdaṃ grasate līyate ca kham || indriyāṇi vilīyante taijasāhaṃkṛtau tataḥ || 55 || ahaṅkāre vilīyante sāttvike devatā manaḥ || yadyadyasmātsamutpannaṃ tattattasminhi līyate || 56 || ahaṃkāro mahattattve trividhopi pralīyate || tatpradhāne ca tatpuṃsi sa mūlaprakṛtau tataḥ || 57 || eṣa prākṛtiko nāma pralayaḥ parigīyate || tirobhavanti jīveśā yatrā'vyakte harīcchayā || 58 || yadā ca māyā puruṣau kālo'tyakṣaratejasi || tadicchayā tiro yānti sa tveko vartate prabhuḥ || tadā sa pralayo jñeyo nāradātyantikābhidhaḥ || 59 || itthaṃ prabhoḥ kālaśaktyā layairetaiścaturvidhaiḥ || asadbaddhvā'khilaṃ tatrā'rucirvairāgyamucyate || 2.9.25.60 || vāsudevetarāndevānkālamāyāvaśīkṛtān || viditvā teṣu ca prītiṃ hitvā tasyaiva nityadā || gāḍhasnehena yā sevā sā bhaktiriti gīyate||61|| śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ tasya smṛtiścaraṇasevanam || pūjā praṇāmo dāsyaṃ ca sakhyaṃ cātmanivedanam ||62|| ityetairnnavabhirbhāvairyaḥ seveta tamādarāt|| ananyayā dhiṣaṇayā sa hi bhakta itīryate ||63|| tribhiḥ svadharmapramukhairyuktābhaktiriyaṃ mune|| dharma ekāntika iti prokto bhāgavataśca saḥ||64|| sākṣādbhagavataḥ saṅgāttadbhaktānāṃ ca vedṛśām || dharmo hyekāntikaḥ pumbhiḥ prāpyate nānyathā kvacit || 65 || naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ kiñcitsādhanaṃ hi mumukṣatām || niḥśreyasakaraṃ puṃsāṃ sarvābhadravināśanam || 66 || ekāntadharmasiddhyarthaṃ kriyāyogaparo bhavet || pumānsyādyena naiṣkarmyaṃ karmaṇāṃ munisattama || 67 || etanmayā vedapurāṇaguhyaṃ tattvaṃ paraṃ proktamaghaughanāśam || ekāgrayā śuddhadhiyāvadhārya sacchraddhayā cetasi te maharṣe || 68 || na vāsudevātparamasti pāvanaṃ na vāsudevātparamasti maṅgalam || na vāsudevātparamasti daivataṃ na vāsudevātparamasti vāñchitam || 69 || yannāmadheyaṃ sakṛdapyabuddhyā dehāvasānepi gṛṇāti yo'tra || sa puṣkasopyāśu bhavapravāhādvimucyate taṃ bhaja vāsudevam ||2.9.25.70 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye vairāgyabhaktinirūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<2.9.26>
|| skanda uvāca || ekāntadharmavivṛtiṃ śrutvā bhagavatoditām || prahṛṣṭamānaso bhūyastaṃ papraccha sa nāradaḥ || 1 || nārada uvāca || dharma ekāntikaḥ svāmiṃstvayā samyagudīritaḥ || tamāśrutya mahānharṣo jātosti mama mānase || 2 || siddhaye tasya bhavatā kriyāyogo ya ucyate || tamahaṃ boddhumicchāmi bhagavaṃstava saṃmatam || 3 || || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || pūjāvidhiḥ kriyāyogo vāsudevasya kīrttyate || sa tu vedeṣu tantreṣu bahudhaivāsti varṇitaḥ || 4 || bhaktānāṃ rucivaicitryāttathā bahuvidhatvataḥ || vāsudevasya mūrtīnāṃ bahudhā so'sti vistṛtaḥ || 5 || sākalyenocyamānasya pāro nāyāti tasya vai || ataḥ saṃkṣepatastubhyaṃ vacmi bhaktivivarddhanam || 6 || prāptā ye vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ varṇāścatvāra āśramāḥ || cāturvarṇyastriyaścaite proktā atrādhikāriṇaḥ || 7 || vedatantrapurāṇoktairmantrairmūlena ca dvijāḥ || pūjeyurdīkṣitā yoṣāḥ sacchūdrā mūlamantrataḥ || mūlamantrastu vijñeyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ||8|| svasvadharmaṃ pālayadbhiḥ sarveretairyathāvidhi || pūjanīyo vāsudevo bhaktyā niṣkapaṭāntaraiḥ || 9 || ādau tu vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ gṛhṇīyātsadvaroḥ pumān || sadaikāntikadharmasthādbrahmajāterdayānidheḥ || 2.9.26.10 || saṃpanno jñānabhaktibhyāṃ svadharmarahitastu yaḥ || sa gurunnaiva kartavyaḥ strīhṛtātmā ca karhicit || 11 || prāptā straiṇādgurordīkṣā jñānaṃ bhaktiṃ ca karhicit || phalennaiva yathā'patyaṃ yuvatiḥ ṣaṇḍhasaṃginī || 12 || prāpyātaḥ sadgurordīkṣāṃ tulasīmālikāṃ gale || lalāṭādau corddhvapuṇḍraṃ gopīcandanato dharet ||13|| viṣṇupūjārucirbhakto gurorevāgamoditam || pūjāvidhiṃ suvijñāya tataḥ pūjanamārabhet ||14|| rātryantayāma utthāya bhakto brāhmekṣaṇe'tha vā || muhūrtārdhaṃ hṛdi dhyāyetkeśavaṃ kleśanāśanam ||15|| kīrttayitvā'bhidhāstasya tadīyānāṃ ca nāḍikām|| tataḥ śaucavidhiṃ kṛtvā dantadhāvanamācaret ||16|| aṃgaśuddhisnānamādau kṛtvā snāyātsamantrakam|| gṛhītvā śucimṛtsnādīnkuryātsnānāṃgatarpaṇam||17|| paridhāyāṃśuke dhaute upaviśyāsane śucau || kṛtvorddhvapuṇḍraṃ kurvīta saṃdhyāṃ homaṃ japādi ca || 18 || vastracandanapuṣpādīnupahārāṃstato'khilān || āharenmāṃsamadirādyaśucisparśa varjitān||19|| devebhyo vā pitṛbhyaścāpyanyebhyo na niveditān || anāghrātāṃśca manujaiḥ keśakīṭādivarjitān||2.9.26.20|| saṃsthāpya tāndakṣapārśve pūjopakaraṇāni ca || udvartya dīpamājyena kuryāttailena vā tataḥ ||21 || kauśe vaurṇe ca vastrādau vikāṣṭhe śuddha āsane || upāviśedvāsudevapratimāsannidhau tataḥ || 22 || śailī dhātumayī dārvī lekhyā maṇimayī ca vā || pratimā syātsitā raktā pītā kṛṣṇā'tha vā mune || 23 || kṛṣṇasya sā tu kartavyā dvibhujā vā caturbhujā || muralīṃ dhārayettatra dvibhujāyāḥ karadvaye || 24 || atha vā dakṣahaste'syāścakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ tathetare || padmaṃ vā dhārayeddakṣe pāṇāvabhayamuttare || 25 || dvitīyāyāstu hasteṣu dakṣiṇādhaḥkarakramāt || gadābjadaracakrāṇi dhārayenmunisattama || 26 || dvividhāyā api harermūrtervāme śriyaṃ nyaset || muralīdharavāme tu rādhāṃ rāseśvarīṃ nyaset || 27 || apyeṣā dvividhā mūrttirakhaṇḍā śubhalakṣaṇā || sarvāvayavasaṃpannā bhavedarccakasiddhidā || 28 || lakṣmīstu dvibhujā kāryā vāsudevasya sannidhau || dadhatī paṃkajaṃ haste vastrālaṃkāraśobhanā || 29 || lakṣmīvadrādhikāpi syāddvibhujā cāruhāsinī || paṅkajaṃ puṣpamālāṃ vā dadhatī pāṇipaṅkaje || 2.9.26.30 || acalā ca calā ceti dvividhā pratimā hareḥ || tatrādyāyāṃ na kartavyamāvāhanavisarjanam||31|| tadaṅgadevatānāṃ ca kāryaṃ nāvāhanādyapi || na ca diṅniyamo'rcāyāṃ tasyāḥ stheyaṃ tu sammukhe ||32|| śālagrāmepyevameva kāryaṃ nāvāhanādi ca || anyatra calamūlau tu kartavyaṃ tattadarcakaiḥ || 33 || tatrāpi dārvyā lekhyāyāṃ jalasparśonulepanam || naiva kāryaṃ pūjakena kartavyaṃ parimārjanam || 34 || udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā calāyāṃ sammukho'tha vā || yathāśakti yathālabdhairupahārairyajeddharim || || 35 || śraddhāniśchadmabhaktibhyāmarpitenāmbunāpi saḥ || prītastuṣyati viśvātmā kimutā'khilapūjayā || 36 || puṃsā śraddhādihīnena ratnahemādyalaṃkriyāḥ || caturvidhaṃ cāpyannādyaṃ dattaṃ gṛhṇāti no mudā || 37 || tasmādbhaktimatā kāryaṃ puṃsā svaśreyase mune || śrīkṛṣṇasyārccanaṃ nityaṃ sarvābhīṣṭāśudāyinaḥ || 38 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye kriyāyogādhikārādinirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
<2.9.27>
|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || khananokṣaṇalepādyaiḥ śodhite dharaṇītale || catuṣpādaṃ nyasetpīṭhaṃ nānāraṅgasuśobhite || 1 || arcakaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ pīṭhapādānkoṇeṣu kārayet || caturṣu teṣu dharmādīnsthāpayetsiṃharūpiṇaḥ || 2|| agnau dharmaṃ nyasecchvetaṃ jñānaṃ śoṇaṃ ca nairṛte || vāyau tu pītaṃ vairāgyaṃ śyāmamaiśvaryamaiśake ||3|| manodhīcittāhaṅkārānkramātpūrvādidikṣva'tha || vinyasetpīṭhagātreṣu haridraktasitāsitān || 4 || sthāpyā raktasitaśyāmā rajaḥsattvatamoguṇāḥ || pīṭhasya paṭṭikāyāṃ tu trayopi munisattama|| || 5 || antaḥkaraṇarūpeṣu gātreṣvatha caturṣvapi || vimalādyā nyasecchaktīrdvedve ekaikagātrake || 6 || vimalotkarṣiṇīti dve gaurāṅgyau pūrvato nyaset || vādayantyau śubhāṃ vīṇāṃ haridvastre svalaṃkṛte || 7 || jñānākriye nyasedyāmye pītavastre'ruṇadyutī || ekā tālaṃ vādayantī mṛdaṅgamaparā tathā || 8 || yogāpraddhyau nyasetpaścācchyāme aruṇavāsasau || saheva muralī cobhe vādayantyau pṛthakpṛthak || 9 || satyeśāne hemavarṇe uttarasyāṃ tato nyaset || śyāmāṃśuke vādayantyāvubhe te parivādinīm || 2.9.27.10 || anugrahākhyā paṭṭikāyāṃ sthāpyaikā ca kṛtāñjaliḥ || sarvā etāstu kartavyā dvibhujāḥ suvibhūṣaṇāḥ || 11 || pīṭhopari sitadvīpaṃ kurvīta śvetavāsasā || tanmadhye'ṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ kurvītojvalakarṇikam || 12 || dvādaśāṃśaṃ parityajya padmakṣetrasya bāhyataḥ || vṛttaistribhistasya madhyaṃ vibhajetsamabhāgataḥ || 13 || tatrādyaṃ karṇikāsthānaṃ kesarāṇāṃ tu madhyamam || patrāṇāṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ syāddalāgrāṇi tu bāhyataḥ || 14 || paritastasya ca puraṃ caturdvāraṃ prakalpayet || raṅgadravyairbahuvidhairharidrākuṃkumādibhiḥ || 15 || kurvīta taṇḍulairvāpi tatra padmādi śobhanam || padmasya karṇikāṃ madhye hemavarṇā suśobhayet || 16 || śoṇavarṇāni patrāṇi paritastasya cārcakaḥ || kuryādaṣṭāpyaṣṭadikṣu svarṇavarṇāni vā mune ||17|| pūrvaṃ tu gopuraṃ śoṇaṃ śyāmaṃ kuryācca dakṣiṇam || pītavarṇaṃ paścimaṃ ca sphaṭikābhaṃ tathottaram ||18|| antarāle ca puṣpāṇi citrāṇi purapadmayoḥ|| kṛtvā madhye'tha śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tadvāme rādhikāṃ nyaset||19|| rādhākṛṣṇasyāsya tataḥ pṛṣṭhe saṃkarṣaṇaṃ nyaset|| caturbāhuṃ dhṛtacchatraṃ gaurāṅgaṃ nīlavāsasam || 2.9.27.20 || dakṣe nyasedbhagavataḥ pradyumnaṃ pītavāsasam || caturbhujaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ dhṛtvā cāmaramāsthitam || 21 || vāme'niruddhaṃ ca harernyasedaruṇavāsasam || indranīlamaṇiśyāmaṃ saṃsthitaṃ dhṛtacāmaram || 22 || trayopyete tu kartavyā nānālaṃkāraśobhitāḥ || anarghyaratnamukuṭāstāruṇyena manoharāḥ || 23 || tato'vatārāṃstu hareḥ kesareṣvaṣṭasu kramāt || ekaikasminnyased dvaudvāvaṣṭasvevaṃ hi ṣoḍaśa || 24 || sthāpayedvāmanaṃ buddhaṃ pūrvasminkesare'grataḥ || ghanaśyāmāvubhau hyetau karuṇau brahmacāriṇau || 25 || sitāṃśukau kare dakṣe bibhratau phullapaṅkajam || abhayaṃ vāmahaste ca śāntau yajñopavītinau || 26 || kalkinaṃ parśurāmaṃ ca vahnikoṇe'tha vinyaset || khaṅgapāṇistatra kalkī parśupāṇistathā'paraḥ || 27 || ubhau gaurau ca tāmrākṣau jaṭilau sitavāsasau || yajñopavītinau kāryau tyaktakrodhamahārayau || 28 || hayagrīvavarāhau ca sthāpayedyāmyakesare || hayagrīvo hayāsyaḥ syānnarāṃgaśca caturbhujaḥ || 29 || śaṅkhādibhṛtsvarṇavarṇo dhṛtadivyasitāmbaraḥ || varāhastu varāhāsyo narāṃgaḥ syāccaturbhujaḥ || 2.9.27.30 || śaṅkhacakragadābjāni dadhatpītāmbaraṃ tathā || madhupiṃgalavarṇaśca karttavyo dvibhujo'tha vā || 31 || matsyakūrmmau nairṛte ca sthāpayetkesare tataḥ || kaṭeradhastadākārāvūrddhvaṃ tau tu narākṛtī || 32 || vāme śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ dakṣe pāṇau ca dadhatāvubhau || śyāmasundaradehau ca karttavyau dhṛtabhūṣaṇau || 33 || dhanvantariṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ ca paścime kesare nyaset || dhanvantariḥ śuklavāsā gaurāṃgo'mṛtakumbhadhṛt || 34 || siṃhavaktro nṛsiṃhastu nṛdehaḥ kesarānvitaḥ || nīlotpalābho dvibhujo gadācakradharo bhaveta || 35 || vāyau nyasedubhau haṃsadattātreyau jaṭādharau || yogiveṣau sitau daṇḍakamaṇḍalukarau tathā || 36 || uttare kesare vyāsaṃ nyasedgaṇapatiṃ tataḥ || tatra vyāso viśālākṣaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ sitāmbaraḥ || 37 || dvibhujo dhṛtavedaśca supiśaṃgajaṭādharaḥ || sitayajñopavītaśca karttavyaḥ sapavitrakaḥ || 38 || gajāsya ekadantaśca rakto gaṇapatirbhavet || raktāmbaradharaścaiva nāgayajñopavītavān || 39 || tundilaśca caturbāhuḥ pāśāṅkuśavarāndadhat || kareṇaikena ca dadhadramyāṃ pustakalekhinīm || 2.9.27.40 || nyasetkesara īśāne kapilaṃ pūjakastataḥ || sanatkumāraṃ ca muniṃ naiṣṭhikabrahmacāriṇam || 41 || śuklāṃgaḥ kapilaḥ kāryo dhṛtacārusitāmbaraḥ || dadhatkarābhyāmambhojamabhayaṃ śāntavigraham || 42 || pañcavārṣikabālābho digvastro'lpajaṭādharaḥ || sanatkumāraśca muniḥ karttavyaḥ pūjakena tu || 43 || saṃsthāpya kesareṣvitthaṃ devatāḥ paṅkajasya tu || nyasecca dalamadhyeṣu pārṣadānarccako'ṣṭasu || 44 || viṣvaksenaṃ ca garuḍaṃ tatrādau pūrvato nyaset || tato dakṣakrameṇaiva prabalaṃ ca balaṃ nyaset || 45 || kumudaṃ kumudākṣaṃ ca sunandaṃ nandameva ca || śrutadevaṃ jayantaṃ ca vinyasedvijayaṃ jayam || 46 || tataḥ pracaṇḍaṃ caṇḍaṃ ca puṣpadantaṃ ca sātvatam || dvaudvāvevaṃ krameṇaiva sthāneṣvaṣṭasu vinyaset || 47 || caturbhujāḥ sarva ete śaṅkhāryabjagadādharāḥ || kāryāḥ kiriṭinaḥ śyāmāḥ pītavastrāḥ subhūṣaṇāḥ || 48 || dalamadhyāntarāleṣu siddhīraṣṭasu vinyaset || nānā maṃgalavādyānāṃ vādane nipuṇāḥ kramāt || 49 || aṇimā laghimā prāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā || īśitā vaśitā caivāṣṭamī kāmāvasāyitā || 2.9.27.50 || etāḥ suvarṇavarṇābhāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || veṇuvīṇādihastāśca karttavyāścitravāsasaḥ || 51 || dalāgreṣvaṣṭasu tato vedāñchāstrāṇi ca nyaset || tatra vedānnyaseddikṣu śāstrāṇi tu vidikṣu saḥ || 52 || pūrve nyasettu ṛgvedamakṣamālādharaṃ sitam || kharvaṃ lambodaraṃ saumyaṃ padmanetraṃ sitāmbaram || 53 || yāmye nyasedyajurvedaṃ madhyamāṃgaṃ kṛśodaram || piṃgākṣaṃ sthūlakaṇṭhaṃ ca pītaṃ cāruṇavāsasam || 54 || akṣasrajaṃ kare vāme dakṣe vajraṃ ca bibhratam || paścime sāmavedaṃ ca prāṃśumādityavarcasam || 55|| dakṣe'kṣamālāṃ vāme ca dhṛtavantaṃ kare daram || svarṇavastraṃ viśālākṣaṃ vinyasedgāyanodyatam || 56 || atharvāṇaṃ nyasetsaumye sitāṃgaṃ nīlavāsasam || vāme'kṣasūtraṃ dakṣe ca khaṭvāṃgaṃ bibhrataṃ kare || vahnyojasaṃ ca tāmrākṣaṃ vayasā sthaviraṃ tathā || 57 || agnikoṇe dharmaśāstraṃ nyasecca kamalāsanam || śvetaṃ ca bibhrataṃ dorbhyāṃ muktāmālāṃ tathātulām|| 58 || dīrghakeśanakhaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ nairṛte tundilaṃ nyaset |3| japamālāṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca karābhyāṃ bibhrataṃ sitam || 59 || nyasedvāyau tato yogaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ kṛśodaram || ūrunyastakaradvandvaṃ svanāsāgrakṛtekṣaṇam || 2.9.27.60|| pañcarātraṃ tatheśāne dhavalaṃ vanamālinam|| nyasetkarābhyāṃ dadhatamakṣamālāṃ ca lāṃgalam || 61 || eṣāṃ caturṇāṃ vāsāṃsi śvetasūkṣmaghanāni ca|| karttavyāni tathākṣīṇi padmapatrāyatāni ca || 62 || agrāṇāmantarāleṣu maharṣīṃśca sayoṣitaḥ || vinyasetpaṭhato vedānpūrvāgneyādyanukramāt || 63 || marīciṃ kalayā yuktamatriṃ cāpyanasūyayā || śraddhayāṃgirasaṃ sākaṃ pulastyaṃ ca havirbhuvā || 64 || gatyā yuktaṃ ca pulahaṃ kriyayā ca saha kratum || khyātyā bhṛgumarundhatyā vaśiṣṭhaṃ saha vinyaset || 65 || dvibhujāḥ sarva evaite jaṭāśmaśrudharāḥ kṛśāḥ || kāryāstapasvino daṇḍāndadhataśca kamaṇḍalūn|| 66 || padmādbahirnyaseccā'ṣṭau diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || dikpālānindrapramukhānsahayānānyathādiśam || 67 || prācyāmairāvatārūḍhaṃ nyasedindraṃ caturbhujam|| vajrāṃkuśāmbujavarāndadhataṃ svarṇasannibham || 68 || kausumbharamyavasanaṃ nānālaṃkāraśobhitam || śoṇāpāṃgaṃ viśālākṣaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 69 || agnikoṇe nyasedagniṃ tāmravarṇaṃ caturbhujam || dadhānaṃ pāṇibhiścaiva śūlaṃ śaktiṃ srucaṃ sruvam || 2.9.27.70 || catuḥśuke haimarathe niṣaṇṇaṃ vāyusārathim || trinetraṃ dhūmravasanaṃ piṅgaśmaśrujaṭekṣaṇam || 71 || yamaṃ nyaseddakṣiṇataḥ śyāmaṃ cāmīkarāmbaram|| caturbhujaṃ daṇḍakhaḍgaparaśuṃ pāśadhāriṇam|| unmattamahiṣārūḍhaṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam|| 72|| ūrddhvakeśaṃ virūpākṣaṃ nairṛtaṃ nairṛte nyaset|| khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ ca dadhataṃ dvibhujaṃ naravāhanam|| 73|| hariśmaśruṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ parivītāsitāmbaram || hāṭakānekabhūṣāḍhyamavaiṣṇavabhayaṃkaram || 74 || tataḥ pratīcyāṃ varuṇamindranīlamaṇiprabham || śvetāmbaraṃ caturbāhuṃ muktāhāra vibhūṣitam || 75 || saptahaṃsarathārūḍhaṃ dorbhyāṃ pāśaṃ ca bibhratam || anyābhyāṃ ratnapātraṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ ca dadhataṃ nyaset || 76 || vāyau vāyuṃ haridvarṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇavāsasam || pṛṣatsthaṃ muktakeśaṃ ca vyāttāsyaṃ dhvajinaṃ nyaset || 77 || saumye nyasetkuberaṃ ca svarṇavarṇaṃ caturbhujam || gadāśaktitriśūlāni ratnapātraṃ ca bibhratam || 78 || nīlāmbaraṃ śmaśrulaṃ ca śibikāyāṃ samāsthitam || piśaṃgavāmanayanaṃ naikabhūṣaṃ ca varmiṇam ||79|| īśāne'tha mūhārudramarddhanārīśvaraṃ nyaset || vāmārddhe pārvatī kāryā dakṣārddhe tatra śaṃkaraḥ || 2.9.27.80 || īśvarārddhe jaṭājūṭaṃ kartavyaṃ candrabhūṣitam || umārddhe tilakaṃ kāryaṃ sīmantamalike tathā || 81 || bhasmanoddhūlitaṃ cārddhamarddhaṃ kuṃkumabhūṣitam || nāgopavītaṃ cāpyarddhamarddhaṃ hāravibhūṣitam || 82 || vāmārddhe ca stanaḥ pīnaḥ karttavyaḥ kaṃcukīvṛtaḥ || kaṭyāṃ ca raśanā haimī pāde kāñcananūpuram || 83 || kausumbhaṃ vasanaṃ caiva karau kaṃkaṇabhūṣitau || triśūlamakṣasūtraṃ ca dadhatau ratnamudrikau || 84 || dakṣārddhe raśanā sārpī kāryā vastraṃ gajājinam || karau ca nāgavalayau darpaṇotpaladhāriṇau || 85 || evaṃvidhaṃ mahādevaṃ nyasedvṛṣabhavāhanam || itthamaṣṭadigīśānāṃ kuryātsthāpanamarcakaḥ || 86 || purādbahistataścāṣṭau sthāpayedarcako grahān|| svasvadikṣu sthitānsvasvānyārūḍhānsyandanāni ca || 87 || prācyāṃ diśi nyasettatra bhāskaraṃ pītavāsasam || sindūravarṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ padmahastaṃ rathe sthitam || 88 || ekaṃ cakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ rathasyāsyātitejasaḥ || saptāśvāśca haridvarṇā vāme santi niyojitāḥ || 89 || agnikoṇe tataḥ sthāpyo bhṛguḥ śvetaḥ sitāmbaraḥ || daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ bibhraddvibāhuḥ saumyadarśanaḥ || 2.9.27.90 || citravarṇāśvadaśake sthito hemamaye rathe || dakṣiṇe ca nyasedbhaumaṃ raktaṃ raktāmbaraṃ tathā || 91 || caturbhujaṃ gadāśaktitriśūlavaradhāriṇam || tasya haimaṃ rathaṃ kuryādaruṇāṣṭahayānvitam || 92 || rāhuśca nairṛte koṇe nīlavāsāścaturbhujaḥ || karālāsyastamorūpaścarmāsiśaktiśūladhṛt || 93 || bhṛṅgavarṇāṣṭaturage sthitaḥ kāryastvayorathe || sauriśca paścime sthāpya indranīlasamadyutiḥ || 94 || dhanvī triśūlī dvibhujo mandākṣaścāsitāmbaraḥ || śabalāṣṭāśvasaṃyukte sthitaḥ kārṣṇāyase rathe || 95 || vāyukoṇe tataścandraṃ sthāpayecca sitāmbaram || śvetavarṇaṃ gadāhastaṃ dvibhujaṃ ca rathe sthitam || 96 || śatāracakratritaye syandane tasya cāmmaye || kundābhāḥ santyubhayato yojitāsturagā daśa ||97|| uttare dvibhujaḥ saumyo varābhayakaroruṇaḥ || haridvāsāṣṭapiṃgāśve kāryo haimarathe sthitaḥ ||98|| īśāne ca guruḥ sthāpyo hemavarṇaḥ sitāmbaraḥ || dvibhujaḥ padmanayano dhṛtadaṇḍakamaṇḍaluḥ || pāṇḍurāṣṭahaye haime niṣaṇṇaḥ syandanottame || 99 || aṃgadevānbhagavataḥ sthāpayeditthamarcakaḥ || karṇikādripurāntāntasthāneṣu kramaśo'khilān || 2.9.27.100 || vāsudevāṃgadevānāṃ nyasenmūrttīstu vaibhavī || pūgaphalānītarastu nyasetpuṣpākṣatādi vā || 101 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye kriyāyoge pūjāmaṇḍalaracanāvidhinirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
<2.9.28>
|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || ācamya prāṇānāyamya tatosau svasthamānasaḥ || namaskṛtyeṣṭadevādīndeśakālau ca kīrtayet || 1 || ekāntadharmasidyarthaṃ vāsudevasya pūjanam || kariṣya iti saṃkalpya kuryānnyāsavidhiṃ tataḥ || 2 || nyāse mantrā dvādaśārṇo gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī tathā|| nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣaraśca jñeyā viṣṇuṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 3 || ete dvijānāṃ vihitāstadanyeṣāṃ tviha trayaḥ || vāsudevāṣṭākṣaraśca haripañcākṣarastathā || ṣaḍarṇaḥ keśavasyeti nyāse home ca saṃmatāḥ || 4 || śrīviṣṇupratimāṃgeṣu svāṃgeṣviva tato'khilān || kuryānyāsāṃśca tairmantraistatorcāṃ vāsasā''mṛjet||5|| kalaśaṃ vāmabhāge sve saṃsthāpyāvāhya tatra ca|| tīrthāni gandhapuṣpādyairupacāraistamarcayet||6|| pūjādravyāṇi cātmānaṃ prokṣayitvā tadambunā|| śaṃkhaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ca saṃpūjya bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret||7|| ābhyantarāgnivāyubhyāṃ dagdhvā pāpātmakaṃ vapuḥ || śuddhasya svātmanastvaikyaṃ bhāvayedbrahmaṇā sthiraḥ||8|| tato'kṣarabrahmarūpo rādhākṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi prabhum || dhyāyedavyagramanasā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaran||9|| adhomukhaṃ nābhipadmaṃ kadalīpuṣpavatsthitam|| vibhāvyāpānapavanaṃ prāṇenaikyamupānayet||2.9.28.10|| padmanāle tamānīya saha tena tadambujam|| ākarṣedūrdhvamatha tannadattīvramupaiti hṛt || praphullati ca tatraitaddhṛdayākāśa ullasat || 11 || tejorāśimaye tatra tatopyadhikatejasā || darśanīyatamaṃ śāntaṃ dhyāyecchrīrādhikāpatim || 12 || upaviṣṭaṃ sthitaṃ vā taṃ divyacinmayavigraham || dhyāyetkiśoravayasaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram || 13 || rūpānurūpasaṃpūrṇadivyāvayavalakṣitam || śaraccandrāvadātāṃgaṃ dīrghacārubhujadvayam || 14 || āraktakomalatalaramyāṃgulipadāmbujam || tuṃgāruṇasnigdhanakhadyutilajjāyitoḍupam || 15 || śiñjatkiṃkiṇimañjīrahaṃsakāṃghriyugaśriyam || suvṛttajaṃghāyugalaṃ samajānūruśobhanam || 16 || sadratnaraśanābaddhapītāmbarakaṭiśriyam || uttuṃgakukṣinābhyantarnimnanābhivalitrayam || 17|| vitatottuṃgahṛdayaṃ śrīvatsāvarttaśobhitam || lalantīgucchagucchārddhadevacchandādibhūṣitam || 18 || nānāsugandhipuṣpasraksvarṇayajñopavītinam || unnidraśoṇapadmābhakarakaṃkaṇabhūṣaṇam || 19 || sūkṣmaparvāṃgulidyotannaikasadratnamudrikam || ninādayantaṃ madhuraṃ veṇuṃ sarvamanoharam || 2.9.28.20 || vipulāṃsaṃ gūḍhajatruṃ mahābāhvaṃgadadyutim || bhramatsugandhalubdhālijhaṃkāritavanasrajam || 21 || kambūpamagalabhrājatsadgraiveyakakaustubham || śobhamānahanuṃ bimbīphalaśoṇādharadyutim || 22 || sitasmitakalārājatpūrṇacandranibhānanam || tilapuṣpasamākāradarśanīyasunāsikam || 23 || samānakarṇavibhrājanmakarākṛtikuṇḍalam || karṇoparilasaccitrapuṣpagucchāvataṃsakam || 24 || samasūkṣmaradajyotsnollasadgaṇḍasthalaśriyam || padmapatrāyatāraktaprāntaramyavilocanam || 25 || pṛthutuṃgalalāṭaṃ ca kāmacāpāyitabhruvam || vakrasūkṣmāsitasnigdhamanoharaśiroruham || 26 || nānāsadratnakhacitakirīṭadhṛtaśekharam || premṇā nijaṃ vīkṣamāṇaṃ prasannaṃ snigdhayā dṛśā || 27 || dhyātvetthaṃ kṛṣṇamatha tadvāme rādhāṃ vicintayet || dvibhujāṃ svarṇagaurāṃgīṃ kausumbhāmalavāsasam || 28 || samakarṇollasadratnabhūṣaṇāṃśukanāsikām || kiśorīṃ mṛgaśāvākṣīṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm || 29 || kṛśamadhyāṃ pṛthuśroṇiṃ ratnakāñcīvibhūṣitām || anekadivyābharaṇāṃ vikacābjānanasmitām || 2.9.28.30 || ratnāṃgulīyakeyūrakaṅkaṇādilasatkarām || śiñjaddhaṃsakamañjīraśobhamānāṃghripaṅkajām || 31 || viśālabhālavilasatsatkāśmīralalāṭikām || bimboṣṭhīṃ sukapolāṃ ca veṇīgrathitamālatīm || 32 || prekṣamāṇāṃ prabhuṃ premṇā dadhānāmambujaṃ kare || dhyātvaivaṃ rādhikāṃ tatra prabhumarcettayā saha || 33 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye kriyāyoge śrīrādhākṛṣṇasvarūpadhyānanirūpaṇaṃ nāmā'ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
<2.9.29>
||śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || upacārairbahuvidhairmānasaistaṃ prapūjya saḥ || āvāhya sthāpayedbhakto mūrtau sthāpanamudrayā || 1 || tatastadaṃgadevāṃśca tattanmantraiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || āvāhya nāmamantrairvā supratiṣṭhāpayecca saḥ || 2 || ghaṇṭādi vādayedvādyaṃ kuryādvā tālikādhvanim || suptotthitamivā'thainaṃ kārayeddantadhāvanam|| 3 || śyāmākaviṣṇukāntābhyāṃ dūrvābjābhyāṃ sahodakam || pādyametatprabhordadyāttatorghyācamanīyake || 4 || candanākṣatapuṣpāṇi darbhāgratilasarṣapān || yavāndūrvā cārghyapātre nikṣipedambunā bhṛte || 5 || jātīphalalavaṃgailākaṅkolośīravāsitam || dadyādācamanīyāmbu tataḥ saṃsnapayeddharim || 6 || sugandhipuṣpatailena kuryādabhyaṃgamāditaḥ || surabhidravyakalkena kuryāccodvartanaṃ tataḥ || 7 || kṣīreṇa dadhnā cājyena madhunā sitayā tathā || snapayeddharimavyagrastattanmantraiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 8 || sugandhinā ca śuddhena snānamuṣṇena cāmbunā || taṃ kārayitvā gandhādyaiḥ snānapīṭhe'rcayellaghu || 9 || nirmālyapuṣpādi tato visṛjyottarato dvijaḥ || rājanādyaiḥ sāmabhirvā mahāpuruṣavidyayā || śrīsūktaviṣṇusūktaktābhyāmabhiṣekaṃ samācaret || 2.9.29.10 || nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa hareraṣṭottaraśatena vā || abhiṣekaṃ tu kurvīranstriyaḥ śūdrāśca dīkṣitāḥ || 11 || tataḥ pramārjya vastreṇa tamanarghyāṃśukāni ca || paridhāpayedatipremṇā rādhāṃ cānyāṃśca śaktitaḥ || 12 || upavītaṃ bhagavate dadyātsūkṣmaṃ sitaṃ śubham|| ratnahemādyalaṃkārānsāṃgāyāsmai ca dhārayet || 13 || yathāṛtu yathāsthānaṃ candanena yathocitam|| tilakānulepanaṃ kuryātsakeśaraghanādinā || 14 || yathocitamalaṃkārāndhārayitvā ca rādhikām || patralekhāṃ ca tilakaṃ vidadhyātkuṅkumākṣataiḥ || 15 || ādarśaṃ darśayitvā'tha puṣpasrakchekharādibhiḥ || pūjayettaṃ sahasreṇa tulasīmañjarīdalaiḥ || 16 || tulasyā vā'tha puṣpeṇa pratyekaṃ nāma vaiṣṇavam || namaḥ prāntacaturthyantaṃ kīrttayannarcayetprabhum || 17 || sugandhidravyacūrṇāni tataḥ saubhāgyavanti ca || samarpya dhūpaṃ kurvīta daśāṃgaṃ vāmṛtādikam || 18 || dīpaṃ ghṛtena kurvīta varttikādvayadīpitam || kṛtaṃ svaśaktitaḥ śuddhaṃ mahānaivedyamarpayet || 19 || saṃyāvapāyasāpūpaśaṣkulīkhaṇḍalaḍḍakān|| pūrikāḥ polikā maudgamodanaṃ vyañjanāni ca || dadhidugdhaghṛtādīni catuṣpadyāṃ nidhārayet || 2.9.29.20 || bhojayettaṃ tataḥ premṇā madhye pānīyamarpayan || muhūrttārddhe gate dadyāddhastaprakṣālanāṃbu ca || 21 || uccheṣaṇaṃ bhagavato viṣvaksenādidevatāḥ || upakalpyānyataḥ sthāpya svārthaṃ tadbhuvamāmṛjet || 22 || mukhavāsaṃ tato dadyātkṛtāṃ tāmbūlavīṭikām || pūgacūrṇalavaṅgailājātījādisamanvitām || 23 || phalaṃ ca nālikerādi dattvā śaktyā ca dakṣiṇām || mahānīrājanaṃ kuryādgītavāditrapūrvakam|| 24 || stuyātpuṣpāñjalīndattvā tatstotreṇaiva taṃ tataḥ || nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kuryādgāyannṛtyaṃśca tatpuraḥ || 25 || muhūrttaṃ sa vidhāyetthaṃ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇām || praṇāmaṃ daṇḍavatkuryāttiryaktaddakṣiṇe bhuvi || 26 || aṣṭāṃgaṃ vāpi pañcāgaṃ praṇāmaṃ puruṣaścaret || pañcāṃgameva nārī tu nānyathā munisattama || 27 || padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāmurasā śirasā dṛśā || vacasā manasā ceti praṇāmo'ṣṭāṃga īritaḥ || 28 || bāhubhyāṃ caiva manasā śirasā vacasā dṛśā || pañcāṃgoyaṃ praṇāmaḥ syātpūjāsu pravarāvimau || 29 || bhītaṃ māṃ saṃsṛteḥ pāhi prapannaṃ tvāṃ prabho iti || tataḥ saṃprārtha svādhyāyaṃ śaktyā kurvīta naityakam || 2.9.29.30 || dhyātvā śeṣāṃ ca taddattāṃ gṛhītvā śirasādarāt || āvāhitaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ rādhākṛṣṇaṃ hṛdambuje|| saṃsthāpayeccāṃgadevānsvasvasthānaṃ visarjayet || 31 || karaṇḍake vā śayyāyāṃ mandire pratimāṃ hareḥ || śāyayitvā pidhāya dvārvaiśvadevaṃ samācaret || 32 || prāsādikaṃ harerannaṃ svapoṣyebhyo vibhajya saḥ || svayaṃ bhuktvā tatkathādyairdinaśeṣamatikramet || 33 || mahāpūjāvidhānena proktenānena yonvaham || bhaktyā samarcayedviṣṇuṃ sa bhavettasya pārṣadaḥ || 34 || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya bhāsvaraṃ devatepsitam || golokākhyaṃ harerddhāma divyāṅgo yāti pūjakaḥ || 35 || phalābhisaṃdhinā vāpi yastamarceddinedine || sopi dharmaṃ kāmamarthaṃ mokṣaṃ cāpnotyabhīpsitam || 36 || itthaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ karttumaśakto rādhayā saha || harimekaṃ yathā labdhairarcedbhaktyopacārakaiḥ || 37 || dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa dvijo'nyo nāmamantrataḥ || śrīrādhākṛṣṇamabhyarcedbhaktirevā'tra siddhidā || 38 || ekādaśyāṃ harerjanmotsavādau tu viśeṣataḥ || mahāpūjaiva karttavyā svaśaktyā'khilavaiṣṇavaiḥ || 39 || pratiṣṭhāmātramapi yaḥ kuryādanyakṛtālaye || sa sārvabhauma rājyaṃ vai prāpnuyānnaṣṭakilviṣaḥ || 2.9.29.40 || kārayenmandiraṃ ramyaṃ dhanāḍhyaśca harerdṛḍham || yaḥ sa tu prāpnuyādrājyaṃ trailokyasyāpyakaṇṭakam|| 41 || vṛttidānena pūjāyāḥ pravāhaṃ varddhayettu yaḥ || sa pumānprāpnuyānnūnaṃ viṣṇuloke mahatsukham || 42 || pratiṣṭhāṃ mandiraṃ pūjāṃ kāraye ttrīṇyapīha yaḥ || samānaiśvaryamāpnoti vāsudevasya sa dhuvam || 43 || harervṛrttiṃ haredyastu kṛtāṃ svena pareṇa vā || kalpamekaṃ sa vai bhuṃkte narake yamayātanāḥ || 44 || karttā kārayitā yaśca sahāyaścānumodakaḥ || caturṇāṃ hi phale bhāgaḥ sukṛtasyetarasya ca ||45|| iti kriyāyogavidhirmayā nārada kīrttitaḥ || yenaikāntikadharmo'tra siddhyettatpravaṇātmanām || 46 || viṣayāṃścintayaṃścitte bahiḥ pūjāṃ hareścaran || saṃbhāreṇāpi mahatā na yathoktaṃ phalaṃ labhet|| || 47 || itastato grāmyasukhe bhramatsvīyaṃ manastataḥ || niyamya viṣṇupūjāyāṃ mumukṣuḥ prayato bhavet || 48 || mahāvratā bhūritapasvinopi svadhītavedā api buddhimantaḥ || sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ pariśīlayantaḥ siddhiṃ na yāntyeva vinārcanaṃ hareḥ || 49 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye kriyāyoge śrīvāsudevapūjāvidhinirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||29||
<2.9.30>
|| skanda uvāca || vāsudevārcanavidhiṃ niśamyetthaṃ sa nāradaḥ || prasannaḥ punaraprākṣīttaṃ munīnāṃ paraṃ gurum || 1 || nārada uvāca || samyagukto bhagavatā kriyāyogo mahāphalaḥ || ekena manasā yo'sau kāryaḥ siddhimabhīpsubhiḥ || 2 || manaso nigrahastatra jñānināmapi sadguro || duṣkaraḥ kiṃ punastarhi nṛṇāṃ karmātmanāṃ bhuvi || 3 || tamṛte tu harerarcā nābhīṣṭaphaladāyinī || atastannigrahopāyamapi me vaktumarhasi || 4 || skanda uvāca || ityāpṛṣṭaḥ sa muninā munīndraḥ sarvadarśanaḥ || nārāyaṇo narasakho nāradaṃ tamabhāṣata || 5 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || satyameva mune vakṣi manasosti balaṃ mahat || jitepi yasminviśvāsaḥ śatruvanna vivekinām || 6 || manasā sadṛśonyastu śatrurnnāstyeva dehinām || viṣṇudhyānābhyāsayogānnirdoṣaṃ taddhi śāmyati || 7 || adāntāśvavadevaitadyatosti duravagraham || ato vairāgyayukpumbhiḥ sadupāyairnigṛhyate || 8 || upāyāstatra bahavaḥ santi teṣvapi sanmate || aṣṭāṃgayogasyābhyāsaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sadyaḥ phalapradaḥ || 9 ||
