yamāśca niyamā brahmannāsanānyasusaṃyamaḥ || pratyāhāro dhāraṇā ca dhyānamaṃgaṃ tu saptamam || samādhiścāṣṭamaṃ proktaṃ yogasyānukrameṇa vai || 2.9.30.10 || tatrā'hiṃsābrahmacarya satyāsteyāparigrahāḥ || ete pañca yamāḥ proktāḥ sādhanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ||11 || śaucaṃ tapaśca saṃtoṣaḥ svādhyāyo viṣṇupūjanam || ete ca niyamāḥ pañca dvitīyāṃgatayā matāḥ || 12 || parihāyāṃgacāñcalyaṃ yathāsukhatayā sthitiḥ || tadāsanaṃ svastikādiproktaṃ dvandvārttijinmune || 13 || caratāṃ sarvato'sūnāmekadeśe tu dhāraṇam || gurūpadiṣṭarītyaiva prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate || 14 || cale vāyau calaṃ cittaṃ sthire tasminsthiraṃ tataḥ || sudeśe'yaṃ sadā'bhyasyaḥ pūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ || 15 || manasendriyavṛttīnāṃ tattadviṣayataśca yat || ākarṣaṇaṃ pratīcīnaṃ pratyāhāraḥ sa īritaḥ || 16 || nābhyādyanyatame sthāne prāṇena saha cetasaḥ || vāsudevasvarūpe yaddhāraṇaṃ dhāraṇoditā || 17 || ekaikāvayavasyaiva cintanaṃ yatpṛthakpṛthak || padābjāderbhagavatastaddhyānamiti kīrtitam || 18 || nirodhaḥ prāṇamanasoratipremṇā harau tu yaḥ || sa samādhiriti prokto yogināmabhivāñchitaḥ || 19 || aṃgairaṣṭabhiretairhi śikṣitaiḥ siddhasadguroḥ || yogaḥ siddhyati vai puṃsāṃ samādheḥ pakvatātmakaḥ || 2.9.30.20 || naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ samyaṅ manonigrahasādhanam|| puruṣāṇāṃ mumukṣūṇāmiti jānīhi nārada || 21 || tapasvināṃ mahāśatrorbrahmāṇḍakṣobhakādapi || madanānnābhayaṃ kiñcidyoginastvasti karhicit || 22 || āyāsyantaṃ vihitvaiva sontakālaṃ ca yogavit || svātantryeṇaiva dehaṃ svaṃ tyajatītthaṃ samādhinā || 23 || pārṣṇibhyāṃ gudamāpīḍya vāyuṃ pādadvayasthitam || śanaiḥśanaiḥ samākṛṣya mṛtyusthānaṃ nayatyamum || 24 || manasā keśavaṃ dhyāyaṃstanmanuṃ ca ṣaḍakṣaram || japastato'muṃ nayati vāyuṃ sthānaṃ prajāpateḥ || 25 || tato nābhiṃ ca hadayamuraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ ca yogavit || nayati bhrukuṭivāyuṃ vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ || 26 || eteṣu ṣaṭsu sthāneṣu tvekaikasminpṛthakpṛthak || yogī prāṇamanokṣāṇāṃ nirodhaṃ ca visarjanam || tāvadabhyasati svasya yāvatsyāttatsvatantratā || 27 || jitaṃjitaṃ vihāyaiva sthānaṃ yāti paraṃ param || prāptasya sthānakaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ tadabhyāse śramo na hi || 28 || saptacchidrāṇi ruddhvā'tha prāṇamakṣamanoyutam || prāpayya tālu vrajati brahmarandhraṃ sa yogavit || 29 || māyāmayapadārthānāṃ tato hitvaiva vāsanāḥ || sa vāsudevaikamanāstyajati svakalevaram|| 2.9.30.30 || tato bhagavato dhāma śrīkṛṣṇasya tamaḥparam || upetya sevamānastaṃ nandate divyavigrahaḥ || 31 || iti te kathito brahmanyogaśāstrasya saṃgrahaḥ || jitvā tena manaḥ svīyaṃ tamārādhaya sarvadā || 32 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye'ṣṭāṃgayoganirūpaṇaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
<2.9.31>
|| skanda uvāca || śrutvaitatsakalaṃ dharmyaṃ yathāvadbhagavadvacaḥ || niḥsaṃśayo muniḥ prāha taṃ praṇamya kṛtāñjaliḥ || 1 || nārada uvāca || naṣṭā me saṃśayāḥ sarve prasādādbhagavaṃstava || vāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ mayādhigatamañjasā || 2 || kaṃcitkālamihaivāhaṃ tapaḥ kurvaṃstvayā saha || śṛṇvaṃśca nityaṃ jñānādi kariṣye pakvamātmanaḥ || 3 || skanda uvāca || ityuktvā nāradastatra tena cāpyanumoditaḥ || uvāsa divyavarṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ sa tapaścaran || 4 || śuśrāva cānudivasaṃ yathākālaṃ harermukhāt || dharmajñānādyatha prāpa pakvatāṃ tatra yogirāṭ || 5 || snehaṃ ca paramaṃ prāpa sa śrīkṛṣṇe'khilātmani || guṇagānaparo nityamāsa bhāgavatāgraṇīḥ || 6 || bhaktiniṣṭhāṃ parāṃ prāptamatha taṃ siddhayoginam || uvāca bhagavatprītaḥ śreyaskṛtsarvadehinām || 7 || śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca || siddhosi tvaṃ maharṣe'dya gaccha lokahitaṃ kuru || ekāntadharmaṃ sarvatra pravarttayitumarhasi || 8 || skanda uvāca || ityājñāṃ śirasā tasya sa ādāya jagadguroḥ || gacchaṃstatastamastauṣītpraṇamya prāñjaliḥ sthitaḥ || 9 || nārada uvāca || namonamaste bhagavañjagadguro nārāyaṇā'prākṛta divyamūrte || anantakalyāṇaguṇākarastvaṃ dāse mayi prītataraḥ madā syāḥ || 2.9.31.10 || tvaṃ vāsudevosi jagannivāsaḥ kṣemāya lokasya tapaḥ karoṣi || yogeśvareśopaśamastha ātmārāmādhipastvaṃ parahaṃsasadguruḥ || 11 || vibhurṛṣīṇāmṛṣabho'kṣarātmā jīveśvarāṇāṃ ca niyāmakosi || sākṣī mahāpūruṣa ātmatantraḥ kālo'bhavadyadbhrukuṭermahāṃśca || 12 || sargādilīlā jagatāṃ tvamīśa karoṣi māyāpuruṣātmanaiva || tathāpyakarttā nanu nirguṇosi bhūmā parabrahma parātparaśca|| 13 || satyaḥ svayaṃjyotiratarkyaśaktistvaṃ brahmabhūtātmavicintyamūrttiḥ || bṛhadvratācārya mahāmunīndra kandarpadarpāpaharapratāpa ||14|| tapasvināṃ ye ripavaḥ prasiddhāḥ krodho raso matsaralobhamukhyāḥ || apyāśramaṃ tepi kadāpi veṣṭuṃ nemaṃ kṣamā hyeṣa tava pratāpaḥ || 15 || chandomayo jñānamayo'mṛtādhvā dharmātmako dharmasargābhipoṣṭā|| unmūlitādharmasargo mahātmā tvamavyayaścākṣayo'vyaktabandhuḥ||16|| nirdoṣarūpasya tavā'khilāḥ kriyā bhavanti vai nirguṇā nirguṇasya|| dharmārthakāmepsubhirarcanīyastvamīśvaro nātha mumukṣubhiśca || tvaṃ kālamāyāyamasaṃsṛtibhyo mahābhayātpātumekaḥ samarthaḥ || bhaktāparādhānanavekṣamāṇo mahādayāluḥ kila bhaktavatsalaḥ ||18|| dhṛtāvatārasya hi nāmamātraṃ rūpaṃ ca vā yaḥ smaredantakāle || sopi prabho ghoramahāghasaṃghātsadyo vimukto divamāśu yāti || 19 || taṃ tvāṃ vihāyā'tra tu yo manuṣyo dehe tridhātāvapi dehikeṣu || jāyātmajajñātidhaneṣu sajjate sa māyayā vañcita eva mūḍhaḥ || 2.9.31.20 || tvadbhaktiyogyo naradeha eva yaṃ kāmayante'pi ca nākasaṃsthāḥ || tvadbhaktihīnaṃ hi divopi saukhyamahaṃ tu jāne narakeṇa tulyam || 21 || tapastrilokyāḥ kuruṣe sukhāya tatrāpi te bhāratavāsipuṃsu || anugraho bhūritaro yadatra kṛtāvatāro vicaranvirājase || || 22 || tasyāśrayaṃ ye tava nātra kurvate ta eva śāstreṣu matāḥ kṛtaghnāḥ || atastavaikāśrayameva bāḍhaṃ kurvatyajasraṃ mayi te'stu tuṣṭiḥ||23|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye śrīnaranārāyaṇastutinirūpaṇaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||31||
<2.9.32>
|| skanda uvāca || iti stutvā tamīśānaṃ nāradaḥ sa yayau tataḥ || śamyāprāsābhidhaṃ brahmanvyāsasyāśramamāditaḥ ||1|| sādaraṃ mānitastena pratyutthānāsanādibhiḥ || tasmā ekāntikaṃ dharmmaṃ prāha jijñāsave sa ca ||2|| tato brahmasabhāṃ gatvā brahmaṇaḥ śṛṇvato muniḥ || devānpitṝnmaharṣīṃśca tatrasthāṃstamupādiśat || 3 || tatrasthito bhāskaraśca dharmmametaṃ punarmmune || śuśrāva nāradātsarvaṃ śrutaṃ nārāyaṇātpurā || 4 || sa prāhātmāgrayāyibhyo vālakhilyebhya ādarāt || merau te saṃgatāndevānindrādīṃśca nyaśāmayan || 5 || tebhyo'sito muniḥ śrutvā dharmametaṃ dvijottama || pitṛbhyaḥ kathayāmāsa pitṛlokaṃ gataḥ kvacit || 6 || pitaraste tvaryamādyā ūcire śaṃtanuṃ nṛpam || sa bhīṣmāya svaputrāya kathayāmāsa tattvataḥ || 7 || sopi bhāratayuddhānte dharmmarājāya pṛcchate || śayānaḥ śaraśayyāyāṃ prāha saṃsadi bhūyasi || 8 || tatra śrutvā nāradopi sthitaḥ sadasi sādaram || kailāse śaṃkaraṃ prāha sa ca māṃ munisattama || 9 || mayā te kathitaṃ brahmanpṛcchate dharmmavarttine || pātrāyaitatpradātavyamiti māṃ hi pitābravīt || 2.9.32.10 || yenayena śrutaṃ hyetanmāhātmyaṃ sātvatāṃpateḥ || sa sa tasminparāṃ bhaktiṃ cakāra svavimuktaye || 11 || yudhiṣṭhiropi rājarṣiḥ śrutvā bhīṣmeṇa kīrttitam || māhātmyaṃ devakīsūnormmumude bhrātṛbhiḥ saha || 12 || tamātmano mātuleyaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam || niśamyāścaryyajaladhau nimamajja mahāmatiḥ || 13 || vāsudevādikaṃ vyūha vārāhādīṃśca sarvvaśaḥ || avatārānapi nṛpo mene'syaiva ramāpateḥ || 14 || tataḥ sahānujo rājā divyamānuṣavigrahe || atyantaṃ bhaktimānkṛṣṇe babhūva dvijasattama || 15 || śrutvemāṃ ca kathāṃ sarvve brahmarājasurarṣayaḥ || sabhāyāṃ tatra ye cāsaṃstepyabhūvansavismayāḥ || 16 || kṛṣṇameva paraṃ brahma viditvā te narākṛti || bhaktiṃ prapedire tasminpraṇamantastamādarāt || 17 || itthaṃ tasyāsti māhātmyamatastvamapi sanmate || sarvātmanā vāsudevaṃ tameva bhaja bhaktitaḥ || 18 || śrīvāsudevamāhātmyametatte kathitaṃ mayā || durvāsanopaśamanaṃ bhagavadbhaktivarddhanam || 19 || kathitāni purāṇe'tra mayākhyānāni yāni te || teṣāṃ sāra idaṃ brahmannirmmathyaiva samuddhṛtaḥ || 2.9.32.20 || vedopaniṣadāṃ caitadraso vai sāṃkhyayogayoḥ || pañcarātrasya kṛtsnasya dharmaśāstrasya cānagha || 21 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ cāyuṣyametatparamamaṅgalam || sākṣādbhagavatā gītaṃ sarvābhadravināśanam || 22 || ya etacchṛṇuyātpuṇyaṃ kīrttayedatha yaḥ paṭhet || vāsudeve bhavetteṣāmacalā nirmalā matiḥ || 23 || bhaktā ekāntikāste ca bhaveyustasya mānavāḥ || brahmarūpā vrajantyante brahmadhāma tamaḥparam || 24 || dharmārthī labhate'nena dharmaṃ kāmaṃ ca kāmukaḥ || dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti mokṣārthī mokṣamuttamam || 25 || labheta vidyāṃ vidyārthī mucyedrugṇaśca rogataḥ || etacchravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet ||26|| brāhmaṃ tejo labhedvipraḥ kṣatriyaśca nareśatām|| dhanaṃ vaiśyaḥ sukhaṃ śūdraḥ śravaṇādasya cāpnuyāt||27|| etacchrutvā raṇaṃ gacchanvijayaṃ cāpnuyānnṛpaḥ|| prāpnuyātstrī ca saubhāgyaṃ kanyā ca svepsitaṃ varam ||28|| etasya śrutikīrttibhyaḥ śāstrajātaśiromaṇeḥ || yaṃ yaṃ yaḥ kāmayetkāmaṃ taṃtaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || ||29|| tasmāttvaṃ sarvadā bhaktyā paṭhannetaddvijottama|| kāyavāṇīmanobhistaṃ bhajethā bhaktavatsalam ||2.9.32.30|| sautiruvāca|| etanmahāsenamukhābjaniḥsṛtaṃ sāvarṇirāpīya vacomṛtaṃ saḥ || cakāra bhaktiṃ vasudevanandane narākṛtibrahmaṇi sarvamaṅgale || 31 || yūyaṃ ca sarve nigamāgamajñā brahmaṇyadevaṃ bhajanīyamīśam || bhajadhvamekaṃ tamudārakīrttiṃ śrīvāsudevaṃ nijadharmasaṃsthāḥ || 32 || golokadhāmapataye prakāśacayamūrttaye || namostu vāsudevāya bhaktyānandavivṛddhaye || 33 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe śrīvāsudevamāhātmye granthasaṃpradāyapravṛttinirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe vāsudevamāhātmyaṃ sampūrṇam|| 2.9 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe dvitīyaṃ vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍaṃ sampūrṇam || 2 ||
